goal.en: Follow the Relic Master's instructions to craft a Scroll of Reinforcement on the Anvil of Artifacts and increase the equipment's level.

name.en: Equipment Upgrading Tutorial: Scroll of Reinforcement

startText.en:
When a new Astral level opens, the level of current equipment is increased, and so does the strength of the enemies that you might encounter on your various adventures. To avoid falling behind, you will need to obtain equipment of the current level.

But there is good news, too: if you have equipment of previous levels, its level may be increased to the current one by using a Scroll of Reinforcement.

Create a Scroll of Reinforcement on the anvil and test it by increasing the level of one of your equipment items to the current one. To create the scroll, you will need the ingredients you're already familiar with: Crafting Parts, Enchanted Dust and Amalgam.

If you have no more items of a previous level - it's not an issue: I'm ready to sell you something from my stocks. Just recently, a hero brought me a whole pile of old equipment, and sold it to me wholesale for a song. His name was Gennady, or Gerasim, or something... he was looking calm and short of height, too, but rumors had it that he's a real butcher when it comes to hard action. No wonders I had to scrub the armor clean of blood, slime and Tensess knows what else - but I decided to avoid asking questions.

checkText.en: Ah, youngsters... We have to explain everything to you! Back in the day, we learned it all by trial and error. And we're still alive and kicking, as you can see. All limbs are accounted for. Ah, well, no use talking now...

finishText.en:
Excellent, then. Now you know everything a hero might need to know about creating Insignias.

If you have questions about daily quests, just ask me, I'll explain everything again.

goal.en: Follow the Relic Master's instructions to craft a Hero's Insignia on the Anvil of Artifacts and upgrade the equipment.

startText.en:
Greetings! I'm responsible for teaching worthy heroes the basics of working with equipment. I have to do something besides hammering over the anvil, right?

First off, put on any kind of new equipment. You can obtain it, for instance, by defeating powerful enemies in the Adventures on Astral allods.

Then I'll be telling you about creating a Hero's Insignia, which would be useful for upgrading your equipment.

You will need several components for this: Enchanted Dust, Amalgam, Crafting Parts and a Sign of the Hero's Insignia.

Let's begin with the Enchanted Dust and the ways to get some of it. Shall we start?

goal.en: Meet the Relic Master

name.en: Getting to Know the Relic Master

startText.en:
Who are you without your equipment? The great hero of Sarnaut, the vanquisher of Gods and the defender of common folk? That is not something one can take away, but to continue on the path of great deeds, you will need to develop yourself and become better. The same applies to your items and artifacts.

The Relic Master is the one who can help you with that - and you can go and visit him now so that you might be taught the secrets of maintaining your mighty power.

finishText.en:

startText.en:
A lot of strange things happen in the Anomalous Sector... Just a little while ago they discovered a Demonic Portal: it appears out of nowhere, and releases hordes of Demons! The researchers are terrified. They even offered a reward for hunting them down!

They are also ready to pay anyone who protects their ship from Demon attacks during their research missions in the Anomalous Sector.

There are also rumors about a Ghost Ship, whose captain is an infernal dead man. They say, mountains of gold are hidden in its cargo hold!

So if you decide to visit the Anomalous Sector, go for it! And if you come back with a reward, stop by and share your story!

checkText.en: Can you read? Do you understand what you read? Good. I need a stain remover, not a hole in the ground instead of the tower.

finishText.en:
Hm, it looks fine... Let me check it out.

Wow. A bit too concentrated, to my taste, but generally fine. Well done! Keep going. I've got another task for you.

goal.en: Purchase an alchemy manual from Sarbaz Losash and read it. Purchase a wooden Pestle and use it to prepare common stain remover. Report to Sarbaz Losash.

startText.en:
Excellent! It's encouraging to know that you've picked up a book to learn more about alchemy. Since you're so eager to get started, why don't you learn on the spot by helping me with a job.

I'm extremely busy at the moment and would definitely appreciate any help I could get. You can assist me by cleaning out these filthy Imperial uniforms. I'll need you to create stain removers. The last thing we'd want is for Yasker to notice that the Imperial Army is not keeping up to their grooming standards.

All you have to do is purchase an alchemy manual and a tool from me.

checkText.en: Our soldiers should rely less on the Gift of Tensess, really.

finishText.en:
These are good potions! You know what, you may leave them for yourself. You're a hero, alright! I'm sure you're going to make good use of them. I can brew potions for the soldiers myself.

Welcome to the ranks of alchemists! Now you know everything that an apprentice should know.

goal.en: Purchase a Sickle and Ether from Sarbaz Losash, obtain five Potent Chamomiles and brew 5 Weak Potions of Healing. Report to Sarbaz Losash.

startText.en:
We receive orders from military hospitals pretty often. For instance, here's one from the Holy Land. They're running out of healing potions. Let's see... they are asking for five weak potions of healing. That's the task for you.

You have a good chance to learn an important lesson: best ingredients are gathered by the alchemist. Oh well, that's rather easy, they're everywhere. Of course, you may buy them from an auction, too. You will need Potent Chamomiles for your potions and Ether. Collect five flowers and buy Ether from me.

checkText.en: Read the manual further, otherwise you might brew or cook something really dangerous... like this last time, when one talented student of mine made a mistake and cooked a piece of Astral in his flask, and was swallowed whole by it.

finishText.en: Hm, I wonder... It's not acid or deadly poison... Look at that, a common stain remover! That's huge success, for a start.

goal.en: Purchase an alchemy manual from Sivoyar Zablosky and read it. Purchase a wooden Pestle and use it to prepare common stain remover. Report to Sivoyar Zablosky.

startText.en:
Do you want to learn alchemy?

I'm not sure, I haven't been teaching for ages... Then again, why not! It isn't Astral demon's biology, after all. Pay for your manual, tools and initial ingredients, and we can start our training.

For starters, prepare common stain remover for me. It's a good exercise, and besides, we have a customer! Gibberling captains made the order, they grumbled something about never taking a herd of 200 cows on board again.

checkText.en: All kinds of healing potions are very popular these days.

finishText.en: All done? The color seems to be right. Go on, take a sip... what does it taste like? Rotten cabbages? That means the potion is good. Welcome to the ranks of alchemists.

goal.en: Purchase a Sickle and Ether from Sivoyar Zablosky, obtain five Potent Chamomiles and brew 5 Weak Potions of Healing. Report to Sivoyar Zablosky.

startText.en:
Don't you think that alchemy is only about using free ingredients for your potions? No way. Alchemy is a complex art, in which brewing is merely a final part of the sequence. You will have to learn all about herbs finding, gathering and combining.

You will need a sickle to collect herbs. I've got one, it's ok for an initial training, and it's cheap. Find five Potent Chamomiles here, in Lightwood, and use them to brew Weak Potions of Healing, just to begin to understand what alchemy really is. Be patient as you pick up herbs, it might take a while, but it's totally worth it. Or, if you're pressed in time and have some money, you may simply buy it from an auction.

checkText.en: Any akara can just mix components, eysh! Finding the right proportion - that is the real trick...

finishText.en:
Rready? Let me trry... No, nothing will happen to me. My orrganism is already resistant to poisoning, so this stuff will do me no harm...

Yikes. The concentration is just perfect. That's a good starrt for an apprrentice!

goal.en: Purchase an alchemy manual from Maas-Shakar and read it. Purchase a wooden Pestle and use it to prepare common stain remover. Report to Maas-Shakar.

startText.en:
Aho! You think, you can easily master Alchemy? Well, any profession has its natural born adepts. Put all your tyalla in Alchemy and it will let you master it, eysh!

Take this manual and the wooden pestle and try to prrepare common stain remover. Be prroud of your work, for this stain remover will serve the cause of virtue - the annual cleaning of the Temple!

checkText.en: Don't mix it up! You need chamomiles and not some meadow weed!

finishText.en:
The color looks right... Come on, let me taste it.

Huh! Not bad. I don't even feel the pain in my knees anymore. Congrratulations, alchemist! Your potion is superb, eysh!

goal.en: Purchase a Sickle and Ether from Maas-Shakar, obtain 5 Potent Chamomiles and brew 5 Weak Potions of Healing. Report to Maas-Shakar in the Residence.

startText.en:
Gathering herbs is an imporrtant part of Alchemist's life. Sometimes your quest leads you farther than any experienced hunter has ever been! You crrawl up and down the hills until your fur is grreen on your knees - all for the sake of a couple of prrecious flowers. You need to learn that lesson, eysh!

Take that Sickle and find 5 Potent Chamomiles. Mix them with Ether to prrepare Weak Potions of Healing. You can buy Ether from me.

Come back as soon as you finish.

checkText.en: To learn blacksmithing, you need to read that training manual!

finishText.en: Good decision! Here, take this. You'll need it.

goal.en: Purchase a blacksmithing manual from Hummer the Nimble and read it. Buy an Apprentice's Portable Forge and use it to forge a Rare Utility Rake. Report to Hummer the Nimble.

startText.en:
So what are you going to say? You want to be a blacksmith, right? Dig for ore, heat the forge, swing the hammer, right?

Go on, make up your mind already. It's a decent profession. Just take this manual.

Remember to read it carefully! When I was a rookie, I didn't know all my letters, but it worked out all right! I guess I just had natural talent. Now I'm one of the best blacksmiths in the world.

Don't forget to purchase your tools. Your fists are strong, but not strong enough to forge iron, huh!

checkText.en: So, have you got the boots?

finishText.en: Not as bad as I thought. Quite good ones, I'd say. You can wear them yourself. And here's your gift for the first lesson learned - upgrader for your next tool. You'll make use of it in the future.

goal.en: Purchase a Rusty Pick and 11 doses of Tallow from Hummer the Nimble. Gather five Impure Copper Chunks, melt them into Impure Copper Ingots and forge Copper Boots. Report to Hummer the Nimble.

startText.en:
Who needs utility rake at war? Soldiers need ammunition! And boots. Listen up.

Every blacksmith must be capable of mining ore. Take the pick and go search for copper ore near Nezebgrad. There are lots of them, regardless that the city is near. If someone else turns out to be faster than you, and you find the mine empty, don't be upset. Just wait for a while, and the mine will replenish with ore once again. Of course, you may simply buy ore at an auction.

As soon as you gather Impure Copper Chunks, melt them into Impure Copper Ingots, take some tallow, and there you are, ready to forge the Copper Boots! I'll check their quality later.

checkText.en: To learn blacksmithing, you need to read that training manual!

finishText.en: Did you read it? All of it? Good. Now you can be my apprentice. I'll teach you everything I know!

goal.en: Purchase a blacksmithing manual from Vlad Kononov and read it. Buy an Apprentice's Portable Forge and use it to forge a Rare Utility Rake. Report to Vlad Kononov.

startText.en:
So, you think you want to be a blacksmith, huh? I hope you realize that a master blacksmith is always buried in work! That means that anyone who dares to become a master of the hammer and anvil will never have a shortage of orders!

You'll probably never find the time to ever start a family... Oh, what I am saying? If you want to learn my trade, I'm not going to stop you. All you'll need to do is buy the training manual and tools from me.

checkText.en: Go on, work, work! Do the clink clank!

finishText.en: Not bad! These boots will keep your feet warm and safe in combat. Good job! Well done!

goal.en: Purchase a Rusty Pick and 11 doses of Tallow from Vlad Kononov. Gather five Impure Copper Chunks, melt them into Impure Copper Ingots and forge Copper Boots. Report to Vlad Kononov.

startText.en:
Now that you are familiar with the basics of blacksmithing, it's high time to study mining and learn how to obtain metal ore. What does it take? A pick! You can buy one from me, I've got an old and cheap one. Take the pick and go search for copper ore near Novograd. There are lots of them, regardless that the city is near. If someone else turns out to be faster than you, and you find the mine empty, don't be upset. Just wait for a while, and the mine will replenish with ore once again. Of course, you may simply buy ore at an auction.

Purchase a Rusty Pick and Tallow. Gather five Impure Copper Chunks, melt them into Impure Copper Ingots and forge Copper Boots!

checkText.en: How is going, apprrentice?

finishText.en: Nice worrk! This rake can plow up rrocks, eysh!

goal.en: Purchase a blacksmithing manual from Saad Kagan and read it. Buy an Apprentice's Portable Forge and use it to forge a Rare Utility Rake. Report to Saad Kagan.

startText.en:
Aho! Do you like the smell of hot iron? The ringing of gold? Heat and flames? Then blacksmithing is your vocation, eysh!

Let's begin with the easiest thing. Want to trry your hand? Then listen. The tillage season is coming. Pridens will need a lot of rakes. It doesn't take to be a grreat master to make one! Just make sure it is solid.

Take the manual and the Portable Forge. Go on, forrge the best rake Howlem has ever seen!

checkText.en: Unusual request, huh? Huh! It makes me wonder, too.

finishText.en: Ahem... Well, they don't come off. And the size seems just rright. Well done! I will rremember you. A couple dozens years of prractice - and you will be able to forrge my real-size statue!

goal.en: Purchase a Rusty Pick and 11 doses of Tallow from Saad Kagan. Gather five Impure Copper Chunks, melt them into Impure Copper Ingots and forge Copper Boots. Report to Saad Kagan in the Residence.

startText.en:
The firrst lesson is learned. Now let's prroceed with more advanced crrafts! Now you will have to extrract ore by yourself. It can be found everywhere on Howlem, just take this pick and go find some. Melt 5 chunks into 5 ingots. You will need some tallow for that.

From ingots, you can forge whatever you want! But first make Copper Boots for me! Yes, that's correct. I was astonished, too. Some cranky lady's wolverine won't stop biting her feet. Huh! She should have learned how to handle these beasts first.

checkText.en: Work on, comrade! Deadline is near!

finishText.en: Good job!

goal.en: Purchase a leatherworking manual from Karim Shagrenin and read it. Buy an Apprentice Leatherworker's Tool Belt and use it to sew a Rare Leather Bridle. Report to Karim Shagrenin.

startText.en:
I'm glad you're taking interest in leatherworking.

Frankly, I'm one of the only master leatherworkers and there's more work coming in than I can handle. For your first task it'd be great if you could get started on the bridle our stable master has been requesting. I've been putting it off for quite some time and it's not fair to keep him waiting.

Just come back when you're done with the work and I'll be sure to inspect it for quality when it's complete.

checkText.en: Careful with the needles. When I was young, I used to be an adventurer, like you... then I took a needle to the knee.

finishText.en: Very good boots. They surely won't fall apart in a day or two! Even better than I'd expected. Welcome to the ranks of leatherworkers!

goal.en: Loot two Training Leather Fragments from city Ravens, prepare them using pincers and sew leather boots. Report to Karim Shagrenin.

startText.en:
Remember that the Empire needs only best craftsmen, capable of providing our army with the best armor and equipment! Alas, we don't have much time for teaching you things, because we're overloaded with orders. But I can give you loads of exercise. Go to the Old Square, kill as many Ravens as you can and loot their skins. Use pincers to cut the leather, and then you can sew leather boots!

The leather you need is sold at an auction, as well.

You will also need Rough Thread, which you can buy from me. It's rough, but tough, as we leatherworkers say!

checkText.en: Don't worry, I wouldn't give you anything too complicated to finish!

finishText.en: Wow! I'm impressed. Keep putting in this type of quality with your work and you'll be able to catch up to me in skills in no time at all!

goal.en: Purchase a leatherworking manual from Raw Family and read it. Buy an Apprentice Leatherworker's Tool Belt and use it to sew a Rare Leather Bridle. Report to Raw Family.

startText.en:
We have an urgent order! League Defenders want several leather bridles for their horses! And we're so overloaded... You say, you want to become a leatherworker? Here's your manual, take it and read it.

Can you give us a hand now? Make a Rare Leather Bridle, will you? We will provide you with the ingredients, and give you a reward after you've finished.

So?

checkText.en: Oh this fashion of elves! It's driving us nuts.

finishText.en:
The same elf came by and canceled the previous order. Don't you worry, he fully paid for it. Now he wants velvet boots with dragons of gold and pompoms.

Oh, you say the boots are ready? Let me see. They're wonderful! Now, as long as the customer doesn't want them, you can wear them yourself!

goal.en: Loot two Training Leather Fragments from Gray Wolves, prepare them using pincers and sew leather boots. Report to Raw Family.

startText.en:
So, you're eager to become a leatherworker? Good on you! Let me find you an interesting order... Ah, here's one. An order placed by an elf, for common leather boots, plain and old-fashioned. He said that's the trend.

First of all, you will need leather. It is rather easy to obtain it. Just go to the forest, kill a few Gray Wolves a loot their skins. Then cut it into stripes using Pincers. To sew the boots you will need Rough Thread. That's all!

What's wrong? Have you ever tried to rip a wolf of its skin? No? You can buy the leather you need at an auction, then.

checkText.en: Is the Bridle ready, zoor?

finishText.en: Huh... Alright. Well, it's better than I expected. You will make a good leatherworker if you trry hard enough!

goal.en: Purchase a leatherworking manual from Laan-Rahor and read it. Buy an Apprentice Leatherworker's Tool Belt and use it to sew a Rare Leather Bridle. Report to Laan-Rahor.

startText.en:
A good leatherworker is always in demand. When the winter comes, all Pridens wear clothes that we made for them. And hunters need special clothing throughout the whole year!

We have many fine cubs this year, eysh. Will you help me with the orrders? I will give you the easiest ones. If you can handle them, I will be your trrainer.

Try a crrude Bridle for a start. Anyone who has two hands can make it. Take the manual and the tool belt first.

checkText.en: The boots are ready? If you learn how to sew them, you will learn how to sew anything, eysh!

finishText.en: Ah-hya! Nice boots! You are gifted. Do not neglect your talent!

goal.en: Loot two Training Leather Fragments from Cowardly Jackals, prepare them using pincers and sew leather boots. Report to Laan-Rahor in the Residence.

startText.en:
It's time to entrust you with a more serrious job. We make special boots for hunters to prrotect their feet from thorns when they chase animals. They don't completely cover feet, so the binding system is complicated.

Also, you need to learn how to obtain materrials on your own. Go to the Foothills, hunt several jackals, and excoriate them. Then cut the skins with pincers. Come back to me to buy some rough tread and start sewing.

It's really simple. For those who have been sewing for ages.

checkText.en: Have you seen the elven dress? All lace and frill!

finishText.en:
Wonderful! These came out nicely.
Remember, the elven clothes are not fit for a true Imperial soldier!

goal.en: Purchase a tailoring manual from Yana Beketova and read it. Purchase an Apprentice's Sewing Case and use it to sew a Fine Handkerchief. Report to Yana Beketova.

startText.en:
Have you ever seen the elven-made clothes? Such a shame! They're nothing but cuts and laces, and reveal the body to all possible kinds of damage. Can you imagine that? They won't protect you even against a fly! It's obvious that they shouldn't import this disgust to the Empire, but they simply won't stop! So we decided to increase quality of our own products. The Imperial clothes are sturdy and protect you well, but we have to make them prettier.

I need a decent sample. A nice and fine handkerchief will do. Sew one and bring it to me. It'll be a good exercise for you, too.

checkText.en: Damned war... Work, work all day, no rest...

finishText.en: These slippers look so cozy, that I want to wear them immediately.

goal.en: Purchase Copper Scissors and Weak Thread from Yana Beketova. Obtain Training Fabric and cut it into two Calico Rolls. Sew Cozy Slippers. Report to Yana Beketova.

startText.en:
Remember, that the Empire needs only best craftsmen, capable of providing our army with the best armor and equipment! Alas, we don't have much time for teaching you things, because we're overloaded with orders. But I can give you loads of exercise.

Go to the Hadron Quarter, kill a few skeletons. I heard they have fabric on them. You may simply buy the Training Fabric from an auction. Use copper scissors to cut the fabric, take some thread, and then you can sew Cozy Slippers!

checkText.en: How's the work going?

finishText.en: Not so bad at all! Such a small piece of fabric turned into a fine piece of art! Now let's get down to something serious.

goal.en: Purchase a tailoring manual from Valentina de Ardeur and read it. Purchase an Apprentice's Sewing Case and use it to sew a Fine Handkerchief. Report to Valentina de Ardeur.

startText.en:
Do you appreciate beauty? Do you rely more on magic, than on physical might? Do you want to earn well? Tailoring is the craft for you then!

I can sell you the manual and starting kit. This is all you need for a start. It won't take long, but it's talent that it really takes. Don't you worry, I'll be helping you along the way.

Your first lesson is to sew a fine handkerchief for me.

checkText.en: Start with something simple, then progress to something more complex... that will make you a fortune!

finishText.en: These slippers are so cozy! Any old lady would be happy to wear them. Now you are a real tailor!

goal.en: Purchase Copper Scissors and Weak Thread from Valentina de Ardeur. Obtain Training Fabric and cut it into two Calico Rolls. Sew Cozy Slippers. Report to Valentina de Ardeur.

startText.en:
Selecting the right fabric for your creations is as important, as the skill of making correct patterns. You need to learn how to obtain the material.

Cutting the fabric also requires decent tools. You can buy sharp copper scissors from me. Training fabric can be looted, for example, from Forest Agitators in northern Lightwood. That's the kind of fabric that you won't be sorry about, if something goes wrong. You may also buy Training Fabric at an auction. Cut the fabric into Calico Rolls, take Rough Thread and sew Cozy Slippers for me.

checkText.en: Clumsy stitches can be different, eysh. They can show whether the sewer has a talent or not. I wonder which is your case.

finishText.en: Ah-hya, that is not bad at all! I did not expect to find such a talent among the youngsters!

goal.en: Purchase a tailoring manual from Gaal-Mahra and read it. Purchase an Apprentice's Sewing Case and use it to sew a Fine Handkerchief. Report to Gaal-Mahra.

startText.en:
Aho, kid. You want to study tailoring? A dress sewed by a professional tailor is light as a breath of wind and comfortable as a crib. Both young and old wear our clothes all year rround. This is why our job is so important. What would be the difference between us and Savages if were walking naked?

If you want to become a tailor, I will teach you everything you need to know. Take the manual, the Apprentice's Sewing Case and its upgrader. Then trry your hand at something simple. For instance, make a Fine Handkerchief for me.

checkText.en: Any hunter in ambush would envy tailor's patience!

finishText.en: Perrfect! It is better than I expected. You deserve the rright to be called a tailor, eysh!

goal.en: Purchase Copper Scissors and Weak Thread from Gaal-Mahra. Obtain Training Fabric and cut it into two Calico Rolls. Sew Cozy Slippers. Report to Gaal-Mahra in the Residence.

startText.en:
Since the basics are so easy for you, let's trry something more difficult. Young women fancy these strange leg decorations that the tailless wear, eysh. Of course, we cannot make them the same for our paws, but I trried to do my best to make comfortable and lovely shoes for our girls.

You want to try and sew a pair? Firrst you will have to obtain training fabric. Cut it with scissors and sew the strripes with the thread. You can buy it all frrom me.

I wonder what it is going to look like, zoor?

checkText.en: You need to use the manual to learn weaponsmithing.

finishText.en: Congratulations on becoming a weaponsmith! Let's get started. If you're diligent, you'll learn very fast!

goal.en: Purchase a weaponsmithing manual from Aurora Bulatina and read it. Purchase Apprentice Weaponsmith's Tools and use them to craft a Rare Whetstone. Report to Aurora Bulatina.

startText.en:
Stay sharp, comrade! The war is on! With the League on one side, demons on the other, and all kinds of monsters all around... What can save the Motherland in these hard times? Nothing but strong steel in our fighters' hands!

The Empire may have plenty of defenders, but sharp swords are always in short supply. So don't hesitate, comrade, and become a weaponsmith! Buy a manual and tools, roll up your sleeves and get started!

checkText.en: Is the knife ready? I expect it to be perfect!

finishText.en: That is a good knife, sharp and durable. You have passed your exam. Here's your reward!

goal.en: Purchase a Rusty Pick and 12 doses of Tallow from Aurora Bulatina. Gather five Impure Copper Chunks, melt them into Copper Tips and forge Copper Knife. Report to Aurora Bulatina.

startText.en:
You've got the basics? Good. Now let's get down to common practice.

You will need enough resources for you craft. You may either mine for ore or buy it at an auction. In any case, you must be able to do it yourself. Buy a Rusty Pick and mine a few Impure Copper Chunks near Nezebgrad. As I said, they're always available at the auction.

You can melt them then into Copper Tips, and use the tips to craft a Copper Knife. Another needful thing in weaponsmithing is Tallow.

Let's consider it your final exam.

checkText.en: You need to use the manual to learn weaponsmithing.

finishText.en: Did you read it? All of it? Good. Now you can be my apprentice. I'll teach you everything I know!

goal.en: Purchase a weaponsmithing manual from Zoritsa Kovaleva and read it. Purchase Apprentice Weaponsmith's Tools and use them to craft a Rare Whetstone. Report to Zoritsa Kovaleva.

startText.en: Tailors make clothes for sorcerers, while blacksmiths equip armor-clad warriors. There is only one profession that everyone definitely needs: weaponsmiths. Choose this path and you'll never lack for work: you'll have enough orders for a hundred years ahead. You'll be able to craft a sword or a bow for a warrior, a dagger or a wand for a mage, and you'll always find a treat for yourself too, seeing as you can make any weapon you might want. Sounds great, eh? Make up your mind: you only need to buy tools and a manual to become a weaponsmith.

checkText.en: Go on, work, work! Do the clink clank!

finishText.en: Well done! Here's your reward - you will find it useful!

goal.en: Purchase a Rusty Pick and 12 doses of Tallow from Zoritsa Kovaleva. Gather five Impure Copper Chunks, melt them into Copper Tips and forge Copper Knife. Report to Zoritsa Kovaleva.

startText.en:
Well, you know now what weaponsmithing is all about. What you need now is practice, the more the better! But that's not all: you need raw materials too. To mine them, you will need a pick, which you can buy from me. It's a bit rusty, but it'll do for the first time.

Take the pick and go search for copper ore near Novograd. There are lots of them, regardless that the city is near. If someone else turns out to be faster than you, and you find the mine empty, don't be upset. Just wait for a while, and the mine will replenish with ore once again. Of course, you may simply buy ore at an auction.

You can melt raw copper into Copper Tips and then craft a Copper Knife. Don't forget about Tallow, you're going to need it.

checkText.en: The Whetstone is ready? Don't make me wait, kylys!

finishText.en: Perrfect, eysh! You can keep the Whetstone. Now when I see your talent, I know you will make use of it.

goal.en: Purchase a weaponsmithing manual from Khoor-Tabira and read it. Purchase Apprentice Weaponsmith's Tools and use them to craft a Rare Whetstone. Report to Khoor-Tabira in the Residence.

startText.en:
Aho! So, you love weapons? That's good! You have the blood of a real hunter in your veins. Maybe you will make a good weaponsmith!

I can teach you the basics of weaponsmithing. Right now, I need a new whetstone. Will you make it for me? It is nothing difficult - you just take the manual and read it. Of courrse, you will need your tools. You can obtain all these from me.

Then go on and work on it until you crraft a whetstone that is good enough for sharpening hunhurr fangs!

checkText.en: I will keep an eye on you, apprentice!

finishText.en: Excellent! You are a talented weaponsmith. One day you will forrge the grreatest blade in the world, eysh! I am prroud to be your teacher.

goal.en: Purchase a Rusty Pick and 12 doses of Tallow from Khoor-Tabira. Gather five Impure Copper Chunks, melt them into Copper Tips and forge Copper Knife. Report to Khoor-Tabira in the Residence.

startText.en:
It is time for us to move to a more complicated stage, kylys. To weapons! But before you can forrge your first blade, you need to learn something very imporrtant. Good weaponsmiths always collect materials by themselves. They dig out ore with their hands and develop it properly. This is how a decent weapon is born!

Take this trraining pick and go find some copper ore. It is found all over Howlem. Then take some tallow from me and melt copper chunks into tips. Only then you will be able to forge a blade that will be rightfully yours, eysh!

checkText.en: Who knows, perhaps soon we will learn to use the chips for something other than runes?

finishText.en: Well, good luck with your research! I admit I envy you a little.

goal.en: Talk to Semer Nemar in Yasker’s Tower.

startText.en: Find Semer Nemar and ask him about the mysterious message.

checkText.en: Who knows, perhaps soon we will learn to use the chips for something other than runes?

finishText.en: I hope you have enough chips! This thing must have plenty of uses!

goal.en: Talk to the Mysterious Family in the Gibberling District.

startText.en: You must find the Mysterious Family and ask them about the message.

checkText.en: Hurry, milordmilady! Treasures are close!

goal.en: Find fragrant chamomiles, gather bouquets and exchange them for goods from the Holiday Committee Official.

startText.en: Fall and its wonderful holidays are approaching! Holiday Committee Officials will give you anything for a bouquet of fragrant chamomiles! Well, maybe not anything, but you can definitely get Marquis's Treasure Map and Marquis's Seal for it.

goal.en: Find a clearing with nimble hares, catch one of them, then bring it to the merchant.

startText.en: They say hare races are popular with the local merchants. One of them, Gorislav Trubin, will give you Marquis's Treasure Map and Marquis's Seal for a nimble hare. Onward, my ameowzing lordlady! After the hares!

goal.en: Find a clearing with hares, catch one of them, then bring it to the tavern to exchange it.

startText.en: They say hare races are popular around here. They are held in the local tavern. The lovely tavern owner will give you Marquis's Treasure Map and Marquis's Seal in exchange for nimble hares. It's a good deal! Onward, my ameowzing lordlady! After the hares!

checkText.en: Just a little more and you will become a truly royal person, my ameowzing lordlady!

goal.en: Learn from Marquis where special goods are located and exchange them for Marquis's Treasure Maps and Marquis's Seals.

startText.en:
MilordMilady!

I found out where you can exchange various curiosities for special treasure maps! These maps show the path to an aristocratic title and other regalia.

I will inform you of the latest news about these maps every day. Meow, be sure to come!

checkText.en: What if they all fell into the swamp? What then?!

finishText.en:
That's marvelous! They are mostly intact. Thank you!

But many of the gifts are still in the Holy Land. We need to find them before it's too late. Come again tomorrow - we will continue the search.

goal.en: Use this compass to collect 10 missing gifts in the Holy Land and bring them to Polina Smilina in Nezebgrad.

startText.en:
We need to collect all gifts that we can find in the Holy Land. Can you imagine that... Gifts all over Tensess Temple, the Merry Forest, even the anomalies of Coba Plateau! At least Prospectors will enjoy this New Year!

Happily, even the Arisen understand the importance of the holiday. Their scientists have improvised this compass. It will locate the gifts. All you have to do is follow the needle and collect them!

Be careful, though. I don't think that storm came out of nowhere. Some dark forces may be behind it...

checkText.en: What do we do?

finishText.en:
Are we saved? Are the gifts saved? Oh, let me kiss you!

Thank you so much! There would be no New Year without you! Believe me, saving such an important holiday is a great deed!

You must be rewarded generously. Here, take this! This talisman will teach you to summon a magical goatling. It's very cute and swift! They produce all kinds of curios things on that Miracle Factory...

Happy New Year!

goal.en: Help Holiday Committee Officials collect gifts in the Holy Land five times. Return to Polina Smilina.

startText.en:
It's a disaster!

We've ordered a huge shipment of New Year gifts from the famous Miracle Factory. Yesterday the ship, loaded with gifts, got into an Astral storm near the Holy Land! The shields were breached, and the ship almost crashed... and the gifts spilled all over the allod!

Please, help us! We are asking for help from everyone, but we still don't think it's enough. We need to save the holiday before it's too late!

checkText.en: What if they all fell into the swamp? What then?!

finishText.en:
You found them? Ah, thank you!

But the shipment was huge, and dozens of gifts are still scattered over the Holy Land... Come again tomorrow - we will continue the search.

goal.en: Use this compass to collect 10 missing gifts in the Holy Land and bring them to Evdokia Bubentsova in Novograd.

startText.en:
Oh, thank you for your help! Our elves have already come up with a magical device that will help you find the gifts! It is called the Winter compass. You just need to follow the needle and pick up the gifts!

But be careful! I can sense that something is wrong... The sailors said that the storm was an unusual one; it started unexpectedly and ended swiftly. I am afraid that some evil spirits want to spoil our holiday... Don't let them do that!

checkText.en: What do we do?

finishText.en:
Phew! I think that's all that we can save. And it's a lot! I hope Lamias, Prospectors, and Eljune settlers will enjoy the rest of the gifts...

Thank you so much. I would like to give you this hoof as a sign of gratitude. Throw it on the ground, and it will turn into a swift and lively goatling! He will be a faithful friend of yours.

Happy New Year!

goal.en: Help Holiday Committee Officials collect gifts in the Holy Land five times. Return to Evdokia Bubentsova.

startText.en:
Ah, what do we do? Such a terrible thing has happened. We asked those masters from the Miracle Factory to produce some magical gifts for the people... They can do wonderful things!

So they did everything on time, and packed everything nicely... And shipped them out yesterday. That's when the trouble started!

The ship got into a storm near the Holy Land! Can you imagine that? The crew wasn't hurt, but the gifts were less lucky... They got scattered all over the allod. And we don't have the time to order new ones. So... we need to save what we can save. Or there will be no New Year!

Can you help us?

finishText.en: Welcome to the celebration!

goal.en: Visit the Eclipse cruise ship

startText.en: Listen, everyone! All residents of Sarnaut are invited to join the celebration of the Annniversary! The most important people are gathering on the greatest astral battle dreadnought - the Eclipse.

finishText.en: Having fun?

goal.en: Go to the lower deck and fly on a sailplane.

startText.en: Want to paint the sky with fires? You can find sailplanes on the lower deck. Pick one and go on a flight! Blow up gold orbs and earn points to receive a generous reward.

checkText.en: Don't lose the Eye! It's a very valuable thing.

finishText.en:
Look, there they are. Nasty mugs!

What took you so long? The Eye won't hold them forever. In fact, it will hold them for a really short time. I told you that, you just weren't listening!

So, here is your reward. I will deal with these boys. If you want to hunt again, feel free to come at any time!

goal.en:
Open Astral Wormhole, catch 5 young demons using the Demonic Eye and return to Bulat Jerohin.

The Demonic Eye can be used anywhere outside the capitals, skirmishes and certain special zones.

Open Astral Wormhole, catch 5 young demons using the Demonic Eye and return to Krasimir Chernov.

The Demonic Eye can be used anywhere outside the capitals, skirmishes and certain special zones.

startText.en:
Hello there! I can see citizens are way too feather-bedded in your capital! That's not surprising - what can you be afraid of behind these thick walls? Demons are somewhere far away... Huh! Not today!

Here, take this Eye. It can open up an Astral wormhole right here! All sorts of nasty things will crawl out of it, and you need to capture them. It's easy - first you beat up a demon, then enchant it with its reflection in the magic Eye - and there it is, miniaturized and trapped inside of it!

Catch five of them and come back. We will use them to hunt bigger demons!

checkText.en:
Glum is a lousy fighter, whatever he thinks of himself. He doesn't know a darn thing about defense. Lanky, that's the real rock! You've got to try real hard before she even notices your blows.

Well, Fang is something. He's as strong as a bear and as cunning as a thousand Astral demons! Very few can beat him, that's for sure.

finishText.en:
How did you like it?

Come again, if you wish! You are always welcomed at the ring. The people are hungry for bread and circuses! Who are we to deny them that?

goal.en: Fight with Glum the Rough-House, Lanky the Quiet and Fang.

startText.en:
It's so boring here! No decent warriors to be seen anywhere. Well, no wonder - what would they do in the capital?

However, we are here and we are in trouble! Our fighters are sick and tired of fighting each other. They know each others' moves too well. They need a new blood!

Are you ready to drop your weapons and try yourself at fistfight? Then welcome to the ring! Of course, you won't fight for nothing. If you win, we will reward you with an Anniversary coin. If you don't, well, we won't take anything from you, don't worry!

Go talk to our three fighters. They will take you to the ring right away!

goal.en: Tease demons in the cages near Krasimir Chernikov 10 times.

checkText.en: These demons look too calm. We should fix that, don't you think?

finishText.en:
Not bad! These scratches are nothing, don't you worry.

You can tease them again, if you want to. The rules are the same - a coin for each ten pokes!

goal.en: Tease demons in the cages near Bulat Jerohin 10 times.

startText.en:
Look at them! The terror of Sarnaut! The great Astral threat!

They're just miserable critters. They have nothing but pointless desire to kill and destroy. It's in their nature. One day you will even stop hating them and start killing them as easily as you kill mosquitos.

But still you can have some fun! Here's how we amuse ourselves: the one who can touch a demon 10 times without losing their fingers, gets a coin!

Well, if you do lose a finger or two, that's your problem. Just don't do it if you don’t want to!

checkText.en: I will try and help you find demons that you can defeat on your own. Don't think it's so easy though!

finishText.en:
So this is it. You've done what you had to, now it's all up to us!

However, I've never seen demons behaving so strangely. And we better find out why before it's too late.

This is none of your concern now, anyway. Here is your reward. Good luck and have fun!

goal.en: Complete Bulat Jerohin's quests and kill 5 dangerous demons.

startText.en:
Let's get to the business. We're having a nice time here in the capital, but we didn't come here to rest.

Something weird is happening in the Astral. Demons... are running. They don't just ramble around, they all fly in one direction, as if they are chasing something. Or escaping...

I don't know what is going on, but it can't be good. Why? Because now they are also hiding on allods! Like the ones that we caught and caged.

We, Demon Hunters, hunt them and destroy. But we don't have enough people. You look tough enough for this kind of job. What do you say? Will you help us?

checkText.en: So, have you killed the monster?

finishText.en:
Perfect! Another peaceful day for the people of Sarnaut, who have no idea how hard we work to keep them safe...

Anyway, you did a great job. Have you ever considered becoming a Demon Hunter? We would be honored to have a  like you in our ranks!

goal.en:
Find and destroy Moloch.

The Demon can be anywhere outside the capitals, skirmishes and certain special zones.

startText.en:
So... Your first objective. Let's see.

Ah, Moloch! That's one ugly creature. And smart, too - he never attacks experienced hunters.

But today it's not going to help him. I have adjusted this visor to Moloch's energy. You just need to locate him and destroy him!

goal.en:
Find and destroy Augur.

The Demon can be anywhere outside the capitals, skirmishes and certain special zones.

startText.en:
So... Your second objective. Let's see.

Huh, Augur. This demon can control Astral magic, so be careful. Though there is no way he can hide from us!

I have adjusted this visor to Augur's energy. Show him how we deal with magic!

goal.en:
Find and destroy Chantress.

The Demon can be anywhere outside the capitals, skirmishes and certain special zones.

startText.en:
Your third objective... Huh, fate has some sense of humor indeed.

You are offered the honor to kill Chantress. She is a terrible monster. Once she attacked a distant allod of Free Traders and enchanted all their kids with her sweet voice right in the middle of the night... In the morning, the trackers found their traces that led to the shore.

They all fell into the Astral. Every single one of them.

I have adjusted this visor to Chantress' energy. I hope you will find her and give her a painful death!

goal.en:
Find and destroy Walker.

The Demon can be anywhere outside the capitals, skirmishes and certain special zones.

startText.en:
So, the fourth is... Walker.

There is nothing special about him. Just an extremely strong beast that destroys everything in his way. We deal with the likes of him on a daily basis. If you're smart enough, you will deal with him, too.

I have adjusted this visor to Walker's energy. Kill him and come back! I have more tasks for you.

goal.en:
Find and destroy Vigilant.

The Demon can be anywhere outside the capitals, skirmishes and certain special zones.

startText.en:
So, you want to hunt a bigger beast? Your next target is Vigilant.

Some think that this creature is older than elves and stronger than most Great Mages. Well, the time of ancient demons has passed. The older they are, the weaker they get with every day.

But we can't wait for him to die on his own. The world is still in danger while he is alive! So you better hurry up.

I have adjusted this visor to Vigilant's energy. Good luck!

goal.en: Congratulate 10 Warriors of the maximum level and return to Zabava Mayskaya.

startText.en:
There are more veterans among us than it might seem. We have gone through so many bloody battles in the last century! But the League always comes out victorious, thanks to our strong faith and mighty heroes! As much as we believe in the Light and Tensess, we put our faith into the brave warriors and artful sorcerers that stand guard of our homeland! In these days we need to show them how much we appreciate them and their sacrifice in the name of the League.

There is nothing difficult in that. You just need to congratulate 10 veterans. Sincere words of gratitude will make anyone happy! The more veterans you will congratulate before the Parade starts, the better spot you will get.

checkText.en: Have you congratulated everyone yet?

finishText.en: Excellent, excellent! You will make the Parade even brighter. Don't forget to complete my requests every day! The more you accomplish, the better spot you will get at the Parade!

goal.en: Congratulate 10 maximum level characters of the specified class.

startText.en:
There are more veterans among us than it might seem. We have gone through so many bloody battles in the last century! But the Empire always comes out victorious, thanks to our unity, heroism, and wise Yasker's command! As Yasker says, our main purpose is to keep up the morale!

There is nothing difficult in that. You need to congratulate 10 veterans. Sincere words of gratitude will make anyone happy! The more veterans you will congratulate before the Parade starts, the better spot you will get.

goal.en: Congratulate 10 Bards of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Congratulate 10 Wardens of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Congratulate 10 Engineers of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Congratulate 10 Mages of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Congratulate 10 Summoners of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Congratulate 10 Paladins of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Congratulate 10 Healers of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Congratulate 10 Psionicists of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Congratulate 10 Scouts of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Congratulate 10 Warriors of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.

checkText.en: Even little help will get you into the ranks of the Parade. But those who will put in great efforts, will be allowed to take the best spots!

finishText.en:
Outstanding! You have surely put in enough efforts to earn one of the best positions in the Parade ranks. Though if you complete all of my quests before the day of the Parade, you will be granted the honor to ride a snow-white stallion in the lead! It is a very rare horse indeed.

Ah, I almost forgot to congratulate you. May your will be strong and your ally's shoulder never fail you! May no beast withstand your onslaught and most powerful enemy flee at the sight of you!

goal.en: Complete 5 daily quests "War Veterans" and return to Maya Styagina.

startText.en:
Good afternoon, citizen! I congratulate you on May Holidays and remind you that soon the Empire's national celebration will take place - the Victory Parade! What do you mean, you didn't know?

Then listen up. By the Imperial edict of Yasker, a ceremonial march is to be organized in the streets of Nezebgrad. The participants of the parade - both resigned and active - will ride the best stallions of the Empire. They will be accompanied by war machinery - old models as well as new ones.

Also, those who help organize the event, will be able to participate, too! Are you interested? I'm not asking for much - you will find pleasure in completing my request yourself. I will tell you more, if you wish.

goal.en: Complete 5 daily quests "War Veterans" and return to Zabava Mayskaya.

startText.en:
Peace to you, my friend! May is a lovely and merry month. At this time, the League celebrates the anniversary of our victory in the Great Astral Campaign. This year, we have prepared something very special - the Victory Parade!

Imagine it: smooth lines of horses, magnificent machines, war heroes in their splendorous march across the capital city! And what's more, anyone who helps organize the event can participate. It's not that difficult to do - just congratulate the veterans! Not necessarily the participants of the Campaign - all war heroes deserve your appreciation!

Every day I will tell you who you should congratulate. If you complete my requests, you will have my gratitude, a ticket to the Parade, and a very nice reward, of course!

checkText.en: Hurry up before the attractions are closed for a break. Go on now!

finishText.en: Did you do everything you wanted? That's great. Here's your well-deserved reward, traveler!

goal.en: Complete the entertainment program from the Resort Manager by doing 5 suggested tasks.

startText.en:
Traveler, have you heard about our new entertainment program? It's not just fun - you can also earn generous rewards. New entertainment every day!

But take it easy - while there are enough snowflakes for everyone, if you come to me too often, the reward will be smaller.

checkText.en: How do you like it here? Having fun?

finishText.en: Nice, nice. Here's your reward!

goal.en: Complete the weekly entertainment program from the Resort Manager by doing 5 daily tasks.

startText.en: Traveler, now you can get even more snowflakes for the winter entertainment program! Just 5 days of winter activities - and the reward is yours!

checkText.en: What are you waiting for?

finishText.en:
Excellent! I guess you deserve a gift, don’t you? Here, take this! I hope there's something good inside. I didn’t peek, I swear.

Hunhurrs will probably be back again, so I might need your help!

And... hand back the tincture, will you?

goal.en: Repel the attack of spirits of eternal frost using the Luminary of Joy.

startText.en:
Not everything is perfect at our Snow Resort, yeah? This whole mess with the holidays woke the local Hunhurrs, spirits of eternal frost. The nasty creatures want to feed on our guests’ souls! Agrh! Unforgivable! They will feel the true wrath... Well, not my wrath, and not yours either. It will be that Gibberling that will deal with them.

Here, take this! This thing is sick! It’s called “Luminary of Joy”. Instills indescribable horror into dark creatures. And take this, too! It’s a tincture of local mushrooms and snowdrops. Allows you to see those dark creatures! And other interesting stuff...

Drink and get down to work. Hunhurrs have no business being here, eysh!

checkText.en: Well, how did you like the procession?

finishText.en: I told you you wouldn’t regret it! It may look funny but the Tekyan take this ceremony very seriously. And Genlun himself too, by the looks of it!

goal.en: Join the festive procession in honor of Genlun, the patron of the Tekyan.

startText.en:
Like many other people of our world, Tekyan has their own rituals for celebrating the New Year. Che-Shoo, the guardian of the holy fire on that island, invites his guests to join a ceremonial procession in honor of their crocodile god, Genlun. I heard it’s fun! The Priestess carries divine tea through the whole island, accompanied by the Dragon, Drummer, and dancers.

Che-Shoo himself can tell you what exactly happens there and its sacral meaning. You won’t regret it, aysh!

checkText.en: Well, have you found the gifts?

finishText.en: Not bad! I hope you like them.

goal.en:
Find the gifts by participating in activities at the Snow Resort.

(Progress is saved if you abandon the quest.)

startText.en: Gifts for the New Year have been hidden all over the resort! You can find them in an ice-hole or a snowman. You can discover a gift on the icy lake or on a mountain slope. You can keep the gifts! That’s the whole point...

checkText.en: How is it going? It's not about catching the fish, it's about fishing. Any fisherman could tell you that.

finishText.en: You did it! You really did it! This is your dream fish! See? Destiny sometimes turns out well.

goal.en: Catch an Ice Fish in Crystal Lake.

startText.en: Yeah! My dream fish! It's right here, under the ice! You don't believe me? A lot of people saw it. It's not easy to catch, though. Firstly, you need a special crystal bait. Secondly, it's attracted to light... Just blow up something, I don’t know! And thirdly, you need luck. And thirdly, you need luck. Fortune favors the stubborn. If you fail today, come back tomorrow. Sooner or later, you'll get lucky.

checkText.en: Did you enjoy the holidays?

finishText.en: Now take this tackle and try to catch it. You'll do it this time. I believe in you!

goal.en: Lure the Ice Fish to the surface

startText.en: All deep-sea fish are drawn to light. Ice Fish loves New Year's celebrations. It's not scared by fireworks and lights - it's quite the opposite. As it gets closer to the surface, it will be easier to catch.

checkText.en: Catch me three fish, and I will find a way to thank you!

finishText.en: Nice catch! That's a good haul! A here's your promised reward. If you catch some more, bring them straight to me. You know I'm good for it!

goal.en: Catch 3 fish in Crystal Lake and bring them to Asp Ershov.

startText.en: You want to go fishing, right? Be aware that fish in the Crystal Lake is very fastidious. Catching it is tricky, but it's selling like hot cakes! If you want to earn a nice reward, go catch three of them.

checkText.en: Catch me five fish, and I will find a way to thank you!

finishText.en: Nice catch! That's a good haul! A here's your promised reward. If you catch some more, bring them straight to me. You know I'm good for it!

goal.en: Catch 5 fish in Crystal Lake and bring them to Asp Ershov.

startText.en: You want to go fishing, right? Be aware that fish in the Crystal Lake is very fastidious. Catching it is tricky, but it's selling like hot cakes! If you want to earn a nice reward, go catch five of them.

checkText.en: If you skate through all the checkpoints on the lake and perform several simple stunts, you'll win a prize!

finishText.en: You were great! You deserve a reward for that!

goal.en: Show your figure skating skills - skate through all the checkpoints on the frozen lake and perform 10 stunts.

startText.en:
Hey? You want to try skating? Don't be shy, it's fun! Even if you fall, it's not a big deal. Nobody's going to laugh!

So, are you in? Great, now take these ice skates and go ahead! And if you skate through all the checkpoints on the lake and perform several simple stunts, you'll win a prize!

checkText.en: Hard work pays off if you are patient enough!

finishText.en: A unique bird that is hard to find in Sarnaut! Now you have one!

goal.en: Catch and raise a Jay mount.

startText.en:
Hello, traveler! Have you ever heard of the Ice Jays?

These mysterious birds can even travel through the astral plane, and no one knows how they do it. They say they serve Winter herself, and build their nests from ice debris on top of the largest glacier in Sarnaut!  Now they came to our resort.

And now, imagine - you can get one of these if you can find an egg and then take care of the fledgling until it grows up.

Our hunter can tell you where to find an egg.

checkText.en: You can do this with a bit of effort!

finishText.en: The fledgling will grow into a big strong bird! Make sure to come back tomorrow.

goal.en: Shoot some game in the forest

startText.en: There's a lot of fish in the lake, but fish alone isn't nourishing enough. Our fledgling could use a more varied diet. These woods are rich with game. However, we don't need a deer. Five hares and five squirrels will do. I'll give you a bow.

checkText.en: You can do this with a bit of effort!

finishText.en: It's going to hatch soon! Come back, we need your help!

goal.en: Collect five sacred flames and keep the egg warm

startText.en: What could replace mother's warmth for the fledgling? Probably nothing. But there's something that can help. The magic of Light can create lanterns: small fires that produce enough heat to keep a traveler warm. They should be enough for a fledgling. Go to the priest Che-Shi and do as he says, and then warm the owlet.

checkText.en: You can do this with a bit of effort!

finishText.en: The fledgling will grow into a big strong bird!

goal.en: Catch fish for the fledgling

startText.en: Every living being needs food. A growing organism needs even more food! As we know, owls and jays are predators. Luckily, there's plenty of fish in local waters. Ten fish should be enough.

checkText.en: You can do this with a bit of effort!

finishText.en: Do you like your new friend? It's not the same as buying something ready-made. You two are very close now.

goal.en: Catch and raise an Owl mount.

startText.en:
Greetings, visitor! Have you ever heard about Snow Owls? They're amazing birds.

You can tame one if you raise an owlet. It's not an easy task. Snow Owls are delicate and require special handling. It's hard enough to catch it, let alone help an owlet hatch, and then keep it warm and fed as it grows. I wish you luck if you're up for this.

Go visit our huntress. She lives nearby, at the edge of the forest. If there's anyone who knows where to find Snow Owls, it's her.

checkText.en: Don't be afraid, the bird won't drop you even during an intense hunt.

finishText.en: You do alright!

goal.en: Demonstrate your accuracy by scoring 50 points in flights on Rocs

startText.en:
Would you like to enjoy the scenery and have fun at the same time?

This season we have a new product - hunting tours on rocs. You just need to hunt for explosive spheres!

Everything is simple: hit the blue spheres, don’t hit the red ones. Earn 50 points, and the reward is yours.

And if you turn out to be a very accurate hunter and score 75 or even 100 points, the reward will be increased.

So, ready for a ride?

finishText.en: Do not miss this great attraction!

goal.en: Meet with Che-Go at the Winter Resort.

startText.en: Dear friend! This year a new attraction awaits you at the Winter Resort. You can ride a Roc and hunt at the same time! Come to our beautiful resort and test your accuracy. My assistant Che-Go will show you everything.

checkText.en: Ask the slalom organizer to take you to the top of the mountain, grab the sledge, and slide down!

finishText.en: Who doesn't enjoy a fast ride? Well, how are you feeling? Did you enjoy it?

goal.en: Go to the top of the mountain and ride down.

startText.en:
Want to enjoy a good ride?

Grab your snowboard and let me know when you are ready - I will take you to the top of that mountain. Then you can ride your snowboard down the hill. You'll love it!

And it's not some kind of children's ride with sledges - we conduct this activity according to the rules of the discipline: you can only slide down when the track is carefully prepared for snowboarding maneuvers. Don't worry about missing the start of the race: we will announce it throughout the resort.

Be careful there, the snowboard is not some kind of sled - if you crash into something solid or get off the track, you're done...

Afterwards, come see me. Daredevils who ride on snowboards deserve a reward!

checkText.en: Ask one of the Flight Masters to take you to the top of the mountain, grab the sledge, and slide to the foot!

finishText.en: You are brave! How did it feel? Did you like it? I'm sure you loved it!

goal.en: Go to the top of the mountain and slide down on the sledge.

name.en: If You Feel Like Riding, Do It

startText.en:
Do you feel like taking a ride on a sledge? We love doing that in our town!

Ask one of the Flight Masters to take you to the top of the mountain, grab the sledge, and slide to the foot! You'll love it!

Be careful - it's not easy to control the sledge and avoid obstacles in your way!

If you manage to get to the finish line, stop by afterwards to collect your reward!

By the way! They say Winter leaves her gifts on the hill...

checkText.en: You should only build fortresses inside the village! Evil frost spirits are wandering outside.

finishText.en: Wow, that was a great battle! Should we do this again?

goal.en: Defend your fortress for 3 minutes.

startText.en:
We are going to start a real Snow Battle! Do you want to join us?

The rules are simple: some players build fortresses, and others attack them. If a defenders lasts for 3 minutes, they receive a reward. Otherwise, the attackers win!

If you're with us, then remember that you should only build fortresses inside the village! Evil frost spirits are wandering outside.

checkText.en: Hit five players with snowballs! Don't worry, they won't take it personally!

finishText.en: I told you: a good snowball always hits the target! And a nice hit deserves a reward - here's your snowflake! Come again!

goal.en: Hit 5 targets with snowballs.

startText.en:
Do you like throwing snowballs? Me too! I love that game... I wonder why we didn't like snow back then? It's so white and fluffy... And if you make a snowball, it's round like an orange! Keep in mind that not any snow is suitable for snowballs. We make special piles of snow so that it melts a little - then it's perfect for making snowballs that always hit the target!

You don't believe me? Then try it! Hit five players with snowballs, then come back to get your reward.

checkText.en: You will find branches in the forest, a carrot can be easily obtained in the village, and snow is everywhere around us. Come back when you're done!

finishText.en: Good job, that's a great snowman!

goal.en: Obtain branches in the forest, a carrot in the village, and make a snowman, then return to Brody Three-Fingered.

startText.en:
You need some branches, a carrot and snow. You will find branches in the forest, a carrot can be easily obtained in the village, and snow is everywhere around us.

You need to make three balls out of snow, then stick the branches where the arms should be and the carrot as a nose - and the snowman is ready!

Try not to place your snowman next to somebody else's. This is not very polite.

checkText.en: How do you like our village? This is the best place in the world, isn't it?

finishText.en:
Did you meet everyone? That's great!

Now feel yourself at home. Guests are very welcomed here!

goal.en: Meet the locals and return to the Elder.

startText.en:
Let me tell you about our village.

Here we have a beautiful frozen lake. There you can try figure skating, and if you long for peace and quiet, you can take a fishing rod and catch some delicious Crystal Fish.

Then, we have an amazing mountain with smooth slopes. There you can take a ride either on a snow board or on a sledge, if you are bold enough!

Also, you can entertain yourself by making snowmen, launching fireworks, and, of course, by playing snowballs. And if you get hungry, stop by the food vendors. They sell most delicious dishes!

finishText.en: Ah, you've come! Give me your coin. It's not just a coin! It's your ticket to an exciting world of not-quite-legal trade.

goal.en: Meet with Captain Solonus at the Eljune Bazaar.

startText.en:
Hello, !

We haven't seen each other for a while. How is it going?

My travels brought me to the Eljune Bazaar. Chewacca and I are helping the Free Traders organize a Black Market. This place can really use one! Anything can be sold to any part of Sarnaut. Need something you can't find in the markets of your capital? No problem! We can legitimize any goods, even those provided by your enemies.

Drop by anytime. Don't forget the coin you got with this letter.

finishText.en: What brings you here?

goal.en: {giver} is waiting for you in a location called {zone}.

startText.en: The adventure might be not over just yet. Go to the location called {zone} as soon as you can. {giver} is waiting for you there. There is a grand quest ahead, so don't waste time!

checkText.en: Back already?

finishText.en: Your guild can now use Generation 1 Banners! They are powerful artifacts that can turn the tide of battle.

goal.en: Bring ten pieces of sateen cloth.

startText.en:
Whenever they talk about the Aoidos, they always bring up the numerous compatriots who joined the League. It’s true that few of us joined the Empire, but they exist, and I’m proof of that!

 It doesn’t matter how many soldiers the League gets. What matters is what the Empire has - and it has Lucia, the best seamstress in the world. And I might not be a mage, but I do have skills.

 My magic does not summon thunder and lightnings, but enchanting fabrics, making them tougher than steel? That I can do.

I'll make magic banners for your guild as soon as you bring me the required materials. I need enchanted sateen for first Generation banners. Bring it to me, and I'll get to work. Let your guild leaders decide who should bear it.

checkText.en: Back already?

finishText.en: Your guild can now use Generation 2 Banners! I hope they will help you!

goal.en: Bring ten pieces of satin cloth.

startText.en:
Banner magic is ancient. I heard you’ve been to Kirah and taken part in the ritual of creating a Standard? Or perhaps you’ve hoisted a War Banner at some point? Or performed feats during the May Holidays under a Victorious Banner?

Then you know what I’m talking about! It’s all part of the craft that creates these rare artifacts, and I’ve mastered it to perfection. But to make a banner like this, I need a special material.

To transform your old banners into Generation 2 Banners, I need something better than sateen. I need enchanted satin! Bring it to me, and I'll provide your guild with new banners. Let your leaders decide who will be worthy of bearing them!

checkText.en: Back already?

finishText.en: Your guild can now use Generation 3 Banners! Oh, this is a masterpiece. Just imagine it flying high!

goal.en: Bring ten pieces of brocade cloth.

startText.en:
What can be worse than losing your own banner? You, a soldier of the Empire, should understand that. Banner is part of a combat unit! I heard a story about one General Sidorov who lost their regimental standard during the battle of Umoir. Poor bastard... He never recovered from it. He couldn’t handle the shame and quietly wasted away, turning into an undead!

But you’re not like that, are you? So make sure to keep the banner safe! To transform your old banners into Generation 3 Banners, I need a proper material. Only the finest brocade will do. Get it for me and come back.

And remember: the leaders of your guild must decide who will bear them.

checkText.en: Back already?

finishText.en: Your guild can now use Generation 1 Banners! They are powerful artifacts that can turn the tide of battle.

goal.en: Bring ten pieces of sateen cloth.

startText.en:
To be honest, this is not a simple order. Still, you’ve come to the right place. I’m known not just as a seamstress, but also a sorceress – of a kind, I guess.

My magic does not summon thunder and lightnings, but enchanting fabrics, making them tougher than steel? That I can do.

I'll make magic banners for your guild as soon as you bring me the required materials. I need enchanted sateen for first Generation banners. Bring it to me, and I'll get to work. Let your guild leaders decide who should bear it.

checkText.en: Back already?

finishText.en: Your guild can now use Generation 2 Banners! I hope they will help you!

goal.en: Bring ten pieces of satin cloth.

startText.en:
Banner magic is ancient. I heard you’ve been to Kirah and taken part in the ritual of creating a Standard? Or perhaps you’ve hoisted a War Banner at some point? Or performed feats during the May Holidays under a Victorious Banner?

Then you know what I’m talking about! It’s all part of the craft that creates these rare artifacts, and I’ve mastered it to perfection. But to make a banner like this, I need a special material.

To transform your old banners into Generation 2 Banners, I need something better than sateen. I need enchanted satin! Bring it to me, and I'll provide your guild with new banners. Let your leaders decide who will be worthy of bearing them!

checkText.en: Back already?

finishText.en: Your guild can now use Generation 3 Banners! Oh, this is a masterpiece. Just imagine it flying high!

goal.en: Bring ten pieces of brocade cloth.

startText.en:
What can be worse than losing your own banner? You’ll become a laughingstock, and no one will ever take you seriously.

I heard a story about one General Sidorov who lost their regimental standard during the battle of Umoir. Poor bastard... He never recovered from it. He couldn’t handle the shame and quietly wasted away, turning into an undead!

But you’re not like that, are you? So make sure to keep the banner safe! To transform your old banners into Generation 3 Banners, I need a proper material. Only the finest brocade will do. Get it for me and come back.

And remember: the leaders of your guild must decide who will bear them.

checkText.en: Soon you will have enough material, and we will start constructing the mainland.

finishText.en: Excellent. A difficult path lies ahead, but we can handle it. And finally: I found this strange creature while I was traveling the world. It’s not aggressive at all. I’m sure you can raise it, and it will be protecting your new home. You will need all the help you can get. So why not use it?

goal.en: Acquire 105 units of Red Meteorite.

startText.en:
I have discovered an interesting phenomenon. Your allods are held together by a spell powered by the willpower of the Great mages and dragon blood. Or meteorite iron. I've always been curious whether these materials are the only ones with that sort of properties. As expected, your world is much bigger than you can imagine. I've looked for new ways of sustaining life on allods, but found... a way to combat darkness.

Red meteorite is one of the most rare resources in your world, and I found only crumbs of it. That's all that's left. But I summoned you not to crush your hopes but to raise them. The Architects used a special material called Matter of Creation – I can use it to recreate this noble mineral.

If we can get enough of it, I will be able to create a continent where you can build a stronghold to defend against the forces of darkness. The special properties of this material will protect you.

However... I've been here for a while, so I know there's darkness in each of you. You will face competition. The meteorite only protects against the forces of darkness, not other people... Prepare to battle other guilds, because everyone wants to survive.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: That’s not much. I hope someone brings another potion or two.

goal.en: Earn Sparks from the Kingdom of Elements and exchange them for a Vial with Sealed Souls.

startText.en: Today we're going to try something unusual. An expedition in the Kingdom of Elements discovered a few suitable sparks. Go there and help our colleagues. Don't forget to take Sparks as payment, because our new pet is very hungry. You don't want it to eat anyone useful, do you?

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: That’s not much. I hope someone brings another potion or two.

goal.en: Earn Sparks from the Kingdom of Elements and exchange them for a Vial with Sealed Souls.

startText.en: I believe we’ve found a new source of Sparks. The expedition in the Kingdom of Elements managed to put something together. They’ll give us these Sparks, but they’ll need something in return. A favor for a favor. So go there and find out what you can do to help, then come back with the Sparks.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: That’s not much. I hope someone brings another potion or two.

goal.en: Earn Sparks from Heroic Adventures and exchange them for a Vial with Sealed Souls.

startText.en: Astral keeps you fed, right? Sparks of the most powerful monsters are perfect for our Keeper. It won’t be easy, but you can do it, I’m sure.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: That’s not much. I hope someone brings another potion or two.

goal.en: Earn Sparks from Heroic Adventures and exchange them for a Vial with Sealed Souls.

startText.en: Astral is an interesting place. People have brought some strange things from the Astral. I believe you can find anything you want over there. But right now we need Sparks for our Keeper. Get them and come back.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: That’s not much. I hope someone brings another potion or two.

goal.en: Earn Sparks from raid adventures and exchange them for a Vial with Sealed Souls.

startText.en: Observatory is a good source of juicy Soul Sparks. You already know what I’m asking, right? Gather your friends and go to the Observatory. Bring me as many sparks as you can.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: That’s not much. I hope someone brings another potion or two.

goal.en: Earn Sparks from raid adventures and exchange them for a Vial with Sealed Souls.

startText.en: With great deeds come great rewards, right? You probably already know what this is about. Yes, it’s time to go to the Observatory. Gather your friends and get me some Sparks!

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: That’s not much. I hope someone brings another potion or two.

goal.en: Exchange the feed for a Vial with Sealed Souls.

startText.en: You know what’s the worst thing in the world? Greed! I managed to find an interesting supplier who’s willing to sell us a large batch of Sparks. But this greedy bastard wants a few tons of feed in return! He’s breeding horses or something. Get me 300 bags of feed and I’ll get us a Vial with Sealed Souls.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: That’s not much. I hope someone brings another potion or two.

goal.en: Exchange the feed for a Vial with Sealed Souls.

startText.en: Nothing is free. Same goes for Sparks. I found someone who can help us with those. In return he wants feed. A lot of feed. They say he breeds horses or something. Get me 300 bags of feed and I’ll get us a Vial with Sealed Souls!

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Excellent!

goal.en: Purchase a Crystal Soul Shard at the Boutique.

startText.en:
It's Goblin Banker, isn't it?

Of course that scoundrel would have a Spark or two in his stash. And not just any Sparks... Crystal Soul - if we want our Keeper to become truly powerful, we need it. So get it!

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: That’s not much. I hope someone brings another potion or two.

goal.en: Purchase a Crystal Soul Shard at the Boutique.

startText.en:
That Goblin Banker, one of the so-called Tycoons that make their living by ripping off common folk!

Of course that scoundrel would have a Spark or two in his stash. And not just any Spark... but a very rare Crystal Soul. If we want our Keeper to become truly powerful, we need it. So get it!

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Wonderful! That will be enough!

goal.en: Get all Ethereal Wood from Al Rihat.

startText.en: Ethereal Wood from Al Rihat is one of the most valuable resources in Sarnaut! And we really need it. But... most of it was cut some time ago, and its last reserves are kept in the Patriarch’s residence. We can probably come to an arrangement, right? They probably need help.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Great, you fulfilled the order. You’re free to go.

goal.en: Get all Ethereal Wood from Al Rihat.

startText.en: Al Rihat. A nasty place full of elves and monsters. All that riff-raff. The order from the capital is simple: you need to go to Al Rihat and provide aid to the enemy of the Empire - the elves. In exchange, you’ll receive Ethereal Wood that you’ll bring to me. Go now!

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Wonderful! That will be enough!

goal.en: Get a Worker Contract by completing quests related to battles.

startText.en:
The world is so bloodthirsty! The blood shedding business is thriving! The best crafters work in gladiator arenas because it’s more profitable! How awful... Why do people enjoy looking at gladiators in skintight leather tunics, with beautiful flowing hair... Hah. I get it. That’s why!

But let’s get back to business. They offered us a good deal in the capital: defeat the local gladiators, and we’ll be able to use their workers for a time. They get a show, and we get manpower. Muscular... handsome manpower. Ahem, sorry.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Great, you fulfilled the order. You’re free to go.

goal.en: Get a Worker Contract by completing quests related to battles.

startText.en:
Fighters, gladiators are a fertile field for a professional soldier of the Empire, but comparing the military power of the Empire under Yasker's leadership and our Stronghold would be odd!

Gladiators from the capital are ready to offer their best fighters in exchange for a Worker Contract for their workers. We need all hands on deck, so we accept their terms! Order: go to the capital and show them what you've learned in the Imperial army!

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Wonderful! That will be enough!

goal.en: 200 portions of animal fat.

startText.en:
Peaceful place, they said. Right! Is there a truly empty allod anywhere in the Astral?! There’s an orc camp right under our walls! A Gill and Waterfolk lair down the river. People go missing!
 I’m asking you - please grab a few tough guys and deal with that vermin!

And I’m going to contact the local mercenaries so they’ll start patrolling the area once you secure it.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Great, you fulfilled the order. You’re free to go.

goal.en: 200 portions of animal fat

startText.en:
We’re short of resources for our combat mechanisms. Oil delivery is always late. I already submitted a few complaints to the capital, but we can’t wait until they deal with it! The mechanisms are starting to fail, which means the quality of my work suffers!

We’ll look for other methods... Primitive methods. Gibberlings use animal fat as grease for their weapons and boats. Wormfaces to the southwest store old fat in containers and no longer use it. It doesn’t matter which one you’ll go after. Just get it for me!
