I’ll heat-treat it and use it as oil for our machines.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Wonderful! That will be enough!

goal.en: Obtain a Crystal Drill.

startText.en:
Crystal chips... They are used for processing various materials required for the construction of our fortress.

I understand their value and know that we both need them, but... perhaps you can get some for me? It should really help us with granite and metal cutting.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Great, you fulfilled the order. You’re free to go.

goal.en: Obtain a Crystal Drill.

startText.en:
Any military action always goes hand in hand with corruption. The bigger the army, the more complex it is to run it. Bureaucracy in the capital won't let us get the Crystal Chips required for the construction of our fortress.

Use any means necessary but get it for me! We can't just sit and wait for the capital to help us.

I wrote to Yasker already, so we'll await mass executions.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Wonderful! That will be enough!

goal.en: Purchase a Shred of Contract for Construction Golems at the Boutique

startText.en:
Nasty! Nasty! Disgusting type! Oh, I'm not talking about you. I mean the Goblin Banker, the nastiest goblin in existence!

He heard about our enterprise and offered his services. Nasty! Nasty services!

He's willing to sell us a few construction golems, and each is worth ten men! Ten men, you hear? Nasty, nasty type!

Well, he's nasty because he's asking a lot... Quite a lot... Nasty...

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Great, you fulfilled the order. You’re free to go.

goal.en: Purchase a Contract for Construction Golems at the Boutique

startText.en:
The greatness of the Empire is impressive but not impressive enough! Endless riches are in the hands of other races. They are headed by the Goblin Banker. This individual refuses to work for the good of the Empire. He’s only interested in money. One day we’ll make him answer for all the problems he’s causing us, but now... we’ll have to play by his rules.

Soldier, bring me a Contract for Construction Golems - his golems are better than our machines, so they’ll build our stronghold faster. Get going!

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Well done. The Guild will never forget your help.

goal.en: Deliver the Contribution to the Stronghold currency to the Stronghold's supplier

startText.en:
Earn special currency by turning in Guild quest items:

Contract for Ethereal Wood Delivery: 15 pcs.

Contract for Land Work: 12 pcs.

Ounce of Animal Fat: 2 pcs.

1 Crystal Chip.

Shred of Contract for Construction Golems: 1 pc.

Sparks of the Kingdom of Elements: 3 pcs.

Sparks of Heroic Adventures: 4 pcs.

Sparks of Raid Adventures: 3 pcs.

Mount Feed: 1 pc.

Crystal Soul Shard: 1 pc.

A Pair of Small Monster Heads: 1 pc.

Large Monster Head: 2 pcs.

Dangerous Monster Head: 20 pcs.

June Reactor: 100 pcs.

Participate in defeating a Stronghold Golem Sentry: 150 pcs.

finishText.en: I'm glad you answered my call! Let me give you this envelope with invitations to battle. I hope you achieve great results in the Coliseum!

goal.en: You must travel to Battle Curator Maximus Cornell in Yasker's Tower.

startText.en:
There's a letter for you. It says "read aloud to the recipient" on the envelope. So here we go:

, my dear friend! I am Maximus Cornell, and it is my pleasure to inform you that I am looking for brave warriors who would fight against mighty Keepers, the guardians of Strongholds. If you are interested, I will be waiting in Yasker’s Tower in Nezebgrad!

finishText.en: I'm glad you answered my call! Let me give you this envelope with invitations to battle. I hope you achieve great results in the Coliseum!

goal.en: Travel to Battle Curator Maximus Cornell in Aidenus' Tower.

startText.en:
There's a letter for you. It says "read aloud to the recipient" on the envelope. So here we go:

, my dear friend! I am Maximus Cornell, and it is my pleasure to inform you that I am looking for brave warriors who would fight against mighty Keepers, the guardians of Strongholds. If you are interested, I will be waiting in Aidenus' Tower in Novograd!

checkText.en: Have you considered my offer?

finishText.en: Wonderful! See you there.

goal.en: Get the envelope with an invitation to the Keeper Coliseum

startText.en:
Battles take place daily. But the number of invitations is limited.

I'll give you an envelope with three invitations to each league. If a suitable Keeper is available, of course. In the future, you will automatically receive such invitations from me every week.

Your invitations are spent only if you defeat a Keeper, not per attempt. Well, a good show earns me money, so I wouldn't want you to die too quickly, yes?

Even if all your invitations are gone, you are welcome to assist those who still have them.

checkText.en: Have you fulfilled the order?

finishText.en: Order 1137 successfully fulfilled! We’ll inform the capital of your results. Keep it up!

goal.en: Obtain at least 200 Small Monster Heads.

startText.en:
Greetings, soldier! I have a job for you.

We received order 1137 from the capital:

The twelfth regiment reports that enemy forces have been spotted in the area and they must be eliminated. Southwest: aborigines detected. Order 1137 calls for a complete annihilation of the supposed enemy and subsequent capture of the territory.

Southeast: powerful psi-subunits detected. Wormfaces pose a serious threat that can disrupt the work of the construction forces at our base. They must be eliminated.

Got it? Go!

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en:
Order 5391 successfully fulfilled! We'll inform the capital of your results.

Glory to Yasker! Glory to the Empire!

goal.en: Obtain 50 large monster heads.

startText.en:
How is it going, soldier? Listen up.

Order 5391 is as follows:

The twelfth regiment sighted special subunits in the enemy army. Powerful psionic and magic units that pose a serious threat to our forces. Request for Yasker Hawks' immediate assistance has been denied. Tactical center advises the use of means at hand.

Enemy's location: Southeast - Wormfaces.

Enemy's location: Southwest - Gibberlings.

Objective: locate and eliminate the most dangerous forces of the enemy. Take no prisoners.

Go now! You have your orders!

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Order 5631 successfully fulfilled! We’ll inform the capital of your results. Thank you for your service!

goal.en: Obtain 5 dangerous monster heads.

startText.en:
At ease, soldier!

What do we know about the Wormfaces? These creatures maintain constant telepathic contact, forming a council of a kind which they call Superintelligence. This Superintelligence allows them to coordinate attacks and act with great efficiency.

Our scouts also report that Gibberling healers use cold magic! They summon elementals in hopes that they will protect their village. Hah! That's not going to happen.

This is order 5631: eliminate Wormface Psionicists to disrupt any connection between them. That's your first task. Possible location: Southeast sector.

Get rid of these icy creatures - that's the second one. This allod will belong to the Empire, and no one can stop us! Possible location: Southwest sector.

You have your orders!

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Fantastic! The case is a bit dented, and the core looks like the whole base is going to blow up, but I’ll think of something... I don’t know, I’ll cover it.

goal.en: Obtain a June Reactor.

startText.en:
Amateurs! Idiots! The quantum system will be exhausted before the turbulence process is complete and the decay period starts. Do they understand that in the capital? It's obvious! You're a hero of the Empire. You should understand these things!

But an order is an order, right? But surely there are people capable of something other than following orders, so what do they need me for?

I detected high energy emission underground, in the Wormfaces' territory. I believe they have a functional golem somewhere in the catacombs. Go there and deal with the thing. Just don't damage the reactor! I need it.

The catacombs are in the southeast sector.

checkText.en: You ready?

finishText.en: I see that gleam in your eyes! I know you won’t flinch when the time comes!

goal.en: Listen to the Political Commissar's speech.

startText.en:
The Empire needs you, soldier! Think what Yasker would say if he saw you falter! The Empire is an Idea! And we follow it.

Look around you! What do you see, soldier? Just snow and ice? No, a loyal citizen of the Empire must see new opportunities and lands for the expansion of the great State!

Break free of your doubts! You decide the fates of thousands of Imperial citizens, and Yasker himself is watching us! For victory! Hurray!

checkText.en: You ready?

finishText.en: My duty is fulfilled, the light is now protecting you!

goal.en: Listen to the cleric's farewell speech.

startText.en: Everyone needs help on occasion. It’s nothing to be ashamed of. Accept the light. My duty is to absolve you of your sins. A great war is coming. You should get cleansed before starting on that bloody but necessary path.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Accept my gratitude! My children will sleep peacefully today.

goal.en: Obtain at least 200 small monster heads.

startText.en:
The smaller the monster, the more trouble it is. It’s an old wisdom, but it’s still true.

Yesterday the Waterfolk tried to steal our cow, but once they realized they weren’t strong enough, they just slaughtered it!

A week ago, goblins set our barn on fire. How long must we suffer this?! The guard only protects us against serious threats. And the little things are ours to deal with, they say. Please... You and your guild are famous around here, so please help the old man out. We did nothing to deserve this.

They say the orcs’ camp is in the Scarlet Forest in the east, and the Waterfolk’s lair is behind the mountains, to the east of the Wild Orcs' Camp

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Orcs and Gills are dead? What a relief. I’ll handle the delivery.

goal.en: Obtain 50 large monster heads.

startText.en:
We need blades by Wednesday, they said. We need armor by Tuesday, they said. I’m not a sorceress! I’m a blacksmith! I can’t conjure armor and weapons out of thin air!

Bloody orcs are out hunting. Ore is mined in the mountains, to the east from here, and these animals want to get their hands on some good iron.

But we both know what I’m asking, right? Oh, no. I’m asking you not to get the iron back, but to stick my swords up their... A lady shouldn’t really speak like that.

They say the orcs’ camp is in the Scarlet Forest in the east, and the Waterfolk’s lair is behind the mountains, to the east of the Wild Orcs' Camp

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en:
Amazing...

If they decided to storm us... we’d be in big trouble. It’s great you’ve dealt with them already.

goal.en: Obtain 5 dangerous monster heads.

startText.en:
The locals say they saw huge creatures near the fortress. There's an orcs' camp in the north, so that must have been mountain trolls. They say orcs often use them as siege weapons.

But what's worse, the Waterfolk are also employing something really big, and I overlooked that somehow. Their camp is in the east.

Please find that "something" before it attacks our fortress! And deal with the trolls while you're at it. We don't want to get showered with rocks at night, do we?

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: So big! I’m sure it was a hard fight. Is everyone alright?

goal.en: Obtain a June Reactor.

startText.en:
Do you hear it? Listen... That's from underground. The ground is shaking every couple of hours. As though there's something living down there. And you know what? There probably is.

I saw a trail in the east that lead to the old ruins. I'd swear there was an underground tunnel, and the ruins looked a lot like a June temple.

June Golems are an inexhaustible source of energy for our mechanisms. If my guesses are correct, we must find and destroy the golem without damaging the energy reactor! It must be kept intact. It would greatly help our constructors, and I'd be able to sleep at night.

checkText.en: May the lucky Moon shine upon you, kylys!

finishText.en:
Here you are! The smell of victory and blood surrounds you - the smell of triumph! Today you’re the hero of your tribe! I mean, the League, eysh!

Rejoice in your victory, fill your cup with sweet wine, and taste the most delicious foods! You have deserved it, kylys.

goal.en: Win 3 rating combats - 3x3 or 6x6.

startText.en:
The best warriors are honored by their whole Branch! When the sun rolls down behind the horizon, and the world is shrouded in the sweet smells of the night, Pridens light up their ritual fires which signify the start of the final combats.

The best of the best enter the ring! Fighting each other is an honor for all of them. This is the combat of the mightiest. The combat of equals!

You are one of them now. Go, kylys, and bring us victory!

checkText.en: Your allies are the key to your victory, kylys!

finishText.en:
Yes! Your allies are the key to your victory, kylys!

I hope your training was helpful. Glorious and terrible combats await you.

goal.en: Win 5 practice combats - 3x3 or 6x6.

startText.en:
Can you feel that smell, kylys? The smell of freshly mowed grass, of the northern wind - and sword steel! The Season of Blood is coming - our ancient Priden tournament. The best warriors of all Branches gather and practice their martial skills. Because practice is crucial however strong you are!

Now we are bringing the Season of Blood to the rest of Sarnaut, eysh! Everyone who thinks themself to be a great warrior should learn to fight side by side with their allies!

Are you ready to learn the lesson of the Season of Blood, zoor?

goal.en: Defeat a powerful enemy on an Astral Allod of the actual sector.

name.en: Not a Day without Reward: Conquering the Astral

goal.en: Kill 30 Demons in Astral Hunt.

name.en: Not a Day without Reward: Terror of the Demons

goal.en: Win in a 3x3 or 6x6 combat.

name.en: Not a Day without Reward: Dueler

goal.en: Complete any Distortion.

name.en: Not a Day without Reward: Distortion

goal.en: Earn victory in any Skirmish.

name.en: Not a Day without Reward: Skirmish

goal.en: Use Tools to convert 10 Enchanted Shards or measures of Matter of the actual sector.

name.en: Not a Day without Reward: Reverse Development

goal.en: Transform equipment on the Anvil of Artifacts.

name.en: Not a Day without Reward: Transformation

goal.en: Win Goblinball match.

name.en: Not a Day without Reward: Goblinball

goal.en: Kill an enemy character in the Kingdom of Elements.

name.en: Not a Day without Reward: Old Feud

startText.en: Every hero who has Astral Keys receives one Box with Loot as a reward on a daily basis. To stop receiving these quests, speak with the Relic Master at the Astral Academy.

A daily single-player quest from the Relic Master. You can abandon it once a day in order to take another one.

This quest will be completed automatically once you complete all the requirements.

Talk to the Relic Master in the Astral Academy to stop receiving these daily quests.

finishText.en: Great, you have your first Artifact. Remember: they last a limited time and need to be replaced at some point.

goal.en: Приобрести любой Артефакт Героев

kickText.en: Good job, now you know where to get Artifacts...

startText.en:
Пришло время обратить внимание на обычные Артефакты, творения Великих Магов, способные даровать тебе дополнительные особенности.

Нам доступны их астральные копии, постепенно теряющие свою силу слепки с изначального прототипа.

Артефакты делятся на артефакты Героев и артефакты Убийц. Первые проявляют свою силу в приключениях, сражениях с разными чудовищами в открытом мире. Вторые окажут тебе помощь с сражении с такими же, как и ты, героями.

Сейчас ты сможешь получить первый из артефактов Героев, купив его у Эрфара Краснобая за Сигнеты Иркаллы, которые можно получить выполняя его задания.

finishText.en: Great, you have your first Artifact. Remember: they last a limited time and need to be replaced at some point.

kickText.en: Good job, now you know where to get Artifacts...

finishText.en:
Great, this is a first and very important step.

Thanks to heroes and explorers, new Draconic Aspect items are constantly being discovered, so don't forget to change your outdated equipment to new one.

goal.en: Acquire any Draconic Aspect item

kickText.en: Good job, now you know where to get Draconic Aspect items.

startText.en:
Драконы – обладают великой силой, с этим никто не будет спорить. Долгие века на них вели охоту, сначала джуны, а затем и Великие Маги. Существовал целый Орден охотников на драконов, представителем которого был, возможно тебе знакомый, укротитель Арат.

Они хотели похитить силы драконов… и часто им это удавалось. Так были созданы могущественные артефакты, известные как драконьи реликвии.

Теперь эти силы нужно получить и тебе.

Самый простой способ – покупка у Эрфара Краснобая за Сигнеты Иркаллы, которые можно получить выполняя его задания.

Добудь одну из таких Драконьих реликвий и твоё обучение будет завершено.

finishText.en:
Great, this is a first and very important step.

Thanks to heroes and explorers, new Draconic Aspect items are constantly being discovered, so don't forget to change your outdated equipment to new one.

goal.en: Acquire any Draconic Aspect item

kickText.en: Good job, now you know where to get Draconic Aspect items.

checkText.en: The process of upgrading equipment is quite simple. But keep in mind that nothing in life comes easy. To get really good equipment, you have to work for it.

finishText.en: Easy, right? Now that you know this, the task of getting the desired equipment won't seem as daunting.

goal.en: Learn to use Hero's Insignias to upgrade your equipment.

startText.en:
It's one thing to craft equipment. Another is to bring it to perfection. We all have development potential, and so does your equipment.

It's simple - the stats of your equipment can be increased with the help of Hero's Insignias. If you carefully examine your equipment, you will notice that each item has its own percentage of effectiveness. 100% is great, but the maximum that can be reached is 115%. To reach the desired percentage, you need to find the corresponding Hero's Insignia.

You're wondering how to get those, right? The most obvious but not the easiest way is to go on adventures to the astral allods of increased difficulty. They can be unlocked using a Hero's Compass. Not everyone can handle this kind of danger.

There's another alternative: accumulating the required amount of material and creating the Hero's Insignia on the anvil. How? Listen carefully:

To craft a Hero’s Insignia, you need Enchanted Dust and Amalgam. Enchanted Dust can be obtained by converting Enchanted Matter using tools. It can be obtained by helping in adventures on astral allods and by completing Distortions.

Amalgam can be acquired by converting Drops of Amalgam that are earned in Skirmishes, Tka-Rik's Cave, or obtained by completing special alchemical quests. Once you have all the components, use the Anvil of Artifacts. You will be able to create the insignia in the appropriate section. To upgrade a piece of equipment, use a Hero's Insignia on the item.

Let's try and create a Hero's Insignia.

checkText.en: Ah, youngsters... We have to explain everything to you! Back in the day, we learned it all by trial and error. And we're still alive and kicking, as you can see. All limbs are accounted for. Ah, well...

finishText.en: Great, now you have gods' power in your hands. Use it wisely.

goal.en: Create the Gods' Legacy artifact.

startText.en:
Gods' Legacy is a powerful item that could be created after other worlds were discovered - when it became clear that they were inhabited by numerous gods. Gods' Legacy is a concentration of their power that's scattered throughout the worlds. It gives you a small glimpse of their might.

If you create this artifact, you will gain great power! It's an opportunity you can't pass up.

goal.en: Upgrade the Gods' Legacy artifact.

checkText.en: Ah, youngsters... We have to explain everything to you! Back in the day, we learned it all by trial and error. And we're still alive and kicking, as you can see. All limbs are accounted for. Ah, well...

finishText.en: See? The artifact has become even more powerful. You can continue to improve it!

goal.en: Upgrade the Gods' Legacy artifact.

name.en: Gods' Legacy is becoming more powerful!

startText.en:
Gods' Legacy can become even more powerful!

You can increase the level of the artifact using the same Elixirs and Gifts of Dreams that used to create Gift of the First - the components that can improve Gods' Legacy. The higher the artifact's level, the more materials you will need.

To increase the level from 1 to 10, you will need 1 Gift of the First.

To increase the level from 10 to 20, you will need 2 Gifts of the First.

To increase the level from 20 to 30, you will need 3 Gifts of the First.

To increase the level from 30 to 40, you will need 4 Gifts of the First.

To increase the level from 40 to 100, you will need 5 Gifts of the First.

See? It's simple. Just takes some time.

checkText.en: You have the matter?

finishText.en: Wonderful, synthesis will begin immediately.

goal.en: Obtain five units of Matter of Creation

startText.en:
This is where our work begins.

Every day I can process only five crystals, because I’m no longer connected to the Architect network and I’m not as strong as they are.

Bring me Matter of Creation, and I’ll turn it into a red meteorite for you.

Matter of Creation is an extremely rare ingredient, but it can be found in various parts of Sarnaut. Follow events around the world. If someone insignificant gets their hands on the Matter, I advise you to take it from them for the sake of the common good. We need it more.

We’ll need 105 units of meteorite - then we’ll be able to create your Stronghold.

Здравствуй, ! Давненько мы с тобой не виделись. Хоть и говорила я, чтоб ты ко мне больше не заглядывала, что, если снова явишься сюда, то приём уже другой будет, всё-таки призываю я тебя по нужде.

Дело в том, что изменилось что-то в самой земле, за которой следить я поставлена. Мало того, что разбит наш мир, расколот на части, аллодами называемые, так ещё и ныне с иных звёзд до нас свет долетает, смуту и волнения приносит.

Вот и мои питомцы, малахитовые ящерки, как не свои в последние времена. Разбрелись, разошлись по всему миру, а тропы у них свои, тайные.

Боюсь в беду попадут малышки, нужно их поймать. В награду одарю тебя каменьями драгоценными, не пожалею малахитов. Прибудь как можно скорее.

checkText.en: Catching pets is an extremely interesting activity.

finishText.en: You will be able to tame pets in all corners of the endless Sarnaut.

goal.en: Arrive at Tatiana Dubinskaya's pet exhibition.

startText.en: The letter asks you to come to Eljune Bazaar on Eljune and find Tatiana Dubinskaya.

finishText.en:
Haha, isn't my daughter clever?

I hope you understand the reason behind all this.

Anyway, I think you've found everything you were looking for. And I'm going to give you a consolation prize, of course.

You can go now. It's time for me to return to my case. In the tavern.

goal.en: See who wins the bet with Nihaz

startText.en: Let's see who wins the bet, shall we?

finishText.en: Well, the rules are set, let's begin.

goal.en: Find a way to take Ath-Zak's Spark from Nihaz

startText.en:
Ugh, I finally got myself to you. Wasn't it a brilliant idea to mail myself in a letter? It's better than having to find a ride. Or going on foot! I'm not a horse, you know.

What are you staring at? Do you think I was all comfy? Think again.

Alright, , listen up. I don't have all day. You're a hero, right?

I know you are. Well, and I am not!

There's something that's been tormenting me, I can't stand it anymore. My friend's Spark is in the hands of this bastard! You get special treatment from Nihaz. Everybody knows that, even the ghosts. I'm telling you, if you show up and ask for Zak's Spark, he's going to give it to you right away. Well, maybe not right away... So, anyway. We'll see.

If you don't do what I say, I'll show up every night and howl over your bed while you sleep.

What are you waiting for? Kingdom come?

finishText.en:
Huh, I hope, you realize now that Junes' fate was their own fault?

Their success depended on the dragon blood, the borrowed force that failed to help them against the Curse of their own Creator.

The Great Mage Tka-Rik? What a whiner. After everything that happened to the Junes, he put the blame on himself, felt remorse, and condemned himself to centuries of imprisonment under Gipat mountains. But his heritage survived. The elves have awakened to find a lot of Junes' artifacts, including those of blood magic. It turned up badly. Over time, the hit upon the idea of trying the dragon blood.

This is how they got their own Great Mages, who trained Skrakan, who trained the others, and finally, you all nearly destroyed the world by shattering it to pieces.

Say thanks for all this to Tka-Rik and his thirst for revenge.

goal.en: Find Tka-Rik's spark on Asee-Teph

startText.en:
Tka-Rik, or Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic, the greatest June mage, first of the Great Mages...

His Revelation was interesting, wasn't it? How did you like learning the mysteries of the world? Oh, I put a lot of effort into staging the Performance to open your eyes to Sarn's lies.

The Great Mage found his death in his cave. He fell to Sarn's demons' hands on the night that you refer to as the Night of Astral Portals. It's only the end of his story. How did it begin?

Let's remember the dragons. The guards of Sarn's prison, watching him on my order. Dragons are obedient. The time has no power over them. They were fulfilling their duty for millions of years. But everything changed when a small ship carrying the Absolute Order got in trouble in the middle of nowhere.

The Ship is falling on Sarnaut. It explodes in a dazzling flash somewhere high. Several dragons fall down, killed by shrapnel. The prison is breached. The prisoner makes a move.

He has a crafty plan, and it takes dragons a while to understand what's going on. Everything becomes clear when people come to this world. Dragons begin their war... the war to destroy all Sarn's creations.

Do you want to know what happened next? Retrace the footsteps of the ancient war. Explore Asee-Teph. Start from the place where there were rivers of blood. This is where you can find a thread to pull and unravel the mystery.

finishText.en:
You have found Luja-Gialla's Spark! Did you like the story? A real tragedy, isn't it?

Sarn created a number of races, trying to make ideal terminators. It was fun to ruin his plans! All it took was telling the Junes what they will face after the last dragon's death! Poor Sarn! He never expected them to renounce their vows! He cursed them in anger, and it was a very strong Curse. He regretted it later, of course, but I didn't let him interfere.

This is a truly beautiful story. Some of them gave up their essence and stop being Junes. Others flee.

Tka-Rik really managed to hold off the Curse during that battle. He also cast the relocation spell that saved the survivors from the Jakala Ruins. They were out of his sight for years.

The runaways were hiding from the Curse, weakened by the battle, for centuries. From time to time it picked up their trail, killed some of them... but others managed to flee. Yes, Luja-Gialla and Ath-Zak are their descendants.

Do you wish to know how Tka-Rik came to be the Great Mage and the Bane of the Fire Dragons? That's a whole different story.

goal.en: Find Luja-Gialla's Spark on Eljune.

startText.en:
Oh, Eljune...

Do you remember the adorable ruins? That's all that was left of the great June civilization. And they were smarter than us. It was hard enough for you to kill two dragons, but Junes defeated eight Great Dragons and a few smaller ones. Junes are gone now. Do you think someone would run around the ruins of your cities, wondering what happened to you?

Let's get to the point. A very curious adventure seeker was here, very curious about the Junes' death. She was logging her findings. Somebody stole her log, torn it apart, and scattered the pages all over Eljune. Find her notes and take her path, and you could find Luja-Gialla's Spark!

What to start with? Well, I can tell you that whoever stole her log, got what they deserved! Balancing between the League and Imperial troops is dangerous. He's food to ravens now.

finishText.en:
Hahaha! You really thought I was hiding the Sparks? Or giving them to someone else? Come on now, it isn't our first game. How could you be so naive?

If I simply wanted to destroy you, why would I waste so much time? Are you really dumb enough to think that your actions bear no consequences?

I hope you've seen and learned enough. The Junes. The Zem. They've made their choices. Who is to blame if the choice is wrong, except for themselves? Do you understand now? Perhaps, not everything is lost for you!

But that's enough. Let's see who wins the bet, shall we?

goal.en: Find Ath-Zak's spark on Coba Plateau.

startText.en:
The time has come for our final game in these lands.

If you only knew how hard it is to stage Performances for you! Actors never stick to the script, prop master spoil the props...

I had to put in a lot of effort to stage a small Performance for someone whose Spark you're going to be looking for. Starting a rumor on Suslanger that there are meteorites in the Futile Lands... Whispering to Kanian degraded descendants on Gipat that the Chosen One appears in the old ruins, according to an old legend... And finally, setting the weakened Curse after the last Junes...

Ath-Zak's Spark wasn't all that valuable for me after all. A crafty thief once stole it. I won't tell you when it happened or who he was, but here's a generous hint. This is a fragment of his letter, when he was going to Coba Plateau...

finishText.en:
Well, that's it... The traveler has found his way. It's time you found yours.

Who knows, you might find another mysterious note in your pocket some day...

goal.en: Find all Centaur the Traveler's notes on Ammer

startText.en:
Heavenly Eye insists her brother never planned to leave Ammer, but the call of adventure was too strong. He's either beyond the border, or his dead body rests somewhere on the green meadows of the Aoidoi land.

In either case, you should start looking for him around. He liked to keep record of his adventures. His notes might contain the necessary information.

finishText.en: May the winds be fair, Stormbringer! I didn't hope you would condescend to me.

goal.en: Hear out the huntress in the Centaur Camp on Ammer.

startText.en:
Greetings, Stormbringer! My name is Heavenly Eye. I'm one of the hunters of the Spiral Ridge.

The tribe respects your strength and wisdom. All the moons of this world favor you. I understand that my problem is undeserving of such honor, but I hope that luck will be with me. After all, the Well won't swallow me for just one question.

My brother has gone missing. He went hunting two moons ago, and I haven't seen him since.

My heart is restless. I can feel it, something bad has happened! I have no one to turn to for help! I tried searching myself, but in vain.

Please, find me in the Centaur Camp on the Spiral Ridge if you think you can help me.

Have a swift ride,

Heavenly Eye.

finishText.en:
The ink dried up and a new text appeared in their place, summarizing the discovered entries:

"The first four worlds became the source of materials for the creation of the rest of the worlds. The All-Mother and Father Time created the gods who were entrusted with the preservation and protection of these worlds. And each god had the same name as their world."

goal.en: Find echoes of power

startText.en: This must be what Cosmos was talking about. It looks like you will have to work hard to find the other records.

finishText.en:
The last records magically changed again:

"These four worlds were created next. Each of them embodied the principle that ruled other worlds.

Subsequently, the power of Enod and Inis spread throughout the universe, and Sherk waged a relentless and fruitless war against them.

Only Ossu remained forgotten, and the power over the Darkness was not claimed by anyone. Eventually it had a new master, but that happened much later."

goal.en: Find echoes of power

startText.en: It won't be easy to understand the records. You should keep searching.

finishText.en:
Once again, the records were rewritten by a mysterious force:

"The last four inner worlds served as the pillars of the entire system of the universe.

From that moment, the Great Gods, the children of the All-Mother and Father Time, set out to create the worlds of the outer circle.

They were countless, and their appearance was infinitely diverse, but each of the new worlds carried particles of the original ones."

goal.en: Find Echoes of Power

startText.en: It's getting more and more interesting! Who knows where it's going?

finishText.en:
Curious...

I should tell Cosmos about the records.

goal.en: Find the last Echo of Power

startText.en:
Your inner voice tells you there is one element missing from the puzzle. Some kind of explanation that will help you understand the notes.

You need to find it.

finishText.en:
Another addressee got interested? Very, very well. The customer base is growing!

Let me tell you more about the exchange.

goal.en: Visit Semer Dinar at Yasker's Tower in Nezebgrad.

startText.en:
The advertising booklet abounds with colorful promises of untold wealth and flowery bureaucratese explaining how the Free Traders again are planning to benefit from other people's endeavor.

Anyway, it is something worth taking a look at! I should stop by that Negotiant and see what he offers.

finishText.en:
Whoa, look who's here! I am extremely flattered that you came here for a trade, but I swear on my purse, I cannot allow a discount. That would get me fired!

But at least I can tell you about our marvelous exchange.

goal.en: Visit Thaler de Pluie in Novograd.

Treasure Hunting is on! Don't waste a minute! Holiday Committee Officials have plenty of Prophetic Cards and Ancient Compasses for the heroes of Sarnaut!

Find Zinaida Krichalkina and ask whether Holiday Committee Officials have any special assignments for you.

checkText.en:
Aha! This is a truly unique prototype. There are but a few like them in our entire fleet! So you've lucked out. Shall we get to it, then?
To upgrade the hull, just select it for work in the hangar and speak to me.

finishText.en:
Congratulations!
Now your ship's hull is a true marvel of engineering genius! You can now add cannons to the upper deck and, best of all, resolve the issue of enemy pursuit by installing some on the aft side.
Not to mention your new hull is much more attractive. There are only a handful of ships like yours in our entire fleet!

goal.en: Bring the hull upgrade module to the master shipbuilder in the hangar. Don't forget to disengage your ship beforehand!

startText.en:
The module instructions read as follows: "This model includes a set of tools and calculations that allow one to modify a ship's hull, creating additional portholes and new cannon mounts for top deck and aft side cannons. This new module also makes significant improvements to the hull's aesthetics.
Do not try to install this module yourself! Go visit a certified specialist, a master shipbuilder. The upgrades are made as quickly as possible (practically instantaneously) and will last throughout all subsequent hull model upgrades."

checkText.en: Hello. Are you looking for souvenirs, too? In that case, I must ask you for your certificate. And remember, the gift is available only if you have a ship. If not, you'll simply have to wait until you've had one built.

finishText.en:
Let's see, everything's signed, the seal is in place... Good. You can choose from third-generation equipment or decorations.
The first prize is a set of modified third-gen equipment: cannons, shields, reactor, motor, and helm. These will allow you to explore the third layer and, with a little luck, even the fourth!
If your ship is already well-equipped or if you choose to decorate it first, then take two ship coupons and an excellent statue made by elven artisans.

goal.en: Collect your prize from the master shipbuilder in the hangar. If you still do not have an astral ship, build one.

startText.en: This certificate allows the captain bearing it to receive equipment or decorations for their ship. You can choose your prize from the master shipbuilder in the hangar.

finishText.en:
Interesting... According to this document, you can choose third-generation equipment or decorations for your ship.
The first prize is a set of modified third-generation equipment: cannons, shields, reactor, motor, and helm. These will allow you to explore the third layer or even the fourth, although that will be more challenging.
If your ship is already well-equipped or if you choose to decorate it first, then take two ship coupons and an excellent statue made by elven artisans.

startText.en: This certificate allows the captain bearing it to choose from a selection of equipment or decorations for their ship. You can collect your prize from the master shipbuilder in the hangar.

checkText.en: So we have a deal?

finishText.en: That's nice! Now you can switch to the ship remodeling mode and decorate your flagship like a royal castle!

goal.en: Bring 1 ship coupon and 2 platinum coins to the Ship Equipment Master.

startText.en: Hey captain! We need to talk. We received a small lot of various elven ship decorations at the warehouse. Beauty's unspeakable! I would have bought everything myself, but I have no ship. But if you want, I can issue a permit to buy elven goods. For quite low prices! All it'll take is one Ship Coupon and a few platinum coins for customs duties. And your ship will glare like an elven galleon castle!

checkText.en: So we have a deal?

finishText.en: Great! You can now switch to ship customization mode and transform your ship into a flying mausoleum or a research lab!

goal.en: Bring 3 Ship Coupons to Ship Device Master

startText.en:
Hey captain! Would you like to decorate your ship a bit? Then I've got a proposition for you!
Not long ago our strike squadron boarded a state-of-the-art Imperial corvette near the Imperial Archipelagos. The prototype is equipped with technological novelties made by the Arisen from stem to stern! The military immediately snatched all the guns, shields, and other equipment for themselves. They classified and disassembled it all. As for decorations taken off the captured ship - projectors, lamps and the like - they're just collecting dust in my warehouse.
For a purely symbolic price of three ship coupons, I'll issue you a permit to buy these trophy gadgets.

goal.en: Complete the astral island Metalville in the actual sector 10 times.

finishText.en:
What kind of brutes are you? Look, you've killed every single person in here! Now their Sparks are scattered all over the Astral! Where shall I find them, eh?
Oh, whatever, they'll come running as soon as they need more gold, anyway. I thought, may be I should stay here, now that the stronghold is vacant.
Here's your reward. Thanks for your aid.

goal.en: Kill all the prisoners and Miroslav Kramolsky.

startText.en:
Look who's here! Wait, wasn't it you who put me to prison? No? Ah, whatever.
We've got a riot here, so I'm off. If you want to stay, it's none of my business.
The White Knight, Miroslav Kramolsky was imprisoned here. His Imperial friends arrived and started shooting this and that, in order to free him and stir the League a bit.
What they didn't know, is that Kramolsky'd got tangled with the evil. Once he's broken free, he trapped everyone's soul in the prison. I was the only one to escape - my soul'd been captured by the gold long ago. So everyone else serves him now.
You know what? I've still got a business deal here. There are some guys who owe me money, and Kramolsky now possesses their souls. Will you kill them and free their Sparks? And then kill Kramolsky, too. Deal? I'll pay you gold!

checkText.en: Hello!

finishText.en: Congratulations! Choose your present!

goal.en: Receive a present from Zinaida Krichalkina in Nezebgrad.

startText.en:
The bottom of an empty chest contains a greeting card:
"Dear hero! Your path was difficult and great are your accomplishments. Your glory will not fade for centuries! Your deeds are forever recorded into the history of Sarnaut, and for this anniversary we would like to present you with a gift, a rare glyph. You can select a glyph from the Holiday Committee Official, Zinaida Krichalkina.
We congratulate you on this celebration and wish you all the best!"

checkText.en: Hello!

finishText.en: Congratulations! Choose your present!

goal.en: Receive a present from Valya Skomorokhova in Novograd.

The bottom of an empty chest contains a greeting card:
"Dear hero! Your path was difficult and great are your accomplishments. Your glory will not fade for centuries! Your deeds are forever recorded into the history of Sarnaut, and for this anniversary we would like to present you with a gift, a rare glyph. You can select a glyph from the Holiday Committee Official, Valya Skomorokhova.
We congratulate you on this celebration and wish you all the best!"

checkText.en: What's our status?

finishText.en:
It's... an egg.

It can't be real! Is it truly the Great Dragon's egg? Or is there something never-seen-before inside? Where has the egg come from? How could the Great Mages of Sarnaut miss it?

All this is very disturbing, Keeper.

What's even more disturbing, is the fact that the hostile bunch of demons is aware of it now. If they are even guessing what treasure is in your hands... We will have to deal with a full-scale invasion soon.

goal.en: Capture Demon Prowler.

startText.en:
I have bad news, Keeper. Demon Prowlers are on the allod. These monsters have an infallible gut when it comes to sensing magic... Anyway, it doesn't matter.

The prowlers can find the source way faster than we can, as crazy as it may sound. Our only chance to beat them is to use their own instinct... Killing them all would also buy us some time!

We'll study their memory as well... and that's not all I can do!

checkText.en: Are you done? I can't wait to start the research.

finishText.en:
Well, I would recognize this magic signature anywhere... Keeper, these emanations are not Astral-related.

On the contrary. They were produced by the Great Dragon.

Do you understand what this means? Demons believe that the Dragon hides on your allod. Not Dragon's Spark, like on the Frozen Frontier. Not its remnants, either. Your allod is very young, there's no way it could have such things.

But how could this happen?..

goal.en: Examine Astral emanations over the allod.

startText.en:
Before we find the source, we must study the consequences of your allod's expansion. Did you notice the shining clots of Astral emanations over your allod last night?.. I find them very interesting!

Try studying them yourself. Pegasus will help you reach them.

checkText.en: It means death to them.

finishText.en: Tritogor's grip is strong... Even in the Empire, he has strings to pull at any time. Fortunately, everything worked out well, thanks to your help!

goal.en: Discover and destroy spies that got onto your allod under the cover of darkness.

startText.en:
I'm sorry, Keeper, but your arrival to our lands was noticed. My people report spotting suspicious strangers in the night. They definitely came from somewhere else. I'm afraid, Tritogor hired spies to sabotage things here.

Creating a full-scale militia will take time, and the spies have to go right now!

checkText.en: Is Nimross dead yet?

finishText.en:
Demons took interest in the allod's growth, too. Nimross is trying to look into the nature of this phenomenon... pretty smart for a demon! Something is telling me it's not the last time we hear about him.

Frankly, I don't think he died. There's something unusual about his Astral nature. I can still feel his mental presence.

goal.en: Track down and destroy Nimross.

startText.en:
I heard about your alliance with the demons, Keeper. Many would consider your decision crazy... but I can see a potential.

Not all demons are eager to meet you halfway. My agents report spotting hostile demons at the allod's borders. One of them, a demon sorcerer of considerable might, blatantly interfered into your allod's magosphere. It is an ephemeral shell, which helps the Great Mage deter... However, I don't think it's something you care about now.

You should take into account, though, that such interference may affect the life on the allod. Astral streams brought me the name of this demon. It's Nimross.

We must repel him.

checkText.en: It means death to them.

finishText.en: Tritogor's grip is solid. Even Aidenus's personal guards got under his influence. Fortunately, everything is fine thanks to you.

goal.en: Discover and destroy spies that got onto your allod under the cover of darkness.

startText.en:
I'm sorry, Keeper, but your arrival to our lands was noticed. My people report spotting suspicious strangers in the night. They definitely came from somewhere else. I'm afraid, Tritogor hired spies to sabotage things here.

Creating a full-scale militia will take time, and the spies have to go right now!

checkText.en: Have you visited the hall yet?

finishText.en:
It's very spacious. New curtains would be nice, but it's okay.

I'll be right here if you don't mind, Keeper.

goal.en: Go upstairs to the hall of your private allod.

startText.en: I had no idea goblins could build such a nice castle. I wonder who designed it.

checkText.en: Have you found out anything?

finishText.en:
Your allod is expanding, he says? Is that all they care about? It means I was mistaken. They're not Tritogor's minions. How could he let me go just like that?

Nevertheless, this information is important. Such anomalies don't appear all by themselves. What are the limits of its growth? Will the land that appears be fit for life? I have so many questions... Pardon my scientific interest.

goal.en: Interrogate the prisoner and find out about their objectives.

startText.en: I must admit, your combat skills... surprised me. My people arrested one of the scouts. He is imprisoned in your catacombs now. I thought you might want to question him personally.

checkText.en: Have you finished, Keeper?

finishText.en:
What we managed to find out is that the source of expansion is evidently somewhere around... It is a physical object, not an ephemeral substance, as it often happens when it comes to Astral magic.

Believe me, I've seen plenty of spirits, incarnations, pseudo-gods, and even animated ideas in my life... I've had enough.

goal.en: Use the Demonic Portal of Nimross

startText.en:
Like almost any demon, Nimross is mentally linked to his "pack" leader. However, I don't feel the leader's presence anywhere near, which actually gave me an idea...

The portal that Nimross supported was probably used not only for teleportation, but also for communicating with his lord. We could use it before it fades. It's pretty easy if you know how. The demonic magic is rather primitive.

Keeper, I can teach you magic decryption so you can use this portal.

checkText.en: What's our status?

finishText.en:
It's... an egg.

It can't be real! Is it truly the Great Dragon's egg? Or is there something never-seen-before inside? Where has the egg come from? How could the Great Mages of Sarnaut miss it?

All this is very disturbing, Keeper.

What's even more disturbing, is the fact that the hostile bunch of demons is aware of it now. If they are even guessing what treasure is in your hands... We will have to deal with a full-scale invasion soon.

checkText.en: Got to hurry! Talk to you later!

finishText.en:
Victory! The victory is ours, Keeper.

The demons confirmed our guess. So it really is the Dragon... It's amazing.

I have no clue how it got here, other than by our own ships. I also have no idea how it got on board. Who brought it to the allod from the ship? Was this someone's idea, or is the egg capable of... guising itself?

What else can it do? I know nothing about the Great Dragons... How fast do they grow? What do they eat? What does it portend for us all?

Oh... Well, it was a long day. I will study it tomorrow. In the meantime, it's time to have rest. Fighting together with you is an honor, Keeper.

goal.en: Defend your private allod from demonic invasion.

startText.en:
Keeper! There's a demonic army at our gates. The walls are standing, but our only hope is to strike back before the fortress collapses!

I took the liberty of calling the reinforcements. Mercenary leader, my old friend Alexander Kuzmin, will arrive together with his team. Talk to him if you need help.

Good luck, Keeper. I hope to see you after the battle.

checkText.en: You're still here? Our ruler's patience is not infinite!

finishText.en: Wonderful! The assault was carried out! I will inform the mistress of your success! For now, accept your reward: the signets of our mistress which can be exchanged for useful goods.

goal.en: Earn 50 points of Hirkalla's favor by participating in the assault on the Wandering Island, then report back to Erfar the Bragger.

name.en: Hirkalla's Decree: Assault on the Wandering Island

startText.en:
The ruler of Sarnaut has issued a decree: the heroes must come to the place known as the Wandering Island where they will assist the cultists of Sarn who are waging an endless battle against the wayward Wormfaces and Draconids.

Hirkalla the Darkest sees what mortals cannot see: in the final battles of the Great War that is coming, the cultists will play their role. Most of all, she wishes to protect the shard of great power that rests next to the Palace Square, for it is the key to the coming triumph of mortals in battle with the insidious gods of Light and Order.

Go there, help the commanders - Dmitri Gromov and Goliath, then capture the Palace Square.

checkText.en: The mistress's orders have not been carried out yet? How dare you anger her?

finishText.en: Wonderful! The battle is over! It does not matter who won. I will inform the mistress of your success! For now, accept your reward: the signets of our mistress which can be exchanged for useful goods.

goal.en: Earn 50 points of Hirkalla's favor by participating in the Battle for Ambrosia in Eden, then report back to Erfar the Bragger.

startText.en:
The ruler of Sarnaut has issued a decree: the heroes must go to Eden where they can help either the Great Mage Felix or the All-Mother's Children.

Hirkalla the Darkest is wise and sees what is not visible to you: with each battle, the Children of Eden are moving further and further away from the path that the All-Mother has set for them. Faced with death, they rebel, refusing to accept it. Thus, they are getting closer to accepting the truth of Nihaz. Just like the inhabitants of Sarnaut who hone their skills and gain Ambrosia which serves the development of your world. So let the flames of war burn, as our goddess commands.

Go there and fight: either for the Expedition or for the Children.

checkText.en: I left Suslanger a long time ago, and that old Jinn is still there.

finishText.en: Wonderful! The storm is over, and the treasures have found their owners! But many more treasures still lie under the sands, and malicious Ifrits continue to guard them. We will deal with them later, but for now, take what you have earned - our mistress's signets which can be exchanged for the goods you need.

goal.en: Earn 50 points of Hirkalla's favor by opening treasures during the Storm on Suslanger, then report back to Erfar the Bragger.

startText.en:
The ruler of Sarnaut has issued a decree: the heroes should travel to Suslanger where, during a sandstorm, they must find as many of Nezeb's treasures as possible.

Hirkalla the Darkest is generous, and it gives her pleasure to see her subjects acquire more and more new treasures. The stronger you become, the more power you will represent when the false gods of Light and Order appear in this world. And though the weak will fall along the way, the rest will become much stronger.

Go there and look for treasures.

checkText.en: The worm is still alive! Do not disappoint our ruler!

finishText.en: Wonderful! The worm is dead and the Orcs of the Landfill are celebrating yet another victory. Of course, Uro-Boros will rise again, but for now, take what you have earned - the signets of our lady, which can be exchanged for the goods you need.

goal.en: Earn 50 points of Hirkalla's favor by participating in the Hunt for Uro-Boros on Suslanger, then report back to Erfar the Bragger.

startText.en:
The ruler of Sarnaut has issued a decree: the heroes must travel to Suslanger and participate in the hunt for the great worm - Uro-Boros!

Hirkalla the Darkest is prudent: she foresees that in the future the heroes still have to fight monsters on the paths between the worlds. Therefore, the battle with this worm Uro-Boros will be a good training for future challenges. Now Reya the Merciless is waiting for you, ready to announce another hunt. Only those who have passed the trial of the desert will be able to join the army of the Darkest Goddess.

Go there and join the Orcs of the Landfill to slay this worm!

checkText.en: The Darkest Mistress does not tolerate tardiness! Neither do I, her loyal servant.

finishText.en:
Didn't expect that, did you, ? It's amazing how things turn out! Rags for some, riches for others. And that's just the beginning - mark my word. Mistress Hirkalla will shake up our whole world and rebuild it in her own way. Life will change for the better!

Especially for those who died a long time ago, hehe... Times are changing, . They are changing.

From now on you will receive our ruler's decrees from me every day. And acquire appropriate rewards - but the amount is limited, so choose wisely. Mistress loves order.

goal.en: Ask Erfar the Bragger about Hirkalla's decrees.

startText.en:
Hello there, hero! Chosen One!

We already know each other, so I see no point in introducing myself. I will say the following: as soon as Mistress appeared in our world, I immediately found her and offered my services. And now we expect service from you.

If you are dutiful, you will be rewarded. How? I will tell you about it if you are interested...

checkText.en: Mistress values loyalty. Keep it up, and she will generously reward you!

finishText.en:
This is only a small part of the our Darkest Mistress's grace!

Now, in the depths of the astral plane, on the forgotten allod Jigran, a new capital is being built - Dar Ulgorn. Soon its most faithful servants will be able to travel there. Those who were dead will be given new lives!

goal.en: Complete 3 of Hirkalla's Decrees and report back to Erfar the Bragger.

startText.en:
I am Erfar the Bragger, once the headman of the Village on Gipat, and now the viceroy of Hirkalla the Darkest in the League and the Empire. I am ready to offer new tasks to heroes.

You must fulfill at least three of Hirkalla's decrees this week in order to earn Mistress's favor. Those who fulfill them will be generously rewarded! Workpieces for the best equipment and a special currency - symbols of the Darkest One's favor - await the heroes.

checkText.en: Well, do you have a story for the next chronicle chapter?

finishText.en: This... This is unbelievable!

goal.en: Tell about the death of gods to the Keeper of Secrets in Nezebgrad.

startText.en:
Wait, are you telling me that Sarn and the Architect have killed each other in a massive battle? And nothing is threatening Sarnaut anymore? And you want me to believe it without any evidence? Well, like I have a choice...

Luckily, very few people know that gods exist. For most of them, Architects are just insentient creatures from nowhere, and hardly any of them know who Sarn was. If you are telling the truth, and gods exist no more, then it won't really affect the lives of regular folks.

We'll see whether you're telling the truth or not as soon as the Astral storm eases off and we send an expedition to the site of battle. If it all had really happened the way you tell it, then you will be indeed the greatest hero in Sarnaut!

It's not the first time that you save the world, you know. But this time no one should know about it. This is too big. Some will start worshipping you, some will start hating you. This will do none of us any good...

But at least you should speak with Mark Staritsyn - the future generations deserve to know who they owe their lives to.

checkText.en: Well, do you have a story for the next chronicle chapter?

finishText.en: This... This is unbelievable!

goal.en: Tell about the death of gods to the Keeper of Secrets in Novograd.

startText.en:

But at least you should speak with Lovewise Catfish - the future generations deserve to know who they owe their lives to.

checkText.en: Only the strongest of the strongest are allowed to touch the Shrine!

finishText.en:
So you come from the surface... We've been watching you.

You wish to touch our Shrine? Learn the secrets of the Origins? Well, since you've come here, I can assume you know how to do that. The only question is, are you worthy?

goal.en: Enter the Destroyer Temple and defeat their Champion.

startText.en: Behind these gates is the temple of the most powerful Wormface warriors who call themselves the Destroyers. They are mighty enemies, and the power of the Seal Shard makes them deadly. You shouldn't face them on your own. Join a raid, and maybe you will make it out of the sanctuary alive!

checkText.en: Looks like a great battle is upon you. I'm sorry, I will not be a part of it - I don't have the right to risk my life fighting rusty June scrap metal. And also, who else will be there to sing songs about your heroic deeds and pay our last respects to you?

finishText.en:
This thing is huge... I didn't know Junes were that advanced in magic technology. Looks like they built that monstrous thing not long before they were extinct. Alas, it didn't save them from the divine curse.

But we did a good job! Now we have the keys to the Seals, and I can weaken them just enough to let Sarn into our world but not let him destroy it.

goal.en: Defeat Bastion and take the Seal Shard.

startText.en:
I can't believe it... You defeated Teumim. You are strong... I won't stand in the way of the strongest, but I am warning you: what you are looking for, will only bring you trouble. The Bowl of Origins grants power, but in the hands of the unworthy, it can hurl the world into chaos.

In order to be able to touch the Bowl, we spend years in meditation, learning self-control and purifying our minds. The Guard protects the Bowl from those who think they can handle its power without preparing themselves. Do you want to take it? Go ahead! We will bury your crippled bodies in this temple!

checkText.en: Be prepared to anything!

finishText.en: Phew! The Void Dragon... I didn't think anyone could make a creature like this one serve them. I heard that these Dragons live in the Void between the worlds. The Great Dragons who guard Sarn's prison were created in their image. I hope there will be no more surprises like this one.

goal.en: Defeat Sirius, the Guard of the Star Gates, and talk to Klavdia Kalugina.

startText.en:
My father created the Star Gates for his own purposes only. Even I can't bypass the powerful spells that are to designed to kill anyone who tries to travel between the worlds.

I'm sure that with your assistance I will be able to weaken their defense, but be ready to fight. I have no idea what we might face, but I know my father loves surprises. So be prepared to anything!

checkText.en: Well, well... Is it something urgent, or are you just abusing your privilege to meet me without making an appointment?

finishText.en: What happened? The Astral has gone crazy! All magical flows are tied in a knot! We had to stop all mana reactors at XAES in order to avoid reactor reload. I think even village healers felt the enormous surge of energy that ran through the world. I have a feeling that this is why you are here. I hope we're not facing another Cataclysm?!

goal.en: Survive the battle of the Gods and make sure Sarn and the Architect kill each other.

startText.en:
The Gates are about to let one mighty enemy into our world, and the Seals can barely contain the rage of the other one... I'm ashamed to say that, but I'm scared. Very scared! The greatest battle in history is about to unfold in front of our eyes, and I'm trembling like a village girl at the sight of a soldier.

I'm sure my plan will work, but we can't afford to make a single mistake. The gods have to destroy each other. If one of them wins, it will be the end of everything that you know and love. It will be the end of me. So there will be no winners in this battle!

checkText.en: What happened this time?

finishText.en: I can feel that something terrible has happened... Magical flows are insane; the Astral is roaring, and the whole world is cracking under the pressure of a tremendous force! I have a feeling that you have something to do with that. Well, go on, tell me!

goal.en: Survive the battle of the Gods and make sure Sarn and the Architect kill each other.

startText.en:
The Gates are about to let one mighty enemy into our world, and the Seals can barely contain the rage of the other one... I'm ashamed to say that, but I'm scared. Very scared! The greatest battle in history is about to unfold in front of our eyes, and I'm trembling like a village girl at the sight of a soldier.

I'm sure my plan will work, but we can't afford to make a single mistake. The gods have to destroy each other. If one of them wins, it will be the end of everything that you know and love. It will be the end of me. So there will be no winners in this battle!

finishText.en: Gipat is the best place for a meeting. Especially since you visited the Reversed Reality and destroyed "Daddy's" spell that allowed him to control this allod...

goal.en: Visit Klavdia on Gipat

startText.en: It seems that Klavdia Kalugina came up with another plan to battle Nihaz. She invites you to Gipat to tell you about it. It makes sense to visit her as soon as possible. The fate of the world cannot wait!

checkText.en: Where else would Klavdia Kalugina? On Gipat, of course.

finishText.en: Gipat is the best place for a meeting. Especially since you visited the Reversed Reality and destroyed "Daddy's" spell that allowed him to control this allod...

goal.en: Visit Klavdia on Gipat

startText.en:
I'm going to show you a bit of temporal magic. I think they call it a montage at the Dream Factory.

We'll jump ahead in time a little, and I'll tell you what to do next. But if you find something else to do, I won't object. They say the Elves have arranged a Ball there. It's always like this: someone's hard at work, while others are having fun. But I think you should pay them a visit, or else you'll miss a few things.

Just remember: when you want to hear what I plan to do next - find me on Gipat Shard.

checkText.en: Have you found a way to regain your strength?

finishText.en:
I see you have recovered!

I don't even want to know how you did it. Let's finish this.

goal.en: Find a way to recover your strength

startText.en:
We're in the right place, no...?

Even though I'm a ghost, I feel uneasy here... This feeling... as if someone is whispering in millions of different voices. It's unsettling. We can only hope that long months of wandering have not led us to a dummy.

checkText.en: I hope it was not in vain!

finishText.en:
Now we need to use this terminal...

I hope this is what we need. Over the months, I've seen quite a few devices like this. They control Seals. And time travel devices... that hold these Sparks...

goal.en: Get to the data storage

startText.en:
I have prepared for the removal of the barrier - I'm afraid it will take all the remaining strength...

Hopefully Danas, Naira, and Fergard with their undead armies drew the attention of the main forces away. And the demons won't notice us...

checkText.en: Can you believe this? We are so close to our goal!

finishText.en: ...Here is what I saw there.

goal.en: Hack the data storage

startText.en:
Let's finish this...

If the Lord of the Citadel has not detected us yet, then he is probably about to... I can practically feel his gaze.

checkText.en: Let's get started.

finishText.en:
So this... man will help us? Well, that makes our task easier...

Otherwise, we'd have had to climb these mountains for weeks, looking for the June caves. There are hundreds of them, trust me. And the Wormfaces... as you understand, after the events at the Frontier you're not the most popular person among them.

goal.en: Find out more about what happened and about future plans

startText.en:
Don't be upset if you don't understand everything. I'll tell you more in time.

But we still need to discuss certain things - particularly what we're going to do...

checkText.en: What are you doing here?

finishText.en: There you go! We just need to insert them like this, and then calibrate...

goal.en: Get to the portal

startText.en:
You probably want to ask - how are we going to meet later? It's simple. My incarnation, Eladia, is on Suslanger. She is the head of the Gates-3 project. When you reach the city, find her... I mean, me! I'll tell you what we know and what we need to find out.

Now go to the ruins Erfar told you about, and I'll talk to him. Don't worry, he'll reach the place before you.

checkText.en: Return to the memory and reach the end.

finishText.en: Well, you know everything you need now... And more...

goal.en: Reach the end of Klavdia's memory

startText.en: I need you to watch something...

finishText.en: You will need this ability in battle.

goal.en: Meet Ereba in Polis on Ammer

startText.en: Wait... I feel an unusual power in you, my friend. Perhaps... Go to Polis and find our cabbalist, Ereba. I believe you’ll have a lot to discuss.

finishText.en: This Centaur is your friend now.

goal.en: Find all mysterious notes on Ammer.

startText.en: Find all mysterious notes and receive a reward.

checkText.en: Patience, my friend.

finishText.en:
It’s decided.

I foresee that Orders have a power to change this world. Perhaps it will happen soon. Perhaps you and I won’t be there to see it. Who knows? What matters is someone is watching over this world but they stay out of this senseless war between the League and Empire.

goal.en: Listen to Zayan, Catherina, and Klavdia.

startText.en: Let’s go! The Forum is about to start. I’m curious to hear that the brightest minds of Sarnaut have to say.

checkText.en: Or maybe you’d rather be a lone wolf?

finishText.en: So be it. All Aoidoi will be keeping track of your accomplishments - and accomplishments of Orders.

goal.en: Join any of the three Orders and inform Cassandra of your choice.

startText.en: I’m asking you now - what will you choose? I cannot advise you on this - all mages serve a noble cause, and each will have many followers. Will you become one of them?

checkText.en: Hello, my friend.

finishText.en:
Let me add your name to the roster... Done.

The Order can now provide you with supplies. Useful and practical.

goal.en: Meet the master of the Order.

startText.en:
I’m glad it’s an easy choice for you. Going into a fight with a heavy heart makes it all that much difficult. And your mind should be clear.

Some Aoidoi offered to help the Great Mages in organizing their Orders. I believe the master of your Order can supply you with certain resources from the warehouse. I hope you’ll find the assortment to your liking.

goal.en: Receive the reward for help in founding the Order.

startText.en:
Wait a second, I recognize your name. I was ordered to give you certain... starter’s privileges at our warehouse. For, I quote, “your help in founding the Order and protecting Sarnaut.”

Ah well, it’s an order. I have to obey!

checkText.en: Go now! Time is of the essence.

finishText.en:
Thank you, my friend. Our guests have arrived.

Stay with us - this is where the fate of the world is being decided. It’s thanks to you that we’re alive and well - so it’s only fair that you’ll be a witness to our agreement.

goal.en: Tell Zayan, Catherina, and Klavdia Kalugina about Cassandra’s invitation.

startText.en:
Time is pressing, my friend. We need to send a message to the three chosen ones, and you’re the only one I can trust to do that. Go to Avilon, Umoir, and the Isle of Revelation - the lands of the three Mages - and ask them on behalf of the Council to come to Polis.

Here we will decide what to do with the Well’s power.

checkText.en: I’m talking about the Well of Souls, a source of incredible power.

finishText.en:
This is the Council’s decision. Whether it’s wise or rash, only time will tell. We couldn’t do nothing.

Now that you know the truth, there is something I must ask of you.

goal.en: Learn about Council’s decision from Cassandra.

startText.en:
I’ve been waiting for you, my friend. Our brother’s betrayal was hard on all of us, but we can’t succumb to fear and despair. Dominae held a Council at dawn. We came up with a solution.

It’s a honor to hear it before all others. So listen to this.

checkText.en: Why are you just standing there? Are you going to ask me anything?

finishText.en: I know about the events in the future where you save the Sculptor on New Isa right before the end. No matter how much I stare into the future, I see no ways of preventing that. Darkness clouds my vision. But it won’t be the end of the world... There will be survivors. And those who will find a new home. Their life will be like an ancient fairy tale - long and terrifying but with a good ending. This is a story of Horizon... Or survivors and renegades. Of people and gods. Of life and death... Of a hero’s journey...

goal.en: Meet with Unn.

startText.en: Still don’t believe it? Maybe you need to see for yourself? I know someone who can help. You’ll find her near Cosmos’ Observatory...

finishText.en: Greetings, colleague. I've heard a lot about your achievements, and I believe your contribution will help us advance in our research greatly.

goal.en: Talk to Negus Setuteph.

startText.en:
That's right, it's been three days! We have already set up our camp and the pickets around it. You say, it's been only two hours for you? Well, this allod is one big mystery!

And the biggest one is - where did it come from? As far as I know, our leaders were expecting to find some kind of an Astral anomaly here, and not an allod that resembles an exploded volcano. There are just no other allods like this one! Believe me - I've seen many of them.

I'm not authorized to give you orders, but your help would be highly appreciated. Our scientists just can't handle all those mysteries. Talk to Negus Setuteph, maybe, you'll figure some of them out.

checkText.en: So, was I right? Is there actually a Site of Power?

finishText.en: Ha! I knew I could rely on you - thanks to my prism and your sword, we must have really upset the League sorcerers... And now they will most probably attempt to take that Site of Power away from us.

goal.en: Capture the Site of Power and return to Ilya Glibin.

startText.en:
Listen, I want to tell you about my observations.

I was charting the magic flows of this allod the other day, and I discovered a curious pattern: the flows cross each other in several places, creating a powerful magic resonance. Then I remembered where I'd seen it before: in the jungle of Asee-Teph. I'm sure there must be something like a Site of Power to the west from here. If you could place my focusing prism next to it, then I could redirect its energy to sustain the alarm spells. You don't think that firecracker trip wire is a sufficient security measure, do you?

checkText.en: Just don't say anything to the command. I'm so sick of all that armistice nonsense!

finishText.en: Wow, you're fast!

goal.en: Kill 10 League players and report to Yaver Nut.

startText.en:
Listen, here's the thing... We don't have an official order to start combat action, and there's actually no one to give that order - all the high command is sitting in Nezebgrad, deciding the fate of the world, while we're just rotting here.

But you're a master to yourself, aren't you? No one's going to reproach you for some ten League soldiers sent to the Purgatory. And we will find a way to thank you. Savvy?

checkText.en: So, did you find the one in charge?

finishText.en: They're not coming for some reason. Maybe they weren't offended enough. What if we kill their Lieutenant again - will we cheese them off then? I'm itching for a good fight, you know...

goal.en: Kill Yelisey Obukhov in the League camp and return to Yaver Nut.

startText.en:
I have an idea. You'll love it.

Here is what I think: there's no point in sending League soldiers to the Purgatory. It's nothing more but a respite for them. But if we kill their leader, then they will panic, and probably even come at us. We will have to defend ourselves! We can even get rewarded for that, huh.

checkText.en: Ursula asked me to find her an assistant, and the trapper could use some help, too.

finishText.en: So, time runs differently here, huh? Years could have passed in Novograd by now. I guess when I come back home, my son's going to be a grandfather.

goal.en: Complete Gaal-Tohtar's and Ursula de Blizare's quests, then return to Bronislav Malinovsky.

startText.en:
That's right, it's been three days! We have already set up our camp and the pickets around it. You say, it's been only two hours for you? Well, this allod is one big mystery!

And the biggest one is - where did it come from? As far as I know, our leaders were expecting to find some kind of an Astral anomaly here, and not an allod that resembles a weird sculpture. There are just no other allods like this one! Believe me - I've seen many of them.

I'm not authorized to give you orders, but your help would be highly appreciated. Our scientists just can't handle all those mysteries. Talk to Ursula, maybe, you'll figure some of them out.

checkText.en: So, was I right? Is there actually a Site of Power?

finishText.en: Ha! I knew I could rely on you - thanks to my prism and your sword, we must have really upset the Imperial sorcerers... And now they will most probably attempt to take that Site of Power away from us.

goal.en: Capture the Site of Power and return to Marius de Ardeur.

startText.en:
Will you do me a favor?

I was charting the magic flows of this allod the other day, and I discovered a curious pattern: the flows cross each other in several places, creating a powerful magic resonance. Then I remembered where I'd seen it before: in the jungle of Asee-Teph. I'm sure there must be something like a Site of Power to the east from here. If you could place my focusing prism next to it, then I could redirect its energy to sustain the alarm spells. You don't think that firecracker trip wire is a sufficient security measure, do you?

checkText.en: Just don't say anything to the command. I'm so sick of all that armistice nonsense!

finishText.en: Wow, you're fast!

goal.en: Kill 10 Imperial players and report to Usina Sapogov.

startText.en:
Listen, here's the thing... We don't have an official order to start combat action, and there's actually no one to give that order - all the high command is sitting in Novograd, deciding the fate of the world, while we're just rotting here.

But you're a master to yourself, aren't you? No one's going to reproach you for some ten Imperial soldiers sent to the Purgatory. And we will find a way to thank you. Savvy?

checkText.en: So, did you find the one in charge?

finishText.en: They're not coming for some reason. Maybe they weren't offended enough. What if we kill their Sergeant again - will we cheese them off then? I'm itching for a good fight, you know...

goal.en: Kill Knuckles the Montane on the Imperial outpost and return to Usina Sapogov.

startText.en:
I have an idea. You'll love it.

Here is what I think: there's no point in sending League soldiers to the Purgatory. It's nothing more but a respite for them. But if we kill their leader, then they will panic and probably come at us. We will have to defend ourselves! We might even get rewarded for that!

checkText.en: Who are you? What do you want?

finishText.en: Oh! The Ladles must have sent you! We're... keeping the watch here! Right!

goal.en: Find the water carriers near the spring to the east from the League camp.

startText.en:
Hey there!

Have you seen three gibberlings with large buckets? No? Oh, where are they!

We're trying to cook porridge to feed the whole squad, and those idlers are nowhere to be seen. We sent them to fetch some water about half an hour ago. If you see them, tell them to get here immediately, or we don't know what we're going to do to them!

checkText.en: Enough! Stop it if you don't want your clear waters to turn into a deadly poison!

finishText.en: That's that.

goal.en: Defeat the Elementals and find out why they are angry with the gibberlings.

kickText.en: Your friends desecrated my spring... I will not tolerate that!

startText.en:
We almost got killed! We just came up to the spring, and all of a sudden, it all started boiling! And then it attacked us! We just had to get out of there!

Can you make the water monsters go away, please? The Ladles must be so angry with us...

checkText.en: I want trees! Green, green trees!

finishText.en:
Excellent, excellent! Now I just have to wait for them to grow!

You're keeping your word, and so am I! You can take as much water as you want - just do not wash your paws!

goal.en: Find seedlings and plant them around the spring, then talk to the Spirit.

startText.en:
If you wish to continue rejoicing in my gifts, then I'm expecting an apology! And not just your empty words, but your deeds!

I've been dreaming of my own garden for a long time now. Unfortunately, I know very little of the ground herbs. So I'm offering you a deal: you plant some trees for me, and I give you water. How does that sound?

checkText.en: Ask, child, and I’ll answer.

finishText.en: I won’t keep you any longer. The process of being born is very exhausting - I remember it myself. Gravity has a particularly severe effect on our tough bodies, so our muscles need time to adjust to such pressure. Although you seem to be steady on your feet... It’s rare and I’m pleased to see it.

goal.en: Ask Domina Cora about the mystery of your birth.

startText.en:
Ah, there you are. I’ve been waiting for your return for 3 days now, and was starting to doubt Cassandra’s words. Welcome to Sarnaut, child.

My name is Cora. I’m the Domina of Life. My duty is to welcome all Aoidoi into this world and bring them into our society.

Here, take these clothes - it wouldn’t do walking around Polis in your birthday suit. While you’re getting dressed, I can answer your questions.

finishText.en: Ah, finally. I've been waiting for you, Stormbringer.

goal.en: Teleport to Polis and speak to Cassandra, the Domina of Fates.

startText.en:
