Cassandra predicted you would come, kid. She’s the Domina of Fates and has the gift of prophecy. Her counsel has saved us from many troubles and, dare I say, it will save us from many more.

She would like to see you as soon as we're finished talking. Go to her and you will see what heights our civilization has reached in nine years of existence.

checkText.en: You shouldn’t despair if you haven’t found your calling. It may find you yet.

finishText.en: You shouldn’t despair if you haven’t found your calling. It may find you yet. You just need to wait a little longer. Phoebus’s idea isn’t that bad either - you are strong, so you could be a warrior.

goal.en: Complete Ionas’s, Phoebus’s, and Dionysius’s quests, then return to Cassandra.

startText.en:
Yes, it’s true - I can look through the fabric of time and see what awaits us. Such vision requires great concentration, and I must be careful not to get lost in my own misconceptions.

I rarely see the birth of Aoidoi in my visions. But... I saw you. Something makes you special, child. I wish I knew what it was. Just one word is tied to your fate in my visions: Stormbringer.

But enough of ominous predictions! Your fate is uncertain. You should try and find your Talent, perhaps? Aoidoi will gladly help you with that. For example, Ionas, Phoebus, and Dionysius... Yes, they are all currently unoccupied. Don’t be surprised - all Dominae are connected through our minds, and I hear their thoughts like my own.

Go to them and try to find yourself. You’ll learn something about our life.

checkText.en: Patience is the key.

finishText.en: Yeah... It looks like the stone can’t stand the sound of your voice. It’s the first time I’ve seen this happen. Well, I guess we both agree that making stone statues is out of the question for you.

goal.en: Create a marble statue under the guidance of Ionas.

startText.en:
Oh, hello. Cassandra warned me that you were coming. So you wish to try your hand at stone cutting? Well, that’s commendable.

You won’t need a hammer, chisel, cutter, or other tools. What for, when you have your mind? Stone of Ammer is filled with life energy. You can talk to it, and it will assume any shape you wish... You just need to speak its language.

Take a piece of marble from that corner, will you?

checkText.en: Honor and will are the marks of a good sportsman.

finishText.en:
That... was... a good fight. Ugh!

Well, what you did was effective, and your uniform inspires respect. But such techniques are not allowed in sports, because they are dishonorable.... I have an idea! Perhaps you have a Warrior gift? Like Kyros? That would be nice. Try talking to him when you have time.

goal.en: Outrun the Kardis Unicorn in a race around the square, then spar with Phoebus.

startText.en:
Hello. My name is Phoebus, and I’m the patron of noble sports. I heard you’re trying to find your calling. Perhaps it’s sports?

It’s easy to find out, actually. There’s a Kardis Unicorn at the end of the square - I trained it. If you outrun the swift-footed beast, I will spar with you. And then we’ll find out if you’re any good in sports!

checkText.en: Music is the language of souls! Hic...

finishText.en: Alas, but music is not your forte. But don’t be upset - a musician’s life is full of pointless suffering, self-doubt, and emotional insecurity. And ambrosia. Lots of ambrosia... Hic!

goal.en: Drink ambrosia and play the harp for Dionysius.

startText.en:
So you want to learn to play music? Maybe you do have talent. There is a way to see it. Let me introduce myself. I’m Dionysius, the Dominus of Music. However, I do other things besides playing music, and... Hic! Oh, excuse me.

Making strings sing is easy, and I guess every second Aoidos can do it. But playing melodies that tear out hearts and heal souls is quite a different matter.

What I mean is - the true musician can create music even when drunk on ambrosia. I myself came up with a few of my enduring masterpieces while pleasantly inebriated! That’s what we’ll start the audition with. Take a sip of ambrosia, and then play the gold-stringed harp. And we will both see if you have Talent for music or the Muses dealt you short.

finishText.en: Greetings, my friend. I’m sorry, but Kyros and Aellona left the Refuge. They don’t waste time going against the new threat.

goal.en: Go to the neighboring island of the Refuge and find Kyros, the Dominus of War.

startText.en:
The ways of fate are inscrutable - I have just received a message from Domina Aellona. Something... strange happened near the Refuge. Refuge is our settlement on one of the neighboring islands. Kyros and Aellona already went there to find out what’s going on.

If you wish to speak with Kyros, you should do it now. Who knows, maybe by helping the Dominus of War, you’ll find your calling?

The area around the Refuge is crawling with dangerous creatures, so you’ll need proper equipment. I’ll give it to you. Once you’re ready to go, talk to Cantos, the Crossing Keeper. He’ll take you to the place.

checkText.en: Time is pressing, go!

finishText.en:
So demons are actually here... That’s bad.

What was this strange knife-eared creature? You’re saying it stood on two legs, like us? Wore clothes and fought off monsters? And looked like a warrior?

This is unbelievable! What if it was an elf? There’s this people in Sarnaut... But what was he doing here?

goal.en: Scout the area around the Refuge and find the strange creatures that attacked the Aoidoi.

startText.en:
I see you are equipped for a fight. I’m afraid I need your help.

Some time ago, our Refuge was attacked by strange creatures - Demons. They are the children of Chaos, creations of mad god Sarn. The walls built by Ionas held them off, because the Dominus of Stone is a great master of magic. But the Demons did not go anywhere! So we are trapped here - all of us.

Well, if you know how to use a weapon, you can look around the Refuge. There aren’t many warriors here - most left with Kyros, and we haven’t heard from them since. This uncertainty is bothering me! We should know if there are any demons around our house, and whether we should ask Polis for help.

finishText.en: Thank you for what you did for the Refuge, child. Come on, let me take a look at your wound.

goal.en: Speak to Asclepia at the Refuge about your wound.

startText.en:
Creator almighty, you were wounded! Why didn’t you say so?!

Go to Asclepia, our healer. Who knows what infection was carried by that creature! Go now, hurry!

checkText.en: Please, make no delay. What if this infection kills you?

finishText.en: Keep the potion - drink it when you can’t stand it much longer. Find a more experienced healer - perhaps someone knows how to cure this thing.

goal.en: Gather petals of Blood Eye and Will-o’-the-Wisps near the Refuge.

startText.en:
Hm... Your wound is not serious, my friend, and not life-threatening as it is... However, there is something that bothers me. You were infected, and your body cannot overcome it on its own. I can slow the spread of infection, but I don’t know how to purge it. I’ll need to make a potion, but it’s not an easy one.

I am sorry, but you will have to father all ingredients yourself. I am completely helpless when it comes to demons. You will also need will-o’-the-wisps - manifested echos of divine power. Their life energy will help you only if you catch them with your own hands. There are a lot of them around the Refuge. You won’t miss them.

I’ll also need a flower called Blood Eye. Its healing properties will help you through the infection. It grows not far from here. Look around carefully - Blood Eye likes shadows.

finishText.en:
I have to say, you are absolutely insufferable! You know what it’s like when your brains are boiling? Well, I do now! And I could have lived my whole life without this knowledge.

And if I went crazy, then what? Even if I threw myself off a cliff, I’d still be reborn as an imbecile!

goal.en: Find out what is going on near the entrance to the Refuge.

startText.en:
For the love of... what is this noise at the gates? Are demons attacking again?

Oh, it’s unbearable... Epius should ask Polis for help!

finishText.en: Sounds legit but couldn’t we do without this thrashing? Great Tensess, it’s like I drank some bad moonshine... See if I ever listen to some elves again! Magic-shmagic. Psha!

goal.en: Find out what is going on near the entrance to the Refuge.

startText.en:
For the love of... what is this noise at the gates? Are demons attacking again?

Oh, it’s unbearable... Epius should ask Polis for help!

finishText.en: I’ll inform Polis about our guests, my friend, but right now I’m more worried about another news. They saw Aellona and Kyros with a troop of warriors! It means they’re still alive. But why aren’t they back already...?

goal.en: Ask Andrey Sechin  why the Empire arrived at Ammer and tell Epius about it.

startText.en:
To be honest, our recent intelligence was the reason we started searching for your town. To the south-east of here, we spotted a group of your people. Aoidoi? Well, that’s alright. Your presence was a surprise to us, so we wanted to deal with this prob... with this intriguing circumstance as soon as possible.

So the troop of Aoidoi was fighting demons. Victorious, they took up a defensive position near the portal... I have to say, the tactics of your people in combat raises a lot of questions. I imagine experienced fighters among you are fast disappearing?

I don’t know what happened to the Aoidoi later. Our scout decided to avoid direct contact. As for the reason for our first arrival at Ammer...

finishText.en: I’ll inform Polis about our guests, my friend, but right now I’m more worried about another news. They saw Aellona and Kyros with a troop of warriors! It means they’re still alive. But why aren’t they back already...?

goal.en: Ask Gostomysl Ranov why League arrived at Ammer and tell Epius about it.

startText.en:
The reason we started to search for your treasure was because we spotted a group of your... people to the south-east of here. Aoidoi? Alright, let’s call them Aoidoi. We didn’t think anyone lived here, and you say you’ve been here all your life? Wow...

I got a bit carried away. So your brothers, Aoidoi, were fighting demons to the south-east of here. I should say you guys make lousy warriors, no offence. Out of the dozen, just two seemed like they knew what they were doing... Lucky for them though, demons were no better. Anyway, your people somehow took those demons down and should be hanging around the portal now.

Our scout decided not to disturb them. What if they take him out along with the demons? Gift of Tensess might save him, sure, but it’s best not to tempt fate. But if you’re interested how we ended up on Ammer...

finishText.en: Well, hello hello, it’s been a while. What do you mean, “you don’t know me”? Ah yes, I forgot. Your Reincarnations have faulty memory. Ah, youth!

goal.en: Help Kyros and Aellona drive demons away from Polis boundary.

startText.en:
Kyros, Aellona, and their legate followers went to protect Polis boundary. Your help would be invaluable.

You see, Kyros is the only warrior among them, and he's not almighty... or immortal. Aellona loves him more than anything and will follow him even into the flames of war. I'm afraid that her blind devotion might end tragically.

My heart is uneasy. Please go to the east as soon as you can!

finishText.en: I didn’t expect to see one of us here. We’re having a bad time, so I’ll take any help I can get. But what brings you here?

goal.en: Find Aellona the Domina, who has gone looking for the Demonic Portal.

startText.en: Here, in the Refuge, Aellona used to be in charge. She is a merciful and brave Domina. When Demons were at our doorstep, she gathered everyone who could bear arms and led them to battle. They drove the Demons away and followed them, but they never came back. I am her apprentice, and I can feel her rage and sadness. Please find her. I’m afraid something bad might have happened.

checkText.en: I can see you have many questions, but there isn't much time to talk.

finishText.en: It saddens me to think that those who bring only destruction were the first to arrive at Ammer. It’s the duty of all Dominae to protect our people.

goal.en: Speak to Aellona and ask her what she plans on doing next.

startText.en: Do you want to ask something? Go ahead then.

checkText.en: Lure the bats with the decoy. They can be of help.

finishText.en: Now I will enchant it and send it on the other side of the portal. Hopefully, it will deliver my message and bring back the response.

goal.en: Catch a bat and bring it to Aellona.

startText.en:
I can feel that you want to help me. I wouldn't dare to ask myself, but I would gladly accept any assistance.

These portals make so much noise, and I can't hear my beloved Kyros' heart. Is he safe? This is my only concern.

But who knows what is waiting on the other side of the portal? I have an idea... Could you please catch a bat? Take this magic decoy, it will help you.

checkText.en: Kill the Demons!

finishText.en: Thank you. I hope you will enjoy this reward.

goal.en: Kill Demons in the Refuge vicinity and return to Aellona.

startText.en: I wanted to ask you one more thing, though this request pains me. Chaos spawns are everywhere, and I fear for our people, who have found shelter within the walls of the Refuge. Our Sparks may return to the Flow after death, but death has different forms, and ours is such that when we die, we lose ourselves. I don't want this fate for the Aoidoi, which is why I am asking you to cut down those spawns of chaos without mercy. Let them quake in terror!

checkText.en: Who? What! How did you get here?!

finishText.en: What?! I asked Aellona to stay out of this... Oh, women!

goal.en: Enter the Demonic Portal and find Kyros on the other say.

startText.en: The bat is back! My plan has worked. I can feel Kyros' anger... There are so many enemies around him. He tells me to bring help, but who is going to help us?! We can't wait for the reinforcement from Polis! I must help him now! Will you come with me?

checkText.en: Go ahead! We don't have much time.

finishText.en: I'm glad to see how fiercely you fight our common enemies. There aren’t a lot of Aoidoi who can wield a sword and kill with it. The sons of Chaos have brought death to our lands, but you are giving us hope!

goal.en: Protect Kyros while he is destroying the Demonic claws.

startText.en:
I feel like you were born just a moment ago, but it matters little. Thank you for your military exploits and for helping Aellona. I’m just afraid that everything that happened until now was just a warm-up. Our allod is being torn apart by demon claws, and chaos spawns are climbing through the portals!

We must stop this demonic filth. There is no one else! Otherwise it will devour everything and become so powerful that even the walls of Polis, blessed with the breath of the creators, won't withstand it.

Will you help? I don't have the strength to destroy the enemy and chase away the filth at the same time. Your sword will be my only protection!

finishText.en: I’m glad that I can call you a friend. There aren’t many Aoidoi who would do what you’ve done.

goal.en: Destroy Desolator and return to the Refuge.

startText.en: It is too soon to celebrate - I can sense the presence of the one who has brought that army to our lands. Anger and madness overwhelm him... I can't believe the Creator could let such ugly monsters invade his beautiful world. We must stop the hateful enemy!

finishText.en: Finally! We can't waste time!

goal.en: Teleport to Aidenus in Novograd and ask what happened.

startText.en:
The message is very short. Aidenus must have been afraid that it could be intercepted.

"Please come to my tower, friend. League needs your help. Aidenus"

You should go there right now. This seems serious.

finishText.en: Finally! We can't waste even a minute.

goal.en: Go see Aidenus in Novograd and ask what happened.

startText.en:
Another meeting! Listen, I got a letter from Aidenus... For you! So I wanted to give it you in person, just to be safe.

The old man is rather concerned, and with good reason...

The message is very short. Aidenus was probably worried it could be intercepted.

"I ask you to come to my tower without delay. The League needs your help again. Aidenus."

You should go see him right away. It sounds serious.

finishText.en: I should probably remind you what "without delay" means. Sit down and listen. Time is pressing.

goal.en: Teleport to Yasker in Nezebgrad and ask what happened.

startText.en:
Another meeting! Listen, I got a letter from Yasker... For you! So I wanted to give it you in person, just to be safe.

Our great leader is rather concerned, and with good reason...

It looks more like a telegram than a letter. Yasker is being concise:

"The Empire calls upon its heroes. Report to Yasker's Tower immediately. Yasker."

It looks as though Yasker sent it to several heroes, but I really doubt that. It's meant for you!

finishText.en: Sit down and listen. We don't have much time.

goal.en: Teleport to the Yasker in Nezebgrad and ask what happened.

startText.en:
Yasker is being concise:

"The Empire calls for its heroes. Report to Yasker's Tower immediately. Yasker"

It looks as if he had sent it to several heroes, but I really doubt that.

finishText.en: It's so good to see you at our ceremony! Considering the latest events, I don't think you have enough time to learn new things... But you may consider yourself an honorary student! Please, accept this merit badge.

goal.en: Participate in the University's Opening Ceremony in Polis and talk to professors.

startText.en: Greetings, Stormbringer! Zayan decided to move the University that he founded a century ago to Ammer. He wants the new civilization to find their way into Sarnaut's science, and Polis - to become one of the world's cultural capital. We're offering you to become the honorary student and inviting you to participate in the Opening Ceremony!

finishText.en: Who are you again? Do you even speak our language? That’s a relief. Major Vasily Molodin, Imperial Sentinel. Nice to meet you.

goal.en: Get to the Imperial Camp and ask the Commander to cure you.

startText.en:
The news that the Imperial forces took note of the fight but stayed out of it makes me angry. But maybe they’ll be of some use after all.

Don’t think I haven’t noticed your wound, my friend. Thank the gods that Asclepia managed to help you in time. My brother-in-arms, Ivar, died from a light injury not unlike yours. Cursed demonic infection consumed his body. The same will happen to you if you don’t find a cure.

The Empire has fought demons for centuries. If they truly wish to form an alliance with us, they should help you get well first. Let’s see what their words are worth. And they should also join the fight against demons. Then - and only then we will consider whether we should let them in.

finishText.en:
Now who is our blue guest? Such a rare occasion. So you’re one of the locals? How many of you are there? Although, why am I asking such a thing? Never mind!

Bronislav Malinovsky, League Battlelord. Nice to meet you.

goal.en: Get to the League Camp and ask the Commander to cure you.

startText.en:
The news that the League forces took note of the fight but stayed out of it makes me angry. But maybe they’ll be of some use after all.

Don’t think I haven’t noticed your wound, my friend. Thank the gods that Asclepia managed to help you in time. My brother-in-arms, Ivar, died from a light injury not unlike yours. Cursed demonic infection consumed his body. The same will happen to you if you don’t find a cure.

The League has fought demons for centuries. If they truly wish to form an alliance with us, they should help you get well first. Let’s see what their words are worth. And they should also join the fight against demons. Then - and only then we will consider whether we should let them in.

finishText.en:
I welcome you on behalf of the Trinity Church. I am Priest Yasskul Jumany.

Tremor, convulsions and irregular breathing are normal for your people?

goal.en: Meet Yasskul Jumany and ask him for cure.

startText.en:
Your leaders have an interesting way of doing things - sending dying messengers to potential allies. That’s nice. What am I to do with you...

Helping you deal with demons is not a problem. It doesn’t matter what they want - we won’t leave a single creature alive. I guess we don’t really have a choice, seeing how you guys fight, he he...

As for your wound - the answer is simple. Demonic taint can be cured by the Magic of Light. Trinity Church knows everything about it. Go to Yasskul Jumany. You won’t mistaken him for anything - a 2-meter tall corpse with bronze prosthetic limbs, and a white mask so as not to scare anyone with his bare skull. The Empire is full of these guys - so get used to it. The Arisen are brothers to us - just like Orcs, Xadaganians, and even some Pridens.

Well, what are you waiting for? You want to die in my arms?

finishText.en:
Hello! Avelinn de Blizare, nice to meet you. I make sure our soldiers don’t get themselves accidentally killed.

You look terrible. Is everything okay?

goal.en: Meet Avelinn de Blizare and ask for cure.

startText.en:
Your healers have a funny way of dealing with the sick - sending them to astral demons? So that they’re my responsibility now? And what am I supposed to do with you?

Helping you deal with demons is not a problem. It doesn’t matter what they want - we won’t leave a single creature alive. Though I heard you aren’t so good in a fight...

As for your wound - the answer is simple. Demonic taint can be cured by the Magic of Light. Trinity Church knows everything about it. Go to Avelinn de Blizare right away. You won’t mistaken her for anything - she is a stately one with wings. She has this look of innocence, but don’t let that fool you - we know what those elves are about, he he...

Well, what are you waiting for? Want to die here?

checkText.en: I’ve never done that in field conditions, to be honest.

finishText.en:
Safe and sound, I see? To be honest, I didn’t think you could become a believer so quickly. I’m sure it wasn’t my eloquence that did it, or was it?

Well, how are you feeling?

goal.en: Go through the Communion Rite of the Trinity Church.

startText.en:
Yes, Vasily Molodin is absolutely right - demonic infection can only be cured by the Magic of Light, which is based on faith. Its power is so immense that a true believer can even resurrect without effort. It’s a phenomenon that is called the “Gift of Tensess”.

You see, the Communion Rite usually takes some time, but it’s clear that delay is tantamount to death here. So listen carefully - I’ll try to explain everything in simple words and without any occult references. Tensess is a real person, just like Nezeb and Skrakan. We worship those three as saints, for it was thanks to them that Gift of Tensess was granted to this world. We believe into the might of fallen Great Mages, and this faith helps us return to this world after a death of our mortal bodies. It is also what helped us defeat the demons, Architects and Nezeb knows what else. Useful? Yes. Unbelievable? Oh yes.

The only way you can survive is to accept this faith with your body and soul. If that’s what you want, I will begin the Rite. I’ve never done that in field conditions, to be honest.

finishText.en: I’ve never seen anyone accept on true faith so quickly. Although, come to think of it, you haven’t been around long, so you accept knowledge with a childlike open-mindedness... How old did you say you were?

goal.en: Go through the Communion Rite of the Church of Light.

startText.en:
A demonic infection? You poor thing... Yes, the Magic of Light allows us to purge the darkness from our bodies. Of course, it's not painless. And it's one thing to help those who already believe, and another is to make you believe it. Not to mention the fact that I'd have to carry out the Communion Rite in field conditions. Oh... Well, no time to complain.

Let's keep holy texts out of this discussion.  The Church of Light venerates Tensess as a saint who at death’s door gave us a great Gift: the ability to resurrect after a death of our mortal body. Tensess is a real person. Like us, he used to fight against the demonic threat... Back then, a long time ago. His sacrifice turned the tide of war. Immortality allowed us to withstand the attack of demonic creatures. And as you can see, we are still alive and thriving.

In our case, knowledge and faith are one. Accepting this knowledge is not enough: you need to believe with all your heart that the power of Light, the Gift of Tensess, can pull you from the other world. I'm deadly serious. No pun intended.

finishText.en:
Welcome back, Stormbringer. I see you are no longer suffering from sickness. Good.

And I feel... Something else.

goal.en: Return to Cassandra in Polis.

startText.en:
Hold on a second. You met the Servant? And he spoke to you directly?

This... I don’t know. It doesn’t seem like you’re making this up - you didn’t know about it... But try to understand me - it’s the first time I hear that the Servant has spoken to someone. That it... Anyway, your conversation doesn’t concern me. Great deeds await you, I guess?

At any rate, I’m glad that the Empire and Aoidoi are bound together with faith. I won’t delay you much longer - you are probably expected elsewhere. I wouldn’t want your friends to think you met your end at an imperial camp.

Go in peace!

finishText.en:
Welcome back, Stormbringer. I see you are no longer suffering from sickness. Good.

And I feel... Something else.

goal.en: Return to Cassandra in Polis.

startText.en:
Wait, wait. So you met the Servant? Really? Giant wings, blue flame, hair like a frenzied Harpy’s... ahem, excuse me.

Oh... It’s a great honor, to be honest. Oh, there we go again... The Servant is Light itself, the creature of immense power! And it spoke with you, just like that? Unbelievable! What did it say? Oh wait, it’s not really my business... Again. Actually, I’m really proud right now, like a Priden who lured a mammoth into a trap. Just think about it - I gave communion to the first of the Aoidoi who had also spoken with the Servant itself! Great deeds probably await you, no?

Well then, it’s time for you to head back, no? What if your friends thought that treacherous sons of the League stoned you to death in the middle of the camp?
Go now and carry Light with yo! I’m glad we are bound by our shared faith.

checkText.en: I sense a new power in you... It’s almost tangible. And so bright that it hurts to look at you. What happened to you among our guests? Tell me everything!

finishText.en: Demons got too close to our house. We can’t let that continue for much longer. Stormbringer, please help us again.

goal.en: Tell Cassandra what happened.

startText.en: I sense a new power in you... It’s almost tangible. And so bright that it hurts to look at you. What happened to you among our guests? Tell me everything!

checkText.en: Incredible... Just like that, in broad daylight...

finishText.en:
Great! Now...

What? What do you need?!

goal.en: Take Wands of Oblivion away from the centaurs and return them to Apios.

startText.en:
I'm sorry... I must remain calm... Breathe in, breathe out... Right.

Our home, Triquetrum, was attacked by centaurs! I have no idea why. They just crashed in and started killing everyone! We were defenseless and never expected them to attack us. And now look...

Well, we had some means of self-defense, but we didn't have the time to use them. Wands of Oblivion can put anyone to deepest sleep with just one touch. We left those wands behind, in Triquetrum... The centaurs must have found them! Oh, Chaos!

We need to retrieve them as soon as possible.

checkText.en: Have you fulfilled my request?

finishText.en: Good job, my friend. We can breathe more easily now.

goal.en: Teach the Centaurs near the Aoidoi’s hideout a lesson.

startText.en:
You probably won’t like my request - I don’t like it myself. Centaurs’ scouts got too close to our hideout. If they spot us, they will kill us like those unfortunate souls in Triquetrum. I can't let that happen. We must strike first, because that’s the only language those savages understand.

Teach the Centaurs around here a lesson. You’ll make this place safer, and I’ll make sure you’re rewarded.

checkText.en: Please, do hurry.

goal.en: Collect "Tears of Gods" and bring them to Daphne.

startText.en:
I beg you to forgive Apios, he's a bit... anxious. Aoidoi are not used to the sight of blood.

I need "Tears of Gods" to heal those who were severely wounded. It's difficult to confuse that mineral with anything... It's like liquid crystal, frozen in time.

Bring me several pieces. They have extremely powerful healing qualities.

checkText.en: Please, do hurry.

finishText.en:
Thank you so much!

Aoidos bodies are partly non-organic, and those non-organic parts are very similar to the "tears" in their compound. So we just mend our bodies using those minerals. This isn't really difficult.

Anyway, I guess you have things to do instead of just chatting with me.

goal.en: Collect "Tears of Gods" and bring them to Daphne.

startText.en:
I beg you to forgive Apios, he's a bit... anxious. Aoidoi are not used to the sight of blood.

I need "Tears of Gods" to heal those who were severely wounded. It's difficult to confuse that mineral with anything... It's like liquid crystal, frozen in time.

Bring me several pieces. They have extremely powerful healing qualities.

checkText.en: Remember that I will run away if there is any sign of danger.

finishText.en: Phew... This is it. We make a good team, right?

goal.en: Neutralize centaur sentries around Triquetrum.

startText.en:
A centaur settlement?! They will kill you in an instant! Like they did with Nimros...

Why, why would you need to go there? You say, they've kidnapped Maya? Of course, of course, I know where their settlement is. I can take you there if you want to. But I forbid you to kill any of them. That's right! Every life is sacred.

We can put the sentries out of our way with these wands and reach the village unnoticed. You distract them, and I will crawl up to them and stun them.

Go, now!

checkText.en: I need Arrowhead leaves.

finishText.en: I just hope animals won't flee too fast, or they'll draw centaurs' attention.

goal.en: Collect Arrowhead leaves and bring them to Apios.

startText.en:
So, the hardest part is over, but the most interesting one is still ahead of us. We can approach the settlement through the ravine, but it is swarming with hungry beasts. Luckily, I know a way to deal with them.

There's that plain-looking bush that grows in this area, we call it Arrowhead. If you break its leaf and smell its sap, you will regret the day you were born.

Find those leaves. Meanwhile, I will check if there are no other centaur sentries around.

finishText.en: Praise the Light! I thought I was dead. Poor Whip... They trampled him to death!

goal.en: Use the smell of Arrowhead to reach the centaur settlement and find Maya Milostina.

startText.en:
Okay, take this gruel and besmear yourself. Don't worry, you'll just wash your clothes afterwards.

We need to cross the ravine. I've walked this path two times before, so we won't get lost. I hope we make it on time and the centaurs haven't killed your preacher...

finishText.en:
Oh great Light! If only I knew our faith could drive Aoidoi crazy!

But they are not everyone like that, are they? We must do something!

goal.en: Ask Maya Milostina what happened.

startText.en:
I think I’m going to be sick... What is this smell, for gods' sake? Oh, it's you! I'm sorry...

Okay, let me pull myself together...

checkText.en:
Here you are, finally. Do you want to tell me something?

Because we have a centaur invasion here, and there isn't really much time to talk.

finishText.en:
I'm particularly interested in the identity of the strange sorcerer and why he helps Kyros. Does he act on his own will, or does he have.... a Master?

Watch out. Who knows what he is capable of.

goal.en: Tell Eladia about Kyros' intentions.

startText.en:
I don't understand how he's going to carry out his plan. The Servant of Tensess is in the Purgatory. In order to get into the Purgatory, you need to die... But Aoidoi cannot do that unless they believe in the Light! And even if they could, their Spark would be helpless against the Servant.

However, I know nothing either about Aoidoi, or that mysterious sorcerer, or about the centaur magic! We need to find someone who could help us. And fast!

checkText.en: What? Do you like demonic landscapes? If you hesitate a little longer, you might even see it from above.

finishText.en:
Well, so you suggest we bargain with a demon, a merciless spawn of the Astral driven by murderous instincts... Sounds like a good idea. I knew I could rely on your rationality.

You started it, you will have to finish it. The most important thing is that the portals have been destroyed. Enjoy the views of Polis while you still can!

goal.en: Destroy Demonic Portals in Polis vicinity.

startText.en:
The Aoidoi's commander-in-chief chose a bad time to weep in the corner. The space around the allod becomes more and more disturbed with every minute - demons are trying to break through the power of the Well, and soon they will succeed.

I marked several spots on the allod map where demonic portals will soon open. You know what needs to be done with them.

Here, take this simple device. It will reverse the processes inside the portal and restore the broken tissue of reality. Yes, I know something about technomagic!

finishText.en: Finally. I've been looking for you.

goal.en: Teleport to Eladia in Polis.

startText.en:
A red-headed sorceress who had arrived together with your allies was looking for you. She must have found out something important.

You should go and see her. She is a pro when it comes to fighting demons.

checkText.en: What's happened? You look perplexed.

finishText.en:
I must admit this was... unexpected.

It's a tough decision. But I know what should be done.

goal.en: Find out what the demon is trying to say and deliver his message to Cassandra the Domina.

startText.en:
This demon doesn't seem to be eager to kill the uninvited guest. It seems like it's even trying to deliver a message.

Maybe we should listen to what he has to say?

checkText.en: Ollum gives you a questioning look.

finishText.en: You can feel demon's sincere gratitude when he gently accepts the hearts from your hands. Well, at least his pack will be fed for some time.

goal.en: Obtain heart of local animals and bring them to Ollum.

startText.en:
Another message from Ollum seems to be a request, too.

You see short visions of how demons got rid of their destructive instincts. You see how the first creatures of this allod were born out of Sarn's boiling blood, which spilled on these virgin lands. Life energy overfills them, and their skin and fur shine brightly in the twilight of the eternal Astral storm.

Ollum's pack stopped hunting Aoidoi and started feeding on the hearts of those creatures. In fact, they turned into local predators. But after the hostile demons occupied Ammer, hunting has become much more difficult for them. Ollum wants you to help him obtain hearts.

checkText.en: Ollum gives you a questioning look.

finishText.en: You can feel demon's sincere gratitude when he gently accepts the hearts from your hands. Well, at least his pack will be fed for some time.

goal.en: Obtain heart of local animals and bring them to Ollum.

startText.en:
Another message from Ollum seems to be a request, too.

You see short visions of how demons got rid of their destructive instincts. You see how the first creatures of this allod were born out of Sarn's boiling blood, which spilled on these virgin lands. Life energy overfills them, and their skin and fur shine brightly in the twilight of the eternal Astral storm.

Ollum's pack stopped hunting Aoidoi and started feeding on the hearts of those creatures. In fact, they turned into local predators. But after the hostile demons occupied Ammer, hunting has become much more difficult for them. Ollum wants you to help him obtain hearts.

checkText.en: Ollum gives you a questioning look.

finishText.en: You can sense that the demon now respects you even more. Ollum accepts the hearts with reverent anticipation.

goal.en: Destroy Shagarzak, Anolea, and Trihead and bring their hearts to Ollum.

startText.en:
Ollum sends you images of particularly dangerous creatures who, as he thinks, threaten lives of Aoidoi and small demons in his pack. Their hearts are especially valuable for Ollum.

He wants you to hunt those creatures, but at the same time, his message is somehow admonitory.

checkText.en: Did you bring my blood to the demons?

finishText.en:
I must say I'm surprised.

I can sense no lies in that creature. It looks like in their aspiration to live they have warded off their very essence, instilled in them by the cruel god. Now they are just like us - alone and lost in this world... So here is what I say: if they wish to join our ranks, they are welcomed.

I feel their desire to live in peace with us. They can help us fight their less reasonable counterparts...

Do you know, Stormbringer, what this means for the world? The oldest enemy of the peoples of Sarnaut may soon become our friend! Oh those times will be blessed!

goal.en: Ask demons of Ollum's pack to drink Cassandra's blood.

startText.en:
When I saw this conversation in a vision three days ago, I thought I was going insane. But here you are, repeating every word that you said in that vision.

I don't know whether those demons are saying the truth or trying to deceive us. However, I know a way to find that out...

I will give you my blood, Stormbringer. Tell demons to drink it. If they are not lying, they will agree, and then I will see their thoughts clearly. If they do that, come back to me.

Go now!

checkText.en: What's wrong?

finishText.en: You say, the Aoidos gave you this voluntarily? If it were not for your service record, I'd say that you're a great diplomat.

goal.en: Bring the connecting crystal to Vasily Molodin.

finishText.en:
Polis? I haven't heard of such thing.

Ah, you're from Vasily. Alright then, I'm not going to play dumb.

Give me your stone. I'll see what I can do.

...

Here you go. I have no idea where it will take you. So good luck!

goal.en: Give the connecting crystal to Svetlana Tropkina.

startText.en:
Don't you understand? Alright, enough with the diplomatic games. We don't have the time to wait for the registry to give us an answer. From what I know of your personal history, I can tell that Yasker trusts you with making decisions. Otherwise you wouldn't be here.

I strongly encourage you to help Aoidoi, especially since they gave you a key to their city. By the way, you should bring this crystal to Svetlana so that she could include Polis in the portal net.

checkText.en: What's wrong?

finishText.en: They must be in a real trouble if they come asking us for help. There's one problem though...

goal.en: Bring the Connecting Crystal to Bronislav Malinovsky.

startText.en:
Sadly, we have no time to search for answers. I have received news from the dominae that the enemy is approaching Polis. The mere thought of those ugly creatures tearing at our dearest city... ah!

We cannot let this happen!

You say, there's a whole nation who is ready to help us. Maybe I'm asking for too much, but this is our only chance on survival. Here, take this crystal. Use it to create a portal to Polis. Bring it to your expedition.

Hurry up!

finishText.en:
You want me to add a new city to our net? This is so exciting!

Unless you were given an explosive alchemical artifact instead of a connecting crystal. I hope you can tell a real crystal from a fake one.

Because I can't.

...

That was easy. A new pathway to Polis is ready. Here you go!

goal.en: Give the connecting crystal to Prosha Perova.

startText.en:
Now when we're done with the diplomatic stuff, I will tell you this: you need to give this crystal to the portal keeper girl and tell her I order to establish a connection with Polis as soon as possible. We can't wait.

How can we just leave them to the demons' mercy?!

For now, you will walk through this portal alone. Then we'll see.

finishText.en: Ah, finally. As it was foretold, the Stormbringer will show up before the tempest.

goal.en: Teleport to Polis and see what is going on there.

startText.en:
You see, we're just scouts and researchers, not diplomats. We cannot make an alliance with an unknown sentient race without an approval from the high command. Yasker and Elizaveta will be furious.

I will send a request to them. And you... you do whatever you want. Understood?

finishText.en: Ah, finally. As it was foretold, the Stormbringer will show up before the tempest.

goal.en: Teleport to Polis and see what is going on there.

startText.en:
You see, we're just scouts and researchers, not diplomats. We cannot make an alliance with an unknown sentient race without an approval from the high command.

I will send a request immediately. And you... you do whatever you want. Understood?

checkText.en: Is that right, stranger?

finishText.en:
I hope we can talk later. I wish I could tell you more.

But time plays against us. We must hurry.

goal.en: Ask Cassandra about what is going on.

startText.en:
I'm sorry, that situation with demons threw me out of my stride... I completely lost the sense of time.

Welcome, stranger! I am Cassandra, the Domina of Fates. Take some rest and explore wonderful Polis, the first city of Aoidoi.

Thank you for your noble desire to help us. I will do whatever you wish to express my gratitude.

finishText.en:
Wakie-wakie! I congratulate you - you were murdered by a rather puny demon. That's a shame, huh?

What? What is it you babbling about paralyzation?

goal.en: Help Kyros and Aellona drive demons away from Polis boundary.

startText.en:
Kyros, Aellona, and their legate followers went to protect Polis boundary. Your help would be invaluable.

You see, Kyros is the only warrior among them, and he's not almighty... or immortal. Aellona loves him more than anything and will follow him even into the flames of war. I'm afraid that her blind devotion might end tragically.

My heart is uneasy. Please go to the east as soon as you can!

finishText.en: That was a nice fight... Aellona! What happened to her?

goal.en: Solicit the support of a priest and fight the demon again.

startText.en:
Hm, this is curious... Since when demons have such powerful sorcerers? Well, this is not the most important thing right now. What is important, is that why that creature is still there, and we're here!

Alright, let's think. You see the ambassadors of the League and the Empire? Of course, there must be priests among them, who are eager to demonstrate the Holy power to the Aoidoi. Resurrection, Great Tensess, Nezeb, Skrakan, blah-blah-blah. Luckily for us, those priests are not just some charlatans. They hold real power. You should talk to one of them and make sure he supports you in battle with that demon.

What are you waiting for? Go!

checkText.en:
I'm fine! Please, help Aellona!

I feel... I see... No, it can't be!

finishText.en:
I'm sorry.... I... don't know what I'm doing.

Aellona...

goal.en: See if Aellona is alive.

startText.en:
I'm fine! Please, help Aellona!

I feel... I see... No, it can't be!

checkText.en: Thank you for your help.

finishText.en:
Here... here is the place. Here we met, seven years ago. Here I will lay her to rest...

I still remember that day as if it were yesterday. Astral storms and ice-cold winds had finally eased off... I was returning from a hunt, and then I saw Her, standing there and looking up. The light of a thousand shattered stars was gleaming on her face...

Her beauty will remain with Aoidoi forever - I will take care of that.

goal.en: Escort Kyros to Aellona's burial place.

startText.en:
There's a place just outside Polis where me and Aellona used to see each other...

She deserves to be buried there, among the beautiful rocks and trees. She asked me of that, not so long ago... As if she knew. Aellona always knew everything...

Will you help me? Wild animals will sense death and try to attack me while I carry her... body.

checkText.en: Those flowers grow all over the place. You won't miss them.

finishText.en:
Thank you, my friend.

I can’t believe any of this... I was so foolish...  Now she’s gone. That was a cruel joke of the Well to give immortality to me, but deprive the other Aoidoi, while all of you can return to life just like that.

I... I need to be alone with Aellona, traveler.

goal.en: Gather wild flowers for Aellona's grave and bring them to Kyros.

startText.en:
Of all flowers, Aellona loved simple cornflowers best. They grow around here. I must lay them on her grave.

Please, be so kind to bring me several flowers. Maybe next year, I will find it all covered in blue cornflowers...

finishText.en:
I can see dire news in your eyes, Stormbringer. Aellona is dead - we all felt it.

...

I see... This is a dark day for us, stranger.  It's hard to describe how much we needed Aellona. The gift of knowledge and guidance is way too valuable for a newly born nation.

The Dominae must decide what we should do to protect our people. We have enemies now...

goal.en: Tell the dominae about Aellona's death.

startText.en:
The rest of the dominae must know what has happened. They must have already sensed... the death of one of us. Go and tell them everything.

I... I will be back. I just need some time.

finishText.en:
"Who's that, Sivar, can you see?"

"They aren't demons! Put down the knife."

"If you say so, Sivar."

goal.en: Find the boat neat the bank and reach the hunters' camp.

startText.en:
Listen, before I go to the Purgatory again: I am a Demon hunter. Our sorcerers from the White Fortress noticed a large pack of demons, heading to the depth of the Astral, and we decided to chase them. Agh... Damn it!

So we found them and destroyed them right next to this allod, but our ship was utterly wrecked. We decided to camp here and repair it. For a day, nothing happened, but then we were surrounded by other demons, like I've never seen in my life. They can play with your mind...

I was fixing the boat when I saw them. I killed a couple of them, but then one of the demons bewitched me with a vision. I came back to my senses on the other bank, all covered in blood. I don't even know where the boat is.

Listen, can you go and look what happened to our camp? Maybe they are alright? If they are, they better come here and rescue me!

finishText.en: Demons can't reach us here, for the power of the Well of Soul protects the walls of the Refuge. But neither can we step outside them.

goal.en: Talk to Epius in the Refuge and find out who Aoidoi are and where did they come from.

startText.en:
I'm sorry, I thought I sensed something hostile in you... But now I see your heart is friendly.

I am just a guard of the Refuge, and I don't know much. Please, come inside and meet Epius. He will answer your questions.

checkText.en: A stranger? On Ammer? What are you doing here?

finishText.en: A stranger? I must admit I am surprised to meet you. Let me thank you, however. In this dark hour, I will gladly accept any help.

goal.en: Find Aellona the Domina, who has gone looking for the Demonic Portal.

startText.en: Here, in the Refuge, Aellona used to be in charge. She is a merciful and brave Domina. When Demons were at our doorstep, she gathered everyone who could bear arms and led them to battle. They drove the Demons away and followed them, but they never came back. I am her apprentice, and I can feel her rage and sadness. She has gone to the west, and you should search for her there, for no one else can show you the way to Polis.

checkText.en: I can see you have many questions, but there isn't much time to talk.

finishText.en: Dominae already know that the strangers have come to Ammer. I can speak on behalf of my people, and I say that we welcome you. The gates of Polis are open for everyone who favors creation over destruction. It is a shame though that the first ones who arrived here could only bring destruction...

goal.en: Talk to Aellona and ask her what she plans on doing next.

startText.en: Do you want to ask something? Go ahead then.

checkText.en: Lure the bats with the decoy. They can be of help.

finishText.en: Now I will enchant it and send it on the other side of the portal. Hopefully, it will deliver my message and bring back the response.

goal.en: Catch a bat and bring it to Aellona.

startText.en:
I can feel that you want to help me. I wouldn't dare to ask myself, but I would gladly accept any assistance.

These portals make so much noise, and I can't hear my beloved Kyros' heart. Is he safe? This is my only concern.

But who knows what is waiting on the other side of the portal? I have an idea... Could you please catch a bat? Take this magic decoy, it will help you.

checkText.en: Kill the Demons!

finishText.en: Thank you. I hope you will enjoy this reward.

goal.en: Kill Demons in the Refuge vicinity and return to Aellona.

startText.en: I wanted to ask you one more thing, though this request pains me. Chaos spawns are everywhere, and I fear for the Aoidoi who have found shelter within the walls of the Refuge. Our Sparks may return to the Flow after death, but death has different forms, and ours is such that when we die, we lose ourselves. I don't want this fate for the Aoidoi, which is why I am asking you to cut down those spawns of chaos without mercy. Let them quake in terror!

checkText.en: Who? What?! How did you get here?!

finishText.en: What?! I asked Aellona to stay out of this... Oh, women!

goal.en: Enter the Demonic Portal and find Kyros on the other say.

startText.en: The bat is back! My plan has worked. I can feel Kyros' anger... There are so many enemies around him. He tells me to bring help, but who is going to help us?! We can't wait for the reinforcement from Polis! I must help him now! Will you come with me?

checkText.en: Go ahead! We don't have much time.

finishText.en: I'm glad to see how fiercely you fight our common enemies. The sons of Chaos have brought death to our lands, but you are giving us hope!

goal.en: Protect Kyros while he is destroying the Demonic claws.

startText.en:
Are you wondering why I’m not asking you who you are and where you're from? Me and Aellona can feel each other better than any other Dominae, and I know that you're a friend of hers who has come from a distant land to help, and the rest doesn't matter.

The only thing that matters is expelling that demonic filth. Otherwise it will devour everything and become so powerful that even the walls of Polis, blessed with the breath of the creators, won't withstand it.

Will you help? I don't have the strength to destroy the enemy and chase away the filth at the same time. Your sword will be my only protection!

finishText.en: Well, I'm glad that our paths crossed. I can see you have many questions. I'm afraid I can't answer them all.

goal.en: Destroy Desolator and return to the Refuge.

startText.en: It is too soon to celebrate - I can sense the presence of the one who has brought that army to our lands. Anger and madness overwhelm him... I can't believe the Creator could let such ugly monsters invade his beautiful world. We must stop the hateful enemy!

finishText.en:
Cough... Cough...

Who are you? Although, who cares... Cough... I’m gonna die anyway!

goal.en: Find traces of intruders next to the Site of Power in Celestial Fingers.

startText.en:
Since you’re still here, there’s another issue that might need your... unique talent for dealing with them. Our scouts report that League soldiers were spotted around the Site of Power located in the center of this island.

I don’t like dealing with unknown variables. I’d like to know what mysterious guests we are having here.

finishText.en:
Cough... Cough...

Who are you? Although, who cares... Cough... I’m gonna die anyway!

goal.en: Find traces of intruders next to the Site of Power in Celestial Fingers.

startText.en:
Still here? Good, good, I have a job for you. Our eagles report that there’s something suspicious going on around a Site of Power. The one that’s right in the center of the island, yeah. There are some scouts, and though they don’t look like they are from the Empire, it’s still nothing good.

We should find out who they are and what they need. We have enough problems as it is...

checkText.en:
"Rudy, I will eat him!"

"Calm down, Sivar, you haven't finished the demon yet."

finishText.en:
"Rudy, are those our fighters?"

"Looks like that, Sivar. Fighters, why does the sun shine?!"

"Look at them, they can't say a word. They must be our fighters after all."

goal.en: Find three escaped fighters and bring them back to Rabid family.

startText.en:
"Where are our fighters, Sivar? Are they chilling in the camp?"

"They ran with you when the demon appeared. It's just you ran toward it, and they were running away from it."

"But I caught it, Sivar!"

"Good job, Rudy, but why would you tear at it with your teeth?"

"I don't know, Sivar, it seemed to me that... Hey, you! Where are the rest of the fighters? Why aren't you on duty?!"

"Rudy, you said it wasn't neither a fighter nor a demon. Maybe I can eat it after all?"

"Calm down, Sivar. Maybe it will find the rest of the guys. Then you can eat it."

checkText.en:
"Chipper!! I need the chipper!!"

"Easy, Sivar..."

finishText.en:
"I told you you would find it."

"Find what, Rudy?"

"Your weapon!"

"What weapon?"

"Agh, shut up, Sivar!"

goal.en: Find the lost weapon and bring it to the Rabid family.

startText.en:
"Rudy, where is my chipper?"

"Sivar, what do you need the axe for?"

"Erm, I don't remember. I need my chipper! You hear me?! I need it!!"

"Calm down, Sivar, you will find your axe. And your sword. And your knives. Right?"

checkText.en: Pretend that you don't know me, alright?

finishText.en: You're right on time! I didn't know what to do next: the demons can't break my charms, and I can't kill them because of my charms.

goal.en: Destroy demons near the Hunters' camp and talk to the survivors.

startText.en:
"One, two, three, four, five... Is five a lot or not, Rudy?"

"That's enough, Sivar."

"Enough for what?"

"For... well..."

"Let's kill them all, Rudy!"

"No, they have to kill the demons! That's why they came back, right?"

checkText.en: Who are you? What is your intention?

finishText.en: Stop! You're not one of us, are you? Anyway, since you're here, you can help!

goal.en: Speak to Eladia, find out what is going on on Ammer and what is happening in the north part of Kardis Isthmus.

startText.en: Don't look at me like that. Just pretend you don't know me, okay? Give me a minute, and I will tell you everything.

checkText.en: If you happen to kill a demon, please bring me its heart. I am wasting too much energy sustaining this barrier. If they attack again, I could use any extra source of power.

finishText.en: Well, it will do.

goal.en: Obtain demon hearts on Kardis Isthmus and return to Eladia.

startText.en:
Oh, I almost forgot. The demons that attacked us are very different from their regular Astral kinsmen. They are way too strong and smart.

If you happen to kill a demon, please bring me its heart. I am wasting too much energy sustaining this barrier. If they attack again, I could use any extra source of power.

checkText.en: I'm still waiting for those hearts.

finishText.en:
Well, I guess I'm going to have to make use of it.

What? No, I'm not going to eat it! Just conduct a small energy-transmuting ritual...

You go bring me some more hearts!

goal.en: Obtain demon hearts on Cadis Isthmus and return to Eladia.

startText.en: Since you're here, can you help me? You see, I am in desperate need of demon hearts. What for? To eat them, of course! I'm running out of energy.

checkText.en: What? I'm sorry, I got distracted.

finishText.en: Who is that?! I remember when I thought that demon was going to kill me, some stranger came to the rescue... Was that him?!

goal.en: Together with Franz de Vevre return to the battle site in the north of Kardis Isthmus.

startText.en:
You... I know you! I saw you in the White Fortress, when it was attacked by demons. And here you are again, coming for help. Is this a coincidence?

Alas, it's too late. My friends must be dead already. Demons attacked us outside the camp, and we were fighting desperately, but there were just too many of them. And I... I don't know what happened to me - my mind was fogged. I ran away without realizing what I was doing.

We should go back and see the battle site, but I'm too scared. I fear that the demons can possess my mind again. Will you help me?

finishText.en:
We must have found the kinsmen of the deceased. I can't understand a word they are saying!

Listen, I have an idea...

goal.en: Together with Franz de Vevre go to the north of Kardis Isthmus and find out where the dead stranger had come from.

startText.en:
We should head to the north - the stranger's footprints come from there.

Reckless braveheart... What if he didn't believe in the Light and didn't resurrect? That would be a shame. We should find out who he was.

finishText.en: What are you doing?! I feel... weird!

goal.en: Grab the stranger by the hand and defeat him in the battle of minds.

startText.en:
I can connect your minds! You will be able to speak without words. Although I'm not sure he will like it...

All you have to do is to touch him. Or grab his hand.

checkText.en: What do you want?

finishText.en: Oh, hi there. I'm sorry, I'm a bit busy - I'm thinking. Wait just another three... two... one... Alright, I'm done. Here's what I think: you are the warrior that whole Nezebgrad has been talking about. That's good; I might need your help.

goal.en: Find Goblin Carriers, escort them to the Imperial outpost and speak with Yaver Nut.

startText.en:
Listen to your assignment, soldier!

On the west from here, there's a small camp that guards the approach route to the outpost. I believe they must be running out of supplies. I was going to send you there to keep the watch anyway, so now I'm also asking you to look for our goblin carriers. They got lost somewhere on their way.

And then someone's got to keep an eye on them, or they will just either eat the supplies themselves or get eaten by wild animals.

checkText.en: Eysh, comrade! What do you want?

finishText.en: Eysh, kylys! Did you find the trail of the beast? Let me see...

goal.en: Track down the strange animal and return to Khoor-Kaas.

startText.en:
My soldiers saw a strange animal in the outpost vicinity. Well, they did not exactly see it - they just noticed something moving in the bushes, but when they got there, it was gone.

The strange thing is, the beast keeps on coming back every time we scare it away. I think it's just waiting for the right time to attack and eat us.

My watchmen are too clumsy and can't sneak up on it unnoticed. Maybe you try?

If you find anything, talk to our pathfinder. I would have sent him to track down the beast already, but that idiot got poisoned with some local fruits and has to stay around the loo...

checkText.en: Find some fine leaves and branches. I could do it myself, but I'm not feeling very good...

finishText.en: Here you go. I swear they won't tell you from a tussock!

goal.en: Collect leaves and branches and bring them to Khoor-Kaas.

startText.en:
I know who this fur belongs to!

I've seen them a couple of times. Those little creatures are called gibberlings. I swear this is their fur. They are League spies, zoor? It means, the League is here and they're watching us... Shoysh!

Without their spies, those Kanians will know nothing about us. So we just have to take them down for now. If you want to sneak up on them, you're going to need a good disguise. Bring me some leaves and branches, and I will make it for you, eysh!

checkText.en: Did you find out who's lurking in the bushes?

finishText.en: So, the League is here too? That’s news. But I’m not surprised – we're always no more than half a step ahead of them. And I intend to increase that distance by a step at least, otherwise we’ll be bound hand and foot here.

goal.en: Use the disguise to sneak up to the League spies and return to Yaver Nut.

startText.en: So, ready to go! Put on the cloak and crawl up to the spies. The sergeant's going to be so happy when you get rid of them!

checkText.en: Just set the traps. It will be enough.

finishText.en: Have you set all the traps? Alright, let's just wait now.

goal.en: Place traps along the road from the Imperial Outpost to the center of the Allod, then report to Yaver Nut.

startText.en:
I know one good cure for curiosity... Actually, it's for bears, but it will work on gibberlings, too.

Here, take it. Place it in a bush, and pretty soon we will hear three piteous shouts, huh.

checkText.en: Have you found the League camp?

finishText.en: Alright, we've got the signal! Our soldiers are ready, and now no stupid high command with their armistice will get in our way.

goal.en: Find the League camp and launch the signal rocket, then return to Yaver Nut.

startText.en:
Since the League spies on us, we should do the same and pay them a courtesy visit.

Since there are no League ships hanging above us, it means they have a camp somewhere nearby.

If you find it, launch a signal rocket. We will send our "friendship team" right away, huh.

finishText.en: Crabs! There they are. Come on, quick, the drinks are getting warm.

goal.en: Catch 15 crabs and boil then in a geyser. Then take the boiled crabs to Khoor-Kaas.

startText.en: There are lots of crabs near the lake to the east of the camp. Want to try the local fauna? Catch a few crabs, then boil them right there in a geyser. And I’ll see if we have anything to drink around here...

checkText.en: Hey! What do you want?

finishText.en:
Oh, the food is here! And you must be the new scout?

Yes, I can see it clearly. You were meant for fieldwork, haha!

goal.en: Find the supply convoy, escort it to the League camp and meet Usina Sapogov.

startText.en:
Here is the deal. You're no good for the watch - you're way too heroic and capricious for that. We should put your energy to some proper use.

We've explored this area, but we still have no idea what's beyond the east outspot. I've sent a supply convoy to the watch, but they must have got lost on the way. Can you find them and escort to the outpost? And don't forget to look around!

If you notice anything, report immediately!

checkText.en: So, did you find anything?

finishText.en: Imperial spies?! Oh my! How could we let them get so close!

goal.en: Search the surroundings of the League camp and find the trails of the mysterious spies.

startText.en:
Someone's spying on us, and no matter how hard we try, we can't catch them. We don't even know whether it's a beast or a human being.

Here's what I think: if somebody's been watching us, perharps they already know everything about us. But they're not expecting you. Why don't you look around - maybe you'll notice something?

finishText.en:
A bottle dropped by the Imperial spies? Hm, let me take a look at it.

Phew, what a stink! Don't they brush their teeth at all?

goal.en: Give the empty bottle to Marius de Ardeur.

startText.en:
There can be no mistake: they are from the Empire. However, I'm not sure what that potion in the bottle was... What if they wanted to poison the spring?

Listen, bring this bottle to Marius, our sorcerer and alchemist. The elf knows his onions. Maybe he'll recognize the smell.

checkText.en: I need Wolf Eye. It's the crucial ingredient.

finishText.en: Nice berries! Now give me a minute...

goal.en: Gather Wolf Eye berries near the camp and bring them to Marius de Ardeur.

startText.en:
Looks like that was a distracting potion. No wonder our sentries didn't notice a thing: this magic potion is extremely difficult to spot. Now when you know who's our enemy, you can surprise them.

I know that Wolf Eye berry grows in this area. Bring me some, and I will make a decoction that will come in very handy for us. Just don't eat it! That would be a very shameful death.

checkText.en: What do you have for me?

finishText.en: You've killed the Imperial spies? That's something I love to hear! I can't wait until this stupid ceasefire is over.

goal.en: Drink the Decoction of True Vision, kill the Imperial spies, and report to Usina Sapogov.

startText.en: Alright, here you go. Just one sip - and you will see even through the thickest haze. After two sips you will see things that nobody is really supposed to see. Well, after three sips people usually see the Purgatory, so don't get carried away. When you're done with the spies, let our gloomy lieutenant know the good news.

checkText.en: Watch your feet.

finishText.en: Let's surprise our uninvited guests!

goal.en: Set the signal rockets around the camp and report to Usina Sapogov.

startText.en:
I have an idea. Since we know that enemy spies are lurking in the bushes, why don't we set a trap for them?

I have a couple of signal rockets. We could string a rope between two trees and attach those rockets to it - the spies will never notice it in the dark. And we will definitely notice the fireworks!

Will you help me do that?

checkText.en: Have you found the Empire camp?

finishText.en: Alright, we've got the signal! Our soldiers are ready, and now no stupid high command with their armistice will get in our way.

goal.en: Find the Empire camp and launch the signal rocket, then return to Yaver Nut.

startText.en:
How about we all play this game together?

If the Empire has its soldiers spying on us, and there are no Imperial ships hanging above us, it means they have a camp somewhere nearby.

I know you don't like to sit around and wait, so why don't you go search the woods and give us a signal if you find their camp?

finishText.en: Crabs! There they are. Come on, quick, the drinks are getting warm.

goal.en: Catch 15 crabs and boil then in a geyser. Then take the boiled crabs to Usina.

startText.en: There are lots of crabs near the lake to the east of the camp. Want to try the local fauna? Catch a few crabs, then boil them right there in a geyser. And I’ll see if we have anything to drink around here...

checkText.en: Good luck. This time you will need it.

finishText.en:
This is going nowhere good.

Well, for now we're fine - we've defeated Kyros, the Servant of Tensess is on his duty again.

But the most important question is - where did Kyros get such power? His body was reshaped by the Primal Chaos itself. Do you understand what that means? I think my father has something to do with that. He must be somewhere near.

I can sense him.

I don't know what he has in mind, but be careful. I will do my best to keep him out of Sarnaut, but you already know that I can't do that on my own.

goal.en: Survive the dangers of the Secret Paths and stop Kyros.

startText.en:
Well, well, the boy is ambitious. How fast they grow!

Alright. The thing is, Kyros has all chances to achieve his goal. How do I know that? Well, let’s call it intuition. I can feel a mysterious power in him.

To follow Kyros if he opens the portal, you will have to enter the Well of Souls. Yes, that pillar of light which spawns newborn Aoidoi. My magic will direct you right to the Secret Paths, the deepest layer of the Planar Rim. I don't know what is waiting for you down there. If you are lucky, you will find an entrance to the Purgatory. And you will be the first mortal in history to enter it alive.

But you're used to it, aren't you?

checkText.en: Did you find the squirrels?

finishText.en: So, no more squirrels in these woods? Good job! Thank you, friend. Here's your reward.

goal.en: Kill Sabertooth Squirrels and their leader near the Imperial camp and collect the reward from Hatchet the Montane.

startText.en:
Hey, you watch out there. The squirrels are crazy in these woods! I've seen nothing like that even on the Wild Isles. They've got teeth as big as human fingers! I tell you, they can bite through steel.

See these four holes on my hip? That's them! If you kill a couple of the furry wretches, I will owe you one!

checkText.en: Did you find the squirrels?

finishText.en: So, no more squirrels in these woods? Good job! Thank you, friend. Here's your reward.

goal.en: Kill Sabertooth Squirrels near the Imperial camp and collect the reward from Hatchet the Montane.

startText.en: Hey, you watch out there. The squirrels are crazy in these woods! I've seen nothing like that even on the Wild Isles. They've got teeth as big as human fingers! I tell you, they can bite through steel.

finishText.en:
Phew! I thought I'd die here! And hardly anything can be worse than being eaten by these monsters.

I must say, I've never been rescued before. I feel a little embarrassed.

goal.en: Find Bowstring the Bosque in the grove near the Imperial camp.

startText.en:
Hey comrade! Have you seen an orcish lady around here? A tall one, with a bow?

She promised to stop by yesterday, and there's still no sign of her. I know her; if she promises something, she keeps her word!

Listen, you are allowed to leave the camp, aren't you? Can you please look for my friend? She said she'd go hunting...

checkText.en: Give hell to the damned spiders!

finishText.en: Thank the Light, she’s alive! Thank you. I’m really glad to hear it.

goal.en: Kill the spider queen and her servants and return to Bowstring the Bosque.

startText.en:
I got into such a mess! I was just walking through the forest when I saw a cobweb and decided to swat it. So, I swatted the stupid thing... I got stuck immediately, the web was strong as steel. While I was trying to break free, those eight-legged monsters surrounded me and wrapped me in a cocoon before I could say a thing! And the huge mother spider kept staring at me and prodding me... Yu-u-u-uck, I almost threw up.

Hey, would you do me a favor? Cut those monsters’ and their queen’s legs right off! I would do it myself, but I'm still nauseous from the poison.

checkText.en: Hey, did you find a way to get rid of the bats?

finishText.en: No more damned bats? Ah, this is good news! Now we can keep our watch safely.

goal.en: Kill 10 bats near the League camp and return to Chivisa Artful.

startText.en:
Do you see them? Do you? Neither do I. Cursed creatures! I can sense their presense, but I can't see where they hide.

Who? Ah, you must be new here.

Every night it's a nightmare. Every night we are attacked by a whole flock of huge bloodsucking bats!

Listen, you're not going to sit around in the camp, are you? Can you do us a favor and kill the damned things? We will find a way to thank you!

checkText.en: Hey, did you find a way to get rid of the bats?

finishText.en: No more damned bats? Ah, this is good news! Now we can keep our watch safely.

goal.en: Kill 10 bats near the League camp and return to Chivisa Artful.

startText.en:
Do you see them? Do you? Neither do I. Cursed creatures! I can sense their presence, but I can't see where they hide.

Who? Ah, you must be new here.

Every night it's a nightmare. Every night we are attacked by a whole flock of huge bloodsucking bats!

Listen, you're not going to sit around in the camp, are you? Can you do us a favor and kill the damned things? We will find a way to thank you!

finishText.en: What? Somebody killed a sentry and nobody noticed?

goal.en: Tell Bronislav Malinovsky about the sentry's body.

startText.en:
This body has been terribly disfigured. It was torn apart with claws and fangs, and the wounds on the chest look as if it was pierced with a spear. But animals don't use spears!

Bronislav Malinovsky and other sentries should be warned of the incident.

checkText.en: Did you find the killer?

finishText.en: So that was a Manticore? What a monstrous thing! Thank you so much for helping us!

goal.en: Find the Manticore near the League camp and bring its head to Bronislav Malinovsky.

startText.en: If you see that beast that killed my sentry, you should chop it into little pieces! But don't forget to bring its head to me - I will use it as a deterrence against other monsters who think they can just come and slaughter my soldiers.

checkText.en: Any minerals will do - mica, granite, whatever! Even limestone.

finishText.en: Mica, granite, pumice, limestone... all mixed into a weirdest blend. What on earth is that? We need to find out more.

goal.en: Obtain rock samples and return to Negus Setuteph at the Imperial outpost.

startText.en:
As far as I'm concerned, you're not a big fan of theoretic research and prefer fieldwork, if I may say so? This is just excellent!

You see, dear colleague, this allods tends to disprove all theories of evolution and evolvement. Even local minerals make my brain squeak like a rusty barrow! Normally, an allod's structure resembles a layer-cake: the more solid a material is, the deeper it lies. And here it's an absolute paradoxical mess!

Could you please be so kind and bring me some samples for the study? Anything will do, from mica to limestone. Maybe this will clear things up...

checkText.en: Did you catch anything, dear colleague?

finishText.en:
Let me see...

My analyzers show that their vital energy is two or three times higher than normally! This is absolutely unbelievable!

At first I thought I had made a mistake when I was researching the flora samples, but now I see that each one of these is just so full of life! However, I have no idea what causes this deviation.

goal.en: Catch a bird, a frog, a jerboa, and a spider, and bring them to Negus Setuteph.

startText.en:
I suggest we stop researching the nonliving world and turn to the living one.

I have noticed that the local fauna is very peculiar. Its representatives seem to be identical with the common species that we are used to, but this similarity ends with their physical appearances. Imagine that: a gopher bit through my steel prosthesis when I was trying to dissect it! I had to exterminate the specimen, and I would be very thankful if you could help me obtain some more experiment samples.

checkText.en: A precise analysis requires different species.

finishText.en: So, we have a prehistoric fern, a tree, and a flower. They are all full of vital energy, and what's more interesting, they are all of approximately the same age! This is just nonsense. Under usual cinditions, they would be divided according to their habitat. What does it say to us?

goal.en: Bring samples of the local flora to Negus Setuteph.

startText.en:
I think we should go back to studying flora. Something tells me that the results of this research will be even more surprising.

Have you already noticed that fern here grows right next to redbud? It is absolutely impossible under usual conditions, but this is not our case. Could you please bring me some flora samples so that I could make a deeper study?

finishText.en:
This is it! All three chronographs show different time! And the closer they are to the center of the allod, the bigger is the differnce. I'm sure, time used to run much faster in this place!

Do you understand what this means? What took days in Sarnaut, took years on the periphery of this allod, and decades in its center. Happily for us, the difference is not that big anymore and it keeps declining. This is just incredible! We must reach the center of the allod. I'm sure there we will find the cause of that phenomena.

goal.en: Take the chronometer readings in the spots marked by Negus Setuteph and return to him.

startText.en:
So, what do we have? Plants and animals hold tremendous vital power, and the species are mixed up in the way they could never be under usual conditions. The same relates to minerals which are not divided into layers as they should be.

What conclusion can we make? I have only one hypothesis, and your three-day delay fits in it perfectly - here, time doesn't go in the same way it does in the rest of Sarnaut. This hypothesis needs a proof, this is why I ask you, my dear colleague, to set these chronometers in three equidistant spots outside the camp. Their readings will show us whether I am right or not.

They will confirm my hypothesis!

checkText.en: Bring me anything you can find - limestone, mica, whatever! Right now, I have no idea how this allod can exist at all.

finishText.en: Mica, granite, pumice, limestone... all mixed into a weirdest blend. What on earth is that? We need to find out more.

goal.en: Obtain rock samples and return to Ursula de Blizare at the League camp.

startText.en:
Greetings. I heard your conversation with Bronislav and, honestly, I don't understand a thing.

You see, this allods tends to disprove all theories of evolution and evolvement. Even plain rocks are wrong! Normally, an allod's structure resembles a layer-cake: the more solid a material is, the deeper it lies. And here it's an absolute paradoxical mess!

Could you please be so kind and bring me some samples for the study? Anything will do, from mica to limestone. Maybe this will clear things up...

checkText.en: Did you catch anything?

finishText.en:
Nice catch, eysh! Let me see...

Shoysh! It can't be!

This little gopher has more vital power than a tiger! It is just full of life, like everything around us, eysh!

This is some kind of magic, I swear on the spirits of ancestors. Every little tree on this blessed land is filled with power!

goal.en: Catch a bird, a frog, a jerboa, and a spider and bring them to Gaal-Tohtar.

startText.en:
I could use some help, before this place drives me completely insane!

Local animals do look like usual ones, but their habits are very different. I can find a way to connect with almost any animal, but here they just don't hear me and run away if I try to approach them.

Maybe you have more luck? Can you please catch some birds or lizards or a grasshopper? I just want to take a closer look at them, eysh!

checkText.en: Here's your saw, there are the trees - come on, we have much work to do!

finishText.en: Very interesting... The trees look old, but they all have from one to three year rings, and the rings that are closer to the center are much thicker than the outer ones. I have a conjecture about how it all could happen, and I need you to help me prove it!

goal.en: Bring cuts of olive, redbud, and laurel to Ursula de Blizare.

startText.en:
The age of this allod can be calculated not only from its minerals, but also from its flora. Something tells me that the results of this research will be even more surprising.

However, let's not jump into conclusions. First, we need to study some tree cuts. If they indeed had been created with magic, as my furry friend supposes, than they will look rather differently from those grown naturally.

checkText.en: Set the chronographs on the north, south, and west from the camp, and I will try and put their readings together into some kind of a consistent theory.

finishText.en:
This is it! All three chronographs show different time! And the closer they are to the center of the allod, the bigger is the differnce. I'm sure, time used to run much faster in this place!

Do you understand what this means? What took days in Sarnaut, took years on the periphery of this allod, and decades in its center.
