Happily for us, the difference is not that big anymore and it keeps declining. This is just incredible! We must reach the center of the allod. I'm sure there we will find the cause of that phenomena.

goal.en: Take the chronometer readings in the spots marked by Ursula de Blizare and return to her.

startText.en:
So now it is a confirmed fact: time runs differently in this place. But how exactly does it happen? That's a good question. The first one we should answer, actually.

Take these three chronographs and place them in three different spots. If I am right, then they will most likely show different time after a while. I can’t wait to see the results!

finishText.en:
Hurr... Pff...

Hurr... Pff...

goal.en: Find the sentries who went to the Imperial camp.

startText.en:
Hey! I've got a request for you. We're friends, aren't we?

I can't find our sentries anywhere. There's a guarding camp to the west from here, and the guards change at the same time every day.

The previous shift was supposed to return already, but they still haven't. Can you please go and see what's the matter with them?

checkText.en: Zzz...

finishText.en: Jeez, what was that?!

goal.en: Try to wake up the soldier and find out what happened.

startText.en:
The soldier sleeps on duty! This a military court case!

But there is something suspicious about his sleepy mumbling... How could four seasoned soldiers just fall asleep all at the same time? They need to be questioned.

finishText.en:
So you say it was all because of mushrooms? They infected our tobacco?

Alright, I have another tobacco seed. But this time I will plant it in a pot!

goal.en: Destroy tobacco bushes infected with the mushroom spores and return to Puff the Mariner.

startText.en:
We fell asleep on duty... Oh, we can be sentenced for that!

Listen, it wasn't our fault! How could we know there was something wrong with the local plants?

So this is what happened: a had a tobacco seed in my pocket. I had noticed that everything here grows like crazy; so I planted that seed, and the next day, there was a bush of fine tobacco! I cut it down, dried it, and then when the guys came to take their shift, I offered them to share a pipe... We all pulled at it just once, and then we fell where we stood!

I can't even move my arms, and my head feels awfully hazy... Destroy that tobacco, will you? Nobody should ever smoke that again...

checkText.en: Greetings!

finishText.en: Good day, officer! Our crew is ready for departure, but there is one thing...

goal.en: Meet Aristarchus Palubin at the Nezebgrad port.

name.en: On the of the Gods' Trail

startText.en:
Finally. I'm not going to beat around the bush - we are starting a research expedition, and I want you in it. I think you know why. Our scouts report that the Astral storm on the site of the greatest battle in the history of Sarnaut has finally eased off. We know the League is sending their ships there, too.

I don't know what they will find there. Maybe nothing, and maybe a legacy of the gods that can decide the outcome of our war. And I'm not going to take risks.

The ships are ready to depart, so hurry up. Remember - the Empire counts on you!

checkText.en: What is it you want?

finishText.en:
Do you want to hire mercenaries? That we can provide, but here's the thing...

We are used to fighting demons, but only on allods and not in the open Astral on the other side of the world. That requires special qualifications.

goal.en: Talk to Alexandra Soldina about guarding "Workers' Pride"

startText.en:
Frankly, there was no need to hurry - we're not flying anywhere right now. The Astral is swarming with enraged Demons. You can't avoid facing them when you're out there. We can hold on as long as our cannons keep them at distance, but if they make it to the deck, we're done for.

As far as I know, you're on a friendly footing with mercenaries? Why don't you ask them to join us? The Empire will pay generously!

checkText.en: Are there any good news?

finishText.en:
Hey! Stay where you are!

Are you standing still? Just let me take aim...

goal.en: Settle the cooperation conditions with the mercenaries.

startText.en: I know I can trust you, but I can't make my guys do what they don't want to. And, honestly, I'm not really eager to risk their lives right now. You will have to speak with them personally. Maybe some will join you.

checkText.en: Is everyone present?

finishText.en: Is everyone present? Great. Come on, jump on board.

goal.en: Tell Aristarchus Palubin that the mercenaries are ready.

startText.en:
Huh, thank you. The cannon works. It didn't blast you to bits, so we can consider the experiment a success, he he.

So, whom did you say we need to shoot? A couple of demons? No problem at all, happy to do it – maybe another interesting idea will come up...

finishText.en: I can't believe my eyes... Where have you been for three days?!

goal.en: Board the ship and follow the expedition flagship.

startText.en: Don't worry! We have the best engines in the whole Empire fleet. We'll catch up with them in no time!

checkText.en: Greetings!

finishText.en: Oh hello. So it's who you I've been waiting for?

goal.en: Meet Igor Compasov in the port of Novograd.

name.en: On the of the Gods' Trail

startText.en:
Good day, good day... I have an urgent request for you.

Our intelligence report that the Astral storm on the site of the greatest battle in the history of Sarnaut - you know what I'm talking about - has finally eased off. We know the Empire is sending their research ships there, and so should we.

I don't know what they will find there. Maybe nothing, and maybe a legacy of the gods that can decide the outcome of our war. And I'm not going to take risks.

The ships are ready to depart, so hurry up. Remember - the League counts on you!

checkText.en: What is it you want?

finishText.en:
Do you want to hire mercenaries? That we can provide, but here's the thing...

We are used to fighting demons, but only on allods and not in the open Astral on the other side of the world. That requires special qualifications.

goal.en: Talk to Vlastemir Naimitov about guarding "Firefly".

startText.en:
Frankly, there was no need to hurry - we're not flying anywhere right now. The Astral is swarming with enraged Demons. You can't avoid facing them when you're out there. We can hold on as long as our cannons keep them at distance, but if they make it to the deck, we're done for.

As far as I know, you're on a friendly footing with mercenaries? Why don't you ask them to join us? We will pay generously!

checkText.en: Are there any good news?

finishText.en:
Hey! Stay where you are!

Are you standing still? Just let me take aim...

goal.en: Settle the cooperation conditions with the mercenaries.

startText.en: I know I can trust you, but I can't make my guys do what they don't want to. And, honestly, I'm not really eager to risk their lives right now. You will have to speak with them personally. Maybe some will join you.

checkText.en: Hey, get out of the way!

finishText.en: Sooo... I guess this goes here, and that goes there... It works!

goal.en: Obtain 20 terminal clamps from broken Mechanoids and Clanking Destroyers on Irdrich and bring them to the Kaboom family.

startText.en:
Come on, who sent you? Was it Shesterkin? We already told him we're not revealing the secret of our grenade mix!

Not him? Huh! So you probably want to hire us. Alright, but there's one business that we've got to finish, and you can help us. We need twenty terminal clamps.

You see those rusty metal chunks over there? There's plenty of those in them. The walking ones have even more!

checkText.en: Look here, and aim there. Don't mix it up!

finishText.en:
Great, everything works!

Scaggy, you lost - all hands are still attached. It's a shame you didn't trust your own family!

goal.en: Destroy two Castle Mechanoids after breaking their shields with the gibberlings' device and return to the Kaboom family.

startText.en:
It works! This is a true engineering discovery!

And you have a unique opportunity to test it! Don't worry, the devices that we invent almost always work.

We saw a couple of bulky metal dolts around here with some kind of energy cocoons around them. We bet our gun will break their shields with one shot.

You help us, and we will help you. Deal?

checkText.en: Is everyone present?

finishText.en: Is everyone present? Great. Come on, jump on board.

goal.en: Tell Igor Compasov that the mercenaries are ready.

startText.en:
Huh, thank you. The cannon works. It didn't blast you to bits, so we can consider the experiment a success, he he.

So, whom did you say we need to shoot? A couple of demons? No problem at all, happy to do it – maybe another interesting idea will come up...

finishText.en: This is unbelievable. Where the hell have you been for three days?

goal.en: Board the ship and follow the expedition flagship.

startText.en: Don't worry! We have the best engines in the whole League fleet. We'll catch up with them in no time!

checkText.en: What do you want to know?

finishText.en:
Madman! Grief has clouded his mind...

But where does that great power come from? Why couldn't we defeat him?

goal.en: Watch the Dominae Forum.

startText.en:
On behalf of all Aoidoi, I thank you for helping Kyros. If it were not for you, who knows where his arrogance would get us? A death of each one of us is a great loss.

We decided that you should attend our Forum. I must ask you not to speak unless you are being addressed. This is our duty as the dominae - we have to settle any strife all by ourselves, and not let anything slip outside.

Let's not waste time. We should deal with this as soon as possible.

finishText.en:
I was just wondering where the hell you were.

Hurry, we don't have much time.

goal.en: Come to Polis and ask Eladia for help.

startText.en:
We can still... feel Kyros. Touching his mind is like fire walking. I'm afraid that in his madness he might kill any of us if we try to pursue him. But we cannot let him into the outer world!

I am most worried about the strange nature of the portal that he opened up. This is not Aoidoi magic, Stormbringer, this is something completely different! We have never seen it before. The mere sight of the portal instills terror in our hearts!

We have to ask you to help us once again. Your people have been in this world much longer than we have. Maybe some of the mages that you know can tell us what it is?

checkText.en: What are you waiting for?

finishText.en: Are you done? Great. Let's see.

goal.en: Use Eladia's device to measure magical disturbances on the Forum, near the Well of Souls, and in Polis center.

startText.en:
This damned allod is falling apart at the seams. On the spatial, magical level, of course. Portal magic does no good to a newly born land. It could barely sustain the demonic portals, but Kyros has created something completely different...

The allod is screaming in terror. Do you understand that? You should thank your gods you can't hear it.

We need to find where Kyros went before he does something worse. We will use the old reliable technique of triangulation. We need to measure magical disturbances in three key points around Polis. Then, using that data, we will find the rupture in space... As simple as that.

Meanwhile, I will stabilize the subspace, or our newly born race will soon have to sail across the open Astral.

checkText.en: Great mysteries can solve themselves, you know.

finishText.en:
Hm, let me see. A spear... I can't say much about it; you better show it to the locals. Crystals... hm.

Damn it. This can be only one sort of magic.

goal.en: Go to the place where the portal was opened and find out where Kyros went.

startText.en:
Here it is! I knew he couldn't get too far away in the material world. Look - the portal is located right here.

Now you should go there and find out where Kyros went. If you find him, I suggest you don't fight him. Who knows what he's got up his sleeve? And then, I would like to interrogate him myself and find out who taught him this magic. And how come that dominae telepathy does not allow us to do it right now.

checkText.en: Do you want to tell me something?

finishText.en: Indeed, providence must be guiding you, Stormbringer. I was going to send for you myself. Something mysterious has happened.

goal.en: Ask Eladia about the nature of the portal and ask the dominae for help.

startText.en: The magic in these crystals is very similar to the kind Nihaz used. Basically, these crystals are extremely powerful mana batteries. One of them can hold enough energy to destroy this whole allod. And there were... how many of them? And they are all empty. All their energy was used to open a portal. But where did it lead? Oh, of course...

checkText.en: I'm sorry I couldn't save him...

finishText.en: Church? Well, this makes it easier, right? The representatives of the Trinity Church most probably know him.

goal.en: Go to Celestia and ask about the wounded orc.

startText.en:
An hour ago our scouts found a wounded orc near the city wall. They say, he is in a really bad condition. He's delirious and mumbles something all the time. They took him to Celestia, our best healer.

Maybe this is the lead that you're looking for. Go to Celestia and find out what had happened to him.

checkText.en: Did you get the answers to your questions?

finishText.en:
The jigsaw is falling into place. At least now we know who attacked the Trinity Church representatives. And who helps Kyros in his dark deeds...

This is going nowhere good.

goal.en: Ask Ilya Molitvin about the dead orc and report to Ionas.

startText.en:
Since that Orc served the church, he must have resurrected, right? Oh, thank Creation... There is nothing worse for a healer than to lose a patient’s life. I still failed, but at least he's alive...

I heard that someone called Ilya Molitvin was the official Trinity Church representative in Polis. He must know who that orc is.

When you find that out, go back to Ionas. The dominae must know what is going on.

finishText.en: Finally, someone's here! The centaurs have lost their marbles!

goal.en: Teleport to the Spiral Ridge and start searching for Kyros.

startText.en:
Together with us, other sentient beings appeared on this allod... With their own customs and beliefs. Those arrows that you found and the horseshoe prints leave no doubt that centaurs are Kyros' allies.

Centaurs are a wild tribe that lives on the Spiral Ridge. No one but Kyros could ever find a common language with them. He challenged their chieftain and killed him, that's how he earned their respect and awe.

But this doesn't bring us any closer to solving the main mystery... Centaur magic is primitive. I don't believe any of them could open that portal.

However, this is where we should look for Kyros. Go there as fast as you can, Stormbringer.

finishText.en: Here you are. Now we can start the Forum.

goal.en: Go to Amos and tell him you are ready to participate in the Forum.

startText.en:
It is time for us to return to the tragedy you had to witness. Kyros has emerged from his grief... and now he's ready to face us. Some things you can't say telepathically. We need to hear about what happened from him too, not just from you.

I would like you to appear at the Forum like one of us. We may need your testimony.

finishText.en:
There you are, Stormbringer!

I had no doubts I’d see you soon. Have you heard of the Olympics? Think of the excitement, the rankings, and shiny victor’s laurels! Oh yes! I know that feeling!

So, Stormbringer. Are you ready to show the Domini and the whole Sarnaut what you’re made of? Ready to show who the real champion of the Dionic Games is?

Welcome to the Olympics!

Any questions? Ask away!

goal.en: Meet with Heracles near the Coliseum on the Dionic Archipelago.

startText.en: Heracles invites you to join the Dionic Olympics and offers you to meet him. He will explain everything about the event and the rewards.

checkText.en: Five trials. Five gold medals. The rules are simple.

finishText.en:
Excellent! I never doubted you, Stormbringer.

Go on and win enough Dionic Emblems to receive the title of Champion!

goal.en: During one day, win five gold medals in five trials of Dionic Games and bring them to Phoebus. If you exchange the medals for Dionic Emblems, you will not be able to turn them in to Phoebus!

startText.en:
I’m happy to see the sporting spirit of our guests!

Anyone can become a champion, but it’s not easy! In order to become a champion, you need to win a gold medal in every discipline... all in one day!

Do you think you’re worthy?

checkText.en: Five Trials. Each will reveal a new side to your talent. Don’t miss your chance!

finishText.en: Not bad! Maybe you want to become a champion? I think you could make it!

goal.en: In 24 hours, participate in all five trails of Dionic Games and report to Phoebus.

startText.en:
So, the Games are on. Five trials open for everyone!

Amos is hosting the trial of speed - the chariot race. Dionysius is the patron of the dexterity trial - Pegasus flights! Kora’s trial is a test of your reaction and stamina - steeplechase. Ionas will challenge your stealth in the Underground Labyrinth. And mine is the trial of strength - Gladiator games in the Coliseum!

I invite you to participate in all of them. You will be greatly rewarded!

checkText.en: How are you progressing with the Challenges? Do not hurry, you have all the time in the world.

finishText.en:
Amazing! You have surprised me, Stormbringer! It is an honor to announce you the worthiest!
Please, accept this whistle for the golden ghostly ball. When you have enough Dionic Emblems, you can have it right from my hands.

goal.en: Complete 5 Challenges of Dionic Games and report to Aegala.

startText.en: Are you ready for a special challenge of Dionic Games, Stormbringer? Complete every Dominus' challenge! Prove yourself worthy of the reward!

finishText.en: Wonderful. I knew you'd be interested! Well, are you ready for the challenge?

goal.en: Meet Phoebus in Coliseum on Dionic Archipelago.

startText.en:
Greetings, Stormbringer!

The games organizers, the Dominus, and I prepared a special challenge for the participants of Dionic Games. Some might find it complicated... but it is not your case, isn't it?

I can't wait to see you in Coliseum.

checkText.en: Who doesn’t like speed? Nothing can be better than a break from the slowness of our everyday life.

finishText.en:
Debacle’s creations are scary, but one shouldn’t doubt their effectiveness. I think the poor bulls are afraid of him. Thank you, my friend. I will not forget this.

Would you like to be the first to take the Road of the Winds?

goal.en: Ask Gaal-Tohtar and Debacle Junior for help. Return to Amos.

startText.en:
Sometimes it seems to me that the title of Dominus of Fate is nothing but a mockery. Why else would my mind make me throw myself into mysteries that I cannot possibly unravel? I’m afraid I need your help, Stormbringer - otherwise the Aoidoi will be dishonored.

Ionas helped us build the road around the Archipelago. There was a clear purpose for that road - it was meant to serve as a track for the race trial. But you see, building a road is just half the work. Who was going to ride on it? So I decided to create chariots, powered by living force and magitechnology. But I know nothing either about taming wild beasts or mechanics... Luckily, some do. Maybe they can help me solve my problem?

I heard there was a great Priden tracker among our guests. I bet he could help me trap several bulls and tame them. I could also use help of a good mechanic... I know a goblin named Debacle Junior who is a master of his profession. Although some say he is a dangerous fellow...

Will you help me, Stormbringer?

checkText.en: Now take this rope and go ahead!

finishText.en:
Haha, you’re a natural-born trapper, eysh! Just kidding. However, you trapped a couple of bulls with just bare rope. And not just somewhere but on Ammer, where they have so much life force! Be proud!

The job is done - the bulls are caught, your Amos is happy, and I had my fun. Now get lost, eysh!

goal.en: Noose three wild bulls and bring them to Gaal-Tohtar.

startText.en:
Ay-hya, what am I even doing here? It’s the most boring place in the world! Nobody fights anyone. Nothing ever happens! Damn those peaceful Aoidoi.

What do you want, zoor? What? Trap some bulls? I used to do this when I was a kid, eysh! Do you call that entertainment? However... I have an idea. Why don’t YOU trap them? I will teach you. I bet it will be fun.

Here, kylys, take this noose. Throw it on a bull’s neck. Then it will run! If it runs towards you, be quick to dodge, and if it runs away, make sure to hold the rope tightly.

Now take this rope and go ahead!

checkText.en: That Amos must be a very wise guy.

finishText.en:
Okay, now that’s what I call the assault of Eclipse! Not that little fight we had three years ago.

Your machine will be ready soon. A damn fine machine!

What do you mean a bull will pull it?!

goal.en: Together with Debacle Junior, get to Eclipse and collect mana batteries from the watch keeper.

startText.en:
Hey there. What do you want?

What? You want to hire me as a mechanic? Ha! I’m making a reputation with Aoidoi! Well, nice to meet you. My name is Debacle Junior. What do you want me to do? Build a machine?

I could do that. I will just need a couple of mana batteries. A watch keeper at Eclipse promised to get me some! They may have been in use, but it doesn’t make them any worse.

Okay, so we need a boat to get to Eclipse. Let’s call it Operation Pi! That sounds mysterious enough.

checkText.en: Are you ready to ride your chariot in Dionic Race?

finishText.en: That was a great race, Stormbringer! Here is your reward.

goal.en:
Take part in Amos' Chariot race.

The race begins 5 times a day. You may find the schedule in the Calendar.

startText.en:
Dionic track is waiting for its riders! Feel the raging howl of the wind, hold your breath on every turn! Your only goal is to reach the finish line and be the first one to do so! Cut them off, use your chariot’s attacks - and victory will be yours!

Are you ready to ride your chariot in Dionic Race?

checkText.en: Let's see how you can make it, he-he.

finishText.en: It cannot be! Is there anything at all that you can't complete?

goal.en: Complete Dionic Games: Chariot Race with extra objectives:

startText.en:
Well, if you're up for a real race... Accept my challenge!

You must finish first. Sounds easy, eh? No way. You have 4 minutes to do so. And you also have to collect all bonuses along the way. Every single one of them!

Let's see how you can make it, he-he.

checkText.en: Let's go!

finishText.en:
This Debacle’s improvement looks... impressive. I like it.

I hope you’re satisfied, too, Stormbringer.

goal.en: Do a test drive on Amos’ chariot around the Archipelago.

startText.en:
Well, the chariots are ready, the roads are ready, the bulls are tamed... Time to start racing! You should be the first one to try out the great Dionic Track, Stormbringer!

Be careful though - Debacle mentioned some “explosive stuff” that he had installed on the chariots... I have no idea what that is!

finishText.en:
Greetings, Stormbringer. The Dominae have approved of your assistance in dealing with our... problem.

I will try and keep it short.

goal.en: Accept Cosmos’ invitation and go to Cassandra’s house on the edge of Dionic Archipelago.

startText.en:
I can see you’ve done a lot for Dionic Games, Stormbringer. I thank you for that, but sadly another trouble has come our way. Something that can ruin the whole celebration... We need your talents.

Find Asclepia the healer near that house on the periphery. She will tell you what happened. Go!

checkText.en: You seem pretty busy, darling!

goal.en: Discover the nature of poison that Cassandra took.

startText.en:
One of the caldrons in the common canteen was poisoned. The food from that caldron was supposed to be served to dozens of people. Domina Cassandra took her host’s privilege and tried it first. In three heartbeats, she... fell asleep. Lost her consciousness, as they say on other allods.

I don’t even want to think of what would have happened if the food had been served to the guests! It would have killed them...

The Dominae think that you can help. Talk to Evrisius, the cook - no, he’s not guilty. And also Aera, the healer, who is trying to extract the poison from the caldron. We must find the evildoer! Or they can strike again.

finishText.en:
Hello. What a beautiful allod right? I hope I live to see our New Land flourish... What is it you want from me? Whaaat? The Great Tree? Are you out of your mind?

Tell me, why do you need it?

Oh, the Aoidos lady is in trouble... That's too bad. You see, our patron Nordrak is helping us restore the New Land. Once he used to be a Great Dragon! Now only his Spark is left of him, but it's still strong - the Great Tree keeps growing thanks to his power. It grows... out of him. Do you understand?

goal.en: Ask Froddy to give you the sprout of the Great Tree.

startText.en:
Don’t panic, of course we can beat that Nothing and banish it from our world. We need to call on the force of Creation itself. The Aoidos is still alive because she’s a descendant of Sarn and the Architect, and this means her body is filled with it. But she’s still mortal, so we need to make sure that Nothing never breaks out of her body. What? Do we need to keep her alive?

Oh, you’re asking for too much... Alright. I saw that gibberling guy strolling around, Froddy was his name, I believe. For some reason he had a sprout of the Great Tree hanging in a vial around his neck.

The tree is capable of resisting the Astral, and there’s a reason for that. It contains a great force - it can feed on anything and grow infinitely... Which makes it kind of similar to that poison. I bet that sprout can devour the darkness inside the Aoidos. You just need to persuade the gibberling to give up that sprout.

finishText.en:
However grateful I am for what you did on that damned ship, I wouldn’t want to end up on the same allod as you.

You are called Stormbringer for a reason.

goal.en: Convince Soliskar to help Cassandra.

startText.en:
Nordrak will die soon, but his power and spirit will remain with us - in the shape of the Tree. It is one with the Dragon force, and we still need Dragons in our world... I was supposed to meet one here, actually. And I already have - I gave her the sprout, and now she takes care of it.

So now if anyone can help you, it’s Soliskar - that’s her name. She couldn’t have gone too far; in fact, I believe the Aoidoi invited her to stay.

I believe since the Dragons and the Tree have so much in common, she can help you cure Cassandra, right?

checkText.en: Cassandra is getting worse. She’s dying...

finishText.en:
I... can’t believe that! She’s breathing, her fever is fading, her skin turns normal again... Thanks Creation! Stormbringer, you work wonders!

Thanks to you and Soliskar and Klavdia and Froddy, Cassandra will live!

goal.en: Together with Soliskar destroy the darkness in Cassandra’s body.

startText.en:
Hm! Humans’ impudence has always astounded me. I needed that sprout to restore my strength after what that demented sorceress had done to me. Nordrak knows that I have to... continue existing in this world.

Tell me, why do you think I would care about your miserable kind? Why would I help that woman?

finishText.en: Welcome, Stormbringer. Let me thank you again for helping Cassandra - each of us felt her pain, and your interference was a great relief for all of us...

goal.en: Use the crystal to teleport to Cosmos’ residence and talk to him.

startText.en:
Thank you for everything, Stormbringer. Dominus Cosmos asked me to report on Cassandra’s disease, but I shouldn’t leave her alone. Could you tell him about everything that’s happened? He will be happy to hear the good news.

You can find him using this crystal.

finishText.en:
Welcome, Stormbringer. Let me thank you again for helping Cassandra - each of us felt her pain, and your interference was a great relief for all of us...

What? You can’t take part in the games? What a shame. But it’s alright, I will wait.

I am glad to announce though that from now on all the trials are open for all visitors. And those who can win gold medals in several trials will be generously rewarded!

goal.en: Tell Phoebus the games have to be postponed.

startText.en:
By the way, we should postpone Phoebus’ Gladiator Games in our new timeline, otherwise it will cause a temporal conflict... I believe Phoebus wants you to participate in the first games, so I think you can convince him to put it off.

He knows nothing about the time shifts, and that’s how it should be.

checkText.en: When you are ready, I will tell you about the rules.

finishText.en: That was a good fight, Stormbringer! Here is your reward.

goal.en: Participate in battle on Phoebus’ Gladiator Arena.

startText.en:
The Gladiator Arena welcomes the new warrior! All for bread and circuses! Remember that every victory is a great achievement, but a defeat is no disgrace as well.

When you are ready, I will tell you about the rules.

checkText.en: I believe in you!

finishText.en: Truly, Stormbringer, you are a great warrior!

goal.en: Complete Dionic Games: Gladiator Battle with extra objectives.

finishText.en:
Here he is... And right on time, of course.

How are you feeling? The time has stopped for everyone on the Archipelago right now, except for us.

goal.en: Participate in the Gladiator combat held by Phoebus.

startText.en:
I am glad to announce that from now on the Gladiator Games are open for all visitors. And I would be honored if you could participate in the first battle held at the arena.

Everyone is equal there. All that matters is your dexterity and experience. If you can defeat opponents using the means that are available to you, you will be a champion. This is the Honor Combat.

Well, are you ready to try?

checkText.en: See those young Aoidoi over there? You could talk to them and encourage them to participate in the games! That would be so great!

finishText.en:
Excellent, my friend. Victory is not the goal; the will for winning is. What’s the most valuable is the experience.

Aoidoi underestimate its importance. We, Aoidoi, have skipped our childhood, and that is our weakness.

I’m sorry, I don’t want to bore you with my reflections. Please enjoy the games!

goal.en: Encourage Aoidoi to participate in the games.

name.en: Will to Live, Will to Win

startText.en:
Excellent. I tried my best to make everyone see that participating is more important than winning... But their own vanity makes them feel intimidated. They’re afraid of losing, afraid of being disgraced.

Maybe you can influence them? See those young Aoidoi over there? You could talk to them and encourage them to participate in the games! That would be so great!

checkText.en: Are you ready to try?

finishText.en: That was a good race, Stormbringer! Here is your reward.

goal.en: Take part in the steeplechase.

startText.en:
Steeplechase is a simple discipline, but it does require some strength and dexterity.

Are you ready to try?

checkText.en: The race awaits!

finishText.en: Excellent! I never doubted you, Stormbringer.

goal.en: Complete Dionic Games: Steeplechase with extra objectives:

startText.en:
If you find my trial to easy, try and complete is flawlessly! Not only you should collect bonuses along the way - you must not fall in water or return to checkpoints even once! Do you still think it's easy? Complete the trial during 160 seconds and collect at least 116 points!

Do you accept my challenge, Stormbringer?

checkText.en: The more obstacles we overcome, the more exciting it feels.

finishText.en:
That was a nice race, Stormbringer. Not that we expected anything less from you.

Thank you for participating!

goal.en: Take part in the steeplechase.

startText.en:
My trial is ready, Stormbringer. Steeplechase is an ancient discipline, and I also find it quite symbolical.

All that matters is your speed, strength, and dexterity. And also your ability to make quick decisions. It’s just like life itself - you rush forward, you overcome the obstacles, and you draw your experience from it.

Do you want to know the rules?

checkText.en:
I need coffee.

And I need it now!

finishText.en:
The construction goes at full speed, thanks to you, Stormbringer! I don’t know how I can thank you.

Even Tur’s warriors expressed their willingness to assist the construction! Now it will be completed so much faster.

goal.en: Ask Corci Gold-Tooth and Tur the Bull’s Roar for help.

startText.en:
Sorry, Stormbringer, I drifted away... My ambitions played a bad joke on me.

I intended to build something very special for the Dionic Games, but it took too much effort from me... But I’m not giving up! I will keep building until it’s finished!

No time for vanity, my friend. I have to ask you for help...

There are two peoples on Ammer whose assistance I need. Minotaurs are sturdy warriors and vigilant sentinels - I need them to guard the Labyrinth. And there are mountainfolk - nobody knows more about underground construction than they do. I can’t go on without their help and advise.

Could you speak with them, Stormbringer? I must admit I feel too intimidated to approach them myself.

checkText.en: You brought the Tears?

finishText.en:
You brought the Tears? Let me see.

Perfect stones! This is a decent payment. Tell Master Ionas we are ready to help.

goal.en: Go to the Spiral Ridge and obtain Tears of Gods, then bring them to Corci Gold-Tooth.

startText.en:
Who’s here? Let them come closer! What do they want? Can they speak?

Ah, you know how to please Corci, don’t you? Master Ionas sent you, right? He wants my people’s help?

Master Ionas deserves my respect. He’s a genius of his people. He can count on us!

But Mountainfolk don’t work for free. I need twelve measures of Tears of Gods which can be found only in these lands. Not less than that!

You go now and bring them!

checkText.en: Once we’re done, we’ll blunt their swords!

finishText.en:
It hu-u-urts to look at these lame weapons. We don’t even need to blunt these, they aren’t sharp! Oh well, I’m just used to the good stuff... When I was you-u-ung, an ordinary club was enough!

Let’s roll! Tell your master he can count on us. His guys won't fail!

goal.en: Go to the Spiral Ridge and take away Centaurs’ weapons, then bring them to Tur on Dionic Archipelago.

startText.en:
You speak wisely! But we’re just mercenaries. We do what they pay us for.

What are you saying? Your stone master wants us to help? Why? Uh... Very interesting. So they want us to roam in the dark corridors and beat up anyone who comes in our way? That sounds entertaining!

But our weapons are designed to kill, and we’re not going to blunt them on purpose. We need something else! And I know where you can find it.

I know there are those Centaurs who keep bugging the locals. We can take their swords and maces, blunt them and use them! That will be completely safe. That’s a good idea, right?

checkText.en: I wonder what you think of our work!

finishText.en:
Excellent! The Labyrinth works exactly how we intended it to. And the Minotaurs are doing a great job!

Thank you for your help. I’m not going to take any more of your time - somebody else might need you, too!

goal.en: Complete Ionas’ trials in the Underground Labyrinth. Report on the results.

startText.en: Good news, Stormbringer - we’re almost done. I think you should be the first one to try it out! And tell us what you think of our work.

checkText.en: Are you ready to enter the Labyrinth?

finishText.en: The Labyrinth has released the winner! Here is your reward.

goal.en: Complete the trial in Ionas’ Underground Labyrinth.

startText.en:
The Underground Labyrinth is ready to challenge its visitors! If you are brave enough, you are welcome!

This is the trial of silence. Your speed doesn’t matter - you just need to sneak past the guards without getting them to notice you.

Are you ready to enter the Labyrinth?

checkText.en: Are you ready to accept my challenge?

finishText.en: Well done, Stormbringer! You learned a lot from years of saving the innocent.

goal.en: Complete Dionic Games: Underground Labyrinth with extra objectives:

startText.en:
If you find my challenge too easy, let's add some flavor to the game!

Free all three captives and bring them to the center simultaneously. Make sure no minotaurs notice you and avoid traps.

Only then will I name you the Master of my Labyrinth!

checkText.en: I wonder what you think of our work!

finishText.en:
Excellent! The Labyrinth works exactly how we intended it to. And the Minotaurs are doing a great job!

Thank you for your help. I’m not going to take any more of your time - somebody else might need you, too!

goal.en: Complete Ionas’ trials in the Underground Labyrinth. Report on the results.

startText.en: Good news, Stormbringer - we’re almost done. I think you should be the first one to try it out! And tell us what you think of our work.

checkText.en: Dermos has crafted something very special for me! I can’t wait to see it...

finishText.en:
Oh, poor winged things. Well, they deserved that! At least it will teach them some humbleness.

What about my order? Was it ready? Ah, so you’ve seen it already... Well, I guess now you know what’s waiting for our guests! Thank you for your help, friend!

How about taking a ride?

goal.en: Help Awki Black-Feather and pick up the order from Dermos in Polis.

startText.en:
What a wonder... hic... ful day, friend! I have never seen so many awesome creatures in one place! Maybe these Games are a good idea after all - what do you think, Stormbringer?

Every Dominus has something special prepared for our guests, and I am no exception. However, my trial is rather humble. Just flying on Pegasi! Have you seen their wings? Those noble creatures were born to... hic... dominate the skies!

Though Pegasi’s temper is horrible. Those creatures are mean! I asked the Aviaks for help - they surely know how to deal with the winged beasts. The Aviak chieftain was willing to help and he sent his own son - you can find him near the stables if you wish to give him a hand. Awki was his name, I think, hic...

Oh, I almost forgot! I’ve got to collect my order from that leatherworker in Polis. I would be so grateful if you could do it for me!

checkText.en: I hope the Spring Spirit gets enraged, cuat!

finishText.en:
Cua-ha-ha, good job, wingless! Look at these pathetic beasts! No pride left in them. They’ve learned their lesson.

I guess my job here is done. Thank you for your help! If you don’t mind, I will take this stone. I know somebody who might need it, cuarh!

goal.en: Help Awki tame the Pegasi.

startText.en:
Cuat-cuarh, wingless! Did you come to mock Awki? My father sure did me a favor, carh!

What? You came to help? Well then let me apologize. My name is Awki Black-Feather. I am the eldest son of our chieftain... sent by him to tame the damned Pegasi! For some reason that drunk Aoidos thinks that if those horses have wings they can speak to Aviaks in the tongue of the skies! Cur-cul! How ridiculous is that?

However, the root of the problem is obvious to me. Those mares are too proud. They were born to fly and not to rot in stables, cuarh! In order to tame Pegasi, you first need to break their spirit.

checkText.en: Are you doing fine, Stormbringer?

finishText.en:
Ah, here are the balls! I hope they didn’t get you in trouble? Dione is a talented sorceress, but sometimes her creations are way too... animated.

No? Good!

goal.en: Deliver Dermos’ work to Dionysius.

startText.en:
Dominus Dionysius told me he would send someone to pick up his order. I didn’t think he would dare to ask the savior of our people! Maybe he had his reasons.

It wasn’t easy, but me and Dione did what he asked us of. Dominus wanted us to craft flying balls! They are here, in this bag.

Wait, don’t open it!

checkText.en: Are you ready to conquer the skies of Dionic Archipelago?

finishText.en: That was a beautiful flight! Here is your reward.

goal.en: Participate in Dionysius’ Air Triathlon.

startText.en:
Have you already been to the dark underground labyrinth and raced on the track of Dionic Archipelago? Now it’s time to fly high in the skies!

And also participate in the Air Triathlon! If you wish, Stormbringer, I will gladly tell you about the rules.

Are you ready to conquer the skies of Dionic Archipelago?

checkText.en: Start the trial as soon as you are ready.

finishText.en: The sky is the limit! Well done, Stormbringer!

goal.en: Complete Dionic Games: Air Triathlon with extra objectives:

startText.en:
You must know that the most difficult part of air triathlon is catching the elusive ghostly ball. Some would catch it just once and consider themselves lucky...

Your task, however, is to catch 5 swift balls!

In addition to that, you must fly through all the rings as fast as you can, throw all balls at the first try, and earn at least 160 points.

And that is my challenge.

checkText.en: Fair winds, Stormbringer!

finishText.en:
I think the trial works! This makes me happy.

Thank you for your help. Dionysius is ready for the Games!

goal.en: Participate in Dionysius’ Air Triathlon.

startText.en:
So Propegasius... hic... taught you everything about the winged horses. Now let’s turn it into a trial!

I’m curious how this is going to work... Good luck, Stormbringer!

checkText.en: Is your training complete?

finishText.en: Can anything be more beautiful than flying in the skies?

goal.en: Complete flight training from the flight instructor.

startText.en:
Before you soar up, Stormbringer, you need to learn something about the winged creatures. If you don’t understand how to treat them, they will just throw you off their back!

So first you need to approach the flight instructor and ask him to teach you. Good luck!

checkText.en: Now go!

finishText.en:
About time... I’d congratulate you on victory, but that wouldn’t be sincere. The war against Nihaz is only beginning.

The loop is unraveling right now. You better not leave the Observatory for the next couple minutes. You and I don’t belong to the current time on Sarnaut right now, so we can, um... Fall out of reality like undesirable elements.

Trust me, that is much worse than death.

goal.en: Destroy Thalos.

startText.en:
Dionic Archipelago is inside a time loop right now. I created it in my Observatory. The loop is very short - only those three seconds that keep us all from dying. Three seconds of total terror and helpless rage. I am powerful, Stormbringer, but I won’t be able to sustain it for a long time. You have to be fast.

I used the powers of the Observatory to take us to the past - to the moment right before the loop closes, so that we can destroy Ionas’ creation. If you manage to do this, it will protect us from the temporal paradox, and those who remain outside the loop will only see the arrival of Nihaz and your following battle with him.

I’m sorry, it sounds too complicated, but believe me - when the time tries to heal itself, weird things happen.

Now go!

finishText.en:
It’s not getting any easier...  I’ve been getting deja vu all morning... Huh? Don't worry about that, it’s just a fashionable elf word.

I would never trust that Dominus of Creation. Who knows what he wants and what he is capable of! We don’t even know what he wants with Nihaz. Unleashing the Dark God on this shattered world is the last thing we need... And how he poisoned his own sister because she was getting in his way with her gift of foresight!

Believe me, I’ve met some super-powered smarty pants before. I used to be one. This is going nowhere good. Creation, destiny, a universal deeper meaning, purpose – ha! I know Aoidoi want to believe in higher powers and some Great Design. But if I’ve learned anything in my life, it’s that Creation doesn’t care about this small, ragged artificial world filled with all sorts of creatures.

We’re on our own. It’s terrible. And great at the same time.

goal.en: Leave the Observatory and tell Klavdia Kalugina about what happened.

finishText.en:
Here you are! I was starting to get worried. The guests are arriving to Ammer in great numbers - we can barely greet everyone.

I guess the Empire has accepted our invitation - I can see their ships in our harbor. And the League is here! Perfect!

goal.en: Report to Cassandra on delivering the invitation.

startText.en:
Astral silver is an extremely rare mineral with vivid magical properties. Working with it requires much caution. One wrong move, and it can destroy a whole allod. This one must have been Cosmos’ work - I wonder if all Aoidoi are capable of handling it?

Well, the Aoidoi wish to see us in their home, and they even invited you personally. I think we should accept that invitation. Take part in their Games as a champion of the Empire! Be careful - the League is going to participate as well.

finishText.en:
Here you are! I was starting to get worried. The guests are arriving to Ammer in great numbers - we can barely greet everyone.

I guess the League has accepted our invitation - I can see their ships in our harbor. And the Empire is here! Perfect!

goal.en: Report to Cassandra on delivering the invitation.

startText.en:
Astral silver is an extremely rare mineral with vivid magical properties. Working with it requires much caution. One wrong move, and it can destroy a whole allod. This one must have been Cosmos’ work - I wonder if all Aoidoi are capable of handling it?

Well, the Aoidoi wish to see us in their home, and they even invited you personally. I think we should accept that invitation. Take part in their Games as a champion of the League! Be careful - the Empire is going to participate as well.

checkText.en: I’m happy to see so many guests on Ammer.

finishText.en: Here you are. It’s been a long day, but I think we found homes for all of our guests. Now it’s time the opening ceremony... and I have a request for you.

goal.en: Greet the guests of Dionic Games.

startText.en:
I must say I thought it would be more difficult to invite some of our guests. We have Mountainfolk, Minotaurs, Sea creatures, Tekyans here... As mad as he was, Sarn’s creations are truly beautiful! Everybody is setting up their temporary houses right now - Ammer will become their home for a long time.

Many in Sarnaut know your name, Stormbringer. And many will be pleased to see you, though some may have their fears... The sooner you get to know everyone, the better. And you should also greet your old friends, right?

checkText.en: My kin knows how to make a feast out of nothing.

finishText.en:
So, my job at Dionic Games is done.

But don’t think my kin will leave you alone. There’s plenty of work to do. You see Amos? See how sad he is? He must be really struggling with something. And Ionas? You know when was the last time he slept? Everyone’s busy, busy, busy!

I’ll go get some rest.

goal.en: Participate in the opening ceremony of Dionic Games by carrying the holy fire to the statue of Thalos. Listen to the Dominae speech.

startText.en:
If it hadn’t been for you, Stormbringer, our house wouldn’t be here now. If Kyros had succeeded... the world would have been deprived of immortality, and its enraged people would have wiped us off the face of Sarnaut. But you won in the battle with fate itself. We are alive, and we thank you.

You would do us a great honor if you agreed to perform the opening ceremony for our feast of peace. May everyone see how you ignite the fire which is the symbol of universal brotherhood! You are a living legend.

Would you do that?

finishText.en:
Welcome again, Stormbringer. A lot has changed here since we last met.

I apologize for being so vague in my letter. But I had my reasons.

goal.en: Meet Cassandra in Polis on Ammer.

startText.en:
I have good news, Stormbringer. The Well has healed its wounds, and Domina Kora is again welcoming newborn Aoidoi to our world.

I have no words to thank you for what you did for us.

But I need to talk to you in person. Please find me in Polis as soon as possible.

Yours sincerely, Domina Cassandra.

finishText.en:
Ah, here is my hero. Let me look at you...

I wonder what you are?

goal.en: Meet Cosmos.

startText.en:
As I wrote to you, a newborn Aoidos has emerged from the Well. We were afraid it would never happen again.

Our new brother has become a new Dominus. This is the highest title we could give him, but in truth he is much stronger than all of us.

His name is Cosmos, and he bears the title of Dominus of Creation. He is eager to meet you, but he doesn’t say why. But I’m sure that must be a strong reason.

checkText.en: It’s time for us to talk.

finishText.en:
But there is a more pressing issue for the Aoidoi right now. They decided to throw a grand event to mark my birthday - the day when the Well started giving life again.

And they want to invite whole Sarnaut to celebrate!

goal.en: Speak to Cosmos.

startText.en:
I’ve been watching you for a while now... I can see you are surprised. You will understand later. Just be sure that I’m not your enemy. And I hope it will remain this way.

My name is Cosmos.

Let me thank you personally for what you did in Secret Paths. Defeating Maverick is a much greater deed that it might seem! But I assume you didn’t think you actually killed him. That rascal was a Dark God’s servant... Though I can’t understand why would anyone want to be an adept of deception and destruction.

However, the tactics of the Great Mages is also beyond my comprehension. What are Aidenus, Yasker, Caterina, Zayan, Klavdia waiting for? Do they really think their job is done?

finishText.en:
This is all very sweet, but we don’t have time for their childish games - we have the League and Nezeb knows who attacking us constantly!

Wait... A spear of Astral silver? How is this even possible?

goal.en: Bring the invitation to Yasker in Nezebgrad.

startText.en:
Dominae of Aoidoi - and I am one of them now - wish to invite representatives of all the sentient races of Sarnaut to Ammer for a celebration.

This will be an unusual event. We call it Dionic Games. Our guests will be offered to participate in athletic competitions under the aegis of peace and mutual respect. The champion will be rewarded with the symbol of peace - a spear made of Astral silver.

Don’t worry - I will take care of everyone’s safety in my land.

Take this message to Yasker. Don’t try to read it - the writing is enchanted. I personally invite you to participate in the Games.

finishText.en:
This is all very sweet, but we don’t have time for their childish games - we have the Empire and Light knows who attacking us constantly!

Wait... A spear of Astral silver? How is this even possible?

goal.en: Bring the invitation to Aidenus in Novograd.

startText.en:
Dominae of Aoidoi - and I am one of them now - wish to invite representatives of all the sentient races of Sarnaut to Ammer for a celebration.

This will be an unusual event. We call it Dionic Games. Our guests will be offered to participate in athletic competitions under the aegis of peace and mutual respect. The champion will be rewarded with the symbol of peace - a spear made of Astral silver.

Don’t worry - I will take care of everyone’s safety in my land.

Take this message to Aidenus. Don’t try to read it - the writing is enchanted. I personally invite you to participate in the Games.

finishText.en: Now We know what to do next. We only need to get the truth out of Tassilon de Ardeur, and We have an idea...

goal.en: Visit the piers and inform them that no one is allowed to leave. Ask the gondoliers if anyone important has left Irene.

startText.en:
We have a serious problem, .

The thing is, Lucretia was a keeper of one of the most important artifacts of our people... And today a friend has visited Us – Cardinal Renard de Ardeur. He informed Us that his supporters from the Great Houses that oppose neutrality would like to see this artifact at the Great Ball. We started to doubt whether the queen still has it.

And as you can guess, Lucretia indeed no longer has it. We will forgive her this mistake, because she is just a woman, and they can be naive when it comes to love.

During their meeting, she gave it to her lover. Alas, Eurial found out and informed the cardinal, and he decided to take advantage of it.

We don’t want our spouse to be disgraced, so We’ll have to help her. Besides... We’d like to get the artifact back. Talk to her and find out how it can be done.

checkText.en: Did you need something?

finishText.en: You're too late... Eurial has already left in pursuit!

goal.en: Find out where the messenger went.

startText.en: Tassilon de Ardeur is not a fool, and he can be quite adamant, but Blanche is really good at her job. She already told us about his weakness: poor concentration. If you put pressure on him from several sides, he'll probably break. Let's discuss this in detail.

finishText.en: I... Cough... I failed everyone...

goal.en: Find the general's camp on Ferris.

startText.en: Yes, I'll tell you everything... I know who you're looking for. Eurial and her Lamias have been looking for him, too. I'll tell you what I told her: he went to Ferris two days ago. That's all I know, I swear! I'm just a gondolier, no one lets me in on any details! You should hurry, because that viper is hot on his trail... You won't let her hurt me, right?

checkText.en: Don't let her get away!

finishText.en: Thank you, friend! If it weren't for you...

goal.en: Chase down Eurial and take the artifact from her.

startText.en:
Oh... It's hard to breathe... I think I'm frozen to the ground...

I missed my shift! Eurial caught up with us, slaughtered everyone in the camp... General Bekin tried to save the artifact and escape, but Eurial went after him. Perhaps everything is already over... Cough, cough...

But if there's a chance we can stop her, we should do it!

checkText.en: Well, ? Did you retrieve the artifact? Hurry, please! The Ball is about to start!

finishText.en:
My gratitude knows no bound! Not only did you save my reputation before the Great Ball, you also kept a dangerous artifact from falling into Eurial's hands.

I and Louis will find out who she is and who is behind all this.

I would like to reward you and those two Aviak heroes that accompanied you... But I don't see them. Perhaps they got delayed. I hope we'll see them later.

goal.en: Take the Dragon Bond and return it to Queen Lucretia de Desirae on Irene.

startText.en:
You need the Dragon Bond? Very well, I'll give it to you.

Who could have though there'd be so many deaths because of this artifact...

It's too bad our expedition ended in failure. Well, take it and return to Ker-Is. Give Lucretia the proof of my feelings, and let her know: no obstacles can keep loving hearts apart!

finishText.en: Oh, dear. What an unexpected meeting... We didn't expect to see you here. Or are you in cahoots with that viper? Explain yourself.

goal.en: Sneak into Eurial's residence and search for information.

startText.en:
! I believe it's time for decisive but careful actions. We need to find out what Eurial is hiding and who she works for.

Tailing her would be too risky. Wriggling into her favor? Seems unlikely. We'll have to resort to good old espionage.

A great opportunity has just presented itself – there's a private gathering tonight at her residence, but Eurial herself won't be there. There's no legit way in, so we'll have to be creative...

We'll send one of our trusted mages behind the Theater. From there, he'll be able to teleport you to Eurial's island. It's bold, so no one will be expecting that. Then you'll have to... Improvise. We don't doubt your talents. Go now.

finishText.en: Thank you. I hope no one followed us?

goal.en: Escort the queen and her servant to the meeting.

startText.en:
I doubt anyone is surprised to hear Eurial is involved in some dark dealings. We'll sort this out, but for now...

We'd be grateful if you found time to help Our spouse, Lucretia. We don't know the details, but she absolutely needs an outsider's help, one she can trust. Speak with her.

finishText.en: I knew there was something fishy about this...

goal.en: Leave Eurial's residence and report to Louis.

startText.en: Listen, I'm in a bad mood. So just do what I tell you to do. As a favor a friend, alright? First explain what you're doing here.

checkText.en: Was the queen's problem taken care of?

finishText.en: Well... Of course, We know all about her flings. We are a royal couple, after all. Occasionally, We ourselves indulge... But this is not the time. The problem is not Lucretia's indiscretions, but the fact that someone is actively trying to besmirch her reputation. And we need to find out exactly what is going on.

goal.en: Guard the doors until the queen is done.

startText.en: We made it, now we need to wait for the queen. I think I heard something...

finishText.en:
Excellent, !

I believe you won't have any problems at the next Great Ball.

goal.en: Demonstrate your manners to the guests of Irene.

startText.en:
Oh, ! We know you've been on the road for years...

And in that time, you manners have gotten a little "rusty"? Yes, that's the word... At any rate, We wouldn't want our guests to side-eye you. But they will! If you give them a reason.

So We started a small school of good manners and etiquette. Simple rules of conduct that are obvious to everyone on this allod... Cecilia de Grandeur is in charge of the lessons. But it looks like someone from another House would like to assist her: Solemna de Ardeur. I believe together they can handle it.

Go to the park in front of the palace and complete a course on these manners. Perhaps you'll need more than one lesson. If that's the case, repeat it a few times.

finishText.en:
Wonderful, !

Hopefully my friend will be more careful next time.

But... probably not.

goal.en: Help Giacomo stay out of trouble.

startText.en:
We'd like to tell you something, ... Our subjects are like children to us. We love them all, but it's difficult to keep peace among children, especially when they gather like this...

There are some who occupy themselves above all with... amorous adventures. Well, why shouldn't they? Can't tame a wild heart...

One of our old acquaintances is an elf named Giacomo de Vevre. He is a legend among the ladies, and we follow his adventures with great interest. He stopped counting his conquests a long time ago, there are just too many. But as the number of his conquests grows, so does the number of enraged husbands who do not enjoy being cuckolded.

I'm afraid Giacomo might get in trouble. We don't want that to happen. So please, find him and find out if he is in trouble.

finishText.en:
Very good, !

I hope their bloodlust is satiated for the time being.

goal.en: Win 3 duels on Irene (you can fight elven duelers and other players).

startText.en:
! We would like to share one of Our troubles...

Right now we have representatives of various Houses on Irene. Any competition between them breeds rivalry, which in turn leads to conflicts. We are saddened to see Our subjects try and skewer each other with their crude weapons...

We are talking about this novelty – duels. And not those noble magical duels, but fencing. It's a new trend among the youth that was most likely invented by other races. Duels continue in spite of Our edict which forbids them!

Unfortunately, many elves are proud of their accomplishments in this field... We'd like you to teach a lesson to several brawlers... Prove they know nothing!

finishText.en: We could hear the applause even here. Wonderful! When this mess is over, We will ask them to stage a play just for Us. With you in the cast, of course!

goal.en: Take part in a play of the touring Miracle Theatre.

startText.en:
! It should be obvious by now, but it's not just the representatives of the seven Great Houses that came to Irene.

Some elves prefer to stay incognito for one reason or another. I remember when Our son also hid this identity under the guise of the Nameless one... Ugh, so tasteless...

But We have taken an interest in another guest, someone called Stranger, the owner of the Miracle Theatre which is staging a play about the destruction of Irene. They say people laugh and cry in turns during the performance...

We got curious. We would like you to investigate... in other words, visit them and see everything for yourself, then report to Us what you've seen.

finishText.en: Even a hero like you needs to let off some steam now and then, yes?

goal.en: Visit the Rose and Hibiscus and learn the secrets of the patrons.

startText.en:
Alas, this quest will not be implemented.

Louis has taken an interest in an establishment called the Rose and Hibiscus. The player needs to visit the place and try to learn something about the patrons. It would also be nice if you helped the House de Delice that owns this establishment. Daily quest: spy on the patrons (you can place hidden cameras), add something to drinks, bribe the strippers, and other interactive things.

finishText.en:
You're a natural-born spy, !

I like clever agents. When the Ball is over, we can discuss our mutually beneficial arrangement in a more... intimate setting. How does that sound?

goal.en: Become a double agent and obtain information.

startText.en:
! You must have already noticed that this time certain mysterious visitors have interfered with our Big Game.

We expected something like that. The League and the Empire aren't the only ones to take interest in the Great Ball. There are a lot of other forces in the world. Nihaz. The Architect. Dragons. Tep knows who else.

In any case, we can't just sit around. Our potential... enemy has set up a network of agents on Irene. My favorite Blanche, who is also the head of our intelligence, and I have come up with a plan. You'll play the leading part.

You must become a double agent. We know where the enemy unit commander will be today. He gives instructions and passwords to other members of the unit. Act quickly! Passwords can change in a jiff, and the same goes for the agents' location.

Blanche will tell you more. Carnal delights isn't the only thing she's good at. She's also smart. You'll see.

finishText.en:
Excellent, !

Did you enjoy the ride? Quite an experience. Blanche and I want to try it some day.

goal.en: Take part in the race on Irene.

startText.en:
! Irene offers all kinds of entertainment.

Races, for example... House de Ardeur is known as a vehicle manufacturer.

Wraith is their most famous one. But they experiment with other mounts, too. Hares, for instance. I don’t know what they inject their furry butts with, but these hares jump higher than the tallest trees.

We think you should try and master it. It will improve your reputation among our nobility which adores gambling and races.

finishText.en:
That was fantastic, !

Dancing makes the ball! You must do it again sometime.

goal.en: Participate in the big dance in the main dancing hall of Galleon.

startText.en:
I'm glad to see you, !

What's the most important thing at the Ball? Not intrigues or conspiracies... it's dancing! We believe any elven lady will agree. We also share this opinion.

Each of the Great Balls was memorable for its dances. Declining an invitation to dance from an elf would be a grave offence to them. And since our Ball is in full swing, it's time for dancing!

This time the House de Blizare has come up with something unusual... You will have to check it out. Go to the Galleon Castle and take part in the activities.

goal.en: Catch 10 fairies flying over Irene in the form of a Free Bird.

startText.en:
, you must have run into fairies on Irene... Wonderful creatures, are they not?

And you have probably wondered... why do fairies look so similar to the elves? Well, let me give you a history lesson:

The transformation of elves that granted us wings was devised by the first mages of Irene. Back then, there was no Conclave, and they weren't even Great Mages as we understand them now, but they were already capable of many things. One of them, Elleken, could create miniature copies of elves using the Key of Creation. He tested his spells on them before using them on our brethren.

Elleken's power was great. He gave magic powers to these fairies who had none of their own. He also gave them the ability to fly...

We would like to have a few fairies for our celebration. It's easy to catch them. Thankfully the House de Pluie is willing to lend everyone their Mask of the Free Flight that allows you to turn into a bird and fly high in the sky!

Now go get Us a few fairies.

finishText.en: How did the hunt go? Who won? Hunters or hedgehogs? How curious...

goal.en: Participate in the Royal Hunt.

startText.en:
Good afternoon, !

The Great Ball has its own tradition - it ends with the Royal Hunt.

We think it would be nice to uphold this tradition.

Our House organized this hunt in the forests of Egladien! Yes, the forests where the Battle for Beauty was once fought.

Back then our ancestors, ancient elves, fought to protect their borders from vermin... Trolls, Ogres, Gremlins...

Fortunately, we managed to throw them back. Egladien is a peaceful place now! But even a peaceful place like this has its own magic... It's connected to the local hedgehogs - despite their amicable appearance, they can handle themselves!

So your task is to catch as many hedgehogs as you can... Or get away from the hunters! You'll know more once you join in.

Happy hunting!

finishText.en:
Vampires... I wonder if we can get along.

You've managed to complete the mission. I'll report this to His Majesty. But I expect you to keep up the good work in the upcoming days!

goal.en: Complete Rosie de Tristesse's daily quest at the Al Rihat Ruins

name.en: Al Rihat Ruins: Helping the elves of House de Tristesse

startText.en:
After Antoinette told us about her daughter Gala's mission on that... Umoir, His Majesty the king ordered that the Galleon Castle be steered towards Al Rihat Ruins so he can see everything with his own eyes. Since our new Galleon Castle keeps the Irene shards together, the cream of the elven society arrived at Catherina's domain. Now we can see everything ourselves.

According to Antoinette, her family is helping House de Tristesse restore this place. Indeed, rotting in ruins isn't the elven way of doing things!

So hear the will of His Majesty, ! You must render assistance to Rosie de Tristesse, the queen of the Patriarch's residence at the House de Tristesse. Obey her every command, and His Majesty will reward you generously. You can go now.

finishText.en:
Druidism... Interesting... Can it make me any more beautiful? I wonder if it's even possible!

You've managed to complete the mission. I'll report this to His Majesty. But I expect you to keep up the good work in the upcoming days!

goal.en: Complete Andrew de Delice's daily quest at the Al Rihat Ruins

name.en: Al Rihat Ruins: Helping the Guardian Ring of Al Rihat

startText.en:
His Majesty see that Al Rihat is doing well, but They also think that you could try harder. His Majesty took an interest in a certain Guardian Ring, especially one of its members, Andrew de Delice. We elves never paid any attention to this kind of magic. You know what I mean, don't you? All that... druidism, shamanism, and other quackery. They seem quite savage and uncivilized, but we might be wrong about them.

, help Andrew with his research. Perhaps, other elves might join this Ring later, after they study this strange magic.

finishText.en:
Fighting monsters should be quite interesting. I ought to try it some time.

You've managed to complete the mission. I'll report this to His Majesty. But I expect you to keep up the good work in the upcoming days!

goal.en: Complete Gorynya Ozornov's daily quest at the Al Rihat Ruins

name.en: Al Rihat Ruins: Helping the Umoir Hunters

startText.en:
His Majesty watched you kill those... animals in Al Rihat Ruins. He was quite impressed with the strength and anger of the corrupted beasts! It's good to have someone protect House de Tristesse lands against them. His Majesty spoke of the hunters that hunt the beasts. Now we want you to help them.

, go there and do whatever you can to assist the hunters.

checkText.en: I doubt these animals that Leticia is hunting can scare you off. But I’d still call a few friends if I were you. Just to be safe.

finishText.en:
Oh, the young maidens on a battle horse, with a sword in their hands! How they charge into battle!

You've managed to complete the mission. I'll report this to His Majesty. But I expect you to keep up the good work in the upcoming days!

goal.en: Complete Leticia de Desirae's daily quest at the Al Rihat Ruins

name.en: Al Rihat Ruins: Helping the Monster Huntress

startText.en:
His Majesty has a big family, and Leticia is his beloved niece. She dreams about glory, and wants to be a monster huntress. Al Rihat is a perfect location. I think she'll looking for some heroes to help her.

Here's His Majesty's wish, : go to Al Rihat Ruins and complete Leticia de Desirae's quest.

finishText.en: Excellent! Oh, the aroma! This is just what we needed! I'll make sure to let His Majesty know about this.

goal.en: Brew or purchase from an Alchemist 10 Dragon Fervor aphrodisiacs and deliver them to Irene. You can purchase the alchemical recipe from the Quartermaster of House de Blizare on Irene.

startText.en:
His Majesty tells me I can trust you completely. Great! I've got a lot to do.

You might have noticed that the cream of elven society gathers here. As you known, all elven ladies are beautiful, and all elven gentlemen are irresistible. All Great Balls are courtesy contests. And, of course, they keep count of romantic conquests.

That is why aphrodisiacs are in a very high demand! We're running out! We need more, much more of it. I'll appreciate it if you help me.

finishText.en: Great! Very fine steel. This is just what we needed! I'll make sure to let His Majesty know about this.

goal.en: Produce or purchase from a Weaponsmith 5 rapiers and deliver them to Irene. You can purchase the blueprint from the Quartermaster of House de Vevre on Irene

name.en: Needs of the Court: Rapiers for Nobles

startText.en:
His Majesty wants me to give you tasks. I have quite a few for you.

Perhaps, you noticed that duels are now in high fashion among the nobility. I admit, there's certain beauty in them. The graceful movements, the fencing skills... Yes, there is something to it. His Majesty put a ban on duels, but all elves insist on carrying a rapier anyway.

We're almost out of them. But the visitors want more and more! We need to produce some new rapiers. I'm counting on you.

finishText.en: Awesome! Great leather. This is just what we needed! I'll make sure to let His Majesty know about this.

goal.en: Craft or purchase from a Leatherworker 5 saddles for riding lions and deliver them to Irene. You can purchase the recipe from the Quartermaster of House de Grandeur on Irene.

name.en: Needs of the Court: Saddles for Lions

startText.en:
His Majesty told me I could ask you for anything... oh, and I do have a lot to ask!

You might have seen lions in the city. They're our domestic animals. They're perfect mounts for any elf! It can take you to your destination and protect you if need be. That's why there are so many of them in the city. Naturally, we need just as many saddles to ride the lions. Saddles wear out over time and need replacement.

Elves come to me for new saddles all the time. Unfortunately, we don't have that many! We're making preparations for a big event, after all. There's no room for leatherworking shops! But we do need saddles. Just a few would solve this problem. Or a part of it, at least.

finishText.en: Magnificent! Great tailoring! This is just what we needed! I'll make sure to let His Majesty know about this.

goal.en: Sew or purchase from a Tailor 5 pairs of formal gloves and deliver them to Irene. You can purchase the pattern from the Quartermaster of House de Pluie on Irene.

startText.en:
His Majesty wants me to give you some assignments for the good of elves. That's exactly what I'm planning to do.

What do you think is missing at the Ball? Formal gloves! They're so delicate and soft that they wear out pretty fast. Everyone wears gloves around here. We're on a verge of the glove crisis! There's going to be a scandal unless I can provide enough gloves for all the guests!

I beg you, help me find formal gloves! Whatever it takes!

finishText.en: Breathtaking! Heavy and tough. Just what we need. This is just what we needed! I'll make sure to let His Majesty know about this.

goal.en: Craft or purchase from a Blacksmith 5 chain links for the Galleon Castle and deliver them to Irene. You can purchase the blueprint from the Quartermaster of House de Ardeur.

name.en: Needs of the Court: Chains for Galleon Castle

startText.en:
On behalf of His Majesty, I'd like to give you another assignment.

You have probably noticed that the Galleon Castle, House de Ardeur's creation, is holding the shards of Irene together with chains. If it weren't for them, the astral streams would tear this archipelago apart. Not only they are holding the allods together, they also allow us to move them through the astral. That's how we've reached Umoir.

However, nothing lasts forever. We constantly check the chain links and replace old ones. Alas, forging new links isn't easy! We don't have enough metal... or blacksmiths. I urge you to bring me several chain links so we could use them as a replacement.

finishText.en: Wow! Heads of the Great Houses managed to agree on something? It's hard to believe. How did you do it? You're a true hero. A great hero, .

goal.en: Sign the Dragon Acquisition Permit at the heads of seven Great Houses on Irene and bring it to Anastasia de Vevre.

startText.en:
This document states:

According to this document, the petitioner is worthy of assuming the responsibility for the Irene Viper. May they continue to be worthy of such honor, and may they glorify their name by exploits and noble deeds in the name of all elves and the seven Great Houses.

This paper must be signed by seven heads of the seven Great Houses. But first, you'll have to earn the elves' trust.

checkText.en: We should make sense of our subjects’ relations before the Ball.

finishText.en:
It looks like we’ve managed to at least cool the conflict. Victory at the Great Ball will put an end to this whole story. There will be one victor - either Antoinette or Renard.

Well, We’ll be glad to be free of the burden of authority.

goal.en: Find out what is going on between the cardinal and the queen.

startText.en:
It’s time to settle all our misunderstandings. Antoinette wants Iris to be returned to her. Cardinal holds her captive.

Well, it’s time to return the prodigal daughter to her family and resolve this conflict between Houses de Delice and de Ardeur.

We want you to handle it. Find out the cause of these issues.

finishText.en:
Look around you! If our wings were capable of flying, and Our position allowed us to engage in frivolous activities...

Well, let’s get down to business. It will begin soon.

goal.en: Meet with Louis in Galleon Castle.

startText.en:
And now the reason we’re all here on Irene: the Great Ball!

Each of the Great Houses will show what they are capable of and demonstrate their greatest achievement... The demonstration will take place in Galleon Castle of House de Ardeur, a creation that is a contender on its own.

It’s time to see it. Go, We’ll meet you there.

checkText.en: Please bring them back. Nothing should delay my performance.

finishText.en: Oh, wonderful. Everything is in order! I hope no one was hurt?

goal.en: Find and pacify 5 dodge balls scattered around the room.

startText.en: As usual, there is trouble. Dionysius from Ammer provided us with dodge balls from Dionic Games for testing. But alas, they are scattered around the room. We need to find and pacify them before they start hitting guests. We don’t want that, right? Though Orcs will probably be ecstatic... But we’re not here for them. So please help, we’re running out of time!

checkText.en: Where is my bugler? Without her, the symphony wouldn’t sound right! It would be imperfect!

finishText.en: Where is my bugler? Without her, the symphony wouldn’t sound right! It would be imperfect! Oh, what a relief! Everyone is here now!

goal.en: Find Tamira Windsong in the room and persuade her to return to the band.

kickText.en: Oh, what a relief! Everyone is here now!

startText.en:
Sooo! My worry was not unfounded. Tamira is missing! The star from Howlem! It'll be our turn soon! Tamira plays an important part at the beginning and the end of the symphony.

She is well-trained and will be impossible to replace at the last moment! Find her quickly and bring her here.

checkText.en: It’s not just an hour of triumph for them, . It’s a turning point for their House. And our House as well.

finishText.en: Incredible demonstration worthy of the Great Houses! We are proud you’ve taken part in it.

goal.en: Participate in the opening ceremony and the demonstration of accomplishments of the Houses de Blizare, de Vevre, and de Grandeur.

startText.en: You’ve helped the Heads of the Houses with their preparations before... Well, they wish to tell you they could use your help again. This time they will show the results. And we could use you, the Hero of Sarnaut, to draw more attention to the event. Let’s not refuse them.

checkText.en: This time everything should be perfect.

finishText.en: Wow, that was incredible. Everyone in the room was able to see the effects of my potion... Thank you.

goal.en: Help Maximilien de Blizare demonstrate the new potion.

startText.en:
Is there anyone better for a demonstration than the Hero of Sarnaut?

Yes, yes. With you, the show will be unforgettable! I’ll remember your help and reward you...

The task is simple: Irene fairies will be flying around the central platform of the ballroom. You need to catch all the fairies, but they are not easy to catch – you will need to drink my Potion of Time to slow them down.

There is one “but”: among the fairies you’ll see the dodge balls I enchanted earlier, and if one of them hits you, you will lose the effect of the potion.

I believe your task is clear: catch the fairies and dodge the balls. Come on, it’ll be fun! Go! I’ll release them as soon as you start!

checkText.en: Just look at the sheet music, it will tell you what to do.

finishText.en: Excellent! Epic! That was... quite inspiring. Thank you for your help, it’s an invaluable experience.

goal.en: Listen to Caspar’s speech and assume the role of conductor.

startText.en:
Oh, I’m starting to get nervous...

Oh well, here goes nothing... Let’s start. You will conduct. Your task is to help the musicians play by showing which part should be performed at the moment. It shouldn't be too difficult. I’m sure you can handle it! I’ll be playing the guitar! Let’s remember the good old days!

checkText.en: Don’t let us down!

finishText.en: What a fight! Almost like the Battle for Beauty. It looks like the proximity of Egladien makes her stronger. I’ll need to conduct some experiments in the forest...

goal.en: Defeat the statue of the Forest Mistress.

startText.en:
Alright... It’s time to show the true power of ancient elves!
