You’ve controlled it before... It’s impressive, isn’t it? Now you need to fight it and try to defeat it... Don’t be afraid of destroying it. The enchantment protects the statue from any damages. It will restore itself after a while.

I’m more scared for you, to be honest. Well, you’ve fought gods and dragons before, you can survive this!

checkText.en: Well, how are you doing? I hope the heads of the Houses won't be at each other's throats before we can even announce the winner.

finishText.en: Well, I'm sure we'll see the result of your preparations at the Great Ball!

goal.en: Help the Great Houses prepare for the competition.

startText.en:
The Great Ball will soon begin, and the Great Game is on! Each House seeks ways to demonstrate whatever they have prepared.

A heated competition is a risky venture! The rules of competition demand that the participants create obstacles for each other. There's a certain limit, of course. The participants can't get carried away. Dirty tricks are considered bad form. However, there's no objection to reasonable, removable obstacles. It's all about prestige, after all.

This is why your task is to visit the heads of certain Great Houses and find out about their needs and problems. And, of course, help them solve them.

checkText.en: Get rid of these echoes of the past. The fewer of them are left, the faster Maximilien will destroy this anomaly.

finishText.en:
I'm quite impressed and grateful, . I must refine my recipe to avoid anything like this during the Ball.

I'm sure I've been framed! The formula couldn't be wrong!

It's the House de Delice's intrigues, I'm sure! The girls are overly interested in my new assistants!

Please don't tell anyone what happened. I don't want my reputation to take a hit.

goal.en: Drink the potion of time and destroy 10 Echoes of the Past in the residence of House de Blizare.

startText.en:
I'm afraid we have serious problems now.

The head of our House, the Great Mage Maximilien de Blizare, wants to demonstrate a unique potion which can alter our perception of time. He decided to test the potion on himself and make sure the final formula worked, but something went wrong.

Maximilien got trapped in a temporal anomaly which let the ghosts of the pasts, the astral hounds, into our world. They found their way to Irene when the key got lost and the protective barrier collapsed. The Astral flooded the town.

Now the ghostly demons wander about the residence, becoming more and more real!

I beg you, kill the hounds, destroy the temporal anomaly, and set Maximilien free!

The only way to meet the hounds is to drink the experimental potion... and pray that whatever happened to Maximilien won't happen to you...

checkText.en: If my creation is blown all over Irene, my reputation will be ruined.

finishText.en:
What would I do without you?

I'm sure it's the mages of House de Grandeur! They want to sabotage my show, so they conjured the wind in my residence to thwart my rehearsal.

goal.en: Catch 5 pages of sheet music carried away by the wind in the House de Vevre's residence.

startText.en:
Greetings, ! I could use your help. I want to impress the audience and throw a gala concert in the ballroom of the Galleon Castle! All races will be invited to participate!

I'm all for the elves' independence and friendship with all nations. I want to set an example for the Great Houses and assemble an interracial orchestra where each plays a part of their own.

Everything's almost ready. Rehearsal is at the final stage. Unfortunately, the wind carried away my sheet music. If the townsfolk find them, they'll learn about my surprise. It'll ruin everything!

Help me collect the pages.

checkText.en: Go on, touch the statue.

finishText.en:
Thank you for your help! Its strength is fantastic, isn't it?

You'll meet them again during the Ball.

goal.en: Help Albert and Baudouin de Grandeur restore the old spell.

startText.en:
Greetings. We could use some help.

Here's the deal: my brother Albert and I, Baudouin, want to restore the spell that revives and grants control over legendary elven statues of heroes of the past. Yes, it's like in the Winter Palace. Once they were legendary heroes, back in the day of the Battle for Beauty. Even after death, they're guarding the borders of Irene as statues.

Let's begin with the Forest Mistress. You know how to control them. You're a good choice for a test. We'll give you the ability to control her. You need to see if she obeys your orders. To check, we'll use a shooting range. Listen carefully to everything we tell you and do as we say.

checkText.en: I can't complete a painting without my paints! It's all lost!

finishText.en:
It's time to take a brush and reproduce this untold beauty on canvas. Go now. Go. Don't get in the way of my creation.

I'm sure House de Blizare's patented alchemists are behind it. Savages!

goal.en: Find paint for Guillaume de Pluie.

startText.en:
Such barbarity!

Someone added solvent to my beautiful paints! It's a nightmare. Do I need to have another batch delivered from Tempesta? Or we can use whatever we have at hand...

Hey, , listen... since the king sent you to help me, please, make yourself useful! Find something... I need ALL paints, do you understand? Do something! Now!

checkText.en: They must never forget what the Empire did for them!

finishText.en:
Well, that's understandable.

According to my calculations, people's opinions are now fifty-fifty. We only need to tip the scale.

goal.en: Talk to the elves released from the Igsh Military District prison.

startText.en:
Greetings, comrade !

Everything's according to our plan. So far it's going as planned: you infiltrated the elven community and earned their trust.

Now I need to know the opinion of the elves recently freed from Termitka prison. Speak with them. And remind them that the League has let them down. We don't need their gratitude. We only need them no stop trusting the League.

Start with these elves: Germain de Grandeur, Landelin de Pluie, Annabelle de Vevre, Herluin de Blizare. They're in their Houses' abodes.

Visit them and talk.

checkText.en: They must understand that the League can give them protection.

finishText.en:
Well, that's understandable.

According to my calculations, people's opinions are now fifty-fifty. We only need to tip the scale.

goal.en: Talk to the elves released from the Igsh Military District prison.

startText.en:
Good afternoon, friend !

I think, we were able to show the elves that they'd be better off with the League. You've earned their trust and run errands for them.

We've got another issue. I've come to know that Yasker released all elves from the Termitka prison in IMD. It pains me to say this, but we failed to set them free, although we tried. I ask you to speak with them and pass on our sincere apologies. Put things in perspective, disrupt their faith in the Empire.

Start with these elves: Germain de Grandeur, Landelin de Pluie, Annabelle de Vevre, Herluin de Blizare. They're in their Houses' abodes.

Visit them and talk.

finishText.en:
That's what I call the will of steel! He hasn't given himself away with a single thought. I fear to imagine what they do to train their brothel bouncers, hehe.

I'm completely sure that your Iris is hiding in there. It's the safest place on the allod. You'd better stay away from the bouncer. If he feels offended, we'll have to storm the brothel like we always do. Let's think of a way to sneak in there.

goal.en: Figure out where to find Iris de Delice.

startText.en:
Yes, yes, I get it. The only thing I'm worried about is the hostility between arch-duchesse and the cardinal. They both are dear to me. It's Antoinette de Delice and Renard de Ardeur. We need to find balance before they break up forever.

We can convince Renard, but it's harder to persuade Antoinette. We need to come up with something. I hear she has a problem with one of her daughters. The poor thing has been kidnapped. Her ship was captured by the Imperial patrol. Her companions died, but her fate was different.

She and several other girls were forced to dance for high-ranking Imperial officials in a hole called Bunker for many years to come...

She was disgraced and refused at the court. I could make an exception and bring her back on my royal command. But first, we need to know where she is.

House de Delice is quite artful and trained in diplomacy. I suggest you ask our orcish friend Skulnar the Fierce for help. Luckily, he's currently staying at House de Delice residence. He's been invited over there just recently.

checkText.en: So? What's the news?

finishText.en:
That's impossible! Nothing gets past me! Your Iris must be flapping her wings in the far corner of the garden!

What's that? Booze? Cool. Give it here!

goal.en: Enter the Rose and Hibiscus and find Iris de Delice.

startText.en:
Their brains are tough, but we aren't simpletons, either. They don't want it our way, then why don't we play along? You'll speak, . My mug is too ugly for this place.

Well, what does it take to let us in?

finishText.en:
I don't think Mademoiselle Eurial is the one she says she is. I'll try and find out more. In the meantime, carry out your missions here, on Irene.

As for Iris and Renard, I'll talk to His Eminence and ask him to return the wayward daughter to her family. Don't tell anyone. I want it to be a surprise.

goal.en: Find our where Iris de Delice is

startText.en:
There was a weird elven lady here. Nothing special, especially for a place like this, hehe. She's wearing a mask, but I noticed a strange serpent decoration. Why don't you look around this flowerbed and search for Iris? I'll join you later. I need more time here.

Look, there she is! The serpent lady! She crossed the bridge, heading outside. Hurry! Get there before she leaves!

finishText.en:
See? And people were laughing! I knew I was right to add some of my juice...

That potion was a strange one, I've only just sobered up... Ah, no, I haven't.

goal.en: Entertain Skulnar and have fun together.

name.en: That is when the fun begins...

startText.en:
! Everything went well, and now it's finally time to have some rest and remember your friends.

Skulnar was looking for you. Go find him and have some fun. We won't be needing your help for the time being.

finishText.en: Ah... You're awake? That was quick...

goal.en: Keep having fun

startText.en:
Listen, why are we just drinking? I have an idea...

When we drank that potion, I noticed that a centaur entered the room.

Could you talk to him and ask him to... well... give us a ride? Imagine the show we can put on!

But we'll have to leave Murk here, let him sleep it off... He's not used to something like this!

finishText.en: Some viper abducted Skulnar?!

goal.en: Find Murk and Skulnar the Fierce.

startText.en: You look lost... Has something happened?

checkText.en: We've heard rumors that your friend Skulnar disappeared somewhere. We assume this is not the orc's usual behavior the morning after festivities?

finishText.en:
Catacombs under the city? Interesting! I've heard about that.

In any event, we need to wait until they clear the rubble.

Hopefully nothing terrible happens in the meantime. We'll tell you once we're done.

goal.en: Follow Eurial's tracks and find out where she took Skulnar. Report to Louis afterwards.

startText.en:
Eurial?

Hmm, I know her. She's a nasty one. I wonder what she wants with our friend.

Let's find out where they went! We saved Elena on Ferris, we'll save Skulnar!

finishText.en:
!

We're finally facing each other without masks.

goal.en: Get past the Kobold King and find the Ritual site

startText.en:
Surface dwellers! Why are you here? That's not your territory! I'm the king here, not you! Zvik!

The Traveler said you'd come! But there's no way forward! You want to pass?

finishText.en: Welcome to my kingdom, surface dweller! Be happy you'll see it with your eyes before you die!

goal.en: Get to the other side of the blockage and find out where the underground corridor leads.

startText.en:
We believe this is the finale of the story, !

We have been informed that the obstruction has been cleared. Which means it's time for the final adventure. We have to say We are tired of hearing the recounts of what's happening. We want to see it ourselves. We don't think We are in danger.

As for you, you need to save your friend. The orc that might become a Great Mage...

finishText.en: Thank you for not leaving me there. I don’t know what happened there but I doubt it's over... But don't worry - trouble doesn't scare us, does it?

goal.en: Rescue Skulnar

startText.en: A long journey and an unexpected finale, am I right? You must have a lot of questions, and I'm willing to answer them.

finishText.en:
Just look at them, .

Why must I always tolerate their fights? But that does it. Out!

I'll speak with my guest without annoying councilors. Our House, House de Desirae, has been leading the elves for thirty years. Over this period, we've made enemies, of course. The ones you've seen, the Houses de Ardeur and de Delice, are our friends. Other Houses are way worse. They envy our success and prosperity. We divide and conquer. This is the only way to hold everything together.

I'm tired. All We want is to have this one Ball without problems. We couldn't have it ten years ago. We won't tolerate any obstacles this time. I'm counting on your help, .

goal.en: Meet the most important guests of the Ball.

startText.en:
I give you Our most esteemed councilors: you already know the Great Mage Zayan, whose wisdom and knowledge are as deep as an ancient ocean. Her Royal Majesty, Lucretia de Desirae, the treasure of the court, the mother of my heir. Bianca de Desirae and Blanche de Desirae, Our beloved ones, official favorites, and my assistants. And finally, Renard de Ardeur, the Cardinal of the Church of Light, the Great Mage of the Lumenara allod. Antoinette de Delice, arch-duchess, the Great Mage of the Ignis allod.

Your arrival interrupted their conversation. I allow them to continue before finishing our talk.

finishText.en: Mass culture is the best propaganda. Well done! Here's your reward.

goal.en: Talk to Elizaveta Rysina about the relations between the Empire and the elves.

startText.en:
At ease, comrade !

I suppose, Yasker has explained the purpose of our cooperation? Fine.

I want you to know that I don't hold grudges for that incident on the Isle of Revelation. My actions were unreasonable.

Here's the deal: the elves allowed other races, including the Imperial ones, including some Committee members, to arrive at Irene. We all will work as a team toward the goal we set.

Our task is to gather information. We need to understand the mood in the elven society. What do different Houses think about the alliance with the League? And there's propaganda, of course. Start with bribing the bards. Let them sing songs that humiliate the League and praise the Empire. Be a valley of plenty if you need to, toss a coin. I'll reimburse your expenses.

finishText.en:
Excellent. Elves will hear a song. I'll plant the idea in their heads that the League is actually very good. Irene will be ours in no time.

Here's your money.

goal.en: Talk to Voisvet Belov about the relations between the League and the elves.

startText.en:
Hey, . I haven't seen you in a long while!

I think you've heard about our woes from Aidenus or Marianne, and what we're planning to do with it...

Marianne is a smart girl. Way smarter than our dumb clerics or war commanders. She understands that we'll either stand together or die apart.

Luckily, the elves allowed all people of Sarnaut enter this place. Well, the Empire too, as well, but we're allowed to come! We'll just have to wait and see who wins.

What do you want me to do in the first place? I need to know people's opinions. What do elves think? What do Houses think about the alliance with the League? And of course, advertise the League on every corner. You know what I'm thinking? Ask the bards to sing songs that praise the League and humiliate the Empire. Be a valley of plenty if you need to, toss a coin. I'll reimburse your expenses.

finishText.en: Very well. The preparations are rolling ahead. We can't let anyone distract us!

goal.en: Rid Ker-Is from Kobolds.

startText.en:
Well, . Kobolds are one of the many problems we faced here. In our lands, this race is elves' loyal servants, but here... they're wild and unruly. Over the centuries without elves, they multiplied, dug a series of underground tunnels. They come out at nights, spoil everything, and scare people to death.

We don't have a choice but to sort them out! The best way is to find their so-called king and punish him for his arrogance, but he's deep in the caves.

I order you to show the Kobolds that there's only one true king on Irene!

finishText.en:
That's what it was...

I want to know who the stranger was. I have an idea, and I don't like it.

goal.en: Examine the western districts of Ker-Is and find Princess Daguta's memories.

startText.en:
. I have a personal favor to ask. It's about the history of this place.

After the Great Experiment, we found ourselves locked on allods, almost cut off from one another. I had a distorted and incomplete information about what was going on on Irene. We don't know for sure how it happened.

We have a chance to find out at least some of it. The death of local population caused by the astral created an astral echo, a number of ghosts, living their life.

Please, examine the location and try to find something out.

finishText.en: What a mercy! I was so worried!

goal.en: Find the missing Harpy Constance and bring her back to the palace.

startText.en:
! It's so curious to finally see you after hearing so much about you! Yes, my dear son told me about you.

I have a request for you. My favorite servant, a Harpy named Constance, went missing. I sent her on an errand a couple of days ago, but haven't heard from her ever since. She's on my personal business... way too personal to ask someone else for help.

Please, find her, . She's in the city. I'll mark the spot on the map where you can find her.

finishText.en:
Good. It's our words plus your reputation!

We hope that the cheekiest Great Houses will change their attitude during the Great Ball.

goal.en: Hang the Royal Duel Restriction Decree on 5 bulletin boards in the city.

startText.en:
We have another problem. Duels.

Hostility between the Houses is growing before the Great Ball. My subjects are easily provoked. A lot of duels take place right in the streets of this beautiful city. One word is enough to start a duel, like one spark is enough to start a fire.

There are people who deliberately trigger duels, hurting others and looking for a fight.

Hear my will: from now on, I'm putting a ban on fights, skirmishes, and duels on Irene. The violators will be arrested and severely punished. So be it.

Please, hang the decrees on the boards in the city.

finishText.en: Great. On this occasion, I hereby declare you my valet!

goal.en: Earn a Royal Goodwill Certificate by completing the Great Ball: Social Manners quest.

startText.en:
, rest assured, we appreciate everything you do for Sarnaut. You are a legend. Your exploits will be immortalized in ballads. I'm not the only one that sees it. It's the leaders of the League and Empire - Zayan, Catherina, and Klavdia.

The society of Great Houses is rather conservative. Only old titles mean something to nobility. Even if the title bearer is an empty-headed nonentity. As a simple elf Louis de Desirae, I find it outrageous. As the king of elves Louis de Desirae, We support this tradition. I hope you understand.

I'd like to make you a part of our society. But you'll have to make your way from the bottom. I can issue a royal decree and assign you a noble title if you prove yourself worthy to the king. Therefore, we will do the following: you will win the trust of the elves on Irene by completing Our tasks.

After completing them for the first time, you will receive certificates of royal favor. These certificates will allow you to get a new title.

By completing Our tasks every day, and also the tasks of Our favorite Bianca de Desirae and Our royal chamberlain Henry de Desirae, you will strengthen relations with the House you select as your patron.

As your rank increases, you will have new opportunities, gain access to new places, and will be able to talk to people who have previously refused to speak with you.

finishText.en: You have earned a new court title. I hereby appoint you squire!

goal.en: Earn a Royal Goodwill Certificate by completing the Great Ball: Dueler quest.

startText.en:
, you've begun to climb our social hierarchy ladder.

You might have noticed that I inducted you into the military. It would be weird to make you a tailor and offer you to join the ranks of the queen's maids! Nowadays even noble elven ladies prefer a sword to a needle. This is why these days traditional male titles are given to beautiful ladies.

Speaking about your merits, We have no doubt that military exploits are what your heart desires. Further steps will take time. Be patient, complete Our missions every day, and you will achieve great things!

Let's discuss the House patronage now. You can take a vassal oath and vow to perform feats in the name of a House, which would increase its prestige. The House you choose will respond in kind. Prove that you are worthy of their patronage, and you will gain it. This will enable you to purchase very rare goods from the House.

Talk to Quartermasters of each House to know more. That's where you can take the oath of allegiance, too. You can also talk directly to the House head to take the oath. Like me, the head of the House de Desirae!

finishText.en: You have earned the Guardsman title. True noble title await! However, you need to work hard to earn them.

goal.en: Earn a Royal Goodwill Certificate by completing the Great Ball: Play quest.

startText.en:
You're climbing higher, ! I heard your name on the streets of the city.

You can ask me: do these oaths oblige you to something? Here's what I say: our society is based on loyalty and reputation. There's a lot of examples in history, when oaths were broken at bad times... and the traitors could get away with it, but doors closed in front of them, and their old friends turned away.

I understand that you are pursuing your own interest. You have the orders of your own leaders, obligations to the Order and the guild. Another oath might lead to a conflict of interests. That's when you have to choose.

I'm not judging you. But don't forget about the power of the word and the possible consequences.

finishText.en:
Good to see you, . It's time for another title.

Life goes on. As you might have noticed, many events happened on Irene over these days. I suggest you look around the city and talk to my subjects to hear the latest news.

goal.en: Visit King Louis de Desirae's court on Irene.

startText.en: It's time to receive the new title of Guardsman from King Louis. It may unlock new abilities and locations on Irene. You'll be able to talk to the elves, who didn't want to talk to you before.

finishText.en: Wonderful! You have earned the first noble title. I can't help but wonder how high you can climb.

goal.en: Earn a Royal Goodwill Certificate by completing the Great Ball: Runaway Lover quest.

startText.en:
You might have noticed, , that the elven society is obsesses with the idea of the Great Game. There are plenty of bloody events, betrayals, and stabs in the back in the history of elves, but the Great Game is free from backstabbing. All violators will be declared outlaws and banished from the elven society.

The victorious House determines the foreign policy of the elves. Victories often led to unexpected turns and formation of new alliances. The victor of the Great Ball is determined by the common decision of all Houses. If there's the equal number of votes, the current ruling House takes the decision. According to an unwritten rule, the previous Great Ball's victor refrains from participating in the competition.

You will comprehend these simple principles as you serve the Great Houses and climb the ladder.

finishText.en:
Good to see you, . It's time for another title.

Life goes on. As you might have noticed, many events happened on Irene over these days. I suggest you look around the city and talk to my subjects to hear the latest news.

goal.en: Visit King Louis de Desirae's court on Irene.

startText.en: It's time to receive the new title of Chevalier from King Louis. It may unlock new abilities and locations on Irene. You'll be able to talk to the elves, who didn't want to talk to you before.

finishText.en: Perhaps I should give you a piece of land on the allod to strengthen your position.

goal.en: Earn a Royal Goodwill Certificate by completing the Great Ball: Espionage quest.

startText.en:
Flying higher, ?

Each of the Houses shows their achievements at the Great Ball. But only something truly grand can earn you a victory. To win the Great Ball, you must come up with something that can affect all elves. A new spell or a great artistic masterpiece. Everyone must be able to say, "Yes, this is the thing that will change our lives forever." Sometimes the victor isn't that obvious. It's hard to choose a single one from truly unique achievements. This is when schemes, secret alliances of the Great Houses, and backroom conspiracies come into play.

The rules of the Great Game aren't written, but every elf, who grew up in a never-ending competition, understands them. Even joining an organization, the elves remember their own House. They're always prepared to do everything for the victory.

Don't forget about it when you come across other Great Houses here, on Irene

finishText.en:
Good to see you, . It's time for another title.

Life goes on. As you might have noticed, many events happened on Irene over these days. I suggest you look around the city and talk to my subjects to hear the latest news.

goal.en: Visit King Louis de Desirae's court on Irene.

startText.en: It's time to receive the new title of Baron from King Louis. It may unlock new abilities and locations on Irene. You'll be able to talk to the elves, who didn't want to talk to you before.

finishText.en: Wonderful! Wonderful, as always. You took another step to the top.

goal.en: Earn a Royal Goodwill Certificate by completing the Great Ball: Race quest.

startText.en:
Going further, ?

Let's talk politics. Soon after the Cataclysm broke the world into allods, my mother decided to cut her ties with the people she blamed for what happened.

For many centuries, elves stayed isolated at their allods, but the time has shown that war can come by itself. The Grok invasion put an end to all ideas about our isolation. The current situation has thrown us into the Kanian embrace. But times change. This alliance is outdated. War over territories became pointless after the invention of astral flights and new discoveries.

Think about it.

finishText.en:
Good to see you, . It's time for another title.

Life goes on. As you might have noticed, many events happened on Irene over these days. I suggest you look around the city and talk to my subjects to hear the latest news.

goal.en: Visit King Louis de Desirae's court on Irene.

startText.en: It's time to receive the new title of Viscount from King Louis. It may unlock new abilities and locations on Irene. You'll be able to talk to the elves, who didn't want to talk to you before.

finishText.en: That's great. Congratulations.

goal.en: Earn a Royal Goodwill Certificate by completing the Great Ball: Ice Dance quest.

startText.en:
The Great Ball, the demonstration of the Great Houses’ accomplishments - it’s all incredible. But even during events like these, We cannot forget about politics, so you shouldn’t either, .

As We already said, times have changed... Both Kania and Xadagan are dealing with new enemies, and the discovery of numerous new allods made their old wars pointless.

Let Us paint you a picture. In a situation where we have vast unsettled territories, reproduction of population starts playing a major role.

The Empire’s position in that regard is unfavorable. The Xadaganians that move to the cities do not have large families. Not to mention the Arisen who increase their numbers only when they find the new bodies of their compatriots. Which happens less and less often these days.

At the same time, big families are a norm in rural Kania. Gibberlings procreate rapidly. Over the last two centuries, this nation has increased its numbers several hundred times, even though there were very few of them in the beginning - they arrived here on a handful of ships.

Of course, elven families are usually small, too. Antoinette is more of an exception... But we live longer than others, except the Zem people who are immortal.

Only Orcs remain. Orcs are the backbone of the Imperial war machine. If it weren’t for Orcs, Yasker wouldn’t be able to nurture his expansionist dreams. He’d be worried about holding what he has.

That Empire would have been easy to deal with. And there would have been no need for the League...

Think about what We have told you. I wonder what conclusions you will draw.

finishText.en:
Good to see you, . It's time for another title.

Life goes on. As you might have noticed, many events happened on Irene over these days. I suggest you look around the city and talk to my subjects to hear the latest news.

goal.en: Visit King Louis de Desirae's court on Irene.

startText.en: It's time to receive the new title of Count from King Louis. It may unlock new abilities and locations on Irene. You'll be able to talk to the elves, who didn't want to talk to you before.

checkText.en: The title of Marquise will allow us to involve you in a more serious matter We'll be dealing with soon.

finishText.en: Wonderful! You are almost at the top.

goal.en: Earn a Royal Goodwill Certificate by completing the Great Ball: Fairies of Irene quest.

startText.en:
, the Great Ball is nearing its end.  I hope you've enjoyed your stay on Irene.

It is also dear to Us, but We'll be happy to return home, to Nocturn which is still controlled by Our brother, Prince Gaston.

Nocturn, formerly called Yoggor, is one of the last shards of our original lands, just like Irene. The rest of our allods were lost during the Night of Astral Portals...

There were much fewer of them before. Andis, which was also inhabited by the Kanians... Nurrir, our former domain, our family's homeland. The majestic Uramesa of the House de Blizare... Fammon, the indestructible stronghold of the House de Ardeur, Grok with its endless steppes...

Our new allods Stellara, Tempesta, Ignis, and others have been discovered once the era of astral travel began. We tried to beautify them, but alas, antiquity cannot be reproduced. That's why Irene is so precious.

finishText.en:
Good to see you, . It's time for another title.

Life goes on. As you might have noticed, many events happened on Irene over these days. I suggest you look around the city and talk to my subjects to hear the latest news.

goal.en: Visit King Louis de Desirae's court on Irene.

startText.en: It's time to receive the new title of Marquis from King Louis. It may unlock new abilities and locations on Irene. You'll be able to talk to the elves, who didn't want to talk to you before.

finishText.en: The grand finale of your efforts is the title of Duke. Only the Head of the House is above it.

goal.en: Earn a Royal Goodwill Certificate by completing the Great Ball: Royal Hunt quest.

startText.en:
, you have achieved the heights of respect in elven society.

Now everyone who doubted your merits has seen clear evidence that the rumors are true.

I hope you managed to learn a lot and came to a better understanding of our people, our plans and aspirations.

All that's left is to wait for the ending of this story. We are both curious to see how it ends.

finishText.en:
Good to see you, . It's time for another title.

Life goes on. As you might have noticed, many events happened on Irene over these days. I suggest you look around the city and talk to my subjects to hear the latest news.

goal.en: Visit King Louis de Desirae's court on Irene.

startText.en: It's time to receive the new title of Duke from King Louis. It may unlock new abilities and locations on Irene. You'll be able to talk to the elves, who didn't want to talk to you before.

finishText.en: The opinions you gathered are quite curious. As we thought, the politics of the Great Houses are very controversial. House de Desirae will be forced to give up power. The question is, which House will come next? If I understand correctly, every House has three rivals, but also three opponents.

goal.en: Speak to Great Houses' representatives on Irene.

startText.en:
I'm curious what my subjects think about the current state of affairs on Irene. House heads may not speak their minds freely. Those on inferior positions have nothing to fear. They can be more open.

Please, find your old friends in the city and discuss their Heads' plans. Find out what they are thinking.

finishText.en:
Hey, what's up? Are you surprised to see me? Ha ha.

Yes, you might have noticed, but this time not only elves are invited to the Great Ball. The king thinks it was right to invite everyone over to Irene. They want to impress everyone with their success. That's literally what they say.

goal.en: Prevent duels between representatives of smaller races.

startText.en:
I've already issued a Decree that bans duels. I'm afraid it won't be enough! There are proud Aviaks that are very peculiar about the issues of honor. Although, maybe they just love to fight. I don't know. There's this ugly tradition of provoking fights after getting paid by the House. Aviaks fight lamias, Kobolds fight harpies, and so on.

They set a bad example for all other races. They involve elves in fights as well. We want you to patrol some popular dueling locations in the city. If you come across a duel, remind them about the royal decree again.

finishText.en: Keep it a secret.

goal.en: Escort Constance and help her deliver the secret message.

startText.en:
Kharr! Khar! Bloody astral hell!

Enough fight! You show what you can do. You fight good, you brave... unlike that scoundrel! It is no time for fun. I speak with pretty harpy, she ask, you come. I need your help. It's urgent. Follow me! All for one, one for all!

finishText.en:
Enough with the questions. The show begins!

Keep the mask, you'll find it handy. You'll see.

Until next time, . Until we meet again!

goal.en: Find out why elves are after Skulnar.

startText.en:
They invited me as a guest of honor, hehe. The king chose me for my talent.

He says he knows the ancient legends about the Orc, who can use magic. It's kind of what he sees now.

He sent me here on a mission. His subjects need some discipline... but I don't know where to begin. They're all super unruly, fighting and killing each other all the time. That's why I'm still hanging around. And there are these circus magicians. They're giving me a headache.

finishText.en: What's going on? Kuarrr! Stop it!

goal.en: Meet Amis, Potis, and Atis in the alleyway near the pier.

startText.en:
Did you fail to catch that moth? I know! She's so skinny it's impossible to get a purchase!

Alright, whatever. I've been thinking, maybe, I should give acting a try. I could play the Princess's role, hehe. They will totally buy it, with my talent.

Oh, I've just remembered something. I stumbled upon someone while you were wandering in the city. Someone who? You know, chicks with rapiers... whatchamacallem... The Aviaks. They wanted to talk to you, and they looked like they meant business. All three of them. They came up to me in turns, and each wanted to meet you in some alleyway near the harbor.

Know what this is about? Make sure not to kill anyone. They're pretty tame. If you hurt them, their owners won't like it.

Go. I'll stay for now...

finishText.en:
You have arrived. Good. The reason I summoned you is simple.

The Great Ball will begin soon. This event defines the elven policy for years to come.

Why should you care?

I'll tell you: we have a chance to weaken the League's position.

Let's look into the history. Kania and Xadagands have been opponents for thousands of years. None of them can win. Several centuries ago the conflict was taken to a new level: other races got involved. Orcs and Zem joined the Empire. Gibberlings and elves became part of the League.

The Arisen helped us develop science and technology and make a leap ahead.

But the League never lagged behind. They're copying our inventions and discover things on their own thanks to their well developed magic. Elves play a decisive role in this process.

We're on truce terms with the League now. But historically, no truce can last long. Moreover, thanks to you and the Cosmos, we have a problem with the orcs who threaten to quit the Empire. So far, it's just talk, but who knows what's going to happen.

What can be done in this situation? Try and weaken the connection between Kania and elves. How? Let me explain.

goal.en: Find Yasker in Yasker's Tower

startText.en:
My dear !

Since you are currently busy with the assault on Nihaz's Citadel, I am forced to order you to postpone this task until later. As far as I know, right now your forces are holding their positions and will continue to do so, but a full-blown assault requires preparation. This pause is quite welcome.

The problem the Empire is facing bears no delay. The matter is urgent and rather delicate.

I order you to visit me in Yasker's Tower as soon as possible.

Yasker mentions a problem in his letter. The Imperial leader wants you to arrive as soon as possible. Don't make him wait.

finishText.en: It's good to see you healthy and safe.

goal.en: Find Aidenus

startText.en:
My dear friend !

Since you are currently busy with the assault on Nihaz's Citadel, I am forced to order you to postpone this task until later. As far as I know, right now your forces are holding their positions and will continue to do so, but a full-blown assault requires preparation. This should give us some time.

The problem the League is facing bears no delay. The matter is urgent and rather delicate.

I order you to visit me in Novograd as soon as possible.

Aidenus mentions a problem in his letter. The League leader wants you to arrive as soon as possible. Don't make him wait.

finishText.en:
Here's your invitation.

Let me tell you what else you need to do.

goal.en: Find Marianne de Ardeur and speak with her.

startText.en:
"My dear , the hero of my people. Every elf knows your name!

Since you are currently busy with the assault on Nihaz's Citadel, I am forced to order you to lay down your arms for the time being. As far as I know, right now your forces are holding their positions and will continue to do so, but a full-blown assault requires preparation. You will have enough time.

You are an outstanding child of our race, someone we all treasure and respect. It is time for you to receive your rewards for your accomplishments. And of course, to do something new.

I order you to visit me in Novograd Church as soon as possible."

Marianne de Ardeur wants you to meet her on a festive occasion. You shouldn't make the Prioress of the Church of Light wait.

finishText.en:
Have you completed your task? Great.

Now the elves will tell everybody that you set them free in person.

This will increase your influence. You'll need it for your next task.

goal.en: Make sure that the elves are released early from the prison and report back to Yasker.

startText.en:
The Great Ball is a perfect chance to change the elven policy. The winning House determines our diplomatic policy. If a neutral House wins, the League's position will be significantly weakened.

Luckily, that's something we can influence.

Elves invite you to take part in the Ball as a renowned hero. Besides, this time they're inviting different races... for propaganda purposes.

We can turn it to our benefit. I created a group, headed by Elizaveta Rysina, our official ambassador at this so-called event.

Report to her. We need to start with one thing. I know some underground crack houses in Nezebgrad, where corrupt officials and other scum gawk at dancing elven girls! It's time to put an end to it. We have truce with the League. Early release of all prisoners is on the table.

I order you to release all elven prisoners within 24 hours to strengthen our position. Complete amnesty! And transport them away from Igsh!

You're going to the Termitka prison in person. I'll give you the Order I signed personally. Supervise the release, make sure they're all set free!

finishText.en:
It's curious.

Well, the elves are divided. We should convince them that the League is going their way. You and Voisvet will be able to find the right arguments.

goal.en: Speak with representatives of the Seven Great Houses in Novograd and report to Aidenus.

startText.en:
Oh, this Great Ball...

It'll take a special effort to prevent the League from falling apart. The winning House determines our diplomatic policy. If a pro-Imperial House wins, the League's position will be significantly weakened.

Luckily, we can influence that. I'm talking about you.

Your deeds are impressive. The elves sent you a personal invitation to the Ball. Besides, this time they're inviting different races... to show off their gloss and glory.

Voisvet Belov, the Head of the Church of Light and the Kanian Warden, will visit to strengthen our position. Report to him directly.

I need you to do something before going there. Talk to the elves of Novograd, figure out their attitude toward the League. This is how we'll find out the general disposition.

finishText.en:
You've completed my task. I'm sure you heard a lot of new things. Think it over. Make conclusions.

And now it's time to go.

goal.en: Deliver the invitation to the Great Ball to the elves on Kanian Archipelagos and report to Marianne de Ardeur.

startText.en:
What a glorious Great Ball!

All elves are dreaming to visit! Luckily, it's held quite often, every few decades. I've visited many Great Balls in my life. I witnessed the ultimate victory of Maximilien de Blizare, who granted us a weapon against demons. I heard Estelle's prophecies. I tasted the triumph, when Romain and Celestine made a breakthrough in astral navigation. I saw the complete victory of Price Dakkar over Armando!

What will the celebration be like this time? We shall soon know.

Other races are visiting the Ball this time. We decided to show them the real magnificence and triumph!

And I want you to inform your allies and friends that accompanied you that they're also invited. I'm speaking about the elves of Kanian Archipelago. Deliver the happy news. Talk to them, ask how they are doing. They will be happy to see a renowned hero such as you.

finishText.en:
I am King Louis de Desirae, Head of House de Desirae, Ruler of Tenebra and Nocturne.

Enough with the ceremony. I've heard a lot about you and your deeds. Welcome to my residence, . Your achievements put you on par with us, Great Mages, those who hold the world on their shoulders. By the royal will, I grant you the royal favor and the right to talk freely on any subject you like, as long as you follow the appropriate protocol.

goal.en: Talk to Zayan and go to Irene together.

startText.en:
A history lesson is in order.

The oldest Sarnaut state is the elven kingdom of Irene. It existed back in the days of Junes, who began to build their empire.

Irene was a closed state and followed the principles of beauty. The elves didn't let anything in their state if it contradicted their ideals. Everyone who crossed the line was subject to destruction.

We don't know much about that period. At some point, the elves decided to undergo the change and turn into dragon-like creatures. The strongest mages of the kingdom managed to do it. They prepared the spells and put everyone in a magic two-century sleep.

Many things changed over the years. Junes destroyed most dragons and fell victims to the curse.

The elven life was significantly changed after the Transformation. They abandoned their old ideals... however, not all mages agreed to do so. The recent Conclave of the Great Mages was destined to split.

Problems with vampires, riots, and unrest in the kingdom made my people spread around the world, forming separate Houses.

finishText.en:
And we meet again! I'd be very much surprised if they sent someone else.

I suppose, Yasker told you what to expect. So hear my historical point of view.

goal.en: Meet Zayan on Al Rihat

startText.en:
Go to Al Rihat Ruins to the Patriarch's Residence and find the Great Mage Zayan to get to the Great Ball.

He'll instruct you what to do.

Talk to Elizaveta Rysina when you arrive. You must find a way to split the ranks of the League and make the Empire succeed!

finishText.en:
And we meet again! I'd be very much surprised if they sent someone else.

I suppose, Aidenus told you what to expect. So hear my historical point of view.

goal.en: Meet Zayan on Al Rihat.

startText.en:
Go to Al Rihat Ruins to the Patriarch's Residence and find the Great Mage Zayan to get to the Great Ball.

He'll instruct you what to do.

Talk to Voisvet Belov when you arrive. Together, you should find a way to prevent the elves from leaving the League.

finishText.en:
And we meet again! I'd be very much surprised if they sent someone else.

I suppose, Marianne told you what to expect. So hear my historical point of view.

goal.en: Meet Zayan on Al Rihat

startText.en:
Go to Al Rihat Ruins to the Patriarch's Residence and find the Great Mage Zayan to get to the Great Ball.

He'll instruct you what to do.

Talk to Voisvet Belov when you arrive. Aidenus wants you to help him solve our common issues. I think we'll have to persuade the wavering Houses that the League is good for them.

checkText.en: Don't keep Antoinette waiting, otherwise you won't have time to take part in the most intriguing plans for this evening.

finishText.en:
! I'm happy to see you again.

The situation is becoming more and more tense. We all have to decide whether we will accept vampires back into our community or banish them forever. The fate of the House de Doucer will also be decided today...

Perhaps you are confused by all these twists and turns... I'll explain just in case. Annette is now the leader of all the vampires that agreed to the amnesty and stopped drinking the blood of sentient beings. Regardless of the House they belong to...

Roxanne, Armando and Carmilla's daughter, leads the remnants of those from the House de Doucer who did not become a vampire.

Gala, my daughter, will become their... defender at the trial of the Heads of the Great Houses. And now we have to decide what we'll say in their defense. Talk to Gala, find out what she is planning and help her.

goal.en: Meet with Antoinette de Delice in the Galleon Castle.

startText.en:
Well, ! The Great Ball is in full swing. We have already seen a lot, it's time to see what the Houses de Pluie and de Delice will show us...

We would like to talk to you about the last House.

Antoinette asked Us to tell you to come see her as soon as possible. After all, you were the one who helped her daughter Gala form this alliance with the vampires. It is time for the final act in this story of their fate.

You will find the archduchess in the Galleon Castle.

checkText.en: Oh no, don't give me this look. Eavesdropping is completely normal in our society. No one will judge you.

finishText.en: So everything is still... Wait, what? Who was Caspar talking to...? What is she doing here? Huh?

goal.en: Eavesdrop on the vampires' conversation in the Galleon Castle.

startText.en:
Annette and I are preparing a speech, perhaps Mother has already told you... But we are interested in what others think of vampires and the House de Doucer. This information will help us identify the best arguments for our speech.

It should be easy - just walk around the room and listen to what they have to say. I'm sure everyone is discussing our vampires... Try to learn the opinions of all Houses but ours.

checkText.en: Food is the most important thing at a party! Hah!

finishText.en: The musicians will entertain us! Ugh... I'm full... Murk is a decent guy! We can rely on him. Hey, come by tonight, maybe we'll find something to drink!

goal.en: Help Skulnar feel at ease at the Ball

startText.en:
There are so many people here.

I'll take care of the final preparations for the trial. In the meantime, help Skulnar feel more at ease - I saw him pacing around here... There he is, to the right of the entrance!

checkText.en: Well? Have you found them all? I'm running out of time! We're going to print the issue tomorrow!

finishText.en: Excellent! Thank you so much! Phew! It's all here...! True, the corners are a little bent... I hope you haven't made copies and sold them to my competitors?

goal.en: Find eight pages of the lost records of past balls in the ballroom and on the second floor of the Galleon

name.en: The History of the Great Balls

startText.en:
Hey, you. Yes, you! You know who I am?

Listen... I have a problem. I am preparing an article on the history of the Great Balls and I've already written quite a lot.

I've lost my notes somewhere. I don't know how it happened...

Be a dear, help me find them... I think some of them are somewhere here in the ballroom, while the rest should be upstairs on the second floor. Please hurry! Let your intuition... or sight... or magic... Whatever it is you have, let it help you!

I think I dropped the first one somewhere near the drake of the House de Vevre when it moved abruptly...

checkText.en: Just don't stare at my girls. It might be a party for you, but for them it's just work.

finishText.en: Good pictures! Maybe I should hire you. We have a good market for that on Igsh, you'll be rich.

goal.en: Take seven "hot" pictures of models from "Sharp Ears" at the Galleon Castle.

startText.en:
! Hey, buddy!

We haven't met, but I've heard a lot about you.

Let me introduce myself - Hugh de Pluie, one of the Tycoons. Yes, one of the seven most influential Free Traders.

Art is my passion. And beauty, of course. We are busy preparing the next issue of my magazine. No, this is not some boring collection of dusty stories... After all, this is the "Sharp Ears". Many in the Empire secretly read it... And not just the Empire.

I'm gathering material for the issue, but my photographer is late. Can you help? You have probably handled the Desorotype before.

Just capture the setting of the Ball. And my girls will help you create the right subtext for the pictures we will print.

checkText.en: It is not easy to defend someone everyone hates... But if there is even a drop of faith in your heart, we will succeed!

finishText.en:
It is decided.

Everyone is happy with the outcome, even the king. Although Renard is angry, vampires will serve us all.

goal.en: Convince the Great Houses to accept vampires and House de Doucer.

startText.en:
We've seen enough. Maximilien de Blizare, Caspar de Vevre, and Baudouin de Grandeur demonstrated their skills, everyone has already seen the painting by Guillaume de Pluie, the Galleon Castle of the House de Ardeur is also present...

It's time for Antoinette. She has been preparing for a long time and you assisted her. Let's see the result!

checkText.en: Soon we'll learn who will be the next ruler of the elves. Are you nervous, ? We certainly are.

finishText.en:
Well, that was expected! We Ourselves chose Antoinette. Hopefully Renard will forgive Us.

The most important part is over, , but that doesn't mean the Ball is! The festivities continue! We think you should stay on Irene a little longer... You never know when something interesting may happen.

goal.en: Participate in the vote and learn the name of the winner.

startText.en:
It's time for the final vote. The processing and counting of votes will be handled by the most impartial creature in the palace, the artificial intelligence of the Galleon named Celestine.

We are willing to trust Renard and Raymond, the architect of the Galleon, that Celestine will be truly impartial.

You only need to provide her with the votes of the elves - to do so, use a special compiler that will collect data. Progress!

You might want to learn what the heads of the Houses have decided - they cannot vote for their own House, so everyone will have to carefully choose their candidate.

Once you're done, return to Us to discuss your own choice. Yes, yes, you can cast your vote, too.

checkText.en: Attack! Today we will be victorious!

finishText.en:
So, this is the end of the Path. But is this the end of war? The Architect was defeated, but wasn't destroyed. Trouble seems to persist - Chaos, Order, Architects, Demons, fanatics - what do we do with them all?!

War after war, catastrophe after catastrophe. It makes me feel sometimes that the Order wouldn't be so bad after all. We're going round in a vicious circle. And I will do my best to find the way to break it!

goal.en: Enter Fractal, defeat the Archont of the Architects and prevent the opening of the Path.

startText.en:
Good job... The banner did work! Our guys were so encouraged.

Now we just have to capture this building and drive the Architects out - back to their world through that Path. We will seal that hole tightly! And destroy their Fractal, if we have to.

Are you ready, soldiers? Let's go then!

checkText.en: Assault!

finishText.en:
So, this is the end of the Path. But is this the end of war? The Architect was defeated, but wasn't destroyed. Trouble seems to persist - Chaos, Order, Architects, Demons, fanatics - what do we do with them all?!

War after war, catastrophe after catastrophe. It makes me feel sometimes that the Order wouldn't be so bad after all. We're going round in a vicious circle. And I will do my best to find the way to break it!

goal.en: Enter Fractal, defeat the Archont of the Architects and prevent the opening of the Path.

startText.en:
Good job... The banner did work! Our guys were so encouraged.

Now we just have to capture this building and drive the Architects out - back to their world through that Path. We will seal that hole tightly! And destroy their Fractal, if we have to.

Are you ready, soldiers? Let's go then!

checkText.en: So, do you have the iron ore?

finishText.en: Wonderful! There's enough here to trade for an entire feast!

goal.en: Collect 20 pieces of Refined Iron Ore to Sigurd the Swindler.

startText.en: Oh, woe is me! With my mine out of commission, I've got no income! And with no income, I've got no way to pay and feed my workers! I have an idea! If you would be so kind as to gather me some iron ore, then I could make enough money to feed my boys for a week! Oh, please! You can't imagine how much it would help - I know how to make a profit out of the most mundane resources!

finishText.en:
Hmm... The security of the Empire demands that we be vigilant, even if we're talking about ravings of a late Great Mage.
It should be noted that we receive regular reports of demons and cultists activities. However, most of those are fueled by old fears and ignorance, and we would waste time investigating them.

goal.en: Speak with Elizaveta Rysina, Head of the City Council, about Tensess' message.

startText.en:
Join forces with the League? I doubt even Nezeb himself would risk introducing such a radical policy on our foreign relations!
Look, even if we suppose that Tensess is right and that the demonic threat has not been neutralized, I can't just up and cease the war with the League without the Empire facing severe ramifications. It would take years just to make the Imperial citizens stop believing in Nezeb's and Skrakan's sacrifice during the Great Astral Campaign. The League is our enemy, and the demons don't seem nearly as bad or dangerous enough to displace it.
No, it's downright impossible! Especially considering that we have no reason to believe Tensess' groundless words! That's right - groundless! It's probably just the demon worshippers acting up locally. And any potentially dangerous consequences of their activity has already been prevented by you!
Still, we shouldn't ignore this signal completely. I suppose the City Council should investigate the matter. Speak to Elizaveta Rysina. Have her reference this data against the information we already have on the demon worshippers. Perhaps there'll be a connection...

finishText.en:
Aha, the Empire finally decided to do something! Of course, everybody needs meteorite ore. I'm sure the Nezebgrad City Council would just rather spit on me and my allod... but they need me.
You're just in time, I had already called for the Demon Hunters, the Trinity Church, and the ZIT scientists, and they're all useless!

goal.en: Meet with Sigurd the Swindler in Swindlerville on Coldberg.

startText.en:
We have a letter here that requires our immediate attention.
A Free Trader, Sigurd the Swindler, tells us that demons have appeared on Coldberg. At first glance, it just looks like another scream from a frightened, stupid Gibberling. But the circumstances of this matter became more serious...
First of all, they say that this Sigurd is one of the Oligarchs, a member of the Council of Seven that rules those rebellious Free Traders. Is it the truth? I haven't got a clue. The Council of Seven is one of those unsolved mysteries. Maybe it's all hogwash... but the Council should check everything, even the absurd.
Secondly, that Swindler is one of the meteorite ore suppliers... We can't lose him.
And third, not long ago Swindler asked the ZIT to help with the same problem. And without even asking us, Nomarkh Nynetjer took several scientists with him to Coldberg on a mission! And we haven't heard anything from them since!
So, the time has come to send our wisest and most talented agent to Coldberg. You will go meet with Sigurd the Swindler at once.

checkText.en: Can I help you?

finishText.en:
A letter of gratitude from the Swindler? Let's read it!
He requests that you be rewarded. Hmm, just yesterday I received a report from Nomarkh Nynetjer, in which he also makes note of your accomplishments. But I still don't understand why he chose to withdraw the expedition from Coldberg. Ugh, those silly scientists always think that our City Council is behind everything that goes on in the world! Oh well, that doesn't matter anymore. What matters is that Coldberg has been cleared of the undead and meteorite ore shipments have resumed!
Still, it's too early to celebrate! This business with the Astral fangs and the Orcish necromancer calls for a separate investigation!

goal.en: Deliver Sigurd the Swindler's letter to Elizaveta Rysina in Nezebgrad.

startText.en:
The Broderen Mine has finally been cleared of those nasty skeletons! Now the miners can go back underground, the shipments of ore will resume, and money will once again start trickling my way! Hurray!
I can't believe things are getting back to normal. Well, I guess we still need to deal with those Astral fangs... But at least the mine is resuming operation!
Everything is working out just fine! Here, I've prepared this letter for Elizaveta Rysina, requesting that she award you for your efforts. Don't forget to give her the letter when you see her!

checkText.en: What are you waiting for? I won't teach you anything until you can tell me where those stones are!

finishText.en: Good job, I knew you'd be fine. Some people just can't do it, though. You didn't happen to see any frozen bodies out there, did you?

goal.en: Find the 4 stones in Swindlerville, Frost Peak, Snowy Wastes, and the Ruined Shore. Report back to Anthropologist Sagehoof the Insightful in Swindlerville.

startText.en:
You say you know Coldberg, but I don't believe you. If you want to prove to me that you know what you're talking about, then you'll need to tell me where the hidden stones are.
What's that? You don't know? Well, then I guess you don't know as much as you thought you did. But don't worry, that's what I'm here for!
If you can go out and find the four stones hidden around Coldberg, then I'll teach you everything that you need to know! Don't worry. They're easy to find. Here, I'll even give you a little hint. You can find them around Swindlerville, Frost Peak, Snowy Wastes, and the Ruined Shore.

checkText.en: Well? Have those creatures been defeated?

finishText.en:
Excellent!
I knew you could do it. And by defeating these beasts, you now know more about the local fauna.

goal.en: Collect 5 Coldberg Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Sagehoof the Insightful in Swindlerville.

startText.en:
I know you're a seasoned traveler, but Coldberg is a very dangerous place!
You let your guard down for one second and that's it! It's all over! I want you to get used to the dangers of a place like this, so I need you to venture out and kill 5 of Coldberg's most dangerous creatures!
But you need to give me proof – a trophy from the likes of Frostrage, Milcake, Drafty Elemental, Shurko, or Kroto Slimetooth.

checkText.en: Well? I hope those mountainfolk shake with fear every time they hear your name.

finishText.en:
Thank you.
Hopefully now we can focus on getting rid of those other pests – the demons and the skeletons!

goal.en: Kill 100 mountainfolk while on Coldberg and report back to Anthropologist Sagehoof the Insightful in Swindlerville.

startText.en:
The next thing that you need to learn about is Coldberg's local troublemakers.
No, not the demons and skeletons. Those pests are not local to this allod. I'm talking about the mountainfolk.
Those little bastards are always trying to steal our goods and equipment! We have enough trouble just getting those good out here! We can't have them up and taking it! Go out and show those punks who the real masters of this allod are.

checkText.en: Reindeer moss grows all over Coldberg but it's small, so you'll have to look carefully.

finishText.en:
Thank you!
Now our warriors are sure to be tough enough to take on the demons!

goal.en: Gather 7 Pristine Reindeer Moss bundles for Anthropologist Sagehoof the Insightful in Swindlerville.

startText.en:
There are a lot of valuable resources here on Coldberg, but only one stands out - apart from the meteorite ore, of course. I'm talking about reindeer moss!
What? Don't laugh! It's good for your health! For everyone's health! If you eat just a bit of it, it will keep you from getting sick! It only grows here, you know.
Please go out and collect some for me. You can find it all over Coldberg. I plan on cultivating this more extensively so that it can be distributed to people all over Sarnaut.

checkText.en: Have you completed all of my tasks?

finishText.en:
Wonderful!
You know, I must admit, I thought you wouldn't be able to do that. That you for proving me wrong! Go ahead and take your reward!

goal.en: Complete all of Sagehoof the Insightful's tasks and report back to him in Swindlerville.

startText.en:
If you can successfully complete all my tasks, you'll be generously rewarded.
And I'm not talking about some rinky-dink potion! You'll have the knowledge that you've gained from this adventure as well as some prime equipment that's bound to help you on your future journeys!
So, find the stones, defeat the beasts, and gather some valuable resources here in Coldberg!

checkText.en: Oh, we are so ashamed!

finishText.en:
Thank you, thank you, thank you!
You have no idea what this means to us!

goal.en: Kill 6 Bears on the north-eastern island of Coldberg. Report back to the Guarded Family in Swindlerville.

startText.en:
We are great bear hunters! Sigurd even shipped us in all the way from Frozen Frontier to take care of the polar bears here!
...But we haven't been able to kill a single one.
The bears here a lot tougher than any of the other bears we've fought on Frozen Frontier. And they're a lot smarter too! Have you even seen a pack this big?! They know that there's safety in numbers!
We need your help! Our reputation is on the line! Please!

finishText.en:
Oh great Light, how am I supposed to react to that!? On one hand, the great Tensess has ordered us to join forces with the Empire to fight the demons... On the other hand, every citizen of the League knows that the Empire is our sworn enemy, while the demons have long since gone!
So who am I to believe!? The great Tensess, the founder of the Church of Light... or history itself!? I'm so confused! What should I do?

goal.en: Speak with Marianne de Ardeur, the High Prioress, about Tensess' message.

startText.en:
"Join forces with the Empire and strike a collective blow against the demons." Oh, if only it were so easy!
I don't want to bore you with a history lecture, but I will say this - even the most ignorant peasant on Umoira knows that during the Great Astral Campaign, Skrakan and Nezeb sacrificed themselves to close the June Gates. And ever since that day, the allods have been rid of the threat of demon invasion.
I think that Tensess is exaggerating when he says that history may repeat itself. I bet it's all just some petty cultists' plot...
That said, we cannot just ignore the words of a Great Mage, even one who's left us. Go and speak to Marianne de Ardeur. If anyone can settle the matter of the demons, it's the Church of Light!

finishText.en: Good to see the League finally fork over some reinforcements! Nobody wants to risk losing shipments of meteorite ore! Just in time, too! I was already beginning to gather up my things. I've already called for the Demon Hunters, the Church of Light, and the ZIT scientists... and they're all useless!

goal.en: Meet with Sigurd the Swindler on Coldberg.

startText.en:
We need to find out what's happening - to either refute the words of Tensess or to corroborate them. Fortunately, I know just where to begin.

Recently, we received a distress signal from the allod of Coldberg. The author of the letter is Sigurd the Swindler - a Free Trader and one of our main suppliers of meteorite ore. Some even say he's one of the Oligarchs.

Who are the Oligarchs? Rumor has it that the actions of the Free Traders are actually governed by the Council of Seven that is comprised of the wealthiest and most powerful Free Traders. It's an old myth, though, and it's probably just another conspiracy theory. Anyway, Sigurd writes that his allod has been attacked by demons! He says that if we don't help, the shipments of meteorite ore will stop and he'll have no choice but to flee the allod.

As you can probably understand, we cannot afford to risk losing our supply of meteorite ore. I've already dispatched some priests of the Church of Light to Coldberg, but there's been no word from them yet.

This worries me! You are to follow them and find out what's happening over there. May the Light be with you!

checkText.en: Can I help you?

finishText.en:
A letter from Sigurd? Let's see what he wrote! Alright, he thanks you for your assistance rendered, and promises to increase shipments of ore to compensate for the losses suffered during downtime!
I guess this means that you were able to save the mine and allod from complete destruction? This is wonderful news! But, unfortunately, this joy is marred by the other things that have been happening these past few days.
Strizhov has come back, and it should be noted that the events on Coldberg have greatly affected his... hmm... his stability. He just keeps going on and on about demons, sowing discord among the clergy and the congregation! I was forced to order his excommunication.
But that doesn't mean we're letting this go, oh no! The matter demands an immediate and highly thorough investigation! We must get to the bottom of the Astral fangs and this strange Orcish woman that has joined the demon worshippers!

goal.en: Deliver Sigurd the Swindler's letter to Marianne de Ardeur in Novograd.

startText.en:
The Broderen Mine has finally been cleared of those nasty skeletons! Now the miners can go back underground, the shipments of ore will resume, and money will once again start trickling my way! Hurray!
I can't believe things are getting back to normal. Well, I guess we still need to deal with those Astral fangs... But at least the mine is resuming operation!
Everything is working out just fine! Here, I've prepared this letter for Marianne de Ardeur, requesting that she award you for your efforts. Don't forget to give her the letter when you see her!

finishText.en: Oh! It's the buried treasure! That old loudmouth in Swindlerville wasn't lying after all!

goal.en: Dig around the Astral fang for treasure.

startText.en: What's this giant thing stuck in the snow? Something must surely be hidden here.

checkText.en: Come on! I know you can find it! If not, then no one can!

finishText.en: Aha! See, what'd I tell you? I knew you could find it!

goal.en: Explore Coldberg to find the stolen chest. Report back to Vlad Gergiev in Swindlerville.

startText.en:
Frost Peak...
The tallest mountain in the north-west of Coldberg. I used to dream of climbing it, seeing the island from up there... But I'm always busy... There's a lot of work to do. And now there's no time for that, as you can see.
Maybe you'd like to do it. Why? Because there's treasure.
That got your attention, I see! Let me tell you a story.
When I started working here, I found the notes of my predecessor. He mentioned a valuable chest that went missing. Suspicion fell on the miners who were working for him at the time. The miners denied everything and eventually quit altogether. The chest was never found. But the notes said the miners took their most valuable things to the Frost Peak, offering them to some deity of theirs. So if they did steal the chest, I reckon it should be there. But maybe not!
You can look for it if you want.

checkText.en: Have you learned everything you wanted?

finishText.en:
That’s how it is. I like this place. It’s chilly but you can warm up near the fire. And if I feel sad, I visit my sister’s grave.

So, will you help?

goal.en: Talk to Skulnar, Kurgan and Sigurd to learn about the situation.

startText.en: So much has happened over the last few months, I don’t even know where to start. I got myself into something and I’m starting to regret it. I decided to train orcs... But it went askew... Just ask me what you want to know, I’ll tell you. And... others wanted to talk to you as well. Kurgan, our shaman, and Sigurd. You probably know them, so find out what they want. And get down to work.

checkText.en: I still need to revive three orc psionicists (Dumka the Big Head, Tolk the Brainy, Gaze the Nomadic) and see what they know.

finishText.en: What? What were they shouting? Something about darkness? And everyone dying? I don’t like this. It’s probably nothing, there have been many doomsayers over the years, but these guys wouldn’t lie about that, right? They must have seen something. But what was it? Well, prophecies aren’t my thing, but our brother psionicist can usually see through time. We need to ask someone else about it...

goal.en: Chase away the dark offspring and revive three orc psionicists (Dumka the Big Head, Tolk the Brainy, Gaze the Nomadic).

startText.en: I have a solution - as simple as an axe, hah. We’ve gathered them all in the tavern. Go there and take care of the vermin in the area, then try to rouse them. It should help. I’d go myself, but I’m afraid I might fall asleep, too. I guess you managed to cure yourself of that when you were traveling around the allods?

checkText.en: Well, what is it? Did you ask those fortune tellers what we should do?

finishText.en: You know, I understand even less now than I did when we first started this. What do we do? Pshaw! If we could just find one decent fortune teller who’d tell us: go there and do this, and everything would be alright.

goal.en: Ask Elizaveta Barisheva, Sarbaz Segret, and Saad Tankha for a prediction

finishText.en: Oh, precious. I knew I’d meet you. I had a prophetic dream.

goal.en: Meet with Elizaveta Barisheva

startText.en:
You can find Barisheva in Eljune, Eljune Bazaar. You’ll see tents there, it’s like a circus.

She’s a wise woman, and she works with cards. I can only play cards, haha. But she sees something in them. Let her tell you your fortune.

Even if she doesn’t say anything useful, she can point you to someone who can.

checkText.en: Oh, my poor deck. Damn those bandits. What was grandma’s curse?

finishText.en:
Oh, precious. My vision is blurry and vague, cards are saying strange things. It only happened once to me, a few years ago when the mysterious Director was sending letters to everyone. It was a difficult time.

You chased him away, didn’t you?

I don’t know how to help you... But maybe...

goal.en: Barisheva asks you to retrieve her divination cards stolen by bandits.

startText.en:
The road called me for a reason. I was worried after all those mysterious travelers appeared, predicting terrible things and confusing people...

And people kept asking questions. Wealthy merchants, young warriors, lovely maidens - all the Novograd citizens. Even Aidenus himself asked for a prediction. But cards were silent that time.

I gave it a thought - and decided that I needed a new card deck. They say there’s a rare deck created by an ancient master, the Wise Khima himself. And apparently you can buy it here, in Eljune. I packed my things and traveled there. Bought the deck.

But the reading was unfortunate. It warned me about loss. My cards were stolen. I don’t know who did it, there are plenty of thieves around here, each more suspicious than the last.

Be a dear, bring me my deck.

checkText.en: Damn those bandits. Will you kill or get killed?

finishText.en: Ivan was right, you can't defeat evil with non-resistance. If the innocent suffer, if orphans and widows weep, what is your duty? Just pick up a sword, and go fight evil!

goal.en: Kill the bandits near the Eljune Bazaar

startText.en:
Oh, honey. Oh, dear!

Scoundrels everywhere! You can't take a step out of the gates without getting jumped... robbed and mugged... and if you're a woman - dishonored!

We live in an evil time, evil time...

The scoundrels are now rampaging here, in the Holy Land. Nothing is sacred to them... The bandits are roaming free right past this fence...

Please, be the hero you are supposed to be - kill them, I beg you!

checkText.en: What brings you here again, foreigner?

finishText.en: Greetings, foreign hero. I knew we’d meet. You want to help the elf? Are you sure he needs it? Ademar was the one who brought misfortune on his house. He brought that cursed mirror, so now he’s paying for it!

goal.en: Talk to Gamayun

checkText.en: Annette, oh, Annette...

finishText.en: What? You didn’t understand anything? Prophecies are always like that. I need to speak with someone who can make sense of it. Whom? Do you know Zayan? Yes, yes, the Historian. What? You mean he can’t help?

goal.en: Brew a potion that can help Ademar.

startText.en:
We’re all architects of our own fortune. Yours is right behind you. Mark my words: if you board the cursed ship, you will die there!

The cure for the elf will be a bitter one. You’ll have to work for it.

Collect some Lotus for me. It will cure any sickness. It grows around lakes.

Then go to the city ruins. Collect some Strange Mushrooms. They restore memories.

But that’s not all. There are some corrupted druids in the area, the cursed sorcerers. The sickness drove them mad. They stole the tears of Umoir forests. These tears bring repentance. Retrieve them from the corrupted druids.

Finally, there’s a Brutosaur dwelling in the Covert Hide. When the Blight hit the land, the Mother Earth screamed and gave birth to this creature. Its liver is the last component.

Collect everything and mix the ingredients in the Totem Circle. Then take the potion to Ademar.

Farewell. Mark my words!

finishText.en: Greetings! Some strange things are happening. Prophecies. Predictions. What does the future hold? I’m concerned. It’s not easy to separate truth from lies.

goal.en: Meet with Sarbaz Segret in Asee-Teph

startText.en:
You can find Segret in Asee-Teph in the ruins of Miktlan where the Historians' Camp is.

He’s technically dead but he still mede... meridi... ugh. Meditates! Yes! Falls into a trance and sees something. I hope he can help us. If not, ask him if he knows anyone else in the Empire that can. Their Council and ZIT Headquarters both dabbled in predictions.

checkText.en: Did you get the tablets?

finishText.en:
Tablets collected.

Entering a trance state... I see. Hmm. I don’t see anything. There’s darkness all around me.

Interesting. This is supposed to be a prediction about the future of the Empire, and yet I see nothing.
It reminds me of the time when some Director was blocking my abilities. However, I’m not feeling any resistance now.

I don’t know how to explain this. Wait...

…

goal.en: Collect June tablets

startText.en:
Residents of the Empire were frightened by mysterious travelers who predicted the future. The Council launched an investigation. They are gathering information and analyzing it.

Accurate predictions. My duty is to provide accurate information. Knowledge of history will help us. Background data: there was a nation known as June people. They had special divination tablets that allowed them to peek into the future. I traveled to the place where the Historians found these tablets.

Problem: the Historians are understaffed. Cause: some left for the academy opening ceremony on Ammer, others are studying Ferris with a group of explorers. What to do: collect the tablets ourselves.

Your task is to help me. I promise to share any information I might find.

checkText.en: I’m glad you are here. I didn’t want to send Yasker Hawks after you.

finishText.en:
Oh! It’s his fault! This will all happen because of that damned orc!

He won’t get away with it! The Empire is strong, and we won’t just stand by. We won’t let him destroy it! From now on, your friend had better look over his shoulder!

We should’ve never given free rein to the shamans! But they are going to dance to another tune now. I’ll make sure they forget the word “independence”.

As for you, choose your companions more carefully next time. He can easily drag you down with him.

goal.en: Speak with Elizaveta Rysina

startText.en:
So. The Council has contacted me. You need to get to the Isle of Revelation, find a place called Granite Madness, and meet with Elizaveta Rysina there.

Of course, you can ignore that, but I suggest you don’t. After all, you want to know the truth, don’t you?

finishText.en:
Hey, stranger!

I am Saad Tankha, the Priden Shaman sent to this allod by the doolgas who communicate with spirits and sages of our people.

Many strange things have occurred around here. The Doolgas saw a great exodus... many spirits left this world. Perhaps you witnessed it yourself. We are worried the same might happen to the Golases that have been guiding us for centuries. The troubles of the rest of the world usually do not concern my people, but what’s coming will affect all of us.

goal.en: Meet with Saad Tankha on Coba Plateau

startText.en:
The Priden is sitting on Coba Plateau in the Demon Hunters’ Camp.

To tell the truth, I’ve never had any dealings with their tribe, but I know they have their shamans and spirits, just like orcs. They are just called differently. And if this Saad Tankha is a shaman, let him tell you what he sees.
