checkText.en: Demons are powerful enemies. We need to use all the tools we can get!

finishText.en: Wonderful! I'll start passing these out immediately!

goal.en: Collect 10 Major potions of Brutality or 10 Common Balms of Purity for Nestor Golovanov to improve your reputation with the Demon Hunters.

startText.en: Listen, we could really use your help. The last run in that we had with the demons nearly wiped us out! If we don't start getting supplies in soon, we won't have a chance! Both the Empire and the League think that we're a group of traitors. While they gave us some supplies after the Great Astral Campaign, shortly afterwards all their help came to a screeching halt! We could really use some potions of Brutality and balms of Purity. You know, just a little something to keep the troops safe. Do you think you could help with that?

checkText.en: Demons are powerful enemies. We need to use all the tools we can get!

finishText.en: Wonderful! I'll start passing these out immediately!

goal.en: Bring 60 Common Balms of Purity to Nestor Golovanov at the Dragon Ring to improve your reputation with the Demon Hunters.

startText.en:
Listen, we could really use your help. The last run in that we had with the demons nearly wiped us out! If we don't start getting supplies in soon, we won't have a chance!
Both the Empire and the League think that we're a group of traitors. While they gave us some supplies after the Great Astral Campaign, shortly afterwards all their help came to a screeching halt! We could really use some potions. You know, just a little something to keep the troops safe. Do you think you could help with that?

checkText.en: How much more do we have to take?! Draconidsss, demonsss... how are we supposed to survive?

finishText.en: Thank you ssso much! Maybe my people will be able to sssurvive after all.

goal.en: Participate in killing Merdash the Malevolent and report back to Vergon.

startText.en:
I have one more request... The draconidsss are terrible foes, but we have a bigger threat. Our worst enemiesss are those Astral demons! There's jussst so many of them!
They're dessstroying our home... They must be ssstopped! Usually, we have no problem killing the demons, but there'sss one in particular that even five of us can't take on!
We named him Merdash the Malevolent, and even the draconidsss are having problems with him! But you... you have potential! If you gather a few alliesss as strong as you, you ssshould have no problem!

checkText.en: I wonder whether or not you're really brave... It's very interesting!

finishText.en: Really? This makes you a more valuable ally!

goal.en: Participate in killing Cullak the Distorter and report back to Soliskar the Wise.

startText.en:
The voice that comes from the seneschal's mouth is more powerful than before:
Do you know what drives this world? Hate! The League hates the Empire, the Empire hates the League, the draconids hate the lizardmen, the lizardmen hate the draconids, I hate the Great Mages, the Great Mages... Ha! The Great Mages are afraid of me!
So I was wrong... Not only does hate drive this world, but fear also! They go hand in hand - fear and hatred!
Don't believe me? Think about the demons! All of them hate! And all of them are afraid! And you, you're afraid, yes... Perhaps you've managed to kill several, but when fate confronts you with a formidable enemy, you're afraid.
Cullak the Distorter, a fierce Astral demon, has appeared on the allod. He wanders around the west bank, hunting my servants. But... if you're ready to face your fear, you can try to defeat him. Make sure you don't face him alone. That would be foolish...

checkText.en: What are you waiting for? I told you where to find them!

finishText.en:
Alright.
The stones are dealt with.

goal.en: Find the 4 Stones of Dragon Ring and report back to anthropologist Gruff the Wily.

startText.en:
You should know the drill by now. We've hidden stones as a test... Blah, blah blah. Don't worry. They're easy to find. I couldn't be bothered to find someplace secluded to place 'em, you know.
You can find 'em on Dusky Isle, Pangol Isle, the Cursed Lands, and Drakefang Isle. Find 'em all and come back to me! Then you'll be one step closer to finishing all of my thrilling missions...!

checkText.en: What are you waiting for? Go kill those beasts!

finishText.en: Ah-ha. Done.

goal.en: Collect 5 Dragon Ring Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Gruff the Wily.

startText.en:
Now you need to collect trophies. I think it has something to do with proving your bravery.
Just get out there and kill these monsters and then bring me back five trophies. An agitated tropical muskier, Jarrkath the Fiery, Hydrilla, a vicious plated alligator, and a savage demon mage. Come back when you have them all. You can easily recognize these creatures by their names or by crown symbols above their heads.

checkText.en: Well?

finishText.en: Great job! See, you're getting the hang of this hole demon hunter thing!

goal.en: Kill 100 Demons and report back to anthropologist Gruff the Wily.

startText.en:
Who do you think is our main opposition on this allod?
Draconids? Lizardmen? Tapirs? HAH! What are you, stupid?
The demon hunters fight demons, of course! Now get out there and kill, kill, kill!

checkText.en: You'll need lots of luck to find those ashes!

finishText.en: Hah! I knew you could do it!

goal.en: Collect 7 pieces of Astral Ashes for anthropologist Gruff the Wily.

startText.en:
Now I'm supposed to make you go get something that's valuable... But Tensess only knows what sort of valuable resources they have here! We have only just arrived!
But us hunters could always use some Astral ashes! It stinks something fierce, but if you rub yourself with it, not even the demon's excellent sense of smell will pick up on you!
You can find the ashes on the bodies of dead demons. But you can't just pick through a fresh kill, the body has to be on the ground for some time. It's hard, so good luck!

checkText.en: Did you manage to complete my quests?

finishText.en: Yeah! Here's your reward. You deserve it!

goal.en: Complete all of the Anthropologist's tasks and report back to Gruff the Wily.

startText.en:
So, let's talk about the reward... I know you're not doing this for free! I mean, I wouldn't!
So if you complete all of my tasks, I'll give you something worthwhile! Get out there and find those stones, collect that ash, and kill those demons!

finishText.en: It is! Won't everyone be excited to see what you've found.

goal.en: Move the boulder to uncover the treasure.

startText.en:
What's this? This boulder looks to be hiding something...
Could this be the treasure that everyone has been talking about?!

checkText.en: Any luck? No? Well, it's a good think that I just sent you instead of one of my men.

finishText.en: So it does exist. How about that... Those dragons sure are mysterious creatures.

goal.en: Find the cultist's treasure and report to Horn the Roughneck.

startText.en:
Some of the boys have been talking about a treasure hidden on this allod. I doubt it. There are only cultists, drakes, and rocks there.
By the way, I've seen something funny. The cultists were walking along the shore, and then there was a landslide - a rock crushed one to death. An accident, so to speak...
If you find yourself on the northeastern shore of Drakefang Isle, try looking through the rocks. Maybe that cultist had something valuable on him! And maybe you'll find things like this on the other Shards!

finishText.en: What?! Why would you need me to tell you? You can see the June ruins from where I'm standing! Now go use it.

goal.en: Speak with Horn the Roughneck about getting to Drakefang Isle.

name.en: The Path to the Lower Isle

startText.en:
You're probably wondering how to get to the next allod... Fortunately, getting to Darkscale Isle is simple enough. You just run down the hill!
Drakefang Isle, on the other hand, is a different story! There's a large chasm separating it from the next allod. Fortunately, there are some handy June ruins located somewhere on Darkscale Isle. Go speak with Horn the Roughneck and he'll show you where they are.

checkText.en: How can I help you?

finishText.en: Ah! I was wondering when you'd show up here.

goal.en: Use the June ruins to travel to Pangol Isle and speak with Sarbaz Sitdjehuti.

startText.en:
I think it's time that you visit the other allods. Our scouts report that they're even more dangerous than this one, but I'm sure you'll be able to handle things. Not far from here there are some ancient June ruins that can take you to Pangol Isle. I would advise you to seek them out.
When you get to Pangol Isle, go and see Sarbaz Sitdjehuti at our camp there. She has some important tasks to complete and it'd be great if you could help out. We need to fortify our position here as soon as possible.

checkText.en: And? How'd you fair?

finishText.en:
Ah ha!
I knew you were one of us, kid!

goal.en: Kill 6 demons on Blackfire Isle and report back to Horn the Roughneck.

startText.en:
During a reconnaissance of Dragon Ring I came across a small isle that was full of demons! Ha! It was a real paradise for the true hunter!
If you're up for a little mayhem, go test your strength on the island! We'll see how well you really fit in around here!

finishText.en: Finally! I was beginning to get tired waiting for you. There's lots I need to tell you.

goal.en: Meet Yaver Yevgini at the Nezebgrad port.

startText.en:
You're already familiar with the astral and the fact that we, Demon Hunters, exterminate the product of the astral. That's a noble, important and difficult pursuit. The church may consider us damned monsters for all we care - without us, this world is doomed. Without us... And the likes of you! The heroes who can see further than the ends of their noses and grasp that the astral is more than just a threat. The astral hides the answers to many questions that keep bothering the mortals. Who knows, maybe those answers are for you to find.
It's time you learned more about that enigmatic, insidious and dangerous entity - the astral. Go to Yaver Yevgini at the astral port. He will tell you about the astral and astral ships and probably help you build your own astral frigate.

finishText.en: Finally! I've been waiting for ages. Let's waste no time - I've got a lot to tell you.

goal.en: Meet Maurice de Ardeur at the Novograd port.

startText.en:
You already know about the Astral and that the Demon Hunters exterminate the creatures of this Astral. It's a noble cause, important and difficult. The church is free to consider us cursed monsters - this world is doomed without us. Without us... and people like you! Heroes who can see beyond the end of their noses and understand that the astral plane is not just another threat. The astral plane contains answers to many questions that haunt mortals. Who knows, maybe you'll be the one to find some answers.

It's time for you to learn more about this mysterious entity - the Astral. Go see Maurice de Ardeur at the Astral Academy - he will tell you about the Astral and astral ships. He might even help you build your own frigate.

finishText.en:
That's some news!
We're sitting here waiting for the Empire to send us our reward for Gorluxor and we get accused of a sham instead! I can see what's going on here! Imperial propaganda seeks to present hunters as monsters and beasts!

goal.en: Find Nestor Golovanov in Dragon Ring and ask about Gorluxor.

startText.en:
You know I don't like riddles! Everything in life should be clear - there's your enemy, there's the axe, you swing, and... there's your enemy's head!
Not long ago the Demon Hunters sent me Gorluxor's head. Someone named Nestor Golovanov said that they intercepted Gorluxor's ship in the Astral. Apparently they defeated the Xadaganian and thought we'd like to know.
This all supposedly happened near a newly discovered archipelago called Dragon Ring. We all know that Gorluxor was killed in the Tensess Temple! But now a second head is collecting dust in my trunk and the hunters await their promised reward. What can I do?
It's clearly a sham! The hunters just want money for free. It's absurd!
Go to this Dragon Ring, look for that liar Golovanov, and call his bluff! Nobody has two heads!

finishText.en:
Oh, what a story!
We're expecting a well-deserved reward for Gorluxor's head from the League and what do we get? An accusation of fraud! And the reason for this is prejudice and false rumors spread by the priests of the Church of Light!

goal.en: Find Nestor Golovanov in Dragon Ring and ask about Gorluxor.

name.en: Two Heads Aren't Better Than One

startText.en:
Demon Hunters intercepted a ship of cultists that, according to them, traveled with the Xadaganian Great Mage, Gorluxor. Yes, yes, the one who recently lost his head in the Tensess Temple. I held that head in my hands myself!
But he evidently grew a second one! The hunters have already sent it to me and are awaiting a reward.
In other words, I have two heads of Gorluxor and I don't know which one is real!
We need to get the story straight! Perhaps, we are dealing with forgery and the hunters are just looking for a large reward. I would rather believe in that, then believe he grew a second head!
You'll have to go visit Dragon Ring. The hunters claim to have discovered the second Gorluxor. Go talk to Nestor Golovanov and see if we can't straighten all this out.

finishText.en:
Wait, what?! They're accusing me of forgery? Do you know how many years I've been around fighting demons? If I was an army Orc, I'd have a whole bag's worth of medals!
Why would I do anything of the sort?! My honor as an Orc is far more important!

goal.en: Meet Horn the Roughneck.

startText.en:
No, it wasn't me that killed Gorluxor. Our squad headed by Horn the Roughneck was patrolling the Astral when his ships ran into a bunch of cultists escorted by a whole pack of demons. A real bloodbath ensued. We lost many brave Hunters that day, but Gorluxor was slain and his henchmen turned heel and ran.
We then followed them to this archipelago, which seemed to be their base. Horn the Roughneck is the real hero - he's the one you want if you need information on Gorluxor. I sent him and his squad to explore this ring and look for more cultists. You can find his camp just outside of the Cursed Lands.

checkText.en: Where are my scouts? I'm beginning to think they're off on a date! I always knew there was something going on between those two! Did you find them?

finishText.en:
I admit that I was unfair to my employees. I should have trusted them a bit more. The information you have provided is rather curious... Let's go over it.
We know that this place is inhabited by bizarre creatures that seem to be a mix of dragon and iguana. We know that someone's been killing demons and that for some strange reason the dragons have been attacking the octulhu. Something tells me that everything is somehow connected! What a curious archipelago we've found.

goal.en: Find Miroslava Harkova and Zacharie de Grandeur and return to Nestor Golovanov.

startText.en:
This archipelago isn't on any of our maps! There are a lot of strange creatures here, some of which we've never seen before. I've sent two scouts ahead to check out the terrain to the south before we send more of our forces in.
Unfortunately, they seem to be taking their sweet time! It must be the tropical climate - all that humidity makes people lazy... Please help me find my scouts. They should still be on this allod. Their names are Zacharie de Grandeur and Miroslava Harkova!

checkText.en: The sooner we patch up the ship the better. Unfortunately, it's not easy finding the right wood... It needs to be both light and durable. Now where are our wood samples?

finishText.en:
Let's see what you collected. These samples look very promising! Thanks so much for getting them. It should only be a matter of days now until the ship's repaired.
You know, we were dying to join in the last battle, but Horn the Roughneck wouldn't have it. He rushed us down into the hold, saying he better not see our faces on the deck. "Who's gonna repair the ship if you die?!" he said. See, masters like us are a precious commodity!

goal.en: Collect 5 Wood Samples for the Knotty Family.

startText.en:
What a terrible battle! The demons defended the cultists' ship to the death! We took some heavy losses, but we gave them a real good thrashing as well.
Those demon claws are strong enough to strip the planking off our ships... and that's exactly what they did! The Arrow got the worst of it. She was built by the best Gibberling shipbuilders in Kania - a solid ship, if a bit on the old side.
Right now the poor girl needs a complete overhaul, but first we need to know whether the local wood can do the job. Here, take this axe and go collect five samples from the nearby trees. We'll take it from there.

checkText.en: I'd keep schooling them if it were up to me. These youngsters need to brush up on their skills, but Nestor Golovanov demanded accelerated initiation. Where's the eye spit?

finishText.en:
Many thanks! Using eye spit for initiations is one of our oldest traditions. Now let's hope that our recruits can compensate for their lack of experience with drive and enthusiasm.
Hm, now who's going to lug our lumber around and polish my boots... They were eager enough to do all that while they were students, but soon as they become real Demon Hunters, forget it!

goal.en: Collect 6 portions of Eye Spit for Yasskul Merenhor.

startText.en:
Our last battle saw the death of many of our valiant hunters. I was their mentor and instructor...
But at least they all died with honor. The thing is, demons and cultists always decapitate their fallen enemies, so they can't be resurrected.
Because of this, our numbers have not been replenished. Fortunately, it's not all bad.
We have some young Demon Hunters in training with us on this allod. They can't wait to become full-fledged members of our brotherhood. We need eye spit from the local eye monsters for the initiation ceremony. Those are rare creatures, but there's plenty of them here. Please bring me six portions of eye spit.

checkText.en: These creatures are quite shrewd, but I'm certain that they will swallow our bait. How's my potion? Don't worry, small doses are completely harmless!

finishText.en:
I didn't think that the beast would actually attack you! I'm sorry for putting you at such risk - I was certain that the creature would consider you already dead and wouldn't attack the corpse.
It's now clear that they're very aggressive and should generally be avoided... But it's still unclear as to where they came from! Our textbooks and manuals make no mention of creatures that resemble lizardmen and dragons at the same time!

goal.en: Drink the Potion of Deathly Pall near the ruins and wait for the creature to appear.

startText.en:
Hey there! Listen, I can't go back to camp until I've figure out what's going on here! There are these strange creatures that resemble lizardmen but... not exactly. Maybe they're in the same family, I don't know. What's interesting is that a few of them are watching us closely! They appear to be scouts - and good ones at that!
Take this potion, drink a few drops, and lie down - the potion will slow down your breathing and make your heartbeat barely audible. He'll think you're a genuine corpse! When the beast comes closer to check you out, get as good a look as you can!

checkText.en: Ordinary demons tail the octulhu in hopes of gorging on the remains of his prey. But where are they now?

finishText.en: Dead demons by the Astral fang? I wonder what killed them. Not my colleagues, that's for sure! The mysteries just keep piling up!

goal.en: Look for demons in the surrounding areas and report back to Zacharie de Grandeur.

startText.en:
I know that I needed to return to the drop point a long time ago, but how could I leave this place?! Just look at this handsome fellow! That's an octulhu in the flesh, the very same kind featured in the famous Micromicon. These specimens are extremely rare in the Astral.
The only thing I can't understand is why the dragons keep attacking it. Such behavior has never been documented! And there's another strange detail – the octulhu is always surrounded by a bunch of smaller demons... But I don't see any now. Listen, would you check out the northern shore of the allod for me? Maybe they're hiding somewhere around there?

checkText.en: Where are those tapir hides? We need to patch up the armor before we get caught by a surprise attack.

finishText.en: Thanks a lot! I'll get to work right away! You know, I actually come from a long line of leatherworkers. My family was against me joining up with the Demon Hunters. One night, when one of their ships was anchored at our allod, I snuck out and hid in their hold. I've been traveling with them ever since!

goal.en: Collect 6 Tapir Hides for Koga the Crafty in the Hunters' Camp.

startText.en:
This victory really cost us.
Many are dead, and many more are wounded. I'm working on fixing our armor - mending dents and holes. We hunters may have tougher skin than most, but it can get pretty scary in a fight without any armor at all!
Listen, there are some tapirs roaming around nearby. They have tough hides. If you bring me six hides, I'll be able to patch up the equipment much faster.

checkText.en: Caw!

finishText.en: The raven ruffles his feathers and takes off for the Hunters' Camp.

goal.en: Find the Rigid Family and Vadim Shishkin on Pangol Isle and use the whistle to send a raven back with a report.

startText.en:
We need updates on what's happening on the archipelago, but I don't have any hunters to spare. Most of them are still recuperating from that battle with demons.
We could really use your help in the matter, so how about it? We'll keep in touch via a homing raven. I'll give you this whistle to use when you complete the mission. The raven will come and deliver your message to me. I've deployed two scouts to Pangol Isle and I want to know what they're up to! I sure hope they didn't run into more of those creatures!

checkText.en: These new demons are even more fierce and dangerous than their old counterparts. As if we don't have enough problems already! So, did you manage to kill any?

finishText.en: Only a true hero could slay so many demons in such a short time! Perhaps you could hang around a bit longer?! We've got plenty of work here besides demons... like the crocodiles in the jungle. If only the crocodiles would snack on the demons every once in a while!

goal.en: Kill 6 Shadowy Demon Mages for the Rigid Family on Pangol Isle.

startText.en:
Ooh, reinforcements! Golovanov sent you?
Great! We've got plenty of demons here on the allod! These beasts in particular are a mean bunch! Have you heard of those? They must have undergone some sort of mutations... These creatures can safely stay outside the Astral! It's a serious threat!
The Demon Hunters are already hard at work clearing them out. But this place... Especially the area near the Astral Fangs... Help us out by killing a few demons around here, okay?
Join the fun! Kill six Shadowy Demon Mages, then come back here. Why? For your reward, of course!

checkText.en: Canabar is a magnificent anesthetic. The only downside is that it's also addictive... Some of my patients get so used to it during treatment that they can't stop using it even after they're well.

finishText.en: Thanks, now let me lock up the canabar just in case! I can't have the healthy stealing it! So, is this supposed to be the crocodile fat? Whoa, those crocodiles sure are fat! Thanks for your help.

goal.en: Collect 3 portions of Crocodile Fat and 3 Canabar Leaves for Sarbaz Sitdjehuti.

startText.en:
Shadowy Demon Mages are extremely dangerous!
Their claws rip through flesh. And they are covered in poison... We don't know anything about it.
But look at these poor souls - they are in agony! One of them was barely grazed by a demon's claw! But he started hemorrhaging only minutes later. That's how their poison works!
I need anesthetics and medical ointments to treat the wounds... There's no other way! But our supplies are running out...
 How about you collect three portions of crocodile fat and 3 canabar leaves for me? There should be plenty of those in the jungle. Just hurry! These people need your help.

checkText.en: The others keep pitying me, offering to hunt as a team like I'm sort of newbie! A Demon Hunter needs no pity. I want them to treat me as their equal! So, is Kagot the Mad dead?

finishText.en: Thank you! I kept having the worst nightmares about him! May he burn in the brightest fires of hell!

goal.en: Kill Kagot the Mad and return to Inna Larova.

startText.en:
I was tracking down a demon in the jungle, but this isn't just any demon. His name is Kagot the Mad and, believe it or not, he's a hunter himself! But he hunts us - Kanians, Orcs, Gibberlings, everything that moves!
I set a trap for him in the jungle near this one spot he always hangs around, but the bastard snuck up on me from behind! I got so scared that I ended up triggering my own trap! Next thing I know I'm dangling off a rope, upside down!
Thankfully, I had some repellent and that kept the beast at bay until my buddies came to my rescue. The demon took off into the jungle, but not before leaving me some bite marks as a keepsake. Not to mention the broken foot I received from twisting and squirming in that noose. Please, do me a big favor and slay that pesky demon!

checkText.en: I hope Marius will succeed! Those draconids can become our friends!

finishText.en:
Interesting! Look, these weapons are coated with some sort of salve. It looks like I was right - this is most likely some sort of virulent poison. We should be very careful when handling them.
I'll take the weapons back to camp and let Theodore - that's our alchemist - take a look at them. Perhaps we can use the salve on our own weapons.

goal.en: Gather 6 Draconid Weapons for Vadim Shishkin on Pangol Isle.

checkText.en: Ah, there you are! What happened?

finishText.en: That blasted Xuan made it very clear that his tribe will not ally themselves with the Demon Hunters. Not only that, but they want us all to leave immediately. I'm not so sure that Nestor and his allies will go for that. You need to take him my letter - it outlines our position in full!

goal.en: Speak with Xuan the Wary and report back to Montaine de Vevre.

startText.en:
That poor scout never made it to the draconids' camp. He received a fatal wound! But who's to blame? The demons or the draconids?
These creatures are conducting some sort of ritual. They're either worshipping the Astral fangs or they're out to destroy them. And that beast out there with them is their leader, evidently. I'll send a message about the scouts... You go see if you can talk with the leader.

checkText.en: I hate those draconidsss...

finishText.en: Thanksss. I was getting pretty sssick of this cage. I tried to gnaw through the bars, but they're pretty ssstrong. How did I end up here, you ask? I didn't break any laws - I have alwaysss honored the twelve precepts of our ancestors. It was those nasty draconidsss that started mistreating us!

goal.en: Find an Iron Key from a draconid, use it to unlock the Iron Cage, and speak to Kromus.

startText.en:
Everything wasss going great before those draconidsss showed up. They sssaid that they were chosssen by the Great Dragon to sssave the world and that all lizardmen mussst obey them. Some lizardmen believed them, but they ssshouldn't have!
Releassse me and I will tell you what happened! You can find a key on any of the draconidsss down there. Take it off their corpssses!

checkText.en: Caw!

finishText.en: A new letter for Nestor Golovanov - "The lizardmen's lakeside village is occupied by draconids. Some of the lizardmen fled westward into the allod. Those who remained now obey their new masters. The draconids claim to have become the dragons' new chosen people. Verifying such a claim does not seem plausible at the moment..." Take this letter, raven, and be safe!

goal.en: Establish contact with the lizardmen, summon a Courier Raven, and send a report to Nestor Golovanov.

startText.en:
I'm glad you're back. Nestor Golovanov has more orders for us. Horn the Roughneck's ship was on patrol and discovered a whole tribe of draconid-obeying lizardmen! He tried to strike up a dialogue with the draconids, but that only led to a skirmish.
Like that wasn't to be expected! However, even if we can't to come to an agreement with the draconids, we should still try for an agreement with the lizardmen. It looks as if they're not exactly thrilled with their masters. Go try to establish contact with them and send another raven with the results.

finishText.en: Things were ssso very different before! The lizardmen were the dragons' chosen people, their favoritesss! The lizardmen helped the dragons and the dragons protected them in return. Who would've thought that everything would change ssso radically, that I would be forced to flee from my own home and ssseek refuge here like some criminal or vagrant!

goal.en: Speak with Vergon on Darkscale Isle.

startText.en:
We discovered that our eggsss were disappearing from the nests. So, one night, I stood guard over a nest and caught the thievesss red- handed! They were draconids!
A battle ensssued, but the draconids were too many. They said that they will continue to take our eggsss, but from now on they'll be doing it openly. That's when I and other disssidents left the village.
There aren't many of us left, too few to drive off the draconids, but I recall seeing the Demon Hunter's ssship waging battle against them... I told myself right then and there that the Demon Hunters would be our allies.
I was going to Dusssky Isle, but was intercepted by the enemy and locked in this cage. They wanted to know the whereabouts of our refuge!
I didn't tell them anything, but I'll tell you ssso that you can relay my words to Vergon, our elder. Tell him that the Demon Hunters can be our friends! You'll find at our refuge in the western region of the allod.

checkText.en: Pleasse help us crusssh our enemy!

finishText.en: I never thought I'd live to sssee the day! Every one of those bastards dessserves to die for all the sssuffering they've caused my people. I only wish this wasss the end of it! What I'd really like to know isss where they came from!

goal.en: Kill 6 Draconid Defenders or Mages and Graakh'shi the Grim, their leader. Report back to Vergon.

startText.en:
You know, I wasss a chieftain. I had ressspect... Every month my people brought me giftsss. They alwaysss obeyed my will.
Now the village hasss been taken over by the Draconidsss. They rule by fear and lock up disssidents in cagesss.
Noble lizardmen have been taken hossstage by these monsssters. I'm too old to do anything about it. And the dragonsss... I've never ssseen them before...
How about thisss... Go to our village near the lake and kill sssix Draconidsss. And their leader, Graakh'shi the Grim. If you do that...
We'll be your alliesss...

checkText.en: I want to go back home to our village. My ssscales are beginning to ache. Do you have our eggsss?

finishText.en:
There they are, my babiesss! Oh how I missed them! We really need to talk to them more. Our priest saysss that the baby lizardmen inside those eggsss hear and understand everything! It's bessst to begin the education process as early as posssible, you know!
I may be old, but I've got a ssscientific mind. I ssshudder to think what those draconidsss would've taught our babies. Thank you for ressscuing them.

goal.en: Gather 6 Lizardman Eggs for Kimela.

startText.en:
Sss...
My children... My darling children!
Sss... We mussst protect the offssspring! The ressst doesn't matter.
You! Will you ssave my children? Go to our village and bring me sssix eggsss. Before the Draconidsss take them!
Lisssen! Do asss I sssay! Or I'll curssse you!

checkText.en: We've tried domesticating the hydrasss, but to no avail. Too bad there's really no local wildlife assside from them...

finishText.en: Skinsss, fangsss, meat... Exactly what I ordered! I knew you were a fine hunter the moment I laid my eyesss on you! I'm a great hunter myssself, you know. I've even taken to training the youngsssters, but when the draconids came, I had to put it all on hold.

goal.en: Gather 2 pieces of Hydra Meat, 2 Hydra Hides, and 2 Hydra Fangs for Hyridion.

startText.en:
Asss you can see, our allod isssn't exactly rich with game. Fortunately, the local hydras meet mossst of our needs. Their meat is tasty, their ssskins are tough, and their teeth are sssharp - perfect for any weapon!
I'm in charge of sssupplying our entire community, but yesssterday a hydra injured my foot, ssso I'm not quite my regular mobile ssself. Could you help me out? I need 2 fangs, 2 hides, and 2 piecesss of meat.

checkText.en: A baby draconid has just emerged from the egg...

finishText.en: This explains it! The draconids are bewitching the stolen eggs with their spells. As a result, draconids emerge from the eggs instead of lizardmen!

goal.en: Learn what happened to the lizardman eggs that have been stolen by the draconids.

startText.en:
It ssseems that draconids only want one thing from usss lizardmen and that's our eggsss. We don't know why, and they don't ssseem likely to tell us - they're not exactly the sssharing kind.
Please go to the Cursed Lands - that'sss where they're taking our eggsss. Try to find out what they're doing with them! No matter how terrible the truth may be, we mussst know!

finishText.en:
So Golovanov thinks you can help us? Sure, go right ahead. These isles are such a mess that you'll need a great, big bottle of Nezebovka just to make sense out of anything!
Lizardmen, draconids... Who do you fight, who do you ally with? I'm no politician, but I trust these aborigines as far as I can throw 'em!

goal.en: Meet with Horn the Roughneck on Darkscale Isle.

startText.en:
Here's a new order from Nestor:
"Horn the Roughneck has landed on Darkscale Isle. You'll be able to find him along the south eastern coast. Go to him, I'm sure the two of you will have lots to talk about!"
Thanks for the letter, raven.

finishText.en: Hush, you'll give away my position... I'm a Demon Hunter working under Horn the Roughneck. He sent me to investigate this part of the allod when we landed. You seem totally out of place... Who are you and what are you doing here?

goal.en: Meet with Marta Kopeva in the Cursed Lands.

startText.en:
The draconids are definitely using their magic to turn the unborn lizardmen into baby draconids... The lizardmen won't be able to handle this sort of threat alone. The longer these violations go unhindered, the fewer lizardmen and the more draconids there will be.
You remember Kromus mentioning the Demon Hunters. He wanted to ask them for help. Perhaps you should find the nearest Demon Hunter and inquire about an alliance.

checkText.en: I wonder if the draconids able to reproduce on their own, or if they absolutely need the lizardmen's eggs?

finishText.en: Great, now I'll have no problem getting to Vergon. You helped me, so now I'll help you! Vergon will receive your message, Demon Hunter's honor!

goal.en: Kill 6 Draconid Lookouts for Marta Kopeva.

startText.en:
This is perfect! Horn the Roughneck had some of us watching the lizardmen. He wanted to find some way to enter an alliance with them. You say that you've managed to make friends with them?
Excellent! That means that half the battle is already done! I will go to this Vergon and tell him everything that you've learned about the eggs and the draconids' magic.
Unfortunately, I'm afraid that I won't be able to make it past these draconid guards alone. Go and clear a path for me, okay? Then I can begin negotiating with these lizardmen.

checkText.en: Are all the demons dead? We need to show those draconids that we'd make great allies!

finishText.en: It seems as if your feats haven't impress the draconids... not one bit. They're probably thinking that they can make do without any allies and that we're nothing but a pesky obstacle in their way. That's a real shame!

goal.en: Kill 6 Hungering Predators on Darkscale Isle without engaging Draconids in combat. Report back to Horn the Roughneck.

startText.en:
Alright, let's do it.
Golovanov really wants to make friends with the Draconids. Those hideous things! I'd never trust them. But orders are orders. Now listen.
Demons are fighting the Draconids near the Astral Fangs. The enemy of our enemy is our friend, right? If you go over there and kill at least six demons, the Draconids might change their mind and ally with us! Eh? What do you think?
But whatever you do, don't hurt the Draconids! We need to show them we are friends. Got it?

checkText.en:
Did you capture and crack any cultists yet?
Scoundrels like that must have at least one coward in their midst!

finishText.en: So the allod is held up by the Great Dragon and the draconids are his servants. That explains why they didn't want to talk to us. They wouldn't dare move a muscle without their master's say-so.

goal.en: Find a traitor amongst the cultists that's willing to leak information and report back to Horn the Roughneck.

startText.en:
I chopped that Gorluxor scum's head off myself and then cut him up into tiny pieces. I held his head in my very hands!
I don't know who it was that you killed, but my Gorluxor was real! Do you think maybe he had a twin brother? Or maybe a clone?! Those cultists probably know something...
Those boys aren't exactly social, but I'm willing to bet that you'll find a few cowards among them. It's up to you to find one and shake the truth out of him! Those cultists are always hanging around the Cursed Lands, that's just south of here. Go and press a few of 'em, see if one cracks!

checkText.en: I've only got basic lab equipment with me which, unfortunately, is not enough for a complete analysis of this poison. Where's the slime I asked for?

finishText.en:
Thanks, now let me get to work...
It looks as if it contains some sort of poison! The poison itself is relatively mild, too mild to take down a demon, but when mixed with other ingredients it becomes absolutely lethal. I will keep these samples for later, they may come in handy...

goal.en: Collect 6 portions of Muskir Slime for Semer Hor.

startText.en:
This might be a great place for an alchemist!
Vadim Shishkin brought me the Draconid weapons that you salvaged from the battlefield. I analyzed the mixture that they're coated with but couldn't identify most of the components. Me! The one who knows more about potions, decoctions, and elixirs than anyone else!
But I've learned something after all. One of the ingredients is definitely muskir slime. You can find them in the jungle. Bring me six portions of their slime, I wish to study it thoroughly.

checkText.en: I grant remission of sin of assassination for the one who will bring me the staff. In the name of Light!

finishText.en: I'll study this staff at once! Both the League and the Empire have expended tons of time, resources, and efforts into finding a way to destroy the Astral fangs, but nothing has worked so far... Perhaps we'll finally be able to solve this secret and deal with the fang problem once and for all!

goal.en: Bring a Draconid Staff to Viktor Tairov.

startText.en:
Those draconids are crafty little devils. Our scouts report that they've found a way to destroy Astral fangs!
Supposedly, the fangs wither and die after a ritual performed by a draconid augur. But the most surprising part of this story is that it seems to be the augur's staff that's doing all the work!
There's a cluster of Astral fangs just to the south of here, go and see if you can't wrestle a staff from one of the augurs.

checkText.en: I can't stop thinking about Gorluxor and his two heads! Our reputation could take a real hit if we don't find out what really happened!

finishText.en: So, Gorluxor thought that he tricked everyone, huh?! I'm sure he counted on us believing him to be dead and leaving his cultists alone while he continued merrily destroying allods, one by one. But now that we've finally put an end to his shenanigans, let's hope he stays dead this time! Thank you for this - you've done truly heroic work. I shall see to it that from here on out your name shall be recorded on the Board of Honor over at Kirah, alongside the greatest Demon Hunters to ever prowl the Astral!

goal.en: Obtain the head of Great Mage Gorluxor and take it to Nestor Golovanov on Dusky Isle.

name.en: Don't Come Back Without Any Heads!

startText.en:
Gorluxor is alive? That's utter hogwash! I was face to face with that ugly mug – there's no way I could have been wrong!
How do I know? Because I saw a giant poster on Kirah that said - "Wanted - Great Mage Gorluxor." I'll remember that poster until the day I die! So there couldn't have been any mistake! That is, unless he grew himself a replacement head and rose back from the dead that way!
There's only one way to get to the bottom of this. Go and get the head of this new Gorluxor guy! And when you do, bring it to Golovanov - let him deal with it!

checkText.en: Another Gorluxor head? That's the third one! We've just about got a complete set! Would you like me to organize an exhibit?

finishText.en:
Let's hope that's the last we hear of Gorluxor...
If some other hero shows up with another head of his, I'm going to lose it!
Though, this one actually looks legit. That must mean that the cultists are in disarray, totally lost without their leader. We'll join up with the hunters and catch all those bastards! Then we'll either kill them or send 'em off to work the meteorite ore mines! Perhaps a bit of honest work for the glory of the Empire will tighten up the screws in those loony heads of theirs!

goal.en: Take Gorluxor's head to Crazystorm the Merciless in Nezebgrad.

startText.en:
Gorluxor's flair for the dramatic has turned out to be the end of him. More than anything, he wanted to kill the dragon alone - a deadly miscalculation! You could say that the devious old fox got exactly what was coming to him!
Take his head to Crazystorm the Merciless and report on all that has happened here. Now no one will dare accuse the hunters of fraud - our reputation is saved!

checkText.en:
Another head! My own head is about to spin off my neck over this damned Gorluxor!
But you say this one is genuine?

finishText.en:
Gorluxor tried to trick us, but it didn't work. Now that he's really dead, the cultists have lost their leadership. I reckon they won't be nearly as dangerous from here on.
Together with the hunters, we'll catch them all soon enough.

goal.en: Take Gorluxor's Head to the Defender Captain, Izbor Yavorsky, in Novograd.

startText.en:
Gorluxor's head. His real one this time! Can you believe that this rogue thought he could trick us?! Now look where his tricks got him!
Take his foolish dome to Izbor Yavorsky and tell him about all that has happened. Surely, this will dismiss any charges and no one will dare accuse the hunters of premeditated fraud!

finishText.en: Who dares to disturb the rest of the Great Dragon? What do you want from her?! Mortals do not deserve to even look at the Great Dragon, let alone speak with them! I will be her Voice for you.

goal.en: Speak with Soliskar the Wise on Drakefang Isle.

startText.en:
If that cultist coward is speaking the truth, then Gorluxor is on his way here to kill the Great Dragon! We need to intercept and speak with him! He has the power to will the draconids to aid us against Gorluxor.
Go to him and try to make a good impression! We can't mess this up!

checkText.en: Horn the Roughneck has sent word of the demons' and cultists' attack on Drakefang Isle! Let's hope our friends managed to repel the enemy!

finishText.en:
Looks like Horn the Roughneck was correct - the enemy's real target was the dragon! And if it weren't for your swift counterattack, they would've fought their way through to him to try and wear him out for Gorluxor's arrival!
Perhaps that was his plan all along. Either way, our enemies have been defeated. I thank you for your timely assistance - a whole squad of warriors couldn't do a finer job!

goal.en: Kill 6 Abyssal Demon Mages or Darksoul Cultists and return to Nestor Golovanov in the Hunters' Camp.

startText.en:
Look at Drakefang Isle! Yuck! Fangs all over the place! It won't last long. They'll take it apart. Unless we do something about it.
It's not just the Hunters' duty to take out demons and cultists. It concerns everyone who wants to survive in our world. And I think the Draconids share my view. And dragons. And the Great Dragon, of course.
So this is what we'll do. We must help our future allies in the fight against the demonic horde! If we don't stop them, they'll get to the Great Dragon, and I'm not sure she'll be able to defend herself!
We must take them out. Kill six Abyssal Demon Mages or Darksoul Cultists. Report back to Nestor Golovanov.

checkText.en: Your actions will speak louder than your words, you know!

finishText.en:
Argh!
Well, thank you! Your help was welcome!
You seem to be trustworthy... I never thought I'd say that to a scaleless one...
Okay! I want to reward you! Choose what you like.
Afterwards, we will continue the conversation. The mistress will speak directly through me.

goal.en: Help Soliskar the Wise to defeat Gorluxor by killing demons he summons.

startText.en:
Mortals! You failed this world! We brought it to the brink of destruction!
Oh, we remember everything! Everything! Centuries of murders, wars, crimes... You are driven only by lust for power, greed, and malice. The Junes started hunting the Dragons, and your vaunted Grand Mages have joined in! And now, when Sarnaut is in peril, you continue to fight and kill each other instead of joining forces...
What?! Who dares to interrupt the mistress?
Aah! Gorluxor, the leader of the Cult of Destruction!
You say you can be trusted?
Well, prove it! Help her deal with Gorluxor! Attack his minions!

checkText.en: Did you get the letter? What does it say? I need to know who I'm allying myself with and who's really backing the hunters!

finishText.en: The hunters don't have any Great Mages! That's probably for the best. Those Great Mages often tend to suffer from delusions of grandeur and those things never end well for anybody!

goal.en: Send a Courier Raven with a letter inquiring about the Great Mages.

startText.en:
The voice that comes from the seneschal's mouth is more powerful than before.
Your bravery impressed me... You say you represent some kind of Demon Hunters?
Hmm... Hmm... So they do that? Exterminate astral creatures and cultists? And they want to propose an alliance?
Do you have a way to contact them? Before I make a decision, I need to get an answer to a very important question.
Are there any Great Mages among the Demon Hunters? If so, then an alliance is out of the question, argh!
Raven? Send it quickly. I'll wait for an answer...
In the meantime, you can do one more important task for me. Once you're done, you should try summoning a raven.

checkText.en: Please, take these firestones to my little dragons. They're having a tough time out there as it is and if we don't help them, they won't stand a chance against the octulhu!

finishText.en: Thank you for your help! My dragons are just little creatures, but what they lack in size they make up for with valor and loyalty! Just watch them spin joyous somersaults in the air when this filthy beasts finally croaks! Try your raven again - it should be close by now!

goal.en: Use the Firestone on 6 Savage Dragons and report back to Soliskar the Wise.

startText.en:
Once again, Soliskar's voice comes from the seneschal's mouth.
While the raven carries the letter, I will ask you for one more favor.
What do you see in the Astral? The Octulhu! A terrible astral creature that is a threat even to me. My faithful servants - the drakes - are going to attack it again. But you need to give them the Firestones before the fight. With their help, the drakes will do it faster.
I will cast the Friend of Dragons spell on you so that the drakes will not attack you. Go and give them 6 stones.

finishText.en: With an ally like that we will wipe all the enemies off this allod! It's good we didn't start warring with the draconids! Had we done so, I bet it would've been much harder to get on the dragon's good side!

goal.en: Relay Soliskar's decision to Nestor Golovanov.

startText.en:
Sirkey's eyes light up with a flame that seems older than the stones of this allod.
"I have made my final decision!
I will make a pact with the Demon Hunters. But only with them! The Hunters can be trusted. For two reasons.
First, there are no Great Mages among them. The second one is you.
You managed to impress me! I hope our paths cross again some day...
Let this Nestor Golovanov know my decision.
Now go. I have things to do!"

finishText.en: The ritual is complete! From here on out the hunters are your brothers in arms! We don't usually accept new members without a lengthy training period and exhausting trials... But you've already proven your bravery in action, so no further tests are required!

goal.en: Wait for the Initiation Ritual to end.

startText.en: Oh, if only all my hunters were as brave and as adept as you! I hereby accept you into our ranks, to know you henceforth as a colleague and a brother in arms. Your name shall be recorded in the annals of the Demon Hunters' history. Yours is the example by which we shall raise our youth. Now, I'll conduct the initiation ritual. When it's done, you'll be a full-fledged member of our organization!

finishText.en: Beating Gorluxor himself is no joke at all! We need the likes of you in the Astral. I will discharge extra workers so that your ship would be constructed 10 days faster.

goal.en: Talk to Nomarkh Hanotep to speed up ship's construction.

startText.en: I know just how to thank you. If you are about to sail off to the Astral, and you've already started to build a ship, I can send a note to Nomarkh Hanotep to speed it up!

finishText.en: Beating Gorluxor himself is no joke at all! We need the likes of you in the Astral. We'll discharge extra builders so that your ship would be constructed 10 days faster.

goal.en: Talk to the Glowy Family to speed up ship's construction.

startText.en: I know just how to thank you. If you are about to sail off to the Astral, and you've already started to build a ship, I can send a note to the Glowy Family to speed it up!

checkText.en: What do you mean you can't find any? Did you try the Auction House?

finishText.en: Thank you! It's great there are such honest people like you!

goal.en: Collect 5 Rare Double Locks for Vlad Shuysky.

startText.en:
Holy smokes! Look at this lock!
This just won't do. There's no way that they could stop a thief! Any one will break it open in no time! These youngsters just don't know what it's like to lose your goods in wartime! I've been already robbed two times this week!
You've got to bring me some proper locks. Please, your help could save lots of my wares. I'll be very much obliged!

checkText.en: I personally detest locks. An Orc shouldn't hide anything! Unfortunately, thieves are poking into every corner, so I'll have to make an exception.

finishText.en:
Good job!
I'll make sure the Sentinels know the locks are from you.

goal.en: Bring 5 Rare Double Locks to Bulat the Rowdy in the Imperial Settlement.

startText.en:
Do you know how to work a forge? Ah, never mind! Even if you don't you can still help out the Imperial Sentinels. I hate to say but while we are fighting, our stuff becomes an easy prey for dishonest pickers. We need to get some Rare Double Locks to secure our coffers.
Get the locks for us any way you can. Make them, buy them, barter for them - I don't care! Just get them to me one way or another. If you do, you can be sure the Imperial Sentinels won't forget it!

checkText.en: There seem to be some members of every race that ally with the demons. Whether they're Elven or Xadaganian cultists, or these cursed dragons, no one seems immune to their influence.

finishText.en: Wow, this fang is pretty big. That must have been one tough fight. Here's your reward - take it with both Soliskar's and the Demon Hunters' blessing.

goal.en: Participate in killing Kuzurgar and bring his fang to Boom the Merciless.

startText.en:
I see you're not from the Sentinels. That means you're allowed to risk your life for the sake of treasure and not just for your commander. Listen up because I have a job you might be interested in.
Soliskar is offering a reward for the fang of Kuzurgar, the leader of the black dragons. You see, we signed a peace treaty with Soliskar and the black dragons are traitors to all the other dragons. They have decided to serve the demons, and so they are our enemies as well.
If that's not enough of an incentive for you to help, you should know that Soliskar promises a reward for this job. I'd recommend that you gather some friends and take this Kuzurgar down.

checkText.en: It seems that dragons also have problems with allegiance with their kind.

finishText.en: Kuzurgar is dead? Wow, I'm sure Soliskar is going to be very pleased!

goal.en: Participate in killing Kuzurgar the Rebellious and take his Fang to Rogneda Boykova in the League Settlement.

startText.en:
I have been sent a very odd message. I'm sure you know all about this, but recently the Demon Hunters on Dragon Ring were able to enter into a treaty with the Great Dragon and together they're fighting the remaining demons. That's pretty fantastic, right? But here's where it gets really interesting...
Soliskar, the leader of all dragons, has used the Demon Hunters to send us a message. She would like to ally with us in this fight against the demons, but we must first prove ourselves. There's a Great Dragon with a bounty on his head on this allod and this dragon and his clan have allied with the demons. Soliskar does not approve of this and has placed a bounty upon his head!
She says that if we bring her his fang, she'll side with us against the demons! We need that tooth! Go to the Blackened Shore and kill Kuzurgar the Rebellious!

finishText.en: It looks like your guess was correct! There's a dusty chest located under the rubble. Those who keep their eyes open are always rewarded!

goal.en: Search under the fallen blocks for something valuable.

startText.en: These ancient stones look like they've been moved recently! It's as if they were carefully arranged to hide something... Perhaps there's some treasure underneath?

checkText.en: When the war is over I hope we have time to come back to this allod and look through the ruins.

finishText.en: So I was right - there was something valuable out there! I wish I could put an end to these demons and do the most exciting thing in the world - search for ancient treasure!

goal.en: Explore the old Xadaganian ruins to find the ancient treasure. Report back to Leon de Grandeur.

startText.en:
What a day! I feel like helping everyone - even my enemies! I wonder why...?
Speaking of help...
There are many Xadaganian ruins on Yazes. There's also Gorluxor's Tower... I hear the Xadaganians were studying them before, back when this land was under Imperial control. I'm particularly interested in the ruins in the east of the Tainted Valley. I think I spotted a chest among the rocks last time I was in the area. Unfortunately I didn't have time to take a proper look. Perhaps you can do it! I just know there's treasure still out there.

checkText.en: What are you waiting for? You'll never learn more if you can't follow instructions.

finishText.en: You're on your way to becoming a great anthropologist yourself!

goal.en: Find the 4 Stones of Yazes Shard and report back to anthropologist Sarang Nebmaatre.

startText.en:
To be able to call oneself a true scholar, one must be very aware of one's surroundings.
As a test, I have placed four stones imbued with magic around Yazes Shard. Explore this desolate allod, find the stones and report back to me.
Only after you have done this will I agree to take you under my wing. You can find these stones in the Tainted Valley, Blackened Shore, Wild Cape, and the Baneful Valley. Good luck, traveler.

checkText.en: Well? Have those creatures been defeated?

finishText.en:
Excellent!
I knew you could do it. And by defeating these beasts, you now know more about the local fauna.

goal.en: Collect 5 Yazes Shard Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Sarang Nebmaatre.

startText.en:
Listen, I know you're a seasoned traveler, but this is Yazes Shard!
You let your guard down for one second and that's it! It's all over! I want you to get used to the dangers of a place like this, so I need you to venture out and kill five of Yazes Shard's most dangerous creatures!
But you need to give me proof – a trophy from the likes of Magmar, the darksoul ringleader, Varkuk the Dreadful, a savage Astral mauler, a savage Astral flayer or a darksoul exorcist will do just fine.

checkText.en: Those cultists tremble at the sound of your name now, right?

finishText.en:
Thank you.
Hopefully now it will be easier for us to carry out our mission on Yazes Shard.

goal.en: Kill 100 cultists and return to anthropologist Sarang Nebmaatre.

startText.en:
The fact that this allod is imperfect is as plain at the nose on your face. There are so many enemies here that telling you to go after one group probably wouldn't even make a dent! But that's what we're going to do anyway. So we should probably start out with those vile cultists.
Maybe if we take away the demons' fan club, they'll be easier to take down later. Go out there and kill as many as you can!

checkText.en: You can find the stones all over Yazes Shard. You just need to keep a sharp eye out!

finishText.en: Great! Now that we have it, we'll be able to create the most powerful weapons!

goal.en: Collect 7 pieces of Evelite and report back to anthropologist Sarang Nebmaatre.

startText.en:
It doesn't look like there would be anything of value here, right? Well, you'd be wrong.
Yazes Shard is rich with a very rare mineral called Evelite! We're probably not the only ones that will be looking for Evelite, so the sooner that you can get out there and find some, the better!
Evelite can be found all throughout Yazes Shard hidden deep with the stone. Hurry, we must not let anyone else get their hands on the Evelite! Please hurry!

checkText.en: Have you completed all of my tasks?

finishText.en:
Wonderful!
You know, I must admit, I didn't think you'd be able to do it. Thank you for proving me wrong! Go ahead and take your reward!

goal.en: Complete all of the Anthropologist's tasks and report back to Sarang Nebmaatre.

startText.en:
If you can successfully complete all my tasks, you'll be generously rewarded.
And I'm not talking about some rinky-dink potion! You'll have the knowledge that you've gained from this adventure as well as some prime equipment that's bound to help you on your future journeys!
So, find the stones, defeat the beasts, and gather some valuable resources here in Yazes Shard!

checkText.en: What are you waiting for? You'll never learn more if you can't follow instructions.

finishText.en: Great! You're on your way to becoming a great anthropologist yourself!

goal.en: Find the 4 Stones of Yazes Shard and report back to anthropologist Germain de Blizare.

startText.en:
To be able to call yourself a true scholar, you must be very aware of your surroundings.
As a test, I have placed four stones imbued with magic around Yazes Shard. Explore this desolate allod, find the stones and report back to me.
Only after you have done this will I agree to take you under my wing. You can find these stones in the Tainted Valley, Blackened Shore, Wild Cape, and the Baneful Valley. Good luck, traveler.

checkText.en: Well? Have those creatures been defeated?

finishText.en:
Excellent!
I knew you could do it. And by defeating these beasts, you now know more about the local fauna.

goal.en: Collect 5 Yazes Shard Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Sarang Germain de Blizare.

Hopefully now it will be easier for us to carry out our mission on Yazes Shard.

Maybe if we take away the demons' fan club, they'll be easier to take down later. Go out there and kill as many as you can!

checkText.en: Stones with impregnated evelite you can find everywhere on the Shard.

finishText.en: You can find the stones all over Yazes Shard. You just need to keep a sharp eye out!

goal.en: Collect 7 pieces of Evelite and report back to anthropologist Germain de Blizare.

It doesn't look like there would be anything of value here, right? Well, you'd be wrong.
Yazes Shard is rich with a very rare mineral called Evelite! We're probably not the only ones that will be looking for Evelite, so the sooner that you can get out there and find some, the better!
Evelite can be found all throughout Yazes Shard hidden deep with the stone. Hurry, we must not let anyone else get their hands on the Evelite! Please hurry!

finishText.en:
Wonderful!
You know, I must admit, I didn't think you'd be able to do it. Thank you for proving me wrong! Go ahead and take your reward!

startText.en:
If you can successfully complete all my tasks, you'll be generously rewarded.
And I'm not talking about some rinky-dink potion! You'll have the knowledge that you've gained from this adventure as well as some prime equipment that's bound to help you on your future journeys!
So, find the stones, defeat the beasts, and gather some valuable resources here in Yazes Shard!

checkText.en: The seizure of this new island is a strategically crucial task.

finishText.en:
Great.
I knew you had it in you. We'll begin our move shortly.

goal.en: Go to the Isle of Gloom and kill 6 Magical Elementals. Report back to Adam Verkhovin.

startText.en:
We had a great Astral storm here not too long ago. It was so big, that it blew a whole new small allod into Yazes Shard!
This would be a great place to for a new camp. Think about it, if we're on an island, they're going to have one hell of a time trying to get over to attack out camp! There's only one problem.
...It's full of elementals. We've tried just pushing them off, but those pesky things just float right back up! So we need you to go in and clear them out! Come on, it'll be no problem for you. Just get in there and do it.

checkText.en: The seizure of this new island is a strategically crucial task.

finishText.en:
Great.
I knew you had it in you. We'll begin our move shortly.

goal.en: Go to the Isle of Gloom and kill 6 Magical Elementals. Report back to Rogneda Boykova.

startText.en:
We had a great Astral storm here not too long ago. It was so big, that it blew a whole new small allod into Yazes Shard!
This would be a great place for us to mount a new attack! Why? Think about it, it's right next to their camp. They'll never expect us to pop up from the Astral! There's only one problem.
...It's full of elementals. We've tried just pushing them off, but those pesky things just float right back up! So we need you to go in and clear them out! Come on, it'll be no problem for you. Just get in there and do it.

checkText.en: It's time to rid this allod of demons once and for all. No more hiding behind this barricade!

finishText.en: I'm glad I wasn't wrong about you. My colleagues are already discussing your heroics, you know. The praise is well-deserved!

goal.en: Kill 6 Vengeful Demon Mages or Malevolent Demon Mages and return to Evgeny Byvalin.

startText.en:
Well done! People like you were worth their weight in meteorite during the Great Astral Campaign. It seems that almost all the rookies here are getting killed.
I hope you'll do better. Also...
I have considerable prestige among the Imperial Sentinels. I would be happy to put in a good word for you. If you continue to fight these demons, I'll make sure every commander knows your name.
Go out and kill a few demon mages and I'll see that your reputation among the Imperial Sentinels improves.

checkText.en: I'm sure you already know how powerful the Astral is. Their reagents are probably vessels for channeling a tiny fraction of the Astral's power.

finishText.en: Thank you so much. I'll inform the Sentinels of your help.

goal.en: Collect 6 Astral Crystals by hunting Destroying Demons and bring them to Yaver Khaba in the Imperial Camp.

startText.en:
Just as we require reagents to keep this portal closed, the cultists must require reagents to keep it open. If we were to destroy those items the portal would close forever. There's only one problem. We might eventually need to use the portal for our own purposes. If it closes we could lose a powerful tool.
If we take the cultists' reagents, then we could prevent them from strengthening the portal. That would make our job much easier. We could also store them for later use so that we could suddenly open the portal when the time suited us.
I'm pretty sure the reagents the cultists use are imbued with Astral energy. Hunt them and steal anything that fits the bill. Bring the items back to me and I'll make sure all the Imperial Sentinels know of your deeds.

checkText.en: No cannons should be wasted! That's the motto of a true Astral sailor.

finishText.en: Excellent! Hopefully that demon is in a lot of pain right now. You know, I bet that cannon has a few more shots left in it. Return to me tomorrow and perhaps you can take another shot at the enemy.

goal.en: Use the Battered Artillery to shoot the Astral demon and return to Sarbaz Rashepses.

startText.en:
Oh, my poor ship!
We were sent to attack the giant Astral demon off the coast of the Tainted Valley, but now it's nothing but wreckage. I don't think the engineers could ever fix her up even if we could get her away from all the demons that have swarmed the decks. I must have revenge on the monster that caused all this!
Listen, I'm pretty sure that some of the ship's cannons are still working. Travel to the coast and board what's left of the vessel, then fire a shot at that damned Astral demon!
Me and the rest of the crew would be grateful for your efforts.

checkText.en: I lost many, many friends in the last Campaign.And it's like it didn't even matter! It's just endless blood and death, like we never won. Ugh!

finishText.en:
It's people like you that helped us secure our victory over the demons 40 years ago.
You have my sincere thanks. That's what League Defenders say, too.

goal.en: Kill 6 Malevolent Demon Mages or Shadowy Demon Mages for Svarog Linev.

startText.en:
I can already see that you're trustworthy! Your dedication to slaying demons is the only proof I need! That's how it was in the Great Astral Campaign and that's how it remains today.
Listen, the other Defenders respect me. If you want to improve your reputation among the League Defenders, I can put in a word for you.
Especially if you help us out.
Kill six Malevolent Demon Mages or Shadowy Demon Mages. Every League Defender will know your name!

checkText.en: Rumor has it that the Astral is a primordial matter that's filled with incredible energy. I don't know... To me, that's just an ocean of evil and darkness!

finishText.en: Thank you. Now we can keep this portal up and running. And, as promised, I will tell Rogneda about all you've done.

goal.en: Collect 6 Astral Crystals for Dmitry Svetlov by hunting Fiendish Predators and Foul Demon Scouts.

startText.en:
Forgive us, great Tensess, for what we done.
We used the power of the demons... but it was for a good purpose! For the triumph of the Light!
Lately, I have been finding it increasingly difficult to find volunteers willing to provide us with dark Astral crystals. What are dark Astral Crystals? They're these strange and terrible little crystals that you can get from the demons. We need them to keep this portal private and maintained.
It's not that we can't get anyone to fight the demons... the League Defenders aren't afraid, it's just that no one wants to touch the crystals. You pick it up and feel the pure evil... right in your hand.
Maybe you can help us? You can find them on the predators just outside the camp. Help me, and I'll tell Rogneda all about your dedication.

checkText.en: Oh, those silly Imperial soldier! What do they think they're doing over there?

finishText.en:
Well done!
Now we just need to figure out what do we say to the guys from the Empire after we'd wiped their nose...

goal.en: Fire the canon from the crashed Imperial ship at the Octulhu and report back to the Whirligig Family.

startText.en:
We caught us a Xadaganian scout the other day and, boy, did he put on a great performance! He kept insisting that we let him go because his precious Empire needs him!
He claims that there's an Octulhu loitering just off the shore near the Imperial camp. And he says that it's his duty to keep a constant attack on the demon. Can you believe that?! He says he just sits there all day firing on a stationary target!
But we know better. If he's supposed to fire at a demon all day then what was he doing sneaking around over here? Does he think that we were born yesterday?! Go see if he's telling the truth. And if there really is an Octulhu over there, fire the canon one time for us!

checkText.en:
Agrh... Woof, woof! Agrh...

How is the search going?

finishText.en: Yazes was considered a dead allod. It should have stayed that way.

goal.en: Find Adramelech Lutov in the cultists' lair and discuss the situation with him.

startText.en:
Agrh... Woof, woof! Agrh...

As you can see, demons are far from defeated. They are here again, preparing to strike. I'm sure this conspiracy has a base somewhere.

We have tasked our other agents with finding this base... I think it's a matter of time.

What should you do? Find our agent. His name is Adramelech Lutov, he's a rather... powerful Demonologist.

I guess you should follow your path until then. Let me know when you're ready.

checkText.en: Smash them, break their bones!

finishText.en: Everyone is dead? Excellent.

goal.en: Kill 20 demons

startText.en:
My recipe is simple and doesn't require delving into demon guts...

I suggest killing them until you run out of them. I think about two dozen will be enough for our troops to mount an attack.

After all, we are weapons against demons, aren't we?

checkText.en: There's no time to waste. The League must be dealt with today!

finishText.en: Nice work. Now the League knows that hiding inside their camp won't save them. Come back to me tomorrow and I'll give you another mission to destroy the bastards.

goal.en: Kill 6 League Veterans or Defenders in the League Camp. Report back to Adam Verkhovin.

startText.en:
What do you think about a daring and dangerous mission whose purpose is to show the League who's the master of this cursed land? Sounds good? I knew you'd say that!
Not long ago the League organized a raiding party and attacked our camp. We fended off their soldiers, but that's not enough. We must pay them back for their incursion. Revenge will be swift and merciless!
Go to the League settlement and break past their barricades. Kill as many battlemages and defenders as you can find. It won't be an easy task, so you should probably organize some friends to go with you. Return to me when you're victorious!

checkText.en: This land originally belonged to the Xadaganians, you know. It's yet another reason the League should not be here!

finishText.en: Thank you for your service! If you want to continue fighting the League, return to me tomorrow and I'll give you another mission.

goal.en: Kill 3 Elven players, 3 Gibberling players, and 3 Kanian players and return to Adam Verkhovin.

startText.en:
In the middle of our battles with the cultists and the demons we must not forget the second part of our mission. I'm talking about the League.
I know that we have the same reason for coming to this forsaken allod, but at the same time we cannot forget the League's past discretions. They're slaughtering our comrades in the Holy Land! Additionally, Yasker made it clear that we need to be the ones to defeat the demons, not them.
The same laws of war are still in place. Every Kanian, Gibberling, and Elf that you see is the enemy. Send them to Purgatory until they decide to leave this land!

checkText.en: It's time for the Empire to understand the consequences of messing with the League!

finishText.en: Hopefully the Imperials learned their lesson. And if not... Well then, we'll just have to remind them.

goal.en: Kill 6 Imperial Sentinels or Spellcasters in the Imperial Camp. Report back to Rogneda Boykova.

startText.en:
Yesterday was a bad day... Very bad! I never would have expected to see an Imperial Sentinel brandishing an ax and shouting obscenities right here in this very camp!
We cannot afford to have the Empire attacking us alongside the demons! If they're not going to fight fairly, why should we?! I want you to gather an army and attack the Imperial Camp! Show them what a true League champion is made of!

checkText.en: Don't let compassion prevail! Think of those who fell in the fight against the Empire in the Holy Land!

finishText.en: Good job. I think I'll have to give the same order again tomorrow... It will take some time before the Empire realizes how stupid it is to oppose the League!

goal.en: Kill 3 Orcish Players, 3 Xadaganian Players, and 3 Arisen Players and report back to Rogneda Boykova.

startText.en:
Even though Aidenus gave us clear orders to fight the demons, we must not forgot about the Empire!
And it looks like Yasker gave his troops the exact the same order. How else do we explain the constant barrage from the Imperial forces? It's even putting a hold on their own fight with the demons!
We're fighting a war with many fronts. We have many enemies, and to survive we must not give any of them even an inch! And so, we must inflict the first blow! Is that clear?

checkText.en: The demons are along the coast and in the Astral! Will there ever be an end to this madness?

finishText.en:
We've repelled this attack, but there will be more... We are too few to wage open warfare!
The Imperial landing party is in the exact situation as us. All we can do is hope to receive reinforcements before the Empire does...

goal.en: Kill 6 Wily Demon Scouts near the League Camp and report back to Rogneda Boykova.

startText.en:
We really stirred up a hornet's nest when we landed. The cultists didn't expect us to capture the portal, and now they're fighting like mad to get it back!
All the while, demons are just pouring in from the Astral. The coast is filled with the creatures. I've already sent a request for additional support, but we need to weather the storm until they get here.
Why don't you get out there and help? Take a walk along the coast and kill twelve demon scouts! After that we

checkText.en: We can't allow those vile beasts to break through the portal and into our camp! Where's the fire essence? It needs to be added to the flame!

finishText.en: Let the flame burn ever brighter! The fire of Holy Tensess is the surest way of battling the demons, especially with our prayers magnifying its effect multifold. And so we keep up our prayers day and night. I thank you for your help. May the power of Tensess be with you!

goal.en: Collect 6 measures of Fiery Essence on the Blackened Shore, then report back to Dmitry Svetlov.

startText.en:
May the Light shine upon your path!
The other day a swarm of demons tried to launch an offensive through the portal. We caught it in time and repelled the attack. Since then we've kept Tensess's holy flame burning in our braziers.
It's the flame and our prayers that keep the demons at bay. But we're going to need some fiery essence in order to keep the fire going. You can get it from the fire elementals that roam the eastern part of Blackened Shore.
Collect six measures of fiery essence for me and the boys. It is vital to our survival!

checkText.en: I don't have enough soldiers or mages to secure a position on the Blackened Shore. I can't leave our camp undefended, now can I?

finishText.en: I thank you for a job well done! Maybe now we'll be able to secure the Shore and carry out Aidenus' orders. You know, we've been through worse. When we first landed here, it was without any preliminary scouting and we quickly found ourselves lost in the mountains and fighting off hundreds of rabid kobolds. Then, we ended up ramming right into an Orc outpost. That was quite an excursion, believe you me! But we managed then and we'll manage now. We're called troopers for a reason!

goal.en: Kill 6 Abyssal Demon Mages or Darksoul Mystics, then report back to Rogneda Boykova.

startText.en:
I have received orders from Aidenus to assume the offensive and secure a foothold on the Blackened Shore. He's worried that the Empire might swing the momentum there over to their side. Can you believe that?! That's our ship!
As soon as we started in to the Shore, the enemy swooped in to attack the berth! They were trying to toss us into the Astral! Help our fighters by killing some of those cultists and demons!

checkText.en: It's difficult to hold the line when your opponent has commanders like that. The demon and that Grusova hag must be destroyed!

finishText.en: And now we'll watch the panic set in among the enemy ranks! They've gotten used to relying on their commanders, so this will be a severe blow to their morale.

goal.en: Kill Minikar the Sadistic and Lada Grusova and report back to Rogneda Boykova.

startText.en:
The advantage that the demons and cultists have isn't only in numbers. They're also well organized and that is the main reason why we haven't been able to force them deeper into Yazes Shard.
What we need to is liquidate their commanders! It'll be crucial to our overall success. And since you have extensive experience in settling matters such as this, you've been selected to handle it!
The demon commander is called Minikar the Sadistic and our scouts report that he's somewhere in the Tainted Valley. And the cultists are headed by Archmage Lada Grusova, who has been spotted at the Wild Cape, not far from the Imperial camp.
Remember, as long as they're alive we cannot resume our offensive!

checkText.en: Picking the right landing spot is crucial to mission success! Have the beacons been set?

finishText.en:
Wonderful! Now we just wait for their arrival.
We were initially banking on capturing Yazes Shard in one fell swoop... But the enemies were too many, so we had to ask for help.

goal.en: Place the 2 Signal Cups into the ancient June ruins on either side of the League Settlement and report back to the Whirligig Family.

startText.en:
Hooray!
Good news! Rogneda Boykova has reported that we will reinforcements will be arriving soon! Three powerful Astral ships are rushing on their way here!
And on their decks are tough veterans, new weapons and ammunition, and of course, crates and crates of sweets! We need to prepare! We must give the ships a signal! We need a signal that screams "We are here! Here!"
So, let's see what we have around here to work with. These signal cups should do it! Go put these in the ruins to the east and west of here. That'll show them where we are!

checkText.en: Please kill those demons! They're not letting me perform the ritual!

finishText.en:
Thanks and don't worry too much about me - I'll be able finish the chapel by myself. The House de Ardeur is renowned for its architects, you know. This will be my third field chapel, actually!
