When the construction is complete, the League and Imperial soldiers will be resurrected here, right by the battlefield, and be able to lay into those blasted demons with renewed strength and vigor!

goal.en: Protect Augusta de Ardeur from demon attacks while she performs the ritual.

startText.en:
Come here, I need your help! The chapels on Yazes Shard are too far from the battlefield! Resurrected soldiers are going to waste precious time and energy running back to rejoining their troops on the front lines.
I want to build a new chapel here in enemy territory. I've already got my eye on this spot, but the area needs to be cleared of demons before I can begin. Please help me! I cannot do this by myself. I need someone to protect me while I'm performing the ritual.

checkText.en: I have lost a lot of friends over the years. Some have been killed by demons, others by Imperial soldiers. I thought that most of the bloodshed was over after the Great Astral Campaign...

finishText.en:
I went over to the Wild Gorge the other day. I had a craving to gut a demon or two to show those recruits how it's done. I never saw any demons... but I did run into an old friend of mine, an Imperial soldier!
Back in our, day we fought against the demons side by side. We recognized each other right away, took a few minutes to catch up, and then went our separate ways... What? No, I'm not crying, I just got some sand in my eye! I forgot how to cry ages ago. Give me those amulets and horns!
Good job, by the way. This wasn't an easy task. We could've used you in the Great Astral Campaign.

goal.en: Bring 3 Demon Horns and 3 amulets of Darksoul Ravagers to Svarog Linev.

startText.en:
I remember a time when the League and the Empire fought together against the demons. Now look at us, we can't even put aside our differences long enough to save our world. Yes, I took part in the Great Astral Campaign! I look good for my age, don't I? Hah!
Rumor has it that you've been busy performing all kinds of heroic feats. I'd like to see you in action myself so I'll know if you can be counted on. Go and kill something on the Blackened Shore! Demons, cultists, whatever! Just remember to bring me back some sort of proof.

checkText.en: How many demons did you kill? We must drive their vile breed away from our camp!

finishText.en:
Thank you for killing those monsters! Unfortunately, they're but a small portion of the enormous army of demons and cultists here on Yazes Shard. The bulk of their forces lie beyond the Demonic Gates to the north, but the area is inaccessible to even our scouts.
The initial plan was to clear out the coast in one fell swoop, crush their defenses and pursue the enemy beyond the Gates. So far we've barely been able to secure a foothold here at the Wild Cape. Perhaps we can make some progress now.

goal.en: Kill 6 Wily Demon Scouts on the Wild Cape shore. Report back to Adam Verkhovin.

startText.en:
So, your first task.
The demons keep trying to drive us off the Wild Cape and reclaim the demonic portal in our camp. Demon scouts constantly land along the shore and attack anyone that ventures outside. I have sent a request to Yasker for more troops. I'm sure he'll deliver. He seems to understand the importance of our operation. But it might be a while... So we'll have to fend for ourselves for the time being.
Well, I'm sure you get the picture. We need to kill Wily Demon Scouts. Go out and kill six of them.

checkText.en: With the right reagents a seasoned mage can keep a whole army of demons from using the portal. Now where are those eyes?

finishText.en:
Good, these are just what we needed. You see, these eyes are part of an ancient recipe. They are dried, crushed, and mixed into a powder that we burn during the recital of our spells.
Even so, this job requires the caster to maintain the utmost concentration. Just imagine the stress! Go on, try and recite a spell for even an hour - you couldn't stand the headache! But we're still here, reciting them day and night.

goal.en: Collect 6 Slimy Eyes and bring them to Yaver Khaba.

startText.en:
There are things that should be taken into account. Mainly demons.
The Astral isn't the only place the demons are launching their attacks from. Not long ago they poured out of this portal right here and caught us by surprise. Ever since then our mages have been keeping the portal closed with their magic.
It's terribly draining, so they've been using magical reagents for their spells. One of those reagents is the eyes of the Damned Eye demons. These monsters inhabit the shore just to the west of here.
Bring me six eyes so we can keep that horrible portal sealed.

checkText.en: Are they dead? Their numbers need to be lessened immediately, lest they gather up a considerable force on the shore and hurl us into the Astral!

finishText.en:
Excellent! My scouts report that the demons have retreated from our camp. Even better, they've refocused their attacks on the League settlement. I do hope the League survives, though. We're all in one boat here. If the League soldiers are destroyed, the demons will come right back to us.
At the same time, it is us and only us who shall prevail over them, while the League must settle for an honorable second place.

goal.en: Kill 6 Abyssal Demon Mages or Darksoul Ravagers and return to Adam Verkhovin.

startText.en:
No matter how bad things are we must complete our mission. Yasker expects us to act decisively. We were ordered to immediately crush the vermin in their own territory, and so we shall!
The League is so much luckier. Their camp is on a small allod and in a good position to fend off attacks. Our camp, on the other hand, is in plain sight and thus much harder to defend. Demons and cultists attack us day and night.
Well, the bastards won't stop until they recapture their portal or we slaughter every last one of them. I prefer the latter option. Victory is still far off, but we can at least ensure the safety of our camp by thinning the enemy's numbers. Kill ten demons and ten cultists and return to me.

checkText.en: Did you find Minikar and that Lada Grusova lady? I trust that they're no longer with us?

finishText.en: Good job! Now's the time to attack when the enemy's disoriented and confused. We need to organize an operation immediately.

goal.en: Kill Lada Grusova and Minikar the Sadistic and return to Adam Verkhovin.

startText.en:
The demons and cultists boast highly disciplined armies. They advance in an organized manner, fight as a group, and retreat without so much as a semblance of panic. They also send out recon parties before every battle. All of those are aspects of sound leadership.
Fortunately, my scouts have found out who those leaders are - the demons obey Minikar the Sadistic, stationed over at the Blackened Shore not far from the League camp. The cultists are headed by Lada Grusova who was recently sighted here at the Wild Cape.
I am ordering you to kill them both, and the sooner the better! Now get going!

checkText.en: Are the beacons set? We need to make sure every shot counts!

finishText.en: Excellent work! I can't wait to charge up the cannons and get this party started!

goal.en: Set the Bright Signal Beacons on the Dark Altars and return to Sarbaz Rashepses.

startText.en:
I'm so tired of waiting! I'm going to rust over soon if I don't get something to do. You see, I was the captain of a great Astral ship a few days ago. Unfortunately, it was destroyed by a rather large demon just to the north of here.
Ever since then I've been left with nothing to do. I'm just waiting on the shore for more ships to arrive so I can give them a hand with their operations. I hope they hurry up. I want to fire some cannons!
In the mean time, I suppose I should start preparing for the ships' arrival. It would make the cannoneers' jobs a lot easier if some signal beacons were planted near their main targets.
Here, take these two beacons and put them on the cultists' dark altars. The bastards tend to group up around there and conduct various demonic rituals. One shot could probably take out more than a dozen of them!

checkText.en: Maybe they worship those Fangs? I have no idea!

finishText.en:
This black stone is brimming with dark energy.
I'd reckon this thing is stronger than a mana elixir. I bet the cultists charge these stones with magical energy as they meditate at the Astral fangs. Then they can use these stones later to replenish their energy in combat.
Hm... Well, thanks for this information. Now there's one less riddle to solve, but we're still far from understanding those strange cultists.

goal.en: Search the cultists for something that could explain the cultists' fascination with the Astral fangs.

startText.en:
The Empire invited me here as a consultant. The Demon Hunters know more about demons and cultists than anyone else. But if I knew this place was in such turmoil, I might have thought twice before diving into this mess alone.
Since I've gotten here I've done a good bit of recon work. Turns out those cracked cultists have a past time of sorts that involves sitting around the Astral fangs. They stay there forever without moving a muscle as if they're spellbound!
This needs some further investigating. I caught a few cultists, but I couldn't get anything useful out of 'em. That means it's time for brute force. Hunt the cultists and see if they have anything that holds the key to this riddle!

checkText.en:
I remember getting shipwrecked around here during the Great Astral Campaign. A storm swept our ship away from the rest of the squadron and hurled it at the cliffs.
Ah, this land was very different in those days. Perhaps I'll tell you more of that story when you finish my task.

finishText.en:
Ah, the horns and the amulets. Let me put them down right here. Hm, well I guess I can rely on you. Good to know that not all the new soldiers are wimps!
Oh yes, let me finish my story. Well, our ship was not the only one to crash against the cliffs. In fact, a Kanian vessel had also been shipwrecked. There on the shore contemplating the war I met one of the League soldiers. His name was Svarog, and we talked at length about the problems of the world.
Remember that one of the most important things in life is to know your goals. Without direction, you are doomed to fail. That is why we must identify the real threat to Sarnaut and put all our energy into stopping it!

goal.en: Bring 3 Cultist Amulets and 3 Demon Horns to Evgeny Byvalin.

startText.en:
I feel like true heroes have gone extinct! Back in my day the world was full of them. What's that you say? I'm hard of hearing after the recent concussion. A demon threw me to the ground so hard, I thought it was the end of me. But nope, I'm still here!
What was I talking about? Oh yes, heroes! The soldiers in the Great Astral Campaign were made of tough stuff. I myself am a veteran. Forty years ago I traveled with Nezeb and Skrakan to the June Gates. Few of us made it... We thought it was over! And demons were finally gone! But when we arrived at this allod, those hopes were shattered. Yeah...
Well, what about you? Are you ready for war? Ready to die for the freedom of the world? Or are you simply here to collect a few medals while you let others do the work? Well, I'm going to test your resolve right here and now!
Bring me three amulets from the cultists and three horns from those demons. Of course they won't part with them easily! You'll have to do some convincing! Exactly!
Then I'll know if I can count on you to get stuff done out here.

checkText.en: The Demon Hunters refuse to sell the League the manufacture patent for detectors. They're using their neutral status as an excuse, but I know they just want a monopoly on the market! Have the detectors been set?

finishText.en:
Conducting reconnaissance on Yazes Shard is difficult and dangerous work. You've got cultists around every corner and the demons looking down from above! And that's why I'm so glad that you managed to set those detectors.
Hmm... This is strange. The detectors are telling us that demons and cultists are constantly leaving the Gates and then vanishing in the portal. Which begs the question - where are those bastards going?!

goal.en: Plant 1 Shadowy Detector near the new Demon Portal and 1 Shadowy Detector near the Demonic Gate and return to Rogneda Boykova.

startText.en:
My scouts have just come back from the Demonic Gate to the north and do you know what they discovered? Another demonic portal!
If they use at and are able to overtake our camp, they'll be able to take this portal here right to the League! Can you imagine it? Demons roaming all over Novograd... That's why it's important for us to know what's happening.
I need you to take these two probes and place them out by the portal and the Gates. These devices were a gift from the Demon Hunters, not it's time we took them out for a test run!

finishText.en:
I've heard enough prayers and psalms! I need the blood of the lost! Only blood can help me best Tensess' power!
Bring me the blood of the lost! Feed me! Feed me!

goal.en: Investigate the Dark Idol in the Baneful Valley.

startText.en:
May Tensess help us!
It's getting harder and harder to hold off the demons that are trying to come in through the portal.
Our enemy has switched to magic attacks and we're weakening by the hour! North west of here lies the Baneful Valley. Our scouts have reported seeing cultists conducting bizarre rituals by some strange statue. And the first of the magic attacks took place around the time that they were spotted.
I think it's time that we really investigated it. Go to the idol and check it out, if someone gets in your way, kill them in the name of Tensess!

checkText.en: Uh... The situation has improved here... I wonder what caused this?

finishText.en: Too bad we can't just destroy the statue... But you've managed to disrupt some sort of terrible cultist ritual and in so doing, rendered the idol harmless for the time being. What I'd really like to know is what sort of deity that thing is supposed to represent. After all, its power was great enough to match that of Tensess himself! Well, whatever it is, you've given us some much needed respite, so let's take advantage of it.

goal.en: Gather 6 portions of the Blood of the Lost and report to Dmitry Svetlov.

startText.en:
That bloodthirsty idol wants "blood of the lost." But what is "the lost?" The fallen soldier of the League and Empire?
The blood will help him to best the magic of Tensess and if this happens, the paladins will falter and the demons will pour in through the portal and into our camp. The cultists have already collected this "blood of the lost" and will soon hand it over to the idol. There's only way to stop them - take the blood away!

checkText.en: How far did you get? Do you think it's safe for our boat?

finishText.en: What did you say? Octulhu?! ...OCTULHU?! There's no way we're taking our dinky little boat up against an octulhu! Maybe if we had Aidenus' fleet... But that's still no guarantee!

goal.en: Scout out the situation along the western shore and report back to the Whirligig Family at the League Settlement.

startText.en:
We just got back from the Baneful Valley and now Rogneda wants us to go again! But this time, she wants us to take a ship along the shore.
We're really limited on resources and can't afford to lose anything! And we're already got a real bad feeling about this... So we want you to scout the area out first. Go along the coastline and explore the area. Learn as much as you can, but be sure to watch out for the demons. They love to hang out on the shore.

checkText.en: We've spent so much time searching and we still don't have a single prisoner! We've tried everything - even distributing leaflets that offered cultists voluntary surrender! Nothing works!

finishText.en:
Excellent! What? No! These can't be right! These are orders that have been signed by Gorluxor! It can't be! We killed him... Three times to be exact!
But what if those Gorluxor's that we killed were just clones? What if there's a hundred other Gorluxor's just waiting to be sent out? Oh, this isn't good. This isn't good at all! We had better tell Aidenus immediately!

goal.en: Obtain 4 Orders from the Darksoul messengers and return to Rogneda Boykova.

startText.en:
You don't know how hard it is to capture a cultist alive! They always insist on fighting to the death... Whether it be by own hand or their own!
But what we can try to do is intercept the orders that they receive from their brass. I want you to go kill the couriers in Baneful Valley and the Tainted Valley. Loot their corpses and bring the orders to me. Four orders should hold enough information for us to learn what our enemy's intentions are. Let's get to work!

finishText.en: I've come here to tell you that our troops have captured your scout. The United Array must not sit on its hands. It's an outrage that we must keep hiding like some sort of fugitive!

goal.en: Look for Maxim Lukov by the Demonic Gate.

startText.en:
Listen, I sent a scout out to the Demonic Gate earlier, but he has yet to return. There are a lot of bad rumors going around about that place, but we've always refused to believe them.
I already know that you have no fear of the demons and cultists. Hell, you decommission them by the dozens! Just like I used to, back in my day... But I digress. Your mission is to make for the Gates and look for our scout. He goes by Maxim Lukov. You can do it, I know you can!

checkText.en: Did you find Lukov? Where is he? Tell me he's not dead!

finishText.en:
So, Maxim was captured by Imperial troops. While that's not exactly good news, our friends from the United Array will not stand by and allow him to be executed.
What's the United Array, you ask? Well, I'll tell you!
When it became clear that the remaining allods were once more threatened by a demon invasion, veterans from both the League and the Empire decided to join forces. It's mad that our nations continue their petty fighting when our world is about to be swarmed by the demon spawn! And many old-school warriors, myself included, couldn't sit back and watch the madness continue.
This is how the United Array was born!

goal.en: Kill 6 Malevolent Demon Mages, then report to Svarog Linev and give him Dina Sondova's message.

startText.en:
It's a real pity that our leaders refuse to realize that the League and the Empire need to join forces in the fight against the demons and their minions. Just look at those demon bastards and their cultist buddies!
They've already got a city here on Yazes Shard, and it won't be long before they branch out to obliterate all living creatures throughout what's left of our world. I killed a demon scout myself just the other day, now it's your turn. Kill a dozen or so demons at the Demonic Gate and report back to the League camp.

checkText.en: We thought that these cultists just worshipped the demons. My colleague, Arnold de Grandeur, even penned a three-volume monograph on the subject that went on to win an Aidenus Prize last year. It was only recently that we've started to have our doubts...

finishText.en: Even a superficial analysis of cultist thoughts is sufficient enough to disprove Arnold de Grandeur's theory. The cultists do not worship the demons themselves, what they worship is the power behind them!

goal.en: Use the Mystical Artifact to read the minds of 5 Darksoul Supplicators and return to Gerasim Gromov.

startText.en:
I can't stop thinking about those cultists! What could be driving them to do all those terrible deeds?! Could the demons have clouded their minds with magic? Or maybe they're seeking to gain something from their service? Or maybe we're dealing with something else entirely... Something unlike anything we've ever encountered.
My question isn't just some idle curiosity. I firmly believe that if we know what the enemy's intentions are, it'll help us to emerge victorious in this war! I'm going to give you this artifact that's imbued with a psionicist's power. I want you to sneak up to some cultists and read their minds.
Then when you come back, we'll be able to analyze their thoughts!

checkText.en: How did the recon mission go? Did you get all the way up the coast? What's happening on the shores and in the Astral?

finishText.en: Wow! Now I understand why Verkhovin wanted that shore scouted so badly. The cultists' defenses are much weaker up there. Now that we know this, we can plan an attack on the demon city from behind. They'll get blasted to pieces! The only problem is that one demon that destroyed my ship...

goal.en: Travel north along the eastern shore and report your sightings to Sarbaz Rashepses.

startText.en:
Verkhovin ordered the eastern coast of this allod to be scouted by Astral ship. As you know, that mission already failed. He asked me if I could complete the mission on foot because I was part of the ship's crew, but there's no way I'd get past those cultists!
I just work the cannons you know. I'm not a scout! But you... you look pretty capable. Maybe you could take this mission on yourself? I'm sure you'd succeed. And this mission needs to be a success. Verkhovin said it was very important. It better be important if my ship was sacrificed for it!
So what do you say? Help me out? Just go north along the coast as far as you can go and tell me what you see.

finishText.en:
Aaaah! Save us, help us!
We were heading to the Demonic Gates when these horrible cultists captured us.
Then they put us in this cage! They're throwing their prisoners into the Astral whirlpool, chanting some demonic words and appealing to the "power of the Astral". You have to help us!

goal.en: Investigate the Astral whirlpool to the west of the Tainted Valley.

startText.en:
Even with the use of magical reagents, we're finding it increasingly difficult to keep the portal closed. The demons keep attempting to break through our spells, and the pressure is only increasing.
On top of that, all of the mages were recently affected by some strong dark energy. Our spells have suddenly begun to weaken, and we need more and more reagents for our magic to work.
This phenomenon is probably related to the influence of the Astral. This has been observed to some extent by scientists at the ZIT when working on a certain secret project.
A large Astral whirlpool has recently appeared off the northeast coast. Head over there and examine it immediately. If the Astral is causing these effects, they should be the strongest over there.

checkText.en: It seems that we're regaining some of our power. That means whatever you did worked!

finishText.en: Hm... It seems that whatever spell those cultists were casting was strengthened by throwing sacrifices into the Astral whirlpool. Perhaps it was using their souls for energy? Unfortunately we don't have the time to investigate this phenomenon right now, but it's good that we got our powers back. Thank you!

goal.en: Get the keys from the cultists and free 3 captives. Return to Yaver Khaba.

startText.en:
Listen, we must free all the prisoners! We don't know why their throwing us in the Astral, but it can't continue! Not only for our sake, but for the sake of everyone. We're pretty sure that whatever ritual their conducting will bring suffering to their enemies.
Kill the cultists, take their keys, and open all the cages. The Astral will not get our souls! After you rescue everyone, return to your camp and tell your leaders what happened. We've got a common enemy here on Yazes Shard, and we must work together if we want to survive!

checkText.en: Those detectors should come in handy. Hmm... I wonder if they could be reconfigured to detect League activity. That would make our mission in the Holy Land much easier.

finishText.en: The detectors are already working! We just discovered that most of the demons are coming out of the portal, through the demonic gates, and into the ruined city that lies beyond. Now we won't lost any more scouts in that region - this device can do the job instead.

goal.en: Plant 1 Shadowy Detector near the new Demon Portal and 1 Shadowy Detector near the Demonic Gate and return to Adam Verkhovin.

startText.en:
I'm about to entrust you with another important mission. I assume you're already acquainted with Boom the Merciless? He's a Demon Hunter - one of the best, they say. A few days ago I would have objected to interference by an outside faction, but now I see how valuable his advice is.
He recently suggested a new operation. You see, our scouts have reported that outside the Demonic Gates is another demonic portal. Through it the demons will be able to keep sending reinforcements until they overwhelm our camp.
At the moment we don't have enough forces to assault the demons near the portal, but we can monitor it. Take these detectors that Boom gave me. He says they'll monitor and all demonic activity so we won't get any surprises. Plant one near the Demonic Gates and one near the portal itself.

checkText.en: We can't do anything until we gather accurate intelligence on the enemy! Where are the cultists' secret messages?

finishText.en:
This is worse than we expected... these orders are signed by Gorluxor! It seems that their best troops have been redeployed to the portal dimension. Now they're waiting for League paladins and Imperial mages to lose control over the portals in their respective camps.
Once that happens they plan to flood into our bases. Then the remaining forces will attack from the front and we'll find ourselves caught between two fronts! This is an insidious plan, and it will be the end of us if we allow them to succeed!

goal.en: Obtain all 4 of the cultists' secret messages and return to Adam Verkhovin.

startText.en:
The enemy is about to strike, but we have no idea when or where! Many times now we've tried to capture and interrogate a cultist, but those fanatical loonies fight to the death. If they see that captivity is imminent, they just kill themselves!
But there's another way to learn the enemy's plans - by intercepting the orders the cultists receive from their leaders.
Our scouts have spotted two cultists near the Baneful Valley and two near the Tainted Valley carrying what appear to be orders. Kill them and bring anything of interest to me. I don't have to tell you how crucial this mission is so get to work!

finishText.en:
Ah, you've come looking for Tamara?
Well, we have some good news for you. She's being held in our camp under the pretense of being a prisoner. However, in reality she's there to communicate with Svarog, so tell Byvalin not to worry too much.
One more thing. Svarog believes that the time has come for the United Array to reveal itself.
Enough of this hiding! We must fight this battle together!

goal.en: Look for Tamara Byvalina near the Demonic Gates.

startText.en:
Alright, it's time to send you on a real mission. My daughter Tamara came to Yazes Shard with me. She's an excellent saboteur, and she was sent to explore some strange activity near the Demonic Gates. Unfortunately she never came back.
I know in my heart that Tamara is still alive. While the odds are not in favor of her survival, I beg you to investigate her disappearance. Go to the Demonic Gates and see what you can find.
And if you happen to meet some soldiers of the League please stay your weapons. Here in this land they are not our greatest enemies. We might even have to cooperate with them if things continue to get worse.

checkText.en: Well, did you find my daughter? She wasn't captured by the cultists, was she?

finishText.en:
She's in the hands of the League, eh? Well, she'll be okay as long as Svarog's around. This is truly for the best if it means helping the United Array.
As I'm sure the Ears Family already told you, the United Array is an organization created by members of both the League and the Empire to fight the demons. It was formed by veterans of the Great Astral Campaign when it became clear that the demonic threat had not been eliminated.
"United we stand, divided we fall!" That's our motto. If we don't unite, the demons will destroy both the League and the Empire. It's a pity that most of our leaders are too caught up in politics to understand. That's why our organization is a secret for now.

goal.en: Kill 6 Malevolent Demon Mages and relay the Ears Family's message to Evgeny Byvalin.

startText.en:
We'll show them! The demons will be sorry! Just imagine... The League and the Empire fighting together! Shoulder to shoulder! Just as it was forty years ago! Yes!
Imagine the things we could accomplish! Just look how many demons there are around here. Every day they continue to pour out from the ruined city. Right now we can barely hold our ground, much less defeat them.
But we'll do our best! If you care about the future of Sarnaut, join us and help us get rid of those demons. If you agree, then I suggest you start by killing six demons in the Baneful Valley. We'll go to the Tainted Valley and do the same!
When you see Eldar, tell him it's time! It's time!

checkText.en: Make sure you're very careful with the artifact. I don't feel like explaining why something so valuable was damaged.

finishText.en:
Astral take my soul! You don't have to be a genius to figure out that it's not the demons these cultists are worshipping! The demons are merely a weapon to them, one that is guided by some unknown force, the name of which the cultists don't dare speak aloud!
Maybe they don't even know that name. Either way, we were dead wrong about these fellas and their intentions! Thanks for your help, the brass back at the capital will be quite shocked to learn this.

goal.en: Read the minds of 5 cultists using the Mystical Artifact and return to Flamefist the Righteous.

startText.en:
I was sent here to provide some brains to this operation, not just brawn. We must understand these cultists, and to do that you must be a thinker, not a punisher!
I heard from Verkhovin that you're a pretty resourceful person, so I was wondering if you could help the Sentinels. We need to figure out why these nuts are willing to give their lives to serve the demons. Did the demons inflict their brains with some disease? Or are they promising them a reward?
Take this device. It was invented by the City Council and it can be used to read the mind of its target. But be warned - you are only authorized to use it on the cultists, no one else! Come back to me after you've read the minds of five cultists.

finishText.en:
Svarog Linev is asking me to make a rather difficult decision. One where I could actually be accused of treason! On the other hand, the demons are about to launch an offensive...
Their troops are waiting in the portal dimensions and our paladins are once more being besieged with magical attacks. If we don't act now, we'll all be destroyed before long. It seems as if we cannot defeat the demonic threat individually... Only together.

goal.en: Relay Svarog Linev's message to Rogneda Boykova, the League Campaign Leader.

startText.en:
It has been decided! The United Array must now act openly and directly!
We were forced to act in secrecy so as to not be accused of treason. But now that the demons are planning an attack, it's time to put all of our cards on the table. Tell Rogneda Boykova that the only way we can prevail is if we pool our forces and resources together with the Empire!

finishText.en: Our prisoner will be here any minute. You know, being captured by the enemy is no picnic. I was a POW myself a while back. That's when the Empire demanded ten captive Orcs in return for one Elf - me. The Orcs resented me for it... And I guess I can totally understand why. Anyway, my commander thought the offer was too lopsided and refused, even though feeding those Orcs was neither cheap nor easy. But then my brothers organized a raid on the enemy camp and released me!

goal.en: Meet with Leon de Grandeur at the exchange point between the Blackened Shore and the Wild Gorge.

startText.en:
Very well, I have made my decision!
We'll conduct a joint operation with the Empire. As our first step toward cooperation, we will complete a prisoner swap. Not long ago the Imperial troops captured Maxim Lukov, a scout of ours, just as we arrested one of their scouts. We will send a dispatch to the Imperial camp with instructions and the location of the designated point of exchange.
It's the halfway mark between the Imperial camp and ours. Leon de Grandeur, our overseer, is already there. Please go as quickly as possible and make sure that this exchange goes off without a hitch!

checkText.en: Wait! The exchange hasn't been completed. I'm ready for any surprises!

finishText.en: I'm glad that everything turned out well. Perhaps I was too much of a cynic. I admit, I thought that this United Array was just some ridiculous joke... Or worse - a provocation by the Empire. I didn't believe that old enemies could unite for the sake of a common goal. But now I see the purpose behind this venture!

goal.en: Wait for the prisoner exchange to be completed.

startText.en:
They'll be bringing in our scout soon, let's hope everything goes smoothly...
But I wouldn't put too much stock in the Empire's honor! Keep your eyes open and wait here until the swap has been completed. I've served many years in the army and there's no way that I can remember every single dirty trick that the Imperial forces have tried to pull just in the span of my service! They're twisted!

finishText.en: That Leon de Grandeur is as grumpy and mistrustful an Elf as you'll ever meet. So if he says that the Empire can be trusted, you can take that to the bank. If they were planning some trick, Leon would know - he has a sense for these things!

goal.en: Relay Leon de Grandeur's message to Rogneda Boykova in the League Settlement.

startText.en:
I guess it all worked out after all. You better return to Rogneda and report on the outcome!
Tell her that Leon de Grandeur is pleased with the exchange and is of the opinion that the Empire can be trusted. Now, hurry! She's waiting on my assessment of the situation!

finishText.en:
The United Array? Does our government know about this? My guess is no. If they had, I bet most of our veterans would be in jail right now!
Hm, I might be accused of treason if I start negotiations with the enemy. On the other hand, the demons are closing in on all sides and we can barely hold this camp. Should I choose a final death on this damned allod, or life in an Imperial prison? Well, I suppose the answer is obvious.

goal.en: Relay Evgeny Byvalin's message to Adam Verkhovin.

startText.en:
I have made my decision! For the sake of my daughter - no, for the sake of all of us - I must take the risk. I may be accused of treason and given the ultimate punishment by our government, but I don't care. Let them! At least I'll die knowing I did everything I could to save Sarnaut.
Go to Verkhovin and tell him about the United Array. Tell him about my part in it, and that many other veterans are backing us. Tell him that our only chance to survive on this allod is to ally with the League. As it was in the Great Astral Campaign, so it shall be again.

finishText.en:
I ain't keen on Elves. They're always so pompous and surly! It looks like the one that's representing the League in this little exchange ain't any different.
I remember when I was serving in the Holy Land my squad captured an Elf. Our commander offered the League a swap - our pointy-eared bastard in return for ten captive Orcs! One friggin' dandy for ten genuine warriors - can you imagine that? What's so special about those lanky bastards anyhow?!

goal.en: Meet with Snowdrift the Nomadic to the west of the Wild Gorge.

startText.en:
I'm ready to cooperate with the League. I think we should begin by exchanging prisoners.
From what I understand, scouts from each side were intentionally captured to open up discussions about the United Array. If this story is true and the League is ready to cooperate, then they should have no problem returning Tamara. In return, we will give the League the Kanian scout we captured.
I'm going to send a messenger to relay our terms to the League commanders. The proposed meeting place is along the coast to the west of the Wild Gorge. The exchange shall be led by Snowdrift the Nomadic on our side.
I want you to go just to make sure things go smoothly. There better not be any surprises! I'm not about to trust the League just yet. They've been known to pull some nasty tricks in the past.

checkText.en: Hold on, the exchanges not complete yet! They could still attack us at any moment!

finishText.en:
Well, all's well that ends well. What a touching scene, eh?! It seems that the "United Array" wasn't some sort of bluff! Which means they're about to get a new member - me! I'm a veteran myself, after all.
I never thought I'd find myself fighting on the same side as the League! But I suppose the demons aren't the greatest enemy right now. I'll just try and stay as far away from the Elves as possible.

goal.en: Wait for the prisoners to be exchanged.

startText.en:
I don't trust the League as far as I could throw them! And those Elves especially. This story with the "United Array" sounds pretty suspicious if you ask me. It could be some kind of trap!
You see, the last thing the League wants is for us to prevail over the demons! I'm sure their commander will do whatever they can to stop that from happening. If I were Verkhovin, I wouldn't give her the time of day.
That said, I have orders that command me to stand here all nice and patient until the exchange is complete. But don't take your eyes off the enemy - who knows what they might pull! Especially that arrogant Elf!

finishText.en:
I've been sitting here on pins and needles the whole time. I'd feel like such a fool if the League betrayed us. So, what happened?
I see. If Snowdrift trusts the League then everything is fine. Nobody could fool that old Orc. Well, now we know that this "United Array" is real. Our veterans have united with the League veterans to fight a common enemy.
After everything's over I hope our leaders will see things for what they are. We must now cooperate with Rogneda Boykova, the leader of the League troops, if we are to have a chance at winning the war against the cursed demons!

goal.en: Report the success of the prisoner exchange to Adam Verkhovin in the Imperial Settlement.

startText.en: Return to Verkhovin and tell him that the prisoner exchange was successful. This "United Array" was neither made up nor a trap. Now we need to organize a joint operation with the League and strike the enemy together! Go now while I discuss some plans with their captain.

checkText.en: Aidenus won't be happy with me taking matters into my own hands. He'll probably send me off to Siveria, where I'll spend the rest of my days shuffling through snow...

finishText.en: Excellent! The end justifies the means and success is never punished! If we didn't stop the demons, they would have destroyed us and then moved on through to the League portal network and pillaged our cities. The only thing that prevented this catastrophe was our alliance with the Empire. I will draft up a report for Aidenus, he must understand that we simply had no alternative.

goal.en: Use the Signal Flare, activate the Demonic Artifact, and channel the artifact's power for 5 minutes until the demonic portal is sealed. Search the defeated Demons' bodies for anything useful and return to Rogneda Boykova.

startText.en:
The Imperial commander, Adam Verkhovin, and I have worked out a plan. The enemy's main military forces are concentrated in the portal dimension of this demon network. Our only chance to prevent a global catastrophe is to seal them there!
Two of the network's portals are located inside our camps and the third is by the Gates. Your mission is to set this magic artifact by the third portal. The artifact is tuned to the magic of our paladins and the Imperial mages and it works in unison with their spells.
When the artifact is in place, fire a signal flare and we will commence the operation at once! But remember, the artifact must remain intact for at least five minutes - otherwise we won't be able to complete the operation. Protect it at all costs!

checkText.en: I wish I could at least steal a glance at Aidenus' treasury! I think it holds some... unimaginably powerful artifacts!

finishText.en:
Holy cow! Looking at this charged artifact I'm beginning to understand why it got its name!
You'll surely close the third portal with it. As long as you don't forget to use it when the demons attack!.

goal.en: Charge the Final Argument with magic energy by eliminating 6 Malevolent Demon Mages. Report back to the League Defenders' commander Rogneda Boykova.

startText.en:
Wait!
Before you go on the Third Portal mission, I have to tell you something else...
You can complete this quest on your own. By using magic, of course. When he sent me here, Aidenus decided to give me something from his own stash... And I think now is the proper time to put the Final Argument to use. That's the name of the artifact he gave me. But before you can use it, you must charge it with the power of six bested enemies. Malevolent Demon Mages will do just fine.

checkText.en:
Heh, those Great Mages!
They sure got a nice supply of toys... All sorts of things that will come in handy in any situation!

finishText.en:
Wow, that artifact radiates immense power!
I'm sure it can help you successfully accomplish the Third Portal mission. Just use its power when the demons start attacking you.

goal.en: Charge the Final Argument with magic energy by eliminating 6 Malevolent Demon Mages. Report back to Adam Verkhovin.

startText.en:
Before you go on the Third Portal mission, I want to tell you something.
If you don't want to share your glory with anyone, you can succeed on your own. I have a suitable artifact for that. It's called the Final Argument. Yasker himself gave it to me before sending me to this dump. "Just in case," he said.
But the artifact needs to be charged first. By killing enemies, of course. And Malevolent Demon Mages are the best creatures for this. As the manual says... Wait a sec... Right there! Six demons!
To sum up, if you decide to complete the Third Portal mission on your own, charge the Final Argument by eliminating six demons.

checkText.en: What are you still doing hanging around here? I thought you'd be out in the thick of it by now.

finishText.en: Oh! What have you there? That clearly once belonged to the demons! A trophy of war?

goal.en: Speak with Dmitry Svetlov about the Blood-Etched Key.

startText.en:
This key is covered with dark red runes and seems to be full of demonic energy... Perhaps it could be the key to the Demon City?
At any rate, it's clearly magical... If anyone could shed some light on this, it would be Dmitry Svetlov. You better go speak with him.

checkText.en: If we don't defeat the demons Yasker will have my head for this unauthorized alliance with the League. Hurry up and complete the operation!

finishText.en:
Hurray! The portal's finally sealed! Well done!
Traditionally, pacts with the enemy can only be made with the consent of Yasker himself. However, this situation was critical. We had to work with the League. They could have crushed both our settlements and then flooded into our cities, destroying the world as we know it!
In light of all that I hope that Yasker forgives my actions. I stand by my decision and will never regret it!

goal.en: Use the Signal Flare, activate the Demonic Artifact, and channel the artifact's power for 5 minutes until the demonic portal is sealed. Search the defeated cultists' bodies for anything useful and return to Adam Verkhovin.

startText.en:
Listen up. After some written correspondences Rogneda Boykova and I have put together a plan. We know that there are many demons and cultists waiting in the portal dimension until they're ordered to attack.
Out of the three portals on this allod, one is in the League settlement, one is in the Imperial settlement, and one is near the Demonic Gates. The first two have already been sealed, leaving only the third one open. If we seal that one as well, all who remain inside the portal dimension will be trapped there forever.
Take this demonic artifact. It's tuned to the demonic portals and with the help of our mages it can be used to seal one. Use this signal flare at the portal near the Demonic Gate so our mage's will know when to channel their power into it. Then use the artifact and hold it near the portal until their spells are finished.
Unfortunately, holding the artifact is going to be very exhausting. In fact, you might not even be able to move. On top of that, the enemy is certain to try and destroy the artifact. Make sure to bring your most trusted friends to help guard you during this mission.

checkText.en: Our efforts to keep the portal closed have been a huge success thanks to you! Keep up the good work!

finishText.en: A key? Give it here.

goal.en: Bring the Blood-Etched Key to Yaver Khaba.

startText.en: This key is covered with dark red runes. It seems to be full of demonic energy. Perhaps it could be the key to the demons' city? It's clearly magical, so if anyone would know the answer it would be Yaver Khaba.

checkText.en: You didn't sneak in? I thought you were more adept at stealth.

finishText.en: Glad to see you alive and well! What were you able to find out?

goal.en: Equip a Shadowy Hood, Shadowy Robe, and Shadowy Spaulders and test the Blood-Etched Key near the Demonic Gates. Report your results to Rogneda Boykova.

startText.en: A demon had this key with him...? Could it be? Could this be the key to open the Demonic Gates? The key to their city? You should check and see if it opens them! Hmm... But if they see you like that, they'll tear you to pieces... You should get a disguise for yourself!

checkText.en: Writing this report to Yasker was incredibly difficult. I hope our great leader will take all of my arguments into account. Especially if we end up winning this battle!

finishText.en: What's this? A key to the Demonic Gates? But... it didn't work, you say? Hm. Well, it's still an interesting find. Perhaps our agents back in Nezebgrad could learn something from studying it. I'll send it to them immediately. Thank you for your work!

goal.en: Equip a Shadowy Hood, Shadowy Robe, and Shadowy Spaulders and test the Blood-Etched Key near the Demonic Gates. Report your results to Adam Verkhovin.

startText.en:
This could be the key to the Demonic Gates! That Elven cultist must have been using it to get inside. This hypothesis needs to be tested immediately!
You should disguise yourself as a cultist before you try this trick. I don't want to imagine what would happen if you stumbled into their lair looking like an Imperial soldier! Steal some of their clothes and then test the key. Report your results to Verkhovin as soon as you're done!

checkText.en: Well, do you have the dragon teeth?

finishText.en: Well done! Now we have fewer enemies to worry about.

goal.en: Collect 12 Black Dragon Teeth for Veleslav Muromov.

startText.en:
Everything has been turned upside down! It's all topsy-turvy! And vice versa.
What do you know about dragons? One would think that they're all enemies of the demons, right? Well, that's how it used to be. But now? Black dragons here are working with the demons! Why? Well, I haven't the foggiest...
But let's be honest, we have never been friends with dragons. It's been like that for a long time. Maybe that's why they got along with demons. They say that even the ancient Junes hunted dragons. And now, I've heard, some are ready to challenge the Great Dragons.
But I can't entrust you with such a matter. It's dangerous. But the dragons that live on the Blackened Shore are a tasty morsel. And I'm interested in the fangs of these creatures. Why? Bring me a dozen pieces and I'll tell you why.

checkText.en: Even the ancient Zem knew how useful dragon teeth were for making weapons. We can't pass up any resources on this harsh allod.

finishText.en: Well done. These teeth will make strong and deadly weapons. Here's a reward for your trouble.

goal.en: Collect 12 Black Dragon Teeth for Sarbaz Takelot.

startText.en:
An interesting phenomenon has been observed here on Yazes Shard. Very interesting.
Here, listen.
First: The demons have always been enemies of dragons. Second: Black dragons obey other dragons. Which means they should be enemies of demons too, right?
But that's not the case. As it turns out, black dragons are allied with demons! A paradox!
I'm sure that sooner or later we'll find the reason behind this. But for now we should use this opportunity!
You see, dragons are made of some pretty tough stuff. Strong skin, sharp fangs, et cetera. Even the Great Mages had an interest in these resources. Black dragons are also quite valuable. Especially when it comes to their sharp fangs.
Bring me a dozen Fangs of Black Dragons and I will reward you.

checkText.en: That's nowhere near enough! We need more!

finishText.en: Thank you - this will help us until we can get a proper cure!

goal.en: Collect 6 measures of Evil Eye Slime for Viktoria Mekhova.

startText.en:
"Use the red with red and the blue with blue." That's what the Order of Mercy taught me. But it doesn't work here! The demonic corruption the wounds of our Defenders just won't heal! There's no stopping it - the rot is growing and taking over the healthy parts of the flesh!
The only solution that we've found to stop the spreading is to just cut off the infected limb completely! But what am I supposed to do?! I can't just let their bodies rot completely!
But I have an idea... I think that if we can use the evil eyes' slime, it can help to stop the rot. That stuff can melt a diamond! Go get me some slime and we'll see how it works!

checkText.en: I've seen the war in the Holy Land so I thought I was ready for anything. How wrong I was!

finishText.en: Thank you! Now I'll be able to save dozens of soldiers.

goal.en: Collect 6 particles of Elemental Flame from the Lava Elementals for Klara Zhilina.

startText.en:
Great Nezeb, Skrakan, and even Tensess! The wounded keep arriving and arriving. The Servants of the Light are capable of many things... but not quite miracles.
These wounds inflicted by the demons are horrific. Dark energy spreads throughout the wounded very quickly, and sometimes the only option is to amputate the infected part. Half of those who become injured end up disabled!
There is one remedy. If we cauterize the wounds with powerful flames the infections can be stopped from spreading. Such flames can be found on the fire elementals to the west. Verkhovin is too busy to send out soldiers to collect them for us, but perhaps you can help?

finishText.en: At last you're here. I was waiting for you. So, are you willing to help the Empire once again?

goal.en: Meet with Yasker in Nezebgrad.

startText.en:
Listen to me very carefully. What I'm about to tell you is top secret. Secondly, it's... well... extremely confusing. To be honest, I don't quite understand it all myself.
Recently some government officials had an important meeting. We mostly talked about demons. We heard reports about their appearance in the Holy Land, Coldberg, Avilon, and Dragon Ring.
You know, when you hear it all at once it's very unsettling. It's as if they're poking their noses everywhere, trying to destroy all of the allods. And they seem to be surrounded by necromancers and vampires! And we can't forget that Gorluxor... Argh! I hate him!
Anyway, it was officially acknowledged that the demonic threat hasn't been eliminated. They're definitely planning a new assault on Sarnaut. It was decided that they need to be dealt with immediately.
Yasker himself is in charge of this mission. All the soldiers who are chosen for it will be sworn to secrecy. If the general population found out about the demons there'd be utter chaos!
Go see Yasker immediately. He asked to speak with you personally. I'm sure he has a complicated mission and he needs a reliable soldier to do it - someone just like you.

checkText.en: I sent the best of the best to Yazes Shard. They were supposed to steal the victory over the demons from the League! And what happened in the end? They actually allied with them!

finishText.en:
Well... what's done is done. If we ignore the shocking details, this mission may be considered a success. A whole army of demons has been forever sealed in the portal dimension. The threat of imminent invasion has passed. Perhaps I'll bend the rules a little this time.
I'll instruct the propaganda department to present these events in a favorable light. Our citizens will believe the Empire played the leading role in this victory. Thank you for bringing me this report.

goal.en: Go to Nezebgrad and give Yasker Verkhovin's Report and the Blood-Etched Key.

startText.en:
Please go to Yasker and give him my latest report as well as this strange key. Let's hope that he forgives us for our cooperation with the League. I know that your service to the Empire has been very great, so I'm sure he'll be more understanding if you're the messenger.
Before you go I'd like to officially thank you for all you've done on Yazes Shard. We're far from winning this battle, but thanks to you we've been able to hold our ground. May Nezeb watch over you!

finishText.en: This must be important if Yasker gave you emergency clearance to this information. Well, let me try and tell you everything we know.

goal.en: Speak with Elizaveta Rysina at the bottom of Yasker's Tower.

startText.en:
So, what do we have so far?
Frankly, very little. First of all, our soldiers are still on the defensive. Secondly, while this key would be very valuable if it opened the Demonic Gates, right now it does nothing.
 What's that? Perhaps it only works with those who have proven their loyalty? Some sort of attunement, eh? Hm... Well, the City Council knows a good deal about these cultists. They might not have the answer to this problem, but I'm sure they'll have some clues to a solution.
Visit Elizaveta Rysina and ask her to tell you everything she knows about the cultists. We must get into their main city!

checkText.en: Yes?...

finishText.en: Hm, the flesh of Mor'Ghuun, the papers of Tep cultists, and one of Tep's devices. Well done. The master will be pleased with your work.

goal.en: Go to Yazes Shard, summon a demon along the northeastern shore, and give him all of the information about Tep.

startText.en:
You now need to make contact with this "master". More precisely, with his henchmen. You have to give them everything you gathered from all of your heroic adventures.
Fortunately the Teonomicon lists a way to get in contact with them. You need to go back to Yazes Shard. On the northeastern shore there is a place where they conduct rituals. If you use the ritualistic dagger to make a cut in your palm at this location, one of the demons will be drawn to you.
Hm. I don't know much about the demons' customs. It's probably best for you not to say anything. Just bow your head, give them the items, and see what the demon says. Hopefully they'll give you a key to the Demonic Gate.

checkText.en: Did something important happen? Speak!

finishText.en:
This news is both wonderful and terrifying. It's good that we can finally get into our enemies' main headquarters. We'll finally be able to put them on the defensive.
But this also means the beginning of a larger war - one against the demons and whoever their master is. The future will be filled with much bloodshed. I hope you will continue to serve your country in these dark times.

goal.en: Return to Yasker with the Blood-Etched Key and the Ritualistic Dagger.

startText.en:
Take this key to the Demonic Gates. You've earned a place among the elite. But remember that more will be expected of you now. And the master does not tolerate failure!
I expect you to report to the Fortified Courtyard within the hour. You'll receive new orders when you get there. Now go.

checkText.en: Familiarize yourself with all the documents. You must know your enemy!

finishText.en: Now you know as much as we do. That means it's time to enact the next part of the plan.

goal.en: Read the three books about the demons and the cultists and return to Elizaveta Rysina.

startText.en:
The cultists and the demons go to great lengths to protect their secrets. They're fanatics willing to die for their ideals, but unfortunately we don't know what they are.
I must admit that after the closure of the June Portal I thought the demonic threat had been eliminated. Since then we haven't paid much attention to the cultists, but perhaps we were wrong.
We have a few documents around the office that summarize our knowledge and them and the demons. I grant you permission to read them.
Make sure to look at "The History of the Demon Invasion", "The Origins of the Cultists", and "Excerpts from the Teonomicon".

checkText.en: Don't draw too much attention to me! I'm just supposed to be an ordinary citizen.

finishText.en: Outstanding work! It seems the poor devil doesn't even understand what happened!

goal.en: Head to the monument in Victory Park and use the Advanced Paralyzer on the cultists' leader.

startText.en:
We know that there's many cultists right here in Nezebgrad and we recently captured one of them. He's being held by the City Council in a magical field that prevents him from committing suicide.
We haven't learned much from interrogating him. From what we have determined he's only recently joined their ranks. That means he doesn't know much anyway. The most interesting thing that we've found out is that the cultists have a list of their enemies. The list is apparently quite long and even has your name on it.
Since the cultists want you dead that means you'll make excellent bait. I'll have the media make an urgent announcement that the Imperial Survivor has returned to the capital. We'll say you're making a pilgrimage to the memorial in Victory Park.
As soon as you get there the cultists should attack you. When they do our agents will come out of hiding and attack them. Our goal is to capture their leader. He'll definitely try to commit suicide, so use this paralyzer on him immediately. Then we can take him into custody!

finishText.en: You did a great job! The plan worked perfectly. We already have our best agents interrogating the cultist. Let me fill you in on the details.

goal.en: Return to Elizaveta Rysina at the bottom of Yasker's Tower.

startText.en: It's unsettling to know there are cultists among our ranks. The faster we expose them the better. Return to Rysina and report on the success of this operation. I'm sure she'll have further orders for you.

checkText.en: Faster! It won't take long for the cultists to find out what's going on!

finishText.en: Excellent! We finally have a complete copy of the Teonomicon! Maybe we can finally discover the cultists' intentions.

goal.en: Go to the cultists' house in the Astral Quarter, retrieve the Teonomicon and the Ritualistic Dagger, and bring them to Elizaveta Rysina.

startText.en:
With the use of psionic powers our agents have already discovered something important.
Apparently the cultist has a complete copy of the Teonomicon is his house! This is an extremely important document. It must be retrieved as quickly as possible before his allies remove all the evidence. His home is located in the Astral Quarter. Go there and find this book.
Also look for a certain knife. We're not sure why it's important, but the prisoner is constantly thinking about it. It might be used in important rituals.

finishText.en: You must gain the cultists' trust at any costs. You need to gain the power of this "Seventh Circle" so that you can get past the Demonic Gates. That means you're going to help them with this mission. Gather information about Tep for their master. I think I know a few places you should start looking.

goal.en: Ask Elizaveta Rysina about her conclusions.

startText.en:
Hmm... this isn't just a book. There are dates, summaries about the cult, demons, missions... It appears to be more like a diary of their activities!
Let's flip to the part about their most recent mission... It says that some "master" ordered them to find Tep. Apparently his power could make him an ally or a problem. The passage goes on to say that this "master" ordered them to gather information about Tep.
Apparently those who aide in this task will be granted access to a "Seventh Circle". It seems to be some sort of elite privilege. I wonder if it would allow you to enter the Demonic Gates. Hmm, I need to think about what all this means.

finishText.en: There you are. I've been expecting you. Listen carefully because I must share matters of great importance with you.

goal.en: Meet with the Great Mage Aidenus in Novograd.

startText.en:
There's something terrible transpiring. Let's look at the clues... The demons teamed up with a necromancer in Coldberg to try to destroy the allod and deprive us of our meteorite ore. That was only the beginning.
Next, the demons teamed up with the vampires in Avilon to try and destroy another allod... the one controlled by the Great Mage Zayan and the Historians.
Their third target was the Great Dragon who controls Dragon Ring in and attempt to destroy yet another allod. You see, a Great Dragon can uphold an allod just as well as a Great Mage and meteorite ore.
And can you remember what happened before all that? The Sites of Power in the Holy Land all got defiled, Gorluxor started his uprising, and Tensess himself asked us to unite against the demonic threat!
Are you sensing a pattern here? It's possible that the demonic threat hasn't yet been neutralized! Keep your mouth shut about it - there's no need to start spreading panic! We'll need to check it out more first. Go speak with Aidenus about what needs to be done next. I believe that he's been looking for you.

checkText.en: Now, that's some news! I knew that Rogneda would have no trouble with those damned demons with you at her side! What I didn't expect was that the whole thing would end in a joint operation with Imperial forces.

finishText.en:
It's interesting that the Empire would agree to a plan such as this...
Hah! I bet that Yasker is having a fit right about now. And I would be too if not for the extraordinary circumstances on Yazes Shard. Decisions on joint action and cooperation are to be made by me and not the commanders!
But I suppose that this is a case where the ends justify the means... The threat of invasion has been eliminated and the demon army is forever locked in their own portal. This is a great victory!

goal.en: Return to Novograd and give Aidenus Rogneda Boykova's Report and the Blood-Etched Key.

startText.en:
I need you to deliver the key to the Demonic Gates with my report of our successful operation to Aidenus at once!
I hope our collaboration with the Empire won't be cause for any punishment... After all, this was done for the greater good!
But I don't need to tell any of this to you! I've already explained everything in the letter, so please take it to Aidenus right away. Good luck!

finishText.en: Greetings. I was told that you were coming.

goal.en: Speak with Marianne de Ardeur, the Divine Prioress, about the cultists.

startText.en:
What do we know about this City? Hmm... Unfortunately, not much.
Our troops are still on the defensive out there and this key does nothing. Well, not "nothing." It did tell you that you weren't worthy enough to enter. Perhaps it only works for those that have proven their loyalty?
If there's anyone who knows anything about those cultists, it's the Church. They might not have all the answers, but even a tiny clue is better than nothing. Go speak with Marianne.

checkText.en: Yes? Why have you called me?

finishText.en: The flesh of Mor'Ghuun, a Tep device, and the papers on the Tep incident at ZIT... The Master will be pleased with your work.

goal.en: Return to Yazes Shard and use the Obsidian Sacrificial Knife to make a blood offering to the Astral on the shore of the Baneful Valley.

startText.en:
Now for the most important job – it's time to call on the "Master." You must offer all that you've obtained - Mor'Ghuun's flesh, the necromantic device, and the ZIT's papers - to the Master.
Listen up and follow my instructions carefully. The Teonomicon says you must return to Yazes Shard and visit the shore of the Baneful Valley. There you will use the Obsidian knife to offer your blood as a gift to the Astral. After that, a demon will appear and you will give him your items.
What happens next is unknown... I will pray for you! Good luck!

checkText.en: Did something happen? Well, don't delay, speak up!

finishText.en:
This news is both wonderful and terrifying. Once inside, we'll finally be able to put them on the defensive.
But this also means the beginning of a larger war - one against the demons and their master. Our future will be filled with much bloodshed...

goal.en: Return to Aidenus with the Blood-Etched Key and the Obsidian Sacrificial Knife.

startText.en:
Take this key to the Demonic Gates. You've earned your place among the elite.
But remember, more will be expected of you from now on and the master does not tolerate failure!
I expect you to report to the Fortified Courtyard within the hour. You'll receive new orders once you arrive. Now go.

checkText.en: Have you read everything?

finishText.en: Wonderful. Now you know as much as we do.

goal.en: Read The History of the Demon Invasion, The Origins of the Cultists, and Excerpts from the Teonomicon and speak with Marianne de Ardeur.

startText.en:
You want more information about the cultists? Well, we don't have much on them but I do have some notes that might help.
I suggest that you read three books that we have on the subject.
First, The History of the Demon Invasion – it's a chronological account from when we first discovered the Astral portals to the state of the demons today.
Second, The Origins of the Cultists – our own private notes that members of the Church have taken on the subject. There are many gaps in our information, but it's the best we have.
Finally, Excerpts from the Teonomicon - the cultists' sacred book. It describes their great mission in depth. It's a terrifying but necessary read.

checkText.en: It's such a shame. Foma was such a good boy in church... I pray to the Light for his soul!

finishText.en: Excellent! Their attack on you is just a matter of time!

goal.en: Post the announcement on the Bulletin Board, visit Foma Upryamov, and return to Marianne de Ardeur.

startText.en:
We know there's a cultist sect in our very own capital, but we haven't been able to trace them yet.
One of their most important artifacts is a sacrificial knife, and it was recently stolen from them by one of our agents. My suggestion is to spread a rumor that you stole it. They'll hear that rumor and come looking for you immediately!
First we'll need to post a flyer about the theft on the bulletin board and describe a suspect that matches your description... This will make the claim look more legitimate.
Then you'll need to pay a visit to Foma Upryamov, our resident trafficker, and offer to let him buy the stolen artifact from you. The cultists keep in touch with the trafficker, so they'll hear about this news right away. Return to me when you're done.

checkText.en: Those cultists think they're so smart... Tee hee.

finishText.en: Oh! There you are. Do you think they bought it?

goal.en: Speak with Foma Upryamov and place the Magic Mark on the cultists' Leader when they attack. Die and then return to Marianne de Ardeur.

startText.en:
I have a new task for you. I want you to visit the trafficker - I'd be willing to bet that the cultists are already lying in wait for you there.
But the cultists are known for their fanaticism... even if they can be taken prisoner, they won't say a word! They say that they'd rather die.
So here's what I propose... I want you to take this magic mark and secure it to the leader of the bunch. But then you'll have to die – and make it look convincing!
After your resurrection, return to the church for new instructions. That magical mark will help us to follow the cultists and stake out their lair. Here, take this dagger with you for added credibility - the cultists won't suspect a thing.

checkText.en: Hurry - the cultists are not fools! They'll soon discover the mark!

finishText.en: Excellent - thanks to these documents, we'll be able to learn much more about the cultists.

goal.en: Find and penetrate the Cultists' Lair, retrieve the Knife, and find any and all information regarding the cultists.

startText.en:
Look! The magic mark is working! Now we know where those cultists are hiding!
You want to get even with those cultists for killing you, right?
Well then, you better get over to their hideout! It looks like they're holed up in the Trade District, near the monument to the Great Mage! Scoundrels!
You need to break in and search their lair. We need documents, books, and letters, anything that will help us to understand who they are and what they're after. And, of course, retrieve the sacrificial knife. Hurry, now!

finishText.en:
Okay, so, the leaders of the cultists groups have been given an order to gather as much information possible on Tep. It seems as if Tep is the only person capable of preventing the "Master" from carrying out his plans.
It looks like Marcel de Doucer was promised a spot in the seventh round, whatever that is, as a reward for bringing Tep in as an ally!

This is exactly what we need! You'll need to play the part of Marcel de Doucer... You'll carry out the orders of this mysterious "Master" and infiltrate the Demonic Gates! Tensess forgive us for going down the path of darkness... But this is all in the name of the Light!

goal.en: Wait while Marianne de Ardeur checks the other copies of the Teonomicon.

startText.en:
I don't understand... This is exactly the same as what we already know. Look, these are pages from the Teonomicon!
Oh... Wait, there's more. Why, it's a journal! It even has a record of orders and reports. This changes everything!
I bet that each cultist has his own journal like this that gets destroyed during the first sign of danger. We must examine all the copies of the Teonomicon that we have! Stay right here, this'll be quick.

checkText.en: Reinforcements? How timely!

finishText.en:
Right now there are more demons and cultists than we could have imagined. On our very first day here half of the troops were lost. Since then we've been on the defensive.
To the west of here are a group of League soldiers. The League somehow found out about our operation here and sent their best forces to battle these agents of darkness. But Yasker hopes that we will be the ones to destroy the demons. It would be a grand victory for the Empire!
Unfortunately, there's a long way to go before we're victorious. This certainly won't be easy.

goal.en: Use the Scroll of Teleportation to travel to Yazes Shard and meet with Adam Verkhovin.

startText.en:
It is now time to address the heart of the matter. The keys you found at Avilon allowed the demons and their minions to us our teleportation network. We used the key of Armando de Doucer to pinpoint the location he had been visiting most often. It appears that it's some remote allod named Yazes Shard.
It used to be a large Imperial allod, but it was captured by the demons during the Great Astral Campaign and over the years most of it was destroyed by the Astral. However, it's still a sizeable piece of land and it's now the home of one of our greatest enemies - Gorluxor.
We believe that most of the cultists and demons are concentrated on this allod. At their head is Gorluxor who's using them in his plots for world domination. We're sure the demons are using him for their own purposes as well, but at the moment we're uncertain of their motives.
I've already sent some troops to the allods to complete a secret operation codenamed "The Phantom Menace". You are now a member of this team and are to report to Yazes Shard immediately.
This scroll of teleportation will take you directly to our main base. Once you're there, speak to General Adam Verkhovin. He'll give you further instructions.

checkText.en: Did Aidenus send you to help? Excellent!

finishText.en:
We really didn't expect to find so many demons and cultists here... They nearly pushed us into the Astral. Our only goal for the moment is survival.
Those demons out there are preparing for a new invasion, they want to get rid of us! Their attacks are non-stop! Fortunately, a good chunk of the demons are distracted by the Imperial paratroopers working the eastern shore.
Yes, Imperial intelligence has also found out about Yazes Shard and Yasker deployed a squad to this area. We're trying to steer clear of them - Aidenus wants us to be the ones to deal with this demon problem. Our victory will consolidate the League's prestige. Unfortunately, it'll be very difficult to win this battle.

goal.en: Use the Scroll of Teleportation to travel to Yazes Shard and meet with Rogneda Boykova, the League Campaign Leader.

startText.en:
The keys you recovered from Armando de Doucer's teleporter has helped our intelligence to gain access the demons' portal network. It looks like most of their activity leads to Yazes Shard – an allod formerly under control of the Empire.
A squad of paratroopers has already been deployed to the allod and is headed by Rogneda Boykova. When they got there, they found many demons and cultists as well as the home of our greatest enemy - Gorluxor's Tower.
There's no doubt that this place is their headquarters. There Gorluxor leads his large army of demons and cultists in an attempt at world domination. We're sure the demons are using him too, but we're not sure what their goals are.
This operation has been classified as top secret and given the name the codename "A New Hope." We hope that one day soon, we can clear the world of this demonic plague. You are to join this team of soldiers immediately. Take this scroll - it will teleport you to Yazes shard. Once there, report to Commander Rogneda Boykova for more information.

checkText.en: The Citadel is great but it is nothing compared to the true magnificence that the Master is capable of.

finishText.en: How do you like the Citadel? It is one of the Master's great masterpieces, but not the greatest!

goal.en: Read the info on signposts in the Trade District, on the Terrace of Truth and in the Master's Sanctuary. Also, meet the Keepers.

startText.en:
The Master, also known as the director of the greatest play in the world, is glad to see you in his Citadel!
No more games... Soon playing will turn into reality and maybe you will play the leading part. There will be some serious disturbances in Sarnaut, but here, in the Master's Citadel, you will be safe. Look around. Here you will find everything that a Seeker of Truth like you may need.
The Bank and Auction operate without delay, in spite of the huge distance between here and the capital Allod. You will find everything you might need in the Trade District.
The Astral Academy Gates will lead you to the Hangar where your Astral Ship is kept.
On the Terrace of Truth you will meet the Keepers, who will guide you in your search for truth. They are the voice of the Master!
In the Master's Sanctuary hovering above the Citadel, Seekers of Truth can take a rest while thinking and observing.
The only door which you cannot open leads to the Master's Chamber. Maybe in the future, as you begin to understand more things, this door will open and you will meet the Master himself.
Take a walk, look around. You will have to spend a lot of time in the Citadel, as the path to enlightenment is long and winding. Don't forget to meet the Keepers on the Terrace of Truth. They can tell you more about the part you are to play in the greatest play in the world.

checkText.en: I am the Ambassador of Demon Hunters. We have made peace with the Draconids, but there are still some misunderstandings between us...

finishText.en: Did the Keeper of Strength send you? Does he really think that you can handle these scaly beasts? Oh, those bastards... Well, I really may need your help right now. These scaly things don't want to obey me at all!

goal.en: Take the Astral Boat, travel to Draconid Island and meet Alexey Borodin, the Ambassador of the Hunters.

startText.en:
I am the Keeper of Strength. When something needs to be done by strength, the Master speaks through me.
Our Master has a lot of enemies in this world but he is always willing to accept friendship and shake hands with those who accept this friendship sincerely. Demon Hunters are the Master's Friends and our loyal allies. With this in mind, I have a task for you.
As you remember, Hunters swore to be allies of Soliskar the Wise on Dragon Ring. Draconids honor Great Dragons as Gods and follow their orders without question. Draconids hate Demons and can be very valuable allies... if only we would try to understand each other. This is the mission Hunters are carrying out on Draconids Island. Their progress has been rather poor so far.
Go to Draconid Island and meet Alexey Borodin, the Ambassador of the Hunters. He is trying to get on track with a local tribe of Draconids, but they are rather arrogant and hot-tempered. He will be glad to receive your help. If Draconids start to trust us, the Master will be pleased.

checkText.en: What are you waiting for? Are you so excited by the importance of your mission that you can't breathe?

finishText.en:
So, here is your companion. He's kinda small... for a Draconid, of course. Oops, my words may offend him... Indeed, he looked at me with such contempt!
Be careful, don't repeat my mistakes. Draconids don't know the meaning of many words, but they can understand intonation well. Please, be polite with them, but not too much. Let them know who is boss!

goal.en: Use the Signal Horn to summon your Draconid Companion and talk to Alexey Borodin.

startText.en:
I don't like these Draconids... I don't like them at all! They are hot-tempered and vehement. If something goes wrong they are always ready to jump on your throat! Be careful with them. Try even not to look at them. If they don't like anything about you, they will eat you! Though, I must admit, they are skillful warriors. In the upcoming battle against the Demons they will be very helpful.
So, we have no choice. Like it or not, but we have to make friends with them.
First of all, we must understand whether we can fight side by side with the Draconids. You need to see how they fight and understand if we can fight together. Prove to those scaly lizards that we know how to fight!
Here, take this horn. It is a battle horn used by Draconid scouts to send signals over a large distance. Use it to summon a Draconid to fight by your side. You will have to fight and cover each other's back. I want to be sure that you will be able to cooperate in battle. But first of all you need training.
Summon your Draconid Companion to continue our training.

checkText.en: How do you like your companion? Yes, he is vehement and willful... But he is strong and agile!

finishText.en: So, Draconids can fight in a team. Well, that's good. Let's proceed to the second part of training!

goal.en: Summon your Draconid Companion and kill 5 Searing Eye Elders with his help.

startText.en:
So, listen carefully. Draconids are hot-tempered and undisciplined. You need to learn how to fight as a team.
Let's start with an easy task. You need to defeat a weak opponent together.
