Don't forget that Draconids don't like to obey commands and they are very willful. So, don't even think that he will follow your commands.
Now let's see if he comes to help you in battle and what he will do.
Your task is to summon your Draconid Companion and kill 5 Searing Eye Elders on this island. These Searing Eyes see almost nothing, so they don't attack first and are very easy to kill even by a novice fighter.
Objectives clear? Go!

checkText.en: Tactics are my forte! I was a sergeant in the Imperial Army before I joined the Hunters! Hup, two, three, four! Oh, that was so much fun...

finishText.en: Well, these Draconids are not stupid! I didn't expect that... Oops, I've done it again. I think I may need to change my point of view about this alliance. If trained enough, these scaly guys may become true soldiers!

checkText.en: So, you failed to defeat Ghash, did you? Of course... He is a ton and five hundred kilos of pure aggression!

finishText.en:
You surprised me... I heard you fighting. Even mountains trembled! So, you defeated Ghash, right? Great news!
Maybe, if necessary, we can make Draconids and Dragons enemies... Who knows what will happen in the future? No, I don't mean to break the alliance, but... I don't trust them! I don't believe in their loyalty! Well, it's not your problem, anyway.
But you did well! You defeated such a beast. Here is your reward. Your training is complete. Good luck to you, warriors!

goal.en: Summon Draconid Companion and defeat Ghash, leader of the Dragons.

startText.en:
Hey, you and your scaly friend are extremely good for sabotage missions! Once you have a little more training I can send you into battle even against the most dangerous enemy.
By the way, your next opponent is very dangerous. I am talking about Ghash, leader of the Dragons, who lives in the mountains to the north of here.
Don't be afraid, it is a training fight. Draconids are related to Dragons, so, they won't kill each other. They didn't say anything about other races, though... But I believe in you!
This fight has two objectives; the second one is a hidden one... If we defeat Ghash, the strongest of all Dragons, we will show our allies that we are ready for actions and that we are strong!
So, your task is to find Ghash's lair and to defeat him together with your companion. If you succeed, it means that you have nothing left to learn and your training will be complete.

checkText.en: Hush-sh-sh... Me wait your oath!

finishText.en: Good! Me swear - you listen! You swear - me listen! Both swear. Both friends. Share food. Share woman. Share enemy. My hand is your hand!

goal.en: Confirm that you are ready to swear to be a friend to your Draconid Companion.

startText.en:
Hush-sh-sh... Meatbag... You not another. Another is weak. You are strong! Me want to be friends with you! Not obey. Not follow. To friend! Like strong with strong!
Me swear. Me swear to be friend forever! Me want to be your blood brother. Like strong to strong!
You want to swear oath of friendship? You want to be friend and brother? Like strong to strong?

checkText.en: You bring tails? No? Why you wait? You not want to be friends?

finishText.en:
Hush-sh-sh... Good! You make blood and bring me tails. Me also make blood. Here! Three handfuls of feet. Me go and kill someone like you. You go and kill someone like me. It is right!
You angry? You be not angry! Meatbag is your old fathers. Scaly is my old fathers. Kill your old fathers is bad. No need. This is why friends. Friends and brothers help each other. Me shame kill my fathers - you do it. You shame kill your fathers - me do it. Friends and brothers!

goal.en: Kill 8 Lizards and bring their tails to your Draconid Companion to prove your oath.

startText.en:
Me swear. You swear. Good!
But swear an oath is not enough. Me talk little, do many. Do is good! Talk is bad! You do and me also do. Then we brothers and friends! Swear an oath prove with blood!
You go find lizards. Kill lizards, bring me tails! Bring three handfuls of tails! Me also go and kill. Bring you feet. You strong, me strong. We brothers and friends!

checkText.en: Hydra is tasty. Your food not tasty. Nut friends and brothers always share food! Me be patient. You be patient. Friends and brothers!

finishText.en:
You, friend and brother, drink hydra blood! Tasty!
Me eat your food. Dump... Dump... Dumpling! Two handfuls of dumplings! Dumpling is bad food. Not tasty. Me eat your food. You eat my food. Friends and brothers!

goal.en: Drink 8 sips of Swamp Hydra Blood and return to your Draconid Companion. The Hydras can be found near Rusty Saltings.

startText.en:
Me do blood. You also do blood. Oath bound with blood. Good! But need more!
Need eat food. Brothers and friends always share food. You go find my food and eat! Me also go find your food and eat. Not like your food, but need eat. Swear. Brothers and friends!
You go to big island! Go to swamp! You kill hydra! Hydra is tasty! Gulp! You drink hydra blood. Two handfuls drink! Hydra blood tasty! But drink blood fast! When you find blood - drink!
Me also go and find your food to eat! Friends and brothers share food!

checkText.en: You kill my enemy. Me kill your enemy. Brothers and friends share blood, share food and share enemy!

finishText.en:
Hush-sh-sh... brother and friend! You kill worm-on-face! You help me much. You are true brother and friend!
Me tell all you are strong. You are brother and friend. My brother-at-birth want talk to my brother and friend. Want talk you! There my friend brother stand. Talk to he!

goal.en: Collect Mushroom Smokers from the stumps near the Citadel and throw them through the Wormfaces' ventilation grates in the Hissing Canyon. Kill 8 Wormfaces after stinking them out with smoke and return to your Draconid Companion.

startText.en:
We share food? Yes! Food make oath strong!
We share blood? Yes! Blood make oath strong!
My hand is your hand! We brothers and friends!
Brother and friend. You listen me. Me tell you secret. Me fight demons. You know! Me worm-on-face kill! You not know? You know!
Me hate worm-on-face. Hush-sh-sh... Worm-on-face my enemy! Our enemy! Old, old enemy! Meatbags not born my fathers worm-on-faces fight. Always fight!
You help me? Me kill worm-on-face! Me revenge! Me have fun! Kill worm-on-face go-o-o-od!
Worm-on-face hide in ground. Me know worm-on-face afraid smoke! You find mushroom! Find Mushroom Smoker. Mushroom grow on old stump. You throw mushroom in ground hole. Worm-on-face not like smoke. They go out. Worm-on-face want smoke away. You kill worm-on-face! Kill two... No, kill three handfuls! Brother and friend, kill worm-on-face. Three handfuls. Me also help you then. You say I kill three handful!

checkText.en: Have you found anything out?

finishText.en:
Well, as I thought. Bandits hide very well...
Well, sooner or later we'll find their den, catch them and send them to court, quickly and fairly.

goal.en: Ask settlers of the island about Bandits, then return to the Citadel Keeper.

startText.en:
Greetings!
I want to ask if you know anything about the Ghost Hunters.
They are true heroes! They are a team which formed quite recently, but they already have a good reputation. They catch restless souls who couldn't return to their bodies and turned into ghosts. It is a chivalrous thing to do. They bring rest to the dead and protect those who are alive!
Recently the Ghost Hunters came to this island to help us to get rid of the ghosts of astral pirates who roam by the wreck of the astral ship to the east of here. Unfortunately, they failed.
First of all, there are too many ghosts.
Second, a gang of bandits, or "adventurers with sticky fingers" if you like, is looking for the treasure which is rumored to be hidden in the astral ship's cargo hold. They call themselves Treasure Seekers but bandits are always bandits no matter what you call them. Now these bandits are hiding somewhere by the ruins and they bother the Ghost Hunters and don't let them approach the ship. These greedy cutthroats understand that rumors about the treasure are just rumors, but ghosts, on the other hand, are really dangerous. What is even worse is that almost all newcomers believe these rumors about the treasure and join the bandits. You are not one of them, right?
Then I have a mission for you. I know some rascals who joined the bandits' gang.
Take a walk on the island and ask if anyone has seen them. Maybe we will find their hideout.
If you get any information, come to see me again.

checkText.en: Have you found the ingredients which the Ghost Hunters need for the spell?

finishText.en:
Well done!
I will give these ingredients to the Hunters and they will start the ghost hunt.
I hope that after all the ghosts are trapped nobody will groan in the Citadel at night or sing dirty sailor songs.

goal.en: Find the Ichor of the Undead from the Undeads infesting the ruins of the Granite Madness, and the Ghostly Warthog's Ectoplasm and Searing Eye's Ooze from near the Master's Citadel. Bring the collected ingredients to the Citadel's Keeper.

startText.en:
The Ghost Hunters asked me for help. Their Soul Traps require a basic Ectoplasm Charge which creates a defensive field to keep the captured ghosts inside. They also asked for some other ingredients for a spell to calm the ghosts down.
The problem is that the Ghost Hunters are very busy and the bandits looking for treasure at the wrecked ship are causing lots of problems.
To cut a long story short, the Ghost Hunters asked me to bring them the Ectoplasm and other ingredients but I have to ask for your help.
The Ghost Hunters need the Ichor of the Undead from the Undeads infesting the ruins of the Granite Madness and the Ghostly Warthog's Ectoplasm and Searing Eye's Ooze from near the Master's Citadel.
Can you help the Ghost Hunters find these ingredients and bring them to me? Of course, I will give you a generous reward.

checkText.en: Gold fever makes everyone lose their head... As a wise man from the past and from another world said, "People die for metal" - and he was right!

finishText.en:
All four are dead? Good.
No, I'm not happy when sentient beings die, but these bandits crossed the line! Gold fever makes their minds blind...

goal.en: Find and kill four Treasure Seekers hiding somewhere on the island. Then return to the Citadel's Keeper.

name.en: Helping the Ghost Hunters: Preventive Hit

startText.en:
The Ghost Hunters told me that they are almost ready to start the hunt. I hope that they succeed and that the ghosts never bother us again.
I am worried about the band of Treasure Seekers. They will definitely try to get in the Ghost Hunters' way. We must strike a preventive hit.
As far as I know, bandits have some hideouts on the island where they meet before a raid. I don't know how many hideouts there are on the island or where they'll be meeting today... My scouts reported about 4 Treasure Seekers but they were spotted and ran away.
If you want to help me you will have to run around the island. Four Treasure Seekers are hiding somewhere on the Island. Find and kill all bandits planning the raid! Only when the Ghost Hunters are sure that nobody will interrupt them will they start their ghost hunt.

checkText.en: So, how is it going?

finishText.en: So, a scroll with ancient knowledge will immediately give you some experience points. If you choose the certificate, you can participate in an exciting hunt. Some people want to receive everything right now, and others don't look for easiest way... You are to choose.

goal.en: Complete the tasks of Citadel's Keeper and choose your reward.

name.en: Helping the Ghost Hunters: Tough Choice

startText.en:
Have you met the Ghost Hunters? These guys arrived here to catch the lost sparks that disturb the living ones.
Their leader, Iron Hoof the minotaur is searching for help, but first he needs to make sure the candidate can be trusted. If you help the Ghost Hunters to get rid of the bandits and find the ingredients for their potion, Iron Hoof will welcome you at the hunt.
Ghost hunt is honorable but not easy. It can only occur at nighttime. When you complete my tasks, you will have to decide if you want to receive your reward at once or participate in the hunt. Destroy the bandits and collect the components, and I will give you either a Ghost Hunter's Credentials that invite you to the hunt, or a valuable scroll with ancient knowledge.
I have just one more thing to add: if you take part in the hunt and the hunt is successful, your reward will be much more precious. But such a hunt is not for everyone...

checkText.en: So-o-o? Ho-o-ow did you like the hunt? It was so-o-o exciting, right? And also very useful for everyone!

finishText.en:
Wo-o-ow, you are go-o-od! We caught so-o-o many ghosts with your help!
So-o-o, here is your reward. If you want to go on hunting, talk to me!

goal.en:
Using the Ghost Trap, catch 30 ghosts haunting the Astral Coast near the wrecked ship and release them in the Spectral Prison. Then talk to Iron Hoof.
To catch a Ghost, reduce its health to 25% and use two artifacts. Different types of Ghosts require different artifacts.
You should use the Astral Splitter and Spectral Energy Absorber to catch a Shipwright's Ghost.
To catch a Cannoneer's Ghost, you will need a Spectral Energy Absorber and High-Frequency Generator.
To catch a Steersman's Ghost, you should use a High-Frequency Generator and Astral Splitter.
These devices can be used in any order. After you have used two devices use Ghost Trap to catch a ghost.

startText.en:
Let the hunt begin!
Have you-u-u ever hunted ghoo-o-osts before? If it is your first hunt, talk to me, I'll explain the details to you-u-u. Now listen.
Ghosts haunt the coast near the wrecked ship but sometimes penetrate into ru-u-uins. There are a lot of ru-u-uins here. You must catch at least 30 Ghosts. The more the better. Why at least 30 Ghosts? Because you-u-u can't keep mo-o-ore ghosts in a portable trap. When you have caught enough, bring them here. This ro-o-ound glo-o-owing thing next to me isn't just a thing! It is Spectral Prison. It can contain thousands of Gho-o-osts! Or maybe less, I didn't check... A couple of hundred, for sure!
So, you go and catch the ghosts. When you have caught 30 gho-o-osts, approach the Prison and release them there. When you are done, talk to me and I will give you your reward. If you want to go-o-o on, you are welcome! There are enough ghosts for everyone!
As one of my friends says, the mo-o-ore you bring - the mo-o-ore you get!
Remember, you need an Astral Splitter and Spectral Energy Abso-o-orber to catch a Shipwright's Gho-o-ost. If you are after a Cannoneer's Gho-o-ost, prepare your Spectral Energy Abso-o-orber and High-Frequency Generator. To catch a Steersman's Gho-o-ost you need the Generator and the Splitter. Do-o-on't forget the Trap!

finishText.en:
So-o-o, you are the hero who helped us to get rid of the Treasure Seekers and found the required reagents for the ritual? Well, thank you-u-u!
There is a saying in the Dead Sea region that you can't drink "thanks" fro-o-om a bottle... so I think everybo-o-ody will support me if I give you a share of the go-o-old found on the ship. but don't tell anyone there was gold on the ship, otherwise do-o-ozens of idiots will jo-o-oin the Treasure Seekers and they will finally drive us away fro-o-om here. We still haven't completed o-o-our mission here.
Do-o-o you really want to participate in the hunt? We hunt ghosts every night and give abundant rewards to those who-o-o catch them! To-o-o take part in the hunt you need our trust and Credentials. I don't want a Treasure Seeker to pretend to be our friend, only to break our valuable equipment.
So-o-o, every time you will have to bring us new Credentials. Nothing personal, we need this fo-o-or o-o-our safety. Only then can we be sure that you are our friend!

goal.en: Bring Ghost Hunter's Credentials to Iron Hoof.

kickText.en: Why are you disturbing me? I am busy! I have no-o-o time for stupid questions!

startText.en:
So, now you have the Ghost Hunter's Credential, you can participate in the Ghost Hunt!
Believe me, it is a very important mission and the Ghost Hunters don't reveal their secrets to any stranger. They are proud and cautious. You have proved your loyalty and gained Credentials... don't waste your chance now.
By taking part in the hunt you are not only helping the Citadel, but also securing the coast against annoying ghosts and earning valuable experience which will help you in your future adventures. Of course, the Ghost Hunters will reward you!
Go to the Ghost Hunter's Camp. Iron Hoof, their leader, is waiting for you.
He has problems with remembering faces. Just show him the paper with your name, otherwise he wouldn't even want to talk to you.

checkText.en: Are you the new one?

finishText.en: You have the great honor of hearing the Truth from the Master himself!

goal.en: Get aboard the Astral Barge and go on a journey. Listen to Gorislav carefully. He might want to tell you something very important.

startText.en:
I like to send letters. No, really. I have a feeling that in the future sentient beings will forget how to write letters... They will find other ways to send information. A letter will no longer be associated with white paper, fancy handwriting, envelopes and beautiful stamps which smell of glue. A letter will become a data pack, pure information sent from a sender to a recipient... That doesn't sound much fun... don't you agree? Hopefully, that time won't come too soon.
Anyway, I digress. So, you are here because of my letter. You are wondering what I might need from you, right? I need a little favor. I need to crack the shell in which you, beings who inhabit Sarnaut, hide in since birth: You don't notice obvious things. You are so comfortable living in a world of illusions and sweet lies that only a decent kick will make you think again. I am going to kick you with my leg, ha!
I didn't mean to kick you literally. But there are some people I want to kick so hard... And then punch their empty heads. No-no, I'm not talking about you.
So, the time to reveal mysteries and punish the guilty ones has come. The final scene of the greatest play in the world is about to begin!
Get aboard the Astral Barge and make yourself comfortable. We are leaving! Where are we going? It's a surprise! I like surprises, you know.
I will reveal some details of the plot while we are sailing. I'll be your guide, ha ha!

checkText.en: To pray to false gods is stupid; to offer them a sacrifice is a crime!

finishText.en: Well, you deserve your reward. I hope the lizards will remember this lesson and won't try to repeat the ritual for a while.

goal.en:
When the time comes, go to the ruins to the north-east of the Citadel to save the innocent victim. Then talk to the Citadel Keeper, irrespective of whether you succeed or not.
You must kill enough lizards to save the victim.
You can prevent other players from saving the victim by using your "Get lost!" ability.

startText.en:
Have you ever felt pity or compassion? Do you feel strong enough to punish evil and protect the innocent? I believe that in spite of dozens of bloody battles and hundreds of enemies killed by your hands, your heart hasn't withered. I believe that you can complete my task.
Lizards in the ruins to the north-east of the Citadel are planning something evil. They are worshiping some vile blood-thirsty god with an unutterable name and offer him numerous sacrifices. I don't know the name of the god, but it's of no importance.
What IS important is that the lizards captured several beautiful girls who arrived here in search of... ahem... revelation. So, these cold-blooded beasts are going to kill them, to offer them as a sacrifice to their god. Imagine that: blood of a young lady splashed over a cold stone altar slab... Even I feel scared, though I don't have any blood at all.
The hero who saves at least one innocent victim will receive a reward from me. Also, everyone who tries to save them will earn valuable combat experience and my gratitude.
It is known that lizards start their rituals according to their own time schedule. Make sure you check your calendar regularly. We will let you know when it is time to challenge these cold-blooded killers.
And one more thing! Before you save a victim on the altar, kill as many lizards as you can... otherwise they will try to get in your way or simply try to kill the girl. I don't mind if you decrease the lizards' population.

checkText.en: Greetings. I am the Ambassador of Historians who arrived here with a scientific mission. We Historians are interested in the Wormfaces. We have information that they are one of the most ancient creatures of Sarnaut, who existed in the centuries of the Junes!

finishText.en:
You've been sent here by the Keeper of Wisdom? You are just on time!
We are having a communication problem... The Wormfaces don't want to talk to us!

goal.en: Find Maurice de Vevre at the Historians' Camp.

startText.en:
I am the Keeper of Wisdom. When it is time to put swords aside and use wisdom collected over thousands of years, the Master speaks through me.
Here, in the Citadel, there are a lot of wanderers looking for the Truth. Most of them are like you: they are adventurers brought here by the wind of war. They dream of victory. But there are also strangers who want to perceive ancient wisdom and knowledge. You've already heard about them. They are the Historians who collect crumbs of knowledge. It is no surprise that they've gladly joined the search for Truth - the Truth which the Master wants to reveal to the world.
While there are beings in the world who search for ancient wisdom, there are also beings who possess it. I mean the Wormfaces. Even I cannot explain all their actions, but they revere the Master and ceased hostilities against the Seekers of Truth when the Master asked them. Wormfaces know part of the Truth which you are looking for, but they are not willing to share it. Therefore I have an errand for you.
The representative of the Historians, Maurice de Vevre, is very close to establishing contact with those hostile creatures. But now he is experiencing some difficulties and is asking for help. The Historians know a lot about you and you used to help them before, so they won't mind working with you.
Maurice de Vevre is at the Historians' Camp to the east of the Citadel. Hurry up! He is already waiting for you.

checkText.en: Have you talked to the Wormface? So, tell me, what did he say?

finishText.en:
He really said that? Shatter, destroy, throw into the Astral? They don't care?! It can't be!
No, I can't be wrong... Their indifference is a lie!

goal.en: Pass on the words of the Seventeenth to Maurice de Vevre.

startText.en:
I am the Seventeenth and I assure you that I don't care about the Junes' rubbish! Or did you think that because we needed wreck samples for study, it might be for something other than just scientific research?
Do you want to burn them? Burn them! Do you want to shatter them? Shatter them! Do you want to throw them into the Astral? I know a great way how you can do it.
We don't care about fragments of the past. You can tell the Elf what I've just said!

checkText.en: You haven't calmed down yet?

finishText.en: Are you really going to burn the statue? Wow... We thought you were all talk and no action.

goal.en: Bring 5 pieces of Kindling and prepare a fireplace by the statue. Use the Talk-back Device to threaten the Seventeenth again.

startText.en:
I got it!
The Wormfaces are playing a childish game to check whether our nerves are made of steel or not! They must be bluffing. Why should they believe us?
But if you show them that we really mean to destroy the statue... Yes... So, I may need your help.
Walk around and collect 10 pieces of Kindling. Put them by the statue. Let them see that we are not joking!
Then ask that snob on the other side of the door if he really wants to see that beautiful statue destroyed!

checkText.en: I hope that the Wormfaces believe our little lie and stop pretending to be indifferent.

finishText.en: Such a jerk! His bluff is so natural... He is so confident as if he absolutely doesn't care about that statue!

goal.en: Bring Kindling Liquid to Maurice de Vevre.

startText.en:
I tell you what. I am tired of all your stupid games with the statue.
If you want to burn it then burn it and stop wasting my time!
Or you gonna tell me that the wood is wet and you can't set it on fire? I can help you. Take our special Kindling Liquid made from Black Blood of Earth. Believe me, you can even make snow burn with it!
Bring this Liquid to the stupid Elf. Let him burn the statue and get out of here!

finishText.en: I am the Second Command. You and the Elf have gone too far. We have to intervene!

goal.en: Start the fire by the statue, see what happens and then talk to the Wormface using the Talk-back Device again.

startText.en:
But what if... But what if this statue means absolutely nothing to them? It is an ancient monument... What shall we do?
No! We'll go on until the end! If we have to burn the statue to make these cold-blooded bastards show their true feelings we will do it!
I mean, you will do it... I wouldn't dare.
Go, burn! But let me turn away so I don't have to watch a masterpiece of art being burnt to ashes! Then no one will see my tears...

checkText.en: What happened to the Elf? Until we are sure that he does not remember anything, the mystery will remain a mystery.

finishText.en:
The Elf remembers nothing. Good job. Listen!
Yes, we collect and preserve the Junes' legacy. It is our past. Every shard, every sculpture and every bas-relief is a piece of history and symbol of our magnificence and might. This magnificence was lost...
We are not indifferent about our past. We suffered enough pain and grief. This pain cannot be forgotten over time... It gives a special flavor to revenge. You might have heard a saying of those who live on the ground: Revenge is a dish best served cold.
Our utmost desire is to take revenge upon the Great Dragons! These cursed beasts hunted us like a prey! They've killed thousands and hundreds of thousands of us. Truly cursed was the day we decided that we can choose the fate of this world.
Today we are forced to make friends with the Draconids, who were created by our old enemies! Such irony... What is worst of all is that we don't have a choice other than to obey...
Don't ask any more questions. There is time for everything. When the Overmind decides it is time to tell you more, I will talk to you again. But for now, good-bye.

goal.en: Talk to Maurice de Vevre and make sure that he remembers nothing about what happened in the last hours. Then talk to the Second Command using the Talk-back Device.

startText.en:
We don't trust these Historians, you know. Professionals never trust amateurs, but these Historians are real amateurs when it comes to matters of history.
When we understood that you were going to destroy a masterpiece of June art, we couldn't let it happen. We are sorry that we had to put you and everyone else around down. But we couldn't let you destroy the piece of art.
We changed something in the minds of the others while they were asleep. Nobody except for you will remember about this statue and about our concerns about the Junes' legacy. Why didn't we change your memory? Because you've proved your desire to cooperate and your loyalty. We are ready to forgive you for this affair with the statue. We are also guilty in it. The Overmind, which is the Council of our race, decided to reveal one of our mysteries to you.
But before we tell you the true story, please, check if the Elf remembers anything about what happened recently.

checkText.en: I realize you might not enjoy this task... But I promise you will be rewarded!

finishText.en:
Draconid blood and heart. This is exactly what I need! We are very grateful to you.
Concerning the reward... We know that you've been looking for shards of the crystal armor of the last June known to you as Zak. We know where you can find this shard.
But we don't want to reveal our knowledge. We gave the knowledge of the location of this shard away to one of those pompous Historians. Let them think that they found the shard... even though we know you deserve it.
Let the Darkness keep you! We believe that you will use this shard wisely.

goal.en: Go to the coast opposite Draconid Island. Use the Magic Decoy to lure the Draconids and take their blood and heart. Use the communication device on the entrance to the cave to send these samples to the Wormfaces.

startText.en:
I have one more request before we part. I'm not sure you'll like it. I mean, I'm almost sure that you won't like it.
You will have to kill. You'll have to kill Draconids. It is a dirty job, I know, but it needs to be done. Believe me, you will get a proper reward!
We'll give you a Magic Decoy. Only Draconids can hear its sound and they cannot resist it.
The Overmind has asked for Draconid Heart and Draconid Blood. Don't ask what we need them for. The explanation would take a lot of time and I'm not sure that you'd understand at least one-third of what we tell you. Just do it for our lost magnificence, which burned to ashes in flames brought upon our race by the Great Dragons!

finishText.en: Two hundred twenty four... I'm so tired of you...

goal.en: Use the Talk-back Device to talk to the representative of the Wormfaces.

startText.en:
The Wormfaces are a very ancient race. They are not as ancient as we, the Elves, but their history dates back to the ages of the Junes! Can you imagine that? They could have told us a lot about Sarnaut's past. However, there is one problem... It is not even a problem, it is a dead-end! The Wormfaces refuse to talk to us!
They've locked themselves under the ground and won't come out. Yes, I understand that they cannot stand bright light and open space, but since we are allies they could have invited me to come in! But they didn't! I have to stand in front of their door and talk to them using an Talk-back Device. But my partner in conversation... I am the Ambassador Plenipotentiary of the Historians whose studies may change the future of the world! But my partner in conversation is... a servant! A plebeian! Oh, great powers of Sarnaut! Sometimes I don't want to act like a scientist, but to act as a stupid militant and to explode the dungeon with all of its arrogant inhabitants.
They could have shared precious June knowledge, their magic and technology... But they are too stubborn to talk!
Please, establish contact with the Wormfaces. I have a feeling that you will have more luck than me. The Talk-back Device is next to the entrance to their dungeon.

checkText.en: So, have the Wormfaces told you anything?

finishText.en: Exactly! This is exactly what I was talking about! Their behavior is absolutely indecent when someone is trying to reveal white spots in the history of Sarnaut. Damned snobs! What should we do? I think we should somehow convince these swelled heads that we are on their side...

goal.en: Return to the Ambassador of the Historians Maurice de Vevre and convey to him the words of the Seventeenth.

startText.en:
Greetings to you, the two hundred and twenty fourth Seeker of, ahem, "Truth".
The Overmind welcomes you and so do I, the Overmind's humble worker, the Seventeenth Observer.
As I already said two hundred twenty three times before, we, the Overmind, are not inclined to believe anything that newcomers from the ground say. We are also not going to tell you anything until you prove your benevolent intentions.
You, fussy creatures from the ground, will never understand what pleasure deep and slow contemplation gives. You will never understand the beauty of the idea which slowly grows in the depths of your mind for decades.
Do you really think that those who live for a moment between birth and death can interest us in any way? Well, you can try.
If you prove that you deserve our attention we will help you in your research. But now, as you seem useless to us, we won't help you.
Convey my words to the pompous Elf who calls himself the "Historian". We are tired of his humble attempts to discover inexistent secrets of the Junes from us!

checkText.en: My monograph will be incomplete without a practical basis for my theoretical speculations. I need the Golem Fragments. Hurry up!

finishText.en:
Thank you. You deserve my sincere appreciation and the acceptance of all Wormfaces!
Now, finally, I can complete my great historical work...

checkText.en: I have already sent the letter to Luc. Your parcel is waiting for you.

finishText.en: Huh? ... What the crap? Some stones, beads... Do we look like butt-naked cavemen?

goal.en: Go to Avilon, take the Bag of June Trinkets from Luc de Blizare and bring them to the Wormfaces' cave entrance.

startText.en:
Wow! It seems to me that the ice is broken... I knew that you could cope with the challenge and break the wall which our "charming" allies built to hide from us.

Before you came, there were hundreds of adventurers like you who tried to talk to them through the Talk-back Device. But none of them received a task other than to kill the Undead or to collect samples from poor Crawlers. Then along you come... and you receive a task not about biology which, I must confess, is not my forte, but about history. Well, I know more about history than anyone else! I am a Historian!

So, the Wormfaces are interested in June artifacts... Hmm, what do they need them for?

Let me think. I also have a little errand for you. Go to Avilon to our base camp and meet the Archivist. I wrote him a letter, so he will give you all the June trinkets our association happened to find. There are various beads, color glass, shards... We don't need that crap.

Let's offer the Wormfaces these trinkets and see what their reaction is.

checkText.en: Sometimes you have to forget about your past to save your future... Remember these words!

finishText.en:
Well well... I already know that you helped us to get rid of one more fragment of our sad past. You must be interested in why we are so eager to get rid of our legacy. I'm sorry but I can't explain it to you right now.
However you've earned our pardon and your reward. I think you can still be helpful, the one who lives above!

name.en: The past is forgotten, the future is lost...

checkText.en: Hey, be careful! Don't trample on the shards! They are of high historic value. Though, not every shard... The one to the right looks more like a piece of packaging from our breakfast...

finishText.en: Here you are! We've been waiting for you. Maurice speaks highly of you. He is sure that with your help we will solve all the mysteries surrounding those weird Wormfaces.

goal.en: Go to the Hissing Canyon and meet Gennady Helmov, the Historian Ambassador's Assistant.

startText.en:
I... I can't believe my ears! These creatures are destroying memories! They're actually erasing their past! Barbarians! They are so happy doing this that they are ready to reward you for helping...
No, there must be something wrong. Maybe I'm mistaken but it seemed to me that I felt hidden sadness in the voice of the Wormface who talked to you.
I don't trust that Tenth. I think he didn't approve of that order. But he had to issue it to conceal... To conceal what? That is the question. And also the problem. We know too little about our mysterious allies...
Listen, I have an idea. Let's try to provoke a reaction from the Wormfaces.
Not far from here, in Hissing Canyon, my colleagues found an almost completely intact statue of one of the Junes' greatest Hunters tearing the jaws of the Great Dragon. At least, we think that this statue depicts that event...
We'll use this statue in our gambit! But the statue needs to be delivered here.
Go to the Hissing Canyon and talk to Gennady Helmov, my Assistant. Help him to deliver the statue there.

finishText.en: Looks like the yak is ready for the journey!

goal.en: Make sure the yak is ready. If it is absent, wait for it to come back.

startText.en:
So, we have loaded the statue and fastened it. Your task is to guard the statue during transportation. Not one single crack should appear on this magnificent masterpiece of June sculpture... Oh, it is a priceless rarity!
Well, we are ready. Let's check the yak. You'd better do it yourself, since you are to guard it on the road to the Catacombs.

checkText.en: But where is the cargo you are to guard?

finishText.en: Oh... The statue is magnificent! A true exquisite masterpiece... Nothing today surpasses the Junes' stone carving art! It's a pity that such beauty will be destroyed... But what can I do... History needs sacrifices.

goal.en: Follow the yak transporting the statue to the entrance to Catacombs.

startText.en:
Let's move...
Hup, animal! Go!

checkText.en: Why did you bring this sordidness to the threshold of our home? Take it back. I told you that we are not interested in the Junes' old crap!

finishText.en: Wha-a-at? Do you want to burn this statue in front of us? You are welcome. We are not interested in old crap.

goal.en: Pass on the words of Maurice de Vevre via the Talk-back Device.

startText.en:
Well, it's time to tell you my plan.
Look, despite what Tenth told you, they didn’t throw away our package after all. Which means it's not complete garbage. As for the destroyed steles... They might have decided to sacrifice what they could to keep their secret.
But this statue... Oh, it's beautiful! And I intend to burn it before their very eyes! The hot clay will crack, and the statue will turn into a pile of sand!
No, of course I'm not going to burn anything. I'm bluffing - there's no way I'd be able to damage this masterpiece. But the Wormfaces don't know about this!
If there really is a connection between the ancient Junes and the current Wormfaces, if they actually collect ancient June relics, they will never allow us to destroy this statue and will try to stop us. Which means they have to take off the mask and show their true face! Do you understand what I mean?
Go tell this Tenth, Seventeenth, or whoever is on the other side of the door, that we have the most beautiful ancient June statue in our possession. But since they don't care about their past, we're going to destroy it!

checkText.en: Where is the letter? Was it delivered in time?

finishText.en:
Well, hello, if you really mean it... I see you are intrigued by my letter, right? I had no doubts.
So, you are tired of being a wooden chip carried away by wild waters of history. Do you want to ride the waves? Do you want to make your destiny instead of following the preset order? Great! That is the answer I was expecting. Otherwise I wouldn't have invited you.
Now listen to me carefully.

goal.en: Meet Gorislav Gipitsky at the Crossroads.

startText.en: I, Gorislav Gipitsky, or the director of the greatest play in the world to be more precise, chose a guise of an innkeeper, and am now looking for new actors to take part in my grandiose play. The reward for participating is revelation - true revelation in which you will discover the truth about the past and in which you can also see the future of this world!

checkText.en: So, is it time for some new discoveries, eh?

finishText.en: I can see you received my letter. You don't get it, do you? It's okay, we can fix it in no time. Listen to me now.

goal.en: Read the letter from Gorislav in your mailbox and meet him at the Crossroads.

startText.en: Hey! Hang on... Yes, sure, there is a letter waiting for you. An urgent one! It was delivered by hand recently, and they asked that it be hand delivered and that I make sure that it reaches it's addressee. You are the addressee, so the letter in the box is waiting for you. Our postal service works like clockwork!

checkText.en: A woman should lie in bed, a corpse should lie in a grave!

finishText.en:
Oh, you smell like hell... Why did you tear the Undead into small pieces? Sneak up from behind, hit them once on the head and they will be buried in their grave again to rest in peace. Don't worry: experience must be earned.
Well, thank you, buddy. I don't know what I would do without you! Here is your reward. If you want more easy money, come visit me from time to time. Don't be shy! I'm always happy to see old friends again.

checkText.en: So, what do you think? Deal?

finishText.en:
Great.
It is very wise of you to follow the Master's wishes. I've been doing it for thousands of years and don't regret it.

goal.en: Confirm that you understood what was said by talking to the Master's Voice.

startText.en:
You are one of those destined to receive the revelation. Me and my brethren are here to help you complete this task. This is Master's Wish.
I will tell you what should be done.
The real Tka-Rik Revelation is kept in the June Mage's Cave to the east of here. The Cave is sealed with a magic barrier which can be penetrated only by someone protected by Crystal Armor. That Armor helped Ath-Zak, the ancient hero, to defeat the June Curse.
Your task right now is to find the shards of Crystal Armor and to reforge it. This is the Master's Wish.
Do you accept it?

checkText.en: So, what do you think? Deal?

finishText.en:
Great.
It is very wise of you to follow the Master's wishes. I've been doing it for thousands of years and don't regret it.

goal.en: Confirm that you understood what was said by talking to the Master's Voice.

startText.en:
You are one of those destined to receive the revelation. Me and my brethren are here to help you complete this task. This is Master's Wish.
I will tell you what should be done.
The real Tka-Rik Revelation is kept in the June Mage's Cave to the east of here. The Cave is sealed with a magic barrier which can be penetrated only by someone protected by Crystal Armor. That Armor helped Ath-Zak, the ancient hero, to defeat the June Curse.
Your task right now is to find the shards of Crystal Armor and to reforge it. This is the Master's Wish.
Do you accept it?

checkText.en: Battling against your vices is a tough battle as you are fighting against yourself!

finishText.en:
I knew that you would succeed! The Master is never wrong and he doesn't need to test you.
This trial was for you all along...

goal.en: Complete the trial of the five Guards by overcoming your vices and bringing the Armor Shard you receive to the Master's Voice in the Citadel.

startText.en:
The fact that you listen to the Master's words and want to know the Truth is good. Not everyone is allowed to understand the revelation. I've seen hundreds and thousands of strong and confident creatures who thought that the world lied at their feet, but they all died one step away from their goal. Why? Because it is in the nature of sentient beings to neglect their weaknesses, to justify their vices and to underestimate their hidden fears.
The Master wants to try you. You will have to face your vices and fears and defeat them. If your body and spirit are strong, without sin or vices, you will achieve true magnificence.
Around the Citadel you will find five Guards. They all want to try you, to make you face your weaknesses. If you can overcome them, you will make one more step towards the revelation.
If you complete the task you will receive a shard of Zak's crystal armor. Bring it to me and I will keep it until you have collected all the shards and are ready to reforge the armor.
Go now and remember: small weak spots can cause huge troubles.

checkText.en: Have you found the World Explorer? How is he doing?

finishText.en:
Look how beautifully the edges of this gem sparkle in the sun... It's fascinating. Now try to imagine how the whole armor would have sparkled and how skillful June artisans created such masterpiece. The Junes were great masters... They died because of Sarn's anger.
But soon his evil reign will come to end. Very soon the Master will discharge his anger upon him and Sarn will be defeated. Peace will come to Sarnaut and you will be its harbinger!

goal.en: Find the World Explorer in the ruins of the Granite Madness and take Zak's Crystal Armor Shard. Bring it to the Master's Voice in the Citadel.

startText.en:
Your loyalty to the Master is doubtless. You perceive his wisdom and want to receive the revelation. Such striving to understand mysteries is rare for inhabitants of this world, who prefer to have fun and not to think about coming disasters.
You already possess a few Crystal Armor Shards. One of our explorers, World Explorer, happened to find another Shard! I can say that you've completed more than a half of your journey to the revelation.
But there is one problem. Our explorers are engaged in battle with the Undead in the ruins and cannot deliver the shard to the Citadel. You must help them out.
Go to the ruins of the Granite Madness, find our explorer, take the shard and deliver it to me. It will be safe here in the Citadel until you have collected all seven shards. Then we'll reforge the armor and you will enter Tka-Rik's Cave and receive the so long-awaited revelation!

checkText.en: What news do you have... good or bad?

finishText.en:
One more Crystal Armor Shard! Excellent!
You are one step closer to the true revelation now. As soon as you have found all seven shards and brought them to me I will try to reforge the armor. Then you will be able to enter Tka-Rik's Cave and will learn the truth about the past, present and future.

goal.en: Use the Searching Stick to explore the swamp at Rusty Saltings. Find the huge Hydra and retrieve the Crystal Armor Shard. Bring it to the Master's Voice in the Citadel.

startText.en:
Agr-r-r... You friend and brother! Me know. You want shiny thing. Sharp thing.
We had such thing. Mage wore thing on neck. Wore it long and long.
Hydra eat the mage! Big Hydra! Chew-chew the mage! With the thing chew-chew!
Now the thing in the belly. In big Hydra. Hydra sleep in swamp. Under water and sleep!
Me give you stick. Searching stick. You take the stick. You poke with the stick. Search Hydra!
Hydra come out, you kill Hydra! And chew-chew!
Thing inside Hydra. Thing not eat! Thing wear. Shiny thing...

checkText.en: I heard the Historians told you about some mysterious treasure... Have you found it?

finishText.en:
One more Crystal Armor Shard! Excellent!
You are one step closer to the true revelation now. As soon as you have found all seven shards and brought them to me I will try to reforge the armor. Then you will be able to enter Tka-Rik's Cave and will learn the truth about the past, present and future.

goal.en: Use Treasure Seeker's Kit to find the buried chest in the Hissing Canyon. Dig it out and take the Crystal Armor Shard. Give it to the Master's Voice in the Citadel.

startText.en:
Recently we learned something very exciting. Scorched remains of some rascals were found in the Hissing Canyon. They were lucky enough to have found one of Zak's Crystal Armor Shards! It is a very precious artifact. I would even say that it's priceless!
They buried the treasure but didn't make it very far. They started to fight and killed each other. Now they are decomposing but give a good example of what can happen if you don't control your desire for money...
So, back to the shard. I'm offering you the chance to try to find it. You can use the special Treasure Seeker's Kit.
When you near the chest, the Scanner will produce a beeping sound. Take the shovel and start digging! If you find a chest and not a rusty piece of plough, then you've probably found the Shard!

checkText.en: Hydra strong! If you strong you kill hydra. If you weak hydra eat you! Chew!

finishText.en:
Now I believe. You strong!
Me respect you!

startText.en:
You brother and friend! You strong? Me not believe.
You show you strong! You go to swamp. Hit Hydra. Three handfuls Hydras!
When you kill three handfuls of Hydra come back. Then me believe!

finishText.en:
Are the zombies really dead? Well done.
Unfortunately, as your saying goes: "Nature abhors a vacuum", and soon new Deadmen will get out of their graves.
But nevertheless, you deserve this reward. You can be proud of yourself!

checkText.en: I don't like Lizardmen... They are savage and don't want to be civilized at all! It's not a problem... If they can't - we'll teach them, if they don't want to - we'll make them, if, of course, there is anyone left alive.

finishText.en:
Did the shaman go on a journey to the land of spirits with a one-way ticket? Great!
If you want to make some money, come in. Don't be shy! We'll find something to do.

goal.en: Participate in killing the Lizardman Shaman and talk to George Siverian.

startText.en:
Hey, do you want to earn some money? Then listen to me.
The leader of those tiny creatures with hoods, Croak the Boss, or whatever his name is, came to me with a delicate matter. I don't know what his problem with the local Lizardmen was, but that weirdo wanted to get rid of the local Shaman. When the Shaman does his shaman thing, Croak turns red from anger. So he asked me to make boots and a purse out of his skin. But there is the problem... My reputation doesn't allow me to do criminal things like this. I am a noble hero, defender of the oppressed, monster slayer, scourge of the undead, etc. Reputation is a strange thing, you know...
But if you kill the Shaman, your reputation will not suffer. You will also receive money which you deserve for eliminating the cold-blooded Lizardman. We'll share it evenly. Deal?

checkText.en: So, have you smoked the worm? Or did the worms almost smoke you out?

finishText.en: Right, here are the thorns. Wow, they are so sharp! Like needles. Here is your share and here is mine. Everything is fair!

checkText.en: Oh, I remember this one sorceress... Dark hair, cherry lips... But what she did in bed! I miss girls so much. I see only beasts around. When I earn some more gold I will go to Eljune, to the Butterflies! I'll spend an entire month there!

finishText.en: Yes, give me the parts, I'll give you your reward! It's a fair deal!

goal.en: Get a Translucent Fang, Dim Hydra's Scale, Blurred Eye and Shield of Deprecation. Bring them to George Siverian to receive your reward.

startText.en:
Oh, my sword is blunt... How much longer can I continue cutting monsters into pieces? As soon as one dies, there are three more taking its place. I tell you, this place is cursed! And don't listen to those midgets with hoods about their Master. Though they do pay for slain monsters in time and they are generous. So I don't complain.
Wait, don't you know anything about me? It can't be! Clever people even wrote about me in their books! Two swords, Wolf's Amulet, potions...
Well, if you don't remember me, I won't insist. My name is George. I come from Siveria. In some regions I am known as the White Beast... Maybe because of my hair color or maybe because I drink more booze than anyone! I like booze so much. Sometimes I even see animals... White animals!
The problem is that I have to pay for booze not with a story, but with a gold coin. So I work hard to save the world and satisfy myself. I kill beasts with sharp teeth, with wings or with two legs. I don't do it for free, of course. Aha, I see that you are interested.
Well, I have an errand for you. Bring me a Translucent Fang from a Spectral Warthog, a Solid Chitinous Plate from a Rocky Crawler, a Tarnished Hydra Scale from a Swamp Hydra and a Blurred Eye from a Searing Eye Elder. I will show them to the midgets with hoods and share my money with you. I'll share the money fairly.
I said "fair" but not "half"! Don't open your mouth too wide! Don't be afraid, I won't deceive you...

finishText.en:
Thank you.
Maybe your assistance will help us to finish our research and learn the truth about the "First Element of Life".

goal.en: Agree to help Sarbaz Samedi with his research.

startText.en:
Have you ever been to Avilon?
If you have, then you might remember Roxane de Doucer. Vampire Patriarch Armando de Doucer's daughter.
However, this is not about the tragic fate of this family. During the attack of the Darkblood Citadel on Avilon, Roxanne studied the blood of various creatures in an effort to learn how widely the vampire infection had spread. Perhaps you even had a chance to help her in this.
I got the results of this research. They were very interesting. A mysterious entity was discovered in the blood of each creature. To find it, we had to use magic and certain scientific methods.
Aha! I see you're interested! I wonder what you will say when you hear that this very essence, which I call "the fundamental principle of life", is exactly the same in mantes, toads, and squirrels! In everyone. In you and me. It's the same in everyone!
I plan to continue my research here, on the Isle of Revelation. Will you help us?

finishText.en:
Thank you.
Maybe your assistance will help us to finish our research and learn the truth about the "First Element of Life".

goal.en: Agree to help Sarbaz Samedi with his research.

startText.en:
Have you ever been to Avilon?
If you have, then you might remember Roxane de Doucer. Vampire Patriarch Armando de Doucer's daughter.
However, this is not about the tragic fate of this family. During the attack of the Darkblood Citadel on Avilon, Roxanne studied the blood of various creatures in an effort to learn how widely the vampire infection had spread. Perhaps you even had a chance to help her in this.
I got the results of this research. They were very interesting. A mysterious entity was discovered in the blood of each creature. To find it, we had to use magic and certain scientific methods.
Aha! I see you're interested! I wonder what you will say when you hear that this very essence, which I call "the fundamental principle of life", is exactly the same in mantes, toads, and squirrels! In everyone. In you and me. It's the same in everyone!
I plan to continue my research here, on the Isle of Revelation. Will you help us?

checkText.en: Did you get a Protoplasm Sample?

finishText.en:
Well done!
I will examine these samples immediately...

goal.en: Get three Protoplasm samples from Hydras, Crawlers and Searing Eyes on the Isle of Revelation. Bring them to historian Sarbaz Samedi.

startText.en:
Let's start.
I've come to this island to examine the creatures inhabiting it. I have already studied beasts from Igsh, the Holy Land and some astral islands. My elven colleagues studied creatures from Kvatoh. Now it is my turn to explore this little island.
You should look for Hydras, Crawlers and Searing Eyes. I am almost certain that we will find the First Element in their samples! But the experiments must be precise and scholastic.
Remember, you don't have to take their blood samples. We have found a more suitable material for research. You can check if the sample contains the First Element straight away.
I am talking about Protoplasm. I need you to get it.
Bring me three Protoplasm samples from Hydras, Crawlers and Searing Eyes on the Isle of Revelation.

checkText.en: It is an extraordinary case in terms of psychology... I cannot understand how Draconids treat lizards, their direct relatives. Do they hate or secretly worship them?..

finishText.en:
Oh, you did it! Great.
I will immediately send the blood for analysis. Here in the middle of the swamp we will find nothing.

startText.en:
Yes! Exactly. Analysis shows that Protoplasm taken from Hydras, Crawlers and Searing Eyes contains the First Element of Life.
Now we need to study Draconids. I must confess that experiments on sentient beings are the most difficult. Not everyone is willing to cooperate. On the Dragon Ring we failed to come to an agreement with the Draconids. So we didn't get their blood and protoplasm for analysis.
But we've made more progress here on the Isle of Revelation.
Draconid Priests agreed to give us drops of their blood. Yes, they were talking about blood. We tried to explain to them what protoplasm was, but they didn't understand. We'll have do things the old-fashioned way. Before you try to convince the Draconids, go and kill the Lizardmen. The Draconid Priests agreed to exchange blood drops for Lizardmen amulets.
Don't forget that you can't take all of the drops of blood at once. Priests will give you one drop for ten amulets. Now go. I'll be waiting for the samples!

checkText.en:
Interesting... While I was trading with some Wormfaces, in addition to June Charms they also asked whether I had any Draconid blood or hearts! Do they also study them?..
Finally, they agreed to take the Charms. However, I'm sure they'll find the way to get the blood and the hearts. I wish I knew what they needed them for...

finishText.en:
Excellent!
I will analyze them right now...
I have received the results of the Draconid blood sample test from my colleagues. They also sent me this portable field laboratory. Now I can analyze samples right here. Why are they so generous? Because we are on the edge of the greatest scientific discovery ever since the invention of astral ships. It seems to me... Oh, I can't believe it, but the facts prove it... Together with my colleagues, I have found an element in the blood of every living being. It is the First Element of Life!

I got it!
What do few people know about the Draconids? ... That they are creatures created by the Great Dragon of the Lizardmen.
What do we know about Wormfaces? This question is far more complicated... There is a theory that Junes somehow turned into them.
What do these two cases have in common?
We know... at least, we guess that there is a power which created everything. But what do we know about the powers that created other creatures with the common Essence of Life? Who created Hydras, Crawlers and Searing Eyes? Who created us?
We don't know. But we have made a step in the right direction.
The Great Power did it...
Was it the God and Creator?
Hmph, I never thought I would make such a conclusion!

goal.en: Wait for Sarbaz Samedi to develop a new theory.

startText.en:
It must be a mistake... My analysis reveals the First Element of Life but... this First Element differs from the First Element we found in the blood of other creatures!
What does this mean? Wormfaces are creatures from another world?!
But what about Draconids? Where are the test results, huh?
Oh, they are in my pocket... Here they are!
So...
Another surprise! The Draconids' First Element of Life is also different! They are also... Aliens.
I need to think... Wait a minute, usually I think very quickly.

finishText.en:

So...
Another surprise! The Draconids' First Element of Life is also different! They are also... Aliens.

checkText.en: The massive stone door is sealed tight. Even if you blow it up, the passageway will surely get blocked up by debris. We'll have to find another option...

finishText.en: Now that you've found the right combination of symbols, the path into the wormface cave is open!

goal.en: Inspect the three stone inscriptions and find a way to get into the wormface cave.

startText.en:
The intercom on the door is silent, completely ignoring your kicks, spits and curses. Is there any way to get into the cave from the outside? Blowing up the door is hardly an option.
However, the strange symbols on the intercom look vaguely familiar to you. Of course! You've already seen similar inscriptions and images on the stones and column remains in the old ruins.
One of the stones with the enigmatic symbols is located somewhere in the ruins to the west of the cave. Another old stone covered in mold and mud is somewhere amidst the Rusty Salt Marshes, so it won't be easy to find. Also, you remember hearing about some interesting bas-reliefs on the ruins beneath the waterfall. If you inspect all three stones, you will probably be able to pick the password to open the cave.

checkText.en: Have you managed to find the Golem?

finishText.en:
Obviously, the Golem was carrying a treasure chest. The way it ran out of charge and permanently shut down... Recently there was a strange outbreak of magic energy and the Golem was reactivated. It woke up and continued with the order it received hundreds of years ago. It is interesting...
Where was it carrying the treasure and why? This mystery will be difficult to solve...

goal.en: Search for and find the Strange Golem.

startText.en:
Greetings. I've heard about your progress in the search for Truth and I am impressed. You are good at solving puzzles, which your fate is rather generous to give to you. I'm willing to share one such puzzle with you.
A historian who visits the Citadel from time to time to boast about his success and to buy provisions told us a strange story. He swore that he had seen a June Golem, which are scattered in fragments all around the ruins of the city, moving! It was heading somewhere towards the south-east of the island!
I am not sure if it is true or if the historian was hallucinating. But if it is true, we should find that Golem and learn more about it.

checkText.en: There is a container in the Golem chest, but its lid is damaged. If you force it enough, you may be able to remove it!

finishText.en:
Your intuition didn't fail! There is a small container in the Golem. An ornate strongbox was hidden inside.
You've earned this trophy!

goal.en: Examine the strange Golem thoroughly.

startText.en:
This Golem is less damaged than the others. It looks old and broken but the dust under its feet has moved. It is not rooted to the ground like other Golems.
You should examine it more thoroughly...

checkText.en: The road of a turncoat is long and winding! Will it ever bring one to anything good?

finishText.en: There you are. A different face, a different ID, a different life. Good luck with it all.

goal.en: Prove you're useful to be allowed to change your faction.

startText.en: It's pretty hard to remain devoted, when you are on friendly terms with the gods, huh? But cheer up, there are a lot of heroes both in the Empire and in the League that only fight for themselves, and for nothing else, I assure you. So even if you're looking at the other side, put off your moral issues, I'm here to help you!

checkText.en: It takes tons of time and effort, but it's worth it. If you give up, you're bound to spend the rest of your pathetic life in prison - either for treachery or for espionage, pick whichever you like best.

finishText.en: Nice. This will buy us another lot of components. Come back tomorrow, we are going to need even more!

goal.en: Complete Path of Trials in Tka-Rik's Cave at the Isle of Revelation. Bring Klavdia Kalugina 50 hearts of the elementals, 400 Battleground Emblems and a Watermark Paper.

startText.en:
Down to business. First, you will need a new set of documents. Easy to forge, provided you have real watermark paper. I have no idea how to steal some from the National Mint, but you will surely be able to get a few sheets from the missionary at Irdrich.
Second, a new face is a must - don't you dream of walking around Nezebgrad wearing an elven face! Novograd people won't be so happy to see an orc in their streets, either! Magic will help us. Bring me 400 Battleground Emblems to buy the necessary ingredients.
Third, the energy for the ritual is needed. Fifty hearts of the elementals will be just enough.
And finally, get yourself prepared for the transfer! Trials await! Meet me at Tka-Rik's cave.

finishText.en:
You touch the icy surface of the Guardian, and a cold wave passes through your body.
The Guardian has allowed you to participate in the battle for the Melting Isle treasures.

goal.en: Use the June Portal to travel to the Melting Isle. Touch the Frost Guardian to participate in the event.

startText.en:
Preparations for the Second Performance premiere are still being made. In the meantime, get yourself ready for it.
This June Portal will take you to a new location called the Melting Isle. For thousands of years this everfrost Allod kept the treasures of ancient Junes hidden. But recently the Global Warming has begun! Ancient ice is melting slowly, giving an opportunity to get hold of the treasures for those who are brave, fast, and smart. You can also try to recover them.
One more note to mention: a special rule works within the Isle - every man for himself. Although there are camps for both factions there, don't let them confuse you - they were established only to make sure that the contestants arrive to the Isle in one piece. Once you make you first step there, prepare to fight everyone on sight.
As soon as the Ancient Treasure appears on one of the thawed patches, Frost Guardians announce it to everyone on the Melting Isle. Only the one who manages to repel all enemy attacks and open the chest will receive the treasure.
You may depart to the Isle now. Upon arrival, touch the Frost Guardian to confirm that you accept the terms of the contest.

finishText.en:
You touch the icy surface of the Guardian, and a cold wave passes through your body.
The Guardian has allowed you to participate in the battle for the Melting Isle treasures.

goal.en: Use the June Portal to travel to the Melting Isle. Touch the Frost Guardian to participate in the event.
