You may depart to the Isle now. Upon arrival, touch the Frost Guardian to confirm that you accept the terms of the contest.

checkText.en: An eternal fight between two great spirits... That's the essence of any war... useless and merciless...

finishText.en:
I knew that you were strong enough to defeat the Great Ones. Now our eternal enemies will wonder whether their battles will end like this too.
Remember, you cannot live in the past. The past is forgotten, the future is closed for now, the present is here for you. Live in the present. Approach the future, stand firmly ahead of the past, then we'll defeat our common enemy Sarn really soon.

goal.en: Participate in killing the Spirit of the Great June Hunter and the Spirit of the Great Dragon. Deliver the Potion of the Great Dragon to the Wormfaces' Leader. Give the Potion of the Great Hunter to the chief of the Draconids. Convince them to stop their ancient war and return to the Master's Voice in the Citadel.

startText.en:
I am the Keeper of Knowledge. I keep knowledge about everything that has happened, that will happen and that is happening now. When the time comes to use this knowledge, the Master speaks through me.
I know that you've earned the trust of our allies, the Draconids. They are young and therefore aggressive. You earned the trust of the Wormfaces, who don't forget ancient crimes.
The future is obscure. I clearly see only one thing: If Draconids and Wormfaces continue their war the world will be changed. It will be changed when it isn't ready to change. The change may destroy the world. We need to bring peace to these creatures. Do you want to help me? Then listen.
Many centuries ago, before Sarnaut was broken into pieces by a Cataclysm, the paths of the two Greats crossed. The Great Hunter met the Great Dragon. Just as fire cannot be mixed with water, these two greats couldn't control their nature. They started a useless fight. Why was the fight useless? Because their strength was equal and they knew it. Nobody could win. The only outcome was the death of both. And they died...
Powers summoned by the Greats were so huge that neither the Hunter nor Dragon could control the flow of energy, and it destroyed them. Their bodies were destroyed but not their souls.
Such irony of fate! The Great Dragon and Great Hunter turned into ghosts doomed to fight against each other to the end of their days.
I know that the Ghosts of the Greats are a good example of what happens when an old and stupid war takes full control over minds. Therefore, I'm asking you to go to the Granite Madness and find the spirits of the Greats. Set them free. Kill them to stop their eternal fight. Bring me their potions, their entities!
Take the Potion of the Great Hunter to the Draconids and take the potion of the Great Dragon to the Wormfaces. Mistakes of the past remain in the past... so do these ghost, who fought against each other for centuries and disappeared into the abyss. I am sure that when they learn about it they will start to wonder if they really needed this war...

finishText.en:
Well... So you are too.
Well, it was predictable.
We were talking just recently with you about the meaning of the Revelation you received. Now our friends, or maybe enemies, are making a new move and offer you power and new possibilities.
Let me tell you what I think about it.

goal.en: Go to Nezebgrad and tell Yasker that you are ready to take part in the ritual of Reincarnation.

startText.en:
So, reincarnation. Let me remind you how your Spark can be transferred to another body. Not a random body, but a specially prepared one.
With your Spark the new... ahem... the new you also receive some of your abilities. It will become another incarnation of you.
You can choose a new body of any race of the Empire. You may choose another class. You will keep two unique abilities of your class and a major part of your valuables; for example, items from the Boutique are available to both old and new you.
This is what Reincarnation is.
At any moment you may travel from one body to another. There is a specialist in Nezebgrad who can help you with that. Yasker, the leader of the Empire, knows everything about it. You should go and see him. One of the conditions of our agreement was that he could talk to every Imperial citizen willing to complete the ritual of Reincarnation in person.
Let's do it quickly. Go right now. Yasker is waiting for you.

checkText.en: Do you have any questions?

finishText.en:
So, everything is clear.
Put your signature here and here... With your blood.
Ha! I'm kidding!

goal.en: Ask Sarang Bisanu about Reincarnation.

startText.en:
Here is what I tell you... If a riot can't be prevented you must lead it!
I mean figuratively. I'm not going to confront Nihaz and forbid you to go through the ritual of Reincarnation. You are to take this decision on your own.
I will just keep the situation under my control.
Anyway, you are offered to gain Power. Who would refuse it? I would accept it. I didn't reject to become Nezeb's follower. When I was drinking dragon's blood I also knew what I was doing.
Now you are to drink from the same cup. If I were you, I would never miss that chance.
Enough of fancy words. Let's go straight to business.
Reincarnation is only for the Chosen ones. Not everyone is honored to go through this ritual. I'll tell you more: not everyone should even know about such possibility. Got it? Everything connected with Reincarnation is a mystery.
You will find a specialist who may help you with the ritual here, on the first level of my tower. I will give her your name and she will be honest with you. Her name is Bisanu. She is a Tep's cultist. A former cultist. Indeed. She is a great specialist in Gorluxor machinery. We named her Sarang so that she wouldn't be very distinguished.
Go to the new scientist and ask her about Reincarnation. This information may help you to take the final decision.

checkText.en:
Have you ever dreamed to start everything over and to avoid all mistakes you did in the past?
Now you have this possibility.

finishText.en:
Now it is done.
Congratulations. I'm sure you won't regret it. As for me, I never did.

goal.en: Start the ritual, defeat yourself and tame your Spark. Complete the Ritual and talk to Klavdia Kalugina in the cave of Kirah.

startText.en:
Every our meeting is a new stage of your life. This stage is very important.
Let's start.
First of all, you are to defeat Fire Elementals in the cave. Not an unusual task, is it? I hope you remember how to use Eternal Fire. Use it to complete your task quickly. After you get rid of them approach the Dragon's Heart and start the Ritual.
The next stage is the most difficult. You must defeat the most dangerous enemy - yourself. You should do it several times. The meaning of the ritual is to take control over yourself and your Spark.
You will do it when it appears. You heart will be cold and your mind will be clear. It is the easiest part of the Ritual. Symbol of your victory.
As soon as you tame your Spark you are allowed to Reincarnate.

finishText.en: Every our meeting is a new stage of your life. This stage is very important.

goal.en: Go to the secret cave of Kirah and talk to Klavdia Kalugina.

startText.en:
Now it is time for the Ritual.
No, we are not going to hold it in the center of Nezebgrad. Yasker wants to keep everything in secret, right?
We also need a Dragon's Heart. But where can we find it?
At the same place! In the secret cave of Kirah in the past.
Klavdia is waiting for you there to reward you with the gift of Reincarnation.
The keys and other stuff you may need to enter the cave I'm giving you right now. Go and find her. She's waiting.
I'll wait for our next meeting with you or with any of your Incarnations.

finishText.en: Every our meeting is a new stage of your life. This stage is very important.

goal.en: Go to the secret cave of Kirah and talk to Klavdia Kalugina.

startText.en:
Now it is time for the Ritual.
No, we are not going to hold it in the center of Novograd. Aidenus wants to keep everything in secret, right?
We also need a Dragon's Heart. But where can we find it?
At the same place! In the secret cave of Kirah in the past.
Klavdia is waiting for you there to reward you with the gift of Reincarnation.
The keys and other stuff you may need to enter the cave I'm giving you right now. Go and find her. She's waiting.
I'll wait for our next meeting with you or with any of your Incarnations.

checkText.en:
By the way! You may complete the trial in Tka-Rik's Cave even after you complete your exercises to harden your Spark.
It will be... right.

finishText.en:
Yes, I know that the exercise is finished. I was in that cave, remember?
Well done.

goal.en: Complete the trials in Tka-Rik's Cave and report your success to Klavdia Kalugina at the Overlord's Citadel.

startText.en:
The first exercise will harden your spirit.
I must be sure that the gift of Nihaz is to be given into the right hands. Fierce battles are ahead of us. I'd better get rid of the weak.
Go back to Tka-Rik's Cave. Now when Zak has fled and the deadly screen is gone, I started thoroughly investigating the legacy of the last June mage. I must admit the place is rather dangerous. There you will be offered to pass a number of Trials.
If you complete them it will mean we are not wasting our time.

checkText.en:
I don't know who you are and I don't like to owe anybody.
Especially when it is a matter of life and death.

finishText.en:
Everything is good. Debt is returned.
Good job.

goal.en: Go to the Kingdom of Elements, drink the poison and kill 20 monsters within 30 minutes. Then report back to Klavdia Kalugina at the Overlord's Citadel.

startText.en:
The second exercise will harden your Spark.
You will have to drink this poison in the Kingdom of Elements. Here you go.
Don't worry, you won't die. You'll become a debtor and will die in 30 minutes if you don't return your debt.
How are you going to return your debt? By killing monsters, of course! If you accomplish the task within the given time, your exercise will be complete and I'll discharge your debt. But if you are late you will have to return your debt by going to the Purgatory, and then start over again.
Is it clear?

checkText.en:
Drops of Mirra have rather weak magic powers. It is a symbol. It is a symbol of faith.
But the price of this faith is rather high!

finishText.en:
The third exercise is complete.
Well done.

goal.en: Donate 3,000 Drops of Mirra to Klavdia Kalugina at the Overlord's Citadel.

startText.en:
The third exercise... Well... It's actually not an exercise.
Every work costs money. But work with Spark costs... Right! Drops of Mirra. Your third exercise is to bring me 3,000 Drops of Mirra every day.

checkText.en:
Come on! Don't be lazy!
Immortality is not easy to get!

finishText.en:
Now I can tell that everything is ready.
Almost ready.

goal.en: Harden your Spark by completing exercises of Klavdia Kalugina to prepare yourself for the final ritual.

startText.en:
I will tell you how we can confront our enemy!
We can use his technology and make it better and more powerful. Nihaz, my benempt father, came to this conclusion.
Do you remember the story about the Dragon of Kirah? What do you think Nihaz is going to do with it? He is already immortal.
He wants this heart for you. Only we, apart from the Great Mages, will use the power of the Dragon's Blood in a different way. They wanted their bodies to be immortal, but we will harden our Spark.
Spark... is more reliable. A Great Mage can be killed, but Spark is much more difficult to destroy.
So, how are you going to harden your Spark?
You have to complete three exercises. It's pretty like your morning exercises. If you make it right, you will be ready for the ritual of Reincarnation.
What is it? It is an ability to transfer your soul to other bodies. When I was talking about enemy's technology I meant this.
It is a possibility to start a new life but with the experience from your previous life and with abilities which are not available to ordinary mortals.
Are you interested?
Let's start the training.

finishText.en:
I've been expecting you.
Recently we talked about the Revelation. Even then I had known that soon you would be offered new possibilities. This Power is much like Tensess' Gift.
I am ready to talk. Now listen!

goal.en: Go to Novograd and tell Aidenus that you are ready for Ritual of Reincarnation.

startText.en:
So, what are we almost ready for?
For reincarnation. I mean... For Reincarnation. Starting with a capital letter.
Let me remind you how your Spark can be transferred to another body. It is not a random body, but a specially prepared one.
With your Spark the new... ahem... the new you also receive some of your abilities. It will be you again! Another incarnation of you.
You can choose a new body of any race of the League. You may choose another class. You will keep two unique abilities of your class and a major part of your valuables; for example, items from the Boutique are available to both old and new you.
This is what Reincarnation is.
In any moment you may travel from one body to another. There is also a specialist in Novograd who can help you. Aidenus, the Great Mage of the League, knows everything about it. You should go and see him. One of the conditions of our agreement was that he could talk to every citizen of the League willing to complete the ritual of Reincarnation in person.
Let's do it quickly. Go right now. Aidenus is waiting for you.

checkText.en: Do you have any questions?

finishText.en:
You have no questions, do you? Good.
Don't be a chicken. Reincarnation is not painful. Some people even like it, ha ha!

goal.en: Ask Mara de Doucer about Reincarnation.

startText.en:
It is always better to regret something you did than something you missed.
I'm not going to persuade you from completing the Reincarnation Ritual. I passed through a similar ritual in the Conclave of the Great Mages. You are the one to make the decision.
But if you ask me if I regret what was done... Am I ready to go back to the Past and order myself not to drink the Dragon's Blood?
No! I have no regrets. It was my chance to gain power and I used it. Now you have such chance. It's your call.
But I want to warn you.
Reincarnation is only for the Chosen ones. The unworthy won't complete the ritual. In order not to confuse minds and not to confront the Church of Light it was decided to keep information about Reincarnation in secret.
The specialist who will help you with the ritual is in Novograd in Elven District. Her name is Mara de Doucer. As far as I know, she is a great specialist in Gorluxor's machinery.
Go find her and ask about Reincarnation. Only then you should make your decision.

checkText.en: So, you want to know the Revelation. Aren't you scared? Those who discovered it before, broke down and cried. Some of them even committed suicide!

finishText.en:
Now you know the truth. Revelation of Tka-Rik, or Nihaz, or your own - it's up to you to decide. Are you feeling alright? You are very pale.

You'll be okay. We have another thing to take care of. Have you ever heard about the Reincarnation? Yes, you have? I guess Yasker sent you here to find out about it, am I right?

goal.en: Receive Tka-Rik Revelation and find your way to Reincarnation. Report to Klavdia Kalugina.

startText.en:
I really appreciate how you are able to appear in the right place on the right time. I've got a question to you. How about a little trip to a far-away allod to find out how Sarnaut appeared? You will see the whole world from quite a new angel. That will be a real Revelation for you.

Ah, I see that familiar sparkle in your eyes. You are not going there on vacation. I have an important mission for you. It's about so called ritual of Reincarnation. You're asking, what it is? One say, it's a great gift. Others say, it's a powerful weapon. Technically speaking, Reincarnation is a transfer of your Spark into a different body, you may also describe it as immortality, but safer, than the gift of Tensess. By the way, you've already come across this phenomenon. Remember Gorluxor with his countless heads? I have no idea, how he found out about the Reincarnation rite, but it doesn't matter, anyway. Committee's agents have discovered a new source of information.

You are going to the Isle of Revelation. Nihaz and his servants are calling the shots there. You will find the Revelation of Tka-Rik and prepare for the Reincarnation rite - you're doubtlessly worthy of it. Klavdia Kalugina will help you with that. You will find her in Master's Citadel on the Isle of Revelation.

Good luck!

checkText.en: So, you want to know the Revelation. Aren't you scared? Those who discovered it before, broke down and cried. Some of them even committed suicide!

finishText.en:
Now you know the truth. Revelation of Tka-Rik, or Nihaz, or your own - it's up to you to decide. Are you feeling alright? You are very pale.

You'll be okay. We have another thing to take care of. Have you ever heard about the Reincarnation? Yes, you have? I guess Aidenus sent you here to find out about it, am I right?

goal.en: Receive Tka-Rik Revelation and find your way to Reincarnation. Report to Klavdia Kalugina.

startText.en:
I really appreciate how you are able to appear in the right place on the right time. I've got a question to you. How about a little trip to a far-away allod to find out how Sarnaut appeared? You will see the whole world from quite a new angel. That will be a real Revelation for you.

Ah, I see that familiar sparkle in your eyes. You are not going there on vacation. I have an important mission for you. It's about so called ritual of Reincarnation. You're asking, what it is? One say, it's a great gift. Others say, it's a powerful weapon. Technically speaking, Reincarnation is a transfer of your Spark into a different body, you may also describe it as immortality, but safer, than the gift of Tensess. By the way, you've already come across this phenomenon. Remember Gorluxor with his countless heads? I have no idea, how he found out about the Reincarnation rite, but it doesn't matter, anyway. Committee's agents have discovered a new source of information.

You are going to the Isle of Revelation. Nihaz and his servants are calling the shots there. You will find the Revelation of Tka-Rik and prepare for the Reincarnation rite - you're doubtlessly worthy of it. Klavdia Kalugina will help you with that. You will find her in Master's Citadel on the Isle of Revelation.

Best of luck in your heroic deeds!

finishText.en:
Do you remember the story with three Gorluxor's heads? Remember those strange machines in Gorluxor's Tower, or you haven't been there yet?
Anyway, explanation is always useful.
Tensess' Gift makes it possible for your Spark, which is the basis of your life, to return into your body after death. It makes resurrection possible and that is why Tensess became a Saint.
But what if there is no body? What if it was torn apart or at least decapitated?
Spark has no place to come back. Say "Hi" to death!
But Gorluxor resurrected. His body had no head but he resurrected.
Those machines made it possible. They created new bodies identical to the original! That's how the rebellious mage broke the restrictions of the Tensess' Gift.
Of course, Sarn was involved, as also was Tep. Demon cultists are trying to contact him. But it is not important right now.
The main question is what our counter-action will be.

goal.en: Ask about Klavdia Kalugina's concerns.

startText.en:
Hey, I'm not old! I am still young! Youth is not measured in years. It is all about your soul!
Well, let's think we greeted each other. How are you doing?
I'm not doing great.
Why? Because I'm concerned about the fate of the world.
Do you want to discuss it?

checkText.en: Eggs tasty! Lizardmen not tasty...

finishText.en:
You friend! You do good.
You take reward!

startText.en:
Lizardmen are our fathers. And our enemy! We fight lizard, but lizards are many. We need less lizard!
You help us! Find lizard village. Take lizard eggs. Five handfuls of eggs!
Me help you! Me reward you! Me reward you tasty! You agree?

checkText.en: Use the paralyzer, then the analyzer. Don't confuse them!

finishText.en:
Oh, here are the tissue samples. Great. We are grateful to you. Maybe... Somewhere deep in our souls. Somewhere very very deep...
Well, take your sign. Maybe we'll need more samples. Come from time to time to check if we have any new errands.

startText.en:
So, you've earned our respect? Good for you...
We need materials for further research. To be more precise, we need lymph extract from the Crawlers. If you bring us these samples you will earn our respect.
The task is difficult because we need these samples taken from a live Crawler, because before death, a Crawler's glands produce a lot of hormones and ferments, which may spoil experiment results.
In the Container under the Talk-back Device you will find a special device which can be used to paralyze a Crawler. When it is paralyzed you must take a sample from under its left neck plate. The analyzer will automatically store the sample in a special container, so you don't have to worry about dealing with 15 fragile bottles with solutions in as was the case with older technology. Be very careful! If you wake the Crawler you are in trouble!

checkText.en: As you have spent several minutes trying to open the latches of the chest you kick its rotten top with your leg and open it!

finishText.en:
Well-well! A cultist decided to hide his belongings in this chest assuming that no one will bother searching such a humble box. That was his huge mistake.
All good things will come to he who seeks. And if he seeks well...

goal.en: Open the old ordinary chest.

startText.en:
The chest looks old. The wood is darkened with time, its corners are covered with web and it is submerged an inch into the ground under its own weight. It seems to be here for several decades.
But there are fresh scratches on the latches and the hinges are dabbled with oil. Somebody must have opened it recently. Was anything taken from the chest or put inside?

checkText.en: Astralophone is cold and motionless.

finishText.en:
A new message on the surface of Astralophone is shimmering with dim light:
Congratulations to all adventurers who found the treasure. The less money cultists have, the less their influence is. Don't forget to check all hiding spots! You may discover another treasure and rob the Cult.

goal.en: Find the treasures hidden by the cultists somewhere on the Twilight Isle.

startText.en:
Text on the surface of the Astralophone says:
Attention! All adventurers fighting against cultists on the Twilight Isle!
Ruins of the ancient city hide a lot of valuables such as gold, gems and artifacts. Cultists might have discovered major part of them and might have hidden the loot somewhere in their camps.
The less gold the cultists have, the less people they will bribe. Adventurers! Don't miss your chance to find chests, boxes and other hidden treasures. Don't be shy to take the loot. All loot is tax free and belongs to the one who found it.

checkText.en: Meatbag... What do you want?

finishText.en:
You are not called meatbag anymore! You are now brother-brother!
You take necklace. You kill enemy, take tooth, add to necklace! Then everyone knows you are great hunter!

goal.en: Go to Draconid Island and talk to Chief Urgash about trust of Draconids.

startText.en:
I've heard about your success that you reached in relationship with our scaly allies. Winning the trust of such aggressive and suspicious creatures was not easy and I'm glad that you broke the wall of enmity.
I rely on Draconids and hope they will be a big help in the coming battle against Sarn. They are strong, quick and numerous. They have strong hate for Demons!
I believe you should go to their Chief and find out if they really accept you as their brethren and if they are ready to join us in the battle against our common enemy. Go and don't waste our time. If they really respect you as deeply as I was told then you may lead their army in the upcoming battle!

checkText.en: Everything in the world has its price, my friend. Only knowledge is priceless! We will never trust someone who doesn't want to work hard to earn the knowledge and looks for ready answers.

finishText.en:
We, the Overmind, hope that you as a distinguished member of your tribe will see the true value of our gift.
Now go. You made us face a tough choice. We are having new issues we have to think about.
Remember, you are our friend now. We are always happy to help someone who sincerely searches knowledge!

goal.en: Talk to the representative of the Overmind of the Wormfaces via Intercom and get the reward.

startText.en:
Wormfaces... What do we know about them? They are an ancient race, reserved and inhospitable. Also they are wise, reasonable and cruel. I am surprised at your success while others, like the Elven historian, failed this mission.
The fact that the Wormfaces trusted you a piece of their ancient knowledge is a huge step forward. They have been accumulating their knowledge about the world for thousands of years. Maybe the only thing we lack to understand the Truth is knowledge. They may help you to receive the Revelation and defeat Sarn.
Now go to the cave. One of the leaders of the Wormfaces, those who call themselves "The Overmind" sent us a message that he wants to see you. I believe the Wormfaces want to reward you!
Hurry up. I think that the reward will be very unusual.

checkText.en: Surface of the Astralophone is dark. There are no new messages.

finishText.en:
The new message confirms the success of the operation:
Great job! At least 50 demons passing through the portal at the moment of explosion turned into dust.
Unfortunately, we cannot block all portals. But if you keep on destroying their portals sooner or later they will rout and the Cult will be destroyed.

goal.en: Activate the Resonator at the Demonic Portal when cultists open it with their spells. Report to Astralophone at the Overlord's Stronghold.

startText.en:
The new order received via Astralophone says:
Urgent message to all armies of the Overlords and their allies!
Cultists found the way to transport reinforcements to the Twilight Isle through Demonic Portals. If we don't stop them, the whole campaign to capture the Twilight Isle may be at risk.
Seeker of Truth, you are entrusted with an important mission. There are Demonic Portals in the ruins on the Isle. Cultists need to keep them open to deliver reinforcements. If you interrupt the process and use the Resonator while cultists keep the portal open, it will collapse and everything inside it will be turned to dust.
The task is complicated because the field of an active portal quickly drains life from anyone who is not wearing special protection. You have a couple of seconds to approach the portal and activate the Resonator.

finishText.en:
Draconid sounds happy:
I knew you understood me! I'm so happy... Fire Father is happy! It is important! It is more important than me, than you, than everything. Fire Father is happy and we are all happy! The whole world is happy!

goal.en: Confirm that you are ready to prove your friendship to Draconid.

startText.en:
Surface of the Astralophone flashes brightly and you hear a very familiar voice in your head. It is your Draconid friend:
Friend and brother! I'm so glad talk to you. I do not see you but I hear you. You hear me?
I'm so glad!
Chief say Fire Father speak. I'm speaking with you! My friend. I know debt. Do you know debt?
You don't know? Friendship is debt! Always pay back. Die but pay back!
I die for you! You are brother and friend! Do you agree?

finishText.en:
Draconid sounds happy:
I knew you understood me! I'm so happy... Fire Father is happy! It is important! It is more important than me, than you, than everything. Fire Father is happy and we are all happy! The whole world is happy!

goal.en: Confirm that you are ready to prove your friendship to Draconid.

startText.en:
Surface of the Astralophone flashes brightly and you hear a very familiar voice in your head. It is your Draconid friend:
Friend and brother! I'm so glad talk to you. I do not see you but I hear you. You hear me?
I'm so glad!
Chief say Fire Father speak. I'm speaking with you! My friend. I know debt. Do you know debt?
You don't know? Friendship is debt! Always pay back. Die but pay back!
I die for you! You are brother and friend! Do you agree?

checkText.en: You hear the voice of Urgash full of hope: "Brother-brother. I'll wait. We are tough. We'll wait your hand bang a portal."

finishText.en:
You hear happy voice of Urgash in your head:
Brother-brother! You great warrior! You boom! Portal bang!
Great is pleased.
Now Great speaks with you. You listen. Great is clever! Great knows all.

goal.en: Use Kaboomer to destroy five Demonic Portals in different parts of the Twilight Isle and report your success via Astralophone in the Overlord's Stronghold.

startText.en:
Voice of Urgash the Draconids Chief reaches through noises in the Astralophone:
"Brother-brother! I talk. Strange thing bring my words, yes? Good.
We talk to great! Great talk wise things.
Great says demon not walk our land. Demon build por... port... portals! Demons not build. Their friend build. Cultists build. Portals everywhere! Worm-on-faces walk!
Me ask you. Take Kaboomer from Worm-on-faces. You seek portal. Find. You fire Kaboomer and run. Kaboomer bang, portal bang. We are happy-happy! We call you great warrior!

checkText.en: Mortal! You did everything right...

finishText.en:
I see my blood was not wasted. Dozens of demons were killed with fangs and claws of my children! They are enraged! That was our goal.
You see, all these errands: assassination of their leaders, explosion of portals and total extermination of the demonic scum lured by the smell of my blood had only one goal - to lure out of the depth of Astral the one called Ar'Kanim, the leader of octulhus and one of the strongest beasts of Sarn. Today I will put the end to his useless life myself!

goal.en: Open the vial with dragon blood in the location marked on the map of the Astral Coast and lure the demons. Then wait for the dragons to arrive and help them to defeat the demons.

startText.en:
Suddenly Urgash's voice disappears and you hear another mighty voice. It seems to come out of everywhere and it makes the land tremble:
Mortal! I am Soliskar the Wise, the Great Dragon. Once we met before, in the place which you, mortals, call the Dragon Ring. I believed in you back then. You... You are different from other mortals. You have something which distinguishes you among others. The errand I have for you I cannot entrust to anyone else.
You will get a vial with drops of my blood. After what happened to you on Kirah you know its priceless. Don't waste it!
I am asking you to open the vial with my blood in three locations on the southern coast in a place which you, mortals, call the Twilight Isle. Demons smell dragon's blood thousands wingbeats away. Hundreds of them will follow the smell. You won't defeat them alone. Give me a signal. Fire a red rocket and I will send my sons to help you. Their breath will turn astral beasts into ashes!
I hope you will succeed. Go now! We don't have much time. Follow my instructions! My blood is too precious to be wasted.

checkText.en: Ar'Kanim is dead... It means my time has come...

finishText.en:
Are you surprised that we cooperate with dragons?
Believe me, even sworn enemies may unite their efforts to defeat the power hostile to them both!

goal.en: Kill demon minions approaching the coast while Soliskar defeats Ar'Kanim.

startText.en:
Listen to me carefully, mortal. Ar'Kanim is on his way here from the depth of Astral. We have no time to argue.
Soon I will engage into battle against one of the strongest beasts of our enemy. I'm stronger than him, but countless demons will fight on his side. This is where I need your help.
When Ar'Kanim start losing his strength, he will summon demon minions to help him. If any of them reaches the coast where the fight takes place, Ar'Kanim will consume its power and heal his wounds.
Mortal! Do not let demon minions approach the coast! Kill them until I defeat Ar'Kanim. Your name will remain in the history of this world.
When Ar'Kanim is dead, you will meet another creature who helps us in this battle, a Wormface. Talk to him to receive further instructions.
The time has come! Let's start the battle!

checkText.en: I am waiting!

finishText.en:
Here it is... Ingot of Astral Iron... Now we the powers of the Seal belong to us! We have completed our part of the deal. The Great One will be pleased...
I know what you want, mortal. Fragment of the Crystal Armor, your next step to the Revelation. You will receive it from the Astralophone at the Citadel of your Master. Maybe then you'll understand what just happened!
Keep it in secret. Nobody should know about this ingot. Let everyone think that you, the great hero, defeated Ar'Kanim. I will remain in shadows.
Farewell, mortal! I don't think we'll ever meet again.

goal.en: Kill Wormface Fanatic and combine his blood with Ar'Kanim's blood. Bring the item you receive to Soliskar the Wise.

startText.en:
Listen to me carefully!
It doesn't matter who I am. My name gives you nothing as my life ends in several minutes. That's right. My death will save my nation.
Ar'Kanim is not just the leader of octulhus. His blood contains supreme powers given by Sarn. Dragons want to receive these powers.
My blood will start the reaction. I've been preparing myself for this day. My body suffered hundreds of magic effects, elixirs, potions and powders. Pure concentrated magic flows in my veins! The time has come to spill it.
I am telling you this to calm you down. Your strike must be precise. The stakes are too high. Don't let my death be meaningless!
Kill me and combine my blood with Ar'Kanim's blood.
Bring the mixture to Soliskar. It's our gift to dragons for their help. A part of the deal.
This deal must not be broken!

finishText.en:
Surface of the Astralophone flashes again and you hear the whisper of your Draconid friend:
The Father of Fire has chosen the reward for you... He gave you this shard. He told it was important for you... Mine is happy, very happy!

goal.en: Learn what the Father of Fire told your Draconid Friend.

startText.en:
Surface of the Astralophone flashes and you hear the familiar voice of your Draconid Friend:
Friend and brother! You my brother! The Father of Fire told so! You are brother to all! You helped!
What you want? You want I kill your relatives? You be free like fire! No debts! We often do so...
Oohh! The Father of Fire wants to tell me something! Wait!
One moment!

finishText.en:
Surface of the Astralophone flashes again and you hear the whisper of your Draconid friend:
The Father of Fire has chosen the reward for you... He gave you this shard. He told it was important for you... Mine is happy, very happy!

goal.en: Learn what the Great One told your Draconid Friend.

startText.en:
Surface of the Astralophone flashes and you hear the familiar voice of your Draconid Friend:
Friend and brother! You my brother! The Father of Fire told so! You are brother to all! You helped!
What you want? You want I kill your relatives? You be free like fire! No debts! We often do so...
Oohh! The Father of Fire wants to tell me something! Wait!
One moment!

checkText.en: Your Draconid Friend is waiting for your triumph. Don't let him down!

finishText.en:
Draconid's voice is coming from the Astralophone full of joy:
You great warrior! You kill demons. You kill all three! Me so happy! We so happy! Chief also happy! Fire Father happy!
Now Chief speaks. Listen to Chief. Chief clever! Chief also your friend.

goal.en: Kill Astral Beater, Demon Bloodsucker and Bloody Malefic somewhere on the Twilight Isle. Report your success back to Draconids using Astralophone in the Overlord's Stronghold.

startText.en:
Surface of the Astralophone is shining brightly. You hear the voice of your Draconid Friend:
You are great warrior. Me knows! Me ask you. Demons kill.
One demon is small. But quick. It run and bite.
Another demon strong. Very-very strong! With big axe.
Third is sly. Third is shaman. Ouch!
Me ask you. Find three demons and kill. Find everywhere and kill. You are friend! You are strong! You help me.

checkText.en: I'm sure you can find the cultists' hideout.

finishText.en: Yes, Twilight Isle is even scarier than Yazes Shard...

goal.en: Find Melchizedek Zavetin on the Twilight Isle and discuss the situation with him.

startText.en:
My friend, while you were gloriously fighting demons, I received a message. From Melchizedek Zavetin himself - he is a high-ranking Demonologist.

It looks like the cultists have another hideout on one of Yazes Shards. Melchizedek managed to infiltrate it.

The cultists are hiding something. I think he'll find a way to find out what.

If you happen to land on this Yazes Shard, find him. Let me know when you're ready to do it.

checkText.en: Have you found the key?

finishText.en:
Excellent. Well, I guess we'll part ways now.

We will look for this Citadel, and you... you follow the Lord.  I think there are many more revelations to come.

Sooner or later, we will meet again.

goal.en: Find the key to the Citadel

name.en: Key to the Gates of Destruction

startText.en:
The cultists have managed to build their own portal network. You need special enchanted keys to access it. Their power depends on the cultist's rank.

The highest ranking cultists can be found here on Twilight Isle, so we have a chance to find this key. I don’t know which cultist has it. I suggest killing everyone - sooner or later you'll find this key on one of the bodies. Then bring it to me.

checkText.en: What a fancy necklace... Let me examine it.

finishText.en:
Wonderful necklace! I can see teeth of various creatures in it: hydras, draconids... ahem... Humans, Elves and Orcs... This double tooth with a cavern belonged to a Troll! Unbelievable...
Draconids would not present such necklace to a stranger. It means that you are more than a friend to them. They trust you as if you were one of them. They are ready to fight on our side against Sarn!

goal.en: Bring Draconid Teeth Necklace to the Keeper of Knowledge in the Overlord's Stronghold.

startText.en:
A huge necklace made of teeth of different creatures proves your loyalty of Draconids. Such necklaces are usually worn by Draconid Leaders. You were the first one to receive such gift.
Keeper of Knowledge will be happy to have a look at it.

checkText.en: Fascinating book! Is it a gift from our Wormface allies? Let me take a closer look.

finishText.en:
I never had any doubts in you. I knew you would earn respect and trust of our allies! This book is written in ancient and now forgotten language. This language was used in the ages of the Junes. Even historians, the keepers of ancient knowledge, cannot understand what is written in this tome. But this language seems familiar to me.
I am absolutely sure that this book keeps the true history of the Wormfaces. This knowledge is priceless! I'll try to translate it, but it may take a lot of time.
It seems to me that reading the Grimoir is also a trial. The Wormfaces could have told us everything in our own language, as they normally do. They want you to translate the Grimoir because they want to make sure you are really interested in what they want to tell you.
Well, let's hope I finish the translation before we summon our allies to challenge Sarn. The most important thing is that you managed to win the trust of the Wormfaces!

goal.en: Bring the mysterious Grimoir to Keeper of Knowledge at the Overlord's Citadel.

startText.en:
Strange book in leather cover is decorated with mysterious symbols. No one can tell what is written there as the language of the book is not known in any part of Sarnaut. There is not a single picture in it... You cannot decypher the Grimoir on your own.
Perhaps the Keeper of Knowledge will be glad to have a look at it.

checkText.en: Did the Keeper of Knowledge send you?

finishText.en:
Greetings! You are just on time. The ship is ready to sail to the Twilight Isle. Eternal twilight covers the cursed land and captured the hearts of those who decided to support Sarn.
You can help us to purify these lands. The light of truth will shine upon the ancient stones!

goal.en: Meet the Herald of Wrath in the docks near the Citadel.

startText.en:
You heart knows no mercy to Overlord's enemies. Time has come to encounter the enemy we both know well, but now you will play by our rules. I am speaking about cultists serving Overlord's worst enemy Sarn.
Don't you know the latest news? Sarn's servants, cultists and demons, decided to defy Overlord's power and attack the Citadel. Somewhere in deep Astral they managed to find another Yazes shard and turned it into their secret camp. Now after the overwhelming defeat at Gorluxor's Tower this shard is their last hope. They created a colossal astral ship out of the lifeless rock chunk splitted off from a solid Allod! Huge chains hanging from the Allod down into Astral serve as a harness for the most powerful demons living in Astral - octulhus. Their incredible power enables them to drag the isle across the Astral. And now it is rapidly approaching the Isle of Revelation.
Acolytes of Sarn not only intend to destroy the Citadel - they want to deprive the whole world of the opportunity to learn the Truth, destroying the Revelation!
They want war, and they will get it! We will attack first. Overloard's wrath will incinerate them! You and other Revelation seekers are about to become that wrath!
Set off to the east coast of the Isle of Revelation and meet the Herald of Wrath. He will lead the mission on intruding the cultist camp.
Go now and bring us a victory!

checkText.en: You did break through all the barriers! Unbelievable...

finishText.en: Overlord has sent me here to break into the hideout of Sarn's acolytes and kill them. I can open the Portal between this Isle and the Citadel, but only with your assistance.

goal.en:
Make your way to the Twilight Isle coast on an Astral Sloop and talk to the Portal Keeper.
Use the Veil of Fog artifact to distract octulhus. If Demon Destroyers appear, use the Draconid Signal Horn to summon dragons. Astral Snipers can be easily destroyed using the Wave of Wrath artifact.

startText.en:
I am Overlord's Herald of Wrath! Overlord is merciful but his wrath knows no limit!
Sarn's minions, human cultists and demonic spawns, are going to destroy the Citadel. They gathered a strong army on their Twilight Isle, and demon guardians are whirling around it. We are going to strike them from the inside!
Our goal is to descent on the isle and regroup there. When we set up our defenses, we will open a portal for our army to destroy the enemy in its lair!
Operation Harpoon is aimed on penetrating the enemy's lair, and you are destined to be the pike of the harpoon.
A fast Astral sloop is waiting for the heroes at the dock. I will also give you a few artifacts to break through the demonic armada that defends the isle.
The first artifact is called Veil of Fog. Its power will avert gaze of the most dangerous demons, octulhus. As you come close to one of them, use the artifact, and the demons won't notice you.
The second artifact is the Draconid Signal Horn already familiar to you. If Demon Destroyers attack the sloop, blow the horn and our ally dragons will come to help.
Finally, the third artifact is called Wave of Wrath. During the whole way to the Twilight Isle your sloop will be attacked by lesser demons, Astral Snipers. Overlord's Wrath contained in the artifact will incinerate all of them!
Set off now and good luck to you, Seeker of Truth!
Remember that the sloop is designed only for one passenger! You will have to break through alone, there is only yourself to count on.

checkText.en: You did break through all the barriers! Unbelievable...

finishText.en: Overlord has sent me here to break into the hideout of Sarn's acolytes and kill them. I can open the Portal between this Isle and the Citadel, but only with your assistance.

goal.en:
Make your way to the Twilight Isle coast on an Astral Sloop and talk to the Portal Keeper.
Use the Veil of Fog artifact to distract octulhus. If Demon Destroyers appear, use the Draconid Signal Horn to summon dragons. Astral Snipers can be easily destroyed using the Wave of Wrath artifact.

Sarn's minions, human cultists and demonic spawns, are going to destroy the Citadel. They gathered a strong army on their Twilight Isle, and demon guardians are whirling around it. We are going to strike them from the inside!
Our goal is to descent on the isle and regroup there. When we set up our defenses, we will open a portal for our army to destroy the enemy in its lair!
Operation Harpoon is aimed on penetrating the enemy's lair, and you are destined to be the pike of the harpoon.
A fast Astral sloop is waiting for the heroes at the dock. I will also give you a few artifacts to break through the demonic armada that defends the isle.
The first artifact is called Veil of Fog. Its power will avert gaze of the most dangerous demons, octulhus. As you come close to one of them, use the artifact, and the demons won't notice you.

Set off now and good luck to you, Seeker of Truth!
Remember that the sloop is designed only for one passenger! You will have to break through alone, there is only yourself to count on.

checkText.en: Hurry up, we have a little bit of time left!

finishText.en:
I don't know how long I can keep the Portal open... The Guardian is in rage and is trying to close it. Perhaps I will need you help again later.
Now that the Portal is being kept open, allied troops of the Wormfaces and Draconids can start fighting the enemy. But we, as Overlord's vanguard, still have a lot to do...

goal.en: Gain access to the portals of Twilight Isle

startText.en: We, Overlord's Scouts, managed to get to that cursed isle before there were too many demons around the coast. But I couldn't open the portal here! I did it a thousand times before, but the monster guarding the portal on the Isle is truly terrific! Apparently, it is filled with demonic foulness. I nearly jumped into the Astral with fear! Fortunately, we have found the way to restrain those fiends, and now the portal is at your service.

checkText.en: Red letters are still burning on the surface of the Astralophone, warning you of the increased demonic activity.

finishText.en:
Scarlet letters flash and another message appears:
"You made it! We saw how the chain collapsed and disappeared in the depths of the Astral. Cultists are no longer ready for a battle. They will spend all their resources to repair the chains.
Remember, Overlord encourages not only those who can bravely fight alone. If your guild helps us in the war against Sarn, if your comrades participate in upcoming battles against the Twilight Isle demons, the Prestige of your guild will increase incredibly."

goal.en: Use acid and the hammer to smash 5 weak chain links. Report to the Headquarter Astralophone in Overlord's Stronghold. Pouring 3 vials of acid within 5 minutes destroys a chain link.

startText.en:
Huge pulsating scarlet letters are displayed on the Astralophone surface:
"Attention! Demons are trying to attack the Citadel. Troops stationed on the Twilight Isle must stop them at any cost.
To those who are faithful to their Overlord! Fight for your faith, for Sarnaut and the truth!"
The second part of the message is displayed below:
Chains hanging down from the edges of the isle serve as harness for powerful demons - octulhus. They are very strong and can drag the isle across the Astral! That's how they brought it to Misty Lands, and their next target is the Citadel! We must stop them!
All Seekers of Truth will receive hammers made of the strongest alloy, and a bottle of concentrated acid. The acid weakens chain links and makes them easier to destroy.
Hurry up! The cultists will try to fix the chains. The moment when they do that is depicted in your calendar. Come to the Astral Coast just before they arrive.
Destroy at least one of these chains. The cultists will need a lot of time to fix it."

checkText.en: Scarlet letters informing about the increased demon activity are still vivid on the surface of the Astralophone.

finishText.en:
Scarlet letters flash and disappear, another message appears:
"Show no mercy to the enemies of the Overlord! Now you know that the cold fury of Truth can smash any obstacles, no matter whether it's just one demon or the whole army. After our victory, the cultists will not dare to attack the Citadel soon!
Remember, Overlord encourages not only those who can bravely fight alone. If your guild helps us in the war against Sarn, if your comrades participate in upcoming battles against the Twilight Isle demons, the Prestige of your guild will increase incredibly."

goal.en: Destroy as many demons and cultists on the Twilight Isle as possible. Report to the Headquarter Astralophone in Overlord's Stronghold.

startText.en:
Huge pulsating scarlet letters are displayed on the Astralophone surface:
"Attention! Demons are trying to attack the Citadel. Troops stationed on the Twilight Isle must stop them at any cost.
To those who are faithful to their Overlord! Fight for your faith, for Sarnaut and the truth!"
The second part of the message is displayed below:
Wait until the time specified in your calendar comes, and join the battle against the demons and their minions. All Seekers of Truth will fighting together against Overlord's foe!
Kill as many demons and cultists as possible! Let their rotten blood wash the rocks! No one dares to defy Overlord!
Let the pious fury fill your soul! Embrace the rage and act in the name of Overlord!"

checkText.en: Scarlet letters informing about the increased demon activity are still vivid on the surface of the Astralophone.

finishText.en:
Scarlet letters flash, and another message appears:
"Stay on course, Seeker of Truth! Demons suffer great losses, today they will not attempt to break into the Citadel. The enemy is not overthrown completely, and if tomorrow they attack again, we will hold another warm welcome."
Remember, Overlord encourages not only those who can bravely fight alone. If your guild helps us in the war against Sarn, if your comrades participate in upcoming battles against the Twilight Isle demons, the Prestige of your guild will increase incredibly."

checkText.en: If you bring me all seven fragments, I'll restore the Crystal Armor for you.

finishText.en: Congratulations! You have found all seven fragments. Let me complete the repair, and soon you'll be able to step into Tka-Rik's Cave, towards the Revelation!

goal.en: Collect seven fragments of Zak's Crystal Armor scattered across the Misty Lands.

startText.en:
Before the battle against the June Curse, Ath-Zak, known as Zak to you, equipped his legendary armor made of diamonds - not just shiny gems sought by Sarnaut inhabitants, but high-purity diamond crystals that have souls of their own. These crystals also have a rare property - they greatly increase magic effects applied to their wearer. Protective spells of a Great Mage Tka-Rik, additionally enhanced by the crystals, allowed Zak to fight the Curse and destroy it.
However, the Curse managed to deliver the final blow to Zak, putting all its anger into it. No one would resist such power! Tka-Rik saved Zak, but the armor was broken and shattered into seven pieces. You need to collect the fragments of Zak's Crystal Armor.
I'm sure the enchantment cast on the armor will allow you to enter Tka-Rik Cave and learn the Revelation. Find the seven fragments, and I'll be able to restore the armor for you.
It won't be easy. Fragments were lost many years ago, and we only know the location of the first one. You will have to search for the rest by yourself.

finishText.en:
It is rightfully yours.
Helmet of Knowledge. Helmet of Wisdom. Helmet of the Revelation...
Wait a minute! I haven't finished yet! Once they hear that word, they rush to the Revelation...
Listen to me first, I have something to say.

goal.en: Receive the Crystal Helmet from Overlord's Herald.

startText.en:
So, the Crystal Helmet. Yes, just a helmet so far. You'll receive the whole armor along with the Revelation. If you survive, of course.
This is exactly the same helmet that crowned Ath-Zak's head during his fight against the June Curse.
Tka-Rik, a Great Mage who died during the first demon invasion, sealed the cave with his postmortem will. Overlord additionally strengthened his magic using the greatest power in the world - the power of Zak's victory over June Curse.
Now only the one who wears this helmet will be able to get inside. Destructive veil protects the cave and the Revelation. Protects from demons, of course. I suppose you remember that the June Curse once had the appearance of a demon. One of the first demons in the world...
However, you'll learn the details from the Guardian of the Revelation. My job is to entrust you the Crystal Helmet.

finishText.en:
You are here...
It means you are allowed to know the truth about this world. I'm here to help you.

goal.en: Go through the destructive veil that protects Tka-Rik's Cave and meet the Guardian of the Revelation.

startText.en:
So. Here it is - the most important task in your life!
Go through the Destructive Veil that protects Tka-Rik's Cave and meet the Guardian of the Revelation. Find out the truth about this world.
May Overlord protect you!

checkText.en: Whisper in your head says: "The experiment must go on... Don't stop, no matter what's happening."

finishText.en:
When you touch the cold surface of Astralophone, you can hear a hissing voice of a Wormface:
"So, the first phase of the experiment is complete. The results are not yet clear, but we don't have enough time for detailed analysis. It's time to start the second phase."

Even such an unusual way of communication can't hide notes of relief that are heard in Wormface's voice:
"We trust you.
Not because we have no other options, but because we are tired of distrust. Sometimes a moment comes when one should forget about the past and make a step into the future."

goal.en: Confirm that you are ready to keep the secret of the Wormfaces.

startText.en:
Instead of text, the Astralophone surface is lit with bright glow. You hear rustling voice of a Wormface:
"Overmind welcomes you, friend. We need your help in an important experiment.
But before we get your consent, we want you to know that we value the ability to keep silence higher than diligence. No one should know what we plan and what instructions you receive from us.
Are you willing to keep our secret?"

finishText.en:
Even such an unusual way of communication can't hide notes of relief that are heard in Wormface's voice:
"We trust you.
Not because we have no other options, but because we are tired of distrust. Sometimes a moment comes when one should forget about the past and make a step into the future."

goal.en: Confirm that you are ready to keep the secret of the Wormfaces.

startText.en:
Instead of text, the Astralophone surface is lit with bright glow. You hear rustling voice of a Wormface:
"Overmind welcomes you, friend. We need your help in an important experiment.
But before we get your consent, we want you to know that we value the ability to keep silence higher than diligence. No one should know what we plan and what instructions you receive from us.
Are you willing to keep our secret?"

checkText.en: Notes of impatience are heard in the voice of the Wormface on the Twilight Isle: "Have you killed the Flesh Torturer? No? What are you waiting for? Experiment must be completed as soon as possible! We count on you."

finishText.en:
Genuine rejoice is heard in Wormface's voice through the noise. Surely he's pleased with your progress:
"Great! The device worked perfectly! The second phase of experiment went in full accordance with our expectations. There is one last step, and it will be completed."

goal.en: Use the mysterious device on Flesh Torturer and kill him. Report to the Astralophone in Overlord's Stronghold.

startText.en:
Wormface is whispering over the Astralophone:
"Here comes the second phase of the experiment. Demons Weepers are not strong enough to destroy... er... well, the first phase proved that they didn't fit. This is why one of the most powerful demons, known as Flesh Torturer, is required for the second phase. We hope that the strength absorbed by the artifact will provide the effect we need. Haven't you thought that this artifact absorbs the power of killed demons? Are you incapable of scientific analysis at all?! We can't tell you so far what it is for. Just trust us, we are your friends.
You will find Flesh Torturer to the far southeast of the Overlord's Stronghold, at the Astral Coast. Activate the device and destroy the demon. You will do a great favor for us and for the whole world by killing that dangerous beast. Don't be surprised if you notice something strange to the device. Everything is under control."

checkText.en: Wow! The device is destroyed... Was it supposed by the experiment?

finishText.en:
Strange Spark is hovering above the ground.
It appeared as soon as a mysterious device of the Wormfaces exploded... Was it hidden inside all this time? But whose Spark it is?

goal.en: Use the mysterious device on Bumpy and defeat the demon.

startText.en:
The voice of the Wormface is shivering with impatience:
"Overmind is satisfied, my friend. Your assistance is truly invaluable. If our scientists made no mistakes in their calculations, we need to kill one more demon to complete the experiment.
This demon is incredibly strong, but we are sure you can defeat him. Even more powerful enemies died by your hand!
Bumpy has been frequently seen at the foothill of the Gloomy Rocks. Don't forget to activate the device before the battle. Go now! We'll be waiting for the result."

checkText.en:
Mortal!
Have you brought what we need?

finishText.en:
Hmm... Have we met before?
I don't think so. I hate your kind. I mean people, elves, gibberlings, orcs... All of you. If I meet someone, it usually ends with their death!
There may be exceptions, anyway... For example, you.
I'm executing the will of a more powerful creature than you can imagine. It is the only reason I'm talking to you and... urrrgh!... I should even reward you, as required by the agreement...

goal.en: Deliver the Strange Spark to the top of the Dragon Peak and meet the one who is awaiting you.

startText.en:
The Spark is shining with a dim light. It grows and becomes brighter, and eventually you see nothing but the light all around...
You see a vision.
A narrow path curls through the mountains. It seems this place is somewhere in the Gloomy Rocks to the north from here. A vague figure is walking down the road with an opalescent Spark hovering nearby. This figure seems to be... you!
The demons are attacking the figure and the Spark. They are dying, one by one.
The Spark and you are reaching the top of the rock, wing clapping can be heard, and something enormous is descending from above, powerful and dangerous. There is no choice... This is the creature you must challenge.
The vision disappears, you see the Spark slowly hovering upwards and landing into your hands. It seems the Spark wants you to find this place in the Gloomy Rocks. Was it a part of the Wormfaces's plan?

checkText.en: Do you want to stay alive, mortal?

finishText.en:
Good decision.
I've got what you were searching for... A fragment of Crystal Armor. I should give it to you. This is a payment for your silence. It is much safer when a person keeps silence not only because of their fear...
With this fragment you will soon find the truth... But I don't think you will like it, mortal.
Farewell! If everything goes as intended, we'll never see each other again. Don't expect me to miss you! Ha ha...

goal.en: Confirm that you understand what Agrus told you.

startText.en:
I'm taking this Spark away from you. All this mess was started because of it...
Don't even ask me whose Spark it was! I want to forget it... You think that I, the Great Dragon, would have helped to resurrect one of... one of those who killed my brethren?
But this is a part of a deal between my kin and the Wormfaces. We are granting them this life, and they will return us another one...
Enough of it! No living or dead soul should know about the Spark and our conversation! If you leak a word you will die! Do you understand?

checkText.en: You should hurry up and deliver the documents...

finishText.en:
The voice coming out of the speaker is full of discontent:
"This... this is not what we were looking for at all! The papers are worthless... Well, a negative result is still a result. Let's have another try tomorrow. Thank you."

goal.en: Make use of the Will Suppressor and capture the body of a cultist. Find the secret documents in Desecrated City and hide them among the stones near the Overlord's Stronghold. Then break the mental link with the cultist, get the documents from the cache and deliver them to the Will Suppressor.

startText.en:
Signal lamp flashes over Will Suppressor, and a low imperious voice sounds from the speaker:
"Seeker of Truth! Are you already familiar with this device, a creation of Overmind and Overlord's Servants? No? Then listen to me carefully.
You can use this device to control the mind of another creature for a short time and manipulate its body like your own. In the meanwhile your own body will be lying peacefully in the sarcophagus inside the Will Suppressor. The device has undergone field tests successfully. We are entrusting you the honor to carry out the final test.
The task is simple. While you are lying in the sarcophagus, your mind should seize the body of a cultist. As soon as you establish control, make a small sabotage. Take cultist documents out of the chest hidden in the depths of Desecrated City, and put them into the stones to the east of the Stronghold. If everything goes smoothly, the cultist won't remember anything. You will only have to take the documents out of the cache and pass the information to us.
Keep in mind: we want a clear experiment. You have to pass this test alone. Don't try asking your friends to help you, or you will fail."

checkText.en: What brings you here?

finishText.en:
Another piece of armor that belonged to the ancient June hero. Wonderful!
I will take it from you and keep it until all the fragments are found.

goal.en: Bring the fragment to Overlord's Herald in the Citadel.

name.en: Dull Fragment of the Crystal Armor

startText.en:
The fragment is glistening and sparkling with warm glare coming out of the cold stone. Mighty ancient magic is concealed in that lifeless crystal, and if someone manages to set it free, the barrier blocking the entrance to Tka-Rik's Cave will fall.
Give the fragment to Overlord's Herald. He will keep it until you collect the remaining pieces.

checkText.en: What brings you here?

finishText.en:
Another piece of armor that belonged to the ancient June hero. Wonderful!
I will take it from you and keep it until all the fragments are found.

goal.en: Bring the fragment to Overlord's Herald in the Citadel.

name.en: Jagged Fragment of the Crystal Armor

startText.en:
The fragment is glistening and sparkling with warm glare coming out of the cold stone. Mighty ancient magic is concealed in that lifeless crystal, and if someone manages to set it free, the barrier blocking the entrance to Tka-Rik's Cave will fall.
Give the fragment to Overlord's Herald. He will keep it until you collect the remaining pieces.

finishText.en:
Stop! Don't say a word.
I know everything. You were in Tka-Rik's Cave and now you know the truth.
You can be proud. You were there in person! Back in Nezeb's times, best minds of the Empire puzzled their brains over the secrets of the past. They were analyzing the events, discussing different theories. No one in their worst dream could even imagine that our world is a prison created by one god for another!
One thing I understand clearly: in the nearest future we are going to make a choice - either we obey our creator and help him to set free, or we betray him for the sake of our happy lives.
Junes made the choice in their times. And where are they now? Who they turned into? Do you want to follow their way? Would it be right?
Think about that.
And think about another thing: what made Wormfaces and dragons defy the gods? What did they hope for? What do they know that we don't?

goal.en: Return to Yasker in Nezebgrad.

startText.en:
Let me ask you for a favor. When you return to Nezebgrad, find Yasker, the most influential and dangerous man in the Empire, and whisper the following words into his ear: "I'm the one who knows the Truth. Isn't it time for you to set off to the Isle of Revelation?"
Don't be afraid. You have done so many great deeds, I'm sure this little joke will pass unpunished.

finishText.en:
You too...
You are not the one who reminds me of the fact that our world has changed...
I'm not going anywhere - I'm old and I've seen enough to believe your words. You are not the first one to come running here, believing you are a great messiah who just learned the Truth.
If I say I knew everything beforehand, it would be a lie. I didn't.
I've been guessing, making up elaborate theories, arguing with my teachers and students, thinking it over and over again.
And you just got everything on a platter. You know the truth about our world. This is a prison for a god suffering from schizophrenia. Or a theater stage for a barnstormer in need of audience?
What are you going to do with this knowledge? Huh? Have you thought about that?
I have. Here is my revelation to you. In the nearest future we will have to make the most difficult choice. Not between right and wrong - it would be easy. The choice between one wrong and another. As Junes did once. Were they mistaken? What would you do if you were them? Or... what will you do being yourself?
Think.
There is one hope for me in this story. The determination of the Great Dragons and the Wormfaces to defy Nihaz. It means there is something that gives them ground to believe in their victory. I wish I knew what it is.

goal.en: Return to Aidenus in Novobgrad.

startText.en:
Let me ask you for a favor. When you return to Novobgrad, find Aidenus, the most influential and dangerous man in the League, and whisper the following words into his ear: "I'm the one who knows the Truth. Isn't it time for you to set off to the Isle of Revelation?"
Don't be afraid. You have done so many great deeds, I'm sure this little joke will pass unpunished.

checkText.en: How is your search going, Truth Seeker?

finishText.en:
Aha! I had no doubt that someone managed to escape and deliver the message.
Let's see what you have got...

goal.en: Find the cultist message and bring it to Wise Pathfinder in Overlord's Stronghold.

startText.en:
I received a word from the Citadel. It concerns both you and our enemies, servants of the demonic cult.
Scouts on the Revelation Isle reported a big well-trained group of cultists fighting their way to the Tka-Rik's Cave entrance. Cultists managed to neutralize the defensive spell surrounding the cave for a short time, so they got inside. Our scouts couldn't follow them. They heard the sounds of combat from the depth of the cave. After a while, a single fighter came out. He was wounded, worn out by a mighty spell. Life was leaving him quickly. The only thing our scouts could learn was that he was covering his captain till the last minute. The captain fled back to the Twilight Isle with a message.
Any information concerning Tka-Rik's Cave is vitally important for us. Start searching among cultists, perhaps this message contains something that might help us see into their motives.

checkText.en: What do you want?

finishText.en:
Interesting... So, the cultists managed to break through the magic barrier and enter the cave. They met an Ancient Guardian there who killed most of them with a deadly magic, "the spell of the Ancient Ones" - that is how the cultists refer to Junes.
So this Ancient Guard is a June creation... But I have never heard that golems, the only June creations that survived to this day, were capable of using magic. I suspect that you will meet something unknown in Tka-Rik's Cave.

goal.en: Find the other part of the Blood-Stained Scroll and bring both parts to Wise Pathfinder in Overlord's Stronghold.

startText.en:
The scroll is torn and smeared with blood. Lower part of it is missing. Unfortunately, a part of the text is illegible, but the remained fragment contains information that can be useful.
This scroll is a cultists' report of an attempt to break into Tka-Rik's Cave. "Ancient Guard", "Magic of the Ancients" and "Deadly Glow" are mentioned in the scroll several times.
You should try and find the second part of the scroll. Keep an eye on Cultist Defilers...
If you find both parts, it will be more clear what the cultists were searching in the cave and what stopped them.

checkText.en: Have you found the papers?

finishText.en:
Oh! Very interesting...
The message is encrypted, but the cipher is so primitive that it's easy to understand what it is about.

goal.en: Bring the message about Tka-Rik's Cave to Wise Pathfinder in Overlord's Stronghold.

startText.en:
Small holes along the edge of the scroll indicate that it was stapled to another paper. There must have been additional orders attached!
Continue your searches! I'm sure that cultists had more papers, they can lead us to understanding of what will happen to you in Tka-Rik's Cave.
Keep an eye on Cultist Assassins. They are the elite troops of cultists' army, eyes and ears of Hierarchs. I have no doubt they are aware of the expedition to Tka-Rik's Cave.

checkText.en: Have you got the fragment?

finishText.en:
Wow! Even a legion of demons couldn't stop you!
Not only you tricked cultists, but received another fragment! It's time for the Cult to give up the idea to break into the cave. Only the one who restored the armor of the greatest June hero deserves to learn the Revelation!
I'll keep this fragment and preserve it until the time is right.

goal.en: Kill Lawrence Weirdin, take the Fragment of Crystal Armor from him and bring it to Overlord's Herald in the Citadel.

startText.en:
One of the papers you found contains an order of a Cultist Hierarch. He commands his most loyal servants, Cultist Assassins, to make every effort and find the fragments of Zak's Crystal Armor! It seems they are unaware that you've already found most of the fragments.
Cultists managed to find one fragment. It's kept at Lawrence Weirdin, runaway Xadaganian explorer who participated in research of June heritage under the Committee's order.
I don't know how cultists make people like Weirdin cooperate. But then again, even the Great Mage Gorluxor fell for Sarn's persuasion and headed the Cult.
In any case, you have to take the fragment away from Weirdin, and certainly he won't give it without a fight.

checkText.en: The surface of Astralophone remains cold and lifeless. You might have not completed the task yet...

finishText.en:
Fancy letters appears on the surface of Astralophone:
"Elimination of Hounds is confirmed. Congratulations!
But don't be satisfied with what you have achieved already. Every enemy you kill brings us closer to victory!"

startText.en:
Message on the surface of Astralophone says:
"Astral Hounds inhabiting the Twilight Isle found an opportunity to assault the Draconid Isle and destroy their eggs. If they continue their raids, Draconids won't help us in the upcoming battle. All their forces will be aimed at saving their children.
We can't leave our allies without support. You are entrusted with a task of killing as many Astral Hounds as possible. The Draconids will be very grateful, you'll see."

checkText.en: Astralophone surface remains dark and lifeless.

finishText.en:
A new message appears on the surface of Astralophone:
"Elimination of Servants of the Demonic Cult is confirmed. Well done!
Let all Overlord's enemies meet this fate!"

startText.en:
Letters appear on the cold surface of the Astralophone:
"Rumors coming from larger Allods say that cultists recruit more followers into their ranks. Demonic Cult Servants are everywhere, bringing discord to Sarnaut inhabitants. Here, on Twilight Isle, they are preparing their adepts to go out to the big world and bring neophytes to the Cult.
All Seekers of Truth on Twilight Isle are entrusted with an assignment to kill as many Demonic Cult Servants as possible."

checkText.en: Astralophone surface is dark. You have no new messages.

finishText.en:
Fancy fiery letters appear on the surface of the Astralophone:
"The death of Ash must have disturbed the pack of Astral Hounds. They won't be so dangerous anymore and will never show their noses outside of the Isle until a new leader emerges."

goal.en: Participate in killing Ash, the leader of Astral Hounds and report to Headquarter Astralophone in Overlord's Stronghold.

startText.en:
Scarlet symbols flash on the surface of the Astralophone:
"Our observers watching the Twilight Isle coast noticed a surprisingly large and angry male Astral Hound whose hide is night black. Other Hounds cringe before him. We called that demon Ash.
All heroes on the Twilight Isle are assigned to kill Ash. The demon can be found in the southern part of the Isle, on the border of the Desecrated City and Astral Coast."

checkText.en: Surface of the Astralophone is blank and cold. There are no new messages.

finishText.en:
Flaming letters are displayed on the surface of the Astralophone:
"Great! We have received the trophies and started the research. Hopefully we will manage to disclose the secret of the new alloy. If we need more weapon to analyze, we'll inform you. Thanks for the excellent job!"

checkText.en: Astralophone is blank and silent.

finishText.en:
A new message appears on the surface of the Astralophone:
"Good job! First results are already obtained. Unfortunately, we couldn't disclose the connection between demons and cultists yet. Cultist heart is no different from a heart of an ordinary Sarnaut's habitant.
Perhaps they just lack material for experiments? If they need new specimens for research we'll inform you."

checkText.en: A warning appears on the surface of the Astralophone: "You must find Aristarkh Zlobin's Diary. Don't waste your time."

finishText.en:
The message on the Astralophone surface says:
"Don't be surprised that the diary looks like an issue of "Pointy Ears" magazine. Its pages are most certainly covered by some code. We couldn't decipher it yet, but we won't abandon our attempts. Many of the Citadel inhabitants are interested in this research, too. Thanks for your excellent job."

goal.en: Bring Aristarkh Zlobin' Diary to the Headquarter Astralophone.

startText.en:
Luminous letters appear on the cold surface of the Astralophone:
"Have you heard of Aristarkh Zlobin? No? Well, isn't it a proof that the glory is not eternal...
He was once one of the most experienced and skilled commanders of the Imperial Army. He became famous for his determination and ability to plan very complex missions. No one could have imagined that Zlobin would defect to our enemies and serve to the Demonic Cultists and Sarn.
What did break his will? If we manage to find out how the cultists recruit new adherents, we will use this knowledge to our benefit.
It is known that Zlobin kept a diary where he noted everything that happened to him and his squad. All his thoughts, feelings and actions... There must be a record of the event that pushed him to the enemy's side!
Find Zlobin at the Astral Coast of the Twilight Isle, kill him and bring his diary to the Headquarter Astralophone."

checkText.en: Our enemy is strong, but we are not giving ground!

finishText.en: You are just in time. The Isle is swarming with demons and cultists. Any help will be useful!

goal.en: Get on board of the Astral Sloop and go to the Twilight Isle.

startText.en:
Our landing is not going as smooth as we'd like to... Demons are attacking our ships, cultists give no mercy to fighters trying to open a portal to Overlord's Stronghold.
You weren't lucky today, too, were you? Many heroes perished in battle. Some of them didn't have your luck, and their Sparks disintegrated in the endless Astral...
But despite to the losses, we must keep assaulting the Twilight Isle. If you are ready, Astral Sloop is waiting for you.
Remember that you can only travel there alone! If you are in a party or a raid, the way will be closed.
May the Overlord's powers keep you safe!

finishText.en:
The body is so disfigured that you cannot even recognize the face! Poor bastard...
But at least now you know what happened to the expedition: everyone was massacred by draconids. Or perhaps someone managed to survive?

goal.en: Go to Draconid Island to find out what happened to the Demon Hunter expedition.

startText.en:
You remember Alexey Borodin, don't you? The hunter emissary who helped you befriend the draconids? Well, it looks like he and his friends are in trouble.
Before that despicable betrayal took place he and I used to correspond virtually every day. He would send me letters with one of his subordinates. Thanks to his reports we have learned a lot about the draconids' culture and religion.
But now I've lost all contact with him! No one has returned from the island yet. The Keeper of Power has sent his scouts there, but they too have disappeared without a trace.
Please, should your journey take you to Draconid Island, find out what happened to the Demon Hunters. They are a fine bunch, and I really don't want to believe that they are dead...
Go talk to the Master's Voice to get to Draconid Island. It knows what should be done.

finishText.en:
Cough... Did they really send someone to our aid?
Too late... Dead! They're dead, you hear me?! All my friends are dead! Killed by those goddamn draconids! We were attacked at night while we were asleep! Can you imagine? A horde of toothy beasts bursts from the darkness, shouting some crap about the Master's betrayal and death to all his servants... They simply overwhelmed us.
I'm the only one who managed to draw a weapon and slay a couple of those bastards. Then I was forced back and down to the shore, where I sustained a few wounds. I had no option but to flee. What a disgrace...
I should have stayed with them... With my hunter friends... Till the last drop of blood... I was right to never have trusted those beasts!
You will help me exact vengeance, won't you?

goal.en: Find Alexey Borodin on Draconid Island.

startText.en:
Looks like the camp was attacked suddenly. The hunters had scarcely realized what was going on before they were literally torn to shreds! There's blood and signs of struggle everywhere...
Indeed, though they were taken by surprise, the demon hunters sold their lives dearly! They died like heroes.
And yet, oddly enough Alexey Borodin is not among the disfigured bodies! Could it be that the battle-hardened veteran has managed to survive and is hiding somewhere on the island?
This must be verified!

checkText.en: I won't find peace until my comrades are avenged!

finishText.en:
Yes! Those filthy beasts shall remember this day and this hour for a long time! They shall curse the moment they had decided to commit their perfidious attack.
Thank you from the bottom of my heart, comrade!
