checkText.en: One day we shall live on the surface once again, unburdened by the heavy armor that protects me and my brothers from the scorching sun... And woe to anyone who might try to drive us back underground!

finishText.en:
The Queen is dead? That's great news! Alas, some other draconid will soon her place soon... The draconids procreate like wild beasts. Well, they are beasts, after all. And each destroyed nest is a step towards the triumph of reason throughout the world.
I promised you a reward and I shall keep my word!

goal.en: Participate in killing the Draconid Queen and bring her head to Kaid in the Dusty Ruins.

startText.en:
Your victory looked... reassuring to me and my brothers. We Destroyers are endowed with a special gift. Our vow and our code bid us to use our power for one purpose only - to destroy creatures that breed like locust. I'm talking about the draconids! It wasn't long that the world didn't even know about them. And in just a few years their numbers have exploded to a point where they are primed to overwhelm the whole world, their scaly flesh sweeping away everyone and everything like an avalanche. But I, Kaid, vow that this shall never happen! We shall destroy these despicable creatures and their false god they call the Fiery Father. And we propose to you to join us in this war. Your aid will not make us friends for as long as you serve the traitor. But the war against surface dwellers is not our war. We only fight the draconids and their allies.
My brothers have found a nest on the Smoldering Highland. And not just any nest, but the queen's nest! It is guarded by the giant draconid queen, and I fear to imagine what might hatch from those eggs.
Bring me her head and I shall reward you handsomely. Have no doubt that by destroying that creature before she breeds a swarm of cold-blooded killers, you will be doing a good deed. But bear in mind that this queen is stronger than all of my brothers combined. To best her you will need a strong team.

finishText.en: Finally! I've been waiting for you!

goal.en: Meet the Master's Voice in the Citadel.

startText.en:
Well, now you know... quite a lot. Not all there is to know, but what I've told you is more than enough. The vast majority of living things live long and utterly blind lives without ever learning even a tiny fraction of what you now know. For now, I have nothing more to tell you. Later, perhaps.
Now go to my faithful servant. What does he call himself? Ah, yes - the Master's Voice... Well, that can't be helped - there is a measure of theatrics inherent to my creatures. Every single one of them believes they've been chosen by the gods!
In short, go to the Master's Voice. It will fill you in on the details.

checkText.en: We cannot engage in an all-out battle for as long as traitors are threatening the Citadel. Hurry up!

finishText.en:
Your reputation precedes you.
With our enemies defeated, the Citadel is safe. It's time you headed for the Frontier!

goal.en: Eliminate the draconid and wormface threats, then return to the Master's Voice at the Citadel.

startText.en:
We shall annihilate the traitors! We will wipe them from the face of the earth! If you are loyal to the Master, if your heart is repulsed by treachery, as is mine, then you can help us.
Go seek out the Keepers of the Altar of Truth. They will explain the plan to protect the Citadel from our former allies. Follow their instructions as if they came from the Master himself! Return to me once you've dealt with our foes on Draconid Island and in the Wormface Cave.

checkText.en: What tidings do you bring - good or ill?

finishText.en: Good lord! I can't believe it! Don't bother, I've already heard the story of your battle with the giant worm. I burn with envy! Such a victory will no doubt inspire my good friend Vasya the Cornflower to compose a ballad! Of course, he does write ballads at the drop of a hat. At least this one will be about fighting. Ah! I promised you a prize! Would a song do? A song might bear your name for centuries! No? Then take your prize. George Siverian's word is his bond!

goal.en: Go to the Frontier and find the lair of the giant underground worm. Lure him out of his burrow with Rocktooth's blood. Vanquish the worm, and report to George Siverian, who will be waiting for you near the Master's Citadel.

startText.en:
Hmm... Very interesting. I might even say you lucked out. Although, in your place I wouldn't be too quick to celebrate.
The other day I heard one of the mercenaries say that there's fighting on the Frontier, and something about a huge, cave-dwelling worm. Its maw is so massive it could swallow an orc whole without a hiccup! It's got teeth like fine knives, as long as your arm! Its hide is as thick as a stout beam. Oy... That'd be the trophy to end all trophies.
But I can't just drop everything and head for the Frontier! You see, I've had a dust-up with some local mercenaries. One thing led to another, I banged my fist on the table, and... Basically, the timing's not right for me to travel. But if you want to make some money, go find that worm. That vile thing's probably got his burrow somewhere in the foothills. Look for gnawed bones, broken weapons, and scraps of armor. And it'll reek so bad your eyes will burn! A creature like that eats a lot and craps even more.
Once you find him, sprinkle some gar's blood on the dirt. The smell will draw the beast out. But don't even think about taking him on alone. Gather some friends, and not just one or two but a whole brigade, at least. Only then test your fate in combat with the worm.

finishText.en:
Yuck! What a stench! Is that you? Ugh... Don't stand upwind, you smelly bastard, my eyes are burning.
Wait, what? It's not you, it's the flask? Let's see what you've got there.

goal.en: Take a clot of Rocktooth's blood to George Siverian.

startText.en:
The blood trickling from the body of the slain Rocktooth is giving off a stunning pong, something sour and coppery. If regular gar blood attracts ordinary earthworms, then what kind of monster will this stuff bring out?
Maybe you should get a word of advice from George. He's hunted a few monsters in his day.

checkText.en: Damned drakes! They have already torched almost a dozen of our astral ships!

finishText.en: Those ignorant drakes think we can't get to the island without a ship. It's as if they're oblivious to the portal's existence. All the worse for them! Let me know if you want to visit their island. I'll get you there.

goal.en: Meet the Master's Voice in the Citadel.

startText.en:
Hey, where are you off to? Trying to get on the ship? Stop!
Do you want to die? We're fighting draconids! They'll torch your ship before you even get close, and you'll be cremated before you hit the ground! If you want to reach the island, go to the Master's Voice. He will help you.

checkText.en: What d'ye want?

finishText.en:
And were you able to find this spying little pissant? Good, let her keep crawling. Or else she'll spoil my discipline with her dubious morals. When would you ever see a commanding officer contradicted in front of subordinates? Better to be a... what d'ye call it... a mercenary. Hah!
But don't worry, I'll pass the information along. Let those city bureaucrats worry about all that bollocks. We've enough to do as it is.

goal.en: Report all this to Gammon the Tempestuous. He's waiting for you at the outpost.

startText.en:
It turns out that neither the draconids nor the wormfaces ever trusted Nihaz. In fact, they'd been plotting against him for a while. Biding their time, they distracted the Master and then struck when the timing suited. Their goal is the Dead City. It's not so much the town they're after, but there's something hidden there, some kind of a powerful artifact that the Overmind, Nihaz, and the Fiery Father all want. I'm worried that we'll never learn anything until we head to the Dead City to see all this with our own eyes.
Go to the outpost, find Gammon, and tell him what we know. He's dumb as a chunk of meat, but he can get the information where it needs to go. Better to have the League and the Empire know what Nihaz and our former allies are planning. It seems to me that all the strange things happening here in the Misty Lands are eventually going to reach the outside world.

finishText.en: Stop! One more step and I'll shoot without warning... Hey, you're one of ours! Great! Someone's finally come to see what we've got going on here.

goal.en: Find Ekaterina Drabova in the eastern reaches of the Frontier.

startText.en:
Listen, you. We had a whole squad of Kanians here. They were led by this warrior broad, Ekaterina Drabova. Imagine: a whole ladies' battalion! What a treat!
Where was I? Ah yes. The Kanians left for the eastern shore. Probably trying to establish a base there. They took over some old June relic, a something-or-other. They fixed it up, and then used it to link up with our teleporter at the outpost. Not good enough to transport people, but cargo and such. And you could send messages.
Till the other day, when they just dropped off the face of the earth. And that thing of theirs quit working - no signal. Quit mucking about and go and see what's what! Just don't kill all the bad guys, save some for us, eh?

checkText.en: What's the good word?

finishText.en: I knew you'd do all right. We're back online with the outpost, and now we can get everything we need using the teleporter. Thanks much!

goal.en: Destroy eight June Monoliths, then report to Ekaterina Drabova upon completion.

startText.en:
Wait till I get my hands on that Gammon... I'll turn that meathead into a proper sausage... We've been stuck here for days, cut off from everything, and that lout didn't move a muscle! What do you expect from an orc?
In any case, we're glad to see you! Just in time, too.
We fixed an old June teleporter. You can't transport people with it, but cargo is a snap. Food, water, weapons, ammunition... If it wasn't for the wormfaces!
I guess there used to be a whole set of teleporters here, or something along those lines. The wormfaces rearranged some of the monoliths that were left over from other teleporters, and now I can't even send a scrap of paper, thanks to disruptions in the magical plane. We were ready to forget it all and head back to the outpost, but it's a different story now that you've arrived! If we destroy the old monoliths the connection with the outpost will be restored.

checkText.en: I wish those golems would crumble to dust! We've had nothing but trouble from this "June heritage"...

finishText.en:
You say there's a golem there protected by a force field? Like a supercharged version of the shields on astral ships? Something on the level of the Aegis, or even better? The wormfaces sure can pick ‘em... Sounds like a tough bastard.
But we're no lightweights, are we? Look, the shields on astral ships shatter under fire from astral weapons, right? So why can't we destroy the golem's shield with our cannons?

goal.en: Make your way to the ancient portal and take a better look at the portal guard. Then return to Ekaterina Drabova to make your report.

startText.en:
Well, now our camp is safe. And I've just received a message. And it concerns you. We need to learn more about these ancient gates and the army of wormfaces.
There's a bit of dry land to the east of here. On it you'll find a strange construction, and odds are those are the ancient gates in question. There's a bridge out to the island, and it's guarded by golems. But they're not the issue! The issue is the giant golem that guards the gates themselves. I've no idea what to do about that big galloot.
I know what Gannon would want to do, but you can't defeat a guard like that by brute force alone. We need to be clever. It's like the joke about the mechanic working on the astral ship engine: "You paid me one gold piece to hit the engine with a hammer, and the other fifty you paid was for knowing where to hit."
We, too, must know where to hit. Sneak your way or blast your way across the bridge and get a closer look at the guard. He must have a weak spot!

finishText.en:
The portal? A burly golem? No, I don't know anything about such things.
You should talk to some of our smarter fellas. They already spend all their time in their laboratories. Let them earn their keep for once! Hah!

goal.en: Meet with Gammon the Tempestuous at the Outpost.

startText.en:
This is how we'll do it. Go back to the outpost and talk to Gammon. Tell him everything that we learned, and try to think of a way to get past the golem to the portal. Something makes me reluctant to take on that big bruiser. If fact, I don't even have the time to plan an attack on the portal right now.
Gammon doesn't have much for brains, but he's got more advisors than you can shake a stick at. Maybe you'll come up with something together.

checkText.en: You already found the key?

finishText.en:
All that work for a piddling piece of plastic... I'll never understand it.
Now that you've got the key, you can continue on without any trouble. Use the key near that big stone lout and he won't touch you.
the Dead City awaits... I wish I could take your place... But I have to be here. Without me, the wormfaces and scalies would have the run of the place! Hah!

goal.en: Get the key to the ancient portal by defeating Ram Shaitan, the ancient war golem. To defeat the golem's shield you'll need to use the cannons on the shore.

startText.en:
Look, our brainiacs have been thinking. And they've come up with something!
You'll need a key to get to the portal. It'll be made of June plastic and covered with symbols. It's like you're one of ours, see? The golem serves the wormfaces. He lets them through freely and uses the key to open the portal. You won't be able to get through without the key. Like it or not, you'll have to take out the golem. It won't be an easy task. He's a tough one, tough like my mum. But we've dealt with bigger ones. Ekaterina's troops have set up their artillery along the shore. A couple of shells from those cannons and he's a goner! Hah! But you can't do it alone. Someone's got to distract the golem and someone else has to be on the cannons. So get together a posse and go for it! Get that key!

checkText.en: If we were big like orcs, we wouldn't need any of this garbage, we'd just grind ‘em into sausage meat with our bare hands...

finishText.en: Oh! Barrels! They look just like beer casks... Is there beer inside? Are the insides bubbling? No? Too bad! Beer would be nice right now, and some fish jerky... But you did good! Many thanks!

checkText.en: I wonder how long the wormfaces will need to dig a new tunnel. We think it'll take them a good couple of days, at least!

finishText.en:
Whoa! That was quite the blast! We even saw it from here!
Those wormfaces under there must be boiling!

goal.en: Escort the sapper to the right spot in the Wild Rocks and wait for him to blow up the cliff over the cave. Then return to the Watchfull family at the docks.

startText.en:
Hey! Greetings! We've got another bit of work for you! You're going to like it!
Remember the barrels of explosives? Well, we found a way to use them. An outpost egghead who messes around with gadgets sent us a new guard recently. A mechanical one! It's as dumb as... as... well, he's dumber than our Cake, let's put it that way. And he's just as buttoned up, too. There's no one at all to talk to here, other than you...
At least we've got that dumb bu... what did we call him? Ah well, it doesn't matter. We're going to have our own suicide bomber! That metal lunkhead won't be good for much else, anyway. We've loaded him up with all the explosives. Now he's set to blow up on command! And he'll bury that cave.
Oh, and we forgot to tell you the most important part! We want to collapse the cave where the wormfaces live. If you take the path up to the Wild Rocks, you'll end up right over the entrance to the cave. A big explosion on that spot would collapse the cave. And the wormfaces will have to dig a new entrance. Pretty good plan, eh?
We're giving you the job of escorting our sapper. Follow him until he gets to the spot. There will surely be armed resistance for our ‘Wind of Death' operation. But you're not scared of wormfaces or draconids, are you? You can help, right? It will be hard to beat the drakes and protect the sapper all by yourself. Call some of your friends to help.
And we'll give you this, just in case - a magic shield generator. It gives the sapper temporary protection against enemies.
One more thing. As soon as the sapper is in position and the countdown begins, get out of there as fast as you can. Otherwise, we'll be gathering you up all over the astral!

checkText.en: What d'ye want?

finishText.en: Phew. I thought we were done for. We barely got out alive! Now the scaly beasts have gone all quiet... Too bad it won't be for long! I hope they choke on a boot! Come back tomorrow, if your sword's thirsty! We'll have a fight! Hah!

goal.en: Repel the attack on the Outpost and protect Semyon Dyldin at all costs. When you're done, report to Gammon the Tempestuous.

startText.en:
Just in time! The enemy's getting ready to attack our outpost! The draconids and wormfaces have had a falling out, and we've ended up piggy in the middle. This is twice as bad as if they'd attacked us separately.
I've just learned that the two armies are going to meet at a certain time in the same field that we set up our outpost. This time is noted on your calendar. Strike me dead, but we need everyone who can carry an axe!
Do you see that beanpole? The one as big and tough as my grandmum? That's Semyon Dyldin. He's going to lead our defenders. Not because he's smart - I'm the smart one around here. Who do you think is going to be the first mark? The biggest one! He's going to lead all our attacks. Stay close, though, OK?
Your job is to help Semyon. Otherwise they'll have his head in less than an hour. And where would I find another lummox like him? So come on, don't be shy! Destroy the scalies and wormfaces!
And that... Well, they've promised reinforcements in case things here go haywire... But they're late, damn it! The teleporter is a little glitchy, but it's working. So, uh... Wander around the camp a bit, go see the ruins. Looks like those greasy slimefaces are blocking our portal with their monoliths. Find the monoliths and blast them to smithereens! Otherwise, without help, we're doomed.

checkText.en: If those draconids hadn't reproduced so quickly, we'd have wiped them from the allods a long time ago!
Sarn's demons are offering us a pact? That's amusing.

finishText.en:
Lies and deception can sometimes sound sweet, but don't be fooled! Sarn's adepts are suicidal maniacs. They hate this world and are constantly trying to destroy it. Don't ever forget it. Anyway... I suppose I'll accept their offer!
It's been so long since Light and Dark have worked together. This will be an interesting game, let me tell you. Hehe.

goal.en: Enter the portal at the Frontier.

startText.en:
Now that you have a key you can continue on. You'll know what to do once you get close to that stone monster. The magic in the key will help you neutralize the Keeper.
the Dead City awaits... I wish I could take your place... But I have to be here. Otherwise the wormfaces and scalies would have the run of the place! Haw!
Well, it's been fun. Take care of yourself! Don't forget old Gammon! Stop by if you need anything.

checkText.en: Another one of Nihaz's minions. Did the Radiant Sarn speak with you?

finishText.en: Don't ever forget this moment! The Creator showed you the way and even deigned to speak with you. It's rare for a non-believer to be graced with such an honor. You can't even fathom what an opportunity this is, unworthy creation of Sarn.

goal.en: Go to the Wandering Island and talk to Patriarch Semer Knef in the cultists' camp.

startText.en:
Sarn is trying to get around me, to leave me behind... He'll pay for it... For the moment we share interests... for the moment. The wormfaces and draconids, those dirty traitors, decided to play rebels. I'll just have to punish the imbeciles. Under no circumstances can I allow them to enter the Dead City!
What do I see when I happen to turn my gaze to that corner of the astral? The path through the portal has been blocked by some unknown allod. The Wandering Island... Another shard of Gipat hidden beneath ancient ruins. The wormfaces and draconids are already there and, if my eyes do not deceive, they are beelining towards the portal. That's right, the Wandering Island has another portal. And this portal also leads to the Dead City.
But not only have you fallen behind the traitors, the demon worshippers are ahead of you as well... I'm talking about Sarn cultists. All they do is sit shaking in their camp like a herd of sheep. These sycophants of Sarn are helpless, they can't even clear their own path.
Go to them and let them carry out the wishes of their beloved god, if it means they'll help us stop those traitors! And see that you don't get lost. It's always nice to do your dirty work with someone else's hands.

checkText.en: The Oath of Light is not the easiest step on your path to the Truth and away from the lies of the Master of Darkness. It is only your first step on the path to the Truth, where many tests and trials still await.

finishText.en:
It was the wisdom of the Great Sarn that brought us here. Good thing, too...
There is a bloody battle underway for this island, which is littered with the remnants of a once great city. Every fighter is accounted for!

goal.en: Take the Oath of Light with Semer Knef at the cultists' camp.

startText.en:
This is a holy war! We didn't allow you to stand shoulder to shoulder with us right away. If you want to fight under the banners of the Light, then first swear the Oath of Light to our All-Merciful Savior.
Swear, too, your allegiance to the tribe of demons, that most exquisite, most youthful, most perfect creation of the Radiant Sarn. For many centuries, Sarnaut's crude creations have failed to understand this. We endured so much before the simple truth was revealed to us - one must not fight demons, one should serve them!
Put your hand on your heart. May the astral swallow you up if you ever break the Oath! I am ready to listen.

checkText.en: Oh, Creator! Do not deny us your mercy. We need your host now more than ever!

finishText.en: Do you see what's happening with our commanders? Still, I do believe that there's hope. I can picture it now. Sarn didn't send you here for nothing. His ways are mysterious; I can only try to understand them. I think that you and your friends are just the ones to inspire our commanders, to fill their exhausted hearts anew with hope, and to lead by example. Remind them how to fight! Talk to our strategist, Punch the Furious.

goal.en: Talk to the cultists' leader, Dmitri Gromov, and the demons' leader, Goliath, at the cultists' camp. Then return to Father Semer Knef.

startText.en:
The enemies of the Light have taken all the important positions. The attacks never cease, day or night. But all of our attempts have been futile! Every time we make the slightest advance, the enemy responds and we are driven back. Our soldiers are losing heart, and even the commanders have stopped charging into battle with any vigor. I summoned all the courage of the Light, all the inspiration of the holy spirit, to no avail. I have given up, to tell you the truth. Many of our kind hate you, my friend. Many of our fighters would gladly kill you if it weren't for our pact. But we've all heard of your military prowess! Your achievements truly demand respect.
That's why I wanted to ask you a favor. Talk to our commanders and find out what they think of our situation. The cultists' forces are led by Dmitri Gromov, while the demons follow Goliath.

checkText.en: If only I were younger, say, closer to 150, I'd lead them into battle myself! Old age is no picnic, let me tell you. My knee's been acting up again...

finishText.en:
The fortification is ours, just like that! We attacked with flawless grace and precision, it was like watching an orchestra follow sheet music. Excellent work!
I can see that the tales of your prowess were no exaggeration.

goal.en: Accept the Death to our Foe mission from Punch the Furious. Complete the Undead of Bone Hill mission. Read the report to any one of the commanders, join the attack and capture any of the enemy's camps. Then return to Semer Knef.

startText.en:
I'm sure you know that planning attacks is no easy task. When facing foes like the wormfaces or the draconids, any mistake, any deviation from the plan is as good as suicide!
Do you think you can handle any foe? We'll see.
First talk to our strategist, Punch the Furious. He's got an important mission for you that's related to our positions and plan of attack. Heed him well!
I, too, have an errand for you. The undead... No, I have nothing against the undead. I myself, in fact, am not entirely alive. But the undead spawning on Bone Hill are stupid, aggressive, and are a constant headache for our commanders.
Carry out this mission and you'll soon have a report that the undead have been defeated. Read your report to any commander. Every victory, no matter how minor, will raise the spirits of our soldiers. Then, once their spirits are at their peak, join the attack and take an enemy fortification.Note that you will become a part of the assault team only after reporting to a commander.
Prove that you're more than a hero of fable, but of life!

checkText.en: Is something unclear? I'll repeat myself for those slow on the uptake. Gromov will drive the draconids from the Wretched Corner. Goliath will capture the Swampy Pass. Then we'll all descend upon the square, and that will be the end of them!

finishText.en:
We showed them again! They're done for! And we've done it! Huzzah!
Here's your reward. But calm down a bit. You know that the enemy will be up in our beeswax again soon enough. The headaches never abate for long!
Are you tired? Alas, the only way to get any rest is to go home to mommy, head back to Nezebgrad, to Novograd, or board a ship. We've got a war going on here!

goal.en: Capture three key points on the island: Swampy Pass, the Wretched Corner, and the Palace Square. When victorious, report to Punch the Furious at the cultists' camp.

startText.en:
Funtime is over! Enough standing around, picking your nose! The enemy had ample reinforcements and again we got a good drubbing. The wormfaces regained control of the Swampy Pass. The draconids, may they rot in the grave, are back at the Wretched Corner. All right, my hearties - to arms!
I remind you of our plan: Goliath and the demons are to take the Swampy Pass from the wormfaces. Gromov will take the Wretched Corner. Then the lot of us, coming from both sides, will attack the Palace Square and decimate the enemy positions.

checkText.en: Your efforts will not be wasted. We are watching you and we can see how much you do for the glory of the God of Light.

finishText.en: Oh! You've done the cult a significant service. We now have no doubt that you can be trusted. Sarn was so right to have chosen you and sent you here.

goal.en: Earn 3 Seals of Sarn's Benevolence and give them to Father Semer Knef at the cultists' camp.

startText.en:
I accepted your Oath. I believe it wholeheartedly, but there's no better vow than that backed up by noble deeds. We, the forces of Light, the cultists of Sarn, have the most holy of missions - the destruction of the wormfaces and draconids. Mutants and degenerates are enemies of the Creator and nature itself. Fighting on our side, you will earn the highest awards that any cultist can aspire to: the Seal of Sarn's Benevolence. If you can gather enough of them we will understand that you are pure of heart, that you are fighting for the Light, and then we will help you find the path to the Wandering Island. That piece of land disrupted the portal connection, but we know how to find the road through the darkness. When the time comes, and if you can earn our trust, I'll show you the road.
One more thing. It's important to us that those on our side fight nobly, without lacking anything they need. During the fighting you'll be able to accumulate Seals of Sarn's Benevolence, which you can exchange at our traders for items that can be found nowhere else in Sarnaut.
Good fighting luck to you! May Sarn be with us!

checkText.en: What are you doing here? Was the Dead City too tough for you?

finishText.en:
What is this? It can't be! The portal has closed and even the Stabilizer didn't help?
I don't even know what to tell you. I will pray heartily for the God of Light to tell us what to do. In the meantime, please accept this humble gift. It's the least I can do to repay you for your efforts.

goal.en: Once you've triggered the Stabilizer, enter the portal under the Palace Square.

startText.en:
I want to repay you for your service to us. I know you are trying to reach the Dead City... And we are in a position to help you. As you know, the ancient portal to the Dead City is highly unstable. It's been flickering, and jumping into a flickering portal is a good way to lose your Spark. But it's not all bad.
We've designed this portal stabilizer so that we could get more of our warriors through to the Dead City. Luckily for you, we haven't had a chance to use it yet. Now I'd like to give this priceless invention to you. Trigger the stabilizer before you approach the portal. If our calculations are correct, the way to the Dead City will open up ahead of you.
I have faith that the wisdom of Sarn will some day help you see the light. But don't forget that once we've left the boundaries of this island, those that trust the false god Nihaz will never know peace from us again.

checkText.en: Is something unclear? Let me say it again for those who are on a dreadnought. Goliath will drive the draconids from the Watchtower and the Wretched Corner. Gromov will capture the ruins and the Swampy Pass. Then we'll all descend upon the square, and that will be the end of them!

finishText.en: What, already? Victory is ours! Huzzah! We gave ‘em hell! I give everyone 24 hours to rest, drink, dress their wounds, find women... Then it starts again: up at 5 in the morning for drills. We can't let ourselves get weak. The enemy never rests.

goal.en: You must join Goliath or Dmitri Gromov during the assault, then capture five key points on the island: Swampy Pass, Wretched Corner, and the Palace Square. When victorious, report to Punch the Furious at the cultists' camp.

startText.en:
So I'll explain our di... disposition. Well, "disposition" is just a fancy way of saying "where to go and who to kill." There are three places where the scum have dug in. The wormfaces have set up in the Swampy Pass. The scalies have taken over the Wretched Corner. Then, in the monsters' rear...(hehe) I mean, to the north is the Palace Square. The monsters' very lair! Devil only knows what we'll find there. But you don't need a fortuneteller to know it won't be good.
So we'll go hard. You, your friends, the cultists and demons... that's the only way we'll make it through. Goliath and the demons will chase the wormfaces out of the Swampy Pass. The cultists and Gromov will storm the Wretched Corner. Then we'll have to go kick the living... well, we'll attack the Square from all sides. Those are our orders. Got it? Sign here! Or at least scratch an X, if you can!
You will get a nice reward if you participate in capturing all check points!

checkText.en: Hey you, how're you feeling? Nothing hurts? Great! My hypotheses were correct. We are on the brink of an amazing scientific discovery. Or, at least, I think we are.

finishText.en:
Thanks for participating. The science appreciates your contribution. Maybe your name will be on my list of guinea pi... err, I mean, my assistants!
I'll send you your prize in the mail. That's it for now. You can relax. I need some time to analyze the data before we can repeat the race.

goal.en: Win the race by visiting every one of the Circles of Power on the track. The route: the Rotten Ruins, the Swampy Pass, the Palace Square, the Wretched Corner, the Watchtower, and the cultists' camp.

startText.en:
Ah, you're just in time. I've just come up with an experiment that could turn our understanding of modern science on its head!
You see, my area of research is the capabilities of Sparks outside the body. I need all the volunteers I can get. You will help me, won't you?
All I need you to do is to make you Spark leave the body and run the course I've laid out for you. That is, the Rotten Ruins then, through the Swampy Pass, to the Palace Square, then around the Wretched Corner to the Watchtower, and finish here, in the camp. It is simple as that, you have to enter the Circle of Power here and wait for the start signal. There is another Circle of Power like this one at each of the five points that you have to visit.
To give you some motivation along the way, we'll have a bit of a race: you'll be competing with other volunteers. Those that come in the top 3 will get a valuable prize!
So come here when it's time to race! The race schedule is on your calendar.

checkText.en: I should have wagered some money! I'd bet my shirt you're not going to make it! Unfortunately, the Patriarch ain't too keen on the idea, screeching about how important this is, that this is "a very important experiment done in the name of Sarn." I let it slip that I was interested in placing a small wager on the outcome... you should have heard the words he used!

finishText.en:
I can't believe it! You're the first rookie in... Let me think... I can't even remember... It's been at least a month. Well done!
Phew, good thing I didn't bet against. I would've ended up losing my shirt...

startText.en:
Our raiding the ruins and the tower is all well and good, but we best not forget about a much nearer threat! I'm talking about the Bone Hill undead. The last time they came around we gave 'em a real good thrashing, and they haven't been back since. But we ain't got the time to get up there regularly to remind them. Well, to this end we've got a test for greenhorns like you who are new to our cult.
Sarn is the God of Light, and light is hella fast. A split second and it's wherever it wants to be. No way you can catch up, no matter how fast your astral ship is. So let's test how fast you are! Here's the test: in a half-hour - no, a half-hour's a lot! Twenty five minutes! Twenty five minutes for you to kill thirty undead. That's right, thirty. Have you got the guts? Or are you too scared?

checkText.en: It's an honor for every fallen warrior if his body serves as a model for the creation of clones!

finishText.en: Oh! That's just what we needed. Soon we'll create these new bodies, breathe Sparks into them, and our fallen brothers and sisters will rejoin us once again!

checkText.en: Fear weakens us, but feeds the demons. Is that not perfection?!

finishText.en: Oh good, our food's here. Thank you kindly. Where are our boys? Hey! Time to refuel! You'd better go. Hungry demons are nothing to fool with. And you don't have clearance to rub shoulders with such higher beings!

checkText.en: An obelisk stands before you. Its smooth, black surface swallows up all of even the brightest light. The longer you stare into it, the more you'll change. It already appears as if the obelisk is looking back at you, its gaze piercing to your very soul!

finishText.en: You feel an irresistible urge to touch its surface. Such a smooth, perfect blackness, so alluring...

goal.en: Speak with Nomarkh Ankh to teleport to the Palace Square, enter the pyramid and get the answers you need.

startText.en:
I've only had you do one thing for me this whole time... But you didn't assume that this was all the all-mighty god would ask of you, did you? This agreement with Nihaz has another, greater purpose! And now it is time to reveal this to you.
You've only heard one revelation, the Revelation of Nihaz, which with his usual bloody-minded sense of humor he has nicknamed Tka-Rik's Revelation. Just as there's no yin without yang, no west without the east, there's no Truth without two sides of the truth. You heard the word of darkness, but soon you'll know the word of Light! The real, true Light, the Creating and All-Merciful Light that is Sarn!
Your path lies to the depths of Tep's ancient pyramid! I don't know what awaits you there. The answers to our questions do not always bring joy. I hope that you'll make the right decision.

checkText.en:
Greetings, Keeper of the Revelation!
The enemy tried to cloud your mind with false words, and I am happy that you did not give in to his seductive promises!

finishText.en:
Unfortunately, as I expected, the alliance with the demons came to nought. the Dead City remains inaccessible...
But don't get depressed! Be happy!
The Master was merciful enough to reveal his thoughts to me. You will get to where you are going. This time, no broken June portals or any of that museum-ready ancient technology.
This time you are going to be witness to the greatest event in the world - an act of Creation! The creation of matter from the astral! We will create our own path to the Dead City!

goal.en: Touch the black stone and come to understand its purpose.

startText.en: You are drawn to touch its cold surface. Something drives you to touch it, and you cannot resist the urge...

finishText.en:
I see. You probably came to me for a bit of ancient wisdom? To learn secrets? To come closer to the unknown? Well, well...
Remember what I said? The only worthwhile wisdom is one that you achieve yourself. What do you need other people's ideas for, when you've got your own head on your shoulders? Think about it.
As far as the Seals are concerned... I wonder if you understand that the Seals are manifestations of God's power. Who, if not a God, could wield pure Power? Only another, stronger Power. I defeated Sarn at the dawn of time...well, the "dawn" as you might understand it. To defeat someone means you are more powerful. And I manifested my power into locks that I placed on Sarn. So far you have encountered only one manifestation of my power, that which you mortals call "the darkness," although that's not quite it. Dark, Light, Good, Evil - all of these are subjective notions, my friend. They are only useful to those who can not see beyond the reality that surrounds them. I wouldn't bother with you or anyone like you if I didn't feel you were capable of transcending the banalities that you've had driven into your skull since birth. So think, my friend, think. Thinking is always worth your while. When you've thought of something interesting, then we'll take up this conversation again.

goal.en: Meet with Nihaz in the Master's Citadel.

startText.en:
Come on, the Master is waiting! Hearken to his words as we all have; the Master's wisdom is without bounds.
Long ago he came to understand things that you inhabitants of Sarnaut can't even imagine!

finishText.en:

Remember what I said? The only worthwhile wisdom is one that you achieve yourself. What do you need other people's ideas for, when you've got your own head on your shoulders? Think about it.

I defeated Sarn at the dawn of time...well, the "dawn" as you might understand it. To defeat someone means you are more powerful. And I manifested my power into locks that I placed on Sarn. So far you have encountered only one manifestation of my power, that which you mortals call "the darkness," although that's not quite it. Dark, Light, Good, Evil - all of these are subjective notions, my friend. They are only useful to those who can not see beyond the reality that surrounds them. I wouldn't bother with you or anyone like you if I didn't feel you were capable of transcending the banalities that you've had driven into your skull since birth. So think, my friend, think. Thinking is always worth your while. When you've thought of something interesting, then we'll take up this conversation again.

goal.en: Meet with Nihaz in the Master's Citadel.

startText.en:
Come on, the Master is waiting! Hearken to his words as we all have; the Master's wisdom is without bounds.
Long ago he came to understand things that you inhabitants of Sarnaut can't even imagine!

checkText.en: We'll also learn the most important part of a living thing: nature or nurture? I am confident that we can raise draconids whose hearts will be open to Sarn.

finishText.en:
Oh, what beautiful, strong eggs! I can already see the precious, scaly little creatures crawling about the camp and cooing the praises of Sarn. Thank you!
Thank you!
But I still haven't figured out... Who will watch over the eggs? Ah yes, we'll give the task to the Skillful Family. They already deal with demons all day... raising draconids shouldn't be difficult for them.

checkText.en: It's a feeling that someone's watching us... right now... it's gone! How goes it?

finishText.en: That means there really were Terminators. And now they've been destroyed! I salute you! I can continue my observations in peace.

name.en: A Dog Is Man's Best Friend

startText.en:
Listen up. I don't feel entirely comfortable when my consciousness passes over into the mystic plane. It's like I can feel something behind me. I can feel movement, or I can feel eyes upon me. I carefully look around, behind every corner, turn over every rock, even poke my head into every basement, and find no one. But I can't shake that feeling that there's someone here besides me!
 One theory is that it might be one of the Destroyers. It might even be a Terminator - the most dangerous one of their tribe. I can't see them, but that awful feeling at the nape of my neck... I can feel their eyes upon me! Ugh! I have a special amulet that I got from the camp: the beater's amulet. With its help, you can summon a demon possessing an excellent sense of smell. Terminators are invisible to the eye, but they must have a smell. Especially because they spend much of their lives in moldy tombs.
Call the demon hound and, if he can find the Terminators, dispose of them!

checkText.en: By the way, a dead golem might suddenly come to life if disturbed. So be careful.

finishText.en: So it's time for combat, eh? But what an interesting artifact! I'll have to study it carefully. But I'll do that when I get back to the camp. In any event, thank you.

goal.en: Search the fragments of the golems. Report your findings to Semer Knef in the Swampy Pass.

startText.en:
While we sit here twiddling our thumbs, waiting for the next attack, I've got a proposal for you. There are bits and pieces of golems scattered all around here. Golems are phenomenal creations. A mechanism has been joined with them by magic, just like inside us, the Arisen.
From time to time the Junes enhanced the golems with combat magic and sometimes even powerful amulets!
You can find a lot of interesting stuff rooting around among the bits and pieces. We should do it. Better than letting all that go to waste. May Sarn guide your hand!

checkText.en: A weapon shouldn't be left out on the field. Every fighter knows this. And any way you look at it, the draconids are excellent fighters.

finishText.en:
Wow! What a haul! It truly was a grand battle. Many draconids were slain.
We'll melt these swords down. Let the draconids arm themselves with sticks!

startText.en:
We've got a little time now. I propose that we do not let it go to waste. There's another way we can help the fighters.
For as long as I've been here, every night I've heard the flapping of wings and the muffled sound of voices. For a while I had no idea what was happening. Then I noticed that the draconids were returning to the scene of the day's battle and were digging around for something. At first I thought that they were gathering the bodies of their comrades for some kind of foul farewell ritual. After a while I figured it out. They scour the field for the swords of fallen tribesmen.
Let's follow their example, only instead of following, let's go out before them and gather up all of their weapons so that they can't be used against us.

finishText.en: Fine. I... I believe you, although you are no friend of ours. My heart tells me that you are a creature of honor and that I can take you at your word.

goal.en: Promise Maria Zavetina that you will not use this new knowledge for evil.

startText.en:
Greetings. I did not think that I would be able to say this. But today I am glad that you are here with us, a hero whose fate is somehow so deeply intertwined with the fate of our world.
Your efforts could change the world. It's too bad you're not on our side. We - all of us - have made so many mistakes. There is a vast misunderstanding between us, Sarn's true children, and you, the heroes scrabbling about in the dust for the remnants of the old world. It will take a great deal of effort to mend this gap...
But now I quite simply have no one else to turn to. What's happening here on the Wandering Island is frightening. I do not hide that I am afraid. I beg you, promise me, before I put my faith in you, promise me that even if our paths part once again, that you will never use the knowledge we have given you for evil.

finishText.en: Fine. I... I believe you, although you are no friend of ours. My heart tells me that you are a person of honor and that I can take you at your word.

goal.en: Promise Maria Zavetina not to use this knowledge for evil.

startText.en:
Greetings. I did not think that I would be able to say this. But today I am glad that you are here with us, a hero whose fate is somehow so deeply intertwined with the fate of our world.
Your efforts could change the world. It's too bad you're not on our side. We - all of us - have made so many mistakes. There is a vast misunderstanding between us, Sarn's true children, and you, the heroes scrabbling about in the dust for the remnants of the old world. It will take a great deal of effort to mend this gap...
But now I quite simply have no one else to turn to. What's happening here on the Wandering Island is frightening. I do not hide that I am afraid. I beg you, promise me, before I put my faith in you, promise me that even if our paths part once again, that you will never use the knowledge we have given you for evil.

checkText.en: Our doctor is a luminary in the world of science, a professor, and even he's clueless. He says it is the first time he's ever seen something like this.

finishText.en:
So, what have we got? Not one of the sick knows how they were infected. Some were injured, while others are completely unharmed, but all of them are suffering from the same plague. What commonality is there among their histories? Ignatius Chernov! He's one of your fighters. He arrived here recently, just as you did: "They say Nihaz wants to make a pact with us."
I've been against that plan from the start! Nothing good will come of anyone who lets Nihaz into their heart. The dark god has no rules, except one: kill and betray!

goal.en: Speak to the four infected cultists and report to Chaplain Maria Zavetina in the cultists' camp.

name.en: The Plague of the Wandering Island

startText.en:
Listen to what I have to tell you. It pains us deeply to take you in, adherents to the dark god. And I am almost certain that one of you Nihazian lackeys is somehow involved!
"In what," you might ask? The camp is in a panic! A strange plague has struck scores of the daughters and sons of Sarn. The infected wither before your eyes and die in pain. But this is not a big deal - we can give them new bodies. The whole problem is that the Sparks of the sick do not remain near the body, nor do they go to the Purgatory. They simply disappear! It all began when you arrived here, with Nihaz's name on your lips! Who would you expect we suspected? Thankfully, we who walk the path of clarity shown to us by the merciful Sarn are not inclined to rash actions. The fact is, we don't have any proof.
I heard your oath and I heard of your successes in the Misty Lands. Your word is strong, and the poison of Nihaz's philosophy has not yet reached your soul. And I believe that you can help me!
We must find the cause and learn the nature of the illness. To start, I ask you to speak with the infected. I have already tried to speak with them, but I couldn't understand anything. Maybe you'll have better luck. Hurry, we could lose them at any moment.

finishText.en:
Do you think that Grigori Domov is too brusque? He's an amazing diagnostician, so we must be patient with him.
But now we need to talk to you about something else. Prepare yourself for a serious conversation.

goal.en: Talk to Patriarch Semer Knef in the cultists' camp.

startText.en:
Well then. I must admit, your help was right on time. We've accomplished a lot, you and I - my mind, on your legs. As far as I'm concerned, you would already be useful as a... Well, it's not important now. Please just relay my opinion to the Patriarch. Tell him that I am proud of you! And Grigori Domov's advice is worth its weight in gold!
We, the faithful followers of Sarn, know the true Revelation. We will share this with you. Some day. You have chosen the right path. History, as they say, is written by the victors. In our case, it is Nihaz. So how can one learn what truly happened? Eh? Easy! Ask the losers! This is something you must do as well: listen and accept Sarn's Revelation in your heart. But don't forget, assistant, everyone lies.

checkText.en: Ignatius's body... Looks like there's no one to bring back to camp, after all.

finishText.en: Yuck! What a stench! Stop. This person has infected many people with a strange illness. The illness appears to be passed on simply by proximity alone. Don't get too close to the body.

goal.en: Find Ignatius Chernov on the Bone Hill.

name.en: We Don't Have a Great Deal of Information

startText.en: The only clue we've got is Ignatius. So let's see where he leads us. As far as I know, Nomarkh Ankh sent a group to the Bone Hill on some kind of mission. The group included Ignatius. He should be there now. No one has yet returned from the hills. Find him quickly and bring him here. Make sure you don't let on that we suspect him of something. The investigation has only begun. And may Sarn's light show you the way!

checkText.en: Were you able to find Ignatius? He is our only clue!

finishText.en:
Dead?! Oh no! How can it be! What do we do now?
Ignatius was a tool of Nihaz! He accomplished his dastardly mission and left. How can we prove it? Or disprove it?

goal.en: Return to the cultists' camp, report to Patriarch Semer Knef about what happened, then talk to Maria Zavetina.

startText.en:
I'll have to tell Maria Zavetina about the death of her first suspect. And I'll have to tell the Patriarch about his death, too.
Hey, what is this?

checkText.en: Hey, what's this? Idiots! I warned you! Don't go wandering around the ruins! Stay away from the corpses! Truly, as Sarnaut's population is increasing, its intellect stands still!

finishText.en: What's that? You're a corpse, that's what! Well, not yet, but you will be. You can crawl off to the barracks and sew yourself a burial shroud. Congratulations! The infection has reached you too.

goal.en: Run as fast as you can to Dr. Grigori Domov.

startText.en:
Stop! It's painful just looking at you! Some people already look better lying in their coffins... This is a... plague!
And you! Oh great Sarn! Another one! Quick! To the doctor!
Grigori is a well-known diagnostician. He promised to find the cure. Go straight to him, and don't lose another minute!

checkText.en: Don't panic! Dying is in fact easier than watching someone else die. Believe you me, I've lived through it all. Oh, so you don't want to die! Then you'll need mushrooms and sulphur - the genius cure I've discovered.

finishText.en: And here are the necessary ingredients. The story goes: "If you want to live, you better know how to hustle!" I understand...

startText.en:
I have bad news, and I have very bad news. Which would you like to hear first?
Well, it doesn't matter. I'll start with the very bad news. They're dropping like flies! Everyone who gets sick is dying! As for the bad news - you've got to help me. Otherwise, you're done for. But there is light at the end of the tunnel. Look at me - I am that light. The genius doctor, whose name resounds throughout Sarnaut. Or, resounds throughout what remains of Sarnaut.
Oh, damn that Nihaz, my leg... Again the leg. Yes, I'm complaining - quit staring at me like that. I've got an idea that we're going to try, you and I. Fly agaric mushrooms and concentrated sulphur - that's what I need. Well, that's what you need, rather.
These ingredients appear to be your only hope. Quick! Find them, you're our only patient still on his feet. Even if you have to crawl. Get a move on!

checkText.en: What's this? Oh no! The leg was bad enough! Now I've got the plague, too!

finishText.en: Right, so the most important thing is to not miss a thing! The infection has reached me... That much is true. Give me a moment, I'm thinking. Aha! Hoorah for the thought process! I know what to do!

goal.en: Wait until the healing process is complete.

startText.en:
Well then, let's get to it! Mushrooms around here are saturated in the miasma coming from the Dead City, and when combined with sulphur and my know-how, the results should be miraculous! Good, so let's have those ‘shrooms, and I'll grind up this sulphur. What's your temperature? Fine. Stand still, I'll read the spell.
Close your eyes. No big deal here, it's not going to hurt, just a pinprick in your heel and a short gap in your memory. Brace yourself! You're very lucky to have fallen into Grigori Domov's hands. Don't forget to write about this in your memoirs, okay? Quiet, I'm going to begin.

checkText.en: Aha, glad to see you again! To be honest, I hadn't much hope of seeing you among the living! The plan went something like this: "...If he doesn't survive the plague, then just try to dispose of the body somewhere far away from the camp." Yes. But all the same, I'm glad to see you!

finishText.en:
There's been just one bit of good news in the whole time that you and I have been here. The plague shadow has been destroyed! Excellent!
 Grigori Domov - you're a genius! Wait a minute, don't go too far! We're safe now, but duty demands that we find out what's going on! And we need assistants! Ideally, ones with brains of their own.

goal.en: With the help of the amulet of sulphuric miasmas, force the shadow to enter your body. Leave the camp's boundaries and then, using the amulet again, destroy the cloud. Report back to Dr. Grigori Domov in the cultists' camp once you are finished.

name.en: Try to Figure It Out, If You Can!

startText.en:
This is no ordinary plague, this is a vile entity with its own evil will. It cannot be cured, but it can be killed! Along with the patient. Hah!
Don't be frightened. That was before. Before I figured it all out. I've just got a couple more creases in my brain than you, and look how much better mine works, eh? Brains of gold!
So now we'll modify the spell a bit... We'll add a few chemicals... A pinch of psi-salt... A dash of "pollen"... That's not for the spell, it's for me! We'll give it a try... Oh, the last batch was better tasting. But this one does the trick. My leg already feels a lot better! And now - to work.
Here's the amulet, which is full of the healing energy that chased the darkness out of your body. Although, if you ask me, it was the hydrogen sulfide... But no matter!
We'll smoke that vile spirit out. We just have to pick the luckiest warrior. Who have we got here? Just you and I. One, two, three! You're it! My mind is too vital to the world of science... We can't possibly risk it.
Well then, your job is to catch this black cloud and confine it in your body. You'll need the special amulet I created for that. I can't predict who the cloud is going to infect next. So you'll have to run, chasing it from one host to the next until it ends up inside you. As soon as you start to feel weak, this means that phase one is complete.
Then go a little further from the camp and try to drive the vile stuff out of your body. It won't have anywhere to go - it's not dumb enough to attack a squirrel or something. The darkness will leave you and then - get on it! It's all very clear to me, how it should go. What are you standing there blinking at me for? Get moving!

checkText.en: Was I right? There's a summoner working over at the Watchtower?

finishText.en:
Here are our Sparks. Well, not ours, but rather the draconids'. The Sparks infected by the plague, Sparks on the brink of death. In my favorite condition!
What do I think? It looks like the plague shadow is a parasite that latches onto the soul. It's goal is not to kill, but rather to infect the spark, to poison it and turn it into something resembling itself. The infection works like a chain reaction and soon the whole allod would have turned into a cloud... If not for my keen, perceptive mind, everything would have come to an end!
Wait just a moment, be quiet, don't move, and don't interfere. I must study the Sparks of the draconids and confirm everything.

checkText.en: I myself wouldn't risk entering the spectral realm right now. I can only imagine what's going on there. But you've got nowhere else to go. And besides, if it hadn't been for me, your carcass would be all rigored by now, and as for your Spark... I don't even want to think about that!

finishText.en:
Welcome back! Nothing like being back in the old flesh again, am I right? If only my damn leg didn't hurt so bad... Oh, how I'd love to have your body! Thunder and lightning, what pain!
But enough of that, tell me what you've learned. All the plague shadows are converging in a single spot? Just as I thought!

goal.en: Speak with Nomarkh Ankh to re-enter the spectral realm as a Spark and visit the Watchtower, the Rotten Ruins, the Wretched Corner, the Swampy Pass and the Palace Square. Report the results to Grigori Domov in the cultists' camp.

startText.en:
Well then. It's not quite how I had imagined it. But that was a hypothesis, while now I've reached a diagnosis.
Did I tell you what a great diagnostician I am? I think I did. So we discard the theory about parasites. This is no ordinary infection. The plague shadows establish control over the Sparks and then... They take them somewhere! Do you know what all this reminded me of? Tep! This all greatly resembles Tep's Plague. It's possible that the plague on Wandering Island and Tep's Plague are one and the same.
But where are the sparks going? They must be going somewhere on the island. But where? So, there's our answer - follow the shadows! Naturally, you'll need to get to where the shadows originate - ghostly world.
Needless to say, it will be you making the trip, not me. And how can we send you to the ghostly world where the essence of these shadows is located? I'll set your spark free - it's no trouble. For me that is. I'll give you a concoction to drink, and that's it. Your body will already be growing cold. Only I can't bring you back...
That's the only hitch. Go talk to our staff pathologist and amateur exhumer, Nomarkh Ankh. He once let it slip that he knew a way to free the Spark free from the body and then put it back. Don't worry. You body will remain here, safe and sound. And your Spark will be free!
Carefully search the ruins. My dear assistant, we're nearing a discovery. My fingers are shaking with impatience. Onward!

finishText.en:
An experiment? Let me think.
No, I'm not familiar with any such "Great experiments." At least, not the really great ones, in which the Great Mages died. Except perhaps the experiment on the Night of Astral Portals. A lot of the Great Mages died in that one, although they're basically immortal.
Wait a second. Couldn't that experiment we know so little about be the one that opened a path for the demons to reach our world? But if that's the case, how does Tep's Plague factor into all this? Could they be related in some way? Something gave the demons the strength to leave the astral for earth.
Nothing but guesswork and hypotheticals! It's too bad you weren't able to learn anything about the Experiment from the fallen mage. Moreover, we don't even know how long ago he died...
But in any event, thank you for telling me that story. I hope that in your wanderings you'll be able to learn more about that experiment. All of my experience is telling me not to discount this kind of knowledge!

goal.en: Meet with the Keeper of Knowledge at the Altar of Truth in the Master's Citadel.

startText.en:
Do you remember what the Spark of that mage you freed said about the Experiment? I can't stop thinking about it. What was the experiment? What were the goals and what were the consequences?
Did those mages of yours try to reproduce Tep's greatest spell?
Report all that you found out to the Keeper of Knowledge. Perhaps that knowledge will become another bit of the puzzle that will help us learn something new about the world.

No, I'm not familiar with any such "Great experiments." At least, not the really great ones, in which the Great Mages died. Except perhaps the experiment on the Night of Astral Portals. A lot of the Great Mages died in that one, although they're basically immortal.

Do you remember what the Spark of that mage you freed said about the Experiment? I can't stop thinking about it. What was the experiment? What were the goals and what were the consequences?
Did those mages of yours try to reproduce Tep's greatest spell?
Report all that you found out to the Keeper of Knowledge. Perhaps that knowledge will become another bit of the puzzle that will help us learn something new about the world.

finishText.en: This is just dandy. I happen to be in need of a reliable assistant, whom I might send to the most dangerous places on this island. I myself never learned to swing the sword, nor can I wield magic. On the other hand, my powerful mind and your fighting skills would be quite complementary, and I think together we could unlock this ancient riddle.

goal.en: Confirm to Nomarkh Ankh your willingness to help.

startText.en:
There you are. I was just thinking about how much I could use a capable, agile helper... Someone like you!
I can't promise you mountains of gold. Nor can I assure honor, glory, respect, or any of that other nonsense that heroes expect. The work will be dirty and it might stink. But the knowledge you gain in helping me in my research will be priceless.
I suspect that the appearance of so many undead on this island is the handiwork of one of the greatest summoners in the world. Maybe a young Tep getting his start! But you'd be reasonable to ask, what did the mad summoner need in the Dead City, and what magic generated such a phenomenal number of undead? If only we could find the answers to these questions... I don't know what it will give us, but I am sure that this knowledge will come in handy for you and your friends in your "understanding of the truth," as well for us.
So what will it be - would you like to advance the cause of science?

finishText.en: This is just dandy. I happen to be in need of a reliable assistant, whom I might send to the most dangerous places on this island. I myself never learned to swing the sword, nor can I wield magic. On the other hand, my powerful mind and your fighting skills would be quite complementary, and I think together we could unlock this ancient riddle.

goal.en: Tell Nomarkh Ankh that you are ready to help.

There you are. I was just thinking about how much I could use a capable, agile helper... Someone like you!
I can't promise you mountains of gold. Nor can I assure honor, glory, respect, or any of that other nonsense that heroes expect. The work will be dirty and it might stink. But the knowledge you gain in helping me in my research will be priceless.
I suspect that the appearance of so many undead on this island is the handiwork of one of the greatest summoners in the world. Maybe a young Tep getting his start! But you'd be reasonable to ask, what did the mad summoner need in the Dead City, and what magic generated such a phenomenal number of undead? If only we could find the answers to these questions... I don't know what it will give us, but I am sure that this knowledge will come in handy for you and your friends in your "understanding of the truth," as well for us.
So what will it be - would you like to advance the cause of science?

checkText.en:
Tep is my meal ticket! Two graduate degrees and a doctorate - these are not just scraps of paper.
You don't think I could put a spark into this heap of flesh and bones? Nothing to it! Give me the material and I'll turn modern science on its head!

finishText.en: And here are the parts. Excellent! Don't go too far. Give me a moment to sew everything in place, and then we'll both be witnesses to the greatest of secrets - the transformation of inanimate matter into a sentient being! Well then, let's get started!

startText.en:
Do you see this lunkhead? His pallor might be a little off, but he's the key to the secrets of the Wandering Island.
Right away I thought: who better to tell us what is going on here than a member of the local undead? The only problem is that these overly aggressive skeletons are refusing to speak with us. The desire to kill will only dissipate once their arms, legs, and head have been ripped off, and then they'll lack any means of communication. It's a vicious circle.
Then I decided to move a little faster, to make a creature that would obey me like child obeys a parent. Since it's made from the bodies of local undead, including, of course, their brains, it will have the necessary memories.
Well then, let me introduce you: this is Meathead. Don't expect a response, though. That's the problem. He's not finished. There's not much time, and I still need a lot of bones and flesh - the same dead flesh that's wandering around here in abundant quantities. Will you give me a hand?

checkText.en: Did you see that? He started to move! Oh, my tough little guy! At times like these, I feel a genuine father's pride!

finishText.en: He is moving awfully slowly. His lips are hardly moving at all. I can't hear his voice. Yes, it looks as if we're not going to be able to talk with this one.

goal.en: Wait for the end of the reanimation ritual.

startText.en:
Right, so the body is ready. I barely had enough thread. Look at what a beauty we've got! He's a sculpture, not a warrior! We could send him straight out to the Palace Square to help our fighters. But Meathead has a higher purpose. He will serve science! We must discover all of the secrets of this island!
Right, the last step. I already put the spark into his chest, but it's still asleep. We only have to wake it up! It's not a complicated process. I did it during my dissertation. Granted, the members of the board did suffer a few injuries. But that was a long time ago. I was young and full of piss and vinegar then. This time everything will go perfectly. Look.

checkText.en: Maybe the oaf needs a Spark from one of these regular skeletons. It needs a little more lifeforce!

finishText.en:
Thank you! The Swallower is about to burst from all the life it's got! I can feel it.
Maybe it'll be hard to believe, but no one values or loves life as much as necromancers.

startText.en:
I know what the problem is. His Spark is too weak. It's been handled too roughly with all of the fighting and then being reborn. To be honest, I simply chose the one closest at hand. It was definitely weak. This can be fixed! We just need to fill his Spark with lifeforce.
And again I must recruit your help. Here's another amulet. This one is called "the Swallower," which speaks for itself. It absorbs lifeforce, soaks it up like a sponge. You'll only have to get close to a dying being to catch the Spark just as it leaves the body. You won't necessarily even have to kill the body yourself. It will be enough to walk around the battlefield with the amulet in hand and you will have it full to bursting. You'll see! Give it a try! The Swallower won't work on the undead, but there are plenty of other sources for Sparks around. What am I referring to? The draconids and wormfaces, of course! Just don't use any of those suicidal ones that fall on our fortifications. They won't work - too weak. You'll have to find more serious opponents. For example, how about the ones protecting the enemy camp?

checkText.en:
What is this? What did he say? Couldn't understand a thing!
What a complicated thing the brain is... Yes, it will take some work to get him going.

finishText.en:
I worry that my work with Meathead is only just beginning. But we do have one finding so far - the local undead know very well who Tep is. I would not be surprised if he's walked in Tep's lands.
Unfortunately, all we've been able to get out of Meathead are these bits and pieces. You go ahead and continue your wanderings for now, but keep your eyes open. And look for traces of Tep!

goal.en: Talk to Meathead and report the results to summoner Nomarkh Ankh in the cultists' camp.

startText.en:
Now we enter the final phase. Thanks to the fresh lifeforce, Meathead has started to talk. His brain is working better and his basic instincts are starting to operate. I hope that his instincts won't tell him to destroy every living thing he sees! It would be hard to part with such a valuable specimen, the product of my many years of accumulated knowledge.
As soon as I'm finished, you can have a word with him. Try to keep your questions simple. Basic syntax, no subordinating conjunctions or any of that malarkey. You know what I'm talking about.

checkText.en:
They say that back in the day there was a local here, Zak, who could creep around golems. Probably just a myth. You'll never take a war golem from behind.
You're better off in front, and then just put him on his ass as soon as possible! Fists will solve any problem, hah!

finishText.en:
Back already? Nice work! Tell me, what are they up to over there?
Supplies, ammunition, and captured women? No... What the hell is that? The black fragment. Hrm. What kind of crap is that?

goal.en: Study the crypt that the golems are guarding in the Swampy Pass and report to strategist Punch the Furious in the cultists' camp.

startText.en:
I have received a report. Somewhere in the Swampy Pass we've found a guarded entrance. I'd bet my arm that it goes underground, into catacombs or a crypt. The walking dead built it, I'm sure of it! The wormfaces are way too paranoid about guarding that entrance... They even set up war golems to protect it!
Our guys didn't have the guts to get in there. Cowards! So that's why I'm giving you an order. Go in and see what the wily wormfaces have hidden underground.
Get to it! Forward, march!

checkText.en: Well well, look at this! So you found a bit of black stone in the tombs?

finishText.en: I knew it! The traces of Tep that we've all been waiting for.

goal.en: Talk to Father Semer Knef in the cultists' camp, then return to summoner Nomarkh Ankh.

startText.en: You mean that this rock was what the wormfaces were trying to protect? Who knows what this crap is. It's the first time I've ever seen anything like it. Take it away from here, please. It seems dangerous. It might blow up. Your sorcery will bring us to an early grave. Bring that cursed thing straight to Patriarch Knef, let him try and figure it out.

checkText.en: Behind that door you'll find everything you need, mortal.

finishText.en:
You won't believe me, but I'm thinking again. And a clear thinker is always a clear speaker.
Sometimes reality turns out to be more complicated than one might think...

goal.en: Go into the ghostly world and travel to the Palace Square. Summon Meathead with the Call of Flesh Totem, then defend him while he finishes his search.

startText.en:
Note that the wormface was summoning Sparks just like Tep did in his day, and their lifeforce healed his wounds. Where did he learn this? More importantly, where did he get the stone?
The Wandering Island is just a bit of earth and remnants of the Dead City. We might never have found this island, and it might have been lost in the astral depths, crumbling to dust. How did an artifact this strong end up here? What if Tep had experimented with immortality somewhere in these very ruins?
Hmmm... Let's try that as a hypothesis. We should go over the catacombs with a fine-toothed comb. You won't be able to pull it off yourself... I have an idea!
Meathead was created using the bits of Tep's knowledge that I was able to understand... That means there's a chance he might be able to sense the black stones. Do you see where I'm going? With his help we can find more fragments. I'll bet my own arm that there are more fragments here! By the way, this is a secret, but I once ordered a new arm for myself from the institute. I got the most advanced model, the very latest.
With some training, Meathead is already moving better and can follow orders. He's not much of a conversationalist, but that's not the most important thing, is it?
Here's the thing. I'll give you the Call of Flesh Totem and send you into the ghostly world. Your job is to go to the Palace Square and activate the totem. Meathead is a sentient creature. Well, he's getting there. This means he can also enter the ghostly world when summoned there by the totem. From then on out everything will be easy - follow him and protect him as necessary. He's still so weak...

checkText.en: I see, Ankh was able to create his own Meathead. I'm not at all surprised!

finishText.en: Yes, I need to talk to you about one important thing... Where did you hear about that? I didn't even send scouts after you!

goal.en: Talk to Patriarch Semer Knef in the cultists' camp.

startText.en:
Behind those doors are all of the Wandering Island's secrets. But there's something more important here.
You are on your way to a new Revelation. To make the right decision, you should hear both sides, isn't that right? The God of Light has opened his mouth and is ready to speak. There's just one step left. Before you enter the catacombs - wake up! Return to your body and speak with Sarn's servant, Patriarch Semer Knef. The words he'll say will inspire you to look at things a little differently...

checkText.en: Is the path to the Wretched Corner clear?

finishText.en: Excellent! We won. The fewer undead we have to deal with, the higher our chances of success. It will also improve your reputation. Perhaps it's time to begin the assault. At any rate, it's for Gromov to decide. Sarn be with you!

goal.en: Destroy 5 fallen Sorcerers or Warriors around the Watchtower and then report to Semer Knef in the camp near the tower.

startText.en:
Oh, it saddens me to see that! A third attack fizzles out. It's no wonder this place is called Wretched!
Don't be surprised to see me here. It's just a projection of me. The Great Mages aren't the only ones who can be in several places at a time. But right now we have more important matters to discuss.
As soon as Dmitry leaves the captured camp near the Watchtower, the place will be overrun with the brainless undead. Cursed things!
It looks like we're stuck here. Dmitry is already sick of fighting the undead. We can't retreat, and we can't fight them... You're our only hope.
Clear the area around the tower of the undead, and maybe our commander will cheer up, and it will improve your reputation among the cultists.

checkText.en: What's the good word? What's happening around the Palace Square?

finishText.en: The more undead you kill, the better our chances of success.

goal.en: Destroy 5 pale undead around the Wretched Corner and then return to Semer Knef with a report.

startText.en:
Now, onward to the Palace Square!
Soon the warriors of Sarn will take it by siege. Goliath is coming from the west, and woe unto them who stand in his way. Here, in the east, we need to help Gromov. He'd be glad to attack right now, but he knows that the undead would just pour right in behind him.
To ensure that no one interferes with our commander's ability to crush the defenders of the Palace Square into smithereens, we'll need to clear the way.
You've already probably seen enough of the undead for a while. I myself don't quite understand where they come from, or how there got to be so many. Well, I must admit I have my guesses... We'll talk about all that some other time.
Annihilate the undead around the Wretched Corner and in the meantime we'll start preparing to assault the Palace Square.

checkText.en: I've been trying to figure out where all these crowds of undead are coming from. Who summoned them? More importantly - why?

finishText.en: Nice job! Keep it up! Here's what I'll say in the report: "Our allies have destroyed a large number of undead around the Palace Square."

goal.en: Destroy 5 outcast mages or outcast warriors around the Palace Square and report to Semer Knef.

startText.en:
Thanks to your help, we were finally able to sweep our enemies from the island. I just worry that it might not be for long. There are too few of us to maintain control of the entire island. Soon we'll have to return to our camp.
But as long as we've still got the Palace Square, I've got a job especially tailored for your talents. There are undead inhabiting the ruins. More to the point, there are undead outcast mages and warriors just waiting for the chance to ambush one of our soldiers and tear him to shreds.
Every demon and every person would breathe a little easier if you spent a little time purging the area of these dimwitted creations who have nothing whatsoever in common with the noble Arisen.
Next time we attack, our warriors will have an easier go of it knowing that someone has already done something to protect our backs!

checkText.en: The death of our comrades is rough on me, too. Maybe in time you'll come to share my grief, when you become one of us in soul as well as body.

finishText.en:
Victory!
Your first sortie, and you completed it successfully. Congratulations! I'll write it in the report: "With Sarn's blessing we've managed to purge the Bone Hill of the undead."

goal.en: Destroy 5 undead on the Bone Hill. Report to Semer Knef in the cultists' camp.

startText.en:
Good thing we've got such excellent warriors as you on our side. It's too bad that the lies of Nihaz found you on your journey to the Truth before the good Word of Sarn. But there's still time, my friend... You'll have a chance to think about which side is better. But now - to battle!
When we last visited the Wandering Island, many of our comrades fell fighting the undead there. There's a reason it's called the Bone Hill.
The death of a warrior cuts a good commander to the quick. And Dmitri Gromov and Goliath are more than just good commanders. They're the best! Now, burdened by heavy thoughts and grief for the fallen, their faith in their powers might have been shaken... The church folk might have wanted to portray the demons as cruel monsters, but they are just as capable of feeling pain, insecurity, and grief during defeat.
Come on, show our warriors how the undead turn to dust under the fury of your attacks. Avenge our fallen comrades and fill our hearts with hope!

checkText.en: What's it like? What's the situation like around the ruins?

finishText.en:
Are you done? Excellent! In my report to Goliath, I will write "I ask you to consider the possibility of organizing an assault on the Pass. The number of the undead has decreased considerably thanks to the brave and decisive actions of our volunteer assistant."
