Actually, demons cannot read, but superficial thoughts and emotions are perceived perfectly.
We must not hesitate! The sooner we drive the Wormfaces out of the Pass, the sooner we can get to portal to the Dead City!

goal.en: Destroy 5 undead around the Rotten Ruins. When the mission is complete, report to Semer Knef in the Rotten Ruins.

startText.en:
Nice to see a familiar face here! It's me, Semer Knef. Comfortable, no? And no scouts necessary. I can watch our progress from the camp. You'll see me again at various hot spots.
The wormfaces have faltered! Good job! But we've only just begun our journey. The road is blocked by the undead. Those blasted undead are all around us. We'll have to deal with those shambling beanbags before we begin our attack. Our warriors' spirits will rise after a difficult battle. For Sarn!

checkText.en: We'll clear the roads leading to the square. Then we can begin the attack!

finishText.en:
Are you done with the undead! Praise Sarn! But don't begin the assault without Gromov - his forces should approach from the east.
Cultists, demons, and those who have found the courage to stand under our banner! Only together, only by joining forces, can we win!

goal.en: Destroy 5 outcast undead in the Swampy Pass and return to Semer Knef.

startText.en:
We've come a long way already! Congratulations! But it's too soon to relax. The big push remains ahead. The Palace Square is the enemy's main stronghold. I can tell this is going to be a very difficult battle, Great Sarn, and we will lose many friends!
But there is a way to make things easier. All around the square are hordes of the undead. If we were to make our assault now and the attack lasted for a while, then the undead would block our ability to send supplies. You'll have to kill more of them. The less undead are left behind us, the easier it will be for our fighters to join the final and decisive battle.
Don't hold back! Spare not sweat, spare not blood! We stand on the threshold of victory! The portal is within our grasp! No retreat! For Sarn!

checkText.en: Die over and over. Be reborn and die again. Day after day! No end to the pain! Unbelievable suffering! The enemy has brought this upon himself!

finishText.en: To die a second time? To suffer, begging for mercy? That's nothing! They still haven't paid for what they've done! Tomorrow you shall return, and let the instruments of vengeance again rain down upon their heads!

goal.en: With the help of the Amulet of Eternal Life, resurrect the fallen leaders of the wormfaces and draconids in the Wretched Corner, and the Swampy Pass. Defeat them and report to Semer Knef in the Palace Square when you are victorious.

startText.en:
There is no worse fate than to have to return to the battlefield day after day to die and die again. Tep, the greatest mage and madman of all time, knows this better than anyone else...
That's what the wormfaces deserve. Once they were humans, today they are monsters. Then there are the despicable draconids. And most of all, their leaders! They will beg for mercy, they will dream of peace and of the eternal compassion of the Creator. But they do not deserve our pity. Just as they showed no pity to us, children of Sarn.
It is a great honor to serve as an instrument of vengeance. Return the sparks to the fallen soldiers and then defeat them again. Are you prepared for this honor?

finishText.en:
You don't seem to be in a hurry. Has my booming voice turned your brain to jelly? It's happened before. What can you do? Being a deity is a double-edged sword. No one will take you seriously without all those absurd trappings of supernal power, dazzling feats of creation, and cryptic knowledge... Yuck! You know how sick I am of all that, after thousands of years?
In fact, everything is much more simple in real life. "If the mountain won't come to Nezeb, then Nezeb shall command goblins to build a new mountain." This is a local saying, but very relevant at this time, for we will create a new allod and erect a new portal to the Dead City on it.
I'll tell you up front that it's not going to be easy. In fact, it's going to be downright dangerous for you. But you don't appreciate things you haven't earned, friend, isn't that so?

goal.en: Climb the stairs of the Sanctum and meet with Nihaz in the Alcove.

startText.en:
I...
I don't have the words to express the grandeur of Master's words. He is awe-inspiring. I swear that this world hasn't seen anything so amazing since the Great Nothing that preceded the creation of the earth and sky.
Oh, how I envy you, the Chosen One, Keeper of the Revelation. You shall meet with the Master as equals and you shall be shown the greatest secret of this world. A secret that only the gods know!
You will have the power to change this world forever. To remake it according to your will and desires. This is the greatest honor that a mortal could ever hope for.
Get to it. Climb the staircase and enter the holiest of holies, the Sanctum Alcove! The Master awaits!

finishText.en:
You don't seem to be in a hurry. Has my booming voice turned your brain to jelly? It's happened before. What can you do? Being a deity is a double-edged sword. No one will take you seriously without all those absurd trappings of supernal power, dazzling feats of creation, and cryptic knowledge... Yuck! You know how sick I am of all that, after thousands of years?
In fact, everything is much more simple in real life. "If the mountain won't come to Nezeb, then Nezeb shall command goblins to build a new mountain." This is a local saying, but very relevant at this time, for we will create a new allod and erect a new portal to the Dead City on it.
I'll tell you up front that it's not going to be easy. In fact, it's going to be downright dangerous for you. But you don't appreciate things you haven't earned, friend, isn't that so?

goal.en: Climb the stairs of the Sanctum and meet with Nihaz in the Alcove.

startText.en:
I...
I don't have the words to express the grandeur of Master's words. He is awe-inspiring. I swear that this world hasn't seen anything so amazing since the Great Nothing that preceded the creation of the earth and sky.
Oh, how I envy you, the Chosen One, Keeper of the Revelation. You shall meet with the Master as equals and you shall be shown the greatest secret of this world. A secret that only the gods know!
You will have the power to change this world forever. To remake it according to your will and desires. This is the greatest honor that a mortal could ever hope for.
Get to it. Climb the staircase and enter the holiest of holies, the Sanctum Alcove! The Master awaits!

finishText.en: Well then. Enough talk, let's get to work. Creating matter from energy is no easy task, and you'll have to do the work of ten. Of course, I will offer you my assistance, both materially and in the form of advice, but you will have to do most of the work. Otherwise, you'll never understand real power and remain easy prey for anyone with a deeper understanding of the astral, not to mention my eternal friend and foe, Sarn. Decide now - are you a powerless flea or do you have what it takes?

goal.en: Speak with Nihaz and listen to him carefully.

startText.en:
It seems that the time has come for a serious conversation. You are a quick study. There are few adventurers that could match you. But do not get cocky! You now stand at the beginning of a long journey which is itself the beginning of thousands of potential journeys. I wonder where your path will take you.
It's early to speak of this. We'll talk of something else...

checkText.en: Be careful when flying in the area where new matter is created! If you deviate from the path, the energy that flows through the area will blast you into tiny particles!

finishText.en:
Excellent. Construction is going as planned. I hope that we can finish it in time.
Bring more astralium right away - the generators are running out faster than I expected. I shall try to discover why the actual power is less than predicted during such high-energy expenditures...

goal.en: Charge the six substance generators and return to the Architect on the Citadel pier.

startText.en:
Now that you've got everything you need to create a new island, it's time to start. I shall call it the Cradle - since it is the cradle of your new power, the cradle of victory over our enemies. The cradle of the new world!
However, we haven't built it yet. There is just an area full of tiny bits of matter created by matter generators. I cannot explain to you exactly how it's done.
Now take an astral ship and get round the place where your island will be. Use your astralium to charge the generators I mentioned. It's simple as it goes: just take a piece of astralium to the generator's engine, and it will absorb its energy. The quantity you've got is enough for the six generators.

checkText.en: Energy, energy... Where are we losing energy? We are expending more energy than was predicted and we're getting off-schedule!

finishText.en:
What?? A generator has exploded? That can't be! It has three defense systems, all its essential components are doubled, all the fragile bits are well-protected, there's practically no operational wear and tear... How did this happen?
Damn it! Here's what we'll do. I will replace this blasted generator with a backup. You run and get some more fuel!

goal.en: Charge the 6 generators with astralium particles and return to the Architect on the Citadel pier.

startText.en:
Damn! I didn't expect the generators to consume so much astralium so quickly! It's like pouring astralium down a bottomless pit. Can it be that the scientists and laborers made a mistake during assembly? No, it can't be, I have already checked and re-checked everything myself.
What are you standing around for? Get back in your ship and charge up those generators with astralium. If the work piles up, then the unstable material will enter a borderline phase and the energy will change its potential... Let's just say that you'll hear the explosion all the way in your new home in the Purgatory!

checkText.en: No problems this time, right? Piece of cake?

finishText.en:
What?? Again? Not one, but several substance generators have all gone haywire at once? This simply can't be!
But what if... Ah yes, I've got it. Someone has been sabotaging our work.

goal.en: Charge the 6 substance generators using astralium particles and return to the Architect on the Citadel pier.

startText.en:
Well then. I was unable to explain why one of our generators blew up. It appeared to be a simple accident, a small mistake in the calculations. I gave my orders to replace the damaged generator and now we should finish the first phase of construction on time. That's assuming you'll stop standing there, gawping, and get busy recharging the generators.
Get back to your ship and get moving!

finishText.en:
Let's see... You must be the piddling mortal that the Master was talking about? Yes... Looking at you, I cannot understand what the Master saw in you, what made him trust your feeble hands with such a powerful instrument. Why, that thing could send our entire universe ass over kettle!
Ah, I may have spoken too hastily. Don't be offended. It's just my pride and vanity. The faults of any creative type.

goal.en: Meet with the Architect on the pier at the Master's Citadel.

startText.en:
Now that you understand the scale of the task ahead of us, let's get to work. I am going to be a little busy, so one of my loyal and reliable servants will assist you during the first phases of construction of the new allod. He prefers to be called "the Architect." I've never understood why my disciples always go in for the most gaudy, grandiose titles... Tell me the truth, do I look "powerful and great" in this barrel-shaped body? So why the hell do all my servants bow and scrape before me?? That's one thing Sarn's got - he's clever. When he gave humans brains, curiosity, and a tendency to destroy, he made the perfect get-out-of-jail-free card for his prison. Now his cleverness has turned around to bite him!
But I'm getting off the subject. What can you do, I'm getting old... Haha!
Anyway. Go on, the Architect is waiting for you on the pier near the Citadel. I hope you two can work well together.

checkText.en: I hope that by setting up regular patrols we'll be able to protect the generators from further sabotage. By the way, have you figured out who was behind that?

finishText.en:
Let's see. Metal flying things that reminded you of Zem Blades? Very interesting... Could it be that the scientists from ZIT Headquarters decided to put a stick in our spokes? No, that's not very likely. The Empire is no longer our enemy, nor is the League for that matter. I doubt your good friend there would let a chance like this slip away... That's Tep I'm talking about!
Wait... I need to think.

startText.en:
Sabotage! I swear to you, someone or something is dead set against us. The Master has many enemies in this world, and among them are those who would be capable of infiltrating our construction project. Oh, Master, why do you trust these adventurers? They clearly do not know how to hold their tongue!
Enough, this is no time for casting blame. We must do something or else we'll end up without any generators at all. Maybe it's time you got to work on this problem.
I'll give you a power cutter. It's not usually any good in combat. It's actually a tool for smoothing out rocky material on a construction site. However, if this kind of saw should run into any material object it will smash it into tiny bits!
Get in your ship and go back on patrol around the construction site. Find those damned saboteurs and grind them into astral dust!

checkText.en: The cursed servants of a mad summoner! They have no idea what they're getting into. Interfering with the operation of such powerful forces could annihilate this entire section of the astral!

finishText.en:
I saw a huge flash... I've always said that curiosity kills the damn cat!
The Master knows that the death of these stupid creatures saddens me. But their interference in the process of creating an allod could have had catastrophic consequences. It was thanks to you that this fate was avoided.

goal.en: Talk to the Architect and head for the Frozen Peak. Find out where Tep Cultists are stockpiling information about the Cradle, then destroy the cultist's camp with a tunneling explosive. Return to the Architect on the Citadel pier upon completion.

startText.en:
There! Now that I've had a chance to study the remains of the saboteurs, I know who we're up against. Moreover, I can even guess where they are hiding!
Those supposed saboteurs are actually reconnaissance drones! They gathered information about the substance generators and the principles of transforming the astral. The breakage started because of this interference in the generators' operation.
The drones are practically impossible to track, but for the fact that they don't have their own reactor and that their fuel capacity is exceedingly small. What does this mean? It means that they need somewhere to fuel up and drop off the information. This could only be one place! The Frozen Peak! It's a piece of icy cliff absolutely devoid of life. It was once the top of a mountain in Gipat. The explosion following the death of Tka-Rik sent a chunk of the mountain far into the astral. When we first arrived, we looked it over and, naturally, didn't find anything of value. So we forgot about it. It's the only spot that the cultists could set up a base on without us knowing!
I'll give you one of our most powerful explosives, the kind that I have exclusive rights to. It was created for peaceful tasks, such as smoothing out mountainsides. I want you to flatten the Frozen Peak. Find the cultists' information stockpile, where their recon drones are compiling information. Once you've found it, blast the whole thing to the astral demons! We won't see Cradle completed as long as the cultists are hanging around the construction site.

checkText.en: How I hate when fools lay their clumsy hands on such delicate, complex machines! These substance generators are not toys! I'd like to impale the bastards on the screws with my own two hands!

finishText.en: Let's see the schedule... Whew, looks like it's fine. And yet something still worries me.

startText.en:
I heard the Harbinger of Retribution's report. Tep's minions got what they deserved! Knowledge must be earned.
Regrettably, these fools don't understand how they endanger us and themselves when they interfere in our work. More so now, when we've completed the first phase of creating an island and started the second phase.
But what can we do? Creation of an island is a process requiring constant work. We simply cannot halt construction and redirect our forces to defend against the cultists. We'll have to deal with both issues at once.
Take my power cutter, obtain an astralium particle and fly around our new allod. You can revel in your handiwork, while clearing the area of enemy mechanical spies.

checkText.en: The ability to divide your body into material and astral components is a gift that is only available to the chosen few. So far I know of only one of your world's inhabitants capable of this. And you know him as well. His name is Tep...

finishText.en:
How are you feeling? Any noise in your head? Are you seeing stars? Hah, you're stronger than I thought! Many never even return to their body.
What if you were to suffer the same fate? Well, I would've been very disappointed in you, considering all the time and effort spent to open your eyes.
But you managed to overpower the guardian, and that is good. That means the astral has accepted you. Take a break, rest up, and we will continue our search.

goal.en: Talk to Nihaz, take over the astral body and pass the first barrier between the astral layers by defeating the astral guardian.

startText.en:
I see you are doing quite well. Well, how does it feel to be a demiurge, the creator of new worlds? Has quite an impact on your self-worth, doesn't it? Hehe. But don't get too full of yourself just yet. You've still got ways to go to become a true demiurge. Although, I must admit you're showing great progress. A few more millennia and you'll become almost like I was in my youth, haha!
Relax, I'm just teasing... You really are doing quite well. Perhaps I can even trust you with a more challenging quest.
As you know, the allod that we're creating in the astral already has its reflection in all the layers of the astral. However, the island is material only in this world, whereas in the deeper layers of the astral it is felt as a kind of "echo." It hasn't materialized yet, and it is easy to distort. And if you distort the reflection of an object in the deepest layer of the astral, then its true identity will be distorted in this world as well!
Why am I telling you all this? Because someone is trying to interfere in the creation of an allod by influencing its reflection. And it can only be Sarn! There's nobody else in this world who knows the principles of working with the astral, even your so-called "Great Mages"!
You'll have to deal with this problem. Your soul, as you know, comprises the astral body and a Spark. I can split your soul and send your astral body into the depths of the astral, where our enemy is hiding.
Barriers between the layers of the astral are protected by astral guards. In order to pass through to the second layer of the astral you have to defeat the guardian, and it will be a very difficult battle. When you feel that you are ready - talk to me.

checkText.en: I see confusion in your eyes. You're probably wondering why I need all this: telling you about the astral body, learning to control it? But I am not going to tell you, hehe. If you can guess, good; if not, well, that's your problem. The ability to analyze facts is far more important than powerful muscles or even the most sophisticated magic. Believe me, I know what I'm talking about!

finishText.en:
Ho! You're a veritable hero! Dealing with astral guardians isn't for everyone. These aren't demons that explode to bits from a single bomb; here strength of spirit is paramount!
Anyway, get some rest, astral combat will wear anyone out. In the meantime, I will check out how things are going with our allod.

goal.en: While in the astral body, pass through the third layer of the astral by defeating the guardians of the barrier, then report to Nihaz upon completion.

startText.en:
I look at you and wonder. Where do mortal beings like you get such an inexhaustible thirst for knowledge, so much perseverance and persistence in achieving your goals? I reckon Sarn did well when he created your ancestors. If I had a hat, I would tip it to him. But the irony is that he will be destroyed by his own creation.
And now on to current events. Our enemy doesn't stop their attempts to hinder our work. So get ready to head into the astral in your astral body.
But this time you'll need to break through even deeper - at least the third layer of the astral - by defeating the guardians of the first and second astral barriers which separate the layers.

checkText.en: Hmm, the problem seems to be more serious than I thought...

finishText.en:
Wow... I didn't expect that, oh no I did not. I blamed Sarn, but this development...
So, the Light is getting aggressive? It sensed power and attempted a power play? We'll see how that plays out...

goal.en: While in the astral body, get as deep into the astral as you can.

startText.en:
Well, well. Our opponent isn't sleeping. The distorted region of space where the future allod is forming as we speak is becoming increasingly unstable. Someone or something continues to interfere in our affairs. Perhaps I might have to intervene personally. Still, the brunt of the work will have to be done by you.
You are no longer the feeble and helpless lump of flesh that had appeared in Gipat a time ago. You've managed to overcome many powerful enemies, more than even your Great Mages have seen in their entire long lives. And I hope that you will carry out my quest as well.
So, you will need to return once more to the deep layers of the astral. But this time do not stop! Go as deep as you can. Give your life if you have to, but break on through! Either we get to our enemy in the nearest future, or our allod-creating venture will fall through.

finishText.en:
I am delighted that we have solved our problems.
The last phase is the most difficult of all. There cannot be any mistakes!
I trust you have the astralium? Soon we shall need it.

goal.en: Meet with the Architect on the pier at the Master's Citadel.

startText.en:
What are you staring at? What? Do you think gods can't make mistakes? Hah! Then Sarn would never have created you. And he wouldn't have bothered to butt heads with me, since he knew that he would lose, I know he did! But he was hoping for some miracle, which obviously didn't happen.
But the Servant of the Light is not someone you can tussle with at this juncture. Moreover, these aren't even your problems. I'll take care of that cheeky bastard myself. Oh, I'll take care of him so hard you'll see sparks fly! Tries his damnedest to pass for an angel, all the while pulling dirty tricks behind my back! No matter, he'll get his soon enough.
And you should go see the Architect. The island's creation is entering its final phase, and your assistance is very much needed.

finishText.en: There you are! Just in time. We ran into some difficulties, and your help is needed.

goal.en: Meet with Nihaz in the alcove of the Master's Sanctum.

startText.en:
The Master requested that you go to him immediately! He's waiting for you in the alcove of His Sanctum.
And make haste! You mustn't keep the Master waiting. Surely such an urgent call is very important.

checkText.en: Welcome to the Cradle, hero!

finishText.en: If it weren't for you, this would've been a failure. So much work... Aye, it has been too long since the Master has shown His truly divine power! Be proud to be a part of the great act of creation of new land!

goal.en: Board an astral ship and charge matter generators, then ask Nihaz about future plans.

startText.en:
I do not understand why the Master is in such a hurry? We won't even have the time to create water and clouds! Even breathing on that forming rock will be difficult!
We'll have to finish much of it on the Cradle itself, without matter generators, virtually by hand. It's not the worst thing in the world, seeing as I know how to turn a barren wasteland into a flourishing oasis, but how long will it take, huh? Why, oh why the Master bid us to complete the works right away? I can see it in your eyes that you know the answer.
No, no, don't say anything! If the Master wanted me to know the reason, he would have told me. Who am I to doubt the Master's wisdom?
But you... you are another matter! This land is intended for you and others who walk the path of Truth. So what use are these empty doubts?
Board an astral ship and go. The generators must be reconfigured and fueled with the energy that was scattered in the ​​construction area, and our work will be completed!
I'll give you an astral converter. It collects regular energy from the environment and redirects it to the generator. Charge the generators, then go see the Master. He'll tell you about our subsequent plans.

checkText.en: Go and only come back with victory!

finishText.en:
I admit, I was afraid that you'd come back a helpless madman, without the slightest glimmer of reason in your eyes. I am glad to see my fears were unfounded. Having defeated madness that's always in hot pursuit of every great hero, you clearly demonstrate your Power of Intention.
With your desire incarnate, you are one step closer to the Dead City!

goal.en: While in the astral body, defeat Madness Incarnate in the Heart of Madness and return to the Keeper of the Universe.

startText.en:
Madness... It always follows in your tracks. You hide from it behind the wall of iron logic, citadels of common sense, but madness always finds a loophole. I have seen many renowned people that have endured countless blows of fate succumb to madness in the span of a moment. It is a miserable sight! What good are all their victories and accomplishments if they cannot even fathom their value?
Your next battle will be against Madness Incarnate. Remember that madness never comes out of nowhere. There are always manifestations of impending madness, and only by detecting them in time can you preserve your mind... and your life!

checkText.en: Go and only come back with victory!

finishText.en:
Do you feel guilty about helping someone, and then turning your weapon against your recent ally? I think not. Circumstances are often such that a common threat unites even the most implacable enemies, but as soon as their misfortune passes, recent allies readily resume their acrimony. And only in your case, a betrayal of a one-time ally has turned against him.
He who plots treason may well become victim of it himself. Accepting the truth of that fact, you assert your Power of Intention.
With your desire incarnate, you are one step closer to the Dead City!

goal.en: While in the astral body, defeat Cunning Incarnate in the Heart of Cunning and return to the Keeper of the Universe.

startText.en:
Cunning is a favorite weapon of your enemies. When you cannot tell your friend from your enemy, when at every moment you expect a blade to in your back, you are weak and vulnerable. But if you wish to win the battle, you have to understand the lessons of deceit: learn to lie, betray and backstab, spin a web of intrigue and falsehoods, toy with emotions, sic one against the other... No one will force you to do these things, but you will need to learn about deadly cunning - a weapon against which there's no protection.
Go into the Heart of Cunning. There the intentions of your enemies have collided. Who will you side with? Or will you deceive them both? Decide!

checkText.en: Go and only come back with victory!

finishText.en:
Good! Taming chaos with order, you... no, you don't create a new life, don't worry - chaos incarnate is not quite chaos, for it has a certain order. However, by winning you demonstrate a clear Power of Intention.
With your desire incarnate, you are one step closer to the Dead City!

goal.en: While in the astral body, defeat Chaos Incarnate in the Heart of Chaos and return to the Keeper of the Universe.

startText.en:
Any war is chaos. Unrest, confusion, discord, general distrust...
But chaos is much more than simply destruction. Chaos is the foundation of all things. If not for chaos, there would be no development, and the world would remain forever still. Order can tame chaos, and then at the converge of the two forces emerges a third, whose name is life.
You want to live? Do you want your friends, your brothers and sisters in arms, your entire peoples to live? Then tame chaos, which is carried by the Master's enemies into this world. And remember - only order can defeat chaos!

checkText.en: Go and only come back with victory!

finishText.en:
Victory over Spirit Incarnate has strengthened your own spirit and clearly demonstrates your Power of Intention!
With your desire incarnate, you are one step closer to the Dead City!

goal.en: While in the astral body, defeat Spirit Incarnate in the Heart of Spirit and return to the Keeper of the Universe.

startText.en:
Spirit, soul. Debates over what it is have gone on for centuries. Some calls it a "breath of the Creator," but who created the Creators themselves? Others call it "the essence of life"... But many living creatures have no soul.
No one can offer an exact answer. We only know that the soul is essentially composed of a Spark and the body's energy aura, its "reflection" in the astral. And the soul can feel pain, too. Not physical pain, oh no, but emotional!
You shall soon meet Spirit Incarnate. Conventional weapons and magic will not harm it, for emotional pain can only be inflicted by another soul. I'll give you a hint - Spirit Incarnate can only feel pain from the death of its own Spark... Or the death of other Sparks nearby!

checkText.en: Go and only come back with victory!

finishText.en:
Well, now you know what power is and how it is dangerous. Look at the Master! His power is almost limitless, but he barely puts it to use. Have you ever heard him issue a stern order? Never! He always asks, persuades, calls on us to believe in ourselves and follow Him. He wishes for our understanding, not blind obedience. And that is why he chooses only those allies who have a powerful will of their own. Like you! After all, you can easily demonstrate your Power of Intention.
With your desire incarnate, you are one step closer to the Dead City!

goal.en: While in the astral body, defeat Power Incarnate in the Heart of Power and return to the Keeper of the Universe.

startText.en:
Power... It is craved by every creature that's sentient and self-aware. To subdue nature and other intelligent beings to your will - this desire is as natural to us as breathing! Power is capable of opening horizons and bringing about new possibilities, but do not forget that power also corrupts. And absolute power corrupts absolutely. But you will yet see it with your own eyes.
Go into the Heart of Power and fight its manifestation. You will understand that those who have power care not for anyone but themselves, not even for their allies, friends and followers. And most interestingly, their power hangs on those who are willing to die for some illusory ideals. But when stripped of his followers and left on his own, the seeker of power is powerless!

checkText.en: Power lies not in muscle mass, not in powerful spells or sophisticated knowledge. Power lies in the sincere belief in your cause, in your abilities, in your Truth!

finishText.en: I rarely ever meet such an more attentive listener like you. I hope you will survive in the upcoming battle, and I will yet brighten up your solitude with conversation.

goal.en: Talk to the Keeper of the Universe and learn more about the Power of Intention.

startText.en:
You and other adventurers will travel from the Cradle to storm the Dead City. You need to go in a straight line by creating a portal.
The basis for the portal has been created, but activating it will require a lot of effort. You already know about the Power of Intention, yes? No? How come? You are fighting astral battles, learning the universe's secrets, but don't even know its basic laws? Truly, the creatures of this world are strange, indeed.
Listen carefully, and I will tell you about the Power of Intention, and how it can serve your cause or impede it.

checkText.en: Strive, fight, harden your will. If you hate - hate, if you despise - despise. But make everyone respect your desires!

finishText.en: Yes! Look, the portal is coming alive! The first and most difficult part of the path is traversed. The will of your enemies is undermined, but you mustn't rest on your laurels.

goal.en: Bring 3 Desire Incarnates to the Keeper of the Universe at the Cradle.

startText.en:
It's time to start searching for the path. The straight path is not always the shortest, but for paths that stretch beyond this world, such as portals, this rule is entirely appropriate.
Every time you emerge victorious and confirm your Intention, the Power of Intention will manifest itself in this world. The Power of Intention is those very building blocks that will form your path to the Dead City. Fight the enemy's will while in the astral body, and achieve success doing so. Share with me your Power of Intention, and I shall open for you the first part of the path.

checkText.en: Aye, it's been a long time since I opened any new paths. Opening a regular portal is easy, but paving a way is tough. After all, I'm sure realize that the issue isn't only whether or not you'll get to the Dead City, but also how you'll get there?

finishText.en: Excellent! Your current path is nearing completion. However, it leads not to a dead end, bur rather to a crossroads, whereupon a thousand more paths shall open to you. And it is only your will and your will alone that shall choose your path!

goal.en: Bring 3 Desire Incarnates to the Keeper of the Universe at the Cradle.

startText.en:
Your will is strong, Keeper of the Revelation. I would not want to be your enemy! You'll break through any barrier to carry out your plans, and woe unto anyone who stands in your way. In this you both resemble and differ from the Master. The Master's will is strong, but while you use it as a battering ram, the Master wields it as a rapier. You sweep away enemies from your way, while the Master... Oh, we should be talking about something else! After all, the work is not yet completed.
Keep trampling enemies with your Power of Intention. With each victory the winding path becomes shorter, and your goal closer!

checkText.en: Know that even once you open the path, the battle will not be over. The only way to completely destroy someone else's will is by destroying its ​​host.

finishText.en:
Yes! The path is open! Your Power of Intention has swept away all barriers. Now all you only have to do is give me an order, and I will send you to the Dead City.
But don't be in too much of a rush. If you continue to fight your enemies' desires incarnate, I will reward you generously for your victories.

goal.en: Bring 3 Desire Incarnates to the Keeper of the Universe at the Cradle.

startText.en: We're almost there. Your enemies' resistance is nearly broken, and only pitiful remnants of a once strong Intention still oppose you. Smite your enemies, let your Intention and your desire for victory lead you! And when your Power of Intention completely subdues the enemy's will, the portal will come to life and the secrets of the Dead City will be laid out at your feet.

checkText.en: Go and only come back with victory!

finishText.en:
Good. You've managed to win, and by taming your own rage you were able to crush the enemy's. Keeping your emotions in check while in battle and resisting the pull of anger, you use the Power of Intention to defeat the enemy, turning his own rage against him.
With your desire incarnate, you are one step closer to the Dead City!

goal.en: While in the astral body, defeat Rage Incarnate in the Heart of Rage and return to the Keeper of the Universe.

startText.en:
It's time to demonstrate your Power of Intention in a duel!
This time you will go up against the base and animalistic emotion that is well-known to every soldier.
Go into the Heart of Rage, enter the protective dome and destroy Rage Incarnate. In a duel that's fair and one on one, your Intention must prevail against the beastly rage of our enemies!

checkText.en: Go and only come back with victory!

finishText.en: Good. You've managed to win the clash of intellects, proving your Power of Intention with the power of thought alone. With your desire incarnate, you are one step closer to the Dead City!

goal.en: While in the astral body, defeat Thought Incarnate in the Heart of Thought and return to the Keeper of the Universe.

startText.en:
It's time to demonstrate your Power of Intention in a duel!
First there was word... No, first there was thought! And word came later, much later. Thought can cure and kill, create and destroy. If you wish for victory, your thought must be victorious first. Go into the Heart of Thought and defeat its manifestation!

checkText.en: Go and only come back with victory!

finishText.en: There is no death! Death is merely transition between states of being. Now, having defeated Death Incarnate and thus demonstrated your Power of Intention, you understand this. With your desire incarnate, you are one step closer to the Dead City!

goal.en: While in the astral body, defeat Death Incarnate in the Heart of Death and return to the Keeper of the Universe.

startText.en:
It's time to demonstrate your Power of Intention in a duel!
Death... Creatures gifted with the power of Light claim that you're not afraid of death. After all, there is no death for you, there is only a brief visit to the Purgatory. But in reality, deep within your soul you are all afraid of death, for there is always a chance that you won't be resurrected, and true death scares you more than anything in the world. But your enemies are accustomed to death. They have become one with it. And if you wish to demonstrate your Power of Intention, go into the Heart of Death and defeat its manifestation!

checkText.en: Go and only come back with victory!

finishText.en:
Very nice. By turning the gift of life against your opponent you've demonstrated tremendous Power of Intention.
With your desire incarnate, you are one step closer to the Dead City!

goal.en: While in the astral body, defeat Life Incarnate in the Heart of Life and return to the Keeper of the Universe.

startText.en:
Life is the most precious thing to a rational being. Taking life is easy, while bestowing life is far from simple. You see this land? It is empty and lifeless. It will take time for the first plants will appear, for the flowers to blossom, and the trees to reach for the sky. Anyone with an understanding of life can bestow it, but also may take it away.
I'll give you a little hint. When you meet Life Incarnate, remember these words. Under certain conditions, that which gives life may also take life away. Now go into the Heart of Life, and show your Power of Intention.

checkText.en: Go and only come back with victory!

finishText.en:
Congratulations on the victory. Now you know that where there is light, there must also be darkness. And where darkness reigns, there must also be light. Or to put it another way... Darkness and Light! Use the light when you need to overcome darkness, and call out to the darkness when your opponent draws on the light. This will always ensure your victory.
In a duel between light and darkness, you've demonstrated your Power of Intention very well. With your desire incarnate, you are one step closer to the Dead City!

goal.en: While in the astral body, defeat Darkness Incarnate in the Heart of Darkness and return to the Keeper of the Universe.

startText.en:
Darkness and shadow... They conceal a killer waylaying his victim, but also lovers as they seclude themselves, away from noise and others. Darkness is full of fear and deceit, but it also brings solace and conceals dirt that is so apparent in daylight. Without darkness there is no light, and without light there is no darkness. And when darkness and light come together, shadow is born.
My words will help you demonstrate the Power of Intention in the Heart of Darkness. This glowing dust that I'm giving you will help you to find what the darkness hides.

finishText.en: So you're going to be my contact in the Committee? Then quit acting so suspiciously, or else you might as well write "spy" on your forehead.

goal.en: Meet with Barbara of Siveria on the Isle of Revelation.

startText.en:
I want to give you a very important task. The Empire's fate might depend on it! Maybe even the fate of the whole world...
What do you know about Nihaz? He's a god. A dark god, as he himself admits. But what do we know of his goals? For the sake of keeping Sarn imprisoned, he might decide to destroy everything that the Sarnaut's prisoner created, including us. In fact, this might very well turn out to be the case. You are nothing but a pawn to him, like all the rest of the Keepers of the Revelation and the Seekers of Truth. I know all too well how powerful beings such as him tend to have their own sense of right and wrong. So long as his goals and capabilities remain unknown to us, he represents a potential threat to our entire world.
But this is all conjecture. And I won't act on conjecture! I need facts! The Committee's agents were able to recruit one Barbara of Siveria, who spends a great deal of time on the Isle of Revelation, not far from the Citadel. With her help, we can get more information about the Master's plans and designs. Therein lies your task. Go see Barbara of Siveria and do everything you can. The Empire shall never forget you!

finishText.en: So you're the hero that was sent to me to help gather information about the Master! Then quit acting so suspiciously, or else you might as well write "spy" on your forehead.

goal.en: Meet with Barbara of Siveria on the Isle of Revelation.

startText.en:
I want to give you a very important task. The League's fate might depend on it! Maybe even the fate of the whole world...
What do you know about Nihaz? He's a god. A dark god, as he himself admits. But what do we know of his goals? For the sake of keeping Sarn imprisoned, he might decide to destroy everything that the Sarnaut's prisoner created, including us. In fact, this might very well turn out to be the case. You are nothing but a pawn to him, like all the rest of the Keepers of the Revelation and the Seekers of Truth. I know all too well how powerful beings such as him tend to have their own sense of right and wrong. So long as his goals and capabilities remain unknown to us, he represents a potential threat to our entire world.
But this is all conjecture. And I won't act on conjecture! I need facts! Barbara of Siveria, our secret agent, spends a great deal of time on the Isle of Revelation, not far from the Citadel. With her help, we can get more information about the Master's plans and designs. Therein lies your task. Go see Barbara of Siveria and do everything you can. The League shall never forget you!

checkText.en: Well, did you learn anything?

finishText.en:
What?? Nihaz got you helping him on the construction of a new allod? That's unbelievable... Do you understand how valuable this information is? Any Great Mage would give his right arm for information about the principles of constructing new islands!
All right, let's have some details. I'll write it all down and then send a letter to our mutual employer...

goal.en: Carry out orders of Nihaz's and his retainers until you are offered to help the Architect at the Citadel docks, then learn about the construction project and return to Barbara of Siveria.

startText.en:
Here's the deal. The Master's servants recently built something on the docks. Lots of astral ships were coming and going, carrying heavy cargo and equipment. What I've heard is that they are planning to install generators and other machinery in the astral near the Citadel. Unfortunately, that's all I was able to learn. Those runty little hooded creeps prefer to keep their lips sealed... But they seem to trust you!
You're on good terms with the Master and his minions, and I'd bet a plugged nickel against all the diamonds in the world that they'll invite you to see their construction. Don't hesitate to accept! Do all of the Master's bidding, and look, listen, and remember. Return to me as soon as you've figured out what the Master is doing.

checkText.en: Not so much noise! Even the stumps have ears...

finishText.en:
Shh... Bring it here. I hope it doesn't explode.
Nice and easy. Continue to carry out the Master's orders, help him build the Cradle, work your way into his trust and gather information. If something unprofessional should happen - an accident, sabotage, or what have you - come straight to me.

goal.en: Bring Barbara of Siveria pure astralium.

startText.en:
Let's see... You're saying that something called "astralium" is needed for the construction of the new island? That would probably interest our Great Mage... And you know what? I don't think it will be a problem to obtain some. Master's henchmen are obviously rather dumb.
It's unlikely that you'll be able to learn what purification technology they use, but it shouldn't be much work to get some astralium itself. They are not keeping records, right? Get a piece of astralium and bring it to me. I will send it to the capital, and I'm happy to let the mages and scientists have at it.

checkText.en: Tep's cultists certainly picked a nice time to interfere... They'll soon pay!

finishText.en:
Samples... Pages of notes... Aha, a complete researcher's logbook! Excellent!
I'll try to get this information to the capital as soon as possible.

goal.en: Find three samples of material, five pages of notes, and a logbook containing the research of Yaver Duakh. Then return to Barbara of Siveria.

startText.en:
Damn! The cultists sure chose a good time to muck things up! Now they'll probably improve security and start keeping an eye on the area around the construction site. What are we to do now?
Wait a second... They're probably going to send you in pursuit of the cultists, if they haven't already. Right? That makes things easier. The blades you just met were gathering samples of the materials that were subjected to the generators' radiation, so Tep's disciples have probably already had a chance to study them thoroughly. So we just have to utilize the products of their labor!
Find boxes of material samples on the Frozen Peak and smuggle three of them away. If you end up having to fight the disciples, be sure to take any written materials you find regarding the Cradle's construction. Most importantly, try to locate their leader. I know that every single one of the Arisen researchers keeps a logbook. We could save a ton of time if you manage to get your hooks on one. Then we wouldn't have to reinvent the wheel.

checkText.en: Don't think anything of the fact that you had to spill the blood of an innocent, for on this depends the fate of those you care about!

finishText.en: You did well! I heard one of the Citadel guards threaten to rip the Tep cultists' heads off in payback for the death of the courier. Haha! Just as I planned, all suspicions fell on Tep. That's what I call clean work!

goal.en: Collect fragments of the Tep cultist's outfit, don the outfit, then kill the courier and take the Master's orders he carries. Then return to Barbara of Siveria.

startText.en:
I have another idea... You're not going to like it. I can't say I like it too much myself, but if this works, our success will be guaranteed.
I noticed that messages between the Master and the Architect travel back and forth by courier. He's always got a thick folder of papers, maps, diagrams, and construction orders. I'd sure like to get my hands on that folder! And those Tep cultists, who interfered in the Cradle's construction at the worst possible time, they can help us find these papers.
The courier's death is likely to arouse suspicion. But if his murderer resembles one of Tep's cultists, then Tep will take all the blame instead of us. Go to the Frozen Peak, find a cultist mantle, mask, and raincoat. Then kill the courier.

checkText.en: Just don't let the Master's disciples catch you carrying your ferrotype camera. They're not going to believe you if you tell them you're just there for the scenery...

finishText.en:
Let's see. Some sort of cube... A geyser... But what's this dome?
Ah well, it's not for me to figure out. I'll pass your photos along to the researchers. Let them figure it all out.

goal.en: Using the ferrotype camera, take photos of the Heart of Power, the geyser, and the broken cube on the Cradle. Then return to Barbara of Siveria.

startText.en:
Now we've got almost all the basic principles of allod creation. Now we must wait until construction is complete so we can see the results. Once we see the results for ourselves, I want to share what we see with others, so that they know that allod creation is not something we've made up. For that we're going to need to use your trusty ferrotype camera.
Wait until the Cradle is complete, then take your ferrotype camera there and take photos of the most notable parts of the island. With these photos, plus the data we collected from the cultists, and the orders issued by the Master himself, our researchers will be able to develop a complete understanding of the construction!

checkText.en: Great deeds deserve to be greatly rewarded!

finishText.en: Only a select few before you have merited receiving this honor, and every one of them has become known throughout the Empire as a real-life hero! I hope you are ready to add your name to the rolls of the Empire's heroes, alongside our greatest warriors, mages, and scientists... There's no going back now.

goal.en: Receive your reward from Yasker.

startText.en:
I think you remember your venture at the Cradle. Unfortunately, the data you gathered there have been leaked to the League.

In any event, the intelligence you gathered for us is invaluable. All the researchers at ZIT Headquarters have spent days on end studying the information you provided. We've already got a rough idea of how to create new matter from the astral! This research shows such promise! The possibilities are endless. Earlier scientific discoveries pale in comparison. And we have you to thank for this breakthrough.

checkText.en: Great deeds deserve to be greatly rewarded!

finishText.en: Only a select few before you have merited receiving this honor, and every one of them has become known throughout the League as a great hero! I hope you are ready to add your name to the rolls of the League's heroes, joining our greatest rulers, warriors, mages, and scientists... There's no going back now.

goal.en: Receive your reward from Aidenus.

startText.en:
I think you remember your venture at the Cradle. Unfortunately, the data you got there have been leaked to the Empire.

In any event, the intelligence you gathered is absolutely priceless. The best researchers of the elven houses have spent days on end studying the results of your reconnaissance. We've already got a rough idea of how to create new matter from the astral! This research shows such promise! The possibilities are endless. Earlier scientific discoveries pale in comparison. And we have you to thank for this breakthrough.

checkText.en: Well, how did it go? Time is money!

finishText.en: So, these are the baubles! They are so small and unremarkable... From far off they looked alright, they seemed expensive. Fine, a deal is a deal, I will find a use even for these unremarkable items. Take your Astralium and remember - we are honest traders, we do not cheat our business partners!

checkText.en: I wonder who will first set foot in the Dead City, a representative of the League or the Empire? While I personally hope that the two sides will still come to terms and unite against a common threat.

finishText.en: Congratulations on the victory! But don't get too full of yourself - today your will turned out the stronger, but who knows what tomorrow may bring? So, return to me if you feel the urge to fight for the honor of your people and your country.

goal.en:
Help your country's heroine to defeat the enemy heroine and return to the Keeper of the Universe at the Cradle portal.
In order to receive the reward, you must have the maximum amount of the Striving for Victory effect by the moment of defeating the enemy heroine!

startText.en:
I have interesting news for you. As I've recently learned here in the Cradle, there is an ongoing resistance against not only the Master's faithful and their enemies, but against the League and the Empire as well. More specifically, against each side's endeavors to be the first to reach the Dead City. And it manifests in images of Elizaveta Rysina, the leader of the Committee, and Marianne de Ardeur, the head of the Church of Light, showing up occasionally in an area the northwest of here. And the opposition to these endeavors takes the form of a magical duel between these two prominent ladies... Indeed, this acrimony runs deep and isn't easy to solve overnight. But it's a good thing! The Master does not need weaklings. Only the stronger will merit learning the secrets of the Dead City! And this battle of intentions, the duel of wills and desires, makes it possible to avoid a bloody war that would take away thousands of lives, while revealing those the one who is most worthy.
If you want to help your country and your people, then head to the area northwest of the portal at the time specified in your calendar, and wait. When the duel of intentions incarnate commences, you are free to join in and assist the heroine of your people. But bear in mind that your opponents will most certainly try to do the same thing, so I would advise that you gather up loyal friends before rushing into battle!

checkText.en: Please hurry! The damaged cubes are greatly hampering my work.

finishText.en:
Excellent! I knew you'd be able to do the job. This will grant me at least a temporary relief from the headache that comes with repairing the damaged cubes.
If you want to help me repair them again, come back at the time specified in your calendar and I'll give you a new assignment.

checkText.en: So, where are the mineral samples? Give them to me quick, while they are still suitable for research!

finishText.en: Hurray! Now I can compare samples of minerals from the depths of the earth against those from the surface, whereupon I will be able to say for certain whether the Cradle's formation is coming along correctly.

goal.en: Find a geyser at the edge of the Cradle, collect mineral samples, and hurry back to the Keeper of the Universe before the samples disappear!

name.en: Secrets from the Depths of the Earth

startText.en:
I have another task for you.
You see, to control the formation of a new land, we must be aware of what is happening within its depths. On the surface everything is clear, but seeing the processes that take place in the bowels of the created allod is very difficult. You can, of course, drill a super-deep shaft into the allod and see it all for yourself, but that is not the best way.
Here on the Cradle there's fading volcanic activity within the allod. After all, we created it in the image of an entire planet, not just some piece of rock. But the geysers that erupt with jets of hot steam will help us to figure out what's going on deep within the Cradle!
Find a geyser and collect minerals particles that the jets carry to the surface. And then run back here as fast as you can! Delay and all your samples will be rendered useless. Also, it would be best to gather samples together with other players. Wit someone at your side you'll be able to run back faster. If you lose your way or sprain your ankle, your companion will be there to support you... And you'll be able to deliver more samples. So gather up your friends... or better yet, call your guildmates, for by helping me you will raise prestige for your guild!

finishText.en: I see you're not running off just yet... Could it be your lust for the secrets of the past has waned? No? Then listen carefully.

goal.en: Go through the portal and meet with Nihaz in the Dead City.

name.en: The Way to the Dead City

startText.en:
The Dead City... Your researchers consider it to be the last remnant of June civilization. But it is more than just another relic! It's a knot connecting the universe's past and the future. And he who cuts this knot in two will decide the fate of Sarnaut!
Now go. The Master is waiting for you in the Dead City. Heed his words. Every one of them has the power to change the universe forever.

finishText.en: I see you're not running off just yet... Could it be your lust for the secrets of the past has waned? No? Then listen carefully.

goal.en: Go through the portal and meet Nihaz in the Dead City.

name.en: The Way to the Dead City

startText.en:
The Dead City... Your researchers consider it to be the last remnant of June civilization. But it is more than just another relic! It's a knot connecting the universe's past and the future. And he who cuts this knot in two will decide the fate of Sarnaut!
Now go. The Master is waiting for you in the Dead City. Heed his words. Every one of them has the power to change the universe forever.

kickText.en: Only by defeating the Guardian will you gain access to the portal

checkText.en: Tailoring isn't your cup of tea? No worries, perhaps you can buy us a few.

finishText.en: Excellent! I know it may seem like just a small amount, but your help goes a long ways!

goal.en: Bring 5 Rare Light Tablecloths to Yaver Kamose.

startText.en:
Ah! It just came to my mind that one thing we're low on are new tablecloths.
We rarely order additional supplies since we normally spend most of our time with our research, but after the issues with the rats, the loose yak, and the pyramid activating - well, we're definitely in need of replacing these torn rags.
You don't happen to be an experienced tailor, do you? Don't worry, I'm not asking for a luxury product, I'm just asking for a few tablecloths to help us out. Think you can bring us a few?

checkText.en: What are you waiting for? You'll never learn more if you can't follow instructions.

finishText.en: Great! You're on your way to becoming a great anthropologist yourself!

goal.en: Find the 3 Stones of ZIT Headquarters and report back to anthropologist Sarbaz Merti.

startText.en:
To be able to call oneself a true scholar, one must be very aware of one's surroundings.
As a test, I have placed three stones imbued with magic around ZIT Headquarters. Explore these great allods, find the stones, and report back to me.
Only after you have done this will I agree to take you under my wing. You can find these stones in the OMUT Division, AD Division, and TaPS Division. Good luck, traveler.

checkText.en: How did you fair? Are you fearless yet?

finishText.en:
Excellent!
Those beasts have been defeated and these trophies you've gathered prove it!

goal.en: Collect 4 ZIT Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Sarbaz Merti.

startText.en:
Listen, I know you're a seasoned traveler, but this is ZIT!
You let your guard down for one second and that's it! It's all over! I want you to get used to the dangers of a place like this, so I need you to venture out and kill four of ZIT's most dangerous creatures!
But you need to give me proof – a trophy from the likes of Scabbers, a squall elemental, a daddy sand spider, a burning elemental, a graceful twilight harpy, an advanced necro-yak or a ravenous experimental zombie will do just fine.

checkText.en: I hope you've taught those harlots a lesson.

finishText.en: Thank you, hopefully we'll be able to get some work done now.

goal.en: Kill 50 Harpies for anthropologist Sarbaz Merti.

startText.en:
I'll keep this short. The harpies here on ZIT Headquarters are a pain in the neck.
They're always flying around, rubbing themselves, and attacking our junior scientists! We have more important things to worry about thank some over-sexed bird ladies! Get out there and take care of those distractions!

checkText.en: You can find those shards all over ZIT if you look hard enough...

finishText.en: Thank you! This will be a great help to the arisen.

goal.en: Collect 5 Tablet Shards for anthropologist Sarbaz Merti.

startText.en:
There are many things that are of value in this world, but there is something that stands above all else. Above herbs and precious stones!
No, the most valuable thing in the world is knowledge.
There are ancient tablets here on ZIT that hold the mysteries of our people. Unfortunately, they're in pieces. We need to collect the pieces of the tablets so that we can put them back together to add to our libraries!

checkText.en: Have you completed all of my tasks?

finishText.en:
Great.
You know, I must admit, I didn't think you'd be able to do it. Thank you for proving me wrong! Go ahead and take your reward!

goal.en: Complete all of the Anthropologist's tasks and report back to Sarbaz Merti.

startText.en:
If you can successfully complete all my tasks, you'll be generously rewarded.
And I'm not talking about some rinky-dink potion! You'll have the knowledge that you've gained from this adventure as well as some prime equipment that's bound to help you on your future journeys!
So, find the stones, defeat the beasts, and gather some valuable resources here on ZIT Headquarters!

checkText.en: Yes, go ahead. But speak quickly, we're really busy here!

finishText.en: Fresh faces and an extra set of eyes! Just what we need! For many years the pyramid was believed to be dead, but what is death? Isn't it the same as sleep? Ah, pardon the philosophical tangent, we still need your help locating the sparks.

goal.en: Speak to Negus Tot, the director of the ZIT.

startText.en:
Isn't it something? A real beauty! Not sure what I'm referring to? I'm talking about Tep's Pyramid, of course!
The greatest achievement of the Zem people! Four faces - four cardinal points. It's a symbol of great innovation into the Astral! And, no... We're not throwing buried treasures at the bottom of the pyramid. Where are these rumors coming from anyway?
Sometimes I find myself completely mesmerized by the magnificence of Tep's pyramid!
Oh, in a hurry are you? Well listen carefully, something happened inside and to make a long story short we've quarantined a number of parts of the institute. Go speak to the Director of the ZIT, Negus Tot. He'll give you more information on the quarantine.

checkText.en: Ah, one issue with the Sparkton Pack is that it only activates through the energy that the Pyramid gives off. Unfortunately, you'll have to be in close proximity to the spark in other to retrieve it.

finishText.en:
Four Sparks are saved thanks to you. But we can't relax just yet.
Here. This is a new version of Sparkton Pack. We just made it. I'll explain what you need to do.

goal.en: Catch 4 Sparks and return to Negus Tot.

startText.en:
It's been many years since this Pyramid was in active use. In some ways it's not surprising that once we activated it there were a number of issues that arose. We believed that upon activation, we would be able to control the accumulation of sparks, instead the opposite occurred and the pyramid began ejecting sparks throughout the entire allod.
There's no need to worry, all stations are hard at work determining what happened and looking for a number of suitable solutions for this situation.
In the meantime, there's a large number of restless Zem souls that are just lingering in and around the Institute. They're not harmful, but every spark is extremely precious to us! As you know, there's only a small number of Arisen remaining in the allods, plus, many bodies have not been preserved and if we don't obtain the sparks soon they will never be reborn.
That's why anyone who can provide a helping hand needs to help us retrieve these wandering sparks. How exactly do you catch a spark? Good question. Here at the Zem Institute of Technology we've developed an invention called the "Sparkton Pack". It's easily portable, light-weight, and works with minimal assistance.
You should have seen the alpha version of the Sparkton Pack! It was big, clunky, and weighed a ton. First you'd have to aim and activate a device to keep the spark from moving, and then you'd have to somehow toss out the trapping device just to retrieve them safely. I'm glad that the ZIT has made a significant improvement on it!

checkText.en: Don't be in a hurry, just collect the sparks as you see them.

finishText.en: Excellent job! We originally had a nice Astral ship cruise planned for you! We wanted to sail you off near some of the more friendly areas in the Kanian archipelagos but it just didn't pan out. Don't worry though, we still have a pretty generous bonus for you!

goal.en: Catch 15 sparks and report to Negus Tot.

startText.en:
Unfortunately, there are still Sparks that need to be collected, so use the new Sparkton Pack. It has greater capacity. If you catch fifteen sparks, you'll get a bonus.

There is something about these Sparks... The pyramid has started working, and some of the ancient artifacts of Tep have awakened - the teleporters, for example. We already know how to use them. There is just one problem: they require Sparks. Don't worry, this won't harm the Sparks themselves: they just need to be close to the machines. But remember this: each spark returned to the Storage gives the deceased a chance to be revived and also supplies our laboratory with precious kilowatt-hours!

checkText.en: You'll be teleporting to all the wrong places until you install those regulators.

finishText.en:
And... the portal works now! You must admit, that was some pretty good engineering. But for the sabotage!..
I wonder who's the culprit. It cannot be the League, and it's unlikely someone from the Empire would do this...

goal.en: Use the portal field regulators in all of the divisions of the ZIT Headquarters and report back to Sarang Senusret.

startText.en:
I'm so glad that we've abandoned all hope for fixing the teleporter's behavior. Trying to repair it is pointless - it needs to be massively redesigned. Fortunately, I've been working on the project for quite some time now.
Portal field regulators need to be installed at multiple locations. They will correct the teleporter's behavior so that it will perform as described. Still we'll have to answer the question why they failed... Was it a design fault or sabotage? So you better look around while searching for places where to install the regulators. If you spot something strange, tell me immediately, it may be valuable for the science!

checkText.en: Plowing through those rats yet? Yeah, don't even bother with a mouse trap.

finishText.en: The rats have been destroyed? Good work! You'd fit right in with the LAD Division. You should consider applying.

goal.en: Kill 4 Scavenging or Famished Rats and report back to Yasskul Pentawer.

startText.en:
It's ridiculous how this entire mess just got slammed right on the LAD Division's lap! It's quite frustrating since we always manage our work very well. You know how many sparks we get returned to their bodies? Three to four hundred per month! That's a damn good number I tell you!
I'm not going to point at other divisions that just guzzle away at resources, but there's definitely some that don't pay attention to how their people are managed. What irks me the most is how much progress we made prior to all of this mess.
Now we have hundreds if not thousands of sparks flying all over the place! And where do they expect us to get bodies for all of them? Corpses are being dug up and brought to the pyramid at a slower rate, and can you guess what new problem we ran into? Rats!
These little rats over here feeding on our beloved countrymen and none of the other lazy divisions are doing anything about it! Oh how I miss working with the Imperial Army, a disaster like this would have been completely avoided.
What are you doing anyway? Why don't you lend us a hand? Go to the LAD Division and start killing those damned rats. We have a teleporter that goes between the departments. That is, we used to until a team from another department broke the damn thing.

checkText.en: These things are so unbelievably heavy!

finishText.en: Thanks for your help! As I stood here, I started thinking - why don't we just take the bodies out of the sarcophagi and put them in something lighter? Who came up with such nonsense?

goal.en: Carry three Heavy Sarcophagi into the empty crypts and return to Yaver Satiah.

startText.en:
Oh my, I wish I could be lying in a sarcophagus myself right now. When will this end? Once again they have piled everything on my shoulders. I feel like my arms are going to rip right off when I lift these things.
I'm talking about these sarcophagi that hold our brothers and sisters. They need to be delivered all over the place. Unfortunately, this is easier said than done. I just can't do this anymore! I just can't!
Listen... Could you maybe drag at least three of them over there? That'll give me time to catch my breath. Please? If Yasskul Pentawer sees that no one is carrying the sarcophagi, he's going to get really angry.
I'm not sure what he'd do exactly, but judging by the look in his eyes, it's something more horrible than life in a mortal body... So, will you move three sarcophagi for me?

checkText.en: The mummifying balm will probably stick to your hands for a few days, but don't worry, it'll wear off eventually.

finishText.en: See! While I admit the LAD Division has their plate full, it'd be nice if they'd properly manage their workload rather than just getting frustrated at all the work they have to do.

goal.en: Collect 4 Mummified Spiders for Negus Tot.

startText.en:
Yeah, everyone knows that the LAD Division has the largest workload. And on top of that, they had to deal with that nasty rat infestation.

I spent some time trying to figure out a long-term solution that's better than just mindlessly destroying the rats. We have spiders at the Headquarters - we bred them ourselves. Yes! Because rats and spiders are bitter enemies and usually stay out of each other's territory. However, when corpses were brought in, the rats went wild, so the spiders are cowering in the corners in terror. Something needs to be done about this!

Let's trick the rodents.

If you can kill several spiders and mummify them, we could use their corpses to scare the rats off for good! Do you think you can help us with this?

Here, you're going to need this mummification balm. Use this generously on ten spiders' corpses and they will remain well preserved. And keep in mind: a quality mummy requires skill! Once you have four mummies, bring them to me. I'll have the lab technicians place them in the crypts.

checkText.en: My colleagues will no longer laugh at the MP Division or at Imkhoten. I will be the one who leads the institution with prophecies!

finishText.en:
Thank you. Still looking for me to prove that I can read the future with the scorpion shells? Okay, give me a moment... Hm...
Unbelievable! A terrible darkness is coming! The entire Empire will tremble! That tyrant, Tep, is watching us every day! He's headed here, to the pyramid! What a morbid feeling...

goal.en: Obtain 4 Scorpion Shells for Nomarkh Imhotep.

startText.en:
Hah! I knew it! I absolutely knew it!
This one's for all of those naysayers that doubted me!
It feels so good to be right and rub it in their faces. I, the great Imkhoten, predicted that under the right circumstances Tep's Pyramid would eventually awaken. I predicted this! Me! Not you or any of the other division heads, me!
You know who I can't wait to see? That useless brute Yasskul Pentawer. What has he ever done for our institution? What exactly did he do that was so great that he received his own division? To think that I have to share this allod with him! It feels good to have my theories proven right. How did I know that Tep's Pyramid would finally reawaken? I saw it in the pattern on the scorpion shells. It's what allows me to predict the future accurately.
What, don't believe me? I can make another prediction. I can tell you what awaits us in the future and how all this is all going to end. First, I need you to bring me some shells. The scorpions can be found near the MP Division.

checkText.en: How did everything go? The harpies didn't try to seduce you, did they? To tell you the truth, I've never tried this method before...

finishText.en: Doesn't your conscience trouble you at all? How many of those harpies are now in love with you? Haha, I'm only joking. Thank you for your help!

goal.en: Touch 4 Twilight Harpies with the Enchanted Love Ring and return to Yaver Rahotep.

startText.en:
Eh... What department am I from? Hm, how should I say this... Oh, fine... I'll tell you. I'm from the Monster Prognostics department. What? You're not laughing? Usually when I tell someone that, they start laughing and calling me crazy.
I'm busy with a new nonsense, a new direction in science - predicting the behavior of semi-sentient beings. If, for example, a twilight harpy stands on its left leg in the morning, then the Empire will prevail in the war with the League... But if it stands on the right leg, the Empire will still win, but it will take longer.
This is all pure theory for now. Anyway, how can you observe the harpies properly if those horrible creatures won't let anyone go near them? That's why we've decided to tame them. Or rather, Nomarkh Imhotep has decided to tame them, and Yaver Rahotep has to go along with it.
I thought long and hard to come up with something to accomplish this. Yesterday it finally dawned on me - love magic. And why not? If it's possible to force sentient beings to fall in love with someone, then why not harpies? The thing is, I need a good soldier to apply the charm. Needless to say, these monsters are not exactly burning with amorous intentions. So when it throws itself at you, show it this ring, it will pacify it instantly... Maybe. Maybe not.

checkText.en: Did you find my double yet? What about those readings?

finishText.en: What? My double is refusing?! He wants to spend time building relationships and talking to people? He developed a mind of his own?! This is ridiculous! I need to think of a way to properly deactivate him if he continues to refuse my orders.

goal.en: Search for Nomarkh Lalulalu's double and take readings from 3 Astralometers.

startText.en:
Hey, it's me! Where have you been!? Hm, wait a second - you're not me! You're not my double!
Where is my double, anyway? You haven't seen a person that looks just like me, have you? Well, he doesn't look exactly like me. His face won't have the same expression of worry as mine does.
After all, a double is only a copy of one's physical attributes. A double is only given enough brains to complete small tasks - it's not a person that can think outside the box.
You see, we plan on starting a new mana station on this allod. I sent my double to measure the energy levels on the Astral shore. Unfortunately, it's been quite a while since I've last seen him and I'm worried that he's floated off into the Astral.
Can you do me a favor? Could you go search for my double? Also, in the event that he ended up being too lazy to complete this tiny little errand, do you mind taking Astralometer readings for me? Thanks so much, I really appreciate it!

checkText.en:
What in the world is this? A web spinned by some crazy spider? All lines are mixed up!
Oh, this is a teleportation chart made by Sarbaz Anen... Alright, give it to me.

finishText.en:
What's this? It looks like a tangled web, woven by a spider that's crazy, blind and lame in two of its legs? Aha, it's a map of the teleport system... I got it from Sarbaz Anen... Good, give it here and let's have a look.
The only thing that's clear is that nothing is clear. It turns out there is no system. Conclusion - making use of the portals is impossible.

goal.en: Bring the teleportation map to the Portal Keeper Sarang Senusret outside Tep's Pyramid.

name.en: One Hundred Times There and Back Again

startText.en:
There has to be some kind of pattern. There must be!
Look, according to my map... in around 25% of cases I came out at the LAD Division, the same number of times at the MP Division, the same at the TaPS Division and the same again to the AD Division. What can we conclude from that?
I've never even been to the OMUT Division! And to be honest, I'd noticed that myself... even without the map. What was the sequence in which the portal shunted me between the different points? Hmm...
If you look at the diagram I've drawn we can see... we can see... no, nothing makes sense... At least we now have a map. I've now been through the portal more than one hundred times! Be so good as to take this map to the Portal Keeper... I'm not sure that I want to see his face right now.

checkText.en:
This is embarrassing! In fact, I've brought such great shame that I wrote letter of resignation and submitted it directly to Negus Tot. I have no idea why, but he decided to reject it!
What do you suppose I shall do?

finishText.en:
You don't want me to write it down for you? Do we have any yak meat?
Oh! That means I'm saved!

goal.en: Bring 4 pieces of Necro-Yak Meat to Yaver Kamose.

startText.en:
I cannot believe what has happened! I feel as though I've brought great shame to the TaPS Division.
I'm really going to need your help here! The lab staff is on a critical deadline towards advancing their science with the undead. One resource they need is a special yak meat that's harvested from the Necro-Yak's that I was in charge of!
I have no idea how they escaped! I was diligent about preparing the proper security measures to make sure that the yak remained confined, but they somehow managed to escape and now they're freely grazing the entire allod!
Look, obtaining the meat is more important than herding all of the Yak back together. For the sake of the TaPS Division and our science I need you to obtain the yak meat for me. You'll do this for me, won't you?!

checkText.en: The head thawed out long ago. It will soon start to rit. Hurry up if you want to have any chance of fishing anything out of there!

finishText.en: So, we've got everything that we need... Let's get started. Step back, this is not a sight for the faint of heart.

goal.en: Bring Special Agent David Proshin the Invigorating Balm, a Mage's Ring, and some Interrogation Tongs from the TaPS Division.

startText.en:
Soon the head will thaw out and we'll be able to begin the reanimation process and then the interrogation.
We'll need the following: reanimation balm, a mage's ring, and interrogation tongs. You can find these and many other things in the chests at TaPS - The Technical and Provisions Supply department. There is one "but" to this situation. I've heard that something strange has been happening there. They say the weapons have come to life.
But what can we do about that? Get yourself over there and find all the items that we need.
