checkText.en: Hold on, let me finish...

finishText.en: Phew... It's ready!

goal.en: Wait until the interrogation is over and speak with David Proshin.

startText.en:
Alright, now I'm going to try to pull out the information.
The hoop goes on, just like that... Now a drop of invigorating balm...
Tongs... Hmm, why tongs? Well, I guess I just ordered 'em out of habit! We won't need them here.
Now I will fall into a trance and pull out the information. Hold on just a little longer.

checkText.en: Has the way been cleared? Am I free to make a run for it now?

finishText.en: Thank you. That's it. I'm out of here! And I advise you not to hang around here either!

goal.en: Kill 4 Tep Blades and return to Sarbaz Khakheperre.

startText.en:
Are they still flying? The... blades. I asked to be appointed here so I could look after the animals, away from war and further bloodshed. Alternative service, you might call it.
I think one death is enough for me. We Arisen must not inflict death. I'm not a coward, I'm a pacifist.
But they still found me! The flying blades! Where did they come from?!
I can't fight, my hand is shaking... I beg you, please clear the way for me. Go and destroy at least four of those Tep blades so I can make my way to the portal.

checkText.en: Please do not distract me! Every moment wasted takes a direct hit to the Imperial budget!

finishText.en:
What council meeting? What are you talking about? I'm busy here!
The council meeting was probably called on by one of the department heads! I hate these council meetings! They lavishly use our resources and bask on a number of gratuitous accoutrements that tie directly into the Imperial budget! I don't have time for this as there are far more important matters to be dealt with!

goal.en: Bring the invitation to Yasskul Djedefre, the head of the AD Division.

startText.en:
Has anyone seen Yasskul Djedefre? We've been waiting on him for ages!
I am completely aware that the AD Division has their plates full, but when I call for a council meeting I expect all of my division heads to be here, deciding not to attend is not an option! We have a ton of issues to discuss!
Many of the ZIT employees are confused over what's happening and they need leadership and guidance from the division heads, which is why I called for the damn council meeting to begin with!
I am growing impatient and his presence is required for this meeting! Can you please do me a favor and check to see if he's still lingering in the AD Division? Tell him that he's keeping everyone waiting and that we won't start until he's here!

checkText.en: I wouldn't mind riding in this thing all day! But now isn't the time for jokes, I suppose.

finishText.en: I knew you'd get the hang of them pretty fast. They're actually quite easy to use. Just touch them and zoom - you're off!

goal.en: Use the June ruins to travel from the TaPS Division to the AD Division.

startText.en:
Did you hear about the properties of the June ruins? They can create a sphere that will move you from one point to the other. The best part is that the spheres protect you from anything - even the Astral!
We even have several June ruins around here. They were brought specifically to us so we could experiment on them. We hope to be able to build them ourselves one day.
If you need to travel between the allods around here make sure to find some June ruins. I even use them for fun sometimes. Floating along in the Astral soothes my nerves! I recommend you try it!

checkText.en: A large part of the Empire's breakthrough is due to the ZIT, more specifically, the AD Division. We developed the Astral ships that you know of today. We've developed so much new technology that I can't even tell my wife about since all documents are to be held classified for hundreds of years!

finishText.en: You have the amulets? What? You are familiar with them? That's impossible!

goal.en: Collect Experimental Amulets from the Experimental Zombies. Bring 4 of them to Yasskul Djedefre.

startText.en:
Look, I'm working on a highly classified project that I cannot reveal too many details on. What I can tell you is that the experiments were conducted on existing zombies. Early test results were moving along according to plan, however, the zombies began to disappear and we started to lose track on a number of our test subjects.
Eventually, the zombies reappeared and were actually quite aggressive. At this point it would actually be more troublesome for me to devise some sort of procedure to calm down their aggression - it would be much more efficient if you could destroy the zombies for me.
Ah, one more thing, I need the amulets the zombies were carrying as they were also part of the experiment.

finishText.en:
How dare he? Regular attendance of Council meetings is clearly defined as part of his job description...
What!? The magic is missing from the experimental amulets?!
Yes... that's a valid explanation!
Shocking! That's terrible!

goal.en: Report what you learned to Negus Tot, the Director of the ZIT.

startText.en:
The amulets are empty! They contained a spell, a long spell with several components and replanting it would take months of work!
Where did it go? Without the spell, these amulets are nothing more than useless trinkets!
What the is going on?! Some strange things have been happening in the institute recently! Report everything that happened to Yasskul Tot and explain that I'm unlikely to appear at the Council in the next century!

checkText.en: You can never have too much energy, you know.

finishText.en: I will go down in history as one of the Empire's best scientists! And your help... well, it will always be remembered by me.

goal.en: Use the Energy Trap to collect energy from 4 Elementals for Yaver Nebiriau.

startText.en:
Everything for the army, everything for victory! The Astral is the basis of the Empire's power and I'm proud to be working for the AD Division. Every citizen should feel pride in helping science and their community and I just happen to be part of our scientific community!
My current job is to seek out energy for the Empire wherever it may be. And then it hit me - elementals! My initiative is supported by the decision makers at the very top and I have been authorized to involve anyone who can help - including you.
Here, take this energy trap. You must place it next to an elemental and kill it quickly while the trap is still on. It's new technology that's obviously still far from perfect, but that's the problem we're trying to work out as we speak.
My current project revolves around constructing a trap that will cause elementals to die as soon as it's in range. If it sounds like a tall order, it is! Unfortunately, until I can deliver the future of the Empire's energy supply is in your hands!

checkText.en: I can't quite remember - did I warn you that in rare cases, the charge might grab an Astral demon instead of a meteor?

finishText.en: Well, look at that... You're still in one piece and with a backpack full of Astral meteors. Good job.

goal.en: Charge the Spark Catcher with 3 Sparks and collect 3 Astral Crystals for Sarang Meritneith.

startText.en:
Hey you with the Sparkton Pack, quit wasting time and get to the shore with the other spark catchers. What? Didn't Negus Tot tell you? Helping research is only part of the job. The AD Division is working on an order for Yasker himself and we need volunteers like you to catch sparks.
It's pretty simple - you catch a few sparks with the Sparkton Pack and then send a powerful charge straight into the Astral. The sparks will be returned to you in the shape of an Astral meteor. Come back once you've have 3 meteors.
Spotting a spark catcher is easy enough - we've made it out of your regular Astral hand cannon. That's how we roll - we take whatever's lying around and turn it into something useful. Incidentally, that's also the main principle of magic.

checkText.en: Where in the Astral did you find this?

finishText.en:
Where did you get this spark? It's been inside a demon?
I have waited for this for a long time. Give it to me and let me deal with it.

goal.en: Show the Demon-Ingested Spark to Yasskul Djedefre, the head of the AD Division.

startText.en: What's this? It looks like this spark attracted a demon from the Astral. Is this normal? It seems to have mutated slightly... We better report this to Yasskul Djedefre, just in case.

checkText.en: It'd be great to hear your thoughts on the Sparkton Pack version 2.0 especially when compared to the original Sparkton Pack.

finishText.en:
As I suspected, the blades contained sparks. However, this is very odd, these are sparks that appear to have originated from the Pyramid repository. These sparks are also quite aggressive, and frankly speaking, uncontrollable.
Hm, this is just a hunch, but these sparks look to be drained by Tep himself, probably during his quest for immortality. According to Tep's research, he indicated that drained sparks can be very dangerous. He also mentions how draining sparks have a reverse affect to whoever begins to suck out its life essence.

goal.en: Destroy 4 Sharpened Tep Blades and capture their Sparks using the Sparkton Pack 2.0 for Yaver Khufu.

startText.en:
Is Tep alive or dead? That's the question that's going through everyone's mind. Though, one thing people should really consider is what being "alive" even means.
Take the Arisen for instance - are they undead beings? Yes. Do they walk, move, talk, or have some sort of conscious? They do. One could argue that the Arisen are perfectly alive, but others would argue that we're not.
My apologies, I went into a bit of a tangent there. In any case, do I have an excellent assignment for you! The Sparkton Pack version two is ready to go. One major modification is that it only works with non-living objects. I want you to head to the OMUT Division and test out the new Sparkton pack.
You'll notice a handful of Tep blades that have gone completely haywire. I suspect that spark's have taken control of each Tep blade.
Destroy the Tep blades, free the spark, and collect it with the new Sparkton Pack.

checkText.en: I would go collect some myself, but what can a humble researcher do against a fire elemental?

finishText.en: The reports have been saved! Oh, thank you so much! Here, take this reward.

goal.en: Collect OMUT Division Reports and bring them to Yaver Sitamun. You need to bring her 4 reports.

startText.en:
Ah! At last someone has come to our aid! The portals are down and there's no way to escape the allod! We're doomed! Phew, let me catch my breath and I'll explain everything.
Alright, listen up. They came here on an Astral ship, landing on the northern shore. They summoned up fire elementals and set them on us! Some of our lab workers died... but the worst of it all is that our archives were destroyed! Razed to the ground!
I can't believe we lost decades worth of our blood, sweat, and tears, everything we've ever learned about Tep! Oh, almighty Astral... Who are "they"? Tep cultists, of course! Who else?!
We tried to save some of the archives as we escaped, but we didn't get many. There are still tons of reports scattered throughout the allod. Find them and bring them to me. Any scrap of paper you find may help us to reconstruct our archives.
Make sure you steer clear of those fire elementals. They're the ones burning down our tomes and manuscripts, destroying all of our departments' achievements! They're terrible creatures!

checkText.en: Lab assistants are hiding in their labs like rats. How am I supposed to save the institute alone?

finishText.en: Let me shake your hand! Thank you! We could never have done it without you. I will vote for placing your portrait under the Best Institute Employee for the Last Quarter heading on our board of honor.

goal.en: Eliminate 2 Sharpened Tep Blades, 2 Flame Elementals, and the Tep Worshipper for Sarang Neithhotep.

startText.en:
We can't stay holed up in this crypt forever! We must act!
Oh, what am I talking about... We can't handle them! Especially if one of them is a conjurer! He was the one who summoned the elementals. And all the other Tep cultists take their orders from him. Even more horrifying is the fact that the Tep blades also obeyed him and submitted to his will. Those blades are Tep and his followers' doing, no doubt about it now.
Are you brave enough to challenge their might?

finishText.en: What happened? What's with that look? What? Tep's servants are roaming the institute unchecked? I never thought I'd live to see that! They were carrying a sarcophagus? Oh, no! What could they be after?

goal.en: Report to Negus Tot at Tep's Pyramid.

startText.en:
Do the rest of the scientists at the ZIT know about the attack? I wanted to teleport to the main pyramid and warn them, but then... they appeared! They were servants of Tep and they had a massive sarcophagus with them!
I hid around a corner and waited for them to disappear through the portal... But when I came back it didn't work anymore! We must warn the director immediately! Something terrible is about to happen, I just know it! Please warn Negus Tot!

checkText.en: Were you able to get into the Forbidden Cell?

finishText.en: For a long time we could only guess whether Tep was alive or not, but now we have the answer. Do you realize that your victory is the first victory over him for many centuries?

goal.en: Find out what the Tep cultists want in the Forbidden Cell.

name.en: The Main Secret of the Pyramid

startText.en:
Above the area where most of the scientists reside, there is another room - the Forbidden Cell. It's protected by a magical shield and none of the institute staff have ever been able to get inside it.
I suspect that it's all related to the peaceful Astral secret project, which Yasker is personally in charge of. The AD Division's best brains are working on it. We began by studying creatures that live in the Astral and near it or, for instance, near Nezebgrad's mana stations. Then we created the experimental amulets and tested them on those dumb capital Orcs... Everything was all going according to plan!
We were inches away from gaining full control over the Astral mutations! Our goal was to find a way to travel freely through the Astral! But then...
Why did the amulets lose their charge now, just as Tep's followers have entered the pyramid? Where is Tep himself? Nothing but questions!
And the answers are right there above our heads. We must get into the Forbidden Cell and get to the bottom of this!

finishText.en:
A secret portal... Hmm... Well, I did notice a leak in magical energy... Perhaps it will lead us to this very portal.
I can try to send you there, but if something goes wrong, I'm not responsible!
You will need 4 Sparks to use the portal.

goal.en: Talk to Sarang Senusret at the ZIT Headquarters.

startText.en:
How do you get into the Forbidden Cell... Wait a second! You said that Tep cultists used a ruin portal? Well, they haven't turned up in the MP Division, the LAD Division, or the AD Division... That must mean there's another portal! And this portal must be inside the Forbidden Cell!
Go to Sarang Senusret quickly! I don't care how he does it, but he must use a ruin portal to send you there! And if he doesn't... Tell him that my next project will be constructing the world's most powerful Sparkton Pack! Custom made, just for him!

finishText.en:
And I thought that nothing could surprise me... This is huge!
Tep is alive! I've always suspected this, but we finally have proof, irrefutable proof! Not only that, he hasn't lost a beat! Just as he was a millennia ago, his accomplishments in Astral research are miles ahead of our feeble attempts to at least establish control over...
Well, that information is classified.
However, your help has been invaluable and I do want to reward you.
I must also ask you to keep quiet about all this. We cannot disclose information about Tep to my people just like that. If we don't prepare them first, there's no telling what their reaction will be.

goal.en: Go back to the capital and report to Negus Kheket.

startText.en:
Remember what I was telling you about the peaceful Astral project?
Well, it looks like Tep has been keeping tabs on it all this time... That rock you've found in the sarcophagus is proof positive of that very fact. In it I sense the force of our own spells, the same ones we've used to charge the amulets! And what was the goal? Astral mutations! The dream of making Astral a part of us. But while we were just setting out on this path, Tep seems to have already completed it...
I can't even imagine what he is now. His new body... It must've been him who activated the pyramid, the one and only pyramid that survived the Great Cataclysm! He manipulated the sparks to sow panic amongst our ranks. He activated the ancient portals and set his vile blades at us, while his minions used the chaos to sneak the sarcophagus with the new body into the Pyramid. The body that was most likely subjected to Astral mutations. And now he is reborn! Reborn once more! You must've just missed him... He got what he came there for and is gone. Gone into the Astral, from whence he came.
Don't feel too bad - if you had met him then, you and I wouldn't be having this conversation now.
But hey, there is a bright side to all this! If Tep was successful in his endeavor, then we've got a shot at ours. After all, he used our advances, so that means that we're on the right track!
We must immediately commence the study of that rock! And the sarcophagus! And the Forbidden Cell, now that we have access to it! Oh my, so much to do, so little time!
I beg you, make for the capital and report to Negus Kheket, the Head of the Scientific Council, on everything that has happened! Man, it's too bad Nefer Ur isn't here. He'd get to the bottom of all this in no time!

checkText.en:
I was already informed of your operation. We have dubbed it codename "Golden Head". How's it coming along?
Give it here. I hope that the Institute will rise to the occasion on this one...

finishText.en:
Ship houses... to travel the Astral... Oh, my! Elves from the House de Doucer were able to conduct some bizarre ritual, based on the Astral's magical nature and... Their magic of death. As a result they morphed into... What an odd word... Vampires... Now they can't survive without blood. But when could Elves not survive without it before? They've always thought themselves demigods and other races mere vermin... They always were bloodsuckers to us working people!
Aye... The League and the Empire neck-to-neck... What I wouldn't give to know what they've learned of our advances...
Why is it that secret information is always secret for everyone other than enemy scientists and spies?
You have proven yourself once more! Well done! Please take this reward, you've earned it.

goal.en: Deliver the Interrogation Report to Elizaveta Rysina in Nezebgrad.

startText.en:
Hmm, you know, there really is considerable value to this head!
Pretty interesting... Anyhow, the Interrogation Report is ready for you to deliver to the Head of the City Council in Nezebgrad. What are you looking at me like that for? Curious to see what's inside? Sorry, but that's classified.
Elizaveta Rysina will fill you in, if she deems it necessary. My job is simple - learn what you can and place it on record.

checkText.en: Plamennik will not leave the OMUT Division alone! Why?

finishText.en: Oh thank you, you have saved me from insanity! I have been sitting here all day tending to my singed flesh. A terrible sight, believe me!

goal.en: Participate in killing Plamennik and return to Sarang Neithhotep at the OMUT Division.

startText.en:
My dreams have been plagued with my greatest fear, Plamennik. He's a great and terrible fire elemental, designed by Tep himself!
Want to know why we're all afraid of it? It's pure fire! Sizzling and everything! If you fight with him, your body will burn, there'll be nothing but ashes left and then your spark will have nowhere to go...
For us, the Arisen, this is the worst! Die, be resurrected, and then die again - forever this time!
I'm begging you, kill this terrible fire beast! But don't try to be a hero and do it alone! We don't need useless death!

checkText.en: Oh, there's so much to be done before things return to normal!

finishText.en: Thanks so much. If you want to help again, feel free to come back tomorrow. There's so much work to do!

goal.en: Kill 3 Serrated Tep Blades and return to Negus Tot.

startText.en:
It seems that the situation inside the pyramid has been mostly resolved. It's unfortunate that Tep got what he wanted. And now what's left to do? That's right - clean up after him.
We really need to deal with those serrated blades that fly through the pyramid's corridors. Do you think you can clear out a bunch? Just make sure to gather some friends before you fight them. They're one of Tep's most fearsome creations.

checkText.en: It'd be such a waste if a gust of wind blew once the Astral dust appeared.

finishText.en: Back so soon?

goal.en: Collect 4 clumps of Astral Dust and take them to Simar the Forester.

startText.en:
Do you know anything about the cult of the Twelve Great Martyrs?

Aah! You already have Patronage. Then we can skip the theory.

I'm here to observe the Rite of Light and record everything. You can join me if you like. First you'll need to collect four Astral dust clumps. They settle on creatures who dwell near the Astral. Local elementals, for example. Then take them to the shaman. He'll tell you what to do.

checkText.en: What's so hard about killing one demon?

finishText.en:
The rite is complete.

Now you can use the Incense I gave you to appeal to your Patron. It will help you in combat.

goal.en: Kill the Mysterious Demon Mage and return to Simar the Forester.

startText.en:
For the last part of your initiation, you will kill an Astral demon. Astral demons gather at the platform where you threw the Astral dust into the wind. You must go and kill it to prove to the martyrs your worth.
Go there, kill it, and go to Sarang Ahmes so we can get this over with. Then you will be blessed with the second level of patronage.

finishText.en:
Interested in the runes? Good! There's a number of things you can do.
First, you can ask me about the runes.
Second, you can complete a few tasks to find out for yourself how it all works.
Now, your third choice is to admit that you'll always be a loser and go on walking around with your head hung low.
I recommend that you do the first and second things.

goal.en: Speak to Semer Nemar in Yasker's Tower.

startText.en:
I'd like to give you a word of advice. When you arrive in Nezebgrad find Semer Nemar, the Rune Trader, in Yasker's Tower. What are runes? Just listen up.
You can often find runes embedded in different equipment. Runes are magical stones that are ingrained with the power of one of the Great Martyrs. The tradition of embedding runes comes from long ago, when craftsmen knew nothing about the Martyrs and just sensed that the stones have a great magical power.
Now that we know how to use the power, it can be a great advantage on the battlefield. It would be a good idea for you to learn how to use runes. Semer Nemar can help you with that.

finishText.en:
Interested in runes?

As you should be. You have several options.

Option one: ask me about the runes.

Option two: complete a few quests and figure it all out by yourself.

Option three: admit that you will always fail and walk away.

I recommend you choose option one and/or two, he-he.

goal.en: Look for Semer Nemar in the Eye of the World and ask him about runes.

startText.en:
So, it's all over. You found your patron, you know what runes are and what power they give you?

Great.

Now I want to give you some advice. Look for the rune merchant Semer Nemar in the Eye of the World when you come to Nezebgrad...

He's the one who will teach you how to work with runes.

checkText.en: My goblin is not so stupid. Let's see how you manage!

finishText.en:
Aha. Goblin is defeated.
Nice victory, ha!
Look at you! A lot of energy was spent, you have been hurt, you need time to recover. This way all the time, yeah?

goal.en: Talk to shaman Simar the Forester, ask him to summon a pet and defeat the powerful goblin in combat.

startText.en:
Soon you will come across runes - magical stones imbued with the powers of the Martyrs. Long time ago people knew nothing about Twelve Great Martyrs, but now the runes are used on purpose. You should learn how to activate runes of your Patron and combine them to greatly increase your powers.
I want you to see for yourself how the runes make you stronger. I'm going to summon my pet for a training fight, you'll fight it without a help of the runes first.

checkText.en: Only when you have tried the power of runes, you will understand how important it is!

finishText.en:
So? Feel the difference?
That's the power of runes! Hope, you'll learn the lesson well.
Now talk to this scientist. Sarang Ahmes. Report him that the ritual is over. And that the runes lesson is learnt by you.

goal.en: Ask shaman Simar the Forester to summon the pet and give you the power of runes. Defeat the mighty goblin in combat and return to the shaman.

startText.en:
Ready for another fight? Don't worry, it will be much easier. My spell will make you stronger and give you extra protection, as if you were using runes of the fifth level!
I want you to feel the powers of runes - they all can be yours!
Let me know when you are ready to start.

finishText.en: A chest! All that remains is to open it and then the treasures of ancient times will have a new master!

goal.en: Dig around the ancient Zem artifact and retrieve the treasure.

startText.en:
Hmm, what's this?! There seems to be something lying around here, and it doesn't look like anyone wants it...
Those highbrow scholars must have their heads too far in the clouds to notice it. If you don't take this treasure, it'll just be buried up by the sands and you can't let that happen!

checkText.en: I keep having that damn dream! I can't wait to have some simple nonsensical ones.

finishText.en: Wow, so it was a vision after all. I wish I could have had time to discover it myself, but this research is more important than treasure hunting. Regardless, I congratulate you on your find!

goal.en: Find the hidden treasure to the north and report your success to Yaver Satiah.

startText.en:
Do the Arisen dream? I can't speak for all of us, but I have pretty vivid ones. In fact, there's one in particular that I keep having that is unbelievably real.
I dream that I'm walking along the sands around the OMUT Division and I see a strange artifact. It's old, and covered with dust and dirt. Then I bend down, dig under it, and pull something out of the sand... Then, as always, I wake up.
I should check one day whether it's just a dream or if there really is some ancient artifact near the OMUT Division, waiting to be discovered... Blast it all, there's so much work to do that I can never find the time.

checkText.en:
Where are the heads? The funeral needs to start soon! Aye, the spirits of perished Orcs may still roam the field of battle.
Just put 'em down and move on!

finishText.en: Ah, the sight of enemy heads brings joy to my heart. I'm sure it makes Horz just as happy! Thank you for helping us give him a traditional funeral.

goal.en: Decapitate 4 Dead Orcs and bring their heads to Lek the Fierce.

startText.en:
Yeah, I know a thing or two about Skulnar. But he's the last thing on my mind right now. You see, we've had visitors recently - Orcs from the neighboring isles. The bastards pillaged our village and killed Horz.
After we tend to his funeral, we still have to see to avenging his death and electing a new chieftain. Then there are preparations for the Goblinball tournament. Ugh, my head is spinning!
Let's start with the funeral. Horz lived a great life and he died with honor! Before he fell he took plenty of enemies down with him. His late rites need to be done properly, the Orcish way.
We gotta pile the funeral pyre with the heads of his enemies to grant him the revenge he deserves. Their bodies are lying around nearby. Take this axe and decapitate them. But be quick about it, lest the bastards revive. Then you'd need to put them down again!
But what's this? Do I see hesitation in your eyes? You don't want to defile your fellow Imperial citizens, eh? Well, that's just how it is. There's no place for mercy when you're at war. And do you want to know about the descendant of the Legendary Orc or not? If you do, then help us!

checkText.en: The ship is already here! Where's the meat I asked for?

finishText.en: Tiger meat is super nutritious. It makes you strong and is generally good for your health! It's especially beneficial for males, just ask around! Now we'll have plenty of money to buy other stuff. Thanks!

goal.en: Collect 4 pieces of Tiger Meat and bring them to Gavelock the Fierce.

startText.en:
Ugh, this is awful!
Because of the attacks and our chieftain's death, all of the Orcs from our clan have been neglecting their duties. They're preparing for war and all that, but soon a trade ship will be here. What will we offer them in exchange for wood, beer, and grub?
They just leave it to old hags like me to think up a solution, I guess. Listen, can you go and bring me a dozen pieces of tiger meat? Those Orcs in Nezebgrad can't get enough of it - it reminds them of home. It's not like that processed stuff that they sell in the capital, it's real wild meat!

checkText.en: Our clan is the greatest in the Wild Isles and our flag must emphasize that fact!

finishText.en: Just look at this skin! It's so warm, so beautiful. It would make a real fine cape... but the good of the clan is above personal interests! We must prevail!

goal.en: Collect a White Tiger Skin from Sin'ghim and bring it to Vurn the Fierce.

startText.en:
When the Goblinball Tournament was officially announced, I made our clan the most beautiful flag! I put my whole heart into it - each stitch was lovingly sewed. I even pulled some all-nighters to make sure it would be done in time.
But then when those scumbags came and attacked our camp, they tore it to pieces and stomped the shreds into the ground! I damn near cried when I found out! It was one of those worst things they could have done.
Now we need a new flag, and if I hurry I think I can get one made in time. The problem is, I need some new material to make it from. Now I've already got a magnificent idea - there's a white tiger living nearby named Sin'ghim. He's a real beauty, that one! What I need is his hide, and if you can just bring it to me I can get my job underway.

checkText.en: I remember the time when Orcs were Orcs, not like today... Don't worry about roughing up the Novices - they can handle it! Bruises only make them tougher.

finishText.en: Heh, something tells me this isn't the last we'll hear of this trio. I think they've got promise. Thanks for your help, I just know we'll still win the Tournament!

goal.en: Defeat the 3 Goblinball Trainees and return to Awl the Fierce.

startText.en:
Seven hells! They've done and killed most of our team! Those despicable cowards! They must have been scared of losing the Goblinball Tournament. And they damn well should be! I'm the best trainer around - I came here from Nezebgrad on the special request of Wrokag himself!
Why? To make real players out of these wild Orcs, that's why! And now all my efforts have gone to waste! Out of our six Orcish team, only two remain.
I've already got my eye on three replacements, but there's barely any time for proper training, what with the Tournament being around the corner!
Help me whip 'em into shape by fighting them, one by one. These boys need to work up their battle spirit! The more pissed off they are, the better they'll play!

checkText.en: These Orcs may be Imperial citizens in name, but they have yet to understand the meaning of civility. Do you have the axes I asked for?

finishText.en:
Thank you for aiding in the investigation. With the Goblinball Tournament coming up these bloodthirsty Orcs might stop butchering one another for a while.
Goblinball is a barbaric sport, but at least it helps channel their innate violent tendencies in a better direction.

goal.en: Recover 4 Orcish Axes and bring them to Yaver Maiherpri on the Fierce Isle.

startText.en:
I serve the Empire!
I've heard a lot about you. I know you. You're the Imperial Survivor, am I right? Your story is already being told at advanced training courses. Now you're a celebrity of sorts at the Council. Mind helping me with an investigation?
I've been sent here to look into the attack on the Fierce Clan. The circumstances are clear enough - it was yet another bloody altercation between two warring clans. For as long as the local Orcs hold on to their barbaric customs, these kinds of incidents will continue to happen. Still, it's my job to collect evidence, find the guilty parties, and draw up a report. You can help me out with the evidence part - there should still be axes bearing clan emblems lying around the battlefield. Bring me four of these axes.

checkText.en: The players must be mean and fierce! Just like a tiger!

finishText.en:
All right! Ahh, tiger blood - fresh, thick, and pure as a tear.
Except... I've been thinking... It's not enough! Can you bring me more? The Orcs will... thank you, yeah!

goal.en: Bring 4 measures of Tiger Blood to Awl the Fierce.

startText.en:
A thousand Astral demons! We're out of blood!
What blood? Tiger blood, obviously! You know what they say about us shamans - that we're not reared on our mother's milk, but on animal blood. The tigers' blood gives us their strength, might, and agility. Every member of my team drinks several pints of it a day. And look what it's done to them - they're invincible!
Hmm... True, most of the tigers have been killed off, but that's no reason to change our age-old traditions! That only means we need to drink as much tiger blood as possible before it's gone! Not to mention I've got a bunch of new players to train and no time to do it.
I need more blood to transform these wimps! Go out and bring me about ten measures of it and I should be good until the Tournament begins.

checkText.en: Did you find all of my competitors? I'm sure we can come to an agreement. There's really no need to shed blood!

finishText.en: They all stepped down? Really? Well, I don't know how you managed to talk them out of it, but I sure am grateful. Please accept this clothing as a token of my gratitude. Now I can tend to the problems of our clan in peace.

goal.en: Reach an agreement with the three competitors for the position of the Fierce Clan's chief.

startText.en:
We've said our goodbyes to Horz, and soon we'll be electing a new chieftain. I say "electing," even though the actual process is nothing like that. Instead, the clan's mightiest Orcs wage battle until only one remains. It is an utterly stupid tradition, because the clan always loses its best fighters as a result.
But this time I want things to be different. I want to be elected without any fighting. And why not? The Orcs are entering a new era, one where they need a spiritual leader that aims for progress. I know I would be the best person for the job. The problem is, not everyone shares my view. For now, that is...
Please speak with the other three contestants and get them to give up their bid for power. Ask them to surrender their weapons and thereby concede my sovereignty over the clan. Help me with this and then I'll help you find Skulnar, but not before.

checkText.en:
Where's the blood I need it!
Hmm, do I seem a bit savage? That's only 'cause I really love our Goblinball team. I'm a die-hard fan!

finishText.en:
Hoho! That color will look great against this white fur.
I'll start painting it right away. Ours will be the most beautiful banner at the Goblinball Tournament, you'll see! Here, you can take some of these clothes I made as a reward. Thanks so much!

goal.en: Obtain 2 vials of Bloodthirsty Clan Blood and 2 vials of Roughneck Clan Blood and bring them to Awl the Fierce.

startText.en:
I'll start sewing the new banner at once! Then it needs to be painted.
I got this great idea: To paint the banner with the blood of the Orcs that pillaged our village! I'll need five flagons of blood from the Orcs of the Bloodthirsty Clan as well as five flagons from the Orcs of the Roughneck Clan. This is revenge for their attack!
I remember the good old times when our allods were separated by the Astral. Leave it to some egghead in Nezebgrad to think up some damn magical crap that lets us travel between them. Things went downhill then.
But you can't change the past, so the only option is to adapt and show everyone who's boss around here. A banner painted with the murderers' blood is a fine way to do just that.
Bring me the blood of our enemies, and I'll owe you.

checkText.en: Those Bloodthirsty and Roughneck Clan players are horrible anyway. They ain't got a chance in hell, and that's the bitter truth! The only real challengers are the Orcs from the Fierce and Righteous Clans.

finishText.en: And here are the ears! Now the Bloodthirsty players must wallow in eternal shame. It's a good thing, too - there's no room for barbarians in our great sport!

goal.en: Collect 4 Orcish Ears from Bloodthirsty Clan Athletes and bring them to Awl the Fierce.

startText.en:
I've come up with a new plan.
At this point anything goes when it comes to those scumbags from the Bloodthirsty and Roughneck Clans. After what they've done, we can do anything we damn well please. Just like in the times of our ancestors, when the world was whole and the Orcs were free to roam the plains and follow their instincts.
Let's deal with the Bloodthirsty Clan first! And by "deal" I mean make sure they won't be showing up to the Tournament. No, we won't behead them like they did to our players. I may be an Orc, but I do know the meaning of mercy!
There is another way - kill them and cut off their ears! Then they'll be resurrected earless! And an earless Orc is the very definition of shame. They will never show their face on the battlefield.
So, are we on the same page? Go cut off the ears of the Bloodthirsty Clan's Goblinball players and bring 'em back to me!

checkText.en: The investigation must follow protocol to the letter. Were you able to... to reach an agreement with the blacksmiths?

finishText.en: Let's check these brands against the marks on the axes salvaged from the battlefield... I was right - they're completely identical! The evidence is irrefutable - the attack on the Fierce Clan was carried out by the Bloodthirsty and Roughneck Clans. Thank you for your help!

goal.en: Obtain the Bloodthirsty Smithing Brand and the Roughneck Smithing Brand and return them to Yaver Maiherpri.

startText.en:
Having studied the evidence, I've come to the conclusion that the attack on Fierce Isle was perpetrated by the Orcs of the Bloodthirsty and the Roughneck clans. The attackers' axes bear their emblems.
However, in order for the evidence to stand up we need to obtain the actual emblems from these clans' blacksmithing brands. Without this ultimate proof my report to the Council will be shot down in flames and widely presented as a model of carelessness and incompetence.
You don't want that, do you? Especially since my report will also be mentioning your valuable aid in the matter. So, what do you say? Can you get me those brands?

checkText.en: My heart aches for revenge. And if Lek is not able to see this done, then I'll have no choice but to assume the position of chief!

finishText.en: Finally, those bastards have paid for their deeds! I guess I'm confident enough in Lek to surrender my claim for power. Here, take my staff. Bring it to Lek as a token of my support.

goal.en: Kill 4 Orcs from the Bloodthirsty Clan and return to Burdock the Fierce.

startText.en:
So Lek doesn't want to fight, huh? Hmm...
I don't know what to say! To be honest, I would accept him as chieftain if I knew for sure that the Bloodthirsty Clan would pay for our clan members' deaths.
Here's the deal. If you can go over to Bloodthirsty Isle and take out four of those Orcs. Then I will recognize Lek's authority without a fight. I'll even surrender my staff. I'm a reasonable orc!

checkText.en: Gah, if only I was ten years younger I'd join you in your quest for horns. My oh my, together we'd score hundreds of 'em!

finishText.en: Just look at them! They're so beautiful, strong, and sharp. A bit on the small side, though. Hmm, I wonder what will happen if I plant them. Do you think they'll grow? I better ask the shamans, those guys know everything...

goal.en: Collect 4 Rhino Horns from Bloodthirsty Isle and bring them to Hammerblow the Fierce.

startText.en:
Sigh. I'm in my eighties now and I'm getting old... If I were younger I'd head out to the prairies and beat the living daylights out of the Bloodthirsty and Roughneck Clan Orcs!
Yeah, I'm a warrior, but back in my day the shamans led all the clans and they took care of us, too. This new... development where warriors want to be their own masters - it's ridiculous!
And look at what those savages have done to our village. It's a disgrace! This kind of thing never happened back in my day. Sure, we had ourselves some wars, ruined some broads, polished some kissers - but why ruin the buildings! Where are we going to find trees in this prairie to rebuild the houses and the palisade?!
The answer is we can't! But old Hammerblow knows what to do. We'll just have to use whatever we can get our hands on. That's where the Bloodthirsty Clan comes in.
They've got a whole bunch of rhinos out there, and those rhinos have some pretty nice horns. They'll be perfect for building a new palisade! Their masters broke it, so the rhinos will have to foot the bill!

checkText.en: Do you have the milk? Don't tell me our boys are stuck with nothing but blood to slurp down?

finishText.en: Finally! I've been waiting forever for this stuff. There's nothing better than fresh rhino milk! Here, take this potion for all your help - I'm sure you'll make good use of it!

goal.en: Gather 4 Pails of Rhino Milk from Bloodthirsty Isle and bring it to Gavelock the Fierce.

startText.en:
I'm old now and all I can do is look after our up-and-coming shamans. I hear that almost all they drink these days is tiger blood. That's a serious problem - sure tiger blood is good for you, but you need to have a balanced diet!
For example, in spite of their name the Bloodthirsty Clan is very health conscious. They domesticated rhinos and have a whole farm of them. They know that there's great strength in rhino milk! It's full of all the nutrients an Orcish needs.
Take these pails and fill all of them with milk. It'll probably be pretty dangerous - I'm sure the Bloodthirsty Orcs won't be too happy to see you, and the rhinos will be even less happy to be milked. But I just know once the Fierce clan gets enough of the milk, they'll be convinced to set up their own rhino farm!

checkText.en: So, you having fun? Me, I love this stuff! Sitting in ambush, stalking your prey, and then bang! Ain't nothing better!

finishText.en: You're my kind of person! I love those who love life and take what they want from it. C'mere, let me give you a little kiss! C'mon now, quit blushing!

goal.en: Kill 4 Wild Rhinoceros Bulls and return to Wilna the Nomadic.

startText.en:
Shh! Don't scare off the game! I'm Wilna from the Nomadic Clan, and I couldn't give a damn about these stupid clan wars. Life is about exploring, hunting, and freedom!
It's definitely not about bashing each other's skulls in and abiding by suffocating traditions. My clan knows this well. Sigh, if only the other Orcs were like that.
Today I decided to hunt wild rhinos. They are noble creatures, worthy of my time. They're much more worthy prey than some of these Orcs. You can join me if you like, but I'm not letting you take any kills, so don't get any ideas! You'll have to find your own prey and take them down by yourself.
I highly suggest you join me, though, 'cause hunting is just so much fun! It's possibly the best thing there is in life. Well, what do you say?

finishText.en:
I don't want to hear about my clan! I'm a lone wolf - get that through your head! There's no way I'm going back. Those shamans have too many rules. I can't breathe when I'm there! Out here I answer to no one and I don't have a care in the world. Plus the hunting season's about to start...
Well hold on, hold on. I didn't say "no" yet! Give me time to think about it I guess.

goal.en: Find Ortag the Fierce on the Righteous Isle and persuade him to join the Fierce Clan's Goblinball team.

startText.en:
Whoa, hold on a second. There's still one problem. There should be six players on a team, right? Right. But all we've got are two veterans and three trainees. That means we're still short a player.
I have an Orc in mind that would make a damn fine goalie. Problem is, he ditched the clan a while ago to be a hunter. These kinds of things happen sometimes - there's no unity among us anymore! Maybe Lek can change that, but I'm not gonna hold my breath.
In any case, it would be great if you could head on over to Righteous Isle and find him. His name is Orn, and you've got to convince him to come back! Tell him the whole clan needs him right now!

checkText.en: With the spirits watching over us, we're sure to succeed! The shamans must emerge victorious, no matter the cost!

finishText.en: Rodogor should be pleased! Hopefully he'll remember our clan and send us the victories we deserve. He should be capable of that, even from the afterlife. After all, Rodogor was a great shaman. It was him who struck the alliance with Xadaganians. We Orcs owe him a great deal!

goal.en: Sacrifice 4 animals on Righteous Isle to the spirit of Rodogor. Place sacrificial marks over their bodies. Return to Tord the Fierce afterwards.

startText.en:
Picking a chieftain without a fight?
He is right - in our struggle for power we always lose our best fighters. And we really need them right now with the clan wars that are going on!
 Our main adversary in the Wild Isles is the Righteous Clan. Even though they didn't attack our settlement! But I won't be surprised if it turns out that they incited the fighters. They are clever!
They know how to draw their strength from the ancestors. They don't care about Tensess's sacrifice or Nezeb's greatness. If we can use the magic of Light, why not do it our own way? We should follow their example!
Go to Righteous Isle and offer 4 eagles or hyenas as a sacrifice to Rodogor, a great shaman of the past. Then I will forgo the battle for power. I'll give you sacrificial marks - place them over their carcasses.

checkText.en: Well, have you brought an end to Clad's little fantasies? He's our key player and we need him back!

finishText.en:
Haha, this is excellent! Now Clad will get his head out of the clouds and concentrate on what's important in life!
Here's a reward for all your help.

goal.en: Kill Klakan, show his head to Clad the Righteous, and report back to Baske the Righteous.

startText.en:
I'm completely confident that we're gonna win the Goblinball Tournament. But I suppose we do have a little problem right now.
You see, an Orc by the name of Clad is one of our best players, but recently he's stopped coming to training sessions. He's met some pretty lass and now all he thinks about is her. The last thing I heard he ran off near the pyre and began slaughtering a bunch of hyenas. He said he was going to bring his girl the head of the pack leader for a birthday present. What foolishness! This is the worst time possible to be slacking on his training and he knows it! I think I know how he can be stopped, though.
Go find that hyena and kill him for yourself. Then show his head to Clad, and once he realizes that he failed his little mission I'm sure he'll come back to us. There's no way he's gonna face his girl's anger when she finds out she's not gonna get what she wants.

checkText.en: All I'm asking is that you don't slack. Back up your words with actions or you won't be getting any of this reward. Now get on out there - those hyenas are waiting for you!

finishText.en: Good deal. Now the order will be completed in time. Here's the coin and equipment I promised. Thanks a bunch buddy!

goal.en: Kill 4 Dusty Hyenas and return to Stirp the Nomadic.

startText.en:
Great, help has arrived just when I need it! I'm sure you feel like making a few coins, right? You see, the members of the Righteous Clan have put out an order for all of the hyenas to be exterminated. They want the beasts gone for good.
That's why I even came over here, you see. My clan isn't known for setting down roots, so we typically go our own way, living off the land and taking odd jobs when we can.
The problem is that there's a deadline and I can't do it alone. If you help me out, I'll be willing to give you some of the reward and hand over this old equipment that I don't need any more. So, what do you say?

checkText.en: Remember I want the goods up front. I know the shamans and their tricks. I'm no fool!

finishText.en: Now we're talking! Only birds sing for you free of charge. Orn's gotta look out for number one. Us loner types have to take advantage of these limited opportunities.

goal.en: Collect a Rhino Hide, 2 Eagle Feathers, and a Goblin Amulet for Ortag the Fierce on Righteous Isle.

startText.en:
Fine, I'll play goalie for the Fierce Clan.
But I expect to be well compensated for my services. I've made a list of everything I want. Here, take a look:
1. One rhino hide for new clothes.
2. Two eagle feathers for my arrows.
3. One goblin amulet to bring me good luck.
The rhinos graze over on the Bloodthirsty Isle, there are tons of eagles here on the Righteous Isle, and there are plenty of goblins over on the Roughneck Isle.
Excessive demands? What did you expect? I'm not just some Orc, I'm the best damn goalie around! And the cost for my services is more than justified, you got that?!

checkText.en: Well, what happened with the totem? Don't tell me that the Righteous Clan didn't let you near the pyre?

finishText.en: Just as I thought, our power is stronger! This information will give our team great confidence in the upcoming Goblinball Tournament. But don't tell anyone about what you did, alright? Trust me, it's in everyone's best interest!

goal.en: Plant the Imbued Shamanic Totem by the pyre on Righteous Isle and return to Lek the Roughneck.

startText.en:
I'm sure your travels will eventually lead you to Righteous Isle. I would really appreciate it if you could do me a favor, but it's a bit of a delicate mission. You see, we don't want to start a war with another clan of Orcs again.
Righteous Isle is the home of the Righteous Clan, and many of their numbers have become paladins. They believe that their holy power is superior to ours - that it's better than the power given to us by nature and our ancestors. It's ridiculous!
They made a large pyre on the allod that uses holy magic to burn what they deem to be evil forces. They say that the energy it gives off invigorates them. Personally, I don't believe in any of this new-age stuff, but I have to make sure. Take this shamanic totem to Righteous Isle. When you place it next to the pyre it should react to the holy energy and you'll be able to tell whose magic is stronger.
But make sure the Righteous Clan doesn't figure out what you're doing - I'm sure they'd get offended and issue our clan an outright challenge to prove their power. The last thing we need is more bloodshed!

checkText.en: How's the chief of the Roughneck Clan doing? Alive and kicking? Meh, looks like I'll have no choice but to claim leadership of the Fierce Clan. Can you tell how excited I am? Heh.

finishText.en: That's excellent news! Now to pack my bags and get over there before another sap rises to power. Here, take my battleaxe as a symbol of my submission. I'll just pick up a better one before I get there. See ya!

goal.en: Kill Badonet the Roughneck and return to Talip the Fierce.

startText.en:
You want me to surrender the position of chief to some shaman? Are you out of your mind?! Just look at what those losers have done to our clan. We barely survived, we're so weak! And now Lek wants me to just hand over my weapon?!
Argh, if only this clan had more warriors. We wouldn't let anyone push us around then. I'll take a hardy fighter over a shaman any day of the week. What I wouldn't give to lead a clan like that...
Take the Roughneck Clan, for instance - good fighters, all of them, not like our wimps! Too bad they already got themselves a chieftain...
Say, should the chieftain of the Roughneck Clan suddenly croak, I'd gladly ditch our clan to try and take his place. If you arrange for that to happen, I might just give up my bid for the chief of this clan.

checkText.en: Let this be a lesson for both the goblins and the Orcs who dare to violate age-old traditions!

finishText.en: Splendid! It's good to have you around, you know? Together we're a force to be reckoned with! Here, take this weapon, it'll come in handy.

goal.en: Bring 4 Bloody Goblin Heads to Geg the Roughneck.

startText.en:
Argh!
Ever since the Orcs joined the Empire, everything's been going straight to hell! It's one thing to have Orcs fighting Orcs, but now the fighters from the Roughneck Clan brought goblins into this, setting their filthy pets on their own kind! A disgrace, that's what this is!
Back on Izune this would earn an Orc a slow and shameful death. Our wars here are our business, others can't be involved. Especially not goblins! Then they'll start thinking that killing Orcs is okay. Drastic measures must be taken!
You're still here? Off with you to Roughneck Isle! Now! Kill as many of those filthy goblins as possible and bring me their heads as proof. Let this be a lesson to them. Let them know that their crimes will not go unpunished!

checkText.en: If this amulet isn't found, I might just have to go on a rampage. I can't be expected to be accountable for my actions!

finishText.en: That's it! That's my precious amulet. If it weren't for you I don't know when or if I'd ever see it again. Thanks for your help.

goal.en: Recover the Ancient Shamanic Amulet from a goblin on Roughneck Isle and bring it to Gavelock the Fierce.

startText.en:
I always knew that an alliance with the goblins was ill-fated! Alas, the shamans are no longer an authority among the Orcs - the warriors want to live off their instincts, never listening to reason. What a terrible idea!
During the attack I spied several of the Roughneck Clan's goblins slip off the battlefield and start rummaging through our camp, swiping everything they could lay their paws on. Filthy marauders!
Turns out an old amulet of mine is now gone. The offense is two-fold - not only did they steal from me, but those brainless beasts won't even be able to put the amulet to good use. They can't know the true power it holds.
Please make for Bloodthirsty Isle and recover the stolen amulet. One of the goblins has to have it. It's up to you to find the right one.

checkText.en: Don't tell me you weren't able to set the enemy's houses on fire? Do I have to find another helper?

finishText.en: Have you got good news for this old man? The flames were huge, eh? Serves them right, those monsters! They got what was coming to them. Now let them wallow in their own ashes!

goal.en: Burn down 3 buildings in the Roughneck Clan's village and return to Hammerblow the Fierce.

startText.en:
I helped build our village with my bare hands, you know! So much of my soul was put into these buildings, so much time and effort... And then those barbarians from the Roughneck Clan razed it all to the ground. Everything gone in less than a hour.
But they should have known that Orcs follow the rule of an eye for an eye. If they wanted their village to stand, they shouldn't have touched ours!
This offense will not go unpunished! But I'm old, too old to exact the proper revenge. Please, can you take this torch and burn down the buildings in their camp? Remember to hit their tavern, their smithy, and their chieftain's home! Then I'll be able to move on and rebuild.

checkText.en: Where are the totems? This may be our only chance to stop the Roughneck Clan. The bastards are fertile, I tell you! They replace fallen players faster than you can waste them!

finishText.en: The Roughneck players won't enter the field without their trinkets, not even on pain of death! That means we've only got one opponent left - the punishers of the Righteous Clan. When we crush them, our victory will force all of the Orcs to give our clan the proper respect!

goal.en: Collect 4 Roughneck Totems and bring them to Awl the Fierce.

startText.en:
We've already rid ourselves of the Bloodthirsty Clan. Now our focus is going to be the Roughneck Clan!
Now this plan is going to be a bit more complicated. Killing and humiliating them won't help - they'll just replace the players and keep plugging away. That means we need to use alternative methods.
Here's my idea. Everyone knows that the members of the Roughneck Clan are extremely superstitious. They don't take the field unless they have enchanted totems. I know, it's very hypocritical isn't it - they think shamans are weak yet they require their trinkets to fight.
Anyway, if you figure out a way to swipe the talismans then the Roughneck Clan will surrender for sure.
Now listen up - I head they keep their totems in little boxes under close guard in their camp. Take care of the guards any way you have to and bring me those totems!

checkText.en: Please don't tell me that the Fierce Clan team won't be playing! We've just had two teams withdraw from the Tournament. If the Fierce Clan doesn't show up, there won't be a tournament at all!

finishText.en:
So they will play! Finally some good news.
Well, it looks like there will only be one match in this tournament. But that just makes it all the more suspenseful I suppose.

goal.en: Replace the goblin head at the Goblinball stadium and talk to the Goblinball manager.

startText.en:
Well, now that I'm the chief of the Fierce Clan I need to help my people prepare for the Goblinball Tournament.
Everything's almost ready but there's just one more thing that needs doing. You're going to replace the goblin head that we use as a ball with the one I'm going to give you. It should be on a stake just outside the stadium on Savage Isle.
I know, this is a bit underhanded, but our clan has to win! We've lost a lot of respect lately because our clan is mostly shamans, and the warriors think they should rule our race now. If we wait any longer to claim a victory, the shamans may lose whatever remaining authority we have left! Then more and more Orcs will become savage cutthroats. And that will spell the end of Orcish freedom and independence The rest of the Empire will lose trust in us and they'll be constantly breathing down our necks. That's what's really at stake here - the fate of the Orcs.
We must be victorious, whatever it takes!
After you swap the head, tell the Goblinball manager that our team is ready to take the field. Once we win, I'll tell you what happened to Skulnar.

checkText.en: Well, do you have it or not? The Tournament is about to start and the girls will be out in the arena any minute now!

finishText.en: Ah, there it is! I won't even guess what ingredients Goggleye uses to make it. I just know that one swig of this concoction and our girls will dance so hard the Orcs' brains will melt and leak out of their skulls!

goal.en: Bring Goggleye's Booze to Victor Udovin.

startText.en:
There's a reason this allod is called "Savage" - it's teeming with all kinds of terrible fauna! Trolls, minotaurs, ogres, you name it.
If you only knew what we went through to build a stadium here. But we didn't have a choice! If we were to choose an allod inhabited by one of the Orcish clans - just imagine how angry the others would get. I get a headache just thinking about it.
Speaking of headaches, listen to this - they sent us a group of Orcish cheerleaders to warm up the crowd. The girls are just super! But they're city girls and they get kind of jittery around these wild Orcs.
Can you help me out with a plan to calm them down? There's a giant cyclops that lives nearby. He's a well known boar farmer named Goggleye, but he brews this fantastic beer too. If you could steal some for our girls I know they'd loosen up and calm down.
Don't bother asking him for it because I know he's not going to share. You'll have to waste him. The only other way would be to kill a bunch of his boars. He might run out to check on them, and when that happens you could sneak inside and grab it. It's your choice, just get me the booze!

checkText.en: How goes the hunt? Getting that meat will make my job a lot easier.

finishText.en: Excellent! That's a load off my mind. As they say, when the Orcs stay happy, Xadaganians stay in one piece. Haha! What, not funny? Hmm, maybe you're right - the joke is a bit dubious. A bit too political, too. Listen, don't pass it around, alright?

goal.en: Bring 4 pieces of Juicy Boar Meat to Miroslav Grubin.

startText.en:
Ho-ho-hey, ho-ho-hey, kiss me darling, whaddaya say! Calm down, I'm just memorizing some poetry. There are parties scheduled after the Tournament, and I've been appointed host.
But I'm a little lost, to be honest. I've never worked with wild Orcs, and I have a strong suspicion that my regular jokes won't go over too well. And I don't even want to think about party games. Can you even picture wild Orcs clenching a stick with their knees and passing it around? I know I sure can't.
So I'm thinking of cutting the entertainment program and just leaving the food. And then the guests will take care of themselves, I've been told. There's just one problem - we didn't bring that much meat.
I guess the suppliers underestimated the Orcish appetite. Do you think you could you lend me a hand? I've seen some boars grazing out in the prairie. Their meat would be perfect for the party.

checkText.en: I'm sure the minotaurs have already realized they won't be able to use the things. They've probably left them scattered around the whole allod by now. Good luck finding them!

finishText.en: Wow, those are really the power supplies! Now I'll finally be able to start up the portal! Here, take this weapon as a reward. Please use it to smash any minotaurs you come across in the future.

goal.en: Collect 4 Astral Power Supplies stolen by Minotaurs and bring them to Semer Khuit.

startText.en:
Want to know if the Arisen can feel hatred? Well, I'll tell you - you betcha! Some hate Tep, some hate their late mother-in-law, but me? I hate those minotaurs!
Tell me, how did you get here? That's right - you took a ship? Why, you might ask? Because the damn portal is still out of order! It should have been fixed days ago in preparation for the Tournament. Do you know how many people won't bother to come to this thing unless we have a portal running? It'll be a huge flop!
It would have been done if those minotaurs hadn't attacked the convoy that was delivering the portal's power supplies. Just imagine - our brave soldiers walking along peacefully, diligently dragging those heavy things along, when suddenly a horde of minotaurs ambushes them and wreaks havoc. How do you like that visual!
Tell me, what the heck do minotaurs need batteries for anyway?! They don't have a clue what to do with them! Damn scavengers is what they are, swiping anything they can get their hooves on.
Look at me, cursing like an Orc. I need to finish my job, wait out those games, and get off this allod before I pick up any more of their habits. Can you please get the batteries back for me?!

checkText.en: Maybe I should just go after Horny myself... No, I won't succumb to blind revenge! Besides, what if he beats me up again?

finishText.en: You killed him?! Hurray! Eh, somehow I don't feel too good about this though. I probably should have done it myself. Maybe us city Orcs are becoming too soft after all...

goal.en: Kill Horny the Barbaric and return to Braga the Unyielding.

startText.en:
Whatcha staring at? Never seen a wounded Orc before? Yes, I was part of the convoy that had to deliver those Astral power supplies! Yes, I fought Horny! And yes, I lost the battle. Grr, barbaric scum!
Phew, I feel better now. I needed to vent. Look, I'm a civilized Orc, not like these savages. I fought a fight and I lost. And to me that's no reason to jump into the Astral, though that's what the clan laws stipulate.
It's just that... I feel like crap, you know? I want revenge! More than anything in the world, I want revenge! Except with this wound here I'm not much of an avenger.
Hey, I've got an idea! Why don't you avenge me? It makes perfect sense! Once Horny dies I'll be at peace. And if I'm not the one who kills him, that'll put me above all these ancient Orcish traditions. Everybody wins! Well, except for Horny, haha!

checkText.en: How can I be expected to keep order when at any moment I could get minotaur horns rammed into my backside?!

finishText.en: The minotaurs finally got what was coming to them! Things will be a bit more peaceful now. Thank you for helping your country.

goal.en: Kill 4 Minotaur Marauders. Report to Gerasim Nadzorin on the Savage Isle.

startText.en:
Sometimes I wonder what the heck I'm doing here on the Wild Isles!
Working here's way too dangerous. When the Orcs start brawling I have to break them up and I'm the first one who suffers.
And I won't even mention the minotaurs, they're a real bundle of joy... Just the other day they pillaged some convoy and stole the power supplies for the portal for no reason. Did you know they're considered to be intelligent creatures? Could've fooled me!
Well, if they are intelligent, that doesn't make things any easier for us. On the contrary. If those horned bastards decide to crash the Tournament, I shudder to think of the consequences!
Listen, you can help everyone by killing four of their kind.

finishText.en:
Shh, settle down. Trust me, I'm just as sorry as you are about all this. Remember Crazystorm the Merciless? Well, he's my fellow clan member and he's said some good things about you. And I don't think he'll be pleased if a horde of furious Orcs tear you to pieces.
Unfortunately, I couldn't let that sabotage slide. The Fierce Clan is disgraced and that was my real goal, not getting you killed. Let me think of some way to get you out alive.
What do you think about the Ancestral Court? It's a kind of duel where you'll fight representatives from each of the three clans. It's an ancient Orcish tradition and you're within your rights to demand it. Say yes, and quickly - there's no other way! Say yes or start running!

goal.en: Demand an explanation from the Crazy Skewer!

startText.en:
Everyone, I need silence! I've got something to tell you, so shut up! That's better...
I regret to inform you that the Goblinball Tournament will not be taking place. It has come to our attention that the Fierce Clan has sent an agent to sabotage their competitors before the game.
It was them who disgraced the Bloodthirsty Clan's team! And it was them who stole the Roughneck Clan's talismans! And they even tried to tamper with the Righteous Clan's holy pyre!
Now I know what you're thinking - "so what"? You might even think "well done"! But now I must tell you that they also swapped the official goblinball with a replacement! It has been enchanted so that any member from the Righteous Clan that touches it will lose his holy powers.
And that, my friends, is foul play! It's one thing to sabotage your enemies, and another to sabotage official Tournament equipment! Beside me stands their agent, the one responsible for all the things I mentioned! Now tell me, Orcs, what is your verdict?

finishText.en:
You're finally here. I was getting pretty tired of waiting. So "the time has come," huh? Hm.
I know you and Lek put a lot of work into ensuring your victory. It was a good effort. A good effort indeed... And now you'll understand why I say that.

goal.en: Bring Victor Udovin's message to Skewer the Merciless.

startText.en:
Everyone's already in their seats! The fans are already plastered - I mean animated! The teams are warmed up and ready to go. The cheerleaders are looking lovely. And that means it's time to finally start the First Annual Goblinball Tournament!
Head to the arena and find Skewer the Merciless. He's the referee and you need to tell him that "the time has come!" Repeat those exact words and he'll know what to do.

checkText.en: Fight, damn you! Don't give up or they'll tear you to pieces!

finishText.en: Murd is down! That means the first duel is over! The ancestors favor the Fierce Clan's representative!

goal.en: Defeat Murd the Bloodthirsty and report to Skewer the Merciless.

startText.en:
Listen up! The Tournament may have been canceled, but we've been given an opportunity to honor the memory of our ancestors! The agent of the Fierce Clan has opted to undergo the Ancestral Court!
They will face three duelists. Each of the clans will present their strongest and mightiest warrior. If their fighter loses, then the Fierce Clan agent will have merited the blessing of our great ancestors. Then the losing clan must drop their charges and vow to never threaten them again. So says the law, so says tradition!
Here comes the first duelist - Murd! He's a scout that hails from the Bloodthirsty Clan and looks to defend that clan's honor! May his name know eternal glory! Let the fight begin!

checkText.en: I hope you can handle the holy magic of the Trinity Church!

finishText.en:
The third and final duelist has fallen! The Ancestral Court is over and the ancestors have spoken! The representative of the Fierce Clan shall live!
But remember this day, Orcs. This day is when the shamans showed their true colors! Let their kind fall, and let the warrior clans thrive!

goal.en: Defeat Purshin the Righteous and report to Skewer the Merciless.

startText.en:
The last but not least duelist hails from the Righteous Clan!
He is one you Orcs should know well! When the preachers from the Trinity Church came to Wild Isles, he was the one that made sure you all wouldn't tear them to pieces. For three days he protected the priests, and the road to their camp was paved with the corpses of countless Orcs. It is the one, the only, Purshin!

checkText.en: Brod is blind with anger. It should be easy to take advantage of his recklessness!

finishText.en: Brod is down! Could it be that the agent of the Fierce Clan brings more to the table than we expected? It looks like the final match is going to be an interesting one!

goal.en: Defeat Brod the Roughneck and report to Skewer the Merciless.

startText.en:
The duelist from the Bloodthirsty Clan has fallen, and now the second fighter is entering the arena! It is Brod - the son of Pigsticker the Roughneck and the personal guard to the chief of the Roughneck Clan! He's driven by revenge for his slaughtered clan members, which means that the ancestors are on his side!
Let's see how the agent of the Fierce Clan handles this mighty warrior. Will they be victorious? The odds look pretty slim, but who knows what will happen? Now let the fight begin!

finishText.en: I trust that you bring good news. I'd hate to think that all our preparations were for naught.

goal.en: Return to Lek the Fierce and report on all that happened.

startText.en:
Bah, I've nearly lost my voice from all that shouting! Man, that was a kickass event! All that blood and carnage warms the heart! The shamans are disgraced and you're still in one piece! Everybody's happy!
You know, I really didn't expect you to make it. Well done! I can see now why Crazystorm values you as he does.
Of course, if Purshin defeated you as we originally planned, it would've been even better - a full-fledged victory! But who knew that you were the Fierce Clan's agent? I sure didn't!
But you've got to admit, those shamans are real scumbags for dragging you into this. Our plan was flawless, we even forgot all about the meddling of the City Council. Oh, you didn't know? Yep, the Council's involved in all this as well.
Go on now, head back to Lek and let him know about all that took place here. He'll pass that on to Wrokag, and I can just imagine what his reaction will be!

finishText.en:
Well, I see no reason to hide the truth from you. Yes, we were trying to decrease the shamans' influence among the Orcs. Yasker and the City Council consider this to be a matter of very high priority.
We need the Orcs to become part of the Empire, and right now the shamans are dreaming of independence, putting ideas into the locals' heads. And that is why we must cut the ground from under their feet.
As far as the descendant of the Legendary Orc goes, that stuff is nothing but legend, and soon we shall prove it!

goal.en: Ask Yaver Maiherpri about Skulnar the Fierce.

startText.en:
What, we're disgraced? This is terrible!
Now everyone knows about what we did! I can't believe this happened! I didn't even make that stupid goblin head that you planted. It was given to me by the Council's detective! And I remember his words verbatim - "I realize the importance of the Fierce Clan's victory! We Arisen scientists can help the shamans earn the respect they deserve." That lying weasel!
The City Council must have been in cahoots with the warriors from the beginning. All along they planned to disgrace the shamans, to make us lose respect amongst our own kind! And I helped them achieve their goal! The only silver lining is that the detective promised to give you some information. He knows about the final descendant of the Legendary Orc. That's right, at least he can be useful for something! Even Horz let Skulnar slip away, but I was finally able to track him down!
Listen, sorry for not telling you everything that was going on. You think it's easy being the chief? And I thought for sure we were gonna win... Well, go talk to the detective and give me some time to think.

finishText.en:
Damn them all to hell! I knew that those City Council scumbags would try to ruin our plans! They don't want us to have our independence and will do whatever they can to prevent it!
And now I'm super angry! They're obviously skilled at lies and intrigue, and I don't believe a word they say. If Skulnar really was powerless, they wouldn't have locked him up in their lab! We need to get to the bottom of this!

goal.en: Bring Yaver Maiherpri's message to Wrokag the Northwind.

startText.en:
Why are the shamans even trying to separate from the Empire? The Orcs alone will never be able to keep their allods from being devoured by the Astral, so any hope for independence is simply out of the question!
Sure, there are a few Orcs that exhibited a small potential for higher magic, but this can easily be attributed to Astral mutations. The last alleged descendant of the Legendary Orc is currently held in one of our laboratories. He's undergoing a battery of tests that will undoubtedly prove us right once and for all.
Feel free to tell this to Wrokag the Northwind what I said. He cannot stop us, and the sooner he gives up his foolish and empty ambitions, the better it will be for everyone.

checkText.en: The Fierce Clan appreciates all the support we can get! Especially if it's backed up by deeds.

finishText.en: These are excellent! Just excellent! Now we're well prepared for a new military campaign thanks to friends like you!

goal.en: Bring 5 Rare Saddles to Lek the Fierce.

startText.en:
I know you've been helping the clan out a lot lately, cracking skulls and taking out wild creatures just so we can get back on our feet. But I have another task you could do that we would greatly appreciate.
This time, all I'm asking is that you bring us some equipment. That sounds simple enough, right? The thing we need the most are some new leather saddles to replace our old and damaged ones.
If you're a leatherworker this job should be pretty easy. And if not, then maybe you can go buy some. I hear that there are tons of people in the capital, just waiting to trade their goods. If you can get them for us, we'd be incredibly grateful.

finishText.en: Horz? Aye, there he is on the funeral pyre! He's dead. He was a great fighter, but they outnumbered him ten to one! Now I'm the leader of this clan. Well, not officially. Not yet, anyway...

goal.en: Find Horz the Fierce on Fierce Isle.

startText.en:
So it seems we've been betrayed by Strina. Damnit! The descendants of the Legendary Orc could only be counted on one hand to begin with. One hand! Now Voxar is dead and Strina ran away. That means that there is only one heir left. His name is Skulnar the Fierce, and he appears to be the cousin of our first two heirs.
All we know about him is that he aspires to be a great Goblinball player, which is why he headed to the Wild Isles. We'll need you to follow him as soon as possible. First you should go visit Fierce Isle, named after the clan that owns it. The clan is run by us shamans, which means they should be very eager to assist you in your mission. The Orc in charge is named Horz. He's an old buddy of mine and if anyone can help you, it's him.
The boat that lands at the dock between the Nezebgrad Port and Cape Stronghold should take you straight to where you need to go. And remember how important this mission is - there is only one descendant of the Legendary Orc left, and his protection is vital!

finishText.en: Crazystorm sent you? Thanks for the help, but we hardly need it now. Victory's pretty much in the bag! You need to understand that the ancestors are on our side, and that's the only thing that matters! But don't worry, I'm sure we'll find something to keep you busy.

goal.en: Meet with Baske the Righteous on Righteous Isle.

startText.en:
You should visit the Wild Isles soon. It's a small archipelago where many of the Orcs have been living for generations. The local clans are wholly isolated from civilization, and the government has been putting in a lot of work into making them less barbaric.
One example of such efforts is the construction of a stadium in the middle of Savage Isle. We're hoping those Orcs will stop fighting each other and start playing more Goblinball instead. In fact, the Wild Isles will soon host the first annual Goblinball Tournament, and we need to make sure it goes off without a hitch.
Speak with the team trainer of the Righteous Clan when you get there. He should be able to tell you more about what's going on. By the way, their team is also under my patronage, and I would love it if they emerged victorious at the Tournament. Do I make myself clear?
You can take a ship from the Nezebgrad Port straight to Wild Isles. The portal there is still under construction, so sailing is your only option at the moment. You should land at Fierce Isle, and from there you should make your way to Righteous Isle to the east.

checkText.en: Man, do I have rotten luck or what! Everywhere you look it's nothing but danger! Those trolls and ogres are the worst of the lot.

finishText.en: Thank you very much! Remember that when the Tournament starts and everyone's having a good time, they'll have you to thank for their safety!

goal.en: Participate in killing 4 Dusty Ogres and 10 Muddy Trolls and report to Gerasim Nadzorin.

startText.en:
I've been watching you since you've landed on Savage Isle, and I'm impressed with how you handle yourself soldier. But do you have the guts to try your hand at a real mission? To battle a truly perilous foe?
