I'm talking about the trolls and the ogres around here. Trust me, I'd do nothing but pray to Tensess all day if that would ensure those beasts don't attack us! They could raze our whole stadium to the ground and not even break a sweat!
I figure it's best not to wait for them to strike first. That's why I've been looking for a soldier to launch a preemptive strike of our own. Do you think you could take out as many as possible, give them a taste of what would happen if they came any closer?

checkText.en: I shudder to think what would happen if he accidentally got poked in the eye. He might destroy the whole allod!

finishText.en: This is fantastic! After all your work, I suppose this allod isn't very savage after all, eh? Haha! Now here's your reward.

goal.en: Participate in killing Goggleye and return to Gerasim Nadzorin on Savage Isle.

startText.en:
Do you want to know what my main headache is? No, it's not the minotaur. And no, it's not the ogres or the trolls. Those were good guesses though. I'll tell you - it's that cyclops!
Which cyclops? That huge one named Goggleye that lives just to the east of the Goblinball Arena. He's a bit of a bully and extremely unstable. Last time he was stung by a bee, he went on a rampage and took out three Orcs that happened to be nearby. Imagine if he was stung by a wasp or something! He could destroy the whole arena!
Now I won't lie - I would be completely useless if I went over to his lair. Even for a seasoned soldier like you, I would recommend that you get help. But if you do manage to get a good group and bring Goggleye down, I promise you'll get a pretty nice reward.

checkText.en: It's not scary at all, I assure you. Actually, it's kind of fun gazing into the Astral as you float along...

finishText.en: So, that was pretty educational, eh? It's information that should come in very handy during your stay here in the Orcish allods!

goal.en: Use the ancient June ruins to get to Savage Isle and then report back to Hammerblow the Fierce.

startText.en:
Not far from here, there are some ancient June ruins that you can use to get to Savage Isle. They're amazing, really! Before we got these nifty Adventurer's Stones from the government, you won't believe how we got from allod to allod.
Bridges! Yes, that's right, bridges. Flimsy old things of rope and wood that were always being cut apart by enemy clans. Pah! Not to mention what would happen if you happened to be ON one when that happened.
Those poor souls... Anyway, I'd advise you to go on over to those ruins and use them to head to Savage Isle. It'll be a great experience, learning how to use the things and seeing the biggest allod in the Wild Isles.
You should come back to me after you've taken the trip and tell me what you think!

checkText.en: What are you waiting for? You'll never learn more if you can't follow instructions.

finishText.en: Great! You're on your way to becoming a great anthropologist yourself!

goal.en: Find the 3 Stones of the Wild Isles and report back to anthropologist Luka the Fierce.

startText.en:
You know, to be able to call yourself a true scholar, you must be very aware of your's surroundings.
As a test, I have placed three stones imbued with magic around the Wild Isles. Explore these great allods, find the stones and report back to me.
Only after you have done this will I agree to take you under my wing. You can find these stones on Roughneck Isle, Bloodthirsty Isle, and Savage Isle. Good luck, traveler.

checkText.en: You've taught them a lesson, right?

finishText.en:
Good.
They need to learn that their actions have consequences!

goal.en: Kill 50 Bloodthirsty Clan Orcs and report back to anthropologist Luka the Fierce.

startText.en:
The Wild Isles is my home, so it pains me to say that it's far from perfect. But it's the truth.
If it weren't for that damned Bloodthirsty Clan, we'd be great! But they decided to cause all sorts of trouble and mess everything up.
I need you to get out there and show them the errors of their ways! They need to join the other clans and behave themselves!

checkText.en: Well? Have those creatures been defeated?

finishText.en:
Excellent!
I knew you could do it. And by defeating these beasts, you now know more about the local fauna.

goal.en: Collect 4 Wild Isles Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Luka the Fierce.

startText.en:
Listen, I know you're a seasoned traveler and all, but these are the Wild Isles!
You let your guard down for one second and that's it! It's all over! I want you to get used to the dangers of a place like this, so I need you to venture out and kill four of Wild Isle's most dangerous creatures!
But you need to give me proof – a trophy from the likes of Dusthoof, a ferocious wild tiger, Goldbeak, Grimetooth, or Earthstomper will do just fine.

checkText.en: There's so few of my clan left. We desperately need that rue!

finishText.en: Great! We'll be sure to put this to good use. If you know what I mean...

goal.en: Collect 5 Goat's Rue Roots for anthropologist Luka the Fierce.

startText.en:
Tell me, have you heard of goat's rue?
What?! It's made from a special root that you can only find here on the Wild Isles. It's the reason why the orc here are so... Numerous. Heh. You get it? It's a special rue that the ocrish men take! Ha ha!
Anyway, you can find it all over the Isles, so please bring me whatever you find! Let's say, five roots will be enough.

checkText.en: Have you completed all of my tasks?

finishText.en:
Great.
You know, I didn't think you'd be able to do it. Thank you for proving me wrong! Go ahead and take your reward!

goal.en: Complete all of the Anthropologist's tasks and report back to Luka the Fierce.

startText.en:
If you can successfully complete all my tasks, you'll be generously rewarded.
And I'm not talking about some rinky-dink potion! You'll have the knowledge that you've gained from this adventure as well as some prime equipment that's bound to help you on your future journeys!
So, find the stones, defeat the beasts, and gather some valuable resources here in the Wild Isles!

finishText.en: This appears to be the cache of the Roughneck Clan's chief. And now his treasures will go to a brave explorer!

goal.en: Look inside the Strange Skull.

startText.en:
Hmm... This thing clearly looks a little out of place. Maybe you should study it more carefully.
The Orcs are known to be a paranoid race, probably due to all the fighting that goes on between them. This is probably somebody's secret stash! Finders keepers - they should find a better hiding place next time!

checkText.en: Well, did you find anything good out there?

finishText.en: Excellent! Now their treasure can be used against them to make sure they never pillage us again!

goal.en: Find the hidden treasure in the Orcish villages and report your success to Gavelock the Fierce.

startText.en:
Those blasted Orcs pillaged our camp when they attacked. They took all of the best stuff they could carry and are now using it for themselves! This kind of thing can't be tolerated!
Hey, when you're out there dealing out the pain they deserve, keep an eye open for any treasure. They should have mountains of it after what they recently stole. It doesn't belong in their hands, and they won't be able to use it anyway once we slaughter them! Hehe.
No, I'm not asking you to bring it back. It's likely that it belonged to an Orc that's dead now anyway. It's just a tip. I'm sure you'd enjoy a little extra loot for all the work you're doing.

checkText.en: Well, did you get them?

finishText.en:
It's just as I thought. With only one sample I was able to figure out this dreadful phenomenon.
What? Why didn't I just ask for one sample to begin with? Because most of the specimen are bad, and I didn't want to waste loads of my time explaining the difference! Instead, we've let the law of probability work for us - typically, one out of every five is the right one.

goal.en: Collect 4 Shards of Light and bring them to Nomarkh Netjerkare.

startText.en:
So, there's a certain black stone that's responsible for the appearance of strange shadowy creatures. It's the same type of stone that was discovered in Tep's sarcophagus. It's also known that the stone inhibits resurrection. As to the cause of this, that part remains unclear. At which point the matter was brought to my doorstep.
What in Tep's name took you so long! Here we are with essentially the same problem - our men are not resurrecting, and their souls are cursed, unable to find their bodies! Now they wander the halls, attacking all who come near!
In the past these sorts of things would appear only when they had no body to return to, but this is a very different phenomenon. The bodies are there, but the souls simply cannot find them!
Listen, we need to study those lost souls. What I wouldn't give for a Sparkton Pack right about now! But in its absence, we'll need to make do with a cruder method.
Each soul contains a shard of light that's infused with holy magic, even cursed ones. Go kill some of the ones up ahead and gather several of their shards. I need to study them immediately.

checkText.en: Is the job done? If the answer is no, then I've got nothing to say to you.

finishText.en:
Is that so. Well, I always keep my word. Aye, an Orcish has been delivered to the lab recently. The operation was top secret, so no one knows any details, but I heard that the scientists had some pretty special experiments lined up for him.
Anyway, I'm sure the poor bastard is long dead by now. Just as all my boys that went in there are long dead! Argh! I never trusted those Arisen idiots and I never will. They really screwed things up.

goal.en: Destroy 4 Skeletons and return to Blackhand the Unyielding.

startText.en:
Descendant of the Legendary Orc my ass! That ain't nothing but a shaman's fairytale! The only magic Orcs can use is holy magic. That and whatever other pagan rituals the shamans still practice. Death magic, elemental magic, mind magic - none of them are a weapon of my people. You should put these silly ideas out of your head and start accepting us for who we are. And that's it.
Hmm, I guess I've got a stubborn one here. Fine. Tell you what - do something for me and I'll throw some information your way.
The task is simple. Recently the undead have been pouring out from the lab in massive numbers, giving the Imperial soldiers trouble. You'll help them.
Kill four undead for me, and then we'll continue this conversation.

finishText.en: Help! Somebody, help!

goal.en: Find someone that can reveal the identity of the cultist that infiltrated Lab Thirteen.

startText.en:
It's now official - the black stone suppresses holy magic, and when it does it summons Shadows. You remember that Tep had this sort of stone, right? He probably used it at the ZIT Headquarters to suppress the holy magic that was binding him and thus get an opportunity to transfer his soul into a new body. Ah, good ol' Tep. You never cease to amaze!
But let's return to our lab. This type of stone is the only thing that could cause the souls of the dead to be unable to resurrect. It must be blocking the holy energy that's involved in the process. Now we just need to learn how the stone got here...
There's only one option - we've got a traitor on our hands! The lab must have been infiltrated by a Tep cultist. Ooh, I'll be having a good chat with Mitrofan Semidolin about this! He swore to me that all the employees went through the most thorough background checks!
Listen, you need to make for the lab at once. The traitor may still be in there. Search every hole and every corner if you have to! Leave no vial unturned, you hear me? The truth is near and it's up to you to find it!

checkText.en:
A?
What's wrong?

finishText.en:
Gibberlings? What Gibberlings?
Ah, you speak about psionic attack, don't you! Oh, that's so unimportant compared to a new problem!

goal.en: Meet Hammerblow the Fierce on the Old Square and request Gibberlings for the sake of art, presenting the instruction. The results must be informed to Uri Bondarin on the Dream Factory.

startText.en:
Here is one of the problems to be solved. According to the script one of the key scenes in our epic "Liberation" is Gibberlings' mental attack. Thousands of small fluffy creatures attacking the ship! Looks great. On paper!
But, tell me, please, where should I take a thousand of Gibberlings! Should I invade Frozen Frontier!?
Oh, this Bondarin! Blotter! I am speaking about the script writer! He denies to change Gibberlings to the undead! He says that Yasker has approved everything and not a single line is to be changed! How can I argue!
In short, now we try to find available Gibberlings all over the Empire. And you can help.
Grok the Bloodthirsty is known to you, isn't he? Standing on the Old Square, showing the Gibberlings for kicks of the people. Talk to him and take the Gibberlings for the sake of art. In case of his objection - show him the Order! He is an agent of the Council after all and has to fulfill his duty!
After that go to the script writer Bondarin. Supposedly a lot of troubles he has.

finishText.en:
Oh, it's worst task in my life!
I need to deal with creative intelligence! They have no clues about working discipline! Everyone considers himself better, everyone has perfect ideas and each of them costs more than building of new XAES!
I have so much to do!

goal.en: Go to the Factory of Dreams using ruins of June portal and talk to Ekaterina Feofanova.

startText.en:
You have several wonderful abilities, one of them is an ability to appear in time, in that exact moment, when I need you.
Yes, Motherland needs your heroic deed again! Don't worry nothing unusual about it. No world conspiracy, secret missions and other gray working days of Committee. We will talk about something Beautiful.
Brothers Sarbaz and Sarang Lumer, scientists of ZIT, made one discovery recently. A side one. When they were studying influence of mystical powers on the mind, they invented "Illusion". Using their new invention, one can recorder all occurring event on a magical strip and them relay them! Awesome! It opens great opportunities for the Committee! And not only for investigating materials.
We are talking about greatest weapon of propaganda! Finally, we can tell truth to our citizens, bring all latest Yasker's orders to everybody! Finally, we can record all our successes of our country to our progeny! And finally, we can demonstrate the League true situation.
We are working at it at the moment. "Factory of Dreams", as I call it, is situated to the west from Nezebgrad. This a place where "moving" history is created. Moving history is my term also. Ekaterina Feofanova is leading the process. She is experienced and respected Committee agent. I assume that she needs help.
If you use ancient June ruins, that are situated in the Nezebgrad's harbor, you can get there. Talk to Feofanova and help her as much as you can.

checkText.en:
How one can work in such conditions? How?!
Pen-pusher from the Art! Parasites that are feed from creativity! Their only goal is economy!
And we are not playing cards here, we are creating everlasting things!

finishText.en:
Oh! It's our survival!
Can you see? These things have the League smell from a mile! They are not fake, they are real!
Thank you! Now we have a hope that we can create something real! True!

goal.en: Obtain 2 League trinkets, a League weapon, and a League armor piece by fighting experienced troopers on the Lookout Isle, then bring them to Dina Ozerina at the Dream Factory.

startText.en:
Here is one of problems that we have to solve.
Dina Ozerina is her name. Firstly, she is director's wife. Secondly, she is main artist. Explosive mix! She orders to get original League armors and their house stuff! We tried our best, most well known masters of Nezebgrad were working on them. And she is not satisfied! Cloth is not the same, she says!
We have to obtain required items in battle.
Go to the Lookout Isle. League deserters landed there. They will help us, I'm sure.
Fight only experienced warriors, scouts and mages. The have new uniform and beautiful weapons, moreover they are rich and can have different small things that will be useful for us. When you obtain everything, bring it to Ozerina. I cannot talk to her anymore.

checkText.en:
Again wriggling to the art! By all means!
And the examples not far to seek! Muhina! She can not even imagine what is it like to be Elf!

finishText.en:
What? Muhina can dance?
Don't believe before see it myself!

goal.en: Go to the bunker, with the help of roll urge the actress Gella Muhina and teach her elves-dancing. The results must be informed to the director Uri Ozerin on the Dreams Factory.

startText.en:
This is one of the key problems. According to the script the major enemy is the Elven mage playing dirty tricks on us. Initially this role was planned for a real elf, but... In one word, Gella Muhina was promoted to it finally.
What? Don't you know Gella Muhina? Hm... Lucky you are. Don't know how but this... smart lady managed to get this Elven role. No, it was not through the director's fault - he doesn't like it either. She has to dance Elven! But to put it mildly she does it not well... Xadaganian-like.
Ozerin, the director, is depressed. He is afraid for the major scene! He says that such dancing will result our epic into cheap amateur art!
We have to teach Muhina Elven dance. Have you ever been to bunker? Don't revert your eyes, everybody has been there!
Alright! If you don't want to confess... Let's pretend that you know nothing.
The entrance to Bunker is located in the Victory Park, in its south-eastern part. The guardian is standing by it. Say the password: "Procedure issue..." and enter.
In Bunker you will see the real Elves. They will be dancing.
Here is the roll of appeal. Muhina is ready. When you come to the Bunker appeal to her and help to warm into her role. She has to learn Elven dance!

checkText.en: If my construction project of a new XAES won't be accepted within three days, I waive the responsibility from myself!

finishText.en:
What's that? Magic essence?
Furzina really thinks that we can work with it?!
What a blatant ignorance!
Hey, hold on! Give me the essence! One should value the energy of art!

goal.en: Obtain 4 magic essences by fighting magic elementals and bring them to the scientist Sarbaz Anedjib.

startText.en:
This is one of the problems to be solved.
As far as you already know, the "moving" history was created by two scientists of ZIT, brothers Anedjibs. One of them is here at the moment. He is providing technical support for the whole process. I must say that this is very expensive. We are already overlimited! Almost all XAES works only for us!
During their research brothers Anedjibs used magic essence. So we need to get it. On an industrial scale!
Fight the Magic Elementals that roam along the shores, get the essence and bring it back to Sarbaz Anedjib.

checkText.en:
I wonder... When we eliminate the problem of feeding the crowd, what else is going to fall on my shoulders? Logically...
Hm... I wouldn't deal with these problems also!

finishText.en:
Great!
Now when the Gibberlings hold the banzai attack they will look authentically!

goal.en: Obtain 4 pieces of Boar Meat and bring it to the screenwriter Yuri Bondarin.

name.en: How can one feed the Gibberlings?

startText.en:
What do you think the work of a scriptwriter is? Hand write over heaps of paper? No way!
You won't believe it, but the scriptwriter is in charge of everything! How else could it be?
Take a look at the Gibberlings. At first I went hysterical to make Feofanova deliver them, and it helped, naturally! We've got the Gibberlings.
But has anyone given it a deeper thought? No! Now they're starving! Just fancy a mental attack of skinny, exhausted Gibberlings! Enough to make a cat laugh!
I literally have to bottle feed them. Their number is growing! There's a real mess!
Well, have I managed to deliver the importance of the issue to you? Then your help is welcome.
Kill the steppe boars and bring me their meat!

checkText.en:
Oh, so much trouble about this Kanian hut!
We took it longwise! By assault!

finishText.en:
That's it! Now it is much more like a birch grove!
I wish the screenwriter made normal script! Just look at this heresy that these two Xadaganians and Kanians are talking!

goal.en: Obtain 4 Growth Potions by fighting termites and use it to fertilize the saplings. Report back to Dina Ozerina.

startText.en:
How about doing something for the sake of art? Excellent!

We are trying to capture the scene of the military council of the League commanders. It took place in Kania, so we need to reconstruct the environment.

We planted a few birches here. They're pretty small and they don't really look like a birch grove.

There's one solution to this problem, and that is the growth potion. Once we feed the sprigs, we'll get our trees!

Termites that live near the Factory are the most suitable source of the potion.

Get four potions and feed the saplings. Then we'll work on the scene. Can you see those two Kanians? Don't touch them! Those are Xadaganians, it's just makeup. They are rehearsing...

checkText.en: Everything must be authentic! Especially what concerns the fight of our Great Sovereign with the enemy!

finishText.en: Great job! Hope it helps our Yasker to get into the role!

goal.en: Teach "Yasker" a battle craft, having outfight 15 "fierce Kanians" in the middle of the temple. The results must be informed to the director Uri Ozerin.

startText.en:
Besides Muhina I have one more. Yasker!
Don't be scared! It's not real. This is the leading actor. In make up. Resembles? Now you understand!
The problem is that he resembles only in outer appearance. And only when he does nothing. But according to the script he has to do what? To fight, yeah! He even took the staff the wrong way!
Listen, would you teach him a lesson? Now evil Kanians appear and attack the place of resurrection. And our Yasker will have to kick their asses. You'll manage, no doubt!
Are you going to help us?

checkText.en: I wonder if we manage. Hope we do, otherwise... otherwise all is lost!

finishText.en:
Look how it is burning! Wonderful!
Hm, may be the future is with it? I wish I have more of these essences and a model of a greater scale...
I have an idea! To capture the Great Cataclysm! That's nice... That will be impressive!

goal.en: Get the fire essence fighting against fire elementals, and with the help of which set the Kanian ship model on fire. The results must be informed to the scientist Sarbaz Anedjib.

startText.en:
Ah! Everyone says about the great scale of our project! Tons of gold were spent! And what working conditions we have here? Wretched!
Have a look. We need to capture the Kanian ship on fire. And what I want to tell you. No money was given for ship construction and further destruction!
They say you are a wise man, so, please, find the way.
So I did. Let's set the model on fire and shot a close scene. Suppose we'll succeed.
Firstly we should check. Get some fire essence for me, I see you are good at such things and then set the model on fire. So we can check.

checkText.en: This "moving history" is the biggest headache, I've ever had! And I have seen lots of things in my life!

finishText.en:
It's good that you are here.
We are beginning! Everyone take your places!

goal.en: Go to the main pavilion of Factory of Dreams and talk to Ekaterina Feofanova.

startText.en:
Oh, I'm trying to find you everywhere!
We have an incident! Main actor, the one who players Yasker himself, is drunk! He is talking that he cannot realize such complicated character! A bastard!
And we are ready to capture all main scenes! Ship is repaired, Gibberlings are fed, extra players are gathered, actress is inspired!
Listen, you played him once! Please, help me!
Go to the main pavilion, its right behind the gates. I and all our team will be waiting for you there!

finishText.en: Right on time! The motherland requests your assistance again! I thought it’d turned out just fine, but it seems that I was wrong.

goal.en: Talk to Ekaterina Feofanova.

startText.en: There now, it's all ready. Equipment, and set design, and actors... What's taking so long? We haven't got all day! Go and ask Feofanova, what's wrong.

checkText.en:
I hope that not only you will succeed, but all other services also.
We won't be able to see it once more.

finishText.en:
Perfect!
I'm sure, Yasker will love this scene.

goal.en: Defeat 4 angry Gibberlings and report to Ekaterina Feofanova.

startText.en:
First scene is that simple Gibberlings' mental attack. They are gathered, fed and ready to fight.
You are Yasker, capturing enemies' ship. You are alone, of course.
After my command you begin fighting Gibberlings and beautifully, nicely defeats them.
Is everything clear? We have no time for repetitions, we are beginning. I believe in your talent.

checkText.en:
Maybe, it's the most important scene!
Everybody knows that Yasker can conquer the ship alone.
And that he also can pass through water fire and copper tubes... We should remind our people about this!

finishText.en:
I'm excited!
Maybe even Yasker himself could not oppose enemy's charms so confidently!
Scene of final Elf re-education we will do later. There we will need other decorations.

goal.en: Go to ship's stern and read Yasker's speech in time. Report to Ekaterina Feofanova on finishing.

startText.en:
The next scene is a scene of seduction. Mean Elven mage tries to tempt Yasker.
Our leader demonstrates high more principles, that are part of character of each Imperial citizen. You will be demonstrating it.
Your partner is Gella Muhina. She is pro at tempting... Especially now, when she learned Elven dance.
Take it. These are texts of your phrases. You need to read them in time. An easy task - main thing is not to miss anything. When Mykhina, the Elf, says her words, you say yours after that. You voice should be strong, steel and courage. Is it clear?
Let's begin!

checkText.en: We can never be confident with those golems! June magic is so unpredictable!

finishText.en: We managed to capture this battle. I'm sure it will be a good decorations to our epic!

goal.en: Go to the reactor room and defeat June golem. Talk to Ekaterina Feofanova on finishing.

startText.en:
We are moving to a final stage.
When the Elf was reeducated, Yasker goes to the ship's lower deck to fight June golem than was used by enemy for reactor's defense. Yasker fought and was victorious!
I hope you know what to do. But... Zem engineers are not sure in golem's actions. He... In one word something can go wrong. So, the fight can a real one.
But I hope you won't retreat! Art requires sacrifice!

finishText.en:
What are you saying? How interesting. Maybe I'll visit a Factory by myself one day. I want to look at it with my own eyes.
And maybe, a day when I will say: "From all arts the most important is... "Moving History" is not far. But it sounds bad, I should think about new word.

goal.en: Meet Elizaveta Rysina and tell about success on Factory of Dreams.

startText.en:
Oh.
It's the end. We managed to capture most important moments. We still have much work to do, but only now I begin to feel confidence in out success.
Do you know what I want to say? I like it
Yes, it's very difficult. Yes, it's unorganized. Yes, it's foolish. But from this difficultness and foolishness a new branch of art is born. Flexible history!
Return to Rysina and tell her that everything is ok.
First performance is soon!

checkText.en: Be ready for any surprises!

finishText.en: Hold on, I'm studying the black stone and the shard. Hmm... Let's see here... Ah! A thousand bloody Teps! It all checks out!

goal.en: Wait until the experiment ends and destroy any threats that might appear.

startText.en:
I need to conduct a quick experiment. The gist of it is this - I put the black stone next to the shard of light. Simple. I expect for the shard of light to show a visible reaction to its proximity to the black stone. There's also a good possibility that a Shadow will appear.
Shadows are odd creatures. They can be summoned easily enough, but to this day no one's ever been able to retain control over them. With Tep being the sole exception, if that legend is even true.
But I am rambling. For this experiment we're not trying to control one. We're simply testing the powers of the black stone. Now are you ready to deal with whatever might happen?

checkText.en: Activating the things are pretty easy. Getting near them is the hard part.

finishText.en: The path is now clear. That means it's time for action!

goal.en: Activate 4 Undead Destroyers and report back to Mitrofan Semidolin.

startText.en:
Here's the situation. Within the confines of Lab Thirteen there's been a series of experiments conducted, dedicated to establishing control over Astral demons. The brightest minds throughout the Imperial allods have been brought here for this very purpose.
All creatures with any form of mind control abilities have been studied by our scientists to no end. They hope to understand and amplify their abilities and then use them on the Astral demons. If we succeed, the possibilities are boundless!
But a few days ago, everything changed. No one knows exactly what happened, and none of the rescue parties have returned. Instead, the undead have been pouring out like roaches. We're practically in a state of siege at this point. But before you head down there, I need you to do one thing for me.
Near the entrance to the lab we've set up several mechanisms that we call "Undead Destroyers". They're a combination of holy magic and Arisen technology. Unfortunately, they're a bit unstable right now. They keep turning off for no apparent reason. Your task is to turn them on again. That should help clear the way so we can get inside.

checkText.en: Milestones of Gipat Shard are waiting for you!

finishText.en:
I wonder... Can you now claim that you are more familiar with Gipat and not from hearsay?
On one hand, you've seen all the nooks of this allod. On the other hand, if you just bounced between each stone without absorbing it's history then you will only cheat yourself in the end.

goal.en: Find 5 milestones of Gipat, touch them, and report to Lark the Ink Quill.

startText.en:
To learn more about Gipat, you need to find the milestones, mysteriously carved stones, that have been hidden in remote places.
Find such stones and touch them to feel its history.
Where are these milestones? Listen and remember for I will only say this once...
Misty Shore, Blighted Road, Wild Orcs' Camp, Windswept Foothills, and Cursed Path. You will find the carved stones there.

checkText.en: Did you manage to get Signs of Gipat?

finishText.en: Excellent! The Signs that you brought proves you have defeated the deadliest foes on Gipat.

goal.en: Get 7 Signs of Gipat fighting against dangerous creatures and bring them to Lark the Ink Quill.

startText.en:
Do not think you can compare yourself to the same level as Masters without at least defeating the most dangerous Gipat creatures?
Prove your might to me. Slay them all and bring me Signs of Gipat to show me you are the real deal.
The creatures that you must defeat to gain their Sign are: Viletongue, Misthoof, Takunda, Ethereal Cutthroat, Mogo, Goblin Barbarian, Guk the Primitive, Runeclaw, Redtooth the Unyielding. You can easily recognize these creatures by their names or by crown symbols above their heads.

checkText.en: I hope word spreads throughout the enemy army of your determination to wipe them all from the face of this allod!

finishText.en: Those stupud orcs do not understand the the Revelation is much more important than their weird old traditions!

goal.en: Kill 100 orcs on Gipat and report to Lark the Ink Quill.

startText.en:
Our world is not perfect... Ah! How truthful these words are! Well, I have lost my thought...
So, our world is not perfect. In every land you will cross paths with dangerous creatures that threaten natives. On Gipat such arch foes are... Surprise!... Wild orcs! These orcs do not revere law, they kill the Chosen ones, and they will prevent you from achieving Revelation!
Take this opportunity to show them who is the master of this land!

checkText.en: Stones of the past can be found everywhere in Gipat... Hm, I nearly let out a secret!

finishText.en: Yeah, yes... Silent witnesses of the past tell all. Do you feel more connected to Gipat's history now?

goal.en: Find 10 Stones of the Past on Gipat and bring them to Lark the Ink Quill.

startText.en: In all of Sarnaut there are lots of valuable resources that can be found in specific spots. Gipat is not an exception. I'm not speaking about herbs and minerals. The most valuable resource here is the past. That's right, the past. Now Gipat is only a reflection of the past. Nevertheless, there are pieces around us to help remember the past. There was a time when we would throw stones around for amusement. Now It's time to collect them. Bring me the stones of the past. Where you can find them? It is a mystery you must unravel. Hopefully you will be wise enough to find the answer.

checkText.en: Have you completed all of my tasks?

finishText.en:
Few people could have accomplished what I set you out to do.
And even fewer of those who listened to me attentively. And I haven't yet met a person, Orc, Elf or other being who refused my trials after hinting at a wondrous. Those whose minds are only on materials tend to fail from not having the proper drive.
Although your intentions and motive is more than just seeking my reward, right?

goal.en: Complete all quests from Anthropologist, Lanol, for a well-deserved reward.

startText.en: If you successfully complete all my assignments, I will generously reward you. You will be able to choose the reward, which will help you fearlessly venture into the depths of Gipat Caves. Prove to me you are indeed the Chosen One!

checkText.en: Greetings, stranger!

finishText.en: You are one of the few who to be fortunate enough to see the most unbelievable show that has ever been seen in this world! Put aside all enmity and prepare to enjoy an amazing spectacle!

goal.en: Read the invitation to the show, take the Mysterious Stone attached to the letter, use it and meet with the Spirit of Peace on Gipat.

startText.en: Hey! Some strange invitation to a "Show" has arrived for you. And there is a parcel with it, a stone. A black one. One item. Aha, sign here. Well, not with an X! No, what will you do.... Now you an take get your parcel. Our postal service is the most reliable in Sarnaut!

checkText.en: Have you cleared the Isle of Intrusion from demons?

finishText.en:
Good.
If you want more experience, come back tomorrow. Demons will return and we will need your help again.

goal.en: Go to the Isle of Intrusion and kill 5 Astral Scouts, 3 Astral Punishers, and 1 Astral Destroyer. Report back to Spirit of Resolve in Gipat Settlement.

startText.en:
Glad you are here.
Overlord Zullo, who looked into your mind, told me that you might help me with a very important mission. We discovered a small astral island where the main body of demon army is located. They want to interrupt the Performance.
Your have to stop the intrusion. I can help you to get to the Isle of Intrusion. Demon Ancestors infest the island with the new sorts of beasts. Don't try to attack the Ancestors, this is useless. You should go for their offsprings. You may also have to fight against Astral Scouts, Punishers, Destroyers and Tainted Predators. Every new enemy will be stronger than the previous one. You must kill everyone to stop their advance, and be quick - you can only stay on the island while the Blessing of Overlord is active.
Can you handle it? Get ready then!

checkText.en:
So be it. Let this preacher waste his breath while the devout League crowd around like bunch of pricks. The Empire's members will make significant strides towards completing their Path.
I wish the boats would come sooner!

finishText.en:
Thanks for your help!
Good luck on your Path and don't forget... For the Empire!

goal.en: Place two Lantern Beams on the side of each shore and report back to Rodion Zotkin.

name.en: Lighting the Road of the Empire

startText.en:
The League. Nothing but the League around! Look, there goes some more League citizens!
Not all Imperials have teleportation stones and the June portal here only works one way. Therefore, we need to establish convenient communication and transportation from Astral ships to attract more Imperial citizens.
Set the signal lanterns on the shore to light the way for our ships. Keep an eye out for debris on the shore - most suitable place for the lanterns. Remember, this is top priority. Your Chosen Path will not go anywhere.
The more Imperial citizens on Gipat, the greater chance that we'll get Revelation before the League!

finishText.en: This mineral is quite old. Long, long ago they were considered valuable and rare, now they’re not good for a thing... However, memories of the old days are so dear to me. Bring me more of these, and I will reward you with another antique and curious thingie: an ancient costume or some headwear. These we don’t need any longer, see.

goal.en: Show this mineral to Mohr in Gipat's Windswept Foothills.

startText.en: You wipe off the dust from your finding. The ancient stone is glistening dully. It looks like a genuine June treasure. What is it meant for? You should ask the Wormfaces about that. Mohr is the keeper of this mystery. He knows what this is worth.

checkText.en:
Orcs started ghost-hunting competitions. I say let them have their fun while distracting citizens from their Chosen Path.
I sit here studying everyone's behavior. While the Empire inhabitants shoot boars all day, the League slowly progresses its faction's reputation.

finishText.en:
Well done!
As soon as the League ships find their way to this allod, it'll feel more like home.

goal.en: Place two Lantern Beams on the side of each shore and report back to Boris Kuznetsov.

startText.en:
I'm so happy to meet you. There seems be many Imperial citizens here.
At first I dove into the bushes at first site of Imperials, but later thought "What an idiot, we are at a Truce here. I have to admit I do feel safe among the Orcs' watch - very convenient to work in such conditions. The only thing bugging me is the scarcity of my League brothers and sisters! The League ships need to find the way to Gipat. Maybe you can help.
Set the signal lighthouses on the shore. Doing this will divert you from the your Chosen path temporarily, but will greatly benefit the League! There are petrified skeletons of sea monsters on the shore. That is the best place for the lighthouses.

checkText.en: Did you find 10 Ruby Minerals?

finishText.en:
Fine. Now you can choose your reward.
Only a select few are privileged to wear this attire.

goal.en: Bring 10 Ruby Minerals to Mohr in the June Catacombs.

startText.en:
During your journey in June Catacombs you can find ancient minerals. Some of them are valuable and others are not. As for me, I'm looking for Ruby Minerals. If you gather 10 Ruby Minerals, bring them to me. I can offer you a decent reward.
You can find ancient minerals in special boxes protected by dangerous enemies. There are also other types of minerals can be found in those boxes, such as Crimson Minerals. They are less valuable, but we need them too. I will exchange 20 Crimson Minerals for one Ruby Mineral. Keep it in mind, as you are hunting for treasures of the dead nation...

checkText.en: Did you find 10 Sun Minerals?

finishText.en:
Fine. Now you can choose your reward.
Only a select few are privileged to wear this attire.

goal.en: Bring 10 Sun Minerals to Mohr in the June Catacombs.

startText.en:
During your journeys in the June Catacombs you will find ancient minerals. Some of them are valuable and others are not. As for me, I'm interested in Sun Minerals. If you gather 10 of them, bring them to me, and I will offer you a decent reward.
You can find ancient minerals in special boxes protected by dangerous enemies. There is also Malachite and other types of minerals, less valuable but still useful for our people. I will exchange 20 Malachite Minerals for one Sun Mineral. Keep it in mind, as you are hunting for the treasures of the dead nation...

checkText.en: Well, how's it going? Found any minerals?

finishText.en: I'll be damned, you've made it! Well then, you take the suit, I take the minerals, as agreed. Now you look almost like a real astral pirate, haha!

goal.en:
Hey, buddy! Listen, I've got something to say. Did you ever happen to visit June Catacombs? If the answer's yes, then I have a job for you! That terrestrial cuttlefish Mohr is looking for sun minerals and offers lots of interesting stuff in exchange for them. I got an idea... I know how we both can benefit from it.
In short, bring me twenty minerals of that sort, and I'll give you a pirate cloak in exchange! You won't find that cloak anywhere else, I swear!

startText.en: Bring 20 sun minerals to Artem Shiryaev in the Gipat Ruins.

checkText.en: Well, how's it going? Found any minerals?

finishText.en: I'll be damned, you've made it! Well then, you take the suit, I take the minerals, as agreed. Now you look almost like a real astral pirate, haha!

goal.en: Bring 20 Sun Minerals to Artem Shiryaev.

startText.en:
Yo, buddy! Listen up! You've ever been to the June catacombs? I've got work for you. This Mohr scumbag trades all kinds of curious stuff for ruby minerals.
So, I've got this idea how both of us can get profit... Bring me 20 Sun minerals, and I'll swap them for a pirate costume! A rare one!

checkText.en: Well, how's it going? Found any minerals?

finishText.en: I'll be damned, you've made it! Well then, you take the suit, I take the minerals, as agreed. Now you look almost like a real astral pirate, haha!

goal.en:
Hey, buddy! Listen, I've got something to say. Did you ever happen to visit June Catacombs? If the answer's yes, then I have a job for you! That terrestrial cuttlefish Mohr is looking for sun minerals and offers lots of interesting stuff in exchange for them. I got an idea... I know how we both can benefit from it.
In short, bring me twenty minerals of that sort, and I'll give you a pirate costume in exchange! You won't find that costume anywhere else, I swear!

startText.en:
Yo, buddy! Listen up! You've ever been to the June catacombs? I've got work for you. This Mohr scumbag trades all kinds of curious stuff for ruby minerals.
So, I've got this idea how both of us can get profit... Bring me 20 Ruby minerals, and I'll swap them for a pirate costume! A rare one!

checkText.en: Did you manage to focus the stone on our portal? Are demons dead?

finishText.en:
That's great. Now we move forward.
Hurry up, demons are coming in. Soon they may reach the Village and the Performance will be in jeopardy...

goal.en: Activate the June portal with your Adventurer's Stone, clear any demons guarding the portal, and return to Lord Zullo.

startText.en:
All right, now the connection between our minds is strong. We can talk.
Those dragon spirits' fears came true. Demons have already swarmed the cave. What's worse, they attacked when many Chosen Ones are near the end of their Path.
This will just prove to be another hurdle that Chosen Ones must pass. Even you have come this far. You cannot give up now!
You need to reach the final ruin and meet up with its dragon guide . It will be no easy task. First, you will have to clear the far June portal of demons and focus your stone on it.

checkText.en: So, the device works? The cultists are suitable for Osip's request?

finishText.en:
I thought as much. The device is silent. It means that their power is weak.
We should find another candidate...

goal.en: Use the Heart of Succubus on 5 cultists to measure their vital force.

startText.en:
Where to find a suitable subject body...
We are lucky to have collected the demons' gel to continue with the ritual. We are even more lucky to have cultists roaming around the caverns. The cultists so kindhearted straddle around in their whole-bodied selves... Hehe, a sense of humor can save the presence of mind even in such desperate situations like ours.
Take this succubus heart. This is a unique but handy artifact!
Use it to measure the vital force of its target. If the heart starts pulsating frequently, it means that the object is "fit". Apply it to the cultists and check if their bodies suit our needs.

checkText.en: Power of word may be more dangerous than power of sword.

finishText.en:
Yes, these are the pages we need. Now we are back in control.
Thank you for your help.

goal.en: Get 8 Scenario Pages fighting against demon cultists and bring them to Lord Zullo.

startText.en:
Now that you know more about caves of Gipat, I want to assign you another task.
Every performance has its foundation. Scenario. Few pages contain hidden power of future representation. Believe me, this is a very important document. After reading it, you can learn about the future.
It's unfortunate that our scenario was stolen during one of their assaults. Our common enemy wants to know our future plans to counter our course of action.
Loss of scenario is a hard blow to the Performance. This will make us revise our plans and we would have to rewrite it from scratch.
In the near future, the information contained in its pages will lose its value, but not immediately. That's why we want it returned as soon as possible.
It is known that demons' cultists posses them now. Enemy knows about our plans and is ready to prevent it, so be careful. We must have the Scenario back in our grasp.

checkText.en: The more information you have about your enemy, the easier it is to defeat them.

finishText.en:
I'm glad that your perseverance has given results. Just as I requested.
Thank you.
Now I need only to compare these sparks with those of other citizens of Sarnaut. But that's another story...

startText.en:
I helped you deal with Osip's situation and in response, I hope you can return the favor.
We will have to cross paths with demons once more. They will prevent your kind from gaining Revelation again and again. So we must be prepared to battle with demons. Do you know a lot about them?
I know much more than you, but not everything. Will you help enhance my knowledge?
What's important to me is knowing if demons possess a spark. All living creatures living in Sarnaut posses it, and you already know that demons are not aliens from another world. This means that they should have a spark, right? We will find it out.
I'm sure it won't be easy. If a spark exists, it is hidden deep. Take this artifact. It should let you extract sparks from demons' ashes. I'm almost sure that it is there. If your attempts fail, do not despair. You should find their remains eventually.
I strongly recommend that you use my artifact only on the strongest and most dangerous demons. I'm talking about blazing and fierce demons. Mizra the Wicked will be ok too. Using the artifact against other breeds will only reward you with dust.

checkText.en: Unfortunately, too many of us have fallen in battle. I am sure it won't take you long to find the bodies lying around...

finishText.en:
So, the books are collected. I will read you a passage from "Domestication". It should hopefully give you the answer.
"When the hunting season is open, deer becomes lizard. When the boats ship out, fish become seashells. When glaciers approach, elephants become mammoths. Slay the part of yourself that is known to the enemy. Let them triumph. The rest of your remaining will create a new self not recognized by death".
Still confused? All right, I have one more hint for you.

goal.en: Find the bodies of the fallen leaders and bring their Journals to Lord Zullo.

startText.en:
You want to know who we are... I would like to know the answer to this question. The real answer...
Do you remember the words of ancient legends? "There is much great knowledge if it is obtained without a fight. It is gained by someone else through suffering and given to you as a loan. If it is gained without diligence, you will never realize its value to find a use of it".
I will direct you and you will find the answers to your questions by yourself.
Many of us have fallen in battle with demons. We have experienced much hardship but acquired valuable knowledge over time. Find the bodies of the fallen and bring me their personal journal records. They will give you the first clue to discovering the answers.

checkText.en:
Did you manage to gather measures of Astral power dioxide?
I mean, "Astral gel"...

finishText.en:
Great... This gel is enough to resurrect Osip and we will have a bit left to fill a pipe if time allows it...
All we need now is to find a new body. As you understand, nobody will willingly give it up. That's why the body should be taken from someone to whom you do not feel sympathy to not burden your conscience.
Maybe you have some valid candidates? You continue to forget I can read your mind. The League and the Empire are allies now. Your current thoughts are not an option.

checkText.en: Have you renewed the Mages' power yet? Hurry up! If our mages energy runs dry, then we won't be able to stop the demon invasion!

finishText.en:
Few more precious minutes redeemed from death...
Why are you still here? That task alone will not solely impress our Masters. You will have to try harder if you want to earn our trust.

goal.en: Create 3 Wormface Ammunition and deliver them to the three Wormface Mages.

startText.en:
I see you are interested in magical things that we sell, eh? First, you will have to prove that you can be trusted with such powerful artifacts. Earn our trust by your deeds and you can dress self in our armor and wield weapons of your choosing.
A few of our combat mages hold back the army of demons at the edge of the ravine. I need brave souls to deliver them more magical charges, so they can continue fighting the good fight. We create our magic from Astral materials, which can be extracted from demons. Force, of course.
As soon as collect some Astral samples, bring them back here and toss them into this Death Bowl. Eventually the magical charges will solidify for you to take to our mages on the field.

checkText.en: I've heard a loud crumbling - was that clamor from my mana bombs? Or was that just another collapse?

finishText.en:
I probably went overboard with the power of the charges. At least the bridge is still intact for our usage. No worries, the bridge carries ancient history. It was enchanted by dragons, so it will endure the biggest explosions.
By the way, I managed to collect three more bombs. Would you like to see fireworks again?

goal.en: Plant four magic bombs on the bridge across the ravine, and detonate the bombs from a safe distance. Report back to Lord Krosus when you have completed your mission.

startText.en:
The most fierce battles rage on to gain control of that damned bridge across the gorge. Every hour our forces exchange blows with demons back and forth.
 We need to achieve ownership of that passage way in order to gain advantage over the demons! I prepared some magic bombs. Sneak on to the bridge when the next wave of demons come our way and plant them in the perfect spot. The stone slabs at the edges of the bridge should fit nicely.
Be sure to move away to a safe distance, wait for the demons run across the bridge, and detonate away!

checkText.en:
Is the beast finally dead? Is the portal closed?
Hurry up if you don't want demons to flush us out!

finishText.en:
They will need some time to open the portal again. This will give us a break.
As for your reproachful look... I heard one story. One famous troupe performed its play many times. With each performance, it proved to be difficult to maintain their reputation and consistency. One after another, exhausted actors started to leave until only a few remained. They performed their last performance with a full house, and went to another theater.
The way the story ends is that they worked as ordinary stage engineers to help young actors perform greatly, and they were able to keep putting on great shows while keeping their troupe together.
I hope you found that tale to be inspiring, Chosen One. They had their chance. Now the stage belongs to you.

goal.en: Find the Astral portal in the caves behind the ravine and kill 10 Cruel Predators along with the Kixxar the Keeper.

startText.en:
We have found the portal that provides passage for the demons. It is further in the caves behind the ravine. We need to close this festering wound! Kill cruel predators, and most importantly, the portal guardian, Kixxar the Keeper . The fierce beast is what keeps the portal open although it drains some of its strength, but it is still a very lethal opponent.
Why do I send you? Well, all of our warriors are busy with fending on demons from entering this safe haven, and I am just an ordinary craftsman.
You, however, are the Chosen One who strives to earn our trust. Here is the chance to show the Lords who's boss!

checkText.en: Is the portal cleared? We need to try to ease the way for other Chose Ones so that demons can't prevent them from playing their role in the Performance.

finishText.en:
I am obliged to you for your help. Allow me to explain the essence of what's left of your Path.
I remember one legend... Once a wise man asked his friend to present him a treasure chest. After receiving the gift, he did not open it, saying: "I may have only one handful of gold, glittering stones, or ancient vase. But until I open the chest, the treasure is mine." When the sage died, his son, nevertheless, opened the chest. There lay only one note. "I knew that you would never open the chest. And if you do open it - it wouldn't belong to you any more."
That wise man knew the value of mystery, the question without the answer. You think that only the answers are valuable, and crave them.
Let your ignorance protect you until you obtain enough power to withstand the truth.

goal.en: After asking Lord Zullo to send you to the portal, kill 4 Vile Demon Mages guarding the final portal.

startText.en:
Your mind is torn from the questions that need answering. You will never hear my shouting even with all that clutter in your head. My voice is drowned among endless cries: your fears, dreams, guesses...
You must understand that it is not answers, but the questions themselves contain the real knowledge. There is one legend... Never mind. Now is not the time for tales.
You have to go to the ruins of the next portal and cleanse it of foulness. As soon as you get there, you will find yourself under extreme pressure. Unpleasant feeling, I should say. You'll find a wave of resistance guarding this next portal since it's the shortest way to the ancient June temple, the final destination where Revelation waits for you.
Activate the second portal and clear any demons preventing you from escaping. Inform me once you have succeeded, so I can prepare to send you to your final destination.

checkText.en:
You have to activate enough golems to hold the remains of demons away from the central hills.
I am increasingly worried that many Chosen Ones will not have time to finish their Path.

finishText.en:
Very efficient devices, aren't they? They're composed of an extremely sophisticated system and complex algorithm. That's why it is difficult for others except the creator to command the golems. Zem, despite his breakthrough in mechanics and prosthetics, failed to create anything like that.
I can already see a spark of understanding in your eyes. The answer has not yet surfaced from your subconscious, but it is already inside you. Give it time to settle.

startText.en:
I promised to give you one more hint of our secret identity. Take this rod and activate it with the help of ancient golem guards. Their ancient battle exhausted their forces. You need to recharge them.
Bringing the rusted back to life will help lead you the right way.

checkText.en: Only one who can put up with the enemy and look beyond one's differences for the sake of the eternal peace is heading to the Chosen Path of greatness!

finishText.en: I am proud of you and believe in your peaceful intentions. The Chosen Path is open to you!

goal.en: With all eyes on you, march to the center of these Ruins, and smash the Weapon of War. Bring its remnants to the Spirit of Peace.

startText.en:
Gipat is a peaceful land.
Gaze at the lush terrain. When a hunter kills a wolf to feed himself, it is an act of enmity. Ath-Zak's Chosen Path was to cleanse Gipat of many dangers. Those who help finish what he has started will gain Revelation.
With all the bloodshed that exists in Sarnaut, we must leave those troubles behind. The past wars have established the races' pre-determined roles that blind them from Revelation. It doesn't benefit a man to kill another man, or for a mighty Orc to raise an axe on his Gibberling foes. Elves create magical wonders while Arisen carry messages about the meaning of the death to all beings. Nobody is created to kill just as no one is created to die before one's time.
Great truth is earned by putting down one's sword and lending one's free hand to yesterday's enemy. Prove that knowledge is power. Take this Weapon of War to the center of these Ruins, and shatter it within sight of all in sign of a Great Truce.

finishText.en:
Ah, the enemy...
Finish me off if you want.
Do the work of demons. I wouldn't expect less of any Imperial scum!

goal.en: Find the League Chosen and save him. Report to Lord Dray after.

startText.en:
Now you respect the League as a powerful ally, but you have take a step further and understand that they are the same beings like you. They also have their fears and hopes, talents and shortcomings. And perhaps, in time, you can accept and love them as if they were your allies.
I want compassion to help you make the first step towards love. Chosen of the League needs your help. Help him like you help your own kind.

checkText.en: One thing I ask you, Tensess... Don't let me die without being avenged!

finishText.en:
What do you feel when you save your former enemy's life? It is not so much unnatural but a noble action of which you are really proud!

Have you ever had Kanian pancakes while washing them down with Gibberling malted beer? Have you ever had a chance to listen to a symphony written by an Elf and performed by a string quartet? It's all ahead of you, and it is going to take you to cloud number nine.

The Spark cannot resist beauty, whatever the source. Beauty is the sole uniting force!

name.en: Avenging the Chosen One of the League

startText.en:
Demons... They wounded me... It hurts...
You're not going to finish me off? That's rather odd for a representative of the Empire.
Then listen! Once our ancestors fought together against these Astral incarnates! It's time for to join forces once again!
Avenge me, kill the slimy demons and their leader. It was they who...

checkText.en: Did the lamp help you to fight against demons? The power of light can blind, but don't let its power dope you.

finishText.en:
So, the lamp was tested and I see you are reluctant to return it. This is good.
Unfortunately, demons of the new breed carry so much darkness inside that no lamp can dissipate it... They seem to shrug off Tensess' influence, and you feel his support no more. Despair may shake the faith of even the most genuine followers. I am sure the Church will find the way to deal with them.
Do you now understand why it is so important for the Empire to act in cooperation with the League? Combining the fruits of scientific thought from the ZIT and the achievements of the Church, you will become the strongest alliance in history. Think about it. Is it not tempting?

startText.en:
My name is Lord Dray as I am responsible for ensuring the orchestra of Chosen Ones play consistently without a hitch. Otherwise, we all fail at the premiere. Prove that the Empire is ready to reject hatred and prejudices, and I will consider your alliance proposal.
This lamp has been hanging in front of the altar of Novograd church for years. It was fanned by the breath of Tensess listening to parishioners' prayers. It keeps their hopes high in hard times and it generates strong compassion for their families thanks to the merciful Tensess. Light it and present it to the Great Mage. Agree to become his punishing sword in struggle with astral spawn.
This artifact will help you to fight with demons, but more importantly, it will give you a chance for feel respect for your enemy.

finishText.en:
How do you feel saving your former enemy's life? Besides the unnatural feeling that you're proud of your nobility, huh?
Have you ever been to Nezebgrad? Have you ever admired the grand Xadaganian architecture and awesome monuments where one can see fresh flowers everyday? Have you been fortunate to see the elevation in the eyes of Orcs that have just scored a winning goal or studied philosophic works of Zem?
Admiration of Imperial citizens' devotion, bravery, and desire to learn will help you to step over the existing hostility. Shared values - that's what can unite our two factions.

goal.en: Find the Chosen One of the Empire that needs help and save him. The results must be informed to Lord Dray.

startText.en:
Now you respect the Empire as a powerful ally, but you have take a step further and understand that they are the same beings like you. They also have their fears and hopes, talents and shortcomings. And perhaps, in time, you can accept and love them as if they were your allies.
I want compassion to help you make the first step towards love. Chosen of the Empire needs your help. Help him like you help your own kind.

checkText.en: I will gather my strength, get up and break their necks... But I need to understand, where is neck on demons' bodies!

finishText.en:
What? You have done all my work?
Well! Nice lad! Despite the fact that you are from the League.

name.en: Avenging the Chosen One of the Empire

startText.en:
Damn, how could I let this happen to me?
I was attacked by a horde of demons - trampled, slashed! Now I'll rise and kick all your asses!
...I can't!
The League is already here! You like to see me suffering, don't you? No help from you...
What? You're willing to take revenge for me?
Ha... then try. Demons that ruined me were Brutal Predators - and their leader, Ku'fan the Abyssal. Avenge me if you can.

checkText.en: So, how convenient is the translocator? After killing demons with it, you will wish you always have it when you bust demons.

finishText.en:
So, the device has been tested and I see you are reluctant to return it. That's good. Unfortunately, it is almost useless against the demons of the new breed. They are already more capable of staying in our world, but I'm sure that with time, scientists of Zem will invent something against them.
Do you now understand why it is so important for the League to act in cooperation with the Empire? Combining the achievements of your church and the fruits of scientific thought from the ZIT, you will become the strongest alliance in history. Think about it. Is it not tempting?

startText.en:
My name is Lord Dray as I am responsible for ensuring the Chosen One's orchestra plays consistently note by note. Otherwise, we all fail on the first night. Prove that the Empire is ready to reject hatred and prejudice, and our alliance will be signed.
This device was developed by the leading scientists of the Empire in ZIT. It generates the flow of anti-Astral elementary particles opposed to typical Astral components. Demons are known to weaken outside their native environment, such as hippos without water. Under the radiance of this translocator, demons start losing their power faster. Strange environment forces them out.
This device will help you to fight against demons, but most importantly, gives you a chance to feel respect for your enemy.

checkText.en: What do you want?

finishText.en:
Hm...
Taking into account the Lords can manipulate golems and June portals as well as demons who sensed you as "cursed" plus possessing Zullo's amulet, we can only come to one conclusion: You have had the honor to meet the last of the Junes!
They insisted you were led to this conclusion, but I can't believe it. We can use June heritage too although we are not strong enough to repeat their achievements.
At least we now have this amulet... I think I know what to do with it.

goal.en: Meet Zayan de Desirae, leader of Historians on Avilon, and give him Lord Zullo's Amulet.

startText.en:
It's time to say good-bye. We will surely meet again at the Performance, but now you have to go. I ask you to inform Zayan de Desirae everything you have found out about us. It is unlikely you will ever find a wiser being able to understand everything that has taken place here.
I'm sure that he will resist everything as you first did, but when the time comes, he will be ready to accept the truth.
Here, take my precious amulet which will make it easier for him to believe. It's the same amulet that helped you summon demons near the Astral break. Give it to Zayan. I'm sure he'll know what to do with it.
We asked you to be patient before, now it's time for us to have patience. We will wait until you are ready. When that time comes, demons will cry for their incoming destruction. Let faith in this day connect us wherever you go.
Take care, Chosen One. Remember the lessons of the Path.

finishText.en:
People! Today is a great day for our village! We all remember the legend of the Chosen One that is to rise from the Kansha Ruins, and look, you are now among us!
Make haste now! Bring our finest food, best accommodation, and sincere respect. That's what we have to offer for the Chosen One! It is written that you are our rescuer and defender. Look at that brave face. You laugh in the face of danger!
Am I right? You'll manage, won't you?

goal.en: Find the way to Gipatia and speak to the elder, Sergey Rybakov.

startText.en:
Welcome to our remote and peaceful allod.
Only here you can find exotic species of thick-skinned boars and putrid spitting toads. For many centuries, their solitary kind accompany our placid life on Gipat. At the foot of the mountains lies a cultured village. Its Elder, Sergey Rybakov, amiably welcomes all who walk the Chosen Path.
What is the Chosen Path? It is the path you create with every step you take. Your actions determine your destiny. In the end, you will earn Revelation!
My colleagues and I will help guide you. Be mindful of what we say and pay attention!
Now take the first step down the road laid before you by the Great Ath-Zak. It was he who found Gipat and cleared the way for people to forge their destiny.
If you ever want to return home, look for the Ruined June Portal's beaming light. Also be sure to hold onto that mysterious stone you've got there. It is your one way ticket back to Gipat.
Perhaps you will encounter other travelers who have lost their way. Push them in the right direction but remember that forging your path is top priority. Now is your time to shine!

checkText.en:
Have you seen the light yet?
I asked two individuals before to be my test subjects on this resurrection ordeal. Nobody returned back to their old self. They all became ghosts! Cross my heart and hope not to transform!

finishText.en:
What?! You're still... You. Not even a scar!
All right, I believe you. You've given me strength to get out there and exercise these metal joints. Maybe I'll go slash some boars or something.

goal.en: Die, come back from Purgatory, and tell your death experience to Sarbaz Sobekneferu.

startText.en:
Have you ever experienced fear of death?
Oh, I'm so scared. Do you notice all the wandering souls? Look around you. We kill wild boars and they come back to life! However, they don't resurrect back to their normal form, but in some ghostly state! This got me thinking how revival works here.
I don't want to be a ghost! In fact, I miss my old human body. Those were the good old days. Ladies used to be all over my masculine physique. Unfortunately, all good things come to an end... Look what's become of me? Clothed with metal scraps although it's these sharp shards that keep me breathing. If I am forced to drift in the wind as a cloudy spirit... Forget about it!
I wish there was something or someone that could test my curiosity. Hey! How about you take a one way trip to the Purgatory and show me if you come back in one piece?

checkText.en:
Did you manage to find out about Ath-Zak?
I constantly hear this name of who he is and what he has done. They say he collected himself among the ruins of the temple, and that the bulk of this area is his doing?

finishText.en: Ah, there you are... It is always difficult to be one with the crowd as a minotaur. Thank you for help. I will continue on my Path and speak well of you.

goal.en: Ask Cyrano de Blizare, Gella Stulova, and Orichka the Wily about Ath-Zak and return to Stonehoof the Wanderer.

startText.en:
Hello there!
For once in a long time, I'm glad. I never would have thought that you would come near me especially with people seeing our minotaur kind as stupid and wild creatures. I am more than just brute strength. I learned to read and write in Pridonsk, and have earned the title of Demon Hunter!
I'll live up to the expectations and go the Chosen Path. Unlike Orcs who hunt boars and Kanians to cause commotion among the Ruins, I'll never leave the Chosen Path! But I know nothing about this Ath-Zak fellow. Nobody has heard anything about him back in Pridonsk. What about you?
I think there are those who would know like those travelers over there. I doubt that they'll tell me. Everyone thinks I am clever enough with my determination for Revelation. I can see you have a kind heart. If you find out something, will you share it with me?

checkText.en:
I hope those buggers leave our ruins alone after you deal with them. Why can't they go tag rocks in the mountains where they belong?
Bunch of troublemakers!

finishText.en:
I heard the vandals' fearful screams of agony in the distance hehe. Thank you!
Here is a little something for protecting my precious stones.

goal.en: Scare away 5 Orcish Miscreants around the Kansha Ruins with the Scream-In-The-Box and return to Kalis.

startText.en:
Hello! I've come to Gipat to uphold this ruins' history with my mighty brush and my prideful touch. I need to remake the existing patterns . I thought ancient ruins were free of civilian touch. What a naive aviak I am!
Bolting around earlier on my rounds, I freak out to see the ruins scarred with inscriptions: "Nezeb lived, Nezeb lives, and Nezeb will live on!" And don't get me started on what other unforgivable marks were scratched on the walls! We must do something! We can't let the history of these ruins be soiled with hooligans' lack of respect! Will you help me?
Confront the vandals and scare them away. Take this scream-in-the-box to assist you. Make sure you point it away when you wind it up...

checkText.en: I had limited space to bring these wares. It was between buckwheat honey or sandals to Gipat. Adventurers need to travel in comfort!

finishText.en:
Boy, what a bunch of speechless fools! What are we going to do now?
Stupid me! I should've brought the honey. No one minds healthy eating. That includes ghosts!
 We didn't make big profit although you seem to appreciate good comfort. Try these on for size!

goal.en: Offer birch sandals to the ghosts of Gipat upon for Kulo the Dealer.

startText.en:
Welcome, outlander! With new allods comes new clients. And new clients means profit! I have lugged traditional shoes all the way from Lightwood. Lot of shoes! I will make a pretty gold piece.
There's one problem though. I badly need an assistant. Don't worry, I'll share my profit with you if you find clients for my shoes. What we need are new clients. Try your sales charm among those weird ghostly figures at the foot of the stairs...

checkText.en: Everyone has his own Revelation. For me it's hard cash!

finishText.en:
Thanks!
You know you've got quite the trader in you. Perhaps you should consider that for your Chosen Path.

startText.en:
We are told that Gipat is the Path to Revelation. For me it is the way to get filthy rich!
Yeah, yeah! I don't care about this Revelation. Even if we learn something new, what's the point? Is it guaranteed to make our life easy and more complete? I don't think so. I see this Gipat place as a hunters' training ground. There is something materialistic to obtain.
Those curious magical Elves desire ghostly crab shells to create semi-transparent plate armor! Ha! Good luck with that. I never understand their winged-kind.
There are also the sought-after ghost boar fangs! Sharp, slender, and deadly... Perfect for forging a swift blade.
Come, join me in my path of bounty! Bring me shells and fangs. Make sure you bring them back in one piece!

checkText.en:
Magnificent!
These beautiful ruins really take your breath away when you get higher. The more we connect with these ancient stones, the more we will understand its history.

finishText.en:
I see, I see. The stones do not differ!
Yet, both type of stones are affected by different elements over centuries. One stone buried in the ground and worn with water, and the other stone pounded by the holy winds.
Only the all-knowing Great Mage Zayan's magic of Avilon can date these stones back to their origin. Thank you again. This is quite fascinating!

startText.en:
Bah! I'm so puzzled. I've heard the legend about Ath-Zak many times - waking from his memory loss and finding himself among small ruins. The ruins seem to be remnants of a wall and few columns from back then. But what do we see now? One huge structure! How?
It's known and obvious that ruins crumble over time and not grow...
Are you interested in this mystery? Let's investigate. Search the ruins from top to bottom. Bring me back any unusual stones you find.

checkText.en:
Holy water will do the trick! Let's do it at last!
Let the Light shine upon these haunted ruins! Let the darkness fade away into nothingness!

finishText.en:
I am grateful for your help!
It's rumored there's an ancient village nearby. Go there quickly before night falls.
What devil brought me to the very end of this world to the land of apparitions? And that Ath-Zak... How am I to look up to someone with a name that doesn't sound Kanian at all?!

goal.en: Sprinkle 4 columns in each corner of the Ruins with Divine Water for Anatoly Borschevsky.

startText.en:
Demon tricks! It's all demon tricks I tell you! Listen, everyone! Calling all citizens with ears and more importantly, pure hearts!
What is the Chosen Path? Where does it lead to? Why are there so meany ghostly creatures? What has become of Gipat? It is a dark, rotting place with no holy church or inn for people to commune as one. There's nothing but musty fog and wailing wandering ghosts.
See the salvation! It is time to follow the path of salvation and rid of the evil that makes us blind! Take this holy water! Sprinkle it on the demonic ruins! May the healing light lead us out of darkness and into the light!

checkText.en:
Oh, those ghostly beasts!
My hands tremble as I feel their heavy presence surrounding us.

finishText.en:
So there are no more boars by the Ruins?
Now I can come closer to picture that illusion from another angle. I am so grateful to you and your appreciation of art!
Now, please don't obstruct the view.

startText.en:
Have a look! What a view - crumbled walls, pillars of tragedy! What do you think happened here centuries ago?
Suppose it was a temple and inside were corrupt priests ripping the hearts right out of Gibberlings' chests! Maybe this was a palace where a caged young Elf waited for her prince charming mounted on a mystical dragon to free her, and soar into the moonlit night. Or rather she was traded to a foul ogre to fulfill his nasty intentions.
Ah, what an inspiration! I've just pictured the final scene. Trembling Elf at the edge of the allod, her hair uncurling and the majestic palace behind...
But... these ugly animals... boars, their smothering aura ruins my fantasy!
Would you kindly remove them from my sight so I can continue daydreaming?

checkText.en:
Well, how do you like our mead? Warm and bubbly, eh?
We really want to know what the Orcs think. We want to see how it'll affect their awareness...

finishText.en:
Well, no more beer left, it's time to go.
No, wait. Off we go! That sounds better... Hic.

goal.en: Treat everyone with a glass of mead upon the Tipsy Family's request.

startText.en:
Weird place, isn't it? What are you looking for here? Revelation? Pfff, big deal!
Who knows, maybe this Ath-Zak character never existed at all. Have you seen him? We sure haven't! Back at the Frozen Frontier inns, there are juicier rumors more worthy of our time! I bet you two to one that all this nonsense is to attract tourists. And maybe even worse... Hic.
Well, assuming this Ath-Zak guy is floating around, beer is on us. We've brought the best mead in all of Sarnaut. It's our treat. Come now, let's raise our glasses. The path... leads to... the Chosen Path!

checkText.en: In an era of menace, it's unbelievable to sleep by the fire and be afraid of being beaten by birch rods in a bathhouse where there isn't a single hint of cleanliness!

finishText.en: Are you don't spreading the influence? Thank you! A great task has been accomplished!

goal.en: Give a speech in the Ruins on behalf of Oxana Fedorova.

startText.en:
Oh, the distress! My heart bleeds of utter sorrow for all these League citizens. If conflict amongst the races continue, I can't imagine what will destroy the country first: the nobles' selfish actions or population will be swept away by alcoholism and syphilis.
How is it possible to drink today while ignoring order and morals?
Hey you, country bumpkins! I am just trying to tell the truth!
Hm, people don't seem to be listening to me. Help me! Raise yourself to get the crowds' attention and tell everybody the truth of our unrest!

checkText.en:
Aha, you think you're so tough from picking on less-skilled warriors from the Holy Land?!
Try your strength against me! Let's see who's better at cracking crabs! I'm the greatest warrior and hunter! Who do you think you are?

finishText.en:
Well, didn't that feel good? The Truce isn't going to stop those who were born to fight!
Best of luck on your Path!

Here's another dead body! Orc stripped of his decency!
Let's take a closer look.

goal.en: Find the murderer of Eric de Vevre.

startText.en:
Hey you! Have a look here. Maybe my eyes deceive me, but I stumbled upon this fallen Elf!
I think he's dead! Can you see marks of boar fangs or wolf claws? Me neither!
What could of caused this unnatural death? Did the dragon spirits lie to us? What happened to the Truce we were assured upon arriving at Gipat?
How are we expected to stroll these trails without turning our head every minute? There's only unspeakable way of dealing with this. Find the renegade killer and punish him! For the sake of peace!

checkText.en:
Gipatia is the center of fate. Here is the center ground for all roads and all threads are interwoven here.
Now you are standing in the front the door of your legacy.

finishText.en:
The road leading to Gipatia is open to you now.
Calm your emotions, take a breath, and enter...

goal.en: Summon and defeat the Phantom Goblin as Ath-Zak once did outside the entrance of Gipatia, and report to the Spirit of Courage.

startText.en:
