This is the last test before the gates of Gipatia. This is where Ath-Zak found goblins roaming around the pasture. They stood like a wall in their overwhelming masses. He lifted his bronze knife and inflicted a crushing blow to the back of a goblin's head. The goblin fell and his companions quaked with fear!
Many of you are here to fulfill the Chosen Path. That's why goblins are here too. But don't get too cocky. They won't hold back like how they did with Ath-Zak. These goblins have grown to be more fierce over time.
This is the last easy step compared to what you will have to face down the road. It's all uphill from here. Every move will take energy and every turn will drain your life force.

checkText.en: Is everything clear?

finishText.en:
Perfect. Everything is falling into place as foreseen.
I'm taking away the artifact you used to get here, as you are now allowed to use the portal of Gipat.
If you have questions, you know where you can find me.

goal.en: Ask Spirit of Resolve about the Chosen Path.

startText.en:
You've proven yourself to my colleagues and you have earned your way into our village.
The Chosen Path leads through Gipatia. This is where Ath-Zak had unique interactions with many people. They faithfully served him, traded him, and even deceived him.
By following Ath-Zak's path, you are the Chosen One now! Go through all his perils: suffer his pain, smile from his joy, feel his disappointment, and burn with his love.
Do you want to know more? Talk to me and I'll tell you all you need to know in order to move forward.

finishText.en:
Look who's sulking! Your face is flushed with rage. What's wrong?
Well, yes, it was me who sprayed the Brave ones with acid. You got a problem with that? It was fair play.
I had to avenge my friend.

goal.en: Confront Yaver Useranat who killed Erl's Family.

startText.en:
Yeah, we attacked that Xadaganian loser, but the Brave Family are definitely not murders. It was him who beat down our friend Maxim Kulakin, so we retaliated.
And to think, we had just started our Chosen Path. Now I am all alone...
Great ghost!
There he is, there he is! Murderer of my brothers! Damned Yaver Useranat.
How can I get my revenge now? When Elm always protected the three of us with his shield, and Edge aimed the bow while I pulled the arrow?
To hell with the Truce! I'll choke the damn bastard!

finishText.en:
Listen, do you have any extra drops of mirra? I'm short of it. Yeah, yeah, that was my corpse back near the ruins. I just returned from Purgatory as you can see.
What? No, no grudge against anyone. I shouldn't of picked a quarrel with that Orc. I'm still getting used to Gipat and the truce between both factions.

goal.en: Find Eric de Vevre around Gipatia and make sure he is alive.

startText.en:
Hear me out before you point fingers. The three of us were on our way to Gipatia with my assistant falling behind. That impatient Seaside went off the trail to fetch my assistant.
Then I heard shouting, steel clattering ahead of us. When we got to the scene, Seaside was already dead. Semyon was standing above him with blood-soaked hands. Where's the truce in that?! Well, we showed him. Maxim and I beat and fried his body to a crisp. He deserved it though. Kanian scum!
Wait, that's not the end of it. Before we could get far, that family of pipsqueaks poured out from the bushes and fired a volley of arrows! What did you think I was going to do? Just stand there and eat steel?
What? Eric de Vevre dead? Yeah, Seaside beat him even before this confusion started. That silly Elf picked the wrong Orc to gawk at. Relax, Eric resurrected awhile ago.
The rest of the Brave Family will also return from Purgatory soon, or did they not have any drops of myrrh left? Well, let that Erl weep for now. Don't you believe me? Eric seems to be around the village already. Find him and see for yourself.

finishText.en:
Oh! A new face! More fun for me! The more, the better!
That flying mongrel, I mean, that baby dragon didn't tag along with you, did it? I don't want to blow the good thing we have going on here.

goal.en: Find the illegal arena in the forest.

startText.en:
Don't you understand we can't live in peace? Most of us are frisky , eager individuals who invest gold on weapons and armor. How do you propose we release our ongoing stress? Shall we hunt boars all day? No, rational beings need to blow off steam in a good wrestling match. Maybe that's why I picked a fight with that oversized Orc.
Do you belong to those Truce cultists? I'll let you in on a little secret... We organized a kind of underground arena southwards from this village. It's deep in the forest covered up nicely by towering trees. But don't tell anybody especially those dragon spirits.
Don't get me wrong, we're all fighting towards the Chosen Path though we can't do without our guilty pleasure every now and then.

checkText.en:
I've had only one fight since I got to Gipat and I lost it. What a fail Orc I am. Shame on me!
I'm in poor shape. More training! As soon as we make the arena ready for all, I'm going to beat your asses up.

finishText.en:
Now even a bootlicker has no chance of discovering our arena! We are safe. Great battles will take place and many will travel to Gipat to witness our underground playground.
If we're expected to exist without being able to bash things with our fists, then to hell with the Chosen Path! I hate the hype with Ath-Zak! He died three hundred years ago. It's not worth making a fuss about it!

goal.en: Set up 4 Shaman Scarecrows on the edges of the arena for Seaside the Bloodthirsty.

startText.en:
Everybody brandishes fists after a good fight, win or lose! Why not join our secret club?
I have shaman scarecrows. I'd better plant them around the arena to scare away those winged spirits in case they show up. The scarecrows are so freaky! It'll make those dragon party-poopers flee in terror! Hopefully...
Well, if not, the puppets will distract them, and we will have time to run like hell!
Nah, they won't catch us. If they do, they will probably take our Signs of the Chosen, and I'll lose all my arena smash brothers! Since you are here, set up the scarecrows around the arena for me.
You don't have a choice. Resist and I'll give you a black eye!

checkText.en: I should have demanded more from that shaman. When I told him I can get his ghostly junk, his eyes were sparkling like hell.

finishText.en:
Yeah! Nice hunting!
There. It's your share of the gold. And something for the long road ahead.

startText.en:
You did such a great job with those ogres. Would you mind lending me another hand? Don't worry about goldy over there, we'll be discreet...
Have you seen the local wolves and toads? Disgusting creatures, eh? Although they are not useless.
One of my fellow shamans needs ghost toad eggs and wolf fangs. I didn't catch what for... Something about the Kingdom of Nature and new pagan potions. I have nothing to do with their crazy voodoo ways, but he said that he would pay well for collecting the necessary materials.
So, are you in? We'll share the profit. You know I'm good for my word!

checkText.en:
Ath-Zak stumbled from the ruins from his slumber only to find a fierce wolf blocking his path.
Only the one who kills the wolf can carry on with his Path.

finishText.en:
Yeah, Ath-Zak killed the wolf with two accurate strikes. Every new accomplishment on your Chosen Path will reward you with a Sign of the Chosen. This special medallion is made of bronze, the only element that Ath-Zak possessed on Gipat.
The more Signs you acquire, the closer you will be to your Revelation. Move onward, Chosen One!

goal.en: Follow the instructions of Spirit of the Rage, kill the wolf with the ritual bronze knife.

startText.en:
You are in the early stage of your Path. Much is in store for you and you will experience difficult tasks and dangerous challenges. The Path is not for the weak-spirited. Don't travel from the Path; believe in yourself; and you will finally attain great knowledge... Revelation!
Three hundred years ago the brilliant Chosen One, Ath-Zak, woke with nothing but a bronze knife in his hand. Follow us, repeat his actions. Ath-Zak didn't know who he was and what was in store for him. I assure you, great mystery is waiting to be unveiled by you, and you will be terrified by what you learn. However, he who follows the Path of the Chosen One will gain great power.
Onto the first step. A wolf blocked Ath-Zak directly in the middle of his Path. It was the first creature which he used his knife against, which stain his knife with blood. You are to survive this battle too, and Sign of Chosen will be the reward.

finishText.en: Ugh. Another corpse. Let me turn it over. Ouch! Magic! This poor Kanian had his eyeballs disintegrated from lightning charges. This doesn't make any sense. Who would do such a thing?

goal.en: Find the murderers of Eric de Vevre and Seaside the Bloodthirsty.

startText.en:
Poor Orc... Something stabbed him right through the chest, just like stabbing fish in a barrel.
His fractured skull and gashes seem to be caused from hammers and sword blows. Whoever did this certainly had help. I must find these violators of the Truce before more beings become victims of their twisted ways.

checkText.en:
Maybe there is some strange Purgatory freak out and their souls get lost between the worlds.
And I thought being an Arisen and rising from the dead that I would have seen everything in this lifetime...

finishText.en: What? No soul at all? Not a single one? What kind of heartless creatures are these?! Looks like I must continue my research. Please leave me. I cannot think with you blocking my thoughts.

name.en: No Room for the Breathing Dead

startText.en:
Who do these Anthropologists think they are trying to attract truth-seeking individuals with promises of some Revelation? I'm a scientist. I need facts, data, and proof before I take one step into some forsaken Path. I agreed to find an explanation how these ghostly creatures walk among the living without hindering the balance of nature.
Hear out my hypothesis. Disaster struck this allod and the Astral consumed everything! That could explain why sparks of the dead act as if these creatures were alive in their original state? It means that the poor things missed their death...
I have brought back Astral sparks from ZIT to test my hypothesis. If you want to help the investigation, please collect some sparks of these strange creatures. Let's try boars and toads!

finishText.en: Ugh, what do you want? Yes, I was wounded... by Gibberlings... the Brave Family to be precise... Three against one... what bastards...

goal.en: Find the killers of Eric de Vevre, Seaside the Bloodthirsty, and Semyon Gromov.

name.en: Investigation: Following the Tracks of the Gang

startText.en: I must put an end to this investigation once and for all! The multiple causes of death can only mean it was the doing of multiple killers. It was probably a gang of heartless scum. It won't be long until I smoke them out of the rock that they're hiding under!

finishText.en: Replicating Ath-Zak's actions is an important part of your Path. You have displayed great dexterity. Soon we will discover if you have enough courage to move forward. It won't be long until we see if you're worthy to enter Gipatia.

goal.en: Slither past Ogres like a cunning snake and meet Spirit of Bravery.

startText.en:
Hail to the Chosen One on his way to Revelation! Remember fighting is not always the solution. If we cannot dominate foes by force then outsmarting them is the preferred option. Cross this bridge and you will come across three horrible ogres. They beat their clubs in unison to make one's blood run cold.
Ath-Zak still recovering from the struggle with the wolf had no strength to fight the savages. He lay on his belly and carefully glided like a snake past the ogres.
Show me your expertise and outdo the giants as Ath-Zak once did. You'll eventually meet my fellow comrade along the road. Show him how stealthy you can be!

finishText.en: You truly are the Chosen one!

goal.en: Meet Spirit of Acceptance on the way to Gipatia.

startText.en: Your next step on the way to Revelation is meeting Spirit of Acceptance. The Chosen One was smart enough not to waste effort. Nobody could notice him move, not even the sharpest eye. You will have to learn this, too.

finishText.en:
No, why, oh why?! They are dead, my brothers are dead! We should have trusted our guts and not have opened the letter revealing the black stone that led us here.
What shall I do now? I'm all alone... Hey! Don't you trouble me! Who the heck are you? What do you want?

goal.en: Find the alleged murderers, the Family of the Brave ones.

startText.en: It was them... the Brave Family! The shooting, the hacking... It was horrible! I almost didn't make it out alive. Find them and teach them a lesson about the Truce. Please!

checkText.en: Our Roughneck Orc kind dare not "slither" past any challenge. We stop at nothing... Kill everything. Genocide on Gipat!

finishText.en: Good work! You're not as bad a hunter as I thought you would be! There's still two ogres but leave them to me. I'm hungry for more!

goal.en: Lure the Phantom Ogre to Roughneck clan hunters and take it down together.

startText.en:
What insolence!
You'll never catch me alive hiding from these ogres like some pitiful Gibberling! I am from the Roughneck Clan! I look death straight in the face and cleave everything in my way!
I have a plan. I call it "We'll cut our own path!" Ha!
Let's forget about this Chosen Path and just kill everything in Gipat! Every single living being! My clan all agree with me! This is the way for real hunters! Genocide will be our Revelation!
Lure one ogre to my brothers and dominate it together! Don't hold back! It's time for a slaughterfest!

finishText.en:
The Chosen Path conceals many dangerous situations, but even more trouble await those who turn from it. Once you start to drift from the Path, you may not be able to find your way back. Always remember that.
Ath-Zak will be far ahead so that catching up to his accomplishments will be impossible. You won't receive anymore Signs of the Chosen, Revelation will be discovered by others, and you will vanish in darkness all alone without knowing anything. Take a look into the river at your cloudy reflection. Is that your real fate?
I won't punish you... This time.
But listen to me carefully and heed my warning. Be wise and do not turn from the Path!

goal.en: Think about what's troubling Spirit of Bravery.

startText.en:
What are you doing, imbecile?!
Why are you deviating from the Path by helping that hate-driven Orc kill ogres? Such actions are not the same Path as the first Chosen One.
If you do not listen to our advice, we cannot help you achieve Revelation. Can you imagine what will wait for you in the end if you sink yourself down that low?

checkText.en:
I cannot progress with my Path without the Signs!
Who knows, maybe pigs have trampled my Signs deep in the mud.

finishText.en:
Oh, many thanks to you! I'll never forget what you've done for me!
Yes, they are all here! My precious...
I am the Chosen One again!

startText.en:
Woe is me!
You won't believe what happened! Look, there's a hole in the bag! I've lost half of my stuff, but that's not the worst part. Oh, no, no... I've lost my Signs of the Chosen!
What shall I do? I asked help from the dragon guides, but they said I'm too clumsy to be a Chosen One. My Path is blocked off now!
No way! Flying liar! I refuse to believe this is the end after all the troubles I have been through to get here! I'm asking, no, I'm begging you. Please help me? I've been all around this village. I've looked into boxes, chests, and barrels.
I went in search for some food to ease my hunger pains, but found only roaches. Maybe I should retrace my footsteps back over there in case my growling tummy distracted me from my search. If you come across my Signs, give them back to me!

checkText.en:
The village seems to be quite different from what I'd thought it would be!
Ah, what a luck it is to turn the time back and visit the place that others have only read about. All fantasies fade back to reality but this one! Who knows how precise the stories of Ath-Zak might be? We are going to find that out now!

finishText.en:
Well, let's see what we have here.
Flint is like any ordinary flint. The speech differs a bit from that in the biographies of Ath-Zak, but that is not surprising. And the pig is a typical ghostly creature like we have on Gipat.
I will send all this evidence to Zayan back in Avilon for his research. We have other business to attend to now.

goal.en: Buy a Chunk of Flint from Boris, record Sergey and Gorislav's conversation, and kick a Ghostly Pig for Delmon de Blizare.

startText.en:
Another Chosen One! Isn't it strange that so many individuals have come to Gipat to complete their Path?
I have been collecting the legends about Ath-Zak my whole life and I dared not to think that I would once see the myths coming alive. It's hilarious! Now I wonder how things work in Gipat.
Will you help me? I want to check if the legends come true literally. I'd like you to do three things.
First, buy a flint from Boris Polonsky.
Then you should sneak up at Sergey and Gorislav while they chat and activate this recording device.
And, finally, kick a village pig. Sounds random, huh? But that's exactly what Ath-Zak did when he arrived at Gipatia. I'm sure he did not do such a harsh act out of malice, because he was a good man.
So, will you help me?

checkText.en:
What's the status report?
If you cannot find out what the League is up to, give me all your Signs, and I will give this order to someone more worthy!

finishText.en:
Wonderful report!
Let's go over their plans: the League intends to host a contest among its citizens. Whoever is the first to achieve Revelation gets awarded a luxurious mansion in the heart of Novograd.
At least our plan with Nina is better - all for one! But it's better to mess around with the League during the process just for fun.

goal.en: Reach out to three League citizens: Romeo de Ardeur, Cheerful Family, and Polina Zaitseva. Romeo de Ardeur requires 5 Wildflowers, Cheerful Family needs a pair of birch sandals, and Polina Zaitseva wants a Mana Lantern. Learn everything they know about the League's plans and report to Viktor Tverdolobin.

startText.en:
Stop! Secret order for all Imperials. I'd like you to meet Nina Krasavina, an athlete and committee worker, and a very beautiful woman. We expect her to attain Revelation first and bring pride to the Empire.
Every single one of us should work toward Nina's success. We plan to have each Imperial member on their Path who have earned Signs of the Chosen to give them to Nina. The Empire should be the first to receive Revelation!
That's not all! We need to know what the League is planning and if they have a plan to get the Revelation before us. Not far from here there is a small League camp. We should gain their trust and learn everything. This important task is yours. If you are successful, we won't pressure you into giving your Signs to Nina.
There is an elf who fell in love, he's looking for Wildflowers for his beloved one. They are growing along the road to the Village - bring him at least five, and he will tell you everything.
Gibberlings need a new footwear - present them a pair of birch sandals, and they will be both grateful and talkative.
Polina Zaitseva is afraid of the dark... Why don't you get her a Mana Lantern to set her mind at rest? I heard Nezebrad smugglers sell one.
Is everything clear? Bring back good news.

checkText.en: The people I'm having you seek out are part of some committee. It's obvious that Empire has evil plans. Save us from darkness!

finishText.en:
Everything is clear.
Imperials are collecting Signs and giving them all to Nina Krasavina. If this persists, she will obtain Revelation faster than anyone from the League. Very valuable information. We must put a stop to their cheating ways!

goal.en: Reach out to three Imperial Citizens: Razh the Fearless, Sarbaz Neferkahor, and Arina Shakirova. Razh the Fearless requires a Stone Hammer, Sarbaz Neferkahor wants an exotic beer, and Arina Shakirova requires a Kanian Shawl. Learn everything they know about the Empire's plans and report to Laure de Grandeur.

startText.en:
Bless the light! Listen, it is very important for the League and its citizens to achieve Revelation first. Who knows what it entails!
Government promises to reward those who will be first. Luxurious mansion in the heart of Novograd is only a slice of the cake! So don't waste time. Forward to the Chosen Path!
I wish I could find out how much the Empire has accomplished so far. Something troubles me. Not far from here, Imperial citizens have settled. It's all so weird... Only yesterday we killed each other in the Holy Lands and today we walk by them and only raise eyebrows instead of swords. But they won't open their hearts to a Priest of the Church like me.
You seem neutral to this Truce. Perhaps you can find out the Empire's plans. Try to connect with them.
Razh the Fearless is always happy to try on a new weapon. Bring him a stone hammer in exchange for the information. I know a local trader sells one.
Sarbaz Neferkahor has run out of exotic beer. If you lend him a hand he will surely loosen his tongue.
When I last saw Arina Shakirova, she was shivering with cold. A nice Kanian shawl would make her warm and grateful. I remember a Novograd trader offered me one.
May the Light guide you!

checkText.en:
We will wait and hope!
But we're not going to worry about you as the Chosen One cannot fail as long as he keeps his friends close...

finishText.en: I am grateful to you, oh, Chosen One! And all citizens of our village too! Now we can graze our cattle on pastures and not fear the goblins keeping us locked in like caged toads. Let's hope for the best!

goal.en: Kill the Goblin Trapper blocking way to the Windswept Foothills for Sergey Rybakov.

startText.en:
Listen to me, Chosen One. Our village has been swarmed by goblins countless times. Surprisingly for goblins, those creatures think one step ahead and set up a post somewhere along the east path with a watchman in case we tried to seek help from outside of Gipatia.
When our warriors try to leave the village, their designated guard immediately hears the clanking of our clumsy armor, and calls for help. But you, Chosen One, are here to rid of us such troubles. I have faith you can overcome the goblin watchman, so our villagers can roam around without being harassed by something half our size!
Don't underestimate the guard's short stature though. Those goblins always have tricks up their sleeves...

finishText.en:
What happened? Why the troubled face?
No, it is absolutely impossible! Magic of the Light is not intended to enslave sparks and imprison them! You've made a grave mistake. That Delmon is just a historian and you are a simple adventurer. One shouldn't meddle in affairs above your comprehension.

goal.en: Talk about the captured souls to Evgenya Radova.

startText.en:
My mission to seek the truth has come to a halt. It is beyond my scope, it surpasses all my knowledge...
To tell the truth, I'm afraid that my faith is shaken. I think it's time to go to the servant of the Light. Seek guidance from Evgenya Radova.

checkText.en:
Hey, again without waiting in line?
What an impudence! It is not enough that world is a mess, and you are just dying to return back to your wretched life!

finishText.en:
Aha, now we're talking! You should of told me right away.
Hm, lovely mirra... So you want me to bring you back to the world as a ghost?
Yeah, I can do it. Hold onto your head!

goal.en: Die and bribe Goblin Spirit in Purgatory with a Vial of Mirra.

startText.en:
Let's presume that you are right and Holy magic is used here... I know how we should proceed. In the world of the dead, we must speak their language. You have to die.
Don't be afraid. As usual, you will find yourself in Purgatory, but do not be hasty to return. Talk to the acolyte. He can do more than resurrect fallen soldiers so that they can fight once again with the same amount of vigor. He can also let a soul out to the world.
I invite you to return to the village in the same bodiless form like other ghosts of Gipat. Then you can communicate with them on equal terms.
Of course, it is not easy to persuade the acolyte to alter the usual ritual. But we all know that he likes mirra. I'll give you a whole vial and he won't be able to resist!

checkText.en: I have never felt so stupid! Everybody is staring at me speaking into thin air!

finishText.en:
Wow! Thank the Light!
My efforts are not in vain. What have you found out?
Really? Poor ghosts have to perform this weird Performance every single day without knowing the reason. They don't even remember what happened to them and what brought them to their ghostly state.
We must help them!

goal.en: Talk to Gipat ghosts: Sergey Rybakov, Gorislav Averchenko, Boris Polonsky and Osip Bazhov. After the conversations, return to real world and report to Evgenya Radova.

startText.en:
Oh, I hope the locals won't think I'm a fool...
Listen to me, ghost back from Purgatory! I can't see you, but I know you're here and can hear me.
While in your apparition form, talk to other Gipat ghost citizens and find out everything that is going on around here!
Again!
Listen to me, ghost from Purgatory!

checkText.en:
Individualism can never defeat team spirit. All together, shoulder to shoulder, and Nina will get the revelation first!
Moreover, it's even better to deprive the League from their hard-earned Signs.

finishText.en:
Well done! Here is a Sign of the Chosen just for you.
I probably should give it to Nina, but one less Sign won't hurt. The Empire is still ahead anyway. And your efforts deserves a reward.

goal.en: Following request of Victor Terdolobin, take three Signs of the Chosen from three League citizens: Romeo de Ardeur, Cheerful Family, and Polina Zaitseva.

startText.en:
Now we know that everybody is madly searching for Signs of the Chosen on the League. Let's take advantage of this. The most suitable tactic is to find weak point in the enemy and hit that spot dead on!
Elf in love? Here is the shard of a bracelet that goblins used to wear. This is a very nice piece of aboriginal art. I'm sure Romeo would like to present it to his sweetheart. Show Gibberlings ghostly leather. These fluffy creatures have never seen armors made of such material that will protect them from the dangers of Gipat. And the woman who is afraid of darkness - we can present her with an Amulet of the Fearless.
But we need Signs of the Chosen from each and every one of them.

checkText.en:
Have you managed to get the Imperials' Signs?
Remember, it is not impossible to find a way if one does not try!

finishText.en:
You see, the Empire view Signs of the Chosen as cheap copper just like I said.
They've lost their Signs and turned from the Path so easily! Lots of things bother minds of simple fools. Such individuals do not deserve Ath-Zak's fate and Revelation. I'm laughing at such Chosen ones.
Here, take this Sign and move forward with your Chosen Path!

goal.en: Following the request of Laure de Grandeur, take three Chosen Signs from three Imperial citizens: Razh the Merciless, Sarbaz Neferkahor, and Arina Shakirova.

startText.en:
If the Imperial citizens are forced to give away their Signs, it means that they aren't of great value to them. That's the mistake of the Committee. Imperials have underestimated the significance of what the Signs of the Chosen stand for, and that will bring troubles.
I'm not going to let those cheaters walk away with my mansion! We should get a little dirty and cheat those Signs from the Imperial citizens.
That Orc likes shiny things... I'm sure he'll enjoy playing with this medallion. I also have an exclusive potion recipe for the alchemist. It was prepared by Forestfolk of Gipat. How it works - nobody knows. And I suppose that Xadaganian is trembling not with cold, but with fear. Offer her a magic guard.
Return when you have all three of their Signs.

checkText.en:
She will be a queen among Elves! Many of them are wear jewels crafted from the finest Elven masters.
But this fancy bracelet won't decorate just any hand... Only to my sweetheart!
All other Elves will die from envy.

finishText.en:
Oh! Wonderful artistic masterpiece! It feels like something primal yet pure as child's soul.
I'll go and give her this bracelet. Look at me. How do I look? Is my shirt free of wrinkles?
Here is my Sign as promised. Wish me good luck!

goal.en: Take a Carved Bracelet from Rord the Ghostly and bring it to Romeo de Ardeur.

startText.en:
I am sure it's possible to acquire a complete bracelet from one of goblins. I heard about some crafty ghost goblin... He is probably their leader. Maybe he has a whole bracelet!
Oh, is she accepts the charm from me, puts it on, and let its cold metal press against her skin... Oh, my heart beats faster from the thought of it. She will then be under my loving influence. But what if something happens to me? I cannot die on the very threshold of happiness.
Find the goblin bracelet for me and I will give you my Sign of the Chosen. Of course, it will lead me one step behind from a luxurious mansion in Novograd, but it will bring me one step closer to her!

checkText.en: In reality, there is no Truce with all this fighting going on. What nonsense!

finishText.en:
Yes, I already heard what happened...
Heh, I should of ran off once I heard you beat my buddy! But a bargain is a bargain. Here is my sign! Take it!
Just one request... Don't tell anybody that my friend fell so easily in combat. Ok?

goal.en: Summon Orc duelist on the west field using the Horn and defeat him in the duel. Tell Razh the Merciless the results of the duel.

startText.en:
As much as I love a wild fight... I have six Signs of the Chosen! I don't want to have any issues with the dragons.
But I bet my comrade will accept your challenge for me. He's not as dedicated to the Path like I am although I bet my Sign on your head!
But please, meet him outside the Village. There is a small field to the west with a giant totem pole crushed into the allod. Here is a horn of my clan. Blow it and it will make a combat sound that will echo with the wind. My comrade will come running and beat you.
Ha! Say goodbye to your Sign!

checkText.en:
Can you imagine, my brothers, we will return to Holy Land in new phantom armor!
And that Prude Family won't slam doors right before our noses anymore! We want, no, we NEED that ghost armor!

finishText.en:
We finally have our hands on skin. Wonderful! We will run to the tailor immediately!
Here is our Sign. If you are in the Holy Land, come visit us.

goal.en: Bring 8 ghostly skins of ghost boars to Cheerful Family.

startText.en:
But we really, really want to own such armor so badly!
What can we do? We have tried hunting with no success and we ran out of gold. You know what!? We will give you our Sign of the Chosen! Deal? Just bring us some ghostly skins. It'll be enough for first-class armor. And then wolfs and fogs will know fear the next time three shadows cross their path!

checkText.en:
An ancient potion. It seemed that a knowledge about it was lost forever. And now I'm holding it's recipe in my hands. I'm a step away from a great discovery!
Wait a minute. What if all those plants... white flower, evergreen leaf... gone extinct long ago? No! I don't want to think about it!

finishText.en:
What do we have here? A white flower. Mmm, such a fragrant scent...
Evergreen leaf... Oh! I have never seen such a vibrant green color in my whole life. I'm so anxious to start brewing. Here is your sign, take it!

goal.en: Find White Flower and Evergreen Leaf for Sarbaz Neferkahor.

startText.en:
Yes, yes, I'll keep my word and give you my Sign if you find such plants that will allow me to brew this complex potion: white flower and evergreen leaf.
Of course I could set out on my own and search for the ingredients, but I think I'm more fit for cleaning tubes instead of coming face to face with snorting ghostly boars.
So, do we agree? You bring me flowers, I'll give you my Sign of the Chosen in exchange!

checkText.en:
Wait a minute!
What if I equip this amulet and start to unwillingly attack those who are more powerful than? I won't live long after that. Am I right?
Nevertheless, I have more brains than chickens. So, is this amulet working as you predicted?

finishText.en:
Come on, I'll wear it... Hm... a strange feeling.
There was an Orc near here. He gave me dirty looks yesterday. He wrapped his large hands around my neck and pressed me against the wall. Now I'll go and show him that I'm no pushing around type!
What's that? Ah, yes, my Sign. Here it is. Take it.

goal.en: Test Amulet of the Fearless on a chicken near the wolves. Tell about success to Polina Zaitseva.

startText.en:
What are you saying? With this amulet, even a hen will be brave as lion? Hm...
You talk big, but show me proof. Around the Village there are lots of ghostly chickens around.
Wrap the amulet around one their little necks and bring it to the forest where wolves prey, and let's see what happens. If the chicken attacks without any fear, it means that you're not lying and this amulet possesses great power!

checkText.en: If the magic guard works properly, I can feel safe in wherever I go. Phew...

finishText.en:
How did he perform in the field? Perfect?
My sweetie guardian, now you will defend me! What should I call him?
Ah, I almost forgot... Here is your Sign of the Chosen.

goal.en: Test Arina Shakirova's magic guard in combat.

startText.en:
If you wish to earn my Sign, you must make sure this magic guard works.
Does he know exactly who is friend and who is enemy? Will the guard attack its master? What is said about it in the instructions?
Please conduct your experiments away from here. At the gates of the village is an abandoned house. Summon the guard there. If he defeats all your enemies and won't attack you, return to me, and I'll trade you my Sign.

checkText.en: Only wild Orcs are worse than wild goblins. Soon they will be defeated too!

finishText.en:
Great!
Thanks for putting them in their place. Now goblins will recognize the Chosen One!
Here is your reward!

name.en: The Weapons of the Wild Goblins

startText.en:
Glad to see you! Our numbers are growing!
We have already encountered the living inhabitants of Gipat. They are not so friendly!
Wild goblins are the ugliest and most repulsive! They don't like us being here. They keep trying to prod us with their spears or fling boomerangs at our heads.
We should give them a fight! Show that we are the new masters of Gipat. Well, in a sense we all are. You too, Chosen One.
So are you game? In order to prove your victory, bring us the goblins' spears and boomerangs.

checkText.en:
I know the Chosen one cannot fail! I have great faith!
The White Wolf will be slain and all of Gipatia will celebrate! Glory to the Chosen one!

finishText.en:
I admire your bravery and nobility! If beheading the beast at my request makes you a little queasy, give the wolf's head to Gorislav. Your Path is important although your demonstration of savagery for our greater good shows a lot about you, and it's an important lesson for completion of your Path.
Our village governor wants people to believe in him and you have helped our village keep up with faith by ridding of the evil that surrounds us. Now hand over the head; I'll present it to him myself. Take this Sign and keep it close to your heart.

goal.en: Kill the Ghostly White Wolf, Ghostfang, and bring its head to Sergey Rybakov.

startText.en:
Besides goblins, Gipatia is also terrorized by wolves. Perhaps you, Chosen One, can deal with them?
The pack stealing our cattle is led by the fearless Ghostfang. This particular breed is smarter than any four-legged beast we have encountered. It's one big game to the wolf as he has played tricks on our hunters numerous times! Only you, Chosen, can outwit this devil. Your bravery and quick wits will leave that white wolf dead in its tracks!

checkText.en:
My tools were made of a rare material! You will never find anything like them in all of Sarnaut.
Now the Chief's stout wife is crafting jewelry with my drill! And the Chief is using my cutter for his no good intentions!

finishText.en:
Is that my drill? No, it's not! Hand blade is not mine either!
Look at that! Here comes the Chosen One to save the day but cannot even fulfill a simple request. Expect no such discounts from me, that's for sure. You cannot expect me to bow before your clumsiness when my tools are still out there handled by those bandits!
Just, please give me some space. I need to re-think how I'm going to be able to continue my sales without my proper tools...

goal.en: Retrieve Boris' Toolbox from the bandits' Chief and his wife.

startText.en:
Well, look who it is! Here comes the Chosen One. Just because of who your glorious title, don't think for a second that you will get anything for free! Before you earn my respect you've got to take back what was taken from me!
Who robbed me of my belongings? It was those blasted "free hunters" as our elder calls them. He says that they are our friends, but friends don't deprive others from what they own! Those rebels are bandits that have brought shame upon Gipatia, and have been cast off to dwell out of our village.
My apprentice caught them looking through our materials, and tried to stop them, but they beat him and ran off with my tools. My dear friend has been shaken by this experience for the past two days, and has not found the will to work since then!
They have taken many things, but what is worse is they took my favorite drill and hand blade. I need those back or else I'm a useless merchant! Help me!

checkText.en:
Ha! I see you're anxious to know what I need these amulets for.
I cannot tell you for now but maybe I'll tell you if you bring me the amulets.

finishText.en:
Perfect.
You've acquired the amulets I needed so it's only fair to give an explanation for my desire.
These ghost amulets have mysterious powers of Gipat's ghosts. I'm going to use this power for my dark ways. I don't care about it's properties. Divine, Elemental, Astral... Power itself is more important than the source of it.
Remember that if you want to make it out of Gipat alive.

goal.en: Get 12 Ghost Amulets from Spectral Rogues and Spectral Corsairs, and bring them to Yaver Useranat.

startText.en:
Hold up!
Do you want to earn some money? I have an opportunity you simply cannot refuse.
While you may not believe your eyes, you can see there are an abundant of ghosts inhibiting Gipat. Let's just say I have a professional interest in them.
I have heard few rumors about the nature of their existence, but it's all rubbish to me. I act according to my instinct rather than waste my days theorizing.
There have been ghost bandits spotted to the northeast of Gipatia. I am interested in their... Components. Relax! I am not speaking about brains, liver, and such organs. I'm talking about amulets. Not all necromancers are into such morbidity, you know?
Ghost amulets are curious jewels. I'm sure that I can use them for my "professional" goals. The only thing left is to find them.
Won't you help?

checkText.en: Time us running out. Wherever those tools are needs to be found before they end up in the wrong hands again!

finishText.en: It looks like you put that magical scanner to good use. See, I told you it was those tricksters. Great detective work! At least you put one raging ghost to rest...

goal.en: Find Boris' true toolbox.

startText.en:
My, my. Look what has happened. You have sent Boris in a spiraling rage by delivering him the wrong tools that no Gipat merchant can possibly use. He has been without work for quite some time. What's worse now is that there are no clients in his shop!
What's that you say? His favorite drill and hand blade had been taken from the commander and his wife?
Weird. This means that someone stole Boris' real instruments and slipped false ones behind those bandits' backs!
Do you see now? This frustrating occurrence is one of the many challenges that will try to bump you off your Chosen Path. Nevertheless, you must push on and do your best to solve this mystery, right? I'll assist you.
Accept this magic metal detector. It will steer you in the right direction to find Boris' real toolbox. My dragon sense tingles. Something tells me the thieves are somewhere around this village. Run your scanner up and down those Gibberlings. They always seem to be up to no good.
Hurry up and find these instruments as soon as possible. And I'll calm down the craftsman.

checkText.en: Hopefully you can find that Orc, so you don't think we're crazy. Tricksters we are, but crazy... No way!

finishText.en: So, it's true that there are not only ghostly beings, but real native creatures on Gipat. They sure don't like our presence here though.

goal.en: Find the mysterious Orc that the Scratchy Family mentioned.

startText.en:
What do you want? We're not like other idiots dragging around the foothills repeating heroic deeds of Ath-Zak. We don't want to do it! If he were at least a Gibberling, we would think it over.
Hey, since you were so lucky at finding Boris' tools, maybe you can solve a mystery for us too. Something peculiar caught our attention earlier. We saw an Orc around here. He wasn't ghostly, but in full flesh and blood! At first we thought is was an Imperial citizen, but then we looked closer. Something was wrong. Judging from its savage-like armor, it seems he wasn't with the Imperial army.
Who was he then? Damned if we know! We decided to keep our distance. If you want to have a look, you may go and see. He's not far from off from the trail ahead.

finishText.en:
"Blunt drill. Sharp hand blade"? Well, well, what do you know about it?.
Ok, I'll brief you if you swear to keep the secret, and that you are also irritated by all this and... that you believe in love.
Swear before me!

goal.en: Find Semer Akhenaten, leader of the rebels in Gipatia, and tell him the password.

startText.en:
Come closer, we will tell you.
There are many others who don't want to dance to the Dragons' tune of some promise of a "Revelation". We are not puppets just to be manipulated! We refuse to take part in this damned play! We are free citizens of the League and... the Empire! Together we have formed an underground organization.
Don't you want to find out everything? Who are those ghosts and living orcs? This is very suspicious.
Still not a believer of our conspiracy theory? Fine. Seek out our leader, Semer Akhenaten, in the village and find out the truth from him! Tell him: "Blunt drill. Sharp hand blade". It is a secret password.

checkText.en:
I'm a Historian, not a priest. And it's good that those ghosts are not just wandering souls.
Sparks of rational creatures are understudied as you can never be sure if the picture of world creation is right or not.
Each time that I die, I'm afraid to vanish somewhere on the road to Purgatory. Who knows what is waiting there? Magic is more easy and understandable.

finishText.en:
Ah, give it here. That magic detector gives the results we need.
Now... Oh, look at this!

startText.en:
While we are waiting news from Zayan, let's make another ancient find!
We need to investigate origins of ghosts. In particular, sparks of the fallen.
I have always been a follower of Zosim's theory: "Spark, the base component that gives life to us and is an essence of Tensess' Gift, is not connected to the, so-called, ghosts, who are really magical creatures not under the church's control."
With that said, the circle of investigation is easier to understand now. I hope we will find truth soon. Here is a June gadget. It catches and analyzes magical emanations. Use it on ghost wolfs, boars, and toads. We won't bother the villagers though. And we also don't know how the dragons will treat our experiment, so let's keep this between us. I anxiously await your return!

finishText.en: Save... Save me!

goal.en: Try to get in touch with a ghost in the Bandit's Camp with the Coba Stone.

startText.en:
Don't be scared. It's ok.
But... It's so extraordinary. Magic of Light! These ghostly spirits were created by magic of Light, and that same holy magic are powers used by the Church! Don't tell anybody our shocking discovery! We need not panic. I know what to do.
I have an artifact from Coba Plateau. It was created by mages with the help of those artifacts of darkness called shards of Light. By using it we can fuse it with the magic of Light and see what happens.
I would like to use the shard on a rational being and have an opportunity to contact him later. But we can't do it within the village. As the legend goes, bandits inhabit a camp north of the Windswept Foothills, so that would be the right place to run our test. Can you approach one of those ghostly bandits and use stone on them? Try to do it. It is very important!

finishText.en:
I don't believe it! So the magic of Light weakened and from its ghostly cocoon appeared a soul?
And this soul was calling for help! What is going on with Gipat! How it is possible that such great, holy magic of Light torments and enslaves souls?
I'm completely puzzled.

goal.en: Share the results of the experiment to the Historian Delmon de Blizare in the Village.

startText.en:
Set me free! Set my soul free! I beg you, set me free!
I beg you...

checkText.en:
Keep your voice down. There are a lot of obedient asses who are loyal to the idea of the Performance.
And asses are known to have long ears.

finishText.en:
"Lords" are Gods who can read minds? Maybe they are just charlatans who managed to impress naive savages with their flashy tricks?
But their protective ruins truly have enormous power. It looks like we will never break through to the villains. A great feat has turned into a farce...
Oh, cursed and blessed Tep, why did you let me live to such a dark day?

goal.en: Semer Akhenaten asks to find out what the Orcs in Gipat know about eternal love.

startText.en:
I've come here in search of eternal love as this is the very place where Ath-Zak made his heroic deed for the sake of love.
And what do I see? Blasphemy! Fake Chosen Ones trying to make a farce out of the June's heroic deed!
Surprised that the Arisen are so curious and fond of eternal love? Believe me, only we a better understanding than anyone else. The lives of Kanians and Xadaganians are so short that they often leave their love and find another one. Elves wallow in narcissism and rush to judge beauty from what's on the outside. Gibberlings love everyone and everything, but it is fake to be so happy all the time.
I created this underground group to protect the memory of unappreciated true love. Will you help us? Maybe these strange Orcs know something that may help us to put an end to this drama! Their camp is to the southeast. Seek out the wise shaman. That's where we'll get our questions answered.

finishText.en:
Foolish, Chosen Ones. You are just like children playing in the sand who do not see the storm that will engulf us all. I will answer your fatuous question - you will meet those whom Orcs call Masters. But in due time.
You'll find that you'll be wasting their time just like you are wasting mine with your suggestions for a useless union. The threat of storm unites us much more effectively than any signed documents. You will understand this one day.
For our purposes, there is only one way out of this mess - the Chosen Path. Take it to the end. And if you are still interested in such nonsense, you can talk to them about the alliance.

goal.en: Following Victor Terdolobin's order, talk to the Spirit of Fate in Village about alliance between the Empire and Masters of Orcs.

startText.en:
Look, I decided our next course of action.
Orcs mentioned something about their Lords being eager to restore Gipat? Obviously, the Performance is part of this rehabilitation program. It means that the dragon spirits also obey the same masters that Orcs do.
Here's what needs to be done. Go to the little dragon and tell him that you need to talk to Lords to sign a peace treaty. Keep your shoulder straight, chest forward, and speak in an upfront tone. Maybe then the little dragon will stop talking about some Performance and start a normal political dialogue.

finishText.en:
Foolish, Chosen Ones. You are just like children playing in the sand who do not see the storm that will engulf us all. I will answer your fatuous question - you will meet those whom Orcs call Masters. But in due time.
You'll find that you'll be wasting their time just like you are wasting mine with your suggestions for a useless union. The threat of storm unites us much more effectively than any signed documents. You will understand this one day.
For our purposes, there is only one way out of this mess - the Chosen Path. Take it to the end. And if you are still interested in such nonsense, you can talk to them about the alliance.

goal.en: On behalf of Laura de Grandeur, ask Dragon Guide, Spirit of Fate, for a meeting with Gipat Masters.

startText.en:
Prayers helped me to return self-control. I think we should find a way to talk to those masters. If they are trying to repair Gipat, they started this weird Performance, but maybe it's for some high purpose that we cannot see now.
We must get them to unite as one. Together, we can end the war, defeat the Empire, and liberate oppressed citizens. Not to mention we will offer them moral, free thoughts, and Tensess' blessing.
Go to the Spirit of Fate and try to organize a meeting with masters.

checkText.en: You shouldn't offend Gibberlings! Those wild Orcs might be able to do that on another allod, but they'll get shot here in Gipat for talking smack!

finishText.en:
Many thanks!
It's so unpleasant to feel anxiety! We even had stomach aches. Though now, since we have been avenged, we feel much better!

startText.en:
Have you ever met the local Orcs? They're bastards, they are! We try to abide by the truce, but they always treat us like crap!
They give us a giant scolding and they have taken our most valuable things! What overgrown bullies!
We must teach them a lesson. Let them vent their anger on the goblins! Take away their knives and their rings. Let's steal from those thieves.

finishText.en: Hey, you must be the Chosen One! Hold on.

goal.en: Meet Nim the Avenger at the Wild Orcs' Camp on Gipat

startText.en:
To be honest, I don't know how to get to their camp. They say that lightning strikes those who dare to come close. But I know that local orcs enslaved some goblins... Distressed and starving, poor creatures are forced to do the hard work. Imperial orcs do not act like this!
I hope the servants will comply easier than their masters. They may help you to approach the shaman. Speak with Nim the Avenger, one of the goblins discontent with the slavery. He tried to find allies among the Chosen Ones in order to liberate the goblins. You can meet him by the bridge, near the Orc's camp.

checkText.en:
Are the village wanderers doomed forever to repeat their actions?
Perhaps they have already abandoned all hope.

finishText.en:
You're telling me that it was the Orcs who killed everyone in the Village? Why did the Great Mage Tka-Rik not help? Is it possible that the Great Mages are too busy with global issues that they fail to see the problems of mere mortals...
Anyway, if Orcs' "Lords" are so powerful, it is likely them who started the Performance and cursed the Gipatians into this state of unrest. Unfortunately, due to the storm traps that guard the Cursed Path, we won't be able to even get close enough to persuade them to release the ghosts' sparks. This is sad...
Perhaps there is another way to help them.

goal.en: Find out more information on the fate of the village ghosts from the shaman in the Wild Orcs' Camp and report back to Evgenya Radova.

startText.en:
You know, when I first received the letter of Chosen One with the mysterious stone inside, I immediately tossed it in my spam mail box thinking it was some advertisement for naughty Elven graphics. Thank the Light that I opened the letter. What if I haven't come here at all...
Why did I ask you to come? Oh yeah! I believe the village spirits are not just simple ghosts. Their sparks and language appear to remain here in captivity of transparent bodies with no way to escape.
We must find a way to help them! If Orcs have been living here for so long, they should know more what happened with Gipatia. Why don't you ask their wise shaman?

checkText.en:
Did the Orcs agree to join our powerful faction?
Their tribe is the size of a drop in a large sea of water, but just think what valuable information about Gipat they can provide!

finishText.en:
You mean they turned their cheek to your offer? "The Empire and the League will die soon"? That's too much. Who do these savages think they are?
Though wait a bit... Now we know about their "Lords". Perhaps we don't need Orcs at all. They are just pawns...

goal.en: On the order of Viktor Tverdolobin, establish an alliance between the Orcs of Gipat and the Empire.

startText.en:
I have just received word that there is a camp of normal, breathing Orcs on Gipat. Long story short, a drunken Elf blurted that he accidentally stumbled upon them.
I order you to seek our their camp right away and invite them to join our Imperial forces. Tell them something uplifting about the Empire. I don't know, "Keeping territorial integrity and cultural heritage". I'll leave it up to you, but we just need them to be impressed our already existing army of Orcs. As for compulsory military service, we will tell them about it later.
You need to find the right approach - promise to give them food, gold, fine Xadaganian women... And don't forget to mention about Goblinball. They'll sure get a kick out of that!

checkText.en:
I calmed down and understood that I was wrong.
We don't need Imperial totalitarian enforcement mechanisms to make people a sense of responsibility for their homeland. But still... Hurry. If we do not talk the Orcs out from allying with the Empire, the very Truce of Gipat may be in jeopardy!

finishText.en:
"The League and the Empire will die soon"? That's what the shaman said? Oh, Tensess... Of course I'm glad there is no need to scare off their alliance, but these words...
What if it is not just foolish pagan chatter? What if these "Masters" unveiled them something that we are not able to see or understand yet? I never imagined such an end.
I'm sorry but I need time to cleanse myself from sinful thoughts, so I can plan our next course of action. Hopefully there is still time left for actions...

goal.en: Go to the Orcs' camp and prevent the alliance with the Empire as instructed by Laura de Grandeur of the Village.

startText.en:
We have new problem, a serious one. Having found out that Gipat Orcs are not ghosts, the Empire will attempt to ally with them, and we can't let it happen.
Go to Shaman of Orcs and tell him how immoral, deceitful, and greedy the Empire is. On second thought... These words may seem tempting for the wild orcs given their wild nature. It might be wiser to point out the advantages of the Imperials to turn off those wild savages.
Tell Orcs about the Empire's discipline, strict subordination, compulsory duty service, and readiness of every citizen to self-sacrifice.
Sometimes the League lacks such commitment. Oh, Eternal Light, I hope I won't fall into heresy...

checkText.en: Hurry, we need to give weapons to our comrades while those overgrown pigs know nothing of our plan!

finishText.en:
Hooray! Attack! Brothers, let's fight for our freedom! Let's put and end to the Goblinball! Orcslay will be Sarnaut's new sport! Watch us cut up those Orcs and carve their curvy spines into slides for our young ones!
Are you saying that I'm a coward? Then drink homebrew, shrink down to our level, hit a table with your helm, and then I will respect your glory.
Are you saying that Gibberlings are small also? They are three and they have ale. We don't have even beer, and we are strictly forbidden to team up three on one...While they are looking, that is. Orcs will forever be our sworn enemies!

startText.en:
Hey, you, give me your hand. I'll tell you your fortune. Oh, what a big hand... Strong, calloused. A great deed is waiting for you. You will help a small but brave nation. Its name begins with "G". Not Gibberlings! Boo hoo to those furry slippers ! You're destined to help goblins!
We are in slavery. Orcs oppress us. Our spirits are weakened, but not broken. We are ready to rise our weapons against our torturers. But where can we get weapons?
I see it now. You will overpower the Orcs and give their weapons to my fellow goblins. Those Orcs will think twice before raising their whips at us again!

checkText.en: Come on! For freedom! For equality!

finishText.en: Ahh! Revolt has failed. Our brave rebels are all dead! Lightning never misses!

goal.en: Ring the gong to signal the rebellion and talk to Klo the Ferocious.

startText.en:
Everything is ready for revolt!
I'll distribute the weapons and you strike the alarm bell! It's right behind you, silly!
Now you will see goblins fighting for their freedom! And no lightning will shock us in the ass ever again!

checkText.en:
Stop, be quiet.
I'm a negotiator. We will have a conversation. I love beautiful words.

finishText.en:
You are stupid thinking goblins and orcs can live in peace.
Tomorrow Klo is surely to get a good beating to make him think before attempting a riot in the future.
Our shaman is wise. He foresaw the goblins' sneaky plan and baited them in. Shaman doesn't want to infuriate the Lords by establishing a treaty among races that is not supposed to exist. Goblins serve Orcs. Orcs rule over goblins. That's how we lived and that's how we will go about our ways.

goal.en: Explore Klo's hiding place.

startText.en:
Uprising failed! It's like they knew our plan and pinned us from all sides with spears. You know, I don't think you put your heart into our attempt for freedom. After all, your kind play Goblinball at the enjoyment of our misery!
See, I was a clever goblin twisting my body to evade incoming kicks to manipulate the players' games. Doing so gave me lots of laughs despite the constant bruises.
Now because of our failed rebellion, I have to give Orcs everything I have so that they don't beat us to pulps more than they already do. Go to my hiding place. It's in a fallen tree to the northeast and bring my treasures to the shaman. And keep praying that his heart softens to cut us some slack.

finishText.en:
Grr! How did you manage to pass past the Lords' blazing fire? Has Sharha given you that emblem there?
Well, I will answer your questions and you must go back! Quickly. Lords told me to be quiet and not bother myself with outsiders.
But if you ever return, we will throw you into the Astral!

goal.en: With permission from Sharha the Wily, go to the top of the pyramid under the protection of Orcish Emblem and talk to Stomper the Wily.

startText.en:
You want to talk to our shaman, eh? Here is the Orcish Emblem. It is a sign of peace and good will. It will also protect you from the Lords' electric surge and you'll be able to approach the shaman.
But Stomper doesn't like to talk much. He has so much work - ruling over goblins, sharing loot among tribal members, blessing our camp with his voodoo magic.
I enjoyed our chat, but I'm getting tired too fast. Leave me to go rest and go slap Klo the stupid. Ha! Have a good hunt, stranger.

finishText.en:
What a fool! How could Semer ever be fit as a rebel leader? His weak-minded self won't help anybody.
Lover of Zem! What other curses will you will bring upon us? World Prisoners? Orc Researchers? Goblin Poets? Elven Altruists and non-drinking Gibberlings?!
Your absurd attempts to help him disrupt the Performance has only clouded your judgment. We all knew and did not want to interfere. Sometimes the shortest way to the realize the truth is an attempt to escape from it. We let you act in opposition, but it time to stop playing. We need you... All of you to finish your Paths!

goal.en: Semer Akhenaten wants you to admit to the Spirit of Resolve that he is the one to blame for attempting to sabotage the Performance.

startText.en:
If I don't at least try to protect you from angering Gipat's "Lords" from that goblin stunt of yours, I will let down my values. Tell the dragon spirit that I am in charge of the underground organization.
I finally want to open my heart to you. Even when I was an ordinary human, I fell in love with a girl. Then our tribe crumbled. After many years we have risen... And my love to Nefertiti resurrected with me.
Memory is what differs us from the undead. Memories about what it is like to be alive and flourishing. Like a phoenix from its ashes, we are reborn from the memory of our love. Love doesn't depend on hormones and passionate lust. It is eternal.
I hoped to find my Nefertiti here where loving hearts of Junes have long ago united. But I failed. I prey, if you meet her somewhere along your Path, deliver my eternal love to her!

checkText.en: Did the village inhabitants know about their fate? We obviously were not able to change it, but we can tell them the truth. It will make their suffering easier to bare.

finishText.en:
Thank you.
This act is worthy of a true follower of the Light. I am sure now it will be a bit easier for them.
Uncertainty is worse than death. You see now that they have accepted their fate and are preparing to live under new conditions. Even ghosts can be optimistic!

goal.en: After talking to Evgenya Radova, turn into a ghost and talk to the Gipatia's dwellers about their fate.

name.en: Crossing over to the Valley of Shadows

startText.en:
While you were at the Orc' camp, the goblin spirit from Purgatory paid me a visit. To leave Purgatory and be amongst the living is very rare. Apparently, he heard about your heroic deeds at the Wild Orcs' Camp.
Through conversing with him, I found out that he has been helping the goblins for a long time. He taught them to read and write and told them stories of the large world outside of Gipat. Evidently, we have the wrong view of goblins...
In gratitude of assisting his goblin kind, he granted me the ability to open a passage to ghostly reality for you. Now you can tell the village people about their fate. Return when you want to go the valley of the shadows and talk to its inhabitants.

checkText.en:
Only strict instructions following the Performance will set you back on your Path. Please remember that...
Letting some goblins sacrifice their lives will let us all live a little more.

finishText.en:
Good... Now you've become closer to understanding our intentions, and the role of the Chosen One.
However, I can still sense doubts gnawing at your heart. Your soul is unsure and finds no answers. Forget your doubts and continue to follow the Path.

startText.en: Here's the first task from Ath-Zak's doing. Kill ten goblins that infest our pasture. Repeat the feat of June and punish them for their rebellion. Let them see what it means to act against the Performance.

checkText.en:
I'm waiting for the map...
I'm waiting to return it to a heroic rogue. He knows his role perfectly and performs everyday without doubts. Fight and accept death. You have the most important role, and despite it, you delay, have doubts, waste time...

finishText.en:
Well, one step closer. At this rate you're proving your worth to me like when we first met.
I know it is difficult. You are agitated by questions that need to be answered. The world in your head threatens to collapse. This is one of the tests of the Chosen Path.
Overcome your fear of ignorance. The fact that you don't know everything doesn't mean that you can't do the right thing. Who knows, maybe completing these tasks again and again will help you focus on what matters most.

goal.en: Kill the Phantom Thief and Ishgaz the Wily. Bring the Thief's map to the Spirit of Resolve.

startText.en:
Your doubts and indecision clouds your judgment. How many times do you have to repeat Ath-Zak's deeds to live up to the Chosen One title? We need to push you harder than you've been pushed before, then it will be easier for you to understand your role on Gipat.
Further prove your dedication of righteousness by taking a special map that was stolen from me from two notorious troublemakers. Keep in mind that it will be difficult for you to deal with him and his fellow outlaw. Unite with other Chosen Ones and conquer the villains. You may find yourself experiencing great power which the Path grants to those who follow it headstrong.

checkText.en:
I hope you won't give this bottle to somebody else.
You now know what happens to those who goes against the Path...

finishText.en: Good... You followed the instructions that I gave you. This will assist with the locals' research. I'll give you a Sign of Chosen.

goal.en: Following Spirit of Fate's order, pour the bottle of essence on 5 ghost wolves, boars or toads.

startText.en:
This next task to earn another Sign is not connected with deeds of the great June.
Ghost creatures... I'm sure you already know something about their unique nature. All around Gipatia there are those who try to understand what is beyond understanding! It's interesting to observe them.
It'll be even more interesting if I push you to find a solution to the mystery. We must support the ghostly essence. And you will help us. I'll give you the vial of ghostly essence. You need to pour the essence on ghost wolves, boars and toads. This will keep them in this world.
I wouldn't advise to fight with them after the bottle is used. You'll understand why...

checkText.en:
That was quick!
Did you really mange to kill all enemies? Maybe some of them just pretended to be dead. These ghostly monsters can do such tricks.
You should hold each of them by their jaws and cut their throats. Do not forget to turn them on belly or you will be covered with blood... Oh, look at me re-living my childhood days. Old fool!

finishText.en:
Oh, thank you, Chosen One! I was afraid that boars would be carriers of ghostly swine flu. I was told this is a bad disease!
As for wolves and toads, to be honest, I can't stand these disgusting creatures.
This spot on the sleeve, isn't it toad's poison? Under the tongue... Why are you staring at me like that? It is a delicacy, you fool.... No, far from it!
By the way, what do you think about hunting tomorrow? I will be waiting. Don't be late. And don't be afraid to get dirty with poison - I will scrape away everything.

goal.en: While in a ghostly form, kill 5 ghostly creatures of each kind: wolves, boars and toads upon the request of Sergey Rybakov of the Village.

startText.en:
Ah, thank you for coming to our aid! Yeah, yeah, you. Other Chosen Ones are useless idlers.
Only you are the embodiment of our beloved Ath-Zak. The same nobility, selflessness, and stature. You even drop your gaze with the same modesty as he did. I know because he was like a son to me!
Please, do me a favor. We are nothing but phantoms, but we also have our needs. Please kill a handful of wolves, boars and toads for me. I know you won't even ask why we need you to do this. Just help us like how you always help everyone else.

checkText.en:
Did you acquire the materials I requested?
My storage is nearly empty. It's so odd to sit without work. I've quarreled with man of the Village locals, because I have nothing to do. Please, be quick.

finishText.en:
What took you so long? Did Sergey persuade you to work for him? He's always been a tricky character when he was alive, and now he got hooked on fog's poison, ghostly dupe. Don't turn your back to a drug addict...
Well, let's examine your loot... What the?! What are all these scraps? What did you do with them, blow them sky high? All the skins are shred, fur singed, worn from your violent overload. Have you never learned to hunt? You need to aim and shoot an arrow at one's neck for a quick fall. Were you afraid those poor toads may knock you off by accident?
Well, leave all these skin pieces here and tomorrow bring the next batch... but in better condition! Maybe I'll craft something for you that you deserve.

startText.en:
What do you want? Looking for work? Live and let others do the same. Here is my errand for you.
Hey, don't get started with me. I know your kind very well! If I tell you what exclusive material is used for your clothes, you will become craftsmen and steal all my clients. I may be missing a brain although my intelligence still remains.
On second thought, I have no choice. All the Chosen Ones who have invaded Gipat have swept all my goods, and I have no time to make new things especially if I have to collect skins myself...
Ok, bring me ghostly skins of boars, toads and wolfs. If you don't give away my secret, I'll reward you.

checkText.en:
What do you think of Ath-Zak's methods to stay in shape? Is it refreshing?
Just hit them from the back of their head like Ath-Zak did.

finishText.en:
You're a nice lad for doing that. Unlike despicable me... It was me who set you on Orcs just for the sake of revenge. Ath-Zak had nothing to do with mindless Orc slaughter. After you told me about the Orcs' raid, I have been looking for the way to pay them back! But I could obviously do nothing - I'm too weak and cannot penetrate the living!
I'm ashamed of myself. I can't forgive myself that I tried to stab Ath-Zak. If he hadn't leave me wounded, I could have protected the Village from Orcs. Everybody would have been alive. We betrayed Ath-Zak and now we are stuck between life and death...
I want to make amends with my sins. Let's kill more Orcs tomorrow for Ath-Zak. Who knows, maybe our sins will be washed away in fury.

startText.en:
Hey, soldier... Ah, sorry, I thought you were a soldier.
Though all of you here are kind of military material. That makes us perfect colleagues. Something I've been wondering - Are all of Chosen Ones following Ath-Zak's Path? Repeating his deeds... Did the Dragons tell you anything about me? It was Ath-Zak himself who chose me to come with him on some of his early adventures. I bet the Dragons tell you to go do this, go kill that. Did they ever have you follow my past accomplishments? Pfff, not surprised.
Listen, as a friend, I'll tell you about one of Ath-Zak's deed: Orc killing! He loved it very much. Every morning, for exercise, he used to make cut himself a heap of Orc carcasses. You need to live up to that expectation otherwise you are a bad Chosen One.

checkText.en:
So, did sparks shine from my eyes? It will happen soon, I hope.
I'm trembling with anticipation. Oh, how I long for a good fight! Come on, throw them at me...

finishText.en:
Splendid. How shrill their screams were! That's what I call resting in peace!. Nothing to do with Sergey's mean tricks - consuming poison and getting tripped out. Oh, you don't know? It's like drugs for ghosts. Digesting the poison and it makes one seem that they are alive. Ugh! I have tried it, but it's gross. Ath-Zak wouldn't approve. It's terrible what this ghostly stuff has done to us.
I'm also glad that Gorislav has come to reason. Now he feels pity about what happened to Ath-Zak. We have reconciled with him and spend the evenings together. Now we can teach sparks a lesson together. Do you want to scare off goblins again tomorrow? I will be waiting.

startText.en:
Hey, I have a proposition for you. It's so damned boring here. We are stuck in this nightmare running on and on about the past...
I can't leave the Village, can't drown myself with ale... I can't even strike anyone! The blow goes through. I'm like fog wearing pants.
I want to feel alive again, feel up women' buttocks, unleash my frustration on foes...
See the ghostly creatures surrounding the Village? They're like ghosts too! They are something I can pummel. Give me the inspiration I need to get my game back - take down some goblins beat their Sparks out of them! Will you do this for Ath-Zak's best friend, ha?

checkText.en:
So, was our righteous deed successful?
I can't wait to make my friend happy, release a great weight from his soul. Ath-Zak is missing, so I would pay a price for my mistake before Osip.

finishText.en:
Your fame goes ahead of you. In other words - spark of damned shaman. Oh, Osip taught her a lesson - tore all her beams. Dim, blinking, more dead than alive...
But I tell you it was a very important thing. Did you notice that every time Ath-Zak's name is mentioned, I start fretting? Shrug my shoulders, turn my head... I begin to feel sick. The first thing I recollect is how Ath-Zak sticks me on a blade.
But I deserve it! And what about others? To know that their murderers live in peace just near them? Now everybody has satisfied one's heart. The-ra-py, as the Arisen say, is nothing to sneeze at.

goal.en: Upon the request of Gorislav of Gipatia, form a team and sneak into the Orcs' camp in a ghostly form. Appear right under the Shaman's nose and kill him.

startText.en:
I have a private requests...
Osip, my sworn brother, is showing off, expressing confidence, but I'm sure he feels nervous too when Orcs shaman is mentioned.
Aha, when you have told us about orcs, Squabbler recalled that it was Aihar who killed him. Do you think, you can kill that shaman off?
Heed caution, he is very powerful. You'd better ask friends to assist you. Go through ghostly world to avoid stroke of lightning. Then jump out to the real world right in front of him and cut the damned creep.

finishText.en:
The Path behind has been a long journey, but the Path ahead of us will be even longer. Take a breath and keep your mind open to new knowledge.
The first lesson of Sarnaut's nightmares are waiting for you.

goal.en: Meet Spirit of Sadness along the Cursed Path.

startText.en:
We did it! I could have asked you to cut fish with a blunt knife, surf the Astral on a staff, and attempt to clap with one hand. It doesn't matter now, but what we have learned is that you need to forget yourself to understand who you are.
Now you can make the next step toward your Chosen Path. The path will lead to Cursed Path through ancient June traps, from the trail that Ath-Zak traveled. Go to the next shard of my consciousness, to the Spirit of Sadness. She will lead you through the next stages of your Path.

finishText.en:
The Path behind has been a long journey, but the Path ahead of us will be even longer. Take a breath and keep your mind open to new knowledge.
The first lesson of Sarnaut's nightmares are waiting for you.

goal.en: Meet Spirit of Sadness along the Cursed Path.

startText.en:
We did it! I could have asked you to cut fish with a blunt knife, surf the Astral on a staff, and attempt to clap with one hand. It doesn't matter now, but what we have learned is that you need to forget yourself to understand who you are.
Now you can make the next step toward your Chosen Path. The path will lead to Cursed Path through ancient June traps, from the trail that Ath-Zak traveled. Go to the next shard of my consciousness, to the Spirit of Sadness. She will lead you through the next stages of your Path.

finishText.en:
Mental connection is nearly established... do not fight it... free your mind...
Do you want to know who we are? Well... you will know... In due time...

goal.en: Find out more of the whereabouts of Gipat's Lords.

startText.en:
Listen to the news I just found out.
Great Elf Mage, Zayan de Desirae, reviewed the materials you collected and sent back the results of his examination. These stones are indeed ancient, but "fresh", like the flint that Boris had. Village ghosts repeat almost word by word what is written in the records of Ath-Zak's adventures. It is obvious that everything happening here and now is a reconstruction, but this is a shard of the real Gipat, and not an expensive decoration.
What remains a mystery is who are the Lords of those Orcs. Zayan is very much interested in them. Follow the trails of Gipat and it will lead you straight to them.

finishText.en:
Osip started a boycott?
Well, that was expected. I would gladly return him to his precious death, which he misses so much with great pleasure. However, he is a key figure in our Performance.
I suppose we should negotiate the terms of his resurrection.
Are you surprised this seems to be an easy victory? You know, I can foresee the ending of this story, and believe me, we have nothing to lose. But I warn you, you have to work hard to ensure the resurrection succeeds. Think carefully if you're willing to go to such extremes...

goal.en: Find Gipat's Lords and inform them of Osip's resurrection request.

startText.en:
Ah, how time drags... It seems like the throat of our sandglass is tied and grains fail to go through. Look at you, you seem just as pale as the rest of us.
Watch as the years stretch just like the time Ath-Zak ambushed the cyclops from behind with a mighty blow. But that giant stood its ground. Damned thing! I even ran out of jokes to make Ath-Zak laugh. Even my ants in the shirt joke - not even a nose twitch. He would just stand there solid like the Cyclops! Those were good times. I miss them.
Sorry, I tend to think back on my wild past so I never forget.
Hey, are you going to visit the Masters of Gipat? Give them a message for me. Tell them that I declare a boycott. Either they resurrect me, or let the winds dispel me into their nightmares!

finishText.en: Well, how is it going? Are you not tired of listening to ghosts moan yet?

goal.en: Take the form of a ghost and speak to Osip Bazhov.

startText.en:
I heard that you managed to find common ground with the dragons? That's excellent! Perhaps you can also agree with the Lords?
What? No, I don't need anything from them. But it seems to me that Osip Bazhov is burdened by some sadness. I can't explain it - I am unable to speak to spirits. But I can sense his grief, buried deep inside. Try to enter the ghostly plane and talk to him. He will be glad of any help.

finishText.en:
We agree only with the triple alliance. The League and the Empire should put aside their petty war, then we will help you.
There is a beautiful tale about a wonderful planet where everybody has enough space, but its inhabitants strive to live close together. They understood that, together, it's easier to move forward. "Only through sharing others' misfortunes and joy can we truly feel alive. Together, we become one with the planet's essence and soul". Those were their exact words.
But one terrible day that planet shattered into pieces. The inhabitants became as lonely as the planet's drifting shards, swallowed by the Astral plane. The soul of their world has been splintered and they became estranged from each other...
I hope that you understand the meaning of this story and you can help me finish it with a happy ending from the present.

goal.en: Following the order of Victor Terdolobin, meet Gipat's Lords, and offer them Alliance with the Empire.

startText.en:
So, I have thought over our tactics. Obviously, we need an alliance with Lords. How to achieve such a task? They are certain that "The Empire and The League will die soon". I would like to wish this prophecy comes true by half haha...
Well, we have to coax them. So, what do Lords like? Right - the Performance. It means that you need to fulfill all the dragons' orders, collect the Signs, play your role, and see where that takes you. As soon as they introduce you to the Lords, you ask to do you a favor instead. Death to the League! Haha.
