Well, at least some assistance in our fight. Good luck, soldier.

finishText.en:
We agree only the triple alliance. The League and the Empire should put aside their petty war, then we will help you.
There is a beautiful tale about a wonderful planet where everybody has enough space, but its inhabitants strive to live close together. They understood that, together, it's easier to move forward. "Only through sharing others' misfortunes and joy can we truly feel alive. Together, we become one with the planet's essence and soul". Those were their exact words.
But one terrible day that planet shattered into pieces. The inhabitants became as lonely as the planet's drifting shards, swallowed by the Astral plane. The soul of their world has been splintered and they became estranged from each other...
I hope that you understand the meaning of this story and you can help me finish it with a happy ending from the present.

goal.en: Ask Masters about forming an alliance following an order of Laura de Grandeur.

startText.en:
I have been thinking all this time... It's nice when war brings no casualties - soldiers resurrect and are thrown into battle again. But after the death of thousands, feelings mold into a sense of meaninglessness. A week later, soldiers make jokes with the enemy and drink together.
Oh, Tensess, do I really grumble about your divine gift? Do I really want people to die again forever? It's time to wake up!
We need to establish an alliance with Masters. As far as I know, you have the best opportunity to follow the path of the great Ath-Zak. Seek out the Masters as he once did and discuss nothing but a hopeful and peaceful future.

checkText.en:
Did you pass the test?
Remember that the Path is not only testing your strength or courage, but an ability to see the Truth and make the right conclusions.

finishText.en:
Do you see? Do you see now? Astral monsters did not flinch outside their native Astral plane. They are no longer afraid of iron. They are becoming more clever... Learning to hide, wait, and gather strength.
What if during the Great Astral Campaign we were attacked by demons of this new breed? Would we have survived? What if such an onslaught happened tomorrow?
Why have they changed? Evolution? Or some alien plan out of our understanding? Who is teaching these demons ways of bring destruction to Sarnaut?
Think about all this on your way to the next ruin. There you will pass another test.

goal.en: Activate the ruin and pass the test, then talk to the Spirit of Doubt by the next ruins.

startText.en:
Close your eyes and cleanse your mind. Forget the League and the Empire, Tensess and Nezeb, Ath-Zak and Tka-Rik...
There is only you and the world, which must be accepted in order to change it forever. Get ready...
Place your hand on this ruin and pass your test.

checkText.en: Is the test passed? Do you know exactly what's going to happen? Well, of course not. That's the point of the test!

finishText.en:
Do you understand what's taking place, Chosen one? There are more and more enemies. When you cut off one head, more of them appear its place!
Why is this world being led into an abyss of destruction with each passing day? What governing power desires such sins to plague the lives of relatives, friends, enemies, to all of Sarnaut?
It's sick there is a strong desire of death to those who breathing and to those who haven't gotten a chance to peer into the eyes of their creator.
Who is ruling these demons? Or should I ask, what is ruling these demons? Move onward in search of answers.

goal.en: Activate ruin, pass the test, then talk to the Spirit of Sorrow by the next ruins.

startText.en:
Get ready for the next test, Chosen One. Be prepared before hand, do not relax.
School teaches you lots of things and you are used to having lots of time before confronted with the day's lesson. And when that bell rings, the test will end and you will be free.
But real tests will never give you chance to gather your thoughts. You have got to be on your toes and ready to act on instinct anytime regardless of the circumstances.
You know the drill. Touch the ruin and meet another horror foreign to this world.

checkText.en: Have you defeated the dangerous unknown?

finishText.en:
Victory! That demon mage apparently was the last ancient monster of its kind left behind from the Great Astral Campaign that warriors failed to defeat. The Astral Gateway is sealed for now... But demons will continue to penetrate into our world, destroying it particle by particle. These evil forces are pulsing all around us, more so than in the past. Unfortunately, Nezeb, Skrakan, and hundreds of great warriors gave their lives protecting Sarnaut from Astral destruction.
Do you feel your triumph, Chosen One? Does the taste of victory tickles your nerves and bring heat to cheeks? Do you feel happiness and release over your great feats?
The Great Astral Campaign... A great lie, a great mistake... Was the great June Tka-Rik who was sent to a useless death the only one who could defend this world?

goal.en: Activate the ancient ruin and pass the test, then meet the Spirit of Terror in the cave.

startText.en:
This is the third lesson about the unknown danger threatening Sarnaut. What is the use of powerful weapons and drawing one's blade if you don't know even know who the enemy is. There is no greater weapon that is more effective and destructive than Truth.
Touch and connect with the ruin, Chosen One. After you defeat whatever spawns, look into yourself and try to feel triumph and happiness for the most important victory ahead...

checkText.en: All the tests we have put you through have allowed you to absorb so much knowledge. We hope you have taken our words in open ears and an open mind.

finishText.en:
Oh, no! Instead of the phantom curse...demons? They are here and have already started to gather their forces!. They bypassed our defense system so fast...
No! It can't be! Millions and millions of Chosen Ones will have their Paths blocked. Oh, Prisoner, how insistently you are trying to break our Play! I knew, I felt something evil...
Damn! Probably, they are already on backstage. Lords will be cut down one at a time... Hurry, we must obstruct the demon forces!

goal.en: Connect with the last June ruin, defeat the Curse, and talk to the Spirit of Terror.

startText.en:
Welcome, Chosen One. Waiting for you is the final straightaway of your Path.
Feel desperation and fear of the last tribe fighting against the great evil that destroyed its people.
Teleport to the moment when Gipat was whole and without conflict. Imagine that your skin is streaked with bronze, your once great tribe is reduced to ashes, and the last Great Mage of your people is standing behind you. In front of you is the June Curse. Your name is Ath-Zak and it is a cold October in the year 786 of a new era...

finishText.en:
Demons started to appear from the Astral!
We need to act quickly!

goal.en: Activate the portal, walk along the ghostly bridge to the Astral coast, and meet Spirit of Benevolence.

startText.en:
Take this portal stone and activate it when you are in gates.
Don't be afraid and don't look down. Just run to the light beacons and try not to stumble. Another spirit guide will be waiting for you on the Astral coast.
If demons manage to block the entrance to the dungeon, then you and other Chosen Ones will be cut from Lords, and your Path will come to an end.
Our world will be doomed! Please hurry now...

finishText.en:
Quiet... calm down... Unpleasant mental connection... weird... at first... then becomes better... more comfortable... do not fight it...
Don't worry... I already know what you want to tell me...
I need time... to connect to your mind... patience... we'll discuss everything soon... wait...

goal.en: Go down to Dusky Cavern and talk to Lord Zullo.

startText.en:
You must descend into the Defiled Ruins! Find Lord Zullo and follow all of his commands.
The Performance is under threat of annihilation! Demons will do everything in their power to strip you from achieving Revelation! Your future... The fate of everyone lies in your hands.
You can make a world of difference. I believe in you... When you are ready, enter the labyrinth and prepare to face Astral hell!

checkText.en: We all must stand together in this struggle for survival!

finishText.en:
Thank you.
Now enter the cave. The Lords need your help!

startText.en:
Danger is now at the footsteps of the caves of Gipat. Look how many there are!
Right now we only have scouts to deal with although If we don't stop them as a whole, eaters and stranglers will make their way here. We must stop the invasion!
Our shield that protects the entrance is supported by power of the Astral plane. However, the forces of Lords has its limits. The only positive thing is that we can use power of our foes against them.
Your task is to fight with demons scouts and collect Astral ashes and dust pieces from their bodies. With the help of these magic essences, we can maintain the shield in working condition.

checkText.en: You're more familiar with the seamy side of the Performance. I'm not just here to lead individuals on the Path, but I also bear a responsibility for everything that happens here.

finishText.en:
Thank you.
Having examined these samples we will be able to understand the nature of the problems.

startText.en:
I must say you have redeemed yourself and my confidence in you is high as it was when we first met.
I have to admit maintenance of ghostly entities is a troublesome task. I've asked your help before with ghost busting. Now I ask for your assistance again.
Keeping track of ogres proved to be the most difficult. A curious observation - we thought we would have problems with bandits and villagers, but we were dead wrong...
Spectral ogres became rebellious! They don't adhere to their designated routes and we've received reports of their random outbursts of action aggression from wandering locals who tread too close to their comfort zone. We want to know the reason for their rage.
I beg you to help. We need to obtain some important artifacts, which allow us to understand why cannibals have gone mad. I'm speaking about ghost essence and ashes. You can find them fighting against ogres located around the Cursed Path.

finishText.en:
Historians sent you here, did they?
Are they more worried about my well being or the knowledge I possess? They want to know everything as soon as possible?
I see. That's the fate of all who don't have ages to wait.

goal.en: Find scientist Sarbaz Takhat somewhere along the path.

startText.en:
As you know we are researching Gipat and all of its glorious mysteries. We need to find out a lot in order to understand this allods' history. We have even asked detached specialists.
I'm speaking about ZIT scientist Sarbaz Takhat. He wanted to help us to understand the nature of ghosts living on Gipat. It's been weeks and we still don't have news of his whereabouts or findings.
He went along the road past Misty Shore. Please help us find him!

finishText.en:
Historians sent you here, did they?
Are they more worried about my well being or the knowledge I possess? They want to know everything as soon as possible? I see. That's the fate of all who don't have ages to wait.

goal.en: Find scientist Sarbaz Takhat somewhere along the path.

startText.en:
As you know we are researching Gipat and all of its glorious mysteries. We need to find out a lot in order to understand this allods' history. We have even asked detached specialists.
I'm speaking about ZIT scientist Sarbaz Takhat. He wanted to help us to understand the nature of ghosts living on Gipat. It's been weeks and we still don't have news of his whereabouts or findings.
He went along the road past Misty Shore. Please help us find him!

finishText.en:
Here it is - Treasure of Gipat!
And no need to share the fourth part of it.

goal.en: Search under the fallen blocks for something valuable.

startText.en:
Ancient treasures can be found in Junes ruins!
So we should examine this place with scrutiny.

checkText.en:
We could of spent more time searching for lost treasure, but these little dragons...
They have been watching us very intently!

finishText.en:
Ah, what a pity! Pity that it was not us who found the treasure!
So be it! Surely this is not the last treasure in Gipat! We will find our own treasure! No doubt about it!

goal.en: Examine June ruins southwest of the Cursed Path to find treasure of Gipat. Report back to Touchy Family once you have found it.

startText.en:
Do you know the story of this famous Ath-Zak?
Ah! So do we. He seems to be very famous. And hero means treasure!
We have already examined this wasteland but failed to find anything valuable. Pity, huh?
Maybe you will be more lucky? June ruins are home to great history and mystery. If we wanted to hide treasure, we would do so around ruins.
Have you ever been southwest the Cursed Path? There are isolated ruins there. Seek out ancient treasure!

checkText.en: Not enough Signs still.

finishText.en: Thank you for enduring my punishment. I now give you permission to move forward.

goal.en: Collect 14 Signs of the Chosen for permission to continue with the Path.

startText.en:
Naughty creature! Why have you become distracted into useless rebellion with goblins and follow rebels' orders?
Your unjustified acts show that you are not ready to continue on the Path. I will set a price for your mistakes. You must bring me fourteen Signs of the Chosen now!
You will repeat Ath-Zak's steps one by one each day until you understand what it means to be the Chosen One.

checkText.en: I hope I can answer all your questions.

finishText.en:
Now you know everything you need.
Good luck!

goal.en: Travel to Gipat and speak to the Spirit of Peace about the Astral Confrontation.

startText.en:
A new letter from Director instructs you to travel to Gipat and talk to the Spirit of Peace.
It might be worth listening to this Spirit.

checkText.en: Only after victory over Astral demon symbolizing the victory of Great Mages over Astral the ritual can be considered finished.

finishText.en:
So the ritual is finished!
From now on the power of your Martyr will be with you. You can use Martyr's Salvation ability to restore your strength after combat using drops of mirra that I give you. When you spend all of them, you will be able to buy more from Servants of Light.
Who knows, maybe you will have the honor to get the higher ranks of Patronage and your power will increase.

goal.en: Scatter the Handful of Astral Dust, defeat the Wretched Demon Mage, and report to Anastasia Yahontova.

startText.en:
Let me introduce myself - Anastasia Yahontova. On Clement's Isle I helped all the newcomers to get support in this life, prepare for oncoming trials. That's what I want to do now.
To begin with - a bit of history.
When Astral wave covered Sarnaut and started eating the world, Great Mages were the only ones who could resist Cataclysm. But Power and Knowledge must be paid! Twelve brave men gave their lives to protect this world. This was in vain! They are still with us, giving patronage, they are ready to give part of their power to those who wants their help.
That's what I want to offer you. We can hold the initiation ritual right here.
Take it. This is Astral dust piece. Go eastwards to the June stele on the coast. Scatter it there. And... accept the power and get the Martyr.
Wait, one more thing!
Appealing to the power of Twelve Great Martyrs, you will have to unwillingly disturb Astral. Astral demon will appear. Your target is to defeat him. I'm sure you'll succeed.

checkText.en: We've seen bloody battles in our time...

finishText.en: Good job! Remember, you need to improve your reputation towards the Soldiers of Fortune by participating in battlegrounds and collecting Battleground Emblems.

goal.en: Participate in Witch's Hollow and Deserted Farm battlegrounds, then report to Roughneck Family in Novograd.

startText.en:
Not only battlegrounds represent a great opportunity to prove that you are capable fighter - this is also a great way to obtain useful equipment. I can tell you more.

At the Witch's Hollow battleground your team must capture and hold key locations marked on the map. The more locations you control, the more points per second you are assigned. The first team to get 2500 points is the winner.

At the Deserted Farm the goal of your team is also to collect 2500 points, but there is only one key location in the middle of the battleground. June Bombards found by the team camps will help you to capture it.

All participants receive the reward according to their contribution. Pieces of Battleground Emblems are combined into the complete emblems that can be used to purchase equipment from Soldiers of Fortune's Quartermasters.

checkText.en: I hope everything will be all right, and that we finally solve the secret of this stone!

finishText.en:
Whoa, it's you!
Is that the stone's doing? Jeepers!

goal.en: Go to the Astral shore and activate the Mysterious Meteorite Stone. Then return to Selene de Ardeur.

startText.en:
You know, I'm really worried about Amanda. You should have seen how her face twisted up in terror when she saw where we ended up. Heehee!
Hm, but never mind me. I really don't mean to be mean, you see. Whoa! Did you see what I did there? Anyway, I'm willing to help Amanda through this emotional crisis.
I'm an Elf, aren't I? That means I know a thing or two about magic and you'd need to be a complete fool to not realize that the stones Amanda gave us had weird magical properties.
Thinking back to your escapade in Clement's Tower, it's safe to assume that you're no stranger to danger. So... I was hoping you could help me out with a little experiment.
Here's what I want you to do - try and activate the stone. Whoa, hold your horses - I didn't mean here! You should do it somewhere else... you know, for safety reasons. I'd suggest a deserted part of the beach. Go ahead, let's see what happens!

finishText.en:
Is that so? Selena believes that everything is connected to this small stone?
Maybe... But I should've figured it all out myself! How could I lose sight of those stones! Could it be that I misunderstood Uncle's notes?
Listen, I need some time to think about all this.

goal.en: Report on the results of the experiment to Amanda de Desirae.

startText.en:
What are you saying...

This mysterious stone can teleport you... where? To the nearest portal apparently... Amazing!

My cousin Marianne de Ardeur, the abbess of the Church of Light, reproached me often for neglecting magical disciplines. I wish she could see me now, solving the mystery of this strange stone!

Go see Amanda. She went deep into the island with her men. I hear they set up camp there. Find her and tell her everything. Tell her it's not her fault we ended up here. It's all because of this stone! I think...

But wait before going there - listen to what they have to say in our camp first. And gain a patron.

finishText.en: I'm so glad you're okay! It was quite brave of you to fight an Astral demon without any patronage! Few people can manage to do that.

goal.en: Meet with Anastasia Yahontova on Evermeet Isle.

startText.en:
I want to give you a little advice. One of the survivors is a wise Kanian druid named Anastasia Yahontova. She used to help some of the new recruits gain their patronage on Clement's Tower.
If you gain this patronage you'll become much stronger! It can help you defeat powerful enemies that you would normally be unable to conquer. Please, go talk to her. She's over by the fire.

checkText.en: Were you able to find the ruins?

finishText.en: You found the stones? Excellent! Give them to me so I can examine them.

goal.en: Find an ancient June stele along the northwestern shore, collect 3 ancient stones, and bring them to Amanda de Desirae.

startText.en:
Let's get back on this subject together. Here's what I've come up with.
The portal that brought us to this allod is the handiwork of the ancient June civilization. Just like these strange stones. Perhaps this is the answer. Could we be dealing with some ancient June magic that somehow connects these stones with the June portals? Could this be what brought us to this allod and not Novograd?
In order to verify this theory, I gathered some more stones. Now I need June items that still hold traces of magic.
Scouts report seeing a June ruin along the northwestern coast. The June used such steles to conduct their rituals. Please find these ruins and bring me back a few stones - obsidian are best.
Oh, I just can't wait!

checkText.en: Lok has explored the southeastern shore already, but he didn't say anything about Astral crystals. But then again, I didn't ask him to look for them. But you're probably more attentive than he is anyway.

finishText.en:
Yes! The powers of the Stone have been awakened. I can feel it!
Now I just need to figure out exactly how it works... It should just take a few experiments I'm sure! Just... stay here with me, okay? I feel more confident with you around.

goal.en: Explore the shore to the southeast in search of Astral Crystals. Charge the Meteorite Stone and bring it to Amanda de Desirae in the Scout Camp.

startText.en:
Yes, I can feel ancient traces of magic in these Stones! But they are very, very weak. I can't quite understand how they work.
Maybe if we increase the power of this magic, we'll be able to identify what it does. I know, we can use the Astral! Astral is pure magic itself, but it's very powerful and dangerous. Only Great Mages have been able to control it, and even then they can't solve all of its riddles.
Oh, don't worry, I'm not going to try something dangerous. That failed attempt with the resistance sphere in Clement's Tower was enough for me. But that doesn't mean that we should give up!
Sometimes Astral crystals grow along the shore that contain a small amount of Astral power. Uncle warned me that they can be dangerous to young mages... But I'm no young mage!
We need to find one of these crystals and try to awaken the power of those Stones. Go explore the southern shore and bring me back a crystal!

checkText.en: Leave me alone, will you...

finishText.en: Who are you? I don't like my solitude to be disturbed. But then again, that's already happened I suppose. These bandits are all over the place.

goal.en: Find the mysterious benefactor and ask for his help.

startText.en:
I'm afraid I just can't do it! What if something goes terribly wrong... again! I mean, I'm not a Great Mage yet!
Bah! I am an Elf, and we Elves never quit! That is the motto of not only the House de Desirae, but of Elves everywhere! If I can't figure out how these Stones work, but there are many lives at stake here and we must do something.
I know, what about our mysterious benefactor? If he's powerful enough to send us these supplies without our knowledge, then he's sure to possess great magical talent! Maybe he's even a Great Mage himself! He's got to be on this allod somewhere. Search every corner of it and ask him to help us get home!

checkText.en: Didn't I tell you to be patient?

finishText.en: It's done. Go ahead and take your mysterious stone back. Well, I guess it's not so "mysterious" anymore, is it? I believe that I've solved all of its mysteries. Make sure to hold on to it tightly - it's quite a treasure.

goal.en: Wait until the end of The Nameless One's ritual.

startText.en:
Let me see this mysterious stone. Now I will try to awaken the ancient magic of this artifact. When you're speaking about June magic you should always remember that it's a very strange and nearly forgotten practice. Amanda didn't know how it worked. In fact, most people don't know how it works. I'm only just beginning to understand it myself.

If I'm not mistaken, this artifact was used to tap into ancient teleportation trails.

They were used by the ancient June people to travel between different locations. This technology was one of the highlights of their civilization, and the activators were built so well that they are some of the only June structures that stand today. Roughly translated, they called these things "Adventurer's Stones".

You should be able to activate it whenever you're near some ancient June ruins to travel to other nearby ruins. After a quick ritual it should be as good as new.

checkText.en: Greetings! What do you want to talk about?

finishText.en: I've already heard about this new discovery! An ancient June artifact serving the League! Just the thought sends chills down my spine! Do you want to bind it's essence to this portal? I can help you with that!

goal.en: Speak with the Portal Keeper in Novograd and bind your Adventurer's Stone's essence to their portal.

startText.en:
This "Adventurer's Stone" of yours is a strange thing indeed! The Nameless One must have awoken some sort of ancient June magic in it. We must take it to the Elven emissary in Novograd - I'm sure our Elves will be able to create similar stones.
Think about it, each League citizen having their own stone and traveling through the Astral! Life will be so much easier!
You should remember that every time you discover a new June ruin you can bind your Stone's essence to that specific ruin. There are also highly skilled Portal Keepers that will bind your Stone's essence to their portal. Then you can activate your Stone to instantly return to those locations.

checkText.en: I'm in the mood for some fried venison. We know the best way to cook it! And there's the deer, you can see them from here. But I can't leave my post...

finishText.en: Thank you, I didn't expect that! The future doesn't look so bleak now.

goal.en: Bring 4 pieces of venison to the Bugeyed Family's camp in the birch grove.

startText.en:
Hey, want to help us out with something?

We all need to eat, right? We also have these crabs here, and gifts from a mysterious benefactor. But the scouts who went with Amanda are probably in trouble... There's a herd of deer not far from our camp, to the north from here. What do you say?

Can you get us four pieces of venison? After all, life is more fun on a full stomach, and the problems don't seem as daunting.

checkText.en: That Astral is so mysterious! You never know what to expect!

finishText.en:
So, what did you find? ...Hmm, that thing clearly had magical properties, but I'm afraid it doesn't have much practical use for us.
Well, we're glad that at least you benefitted from it! And let this be a lesson to you - there are lots of wondrous things in the world! You never know what you may stumble across and how useful it might be, so always remember to keep an eye out!

goal.en: Search the Bearded Crabs for anything useful and report to the Dumpling Family.

startText.en:
Hello! Remember us? We're really grateful for your help! We were there... when demons attacked. Ah, we really hoped we'd be teleported to Novograd!

But we wound up here, on this desert island... Though Amanda believes there has to be someone controlling this allod. Unless there's no meteorite ore here.

Well, it's not like we can do anything about it...

Have you seen the local crabs? Those speedy little bastards are running all over the shore!

We've noticed that they're not your regular crabs. We saw something similar on Umoir. It's all because of the Astral!

An elf once told me that certain creatures can develop magical abilities because of it! What did he say... Give a moment... Right! "Long-term exposure to the astral substance leads to irreversible changes in their bodies." There you go!

We wonder if their mutations could be useful to us? We should find out! On Umoir, we extracted astral blobs from them. Maybe we can do that here?

We want you to hunt those crabs for us. If you find an astral blob, try and figure out how it works!

checkText.en: I saw another snake just now! They're disgusting!

finishText.en:
So, it's ten adders that you've killed? Not enough! I've got to think up some kind of poison to get rid of them once and for all.
In the meantime I think I'll stay here and look at the June ruins. They're the stones right there on the shore. They're the remains of a lost civilization, you know.
Such ruins always seem to attract bounty hunters. Barbarians! They hope to find something valuable and don't realize the ruins are valuable all by themselves. They are so beautiful!...

goal.en: Kill 3 Forest Adders and report to Alice de Doucer.

startText.en:
Out of the frying pan and into the fire! We leave the Great Mage's tower and find ourselves in this dump! No shower, no nothing...
And the snakes around here! I took a couple of steps into the birch grove and this nasty adder was all over me. I just barely escaped with my life! I mean, crazy, right?
Hm, I remember your face... Ah, I got it - I've seen you in the portal battle! Great! You're the one I need!
Go into the grove and kill every adder in sight. Since we're probably stuck here, we might as well try and turn this creepy place into something enjoyable and safe. So, I'll take care of all the hard management work and you... you just get in there and hit stuff.
If you need something, just let me know. I am a Servant of the Light! I can always provide you with drops of mirra. Remember, the Church is there to help those in need!

checkText.en: Do you have any news from Daria? I miss her so much.

finishText.en: Dog Rose Berries? For me? Well, it's very nice of you, and so touching. Though I'd have preferred... Never mind, many thanks.

goal.en: Gather 3 Dog Rose Berries and take them to Nikolai Rubtsov in the Scout Camp.

startText.en:
Nikolai Rubtsov, my... well, a good friend of mine, went inland on a scouting mission. They hope to find some way of leaving this place. I'm sure they can do it - my Slavuta is with them!
I'd like to support my friend. I saw some dog rose bushes in the forest and that's his favorite berry! Do me a favor and gather some to take to him as a present from me. My mother used to say that showing attention to your loved ones can be a great help in times of trouble.
Please beware of adders! Try not to disturb them while gathering the berries.

checkText.en: Yay! There you finally are! I kept my fingers crossed for your safe return. Things are definitely going to get better with you around! So, what news do you have for me?

finishText.en: Wow! We can really make use of all of these! I wonder who it's from. Well, I guess we shouldn't worry about that for now. Meanwhile, choose whatever you want from this box.

goal.en: Take the Mysterious Box of Supplies to Amanda de Desirae.

startText.en:
That melancholy Elf over there took a stroll along the shore and found this strange box. Of course, we've already opened it - inside there were weapons, food, medicine, and clothes - all you need to live on a deserted allod! It's an answer to our prayers, like someone knew just what we needed!
We've got to send some of these to our scouts and tell them about the find. We have a feeling this allod isn't so deserted after all. The scouts went north along the path through the birch grove. Get on up to their camp as fast as you can!

finishText.en: Hey there! I can see that you, too, have been blessed by a visit from the muses! Great! There's nothing better than a good song! Well, except for throngs of attentive listeners.

goal.en: Talk to Charles de Vevre, who can introduce you to the talents of a bard.

startText.en:
Hear ye! Hear ye!
Can you hold a weapon? Do you believe in freedom, equality, and brotherhood? Then our trainers of Novograd are here to set you on the path to victory!
The most experienced and wisest teachers are prepared to share their knowledge.
What are your interests? Do you sing well? Can you play? Good enough! A good singer-musician has great prospects!
If you'd like to learn some new songs, meet with Charles de Vevre in Novograd's Elven District. They say he's got a voice of gold!

finishText.en:
You want to be a warden?
You're sure that you want to learn our ancient magic?

goal.en: Speak with Timur Siniakov in the Main Square.

startText.en:
Hear ye! Hear ye!
Can you hold a weapon? Do you believe in freedom, equality, and brotherhood? Then our trainers of Novograd are here to set you on the path to victory!
Our wisest and most experienced trainers are eager to share their knowledge with you!
Oho, you're interested in becoming a warden? How mysterious! As a warden, you'll befriend the beasts and learn to bend nature to your will. How exciting!
Let me just check my list... Ah, Timur Siniakov! He will be your trainer. Don't just stand around, you need to go make yourself useful to the League!

finishText.en: Engineering? We Kanians are beyond compare in this sphere! Gunshots and explosions are like music to our ears!

goal.en: Talk to Danil Cooley to learn engineering.

You're not spellcasting kind, and you are not into weapons, either? You say you're good with figures and formulas? You're an engineer then, eh?
Let me just check my list... Ah, Danil Cooley! He will be your trainer. Don't just stand around, you need to go make yourself useful to the League!

finishText.en:
Hm, you wish to become a mage?
Stand up straight, child! You need to have discipline if you wish to learn from me!

finishText.en:

checkText.en: May the Light bless you!

finishText.en:

Well, step right up! We'll teach you everything you need to know!

goal.en: Speak with the Acrobatic Family in the Gibberling District.

goal.en: Speak with Dobrinya Bykov in the Main Square to learn more about becoming a warrior.

startText.en:
Hear ye! Hear ye!
Can you hold a weapon? Do you believe in freedom, equality, and brotherhood? Then our trainers of Novograd are here to set you on the path to victory!
Our wisest and most experienced trainers are eager to share their knowledge with you!
Oho, you're interested in becoming a warrior? How commendable! As a warrior, you'll master the art of close combat. How exciting!
Let me just check my list... Ah, Dobrinya Bykov! He will be your trainer. Don't just stand around, you need to go make yourself useful to the League!

checkText.en: How's the lynx hunt going?

finishText.en: Great! Sharp and strong claws and fangs - all you need to make good hunting weapons!

goal.en: Gather 3 Lynx Fangs and Lynx Claws and bring them to the Bugeyed Family in the Scout Camp.

startText.en:
We were well known hunters on Isa. We used to spend our days helping them on their hunts. One of their experienced hunters would often say - "like cures like." We took it to mean that the thing that kills you can also cure you.
Northwest of here is the Twilight Forest where the lynx live. One of the beasts wounded a fella of ours already - we're going to have to face them more than once if we want to survive here.
That's why we're going to make weapons! But first, we'll need to gather sharp tips for them. Lynx fangs and claws will do just fine for that purpose. Get them for us and we'll give you the first weapon we make.

checkText.en: Have I been avenged? Are those ginger rogues dead?

finishText.en: Great job! I only wish I could have done it myself. Please choose your reward.

goal.en: Kill 3 Ginger Lynxes, then find and kill the Great Ginger Lynx in the Twilight Forest. Report to Nikolai Rubtsov in the Scout Camp.

startText.en:
There's nothing worse than being a burden on others. Damn! If not for these wounds I would go out there and slay the menace myself...
You see, we were attacked while scouting. Several beasts ambushed us from the thicket - I fought like a mad Orc! I was pushing my way through, cat after cat - but there was one special lynx among them, a strong and massive beast.
Look! These scars on my chest are her signature. An underhanded strike! She attacked me and used the cover of her fellow lynx to escape!
Take vengeance for me. Go into the Twilight Forest and kill ten of those ginger beasts. Then find the great lynx in the eastern part of the forest and kill that ugly thing.
I'll have a good reward waiting for you.

checkText.en: Have you found any plantain leaves?

finishText.en:
Good. Now we're prepared for any surprises.
If you manage to find more, we would be grateful!

goal.en: Gather 5 Plantain Leaves and take them to Alfred de Delice at the Scout Camp.

startText.en:
The recent accident has shown that we are unprepared for life on this allod. If not for the plantain shrub that happened to be nearby, the man would have bled to death.

Unfortunately, this is the only medicinal herb we have found here. It grows all over the allod, but this place is rather dangerous.

Could you please bring me five plantain leaves? I've run out, and we'd do well to have some of it in reserve.

checkText.en: Ah, so you're back. What happened?

finishText.en: What a scoundrel! All of that fuss over nobility and honor. I will never understand how humans can be so silly. Now beauty... that's something worth quarreling over. Anyway, thank you for saving Mila and returning this chest to me.

goal.en: Find Mila Dubovskaya and Veleslav Seversky in the Twilight Forest. Defeat Veleslav, recover the Chest of Meteorite Stones and return it to Amanda.

startText.en:
I have a bit of a problem at the moment. You see, Mila Dubovskaya and Veleslav Seversky went out scouting with us. They're both from noble society, very respected in Kania. They were quarrelling quite loudly and I heard Veleslav was saying something about his brother, that he fights for truth.
I didn't pay attention to the details. Those are human issues and Elves aren't interested in petty quarrels. But maybe I was wrong to ignore them this time.
They were supposed to come back several hours ago, but no one has seen them. I'm worried something might have happened.
To make matters worse, Mila asked me to give her several of those Stones from my Uncle's lab. I saw no harm in letting her study them, but I would like them back eventually! Search for them in the Twilight Forest, find them, and recover the chest full of Meteorite Stones.

checkText.en: Have you found Mila and Veleslav?

finishText.en: What?! Veleslav was partially responsible for my uncle's death? Kanian noblemen! They are a disgrace to the League! And now my uncle is dead because of these horrible stones...

goal.en: Accompany Mila back to the camp and notify Amanda de Desirae.

startText.en:
Thank the Light! I owe you. Veleslav... Oh, I'm so ashamed to speak about that. You see, Seversky is an ancient and respected family, relatives of the Valirs! But they are also the ones responsible for our troubles.
You see, him and his brother Boris helped get the rebels in to Clement's Tower. Their goal was to steal this strange chest of meteorite stones and any other useful materials to aid them in a rebellion against the Kanian government!
Amanda managed to get the stones first, so Veleslav decided to pose as a refugee in hopes of stealing them from her later. He didn't want to draw attention to himself, so he blackmailed me into getting them from Amanda myself. Turns out he was planning on killing me anyway once I finished his task. Only you saved me from death!
Please help me get back to the Scout Camp. And tell Amanda about what happened... I'll be too embarrassed to show my face to her for a long time.

checkText.en: Poor thing... I wonder who would want to hurt this Gibberling?

finishText.en: The Gibberling is safe for now. His wounds have been healed and death no longer threatens him. But this mysterious native is clearly out of his mind. His eyes are hazy and he cannot speak in coherent sentences. The sad condition he's in was apparently caused by something more than just physical injuries.

goal.en: Use the Scroll of Healing on Ton the Windblower and talk to Daniel de Pluie.

startText.en:
While you were gone, some very interesting developments came to light. The scouts found a Gibberling that had been badly wounded on the northern coast. He must thank Tensess for our appearing here! He's at death's door with terrible wounds inflicted on him by some unknown monster.
Luckily, there was a Scroll of Healing in the box of supplies. I'd very much like to have a chat with him. If he's been here for a long time, he might be able to shed some light on a few of this allod's mysteries.
You'll find him by the hut on the northern coast. Use the scroll and ask him any questions you can. If there are any problems, talk to Daniel. He's there doing all he can to save the poor Gibberling.

checkText.en: Have you brought the crab meat?

finishText.en: Look! He's definitely showing some signs of recovery. At the very least he understands that this is food and what to do with it. What an appetite!

goal.en: Bring 3 pieces of Stringy Crab Meat to Daniel de Pluie.

startText.en:
Perhaps the cause of his insanity is simple. Hunger! Look at how emaciated he is!

Now, there are many crabs in this area. And the heaps of shells around the patient's hut indicate that to have been his staple diet. Perhaps the injuries have made him unable to gain sustenance, which led to hunger and, in turn, madness. This can be verified easily as well as fixed if the hypothesis is correct.

Bring me three pieces of crab meat. We'll feed the patient and check this first theory.

checkText.en: Did you manage to find the giant crab?

finishText.en:
Oh, Great Astral! It's a monster! If this doesn't work, I don't know what else we could even attempt to try.
Let's show this loathsome thing to our patient... Aha! It's working! Our Gibberling is definitely regaining his senses...

goal.en: Collect a Giant Crab Head from the Giant Thorny Crab and bring it to Daniel de Pluie.

startText.en:
The last of my theories pertains to the terrible wounds suffered by our patient. Judging by the bite marks, it was definitely not a lynx.
Perhaps the cause of his madness is fear. Something scared him immensely and the Gibberling went insane. Dilated pupils and that indistinct babble are the first symptoms of such madness.
Shock therapy is the only cure in cases such as this. The patient experiences a shock so great that the new fear overcomes the previous one, bringing him back to his right mind.
I've seen some prints left by a giant crab's nippers on the coast. These creatures aren't normally beautiful and if it is an especially gigantic and ugly one...
Hey, that's an idea. The tracks lead eastwards along the coast. Go find this grotesque beast, kill it, and bring me its head. We'll show it to our patient and... well, we'll see what happens.

checkText.en: How is your search going?

finishText.en:
Wow, his family's portrait! If loneliness is the cause of his madness, this is the best possible cure!
...Look! He's crying! This means he's regaining his... um... Gibberling feelings!

goal.en: Find the Gibberling Family Portrait and bring it to Daniel de Pluie.

startText.en:
Another theory concerning the cause of his insanity is loneliness. He has apparently been living on the allod alone for the past few years. No wonder he has lost his wits!
To bring him back to normal, we'll need something from his past, some kind of memoir from his previous life. Our patient's hut is made of the remains of an Astral ship, we can assume he wrecked on some nearby rocks.
Search the coast for the crash site. Perhaps you will find something that can remind the Gibberling of his past and restore his sanity.

checkText.en: What have you learned from the Gibberling?

finishText.en: Well, well. Now it's all starting to add up. I'll have a new mission for you.

goal.en: Relay Ton the Windblower's story to Amanda de Desirae at the Scout Camp.

startText.en:
Now I can rest easy. It's time to tell you what happened just recently.

The last thing I remember is our encounter with some strange Kanians. I was so happy when I heard the voices! But those evil people just laughed at me. They sicced a giant bear on me!

So that's what you should know: there's some good power dwelling here. But there are also malicious people...

We need to find a way out of here... or else this island will become our grave! Tell that to everyone in your camp so you don't make the same mistakes...

checkText.en: Were you able to set up the signal light?

finishText.en: Wonderful! Now all we have to do is wait... Wait and hope!

goal.en: Find a Ghostly Light and place it near the June Ruins on the northwest shore. Report back to Alfred de Delice

startText.en:
Now that we have what we need, let's think of how to get off this allod. Amanda thinks the chances of survival are pretty small, and there's little hope of outside help - as huge as the Astral is, the odds of a ship passing by are slim to none. But me, I believe in the best!
Lok told me that the western shore is inhabited by will-o'-the-wisps. These creatures are cryptic enough, but now's not the time to study them. We'll just go on what we know about them.
You'll have to kill them to find the ghost lights. This supernatural substance can maintain a steady radiance for a long while. Once you find one, you'll have to set it on somewhere on the shore that's elevated - the June ruin should do.
If a ship should pass by, the crew will notice our signal. This is our chance and we can't let it slip by!

checkText.en: Have you found the ship's log yet?

finishText.en:
Give me a moment to look into the ship's log.
So... Hm, oh dear.
Oho! That explains a lot.

goal.en: Take the Ship's Log to Amanda de Desirae.

startText.en:
One of our scouts, Lok, was sent to explore the southeastern part of the allod. Can you guess what he found? An Astral ship crashed on the rocks! Lok claims that it was the same exact ship he'd seen at Clement's Tower immediately before the catastrophe.
Perhaps these ‘others' who attacked the Gibberling were on that ship. Maybe fate has thrown us together with the culprits responsible for Clement's Tower! This must be investigated. Lok says the ship is crawling with the undead and didn't dare to poke his head in, but you're tough enough to do that.
Go to the southeast shore, find the ship, and investigate. What I'm really interested in is the ship's log. Once we have it, we can decide what to do next.

checkText.en: Have you managed to find everything I need for my book?

finishText.en: This is perfect! Now if you will please excuse me, I've got some writing to do.

goal.en: Bring 3 Owl Feathers, a Birch Bark Scroll, and Black Chokeberries to Alfred de Delice in the Scout Camp.

startText.en:
I miss putting a pen to paper more than anything else. I feel my duty is to chronicle our adventures. This story could become extremely popular when we return to the mainland!
And with good reason. A group of men, Elves, and Gibberlings miraculously end up on a deserted allod. A mysterious benefactor, some evil enemies, a terrible polar bear... No one has ever written anything like this!
You can help me. I've seen some black chokeberry bushes nearby, I can make ink out of those. And there have been owls spotted to the west of here, their feathers will make fine pens. Birch bark can be used as my paper.
Bring all that to me and I'll make you my book's main character. "The Mysterious Isle," I'll call it! Or even better - "Lost!" It'll be a true masterpiece!

checkText.en: Oh, you've come just in time!

finishText.en:
Oh, shame on me, shame on me! Caught like some sort of greenhorn! All because I was alone - I wish Shpok and Glok were here. Oh, man!
Well, every cloud has a silver lining, right? I managed to uncover some information and, more importantly, steal from those cutthroats. Look at these beautiful weapons I pinched! You can choose anything you like.

goal.en: Find Lok in the cave to the northeast.

startText.en:
Let's see... The wrecked ship is definitely the one we saw at Clement's Tower. When my uncle died and everyone was rushing to escape, the captain realized too late that his passengers were rebels and murderers. The crew tried to arrest the criminals but failed. The captain then crashed the ship against the rocky shore. This was how they found themselves here.
I feel like the whole incident is coming to a head. While you were absent, our mysterious benefactor brought us another present. It contains weapons and a note. The letter said that the rebels from the wrecked ship have found his shelter. It's hidden in a deep cave in the Eastern part of the allod.
He asks us to help expel them, promising to send us to Kania in exchange for our help. This is our chance!
I've already sent Lok, our best scout, to search the cave but I'm sure he could use some help. Follow Lok's trail, find him, and... well, frankly, I don't know what to do next. You better play it by ear.

checkText.en: What can I do for you?

finishText.en: I've seen you before... You're one of those who came through the portal. Perhaps you'll be able to achieve what I cannot.

goal.en: Kill Arsene de Vevre and talk to the Nameless One.

startText.en:
Okay, here's the situation. Our mysterious benefactor has been living on this allod as a hermit for many years and is apparently a very powerful mage. He's the one that's been helping the shipwrecked Gibberling, and when we appeared together with those bastard criminals that attacked our mage, he decided to do the same for both groups.
But the others have worked out where his shelter is. This is where I came into the story. One of the attackers, a necromancer, threatened to kill me if our benefactor didn't hand his ship over to them. And guess what? He agreed! I'm shocked!
The bay where his ship is docked can be accessed through this cave. Many of them have already started boarding, so you must hurry! My advice is to find the necromancer first - he stayed behind to ward off any intruders. You must deal with him and then find our benefactor's shelter.

checkText.en: How did it go? Did you manage to find one?

finishText.en: Excellent! But what I'm going to ask you to do next will be tough...

goal.en: Find an Access Crystal for The Nameless One.

startText.en:
Normally I hate to ask for favors since it goes against my solitary nature, but those loathsome mutineers have stolen all of the access crystals for my ship. We're going to need to find one if you want to get on board.
Go down there and slay as many as you need to. One of them must have a crystal on them.

checkText.en: Have you found my artifacts?

finishText.en: So the menace is done with... Now it is time for you to leave my allod. First you must choose your reward.

goal.en: Use the boarding device to teleport to the ship, find the Ancient June Cup, Sacrificial Dagger and Obsidian Rod and bring them to the Nameless One.

startText.en:
This choice is completely tearing me apart! It's putting your life on the line by taking out these delinquents versus keeping my pledge.
I'm sorry, but right now the former means more to me.
We'll have to board the ship and in order to do that we'll need that crystal you plucked from a mutineer earlier.
These outlaws are led by a druid whose terrifying pet polar bear is almost always by his side, they'll be carrying a sacrificial dagger and an ancient June cup. Those two are the core of this gang and your key target. Your other target is their navigator, she'll have an obsidian rod.
With those three gone, these criminals will easily be crushed! When you're done, bring these items back to me and I will help you and your friends leave this allod.

finishText.en: That sounds pretty amazing! Too bad we don't have time to stay and chat. The ship to Kania will be here any moment! Perhaps we shall meet again under happier circumstances!

goal.en: Use the June ruins to travel to the allod where the rescue ship is set to arrive when you are ready to leave Evermeet Isle.

startText.en:
I've contacted a Kanian patrol ship. It will be here shortly to take you and your friends back to Kania. However, I would like to keep my part in this story secret.
That is why the ship has been ordered to dock at a small allod not far from here. This way you and your companions can be rescued without me ever being seen.
Soon I too will leave this allod - it has already become unsuitable for fulfilling my vow of solitude. One of your friends, if not you, may give away my secret and I need to find peace.
When you are ready, use the June ruins to travel to the spot the ship is set to arrive. I wish you the best of luck in your future adventures!

checkText.en: We are the Gray Family, the Gibberling Ambassadors in Novograd. Asgerd, Stein, and Torvar. It is our great pleasure to make your acquaintance. What news do you have?

finishText.en: I see. Even though that expedition failed, I'm sure that one will eventually find our beloved homeland.

goal.en: Visit the Gibberling Embassy in Novograd and relate Ton the Windblower's story.

startText.en:
At long last I saw the mage I owe my life to! He's a strange one. I tried to thank him, and he started waving his hands and talking ‘bout some urgent business. Ah, to heck with him!
I decided to wait for the others with the Elf. Since you'll be the first to Novograd, will you do me a favor? Please visit the Gibberling Embassy in the Gibberling District and tell them my story. I'm sorry to say that my search has failed. I was not able to find the Gibberling homeland but maybe other scouts will have more luck.
Thank you for everything. Losing my sisters was a serious blow, I tell you. But I will continue on my way, perhaps together with Lok, another loner like myself. Together we'll have an easier time dealing with our loss. Maybe we'll meet again one day!

finishText.en: Information pertaining to the rebels? We need any kind of information we can get now. Go ahead, I'm listening.

goal.en: Report to the Novograd Detective Bureau on everything that occurred on Evermeet Isle.

startText.en:
Our mysterious benefactor has sent Ton and I to this small allod. The others should soon be here as well. Tell me, did the mage introduce himself to you? No? I wonder who he is. What a curious man...
Don't bother waiting for the others. Take the first ship you see and head on over to the League headquarters in Novograd. Everything that happened at Clement's Tower and our experience here on this allod must be reported at once! There is a rebellion developing and it must be stopped before it's too late!
It's amazing. I was at Clement's Tower for military training to fight against the Empire. I didn't expect war to catch us so soon. And right here in the very heart of the League! We're caught in the middle of great changes, I can feel it. When you get back to Novograd make sure to report to the proper authorities immediately. I'm sure the League will want to know what happened.

checkText.en: Sometimes I think that she wants to be destroyed so she can rest in peace. But when I tried to fight her, I nearly died myself!

finishText.en: Thank you. Now I can sleep peacefully.

goal.en: Kill the Damned Soul and notify Ton the Windblower.

startText.en:
Turn around, don't look... I'm crying here like a girl, but I can't help it... I remember everything now...

My name is Ton the Windblower. My sisters and I were on an important mission, but our ship hit these rocks... I was completely alone here for three years. And I would have probably died... If some mysterious benefactor hadn't provided me with supplies and weapons!

I want to ask a favor of you...

My loneliness on the island was particularly awful because sometimes I saw it... The cursed Spark. Or rather... it found me.

They say cursed Sparks are the doomed souls of evil people, orcs, elves... But I doubt even churchmen can make sense of it all. I know one thing for certain - there's ill will in this Spark! It's a vicious enemy that knows no fear or mercy!

We might be able to leave the island. But even on the mainland, the thought that it might find me again will keep me up at night. It needs to be destroyed. Do it, and I will be able to regain my peace of mind.

checkText.en: Bring us anything of use, anything! Now, we especially need Potions of Determination.

finishText.en: Wow, thanks! On behalf of all Gibberlings, thank you!

goal.en: Bring 20 average potions of Determination to the Attentive Family at the Quiet Harbor to improve your reputation with the Gibberlings.

startText.en:
Are you an alchemist, by any chance?

We could really use one right now! There are enemies all around - snow monsters, harpies, bears... We can hardly manage to shoot them down as they come! It's so cold that it takes half a dozen arrows to hit the target.

So if you want to earn the Gibberlings' gratitude and improve your reputation, bring us 20 average potions of Determination. That's going to be good for everyone!

checkText.en: Hurry up! I want to see if you know what they say!

finishText.en:
You found them?
Oh, you don't know what they say either. How disappointing.

goal.en: Find the 3 Stones around Frozen Frontier and report back to the Slider Family in Quiet Harbor.

startText.en:
There are these funny stones all around Frozen Frontier. We're not too sure what their original purpose was, but we like to use them to figure out what island we're on since they each have different markings on them!
See, the Bold Hill stone has squiggles that look like this and the Shaggy Island squiggles are similar, but this one particular squiggle really stands out! And the squiggles on the stone on stone on Nordheim are something else completely! It's all very interesting!
You should go check it out for yourself! And then come back and tell me if you can figure out what the squiggles say.

checkText.en: Have you found and trophies yet?

finishText.en:
See! I knew you were brave!
My brother here wasn't so sure, but you really showed him!

goal.en: Collect 4 Frozen Frontier Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to the Slider Family in Quiet Harbor.

startText.en:
It's scary out there. It's okay to admit it. We know it!
Especially with creatures out there like Sagefeather, Bartach, Icemaw, Nightscreech, Razika, and Arkando Icefist! But work must be done! So we want you to go out there and face your fears. It's the only way we'll be able to know for sure that you're not afraid of the beasties that lurk in the dark!
Bring us back four trophies from nasty creatures like the ones that we named off and we'll make sure to tell everyone that you're the bravest adventurer we know!

checkText.en: Those hooligans better fear your name now!

finishText.en:
Thank you!
It'll be so much safer here on Frozen Frontier for us Gibberlings now!

goal.en: Kill 50 miners on the islands of Frozen Frontier and return to the Slider Family in Quiet Harbor.

startText.en:
This land doesn't completely belong to the Gibberlings. The mountainfolk miners have proved to be a huge threat to us and this land!
They're stealing all the natural resources! And to make matters worse, those nasty miners are completely feral! They're like wild animals out there! They just won't listen to reason...
And that's where you come in. We want you do go out there an teach them all a lesson! Let them know that if they don't want to end up on the endangered species list, they better make nice with us!

checkText.en: You can find stones with Astral ice essence all along the shores of Frozen Frontier.

finishText.en:
Amazing!
I'm sure Aidenus will start doing flips once he sees all this!

goal.en: Find and collect 5 samples of Astral Ice Essence for the Slider Family in Quiet Harbor.

startText.en:
Frozen Frontier makes something that everyone wants! Something that's invaluable to the League and only we have it!
We're talking about Astral ice essence, of course! It's a magical substance that can only be made when the Astral meets the extreme cold. So magical that even the great mages are drooling themselves over it! Aidenus is constantly asking about our captains if they brought the essence back to Novograd.
So we want you to go out and see if you can't find any that we can send to Aidenus!

checkText.en: You've done them all? Already?

finishText.en:
Thank you! You have no idea how big of a help you've been!
Go ahead and take whatever reward you'd like!

goal.en: Complete all of the Slider Family's tasks and return to them in Quiet Harbor.

startText.en:
If you do everything that we ask, then we promise to give you one of our most prized treasures! We're sure that it will help you on any adventure that you chose to take from here on out!
So, please help us with the squiggly stones, miners, and dangerous beasties!

checkText.en: Security comes first! That's our captain's motto!

finishText.en: Good job! We thank you on behalf of all the Gibberlings!

goal.en: Kill an Icy Dragon on Nordheim Isle and return to the Cunning Family.

startText.en:
So, now we know how to fight the dragon. And more importantly, we know that we can win. It's simply a matter of knowing the correct strategy!
It's time to put an end to these monsters. Nordheim Isle is to be the new hunting ground for the Gibberlings - and for you too! For every dragon you kill we'll be eternally grateful.
Just make sure you are well-prepared. Nordheim is a tough place, the cold can freeze you out before you reach your opponents. Bring some ale and whatever useful potions you can find!

checkText.en: When we first decided to use the ruins, we were terribly frightened! But now we're used to it and we even like it!

finishText.en: Great job! Wasn't that fun?

goal.en: Use the June ruins to get to another allod and return to the Stubborn Family.

startText.en:
The only way to move between the allods of this archipelago is to use the ancient teleportation trails. They're made of magical energy that goes from one June ruin to another.
At first it's a little frightening using the power of the ruins. You have to float over the Astral with nothing but a magical sphere to keep you from falling forever! We nearly passed out the first time we tried it. Unfortunately, there's no other way to move between the allods.
If you're going to be spending some time here you better get used to it. We suggest you try the ruins out as soon as possible. Come back to us when you're done and tell us what you think!

finishText.en:
Of course we know all about the Sludge Splitter - she's an excellent vessel, especially if she's properly captained. We remember sailing side by side with the Sludge Splitter in the Astral - those show-offs overtook us and then offered to tow us!
We're not surprised that her captains ended up running into trouble. Well, we can hardly ignore the plight of our fellow Gibberlings, can we? We'll send a crate of meteorite to help those hapless fellows soon. Thanks for informing us.

goal.en: Speak to the Cunning Family in Frozen Frontier.

startText.en:
Fortunately, we've gotten our cargo back. The thing is, our ship's still busted and we can't leave! We've run out of meteorite ore. We feel so foolish. Only a moronic Orc would run out of something like that.
Are you heading for Frozen Frontier any time soon? It's a small archipelago to the northwest of here. It's a territory that was gifted to us Gibberlings by a Kanian lord.
We know for a fact that the Little Sparrow is moored there. Her captains are old friends of ours. We know they'll find a way to get an emergency supply of meteorite to us if you could take a message to them about our troubles.

checkText.en: I'm surprised to see that anyone out here is still sober...

finishText.en:
Re-p-p-place who? Those old bellyaching fools must have lost their m-m-marbles. Replace them! They've only just gone on duty!
Last night they managed to down three b-b-bottles of ale and another two bottles of homebrew and completely d-d-drank themselves under the table. They're a disgrace! Let them sit out there and reflect on their behavior. I've had it up to here with their t-t-troubles.
Leave them there to suffer without anything to d-d-drink and without anyone to fuss over them. We G-G-Gibberlings are made of stern stuff!

goal.en: Speak with Torn the Stutterer in Quiet Harbor.

startText.en:
Well, hello... hic. Sorry... there's nothing left. There's nothing worse for a Gibberling than seeing the bottom of a barrel of ale. When the cold weather started approaching, we collected everything up and downed the lot!... Hic...
Shame you weren't here, we had a really good time! And by the time the ice monster showed up, we were already completely sloshed. Yeah... it was a good thing that the barrels were already empty. It meant we had somewhere to hide. A blessing in disguise, as the saying goes...
Anyway... we've been dealing with the enemy since early this morning. Does it show? We're stuck here, waiting for a new ship to arrive with supplies... hic! We're sure the others are still putting the ale away - yep, no doubt about it. Where's the justice in that, eh?
Listen... Could you pay a visit to the boss for us? We think he forgot to send someone to replace us. Hic... we'll be eternally in your debt. Just don't say anything to him about him being alone! It drives him absolutely mad.

checkText.en: Ah! Oh, my poor old heart. I almost jumped out of my skin...

finishText.en: So, the monster made it past the western p-p-patrol again... It's time we dealt with this p-p-problem by whatever means n-n-necessary...

goal.en: Check on the patrols on the east and west sides on the allod.

startText.en:
The w-w-worst problem out here is the ice and the cold. We G-G-Gibberlings are a friendly, hard working people - even in these barren snowbound lands. But somehow an ice m-m-monster has found its way into these parts. We d-d-don't know anything about it except that it came from the Astral. I dispatched patrols to all f-f-four corners of the allod. But last night, in the middle of the drinking, the monster caught us unawares. I've no idea what happened to the p-p-patrols - they didn't light any flares or anything. Something's not r-r-right!
I can see you're up for an adventure. So, here's a challenge for you - head out to the eastern shore of the allod and f-f-find out what happened to the patrols that I posted there. After that, f-f-find the second patrol around Bold Hill.
Once you've found them... C-c-come back and see me.

checkText.en: Just look at these poor, frozen specimens. They've turned blue from the cold!

finishText.en: Oh, thank you! Let us give you a hug!

goal.en: Hug and help three frozen Gibberlings get warm. Report to the Attentive Family at the Quiet Harbor.

startText.en:
Do you see what that monster has done? These poor bastards didn't manage to hide in time. Just one blow of the monster's icy breath and that was it. Now we can't tell our Gibberling brothers apart from the icicles.
We don't know what to do. Maybe light a fire next to them? Or perhaps pour some boiling water over them? We don't want to upset them when they come round. No, we'll have to try a more tender approach - Gibberlings respond better to a gentle touch.
You'll have to hug each and every one of them as hard as possible and warm them up with your body heat. Just be careful that we don't end up having to defrost you too! Here, take some of this burning ale. Drink it as soon as you start to get cold. The ale might go to your head, but unfortunately that's unavoidable.
Make sure you don't only hug the females or the males - we won't judge. Just don't think of them as male or female, but merely as victims of the ice monster!

checkText.en: Without curly lichen, there's no ale. And without ale, there's no Gibberlings!

finishText.en: Wow! I'd give you another hug if I thought you wouldn't take it the wrong way. But here's some ale for you troubles.

goal.en: Collect 4 Bundles of Curly Lichen for the Attentive Family in the Foothills of Arov.

startText.en:
Looks like I miscalculated and we ran out of ale... But then again, who could have anticipated how much we'd need to warm those guys up. Or maybe someone has been exaggerating how frozen they were and drank more than their fair share of the ale. Well, never mind, we can't do anything about it now.
To make ale, I need curly lichen. It grows in the Foothills of Arov, one of the neighboring allods. Go and fetch me four bundles of the curly lichen. You'll need some of the ale for yourself when you venture into the colder allods. Trust me.

checkText.en: Don't forget to fire the blue flare rocket before you start hunting for the leopards.

finishText.en: That Eric is a jerk! As soon as I saw the blue flare I started my timer, but then he started distracting me with his stories. Now I don't even know who won! What a pity, it would have been an interesting wager...

goal.en: Go to Gray Lake, release a Blue Flare Rocket, kill 4 Snow Leopards, release a second Blue Flare Rocket, and return to Vicki the Red.

startText.en:
My brother Eric says there is no beast more dangerous than a bear. Do you know why? It's because yesterday he managed to kill one. Why would you do that? The poor bear barely got its paw out of its mouth. I feel for the beast. But leopards, leopards are a different story altogether. I don't even have the words to describe it. A leopard will be at you with its claws out before you can even spot it.
Anyway, I'm sure you can settle our dispute for us. Take these blue flare rockets. The snow leopards are near the Gray Lake. Fire a rocket when you spot the leopards, then kill 4 leopards, then fire the second rocket. Talk to Eric about the bears. We'll time how long it takes you to kill them from here. Whichever beasts take longer to kill are the most dangerous. It will be interesting to see who's right.

checkText.en: Go and take care of the bears and the leopards, we'll time you and then we'll see that I was right.

finishText.en: Hmph! That's the fairer sex for you. As soon as you released the blue rocket she started prancing about and distracted me. I wasn't able to time you properly! Well, you've still done a good job - you've completely cleared the area of the beasts.

goal.en: Go to Bold Hill, release a Red Flare Rocket, kill 4 Polar Bears, release a second Red Flare Rocket, and return to Eric the Red.

startText.en:
Snow leopards are nothing but oversized pussycats. And no one's afraid of pussycats. But the bears - now those are real beasts! And believe me, I'd know. Vicki says leopards are more agile and quicker, which makes them more dangerous. That's feminine logic for you! Lice are even faster, but they're not exactly deadly, are they? No! What matters is the weight and bulk of the beast, how far they can reach when they swipe at you, and how big their teeth are. But she'll never learn...
Here's what we'll do. I'll give you two red flare rockets. You'll head out to Bold Hill, fire the first flare, kill four polar bears, and then fire the second flare as soon as you're finished. I'll time you. Talk to Vicki, she'll give you her rocket and tell you where the leopards are. Whichever takes the longest to kill is the more dangerous animal. It's pretty obvious to me. But let's show her, too!

checkText.en: I'm sure those harpies won't be doing any more fishing after that.

finishText.en: It looks like the harpies have become more cautious. They're circling the lake, but now they're afraid to get any closer. And we have you to thank for that! I'm afraid all I have to offer you is some fish. Here, take it.

goal.en: Kill 4 Snowbound Harpies for the Whispering Family.

startText.en:
Shhh! Keep your voice down! You'll scare the fish away! There's barely any as it is.
We've tried giving the lake harpies some fish to keep them happy, but now they're running amok. They attack fishermen and snatch fish right out of our hands. We're stuck out here freezing our rear ends off, while the others are in the village drinking away! All for nothing...
Please go and kill four harpies for us. That should stop them. I mean, every time we catch something, they're all over it within seconds.

checkText.en: The juicy bark beetles live on the trees in the forest. They make magnificent bait!

finishText.en: What would we have done without you? There'll be no Gibberlings dying of hunger now!

goal.en: Collect 2 Bark Beetles and 2 Fat Bark Beetles for the Whispering Family.

startText.en:
Shhh! We've dealt with the harpies, but now we have another problem. There's plenty of fish, but we've got nothing to catch it with. We're out of bait.
Why don't you take this fisherman's knife and fetch me some bark beetles from the trees. I need at least two... And the fatter, the better! Fish love the fat ones! At least two if you can find them. You'll be really helping us out.

checkText.en: Pretty clever, right? We planted the markers at the edge of the allod. Now anyone who doesn't believe us can go and check for themselves!

finishText.en: Well? We were right, weren't we? What do you think this means? The territory that we're responsible for watching is expanding! That means we must be entitled to a pay raise!

goal.en: Check on the 3 markers around the allod for the Stout Family.

startText.en:
The ice monster attacked again? We had no idea. We haven't seen it. So it wasn't here. It's true. You don't believe us?
Okay, so our buddies may have brought us a couple bottles of homebrew, but we swear we didn't have any. We don't get drunk on that anyway. And not on guard duty, of course.
But we did notice something else...
the allod is getting bigger! Why are you looking at us like that?! Like we said, we don't get drunk on duty. But we're telling you, the Astral is retreating! You don't believe us? Fine...
We've placed eight markers around the edge of the allod. Go and have a look - you'll see for yourself that the Astral has shifted - if there's land beyond the markers, then you'll see we're telling the truth.

checkText.en: There's good news and bad news. We're still waiting for the good news...

finishText.en: So, the allod is expanding... That's good! It's only bad when it gets smaller. But before we start celebrating we need to find out why it's happening.

goal.en: Take the news to Froddy the Fidget in Quiet Harbor.

name.en: The Ebb of the Astral Tide

startText.en:
I don't think we'll be able to work out this mystery between the two of us. And especially not without any more homebrew to stimulate the brain cells... We'll need someone else to help us out here.
Go tell Froddy the Fidget, our High Druid. Musing on the mysteries of creation is what he does best.

checkText.en: Is there something that we haven't made clear? We'll explain it again. This is a hammer. You use it to break off seven ore samples, got it? Then you return to us.

finishText.en: Well, you didn't do too badly. Your contribution to science will not go unnoticed. We definitely won't forget what you've done... especially if this ore sample contains any traces of meteorite.

goal.en: Bring 4 pieces of Gritty Ore to the Stooping Family.

startText.en:
Tell us, has anyone seen a Great Mage's tower here? No? That's because there's none. And if there's no Great Mage around here, what does that mean? Well? Jeez, didn't they teach you anything about allod history in school?
If there's no Great Mage, that means there must be meteorite. It's elementary! If there's no meteorite, It means it simply hasn't been found yet. We'll have to go and find it!
In the yeti settlement on Bold Hill you'll find a cave with a ton of ore. We need seven samples of that ore. Here, we'll give you our hammer - take it and make your way into the lair of those hairy creatures. Now, don't think you can use the hammer on those monsters. It's a tool, not a weapon. Use the hammer to break off ore samples. Bring the samples to us. Are these instructions clear enough?

checkText.en: Oh my, it looks like I'm not going to die after all!

finishText.en: Hey, I'm Atli. Please say that you're looking for me.

goal.en: Look for Atli the Colossal in the Foothills of Arov.

startText.en:
What's the story with the "Sparrow"? Is everyone alive? It was us who let the monster slip through the net... but it wasn't our fault!
We were attacked by savages from the neighboring allod. They're mountainfolk, they call themselves the Ar. There were tons of them, a higher number than I could count, so we had to switch to Plan B - we scattered.
That's when the monster showed up. If you want to know why I didn't light the fire, it's because I was too busy hiding behind that hill over yonder and the savages were by the fire, so how could I have lit it?
When the savages left, I noticed that Atli and Barni were missing and I have no idea where they are. I'm really afraid for them! But I can't leave my post to go look for them - so could I bother you to go to the Ar camp? Maybe the savages have taken them and have them there. Okay?

checkText.en: We'd like to point out that while it may be the mages who maintain the allods it's us, the traders, who unite the whole world. We might go broke, but we're forcing those barbarians to trade with us! That's how civilization is born!

finishText.en: So, how are you liking your role as a missionary? What's that?! An ambush by the savages?! It looks like not all of those savages are ready for mutually beneficial cooperation. It seems like our friendly relationship has come to an end. Looks like it's time for us to find a new pursuit.

goal.en: Collect 4 pieces of Bear Meat and place them in the chest in the Foothills of Arov. Report back to the Stubborn Family in Quiet Harbor.

startText.en:
What are we doing here? Who can we trade with? We need some big deals! What are we supposed to do here? Sell beads to the yetis?
There's a mountain tribe on that allod over there, but all those savages know how to do is fight. Trading with them is a little strange - we leave our goods out for them in an agreed location, and the next day we go back and collect whatever they give in exchange.
It's mainly just skins, claws, and innards - that's all they ever have that's worth taking. We know it's not much, but you've got to start somewhere. We're like missionaries, bringing the light of civilization to this backward people.
Truth be told, we're doing this all at a loss - it's all about the principle. Often times, we'll leave our goods there for them and get zilch in return! But we're not ones to give up that easily! We've decided to give it one more go. So, do you want to help us bring civilization to these savages?

checkText.en: Bloodshed is always a terrible thing, but there's no other alternative in this case.

finishText.en: It's a shame that the yetis didn't understand us. Maybe they really don't have anything going on inside those heads of theirs.

goal.en: Kill 4 Arctic Yetis and report back to the Cunning Family.

startText.en:
Sure, it's cold in these parts, but we're just glad to have firm ground under our feet. And just look at how clean the air is! And there are fish in the lake - okay, not many, but still... Really, this place isn't as bad as people say.
However, we're not without danger. Not far from Quiet Harbor, just up in the hills, is a group of yetis. We have no idea just how intelligent they might be. We've tried to make contact with them but it's only caused them to attack our harbor. They're frightening, bloodthirsty creatures...
As captains we're responsible for the safety of the crew even when we're on land. Maybe you can help. Please go kill ten yetis for us. We must show them that there are consequences for every action! Then they'll stop attacking our camp.

checkText.en: Wow, what a weird feeling...

finishText.en:
Hm... You know, this isn't the first time that I've died. I made it out of Purgatory before, thank Tensess, but this time I'm getting a different kind of vibe. It feels as if I'm being pulled away... Far away... Maybe because I was used as a sacrifice.
