Hm, definitely not my idea of fun. The good news is that I sense a kind of levity in my whole body and I don't feel cold anymore! Well, enough about that... I don't have long until I'm pulled away for good, so listen up and let's make this quick.

goal.en: Go to the altar in the Foothills of Arov and find Barni the Courageous.

startText.en: I'm fine, but Barni is in trouble! Those savages have taken him to the altar. They want to sacrifice him to some kind of "Ice God." I beg of you, please be swift! Go save him!

checkText.en: Oh, what should I d-d-do? I've been torturing myself with this question for days now. What if these m-m-monster attacks continue and our shipments keep getting delayed?

finishText.en: The ice monster is a d-d-dragon? It gets worse by the hour!

goal.en: Tell Torn the Stutterer about the dragon.

name.en: The Identity of the Ice Monster

startText.en:
The ice monster isn't from the Astral, it lives here, on the archipelago. What's more, our monster, this so-called "Ice God" of the savages, is one in the same! One creature with two faces... If you can call that a face! Well, whatever you want to call it, it's still there...
It looks like a dragon. So, be sure to inform Torn as well.
Say hi to Atli and Ella for me if you get the chance. They'll probably have a tough time without me. But then again, the two Reds are doing okay on their own and Torn and Froddy have been left with no family at all. We Gibberlings are a tough breed, I'm sure they'll manage. That's about it, I can't stay here any longer. Farewell...

checkText.en: How would someone manage without sails? Do they pull the ships with a rope or something? They don't have haulers out in the Astral, do they?

finishText.en: Much obliged! Now we just need to fix up the sail for the Astral by tomorrow at the latest!

goal.en: Bring the Curly Family 4 Harpy Wings from the Foothills of Arov or Gray Lake.

startText.en:
Oh... My head feels like it's going to explode... All three of them. Can you imagine that?!
I don't know if it's because I spent all day yesterday working away with a hammer or because I spent all night drinking. What do you think? Yes, must be the hammer.
What does it mean when a boat is moored? You need to mend this or that... What a headache! It's endless. I'm dying here and you want to know about the sails? They've been worn completely thin and our spare sail was shred to ribbons in the last storm. And we've used up all our cloth! Hmm... Maybe Inga would be willing to take something off... Now there's a thought! Unfortunately, it wouldn't be enough for our needs.
We've heard there are harpies on the allod. If only we could make use of their wide, leathery wings...
Hey, it might actually work! I'd say we need two of those wings... no, two wouldn't be enough. Four would do it! Will you help us?

checkText.en: Fir trees have cones, and inside the cones there are seeds, and in those seeds there is a forest.

finishText.en: I'm eternally grateful to you. I can sense that these seeds contain some sort of mysterious power. I'll need to examine them very carefully.

goal.en: Collect 1 Underripe Fir Seed, 1 Ripe Fir Seed, and 1 Overripe Fir Seed for Froddy the Fidget.

name.en: A Garden City Shall Stand Here

startText.en:
I've been doing a lot of thinking and maybe it's for the best that there's no hope of reclaiming our homeland - enough of all this venturing off into the Astral! The time has come to face the facts and realize that this is our home now!
Yes, this archipelago will be our new home. I'm sure that the rest of the Gibberlings will agree with me and we'll organize a magnificent feast in honor of our new home.
However, it's not the right time to reveal the truth to my people. We already have enough problems and no one likes the taste of tears in their beer.
Fortunately, I'm a druid! How hard can it really be to transform this icy land into a flourishing garden?! There are beautiful and giant fir trees growing on Shaggy Isle and it's colder there than it is here. I want to find out how they can survive there.
Go fetch me some of their seeds. Please make sure that they're varying levels of ripeness. It'll greatly speed up my research if they are.

checkText.en: We tamed a rhinocerous once, so owls should be a piece of cake.

finishText.en: Thank you! Now we just have to figure out who's going to hatch these eggs...

goal.en: Bring the Rosycheeked Family 4 Owl Eggs.

startText.en:
Phew... We've just now finished washing the remaining dishes. Our men have broken so many pots and mugs this time! First they started clinking their mugs so hard they kept breaking the handles! Then that monster attacked and nobody cared to watch where they were going! How's that for a "bottoms up!"
We need to start scrubbing these tables. In the meantime, I need you to bring me four eggs of arctic owls. They live on Shaggy Isle. Naturally, they won't be happy to see you poking around in their nests. But we have an idea... We're going to tame the tiny, fluffy baby owls from those eggs. Don't look so surprised! Just look at the Kanians, they use owls to carry the mail all the time. Then we can breed enough to supply us with meat and eggs too! Now that's what we call progress!

checkText.en: Our research has hit a dead end, but this is just a temporary setback, we're sure of it...

finishText.en: We're on the right track! Alright, enough chatter, we need to examine the ore.

goal.en: Bring 2 Black Ore Samples and 2 Red Ore Samples to the Stooping Family.

startText.en:
There are no signs of meteorite in this rock. So, what does this mean? It's elementary! This can only mean that the meteorite is somewhere else.
There's a cave on Shaggy Isle that is inhabited by monsters. The monsters are very interesting from a biological viewpoint. They're werebears and they're incredibly ferocious and cruel. Luckily, one of our scouts managed to make it out alive. He told us there's an abundance of both black and red ore in the cave! We are itching to study it!
You understand what needs to be done, right? Take the hammer and get to work. We're going to need four ore samples from the cave: two black and two red.

checkText.en: Werebears... nature can create the most revolting creatures!

finishText.en: Thank you! Shaggy Isle will now be a much safer place.

goal.en: Kill 4 Frosty Werebears and report back to the Clever Family.

startText.en:
The yetis have quieted down thanks to you. Unfortunately, there's still one more unpleasant task to complete. This time our conscience will be clear when we send you to slaughter these beasts. I'm sending you after the Werebears. They have the worst features of animals and humans! These creatures must be exterminated!
Go in and kill twelve Werebears in their cave on Shaggy Isle.

checkText.en: I still can't track down that crafty silver snow leopard... maybe you'll have better luck.

finishText.en: Wow, you are really something else! You're as good a hunter as I am! My hat's off to you!

goal.en: Get the Silver Fur from the Sangiyok and bring it to Vicki the Red.

startText.en:
Listen, there are strange things developing on Shaggy Isle. I've set several snow leopard traps over there and when I check on them, I see that they've all gone off but not a single animal has been caught. It seems that the only thing I've been able to catch is a clump of silvery fur.
I'm afraid that there's an unusually intelligent and crafty snow leopard in the woods. I'm only bringing this up because I figure that maybe you'd enjoy the challenge in hunting this cunning beast. Let's see who can track him down faster, you or I. Our proof will be the skin with silver fur.

checkText.en: If you're here, then that means that the ship batteries are drifting somewhere around Cold Isle...

finishText.en: You found one! Oh, my darling battery! I could just kiss them. Oh, thank you! I'm in your debt for as long as I live!

goal.en: Retrieve an Astral Battery for the Curly Family.

startText.en:
No, I haven't started on the sails yet. It still feels like someone put a pot on my head and gave it a good whack.
And now it looks like I've made a huge blunder. Please, I beg of you, just don't tell Inga. I threw our Astral batteries into the Astral to... well, to charge them up a bit. But then a storm kicked up the next thing I know is that the batteries are gone and so is the mead!
Judging by the wind direction, I'd say that the batteries must have been blown off to the northeast, probably somewhere around Cold Isle. But on the other hand, this was a serious storm, so they could have scattered across all the neighboring allods.
Could you jump over there and see if you can find one? We lost five regular batteries and five modernized big ones, but we only need one. Please, there's no one else I can ask.

checkText.en: What, are you chicken? Afraid to take on some polar bear? Hmph. That's what I thought.

finishText.en:
You managed to take it down?
I'm speechless! You have my respect!

goal.en: Bring the head of the Great Polar Bear to Eric the Red.

startText.en:
I was sailing past the Ugrov Ridge the other day and noticed a polar bear thi-i-is big! You just wouldn't believe how big it was! I wish I could get my hands on its head to hang on the wall in my cabin. That's if it fits through the door, of course. Well, if worse comes to worst, we could tear down the bulkhead.
But I don't have the time to hunt it, I need to get meat for our men and the ship. So, if you're up to the challenge and not scared - then the bear is yours. But the head, naturally, is mine. I did see it first, after all!

checkText.en: Poor, wretched Tooh the Rotten! He was torn out of his people's jaw and thrown out into the street!

finishText.en: The Arg threw poor old Tooh the Rotten out. Tooh the Rotten was the one who kept bringing skins, claws, and entrails to the place where meat appears. Tooh the Rotten wants to live on friendly terms with those weird goblins from the big boat. But Arg don't want that, they chased Tooh the Rotten away and set up an ambush near the place where the meat appears. The Urgs also chased Tooh the Rotten away. They want to kill the weird goblins from the big boat as a gift to their ice god. What does this goblin want with them? Ask Tooh the Rotten.

goal.en: Find out how the savages from Ugrov Ridge summon the icy dragon.

startText.en:
We've never run into a d-d-dragon before, but there's nothing that G-G-Gibberlings can't handle when they use their heads. Let's try to trick the m-m-monster.
There is another mountain p-p-people living on the ridge, the Urg Tribe - I'm sure that they also worship the ice monster. I know that this is very dangerous, but you need to s-s-sneak into their camp and find out how they summon the d-d-dragon, maybe we can also lure it into coming to us.
Oh yeah, it's very c-c-cold on Ugrov Ridge, so make sure you bring a supply of burning ale with you or you might risk getting f-f-frostbite on your n-n-nose.

checkText.en: How did you do? Manage to l-l-learn anything?

finishText.en:
What is this? L-l-looks like some old June knick-knack. Is this really what the Urg Tribe uses to summon their "ice god?" Hm... Maybe we should show this thing to Froddy?
... Actually, this can wait. There's more important b-b-business to attend to. While you were gone, we had another m-m-misfortune.

goal.en: Take the Blood Colored Artifact from Kewell the Heartripper and take it to Torn the Stutterer.

startText.en:
This mountainfolk is looking for the ice god? The ice god feels the scent of scarlet life and then he comes. When there's no stranger to take lots of scarlet life from, Krewell the Heartripper picks up the Great Red Treasure and takes his own scarlet life and the soul of the ice, then the ice god hears the call and comes.
The Urg Tribe had the Great Red Treasure even before my grandfather's grandfather left his mother's womb. They say the Urg Tribe and the Arg Tribe became enemies after the ice god came.
Take the Great Red Treasure away from Krewell if you want to talk to the god. But remember that the ice god brings evil - Tooh warned you!

checkText.en: Frozen yaks were found embedded in the ice. It's like nature prepared a meat locker for us Gibberlings.

finishText.en: A hero! Our great hero! We mean that. But as to that daily pint of mead... Uh... Alas... It seems we overestimated our stocks...

goal.en: Collect 4 chunks of Frozen Meat for the Custard Family in the Quiet Harbor.

startText.en:
No! We told you, there's no more mead! There's nothing at all - we don't even have meat or fish!
Instead of hanging around the harbor, why don't you go do something useful? Our scouts saw some yaks frozen into blocks of ice on Ugrov Ridge. This is a wonderful opportunity to prove your valor and supply the ship with meat at the same time. Take this ice pick. Fight your way through the hordes of hungry polar bears and chop up four chunks of frozen meat for us. Any hero that accomplishes this task will have an additional daily pint of mead coming to them.

checkText.en: T-t-to be honest, I'm n-n-not comfortable with these shamanic rituals... But we need to take care of this dragon or he'll never leave us in p-p-peace here.

finishText.en: I am so happy to see you! You're coming to our aid again! Alright, w-w-wait, we'll get everything ready for the ritual.

goal.en: Collect 3 Ice Elements for the Torn the Stutterer.

startText.en:
That d-d-dragon visited us again. We need to do something. But now we have the J-J-June artifact. We can summon the dragon like those m-m-mountain people do and when it appears, we'll attack and f-f-finish it off! But we have one problem though...
As the savage said, the ritual requires "scarlet life" which has to be b-b-blood, that's a no-brainer. And we also need the "soul of the ice."
Froddy, the Cunning Family, and the Stooping Family all agree that this "s-s-soul of the ice..." Um... How do I put it... It's the substance of the ice, the essence of elementals and is f-f-found somewhere deep within them.
I'm not a scientist, so this explanation must sound c-c-confusing... You will have to go to the Cold or Nordheim Isles and tear the ice s-s-soul out of some ice elemental. I would rec-c-commend Cold Isle... It's c-c-colder there, but not as dangerous... It'll be hard, so get r-r-ready!

checkText.en: Trolls... We used to think there was nothing worse than mosquitoes.

finishText.en: Wonderful! The trolls are dead and I can finally stop to take a breath - we won't have to worry about an attack from this side.

goal.en: Kill 4 Icy Trolls on the Cold Isle and report back to the Captains of the Little Sparrow.

startText.en:
You probably think I'm some cold hearted battle axe. That I don't care about anything as long as I get to kill someone. That's not true. The captain's position entails responsibility. And sometimes it's better to be overly vigilant than let your crew be killed.
So I'm sending you out to Cold Isle where some very scary creatures live - trolls. Striking first will be the right thing to do.
Go kill four trolls and the Gibberlings will sleep a little better at night.

checkText.en: I can probably ask for a bonus for my innovative proposal with the beacons!

finishText.en: Are the beacons set? Great! I'm going to comb my hair and go tell the captain about your heroism. Well... our heroism...

goal.en: Set 4 Buoys on Cold Isle and report back to the Curly Family.

startText.en:
You're not going to believe this, but I've just had a great idea! I'm not sure how I managed, but it did!
All of our ship's troubles are due to the fact that there aren't any proper navigational directions in Frozen Frontier! No one has bothered to set up any buoys! Oh, those are usually a signal beacon or a signaler with flags on the coast. Given the conditions, it's no surprise that ships are crashing on the rocks... But we can change that!
Go to Cold Isle and put up signal beacons along the coast. If you do this, the captains will be able to navigate between these allods on our way home without worrying about damaging the ship.

checkText.en: It's like a test for me every time you come around. I have to guess what sort of unbelievable news you've brought me!

finishText.en: There's magical power in the ore? I wonder if it's similar to the power that I sensed in the Great Tree's seeds... Give me some time to think about all of this...

goal.en: Speak with Froddy the Fidget in Quiet Harbor.

startText.en:
Hm, no signs of meteorite again! What could this mean? No, it doesn't mean we'll send you out to get more samples. However, the ore from the werebears' cave poses a conundrum. It seems like the stone had been melted from a very powerful fire. It also seems to be imbued with magical power of some sort.
What should we do? Well, that's obvious! We need to inform Froddy the Fidget, our elder. Magic is his forte, you know. He should be able to tell us what these strange signs mean.

checkText.en: Well now, we must be seeing ghosts. We've gone and drank far too much!

finishText.en: We don't believe our eyes! You're breathing! You look well and don't seem to have frostbite! How did you manage to get here?

goal.en: Deliver the Crate of Burning Ale to the Burly Family.

startText.en:
You know, I believe these seeds posses a magical power that helps the trees grow in these harsh conditions. It looks like this ore contains a similar power. I have a feeling that we're getting closer to uncovering this archipelago's secret.
There's a tribe of trolls that live on Cold Isle and they're another link in this mysterious chain. Living beings! How do they survive there and why haven't they frozen to death?
We sent a group of brave explorers to Cold Isle headed by the Burly Family, but we haven't heard a thing from them since. Please find them and take them a box of ale - it's very useful for dealing with the cold weather.

checkText.en: What? Do you want a hug?

finishText.en:
A trip to Cold Isle without Burning Ale is not just dumb, it's criminally insane!
Here, take this.

goal.en: Purchase Burning Ale from the Attentive Family.

startText.en:
You're going to Cold Isle? You better remember, it's real easy to croak in that place. Don't even think about setting foot out there without some burning ale. It'll warm you right up when you start to get frostbitten!
Make sure you drop by and see the Attentive Family before you leave. They keep a bunch of ale around at all times. You'll thank us later!

checkText.en: The only language you'll find that they understand is the language of death!

finishText.en: We're saved! You've given us hope! Now we can start studying this allod again!

goal.en: Destroy 4 Frosty Demon Scouts and return to the Burly Family.

startText.en:
Thank you for the ale. But unfortunately, many of our boys have died, so we don't need this much...
You wouldn't believe what happened here. Things were quiet at first - we dug into the snow and watched the trolls. That's no easy task! They stand still for hours on end and you don't know whether they're asleep or lost in thought... But then demons came out of the Astral! What could have made them leave their element? No idea.
Our boys fought bravely and we're proud of them. Killed nearly all the demons.
Four demons still remain on the shore - their scouts. Disgusting little creatures.
Could you deal with them?

checkText.en: A strange artifact appears to have been placed here...

finishText.en: A strange artifact appears to have been placed here...

goal.en: Discover the secret of the trolls' ruins and return to the Burly Family.

startText.en:
Let's get back to our main objective. We've encountered trolls several times, killed a few, and even had to eat one. The meat was a bit tough, but not much tougher than a horse's.
What? A real Gibberling doesn't seek comfort - instead they try to reach places where no one has set foot before. Sometimes that comes at a high price... Anyway, we still don't know how the trolls survive in this terrible climate.
Then again, their survival may be in danger at the moment due to the appearance of the ice elementals. They've driven the trolls out by capturing the ruins where they used to live. We suspect there won't be any trolls left soon - they'll all die out like the yaks did on Ugrov Ridge.
We must investigate those ruins! It's clear to us that the trolls didn't have any problem with the cold until their ruins were captured by the elementals. We were planning a trip there, but the demons put a stop to that, so we're forced to ask you to do this for us.

checkText.en: What is it this time? Another important discovery?

finishText.en: Oh, dear! My head is spinning! This artifact is as cold as the land itself! You probably won't be surprised to hear me say that I need to think things over!

goal.en: Take the Ice Colored Artifact to Froddy the Fidget.

name.en: An Artifact the Color of Ice

startText.en:
What a strange artifact... It's a frozen teardrop that emits waves of heat. This must explain how the trolls are able to survive here. However, as soon as the artifact is removed from the pedestal it becomes as cold as ice.
This should be taken to Froddy the Fidget as soon as possible! It be uncover the secret behind the archipelago's strange magic!

checkText.en: Sometimes when I am deep in thought I don't notice anything around me... What's going on?

finishText.en:
So, the dragon is dead. Are you s-s-surprised that I know? I don't want to scare you but it looks like the dragon wasn't the worst of it. That June artifact has b-b-begun to speak!
Someone has been communicating with me via the artifact and whoever they are they're very unhappy with what we did to the d-d-dragon, their accomplice.
I have a fairly good idea who it is, but maybe you ought to sit down before I tell you! There's a Great D-D-Dragon on our archipelago! That explains everything - the lava, the power within the s-s-seeds, the lack of meteorite, the r-r-receding Astral and even the appearance of the demons.
The demons have been enemies with d-d-dragons since the beginning of time, you! It makes sense that they'd attack them! Now what do you think of that?
While you're thinking it over, take a l-l-look at these weapons. Take whichever you fancy - it's your reward for killing the ice m-m-monster.

goal.en: Summon the Ice King by using the artifact, your blood, and an Ice Element. Participate in killing it and report to Torn the Stutterer.

startText.en:
Everything's r-r-ready for the r-r-ritual! Remember what the savage told you - you need to use the artifact, your blood, and the "s-s-soul of ice."
I fear that the dragon is too powerful but I have come up with a way of defeating him! See those Astral c-c-cannons? Try to wound him while he's in the air and then finish him off on the ground. Kill the monster and the G-G-Gibberlings will reward you handsomely! Good luck!

checkText.en: Brr, it's cold...

finishText.en: There's no dragon... But there is a strange shining creature that looks like a huge will-o'-the-wisp. As soon as you get near it, a terrible chill comes over your heart!

goal.en: Find the Great Dragon on Nordheim Isle.

startText.en:
As you may know, there's an Orcish allod that's supported by a Great Dragon instead of a Great Mage. I believe this may be true of our archipelago as well. The only difference is that our local dragon has been weakened by something. That means we must seize this opportunity!
If we offer him help then maybe he'll let us stay here. Our lives hang by a thread - it's time that we stand or fall. I believe that the dragon can only be in one part of the archipelago - Nordheim Isle, the most remote allod of them all.
The allod reeks of death! We've never ventured that far but the time for heroism has come. You must find the dragon and try to come to some sort of understanding with him. This mission is a great honor and an even greater test of your courage!

checkText.en: I've been waiting for you, the first mate let me know that you were coming...

finishText.en: Hm, cannonballs made from cave gargoyle hearts. Yeah, this will do just fine, like last time! You'll see soon enough, just don't go too far.

goal.en: Speak with the Captain of the Little Sparrow.

startText.en: I know I've made you w-w-wander the whole archipelago but I have one l-l-last request. Oh, don't make that face at me. Go tell our wonderful c-c-captain that we have cannonballs. Got it? Tell her word for word - "We've got cannonballs!"

checkText.en: Finally. The Stooping Family kept promising me that you'd come...

finishText.en: Oh, lapis lazuli! It's the most wonderful thing I've ever seen on this allod. You'll see what I mean soon enough.

goal.en: Speak with the Captain of the Little Sparrow.

startText.en:
You have great potential to be an explorer! It's easy, isn't it?
It's all because of that potential. If you read, think, compare, and analyze everything, we'll be colleagues in no time. But for now, I have the easiest and final mission from the Stooping Family. Go and tell Inga that I was right and that it's lapis lazuli. Tell her what I said word for word "it's lapis lazuli!" Make sure you get it right!

checkText.en: The Great Tree! Long have I dreamt of resting under its branches!

finishText.en: The seeds of the Great Tree... Hm, I don't think it's going to be that easy. Things are very difficult in Darkwater at the moment. The Valir castle has been cursed and nobody's been able to set foot inside it for twenty years. The natural equilibrium has been disturbed and darkness is amassing in the forests. Would the Great Tree be willing to share its power? It's hard to say.

goal.en: Talk toVeleslav Kapishev in Darkwater.

startText.en:
Wait a second! Look, the seal is broken! See that crack? I guess it could've been me, with the way I swung my arms around. Or maybe you, on your trip back... So, does that mean that the dragon resurrected already?! Oops.
Let me try to get in touch with him now... Uh oh! Our dead friend is very angry... His soul has returned to his body, but he can't get out. The rock and ice surround his body. He's completely trapped!
...Oh, my. What an interesting word! A real ancient one! It seems that our dragon needs our help once again! We'll have to melt through the ice and help the dragon break free. I know exactly how we can do that, they don't call me a wise man for nothing!
There's a Great Tree that grows in Darkwater. It's tended to by Kanian druids. The power of Great Trees can melt the ice and warm up the frozen earth. Perhaps they'll share some of their seeds with us. We could plant a Great Tree here, grow it big and strong, and it will melt the ground so the dragon could break free!
Listen, I'm sorry for troubling you again... But maybe you could find some time to go to Darkwater and ask them for a seed? We don't have anyone else that we can count on...
I suppose that now is as a good a time as any to address the nation. What do you think sounds better - "my fellow Gibberlings, we no longer have a home" or "my fellow Gibberlings, we have found a home?" Yes, I guess I like the second option too.

checkText.en: What? You don't want to fire the cannons? I don't believe it!

finishText.en: Remember, you've got friends here! Come back and you'll always receive a warm welcome, a hearty meal, and more than enough brew to wash it down with! Hah!

goal.en: Fire the Little Sparrow's cannons using the Special Fuse. Report to the Cunning Family.

startText.en:
You want to know how Gibberlings will take the news that they've lost their home? We've all known for a long time. I overheard your first conversation with Froddy and didn't feel the need to keep it quiet from the Gibberlings.
The Little Sparrow has been our refuge for years and we'll make a real home out of it now! The Gibberlings have readied their barrels of beer - but the supply ship never came, I wonder where all this beer came from? They've probably been saving it.
And we have a surprise for you. The lapis lazuli and the gargoyle hearts that you spent so much effort procuring are not strategic weapons, they're... Well, you'll see. Take this special fuse and fire the cannons!

checkText.en: Hic! Who are you?

finishText.en:
This is for us?! Oh, what a wonderful day - you're the third person to bring us a bottle!
Who's this one from? Torn?! Wow!
He's good man, you know, but totally nutty in the head. Didn't you know? He lost all his brothers! Some Astral tore them to shreds, so resurrection is out of the question... He was the only survivor and he has stuttered ever since. But he doesn't believe that his brothers are dead - he thinks they just moved to some other ship. I guess that's the only way he can live on.
But hey, that's not something that we should be thinking about, right? Let's drink one in honor of their memory! Theirs and all the others who are not here with us to see this great day!

goal.en: Take some ale to the Snoring Family.

startText.en:
It's a good day and we've g-g-got many things to celebrate! We killed the ice monster, came to an agreement with the Great D-D-Dragon, and found a new home... That calls for a party! Hic!
A drinks r-r-reception will be announced soon -"Bottoms Up: Part Two." Everyone is welcome! We were even going to invite the d-d-dragon but thought that he probably wouldn't enjoy it. And we've got plenty of folks here who'll down a b-b-barrel of ale in seconds.
Oh, no! We forgot about the Snoring Family! They're probably still at their post! Cold! And sober! That just won't do. Go take them a bottle of ale so that they can have a good time too.

checkText.en: A few years ago we landed on an allod with cave gargoyles. That's where we found that their stone hearts made for amazing cannonballs!

finishText.en: Great! It's w-w-wonderful to feel the weight of these heavy hearts in my hands once again.

goal.en: Obtain 4 Stone Hearts of Cave Gargoyles on Nordheim Isle for Torn the Stutterer.

startText.en:
Damn, as soon as we deal with one p-p-problem there's another one waiting to take its place. They just keep building up.
You're going to Nordheim? Well, given that you're putting your body on the l-l-line we might as well get as much use out of it that we can. I have a job for you. You will meet, and undoubtedly defeat, some t-t-terrible monsters called cave gargoyles.
Please take their hearts for me. The hearts are made of stone and make great cannonballs. Surprised? Don't be, it's true! The best cannonballs a G-G-Gibberling can get, I swear on the memory of our lost home!

checkText.en: I can't be wrong this time! The lapis lazuli was spotted on Nordheim.

finishText.en: I told you it was lapis lazuli! See? All I needed to reach the correct conclusion was a brief description made by a simple scout. I have to say that I couldn't have managed without you. Good job!

goal.en: Collect 4 chunks of Lapis Lazuli on Nordheim Isle for the Stooping Family.

startText.en:
It seems that some corrections must be made to our initial calculations - there is no Great Mage, there is no meteorite... But there is something better than a Great Mage and a meteorite put together - a Great Dragon! You could say that the results exceeded our expectations.
Now, listen carefully for I do not like to repeat myself or waste my time. Our scouts have reported that a rare mineral, lapis lazuli, can be found on Nordheim.
There won't be any mistakes this time - I was able to recognize it from the description. It's a very useful material, I swear. We need it badly, so do everything you can to get me some of that lapis lazuli.

finishText.en:
I'll tell you what I've learned! My spirit, or soul as you call it in your mind, has returned to my grave. I feel I can spring back to life! Spread my wings... and fly again! But my body is still enchained by the June magic. By these three seals...
The savages were the first to break a seal. They fed it blood and that gave me strength. I could raise my head and summon my dragon servants.
The second seal was found by trolls. They used the ancient magic to stay warm, but it was broken when the seal left its altar. It is not gone for good.
The third seal is all that remains. It's well-hidden and protected by ancient curses. You will break it so that I can be released!

goal.en: Continue the conversation with the Dragon's Soul.

startText.en:
The cold penetrates deeper and deeper, and a strange hissing voice is heard in the frozen cave.
"A warm blooded creature... A child of the world... It's been a long, long time since I saw one of your kind... It was not a pleasant meeting... Sit, child, and I will tell you all about it.
It was a brutal and bloody war. A great tribe of people, if the word "great" could ever be used in reference to those June, attacked us dragons. Many fell... Including myself.
Pestilent Wolf! That was the name of the Great June Mage that slew our dragons mercilessly. He led me into a deceitful trap. It was there when I found out that he was skilled not only in the power of ice, but also in blood magic.
You are fortunate that it no longer exists in this world. He bound me with eternal cold and sealed it with three blood seals and I could do nothing to resist him...
My body, my beautiful, strong body is buried deep inside this mountain, still bound by the power of his magic. But my spirit is not dead... I can return to life!
Though, I don't understand why. Something has happened in this accursed world while I was dead...
Oh, sorry. Heh, it seems my strength is coming back! I'll loosen my grip now before you also die. Then we can continue our conversation..."
The chilling cold subsides and you can breathe again.

checkText.en: Didn't I ask you to wait?

finishText.en:
Your forest mage and I have come to an agreement. You will carry out your purpose and break the third, main seal, and I shall help your people settle on this snowy land and take you under my wing.
Now, you must do exactly what I say.

goal.en: Wait until the dragon finishes his conversation with the Froddy the Fidget.

startText.en:
I have spoken. Now a decision must be made - help me and become my allies or turn into my new enemies. Both outcomes seem equally interesting... Relax, I know very well that it's not for you to decide.
Please wait while I talk to your forest mage. It seems that he's much more aware of how the world has changed over the last several thousand years. But, of course, even he doesn't know everything.
I will go speak with him now - I have many questions for him. Please just wait here.

checkText.en: Be quiet, you don't have to say anything! It's surprising, but it's one of those rare cases when I already know everything myself!

finishText.en:
Communicating with an ancient creature like a dragon, even a dead one, clears your head right up... Just think about it - he's been here for thousands of years, before the Great Cataclysm! Hell, even before the June people perished! I wonder where his soul has been all this time?!
There's a lot to think about here. This must be a gift from Tensess - nothing else could explain the dragon coming back to life! Of course, it probably helped that his body was completely preserved, protected by the June magic and the ice... like the embalmed bodies of the Zem people.
So, let's see that third seal... So, if I break it it'll release the dragon? That's a little creepy. Before I do this, please accept this humble gift from my people. It's much less than you deserve, but it's the dearest thing we can give you as a token of our appreciation.

goal.en: Destroy the Ancient June Golem, acquire the Third Seal, and take it to the Froddy the Fidget.

startText.en:
"There's an enchanted June golem, which stands deep inside the cave. He guards the final seal. One of my dragons was supposed to finish him off, but try as I did, I just couldn't subdue his will to mine. The dumb beast forgot who his master was!
You will take his place and kill the golem. He is powerful, and you will need my help, so I will share my power with you. Once you retrieve the seal, take it to your leader. He'll know what to do with it. Good bye, child of this accursed world!"

checkText.en: Only a joint effort will help you overcome this enemy. It's time to acquire friends and learn to work in a team.

finishText.en: So, it's been done. Do we feel sorry about his death? Yes. Will we hesitate to give another order such as this? No.

goal.en: Participate in killing Slag the Stonefoot and report back to the Cunning Family.

startText.en:
The mountainfolk that inhabit the Foothills of Arov have been giving us a lot of trouble. If we want to make this land our own we need to put an end to their atrocities.
There's a dangerous and vicious fighter in their tribe that we have yet to defeat. If we succeed, we believe their raids will stop. Strength is the only thing that those savages respect. We have to show them what we're made of!
Unfortunately, our hands are full with the ice monster attacks and just staying alive. So many of our allies are still frozen from the last attack! That's why we're asking you. However, we don't expect you to do it alone! Oh no! You'll need a good, strong team to take this savage down. Good luck!

finishText.en: This is the treasure! I wonder who buried this chest so far out in these frigid wastes. Let's just hope that it contains something valuable and not some useless old trinkets!

goal.en: Search among the ice for any treasure.

startText.en:
Oh ho, what's this?!
Maybe if we chip through this ice we'll be able to find something truly incredible!

checkText.en: The cold and freezing wind is what stopped me from finding that treasure myself! Well, that and the elementals, of course...

finishText.en: Aha, so you found it! I knew it had to be out there!

goal.en: Find the hidden treasure to the north and report your success to Eric the Red.

startText.en:
Rumor has it that there's a real treasure hidden somewhere among the northern allods. I have no idea who would have put it there, or even who started this rumor, but it just has to be true! I mean, this place is so mysterious, something like that is totally possible!
It's too cold out there for us to go searching, but you look like you could brave the elements! And of course, all of those nasty creatures lurking among the snow.
You should go and see if you can find it. And if you do, come back and tell us about it! We have a bet going with one of the other families about whether it really exists!

checkText.en: Please just try your best.

finishText.en: Excellent! You really are a great help!

goal.en: Kill 5 enemies of the Gibberlings (any of them will do): Harpies, Glacier and Hailstone Elementals, Werebears, Mountainfolk Shamans and Warriors. Report back to the Cunning Family in the Quiet Harbor.

startText.en: We suffer from everything here, from elementals, from the mountain people, from the bear people... they all plague us. We really need to exert our dominance on this allod! A parade will be thrown for every enemy of the Gibberlings that you kill!

checkText.en: Blankets are good for starters. At the moment, we've just started to supply Nezebgrad with the masterpieces of the Elven literature.

finishText.en: Wonderful! These feel great and look good too!

goal.en: Bring 5 Rare Light Blankets to Geoffroi de Desirae.

startText.en:
Tenebra wasn't always like this - it used to be bright and cheerful. You can probably imagine what it was like to suddenly have things change like this. Our people need warm light blankets to shield us from the cold darkness. That's right, fashionable light blankets.
There's got to be some way for you to get us some, right? You look pretty talented. I'm sure you can make us some in no time! If not, go check the Novograd Auction House.

checkText.en: The Gibberlings won't be able manage without the help of a Great Tree. We must do as the Keeper of the Great Tree wishes!

finishText.en:
Hurray! On behalf of Gibberlings everywhere, please accept our thanks. Adrian has found rest and that means that the Great Tree's bidding is done, and we will receive the seeds of life!
We'll go to the Keeper for the seeds right away, and then we'll take them to Frozen Frontier. Froddy the Fidget has been waiting for them!
Oh yeah, we almost forgot! Froddy asked us to reward you for your help. Oh yeah, and we also had to tell you something important... Shoot, we totally forgot! Oh well, don't fret, I'm sure it was something minor. You know - "thank you, the Gibberlings are now happy," that kind of thing...
Alright, we're out of here. So much to do, so many places to see... Good luck to you, friend of all Gibberlings!

goal.en: Kill Adrian Valir and report back to the Keen Family.

startText.en:
Hey! We're in on this too! Veleslav told us all about your heroic deeds for the sake of the Great Tree's seeds. Now we're busy running back and forth between the Settlement and Lukomorie, keeping the druid and the Keeper in touch. We've recently got some good news! The Great Tree has given us an answer!
We'll have a new home soon! The piece of land that the League allotted to us is harsh and inhospitable, but we'll change that. If we satisfy the last of the Great Tree's conditions, it'll grant us some seeds and Frozen Frontier will turn into a blooming garden. That's great, isn't it?
Now let's talk business. For some reason, the Keeper of the Tree is concerned about the Valir family. The last duke of that great house, Adrian, was cursed and became the "Prince of the Undead". The Great Tree wants him to finally rest in peace.
He says that if we kill the duke we'll save his soul. Please go to Castle Blight, find Adrian, and grant him eternal rest. So, will you help us? Just one more time, pretty please!

checkText.en: We must expose that impostor at all costs! It's the only way to stop the unrest.

finishText.en:
Just as I thought - the White Knight had no claim to the throne. Look at what Prince Adrian carved with his own hand under the name of his daughter Svetlana -"The last of the House of Valir." What a house!
Everything, including Kania, is changing.
Now we just need to convince the Kanian rebels of the same. But the good thing is that we've taken the sting out of them - let them try to bite now. Not a chance!
I want to reward you for this accomplishment. On behalf of the League Defenders and all Kanians, please accept our profound gratitude!
What would we ever do without you?

goal.en: Find the Family Tree for the House of Valir and bring it to Dobrinya Nikitov in the Settlement.

startText.en:
The White Knight can cause us a lot of trouble even after he's dead. The rebels will want to turn him into a martyr, and the revolt will blaze up anew.
There is only one way to prevent all this. In the Castle of the House of Valir, there is a scroll with their family tree. You've got to go in there and find it.
We must prove that the late White Knight had no claim to the throne.
Be careful - we don't call it the Castle Blight for nothing! The place is extremely dangerous.

finishText.en:
So, another chapter in the League's history book is complete. And you helped write it, but it's a shame the ink is so bloody...
O tempora, o mores!
No, I don't blame you. What was done was done right. It's just my old age showing through...
Please accept this reward. You've earned it, fair and square!

goal.en: Meet with Aidenus in Novograd.

startText.en:
All's well that ends well. I am with Svetlana and Tep's plans have been crippled. Soon I will rejoin my house and I won't be alone - I'll have my wife with me!
And the House of Valir will not wither away! Old Kania blood will blend with the old blood of Elves, and we will enter the future together, renewed. A future with no enmity between the League races. Amen!
I ask you to return to Novograd and meet with Aidenus. The Great Mage helped me investigate the affair with of House de Doucer and he will certainly want to learn how this story has ended. Tell him everything.
Your courage and bravery will serve the League many more times. There's so much out there to do!

finishText.en:
Don't kneel! This is no time for pomp and ceremony - only a shadow remains of the former glory of the House de Desirae...
We were thrown out of our home like pathetic weaklings! A home that was wonderful and grand, the offspring of the architectural genius of our allies, the House de Ardeur!
Damnit! I am furious. The humiliation, the shame... We must make the enemy pay! We will avenge every drop of de Desirae blood they consume.
But it looks like you're not very interested in that... What brings you to Tenebra? The Valir castle... It's interesting that the story has surfaced at a time when the very same darkness has enveloped our allod. Is there a connection? Possibly... Nothing surprises me anymore.

goal.en: Meet with Marguerite de Desirae at Summer Manor.

startText.en:
We need advice - the advice of those that accept Light and the dark equally, the advice of those competent in magic, the advice of those who were connected to the events surrounding the Valir castle twenty years before it became Castle Blight.
I'm talking about the Elves of the House de Desirae. It is well known that the old duke was friends with Elves from that house and that his daughter, Svetlana, was in love with one of the de Desirae princes.
After the tragic death of his daughter, the old duke went to none other than de Desiraes. I was really young at the time and very much into magic. I remember how the Elves came to the Settlement... I followed them like a puppy, listening in on their conversations and trying to feel like I was a part of their world.
Please go to the allod of Tenebra. It's a small Elven allod not far from here. Marguerite de Desirae is in charge there. Tell her everything and perhaps she will help. You can get to Tenebra by using the ancient June ruins near the Great Tree in the Lukomorie.

finishText.en:
A letter from Pierre? Hm, news of more trouble... All sorts of problems have started here lately. The Galleon, built for us by the de Ardeur architects, was attacked during the night by some strange creatures. We had to flee here, to Summer Manor. We've lost everything!
Wait, let me gather my thoughts. What was your mission? Oh, yes, the sculptor from the rebellious House de Doucer... What did you find out?
You witnessed a ritual that created an Astral creature, and Raoul participated in it?! Wow! That's very interesting! We were attacked by strange Astral creatures - maybe they're related.
They are similar to spiders, bats, and rats in appearance but they have different abilities. We call them mutants at the moment, for want of a better name. They are very dangerous, so be careful when roaming this allod!
Well, it's clear that there is a link between our troubles and the events in Darkwater... Don't go anywhere, I'm going to need your help if we're to fix this mess.

goal.en: Meet Christophe de Desirae on the allod of Tenebra.

startText.en:
This is a letter from Pierre de Ardeur who heads the Elven Embassy in Novograd. He has reviewed our report on the case of Raoul de Doucer, the sculptor.
He requests that you meet with Christophe de Desirae at once to give him this letter. Christophe is the lead strategist of the House de Desirae. He's currently on the Tenebra allod. You get there if you use your Adventurer's Stone.
Farewell!

finishText.en:
The Great Ball? What are you talking about?! We've got enough to worry about here! I've got no time for parties!
Then again, I shouldn't panic. That's not very Elf-like behavior... So, welcome to Tenebra!

goal.en: Go to Tenebra and meet with Geoffroi de Desirae.

startText.en:
What a great invention this Adventurer's Stone is! And trust me, I've seen all sorts of magical items. Especially when it comes to Astral travel, portals, and the like. But this Stone is one the best things I've seen.
You can use these ruins here to get directly from Darkwater to Tenebra, the residence of the ruling Elven House de Desirae. You can even go visit their leaders if you want.
That reminds me, I heard that Geoffroi de Desirae, the guardian of this great house, was looking for an assistant. The Great Ball is coming up soon, so I'm sure he has plenty of things to get done.

checkText.en: The darkness thickens and our hopes wane with every passing moment...

finishText.en: Thank you, that's enough. The spawns of darkness won't dare come near while there is light. Keep the cell, you may need it later. There are lanterns all over the allod and lighting them will help you and others to feel safe.

goal.en: Used the Charged Astral Energy Cell to light 4 Elven Lanterns and return to Geoffroi de Desirae.

startText.en:
Welcome to Tenebra - the residence of the ruling Elven House de Desirae! I am Geoffroi de Desirae, one of the head guards. For many years this small allod was a harbor of peace and prosperity for all Elves wishing to leave the main Kanian allod. Now, all that has changed...
The Elves built a galleon that was a magnificent structure designed by our allies from the House de Ardeur. Recently, our beautiful building was captured and we were forced to flee. I'm ashamed to admit that we still don't know what kind of enemies oppose us.
I sincerely hope that you can help us. Recently our allod has become filled with bizarre creatures of the darkness. If you stay in the darkness for too long, you run the risk of being attacked by one of those hideous creatures.
That's why the lanterns must be lit at all times - the order comes from Marguerite de Desirae herself! "As long as the Light is with us, we shall survive," she said.
Please take this charged Astral energy cell. Use it to light four lanterns around Summer Manor. Don't think of it as your duty, think of it as an opportunity to help us out in a difficult situation. Who knows, tomorrow we may be able to help you...

checkText.en: The faster the Council gathers, the sooner you'll get the answers to your questions.

finishText.en: Thank you for your help. We will now need some time to discuss everything in detail. Be patient, for the Elves do not rush decisions on important matters... The Valir castle, your Castle Blight, is a matter of great importance. You may yet see that for yourself.

goal.en: Deliver the invitations to the 5 Council Members of the House de Desirae.

startText.en:
The story of the Castle Blight is a secret of the House de Desirae, and I cannot speak about it to you until I consult with the others. My heart tells me that the time has come to reveal this sad story, but that requires the will of the Council.
Deliver these invitations to the Elven Council members of our House. All of them refused to leave on the rescue ship in order to stay here and recapture what the darkness has taken from us. I am proud of my relatives.
You'll find them here, in the Estate, and on the Amber Coast to the west. Please hurry, we have much to discuss.

checkText.en: Oh, what times we live in! Things that took centuries to create have been turned into dust in seconds!

finishText.en: I don't know how to thank you. These books are only a small part of our great collection, but it's better to save a fragment than to lose everything! Please let me be right now, I must care for these books and mourn my loyal friends, the wise owls...

goal.en: Find 4 books from the archives of the House de Desirae for Augustin de Desirae at the Summer Manor.

startText.en:
I have seen much but rarely have I wept. Even the Great Cataclysm did not wound me as deeply as the destruction of the House de Desiraes' library!

So many unique books, priceless documents, and brilliant paintings... So much was destroyed! I watched as dark creatures tore Pascal's Revelations to shreds. Gargoyles defiled the gorgeous marble face of Zayan's statue! I was powerless to stop them! I was running around the library, mad with grief, trying to save a fraction of the wisdom and beauty entrusted to me for safekeeping. Oh great Astral, save me from suffering that again...!

I was able to save something, however. The owls, my loyal servants, also saved a few things. The clever creatures grabbed books and documents and flew out of the windows! Unfortunately, not all my owls returned to the Summer Manor. Many of them may have been killed by the twilight creatures. The scouts have found one of the Elven masterpieces scattered around the allod. It was covered in owl blood.

I beg you, find the remaining books in the forest. I believe there are nine owls unaccounted for, each of which took one masterpiece with it. My heart tells me that the books are lying in the grass of nearby forests. But they should be here where I can keep an eye on them.

checkText.en:
I only have one color of paint now - red. And you are the brush that paints the future. A good future.
How is that painting entitled "All Rats Are Dead" coming along?

finishText.en: Excellent! We're now safe from the rats now and it's time to proceed to our next painting -"Getting the Galleon Back." I don't want to change the color of the paint just yet - let it be red once more.

goal.en: Kill 4 Cursed or Tainted Rats around the Summer Manor. Report back to Patricia de Desirae.

startText.en:
I spent many years painting the Galleon, decorating that exquisite combination of magic and technology! Unfortunately, their part in building the magnificent ship guarantees the House de Ardeur success during the next Great Game. But let them enjoy it, for we, the de Desirae, get to control it in return!
Well, that was the plan, but now all that beauty belongs to the darkness. Evil Elves have seized control of it and renamed it Darkblood Citadel.
I am sure we'll get the Galleon back eventually, but it won't happen by itself. We must... paint the future with our actions!
The mutants who have been attacking us didn't appear out of nowhere - they are the same rats, gargoyles, and spiders that have lived here for centuries. They are nothing but the enemies' twisted weapons and we must disarm them!
There are many rats around here that have not yet been infected by the darkness. They're normal now, but tomorrow they could fall under evil influences and attack us, just like the Elves from the Galleon. We must deprive them of the opportunity and make sure it doesn't happen. So, can you kill off a few of those rats?

checkText.en:
Those creatures threaten us all. The amber they collect is intended for some evil purpose!

Kill at least four Twilight Gargoyles. Even if it doesn't stop them, at least it'll distract them for a while.

finishText.en:
A good job merits a reward. Take these clothes, they'll come in handy later.
However, we must not rest on our laurels. We must find out where these mutants are coming from! My scouts are already working on this and I hope to get news from them soon.

goal.en: Eliminate 4 Twilight Gargoyles on the Amber Coast. Report to Christophe de Desirae at the Summer Manor.

checkText.en: We must fight fire with fire! Everything that's happening here is caused by magic and only magic can save us from the forces of darkness!

finishText.en:
What a silly mistake! I have a way to go before I reach Prince Dakkar's level... Who is Dakkar?! The Prince was the best necromancer in history until his disappearance!
We must get back to the matters at hand, however. Bats are flocking to the wandering lights like moths! That's not quite what I expected but on the other hand, that indicates that their nature is also related to necromancy. Interesting...

goal.en: Collect 4 lights from the Will-o'-the-Wisps with the Deluminator and use it to charge the Necromancer's Lantern. Report back to Patric de Desirae.

startText.en:
While the others panicked and counted their losses, those of us in our right minds got to work.
The House de Desirae became famous for its necromancy and that is exactly what will help us in this hour of need. Will-o'-the-wisps live in the forest to the east of here. In case you're not familiar with them, they're magical creatures - fragments of the souls of dead Elves, people... and others.
The power from these beings is often used in necromancy, and that's exactly the resource I intend to use now. I'm sure that the fragments of departed souls will be better sources of energy for our lanterns than Astral energy cells.
Help me to kill a few will-o'-the-wisps and collect their energy by using this trap I'll give you. Once it's full, try using it to light the lantern right next to me! We'll see what the darkness thinks about a flaming soul!

checkText.en: I am going to draw up a catalogue of the items you saved. I hope they'll be safe at Summer Manor. Have you managed to find anything?

finishText.en:
I'm planning to make a list of items we've saved. I hope they'll be safe in the Manor. You have a mysterious look about you... Did you manage to find something new?
Oh my! This bust once stood in one of our drawing rooms. Wonderful work, it's a depiction of Dakkar de Desirae, the most powerful necromancer of our House. He disappeared twenty years ago in the Valir castle... It was a tragic loss for all of us! I'm sure that if the Prince was still with us, the darkness wouldn't have dared to invade our allod.
It's interesting that his bust survived, I'd say there's something symbolic about that!

goal.en: Deliver the bust of Prince Dakkar to Augustin de Desirae.

startText.en:
There is a marble bust inside the Elven chest. The inscription on the base reads "Prince Dakkar de Desirae." It must be one of the lost Elven relics.

The poor soul is missing his nose but the librarian will be delighted to see him anyway!

finishText.en:
What's this? Hm... Interesting... The twilight creatures who attacked us behaved just like the diary describes. They sought our blood! Can it really be that these sentient beings act just like animals?
Poor Vamp! He paid for this discovery with his blood! That is another matter for the consideration of the Council. I wonder who that Elf was... the one that bit my counselor?

goal.en: Take the Diary of Vamp de Desirae to Marguerite de Desirae in Summer Manor.

startText.en:
The diary of Vamp de Desirae, what an interesting read... The diary tells the story of Vamp meeting an Elf who later attacked and bit him. After that, Vamp began suffering from strange symptoms - a fear of light, constant thirst for blood, aggressive drive and growing fangs...
This document must be taken to Marguerite de Desirae at once! She must see this! This could explain a lot of the strange behavior that's been happening in Tenebra lately.

finishText.en:
Life here is full of danger now. But as one of the creators of the Palace I am primarily interested in what caused the darkness to appear.
This fell out of a mutant? What an interesting substance... It must be studied carefully. Thank you for this find, it could turn out to be extremely important!

goal.en: Deliver the Astral Clump to Romain de Ardeur.

startText.en: This substance looks to be Astral in nature. The House de Ardeur studies the Astral, so the architect must know what this is! Show him your discovery.

checkText.en: I welcome you to our little camp! After the Great Cataclysm, this forest was used as a haven by the Elves of the House de Desirae, and now we have found a home here too! Did you manage to find the problem with the beacons?

finishText.en:
Thank you so much for your help. How do you like the Galleon we've built? A sad sight, wouldn't you say? We are calling it Darkblood Citadel... and to think that it was once the most beautiful building in the universe, of which the House de Ardeur was rightly proud!
Our architects could not have made a mistake. This was sabotage and we will find those who are responsible and make them pay sooner or later!

goal.en: Check the communication beacons and return to Romain de Ardeur.

startText.en:
After the darkness descended upon us the Elves of the House de Ardeur took refuge in the Tainted Woods. We had no problems communicating with the de Ardeurs until recently...
The fact that our communications have been interrupted worries me greatly. Please take the June ruins and check the communication beacons.
Go from beacon to beacon and you'll eventually end up at their camp. Once you get the job done, go see the head of the House de Ardeur. Good luck!

checkText.en: Some call me mad, but I swear I know more than any of these Elves! The spawns of darkness must be destroyed!

finishText.en: I'm glad you're on my side. My cousin Romain wants to study the mutants while another cousin, Alphonse, is busy studying lamias. But why would anyone waste their time with lamias? If I could convince them to side with me, we could get rid of the darkness once and for all...

goal.en: Kill 4 Twilight Cobras, Twilight Rats or Twilight Tarantulas. Report back to Vivien de Ardeur in the Tainted Woods.

startText.en:
Oh, thank Tensess! Here's someone who'll listen! There's nothing more depressing than a failure to act! While we Elves tried to work out what caused the darkness to appear, while we concocted elaborate theories and pretended to be intelligent, the spawn of the darkness took our beautiful allod from us!
We cannot sit around doing nothing while mutants roam our lands! They must all be destroyed immediately! Help me in this noble quest. You'll find mutant cobras near our settlement, mutant rats at Lamia Lake, and mutant spiders in Spider Thicket. Show them no mercy!

checkText.en: The power of the Holy Tensess shall help us overcome the forces of darkness! Did you bless the water?

finishText.en: The times are truly terrible if Chapel of Tensess has become home to mangy bats. Nonetheless, I believe we will be victorious! What we need to do now is try out this holy water!

goal.en: Bless the jar of water at the altar in the Chapel of Tensess.

startText.en:
You are just in time, I require a reliable and useful assistant. The Church of Light draws its strength from loyal servants of the ideals of Light, like you!
Anyway, let's get down to business! I am looking for a more effective weapon against the creatures of the darkness that have captured our land and chased us from our wonderful home. The first thing that comes to mind is holy water! The powers of Light and the Holy Tensess against the creatures of the darkness is bound to work.
However, our Chapel of Tensess has fallen under the darkness and getting to it is not as easy as it once was. Take this jar of water and bless it at the Chapel altar. Beware the of bats and may the Light be with you!

checkText.en: Not long ago I dreamt that I was back in my library... There was no explosion and the books and scrolls were safely on their shelves... Oh, what a wonderful dream it was!

finishText.en:
Yes, this is the ruling house's coat of arms. The de Desirae family received it twenty years ago during that year's Great Ball. Eight houses competed in art and magic but Prince Dakkar, our genius necromancer, managed to outshine them all. It seemed that there was no barrier to his knowledge and death was turned to art in his hands... Soon after the Great Ball something terrible happened and the Prince disappeared without a trace.
Let me wipe the dust and dirt off our coat of arms.

goal.en: Take the coat of arms to Augustin de Desirae.

name.en: Lost Relics: The de Desirae Coat of Arms

startText.en:
Judging by the ornate pattern and the motto "Learning is greater than death, and beauty is greater than learning," this is the coat of arms of the ruling house and will be of special significance to the de Desirae family.

The librarian will be happy to add it to his collection of relics.

checkText.en: Holy Tensess, you see that the darkness has enveloped our allod and we are confused. Send us a sign... Who's there? I was expecting a sign and got you instead! Did you test the weapons?

finishText.en:
I'm surprised... Though, I shouldn't have doubted the wooden stakes. They may be primitive but they're certainly effective. Oh, Tensess, have mercy on your poor servant and guide him to the path of righteousness!
So, we'll use the stakes to fight the spawn of darkness, be they snakes, spiders, or Elves!

goal.en: Kill the creatures of darkness by using the holy water, the lamia weapon, and the wooden stake. Inform Frederic de Ardeur of the outcome.

startText.en:
It's time to test the weapons. We need to find out which of the three is more effective against the spawn of darkness.
Let's do this - there is a lantern next to it that guards against darkness. So go to the chapel and extinguish the lantern. Hopefully by doing that, some sort of Astral mutant will appear and you must fight him using the water, the silver lamia weapon, and the wooden stake. It might be a bat, a rat, or maybe even one of the fallen Elves, the "vampires", will grace you with their presence. But whatever it is isn't important.
What matters is finding a weapon against to use against the darkness. I shall pray for you, Oh Warrior of Tensess!

finishText.en:
Wooden stakes? It's hard to believe...
But then again - I have no reason to not trust you or Frederic. The good thing about this weapon is that it can be made very quickly and in large quantities. I think eliminating mutants and vampires should only be a matter of time now.
You deserve a reward for bringing such good news!

goal.en: Inform Christophe de Desirae that a weapon for fighting vampires has been found.

startText.en:
The Elves of the House de Desirae must be informed about a weapon being found. I would rather not inform them via the communication beacons seeing as they are so close to the Darkblood Citadel.
Go see Christophe de Desirae personally and tell him that we finally found an effective weapon to fight against the vampires!
A piece of wood... Who would have thought?

checkText.en: Hello. Are you still with me?! The surrounding area is crawling with mutants. It seems that they're multiplying before our very eyes. We must continue our experiments on them... What's this?

finishText.en:
...Oh, you know everything! My life is over...
There is no point in denying it - everything that has happened is my fault! Fate drew me to Armando during a visit to Novograd. He was... Just like me... We fell in love. You probably won't understand but he could make me do whatever he wanted... When he asked me for a small favor with that damn stone I wasn't able to refuse!
I didn't know it would end in darkness! I'll never forgive myself...

goal.en: Accuse Vivien de Ardeur of treason.

startText.en:
The letter found on the vampire's body reads:
"Vivien, you are wrong to avoid me. My feelings for you have not changed. In your last letter you say that I betrayed and used you, Astral forbid... How could you possibly say that?! If I am at fault for our disagreement, then my only mistake is not to have told you the full details of my plan. I simply didn't want to scare you! I can tell you everything now, however.
It is true that the artifact I asked you to put in the engine room was not a surveillance device. Forgive me for this lie - I was forced to deceive you in order to achieve my objective. I now posses the great and terrible power that I hinted at so many times before and I want to share it with you. I need you, Vivien! All my dreams have come true but I lack only one thing - your love. In addition, I can't seem to make any sense of your Galleon and your engineering genius will come in handy.
I'm sending you this letter with my young cousin. He has already become one of is and he'll be able to perform the initiation ritual on you as well. Don't be afraid, it only hurts a little and only lasts for a few seconds. But what follows is power, strength, and immortality. Eternal love, Vivien, is that not what we dreamed of together, you and I?
Forever yours, Armando de Doucer"
Who would have thought! Vivien hates the creatures of darkness so much... But the evidence is irrefutable - she is clearly involved in this whole story.
She must be questioned about this letter at once!

checkText.en: I have been studying the substance you brought and have reached some very interesting conclusions... What?! Vivien has screwed up again?

finishText.en:
Oh, my! Damnit! Poor Vivien... I have suspected that she... But how could she believe Armando de Doucer?! That soppy idiot!

And what am I supposed to do now? Damnit...

I can't abandon her but I can't conceal what happened from the House de Desirae either...

I must tell the story without exposing my cousin.

And I'm going to need your help to do that!

goal.en: Take the request to Romain de Ardeur in Summer Manor.

startText.en:
After what happened, I didn't have the courage to own up! Nobody would have understood what I did!
I wanted to make amends by fighting the darkness... I curse the day I met Armando!
I beg you, please find my cousin, Romain de Ardeur, in Summer Manor. I hope that he'll forgive me and protect me! Maybe he'll think of a way of telling others about what the darkness is concealing and that the House de Doucer, with some sort of terrible and mysterious power, is behind what happened.
Oh, please don't tell anyone about this! I regret what happened tremendously... If my crime is revealed, I will be executed. Spare me and give me a chance to redeem myself...

checkText.en: The librarian told me about your discoveries. I am delighted that at last someone has began to work on recovering our relics!

finishText.en:
The items and documents you returned are valuable to not only to Elves, but all of Sarnaut. They are part of the history of the world, its cultural heritage!
Take this weapon as a sign of our gratitude. You may soon need it!

goal.en: Receive your reward from Marguerite de Desirae for saving the Elven relics.

startText.en: I've never had an assistant as reliable as you. If it weren't for your help, our relics would have vanished into oblivion. I've informed Marguerite of this and she is waiting to see you, so that she can give you the reward deserve.

checkText.en: I've been waiting for you.

finishText.en:
So, we've unraveled this mystery and all thanks to you. In gratitude, the House de Desirae has unanimously decided to share the story of the Valir castle with you. I will tell you everything we know.
Soon after our victory at the Great Ball, the daughter of Adrian Valir, a Kanian Duke, died. Thanks to Tensess' sacrifice, everyone who lives on the allods are given the hope of resurrection and eternal life. Everyone except Svetlana Valir, whose soul was stolen by magic. Priests of Tensess were unable to do anything and so the Duke turned to Dakkar de Desirae, our necromancer. Prince Dakkar loved Svetlana and began the Rescue Ritual immediately. But something terrible happened during the ritual and we're still unsure as to what. The castle was cursed, its inhabitants abandoned it, Adrian Valir turned undead, and Prince Dakkar and his beloved have been missing ever since.

goal.en: Meet with Marguerite de Desirae.

name.en: An Audience with Marguerite de Desirae

startText.en:
We now have a fairly good idea of what happened. It is important for me, as the strategy expert of the House de Desirae, to know all the details of this crime.
Some unknown "Ally" bestowed upon Armando de Doucer some sort of knowledge that allowed him to gain power over the darkness. The price he paid for this was the need for other beings' blood. Armando became the first vampire, and he then infected the other de Doucers. Then, I'm not yet sure how, the Artifact of darkness was delivered onto the ship and this turned our home into a vampire incubator.
Part of the energy was channeled to the magic artifacts at the Boarder and caused the twilight creatures to appear. They turned our beautiful palace into their instrument of vengeance, their revenge for the power they lost at the Great Ball twenty years ago.
There's only two things that aren't clear - how the artifact turned up on the Galleon, and the identity of this mysterious "Ally." I have a hunch about the former...
But the latter... Perhaps you should talk with Marguerite de Desirae.

checkText.en: I never thought I'd see you again, especially in this terrible place!

finishText.en:
The Rescue Ritual could not be completed. Svetlana awoke from the dead but in the form of a witch and her poor father turned into an undead ghoul. I blamed myself for everything and chose to leave this world.

However, the events on Evermeet Isle forced me to carry out my own investigation. I now know that I am not to blame for the curse on the castle. The real culprits are the House de Doucer and their ally from the Astral - Tep, the evil necromancer.

Tep didn't have a pyramid or spark vault out here and so he chose the Valir castle. With Tep's help, the necromancers of the House de Doucer sabotaged my ritual and turned the castle into a kingdom of the undead. Tep put his guardian, Mor'Ghuun, in the castle to watch over it. The monstrous creature can kill with a mere glance and I fear we'll have to face it!

goal.en: Find the identity of the ally that's in league with the House de Doucer.

startText.en:
We don't know what is going on in the castle now. And to be honest, I am more concerned about this ally that helped the Elves of the House de Doucer. His magical talents are obvious.
I am inclined to think that this "ally" has something to do with what happened at the Valir castle. Either personally or through the late Armando, he interfered with the ritual Prince Dakkar was performing. And we all know is how it ended...
I'm asking you to find out who this ally is and I am confident that you will succeed! The only place where you can do this is in the Valir castle.
Go back to Darkwater, take your most trusted and true friends, infiltrate the castle, and unravel this mystery!

checkText.en: We have too many enemies here...

finishText.en: The deed is done. I hope the lamias will stop giving us trouble now - we've got enough problems as it is!

goal.en: Kill 4 Lamias and their leader Deianeira. Report back to Simeon de Ardeur in the Tainted Woods.

startText.en:
Now, let's get down to business. The House de Ardeur needs your help. Our situation is very insecure. The more the darkness deepens, the more active these twilight creatures become. However, the lamias are giving me even more cause for concern.
These creatures have always lived on Tenebra. We've never had peace with them, but we've never destroyed them either - the era of the Battle for Beauty is long past, and it's not my people's custom to kill for the sake of killing.
However, we barely managed to repel their most recent attack. If we don't show those cunning creatures our real strength, we can be certain of another invasion. Unfortunately, we don't have the ability to fight them again right now.
Please go to Lamia Lake and kill a few of them for us. While you're there make sure that you destroy their leader - Deianeira! She's an old and cunning creature. I'm sure it was she who ordered the attacks.

checkText.en: Did you manage to get me a lamia weapon?

finishText.en:
So that's what a lamia weapon looks like! All covered by dark patina, so threatening, so noble...
It seems that the forces of darkness are afraid of silver. I can't wait to find out how effective it is against mutants.

goal.en: Steal a Lamia Weapon and bring it to Frederic de Ardeur.

startText.en:
There are lamias that live near the lake not far from here. They're evil and wanton creatures - may Tensess damn them! After their recent attack, one of our scouts followed them back to their lake. He saw them kill the mutants with incredible ease.
The only explanation for this lies in their weapons, for the holy Tensess could not have given them the power to fight the darkness instead of us.
I'm also sure that the scout's report is a sign from Tensess himself. Lamia weapons will help us defeat the darkness. I'm sure your mission is clear to you - infiltrate the lamia camp and bring me back one of their weapons!

finishText.en: Stop! What are you doing here? You're a vandal, a barbarian, a murderer! Don't you dare harm these darling lamias. I have spent countless hours in their company and I can assure you that they're not the heartless monsters my kin believes them to be. On the contrary, lamias can be very kind and gentle...

goal.en: Find Alphonse de Ardeur near Lamia Lake.

startText.en:
Oh, will no one help me? My fiancé, Alphonse, has been studying those damn lamias his entire life. Now that they've attacked us, I fear for him! He could be hurt! Or worse, he may have perished...
I beg you, go to the lamia camp and find my Alphonse or whatever is left of him. I hope... no, I'm sure he's still alive, but there's nothing worse than uncertainty.

checkText.en: Did you find him? Please don't tell me Alphonse is dead! My life has no meaning without him. He loved me so dearly and our wedding was to be so joyful...

finishText.en:
What?! That lamia loving son of a... I knew he was a little weird but I could never have imagined this! Oh the shame, I wish they had really killed him!
Listen, please don't breathe a word of this to anyone. There will be no end to my embarrassment if word gets out that he left me for lamias! Okay?

goal.en: Convey Alphonse de Ardeur's response to Isabelle de Vevre.

startText.en:
Isabelle sent you? Of course... I should have let her know that I'm okay and that there's no reason to worry. But In truth, I forgot all about it! I've gotten to know these creatures... very intimately, if you know what I mean.
Boy I tell you, lamias make great lovers! Elven wives don't even come close to them. They can move in ways an Elf never could!
Oh, you don't approve of that? Well, you're just another snob and bigot like the rest of my kin! I have no intention of going back to live among them! I am happy here! Please tell Isabelle that... and tell her that I'm sorry.

checkText.en: I thought that our collection would be as safe as possible in this new Galleon Palace, but it turned out to be quite the opposite...

finishText.en: The creation of the League was a turning point in the history of Elves. The Elves had never before sought out allies, but the Great Cataclysm brought about a great change and we were forced to change with it. In the year 707 of the New Era, the Orcs and Xadaganians captured the Elven allod of Grokh and it was clear they had no intention of stopping there. At an extraordinary Great Ball it was decided to agree to an alliance with Kania and in 721 the Elves and Kanians finally signed the Declaration and created the League... A truly priceless find!

goal.en: Take the Declaration on the Creation of the League to Augustin de Desirae.

startText.en:
The scroll is affixed with several seals, one depicting a Kanian eagle stands out above the rest. Peeling away part of the scroll reveals its title - "Declaration of the Creation of the League."

This is undoubtedly an historical document of great value. The librarian will be delighted.

finishText.en:
Oh, I thought you were another one of those creatures from the darkness. A couple of them showed up here earlier, but I was too strong for them!
It looks like the Elves really are in trouble if they're seeking the wisdom of an old, overgrown tree! The question is, should I help them?

goal.en: Speak to Silvio in Spider Thicket.

startText.en:
It would be foolish of us to refuse help at this difficult time. The Elves have always shunned nature magic, believing it to be insufficiently elegant. However, even those who did not accept the sacrifice of Tensess must have many useful secrets, or Tensess would not have blessed everyone with his gift.
