There is one such creature that lives in the grove to the northeast of here. His name is Silvio and he is a wise old treant. Maybe he knows of a better weapon to fight the vampires with? In any case, you should seek his advice immediately. Hopefully he can help us in these dark times.

checkText.en: The forest is full of rustling, there is no light, and strange creatures move in the darkness. The world is changing again and if there's one thing I hate, it's change...

finishText.en: Hah! Looks like old Shelba got what was coming to her! Fear not, I remember my promise and I'll keep my word.

goal.en: Kill Shelba and her 4 Tarantulas. Report back to Silvio in Spider Thicket.

startText.en:
The darkness that came from the castle has covered all of this allod. I am old, very old... I saw the world shatter when I was a mere sprout, I saw... Hm, I don't remember now. My memory is not what it once was.
But what I can say for sure is that everything passes. This too shall pass. The darkness will retreat and then return again as it has for centuries. There are more important things to worry about. For example, Shelba, the giant spider...
She and I have been enemies for a long time now. If you help me deal with her, I might be inclined to give you advice about the creatures of the darkness.

checkText.en: Oh, there you are! How is our old wooden friend? Did he tell you anything useful?

finishText.en:
Wooden stakes? Hmm, is that not too simple a weapon? Then again, Silvio's word is one you can rely on. It's a good thing you managed to get some stakes on your way here - the sooner we can begin our experiments the better!
What Silvio said about the Elves and the darkness has been confirmed by the folks at Summer Manor. The poor souls were spotted there too. They even have a name for them over there - vampires, after their first victim, Vamp de Desirae.

goal.en: Prepare 4 wooden stakes by breaking branches from nearby trees. Return to the camp in the Tainted Woods and relay Silvio's words to the priest Frederic de Ardeur.

startText.en:
Here's what I know... There were two Elves here, and they too were victims of the darkness. Or maybe they created it...
Either way, they're dead now. My branches were the weapon that killed them. Pierced through their soft flesh with ease, and their souls returned to the Astral.
That's what you need to tell the Elves - a wooden stake is the best weapon against the spawns of darkness! If anyone is in any doubt, they can test it out themselves. You can gather branches from the trees on your way back and give them to the Elves to test. Farewell, gentle one...

checkText.en: You have a mysterious look about you, did you manage to find something else by any chance? Tell me, I beg of you!

finishText.en:
Yes, this truly is a wonderful document! 2 years ago, following his victory at the Great Ball, Prince Dakkar de Desirae staged an important ritual in the Valir castle. It ended in tragedy with the Prince disappearing and a curse being laid on the castle. We believed that it was the House de Doucer that meddled with the ritual using Astral magic and causing the disaster.
An investigation began and while the evidence was circumstantial, the reputation of the House de Doucer was left under a cloud. We have been sworn enemies ever since.

goal.en: Take the Court Judgment to Augustin de Desirae.

startText.en:
This scroll is bound with the seal of the House de Desirae. The parchment is soaked and the letters can be read through it...

"Court Judgment on the case of the House de Doucer". Another wonderful relic from the library, which should be returned to Summer Manor.

checkText.en: Demonic scouts are the first sign of trouble. Death, destruction, and chaos come hot on their heels. Only by destroying them can we hope to avoid the second wave of the invasion on Tenebra.

finishText.en:
We are saved? Phew... Thank the Light!
Heh, these disasters sure have made a believer out of me. But then again, we also have you and your weapons to thank. Providence has sent us a real warrior in our hour of need.

goal.en: Eliminate 4 demons and cultists. Report back to Geoffroi de Desirae at the Summer Manor.

startText.en:
At last! I've been looking for you everywhere.
I have terrible news... Demons have appeared on our archipelago! A scouting party was spotted southeast of here on the Astral coast. They have a cultist with them and that can only mean one thing - they'll soon be joined by the Defilers and Soul Devourers. May Tensess save us!
The demons must be destroyed immediately, before their main forces arrive to help them. We can't rely on the Galleon to protect us now. Eliminate the demons and save us!

checkText.en:
Vivien made a terrible mistake but her remorse is genuine. I do not want the mark of dishonor to stain her good name and our House.
Did you get the ichor samples?

finishText.en: I'll attach these samples to the report. We will make public the reason why darkness is spreading - however, the name of the guilty party shall remain secret. Thank you for your help with this delicate matter.

goal.en: Collect 4 Astral Ichor samples from the Twilight Gargoyles. Take them to Romain de Ardeur at the Summer Manor.

startText.en:
We must tell the de Desiraes everything we know. But in a way that prevents Vivien from being suspected of involvement. It's not going to be easy.

But first things first. I've studied the substance you found. it's certainly interesting and clearly of Astral origin. I have decided to call it Astral Ichor. It can accumulate magical energy, but this magic is blacker than darkness itself. It's the magic of death...

I can probably fool Marguerite by putting forward a believable theory about a certain artifact that caused this ichor to appear. But I will need samples to support my theory, and the more I have the better.

Get me another four Astral Ichor samples from the Twilight Gargoyles at the Eastern Border. I'll draft a report about the artifact and use the samples as evidence to support my conclusions.

checkText.en: Hm, we're losing more scouts. I'm starting to get worried.

finishText.en: You saved Guillaume?! He's been missing since the darkness fell. The House de Desirae is forever in your debt. ...You say he was attacked by Astral demons? That's disturbing news indeed. I'll inform my superiors that their attacks have increased. Thank you.

goal.en: Escort Guillaume de Desirae to Summer Manor and speak with Geoffroi de Desirae.

startText.en:
I'd almost given up hope of getting out of here alive. That Xadaganian bastard is a master of torture. I didn't even know I could take that much pain.
After darkness fell, we sent a wave of magical energy into the Astral in an attempt to dispel the darkness. The demons must have found out where the epicenter was and came to investigate. They sent their cultist lackey to interrogate me, but I had nothing to tell them...
Please, you've got to help me get out of here! I've taken some pretty grave wounds and I need to get back to town. If we make it to safety, please tell Geoffroi de Desirae about the demon invasion as soon as possible.

checkText.en: Each new discovery warms my heart. It's like I meeting an old friend I had lost all hope of seeing again. What is it this time?

finishText.en:
Each new discovery warms my heart. It's like I meeting an old friend I had lost all hope of seeing again. What is it this time?

 Oh my, I don't believe my eyes!

"I stand on the shore alone

The darkness is upon our home

It is midnight and the road is long

Who will miss me when I'm gone?"

Wonderful words, wouldn't you say? After the Great Cataclysm, beauty in all its manifestations became our ideal.

At the Great Ball, we decided on cultural expansion and the alliance with Kania helped our great mission of enlightenment.

goal.en: Take the book of Francois de Vignon's poetry to Augustin de Desirae.

startText.en:
This book of poetry is a collection of the works of the great Elven poet, Francois de Vignon. This edition, published during the author's lifetime, is a real treasure.
It ought to be taken to the librarian - he's bound to be delighted.

checkText.en: These nocturnal creatures are causing too much trouble - they must be destroyed. Don't put this job off.

finishText.en: Splendid! The fewer of those disgusting creatures there are, the better we'll sleep at night. I hope the day we finally rid our archipelago of these wretches is nigh.

goal.en: Eliminate 4 Twilight Bats at the Western Border. Report to Christophe de Desirae at the Summer Manor.

startText.en:
I have very important news. Our scouts have finally discovered where all these twilight beasts are coming from.
The Western Border! The Border has now become home to an enormous population of twilight bats. Their wings obscure the light and their screaming can drive you crazy. No wonder my very best people were unable to make it back...
A difficult and dangerous mission awaits you. But do not avoid battle! Kill as many creatures of the darkness as you can and you will earn the eternal gratitude of House de Desirae.

checkText.en: Hmm, trouble? I know the steles are well guarded but they must be destroyed at any price!

finishText.en: The Nosferatu Farm is no more and that's all down to you. Here, take these clothes as your reward. However, the destruction of the Farm was but a first step. The time for decisive action has come and our enemies will be made to pay for their evil!

goal.en: Use the magic time bombs to blow up four Vampire Stele and report to Christophe de Desirae.

startText.en:
Now let me get to the point. We discovered strange steles at the Western Frontier. No doubt they are connected to the darkness that has straddled Tenebra. One of the masters of House de Doucer who was lucky to come back alive from there described them thus:
"These magical steles seem to emanate darkness themselves. Anyone who comes under their influence changes literally within seconds, becoming the very twilight creatures of darkness that attacked us.
The steles are guarded by "vampires", as they are now called. Without a doubt, we are dealing with some kind of new, unknown magic and these steles are part of that magic."
So there we have it. We've decided to destroy these steles. Will you do it? I'll give you four magic bombs. These weapons are dangerous, so handle them with care. Set a bomb next to each stele, and don't even think of standing near - they could blow your head clean off!

finishText.en:
So, everything is finally clear - our ancient enemy, the House de Doucer is at fault... What scum!
Then again, if the enemy is hiding he must be vulnerable. The Elves of the House de Desirae will act immediately! It's time we recaptured the Galleon and ended the invasion of the darkness!

goal.en: Take the House de Doucer Signet Ring to Marguerite de Desirae in Summer Manor.

startText.en:
A signet ring with the seal of the House de Doucer! This is an excellent opportunity to tell the de Desiraes that their enemies, the House de Doucer, are the cause of the darkness and keep Damien's name out of it!
This signet ring must be delivered to Marguerite de Desirae at once.

checkText.en: Did you find something?

finishText.en:
The castle of the Valir family, now called Castle Blight, is one of the gloomiest places in Kania. Since the castle's curse, it has been inhabited by ghosts and the undead. They say that a terrible monster lives in the castle, a beast that can kill with a mere glance. I don't believe that nonsense, though!
Brave folk have tried to get into the Valir castle many a time. Some were after their treasure, while others were simply curious. It didn't seem to make much difference though - none of them ever returned. Our scouts seem to be no different...

goal.en: Take the Scout Report to Augustin de Desirae.

startText.en:
"The report drafted by the scouts who explored the Valir castle". Hm... The seal on the document is broken - it reads:

"Our unit was sent to the Valir castle to investigate the grim rumors that have been popping up about it. The area around the castle is deserted and no one dares to approach it. Local legend tells of the undead and a terrible monster that lives in the castle.

An external examination did not yield anything of value, however, we heard voices behind the walls and some unclear but chilling whispers. A heap of carts and abandoned items can be seen in the courtyard, just beyond the gate. There are no human remains. The place bears the mark of desertion, yet the presence of something alien can be felt very clearly. It's as if someone invisible is watching us. Two of our scouts volunteered to try to reach the Count's throne through the courtyard. It seems as though they met their end here. We waited outside for an extra two hours before deciding to head back.

Rudolph de Desirae".

This is an Elven scout report regarding the situation at the Valir castle. Another gift for the good librarian and some good insight as to what happened in the Valir castle.

checkText.en: Only the death of Armando can lift the dishonor from his house. Choose a method of execution and carry it out!

finishText.en: I met Armando de Doucer at the Great Ball several times. He was so sophisticated... His unbridled vanities lead his house to a sad end. Now he's dead... dead forever! Justice has triumphed!

goal.en: Bring the Head of Armando de Doucer to Marguerite de Desirae.

name.en: The Execution of Armando de Doucer

startText.en:
So, the House de Doucer... A once great house... The decision to attack Kirah was made when the House de Doucer was in power. It was their house that had to bear the brunt of the demon attack that fateful day. Perhaps that was what broke Armando...
Armando is the head of the disgraced house. He's lived through so much and the defeat during the last Great Game must have been his last straw. I don't think he'll ever forgive Prince Dakkar for that defeat. He beat him using death magic - the very magic in which Armando considered himself to be the most skilled in.
I'm sure Armando is behind all of this. Only he has the power to wield this blinding darkness. Armando was the major suspect in what happened at the Valir castle. Unfortunately, all our efforts to find him have failed...
You will do it! Go to Darkblood Citadel and kill Armando de Doucer. No, don't just kill him - annihilate him forever, give him the gift of ultimate death. Yes, I demand Armando's head! May his damned soul never return to this world! Bury him in the past - forever!

checkText.en: You failed to infiltrate Darkblood Citadel? Did you run out of stakes?

finishText.en: Death has released these poor souls! Even though the Elves of the House de Doucer brought endless grief upon us, I pity them nonetheless. I'm sure that it was not their will to become vampires, but Armando left them no choice.

goal.en: Kill 10 Vampires living within Darkblood Citadel.

startText.en:
The time has come for us to pay a visit to the Darkblood Citadel. We will no longer be pushed around by their kind! We must take back our Galleon! Our architectural triumph that was painstakingly created by the House de Ardeur!
And now I am sending you to our beloved palace with an order to kill. Take out as many vampires as possible. Wooden stakes have been proven to be a good weapon, so that's all you should need to do the deed.

checkText.en: Couldn't find the artifact? It must be in the engine room somewhere. Find it, quickly!

finishText.en: Here it is, the cause of all our troubles. Its magical power has left it and passed to the Galleon. How sad... All the time and effort that went into this palace and now all that's left for me to do is seal its doors forever or at least until we can find a way of purging it of the dark energy.

goal.en: Find the artifact in the engine room on the Galleon and take it to Romain de Ardeur.

startText.en: I have provided Christophe de Desirae with the Astral ichor analysis data and informed him of the source of the magical energy in the engine room on the Galleon. Suspicion will not fall on Vivien but we must get that artifact! As long as it continues to work, there will be no end to our troubles.

checkText.en: Ah ha! I knew you were one of them! I won't open the door until three Vampires lose their heads.

finishText.en:
So you're not a vampire after all! My name is Emile de Ardeur and I was the chief mechanic until the explosion happened.
I was sent a vision and learned the truth! Everything that's happened here is punishment for our Elven pride. Our necromancers wanted to defeat death itself and our builders experimented with the Astral...
The Elves have angered the mighty Tensess and they must repent. To make up for our sins we have founded a new church here, the Church of the End of Time. I am its leader, and I am committed to setting things right.

goal.en: Kill 3 Vampires and brings their heads to the magic protective field that shields Emile de Ardeur.

startText.en:
No, no... Don't even bother trying to trick me! You're just another one of those cursed vampires! Leave, you'll never get a droplet of my blood! Oh, you want me to trust you?
Then bring three vampire heads to this door! Once you've done that, then I might believe you.

checkText.en: Who's disturbing me? Yet another spawn of darkness?!

finishText.en: At last! Someone who is free of evil influences... What do you want? Help? You want me to use the meteorite against the darkness? That's easy... Get ready!

goal.en: Defeat the Twilight Shadow and speak with Caesaria.

startText.en:
Wait! I've seen you before! In one of my visions... You were fighting the vampire patriarch, Armando de Doucer, and he defeated you... I will help you avoid a fatal mistake! That is my sacred mission! Now listen...
Armando de Doucer has bent the darkness to his will with the help of a so-called "Ally." I don't know who he is, but he taught Armando the secret death magic rituals and revealed to him the now forgotten mysteries of ancient blood magic...
This knowledge allowed Armando to use dark power of the Astral! However, the price he paid for this power is blood. Blood that Armando de Doucer and his minions now need to consume to survive.
To defeat Armando, you have to deprive him of this power! And what opposes the Astral? That's right - meteorite!
Armando fears the fragments of meteorite that we have hidden away to protect the Galleon. You need to find Caesaria, the spirit of the palace - Armando has no control over her. You can find her in the chapel at the very top of the Galleon. To get there, use elevators and side stairs. Fighting Armando is pointless until you talk to Caesaria, so avoid him!
A shadow guards Caesaria - it's an eerie creature that serves Armando. You will have to kill it before you can reach her. Now go, and may Tensess be with you!

checkText.en: Please tell me everything! I don't need consolation, just give me the truth, no matter how bitter it is...

finishText.en:
That means that all is lost... All the things I created and had been working on for decades, everything I devoted my life to is destroyed! Damn you, Vivien!
No, I will not give up! I will find a way to cleanse my ship, even if it means learning the blackest magic there is and sacrificing myself - I am ready!
I would like to thank you for everything you've done... But I can't! Anger and despair fill my heart. Leave - that is the only thing that you can do right now.

goal.en: Convey Caesaria's message to Romain de Ardeur at Summer Manor.

startText.en:
Were you aware that this palace is actually a ship? It was one of the Elves' most splendid creations, you know. Just imagine this grand galleon floating along in the Astral... But before you go into battle, please hear my last request.
A powerful source of magical energy appeared in the engine room before the darkness came. It was some sort of artifact. I raised the alarm and the Elves managed to evacuate. Within no time, the artifact had released a massive amount of dark energy. This galleon soaked it up like a sponge...
I fear that it is now contaminated and anyone who enters will turn into a vampire. Tell my maker, Romain de Ardeur, about this phenomenon. This galleon is his brainchild and he must be told everything. Tell him the galleon is lost for good...

checkText.en: Vampires are dangerous creatures. May Tensess be with you!

finishText.en: I'm glad that was not mistaken in my choice of weapons. If you'd like a rematch with the vampires, let me know.

goal.en: Go to the Western Border, drink the Werewolf Potion, kill 5 Twilight Vampires, and return to Romain de Ardeur.

name.en: On the Other Side of Darkness

startText.en:
Each of us must fight in his own way against the darkness that blankets Tenebra. And I want to contribute to this fight. There are creatures that exist in this world whose primal fury and ability to track down and stalk the victim can help us fight the creatures of the darkness. I'm talking about werewolves.
I was once very fond of alchemy, so I've used my vast knowledge to create this potion that will turn you into a werewolf. It is in this form that you'll be able to move between worlds.
You must go to the twilight, where the darkness has settled, and fight the vampires that have made it their home. I beg of you, kill five Twilight vampires at the Western Border.
Drink this potion as soon as you arrive at the Border.

checkText.en: I miss my brother, but I must bid him farewell.

finishText.en: Thank you. Go now. I want to be alone to mourn my brother, the forest, the allod, and this world that has been torn to pieces.

goal.en: Participate in killing Briarstank and return to Silvio.

startText.en:
I once had a brother... We were born from tiny acorns and grew side by side next to our mother. We sprouted together, budded together, reached our branches out to the sun together... but the darkness that covered the land has also covered my brother.
Briarstank loved the Astral. It was dearer to him than his own family, but now the Astral has mutated him... A careful treant would have monitored the infection and remove the rotten parts, but he has let it consume him.
My brother must be removed from the forest and forgotten. You must gather your allies and uproot this menace! He roams along the shore, staring into the Astral with maddening looks...

finishText.en: Treasure! Many thanks to the lamias for saving you the hassle of digging this stuff up! Now to see what's inside...

goal.en: Take the lamia's treasure for yourself.

startText.en: Oh, what's this? It looks like the lamias got to the buried treasure first. But I'm sure they wouldn't mind if someone took it off their hands... Besides, you need it more than they do!

checkText.en: A treasure hunt is such a fascinating thing! It sounds almost as exciting as the study of necromancy!

finishText.en: Oh! So it really did exist... Good job finding it!

goal.en: Find the hidden treasure on the southern allod and report your success to Patric de Desirae.

startText.en:
I've heard that there's a treasure hidden somewhere on the southern allod of Tenebra. It was supposedly buried by some Elves a long, long time ago. I'm not sure why - perhaps they were in danger of something almost as perilous as the vampires, and they had to hide their goods before they fled.
Unfortunately, I haven't the time to go gallivanting off in search of a treasure that may or may not exist. But you have all the time in the world.
If you didn't, I don't suspect that you'd be here helping us! Instead you'd be attending to your own matters. If you find yourself in need of something to do, I'd suggest you look for it.

checkText.en: What are you waiting for? You'll never learn more if you can't follow instructions.

finishText.en: Great! You're on your way to becoming a great anthropologist yourself!

goal.en: Find the 3 Stones of Tenebra and report back to anthropologist Harold de Ardeur.

startText.en:
To be able to call oneself a true scholar, one must be very aware of one's surroundings.
As a test, I have placed three stones imbued with magic around Tenebra. Explore this great allod, find the stones and report back to me.
Only after you have done this will I agree to take you under my wing. You can find these stones in the Western Border, Eastern Border, and Lamia Lake. Good luck, traveler.

checkText.en: Well? I hope those lamia shake with fear every time they hear your name.

finishText.en:
Thank you.
I'm sure Tenebra is on it's way to a bright and cleaner future.

goal.en: Kill 50 Lamias and report back to Harold de Ardeur.

startText.en:
I'm just going to cut to the chase. Lamias are a blight on this land. Well, the vampires are worse, I suppose. But those lamia women are such insidious creates! I mean, can you really trust a woman who is actually part snake?!
I'm sure you'll come across them at some point. And when you do, be sure to give them a good bop on the head for us!

checkText.en: Search for mound of soil. That will lead you to the sandstone mushrooms.

finishText.en:
Perfect.
Imperial officers will do everything to be able to try this delicacy!

goal.en: Collect 5 Sandstone Mushrooms for anthropologist Harold de Ardeur.

startText.en:
There are treasures here in Tenebra - voluptuous elven women, the smartest magical scholars, and of course, the most handsome of men. But there is one treasure that stands out above all else.
I'm talking about our sandstone mushrooms! Oh, believe me, this delicacy is of great value. First of all, it is very difficult to find. And secondly, it has a fabulous taste! It's all bitter and spicy... Oh, I'm drooling just thinking about it!
Local rats adore the taste of the shrooms as well, and they dig the ground to get to them. Piles of fresh soil is what you need to look for! This is a sign that a rat has just started digging, and you have a chance to be the first to grab the mushroom.
Bring them all to me. Don't worry, I won't eat them, although I want to. I need them for something else.

checkText.en: Well? Have those creatures been defeated?

finishText.en:
Excellent!
I knew you could do it. And by defeating these beasts, you now know more about the local fauna.

goal.en: Collect 3 Tenebra Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Harold de Ardeur.

startText.en:
Listen, I know you're a seasoned traveler, but this is Tenebra!
You let your guard down for one second and that's it! It's all over! I want you to get used to the dangers of a place like this, so I need you to venture out and kill three of Tenebra's most dangerous creatures!
But you need to bring me proof – three trophies.

checkText.en: Have you completed all of my tasks?

finishText.en:
Wonderful!
You know, I must admit, I didn't think you'd be able to do it. Thank you for proving me wrong! Go ahead and take your reward!

goal.en: Complete all of the Anthropologist's tasks and report back to Harold de Ardeur.

startText.en:
If you can successfully complete all my tasks, you'll be generously rewarded.
And I'm not talking about some rinky-dink potion! You'll have the knowledge that you've gained from this adventure as well as some prime equipment that's bound to help you on your future journeys!
So, find the stones, defeat the beasts, and gather some valuable resources here in Tenebra!

checkText.en: Ships require proper care. Cannons and artillery must be scoured, all details greased, and the gull has to shine! Then Demons will run in fear before the seasoned Astralonauts!

finishText.en: Have you completed the mission successfully? Congratulations! Well done! If you want to hunt again, come tomorrow. We are running short on Demons!

goal.en: Start the hunt in the open Astral and obtain 10 Treasure Chests. Report to Marat Lisitsin.

startText.en:
Greetings! They say, soldier's duty is dangerous and difficult... Huh, hunting Demons can be dangerous indeed, especially if you are a novice. But difficult? I wouldn't say so.

To keep ourselves in a good shape, we came up with an entertaining activity that we simply call Astral Hunt. You just take a fully equipped ship, fly it into the Astral, and start slaying all demonic filth that you see.

Your ship has a new device called Astral Trap. When you activate its hunting mode, it starts counting killed Demons. The stronger is the Demon, the more points you get for killing it. When the counter reaches 100, you get an extra Treasure Chest!

Easy, isn't it? Do you want to try? Get 10 Treasure Chests and come back again. Don't worry, we will let you keep the loot. I will just be pleased to know that young soldiers of the Empire take on our traditions!

checkText.en: Don't go unprepared! The hunt itself does not take a lot of efforts, but a weak ship won't last long in the Astral.

finishText.en: It was fun, wasn't it? I can see you loved it. Come again tomorrow. As Pridens say, the hunt never stops.

goal.en: Start the hunt in the open Astral and obtain 10 Treasure Chests. Report to Nastassja Ushkuynikova.

startText.en:
We, Hunters, have one entertainment - hunting Demons. Some may think that it's a tough duty and we are doing it against our will. Not at all!

Killing mighty Astral Demons is an honorable thing to do. As regards the small ones, we are just having fun and derive some benefit from that. It's simple, really!

Set up the Astral Trap to start counting the killed Demons. The stronger are the Demons, the higher goes the counter on the trap. When it hits 100, you will get a small Astral gift, so to say, - a Treasure Chest!

Is everything clear? Right. Obtain 10 Chests and come back to me. It's fun and profit at the same time, see for yourself!

checkText.en: Did you defeat that wicked monster?

finishText.en: Great job! Now all the traders can live in security.

goal.en: Defeat Fierce Tempting Predator in the Mysterious Astral and report back to Marat Lisitsin.

startText.en:
Oh, dear, I could hardly ever imagine that I, the great demon hunter, will have to ask an Imperial devotee for help. But the menace is too serious to fight it alone... Those who faced them and survived can hardly stutter a word about it and refuse to approach the astral ship. Even if you are very brave, do you dare to fight those terrifying creatures?

They destroyed many astral ships, and each time you defeat a demon you save someone's lives! To get to a fierce demon tempter, find the Astral Monster Den on the map of the Mysterious Astral and use the Astrolabe. When you get there, use a scanner to find the Monster Den and turn the demon to ashes!

checkText.en: Well, is your ship ready to serve for the glory of the Empire and your purse?

finishText.en:
Excellent! Everyone in your crew at the time of loading will get rewarded for cargo delivery. When you get to the outpost, go to the supplier and unload the supplies.
And remember, even if we're not preparing a caravan, you can buy supplies from us, deliver them to the outposts and sell them for profit - the miners are happy to purchase sausage and books alike.

goal.en: Fly the ship into the hangar, get the supplies from Michael Kazakin and deliver them to the remote outpost.

startText.en:
Greetings, comrade!
By the command of Yasker himself, I am authorized to employ available astral ship captains to deliver supplies to the remote outpost, where honest workers are mining valuable meteorite ore.
If you wish to serve for the glory of the Empire and earn some money, simply sail your ship into the hangar and talk to me. I will order the workers to load the supplies into the hold.
When you reach the outpost, report your arrival to Sergey Kirkin, our supplier. He'll accept the cargo and pay for the delivery. While in his office, you can also have some crates of meteorite iron loaded onto your ship. Deliver them here, and I'll pay handsomely for each crate!

checkText.en: I hope that the League fleet did not put up any serious resistance?

finishText.en:
An excellent result! We have deprived the League of their protectorate over one of the Free Traders' allods, and improved our own position... The more astral sails we can make, the more ships we will have, and the better we will be able to strike against the League.
As a reward, take this payment and a Particle of Anomalous Matter, made by our laboratories in the distant Astral - it will definitely come in useful!
And remember, the trade war never stops, not even for a day!

goal.en: Capture any of the trading allods, where necessary depriving the League of its protectorate over it, and inform Nomarkh Hanotep of your victory.

startText.en:
Greetings!
You probably already know that the Empire is increasing its construction of astral ships, and the Free Traders are offering us... or to be more precise, all interested solvent parties, the opportunity to use their trading allods to produce the ethereal thread needed for astral sails...
Our requirements are simple - they should offer this opportunity to us, and to nobody else. And to ensure this we need to establish a "protectorate" over their trade allods. Someone has to protect them from the pirates and robbers of the League, right?
The plan is simple: on the map of astral sectors you can find the target - any neutral allod of the Free Traders, or one under the protectorate of the League. Jump to it and, if the League has already established control there, destroy their astral turret... it is not too dangerous. Then you need to go to the center of the allod and raise the imperial banner there... and that's it! ! And you don't have to do it all on your own - the main thing is to participate in the capture.

checkText.en: How is the etherium transportation progressing?

finishText.en:
Excellent! We will start processing it immediately.
You can acquire the resulting ethereal solution from us and supply it to the manufactory.

goal.en: Buy the raw etherium from Michael Kazakin, deliver it to the trading post and sell it to the Free Traders.

startText.en:
Greetings, comrade!
A large-scale shipbuilding program has been started for our brave astral fleet. And the sail production capacity is no longer sufficient!
The Free Traders, as always, have decided to make money on this by developing new technology for producing the necessary ethereal thread. The first stage of production is to process the etherium.
You can acquire raw etherium from me, and then take it and sell it at any trading post of the Free Traders that support us. For the first cargo of the day you will receive an additional payment - on top of the profit on the difference in price.
Remember three things: first of all, you can only trade with posts that support us, don't expect a warm welcome from League posts. Secondly - prices vary at trading allods, so if you are an experienced trader, look for one where demand for your commodity is higher. And thirdly - by defeating astral demons you can also acquire etherium, which you can sell at the trading post.

checkText.en: Did you get the Anomalous Matter?

finishText.en:
Excellent! Let's proceed to tests!
You can come back tomorrow, if you have liked working with us!

goal.en: Capture and stabilize the Anomalous Matter in the in the anomalous sector, then return the matter to Marat Lisitsin.

startText.en:
A new sector has been recently found in the unexplored astral, where an anomalous matter that can be used as a power source is generating spontaneously! We are extremely interested in obtaining some samples of this matter.
The wormhole leading to the Anomalous Sector opens only once a day just near the home sector. When you get there, use the scanner to find the anomalous matter. You'll recognize it at once, it looks... weird. Capture the matter and hold it on for some time until it stabilizes.
Looks like a piece of cake? Well, the problem is you're not the only soldier of fortune trying to get a reward. Other adventurers from all over the Sarnaut may try to attack you... or take away your anomalous matter. So, be on the alert!

finishText.en: I remember the time when Astral ships could be counted on the fingers of one hand, and people used to respect captains almost as much as they respected Nezeb himself. Today ships gain so much popularity, anyone can become a captain. If you need navigating lessons, you've come to the right place.

goal.en: Talk to Nomarkh Hanotep in the hangar.

startText.en: How did you feel in the astral? This is only beginning. Scary monsters live in distant sectors! The very sight of them will make you tremble. We aren't taking you there, no way. Did you expect our captain to be your ride forever? No way. We'll give you a ship if you don't have one, but you need to steer it yourself. Do you even know how to steer? No problem if you can't. Talk to Nomarkh Hanotep, he'll teach you in a jiff.

checkText.en: Did you defeat that wicked monster?

finishText.en: Great job! Now all the traders can live in security.

goal.en: Defeat Fierce Tempting Predator in the Mysterious Astral and report back to Nastassja Ushkuynikova.

startText.en:
Oh, dear, I could hardly ever imagine that I, the great demon hunter, will have to ask an Imperial devotee for help. But the menace is too serious to fight it alone...

They destroyed many astral ships, and each time you defeat a demon you save someone's lives! To get to a fierce demon tempter, find the Astral Monster Den on the map of the Mysterious Astral and use the Astrolabe. When you get there, use a canner to find the Monster Den and turn the demon to ashes!

checkText.en: Will you take up the delivery job? Simply summon the ship to the hangar and have us load the supplies!

finishText.en: We're glad you're willing to help us! Everyone who was on your ship's crew at the time of loading will be rewarded for delivering the cargo. When you get to the outpost, unload the cargo from the hold and see the supplier for your reward. And remember, even if we don't prepare a caravan, you can buy supplies from us, deliver them to the outposts and sell them for profit.

goal.en: Sail the ship into the hangar, get the supplies from the Baccy Family and deliver them to the remote outpost.

startText.en:
Greetings!
You're not afraid of pirates, are you? We have an errand just for you: a batch of supplies to be delivered to a remote settlement.
If you want to aid our workers and earn a pretty penny, simply sail the ship into the hangar and talk to us. We'll order the workers to load the supplies into the hold.
When you reach the outpost, report your arrival to Tverdoslav Meshkov, our supplier. He'll accept the cargo and pay for the delivery. While in his office, you can also have some crates of meteorite iron loaded on your ship. Deliver them here, and we'll pay you handsomely for every crate!

checkText.en: I hope that the Empire's fleet did not put up any serious resistance?

finishText.en:
A wonderful result! Imperial ambitions have again been curtailed, and we can produce more ethereal thread as a result... The more astral sails we can make, the more ships we will have, and the better we will be able to strike against the Empire.
As a reward, take this payment and a Particle of Anomalous Matter, found by our research ships in a distant astral anomaly - it will definitely come in useful!
And remember, the trade war never stops, not even for a day!

goal.en: Capture any of the trading allods, where necessary depriving the Empire of its protectorate over it, and inform the Glowy Family of your victory.

startText.en:
Greetings!
You have probably already heard that we are expanding construction of astral ships, and the Free Traders are offering us the possibility of using their trade allods to produce ethereal thread needed for astral sails.
Unfortunately, the Empire also knows this and they are already planning to rob us of the opportunity to trade with these allods. Therefore, we should strike first and establish control over trade with these factories... better us than the Empire, right?
The plan is simple: on the map of astral sectors you can find the target - any neutral allod of the Free Traders, or one under the protectorate of the Empire. Jump to it and, if the Empire has already established control there, destroy their astral turret... it is not too dangerous. Then you need to go to the center of the allod and raise the League banner there... and that's it! And you don't have to do it all on your own - the main thing is to participate in the capture.

finishText.en:
Excellent! We will start processing it immediately.
You can acquire the resulting ethereal solution from us and supply it to the manufactory.

A large-scale shipbuilding program has been started for our brave astral fleet. And the sail production capacity is no longer sufficient!
The Free Traders, as always, have decided to make money on this by developing new technology for producing the necessary ethereal thread. The first stage of production is to process the etherium.
You can acquire raw etherium from me, and sell it at any trading post of the Free Traders that support us. For the first cargo of the day you will receive an additional payment.
Remember three things: first of all, you can only trade with the posts that support us, don't expect a warm welcome from the League posts. Second, the prices vary at trading allods, so if you are an experienced trader, look for ones where demand for your commodity is higher. And third, etherium may be also looted from the astral demons.

checkText.en: Did you get the Anomalous Matter?

finishText.en:
Excellent! Let's proceed to tests!
You can come back tomorrow, if you have liked working with us!

goal.en: Capture and stabilize the Anomalous Matter in the in the anomalous sector, then return the matter to Nastassja Ushkuynikova.

startText.en:
A new sector has been recently found in the Mysterious Astral, where an anomalous matter that can be used as a power source is generating spontaneously! We are extremely interested in obtaining some samples of this matter.

The wormhole leading to the Anomalous Sector opens only once a day just near the home sector. We are particularly interested in that sector and the anomalous matter, so it is your chance to improve your reputation with the Demon Hunters!

When you get there, use the scanner to find the anomalous matter. You'll recognize it at once, it looks... weird. Capture the matter and hold it on for some time until it stabilizes.

Looks like a piece of cake? Well, the problem is you're not the only soldier of fortune trying to get a reward. Other adventurers from all over the Sarnaut may try to attack you... or take away your anomalous matter. So, be on the alert!

finishText.en: We remember the time when you could rather see a snowman in Novograd than an Astral ship! People used to respect captains as if they were military generals! It isn't like that anymore. Today even cats know how to navigate ships! Do you want me to teach you?

goal.en: Talk to the Glowy Family in the hangar.

startText.en: How did you like the Astral? Oh, that was just a start! Distant sectors are inhabited by monsters so scary your knees will tremble! But don't go away with the idea that our captain will give you rides forever. No one is going to take you there, steer yourself! We will give you a ship if you don't have any. Can you navigate at all? No? Talk to the Glowy Family, they'll give you a couple of lessons.

checkText.en: A little more bite and a little less bark!

startText.en:
Hey there! You are good at fighting, as long as I recall, want to join us for a dangerous, but profitable business? We’re going to a haunted allod to search for treasure and fight the ghosts. And you have a chance to see the Astral with your eyes!

You’re in? Great. Go straight to the Astral Hangar to Glowy Family. They’ll take care of you.

finishText.en: Here we are. See, the Astral knowledge is not that hard to grasp.

goal.en: Get to the allod on Mercenaries' ship.

startText.en:
Hey there! You are good at fighting, as long as I recall, want to join us for a dangerous, but profitable business? We’re going to a haunted allod to search for treasure and fight the ghosts. And you have a chance to see the Astral with your eyes!

You’re in? Great. Go straight to the Astral Hangar, you’ll be taken care of.

checkText.en: You better watch out when you're out there, in the Astral! It has no pity for the weak!

finishText.en: How was your flight? Did you have good loot? We must have a party now!

goal.en: Visit any allod in the Mysterious Astral.

startText.en:
Congrats, cap! Can't wait to go out to the Astral? Here's my advice for you then.

If you know for sure which sector exactly you want to go to, you don't have to travel all across the Astral. You may simply use an Astrolabe to jump directly there. Gather your friends on board, open your Astral map, switch on the Astrolabe and select a sector. Voila, you're there in one easy hop!

Next, go to the stern to the scanner - it's going to be your most often used device. You'll take your chance to learn all about its functions later. For now, you only need two of them. Oh, and bear in mind that using the scanner takes Astral emanations! If you run out of them, kill two or three demons.

So, you're at the scanner. Press "Scan for Small Allods", and you the allod, if it is in the given sector. Press "Route Tracing" to find a route to the allod, and you'll see a chain of regions, connected with lines of colors. Make sure to remember well the consequence of colors! Now you may return to the steering wheel.

Vortex connect regions. They are marked with one of the three colors: red, blue or green. The link shown on the scanner has the same color as the corresponding vortex. The route is usually put down like "blue-red-green-blue". Make your way from one vortex to another, until you see the allod that you need. Basically, that's all. Fly safely!

checkText.en: This obelisk matches the one near the Gibberlings! It appears to have two small holes in it, as if something is meant to fit inside them...

finishText.en: Placing the artifacts in the obelisk causes a strange glow to emanate from the icy tomb nearby... You should be careful, anything could happen now!

goal.en: Collect the Frosty Artifact and the Frozen Artifact and bring them to the Worn June Obelisk.

startText.en:
It's difficult to make out what's on the stone - it has been severely eroded from the brutal elements. However, you can clearly make out the figure of a hunter battling a winged beast.
Perhaps this marks the path to Yad-Volk's grave! You should follow the trail and collect any other clues along the way. Anything related to the June warrior might come in useful later.

checkText.en: We were known as the Fantastic Four! Yes, we used to be this...

finishText.en: It appears my comrades didn't make it out alive. I'll carry their rings with me in memory of 'em. Thank ya.

goal.en: Discover the fates of Atis, Amis, and Potisa and return to Ivok.

startText.en:
Hey there! Who am I? I'm possibly the last one flyin' from a merchants' expedition that went haywire. There were originally four of us merchants. We heard that this allod contained some rare 'shrooms which sell for a pretty coin on the black market.
My botanist mate and I stayed behind while my three comrades - Atis, Amis, and Potisa - went in search of the fungi gold mine. We heard some terrible screams from way off in the woods while we waited, and I fear the worst has happened...
I just wanna find my friends and get outta here now. This place gives me the creeps. A group of fellow merchants are gonna arrive in a couple hours to take us off the allod. Could ya lend a hand and find what became of my friends before we have to leave?

checkText.en:
Wolf Island could be a great camping site for the moments of rest between my expeditions.
If not for werewolves...

finishText.en:
Have you managed to do it?
There are very few adventurers brave enough to challenge the pack...
I am proud to be your friend!

goal.en: Explore Wolf Island and kill 6 Fierce Werewolves and Vseslav the Charming, the leader of the pack. Then report back to Fedor Stablemanov.

startText.en:
During my travels I try to keep away from the Wolf Island. There is an old legend about this sinister place. It tells about Kanian village that became a feeder for a werewolf.
A long, long time ago Kanian druid Vseslav the Charming became so close to the wolves from the island that he learned how to transform into one. He became their leader, and his neighbors turned his first victim. After a while the whole island had been infested with wolves and werewolves. Unlucky travelers who ventured to the island were eaten by predators. Everyone is trying to avoid it. Who wants to be torn apart by predators or even worse, to be transformed into a werewolf?
If you want to perform a feat, you should go to the Wolf Island. But remember! As you step on the wolves' land, you will be risking your life every second. Think it well before you challenge the pack!

checkText.en:
Wolf Island could be a great camping site for the moments of rest between my expeditions.
If not for werewolves...

finishText.en:
Have you managed to do it?
There are very few adventurers brave enough to challenge the pack...
I am proud to be your friend!

goal.en: Explore Wolf Island and kill 6 Fierce Werewolves and Vseslav the Charming, the leader of the pack. Then report back to Afanasy Nikitov.

A long, long time ago Kanian druid Vseslav the Charming became so close to the wolves from the island that he learned how to transform into one. If you want to perform a feat, you should go to the Wolf Island. But remember! As you step on the wolves' land, you will be risking your life every second. Think it well before you challenge the pack!

checkText.en: I cannot completely trust you until the trolls are destroyed!

finishText.en: I'm glad I was wrong about you. Your service gives my family hope for survival and a new life.

goal.en: Kill 5 Monstrous Trolls and Kirth Foulfoot and return to Tristan de Doucer.

startText.en:
What is it? What do you want? Are you here to accuse my family of involvement with the vampires? Here to slaughter us, perhaps? Or maybe... you're here to help?
You see, we fled Kania to get away from the prejudice. Everyone expects us to be traitors just because we're from the House de Doucer. We seek to start a new life, away from the poison of Armando.
The mains thing that prevents us from achieving absolute solace are the hostile creatures that inhabit this allod. Our mages created a magical barrier, but it's only a matter of time before the trolls shatter our defenses. No matter how much we drive them away, they keep coming back.
The only way to defeat the trolls is to take out their warlord, Kirth Foulfoot. Then and only then will we be able to live in peace. Please kill him and as many trolls as you can!

checkText.en: Forgive my friend Tristan, for he is less trusting of members outside of our family. However, I have high hopes for you. Please do not disappoint my expectations!

finishText.en: Thank you. Today may be a turning point for my family!

goal.en: Kill 12 Mantis Fighters and 12 Mantis Sorcerers and report back to Robert de Doucer.

startText.en:
Welcome, stranger.
In front of you there are weary but hopeful fugitives. Do you know the story of my family? Most of the Elves from the House de Doucer followed Armando. They accepted Tep's gift and became horrible vampires. We, however, rejected that path.
We hope to one day restore the glory of our house. Even your acceptance of us is a good sign. While my relatives may view you with suspicion, deep down they are hoping to gain new allies.
Please help us protect our new home. It would really help if you could kill some of the mantises that inhabit this allod. The Elves from the House de Doucer would be forever grateful.

checkText.en: The survival of my family rests in your hands. You can help or simply give up, dooming us to extinction...

finishText.en: I wasn't wrong about you! I can already feel the evil energy starting to dissipate... My family will forever be grateful!

goal.en: Defeat Sikolo the Cursed and inform Eliott de Doucer of your success.

startText.en:
Hello adventurer. I'm the Great Mage Tristan de Doucer. Yes, I am young and not as strong as the cursed Armando, but I have worked hard so my family can call this allod our home. Almost all of my energy is spent protecting this allod from the onset of the Astral and keeping up our magical shields.
You may be familiar with the mantises and the trolls that trouble us on a daily basis. However, they are nothing compared to the lizardmen that live to the northeast of here. They're led by a horrible undead creature named Sikolo the Cursed.
When we first arrived at the allod, every guard that we sent to scout the northern section never returned. I later ordered a small band of scouts to check out the woods for signs of our fallen comrades. It was then that we discovered the lizardmen's camp.
This creature needs to be destroyed. He is just as evil as Armando himself. I would like to destroy the creature myself but I must use my energy to protect this village at all times. If you want to help us, please seek out Sikolo the Cursed and destroy him!

checkText.en: You can find a picture of Smasher's smiling face on many boxes of smuggled goods in both Nezebgrad and Novograd. That's his little mark, the bastard!

finishText.en: Well done. Thank you for giving them what they deserve!

goal.en: Kill Smasher the Rowdy and report back to David Tamirov.

startText.en:
Why hello! We are honorable Free Traders and we wish you no harm. We came to this allod while searching for the headquarters of a bunch of nasty smugglers. The good news is that we found them. The bad news is that they destroyed our ship and most of our comrades.
Those damn thieves make our lives so difficult! They're constantly ruining our reputation. Can you believe that ordinary people see little difference between us and the smugglers? What an outrage!
We wanted to strike at the heart of their miserable little operation once we found our lair, but it seems that we won't be able to proceed as planned.
Do you think you could help us finish this mission? If you could kill their leader, the rest of the smugglers would be like a flock of lost sheep. Please take out the one named Smasher the Rowdy - the big Orc in the heart of their camp.

checkText.en: Once we capture the meteorite ore the allod will vanish!

finishText.en: Great! This will all be over as soon as our ship arrives. Thanks for your help!

goal.en: Collect 12 pieces of Glowing Meteorite Ore and bring them to the Earthy Family.

startText.en:
You're not a smuggler, right? Good, we didn't think so. You see, in the middle of this allod is some smugglers' camp. We are some mercenaries that the Free Traders hired to help them wipe the smugglers out.
You see, the smugglers cause a lot of trouble for the Free Traders. Their methods lead to unfair prices and unpaid taxes. They're a blight on Sarnaut!
We lost most of our forces in a battle with the smugglers a few days ago, but we haven't given up hope! We were hired to destroy the smugglers and that's what we'll do!
We came up with a little plan and we were hoping you could help us with it. You see, the smugglers don't have a Great Mage here. They keep the allod protected with boxes of meteorite ore. If we take them away, the allod will be destroyed. With their headquarters gone, they'll be crippled!
Go collect as much meteorite ore as possible. After we collect it all, we'll sail away with the band of reinforcements that should soon come for us. Then this job will be complete!

checkText.en: What? You can see me? How is that possible!

finishText.en: Don't kill me! I did nothing wrong!

goal.en: Use the Mental Detector at the Zem ruins to the west to locate Sarang Khamudi.

name.en: To Beat or Not to Beat?

startText.en:
The demons attacked swiftly. They destroyed our communication lines and cut us off from the port. The Astral fangs then destroyed half of our base!
After rallying our forces we were able to repel their attack, and we even began a counterattack! Now our scientists are trying to find a way to rid the allod of the Astral fangs.
There's only one thing that worries me. We believe that one of our scientists is an accomplice of the demons. He's hiding near the ancient Zem ruins to the west, but he used an invisibility spell to cloak himself.
Take this device. It detects brainwaves, and those are things that cannot be hidden. Once you detect his presence, his invisibility spell should fade and you'll be able to apprehend him!

checkText.en: Hurry, every minute you wait brings the demons closer to accessing the information!

finishText.en: Good job! The demons' plans have been completely ruined. Here, take this documents - I sense they could help you in your future travels. I can see into your mind, and I trust that you will keep this information safe.

goal.en: Kill the demons controlling the Stranded Scientists and return to Sarang Khamudi.

startText.en:
I am Sarang Khamudi. I used to be one of the head scientists at this facility. We were researching some of the nearby Zem ruins, but a few days ago an invisible demon attacked me! It tried to take control of my mind.
Oh, they knew not who they had come across! I am a skilled psionicist, you see. I managed to subdue the creature and look into its mind. This revealed the fact that the demons are here for the Empire's top secret information, it's our Tep's inheritage.
Their chief is dead now. The rest of the gang is still as threatening as it was, for they're able to squeeze the information even out of the dead.
I've altered this device to detect the invisible demons that are controlling the dead soldiers. Go to the West of the island. Kill the monsters and return to me once the allod and the secret it is hiding are safe.

finishText.en: He said that everyone was dead, and that demons were penetrating his soul? Poor Feodor seems to have lost his mind... Anyway, we do have some problems that we need help with, but none are that grave, though.

goal.en: Go to the Imperial base on the Hikut Shard and find someone who can explain the situation.

startText.en:
The demons are everywhere, trying to penetrate into my soul! Don't trust anyone, I tell you! Okay? You should leave immediately. There's no one left to save anyway... everyone's dead...
Above all, don't go near those horrible ruins near the Imperial base! That's the source of the evil, okay? You'll just be going to your own doom. Now run, run as fast as you can!

checkText.en: I am fed up with these rattling bones. Their rumbling and crunching distract me...

finishText.en:
So, these walking skeletons are finally put to rest!
You fulfilled my wish, and I'm fulfilling yours. I'm granting you the ticket to the fantasy land!

goal.en: Defeat 36 Bone Warriors and receive your well-earned ticket to the world of fantasy from Professor Mainus.

startText.en:
World of fantasy is delightful and sweet... But you won't get there without my help, hehe.
If you want to plunge into your deepest wishes, you must help me first.
The dead raised from their graves at the cemetery not far from here. They don't bother me much, except for the noise they make with their dry bones. It really drives me crazy!
Put these bone warriors back to their graves, and I'll give you the ticket to the Fantasy.
Be aware of Arisen Enchanters - if they manage to breathe supernatural powers into nearby Bone Warriors, your death is imminent.

checkText.en: You have to earn your ticket to the fantasy world!

finishText.en:
Well, well. Necromancers are below ground, and my devices are working perfectly fine.
You deserved this ticket to the land of fantasy!

goal.en: Kill 5 Arisen Necromancers at the cemetery and return to Professor Mainus.

startText.en:
Damn it! Some magical perturbations cause disorder to my navigational devices. Where are they coming from?
Oh, I know. These Arisen Necromancers are messing around, their pathetic sorcery is like a grain of sand in my fragile mechanism. So disgusting!
Do you want to travel to the fantasy world? Grind to dust five Arisen Necromancers, and I will help you.
Although necromancers look like easy targets, skeleton crowds they raise may become a serious trouble. Be careful!

checkText.en: Well, do you want to travel to the fantasy land? You will have to work hard then.

finishText.en: What a disgusting smell! You stink like rot and damp. I believe you have completed my request. Now you can safely travel to the fantasy world!

goal.en: Defeat 15 Drowned Corpses and return to Professor Mainus.

startText.en:
One must find their own way to the fantasy world. For a child, it would be a wide road paved with yellow bricks, while the adult would have to travel over a narrow path across a deadly swamp.
I will help you to find your dreams, for a price of course.
You must dispose of 20 Drowned Corpses. These vile creatures are poisoning the water in the stream.
Remember that the corpses still have some remnants of mind. If you kill one of them, it will enrage the others.

checkText.en: Nightmares destroy fantasies... and your aim is to destroy the nightmares!

finishText.en: Phew... Now I can sleep well and you can safely travel to the fantasy world.

goal.en: Defeat 5 Nightmare Shadows and return to Professor Lextor.

startText.en:
Do you want to travel to the fantasy world? It's easy! Just close your eyes, forget your useless thoughts and set your imagination loose!
Did it work? No? I knew it.
You see, in the world of adults, there is a huge problem with fantasizing! All life is scheduled in advance... there is little time for imagination.
But I'm an expert in the field of fantasy. And if I can't awaken your imagination, nobody can.
Of course, my help will cost you something. Nightmare Shadows settled in the old ruins to the west are the reason why you are waking up in the middle of the night. And not you alone...
Kill five of these creatures, and nothing will stand between you and the fantasy world.

checkText.en: Fantasy awaits you, my friend!

finishText.en:
You are nobody's fool! Who else would risk their life battling the vile undead for the sake of fantasies?
The fantasy world is open for you!

goal.en: Defeat 8 Arisen Enchanters and 8 Cursed Warriors, then return to Professor Lextor.

startText.en:
Fantasy... Fantasy makes this world so amazing. Without imagination, we are all doomed to stagnate.
Today you have a chance to travel to the wonderful world of fantasy! Help me to deal with the undead settled in the ruins to the west, defeat 8 Arisen Enchanters and 8 Cursed Warriors, and I will show you the way to this beautiful world!

checkText.en: Nightmares inhabiting this island prevent me from catching the... Nevermind. They just annoy me.

finishText.en:
Well done! They will forget the way here for good.
You deserved the ticket to your innermost fantasy!

goal.en: Kill 4 Harbingers of Nightmares and return to Professor Lextor.

startText.en:
Wait, wait... I'm busy!
What's there? Do you want to travel to the world of living fantasy? Aren't you afraid? Playing with imagination may be dangerous... I can help you, but you must pass my test first.
Harbingers of Nightmares, nasty creatures settled in the ruins to the west, are chasing the dreamers, hovering around them and forcing them to scream in their sleep. They can even bewitch some of the sleepers, stealing their minds and subduing their will. They will easily sacrifice lives of their minions in case of a danger, increasing their own strength.
Can you imagine what a dangerous enemy you are going to fight? Kill four Harbingers of Nightmares, and I will show you the way to the fantasy.

checkText.en: The nature of this curse is very interesting... But this is a topic for a scientific paper, not a hasty conversation.

finishText.en:
Have you put the soldiers to rest? Excellent!
Do you still want to go to the fantasy land? Then what are we waiting for? Let's go!

goal.en: Defeat 5 Cursed Soldiers and return to Professor Yvish.

startText.en:
I bet you are dreaming of a long life and valorous death in the end, like all heroes? Worthy fantasies.
The soldiers who died here long ago were dreaming of that, too. But their dreams never fulfilled. They turned into terrifying zombies, now wandering to the northwest from here.
Give rest to the souls of five Cursed Soldiers, fulfill their dreams of peace, and I will send you to the fantasy land.

checkText.en: This forest is terrifying... I would never risk my life going there.

finishText.en: You are not easily frightened! The fantasy awaits you, my friend. Let's go!

goal.en: Kill 3 Twilight Shadows and return to Professor Yvish.

startText.en:
Have you ever been to the Dead Wood? Aura of despair surrounds the piles of bones and dried trees... Twilight Shadows hiding there bring dead melancholy to a traveler foolish enough to step into this dark place.
Dispose of five shadows to make the wood a safer place! The shadows are not visible to the naked eye, but I will teach you a spell allowing to uncover them in the gloom. If you help me, I'll send you to the very innermost of your fantasies!

checkText.en: I'm checking my ration - hopefully it's not rotten...

finishText.en:
Already done? You know, I believe you. Your part is complete, now it's my turn.
Welcome to the land of fantasy!

goal.en: Defeat 8 Rotting Corpses and return to Professor Yvish.

startText.en:
Dead Wood was once a green and peaceful forest, but some evil force infected it with a terrible curse. Not only it turned the trees to rot... The unfortunate travelers who die in the Dead Wood are raised as zombies, spreading the infection further...
Listen, if you want to travel to the fantasy land, I will need your help. Defeat five Rotting Corpses, and the way to the fantasy will be open.

checkText.en: Oh, I do not like it!

finishText.en: I am grateful to you for destroying another lair of Tep's followers!

goal.en: Save Kir Buran, stop construction in the Mechanoids' Lair and report to Alice Bullicheva.

startText.en:
Thank you for saving me! If I would have been captured, I wouldn't be able to save captain Kir!
I wonder where they're holding him. And what's going on in this island? I'm sure Buran was able to find out something. Please, help me rescue him!

checkText.en: As soon as you deactivate the protection system, you will be able either to destroy it or start Genesis. This will be your own choice. I have no rational reason to let you go.

finishText.en: Was it what you call mercy? You don't seem to have had any rational reason for such a decision. Go now. The Integral must make some calulations to comprehend what has just happened.

goal.en: Start Genesis and talk to the Integral.

startText.en: The Priests call me heretic. This is a mistake, it's them who are heretics. We are Tep's servants who have failed. We didn't want war. We escaped to build our own world of mechanisms, without necromancy or Nihil. The Priests came with us and helped us with the phase one: building the Integral. I was to take care of the phase two, the Genesis, that would have given birth to the godly supercreation. System error. Process was interrupted. They locked me in here. Now they control the Integral and my brothers' machinery. All they need is power. Uninstall priests. Initiate Genesis. The machines never forget the good.

checkText.en: How is the ethereal thread transportation progressing?

finishText.en:
Wonderful, now we can reach our astral sail production targets, and consequently - out shipbuilding targets too!
Remember, you can transport as much freight as you wish - we have a lot of work ahead of us.

goal.en: Buy ethereal thread and bring it to Michael Kazakin in the home allod.

startText.en:
Greetings! Here, in the factory, work is winding up - ethereal thread is being made from ethereal crystals.
This can then be used to make sails for astral ships at the wharves of large allods. If you want to earn some money, you can by the thread from me and deliver it to Michael Kazakin.

checkText.en: How is the ethereal thread transportation progressing?

finishText.en:
Wonderful, now we can reach our astral sail production targets, and consequently - out shipbuilding targets too!
Remember, you can transport as much freight as you wish - we have a lot of work ahead of us.

goal.en: Buy ethereal thread and bring it to the Baccy Family in the home allod.

startText.en:
Greetings! Here, in the factory, work is winding up - ethereal thread is being made from ethereal crystals.
This can then be used to make sails for astral ships at the wharves of large allods. If you want to earn some money, you can by the thread from me and deliver it to the Baccy Family.

checkText.en: How is the ethereal solution transportation progressing?

finishText.en:
Excellent! We will start to make ethereal crystals immediately.
These can be delivered and sold to the factory.

goal.en: Buy the ethereal solution and bring it to the Free Traders' manufactory.

startText.en:
Greetings! At our trading post we produce ethereal solution from all its primary forms, from pure etherium received from astral demons, to raw etherium collected from the astral traps in the home allod.
We produce and store the ethereal solution, which will have to be transported to the factory to be processed further.
Will you do it? For the first consignment there will be an additional payment! And, of course, try to bring the cargo to wherever the demand is greatest... and where you will not encounter enemies.

checkText.en: How is the ethereal crystal transportation progressing?

finishText.en:
Excellent! We will immediately start to produce ethereal thread.
They are happy to buy it in the home allod - they use it to make sails for astral ships!

goal.en: Buy the ethereal crystals and bring them to the Free Traders' factory.

startText.en:
Captain! Welcome to the factory! Here we grow ethereal crystals out of etherium solution. That’s a big seller! I am looking for a reliable captain who could take these crystals and deliver them to a crystal thread factory.
Will you do this? I will pay some extra for the first delivery! Choose those factories where they won’t fire at you - the League and the Empire keep fighting over them, and sometimes you can see blue flags waving over factories in the morning, and red ones in the evening... But as long as we get paid, I don’t care who we work for!

finishText.en:
Now you may return to the saved class at any time. Just talk to one of us to do so.

If you ever change your mind, you can always purchase the Memory Stamp.

goal.en: Talk to your class trainer

startText.en:
There were big changes for those who like to try various roles.

For instance, the Impression is no longer needed! The class trainer may now restore your memory and return the lost soul to the right path.

Talk to your class trainer to learn more.

finishText.en:
The Children of Sarn are great warriors. Like Sarn himself who protected the All-Mother from all threats!

My people have a lot to learn from people like you.

And we have something to teach you.

Here - take a look!

goal.en:
Fight in the Battle for Ambrosia, participate in capturing a Source, and kill 5 enemies.

Report to Waterlily afterwards.

startText.en:
Child of Sarn, I'm beginning to trust you. You have proven that you are truly on our side.

When the forest first met you, it began to defend itself. Thorns rose from the ground, poisonous spores filled the air. The forest rejected you like parasites.

If you want to be a part of it, go ahead and show that you are a new thorn. Deadly and strong.

finishText.en:
You can learn about other types of traps from me.

Now I want you to learn how to deal with poison spitters.

goal.en: Fight in the Battle for Ambrosia and trap three opponents.

startText.en:
Child of Sarn, the forces of the Expedition are heavily armed, but we have something we can use against them.

The forest has accepted you. Now you need to learn how to use the enemy's power against them.

Tenacious roots, poisonous spores, and deadly thorns are the natural defenses of Eden. Now you can call on some of that power to help you.

Use traps against enemies.

finishText.en:
Sarnaut's technology has proven its worth in this world. But we still have something to surprise those who are trying to resist us.

If you want to win, you must study military science.  I will help you.

Take a look at what we have in our arsenal.

goal.en: Fight in the Battle for Ambrosia; participate in capturing a Source and killing 5 enemies. Report to Yasskul Addaya afterwards.

startText.en:
I'm glad you're on our side! It's time to punch these natives so they know they can't stop us from getting what we want.

Now the real fight begins. And as you already know, some of our "heroes" turned out to be traitors and defected to the side of the All-Mother. There is nothing worse than traitors. The Children are at least honest. And traitors deserve only one response!

While you're doing this combat mission, teach them what patriotism means. Maybe they will come to their senses.

finishText.en:
Not bad. I recommend mastering the Deathtrap as soon as possible.

 In addition, I give you clearance to use the turrets. A powerful thing. Try it, and you will thank our engineers.

goal.en: Fight in the Battle for Ambrosia and trap three opponents.

startText.en:
These Children have some curious means of warfare, but we have our own answer to that.

Sarnaut has been at war for thousands of years, and we have strategies our enemies can't even imagine.

All is fair in war. Use traps. Learn new ones. And look around carefully - the natives are also preparing unpleasant surprises for us.

finishText.en: The outcome of this war depends on your actions. The more Ambrosia the enemy gets, the stronger they become.

goal.en: Ask Rhubarb about the battles in the Ambrosia Valley.

startText.en:
Before you is the great Ambrosia Valley, the very heart of our home. It is guarded by the mighty guardian of the forest - Cypress, and we strive to provide him with support.

The power of our All-Mother flows freely in places of power, and they can be controlled.

If the Valley falls, the Great Tree is doomed. We can't let it happen!

You want to know how we plan to protect it? Ask me.

finishText.en: The outcome of this war depends on your actions. The more Ambrosia we get, the sooner we win the day.

goal.en: Ask Felix about the battles in the Ambrosia Valley.

startText.en:
Before you is the so-called Ambrosia Valley, the very heart of our enemy's domain. It's guarded by a strong Treant, Cypress. We need to destroy this creature.

The power of this goddess, the All-Mother, flows freely in places of power, and they can be controlled.

If the Valley falls, then the Children will have no choice but to recognize our victory. So do everything you can.

You want to know our plan of attack? Ask me.

finishText.en:
The flowers in the Valley will be thoroughly fertilized.

Here is your reward, outlander.

startText.en:
We have to do something. And we will!

I told you the aliens can't be trusted. At least the ones left at this base.

Darkness has long swallowed their souls, and there's only one thing we can do...

The valley will not rest while the children of Sarn are here.

Go and drive them away.

finishText.en:
Good. We will be consistent and persistent, and we will get what Sarnaut needs to survive.

Here's your pay.

goal.en: Fight in the Battle for Ambrosia, earn at least 500 points, and participate in killing at least 5 enemies.

startText.en:
We have to do something. And we will!

I told you the savages can't be trusted.

But you decided to befriend them. And look what happened!

We're not leaving here until we get the Ambrosia. We have no right to let our homeland down.

Go to the valley and force the natives to give us the source.

checkText.en: You need to understand the nature of the cycle...

finishText.en:
So you've learned your first lesson. Elemental powers are everywhere, and they are extremely important. In your destroyed world, seasons barely change, but in those worlds that were properly created, they always do.

Perhaps eventually you will meet my Children, the masters of the elements. Each of them has its own world, and each has many followers endowed with the same powers. There are similar entities in your world.

goal.en: Learn the cycle of elements in combat.

startText.en:
I assume you already know about the existence of elemental entities such as fire, water, air, earth...

These are the building blocks of the universe, the foundation of all worlds. They manifest themselves in everything that's burning, flowing, blowing, and in solid things... Warm, cold, wet and dry...

Finally, in winter, spring, summer, and fall.

The cycle is endless because it has no beginning and no end.  See for yourself.

checkText.en: You need to understand the nature of the cycle...

finishText.en: You have learned this lesson. To understand the true meaning of my words, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.

goal.en: Learn the cycle of elements in combat at the roots of the Great Tree

startText.en:
I want you to repeat my lesson.

You already know about the existence of elemental entities such as fire, water, air, earth...

These are the building blocks of the universe, the foundation of all worlds. They manifest themselves in everything that's burning, flowing, blowing, and in solid things... Warm, cold, wet and dry...

Finally, in winter, spring, summer, and fall.

The cycle is endless because it has no beginning and no end.  See for yourself.

Go and learn this lesson again!

checkText.en: Do you understand the essence of the Circle of Life?

finishText.en: As you can see, death is part of the cycle, just like life. Without death there is no life, so universal immortality would become the final death of all living things. I hope you can remember this simple truth.

goal.en: Understand the circle of life by going through the plant, herbivore, and carnivore stages.

startText.en:
Everything you see is interconnected and balanced. Everything serves what was before and what comes after. Everything is necessary.

Grass grows in a clearing, Strantlers eat it, Strantlers fall prey to predators, and when they die, they themselves become grass.

Everything is interconnected. You will learn this lesson.

checkText.en: Do you understand the essence of the Circle of Life?

finishText.en: You have learned this lesson. To understand the true meaning of my words, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.

goal.en: Understand the circle of life at the roots of the Great Tree by going through the plant, herbivore, and carnivore stages.

startText.en:
I want you to repeat my lesson.

Everything you see is interconnected and balanced. Everything serves what was before and what comes after. Everything is necessary.

Grass grows in a clearing, Strantlers eat it, Strantlers fall prey to predators, and when they die, they themselves become grass.

Everything is interconnected. Death is part of the cycle, just like life. Without death there is no life, so universal immortality would become the final death of all living things.

Go and learn this lesson again!

checkText.en: What are they talking about?

finishText.en: Well, a lot of things are starting to make sense now. It's a unique culture that has no match anywhere in Sarnaut. But at the same time, I understand that their way of life is contrary to the goals pursued by Felix and Catherina. I wonder if we can still come to an understanding?
