goal.en: Ask the Children about their legends and traditions.

startText.en:
Listen, I have a suggestion for you - we ended up here in a completely new world, and I think the best way to negotiate with its inhabitants is to understand how they live.

I suggest you interview them and see what they have to say about their culture. I'm sure that if we know more about them, we'll be able to find common ground with them.

You should speak with the Children with different occupations. So your observations will be more complete. Trust me, I'm an experienced spy and scout.

checkText.en: Let's see!

finishText.en: Wow, you are strong, can't argue with that. Alright, they seem to be good guys. I'm starting to understand them: we came here uninvited and made a mess. Yes, but how can we explain this to our people?

goal.en: Fight the Children to see who is stronger.

startText.en:
Talking about it won't get us anywhere.

Do you know what my first goblinball coach told me? "If you want to understand someone, punch them in the face!"

These Children are big guys, but we've dealt with worse. Maybe you'll fight them? Then make up.

No, I'm serious. We need to understand what they are about. I suggest we challenge those who consider themselves warriors.  Choose someone strong. The girl who dragged us here looks like a twig.

checkText.en: How is the training going?

finishText.en: As you can see, my people are adapting quickly. We grow thorns and claws, and soon the hour will come when Eden will get rid of the arrogant aliens stealing the ambrosia!

goal.en: Fight the warriors of the Children on the branches of the Great Tree

startText.en:
Your world has known many wars, but Eden was a peaceful place before you arrived. That is why there are almost no warriors like you among us. However, thanks to the wisdom of the All-Mother, we are learning quickly, and I think we will soon be able to fight back against the invaders.

Of course, this requires training, and warriors have already begun training hunters from our tribes. But the Rhubarb's warriors have much to learn from you. So I ask you to give them a few more lessons.

checkText.en: As we grow, we only get stronger. It is in my power to give them thorns, and it is in your power to teach them how to use them.

finishText.en: Yes, my Children grow stronger every day. Their bark will not be pierced by machine blades, and their sap will poison anyone who encroaches on Eden. To better understand my lesson, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.

goal.en: Fight the warriors of the Children on the branches of the Great Tree

startText.en:
Child of another world, you were molded by a different culture, and I still can't understand what Sarn expected from you.

However, you must not disparage the warriors of Eden, because from the moment you arrived in our world, they have been constantly growing and changing. This is my gift to them, and now all of Eden must become stronger.

You can help me. I think we could learn a lot from each other.

Three of our strongest warriors are impressed by your abilities. They are ready to challenge you again!

If you ready to accept the challenge, go fight them in a training duel!

checkText.en: Well, what are you waiting for?

finishText.en:
Excellent. I guess you can be trusted. Each fruit is precious, because no one knows who will become a new Great Tree.

We believe that our Sparks, and the Sparks of everyone who got to Eden, are reborn in new Children, but only our Creator knows whether this is true.

goal.en: Help Caraway collect the fruits of the Great Tree and deal with Chamomile's problem.

startText.en:
It used to be easier to take care of fruits. Now... the animals are more aggressive, and you, invaders, are not making our lives any easier. I hope we manage to keep all the new Children.

We need all the help we can get, and we'd like to get things done faster. If the All-Mother trusts you, then so do I.

I'll ask a favor of you - Caraway is in charge of collecting fruits east of the Great Tree, but he still hasn't returned. Find him and provide help if he needs it.

checkText.en: You need to collect the fruits as quickly as possible!

finishText.en: Thank you for your help. I see Waterlily was right to vouch for you. I'll have another task for you tomorrow, be sure to come back and talk to me.

goal.en: Help Caraway collect the fruits of the Great Tree at the Blossoming Riverbed

name.en: Gifts of Nature: Fruits of the Great Tree

startText.en:
Greetings. May my Blessing be with you!

My Children's lives used to be simple, but now... we're facing a lot of problems, and I want to ask you for help.

I'm talking about collecting the fruits of the Great Tree. I've been told that you have helped our fruit pickers and keepers, so I will ask you to do it again today.

Caraway is in charge of picking fruit, you can find him to the east from the Great Tree. Find him and provide help if he needs it.

checkText.en: You should hurry...

finishText.en: Excellent. It looks like you can be trusted... I also think it's kind of stupid to judge everyone by the actions of one. In your case, that means you shouldn't be judged by the actions of this... Expedition.

goal.en: Harvest Ripe Ambrosia Blossoms and Hungry Strantler Sap at Blossoming Riverbed.

startText.en:
I have a job for you. Will you help us?

The thing is, we've been having problems because of your Expedition. There are other reasons, too.

Animals started migrating, which means there are too many of them in one place, and too few in another.

And now Ambrosia is ready to be harvested at Blossoming Riverbed near the roots of the Great Tree.

Alas, the frightened Strantlers moved closer to the Great Tree, and now all blossoms are at risk.

We need to harvest them before the animals eat them. And hunt for the Strantlers while you're at it so we have something other than the fruits. It would also scare them away from our lands. They should go back to the forest.

checkText.en: If we want to restore balance sooner, we must act now.

finishText.en: Darkness is trying to bring confusion into this world, but these attempts are in vain. Life will always find a way. To better understand my lesson, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.

goal.en: Harvest Ripe Ambrosia Blossoms at Blossoming Riverbed

startText.en:
You know that animals started migrating, which means there are too many of them in one place, and too few in another.

And now Ambrosia is ready to be harvested at Blossoming Riverbed near the roots of the Great Tree. But scared Strantlers are all over the place now. The blossoms are in danger.

We need to harvest them before the animals eat them.

checkText.en: This is terrible...

finishText.en:
Those poor things! These unfortunate creatures are looking for salvation in the healing water, but it's not helping...

But why? Is there nothing we can do to help them? I'll look for answers in the forest where they came from. Perhaps I'll find the source of their sickness.

Help Reed for now - I'll be back later.

goal.en: Send the hostile Windrunners to the beginning of the cycle.

startText.en:
Rhubarb is right, the Windrunners get more and more aggressive every day! They have moved closer to the Great Tree and chased the Strantlers here - those creatures are devouring the flowers now... As you can see... At this rate, every single animal and plant in our forest will be driven from their homes.

We need to do something about the Windrunners now. They are more dangerous than scared herbivores. Most importantly, we need to figure out what's causing them to behave that way...

checkText.en: Everyone has their place and their boundaries which should not be crossed.

finishText.en: Alas, sometimes there is no other way out. Death is part of the cycle, just like life. To better understand my lesson, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.

goal.en: Send the hostile Windrunners to the beginning of the cycle in the Strantler Meadow

startText.en:
Unfortunately, the Windrunners get more and more aggressive every day. They have moved closer to the Great Tree and chased the Strantlers here. At this rate, every single animal and plant in our forest will be driven from their homes.

We need to do something about the Windrunners. They are more dangerous than scared herbivores. I ask you to deal with them, since they left the area they were supposed to stay in. We have no choice but to exterminate them, sending them back to the beginning of the cycle!

finishText.en: There are more and more of them... Who? Just look down!

goal.en: Meet with Waterlily to the east of the Great Tree and go to the forest.

startText.en:
What's going on in our forests? I keep getting news of new problems. I'm sure the reason is you. Or rather, this Expedition of yours... Before you appeared in our world, we'd lived in harmony with all the creatures that dwell here...

Now the animals are anxious... You managed to deal with the Strantlers, but what about the Windrunners? They are much more dangerous.

Go with Waterlily there and decide what to do.

checkText.en: We can't begin the hunt without the sap of these plants.

finishText.en: Meet Clover and Mint. They will help us hunt.

goal.en: Gather plants for the special potion for your hunt.

startText.en:
Great and mighty is the Treebor, the strongest creature in our forest... Even the Windrunners and Swearwolves are scared of it. It wanders the forest like its own domain...

The only way to deal with it is to work together with several hunters.

Before each of our hunts, we perform special rituals, asking for the All-Mother's blessing. The Treebor is her creation, after all...

We need special leaves so we can brew a potion for the ritual. I suppose it's nothing unusual for you - just collect the leaves, and I will do the rest.

checkText.en: Let the great hunt begin!

finishText.en: Great, thank you for the leaves. It will be a glorious hunt...

goal.en: Gather plants for the rituals in the Strantler Meadow

startText.en:
There are many similarities between war and hunting. Therefore, we will follow our traditions, but we will need your help to prepare. Have you ever collected leaves in the Strantler Meadow?

You will need to repeat this simple task again. After brewing a special potion, our hunters will be ready to hunt this unusual prey! And may the All-Mother punish these aliens!

checkText.en: They can't begin the hunt without the sap of these plants.

finishText.en: The gods don't need rituals, but believers do. To better understand my lesson, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.

goal.en: Gather plants for the hunters' rituals in the Strantler Meadow

startText.en:
Before every hunt, my Children perform special rituals, asking for my blessing. I think you can give them the help they need.

They need special leaves to brew a potion for the ritual. I suppose it's nothing unusual for you - just collect the leaves, and they will do the rest.

checkText.en: We should start...

finishText.en:
I saw the fight. It was a great hunt. Now you know the Treebor's strength, and it knows yours. All its brethren in the valley will recognize you and your allies. We learn quickly, Child of Sarn. Thank you for this lesson.

Now listen - this is what I've learned...

goal.en: With the help of Reed and Mint, obtain the Treebor's sap in battle, then defeat it.

startText.en:
Look, that's one of the strongest creatures in the forest down there.

A magnificent and dangerous creature - its beauty is in its might. The Treebors are the biggest inhabitants of our forests. Only the Tree Herders come close.

In this fight, you will know the Treebor's strength, and it will know yours. The Treebor will grant us its strength and rage, and you will take that from it.

I'll tell you how to do it.

checkText.en: Something happened in our forests...

finishText.en: Who are they...?

goal.en: Defeat Hirkalla with her minions and close the portal.

startText.en:
I'm afraid it happened... It's the Old Tribe! They reached our Valley...

I... I can't believe they are here. How could the All-Mother let it happen?

Some time ago, one of the tribes nearby perished. Their Tree was too old to bear fruit, and the Children of that tribe were born sick and weak. Which meant their Tree would die soon.

But they refused to accept their fate! Rejected the laws of the All-Mother... And now... they are here.

They are doing something... wrong... Twisted.

It has never happened before in our world!

We need to stop them!

checkText.en: The time of the Old Tribe has passed.

finishText.en: Darkness has no place in the World of Life, and you have proven that... Sooner or later, we will defeat Hirkalla.

goal.en: Kill the members of the Old Tribe in the Twisted Ravine

startText.en:
I've already heard the story of Hirkalla and how she tried to turn the Old Tribe against the All-Mother! A foolish attempt, but the darkness still poses a threat to this valley.

If the defenders leave to fight the Expedition, the Old Tribe may attack again. Which is why we need to prevent that and crush their forces near the Great Tree.

Go to the Twisted Ravine and deal with them.

checkText.en: Something happened in our forests...

finishText.en: The Old Children decided to call upon the forces of Darkness. You proved that the Darkness can't help anyone. To better understand my lesson, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.

goal.en: Kill the members of the Old Tribe in the Twisted Ravine

startText.en:
Some time ago, one of the tribes that lived near the Great Tree perished. Their Tree was too old to bear fruit, and the Children of that tribe were born sick and weak. Which meant their Tree would die soon. Alas, their fear of death was too strong. They fought against their fate and rejected my laws.

Now these mad creatures attack our part of the forest, steal our Ambrosia, and hurt my other Children. We must stop them and remind them that immortality does not exist.

checkText.en: Hurry! The All-Mother must know!

finishText.en: I see my lessons did you some good. Don't worry about the Darkness, it's deceptive... Follow the path I have shown you, and you will see what caused this.

goal.en: Tell the All-Mother what happened.

startText.en:
These creatures... They are not from this world! But they are different from you, too...

It can't be... Unbelievable...

They are... Nihaz's servants! They are here, in Eden! How did they find our world?!

This goddess... Hirkalla. Darkness incarnate! I can't believe it... So it wasn't the Old Tribe's decision to turn against the All-Mother. Hirkalla incited them!

This changes everything. You need to tell the All-Mother and show her this... piece of rot. We are helpless against this evil, but I'm sure she'll think of a way! Hurry. We'll stay here in case they come back.

checkText.en: Catherina does not like waiting...

finishText.en:
I suspect she is one of the sorceresses that started drinking dragon blood to become immortal?

Oh, Children of Sarn, you are such... children. You have no idea what transpires outside your world, but your self-importance is boundless.

Catherina does not need my lessons, but her pride will do her an ill turn.

goal.en: Talk to Catherina

startText.en:
Those who sent you here must be worried about you. Do not keep them waiting.

I make no secret of what you have learned here. Tell them everything - perhaps they will make the right choice? I can only hope they will.

checkText.en: Have you found all the flowers?

finishText.en: Now you know the truth...

goal.en: Find ten flowers with memories of the Great War.

startText.en:
I know that Nihaz told you a lot about the Great War, but there are things he kept from you. If you want to know how it happened, you will have to go back to the very beginning. Why were Sarn and Nihaz fighting? How did my daughter end up in Sarnaut? How did everything around us come to be?

I transferred everything to the memory of my Trees, and to this Great Tree. Its roots are deep, and from time to time a flower sprouts on it, bearing images of the past. I don't want to tell you everything at once. You will go on a journey through my forest, and you will find these flowers. You will learn what happened. You will hear the whole truth about what happened.

checkText.en: Deal with this.

finishText.en: Wonderful. These cute creatures will no longer interfere with my work.

goal.en: Eliminate the Strantlers that settled at the base.

startText.en:
What's up with this base? Where is the security, where is the staff?

It's a nightmare... And these deer roam everywhere...

You know, we deliberately set up a second base a little further from the Gates, so it would be more quiet here. At first it was like that... however, the war has clearly reached this place, too.

You need to figure out what happened and where everyone is... But first, get rid of these pests, I don't want them to break anything. Perhaps we can restore something.

checkText.en: Deal with this.

finishText.en: Great job! Now you need to make sure these stupid deer remember the lesson! Perhaps tomorrow we will repeat what we did today!

goal.en: Eliminate the Strantlers in the Green Pigweed

startText.en:
For the Penelope base to continue its work, we need to get rid of the creatures that are wandering around the place. The Strantlers in particular - those impudent hoofed creatures, stupid and stubborn.

Apparently our buildings are in their way, I can't find any other explanation for why they keep coming back.

Either way, you need to reduce their population before they damage our equipment. Regrets would be unwarranted here - if they don't understand why they should stay away, we will make it clear to them! Get to work!

checkText.en: Local deer are beasts if they did that to our machines. Or the machines weren't that great to begin with.

finishText.en: Wonderful. Though the quiet of the forest was better than this clanging.

goal.en: Repair the Mechanoid sentries around the base.

startText.en:
"Penelope" is named after the first victim of this world who died from the fangs and thorns of the local flora and fauna.

But I doubt this victim will be the last. It is important for us to avoid irretrievable losses. So our main fighting force is the Mechanoids based on the Xadaganian schematics. Cheap and easy to produce. It would be worse to lose my knights.

These combat Mechanoids are well-armed, I wonder what could go wrong?

It looks like the forest won the battle here - there are a lot of broken sentries around the base. First of all, they need to be repaired so they can continue to keep order.

Fortunately, their modular construction makes it easy to replace faulty parts as long as you have spares.

checkText.en: Losses mean extra expenses.

finishText.en: Wonderful! We repaired our equipment and saved our resources. We can even give bonuses to the staff!

goal.en: Repair the Mechanoid sentries at the Penelope base

startText.en:
Our combat bases are guarded by the Mechanoids based on Xadaganian schematics. They are cheap and easy to produce, but we don't have an infinite supply of them. So it would be nice if you could repair them.

It's easy to do. Their modular construction makes it easy to replace faulty parts as long as you have spares.

I ask you to go there and repair as many Mechanoids as you can.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Well, we've learned some things, but it's still hard to say where they are.

goal.en: Read the remaining reports at the base and complete the tasks indicated in them.

startText.en:
We need to figure out why there's no one here.

I don't think people disappeared completely without a trace, but to reconstruct the course of events, you need to understand what happened here recently.

Herbert and Elena had to do certain research, which means they had to keep records. Find them and read them. It should help us figure out where to look for the missing members of the Expedition.

checkText.en: I understand, but we need it. For science.

finishText.en:
Wonderful!

I will analyze it and try to find a remedy for this allergy. I don't need runny noses around here. One of the Zharova sisters, Beliana, was always sniffling when flowers were blooming on Umoir. Trust me, it's the most annoying sound.

goal.en: Pick poisonous mushrooms.

startText.en: It looks like Herbert wanted to collect pollen samples before everyone on the base died of allergies. If we want to avoid that, you need to collect spore samples and take them to Catherina before it's too late.

checkText.en: I understand, but we need it. For science.

finishText.en: Wonderful! One of the main properties of the local plants and animals is that tomorrow they will be completely different. So I might need new samples tomorrow.

goal.en: Pick poisonous mushrooms in the Green Pigweed

startText.en:
If we want to understand this world, we need to continue studying it. Despite your contacts with the Children and the All-Mother, the local fauna and flora still continue to give us trouble.

What's bad is that they change very quickly. It means we need to keep developing new antidotes for local toxins and antiallergic drugs.

For that, I need samples. Right now I need samples of mushrooms. Gather some for me.

checkText.en: That's not a bad idea. The fewer beasts, the better.

finishText.en:
Elena was right. These creatures breed like rabbits.

I wouldn't want one of them to break in in the middle of the night, completely wrecking the place. And I'd happily burn down the weeds with my own hands.

Since you've already figured it out, I'd better get down to more intellectually challenging work.

goal.en: Eliminate Sunchews and Stumpers near the base.

startText.en: It looks like Elena wants to eliminate animals near the Penelope base. We should address this issue if we want to keep using the base, otherwise even the Strantlers' invasion will seem like a walk in the park. We must eliminate some of the creatures.

checkText.en: The fewer of those creatures, the better.

finishText.en: I believe the local animals have been breeding faster than ever since your arrival at Eden. Felix suggests eliminating them before they eliminate us!

goal.en: Eliminate the Stumpers in the Green Pigweed

startText.en:
Stumpers are perhaps the most dangerous creatures on Eden. They're strong and almost invulnerable to our firearms. With their population as big as it is now, we can't feel safe in this world. We need to reduce their numbers.

Why don't you take care of it? I'll show you where our scouts found the greatest number of these creatures.

Kill as many as you can! No pity! Stumpers will surely show none to us!

checkText.en: Try to survive, for the sake of Tensess!

finishText.en:
I've read the report. They might be right. Therefore, if we want to win this battle once and for all, we have to destroy the mighty Great Tree. I hope we can avoid this. For now, let's stick to the traditional methods and see if they work.

Hand over the thorns. I need to do some research. Perhaps, we can find something that can resist them and make mechanoids' armor impervious to them.

goal.en: Collect new thorn samples from under your feet.

startText.en: The thorns that pop out from the ground might be part of the Great Tree's root system. Apparently Herbert and Elena need to study them for their work on the Tree's defensive mutations. Collect fresh thorns to see how they transform over time.

checkText.en: Try to survive, for the sake of Tensess!

finishText.en: Wonderful! Extreme changeability is one of the main features of local plants animals. They evolve by the day. That's why I might need more samples tomorrow.

goal.en: Collect new thorn samples in the Green Pigweed when they appear under your feet.

startText.en:
I'd like to study new underground thorns that might be part of the Great Tree's root system. We need to understand how each part of the local symbiosis works with the rest of the system. This is the only way to confront dangers of this world.

I need fresh thorn samples to see how they transformed since the last time.

checkText.en: What are you and the orc plotting?

finishText.en: Green aliens? If I hadn't read Herbert's journal, I would have thought that you got sunstroke. I hope, our visitors are alive.

goal.en: Find and catch intruders on the Penelope base.

startText.en:
Hey, listen up, yo.

We're watched. Don't turn around! Hush. We've been watched since we left the previous base. There are two of them. I tried to get into their heads but couldn't. They're protected by something big, like a thundercloud over the sun. I just couldn't do it!

They're still watching us so catching them won't be a walk in the park. But I have an idea, heh. I can distract them with your phantom while you're sneaking from behind.

You're cool with that, right?

checkText.en: They're friendlier than I thought.

finishText.en:
I'm sure you three can make it. I'm counting on Eurial in particular. She alone is smarter than you two dumbheads, you and Skulnar. As you know, you don't have much time. Ivan and Felix will get bored at some point, and then they'll knock the Children of All-Mother into tomorrow! You need to hurry.

I'll stay here to look after Penelope, continue Herbert and Elena's research, and wait for some news from you.

goal.en: Talk to the locals, then talk to Catherina.

startText.en:
Just look at that! The elusive locals. Wow. I've never seen them so close. Our previous encounters ended up in shooting. It's a good thing that Felix isn't here today. At least, this time we can talk for real.

Ask them what they want. And I need to know where my people from the base are.

checkText.en: Outsiders! What do you want in Eden?

finishText.en:
You will pay for what you've done! I've been watching you! I know everything about you! Every little thing!

All-Mother awaits. Her sentence will be swift, just, and final.

goal.en: Mount the Windsower, get to the Great Tree, and deserve the right to talk to All-Mother.

startText.en:
I knew you would agree to come with me.

All-Mother has chosen you for a reason. All tribes of Eden used to live in peace until the Darkness came and the Old Tribe went to war against the others.

Juniper predicted your arrival but no one believed him. And now you're here. You've come a long way, but you don't know much about this world. You have a lot to learn. But I believe that you're destined to save our world.

Our Windsowers are waiting for you upstairs whenever you're ready.

checkText.en: It's time...

finishText.en:
Ah. A long-awaited "savior" from another world.

Don't flatter yourself, I don't really need your aid. I've seen worlds being born and destroyed. You're nothing but a flash. A short instant of my life.

But this young child may be right. You might be not completely hopeless.

I don't know what was the God of Darkness's concept behind your creation, but I'm sure you have no idea how it all began. He didn't tell you, did he?

My lessons will teach you the real purpose of Being.

goal.en: Face All-Mother's trial and defend your right to exist.

startText.en:
You're relying too much on your invulnerability. You think you're immortal. But this is our world. Here you're exposed and vulnerable.

The likes of you realized that the end was inevitable and begged for mercy.

Are you ready to end your journey here? Once and for all?

Go ahead. We shall meet at the end of your way. This is where you shall reply for the deeds of your people and yourself.

checkText.en: Our Expedition was thrown together by the bureaucratic Imperial chaos and crazy League voluntarism.

finishText.en: Now you know what's going on here. Remember that apart from Klavdia's followers, there are plenty of Felix and Catherina's people.

goal.en: Ask the Expedition members about Eden.

startText.en:
Greetings.

I didn't expect you here, although it's only logical. Connection with Sarnaut has long been lost. I suppose, you were curious what was going on here. We're alright, as you can see.

Catherina and Felix's operation is going according to the plan. We settled here, set up a base, and started ambrosia mining.

You can talk to the Expedition members to get a full picture.

I suggest you start with the medical unit, processing workshop, and the production hall. This should suffice.

checkText.en: A sunchew grew in our shithouse once. The base was paralyzed.

finishText.en: Sunchews are a small sample of this world for you. Other creatures may impress even a seasoned botanist.

goal.en: Destroy Sunchews on the base

startText.en:
We have another problem.

Let me give you a hint. Everything is growing here. Stick a twig in the ground, and it'll spring roots and leaves. It would have been great if not for the local plants that fling their seeds everywhere. They're carried with the wind, stick to your shoes, land on mechanoids. We're trying to keep the place sterile but we can't get rid of them completely. The problem is that they grow! Fast!

You miss one sprout, and in no time, it uproots and walks around the base, breaking everything in its way. We must inspect and weed this place all the time!

I can't be on duty 24/7. I need your help. It will give you an idea of what awaits you here.

Walk around the base and weed out all Sunchews.

checkText.en: I hear they even tried making moonshine from them. So? It's biomass!

finishText.en: Good job, chief. The base is almost clear, there's nothing to fear now.

goal.en: Destroy Sunchews on the base

name.en: Mounting an Offensive: Enemies at the Base

startText.en:
I'll be brief, chief! There are enemies all over the base! But not the ones Felix was talking about... The real ones!

We have an invasion of these Triffids... Sunchews! They are quite scary! Hideous weed!

Not only do they propagate at a wild rate, but you can’t grab them with your bare hands - you'll get nasty burns! Already lost a troop of Orcs there, chief. The nurses are running out of tissues, mourning them.

But I know you're not afraid of any burns. You can handle them, chief.

checkText.en: A sunchew grew in our shithouse once. The base was paralyzed.

finishText.en: If I could, I would tell Felix to burn down the forest to solve the Sunchew problem once and for all. Since it's impossible, we'll have to be extra careful! The enemy is waiting for us to drop our guard... And our losses keep mounting.

goal.en: Get rid of the Sunchews at the Gates base

startText.en:
Have you realized where you are? Local plants fling their seeds everywhere. They stick to your shoes, land on mechanoids. We're trying to keep the base sterile but we can't get rid of them completely. If a seed lands, it instantly sprouts.

You miss one, and in no time, a Sunchew uproots and walks around the base, breaking everything in its way.

Your task is to get rid of the weed!

checkText.en: I think our base is under attack. To the cannons! They're right on the walls.

finishText.en:
These things are getting more and more aggressive. Felix thinks that the locals let them out to attack us. Catherina is sure that they've got a hive mind.

On the downside, we have to kill them all. There's no other way.

goal.en: Escort Felix and Catherina to the base.

startText.en:
Excellent! By the order of the senior base officer on duty, you are now a member of the Expedition.

You see, Felix and Catherina haven't arrived yet. They've been out scouting. Should be back soon.

You need to meet them by the gates. You might have to get rid of uninvited guests. The gates of our base are a ripe target for everyone out there.

checkText.en: They want to see you as soon as possible.

finishText.en: Remember, you must talk to me and ask for my approval before you do anything at all. I am the Expedition leader. I decide what's best.

goal.en: Speak with the Expedition leaders.

startText.en:
It's good to know that I'm no longer responsible for the base. I wouldn't want to lose it while Catherina is away.

I suppose, the Expedition leaders would want to talk to you in person. We divided the jobs according to our talents. Felix fights and protects, Catherina studies and invents, and Ivan Chelezny pays for everything.

Each of them has something to say. Go to the headquarters and report your arrival.

checkText.en: Report the progress of my task.

finishText.en: The fewer of them, the easier. I wish they didn't reproduce so fast. We could try and burn down their breeding spots.

goal.en: Destroy local animals and birds around the base.

startText.en:
Plants and animals of Eden are real terrorists. They can't stop beating up each other. There are beasts of every color: armored, venomous, clawed, tentacled... A mixture of animals and plants. I'm talking about everything that can crawl, fly, or just sit there.

There's a new abomination every day. And all of them love hanging around our base. Here's my order: kill as many predators out there as you can.

checkText.en: So how are our birds and animals?

finishText.en: Great, boss! While we can't get rid of them entirely, we can at least reduce their numbers...

goal.en: Eliminate the local animals and birds around the base.

startText.en:
I'll be brief, chief! Here's the thing: there are too many beasts around the base. It would be fine, but our enemies use them to spy on us.

So if we want to launch an attack, we must first secure the area around the base. Everyone thinks so, but no one wants to do anything, so they decided to task you with it. Well, you are a hero, so you can fight the beasts, surely.

checkText.en: How is it going with my request?

finishText.en: Well done. The fewer of them, the easier. We'll kill them all sooner or later. In the meanwhile, we'll have to do some good work for the sake of Sarnaut.

goal.en: Eliminate the Swearwolves and Disbeleaves near the Gates base

startText.en:
Alas, every beast outside the base wants only one thing: to get inside and destroy everything. They keep circling the perimeter. It's the only thing that separates the wilderness and our civilization!

The local predators are the most dangerous. Swearwolves are fast, cunning, and deadly. Disbeleaves are giant birds. You won't see them before they start pecking your eyeballs out.

There's only one way to put an end to it: ruthless elimination. Your task is to clean up the area around the base before we lose more people.

checkText.en: I could wait more, but you'd better hurry.

finishText.en:
Alright, let's see what you got. Luckily, we can extract the life essence, or whatever they call it.

I can already see the change... They've grown some new prickles and hairs. I hope you were wearing gloves while gathering them. I wouldn't want you to lose your hands.

goal.en: Collect mushroom samples.

startText.en:
Felix loves to solve problems with brute force. However, I believe there's something else behind the aggression of the local floral fauna.

You see, during the first days after our arrival the local animals and plants showed zero aggression.

It started a little later. Our mining routes were blocked by a herd of migrating mammals. We were compelled to use weapons.

Later on, it got so bad that we had to build a wall and secure it with cannons.

Day after day the animals and plants evolved, becoming more and more dangerous.

I need to study plants around our base. Bring me several mushroom samples. The symbiosis they form with other species is quite unique.

checkText.en: I could wait more, but you'd better hurry.

finishText.en: Wonderful! Extreme changeability is one of the main features of local plants animals. They evolve by the day. That's why I might need more samples tomorrow.

goal.en: Collect mushroom samples near the Gates base

startText.en:
The Forest has changed the most around the Gates base, and it's puzzling. Apparently, the local fauna identifies us as threat and strikes back. I must say, the pace of their evolution is amazing.

In a matter of days they can produce new types of toxins or grow new prickles that pierce through any material.

I need to study them all the time to come up with relevant protection. Get me more mushroom samples. It looks like they contain tissues of every living object around here.

checkText.en: Every second that our harvesters stand idly is a lost profit. Hurry.

finishText.en: The harvester is up and running once again? Excellent. The sounds of its cogs and gears, screeching saws, roaring power units are music to my ears. They make me richer my the minute!

goal.en: Fix the harvester outside the base.

startText.en:
Our Expedition is still a huge risk. A financial risk, of course. Catherina and Felix couldn't care less how much the Expedition costs, but the Tycoon Council will hold me accountable for every penny spent here.

Even though there are plenty of spare parts for new mechanoids in our warehouses, we must cut corners wherever we can. Let's fix what was broken.

Like, for instance, our harvester. A universal resource collector and a moving processing plant that turns wood into ambrosia.

Try and fix it. You should find plenty of spare parts around the base.

Constant losses and growing costs take the wind out of my sails. Only future profits from ambrosia sales can warm this old heart.

checkText.en: The Harvester is a great machine. I'll get one of those for my summer house. After the war, I mean.

finishText.en: Wow, you really are unmatched, chief. A Jack of all trades. I believe the construction of the mana bomb is almost finished.

goal.en: Fix the Harvester outside the base.

startText.en:
I'll be brief, chief! Everything is fine, the troops are ready to march and die for our cause, but there is one more thing we need to do - fix one of our Harvesters. The damned Children keep trying to break them like they have nothing better to do. And now they brought their elephant and destroyed the machine, and the parts are scattered everywhere.

You need to collect them. It's not difficult - they were designed in a way so even a dumb Orc could fit the square into the square and the circle into the circle. Though I hear they still mix them up, but you are smarter than them, boss. You can handle it. At least on the second try.

checkText.en: Every second that our harvesters stand idly is a lost profit. Hurry.

finishText.en: Wonderful! We brought an old harvester back in line and saved our resources. We can even pay bonuses to the staff.

goal.en: Repair the broken Harvester near the Gates base

startText.en:
Even though there are plenty of spare parts for new mechanoids in our warehouses, we must cut corners wherever we can. Let's fix what was broken.

Like, for instance, our harvester. A universal resource collector and a moving processing plant that turns wood into ambrosia.

Try and fix it. You should find plenty of spare parts around the base.

checkText.en: Are we going or what?

finishText.en: The harvester's explosion was unfortunate. Thank Tensess, it's very hard to die here. Even severe wounds heal in no time. Let's see what we have on the other base.

goal.en: Get to the other base.

startText.en:
Now that we've solved the most pressing issues, it's time to take care of Penelope.

My old friends Herbert de Vevre and Elena Zimina hang out there. They interrupted their vacations on my request. Yes, I know they're Zayan's spies. And City Council's. And Detective Bureau's. So what? They're outstanding researchers. It's all that matters.

The problem is that we stopped getting updates from Penelope a week ago. There's no way to send a messenger. You can't get to Penelope on foot through the dense forest, full of predators.

Perhaps, their transmitter is broken, but we must be prepared for the worst. The defense perimeter is equipped worse than the Gates base.

I suggest we go together. Let's take Skulnar and Eurial. They're the smartest of your guys.

We're going by an experimental all-terrain forest-hacking anti-predator armored harvester. The navigation bot will lead us. Keep following it, don't stop.

checkText.en: Please don't...

finishText.en: It's time to hit the road... If you are ready, we can do it right now.

goal.en: Complete negotiations with the All-Mother

name.en: We are all part of the cycle of life

startText.en:
So many victims, so much blood spilled... Do you want to destroy the Great Tree? The source of this world's life force that allows the Ambrosia to flow through its veins?

I'm tired of watching you kill my Children... What do you even want?

Ambrosia? I can give it to you, just stop destroying my world!

Protection from Nihaz? Is that what my lost daughter wants? I will help her.

Just stop. Tell her... this sorceress who has a shard of Sarn in her...

checkText.en: An interesting twist...

finishText.en:
Well, you're probably wondering what happened.

This was all part of my plan, so I'll tell you what happened.

goal.en: Return to Sarnaut and find out what happens next

startText.en:
Sarnaut. The world that Sarn created. And populated with different races. Indeed, I'd be interested to see what he created.

And even though Nihaz has corrupted my friend's creation, I still want to see it.

While I'm away, Rhubarb will look after my Children. Let's go.

checkText.en:
What, you didn't expect that?

Hmm…

finishText.en: And yes, if you are thinking of destroying my prison again or killing the prisoner... I'm afraid nothing will come of it this time.

goal.en: Learn Nihaz's plan and survive

startText.en:
It was a long road that took a lot of time. And, as you already understand, without you and Klavdia I wouldn't have succeeded.

Yes, my friend - I was behind every event since the moment the mad Kyros decided that the immortality I bestowed on you was unnecessary.

I hope you've learned to appreciate Daddy's gifts since then?

Fine, I see you're dying to know what's going on. Let's dot the i's.

checkText.en: Well, well, well. What do we have here?

finishText.en:
I see my plans inspired you.

Great things await us! It will be lots of fun!!

goal.en: Talk to Hirkalla and find out what happens next

startText.en:
I won't leave Sarnaut unattended. It would be too dangerous to give all power to born destroyers.

My eldest daughter will look after things. Yes, Hirkalla will make sure that you don't break anything around here. Of course, my system of Citadels and Seals will continue to work. It never stopped working, and your attempts to break it were initially futile due to the fact that everything was repeatedly duplicated and supplemented with backup and contingency plans. I never bet on just one card, you see.

As for Klavdia, she will still play her part, you can be sure of that.

Well, it's time to say goodbye. Fight your destiny, Hero of Sarnaut.

checkText.en: What's going on?

finishText.en:
What?!

I have no words.

You... you... what have you done? You surrendered our world to the Goddess of Darkness?

This is outrageous! I trusted you, but you and Klavdia... you ruined everything! How could you be so reckless?

Get out! Get out of my sight! I don't want to see you again! And you... you're not a hero anymore, and everyone will know what you did!

And I… need to think.

goal.en: Report to Yasker

startText.en:
Where do I start?

Well, first tell Yasker the news - let him rejoice. If he is afraid of Cosmos, reassure him - our control of the Citadels won't let the Observatory change the past and destroy the Empire.

As for the rest, I expect obedience and cooperation from him. If he works with me, he will be rewarded. Otherwise I will show him the true meaning of the words "torments of hell".

See you soon, hero!

checkText.en: I understand now...

finishText.en:
I hope I took some of the weight off your mind.

At least you and I are in the same boat now.

I'm not saying goodbye, because you can always find me...

goal.en: Meet with Alice and talk

startText.en:
What a day! Strange signs everywhere, and even stranger assignments.

You're , right? I'm here to deliver a message.

In short, a certain Alice is waiting for you at the Astral Academy... She asked you to come.

checkText.en: What's going on?

finishText.en:
What?!

I have no words.

You... you... what have you done? You surrendered our world to the Goddess of Darkness?

This is outrageous! I trusted you, but you and Klavdia... you ruined everything! How could you be so reckless?

Get out! Get out of my sight! I don't want to see you again! And you... you're not a hero anymore, and everyone will know what you did!

And I… need to think.

goal.en: Report to Aidenus

startText.en:
Where do I start?

Well, first tell Aidenus the news - let him rejoice. If he is afraid of Cosmos, reassure him - our control of the Citadels won't let the Observatory change the past and destroy the League.

As for the rest, I expect obedience and cooperation from him. If he works with me, he will be rewarded. Otherwise I will show him the true meaning of the words "torments of hell".

See you soon, hero!

checkText.en: I understand now...

finishText.en:
I hope I took some of the weight off your mind.

At least you and I are in the same boat now.

I'm not saying goodbye, because you can always find me...

goal.en: Meet with Alice and talk

startText.en:
What a day! Strange signs everywhere, and even stranger assignments.

You're , right? I'm here to deliver a message.

In short, a certain Alice is waiting for you at the Astral Academy... She asked you to come.

checkText.en: Fire is one of the most destructive forces. We need to tame it before it devours the entire valley.

finishText.en: We managed to prevent the worst. However, the main enemy forces are approaching.

goal.en: Eliminate the Fire Throwers of the Expedition

startText.en:
All this time we have successfully resisted the Expedition's attempts to seize our Ambrosia, and it looks like their patience has come to an end.

One of your friends, a Priden named Murk, has passed on a message. He reports that the leader of your people, Felix, has ordered an all-out attack using all available forces.

They have adopted a new tactic, trying to cause panic among the animals so they flee in our direction and throw our forces into disorder. To do this, they use new troops armed with strange weapons that spout fire!

We need to stop them. Let's kill those fire starters!

checkText.en: Felix is somewhere out there! We need to defeat him!

finishText.en:
Skulnar and Felix have left the battle!

But this is not the end. Catherina is on her way here with some monstrous device that can destroy everything around!

goal.en: Fight Felix with Skulnar the Fierce

startText.en:
Eh, when I came to this world, I didn't think I'd have to fight. But it looks like we have no other options. Too bad our guys from the Landfill aren't here. They love a good fight, heh.

Wait, you're not the only one I'm going to have a chat with. I'll try and use this psionic stuff to reach out to our people. I hope everyone hears my speech.

In short, this Expedition is trying to prove they are calling the shots here and that no one will stop them. But we have something to say about that!

We contacted members of other tribes of Eden, and they joined us! Now we'll show the Expedition they have no power here and that this land doesn't belong to them!

You and I have a special task - Felix is somewhere among the troops. Their Commander in Chief. If he's gone, the Expedition troops will be in turmoil.

Well, shall we deal with the Xadaganian?

checkText.en: We have only one chance! Disable this device!

finishText.en:
ENOUGH!

This is going too far. Stop this madness!

goal.en: Destroy the mana bomb

startText.en:
It's something monstrous.

They... used the power of the Ambrosia to make their weapons more powerful. If it works, then... the entire Valley will be destroyed.

We can't let this happen! Our warriors are wounded, but we must fight as one!

Everyone, we need to destroy this bomb before it reaches the Great Tree!

checkText.en: We must clear a path for the mana bomb to achieve our goal!

finishText.en: Let the earth and the skies burn! Let the astral blaze! I will achieve my goal or I will raze everything to the ground!

goal.en: Clear a path using the flamethrower to fight the beasts

startText.en:
We're wasting time!

Everyone here is fighting for survival. Hordes of locals are preparing to attack.

The number of enemy combatants rose from a few hundred to thousands in recent weeks.

And many of them are still on the way, soon there will be even more of them! At this point, they will breach the perimeter.

But that won't happen. The only way to safety is a preemptive strike.

We will fight terror with terror! Our enemies naively believe that the thorns of the Valley are protecting their Great Tree.

When it's destroyed, they will remember this lesson even thousands of years down the line!

I've tasked the flamethrower troops with clearing the way for our mana bomb. I command you to go with them and provide support.

checkText.en: It will be all over when I give the order.

finishText.en:
Felix is unconscious, and so is Skulnar...

But the battle must be finished! We have no other choice!

You need to bring the mana bomb to the right spot. After that I will teleport us out of here with a spell!

goal.en: Fight Skulnar the Fierce with Felix

name.en: What's it like to betray your homeland?

startText.en:
Yes, some of our allies disappointed me...

Those who came with you to Eden. Skulnar the Fierce. Eurial. And even Murk. Yes, him too.

They chose to go over to the Children's side. And thus they betrayed Sarnaut!

However, I never trusted the orc. It's all about Yasker. Once he was worthy of leading the Empire, but over time he softened, became weak. He should have nipped this orc rebellion in the bud, but he still hesitates...

The Empire is an idea! We shouldn't doubt what we're doing. When we get enough Ambrosia, Catherina and I will return to Sarnaut and establish a completely different order there. The Empire and the League have become too weak. They will be transformed into a new state, and we will lead it!

Let's move onward - the future lies there, right behind this one orc who is destined to die at the hands of an Imperial warrior! And I will fix the mistake made by the Observatory!

checkText.en: It's time to finish what we started!

finishText.en:
ENOUGH!

This is going too far. Stop this madness!

goal.en: Protect the mana bomb

startText.en:
We have a unique weapon - a mana bomb enhanced by the Ambrosia.

Nobody knows the real power of this device.

Presumably, it's capable of turning this whole Valley into a big crater. It will stop this war.

Our troops have suffered heavy losses, and I understand that it won't be easy, but we're almost there. Bring this bomb to the agreed point, and it will be over.

checkText.en: Find all the ghosts and find out what they want.

finishText.en: They must have been resurrected by Hirkalla, I guess? Well, let's hope they will soon leave Nezebgrad and go straight to Jigran!

goal.en: Find the ghosts and ask what they want

startText.en: I sense something unusual in our city. A large number of paranormal entities have appeared. I wanted to call ghost hunters first, but maybe we can deal with it ourselves? Ask them what they want.

checkText.en: You need to find all the ghosts!

finishText.en: I see! They are Hirkalla's creations... I hope they leave Novograd soon and go straight to Jigran!

goal.en: Find the ghosts and ask what they want

startText.en: Miracles are happening in the city! These strange ghosts have appeared... Find out what they need - perhaps trouble is brewing!

checkText.en: How is the training of our troops going?

finishText.en:
You bring good news!

Our scouts report that the Expedition is preparing to set out...

goal.en: Raise an army that can defeat the Expedition

name.en: Making Friends with Grass and Trees

startText.en:
So you're on our side. Now I see it, and I understand that you decided to become one of us.

I know that it was not easy for you to leave your tribesmen. But the Expedition does not understand what they are doing. They think harvesting the Ambrosia will give them divine powers against Nihaz.

But the Ambrosia is the force of life itself. It can't destroy, it can only create. So they are going to fail.

Unfortunately, it is impossible to explain this simple truth to them. There is only one thing left - to drive them out of Eden, once and for all.

And while the forces of my tribe can hold off their onslaught, destroying their base is a much more difficult task. Fortunately, we are not alone on Eden - there are other tribes here.

Your task is to enlist their support.

finishText.en:
My friend, I'm glad to see you!

I was just thinking of sending for you. I need to tell you something important.

goal.en: Go to Rhubarb

name.en: You will become one of them

startText.en:
The story of Eden is nearing its end.

The final battle is close, and who wins it depends on you.

Of course, you believe siding with the Children will help you achieve the goal that Klavdia set for you.

checkText.en: How is the training of our troops going?

finishText.en:
You bring good news!

Our scouts report that the Expedition is preparing to set out...

goal.en: Raise an army that can defeat the Expedition

name.en: Making Friends with Grass and Trees

startText.en:
So you're on our side. Now I see it, and I understand that you decided to become one of us.

I know that it was not easy for you to leave your tribesmen. But the Expedition does not understand what they are doing. They think harvesting the Ambrosia will give them divine powers against Nihaz.

But the Ambrosia is the force of life itself. It can't destroy, it can only create. So they are going to fail.

Unfortunately, it is impossible to explain this simple truth to them. There is only one thing left - to drive them out of Eden, once and for all.

And while the forces of my tribe can hold off their onslaught, destroying their base is a much more difficult task. Fortunately, we are not alone on Eden - there are other tribes here.

Your task is to enlist their support.

checkText.en: How are we doing?

finishText.en:
What's taking so long?

We have a critical situation here - the threat is mounting. We must remember one thing: our people are counting on us. And we can't let them down. I'll say one more thing. When this is over, you're all getting promotions and government awards.

goal.en: Create an Ambrosia-infused mana bomb

startText.en:
Traitors - "the Children's supporters" - do not care about other people's lives or their own. In this regard, I order you to take emergency precautions. The enemy can come alone or with an army. They may come in the form of our soldiers. We must stop them. You can't let the enemy infiltrate the base. Which is why I order you to remember three simple rules:

First. Do not trust the uniform or the title if you don't know the person.

Second. Anyone who goes inside the perimeter must be destroyed.

Third. Shoot first, ask questions later. It's better to lose a few of our men through a misunderstanding than through carelessness.

Any change to these rules must come from me personally.

Aside from that, I have a special task for you...

finishText.en:
Oh, my friend! You're just in time.

I was just thinking of sending for you. I need to tell you something important.

goal.en: Visit Felix

name.en: I don't leave my people behind

startText.en:
The story of Eden is nearing its end.

The final battle is close, and who wins it depends on you.

And while you are not doing what Klavdia wants you to do, you still expect the Expedition to help defeat Nihaz.

checkText.en: How are we doing?

finishText.en:
What's taking so long?

We have a critical situation here - the threat is mounting. We must remember one thing: our people are counting on us. And we can't let them down. I'll say one more thing. When this is over, you're all getting promotions and government awards.

goal.en: Create an Ambrosia-infused mana bomb

startText.en:
Traitors - "the Children's supporters" - do not care about other people's lives or their own. In this regard, I order you to take emergency precautions. The enemy can come alone or with an army. They may come in the form of our soldiers. We must stop them. You can't let the enemy infiltrate the base. Which is why I order you to remember three simple rules:

First. Do not trust the uniform or the title if you don't know the person.

Second. Anyone who goes inside the perimeter must be destroyed.

Third. Shoot first, ask questions later. It's better to lose a few of our men through a misunderstanding than through carelessness.

Any change to these rules must come from me personally.

Aside from that, I have a special task for you...

checkText.en: Have you found the suits? Is the power back on? No? Well, why don't you take care of it, Hero of Sarnaut?

finishText.en:
I didn't expect to see him here... although I should have known.

Alright, what are we going to do? Try to drive him out? The whole place is going to be destroyed if we start a fight.

goal.en: Find Hazmat Suits for the Expedition members and fix the mana flow.

startText.en:
We fought off the first attack. Good. But it's not our only problem. We got a problem with the mana flow. The worst part is that the way to the mana station is guarded by Draconids. You're the local hero, right? So you should be able to get to the mana station and restore power flow.

But first let's talk about the situation.

checkText.en: No time to talk. The enemies are approaching, and the Gates are still out of order. Chop-chop!

finishText.en:
Farewell!

I hope you can complete everything we talked about. Remember, my mother's patronage is Sarnaut's only chance for salvation.

goal.en: Launch Gates-III

startText.en:
Looks like we don't have any other choice. I could deal with the Draconids but I'm not so sure about the Great Mage... and the demons and Wormfaces attacking from behind. No, that's too much.

Let's discuss conditions. I wonder what he wants from us. He can't have Skulnar and the Gates but if he wants to tag along to leave Sarnaut... whatever. He can join.

finishText.en: Welcome to Eden. The new world, different from Sarnaut.

goal.en: Get to another world

startText.en:
The Gates are working. And that's great! All that's left to do is exit them. It might be the hardest part. The previous Expedition lost more than half its members on the way between the worlds.

Don't worry about the hazmat suit. It's equipped automatically when you enter the Interverse. We implemented after the last time. Not everyone was smart enough to equip it manually, you know...

Anyway, good luck!

finishText.en: I thought we were done with. Hah. There were so many of them. The first leap is over, but we still have many to make.

goal.en: Protect the Great Mage from architects.

startText.en:
Phew. Everyone's here. We haven't lost a soul.

We need to make a few more leaps to reach the destination. You can never guess where a leap might take you, hah.

The ancient elf will cover us with a shield. We need to survive till he casts a new spell. As you see, we aren't alone here. Those fartitects were split into shards when the core was destroyed. Now they're at war with one another. That's what Catherina said. They're too busy fussing with one another but they're gonna notice us soon.

finishText.en: We've found each other! Neat.

goal.en: Get to the next portal, while avoiding the gaze of the creature of Darkness.

startText.en:
Where are we?

Elleken's spell scattered us over different paths of the Trail, hah. But that's fine. There's a portal nearby. We will find the rest of the group in not time. I've got a trick up my sleeve to run the portal.

There's just one thing... see that exploded sphere over there? Something ancient lives in it. It's not gonna be happy to see us.

It's got an exceptional nose for magic. It's going to see me if I budge. Get ready. We'll have to run for our dear lives as fast as we only can!

finishText.en: Greetings in Eden! Get down to business.

goal.en: Help Skulnar solve the riddle before entering the portal.

startText.en:
Well, here we are. We need to go our separate ways now. You've almost reached your destination. I will be on my way, and so will Sturegga. Where? You're not supposed to know this.

We might meet again.

You will make more discoveries that will make you look at our story at a different angle.

Eurial is staying with you. She needs to gain some experience. All that's left to do is help Skulnar solve some kind of a riddle. Farewell.

finishText.en: I'm glad you answered my call...

goal.en: Visit Simon on Suslanger

checkText.en: No time for talking! We're under attack!

finishText.en: Who could have thought that our humble little Gates will hit Sarnaut's jackpot this year?

goal.en: Deal with the enemy troops and find Eladia.

startText.en:
Greetings, comrade!

It's been several months since you found the Chronophone. We haven't lost time!

The Expedition, headed by Catherina and Felix, my colleague from Yakhch, has departed for another world. They successfully passed the Gates, evaded all dangers, and landed on Eladia's exact coordinates.

Sadly, there have been no news ever since.

Moreover, the Gates themselves are now under threat. There was a massive attack on our allod! Armies from all Sarnaut gathered here. While our brave fleet is fighting dragons and demons in Astral, there's another fight with enemy troops at the Gates. Wormfaces crawled out of their caves, too.

They want to get through the Gates and leave Sarnaut. We can't afford losing control over this object! We invested so much effort in it. Eladia needs your help as soon as possible. I'll teleport you to the Gates construction site. You will need to find her there.

Try to get rid of some of the enemies along the way. It'll make your life a little easier.

checkText.en: How is your search going?

finishText.en: See, the divine powers are everywhere. If there were no Darkness, there wouldn't be hideout for animals, there wouldn't be nights for resting. Without Chaos, the world would have never seen change. Everything is important. Everything matters.

goal.en: Find examples of divine powers in action.

startText.en:
We continue our lessons.

Light. Darkness. Order. Chaos. These are the divine powers. They rule the world, guide the intelligent beings, set them on the right paths.

We can't get rid of Darkness because we need it. Darkness is part of the natural cycle of life.

I would like you to realize this simple truth. The divine powers don't belong to Sarn, or Nihaz, or someone else, equally powerful. They show everywhere. Go and find examples of divine powers in the world.

checkText.en: You need to know how the divine forces manifest themselves in our worlds...

finishText.en: You have learned your lesson. To understand the true meaning of my words, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.

goal.en: Find examples of divine powers in action in the Howling Forest

startText.en:
I want you to repeat my lesson.

Light, Darkness, Order, Chaos. These are the divine powers. They rule the world, guide intelligent beings, set them on the right path.

We can't get rid of Darkness because we need it. Darkness is part of the natural cycle of life.

I would like you to realize this simple truth. Divine powers don't belong to Sarn, or Nihaz, or any other powerful being. They manifest themselves everywhere. Go and find examples of divine powers in the world.

Go and learn this lesson again!

checkText.en: How's the assignment going?

finishText.en: Some think that predators are evil for creatures like Sunbunnies. But as you understand now, they aren't. Some have to die but others live and strive.

goal.en: Tune the balance of life in this part of the forest.

startText.en:
From the previous lessons you know that everything is connected. Herbs and vegetables are food for herbivores, herbivores are food for predators, who return to the soil after death and become food for herbs and vegetables.

The circle can't be broken. Death isn't a problem. The tipped balance creates more problems than anything else. Everything must be strictly measured. If my creations eat all herbs and veggies, they will die. If there are too many predators, they will eat all herbivores, and they're also going to die.

Life is a great power. Death is the reverse of life. Believe me, life will always find a way to correct mistakes. But if we want our gardens to be the most beautiful place ever, we need someone to tune the balance.

My Children are the keepers of balance in Eden. You must learn the lesson that is why I want you to do their job.

checkText.en: You need to understand the balance of all living things...

finishText.en: You have learned your lesson. To understand the true meaning of my words, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.

goal.en: Create a balance between the living creatures in the Howling Forest and Grassy Woodland

startText.en:
I want you to repeat my lesson.

Herbivores feed on plants and become food for predators who return to the soil after death and nourish plants.

The circle can't be broken. Death is not a problem. Disturbed balance creates more problems than anything else. Everything must be in moderation. If my creations eat all plants, they will die. If there are too many predators, they will eat all the herbivores, and they're also going to die.

Life is a great power. Death is the reverse side of life. Believe me, life will find a way and correct all mistakes, but if we want our gardens to flourish, we need someone to maintain the balance.

My Children are the keepers of balance in Eden. You must learn this lesson, and that's why I want you to do their job.

Go and learn this lesson again!

checkText.en: We have no time to waste!

finishText.en: The harvester has suffered a fit of rage. It's damaged beyond repair.

goal.en: Find the thing that worried All-Mother.

startText.en:
Are you deceiving me, Child of Sarn?

While you're learning my lessons, there's something strange going on in the Forest. I hear my plants screaming in pain, hear my animals calling upon me in agony.

Go to the distant forest. Find out what's happening.

finishText.en:
Haven't I warned you against ruining our Forest, aliens?

All-Mother trusted you, but you just went on with your nasty deeds? You're going to die. We're going to destroy all your disgusting metal monsters and wipe out your homes, build without permission on the land of Eden!

goal.en: Follow the tracks of battle.

startText.en:
What is the harvester doing so deep in the forest? A battle happened here. I need to track it down and see what happened.

I wonder who sent them here and why...

checkText.en: Destroy everyone who is corrupting our forest!

finishText.en:
Maybe... just maybe... Maybe I can trust you.

Tell the fools at your base that we will never tolerate another invasion of iron machines.

goal.en: Destroy the harvester and its convoy.

startText.en:
These... machine of yours have gone mad.

Not only do they destroy our animals and plants, they attack your own people!

Eliminate the plague before I do it. And don't get me started, otherwise I'll storm through your iron harvesters all the way to the Gates, and I'll stop only to kick your out of my world!

checkText.en: Eliminate everything that's defiling our forest!

finishText.en: This semblance of life will never replace real life. To better understand my lesson, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.

goal.en: Destroy the Harvester and its convoy in the Dusk Grove

startText.en:
The Children say that your iron Harvesters are once again chopping down my forest and everything in it. Alas, if the Expedition does not understand that they should stay away from the forest, they will have to learn the hard way.

Rid us of these poor imitations of the living.

checkText.en: We have no time to waste!

finishText.en: It was wrong to call the children "hippies." Herbert told me that they could kill us all if it weren't for you. Well... thanks!

goal.en: Find the missing Expedition members and Elena Zimina.

startText.en:
Greetings!

Under less tragic circumstances, I'd be jumping with joy seeing you. But the way things are going, I must ask for your help.  Don't laugh but Elena is missing again. Well, it isn't funny anyway... The most part of our group has gone missing along with her.

Our adventure in the Forest is quite a story! Although I'm not sure that I could ever put the horrors we survived into words.

All that matter is that the... wooden lady agreed to spare our lives for now. I suppose, most of my companions fell into different traps here, in the forest. I would be grateful if you could find them all and bring them here. Once we gather together, we'll negotiate our freedom.

checkText.en: Move.

finishText.en: Where's your company? Ran away? Come over, let's talk.

goal.en: Escort the prisoners to safety

startText.en:
I'm still thinking that we must leave this place. I'm worried.

If Willow agrees to set us free, I won't mind! But she said that the local animals are angry with us.

Perhaps you could help us out again? Herbert and I on our own could get out of any situation. But we'll be bringing our research fellows. They're not soldiers, they don't know the first thing about dangers.

Can you take us to the campsite?

checkText.en: Well, well.

finishText.en: What's up? Who got into a fight with you? Can I even leave you alone for five minutes?

goal.en: Stop Hirkalla's ritual

startText.en:
Hah! What a nice little encore! A tragic encounter in the Forest! How dramatic!

So, what do you have to say? Nothing? I thought so.

Let's start then. We need to finish this play.

checkText.en: Are you even listening?

finishText.en:
Hirkalla...

She has never been obedient. Both sisters had incredible potential... if only Nihaz didn't lead them astray.

And now look at her. Poor Children that trusted her... they can't accept their own fate. I'm afraid, you're too weak to fight her yet. You have a lot to learn.

I'll summon you later, when it's the right time for the final lesson.

goal.en: Listen to Catherina and return to All-Mother.

startText.en: Calm down, breathe... you can report later. I also have news for you. Good or bad, it's up to you to decide.

checkText.en: Hurry, time is of the essence.

finishText.en:
Destruction leads to balance, because its essence is time. Insurmountable and unstoppable. Rocks disintegrate into dust, oceans dry up, luminaries die. Time dominates everything...

And only Creation can oppose it. Build a city out of sand. Grow a garden in the wasteland. Kindle a warm fire.

goal.en: Learn a lesson about life and death

startText.en:
Are you ready for the next lesson?

So, you already know about the existence of two circles of forces present in all things. The forces of nature and the forces of the gods. They manifest themselves everywhere, but there is a third circle - the most important one. The circle of forces of the demiurges, those who create worlds.

Everything is subject to our laws, and these laws come from the forces the demiurges represent: Life and Death, Creation and Destruction. One is impossible without the other.

To you mortals, Death seems evil, but you must understand that it is one with Life. One is impossible without the other.

You have to learn this simple truth.

checkText.en: You need to understand the nature of demiurges' powers and how they manifest themselves.

finishText.en: You have learned your lesson. To understand the true meaning of my words, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.

goal.en: Learn a lesson about life and death to the north of Illuian's lair

startText.en:
I want you to repeat my lesson.

 So, you already know about the existence of two circles of forces present in all things. The forces of nature and the forces of the gods. They manifest themselves everywhere, but there is a third circle - the most important one. The circle of forces of the demiurges, those who create worlds.

Everything is subject to our laws, and these laws come from the forces the demiurges represent: Life and Death, Creation and Destruction. One is impossible without the other.

To you mortals, Death seems evil, but you must understand that it is one with Life. One is impossible without the other.

Go and learn this lesson again!

checkText.en: Move! This is my will.

finishText.en:
Not everyone is destined to die knowing they won't be resurrected.

But it's not your time yet.

goal.en: Defeat the dragon Illuian and... die.

startText.en:
One of the last and most important lessons.

Why do you think I create nations and uplift heroes in them?

In the beginning, people live in primitive savagery and fear. Around them are vast, unexplored lands inhabited by monsters.

But then a hero comes, and everything changes. They perform feats in the name of us, gods; they expand the spaces available to their people, they bring knowledge and skills. Sooner or later, every hero realizes that they are mortal. And they begin to seek immortality.

But only gods are immortal, not people. The most important moment for any hero like you is to understand that they are mortal. It is time for you to understand this, too.

If you wish to learn my lesson, then go into the woods. An ancient monster dwells there who has existed for as long as I have... Illuian.

Fight him... and die.

checkText.en: Illuian continues to struggle, but he has lost this battle.

finishText.en: An old friend and foe, he has witnessed so many events... Eternity is his punishment.

goal.en: Defeat the dragon Illuian in his lair

startText.en:
Sometimes my Children don't listen to me...

Well, such is the fate of every mother, but admonition is also necessary.

Illuian, the dragon you know, sometimes rebels against fate - to be a living witness to the struggle of heroes against monsters. Then I need to calm him down before he hurts my Children.

Alas, usually a meeting with him is fatal for heroes, but we know that the moment of your final death has not yet come. So go to him and interrupt his existence for a while - until he is reborn again.

checkText.en: I can't plan my next move while I'm thinking of the dragon right next to our base!

finishText.en: The dragon is defeated? And you managed to survive? Incredible. This once again proves that you can be trusted to complete the most risky and dangerous tasks!

goal.en: Defeat the dragon Illuian in his lair

startText.en:
I've been told that the Children have a real dragon here! We could do without one. Treebor and Cypress pose enough problems as it is.

Luckily, intelligence says that the dragon is quite weak...until he recovers his strength, there is a chance to defeat him.

There are two "buts": firstly, the power of Eden is such that even a dragon torn to pieces will be reborn after some time. It can only die of old age - but do you know of any dragon that died of old age?!!

Secondly, its poison is extremely venomous. If it gets into your blood, death is inevitable. So be careful and don't let him poison you. If that happens...

Well, we will remember you as a hero.

checkText.en: Are you still thinking?

finishText.en: Well, I see that you have learned my lessons. You are truly free from Nihaz's Darkness. Now we need to decide what to do about this Expedition which is nowhere near as reasonable as you...

goal.en: Answer the All-Mother's questions correctly

startText.en:
Now I need to know if you really learned my lessons.

I will ask and you will answer.

Let's meet in my Sanctuary, before my other Children.

checkText.en: Ashes to ashes, rot to rot.

finishText.en:
What? Do you think we care about your Expedition? Its fate will be the same as that of everyone on this land.

The same goes for this Old Tribe that refuses to accept its fate!

goal.en: Find Rhubarb and explore the area

startText.en:
You have proven that my lessons have indeed sunk in.

Now it's time to dispel the darkness that settled in our forests. The apostates who serve darkness rejected their fate and turned against me and my Children. They, too, need to be taught a harsh lesson.

You will be my avenging hand: go to Rhubarb and find out what needs to be done to put an end to this pathetic rebellion once and for all.

checkText.en: Eden has been a peaceful world for many centuries, but behold - the war has come here again.

finishText.en: Excellent. I'm sure this weapon will still serve my Children, and the Ambrosia will be returned to the cycle.

goal.en: Collect the stolen Ambrosia and weapons off the bodies on the battlefield near the Withered Grove

startText.en:
The expedition continues to harm us. My Children are very upset that ambrosia continues to be stolen. Both the Expedition and the Old Tribe are responsible for this.

The scouts reported that a battle took place on the edge of the Withered Grove where aliens from another world fought these madmen led by Hirkalla.

The children arrived as the battle was drawing to a close. They also suffered losses.

We need to recover the stolen Ambrosia and the lost weapons which can still serve my Children in future battles.

checkText.en: If we manage to recover the notes, then the sacrifice of our friends was not in vain!

finishText.en: Thank you. Thank you so much! I think this world will bring us more losses, but we are still going to conquer it!

goal.en: Collect the carcass samples and notes off the bodies on the battlefield near the Withered Grove

startText.en:
Alas, we suffer irretrievable losses in this world! And who is dying? Not warriors, no. Scientists!

Recently, one of our science teams was returning from a mission when they ran into these savages! They didn't take prisoners and just slaughtered everyone!

We can't bring back the fallen. There is no Purgatory in this world, so death here is final. But they had samples and notes with them that could help us in our research.

Please go to the edge of the Withered Grove, find their bodies, and collect records and notes.

checkText.en: Everyone is dead?

finishText.en: Final and inglorious death. I hope their Sparks get lost in the deepest caverns of Eresh, beyond the gates of Ganzir.

goal.en: Eliminate the members of the Old Tribe

startText.en:
Once the Old Tribe were just like us. But the life of their Tree came to an end, and their tribe began to wither and die. Instead of accepting their fate, they rebelled and turned against the All-Mother.

Now they constantly attack our lands and steal our Ambrosia, intending to live forever. That's not going to happen!

Show them that Darkness has no place in Eden. The goddess they swore allegiance to has no power here! Kill them, stop this senseless rebellion against nature.

Reed will go with you.

checkText.en: The time of the Old Tribe has passed. That's the law.

finishText.en: Well, this rebellion never stood a chance, they followed Hirkalla's illusion like many other people before them.

goal.en: Eliminate the members of the Old Tribe in the Withered Grove

startText.en:
Once the Old Tribe was just like the rest of my Children. But the life of their Tree came to an end, and their tribe began to wither and die. Instead of humbly accepting their fate, they rebelled and turned against me.

Now they constantly attack the lands of my Children and steal their Ambrosia. They want to live forever. This can't happen.

Show them that Darkness has no place in Eden. The goddess they swore allegiance to has no power here! Kill them, stop this senseless rebellion against nature.
