finishText.en: You don't look like a stone statue, so I assume the gargoyles have been dealt with.

goal.en: Eliminate 10 Veligrad Gargoyles

startText.en:
Outrageous negligence!

When we entered the ruins, all the gargoyles were asleep. I told my men not to touch them. But no! Someone broke one, and then every other gargoyle came to life. If Christina had anything to do with it...!

But that doesn't matter now. It'll take time to get rid of these stone creatures. Be careful with them, or you'll turn into the same piece of rock.

finishText.en:
Phew, now we don't need to worry about turning our back to the statues.

Skrakan himself created them to guard the streets and walls of Veligrad. As you can see, it didn't save the city, but you've got to appreciate the elegance of thought and magic that went into it.

goal.en: Break 7 stone gargoyles.

startText.en: Some gargoyles are still asleep as statues, but they'll wake up soon. Maybe it's vandalism but it's easier to break these statues before they wake up and turn us into the very same thing.

finishText.en: Exactly. Practice showed who was right, summoners or sorcerers.

goal.en: Break 7 stone gargoyles.

startText.en:
Have they told you that the local sorcerers created gargoyles to guard the city?

Right.

Of course the dumb rocks didn't help anyone. Those sorcerers were burned to a crisp, and the gargoyles are still sitting in the ruins.

As you can see, they make things difficult... The wisest course of action would be to destroy them all. And remember - if you want something dead to defend you, become a summoner.

finishText.en:
Is everyone alive? That’s good. I'll have a word with each of you later.

Especially with Andrea.

goal.en: Find and free the sorcerers turned to stone.

startText.en: Alfred seems to have fallen victim to some magic. You need to free him from the stone shackles. Other summoners in the ruins will also need help.

finishText.en: The work is in full swing! Thanks to your help, we gathered a lot of zombies for our army. Just a few more, and it will be a force to be reckoned with.

goal.en: Help the summoners gather the undead in the ruins of Veligrad.

startText.en: I'm glad Alfred and the others are okay. Their work is very important to us. But you are not done here yet. Find them and ask if you can help them in any way.

finishText.en:
However!

Some of the dead refuse to obey! They seem to be under another influence, it's clearly not something they wanted when they were alive... They said something about a banner?

Someone commands them!

goal.en: Put to rest and then raise again 7 Veligrad fighters.

startText.en: Just look at that... They walk around here as through it's completely normal. They seem to be busy with something. I guess we'll have to put them to rest again before they can serve us! Put them to rest and then use the Horn to subjugate them!

finishText.en: Wow, the dead are accounted for, and you are intact, too. You are smarter than you look.

goal.en: Put to rest and then raise again 7 Veligrad fighters.

startText.en:
The backbone of every army, even the undead one, are ordinary fighters.

So we need those as well, so the easiest way to increase our numbers is to raise everyone who can walk and arm them with a weapon.

Our weapon situation is not ideal at this time, but numerous Veligrad defenders are buried here... some of the metal might still be salvageable. We might even find mithril or adamantine.

Right, why am I discussing this with you? Go to the ruins and raise some fighters for us.

Is your task clear, , or will you mess up again?

finishText.en:
This... is very interesting!

So they were controlled by a Xadaganian commander? Even though they weren't Xadaganian themselves? He must have a strong will even in the afterlife if he can bend others to his wishes. That's an amazing discovery.

Well, now we'll have an easier time controlling these soldiers.

goal.en: Find the general and fulfill his request.

startText.en: These dead are controlled by someone else. They are all muttering something about their commander - it sounds like they still follow his orders. But we haven't seen any commanders here. Here, I'll let you control one of the dead. Find out what's going on.

finishText.en: Oh, I heard their screams. They spoke about fault, retribution, atonement... I think I'm starting to understand.

goal.en: Subjugate the dead Banshees.

startText.en:
Oh la la! These girls are very stubborn. We've reached an understanding with a few, but I could use your help.

You see, these wonderful creatures are already controlled by... someone. I haven't been able to find out more. We'll use the old recipe: put them to rest, then raise them again. They become obedient after that.

At least, they should...

finishText.en: Now we have someone else to cry about things.

goal.en: Subjugate the dead Banshees.

startText.en:
Just skeletons won't be enough to build an army, the elves are right about that. We'll need Banshees. Girls that never found rest.

Personally I'd rather not listen to their wailing. But I have you, so you'll be the one to gather those still wandering the ruins.

Go to that valley of sorrow, . Put those creatures to rest and raise them again on our side.

finishText.en:
What a beautiful and dark story... an inquisitor that condemned his beloved witch. He should've known what a woman scorned is capable of!

Anyway, I'm really glad it has been resolved. I'll talk to the girls myself. They will probably agree to direct their natural vindictiveness at a new enemy.

I'm very grateful for your help.

goal.en: Find out who controls the banshees and resolve the issue.

startText.en:
Someone is keeping these girls here, and we need to find out who's doing it. To avoid killing them needlessly, you should disguise yourself as one of them and find out what's going on. But be careful! If any of them gets angry with you, your disguise will vanish.

So, will you do it?

finishText.en:
Ha...! Ha ha ha ha!

Alive! Whole!

Oh well, not exactly alive, but definitely whole. Two missing bones don't count. You and the knife-eared did well. I'm a man of my word, so I'll do my part. Take your zombies.

There's something I need to find here...

goal.en: Help Sea Drift collect his bones and belongings.

startText.en:
Hello, greenhorn! Are you one of those who want to command the dead?

Then we have... whatchamacallit... A conflict of interest. The dead that roam the ruins owe me a debt. And your knife-eared friend told me this debt won't let you put them under your control. I don't need them, but I won't let them go until they return what's mine.

There you have it. Let's do this one thing. We'll both benefit. Here it is: these rats ate my bones and stole my stuff. I dread to think what happened to my little pal Jack. If someone finds my belongings and retrieves my bones from a few dead bellies, I'll be willing to talk.

Deal? Come on, you don't really have a choice, he he.

finishText.en: Good. These markers will help you direct the power of the ritual into reanimating the strongest corpses.

goal.en: Examine the remains on the Corrupted Hill to find out where mighty warriors are buried.

startText.en:
Catherina is wrong! Our future army will be strong and sturdy. But we'll have to pick our material carefully.

, Grimwald will assist you. Yes, that's my Guard. He can inspect remains in the area and figure out which corpses we need to reanimate and which ones are better left alone. You just need to mark mighty warriors.

finishText.en: Good. No one can disturb us now.

goal.en: Get rid of grave worms on the battlefield

startText.en:
It's no wonder some zombies are falling apart. Just look around... there are so many corpse-eating worms in the area. Battlefields attract them like a feast.

They are our competition - we need these bodies, too. And I'd rather they were undamaged. Be a dear - kill them all.

finishText.en: Did you enjoy killing worms, ? Come back again.

goal.en: Get rid of the grave worms on the battlefield and report to Nawlad Jeer.

startText.en:
When Leviathan struck, many people died in Veligrad.

That's why you see so many grave worms. It's been years, but they still have no shortage of food.

Of course, the Blight helped... sowed these fields generously again. But now we're interested in the dead ourselves, and the worms are eating them.

So the more worms you kill, , the better. But it will take you more than one try... They are really hard to get rid of.

finishText.en:
That's very odd. Some of the undead refuse to obey. Something is not right...

Perhaps... they are under some kind of influence. Or someone is controlling them.

goal.en: Help Dakkar carry out the ritual that will raise the dead.

startText.en: Now let's get to work. To raise the dead warriors around here, I'll need a brave and agile assistant. Take my Necrosphere. If you see any remains, give me a sign. I'll direct a flow of magic into it, and all the dead nearby will rise from the ground.

finishText.en: Some of them are too capricious. Now, now. Stop whining, it's your duty now - to serve me. Ha ha.

goal.en: Raise 40 skeletons on the Corrupted Hill and report to Nawlad Jeer.

startText.en:
You know what my grandfather used to say?

"Raise them all, you'll sort them out later."

Time is pressing, that elf keeps sending me notes, asking how it's going and where the new warriors are.

So go the battlefield and raise them all. If any corpse makes a fuss and tries to hit you - hit them right back. Once they calm down, raise them again.

What are you waiting for? Go, !

finishText.en: You are looking at an old grave. Someone important is buried here. The epitaph is barely visible, but you can see fragments of words. "H..re r..sts G..len..l, a p..werful s..rcer..ss and k..eper of Vel..grad wond..rs."

goal.en: Find the restless spirit by following its traces.

startText.en:
There's a ghost that appears now and then, trying to interfere with our work. Have you seen it?

It looks like our spells awakened quite a few souls that were at rest in these ruins...

But our mission cannot wait!

Let's finish this. I'll give you an artifact that detects ghostly traces. You can use it to find traces nearby and follow them to the ghost's hideout. Find out what it wants. You're good at solving the dead's problems, so go!

finishText.en: Why... Why are you doing this?

goal.en: Summon Galenel's spirit and pacify her.

startText.en: It appears that Galenel passed away a long time ago. But her restless soul is still wandering around Veligrad. She is trying to disrupt our work. You should ask her what her problem is.

finishText.en: Galenel? The one? I don't believe my ears... I never thought I'd meet her in person. We have a lot to discuss.

goal.en: Talk to Galenel and take her to Dakkar

startText.en: What do you want now? I'll happily throw you and your friends out. Now talk before I get angry!

finishText.en: We're here. Just look around you! So many great warriors are waiting for a chance to hold a weapon again.

goal.en: Go to the Corrupted Hill with Dakkar

startText.en:
It's time to gather our forces.

It's easier to raise and subjugate those that are already in the ground. There's a battlefield nearby where a lot of people died - Corrupted Hill. We'll start there.

finishText.en:
Wow! What do you have there? A scroll? Ancient spells? And some local witch had them?

She didn't write them, that's for sure! Look at the words... It's an old Xadaganian script. I'd say the scroll is about 300-400 years old.

We need to take it to Zayan, let him decipher it... Perhaps we'll learn more.

goal.en: Find the witch's lair, defeat her, and obtain a scroll fragment.

startText.en:
Now that we're paying attention, I'm actually starting to sense something.

Some unknown magic! Someone's raising the dead.

Hmm... A very interesting enchantment. Perhaps we should check it out, ?

I'm afraid that other... summoner might disrupt our plans. Persuade them to stop.

finishText.en:
Has the party made it?

Disobeyed, you say? Yes, that's what I thought. I've never had this much trouble controlling the undead before. We got rid of all the creatures that exerted control over the local corpses, and yet...

Not everyone, apparently. There's one left. Galenel says she sensed another ghost in her tower. A very powerful one. She doesn't know who it might be...

goal.en: Lead the Veligrad fighters to the Flooded Garden

startText.en:
I want to see how long my zombies can follow an order without my direct control. I suggest you check if our wards can make it to the Flooded Garden. I'll send a few Veligrad undead there, and you will escort them. Make sure they don't wander off or get distracted along the way.

I'll give you a special horn that will let you control them.

, if you notice anything strange in their behavior - let me know.

finishText.en: Ha, they made it. Honestly, I had doubts.

goal.en: Lead the Veligrad fighters to the Flooded Garden and report to Navlod Koshunsky

startText.en:
Have I told you the undead are useless? No?

I'm saying it now. They are dumb. Their brains decomposed while they were in the ground.

But what do we need? We need them to be able to follow simple orders. March in line, for example.

You'll get on that. Go to the ruins and lead a troop from there to the Flooded Garden.

I wonder if two dummies can teach each another anything?

finishText.en: You need to understand: favor for a favor, blood for blood...

goal.en: Discuss with Wigo the terms of a possible alliance with House de Doucer.

startText.en: I hope you understand that you need to find a way to enlist the vampires' help, . Their current leader Wigo de Doucer has been notified of your plans to visit them. He seems to be willing to talk... Be careful and don't blow this chance. I only know that he's arrogant, and you'll have to play up to his ego.

checkText.en: Are you done with my task yet? Don't waste my time!

finishText.en: Excellent. According to the reports I've received, you handled everything. We can get to the real favors now. Remember? Blood for blood...

goal.en: Help the vampires of Amarantha with their problems.

startText.en:
I know everything about my brethren's troubles, but I can't always help them. So you'll handle it, . It's not easy to gain trust. Everyone has their troubles and worries. Listen carefully and remember:

Angie de Doucer is responsible for food supply, and we've had problems with it recently. I'm sure you understand: we need... specific food. She will tell you the details.

Come back to me for another quest when you're done. That is all. You can go.

checkText.en: What about unicorns? Are you done? There's no time.

finishText.en:
They say whoever drinks unicorn blood will be forever cursed... But it can't get any worse for us, can it? Let's see what we have...

Well, that's something... We can consider the experiment successful. I hope the unicorns are alright? I'll analyze the results. You can go.

goal.en: Gather unicorn blood

startText.en:
Finally, some help! As you can probably guess, we have trouble procuring blood.

Where can you get it? From the locals or animals. The locals are not an option, but the animals in the area are all infected, so it won't do either.

We'll have to resort to extreme measures. The Blight is leaving the land, and various creatures are returning. I've seen unicorns nearby, and I'd rather not do it, but...

We'll have to borrow their blood. I'll give you an artifact that will put them into a trance, giving you time to collect some blood, but be careful - if you take too much, I won't be responsible for any side effects!

checkText.en: What took you so long? Here are the tools, go! We have much to do...

finishText.en: Great, we can start tests soon! I hope we all enjoy the results...

goal.en: Help Genevieve de Doucer repair the cloning equipment.

startText.en: Finally! Someone willing to help! I'm very grateful to you. We have a practical task, I've prepared everything. See the cloning equipment? These can still be utilized. They just need to be calibrated. I'll give you the tools and parts, and you'll find the instruction near the equipment. I'm sorry, I don't have time to instruct you - you'll figure it out, I'm sure!

checkText.en: Oh... maybe you could help me?

finishText.en: Oh, a load off my mind! I can finally do something else instead of constantly worrying... Thank you! I'll put this head to use...

goal.en: Help Edward de Doucer with his personal problems

startText.en: Oh, what a mess. Why does this happen to me? My heart can't take this, and I can't even tell anyone...

checkText.en: So have you found out what's going on? I can't sleep because of this...

finishText.en: See? I told you! This is absolutely bizarre... Perhaps we shouldn't tell anyone about this. They'll think we are both crazy. They can't see beyond their nose...

goal.en: Find out where the girl with pies disappears to every night.

startText.en:
So they finally sent someone! You're a professional, right?

Alright, there's no time... Every night, the girl next door goes somewhere... with pies!

Why are you looking at me like that?! Just think about it - a VAMPIRE I'm not acquainted with TAKES PIES into the blighted forest every night!

Look into this. I promise something weird is happening. Wait somewhere nearby until she shows up and follow her discreetly.

finishText.en: That's quite a story... It sounds like vampires are a more of a problem than a solution. At least you found another part of Urd's scroll, which is fortunate... And suspicious. Alright, there's another solution. Talk to me when you are feeling better.

goal.en: Buttress Wigo's authority by eliminating all potential competition.

startText.en:
Let's get to important matters. Here, in our city, no one questions my authority. However, there's a group of Separatists.

When you become a vampire, you change... Why did we follow Armando like lambs? He was our Patriarch... but most importantly, we were unable to disobey. It was part of our new nature. The part that makes us more like animals rather than rational beings. Alas, you can't resist the call for long. A strong vampire will have followers, and they don't need rivals.

Unfortunately, I have those. Marishka, Alira, and Verona - they used to hold powerful positions in our House. Together we escaped to Umoir... and then it turned out we had different views on what our priorities should be. They have their own idea of what they want... I'm afraid there's only one way to deal with this. Kill them all. I could lie to you and say they are bloodthirsty monsters who slaughter people... But it's not true. They are no more monstrous than we are. But you'll have to kill them all if you want an alliance.

You have doubts? You don't want to spill innocent blood? I was like you once. So you have a choice - kill them and form an alliance with me, or spare them - but then Amarantha will not help you. Decide.

finishText.en:
Good, . I'm glad we have nothing to fear from the direction of the Outpost.

But these lands are far from peaceful.

If you start helping people around Clear Valley, they will eventually start trusting you. Trust is very important, as you know.

I can give you new tasks every day, if you show up. So don't forget the old man.

goal.en: Report to Vseslav about the defense of the outskirts.

startText.en:
I assume Clear Valley is safe now.

But my duty to the Queen is to protect her subjects. So even though the threat was eliminated, there's still a lot you can do to help.

Vseslav spends all his time in Clear Valley. I suspect he has new problems every day. It would be great if you could help him.

Go see him and ask what you can do.

finishText.en: You found... the third part of Urd's notes? I really didn't think it would be that... Easy. No, I'm not belittling your efforts, but these lucky coincidences are too suspicious. Fine, I'll need some time to decipher it, and then we'll decide on our next steps.

goal.en: Find the third part of Urd's notes.

startText.en:
Listen to me carefully. I found the source of our problems.

Every time they gathered an army of the undead, the summoner that raised them wasn't the only one commanding them. Someone needs to keep them in check. In the Dead City it was the Dead King, on Gipat - Nihaz's dragons, in Castle Blight - Mor'Ghuun, and here on Umoir - the Xadaganian general, inquisitor, and Urd's shadow.

In short, we need strong and powerful "generals of the dead". At any rate, to accomplish something like this, we'll need the third part of Urd's notes. The Xadaganian arrived at this conclusion on his own, but the required rituals are described in that missing part of the scroll.

I admit we don't know where it is, but we have... an idea. A local wise woman went missing here in the Dale. It's a strange occurrence for a quiet place like this, and she lived in a remote place far away from people. Go there, find her house and try to learn what you can.

checkText.en: Did you do it?

finishText.en: Wonderful! I'm sure it will happen again in a few days, but maybe they'll learn something...

goal.en: Collect 10 books in Amarantha and return them to Philip de Doucer.

startText.en: ! Amarantha needs your help again, but it's a fairly easy task. You see, vampires got too lazy under Wigo's rule. They don't care about personal growth anymore. I'm trying to change that, but it's... difficult. They like to read but I've been unable to make them treat books with respect - they leave them all over the place then have trouble finding them. Collect at least ten of them and bring them here.

checkText.en: What's taking so long? The day will be over before you're done...

finishText.en: Great, the research continues! Just no more questions, please. And don't come here at night. Just in case.

goal.en: Help calibrate the cloning equipment

startText.en: ! Genevieve needs your help this time. I don’t know why it affects the cloning devices, but our magical fields interfere with their operation... So they need to be calibrated daily. Vampires have no patience for that work, but you seem to be doing alright. Genevieve left her tools for you. Report to her once you're done.

checkText.en: How is it doing?

finishText.en: Oh, Edward... He'll never change.

goal.en: Take the gift to Edward's beloved in Clear Valley.

startText.en: I have... an embarrassing request... You already know Edward and his troubles. Fortunately, no one else has tried to entice her away, but he hasn't stopped worrying. Now he wants to send regular gifts to her so she doesn't forget him, and not by mail, but with you! Edward's administrative skills are too valuable to Amarantha, so I hope you will fulfill this strange request.

checkText.en: Where is my blood?!

finishText.en: Yes, another batch! I'll be able to continue my research for another couple of days... Why are you standing there? Go, it's not your business!

goal.en: Gather unicorn blood

startText.en: I know it's not the first time you hear this, but... Angie needs unicorn blood again. I don't know what she's researching but they clearly take more time than we expected... Although, why not? Our situation is not as dire now, and we should be prepared for the future. Here's the amulet, you know the drill. When you have 10 flasks, take them to Angie.

finishText.en: Greetings, hero. You already took an oath and signed an NDA regarding government secrets, so let's skip the bureaucracy. I'll be straight with you. The Empire needs heroes now more than ever! I sense big trouble coming and the only ones who can deal with it are heroes, just like you.

goal.en: Meet with Elizaveta Rysina at Yasker's Tower.

startText.en:
Well then, hero. I don't know what exactly awaits you there, behind the gates of the Dead City, but I'm sure it will be another great feat and a new exciting adventure.
So it's time for you to return home. I can perceive it from the astral motions that something terrible has happened in your lands, and it will take all of your strength to defeat it. May Master's wisdom guide you!

finishText.en: Oh, there you are! Strange things happen in the world after Master fell in the battle against the heroes of Sarnaut... I'm afraid that in slaying him we pushed the world closer to the brink!

goal.en: Meet with Marianne de Ardeur in the church at the Novograd square.

startText.en:
Well then, hero. I don't know what exactly awaits you there, behind the gates of the Dead City, but I'm sure it will be another great feat and a new exciting adventure.
So it's time for you to return home. I can perceive it from the astral motions that something terrible has happened in your lands, and it will take all of your strength to defeat it. May Master's wisdom guide you!

checkText.en:
A fish's splash, a wolf's leap.
A hiss of rain, a stomp of feet.
A howl of wind, an ocean's croon.
Nothing is eternal under the moon!

finishText.en: Kug quag, wingless one! You've brought a good shell. Pure, smooth, big. The potion is very strong, it can turn a regular jar into sand in a heartbeat. Only a pure pearl, born in saltwater, tempered in a roaring storm, warmed by hot sun, may hold the magic elixir.

goal.en: Find a giant oyster shell, capable of containing a Cycling Potion, and bring it to Elchana at Kahlua Island.

startText.en:
I made a special potion to speak with spirits. Whoever wants to talk to them should help me. Spirits talk only about hardships, so we won't bother them for nothing!
The Potion is prepared according to an ancient recipe. A hundred moons waned and waxed a hundred times, since we found out about the power of four! They keep us safe and protect our people, but talk only to the witch. I don't care whether the seeker of spirits wears white feathers or red. This is no man's land, there must be no squabbles!
The Potion needs a special vessel – a big shell. Very big! Find the shell and bring it to me, I'll make a potion.

checkText.en:
Hot wind with briar
Smells like an open prairie...
Wash with a cold wave
A hand that spills blood!

finishText.en: Yes! I sense the power of four elements behind you. Spirits await you!

goal.en: Collect 5 sea creature scales, 5 handfuls of fertile soil, 5 bird feathers and 2 drops of enemy blood, and bring them to Elchana at Kahlua Island.

startText.en:
While you were looking for a vessel, I did some prepping – I boiled tinctures, evaporated them, mixed the resulting extract with rare decoction. But the spirit seeker must get the last component. Listen and remember!
It shall be just like a sea creature, slithering in the ocean, fed by water.
It shall be like a free-spirited bird, circling in the air, carried by wind.
It shall be like soft clay, hard as a rock and porous like sand, fed by earth.
And enemy's hot blood must wash the hand of the one whose heart burns with untamed fire!
You should collect all four symbols of elements. Don't buy, trade, or receive them as gifts. Get them yourself. Only then the spirits may hear your request.

checkText.en:
Hot wind with briar
Smells like an open prairie...
Wash with a cold wave
A hand that spills blood!

finishText.en: Yes! I sense power of four elements behind you. Spirits await you!

goal.en: Collect 5 sea monster scales, 5 handfuls of fertile soil, 5 sea bird feathers, 2 drops of enemy's blood and bring them to Elchana on Kahlua Island.

startText.en:
While you were looking for a vessel, I did some prepping – I boiled tinctures, evaporated them, mixed the resulting extract with a rare decoction. But the last component must be gathered by the spirit seeker. So, listen and remember!
It shall be just like a sea creature, slithering in the ocean, fed by water.
It shall be like a free-spirited bird, circling in the air, carried by wind.
It shall be like soft clay, hard as a rock and porous like sand, fed by earth.
And enemy's hot blood must wash the hand of the one whose heart burns with untamed fire!
You should collect all four symbols of elements. Don't buy, trade, or receive them as gifts. Get them yourself. Only then the spirits may hear your request.

checkText.en: Night spawns are dangerous. They come deep at night and leave neither feathers nor bones of careless fools, but bring no harm to cautious sages!

finishText.en: Good. Fire's burning and eternally hungry spawn of night returns to its lair. Nothing can interrupt the ritual.

goal.en: Ignite ritual torches erected on Kahlua Island, then return to Elchana.

startText.en:
Al khakar tugat! Kuratag tak maggar! Cough... I sense darkness, Son of the Wind! Terrible darkness from eternal void. It follows you with hungry eyes, smells your scent, craves your body. Umm-tala... I know what to do!
Darkness is afraid of the sacred flame. Like a bonfire in the night that protects a hunter from wild beasts, so will fire above the altar protect you from the night's spawn. You will ignite the sacred flame at altars, and it will protect you during the ritual. Go!

checkText.en: Did you catch the requested animals?

finishText.en: Good. To be honest, I did not believe that this ripped sack I gave you still worked. I wanted to throw it away... Anyway, now we can continue the ritual!

goal.en: Catch a Stout Tapir, a Sharp-toothed Moray, a Giant Albatross and a Bloodthirsty Sundew with a magic sack and bring them to Elchana as sacrifices to elemental spirits.

startText.en:
Al khakar tugat! Kuratag tak maggar! Khamaz tak karrak!
Tuar kra durrat! Sakhat khamar ulkrat!
...
Spirits don't want to talk to you, wingless one. You smell of a foreign land. You were not born winged and spirits don't trust you. But do not despair! Spirits are strict, but I know what to do. We will give them sacrifices! Just as good presents soften even the strictest judge, so will good sacrifices soften even the most vicious spirits.
I'll give you a magic sack, which can hold more than you could think. You will find a sacrifice, stuff it in the sack and bring it to me. I will take the sacrifice out of the sack and offer it to spirits. Then spirits will be satisfied and agree to speak to you.

checkText.en: Oh... my aching bones!

finishText.en: But we have won! It was long ago when the spirits last responded to my call. I was very young and dumb chick and almost died. You are a strong warrior and spirits respect you.

goal.en: Protect the witch while she performs the ritual.

kickText.en: You are such a klutz, you couldn't even protect me!

startText.en:
Al khakar tugat! Kuratag tak maggar! Sakhat khamar ulkrat!
Ktatak ulu graa! Kugar! Kotar! Ko-karr!
...
I sense spirits, Son of the Wind. They hurry to my call. And they are furious! Terribly furious! But you should not be afraid! Elements are always willful and threatening. They don't like it when a mortal calls to them. Storm crushes a rock, wave washes away the city, fire burns a forest, and earth shakes and destroys the strongest fortress. But the wise are always more powerful than elements. They can subdue an element, make it serve them, like fire burning in hearth, water irrigating fields, wind rotating mill blades, and earth producing grain. If you tame a young elemental spirit, a mature spirit will speak with you.
They are already near. They want my blood and flesh. They want to rip apart an old dumb witch who challenge them. But you are strong, you can protect me, tame a young spirit and receive a blessing from every element!

finishText.en: Quarr, outlander. I heard about your deeds. Do you wish to receive power of elements?

goal.en: Enter the Cave of Elements located under the waterfalls, and meet with the wise Kutal Silver-Tongued.

startText.en:
Now you have the right to enter our sacred cave, Kotal-Khoorlan, where spirits of elements live. Kutal, an old wise aviak, will meet you there. You will receive blessing from caves for your people and obtain power of the elements for yourself. Only the Chosen One may enter our cave and obtain true power!
The cave will have incarnations of all four elements: fire, water, wind, and earth. Touch them and you'll obtain great power. Hurry! Old Kutal does not like to be kept waiting.

checkText.en: The waterfalls sang me your name, mortal creature...

finishText.en: Was your travel easy? A thirst led you here... Thirst for power, might and glory? Or some other thirst that cannot be quenched even by waterfalls?

goal.en: Pass all of Wind Master's trials and meet Sea Master at the Isle of Singing Water.

startText.en:
You were sssuccesssful at finding thisss place. I sssenssse your ressstless, freedom-loving sssoul. You will have my blesssing as sssoon as you passs all my trialsss!
If you sssucceed, your path will take you to the Isle of Sssinging Water. My brother, the Sssea Massster, lives there. He will guide you further on your difficult journey.

checkText.en: I'll twissst you... I'll sssmite you...

finishText.en: Ha... You were able to complete my tasssk. Not bad for a wingless one. Perhapsss the old witch wasss not wrong about you...

goal.en: Collect 10 giant feathers from albatrosses who live among the cliffs, then bring them to Sea Master at the Seven-Winds Cliff.

startText.en:
You want my blesssing, don't you? Then I would like to tessst you!
There are giant albatrosses among the cliffsss. These are powerful birdsss, capable of ripping to piecesss those who are weak of body. They are born of the wind. The wind isss their life, flesh and blood... Can you overcome these predatory birdsss? Will you cower before precipitousss cliffsss? Will your head grow dizzy from their heightsss? We shall sssee...
Get me albatross feathersss. Thisss will be your firssst trial!

checkText.en: I am waiting, mortal...

finishText.en: You were able to sssurvive the fury of a ssstorm... Good! The sssecond trial isss complete!

goal.en: Trap Breeze blowing through the atoll into the Wind Catcher's Bag and release a storm at the top of the Seven-Winds Cliff. Report to the Wind Master about the task completion.

name.en: Whoever Sows the Wind Shall Reap a Storm

startText.en:
Hear my sssecond tasssk, mortal.
Have you heard the legend about the wind catcher? There isss an old proverb... Whoever sssows the wind shall reap a ssstorm! And that'sss not a joke. Wind isss born free and isss difficult to catch... And to keep it isss imposssible!
Take my bag. You can capture in it a young and ssstupid breeze that blowsss through thisss island. But don't even hope to hold it long. Hurry to the top of the cliff and releassse the foolish wind... and you will sssee how powerful even the weakessst wind isss, if you trap it!

checkText.en: An old horssse won't spoil the harvest. Isssn't it what you mortalsss sssay?

finishText.en: I heard the horn. You have the valor and courage of the giantsss. Let Kean the Thunder-Roar ressst in peaccce - the lassst echo of hisss horn will forever be carried by the wind. You completed your trial!

goal.en: Slay the giant living at the Seven-Winds Cliff and blow the horn, then return to the Wind Master.

startText.en:
Here isss the third trial that I am tasssking you with. The mossst difficult!
An old giant livesss here, on the cliff. Hisss name isss Kean the Thunder-Roar, and every morning the sssound of hisss war horned, proclaiming my glory, can be heard above the sssea. But hisss time long hasss passed, and he wishesss for death... It isss not right for sssuch a powerful creature to die from old age. Giantsss like him mussst die like warriorsss, with weapon in hand!
Climb to the top of the cliff and challenge the giant. If you can ssslay him in battle, blow hisss horn, proclaiming my glory, and you shall receive my blessing!

checkText.en: Boom! And only feathers flew! It was beautiful...

finishText.en: I heard a boom from here. Anarchists will not be the same for a while. Excellent work! I will tell the whole guild about your deed and prowess!

goal.en: Burn the anarchists' forge, warehouse, headquarters, kitchen and barracks on the Freedom Island, blow up 70 anarchist aviaks and then report your success to Cha Pie-Pie in the Steel Claw village.

startText.en:
Quarr, Son of Heavens! I heard you know how to handle a squawker. Then I have a task for you.

Wingless people know how to make boom powder! Very loud boom! Have you ever deal with such powder, Son of Heavens? Kulgar kutar! Very well!
People of Heavens can fly, but are afraid of boom. Wingless is not afraid of boom, but cannot fly. Son of Heavens can ride a squawker and is not afraid of boom. So you can help us.
There is camp of foolish aviaks on Freedom Island. They call themselves anarchists. They are pain in the butt! They build forge, make weapons, and rob the Steel Claw. Brazen anarchist!
I'll give you a squawker. A squawker can fly to Freedom Island. I will tie sacks with boom powder to the squawker, so that you can drop sacks on stupid anarchist heads. Boom! And only feathers remain from anarchist! Son of Heavens will make a great deed!

checkText.en: Boom! And only feathers fly! Beautiful...

finishText.en: I heard boom from here. Anarchist not recover soon. Excellent!

goal.en: Burn anarchists' forge, warehouse, headquarters, kitchen and barracks on the Freedom Island, explode 70 anarchist aviaks and then report your success to Karrok Stout-Hearted in the Glittering Wing village.

startText.en:
Quarr, Son of Heavens! I heard you know how to handle a squawker. Then I have a task for you.

Wingless people know how to make boom powder! Very loud boom! Have you ever deal with such powder, Son of Heavens? Kulgar kutar! Very well!
People of Heavens can fly, but are afraid of boom. Wingless is not afraid of boom, but cannot fly. Son of Heavens can ride a squawker and is not afraid of boom. So you can help us.
There is camp of foolish aviaks on Freedom Island. They call themselves anarchists. They are pain in the butt! They build forge, make weapons, and rob the Steel Claw. Brazen anarchist!
I'll give you a squawker. A squawker can fly to Freedom Island. I will tie sacks with boom powder to the squawker, so that you can drop sacks on stupid anarchist heads. Boom! And only feathers remain from anarchist! Son of Heavens will make a great deed!

checkText.en: Khar kual... It is always cold in the afterlife...

finishText.en: An outlander returned bones... Good outlander. Ungrateful descendants completely forgot about this grave... An outlander took care of the grave... What is the world coming to?

goal.en: Take away the aviak shaman's bones from the leopards living on the Copper Isle and return them to his grave.

startText.en:
Quarr... Outlander...
Narri was my name... I died not long ago... Descendants do not take care of my grave at all. Wild beasts dig up the grave and steal bones. It weakens me a lot... My spirit's strong, but my body's d decaying... Please return me my bones and put them back in my grave... My spirit will become stronger and I'll finally rest in peace. I'll be very grateful... A good reward I'll give...

checkText.en: Without a silver eye, I'm merely a blind chicken...

finishText.en: Now Narri can see again! And take care of my people...

goal.en: Find 2 silver coins in bird nests and return them to Narri, the shaman's ghost on the Copper Isle.

startText.en:
I ask you outlander one more favor... People of the Wind have a tradition – to give silver eyes to dead, that is to cover eyes with two silver coins. Silver is pure, magic... Cough... Silver eyes will see through darkness of ages... The old shaman's spirit will protect the people of the Wind from sudden troubles. The spirit will come to young shaman in dreams and alert him of trouble... When the young shaman dies, he'll take Narri's place...
Wild beasts dug up the grave... Cough... Dumb birds stole silver eyes... Stole both eyes... I cannot see anymore... I became blind... I cannot foresee troubles without my silver eyes... A young shaman is healthy. He won't die for a long time... No one can foresee troubles...
Will you help me?.. Help the people of the Wind... Return silver eyes!

checkText.en: Defenseless golem... all efforts for naught...

finishText.en: Good reward... Little remains...

goal.en: Collect 30 beautiful albatross feathers, 5 giant pearls and one giant crab shell. Return them to Narri, the shaman's ghost on the Copper Isle.

startText.en:
I ask you outlander one more favor... Cough... It's not important... And yet it's very important!
Let's talk about graves... A totem protected the grave. It scared wild beasts, greedy birds, and evil spirits away... But the totem won't work anymore. The grave's almost in disrepair. Wild beasts steal bones again; dumb birds steal eyes again... Very bad... Do you outlander want a reward? If only you refresh the totem... collect feathers, sea moon, and a beautiful shell...to make a new totem. A powerful totem! Cough...
The totem will protect the grave... Scare away wild beasts...

checkText.en: I see... I see far...

finishText.en:
Outlander... Listen to what old Narri has to say...
I see two betrayals... One from an enemy... One from a friend...
The enemy has already betrayed you... If you don't see it coming... I cannot tell what would happen... It's dark and chaotic... Cough...
And the second betrayal will happen... From a friend... It will be sudden... You'll see it, but it will be too late... A strange betrayal... It can be for the worse or for the better... Everything's in your hands... Cough...
Now you should leave... I'll be finally at peace...

goal.en: Repair the shaman's grave on the Copper Isle and receive your reward.

startText.en:
You did everything... Cough... Found bones... Returned eyes... Collected totem gifts... You're good. I'm grateful. I'll look into future... Cough...
You will repair the grave now while I'm looking into the future. If there's a trouble, I'll warn you outlander...
This is not a complete reward yet... Shamans are always laid to rest with good stuff, though they are useless in the afterlife! You can take anything you like.. And I'll look...

checkText.en: Listen carefully, I don't have time to yack with you. There are still plenty of wounded to care for.

finishText.en: So this is what's happening with gibberlings... Looks like the other ships of our squadron had no chance of making it. Oh well. The Empire is where its soldiers are. We'll persevere! It ain't our first time!

goal.en: Ask Maxim Verevkin about what happened.

startText.en:
It's the end of the road for your cap'n. He suffered enough, poor bastard. The mast fell right on his head. Only a bloody spot remained on the deck. You also had your share, I see. A corpse in a coffin looks better than you.
So, listen. While you are pulling yourself together, I'll tell you what's going on. My name is Maxim Verevkin. I am the first mate on Vlad - the flagship of our strike squadron of the first Imperial Navy. Former flagship, that is to say. Only a wreck remains of our ship, the first to enter the wormhole. But all the other ships... not even a trace of them. Haven't seen losses like this since... well, ever!

checkText.en: Whoa! Who bit you like that? Morays? There is no rest from them!

finishText.en: So have you managed to chase morays away? Excellent! Now we can walk in shallow waters without fear of losing our feet. By the way, don't forget to take care of your wounds. Morays' teeth may contain all sorts of things. You may even get some disease from their bite.

goal.en: Exterminate 10 morays eels around the shipwreck site and report to Melor Luzhin.

startText.en:
Tropics... I hate tropics! Just look at the local sea - the predators are all piled up on top of one another! Truly, this is no tropical atoll. The worst I saw was this enormous fish with finger-length teeth! If a beast like that grabs hold of your leg, get ready to limp for the rest of your life. I only saw them before in pictures. Gibberlings call them morays.
I fear that these beasts will start feasting on us... Chase them away! Morays have a cowardly reputation, so if you manage to kill ten of them, the rest will learn to keep their distance.

checkText.en: There's plenty of local fauna... There are 15 types of mosquitoes alone. And all these bastards bite!

finishText.en: Wow, my sextant! Thank you very much. I'll try to take measurements again, but I think it is futile. It looks like this place contradicts all known laws of astralo-physics.

goal.en: Take away the stolen sextant from the impudent crab and return it to Maxim Verevkin at the shipwreck site.

startText.en:
Hey... I don't feel comfortable bothering you, but there is nobody else to ask. Most people are still not themselves or extremely busy. Anyway, somewhere in this area I lost my sextant. It's this thing to measure angles and positioning in the Astral. I was using it to calculate the angle of the fall and determine the wormhole's exit location. I made my measurements, put the sextant on the barrel, turned my back to record the results, and lo and behold, the sextant was gone! I only saw some crab running toward the nearest stone. Perhaps that bastard stole my sextant! It is shiny and crabs like shiny objects.
Help me out, find me the sextant, what do you say? I will be in your debt! Being a navigator without a sextant is like being without hands.

checkText.en: Well, have you managed to save anyone?

finishText.en: Great! That was my last ration of mirra. I dread a trip to the Purgatory without it.

goal.en: Find 10 surviving sailors in shallow waters and the missing bosun, then report your success to Anna Borzukina.

startText.en:
So, what do we have here? Hold still, let me take a look!
Swelling, bruises, scrapes. No sprains or fractures. That means you are going to be just fine. And since you are healthy, then you can certainly perform nurse's duties!
What? No, no need to take care of bedpans. You need to save those that still can be saved. After they hit the ground, people fell overboard like bowling pins! Many could have survived. That's why I want you, and others who are still able to move, to search and rescue the fortunate ones.
Also, it would be nice to find a surviving officer. A bosun, for example. I recall that a huge orc was a bosun on this ship. He was rude and impudent. Always wanted to pick a fight with me. Even a shipwreck would not have hurt such a hard-headed cretin too much!

finishText.en: Quarr, wingless one! You wear red feathers, I see. That means you're also a Red Avenger!

goal.en: Meet Ian Down-and-Out on the Isle of Singing Water.

startText.en:
Gold is a sacred metal for aviaks. White aviaks try to hide gold from Steel Claw. Warriors catch up with white aviaks and fight! Many white aviaks were killed, but a glorious victory did not help us in finding gold. Damned monarchist hid gold. Gold is for everyone, it must belong to all laborers, not to a few white exploiters!
Last battle occurred at the Isle of Singing Water. And the map points to that isle! White tyrants probably hid gold on that island. If Red Avengers find gold, it would be a great deed. Proletariat will have high morale and happily fight in the name of revolution!
Son of the Wind should go to Ian. Ian is also a Red Avenger. He scouts the Isle of Singing Water. You will easily find him. He will come to you when he sees your red feathers!

checkText.en: So, what is it? Sorry, I am too busy right now to talk. I need to tend to wounded.

finishText.en:
What? Someone put an arrow into our bosun's haunch? Wow... And this is the arrow, as I understand? Familiar plumage...
You know, taiga owls, whose feather were used in this plumage, live only in Siveria. This means that someone from the League shot this arrow. Looks like my theory that the shipwreck somehow involves the League just got its first confirmation!

goal.en: Bring the broken arrow to Maxim Verevkin at the shipwreck site.

startText.en:
Ooh... Am I really alive? Cool! Cough, cough... I thought, this is it, the end!
Why the end? Because some treacherous bastard shot an arrow at my back, got it?! Almost croaked!
Anyway, we got hit pretty good. As soon as I came to life, everything was burning, smoking and crackling. I knew I had to hightail outta there before some beam came crashing on my head. So I got out and ran... I mean, for help. And then I spotted some fella behind those bushes looking at me. I motioned him to run... for help. But as soon as I turned, he shot me in the back... well... slightly below my back! I looked at my back and saw plumage. I only had time to grab the arrow and pull it out along with an arrowhead. And then dropped like an autumn leaf. Hurts, damn him!
But we, orcs, are a hearty race; it takes more than one arrow to bring us down, ha! As soon as I came round, I saw you...
Hey, have you seen the rat that shot me in the back? I'd shove that bow and quiver right in that bastard's throat! Ooh, just look where he shot me! I didn't even see clearly who it was. Maybe he wasn't even human at all. Hell knows who lives on this island!
Hey, go to the active commander and give him the remnants of this arrow. Maybe the two of you can figure out who was bold enough to hide behind the bushes with a bow and shoot Imperial soldiers in the back!

finishText.en:
Greetings, warrior. Why are you breathing so heavily? Were you galloping all the way from the shore?
Oh, you are from that recent shipwreck? My condolences... Today we all mourn our losses. As I understand, Verevkin sent you to us.
...
So, directly shot in the back? Oh my... Looks like the League's handiwork, indeed!
On behalf of the army commander, I give you our gratitude!

goal.en: Meet political commissar Leonid Brelin at the Imperial Camp near Rumbling Bay.

startText.en:
Here is the order. Listen up! You will go to the surviving senior political commissar, Brelin. You will report to him details about the crash, the attack on our soldier, and that I've identified the arrow as belonging to League scouts. I don't want to hear any buts!
The political officer is leading the construction of a temporary camp. He will be happy to have extra hands there. Since you are shipwrecked, and your captain is gone with the ship, you will come under command of a superior officer. From now on, we can consider ourselves at war! That is all! Run!

checkText.en: Were you able to find evidence of the League's presence?

finishText.en: Aha, I knew you could do it! The map? I'll take a look.

goal.en: Find evidence of the League's presence on the Copper Isle and report the accomplished mission to Igor Kalinin in the Rumbling Bay settlement.

startText.en:
Greetings. I have an important task for you! The task, so to speak, is of governmental importance!
Your efforts to initiate contact with our potential allies is very commending, but let's not forget about our main mission. We cannot allow the League to secure a strategic advantage over the Empire. The standoff is only gaining steam here. And our mission is to strike first!
Unfortunately, the initiative right now belongs to the opponent. I heard from commander Cha Pie-Pie that the enemy was detected in close proximity to our site. I think there is a threat of a sudden attack on our camp. But I am sure that the Empire will retake the initiative and turn things around.
You are very well acquainted with this region, so I will assign you to a recon mission. Therefore, on behalf of the Committee, I am ordering you to scout a location near the Copper Isle, where the enemy was detected, and make every effort to determine the size of enemy forces.

checkText.en: How goes the propaganda campaign? I tried to remember all of the slogans that I learned at political science workshops.

finishText.en: So they read the leaflets? Did they understand their content? I just saw with my own eyes some young bird attempt to make a scout's cap out of the leaflet!

goal.en: Distribute 10 leaflets to the aviaks in Steel Claw village and report the accomplishment to Nadia Krupina.

startText.en:
Greetings. I heard that you were able to find a common ground with aviaks and even gain some renown as the hero who saved the deputy of the red commander himself? Excellent. Then you are just the right person to drill the main postulates of our ideology into the chicken brains of these savages. Imagine it, they don't want to listen to me! All they do is chirp behind my back: "that chick ain't no bird." The nerve of them!
Brelin personally ordered me to conduct propaganda to representatives of friendly nations. I am a navigator, not a propagandist! But, I can't argue with superiors. If they want you to do it, then you must. But what can I do if the aviaks don't even want to read the leaflets I had spend the whole night working on?
Well? Will you help me find a common ground with these winged creatures? Distribute the leaflets to them and ask them to read at their leisure. They trust you and probably will comply with your request!

checkText.en: There's no rest for us - we will burn but survive... Is that how it goes? If you burn, you will not live. If you burn, you will become charred meat, get no rest!

finishText.en: Good feather! Durable, long, beautiful. Only it's white. White Avenger... that can't be right. Hold on, let me think...

goal.en: Collect 12 feathers of carnivorous albatrosses living at Rumbling Bay and bring them to Danick Break-Neck.

startText.en:
Quarr, Son of Heavens! I heard about you from Leck. Leck is my best friend! He told me a lot about your heroism. He told me that you saved Leck, risked your own life. Son of the Wind is a true hero! Such hero has place among Red Avengers!
What, wingless one never heard of Red Avengers? How can it be? The leaflet that wingless female gave us was about Red Avengers. It was about a group of young wingless people who fought damned monarchists. We also fight monarchists! White aviaks are our main enemy and oppressor of honest hard-working folk!
For now, there'll be three of us. Do you, Son of the Wind, want to be the fourth? You must want to be an elusive Red Avenger, yes? We also want to raid enemy camps, rob their caravans and beat up enemies wherever we see them! Just like in leaflets.
There's only one problem... A Red Avenger must have red feathers. It is a distinguishing sign of our squad! But the Son of the Wind is wingless, no feathers at all, not even small ones. That's bad... You must wear feathers. If you can't grow your own, no problem. There's many big albatrosses around Rumbling Bay. Albatross feathers are almost as beautiful as the aviak's. Collect albatross feathers and become a true Red Avenger!

checkText.en: Did you bring red feathers? Red is the color of victory! Red is the color of our victory over white monarchists and tyrants!

finishText.en:
Good feathers! Red as blood!
You can now wear red feathers and kill white monarchists. Red Avengers will spread our great red revolution on every island!

goal.en: Dip albatross feathers into the blood of killed animals to make them red and return to Danick Break-Neck in the Steel Claw village in Rumbling Bay.

name.en: Red Is the Color of Victory!

startText.en:
Think! Think how to make white feathers red!
Red is the color of blood. If you dip white feathers in blood, they will become red. And if you whisper right words, beast's spirit will enter feathers. The old shaman always said that word, since I was a tiny egg. It was a very powerful word, so powerful that all spirits fled from it. Even skittish females plugged their ears. That is how powerful that word was! The word is: "Taggar takkar ukh kurruk over kurrak into kagar, turluk kurlad." I don't know what it means. But it probably works!
You should find the beast. Not a weak beast, only a strong one, with a strong spirit and a hot blood. Then you should dip feathers into the blood of the killed beast, speak the word to enchant the spirit. I can make a beautiful crown from the enchanted feathers. You'll wear that red crown and become a true Red Avenger!

checkText.en: Will you, Son of the Wind, join Red Avengers? Marvelous! Now we'll defeat all enemies!

finishText.en: Wow, so many weapons... So sharp and shiny... Now Red Avengers will defeat all enemies!

goal.en: Collect 7 trophy blades, 7 hammers and 20 arrows on the Rumbling Bay battlefield, and bring everything to Xia Break-Neck.

startText.en:
We need to find good weapons to fight. But we only have hunting spears, light bows with two arrows for three of us. How do we fight without weapons? Peck monarchists to death with our beaks? Well, we could... a true red warrior can use his bare wing to drive enemy into the ground. But it is much more convenient to crack their heads with hammers! Bang! - and only feathers fly!
We need to find weapons. And I know just where to find plenty of weapons! There was a huge battle at the edge of this bay! Our glorious red army detected and destroyed the damned white aviak brigade. We took trophies, as much as we could carry, but a great many remained there! My sister Xia went there to collect weapons, but she's weak and cannot bring a lot of them back. You are strong and you can carry many weapons. We'll use white aviak weapons against them! Whatever you find, bring to Xia. Bring hammers, swords and arrows to Xia. We'll use everything!

checkText.en: Did Son of the Wind chase away a scary dwarf?

finishText.en:
What a weird map... It was not drawn by an outlander! It was drawn by an aviak. Damned white monarchists! It's their map.
I understand! The map shows the location of a treasure. A treasure in a sacred chest. A chest with gold bricks!

goal.en: Destroy the Elven necromancer and his servants, find out what they were searching for in Rumbling Bay, and return to Xia Break-Neck.

startText.en:
You brought weapons just in time. I saw a strange creature nearby. It's very-very strange, I've never seen someone like this. A small wicked creature with a crate on the back, that stinks like a dead monkey who has not washed for ten moons before the death! Wicked dwarves are searching for something, very thoroughly. And they all take orders from a tall strange outlander. That outlander looks like you wingless one, but not exactly the same. That outlander has wings, though they are small and frail, and he cannot fly. He orders dwarves to dig the ground, so they dig it here and there, searching for something. As I fly high, they didn't notice me. Those dwarves are stupid, but evil and stinky.
Now Red Avengers have weapons and can defend ourselves, but we need to chase the dwarves away. Far away! Will you do it? Will you chase away the dwarves and the outlander for us?

checkText.en: I need this information to compare the coordinates I know with the entrance coordinates of the wormhole. I can then draw a certain conclusion whether there are any differences or not.

finishText.en:
Aha, there are the coordinates. Let's see now...
How odd! The data do not match any of my theories! Such disposition is simply impossible.
Were the coordinates accurately recorded? Do you guarantee that there are no errors? Hmm... Very well, let's try to correlate data...

goal.en: Measure coordinates with the astrolabe at five locations near the Isle of Singing Water and the Irdrich shore. Return to Yasskul Naboo with the results.

startText.en:
So, Igor Kalinin sent you? And may I ask what the Committee requires of me? Just help? Pardon me if I don't believe it. I have an assistant to lug equipment from place to place and you cannot make the required calculations anyway. Well, if Kalinin wants to send his own trusted man to monitor my research, so be it. But know this: since you are now my assistant, I will not give you any slack!
That idiot I sent to measure coordinates with the astrolabe went missing, while data is needed right now. So, assistant, here is the astrolabe and a marked up map where you need to record measurements. Taking measurements is simple: stand in the indicated spot, guide the astrolabe pointer to the most outstanding reference point, say Giant's Claw, look through the viewer and record the number that you see. As I said - simple!
That's all. Now go, record measurements, and come back soon. We still have many things to do!

checkText.en: Have you already caught monkeys? No? Then you must hurry. Our enemy never sleeps!

finishText.en: Five monkeys? Not so many... Oh well, I think that'll be enough.

goal.en: Catch 5 Greedy Monkeys with a lasso and drag them to Ian Down-and-Out on the Isle of Singing Water.

startText.en:
Your help is just in time! I found a camp on this island full of damned white enemies! And there's another wingless outlander with them, not the Imperial one. They are looking for something. The whole island is dug up.
Xia says they be are looking for gold. That very gold that we took from the white monarchists, then lost, then obtained again and lost again? Four times it passed from claws to claws? Then I understand!
Red Avengers must recoup gold. But there are only two of us against many white enemies!
I think of using a very old trick. It is called the "mad monkey." Do you know such trick? Neither does the white enemy! To awe the enemy is the first step towards victory!
First, you must catch monkeys. You'll need quite many of them since they quickly spoil.
Here is a lasso. I'll show you how to catch the monkeys easily.

checkText.en: Damned white monarchists want a war? Then they'll get it!

finishText.en: There is enough sulfur to blow all the whites and the outlander to smithereens!

goal.en: Collect 5 Hollow Bamboo Stems and 5 Sulfuric Stones and bring everything to Ian Down-and-Out on the Isle of Singing Water.

startText.en:
We have a monkey. Now let's make this monkey amazing! So that the enemy will be amazed and left aghast. Do you think a big bang will awe the enemy? Me too. So we will make a bang.
Many moons ago, wise Cluck Golden-Heart invented this entertainment - he filled a hollow tube with the sulfur powder and ignited it. The tube flew very high, higher than any aviak could, and shone like a bright star. We call it a firecracker. And then his dumb assistant Tun One-Legged forgot to make a hole in the firecracker for fire... That's how Tun One-Legged became legless. It exploded just like a real taq taggar! Do you understand my idea?
Bamboo grows here in abandance. Bamboo stems are hollow inside. There is a plenty of sulfuric stones here as well. Fill the bamboo stem with the ground sulfuric stone, plug it in both ends of tube and ignite - kaboom!
Why do we need a monkey? Kul ktar, you will soon find out.

checkText.en: Outlander! Stop! I want to talk to you!

finishText.en:
I'll give you a ring, a good one. Don't hit me, OK?
My name's Klesk. Klesk Dare-Devil. And I'm not from the Glittering Wing tribe! My disguise fooled you, just like it fooled many others. It's a good disguise!

goal.en: Blow up 30 aviaks using monkeys with firecrackers, then find a chest with gold.

name.en: Like a Monkey with a Grenade

startText.en:
Monkey... Check... Firecracker... Check... Time to make a big bang!
So, why monkeys? Who do you think will throw firecrackers at the camp? I cannot fly, as white bastards are sharpshooters! So long as you run with the firecracker, ignite and throw it, you'll become like a porcupine. I know that you are a brave warrior, but why banging your head on the rock when you can go around it?
I will fasten a firecracker to a monkey. The monkey will go mad from the flaming firecracker and run into the enemy camp, If we release the monkey near it! And then, kaboom! Instead of the wicked white aviaks, you'll have plucked chickens!
Half the camp will blow up sky high, the other half will obviously forget about searching for gold. Then we'll calmly enter the camp and get what we've come for. It's as easy as pie. If we find the chest, it will be a great feat. All Red Avengers will become heroes!
Just be careful, wingless one. If a monkey explodes near you, you will learn to fly. Without any wings!

checkText.en: Did you find gold?

finishText.en:
What?! Gold is lost forever? How can it be... It's a sacred metal! Through many generations only a true chief could own this gold. It was simple - whoever had the chest of gold, he called himself chief. Even I could call me chief if I took gold from the whites! Now what kind of chief am I? I am Ian Down-and-Out, and I'll always be...
Oh well. If the reds cannot get gold, at least the whites will not get it either. Maybe it's for the better!

goal.en: Throw the chest into the Astral and tell Ian Down-and-Out on the isle of Singing Water that gold was not found.

startText.en:
You do not know our history and our culture. You are called Son of the Wind, but you still do not understand our people!
Gold is evil! You don't know how many good aviaks died for this wretched metal. Only a fool considers gold sacred. It is not sacred, but cursed!
There have been four battles over it. The white aviaks chased away the red, then the reds took it away from the whites, the whites slayed the reds, and the reds avenged. Blood flows freely for the sake of useless yellow metal. The war for the sake of gold is a mindless war, outlander. The war is always merciless. But when a brother fight against his brother, a son against his father, it is the most terrible mindless war! This war has no winner. Everyone is a loser!
If you wish our people well, then you must destroy gold. Throw it into the great emptiness! No gold, no stupid fight for yellow metal. To fight for freedom, for your people, for your tribe - that will be good. Fighting for gold is really bad!
If you are smart and noble, then throw that gold into the great emptiness right now. And tell those greedy reds that gold is lost forever. I'll tell the whites the same. Then there will be less reason to go to war!

checkText.en: So where are my long-awaited samples? My work is at a standstill without them!

finishText.en: So, I have living and dead matter. It would be nice to acquire matter from demons living in the local Astral, but without ships it is impossible. Except by slitting the throat of some dumb assistant in the name of science and baiting demons with their blood.

goal.en: Collect 5 eggs and stones warped by the Astral, and return to Yasskul Naboo on the Isle of Singing Water.

startText.en:
I have one hypothesis that may explain a lot. However, due to outdated measuring equipment and extremely large tolerances that I cannot reduce... Anyway, we will have to work just like in the old times, using any means available. Purely theoretically it is possible to identify some properties of the Astral that surrounds Irdrich indirectly, i.e. by its influence on matter.
Don't worry, you won't have to jump into the Astral. But, I must admit, that would have been an interesting experiment and even somewhat amusing for me, albeit not terribly productive. Therefore, you will still have to toil in the name of science and collect research material.
At the shore, where the Astral contacts hard matter, you may find minerals subjected to its erosive impact. While the albatross living near the shore are not warped, their eggs were likely impacted by the astral. So if you can collect ten warped minerals and eggs, then I can make some initial conclusions. I can find a reference point that may turn our understanding of the Astral upside down...

checkText.en: Hello, what are you doing here? I am kind of busy with important research!

finishText.en: What? No, I could not have sent you for any samples! I am a microbiologist. I deal with bacteria! You know: small, wonderful bacteria that can be seen only under a microscope. Do you have a microscope? Of course you don't. I possess the only working microscope. Moreover, I've never seen you before in my life. And if this is just Kalinin checking up on me, then I don't have time for such nonsense!

goal.en: Measure the activity of the mentioned animals that live on Irdrich and return to Yasskul Naboo on the Isle of Singing Water with results.

startText.en:
While I will deal with your collected samples, I have a new task for you. Not a complex one, but rather nauseating. It befits you, ha ha.
See this thing? It is an intelligent Magic Activity Coefficient meter, abbreviated as iMAC. This device is simple as a brick and reliable as a hammer. However, this bastard is expensive! Thankfully, the Empire spares no expense in the name of science!
Anyway, take the iMAC and record measurements of magic activity of Irdrich's fauna. The process is really simple. Point the iMAC towards an animal, press this button on the top lid, and voila! Measure every animal you manage to catch. The more information, the easier it is to draw a conclusion.
That is all. Now go and don't interrupt my research.

checkText.en: Greetings. Where have you been for so long?

finishText.en:
What? Are you sure you did not suffer a heatstroke? I remember exactly that I sent you with a package of orders for our research group that works on the neighboring island, not to help scientists in their research. They are sufficiently competent in their search of the next pill for stomach flu, caused by some local bacteria.
And what is this? A work log? Are you out of your mind?! This is the expedition's financial statement! Look: numbers in columns, abbreviated names. Accountability above all!
A work log... as if! Yes, of course, I understand that we need to be vigilant, but it needs to be a healthy vigilance, not acute paranoia!
Meanwhile, please visit our medical facility. Let the doctor examine you and prescribe some sort of a mixture that calms nerves...

goal.en: Drink the invisibility potion, steal the research log from Yasskul Naboo on the Isle of Singing Water and bring it to Igor Kalinin at the Rumbling Bay camp.

startText.en:
Hey! Be quiet and quit staring at me. Are you also annoyed by this fool, Yasskul Naboo? Sure, I get it that it's not polite to say that about your scientific leader, but most recently she really has been acting... well, strange! For example, she forgot that she had already sent me to measure coordinates. I wrote it off as her resentfulness and absent-mindedness, common to all scientists. But what I heard during her conversation with you is outrageous! What microbiology, for crying out loud?! Yasskul Naboo was at her time one of the best specialists in astral studies. One might say that her monographs opened a whole new chapter in this extensive branch of science. And then microbes... unexplainable memory gaps... Something isn't right here!
I... I feel kind of uneasy suggesting this... But I think that you should steal Yasskul Naboo's work log. She records all of the experiment data in there. It probably contains the results from the last scientific research that we performed on this island! And if my leader knowingly does not disclose information or deceives us, then the brass should know about it.
I have an invisibility potion somewhere from the emergency stash. Here, take it. The log is usually somewhere near Yasskul Naboo. Drink the potion, steal the log from Naboo when she's not looking, and bring it to Kalinin. Let's see what he will say!

finishText.en: I thought that you would not come. Well, you made the right choice. I am not disappointed in you.

goal.en: Meet the mysterious stranger in the Cave of Elements under Sunny Cascade. But first you will need to receive Blessing of Elements from an ancient witch who lives on Kahlua Island.

startText.en:
Listen carefully and don't interrupt. And don't stare at me! I am visible only to you, I don't exist to others. So simply shut up and listen.
I know that you've already noticed people's strange memory gaps. That's just the tip of the iceberg. Let's just say it is a small error that made its way into robust calculations of our old acquaintance.
You probably don't remember me? Oh well. It is not important right now. What is important is that you know that you're in great danger. Let's just say that the owner of this paradise is saddened by your unbridled curiosity and wishes to get rid of you. Don't believe your eyes: everything surrounding you is a trap for naive fools, and the trap door just shut itself. Whether you believe me or not is up to you. But if you want to survive, then meet me in a place called the Cave of Elements, and I will show you just how deep the rabbit hole goes.

checkText.en: Yesterday I wanted to protect myself with a mosquito net from these flying bastards, but they stole it and drowned it! I am just glad that they didn't drag me into some swamp...

finishText.en: Mosquitoes got it in their snouts? At least someone delivered good news today. Thank you!

goal.en: Kill 12 Mosquitoes on the Isle of Singing Water and return with victory to Sarbaz Fakhar.

startText.en:
Oh, these vampires got the best of me. I have no more strength left! No, not the kinds of vampires who invaded the Galleon Palace and made Historians suffer. I am talking about real vampires, the ones who sucked me dry and then started on lube oil in my prosthetics. Ooh, damned mosquitoes! There is no respite from them! Aviaks may not care since they are all covered in feathers, but I'm scratching myself silly all day and have bites as big as a fist. Local mosquitoes cannot be compared to the harmless Nezebgrad variety, which can be poisoned easier than calculating an integral. Local mosquitoes are the size of a dog! And if they bite you, it is very painful!
If you're heading into the jungle, I beg you to give them a passionate "hello" from me and a sword between their insolent faceted eyes. Let them know that you can't just bite a poor laborer of science!

checkText.en: You cannot imagine how exciting it is to research pedipalps of some especially rare kind of tropical spider or drawn scales on the wings of a swallowtail butterfly!

finishText.en: Oh... Insects! Just look at those beauties. It's a breakthrough! It's not just a monograph, but a whole dissertation!

goal.en: Collect 5 butterflies, 5 green and 5 blue tropical bugs, and bring them to Sarbaz Fakhar on the Isle of Singing Water.

startText.en: While my scientific leader is a prisoner of her personal scientific research, I decided not to waste time and create a draft of my own scientific work. No, not about the Astral. I am passionate about entomology! Irdrich is an unexplored territory for an entomologist. Native endemic types... I lack the words to express their beauty! It is a researcher's dream! The only thing is that I don't have time to chase after bugs with a net. Being a junior scientific assistant to a famous scientist, you know, does not leave me much time for personal research. All I hear is: "Get me, give me, go to hell, don't bother me..." If someone were to catch me at least fifteen local bugs and butterflies, I'd be ever grateful! I'd even mention their name in a monograph... in fine print... on the last page... in a footnote...

checkText.en: Oh, I hope the pandemic will be prevented...

finishText.en: You were able to stop the spread of infection? Whew! A load off my mind! And a direct contradiction to the belief that heroes don't care for the problems of locals.

goal.en: Cure 10 sick aviaks hiding in the jungle of the Isle of Singing Water with a universal vaccine and report to Sarbaz Farrakh.

startText.en:
Indeed, we were too rash in contacting the local population... I heard stories that isolated tribes are more vulnerable to diseases of the "outside world." There was a story about a lost colony of gibberlings that went extinct from measles after it made contact with an elven astral ship. And now I stumbled upon a similar immunity problem myself.
You see, I had a parrot aboard the ship. Just before the departure, it started sneezing and coughing. Just a bird flu, nothing special - a few drops into the beak, a thermometer into... the output orifice, and the bird is good as new. Bird flu, as follows from its name, is only dangerous to birds. And aviaks are obviously birds, only bigger and with no immunity to bird flu. And so our guides and porters, recruited from local winged population, got infected. The flu impacted them terribly: horrible inflammation, delirium, hallucinations... It's awful!
I tried to inoculate them with a vaccine, but it was futile. They started attacking anyone on sight! They've gone mad! I barely escaped with my life. But you are a hero and can easily subdue weak and sick aviaks. Will you help? I don't want to be the cause of a whole nation's demise. Winged ones, in contrast with the Arisen, don't have a chance for resurrection and eternal life...

checkText.en: Well, how many sea creatures have you killed?

finishText.en: Do you have anything for me? A skin or a ripped out tentacle? Whoa! Skins, tentacles, and shells... Thank you very much. Now where would I find some formaldehyde to preserve at least some of these samples for science?

goal.en: Collect samples of sea creatures living around the island: 7 sea turtle shells, 7 cnidaria's tentacles and 7 hides of sharp-toothed alligators, and bring everything to Sarbaz Fakhar on the Isle of Singing Water.

startText.en:
Besides researching the Astral, we also study local fauna. Well, at least I do. My scientific leader is bent on the Astral, its emanations, aberrations, and anomalies. While I am closer to the earth and interested more in biology rather than in astral sciences.
Presently I am attempting to classify the local sea creatures. Even though we are involuntarily imprisoned on this allod, there are a few benefits. For example, I can peacefully do my research... If only Yasskul Naboo wouldn't saddle me with her orders day and night! I, an adequately known entomologist, being ordered around like a rookie lab assistant without a scientific degree!
Listen, can you help me? Sooner or later you will stumble upon some local predatory creatures anyway. If you happen to kill some sea creature, drag its remains to me. The more, the better! I'll try to develop at least an initial classification from the remains, and then, when I free myself from serving our arrogant star of science, I'll create a proper catalog.

checkText.en: Greetings. Judging by your amazed look, you have very important news for me.

finishText.en: So... Gibberling seers are directly in front of the research expedition's nose... And what did I say! Exactly this! I insisted that those eggheads take a reliable security consisting of sailors trusted by the Committee. But no! "Your sailors would break valuable scientific equipment. They would distract us from our work and be a general nuisance!" Damn it! At least you were able to eliminate an enemy agent. But how can we be sure that there is no more of them? I will immediately order to double... no, triple the security! No Imperial secret shall reach our enemy!

goal.en: Slay the three-headed monster on the Isle of Singing Water and report about your opponent to Igor Kalinin.

startText.en:
Quarr, Son of the Wind! I want to thank you for saving lives of me and my friends! A strange disease turned us into wild beasts that pecked a healing hand. I want to apologize that my brothers and I attacked you! I was very sick and terrified. I was scared by a horrible monster that lives in the jungle. It's a very scary monster! I've never seen anything like it. A monster is small, but very fierce. It has three heads, I saw it clearly. Three heads, six arms, sharp steel claws, and it screams horribly. I was very scared.
My brothers have not come back from the jungle yet. I'm worried! What if the same monster has eaten them? But I'm sick and cannot search for brothers in the jungle. Will you help? Slay the monster! Kill it dead! Then my brothers can safely return from the jungle to our camp!

checkText.en: Have you found a squawker's egg already?

finishText.en: That's good! I know what to do with an egg. Now wait, wait just a little.
