goal.en: Bang a gong in Rumbling Bay and summon a tamed squawker. Use it to fly to the top of the Giant's Claw, steal a squawker's egg and go back to Chewy Wind-Born in Rumbling Bay.

startText.en:
Quetal quarr, outlander! What brought you to Chewy? Do you want to learn? Then Chewy will teach you!
Do you outlander know squawkers? I'll explain. A squawker is a bird. Toothy, powerful and always hungry. Very smart, but very angry. It's hard to tame. But squawkers fly like lightning, faster than wind! If the wingless outlander wants to understand People of the Wind, you should tame a squawker. A mature squawker can't be tamed, as it's completely wild. An outlander must find a small squawker and tame it. Feed and care for it... Then a squawker will grow big and fly the outlander on its back. Then wingless one will become winged and understand our people!
Now wingless one should climb a mountain and hit a gong. A tamed squawker knows the gong sound well. Every island here has its own gong. As soon as a squawker swoops in, wingless one should climb atop the squawker and fly to Giant's Claw. Wild and angry squawkers live there. Outlander should look for a squawker's egg, then strike the gong and bring the egg back. Chewy will then help hitch... hooch... hatch... Tagar! Bring the egg and Chewy will tell you what to do.

checkText.en: If you feed a squawker well, it will love you and fly you high. But if you do not feed it well, it might become angry and bite you.

finishText.en: Kamul kutlak, wingless outlander! A squawker is like wings for yous. Now you wingless one may bang a gong on any island and summon a squawker. A squawker will easily fly to the gong, soar high and fast. You will become a true Son of the Wind!

goal.en: Feed a squawkling with 20 chunks of raw meat and return to Chewy Wind-Born in Rumbling Bay.

startText.en:
Wingless one, listen to me now. I'll give you a bone whistle. Blow the whistle, and a squawkling will come. It's small and hungry. It gonna eat like hell! A squawker is not a parrot, it doesn't eat fruits, only meat.
Go hunting, outlander, to get meat and feed a squawkling. When a squawkling grows very big, it will love you like its parent. It'll carry you on its back up high in the sky! Then you will understand and trust our people, or even make friends with us!

finishText.en: Greetings, hero. You already took an oath and signed an NDA regarding government secrets, so let's skip the bureaucracy. I'll be straight with you. The Empire needs heroes now more than ever! I sense big trouble coming and the only ones who can deal with it are heroes, just like you.

goal.en: Meet Elizaveta Rysina in Yasker's Tower.

startText.en:
Hello! You have an urgent telepathogram from Rysina herself!
Elizaveta Rysina orders all Imperial heroes to come to the Committee headquarters immediately. Order priority - highest, secrecy - four zeroes. So run to Rysina without delay!

finishText.en: So you are the authorized Committee agent that keeps an eye on us? I hope you have a strong stomach. It's going to get hot!

goal.en: Meet captain Mackin in the Nezebgrad port.

startText.en:
Strange code... Pah! This one is not a letter at all. It is a drawing that kids doodle on walls! Fine, we'll see what we can do. I personally will find the one responsible for it and rip his arms off!
Meanwhile I have an important task for you. No one can succeed in this task but you, so consider yourself volunteered!
Anyway, we have an experimental ship here. A secret development! The world's fastest ship. I've decided to send it after the fleet. The ship has excellent armor and its cannons are capable of making a hole even in an astral island! If anyone can find our lost fleet, it is only this ship's crew under the command of an experienced Committee agent. This means you. The ship has already departed, but that doesn't matter. It has a special item on board, a teleportation device, so just say the word, I'll press the button and you'll be aboard the ship.
Oh yeah... The last communication received stated that an armada of demons is attacking the ship, so be prepared for the battle!

checkText.en: How do you feel? Dizzy? Do you see multi-colored spots?

finishText.en: Glory to the Martyrs... At least someone came to life! What a crash! Half of the crew is unconscious, the other half is in the Purgatory. Damned demons! This is the first time I see a wormhole directly above an allod. And here is your captain... dead... he did not expect such a surprise.

goal.en: Use a ship cannon to shoot down attacking demons.

startText.en:
We are getting close to the wormhole that leads into the sector where the squadron was lost. No rest from the demons. We're barely afloat and...
Demons! Demons attacking again! Fire in the hole! All hands on deck!!!
Astral take them, we'll have to blindly jump into an unknown sector, without preparations! Light save our souls!
What are you doing here? Grab a cannon and show those astral shrimps how things are done in the Empire! We just need to get through to the wormhole, and then we're in the clear!

finishText.en:
Hey! Wanna jump the line?!
Wait a sec... I remember you! You're that hero who helped the goblins and the ghosts on Gipat! You were sent by Elizaveta Rysina, right? Thanks Light! This is very handy!

goal.en: Go to the Purgatory with Rysina's help and talk to the Servant of the Light.

startText.en:
Lately, I am beginning to think that we are waging a war on several fronts. Nihaz has been defeated, long live the heroes and so on, but I sense that problems are just coming up...
Recently I was given a message from this bourgeois, a goblin from the Purgatory. You see, he is worried about the presence of some strange Sparks in his neck of the woods. Allegedly, they cannot return to their bodies but nevertheless do not dissolve into the great void, and act like sleepwalkers, wandering around the netherworld and scaring those who are awaiting their turn to be resurrected.

checkText.en: Honest folks are losing Sparks!

finishText.en: So that's how it is! Cultists, then... I think it's time to warn Elizaveta!

goal.en: Inspect the lost Sparks in the Purgatory and find out what happened to them. Report the information to the Servant of the Light.

startText.en:
Oh, something's rotten in your kingdom, yep! Look at those poor souls restlessly wandering through the Purgatory. Empty eyes, empty heads... The horror!
I don't know what happened to them. They appeared in the Purgatory already like this, with neither will nor power. I tried to talk to them, shake them, but to no avail, yep. They talk nonsense. I saw crazy Sparks before, and all of them would leave this sorrowful place after a certain time... But not these, they wander around here, scaring the dead, and cannot return, as if they are stuck between life and death. Perhaps you can try to talk to them? It is not good that our set routines be interrupted by some lost souls, yep.

finishText.en:
What? You were sent by the goblin from the Purgatory? I don't believe my ear drums... That greedy goblin is asking our help? That's unheard of!
Well, tell me everything, while I think about what we can do.

goal.en: Talk to Negus Tot at ZIT.

startText.en: Very well, I will personally write a note to Elizaveta, and you have more important business awaiting you! Go to the mass grave, which your Arisen call ZIT, and find my old buddy, Negus Tot. This narrow-minded skeptic knows everything that's going on in the old pyramid like the gears in his prosthetics. I hope that, with a joint effort, you can help me solve the problem with the Sparks that lost their bodies and memories. It's not good when a Spark exists without a body. It is unnatural!

finishText.en: Hey! Who are you, plague take you! Access is granted only to category two clearance!

goal.en: Meet Yaver Gaudi in the ZIT's sealed crypt.

startText.en:
So that's how it is... It is somewhat clearer now!
Several days ago we found a thoroughly hidden and sealed room in the pyramid, that is in ZIT's main wing. With utmost care, we opened it and were stunned: it was packed with devices that we never knew existed! Tep's heritage... You cannot imagine the thirst of knowledge that is ignited in the heart of any scientist upon hearing those words!
I myself don't participate in research. I have enough to do as it is. Yaver Gaudi is leading the research. Go to him and give that modernized crocodile a message that I order him to support you in your research.

checkText.en: Well, were you able to find out about the Arisen stuck in the Purgatory?

finishText.en:
What?! Tep Cultists, under the guise of ZIT employees, were preparing to take valuable equipment and attacked you?
I can't believe it... Do you have any proof?

goal.en: Ask Yaver Gaudi about the circumstances of death of the Arisen stuck in the Purgatory, and return to Negus Tot.

startText.en:
Access only by permission from Negus Tot! Forbidden to unauthorized personnel!
What? Negus Tot sent you? He even said "modernized crocodile"?! How dare he! Very well, I'll deal with him later.
What do you want to know? We value every minute here.
So, the Spark of a slain one is stuck in the Purgatory? And that poor soul died here, in the crypt? Hmm... Damnation! I shouldn't have used Master's weapon... What terrible luck! I thought that we did everything perfectly, but now I find out that some curious bastard died and appeared in the Purgatory...
That's bad, very bad. Now I won't be able to transport Master's valuable equipment quietly. Well... As they say, nothing personal, just business! Master will make use of your Spark as well!

finishText.en:
Good day, comrade. I hope that you truly have important news, and not some rumors of an astral dragon that was seen above the Wild Isles by drunk shamans.
Wait a moment... So it was you who destroyed the cultists disguised as ZIT employees? Excellent. Wonderful. Congratulations. You've quite masterfully derailed a Committee operation aimed at infiltrating the spy network of Tep followers! Your interference roused all the spies and forced them to act before our detectives found all their contacts and locations! What are we to do now? Start from scratch?

goal.en: Report to Yasker about the cultists' schemes.

startText.en:
The papers that you took off Yaver Gaudi's body... Their contents scare me!
Why would Tep need live prisoners? Aside from inhumane experiments. And how is it connected to the lost Sparks in the Purgatory? There are more questions than answers!
What was the security service doing? And the infamous Committee, whose spies stick their noses into every vial in my institute, failed to detect a whole gang of cultists under their nose. I am partially to blame as well. I sensed there was something wrong when Yaver Gaudi asked for cart blanche in his research... He even personally selected his employees!
All right. Go to Yasker and report the liquidation of the spy cell. You are a hero, he won't execute you right away...
Cultists in the scientific center of the Empire... Imagine that!

checkText.en: Hurry. If cultists escape with the hostages, their lives will be on your conscience.

finishText.en: Were you able to free our recruits? That's good news!

goal.en: Kill all Tep cultists, free hostages and return to report to Yasker.

startText.en:
Oh well, what's done is done. I'll have to assign you to this case as a detective. Listen carefully!
Yes, the Committee was aware of the Imperial citizens kidnapped by Tep's servants. The Spark of the Arisen that lost his memory and energy, whom you had a chance to talk to in the Purgatory, was obviously one of the kidnapped.
Yes, we did not interfere. The security of the Empire is more important than that of a private citizen and everyone understands it. If dozens die to protect thousands, that is a sacrifice I'm prepared to make! The Committee was prepared once and for all to purge our ranks, and would have succeeded if not for your meddling. Now, the cultists, understanding that they were detected, hit several of our posts and got away! They also kidnapped a number of our citizens. I hope you understand that this is largely on you! And it is on you to fix your mistakes!
The Blue Barracks were attacked by cultists. The cultists took several of our recruits hostage, but probably did not flee far. If you hurry, you might still save them! Run!

checkText.en: Hurry. If cultists escape with the hostages, their lives will be on your head.

finishText.en: So orcs were right, and spark snatchers are collaborating with Tep's servants? I don't like this...

goal.en: Kill Tep cultists on the Wild Isles, free the hostages and report to Yasker.

startText.en:
Right before your appearance, I received a report of another cultist attack on our citizens. It was on Wild Isles, of all places! Strange that enraged orcs did not rip them apart on the spot. Then again the report talked of strange shadows that inspire pure horror and kill with just one touch... Aren't those the spark snatchers that we've met on the Wandering Island? That might explain the Sparks' exhaustion in the Purgatory.
Then again, guessing never amounts to anything. I need facts and you shall provide them. And also save our guys, who are in trouble. Get to it!

checkText.en: Hurry. If cultists escape with the hostages, their lives will be on your head.

finishText.en: Excellent! Kidnapped privates will be awarded a resort vacation. Let them rest and forget about their misfortune. The Empire values its defenders!

goal.en: Kill Tep cultists at Eljune, free hostages and report to Yasker.

startText.en:
Besides the IMD, the cultists attacked our military camp at Eljune. Somehow they are interested mainly in physically seasoned citizens with high emotional stability. Those who are able to serve in the army. If I was not so confident in the loyalty of our citizens, I would have assumed that the cultists were planning to convert our recruits and make them Tep's watchdogs. But that's impossible! Loyal sons of the Empire will not serve the mad necromancer... though I am not sure about some Arisen. We will have to order Rysina to do additional checks among ZIT employees.
But that does not concern you. Your job right now is to free the kidnapped privates from cultists at Eljune. Hurry up and go. Time is against us!

checkText.en: You, move! Don't lose time!

finishText.en: So that's how it is? The League spies are confessing their evil deeds before their death? Strange... They have never done it before! Oh well, let's assume that we can forget about a truce with the League. Let's take a look at the coded message, shall we?

goal.en: Interrogate the port workers, find the traitor and confirm Crazystorm the Merciless' suspicions.

startText.en:
The Committee was able to neutralize all enemy spies. I trust you, but note that what I am about to say is confidential! This is classified information!
To resolve the cultist problem we were forced to ally with the League. It looks like old man Aidenus has similar problems in his neck of the woods. Since he understands that he cannot deal with Tep alone, he swallowed his pride and contacted me. We even signed a temporary joint effort agreement... Except that I am starting to suspect that he has some hidden agenda, besides his wish to forget about our squabbles and fight Tep!
The documents retrieved from ZIT revealed the hideout location of Tep in the far Astral. We were preparing a fleet for military action when Aidenus contacted me. As a result of our negotiations, we joined our forces and fleets. Our fleet, joined with the League's strike squadron, had reached the location at the wormhole that leads into an unexplored sector, and went missing! Crazystorm the Merciless suspects that the truce was a sly move by Aidenus to weaken our defenses and attempt to board Imperial ships, which were left without any additional support.
But fleet departure was prepared in utter secrecy! Even if someone did report about the departure of our armada, it would have been someone from the port or lighthouse personnel. I am ordering you to find this rat and rip the whole truth from him or her!

checkText.en: The bigger the animal, the more glory for a hunter!

finishText.en: Good catch! You're a mighty hunter to fell such a beast. You'll get a good reward!

goal.en: Ask Nukah Scraggy-Bone to show you the way to the pangolin's lair, defeat it and brag about your victory to Arko Raw-Boned in the Steel Claw village.

startText.en:
I heard that you're a great wingless hunter. I know where to find a prey worthy of a legend! A terrible pangolin! Its roar makes trees tremble and its step makes earth quake. It is a real beast!
If you want to prove your valor, you should hunt the beast. Nukah Scraggy-Bone knows where beast's den is and he'll show you the way. If you kill the beast, I'll give you a nice reward!

checkText.en: Dumb tapir. And tasty!

finishText.en: Did the amulet work? Excellent! I had doubts... But as you are brave and quick, you got meat and tried the amulet. And not even fried yourself. That's very good!

goal.en: Fry 12 tapirs using the Amulet of the Fire Gaze and bring Glick 12 well-done steaks.

startText.en:
Hey, wingless one! Are you a hunter? Can you hunt? Kur-r! Good! I have a favor to ask. Do you want to help?
I'm a cook. My cooking is very tasty! You bet your beak it's tasty! And you outlanders eat a lot. Outlander have eaten everything I prepared. I have no more meat to feed such hungry outlanders. If outlanders want to keep eating, you must help me.
Take this fire amulet. A true flame lives inside it. When you find a tapir, a fat tapir, while hunting, hold this amulet tight and say a magic word. The amulet will emit flame and fry the tapir. It'll be a royal dish - tapir au jus!

checkText.en: Spotted leopards are the most dangerous predators in our jungle!

finishText.en: Son of Heavens is a great hunter! Our people are proud of you!

goal.en: Kill 12 leopards in Rumbling Bay and boast about it to Arko Raw-Boned in the aviak village.

name.en: Beast that Lurks in the Night

startText.en:
Quarr, Son of the Wind!
It's time for a great hunt. When the wind blows from the south, and the waves break on the doorsteps of our houses, we begin hunting. We hunt great spotted beasts - leopards! Only the bravest can capture a leopard. Are you such a hunter? Then you can join our hunt!
A leopard is a fast and sly beast. It's growl often sounds around our village. We don't kill them for fun, we hunt to protect ourselves. Go into the jungle, kill leopards to protect our people, and protect your own people, too. It's good for everyone!

checkText.en: Are you bumping my wing again?

finishText.en:
Oh, you've found the needed herb. Much of it! Thank you so much!
Would you like new shoes? Your people make necklaces and shoes for People of the Wind. Necklaces are pretty, so I wear them. But why do I need shoes? You may take and wear yourself.

goal.en: Bring 12 Milva Fruits and 12 Whoopgrass Roots to Zul Stamen in the Rumbling Bay village.

startText.en:
Koot nakar... Tukkar tak... Tri shar kudrag khanok... Whoa!
Why do you distract me? I've spilt all of the herb! Where do I find new herb now? Do you know? So you know how to bump a wing, but don't know where to get medicinal herbs?! Taggar sharrak!
Since you've disturbed me, you must help me!
Whoopgrass root is difficult to find. Go look for a curly grass with miniscule red flowers. Pull it out carefully, not to break root. It's simpler with milva. Simply shake the tree and fruits will fall to the ground. Pick the juiciest fruit and bring it to me. I'll discard its pulp, make a medicinal powder out of its pit, and mix it with the ground root. It'll be a potion potent to help with every illness!

checkText.en: Oh, young chicks are stupid... You must keep a sharp eye on them!

finishText.en:
This little rascal wanted to make me surprised and almost got eaten by leopard. I'll show him a surprise... He won't sit on his bum for a week! And forget about entertainment for a month!
But he told me an interesting thing. When he run, he saw a strange outlander. Wingless just like you, but... different. I don't know how to explain. We heard about another outlander from your commander. He calls them "League." Leck thinks he saw League outlanders. They were going somewhere towards the Copper Isle. Leck didn't see how many and why. Perhaps it's your League that lives there?

goal.en: Find Leck Green-Horn in the Rumbling Bay jungle.

startText.en:
Wingless Son of the Heavens, did you see my young deputy? He's still a young, green-horned chick. Hence his name – Leck Green-Horn. Completely dumb and always getting lost! How can he become a real commander? Young'un, taggar kutar! His head is filled with rest and relaxation. And who will be serving in the army? Old Furr Wagging-Tongue, who can't even remember the business end of a spear? Or red commander Cha Pie-Pie must personally check the sentry posts? These young'uns are not the same as before, not at all... They don't understand ideas of our passionate revolution!
But we must find Leck. I cannot be without a deputy. Who will I send to the warehouse? Who will I order to write orders? Not you, right? I agree, you have more important matters, cannot be my errand boy. All I ask that you find Leck, grab him by tail and drag him here. He probably run off into the western forest, near the cliff shores. Young'uns always run off into those woods to meet with some female... I remember, I was myself like him, kul kaurr...

checkText.en: I've never seen such a big and angry cat in my life! Toothy creature!

finishText.en: Is the beast dead? Thank you, outlander! Wind take it and its teeth. It's good that the beast won't attack any aviak anymore. The jungle is a little safer now.

goal.en: Kill the Bloodthirsty Leopard in the Rumbling Bay jungle and report its demise to Leck Green-Horn.

startText.en:
Hold it! Stay back! I'll defend myself until my last drop of blood! Oh... I don't have much blood left already...
What? You were sent by Cha Pie-Pie to find me? What a dumbass I am! My commander shows care, but I cannot care for myself... I let the commander down!
I wanted to surprise the commander. Commander's Hatching Hour will be soon, and I wanted to give him a present. A spear tip made from a big cat's tooth! I tracked down a very large cat. It's teeth are bigger than my beak. I sneaked up on it, shot at it, but that beast jumped and bit me! I barely escaped. Alas... I am weak...
You, wingless outlander, are very strong. Will you help me kill the beast? It's not right for a toothy cat to roam free! Today it has bitten Leck, tomorrow it will maul Xia, or steal chicks from our homes! Will you help slay a killer cat?

checkText.en: Oh those youngsters are brainless... Need thorough watch and care!

finishText.en: What dumb chick. I ordered you not to go hunting alone. At least you're alive...

goal.en: Lead Leck Green-Horn to the Steel Claw village.

startText.en: I've lost a lot of blood... A toothy cat has broken all feathers in my wing. At least it didn't have time to bite off my bones - I hit it straight in nose and fled. But now I'm afraid to walk to the village. We aviaks do not walk well, but we fly well. When we walk, we're like a stupid chicken - funny and slow. You are wingless, you're comfortable on the ground, like a fish in the water. Will you help me and clear my road to the village? I'll be very grateful!

checkText.en:
So... As I understand, this is our experimental subspace communicator? Pretty, but dumb. We ought to considering cutting the budget for our R&D department.
All right, back to business. Report!

finishText.en:
It is clear... that nothing is clear! Could the League have really taken the risk to play their game? We will think on it. Think long and hard. And, perhaps, execute some folk! But that does not concern you. For now.
Communication via this experimental transmitter is very unstable. I am spending my strength to smooth disturbances in the Astral. Try to find something that may stabilize the channel and contact me again.

goal.en: Contact Yasker using the subspace communicator and report on the demise of the fleet.

startText.en:
The League is really something! They entered the wormhole ahead of us, prepared an ambush and met our defenseless ships with guns blazing. But how did they survive themselves if the wormhole opens up directly above the island? Baffling... It looks like we are stuck here for a long time. We have no ships and the remaining ones cannot be repaired... Communication is a problem as well. All right, I'll tell you one more military secret. At this point, what's one more secret to you anyway? We do have communication. Before the departure, the admiral, may he rest in the Astral, was personally handed from Crazystorm the Merciless the latest Imperial invention - a remote communicator that can contact the capital from any point of the universe. Fortunately, the device survived the shipwreck. Except that the charge won't last long.
Here, take it. Press this button, rotate this lever and imagine the person you want to contact. What do you mean "who to imagine?" Yasker, of course! We have to report our failure and bring him up to date. You can imagine him better, and you won't lose any stars off your lapels. That's why you should report!

checkText.en: Don't interrupt me. I am trying to understand why these ruins don't work.

finishText.en: What? How did you do it? I lost my head trying to figure out how to rouse the ancient magic in this stone, but you did it with a single touch!

goal.en: Find out about June Ruins from Negus Sukhitep on the shore near the Imperial camp.

startText.en: Communication channel? Let me think. I have an idea... A scientist that was attached to our crew, Negus Sukhitep, found some old June ruins near our camp. Frankly, we don't care about them, we don't have working Adventurer's Stones anyway, but they may be useful to you. So go to our scientist and find out the latest news from him. Perhaps studying the ruins will yield some benefits?

checkText.en: Well, what happened to you? As a matter of fact, I have a top secret meeting to attend!

finishText.en:
Irdrich? No, never heard about such an allod. Perhaps if we check the old records, then something might be cleared up.
However, this is not important right now. As I understand it, you weren't able to find the evidence of Tep's presence yet? Then you haven't searched hard enough! I don't believe that our recon data is erroneous and our scouting is for naught. It seems like you are not looking in the right place.

goal.en: Contact Yasker using the subspace communicator and receive further instructions.

startText.en:
All right, wait. I will try to understand the structure of the spell. All June teleportation stones were assigned to old world coordinates and this stone is probably no exception.
Triangulation... Adjustment of two minutes... Dislocation of 1.5 degrees due south by southwest... Aha! Here it is!
Some strange results. This place is recorded as "Irdrich," but this is the first time that I hear about this allod. I think I saw some mention in the ancient records of a legendary island hidden among sharp reefs, and therefore inaccessible to navigators of that time. But there were no Great Mages, which means that the island should have dissolved in the Astral long-long time ago. Strange. We should probably report this to Yasker immediately! But don't try to do it right here! Secrecy above all!

checkText.en: So, were you able to contact the capital?

finishText.en: So that's how it is? Continue with the assigned mission, despite the fact that nothing remains of the strike squadron? Hell of a job for us! When the Motherland says "do it," our only answer is "yes!"

goal.en: Teleport to the Demon Hunters' ship, return to Irdrich and relay Yasker's orders to Leonid Brelin.

startText.en:
Right now it is important to determine whether or not the sector where you currently are is cut off from our world.
The demons' activity has drawn the Hunters' attention; their battleship is cruising near the wormhole. I've already received a preliminary assessment of the situation from them. I must say that they are better at studying the Astral than us and the League. Anyway, they state that the wormhole entrance is ringed into an energy loop and going through it might drain energy from any object, be it a reactor or a human. This is what you experienced when you fainted. Don't ask how such an anomaly was created. There are many theories and not enough facts. But everyone agrees that your chances returning the same way are nil. Therefore, we should utilize good old teleportation.
I'll try to tune my Adventurer's Stone to the portal on the deck of the Hunters' flagship. Try to teleport there and enter the wormhole again. If my conjectures are correct, then the maximum risk is a loss of consciousness. I certainly hope that you don't manage to break your neck doing that...
And relay my order to the most senior able-bodied officer: Don't stop searching for Tep. We cannot wage war on two fronts without any verifiable information!

finishText.en: Quarr, wingless one! What do you want? I'm a bit busy right now. I have to prepare a patriotic speech for my warriors. Your wise wingless Igor advised me so.

goal.en: Show the strange map to Cha Pie-Pie.

startText.en:
So... Let me think. No, I am definitely not familiar with the map legend. Besides, I've never heard of the League's military creating operation maps on a lousy papyrus, where all legends are stupid doodles, written in coal. It is probably the work of our potential enemies: Glittering Wing tribe.
You know what? Take this map to Cha Pie-Pie. He probably knows what is shown on it.

finishText.en: Ah, wingless outlander did come see me. Let me guess... Cha Pie-Pie send you! He wants our spirits to bless alliance with outlanders that came from the great void? All right... You shall hear their word!

goal.en: Meet Elchana Speak-with-Spirits on Kahlua Island.

startText.en:
Did you find this map in the enemy camp? Did you take it away from wingless spies that call themselves League? Bad news for all of us.
I believe you. Scouts detected a strange small furry creature monitoring our city. They also saw a white-winged creature near it. The map confirms my concerns. It shows our patrols, fortifications, all passages and exits. This map obviously was drawn by white aviaks. If white-winged ones ally with League, we'll be in trouble. They will bury the fruit of our revolution deep in the ground. That cannot happen!
I, Cha Pie-Pie, on behalf of working people, state: Steel Claw and wingless outlanders must form an alliance. We see that future belongs to a just and honest country, and that is our strength!
But we cannot enter into treaty without blessing of elements. Wind that carry us, earth that give us shelter, sea that feed us, and fire that burn in our dwellings all are our patrons. Only Elchana-Speak-with-Spirits understands them. She lives on Kahlua Island, to the east of our town. You, Son of the Wind, should go ask Elchana to talk to spirits. I've spoken my word, let them speak theirs.

finishText.en: Oh you clumsy oaf, where the hell have you... Oh! excuse me! I thought you were one of my assistants that I sent to the Astral shore to record measurements.

goal.en: Meet Yasskul Naboo on the Isle of Singing Water.

startText.en:
So, the Copper Isle... Irdrich... See, the problem is that I sent a recon team to monitor the League, and they report that the League's military is in dire situation, like us. Without navy and support. What conclusion can we draw? A very simple one! If the League's military lured us into this sector, they did not expect that getting out of here would be rather... problematic.
Anyway, the side that works out the nature of this anomaly will strengthen its influence and dictate its terms. And, naturally, that has to be our great Empire!
In addition to everything, our squadron had separate research projects. We had several scientists attached to us, Yasskul Naboo and her assistants. They are conducting research now and are in need of a trusted person. I, as you understand, cannot send some storm trooper oaf to conduct such delicate research, so I need to enlist your help to assist the scientists. Success of this research is an important task and its solution will be for the benefit of the Empire!

finishText.en:
Quarr, wingless one!
Do you also think that honest work is the metric of respect? Good! But your heart is closed to a song of the wind... I see it. You cannot fly and you can never understand our people. If you want to speak with our people, you must learn to talk to wind spirits. You should go to Cheeba and learn, only then we can talk!

goal.en: Meet the chief of Steel Wing tribe, Cha Pie-Pie, in the village of red aviaks in Rumbling Bay.

startText.en:
Do you know what is the main weapon of the Empire? It is not blades and bows, not astral ship cannons, not destructive spells of the Great Mages, not at all! The main weapon of the Empire is the enduring belief in its own righteousness. Ideology of our great country is dear and clear to everyone, from a scientist to the worker bee, from the wise Arisen to the dumbest goblin. And where weapons are powerless, our beliefs will bring us victory!
You're probably trying to guess what I'm getting at? You see, thanks to our ideology, we already found allies on this hostile earth. They are aviaks!
We met the local aviaks right after the crash and quickly found a common ground. Their country recently split when the aviaks that were dissatisfied with the local "aristocracy" rebelled and unanimously unseated the tyrants. Good for them! To each according to his needs, from each according to his ability! A citizen is valued for his labor, not his titles!
Anyway, right now there is a smoldering war raging between two tribes of a once united people, and with our help, our red allies - Steel Claw tribe - have all the chances to win. And then we will deal with the League with a joint force.
Hear my command! Go to the village of our allies and meet their chief, red commander Cha Pie-Pie. And try to gain his respect!

checkText.en: Ha ha ha! I knew you'd come!

finishText.en: You cannot extinguish the flame burning in the heart. Ha! The flame that you may help to fan will burn this whole boring world!

goal.en: Pass all trials given by Cliff Master and meet Fire Master on the Ashy Wasteland.

startText.en:
Khurr... A sand speck is no dust. A flintstone! Good job... Hasty. Fussy. Dumb. Impatient. But hard. So, a sand speck or a flintstone? I must know...
Hurh... Let's test a send speck. Try it. No hurry. If it succeed, let it meet Brother. He is hasty and hot-headed as well. A flintstone will like him.
Umm... Brother lives far, on Azure atoll. He called me. Why should I? The earth is everywhere.
Humm... Go. I bless you. A fast sand speck, willing to understand the earth better. Will it? It can't go wrong. Go.

checkText.en: Hurh... Dumb rolling boulders. They don't understand their purpose.

finishText.en: Humm... Rumblers don't rumble anymore. So quiet. Good. Not a sand speck, but a flintstone. Small. Hard. Calm. Good.

goal.en: Destroy 12 mad boulders on the Ashy Wasteland and report your success to Cliff Master.

startText.en:
Humm... Hmm... A sand speck. Trying to understand a mountain. Amusing. Very. Ho ho ho.
Rocks will crush a fool. Earth will swallow. Fertilizer... OK, let the sand speck try.
Humm... Earth varies. Soft. Hard. Fertile. Barren. Calm. Quaking. It can be also alive. Dust specks call them spirits.
Humm... Spirits vary. Kind. Evil. Mad. I don't need the mad ones. They roll. Here and there. Thunder. Won't let you sleep.
Umm... A sand speck is weak. Mad ones are too. Equal opponents. Let the sand speck turn mad ones to dust. I don't like fuss...

checkText.en: Ooh... Earth has been patient for long. But if it angers, it is unstoppable...

finishText.en:
Humm... Evil. Was. Gone. Good. A sand speck is light, but it fell on the proper side of the scale.
Hurr... Patience. Is altruism. Everything else decays. Time conquers all things.

goal.en: Plant a seed at the Ashy Wasteland and teach the Scorched Treant a lesson. Afterwards return to Cliff Master to report your victory.

startText.en:
Hurh... Earth is bad here. Tasteless. Smells burnt.
Umm... Plants are alive. They feel pain. Afraid of death. Scared of fire. Fear is rooted deep. Very deep. Nothing grows anymore. Nothing. Earth is scared...
Homm... A sand speck can help. Plant a seed. Say the magic word. A stem will sprout. It'll be evil. Very. It will absorb the earth's evil.
Ooh... The stem will sprout. It'll be wicked. It will absorb earth's wickedness. Strike it. Strike the wicked out of it. It'll become peaceful. Calm. It'll return to the earth. Bring appeasement. It will grow roots. Forest will grow. Not right away. Earth is patient. It can wait. Go.

checkText.en: Hurr... Mountains turn into seas. Rivers into ranges. The important thing is to wait...

finishText.en: Humm... I hear. I see. Earth is blooming. Again. Good.

goal.en: Summon the earth spirit by touching an ancient menhir and help it clear the scorched areas of the Ashy Wasteland, then report your success to Cliff Master.

startText.en:
Hurh... A sand speck is still here? Annoying sand speck. Fussy. Lives fast. Hurries somewhere. Why? Stupid...
Homm... Very well. Let the impatient sand speck be useful. Earth is tired. Long time ago a fire occurred here. Many things were scorched. It is time for new things to grow. The shadow remains inside earth. It does not let new life start. Must be cleansed. We can wait. But a sand speck is in a hurry. Let it help, then.
Hurh... Menhir. Ancient. Protects the power of inceptive life. If you touch, it will release. It will breathe new life into the earth. Go.
Humm... Hurries. Everyone hurries. Where? Why? Hurry slowly. Then you will be prompt.

finishText.en: Mortal... You have no wingsss, but you hear my voice... You are truly the Ssson of the Wind!

goal.en: Meet with Wind Master at the Seven-Winds Cliff.

startText.en: I heard the call! Wind Master is calling you. He is the kindest of all elements, always looks after our winged people. He lives where the wind eternally sing its sorrowful song among grey cliffs, and sea foam from waves flies into the air and falls in thousands of droplets. His voice is menacing, but be not afraid of him. Wind Master will not harm his children. He is merciful and just. If you receive his blessing, it will be easier later!

finishText.en: Did spirits give their blessing? Good news, outlander!

goal.en: Pass all the Fire Master's trials, return to Elchana on Kahlua Island and report that all the spirits of the elements gave their blessing.

startText.en:
Listen to me, creature of zest. Wind, water, earth and fire gave you a bit of their wisdom. I hope now you understand us, our ways, and our purpose. Ha! I wouldn't want our efforts to be futile. In the end, the purpose of our trials was just that. We don't care about squabbles of sentient beings and those who sent you for the elements' blessings; they can war with whoever they want. What we are interested in is you!
We sensed the hidden strength in you, strength that is more advanced than that of your clansmen, and we wanted to meet you. We wanted to understand who you are and give you the opportunity to understand us. My brother have drawn the conclusions. Now it's my turn to test you.
After you finish my task, go to the witch and tell her that they can butcher each other all they want! Ha ha ha!

checkText.en: Fire is alive, understand? If you don't feed it, it will die. But if you feed it regularly, it will be sky high!

finishText.en:
Ah! I love the smell of ashes in the morning! Ha ha ha!
Oh, you are good, not even scared of all-consuming flame. I like you, hero. I swear by absolute zero, we will be friends!

goal.en: Collect 5 units of tapir tallow, 5 bundles of dry brushwood, and use them to kindle a big fire out of a small one that burns near Fire Master on the Azure Atoll.

startText.en:
My brothers... are boring! Wind can only whistle and mindlessly wander to and fro. Water can only murmur something philosophic. It is trying to show itself as wise! Stone is slow-thinking and lazy. Not one of them understands life! Remember, fire is life! You are alive so long as you burn. When you are extinguished, you are dead. Ha! It is simple, like igniting a fire! Speaking of which, can you make bonfires? Not just bonfires, but a whole sea of fire, one that can be seen from the sky? No? It is very entertaining!
There are lots of fat tapirs around. So fat that they can barely walk. Their fat will make the flames shoot sky high. Ooh! Only throw in some logs. Plenty of those around as well!

checkText.en: I am worshipped like a god. I am offered sacrifices. They think it will make me merciful! Ha ha ha! Fire cannot be merciful. It ignites to burn, not to lick hands like a stupid puppy. It can be a friend or an enemy, but flame will always be flame!

finishText.en:
Eenie, meenie, miney moe.
Catch a tiger by the toe.
If he hollers, let him go.
 Eenie, meenie, miney moe.
...
What, not a tiger, but a leopard? Oh, you ruined the nursery rhyme...
...
 Eenie, meenie, miney meil.
Catch a tiger by the tail.
 If he hollers, let him be.
 Eenie, meenie, miney, me.
...
Now that's better! So what if it's not a tiger? The important thing is for the predator's blood to feed the flame with its power! Look how brightly and merrily it burns! Ha ha ha!

goal.en: Lure to the bonfire on the Azure Atoll and sacrifice 5 leopards, then boast about it to Fire Master.

startText.en:
So... What to do for fun now? What do you think, creature of flame? Burn? Ha ha! Outstanding idea! Of course, burn!
Burn is good. However, burning for the sake of burning is boring. Let me think... I got it!
Huge leopards live here. Toothy, predatory and spotted. Hot blood, flaming heart! Would you sacrifice them to the flame? Or shall I feed you to it? Ha ha ha! Don't be afraid, I am kidding! I like you! Just lure these big kitties to the burning bonfire and let the flame consume their beastly blood!

checkText.en: You can make a giant fire out of a small spark. It's beautiful!

finishText.en: Ha ha ha! Stupid bird will not annoy me anymore with its awful screams. Freedom, my sweet little flame. Someone is free to scream obscenities, and someone is free to break the neck and rip the heart from the chest of the stupid screamer. Know your abilities and your actions, lest you become hot ash, just like the heart of this stupid bird.

goal.en: Find the screaming squawker, kill it and bring its heart to Fire Master.

startText.en:
Birds, birds... I don't like birds! My hissing and whistling brother spoils these loud creatures that poop from the sky, but I only acknowledge one kind of birds - fire birds. Ha!
Have you ever seen a rain of fire? It's when giant flames shoot from the earth's depths into the sky, like thousands of birds with fiery wings... A stunning spectacle... for those who understand the essence of fire! You do understand the essence of fire, don't you? Freedom is the answer! Freedom of desires, freedom of thoughts, freedom of actions. Say, I want to rip the heart out of a stupid winged creature that's always shooting at the mouth among the cliffs. Will you help me, creature of fire?

checkText.en: Kual! Wingless one save me!

finishText.en: Poor, stupid Torrick. I'm always unlucky... Always in trouble!

goal.en: Rescue Torrick Hard-Luck from harpies that live on the Giant's Claw, by killing their leader, Shizgana.

startText.en:
Wingless one! Hail to Seven Winds! Will you help me? I really-really need help!
My beloved Torrick is gone. He is so unlucky! Trouble always finds him. And now he is in trouble again.
Harpies live on this island. Very wicked, insolent and loud. I hate them! They kidnapped my beloved to do something terrible. I think they want to marry Torrick to their leader, vile Shizgana! Such fate is worse than death!
I beg you, rescue my Torrick. He is so defenseless... But I love him more than life!

checkText.en: I was unlucky even in childhood. Even an egg with me inside always fell out of nest!

finishText.en:
Did you find stones? Excellent!
...
Oh no... Stones are scratched and gnawed. Not shiny anymore. Again no luck for Torrick!

goal.en: Collect bright and shiny necklace gemstones that were eaten by hungry squawkers and bring them to Torrick Hard-Luck on the Giant's Claw.

startText.en:
I was going to my bride, beloved Gia. Then a black flock of harpies swooped in! They hit me in my beak and my eye and took my bag. The bag contained a present, a beautiful necklace. I've made it for the wedding. It took me a long time to make it! I wanted to give the necklace to Gia and ask her to marry me.
Dirty chickens are those harpies, they stole the bag and threw it atop the Giant's Claw. The bag opened, the necklace fell out and broke. Gems scattered everywhere. Hungry squawkers ate everything. Gems were beautiful and shiny. Squawkers swallowed all the gems!
Poor, poor Torrick! Now I have nothing to give my bride. It would be better if I die...

checkText.en: Did you find a big egg? This is a very good gift!

finishText.en:
Oh... Such a large egg... Gia will be excited! She will declare me a great hunter and agree to marry. Oh, I love Gia so much. More than life!
I'm very thankful to you wingless one. There are no words to express my gratitude!

goal.en: Collect a large squawker's egg and bring it to Torrick Hard-Luck on the Giant's Claw.

startText.en:
I know what to do! If wingless one helps me, I can save my love! I know where to get best present for my beloved Gia.
Huge squawkers inhabit Giant's Claw. Very ferocious. If you collect its egg, we may hatch the squawkling. The biggest, strongest and kindest squawker. I'm weak and cannot overcome a big squawker. But you surely can! Then I'll give an egg to Gia and help raise the best squawker in the tribe. Cheeba will be so jealous, he'll rip his tail feathers out!

checkText.en: This blasted jungle's giving me the willies... Without a deck below my feet, life sure ain't easy...

finishText.en: Oh, you've found them, the prodigal children, damn them! I am not taught to say thanks. But I swear I owe you one. If we see your tub in the Astral, we won't sink it immediately!

goal.en: Find the pirate ship's crew lost in the jungle, then tell Bell the Forester on the Rainbow Atoll about your success.

startText.en:
Oho! Hello! Where are you from? Then again, what's the difference?! We're all in the same deep doodoo here.
Whatcha staring at me for? Yes, I am a pirate. So what? Never seen one before? Pah! People usually see us either on the ship's deck or hanging from its mast. But now we're stuck here like landlubbers, dammit!
See, we wanted to pluck a few fat merchants. We hid behind a wormhole and waited for the tubby to appear. And then, all of a sudden two fleets emerged from the astral depths, an Imperial one and a League one. Nothing's in it, either way, it's not worth powder and shot... So we fled into the wormhole and that's that.
When I came to life, only wreck and corpses were around me. No water, nothing to eat, only warped masts from the ship. Kaput, so to speak. We somehow gathered and made a bonfire. Some of the boys went to find some grub and got lost.
Listen, you are going into the jungle anyway. If you see my guys, tell them that I'll shove a mast down their throat if they don't get back to the camp this instant!

checkText.en: So, got anything to eat?

finishText.en: Dang! This is enough for a feast! Damn, yo, you really are a savior. Like a... what's his name... Plam the Martyr!

goal.en: Collect meat, water and fruits and bring them to Bell the Forester on the Rainbow Atoll.

startText.en:
I'm friggin' hungry... My guts have been banging against each other for days in search of food! But there ain't nothing to eat. There's trouble with water as well. All supplies in our barrels have spoiled. Bad news, in a word. I can't leave camp, but without food and water we'll start eating each other soon. I ain't sending my guys into the jungle no more. Half of them are already gone.
Hey, listen... If you find any grub or a flask of fresh water, bring it here right away, ya hear? Meat, fruit... that don't matter! Fruit will be even better - my fangs are gettin' all loose from scurvy. We will repay our debt to you, honest!

checkText.en: I hate cats. I hate dogs, too. Any beasts with fangs, actually. D'you know who I don't hate? Parrots! A parrot sits on your shoulder, curses and chomps on seeds. A true orc in spirit!

finishText.en: Oh, listen, kitties don't growl anymore. Damn! Too bad I don't have gold to pay you. So take this. We'll see each other again, if the Astral permits. Then I will fully repay my debt. My word as a pirate!

goal.en: Kill 15 leopards on the Rainbow Atoll and report to Bell the Forester.

startText.en:
Dammit! You hear that? They growl and prowl around our camp... Demons take those flea-covered felines! I remember when we landed at Koch-Itzmahl. It also had many overgrown cats. I got myself a stylish tiger pelt overcoat then!
But that's when we had a full crew, armed and armored. Here my only weapons are a fist and some dirty words. Ain't the same thing...
Lookit, you've got a real weapon on you. How 'bout a business proposition? Chase these spotted tigers outta here before they gobble up one of mine. I will thank you as I can!

checkText.en: Well, were you able to save my guys from disgraceful death?

finishText.en: This is how you start believing in fairy tales. At the last moment, a handsome prince appears and rescues the princess. Now, I'm not exactly a princess, but then again you ain't much of a prince either. So, our little fairy tale seems rather... off. Anyway, thank you... for everything. If I'll see you again, I'll reward you handsomely, Astral permitting!

goal.en: Kill 10 Ogres on the Rainbow Atoll and free 5 imprisoned pirates. Then return to Reya the Merciless.

startText.en:
Oh... Don't fuss, landlubber, it's bad enough here... Were you sent by that fat bastard Bell? Sea urchin up his arse! Probably he's sitting up in the camp, drying his underwear, while we're being devoured by ogres. Bastard! If I get back in one piece, I'll scratch his eyes out!
Anyway, my name is Reya. I led the boarding crew on our ship. When we crashed from the skies, I gathered our toughest guys and went scouting the jungle. Who knew that this place was inhabited by ogres, in addition to leopards and monkeys? Real life ogres, no joke! They caught us like we were little kids. Cornered us in the brush and started beatin' on us with clubs. The lucky ones died right then. Maybe they'll even be resurrected. Some were gnawed at a bit, but that's no biggie. A pirate isn't a pirate without a peg leg! But for those who were taken captive, their fate looks much bleaker. If the ogres stuff 'em with garlic and gobble 'em up with salt and pepper, hell if any of them are going to resurrect!
Look, I'm in no condition to fight. They left me for dead here. Save my guys, won't you? We may be pirates, but we don't deserve such a vile death. If you want, you can kill or free them, but don't let them be eaten by ogres! I beg you!

finishText.en:
Hurray! You've found us! You are from the rescue team, are you not?
What do you mean "not a rescuer"? We told the admirals that even if this tub were to fly, it wouldn't be for long. But together with that scientist, they kept repeating that it was super important to ascertain coordinates and find out what was wrong with the local Astral... So here we are, dammit! As soon as we departed from the shore and made one turn, our reactor failed. We immediately began to steer toward the shore, but it was too late. The reactor exploded and we fell from the skies onto this sinful earth. The aft was smashed and only a burnt service cap was left of the captain... Oh ho, he probably won't resurrect now! A sad flight to end a career on...
So, no one thought to send a rescue for us? Did they forget about us?!

goal.en: Look around the Badger Island and find the source of the explosion that workers and guards talked about.

startText.en:
Do you at least believe us? You don't... I see it in your eyes, you don't! But we are certain there was a ship. The Elf also sent you for some garbage, such as stones and bones, and then refused to admit he ordered you to do it! Are you going to deny what happened? Didn't think so!
We should go to Badger Island and see what's what. Except that we are forbidden from leaving the camp. The admirals say that loose lips sink ships. But I don't see any functional ships around here, only morays...
Listen, let's have you go to the Badger Island and check what exploded there? What if you find that very ship there?

checkText.en: They forgot about us... Did they go mad? How can you forget about a whole ship? We knew they shouldn't have started brewing booze from the local fruit. That must be the reason no one remembers anything!

finishText.en:
And here is the last page. There's the official entry, as per protocol. "The ship Cuttlefish departs to conduct visual observation of the shores of an unknown allod and to collect information about a potential enemy." Signed: Admirals of the strike squadron of the first fleet of the League, the Chubby Family. You cannot forge their seal!
This is some kind of nonsense... We were sent to study the Astral! And the date is strange, it is a yesterday's entry. What the deuce!

goal.en: Gather pages of the ship's log from Cuttleship, which crashed on the Badger Island, and bring them to the Ropemaker Family.

startText.en:
Strange things you are saying. The admiral himself ordered us to fly. We remember it for sure! We even made a note in the ship's log that we bear no liability, since we are obeying the order of a superior officer. The ship was barely functional, and now it's nothing but a pile of metal.
You don't believe us? Here is the ship's log... Oh! Only the cover is left from the log. All the pages must have been dispersed by the wind.
We can't leave the equipment we're responsible for, even if it's all one big wreck at this point. We will sit tight and wait for the rescue team. Someone in the camp has to start wondering about a missing ship, for crying out loud! And you, if you don't believe us, can gather all the missing pages. You'll read for yourself the take-off entry and the flight's objective. That note will confirm our words!

checkText.en: Well, don't torture us, speak! Did you find out anything? We are very curious!

finishText.en: Oh... Oh... How is that? What do you mean, "no research was conducted"? We heard everything ourselves! But the paper does not lie... Or does it? What shall we do now?

goal.en: Bring the ship's log to the Prying Family in the League camp near the Green Cape.

startText.en:
This is unbelievable. Does it mean that all three of us lost our minds? Too bad our guys aren't back from the Purgatory yet, they would have most certainly confirmed our words! We weren't sent on patrol, but on a scientific mission to observe the nearby Astral and learn about its structure. We remember the Elf waving his arms at our captain and making scary eyes, talking about the dangers of astral anomalies.
We'd love to go back to the camp and grab the Elf by the neck ourselves, but cannot abandon the equipment trusted to us. We are the only men left from the crew! Which means we are responsible for the ship. So we'll just sit tight here until the rescue team comes. But you should take the ship's log and return to the camp. Let them figure out what the hell is going on.

finishText.en: Are you a complete fool? Krakharak! Don't you try whistle in your own ear? Why not beating drums, playing horn, or dancing like a rabid bear? It's still not so easy to notice!

goal.en: Meet Viss Sharp-Spear on the Badger Island.

startText.en:
Quarr, Son of the Wind! Good you're here. I've brought urgent news to the war chief. It's very important. We have found the traitor, the planted chick. The same one that got away from you. We know who it is. It is the damned anarchist. They do not want good or bad government. They only want war. They think no one should tell them what to do. Tagar kual kurrakh!
I will fly to the winged city for help, while Viss will stay to spy on foolish anarchista. Your help will be very useful right now. Viss is hiding in bushes. You should quietly whistle, like the wind among cliffs. He will respond like a seagull cry. Together you will easily defeat anarchists.

checkText.en: You should only choose fresh liana. Dry liana will not make a good net.

finishText.en: Ar-karna, wingless one! You've brought good liana. I'll weave a durable net. No traitor will escape. Only if I could weave... but without tools, with just bare talons, it's impossible to weave a good net.

goal.en: Gather 8 Elastic Lianas and bring them to Viss Sharp-Spear on the Badger Island.

startText.en:
Traitorous anarchists are crafty and agile. I watch them. They are very careful bastards, twitching from slightest noise, flying like lightning. Wingless one cannot catch them up. Still, it's good to be quick, but it's better to be smart!
Lianas grow in the jungle. Very durable lianas. No one among the People of the Wind can tear it. Wingless one is strong, you can pluck lianas. I will make durable net from lianas. Traitors entangle themselves in the net and will not escape. Then wingless one will take them to the city and have our chief punish them. The chief will be happy, thank outlander and reward me with the best hen to marry! Wingless one does not need a hen anyway, while I want to bring up chicks.

checkText.en: Some time ago, badgers inhabited this island. Then monkeys came and no more badgers could live there. Only the badger's name's what's left.

finishText.en: Hurray! You have found a sack. I can now make a net and you will easily capture all anarchists.

goal.en: Take away the traveling sack from the monkeys inhabiting the Badger Island, then return it to Viss Sharp-Spear.

startText.en:
While you were plucking lianas, I was spying green traitor's camp. Very careful. So careful, even a monkey did not notice. Insolent monkeys stole my sack, kurrakh kurr them all! There were tools in that sack. Knife, awl, everything is lost!
You have to help me again. We must find monkeys and retrieve the sack. I cannot weave a good net without tools. If I do not catch the traitor, then the whole tribe will laugh at me. Then I'd better not return to the city at all.

checkText.en: Mother of order, no one to rule, freedom, brotherhood, equality... Malarkey! Without a chief, any people become a herd. Only a sturdy wing of a real chief can show the way into future!

finishText.en: Those idiots lost feathers? That's a good job. People of the Wind will remember this victory.

goal.en: Kill 12 Aviak Anarchists on the Badger Island and report your victory to Viss Sharp-Spear.

name.en: Anarchy Is the Mother of Order

startText.en: Monarchy's not something they like. Neither those morons are too enthusiastic about the stupid idea of the red-winged. Freedom is all they want. But their understanding of freedom is impunity. Freedom to steal and kill! Cause nothing but trouble. Now they rob us, now they assault red ones, now they carve nasty words on the rock. What word? I don't want to say it, as it's very, very dirty word. They carved it so hard it took us two weeks to paint over it. These anarchists are plain stupid! If you get rid of those morons, all Children of the Wind will be grateful.

checkText.en: I don't want to fight. This war is not outlanders' concern.

finishText.en: Why do you interfere in affairs of People of the Wind? You'll never grow wings or understand true nature of our people, no matter what stupid Ko'Chuck say!

goal.en: Find the traitor while fighting aviak anarchists, snare him in the net, and find out what he wanted the Crown of the Wind for.

startText.en:
The net is ready. It's time we should take care of the traitor and find out where the crown is hidden!
You're stronger than me, so you can easily handle anarchists, while I should stay here and make sure the traitor will not flee from the camp. If the traitor tries to escape, I'll cry out loud. You'll sure to hear.
It's crucial not to let the traitor flee. He probably is hiding among other anarchists. As soon as you know that he is the traitor, cast the net, tie his wings, ground him and kick his beak. With his wings tied, the traitor won't escape. And if you tickle his feathers, he'll chirp like nightingale. He'll tell you everything, why he stole the crown and where it is. If we get the Crown of the Wind back, Ko'Chuck will be so delighted!

checkText.en: I was visited by tattered Chlo Bob-Tailed. He said you've found the traitor's den and fought him. Did you find the Crown of the Wind?

finishText.en:
What?! The Crown of the Wind turned to ashes?! This cannot be... It is a great symbol! If Karrok owned the crown, all People of the Wind would bow to their true ruler. Even the Steel Claw would accept our authority. And those who refused, would lose their feathers! There can be only one ruler. People need solid government. And we could create such government, and my people could prosper again... But now we need to negotiate with those stupid red-winged - everyone is fed up with the war...
However, there's no great loss without a small gain. If we did not get hold of the crown, the Steel Claw could not have it either. One problem less. Still, I am grateful to you. Please accept this weapon as a gift. Carrying it is a privilege only given to distinguished warriors!

goal.en: Toss the crown into the Astral and tell Ko'Chuck in the aviak town by the Green Cape that the crown was destroyed by anarchists.

startText.en:
An outlander doesn't know our history, our customs... Your name is Son of the Wind, but you still do not understand our people!
The Crown of the Wind is not some nice hat. The Crown of the Wind is a symbol. A symbol of a great power! Lust for power split our people. Glittering Wing wanted a chief. Steel Claw wanted no chief. And we... We only wanted brothers' blood stop flowing like a river! One who gets the crown pronounces himself a sovereign of all the winged ones. The war will erupt with new intensity. The war will have no winners, everyone will lose!
If you want do our people good, destroy the Crown of the Wind. Discard it into ever-hungry void beyond our land, and tell the chief the crown is lost forever. With no crown, he will have no reason to call himself a lawful sovereign. Glittering Wing and Steel Claw will be equal in power, their chiefs will need come to agreement. That will not happen right away, but eventually. I believe it. Then People of the Wind will live in peace again!

checkText.en: Carnation essence is useless against local mosquitoes, you need to pile up crossbow bolts!

finishText.en: Wow, a tenderloin! We'll just smoke it a bit, then add some garlic and pepper to get rid of the tropical sores... Gonna make your mouth water!

goal.en: Kill 8 mosquitoes and 8 finguses, get 8 pieces of Tapir Meat and bring them to the Ropemaker Family at the shipwreck on the Badger Island.

startText.en:
Argh, what a nice ship got wrecked... The flotsam can't just be left here... It's our inventory assets! We're not allowed! Only we're scared guarding the remains of the ship here: the jungle is teeming with strange creatures, and mosquitoes are the stuff of nightmares, they are nearly as big as people. One of them stung Brody, our youngest one, and sucked some two pints of her blood on the spot. We barely brought the poor thing to life. She still stutters!
We can't leave the ship, but we can't bear to stay here any longer either! Pray, help us! Take care of the local beasts and we'll be very grateful to you. Also, we'll report your feats to the headquarters when we get back to the camp. Only we're afraid that's not gonna happen soon...
And yeah, if you come across anything edible, kill it and bring it here, because our bowels are roaring like hell. Our bellies are rumbling so loud that Greta mistook me for a tiger a while ago; we had a hard time getting her off the bowsprit.

checkText.en: Tropical paradise my ass! Whenever I recall the local creatures' teeth, my hair stands on end. That... scares you witless!

finishText.en:
Is the beast dead? That's great news!
Whoa, what the hell is that? You say that was in the moray's belly? Let's have a closer look...

goal.en: Kill the Giant Moray and report to the Ropemaker Family on the Badger Island.

startText.en: We also spotted a moray around here. A big badass one! Thick as a log and razor-sharp, those teeth can bite off an arm or a leg in an instant. Scary as hell... We were about to stroll around the shallow in search of drowned sailors, but the place was swarming with morays! We bolted outta there so fast we nearly ran up a palm tree. If that moray could be taken care of, that'd be a great relief. That beast must have taken plenty of lives!

checkText.en: So many fine fellas that died for nothing... Sob...

finishText.en: The ship's cook used to make cakes from old bootlegs that were finger-lickin' good. And the helmsman would steer the ship through anomalies like a thread through a needle's eye. And the chaplain... Argh, no point going on... Suffice it to say we've lost good people! May their memory live forever!

goal.en: Kill 5 Terrifying Morays, gather 5 items that belonged to the crew members, and bring them to the Ropemaker Family at the shipwreck on the Badger Island.

startText.en:
Oh, we're in trouble... That signet belonged to our captain! Does that mean the beast gobbled him up? Holy cow, he won't be able to resurrect now! How dreadful... Goddamned beasts, it's all their fault that our crew died a final death!
Help us avenge our companions. Please! Their souls must not be left unrequited. Should you find any items that belonged to the sailors, bring them to us. At least we'll know who can still resurrect and who should be given funeral rites.

checkText.en: Now, what do you want? Gonna bother us with idle chit-chat again?

finishText.en:
What's that trash? Dead crew members' stuff? What the hell are you talking about?! Once again, we didn't have a ship and we didn't send anyone anywhere.
The Ropemaker Family? Never heard of them. Do you engage in alcohol abuse? Or maybe you had a sunstroke?
Get out of here... Go find Maria Divova! She can give you some pills to bring you back to normal, 'cause you're clearly hallucinating!

goal.en: Deliver the Bag of Dead Sailors to the Chubby Family at the League Camp next to the Green Cape.

startText.en:
We can't even bury our companions, seeing as they found their last refuge in the morays' guts. Looks like we'll have to mount gravestones over empty graves. At least we have some of their belongings, that's something to remember them by.
 Please take these items to our admirals and tell them the guys died heroic deaths in the line of duty. Let the dead be given proper respects...

checkText.en: Listen carefully, I don't have time to yack with you. There are still plenty of wounded to care for.

finishText.en: So that's that. Now I understand what happened to our fleet. Imagine what happened to common brigantines and corvettes if the League's ships were left in tatters.

goal.en: Ask Mark Gorlov about the situation.

startText.en:
Hey, just don't faint again! I was barely able to revive you! I thought that's it, no more hero... Glory to the Light, you have a strong head.
Wait, relax. Look how wobbly you are. You can barely stand on your feet. You are about to crash. Don't fuss, breathe slowly, let me introduce myself.
My name is Mark Gorlov. I was captain's first mate on the flagship of our strike squardron. Our ship entered the wormhole first... Its remains are over there, floating in the Astral, near the shore. So consider yourself lucky!

checkText.en: Eh, I could use a keg of beer...

finishText.en: Good! Now that means business! With these instruments and durable ropes we can build a camp in two minutes flat!

goal.en: Collect barrels of provisions, boxes of tools and coiled ropes that remained after the shipwreck, and bring them to Mark Gorlov at the shipwreck.

startText.en: I want to ask one more favor of you... We don't have a cargo hold after the shipwreck, while your ship is almost intact. Right now every little thing might help. Salted meat, ropes, nails, hammers, saws - everything! We need to reinforce our camp, or at least to put canopies to live under, and also we don't have much too eat. If you see anything useful, bring it to me immediately, I'll find a use for any and all supplies.

checkText.en: Whoa! Who bit you like that? Morays? There is no rest from them!

finishText.en: So have you managed to chase morays away? Excellent! Now we can walk in shallow waters without fear of losing our feet. By the way, don't forget to take care of your wounds. Morays' teeth contain all sorts of things. You may even get some disease from their bite.

goal.en: Exterminate 10 morays around the shipwreck site and report on the completed task to Chubby Family at the League camp.

startText.en:
Tropics... I hate tropics! Just look at the local sea - the predators are all piled up on top of one another! Truly, this is no tropical resort atoll. The worst I saw was this enormous fish with finger-length teeth! If a beast like that grabs hold of your leg, get ready to limp for the rest of your life. I only saw them before in pictures. Gibberlings call them morays.
I fear that these beasts will start feasting on us... Chase them away! Morays have a cowardly reputation, so if you manage to kill ten of them, the rest will learn to keep their distance.

checkText.en: Well, what's playing tricks, it is our ears or the admirals' memory?

finishText.en: No one remembers the ship? Impossible! Although there was one worker who mentioned that some ship wrecked near the Badger Island...

goal.en: Question workers and guards in the League camp about the "lost" ship and report results to Inquisitive family in the League camp.

startText.en:
No, we won't let it go! There was a ship! Was! We heard it ourselves! We cannot all be struck by senility simultaneously!
And if the admirals refuse to confess to existence of a ship, maybe the guards or the workers will be more loose-lipped. Except they won't tell us squat. They'll think that the Prying Family have heard another rumor... You, however, they may trust. So you question them.
There was a ship, we know it! Why would they hide it from us? Strange...

finishText.en: For a moment I thought you would not come. Well, you made the right choice. I am not disappointed in you.

goal.en: Meet the mysterious stranger in the Cave of Elements under Sunny Cascade. But first you will need to receive the Blessing of Elements from an ancient witch who lives on Kahlua Island.

startText.en:
Listen carefully and don't interrupt. And don't stare at me! I am visible only to you, I don't exist to others. So simply shut up and listen.
I know that you've already noticed people's strange memory gaps. That's just the tip of the iceberg. Let's just say it is a small error that made its way into robust calculations of our old acquaintance.
You probably don't remember me? Oh well. It is not important right now. What is important is that you know that you're in great danger. Let's just say that the owner of this paradise is saddened by your unbridled curiosity and wishes to get rid of you. Don't believe your eyes: everything surrounding you is a trap for naive fools, and the trap door just shut itself. Whether you believe me or not is up to you. But if you want to survive, then meet me in a place called the Cave of Elements, and I will show you just how deep the rabbit hole goes.

checkText.en: Hello-hello! Are you from the ship that wrecked nearby?

finishText.en: Too bad not everyone was lucky enough to survive... But you are good! First you tend to others, only then to yourself. Respect!

goal.en: Revive 5 fainted sailors and question them as to the shipwreck cause. Report on the addition to the Chubby Family in the League camp.

startText.en:
Well, how do you feel? No longer dizzy? Great! Since you are all right, then help me revive the other survivors. The impact was so strong that the boarding crew from the upper deck was cast everywhere along the shore. I pray to Tensess that our guys are all right.
Go, find survivors, revive them and send them here. I'll tend to their wounds. And question those who are conscious. Perhaps they saw something that may explain the cause of the shipwreck.

finishText.en: So that's how it is? Oh, good thing we did not trust those damn Imperials! If it was a trap, then Kania is facing a serious threat. Oh man... We were fools to agree to this venture! We must contact Aidenus immediately!

goal.en: Tell the Chubby Family at the League camp about the sailor's suspicions.

startText.en:
Cough... My lungs are full of water... I thought I would die for sure!
Hey, didn't you have an Imperial uniform on you? Yes, you did! I remember! When the ship crashed, I fell overboard into the water. I remember vividly: everything became a blur, folks screaming horribly, fire everywhere, and you standing over me in an Imperial uniform. I thought that the Imperials came to our rescue... and then I fainted. When I came to life, you had another set of clothes on.
Hold on... If it wasn't you, then the Imperials knew beforehand that our ship would crash and explode? Then why would someone in an Imperial uniform be around right after the shipwreck? It must be their handiwork! They must have lured us here and caused the crash! We need to tell everything to our leader immediately!

checkText.en: So, did the Imperial bastard get what he deserved?

finishText.en: What do you mean "the Empire is innocent"?! How can they not be guilty? They were the ones to lure us here!

goal.en: Track down and kill the Imperial spy near the League camp and report your success to the Chubby Family.

startText.en:
So that's how it is. Act with our own forces and without support. And with the Empire throwing monkey wrenches our way. We don't have a clue whether Tep was involved in what happened, but there's no way we wouldn't know if it was the Committee! Damned traitors! We'd strangle all of them with our bare paws!
With all the running around trying to establish communication, we totally forgot about what one of the sailors told you. Do you remember? If his memory is true, then he saw a live Imperial in our area. And our sentries reported some creature hiding in bushes near the camp, which fled as soon as they cocked their crossbows. What wild animal would know a crossbow?! It must have been an Imperial spy, and he is hiding somewhere near.
We ask you to find him and kill him! Traitors must remain ignorant!

finishText.en:
Quarr, wingless!
What brought you outlander to our village? All kind of winds blow through here, but we are happy to see new friends!
You heart is closed to the song of the wind... I see it. He who cannot fly never can understand our people. If wingless one wants friendship, you must obtain wings. Outlander should go to Cheeba and learn, then return, only then we can talk!

goal.en: Meet the aviak shaman, Whew Black-Feather, in the aviak village on the Green Cape.

startText.en:
Well... If the Empire wants a war, then they'll get a war! We also have an ace up our sleeve. And this ace is locals!
Don't you know? Oh, our empty heads! We forgot to tell you the most important thing! We recently made contact with the locals and were able to find common ground. They are aviaks! Frankly, they are some strange aviaks. Wild and illiterate. But they fully agree with our ideas! And for sure they won't support the damned Imperials.
Why, you ask? It's simple! If we understood correctly, there was a schism in the aviak tribe. Separatists under red banners attempted to start a revolution but were defeated and forever banished from the tribe to the other side of the island! The locals call that land Irdrich, by the way.
Whoa, mama... The Imperials landed on that side of the island! What if they ally with these revolutionaries? Alarm! We have to immediately inform our new friends!
Quickly run to the aviak village, find their shaman and tell him that reds may return with reinforcements.

checkText.en: Did you find the traitor?

finishText.en:
He escaped? How could you let him get away? You are strong and agile... A young aviak could not overcome you!
Oh well, let him be. You say that a planted chick fled towards the Badger Island? Then I give him chase. We'll find him and interrogate him ourselves. You needn't do anything else. I'll deal with everything myself. In any case, I am grateful. Perhaps the traitor escaped, but I will not repeat that mistake again!

goal.en: Find a traitor among young white aviaks inhabiting the edge of the Green Cape, then return to Ko'Chuck in the Glittering Wing village on the Green Cape.

startText.en:
So did you find this symbol at Ktar-Karkh? Outlanders also call it Deadman's Rock. Did you find it on the ground in the other outlanders' camp? Strange, but I believe you. You have no reason to lie.
I want to say one thing to you. Promise you won't tell anyone. It's a big secret! We were transporting a treasure of the old capital. Wind Crown! A symbol of a true ruler! Since long ago, the crown belonged to the ruler, a king of aviaks. If Karrok equipped the crown, his power would increase significantly. Reds would be scared, and whites would show respect and fight reds better. But it was not given to him...
The crown was stolen by the reds long time ago. We recently retrieved it, older aviaks stayed behind to protect it from chase, younger ones carried the crown to the village. But I think there is a traitor among the young ones. A planted chick! He wears white feathers, but he is red. Will you help me find him? Youngsters do not know you, so they won't be surprised by your questions. An outlander is an outlander, after all. You will find the traitor and find out where he carried off the crown.
Young aviaks do not live in town. They live on the edge of the cape, nest in a big house, until they become real men. You should go there, ask around, look around, find a planted chick, and report to me. Try not to scare him. We need him alive!

finishText.en:
Greetings! What can I do for you?
Maria sent you? Hm... I actually asked her to send me an available sailor and not to bother busy people. But the thoughtless dame mixed up everything again...
Oh well, since you're volunteering to help, I am not going to reject it.

goal.en: Meet Jean-Jacques de Desirae in the League camp near the Green Cape.

startText.en:
Oh, I was just going to look for you. Have you met Jean-Jacques? He is such a dearie! Can you imagine that he promised to name an allod after me, should he discover one? What a man!
Oh, excuse me, I digress. Jean-Jacques asked me to find someone with strong muscles who could help him with his research. He is so smart, he knows everything! And if he doesn't know something, he knows just what to do to find the answer. It is a great pleasure to work with him!

checkText.en: Have you ever seen an astral storm? It's quite a rare sight. Mesmerizing and deadly! One who survives such a storm never forgets it.
