finishText.en: Measurements ready? Good, just in time. I've already constructed an approximate matrix which can shed light on the nature of the local Astral, but I need precise data, not a crystal ball. Fortune telling is Barisheva's job, while astral studies are precise science!

goal.en: Record measurements at the indicated locations and report to Jean-Jacques de Desirae in the League camp.

startText.en:
I admit, I am totally confused! I dedicated my whole life to exploring the Astral! Not many people understand the Astral. Everyone considers it fatally dangerous element, but I worship it. It is beautiful! Look into the Astral, feel its breath and pulse. It is eternal and ever-changing, beautiful and terrible as nothing else; it gives birth and death... It's wonderful!
But the local Astral looks... different. It is dead and cold. I don't sense in it any primeval and wild energy which overflows the Astral in any other sector of any layer. And that wormhole through which we ended up here... I don't see any exit from it in the sky. But we are alive, which means it must open directly above the island. And that simply cannot be! The allod would have been blown to pieces and absorbed by the Astral long ago due to such close proximity to the wormhole.
I have some theories, but without facts they are nothing. I need precise data, and I would like you to collect it. Take my measuring device. It is already calibrated. All you have to do is press this green button. Record measurements in several places on the astral shore and return to me with the data. Let's not waste any more time.

checkText.en: So, fifteen for tolerance, minus hundred eleven... Subtract the division of matrix from the constant, add a differentiated variable... Well, what do you have?

finishText.en:
Samples? What kind of garbage is this? I didn't order that!
What do you mean "device was broken and I asked to collect samples"? I never asked you to collect this trash!
Were you, by chance, concussed during the shipwreck? Any memory gaps? None of my equipment is faulty! Everything works properly! I am processing data as we speak, though I already see that everything is within norm. This local Astral is no different from a regular one.
...
Cut it out - I never sent you for any samples! Read my lips: did not send! My trained intellect remembers everything in detail. Aside from readings, I did not expect anything else from you. The readings were adequate, the data was accurate, and the result was perfectly expected.
That's it, now go away and don't bother me with your nonsense. Better yet, see the ship's doctor and let him check your head for brain trauma. What nerve! Accusing me, an outstanding researcher and scientist, of amnesia!

goal.en: Collect 5 fish bone fragments, 5 crooked beaks, 5 turtle shells and 5 stones warped by the Astral. Bring them to Jean-Jacques de Desirae in the League camp near the Green Cape.

startText.en:
It is impossible! Here, look - the first reading has zero voltage, while the second goes beyond all tolerable limits, and yet the allod somehow remains intact. The third reading has a negative value! It is im-pos-si-ble! No way. No how. Theoretically.
Equipment looks operational... I think I haven't gone mad yet. Readings were done exactly per instructions. I set all the parameters on the measuring device myself. What if I was given defective equipment, which some paper-pusher approved as operational? When I return home, I'll rip the procurement agents' heads off, encase them in formaldehyde and create an impressionist exhibition entitled "Triumph of Greed Over Common Sense." But that's going to happen later. Right now we will perform our research using old school methods - with materials touched by the Astral. Just for that, I have samples of astral amber, collected in Darkwater. A comparison of parameter deviations of that matter with the local samples should help me solve this mystery.
I will start preparing the necessary equipment right away, and you, if it is not too difficult, should start collecting samples. For research I will need something mineral, i.e. stones or crystals that are strewn about the shore. I will also need various living samples, such as bird beaks, fish bones or turtle shells. In a word, any hard organic material that hasn't been subjected to decay.
I hope that by setting parameters for local astral warping we will understand how to get out of this cursed sector... I truly hope so!

checkText.en: Well, were you able to extract anything interesting from the admirals?

finishText.en: What? How so? We heard about the ship ourselves... Honest, we are not lying. Amazing...

goal.en: Question the Chubby Family about the fate of the ship that survived the wormhole and return to the Prying Family.

startText.en:
Hey! Psst! Listen to what we say. Please forgive us for eavesdropping on your conversation with the elf. We did not do it on purpose, honest. It is just that we are too inquisitive. They even call us like that, the Prying Family.
We think that something strange is going on. You are not the first to encounter similar forgetfulness. We, for example, heard with our own ears that Jean-Jacques proposed to admirals to send the sole surviving ship to circle the island. It happened before your arrival here, but now everybody is sure that no ship has survived. But we heard it with our own ears! Honest!
Listen, our admirals trust you. Try to tell them our suspicions. Just don't tell them that we were eavesdropping, otherwise we'll be punished...

checkText.en: Just don't grab them with your bare hands. Local frogs are terribly poisonous, and I have neither anesthesia nor antidote. If you get bit, we'll have to amputate the extremity all the way to the neck! It is an age old method!

finishText.en:
Whoa, such scrumptious legs! These frogs must have been huge. This is just what I need for the potion.
Now I will boil them, dry them, and make a potion from their slime... It'll treat any illness!

goal.en: Bring 20 tree-frog legs and 10 beakers of tree-frog slime to Maria Divova in the League camp near the Green Cape.

startText.en:
Oh, hello! You are probably one of those who were sent to search for us? We got in trouble! We got stuck here, like a bone in a throat, neither in nor out... Oh well. We've been through worse jams than this, so we'll be all right! Come to think of it, it is not that bad here. Local aviaks are pleasant enough, even though they are savages. The important thing is that they understand that a steady hand and strict authority, without extra committees and bureaucracy, can be effective. Except that their king is ailing. I am not sure whether he was wounded in battle or ate a rotten fish. I don't understand their chirping much. But I think that if we can heal their king, the locals will be much friendlier to us.
Well, would you like to help me in a noble cause of saving the leader of a friendly country, even if their country is the size of this island? Then catch me some local frogs, please. They are awfully repulsive! I've been afraid of these creatures since childhood, but I cannot make a magical elixir without their legs. You don't have to bring me whole frogs. All I need is twenty frog legs and ten beakers with their slime.

checkText.en: Quarr... I asked you not to bother me...

finishText.en: What? Young lady with blond feathers on her head wants to treat me? Kha... She thinks she can treat children of the Wind?

goal.en: Add 10 doses of snake venom into the beaker with the potion, then bring it to Karrok Stout-Hearted in the Glittering Wing village on the Green Cape.

startText.en:
Oh, my forgetful head! I completely forgot! The main potion component is venom of a tropical horned viper. Without it, this potion was and will remain poisonous. But with that venom... Do you know the proverb: "Treat like with like"? This is exactly how this potion works. Snake venom neutralizes the toxins in tree-frog slime, and the resulting compound, when it enters the patient's body, forces them to fight the illness with all of the might, and defeat it.
Don't you want to save the chief of our new friends? Then help me complete my task. The beaker that I gave you contains an almost prepared potion. All you need to do is add snake venom, ten doses, and have the chief drink the mixture. I hope I calculated dosage correctly...

checkText.en: First you drink, then I will. If you survive, that is.

finishText.en: Kukhul taq-taggar! are you all right? I was afraid that you had already gone to heaven to eternally fly with the free wind and never return to the sinful earth. I do not want to drink this gross mixture. You better spill it into the deepest hole on the most remote island and never bring it up. And tell that wingless torturer that chief is feeling much better. I'm not lying! I saw you bend in pain and I immediately felt will to live!

goal.en: Taste the healing potion and tell Karrok Stout-Hearted about your sensations.

startText.en:
It's not that I don't believe you... But this mixture stinks so much! I don't even want to know what's inside. Tak-taq arrawakh... I really doubt the medicinal power of this stinky liquid. I think that beaker will crack from stench soon.
Are you sure it will help? No? Then you better drink first. Just a little bit. Just one sip. If you're fine, then I'll drink as well. Don't be offended, but I did not become chief by being a naive chick, quetal-kul!

checkText.en: Gather berries carefully. Juice is also poisonous. If you burn yourself with juice, apply an arrowhead right away. It will extract poison and save you.

finishText.en: You've done a great job. You've found juicy berries and the emerald arrowhead. Thank you, Son of the Wind!

goal.en: Collect 10 stems of Emerald Arrowhead and 10 Kurru Berries on the Green Cape and return to Whew Black-Feather in the Glittering Wing village.

startText.en:
I've heard you want to receive wings, wingless one. Then you will become a swore brother to People of the Wind! From then on, you will be called Son of the Wind. A son always helps his father, does not he? Then you will help us!
Father of People of the Heavens, Karrok Stout-Hearted, is wise and strong, but he's ill. Very ill. When we fought with the damned red rebels, Karrok flew in the vanguard! He led our tribe in battle! An arrow hit him right in chest. Now Karrok is really sick. Between life and death. And a new Son of the Wind can help me cure him.
Go into forest to find kurru berries and emerald arrowhead. Kurru berries are very poisonous. You can die if you swallow even one. Arrowhead is useful and medicinal. It treats wounds, cough, and infertility. It treats everything! Combined together, they are strong enough even to resurrect a corpse.

checkText.en: A sea stone is tasty. Just it's so difficult to catch. One must take it very high in the sky and then drop on the ground. Then a sea stone lose its cover and is tasty.

finishText.en:
I remember how wingless ones call a sea stone! Tattle! No? Toottle? No... Got it! Turtle!
Wingless ones speak a tongue-twisting language! My beak hurts.

goal.en: Collect a large Turtle Shell and 10 chunks of Turtle Meat. Return to Whew Black-Feather in the Glittering Wing village.

startText.en: Now I have another task for you. I heard that you can swim. That's good. We, people of the Wind, can fly, but we swim badly and only down. I need a cover and meat of a sea stone. You call it something different, not a sea stone, but I don't remember. Why do I need a difficult word when there is a simple one? A sea stone is a stone. It swims and eats and, when in danger, it hides inside a stone. Dive into the water, catch the sea stone and bring it here. I'll make an amulet out of its cover!

checkText.en: Cough... Cough... What do you want from an old and sick aviak, chick?

finishText.en:
Amulet? Old Whew completely lost his mind... Oh well, give it here. Amulet won't hurt, I think...
...
Taq-taggar! I think it's working. I feel... better! Quar-caw, chick. You saved me! My honor tells me, not many winged ones would risk their lives for an outlander. But you, wingless one, risked and saved me without hope for gratitude! You are very noble, my friend. I don't speak for all your people, but you are always welcomed in my home!
I wish to reward you. This reward cannot compare to what you do for me, but I think it will be useful in your travel through our land.

goal.en: Using an amulet, create a sacrificial circle, kill 10 leopards while in the circle, and return to Karrok Stout-Hearted in the Glittering Wing village.

startText.en:
A powerful amulet can be made from hydra teeth. Son of the Wind, you're almost done, wash the amulet in sacrificial blood of a powerful enemy. Then a spirit will hide in the amulet. Chief will wear the amulet and the spirit will protect the chief. It protects from illness, sickness, even death... With luck.
Taq-kuarr, Son of the Wind! The Chief's life is in your talons. Take the amulet and go hunting into the forest. Powerful, fierce and agile leopards inhabit it. Strong spirit, taq-taggar! When you touch the amulet, it will draw a sacrificial circle. If you kill a leopard inside the circle, its spirit will inhabit the amulet. Then you can give the amulet to Karrok. The Chief will wear the amulet and become completely healthy!
Heaven loves you Son of the Wind. I have faith in your success! Qual-kutarr!

checkText.en: Hydra is strong, Son of the Wind is quick, but old Whew is crafty! Craftiness and agility always trump dumb strength.

finishText.en:
Good hide! I'll make a hat out of it. You're a good hunter, you have the right to wear the hat made from hydra. Beautiful hat!
I'll make an amulet out of teeth, summon a powerful spirit, bind it to the amulet, and give it to Karrok. The spirit will chase away sickness and make the Chief healthy!

goal.en: Throw a poisoned bait to the nightmarish hydra, wait until the poison works, kill the hydra, take its tooth and hide, and bring them to Whew Black-Feather in the Glittering Wing village.

startText.en:
You are just wonderful! You collected poison berries, sea stone's cover and meat. No question was asked. I had a hidden agenda when asked for those items. I'll make a potion from herbs that eliminate pain and give it to Karrok. And others go toward a poisonous bait. It will be a very tasty bait! I'd eat it myself if not for poison. A hydra is stupid, knows nothing about the poison. What hydra, you ask? A hydra that you are going to kill.
Hydras live on a small island near our village. Hydras are strong, but stupid. Throw the bait at it and a hydra will swallow it, and then get very ill from poison. Kill that hydra, collect its teeth and hide, and bring them to me. I'll make a powerful amulet out of them!

checkText.en: By the looks of it, this is that very box with the valuable item inside that Ko'Chuck was talking about...

finishText.en: The valuable item is gone. Carried off. Where will it be found?

goal.en: Kill zombies that attacked an aviak platoon on the road leading to the Deadman's Rock, and find the valuable thing lost by white aviaks.

name.en: Zombies with Scythes Stand along the Road

startText.en:
Quarr, friend of Glittering Wing. People of the Wind talk much about your deeds. They say you strangled the Swamp Terror, the gigantic hydra that ate many good warriors, with your bare hands. They say you know martial art of other people, other land, and that is how you win. I think it will be easy for you to fulfill my request.
Our platoon was going to the east of the village, carrying a valuable item there. Then someone attacked the platoon, consisted mainly of chicks... young and dumb chicks. They were afraid to fight and fled from battle. They flew into the village and talked about strange things.
They say the platoon walked at night. Red enemies were not asleep, looking to sabotage. Workers! Proletariat! Damn their taq-taggar... Except our warriors did not meet reds, but someone else. Chicks say they were walking stealthily. They did not see anything at night. And then a bright light shone on them, a box where outlanders bury the dead flew in the air above the road. And zombies with scythes were standing along the road... And complete silence!
I want to ask you, go and see what happened to platoon. Our warriors are brave, but they are afraid of the dead. Will you check? I'll be grateful!

checkText.en: Did you find out what scared our chicks?

finishText.en:
You talk strange things. Arisen? I do not know them. Our dead never roam the earth. There are no other outlanders besides you. Where did the dead come from? That's a mystery.
And here's an interesting feather you found. It tells me many things. But I tell you about it some other time. I don't want to make a mistake, understand? The matter is too important to... tal-kutul, how you say it... poke a finger at the sky? A very wise word. Return later, when I stop thinking and start talking. Agree?

goal.en: Track down the robbers and find out their fate. Relay the news to Ko'Chuck Water-Fowl in the Glittering Wing village on the Green Cape.

startText.en: Shoe tracks near the box lead deep into the jungle. The robbers that routed the platoon of white aviaks did not bother to cover their tracks. Perhaps it makes sense to follow them and find out where the hapless robbers hid, and also look for evidence that may shed light on one question: why would the Arisen attack an aviak platoon?

checkText.en: So, is the news good or bad?

finishText.en: Wow! I'll be damned... That's a tribal sign of the aviaks, their warriors put it on the wing. And this camp doesn't look like our scouts stayed in it. The Empire may have banded together with the aviaks. However, I don't wanna slander them without proof. After all, what if I'm wrong?

goal.en: Find traces of the Empire's citizens on the Deadman's Rock and report your findings to Yaroslav Kramov, who's waiting in the settlement of the Glittering Wing tribe.

startText.en:
Well met, friend! I heard a lot about your feats. And, well, I envy you. You know how to win others' trust! By the way, it's trust I wanna talk to you about. Trust between us and our little winged allies, or, to be more precise, the absence of it. Why do you think their leader told you nothing about the valuable cargo? They don't seem to trust you... And a lack of trust is a step away from enmity.
Looks like their honcho blames us for the loss. While I'm sure it's the Empire's doing. The Arisen didn't turn up here by chance! Those bastards must be plotting something. And if we don't keep our eyes open, we're gonna be in trouble. Now more than ever, we need a solid alliance with the natives. This is why I order you to find the aviaks' loss by any means necessary. If the Empire really is behind it, as I suspect, make sure the natives know all about it.
If I understand correctly, the aviaks were attacked in the vicinity of the Deadman's Rock, right? What are you waiting for, then?! We should have combed the island and looked under every boulder long ago. They must have left a trail!

checkText.en: Crabs are agile, but I'm crafty. I was the first to figure out how to catch crabs with a net. The whole thanked me.

finishText.en: Crabs! Many crabs! Wind speaks the truth - hunting spirits and a wingless outlander are gracious. Thank you. I'll wrap crabs in raw leaves, put them in the net and take them to the village. They will cook crabs and maize broth, and add cane tincture... It would be delicious!

goal.en: Catch 25 crabs with the net and bring them to Alarik Falcon-Eye on the Deadman's Rock.

startText.en:
Quarr, outlander! I heard the wind speak. Wind loves you! Wind tells a lot to the one who can hear. Wind says you are very, very fast. You have a keen eye and a steady hand. Skilled hunter, yes? Can you hunt agile crabs, wingless one? No? How can it be? I'll teach you!
Take the net and go along the beach, wingless one. Crabs are e very agile, catching them is not easy. You should cast a net, wingless one. A crab will get into it and stop running. Then the crab is easy to catch. Toss it into the pot right away! The crab will turned red, and adding cane tincture will make it much tastier.

checkText.en: Do not eat birds, wingless outlander! Do not eat singing birds, listen to them. If a bird starts singing in your belly, it will scare away the whole village. The sound will be just horrible...

finishText.en: You've been a great help, wingless one. Now, I will make huge bouquets and give them to ladies. They will favor me very much.

goal.en: Check the snares set on the Deadman's Rock, get 10 Singing Birds and bring them to Alarik Falcon-Eye.

startText.en: I have another favor to ask. I set snares everywhere on the cliff. I wanted to catch singing birds. Aviak ladies like singing birds a lot. They also like lucky hunters who catch birds. Though I'm not so lucky. Birds got into snares and sat quiet. As soon as I fly near, birds thrash their wings, try flying away... Snares are strong and birds are dumb - they often die from fear! But you - you walk silently. No wings, no wind. Birds will not fear a wingless one. Take them carefully out of snares them to me. I'll make bouquets, tie to birds' feet and give them to ladies. They will favor mecook crabs for me and serve maize broth and cane tincture. Celebrate!

checkText.en: Armored crocodiles have the best hides and fangs. Tough like a rock!

finishText.en: I'm saved! You got half of hides and fangs, I got the other half. Now I'll give hides and fangs to the Chief and then go to ladies to listen to singing birds and have delicious crab with cane tincture. I am so happy! You should take this reward and not refuse. Keep it as a memory!

goal.en: Get 10 Crocodile Hides and 20 Crocodile Fangs. Bring the trophies to Alarik Falcon-Eye on the Deadman's Rock.

startText.en:
I completely forgot! The Chief did not send me to catch birds. Not even delicious crabs. The Chief wanted a strong hide and sharp fangs. A hide to make armor and fangs to make amulets, arrowheads and sharp knives. I'm such a fool, I was thinking about ladies... If I return without a hide and fangs, the Chief will skin me and use my hide to make a tambourine! Poor, poor me. A bird is done for...
I don't want to bother my wingless friend anymore. But I don't want to lose my skin either. I offer a deal - you will help me get the hide and fangs. A good thing to do and a good reward to get!

checkText.en: Outlander, I sent you to bring a squawker's egg. Did you find one?

finishText.en: That's good! I know what to do about the egg. You should wait. Wait just a little.

goal.en: Bang the gong on top of the Green Cape and summon a tamed squawker. Use it to go to the top of the Giant's Claw, steal a squawker's egg and go back to Cheebah One-Eye at the Green Cape.

name.en: On the Wings of the Wind

startText.en:
Quetal quarr, outlander! What brought a wingless one to Cheebah? Do you want to learn? Then I'll teach you!
Have you ever heard of squawkers, outlander? I'll explain. A squawker is a bird. Toothy, powerful and always hungry. Very smart, but very angry. It's hard to tame. But a squawker flies like lightning, faster than wind! If you want to understand People of the Wind, you should tame a squawker. A mature squawker cannot be tamed, it's completely wild. You must find a small squawkling and tame it. Feed and care for it... Then a squawker will grow big and fly you on its back. Then you wingless one will become winged and understand our people!
Now climb the mountain and hit the gong. A tamed squawker knows the gong's sound well. Every island has its own gong. As soon as a squawker swoops in, climb atop it and fly to Giant's Claw. Wild and angry squawkers live there. Look for a squawker's egg, then strike the gong and bring the egg back. I will then help you hitch... hooch... tell you what to do.

checkText.en: If you feed squawker well, it love you and fly you high. But if you not feed it well, it might become angry and bite you.

finishText.en: Quamool qootlack, Wingless Outlander! A squawker for Wingless equals to wings. Now Wingless can bang the Gong on any island and call a squawker. A squawker will fly to the gong, fly high and fast. And Wingless will become Son of the Wind!

goal.en: Feed 20 pieces of meat to the squawkling and get back to Cheebah One-Eye at the Green Cape.

startText.en:
Wingless one, listen to me now. I'll give you a bone whistle. Blow this whistle, wingless one, and a squawkling will come. It will be small. Hungry. Gonna eat like hell! A squawker is not a parrot, it doesn't eat fruit. Only meat.
Go hunting, outlander, to get meat and feed a squawkling. When it grows very big, it will love you like its parent. It will carry you on its back up high in the sky! You will understand, trust us and make friends with our people!

finishText.en: Oh, there you are! Strange things happen in the world after Master was defeated by the heroes of Sarnaut... I'm afraid that by slaying him we pushed the world closer to the brink!

goal.en: Meet with Marrianne de Ardeur in the church in Novograd's Main Square.

startText.en:
Hello! Forgive me for distracting you from your heroic deeds, but I have an urgent order that can't wait.
Marianne de Ardeur, abbess of the Church of Light, wants to see you. Looks like something came up... I don't know what exactly, though.
Now hurry to Marianne, she wouldn't summon a League hero for nothing!

checkText.en: How do you feel? Dizzy? Do you see multi-colored spots?

finishText.en: Praised be the Light, you're OK!

goal.en: Use a ship cannon to shoot down demons attacking the ship.

startText.en:
We're getting closer to the wormhole. We had a pretty hard time, the ship is barely holding itself together... What the hell?!
...
Demons! Demons attacking again! Fire in the hole! All hands on deck!!
May they get devoured by the Astral, we'll have to jump into an unknown sector blindly, unprepared! May the Light save our souls!
Why are you just standing there? Grab a cannon and show those astral shrimps how things are done in Siveria! We just need to get through to the wormhole, and then we're in the clear!

finishText.en:
Hey! Wanna jump the line?!
Wait a sec... I remember you! You're that hero who helped the goblins and the ghosts on Gipat! You were sent by Marianne, right? Nice girl, yep!

goal.en: With Marianne de Ardeur's help, go to the Purgatory and talk to the Servant of the Light.

startText.en:
Defeating Nihaz, the God of Darkness, didn't make us any happier. I'm afraid we only pushed the world closer to its downfall. I'm not gifted with clairvoyance, but I have a feeling we're missing something very important. Something... evil. And not only me!
The servant from the Purgatory spoke to me a while ago. Can you imagine?! Given his self-righteousness and lust for profit, this stingy goblin needs something extraordinary to happen for him to condescend to mere mortals! And it does seem to have happened.
The servant told me about some strange Sparks stuck in the Purgatory. The Sparks of some poor bastards can't return to their bodies or leave the Purgatory. They don't vanish either but wander idly among the heroes waiting for their turn to be resurrected... That's horrible!
Please go to the Purgatory and find out what has befallen those Sparks. You don't even have to die to do that - simply talk to me, and I'll help your Spark leave your body.

checkText.en: First they pass to and fro, then honest folks are losing Sparks!

finishText.en: So that's how it is! Cultists, then... I think it's time to warn Marianne!

goal.en: Inspect the lost Sparks in the Purgatory and find out what happened to them. Report to the Servant of the Light.

startText.en:
Oh, something's rotten in your kingdom, yep! Look at those poor souls restlessly wandering through the Purgatory. Empty eyes, empty heads... It's horrible!
I don't know what happened to them. They appeared in the Purgatory already like this, with neither will nor power. I tried to talk to them, but to no avail, yep. They talk nonsense. I saw crazy Sparks before, and all of them would leave this sorrowful place after a certain time... But not these, they wander around here, scaring the dead, and cannot return, as if they are stuck between life and death. Perhaps you can try to talk to them? It is not good that our set routines be interrupted by some lost souls, yep.

finishText.en: The snow is trampled down around the wreckage. There are some traces of blood. There must have been a serious battle here!

goal.en: Find traces of a shipwreck at the Frozen Peak.

startText.en:
So it's the cultists... I've never met them myself - those fools don't believe in the Light. However, they have complete trust in every word of their prophet Tep, may his bald skull be eaten through by herpes! You, however, must have already come across them in battle. So it's you who's going to handle this mess!
I'll bring you back to the world of the living. Go to the Frozen Peak and find the spot where that poor bastard met his death. Try finding out what exactly happened to him and why his Spark is in such a sad state.
Now go. And try not to visit me too often, eh? Good luck!

finishText.en: Hey! I'm here! Save me!

goal.en: Get inside the pyramid and find the prisoners.

name.en: The Mystery of the Ancient Pyramid

startText.en:
The traces are hard to see, but that's enough to understand that a vicious battle took place here! The sailors and mercenaries stood their ground against the cultists, but they were clearly outnumbered. Interestingly, there are no dead bodies or weapons around.
Looks like the cultists didn't want to kill the Kanians who survived the shipwreck but rather capture them. In which case, they might be alive! Or just one of them, at least...
The cultists' tracks lead towards Tep's Pyramid that looms on the mountain. The prisoners must have been taken there!

finishText.en:
Tep's cultists? Again?! Oh, a thousand astral demons! That insane sorcerer is the last thing we need...
You're not the first to bring such sad news. A while ago, the cultists attacked our settlements in Darkwater and Siveria and even raided the military camp on the Coba Plateau! A few knights got killed! Voisvet starts gnashing his teeth every time he receives the mirra bill for our army.
What's that? Cultists' documents? Give 'em to me!
Well, well... Let's try finding out what those fanatics want.

goal.en: Kill 10 Tep's Cultists and their prelate Sarbaz Dhoru, take Tep's orders off his body and deliver them to Aidenus in Novograd.

startText.en:
Goddamned cultists... They fell on us like snow trolls, immobilized us all by spells. The bastards even killed the senior aide! Those who were conscious were tied up and brought to the pyramid. They didn't torture or beat us; in fact, they ignored us completely. They stuffed everyone into this hole and began to take one after another away. I don't know exactly where to.
The cultists are led by some evil prelate. Sarbaz Dhoru is his name. A real mean bastard! After I asked what they wanted from us, that walking corpse punched me so hard that my teeth became loose. I wish I could find the prick and tear him apart, but I'm too weak to handle the dirtbag. But I'm sure you can take care of him. He and the other cultists must not go unpunished! Find the bastard and kill him. He had some papers on him that can hopefully help you find out what those bastards want and where they took the rest of my friends. When you're through, hurry to see Aidenus! He must know what happened to our guys.

checkText.en: Hurry up! I'm scared for the ordinary people captured by the fanatics...

finishText.en: The captives are saved? Oh... That's a relief! On behalf of the entire Kania, I thank you for saving their lives!

goal.en: Find Tep Cultists near the Brazen Hill, exterminate them and rescue the captives, then bring the good news back to Aidenus.

startText.en:
The documents you secured make me think that we underestimated the threat those wackos pose to the whole world. Tep ordered his servants to kidnap all the rational beings they can and take them to some place hidden deep in the Astral. We were unspeakably lucky - the captured papers contain the coordinates of the cultists' den!
I will immediately order our combat squadron to get ready for take-off. It's time we stamped out that cultist plague once and for all! As for you, I have another order that's less heroic but equally important.
After we raided the military camp by the Brazen Hill, we were missing a few rookies. I thought they were dead and waited for resurrection in the Purgatory, but upon reading these documents, I'm afraid they were captured by Tep's servants. I'm sure the cultists didn't make it too far. Please go to the Coba Plateau, find our guys and rescue them! I'm scared to imagine what the damned fanatics can do to them if we don't hurry...

checkText.en: Hurry up! I'm scared for the ordinary people captured by the fanatics...

finishText.en: The cultists couldn't finish what they started and their bodies are lying around in mud? Well, that's well deserved!

goal.en: Find Tep Cultists near the Valir Settlement, kill them and rescue the captives, then bring the good news back to Aidenus.

startText.en:
The Brazen Hill is not the only place where our warriors recently encountered cultists. Just now, I got news of cultists raiding the Valir Settlement in Darkwater. They slashed the guards to pieces and took some of our subjects away with them. I'm afraid we'll never see them again if we don't hurry up.
Go to the Valir Settlement, find those damned cultists and annihilate them! Their rotten breath must not defile the Kanian air! But most importantly, rescue the captives! Their lives are in your hands, hero!

checkText.en: Don't delay! There's no time to waste...

finishText.en: The captives are saved and the cultists received their just deserts? Great news! I knew you wouldn't fail!

goal.en: Find Tep Cultists near Gravestein, kill them and rescue the captives, then bring the good news back to Aidenus.

startText.en: The damned cultists managed to get as far as Siveria! They caused a snowstorm and stealthily attacked the residents of Gravestein. The settlement residents fought bravely and threw the enemies back, but some of those slain have not risen yet. Now I understand they were captured, and I'm asking you to go there, find the cultists and rescue the captives!

checkText.en: The Empire's saboteurs are extremely well-prepared, but remember - even the best spies have their cover blown by trifles...

finishText.en:
What? The traitor was one of the guards? And she had an encrypted message on her? Strange and suspicious. The answer is too simple, the decision is too stupid, the suspect is dead, but she confessed everything before she died... And Committee agents are not especially talkative, you know!
We'll try deciphering the message, but only Tensess knows how much time it's going to take. I don't know who's behind it all, but we seem to be playing by someone else's rules...

goal.en: Question the workers at the port, find the traitor and bring the proof of treason to Aidenus.

startText.en:
You managed to save a few lives while I... I sent an entire squadron to a certain death! We shouldn't have trusted the Empire! Never ever!
Tep is not only a threat to the League, or the Empire, or old fools like myself. No, he brings death to all living beings! And I was so naive as to decide we could only take care of him by siding with the Empire! What a blunder of mine...
I sided with Yasker himself. The Empire's soldiers faced the cult's intrigues. He had nothing left to do but agree on joint actions against our common enemy. But was it a common enemy?
Two squadrons, ours and the Empire's, went to the known coordinates, and then the comms with our ships were down. We lost our best squadron! Now our capital is exposed to attacks by the enemy fleet. Izbor suspects treason, and I'm inclined to agree with him. Seizing the opportunity to deliver a treacherous stab in our back is typical of the Empire. This only means one thing - we have a rat in our midst! Find it!
The squadron's deployment was top secret, only the workers and the port guards knew about it. Question them all, find the traitor and make him talk!

finishText.en: Thank the Light, you are fine!

goal.en: Meet with Gleb Puskarev, captain of the Stiletto.

startText.en:
Despite any doubts, I believe we must take action. If you don't know what to do, do anything!
To find the missing squadron, I sent Stiletto, a new ship that's fresh off the shipyard, on a search mission! That brig is speeding through the Astral faster than a thought, and its long-range weapons can shoot even an Octulhu full of neat holes. The ship is under command of a proven captain named Gleb Puskarev. But I want someone on board whom I can trust like myself. Someone capable of handling any problem... I mean you!
The ship has a teleport beacon installed on it, so one nod is enough for your Adventurer's Stone to drop you directly on Stiletto's deck. And may the Light be with you!

checkText.en: Bigger animal, more glory for hunter!

finishText.en: Good catch! Outlander be mighty hunter to fell such beast. You get good reward!

goal.en: Ask Nukah Scraggy-Bone to show you the way to the pangolin's lair, defeat it and brag about your victory to Cheebah One-Eye in the Glittering Wing settlement.

startText.en:
I heard that you're a great wingless hunter. I know where to find a prey worthy of a legend! A terrible pangolin! Its roar makes trees tremble and its step makes earth quake. It is a real beast!
If you want to prove your valor, you should hunt the beast. Nukah Scraggy-Bone knows where beast's den is and he'll show you the way. If you kill the beast, I'll give you a nice reward!

checkText.en:
Damm...t... Comm...s Nee... Adju... Freq...cy... Wai... sec...
...
There! Finally I was able to get through the distortions. Looks like something hinders me from tuning in to you.
Is this the much-praised elven long-range comms? Hm... Nice, but not too practical.

finishText.en:
What's up with you? Why didn't you contact us? Why didn't you report the situation? You received no further instructions but rushed headlong into an unexplored sector?
What? Speak up! I can't hear you!
Dammit...

goal.en: Use the long-range communicator to establish communications with Novograd and report the situation to Aidenus.

startText.en:
How can we get in touch with Novogard, eh? We have no Adventurer's Stones, and teleport spells aren't working. Even the elven master who was on board of the flagship only shrugs his wings and mutters something queer about distortions in astral channels and displacement of some kind of nodes. I guess we're stuck deep here... Oh, whatever will we do? We may have to utilize that secret elven invention. I just hope it doesn't break down...
Here, take it. This thing is called a long-range communicator. It was made by elves! If they're telling the truth, we can use it to get in touch with any sorcerer in Sarnaut. However, it's only charged enough to last two minutes.
Well then, let's try contacting Aidenus.

checkText.en: Goddamned portal... I've never felt so absolutely helpless!

finishText.en:
How?! How did you manage it?!
I've been racking my brains trying to awaken those ruins, but nothing would come out of it... And now, they nearly came back to life! Though I wouldn't risk binding a Stone to them. You can easily miss while being teleported and end up being fused into the allod's center...

goal.en: Find the ruins of an ancient June portal on the coast, try awakening them with your Adventurer's Stone and report the results to Clement de Ardeur.

startText.en:
Oh, the comms are down... Whatever will we do? Think, my dear brain, think...
Bingo! I got an idea! Clement, a scientist from House de Ardeur, mentioned something about stone ruins not far from the camp. He said they looked like a portal and have been there since the June era. However, it was non-functional when we checked it. We'd kick and rub it, and the elf would cast all kinds of spells - it just wouldn't work. But we didn't have an Adventurer's Stone, which you do! All Stones are linked to portals, we know that for sure. What if your Stone can awaken the portal?
Trying costs nothing, after all. Go see Clement and try doing something about that goddamned portal. What exactly? How should I know?! Bang your head against it or strike it with your Stone!
Get creative! Actually, that's not a bad idea. No, not the one about the head! I'm talking about the Stone. Perhaps contacting the magic slumbering inside the ruins can awaken them, eh? That would be great!

checkText.en: Can you hear me?

finishText.en: Finally, I can hear you too! Come on, tell me what's going on and why you didn't get in touch for so long.

goal.en: Use the long-range communicator to establish communications with Novograd and report the situation to Aidenus.

startText.en:
That's interesting... If I have the slightest idea of astral science, we're now in the middle of nowhere! The coordinates of this place don't seem to exist at all! I think if you try using the Stone to go to Novograd now, you're unlikely to get back here. Yeah, we're stuck all right. You can't even call a rescue mission with teleportation experts.
But there's some good news. The remains of June magic can allow us to establish reliable communications with Novograd. Try calling Aidenus again right now!

checkText.en: Where have you been? We ran off our feet looking for you!

finishText.en: What? Aidenus orders us to adapt to circumstances and continue looking for Tep here? I'll be damned! With no comms, supplies or support... That's madness! But if we don't do it, who will? So we'll make it!

startText.en:
I'll be damned... The entire squadron perished in a blink of an eye... Shame on my gray head! I had a gut feeling we shouldn't have made that temporary alliance with the Empire. Now, we'll have to use all our forces to protect Kania against a potential attack. How inopportune... But anyway, it's not the time to complain. We must take action.
Because you have an Adventurer's Stone, you'll have to be a messenger between me and the survivors. Listen up.
No one in this world knows about the allod you found yourselves on. I checked all astral maps made since the discovery of astral flights, but I found nothing. So you'll have to act at your own peril.
I'm sure Tep did everything to make his secret refuge inescapable for intruders. Although the fleet is destroyed, any information about Tep can end up being extremely important to us. So keep searching!
Your having an Adventurer's Stone on you is sheer luck, but it can help us all. The Demon Hunters' destroyer is now barraging the area around the entrance to the wormhole, exterminating nearby demons. The Hunters don't interfere with politics between the League and the Empire, but the threat Tep poses concerns us all, so they agreed to help. They have a teleportation expert and a portal device on their ship. If you can't come to your enigmatic allod directly, I'll bind your Stone to the portal on the Hunters' ship. Teleport there right now and try getting into the wormhole once again. If it exits directly above the allod, the worst thing that can happen is that you simply black out again. Then go back to the admirals and report my instructions.

checkText.en: Quarr, friend. Why do you disturb me? I have already told you what I think about that piece of evidence. For now, I have nothing to tell you.

finishText.en:
Where did you get that sign?! That's the sign of our sworn enemies, damned red traitors. They call themselves Steel Claw tribe! Long time ago, we were one tribe. But there were fools who wanted equal rights. A lady and a nest for everyone, and no need to work! They wanted a stupid thing, a revolution. There was the war, an old town was burned down. Now, there are two settlements, two tribes and a never-ending war.
Tell me why did you go to their settlement! You could not get the sign of Steel Claw anywhere else.

goal.en: Meet with Karrok Stout-Hearted, the leader of the Glittering Wing tribe, and tell him about the tribal sign found on the Deadman's Rock.

startText.en:
Oh, I'm not sure at all! What if I falsely accuse the whites of allying with the Empire? They seem to value their words more than gold. Birds of honor, they are. If we make such a blunder, they won't even talk to us after that. Indeed, diplomacy isn't easy. Negotiating from a position of force was always more to my liking. You pull a sword, put it to the other party's throat and hand them your protest note. If your political opponent refuses to accept your note, you take a good swing and lay an embargo straight between their eyes. Oh, those were good times...
But never mind. Here's what I think. The aviak ruler owes you his life. Show him this emblem. If these birds really are plotting something, they won't touch you. A life for a life, that's how it works. And if they're not to blame, let them help us find the culprit, for it's in their best interest!

finishText.en: Ah, wingless outlander did come see me. Let me guess... Karrok send you! He wants our spirits to bless the alliance with outlanders that came from the great void? All right... You shall hear their word!

goal.en: Meet Elchana Speak-with-Spirits on Kahlua Island.

startText.en:
Did you find the sign in the camp? And were there evil outlanders calling themselves Empire? Bad news for all of us.
I trust you - our scouts noticed a strange human watching our town. They spotted red-winged one next to him. Your sign reinforces my concern. If red-winged ones ally with the Empire, we'll be in trouble. They will summon their stupid Council and ruin everything our ancestors created. That cannot happen!
I, Karrok Stout-Hearted, speak on behalf of Glittering Wing. Our people and wingless outlanders need to make an alliance. Our future can be secure by solid authority, and that is our strength!
But we cannot enter into treaty without blessing of elements. Wind that carry us, earth that give us shelter, sea that feed us, and fire that burn in our dwellings all are our patrons. Only Elchana Speak-with-Spirits understands them. She lives on Kahlua Island, to the east of our town. You, Son of the Wind, should go ask Elchana to talk to spirits. I've spoken my word, let them speak theirs.

checkText.en: I see it in your eyes that you expected another kind of talk with the old man? Well, sorry. I warned you that your actions incurred the wrath of mighty enemies. Luckily for you, those are my enemies too.

finishText.en:
To defeat one of the minions of Sihal, the master of this giant illusion... Once again, I was right in assessing your abilities. Without my help, though, you're going to be stone-cold dead very soon.
Remember I promised to show you how deep the rabbit hole was? I guess you'll have a few minutes to get ready for the journey while I'm opening the entrance. A way back is not foreseen, sorry - it's a one-way ticket.

goal.en: Kill the Lictor.

startText.en:
Listen and memorize. Each element has its own power. When you touch an element, it shares its power with you. Water heals your wounds, fire boosts your energy, air makes you very, very fast, and earth gives you reliable protection. Ask...
What's going on?! I sense presence of a strange spirit, but cannot see it. Help...

checkText.en: Humm... Who dares to interrupt my sleep?

finishText.en: Mortal. Pathetic. Weak. Frail. Wants to understand the power of earth? Hear the rumble of rocks? Humm... Well, let them try...

goal.en: Pass all trials given by Sea Master and meet Earth Master on the Ashy Wasteland.

startText.en:
You can now better understand the circle of life that is never interrupted. Hot blood, wild and incoercible, pumps through your veins like water in a mountain stream. You justly deserve my blessing! Still I wish to test you, and this is mostly for your sake.
If you pass the trial, turn your steps toward a place called the Ashy Wasteland, where you will be met by my brother, the master of everything that grows. He is named the Cliff Master, and his temper is as severe as a sharp cliff. He will show you the way further...

checkText.en: The sky is but a reflection of the water surface...

finishText.en: Yes, mortal... The stars that fall from the sky get straight into the ocean, their splendor splashing. These drops give birth to starfish that will, in time, shine in the sky, thus ending the cycle of their lives like you ended the first trial...

goal.en: Collect starfish from the sea bottom and bring them to Sea Master on the Isle of Singing Water.

startText.en:
My blessing is expensive. I want to entrust a trial to you. First a simple one, then one a bit harder.
A sky full of stars... Did you ever stop to think where they come from? Did you ever make a wish at the sight of a star that broke loose from the firmament in a swift flourish? As years go by, however, the stars do not disappear... Why do you think that is? Get me a handful of stars from the sea bottom, and I will tell you that secret.

checkText.en: All living beings are worthy of living, but what procures its life through others' deaths is worthy of nothing but dying...

finishText.en: I can hear words of gratitude in the swashing of water. Those words are being said by all sea creatures, both small and big. You have passed my trial with valor!

goal.en: Exterminate 12 Venomous Cnidaria and report your success to Sea Master on the Isle of Singing Water.

startText.en:
Water can be different: tender and affectionate, quiet and serene, icy and gloomy, roaring and fierce... Equally different creatures dwell in the depths of the sea. I am joyful about each, I cherish thoughts about each, I look after each. Just as a gardener roots out the weeds in a green meadow, I cleanse the clear water from filth as best I can. If you want to grasp the essence of water, you will help me in my laborious endeavor.
The sea is full of life, but there are those who, though endowed with life, only bring death to others. I am speaking about stingers whose venom can turn an elixir of life into that of death. Will you be strong enough to take care of that plague? If your answer is "yes," you will have my blessing.

checkText.en: I weed out the field in pain, protecting myself against a greater pain...

finishText.en: Here it is, the filthy liquid that brings death to all living beings. However, just like death is followed by life, this venom will be used to the benefit of life, too.

goal.en: Gather some Jellyfish Slime from Venomous Cnidaria and Snake Venom from Horned Vipers and bring them to Sea Master on the Isle of Singing Water.

startText.en:
I have the toughest trial for you. Many brave warriors met their death trying to complete this laborious task. However, those who fear danger shall not have my blessing. Now listen to my will and perform it exactly that way!

There are lots of venomous reptiles in the world, and each of them has a purpose, a place in the circle of life, each makes way for another life with that of its own. There are those, however, driven by death alone who strive to spoil the vortex of life with their venom. Death-Adder is its name, and there's nothing better for it than turning life into death. However, that serpent is extremely cunning and only able to attack on the sly. Your task is to lure it. And to make a bait for the venomous reptile, you will need another type of venom. Although it is not so strong, its filthy stench is to that reptile like heavenly fragrance...

checkText.en: Life emerges from the water, breathes air, gets warmed by heat, goes into the earth and returns into the water. This is the eternal cycle that should not be broken.

finishText.en: The fluids of underground waters told me about the black blood spilled onto the sand. Let it be... What emerged from the water, should turn into water once more. You have passed your trial brilliantly!

goal.en: Lure Death-Adder with the smell of the venomous mix spilled on the southern coast of the Isle of Singing Water, kill it and tell Sea Master about your feat.

startText.en:
From a mix of venoms, I will make one that can even turn rocks into sand. Its smell is not dangerous, albeit rather filthy, so only a reptile that has even more venom will be drawn by it. Death-Adder is strong and its venomous fangs have killed a lot of worthy beings. The water that washes its filthy form will never bring about new life, but its death will be a boon.
Spill a drop of the venomous mix onto the stones. Lured by the smell, Death-Adder will appear before you like death incarnate. Don't be afraid, defeat the reptile in combat. New life will be brought about by its death, and you will have my blessing that very instant!

finishText.en: Oh, who's there?

goal.en: Find the shipwreck survivors on the Rainbow Atoll.

startText.en: It looks like this is the wreckage of neither the League, nor the Imperial ships. Look at the strange color of the ship camouflage. And the wood is rotten... I wonder who could have sail on this to Irdrich. Maybe we should search for the survivors.

checkText.en: Hey, equip your new weapon! You know I'm not just the quartermaster... I'm also in charge of handing out punishments to anyone who's disobedient on this ship!

finishText.en: That's it! Now get in there. You're one of the last shreds of hope for the survival of this ship.

goal.en: Equip the weapon in your bag. Then talk to Quartermaster Birchy the Merciless.

startText.en:
Listen up, everyone! We've got every single private accounted for! Equip yourself, on the double! Unless you think that the League soldiers will simply surrender the moment they spot your bare hands!
You! What are you waiting for? Scared, are ya? Is this your first battle, rookie?
Well, if you don't want it to be your last, you better move it! Obey, and you just might make it out of here in one piece!

checkText.en: Hey, equip your new weapon! You know I'm not just the quartermaster... I'm also in charge of handing out punishments to anyone who's disobedient on this ship!

finishText.en: There! Now you're nearly invulnerable! The hope and support of the whole Empire, I say!

goal.en: Equip the weapon in your bag. Then talk to Quartermaster Birchy the Merciless.

startText.en:
Listen up, everyone!
We've got every single private accounted for! Equip yourself, on the double! Unless you think that the League soldiers will simply surrender the moment they spot your bare hands!
You! What are you waiting for? Scared, are ya? Is this your first battle, rookie? Well, if you don't want it to be your last, you better move it!
Obey, and you just might make it out of here in one piece!

checkText.en: What's with the face? Sure, maybe it doesn't taste like fruit juice but its benefits are amazing.

finishText.en: Can you feel it working? Has it kicked in yet? It's sure to get you going. Heck, it might even have you feeling like you can take on the entire League Army! It's the latest invention from the Imperial scientists, it's been known to transform even the most cowardly of goblins into real warriors.

goal.en: Use the Battle Cocktail and then talk to Birchy the Merciless.

startText.en:
You look great! Our uniform suits everyone - Xadaganians, Arisen, Orcs... Now for my favorite task... don't worry, you'll be fine. You've not done anything to deserve it so far. But if you act like a coward, if you abandon a comrade on the field of battle, or if you break any of our rules, then you can be sure I'll be coming after you!
Take this. It's a battle cocktail, a potent little shot of invigorating, revitalizing, liquid courage which turns pansies into true warriors. Drink away, don't worry, it's allowed in the rules. Come on soldier, don't mess around!

checkText.en: Give them everything you've got! What are you waiting for, you pansy?

finishText.en: Well, it seems like I can't call you a pansy any more. You've won your first battle! I got this armor from the ship's stash to help gear out the recruits. For doing such a good job I'll give you first pick. Go ahead and choose what you like the most.

goal.en: Defeat the League troops and return to Whir the Unyielding.

startText.en:
Seems like I poured you a stiff one just in time. The battle is about to begin! So, whatcha waiting for? Attack! You gotta fight off the League's assault troops before that battle cocktail wears off!
Go straight for the enemy's leader! They won't put up much of a fight without him. Onwards, for the Empire! For our homeland! For Yasker! For Nezeb!

checkText.en: Help me... someone!

finishText.en: Thank you for the assistance... Huh... What's wrong with my legs? They're not moving. It appears that my arteries are shot and my mechanisms are severely damaged... How much blood and oil have I lost? Looks like more than I should have...

goal.en: Defeat 4 League Troopers and 1 League Veteran and talk to Sarang Minx.

startText.en:
I have a new task for you, rookie. League assault troops have captured the armory! This is unacceptable! Go there right now and slaughter every one you see! We must remove the bastards from our ship.
When you're there be on the lookout for a scientist named Sarang Minx. He was in there when the League attacked and he might still be alive, although it's not likely. The League assault forces are ruthless executioners, and they take mercy on no one!

checkText.en: What's the matter, soldier? Don't tell me there's more bad news.

finishText.en:
Sarang Minx believes this was no ordinary attack? Hm... This changes things. We should review our tactics. I'll need to consult with the Captain.
Thank you for giving me this news. As for the activation key... Well, you seem to have a good head on your shoulders. And most League troops would never suspect that an ordinary soldier like you is carrying something important.
Keep it with you for now, but remember that it is the property of the Empire and must be returned to me as soon as this fight is over!

goal.en: Take the Activation Key from the safe and bring it to Yasskul Odzhi.

startText.en:
Listen up carefully... The assault party was targeting this safe here. It's storing an activation key for a very important item, but unfortunately I can't tell you more since this is highly classified information.
The key's security has obviously been compromised, so you must open the safe and take the key to First Mate Yasskul Odzhi. He'll know what to do with it. Tell Yasskul that the League assault was not a random act... the League knows all about... the "device". I can't explain any more, but he'll understand.

checkText.en: What are you doing talking to me for? Did you take out that ship yet?

finishText.en: What beginner's luck! You hit the League ship's power line and took it right out. It'll be a while before they recover from this! Good job! I salvaged this from one of our wounded crew mates. Take it!

goal.en: Hit the League ship using the Cannon and return to Yasskul Odzhi.

startText.en:
Hold it! At my command!
One of our bombardiers has gone down from enemy fire. Man the free cannon and fire at the League ship with everything you've got! We need to blast them to pieces!

checkText.en: We're in a tough spot. We can't get rid of that shield and our power is fading!

finishText.en:
What? Of course I had nothing to do with this! What do you take me for, an idiot?! Open your eyes rookie!
League assault troops captured the reactor room and are wreaking havoc in there!

goal.en: Talk to Sarang Khafre and determine the cause of power failure.

startText.en:
Damnit! The League assault troops hit us hard and disabled a large part of the ship. We had to turn on our secondary power generators, but for some reason they're starting to fail too!
I need you to head to the reactor room on the double! Find Sarang Khafre and see what's going on. And if this is the result of another of his stupid experiments... tell him I'm going to rip his hardware out!

checkText.en: Those fire elementals make it pretty hot in here...

finishText.en: Perfect, the reactor is back under our control! Here, take one of my weapons, I'll be too busy trying to fix the reactor anyway. Oh no... the captain is going to kill me! One of the League assault troops stole something very valuable from us!

goal.en: Use the Neutralizer to destroy the magical shield, kill the Fire Elementals, and talk to Sarang Khafre.

startText.en:
See?! They're destroying the reactor, and without it we're doomed! Some blasted Kanian cleric created a shield that's blocking our access to it, too.
Do you see those fire elementals? Those damn Kanians probably summoned them there. It's only a matter of time before they completely obliterate the device!
We have to destroy the shield! Take this neutralizer and help the other technicians remove the cleric's shield. After you destroy the shield, kill those fire elementals at once!

checkText.en: Get back in there and get the reactor back under our control!

finishText.en: Son of a... I told Sarang Khafre a million times to let me keep that device! But no, he had to go and experiment with it!

goal.en: Tell Kazimir Sablin that the device has been stolen.

startText.en:
Circumstances are forcing me to violate my security protocol. I am about to tell you extremely classified information.
A Kanian crusader stole something from us... let's call it a device. It is an equipment of high security and value to the Empire. Now that I think about it, I'm sure this whole attack was designed to steal our te... mm... device.
Go see the captain and tell him about this new complication. We need to send an assault team to the Kanian ship! Otherwise Termitka Prison will be our new and only home...

checkText.en: How are you feeling? Looks like you are getting better.

finishText.en: I'm glad you are doing fine. Everyone was talking about the hero who alone managed to destroy a League ship.

goal.en: Make your way onto the Kanian ship, use the Activation Key, and defeat Gradimir Kozlov.

startText.en:
Assault team? We have two cannon crews down, an entire team fixing the reactor, and the rest of the men fighting those League bastards on deck. I'm not sending an assault team, I'm sending you!
You see, the device he stole was a personal teleporter that was supposed to teleport our soldiers out from the midst of battle. Why didn't it actually work and save our men? Because it's a piece of crap! Sometimes it works and sometimes it doesn't... and most times it doesn't.
Fortunately they didn't get the activation key. Grubin tells me you're actually the one who kept it safe! That means they won't be able to actually use the thing themselves, but that's the only complete prototype in the Empire right now so we need to get it back!
Go up to the outer deck and use the landing pad to get to the League ship. Once on board, use the activation key to attune the personal teleporter to yourself. That should interfere with any of their attempts to use the device. Then defeat the crusader and get it back!
If you're lucky, you might actually make it through this in one piece. If not, I'll make sure to personally nominate you for a service medal. Posthumously, of course, and that's if I manage to get out of this mess myself.

checkText.en: Are you ready to go?

finishText.en: We've barely made it!

goal.en: Equip the weapon that Svetobor Ratnev gave you and report to him for further orders.

startText.en:
This is a tragedy! We must take matters into our own hands and notify League officials about the assassination of Clement de Desirae. Our only chance for survival is through a portal located on the first floor of the tower. We need to head to the portal immediately!
Consider this a field promotion, your service in the League's Army has officially begun!
It would have been nice to be better prepared for the situation, but unfortunately we cannot afford that luxury. Here, take this weapon, it'll have to do.

checkText.en: Impressive. You're more reliable than you look.

finishText.en: I found a piece of old armor in the laboratory. Take it. During times of war you must use whatever resources you can to your advantage. You must always remember one thing... Wait, hold on! Someone's alive in the corridor!

goal.en: Kill 3 Laboratory Rats and talk to Svetobor Ratnev.

startText.en:
Through this path lies Clement's laboratory... Hm, Clement's lab rats appear to be blocking our path. The Great Mage Clement used to put them through all kinds of odd experiments, so now the rats are extremely vicious.
The assailant must've broken the cages and released them while they were retreating. We must kill all the lab rats if we're to make it through. Let's move!

finishText.en: Treason! It was Kirill Meshersky, the Chief of the Guards... It was he who led the rebels into the tower! They caught us by surprise, we stood no chance against their assault... many... dead. My wound is too deep. I don't have much time left, but please tell me everything.

goal.en: Talk to Boris Hopelesaev in Clement's Tower.

startText.en: It's Boris Hopelesaev, one of the elite members of the League Defenders! Attend to him immediately and I'll talk to the others.

checkText.en:
...Oh Great Light, abandon me not with your mercy, grant me redemption and just retribution...
Ah, it's you... Where's Leshko?

finishText.en: Dead!? I... at least now I know that I'll be joining my brother soon. That damned Kirill! I've never trusted those nobles! They need to be dealt with before it's too late!

goal.en: Kill the young manticore, find out the fate of Lev Hopelesaev, and report your findings to Boris Hopelesaev.

startText.en:
The Great Mage is dead?! How?! If that is indeed true, this allod will soon crumble! Listen... in the next room are even more of Clement de Desirae's experiments. A few guards were sent down here to contain them when the tower began to crumble, but Meshersky released the violent manticore.
Among the guards was my brother Leshko... my younger brother... he was in that room to help contain the beast. If you find my brother Lev please bring him to the portal... Lev has to be there... it's hard to imagine that the unthinkable has already happened.
Go into that damned zoo and kill the manticore - I know you can do it! Please find out what has become of my brother, I must know that he's safe!

finishText.en: There's no one to support this allod... everything will be destroyed.

goal.en: Check on Svetobor Ratnev in Clement's Tower.

startText.en:
You must survive... the Astral will swallow the tower soon... It's coming. Everything... will be destroyed... You need to head down the stairs to find the portal, it's the only way to escape...
You should check in with Svetobor and see if he is okay... the heavy shaking in the tower just a few moments ago... I heard something collapse down the corridor... I hope that nothing bad has happened...

checkText.en: I'm glad you showed up!

finishText.en:
You were wonderful out there! Rookie huh? Didn't look like one to me. Please tell me what's happening out there. One moment I'm helping prepare for the banquet, and the next moment everyone's fighting.
One thing's clear - we need to teleport off this allod! Unfortunately, the rebels are fighting us near the base of the tower, and they won't let us anywhere near the portal.

goal.en: Slay the Kanian traitors and Kirill Meshersky and speak to Glok the Knife.

startText.en:
Rookie, this is my final order! Survive! Do you hear me?! Survive, whatever it takes! You must reach Kania and tell the League officials what has happened here.
Access to the stairwell is blocked, you'll have to jump down below. Be careful though, the rebels are stuck in the same room.
Avenge us... the Hopelesaev brothers, Clement, all those who have died in this travesty.
Go... I will remain with Boris. We served many years together in the League Army, perhaps we shall appear before the Holy Tensess together as well.

checkText.en: Have you found the elixir yet?

finishText.en: How was that? You feel pretty good, don't you? It's definitely quite the elixir considering that it instantly healed your wounds. I'm sure Clement must have been saving it for a special occasion. I found some useful items around the room while you were gone. Please choose one that fits you the best.

goal.en: Find and use the Elixir of Invulnerability and return to Glok the Knife.

startText.en:
What a fight that was! Hey, you're wounded! You didn't even notice huh? If my brothers Lok and Shpok were here, we would've protected you! One Gibberling is good enough, but three can stand toe-to-toe with even the strongest of Orcs.
We need to patch this wound immediately! Normally I'd recommend a bandage but since we're in Clement's office... let's see...
I know, check out that chest over there! I saw him keep useful potions and elixirs in that chest. Once he mixed three components together, poured it over a wound, and it magically healed right before my eyes. You need to find one of those elixirs!

finishText.en:
I heard about my uncle's death... My uncle was not only my mentor but a great man who had lived through the Great Cataclysm.
It's unforgivable that he fell by the hand of Kanian conspirators! Unfortunately, now is not the time for remorse - we must activate the portal and evacuate this tower.

goal.en: Find Amanda de Desirae in Clement's Tower.

startText.en:
Listen, I'm going to go on ahead of you. There are still lots of people outside that need to be brought in. I'm also worried about my brothers. You know, we Gibberlings are sore to be alone.
You should go down and make your way through to the floor below us. Clement's niece Amanda should be in there. The two of us had been fighting off the traitors together, but she came up with some sort of plan that involved magic. Please find her and make sure she's safe, okay?
I'll be off then. Good luck!

checkText.en: Thanks for your support! I'm surprised that the elementals actually appeared.

finishText.en:
I wasn't able to complete the ritual but I bought us enough time to at least make it to the portal room.
I've been carrying these weapons around with me and I don't have much use for them. I need to focus on activating the portal, you know. Why don't you take one?

goal.en: Defeat the Magic Elementals and talk to Amanda de Desirae.

startText.en:
See this magic device right here? It's nearly a thousand years old. My uncle was an avid collector and he kept this Resistance Sphere in working condition.
This very device was used by Great Mages of the past to keep allods from being devoured by the Astral. Of course, there have been great advances in the field of magic since then and no one has used these antiques in ages, but this sphere may still prove itself useful.
I'm not a Great Mage, but I will try my hardest to activate it. There is no other choice, we must activate the Resistance Sphere to buy us more time to make an escape portal.
I must warn you though, using the Resistance Sphere has a potentially negative side effect. It's possible that elementals will appear because their power is tied to the Resistance Sphere itself. They do not want us draining away their energy source. I'll focus on activating the sphere, just support me if anything happens!

checkText.en: There you are! Praise Tensess for bringing you here safely!

finishText.en:
Did you see the undead?! That's the handiwork of the demonologist's below.
It wouldn't shock me to find out that the Great Mage's blood is on his hands. Who else could've summoned up a Shadow that terrible?

goal.en: Escort Amanda to the portal downstairs and talk to Shpok the Knife.

startText.en: Let's hurry to the portal! I'm sure Glok is already downstairs waiting for us with his brothers.

checkText.en: When Glok told me about your valiant duel with Kirill Meshersky, I didn't believe it at first. But now that I've seen you with my own eyes, I know he was telling the truth!

finishText.en: Before you go take this. I found it on the demonologist and I'm sure he won't be using it anymore. Now let's get out of here!

goal.en: Slay Raimond de Doucer and talk to Amanda de Desirae.

startText.en:
Who told me about the shadow? Glok, of course. When he returned, we attacked those Kanian rebels together and nearly took them all out! All of them except that awful demonologist. He raised those who had fallen and now there are dozens of zombies on his side.
It's a strange sight, an Elf and Kanian rebels working together.
We're up here while my brothers, Lok and Glok, are outside gathering the rest of the people. The demonologist and his undead are downstairs and they're the only things standing between us and the escape portal.
We need to go downstairs and kill the undead and that douchey Elf. When they're out of the way, we'll activate that portal and get outta here.

checkText.en: What a battle that was...

finishText.en: Amazing work! You gave us just enough time to open the portal and evacuate most of the people in this tower.

goal.en: Hold off the Astral demons while everyone evacuates the Tower, then talk to Amanda de Desirae.

startText.en: I'm going to make sure that door stays open and everyone gets in. Amanda will focus on activating the portal. I have a feeling some more trouble might be coming our way, so keep your eyes open!

finishText.en:
Hi there! I am Selene de Ardeur, the famous poet! How lucky you are to be stranded with someone like me. I'm sure you just adore my new poem, right? "Love is a magic country, where the spring rules..." You haven't heard it? Hm...
What do I mean by stranded? Well, look around. After we took the portal in Clement's Tower, we all thought that we'd appear in Novograd. But fate is a crafty feloness! We appear to have ended up on a deserted allod instead.
Amanda said that these strange Meteorite Stones that she gave us would make sure we got to the right place. But as you can see, she wasn't quite right. Poor thing, she is so upset right now!

goal.en: Use the portal to escape the doomed allod.

startText.en:
Soon the Astral will swallow up this miserable allod. We should head through the portal ourselves now. Soon we will be safe and sound in Novograd!
Here, take this. It's a magical Meteorite Stone that I found in my uncle's lab. According to his notes they're used to stabilize the portal to make sure we make it through in one piece!
Well, off we go. And may Tensess watch over us!

checkText.en:
Look right. The first stage is behind those gates - the foul demon ruins. I'm sure they're just dying to break free and tear everyone in the audience to shreds! It's too bad they're too weak to tussle with a god. No matter what they do, their powers are essentially useless, because the gates open on my command!
Right behind me you can see the entrance to the second stage, lit only by the crimson flame of the scaly horde of draconids and their Fiery Father. They tried to outplay me on my own turf. And they failed. They just don't know it yet, haha.
Last of all, behind the third set of gates are waiting some of the once-great Junes, now resembling the worst of a drunkard's nightmare: wormfaces, led by their relentless leader, Zakom. It was his Spark that they were able to steal from me on the Isle of Revelation. He's got a new body now... But something tells me that it's not a perfect fit.

finishText.en:
The best part is that all of them - the draconids, the wormfaces, and Sarn's demons - all fear something more than me! They are afraid that someone else will get here first, to the heart of the Dead City. Each of them is trying to reach an agreement with me behind the others' backs, promising to help destroy what they imagine are my enemies, their own mates. Hah! Can you imagine, they all want to settle their scores with their long-time enemies by having someone else do the dirty work!
You can probably guess what brought them all, wormfaces, draconids, and even the demons here to the Dead City? Hehe. Look up! See that huge construction? That is the key and the lock in one. But let's leave its purpose a secret for now. It will be made clear to you when the time comes. It's not good to change horses midstream, right?
Let the presentation begin!

goal.en: Listen to Nihaz's speech until the end.

startText.en: Welcome to the Dead City, my trusty helper! Are you still trying to understand all the secrets of the world? That's quite commendable! I already told you that brawn does not decide everything. It's not enough to just be strong. You have to know how to apply this strength. So it is that this is the position you are in. The throne room of the Dead City is where everything began, and it's where everything will end... All of the figures in our story are already in their places and are squirming with anticipation, so eager are they to play their roles in our new play. Three acts simultaneously on three stages! And you will be playing the lead role. For my part, I'll stay here in the audience.

checkText.en: How's our fire-spitting lizard doing?

finishText.en: He won't ever walk again? Excellent...

goal.en: Participate in the murder of Lickflame Tinderbox in the Upper City, then report to Nihaz.

startText.en:
Oh, the efforts of my enemies - and yours, too - are truly entertaining. To think that anyone hopes to challenge me on my own terms and on my own turf and actually win... You can't make this stuff up! For instance, Sarn's demons really want Lickflame Tinderbox to die. That draconid was one of their Fiery Father's first sentient creations. The demons hate him almost as much as they hate the Great Dragon. The Great Dragons were Sarn's jailkeepers for many thousands of years... They still haven't totally worn out their welcome with their idiocy and inability to accomplish the simplest tasks.
But we'll talk of the Great Dragon some other time. As for Lickflame, that overgrown scaly freak... In contrast to his creator he can use the powers of my Seals, and Sarn and his henchmen understand that if the draconids are able to make their way here to the throne room, Sarn will always remain a prisoner. The Demons are even willing to help me if it means being rid of Lickflame. Imagine that! Demons! Willing to help! Me! Haha!
But you don't look a gift horse in the mouth, isn't that right? You should know that if you decide to get rid of Lickflame (which will have to happen sooner or later), then the demons will happily help you with that.
Oh, how I love these moments... My enemies are destroying one another!

checkText.en: I wonder why the number ‘three' figures so heavily in the myths and legends of this universe. Not two, not four, not seven, but exactly three... Strange.

finishText.en:
One, two, three... Oh no, the wormfaces have lost their trainers and sages. What rotten luck!
But it's nice to watch your enemies gnashing their teeth at the base of the mountain when you're sitting pretty on top. Look, friend. See what stupidity leads to. Instead of putting their efforts into setting and achieving goals, my enemies spend all their energy on pointless horseplay. Choose your goals and your enemies wisely, sweet thing, for only then can you achieve power, glory, and respect.

goal.en: Defeat the three Trainers and tell Nihaz of your victory.

startText.en:
The dragons hate the wormfaces with all their souls. I may be their enemy for the moment, but the wormfaces are their eternal sworn enemies. After all, the wormfaces were once the Junes. I created the dragons, and the Junes exterminated almost all of them. The Great Dragon has no real reason to hate me, and he has many reasons to wish for the wormfaces' destruction.
