Initially, the flow of Light was weak and there were very few people who believed in its power. But it was enough that people began to resurrect after death. When they saw these miracles occur, the number of believers started to increase along with the Light's power.
When the Trinity Church sainted Nezeb and Skrakan, the faith of the Imperials grew much stronger and my strength doubled. Do you understand how it works now? The power of the Light comes from faith itself! It's not from me, and it's not from Skrakan or Nezeb.
Faith is something that cannot be understood or explained. And if you try to explain it, people will start to doubt and the Light will grow weaker. Therefore, you must return to the League and tell them something they will not want to hear. Tell them that Skrakan and Nezeb are saints just as am I.
Tell them that the source of the Light is in me, and you, and everyone. Let all of the League believe and the Light will never go out.

checkText.en: What's this piece of paper?

finishText.en: So that's who's behind this - Gorluxor! What a pleasant surprise...

goal.en: Bring the Blood-Encrusted Letter to Nefer Ur.

startText.en:
Through the filth you can make out a few of the words. It seems this letter was sent by someone named "Gorluxor". He ordered the Dark Artifacts to be delivered to him inside the Temple. It seems that only with their help will he be able to corrupt Tensess' Gift...
This Gorluxor sounds like a very dangerous person. You should probably show this letter to Nefer Ur.

checkText.en: Do you have any news for me?

finishText.en: What? Voisvet Belov - the Hero of the Great Astral Campaign, the High Knight of the Church of Light - has been defeated? Great job! I'm sure the League will be pretty upset about that. That's just what I needed to hear at a time like this!

goal.en: Defeat Voisvet Belov and report back to Elizaveta Rysina in Nezebgrad.

startText.en:
On our way to free Tensess' soul we met a certain obstacle - Voisvet Belov. He's a hard- nosed and stubborn dunce. I offered him a truce until we were able to break through to the top of the Temple and save Tensess, but he refused.
I suppose the good part is that now only we, the Empire, will be responsible for saving the world. We'll be able to throw this fact at the League for years! I'm sure this will raise the morale of our citizens.
Well, since I'm not about to offer sanctuary a second time, that means there's only one way left to deal with that Kanian. Voisvet must be eliminated so our troops can reach the heart of the Temple and save Tensess.
He should be just down this corridor. Kill him as soon as you find him, but don't cut off his head. Let him rise again and live with the shame of defeat!

checkText.en: Why are you here and not in the Holy Land like other true Imperials?

finishText.en:
Whose head? Gorluxor's?! Woohoo, my birthday came early this year! Great job!
This head is worth its weight in gold! Gorluxor is Yasker's sworn enemy! And now he's dead?! Kickass! I can't wait to tell him!

goal.en: Kill Gorluxor and bring his head to Crazystorm the Merciless in Nezebgrad.

startText.en:
Have you ever heard of Gorluxor? No? You should learn more about the history of our country. He plays quite a role in our past.
When Nezeb set out for the Great Astral Campaign, he left Yasker to rule in his place. When Nezeb disappeared, a Great Mage named Gorluxor sought to defy Nezeb's will and seize power over the Empire.
The short-sighted human only tried to gain the support of the Xadaganians, ignoring the Orcs and the Arisen. While they didn't have as many rights as the Xadaganians at that time, the opposition of the Orcs and the Arisen proved to be his downfall. He lost his bid for power.
He disappeared shortly afterwards, and for many years no one has seen or heard from him. But now it appears that he's back and the leader of an army of cultists. I suppose his thirst for power never vanished, and now he's determined to subdue the entire world.
We must defeat this monster together. I will be by your side when the battle commences. I fear this foe may turn out to be even more dangerous than Voisvet. After he's slain, cut off his head immediately so that he may not resurrect. Deliver it to Crazystorm the Merciless when you're done.

finishText.en: Come closer, oh warrior of the Light.

goal.en: Find Tensess' Soul and save him from the demons.

startText.en:
Curse Gorluxor! He was more powerful than I expected. Great Light, how could I be defeated by an old Xadaganian dog?
I don't think I'm going to make it through this. And I doubt that I'll have time to resurrect and return to the Temple before the demons accomplish their goals. That means everything depends on you! You must be the one to head further into the Temple and save Tensess.

finishText.en:
Tensess is dead?
What a horrible loss for the entire world!..
What are you talking about? He told us to ally with the Empire?

goal.en: Relay the words of Tensess to Aidenus, the leader of the League.

startText.en:
So, you came to save me? Thank you brave hero, although it's the world you should be concerned about, not me. You might have noticed that the demons started resurrecting after death.
Their goal wasn't to destroy me - it was to learn to use the power of the Light for themselves. They were very close to fulfilling their goal, too.
Once I gave the gift of life to the world. Now it's time for me to give another gift - the gift of death. My death.
Don't worry, my Gift won't disappear after I'm gone. The power of the Light shall remain, but with my death it can no longer become their prey. And as for me - my life was long and wonderful. I was able to fill the world with Light for many years, and so I have no regrets.
Please do not grieve for my loss. I have one more thing to say before I go - the League and the Empire must unite! The demons are still a threat to this world, and without unification they cannot be defeated. Please relay my last testament to your leader.
Now, I must bid you farewell...

finishText.en: I can see the question in your eyes that you dare not ask. But fear not, I am ready to answer.

goal.en: Enter Tensess Temple and speak with Tensess' Soul.

startText.en:
What is the main difference between the League's Church of Light and the Empire's Trinity Church? The fact that we're right about the source of the Light. It's Tensess and only Tensess! The Empire is just a bunch of heretics that dare to claim Skrakan and Nezeb as equals!
There's only one way that we can settle this dispute. And that is to go into the Temple and ask Tensess himself! It's pretty clear to me that you're the only one capable of doing this, so off you must go!
I am confident that Tensess will confirm our beliefs. Unfortunately, the Imperial sinners need facts, not my confidence. Find a way to get into the Temple as soon as possible. I don't know how, but you must figure it out. I'm counting on you, okay?

finishText.en:
You saw Tensess? What did he say?
Hm... I don't think the citizens of the League will be eager to hear that.
Before we go and disclose the truth, a lot of work needs to be done. If this news was spread in such a time of unrest it could start an uprising. Perhaps it can be revealed after the war.
Thank you for finally answering this question.

goal.en: Relay the words of Tensess to Aidenus, the leader of the League.

startText.en:
I know what you want to ask.
I have the answer, but it's unlikely to please you.
Simply put, the answer is the Light. After I died in battle when my soul began to leave my body, I saw a great column of light and I could not resist its power. I was drawn towards it. I remember my thoughts very vividly... That this is what's after death, and that I would soon know the truth about life.
Unfortunately, I never made it to the column of light. Halfway there some other force pulled me away. My soul became captured inside this pyramid. But when I got here I was not alone, although I cannot say who was with me. All I know is that they gave me eternal peace and a new power - the power of the Light. Initially, the flow of Light was weak and there were very few people who believed in its power. But it was enough that people began to resurrect after death. When they saw these miracles occur, the number of believers started to increase along with the Light's power.
When the Trinity Church sainted Nezeb and Skrakan, the faith of the Imperials grew much stronger and my strength doubled. Do you understand how it works now? The power of the Light comes from faith itself! It's not from me, and it's not from Skrakan or Nezeb.
Faith is something that cannot be understood or explained. And if you try to explain it, people will start to doubt and the Light will grow weaker.
Therefore, you must return to the League and tell them something they will not want to hear. Tell them that Skrakan and Nezeb are saints just as am I. Tell them that the source of the Light is in me, and you, and everyone.
Let all of the League believe and the Light will never go out.

checkText.en: What is this? A letter? From whom?

finishText.en: It's from Gorluxor, that old Xadaganian dog! Damn! Why did he have to be involved with this?

goal.en: Bring the Blood-Encrusted Letter to Voisvet Belov.

startText.en:
Through the filth you can make out a few of the words. It seems this letter was sent by someone named "Gorluxor". He ordered the Dark Artifacts to be delivered to him inside the Temple. It seems that only with their help will he be able to corrupt Tensess' Gift...
This Gorluxor sounds like a very dangerous person. You should probably show this letter to Voisvet Belov.

checkText.en: May the Light be with you!

finishText.en: Nefer Ur has been defeated? The leader of the Arisen and the right hand of Yasker himself?! What a great victory! This news shall be spread throughout the League!

goal.en: Defeat Nefer Ur and report back to Marianne de Ardeur in Novograd.

startText.en:
I've had enough! While I was trapped in here those horrible Historians betrayed us! The betrayed the Light! They're ready to leave the world without Tensess' Gift, the gift of resurrection! When we manage to get out of here, I'm going to make sure all those traitors are locked up!
But that must come later. Right now we must deal with the most immediate threat. Nefer Ur, the Arisen Great Mage, is just up ahead. If he's not defeated the Empire might eventually seize the Temple, and that cannot be allowed!
The League must be the one to save Tensess and end this demonic plague. If the Empire were to accomplish this feat, they would always hold that against us. On top of that, the defeat of Nefer Ur would be a crushing blow to the Empire's morale.
When you win the battle and escape the Temple, tell everything to Marianne de Ardeur, the Divine Prioress of the Church of Light. Let the church bells ring and proclaim the victory of the Light!

checkText.en: Any news from the Holy Land?

finishText.en: Whose head? Gorluxor's? And you say that this former Xadaganian Great Mage was leading the cultists? Well then, this is quite a feat! I believe that merits a reward.

goal.en: Kill Gorluxor and bring his head to Izbor Yavorsky in Novograd.

startText.en:
Gorluxor... Is it any surprise that such a monster and criminal was spawned by the Empire?
This Xadaganian Great Mage once fought Yasker for power over the Empire. This happened right after the disappearance of Nezeb and Skrakan. Gorluxor promised to lead all of the Xadaganians to victory over their enemies.
Yasker, however, made a smarter proclamation. He promised to protect not only the Xadaganians, but the Orcs and Arisen as well. By giving all of the Imperial citizens full rights, he received their backing and Yasker is now in charge today.
Damn! It would have been best for Gorluxor to take power. He probably would've destroyed the Empire from within. But once he was defeated, Gorluxor swore loyalty to no one. Now he aims to destroy the world out of anger!
It appears that Gorluxor is leading a large army of cultists that serve the demons. Worst of all, he's posing a threat to the great Tensess! He needs to be killed immediately. This will definitely be a difficult battle, and so I will enter it by your side!
After you kill Gorluxor, make sure to cut off his head. Then his spirit won't be able to return to his body. He wants to deprive the whole world of the gift of resurrection, eh? Well, let him experience firsthand what it's like!
Bring Gorluxor's head to Izbor Yavorsky when you are victorious.

checkText.en: How are you?

finishText.en: Have you survived? Great. Try and find something good in anything that happens to you.

goal.en: Pass 3 trials of Ghostly Zak and learn the Tka-Rik Revelation.

startText.en:
I'm a ghost of Ath-Zak, the one who defeated June Curse. This is the last event I remember. Nihaz gave me this form after death but never told me what happened. He said that every story has a best moment to end. The moment of my victory over the curse was such moment.
Do you know who Nihaz is? He is Director. And he is god. God of Darkness. Don't let this word scare you. Darkness, Light... Sometimes it doesn't matter...
So, Nihaz needed me because the aura of my victory over the Curse, the aura of the deadly veil, was the most reliable protection against demons. As long as I'm here, they can't break through the veil and stop you on your way to the Revelation.
The Revelation consists of three parts. If you pass three trials and survive, you will learn the truth about our world.
Tka-Rik, the last Great Mage of Junes, wrote this book of Revelation. We are going to read it now. Tell me when you are ready to turn over the first page.

finishText.en:
Well, now you know all I wanted to tell you. Isn't it great?
If I appeared to you in my true form and told you everything you wouldn't understand a thing. In other words, you appreciate knowledge only if you gain it through blood and sweat. Perhaps this is the most important revelation...

goal.en: Listen to Nihaz.

startText.en:
Yes, I'm a god. Nihaz, God of Darkness...
You know, I don't like these long titles. I like feeling excited. It becomes important, when you are immortal.
Betrayal of our former allies makes me excited. Well done! What a surprise for daddy!
I have transformed Junes into Wormfaces. Draconids were created by the Great Dragon, but derives his strengths from the same source that I use. All of them are my children, in a way. Stupid kids who betrayed me... How dare they to challenge Nihaz!
What? You can't understand what I'm talking about?
That's because this stupid Zak didn't tell you the whole story. I'll do it. I'll tell you everything about the past and the future. I'll also explain what's going on right now.
Let's talk, shall we?

checkText.en: Well, how are you doing? Have you passed all the trials?

finishText.en:
Great!
Nihaz will be pleased.

goal.en: Accept the challenge of Nihaz and pass 10 trials in Tka-Rik's Cave, then report to Klavdia Kalugina.

startText.en:
Zak should have been here now, but he has betrayed my father.
Are you ready to accept the challenge of Nihaz and complete 10 trials?

checkText.en: And I see you are trying to compete with the Great Mages? Not good at all...

finishText.en: Unbelievable... All twenty trials are completed! The key is rightfully yours.

goal.en: Accept Nihaz's challenge and complete 20 trials in Tka-Rik's Cave. Report to Klavdia Kalugina upon completion.

startText.en:
Let's see... Who was it that was thinking of becoming the center of our universe, playing with forces that no ordinary mortal should ever touch? Sure you won't explode from all the prospects opening up? My father doesn't like social climbers... Although I might not tell him anything. It's more interesting this way!
Now listen up. If you want an emblem, you'll have to work for it. Ten tests? Hah! How about twenty? That's what it'll be!

checkText.en: Aren't you tired of running about? Don't you want to retreat?

finishText.en: You have passed all the trials successfully. Well done! Come back tomorrow, if you want more. I'll be here. Or not.

goal.en: Accept the challenge of Klavdia and pass 5 trials in Tka-Rik's Cave, then report to Klavdia Kalugina.

startText.en:
Tka-Rik's Cave is a wondrous place, don't you think so? So old and scary... Are you scared? No? You should be.

Anything can happen here. This "anything" may eat you alive, as well. But as soon as you're determined, let's have a little warm up, shall we?

You will have to complete five trials. If you manage to pass them all, you will receive a reward from me. If not - oh well, you've been warned. What trials? Ah, that's a surprise!

Do you accept the challenge?

checkText.en: What took you so long?!

finishText.en: Finally! When the battle ceased, I thought you were dead. I hardly made this cowardly healer wait another couple of minutes!

goal.en: Escort Seeress Unn to the pier near the White Fortress and meet Luka Buranov.

startText.en: No time for talking! Run! The threads are strained, they ring like strings of an elven lyre! I can't see the Pattern of Fates: it is always alive and flowing, but now it is as cold as ice. It bodes not death but oblivion... Run, while there's still a place to run to!

checkText.en: Ha! I never doubted you'd survive!

finishText.en: You are right in time! That traitor wanted to leave without you, but we ain't leaving our buddies behind!

goal.en: Escort Seeress Unn to the pier near the White Fortress and meet Ilya Dubinin.

startText.en: No time for talking! Run! The threads are strained, they ring like strings of an elven lyre! I can't see the Pattern of Fates: it is always alive and flowing, but now it is as cold as ice. It bodes not death but oblivion... Run, while there's still a place to run to!

checkText.en: Hold on! Don't let the enemies reach the ship!

finishText.en:
Thanks Tensess, we're alive! There is the ship! It's just... No, she couldn't have survived.

But still we have to check!

goal.en: Mount the Ogre Assaulter, reach the pier, clear it of Architects and cover the evacuation of Dane Hunters.

startText.en:
See that big one? We have been training Dane ogres for some time. Usually, they are as dumb as stumps, but Fedor is quite smart. Pay no mind that he can only say "Fedor!" He's not afraid of shooting and follows your orders. A perfect fighter!

So get on his back and shot at everything you see! We have almost made it to the pier.

checkText.en: Finally! Where have you been?

finishText.en: You have been away for a week! I hope you have something new to tell us, for we already know about the Architects. Aidenus has sent us a message about the Architects' attack on the allod of Free Traders. Yasker is furious. Go and report to him. Maybe, you can shed light on what is really going on.

goal.en: Reach the ship and leave the White Fortress.

startText.en:
So this is the Thread Mistress? Wow! I've never seen a black gibberling in my life...

Enough with the talking, the ship is about to depart. Luckily, we only need to fly a short way to the Shore City. The fortress fell because they were not expected here, but the Shore City will be perfectly defended... If we make it.

checkText.en: Oh Tensess... You're alive!

finishText.en: We thought the Light took you - it's been several days! The whole League is in panic, sinister tidings are coming from the Empire, nobody understands anything apart from one thing - somehow the Architects have broken into our world and attacked the allod of Free Traders! The most interesting thing, Yasker himself informed us in a message... I hope you have something to tell Aidenus?

goal.en: Reach the ship and leave the White Fortress.

startText.en:
So this is the Thread Mistress? As far as I know, black gibberlings are gifted visionaries and fortunetellers.

Enough with the talking, the ship is about to depart. Luckily, we only need to fly a short way to the Shore City. The fortress fell because they were not expected here, but the Shore City will be perfectly defended... If we make it.

checkText.en: So, have you spoken with our guest?

finishText.en:
She recognized you! How interesting...

So the fortress fell under the onslaught of "flowing stone"?.. Hm. As far as I remember, the White Fortress is located on Dane, the allod of Free Traders. But is that poor girl really from there? I don't know. Her papers are all tattered and covered with blood. And she herself is as crazy as a rabid goblin!

Looks like we have only one way to find out what happened...

goal.en: Talk to Sledge the Fiery and return to Elizaveta Rysina.

startText.en:
A couple of hours ago an Orc is smoking clothes fell out of the Portal in Yasker's Tower. Judging by her armor, she is one of Demon Hunters. But Demons have been keeping away from our allods since the battle of Yazes, and then we crushed them in the Dead City! This is very strange.

I am afraid our guest is a little bit out of her wits. Her mind is wandering in the dark, no matter how hard it try to reach out for her consciousness. She doesn't seem to see me. I remember that you once met Demon Hunters in the Dragon Ring. Why don't you try to talk to her?

checkText.en: Talk to our guest. She's from the Fiery clan. Maybe, she will recognize you at least.

finishText.en:
White Fortress? Yes, I think I heard something... It's on Dane, the allod of Free Traders. But what on earth is "flowing stone"? What could have possibly happened? Could it be demons?!

Damn it! That orc had some papers, but they are all tattered and covered with blood. Looks like we have only one way to find out what happened...

goal.en: Talk to Pike the Fiery and return to Izbor Yavorsky.

startText.en:
A couple of hours ago an Orc is smoking clothes fell out of the tower Portal. Judging by her armor, she is one of Demon Hunters. But Demons have been keeping away from our allods since the battle of Yazes, and then we crushed the in the Dead City! This is very strange.

I am afraid our guest is a little bit out of her wits. She doesn't recognize anyone and doesn't answer any questions. The healers can't even approach her.

I remember that you once met Demon Hunters in the Dragon Ring. Why don't you try to talk to her?

checkText.en: What the hell... What are these creatures?

finishText.en:
Phew... I don't know what's your name, but you are right in time! They would have killed me in a moment.

Listen! I need to tell you something.

goal.en: Use the cracked Adventurer's Stone and find out what happened to the Demon Hunters.

startText.en:
The orc had an Adventurer's Stone, the one just like yours. It's a little cracked though, and I'm not really sure it can be used to teleport. And if it works, only gods know where it might take you.

We must find out what kind of an enemy has destroyed the fortress! I believe no one can handle this responsible mission better than you.

Please don't play hero! Just find out what happened and come back as soon as possible.

checkText.en: Blimey!

finishText.en: Who are you? Don't grab your weapon, we seem to be on the same side. If it were not for you, that creature would have killed me. What was it anyway?!

goal.en: Use the cracked Adventurer's Stone and find out what happened to the Demon Hunters.

startText.en:
The Huntress had an Adventurer's Stone, the one just like yours. It's a little cracked though, and I'm not really sure it can be used to teleport. And if it works, only gods know where it might take you. But we really need to find out what happened to the Hunters! And you are just the right person to scout it out.

Just don't play hero or anything. Find out what happened, and that's it! Come back as soon as you can.

checkText.en: Go down! Come on, hurry up!

finishText.en: Who the hell are you?! Hands up and don't move! Now, who are you and what are you doing here?

goal.en: Reach the tower in the White Castle together with Luka Buranov and look for survivors.

startText.en:
Listen to what I say. Whether you want it or not, we are in the same boat. I have no idea what these monsters are, but I swear on the Light - Demons are just innocent lambs compared to them.

When a dead man in Demon Hunters' armor fell out of the Portal in the Aidenus' Tower, holding an Adventurer's Stone in his hands, we thought that Demons were attacking us again. So I volunteered to investigate what happened.

That White Fortress stands on the edge of the allod, which belongs to the Free Traders. I don't remember what it's called. Dine or Dane, something like that.

Alright, enough with the talking. We need to find the surviving Hunters, for one thing.

checkText.en: Go down! Come on, hurry up!

finishText.en: Who the hell are you?! Hands up and don't move! Now, who are you and what are you doing here?

goal.en: Reach the tower in the White Castle together with Ilya Dubinin and look for survivors.

startText.en:
Architects, you say? Never heard of them.

You're wondering what I'm doing here? Same as you - trying to find out what happened to the Hunters.

It must have been something really terrible if they had sent messengers both to the League and the Empire. Something must have gone wrong when they teleported and deranged them...

I think we should find the survivors and get out of here. Those Architects, whatever they are, pose a serious threat for all of us.

checkText.en: Who are you? Name yourself!

finishText.en:
You clashed with them on the bridge, right? Damn it. We thought we could stanch our wounds and break out of the fortress on our own. I can see that was hardly gonna work out.

Have you seen Lock? A huge fella, with a cracked tooth and shoulder straps. Loud-mouthed like a ship siren!

He died?.. Oh dear... May the Light rest his soul!

goal.en: Break to the White Fortress gates.

startText.en:
Is this for real? The League and the Empire fighting hand in hand! Looks like the messengers could make it after all.

So you say these stone monsters are called the Architects? They came out of nowhere in the middle of the night and completely destroyed our defenses. They even somehow wrecked our Portal and turned our Great Mage to dust when he tried to take us away from here. I sent two guys with Adventurer's Stones to deliver the messages and gave the order to fight to the bitter end. We won't give up just like that!

Alright, let's break through to the gates before it's too late!

checkText.en: Have you seen Nikolay Chilin? With a moustache and a headband. He went to fetch some water, and now there's no sign of him.

finishText.en: Water! Finally! The wounded are dying to have a sip.

goal.en: Reach the river bank, fetch water and bring it to Radovid Gloomov.

startText.en:
Hey, friend... I don't know what is your name.

There are not so many of us left. Radovid, our healer, is doing everything he can, but he needs water. I tried to get some, but those critters on the bank shoot me. I could hardly get away...

Will you help me? Take this flask and fetch some water in the river for Radovid. Watch out for the shooters!

checkText.en: The soldiers dying from wounds and thirst. The damned monsters destroyed all storehouses!

finishText.en: I hope this will help the wounded. I thought of putting an end to their suffering myself, but where would they have gone from the Purgatory? Right into the enemies' hands! Only Tensess knows what they could do to them.

goal.en: Give enchanted water to 5 wounded soldiers in the White Fortress.

startText.en:
Wait, I will add some healing powder and a drop of water of life to the flask... Here you go!

Please, give it to those wounded who are still conscious. I'm trying to save those who already have one foot in the Purgatory.

checkText.en: I swear on the new gods and the old gods - these monsters could not have been born in our world!

finishText.en:
We hardly made it... I don't understand what is it they are trying to achieve, those... how do you call them? The Architects!

Why are they attacking us? What do they need? Do you know? Neither do I...

goal.en: Use the tower cannon to cover the soldiers who are trying to break to the White Fortress port and meet Radovid Gloomov near the pier.

startText.en:
What do we do now? The fortress has fallen, the commanders have died, and I'm just a healer! These people trust me because I mend their wounds, but I am no soldier!

I hate to say that, but we need to retreat. I can see the sails of our ship in the port! This is our last chance!

There are a lot of wounded soldiers here. Somebody has to cover us as we pass along the outer wall. If the monsters reach us, we're dead.

See that cannon on the wall? There's still energy in its batteries. Go there and blast every creature who tries to get in our way!

checkText.en: What... What happened?

finishText.en:
What's going on? I... I was dead, right? My Thread was cut, I can feel it! Now it's interlaced in the Fabric of Creation once again, but the Pattern... The Pattern has changed!

How?! How did you do it?!

goal.en: Find Seeress Unn in the fortress and protect her from the Architects.

startText.en:
I'm worried for Unn. She's a very powerful seeress, and gibberlings call her the Thread Mistress. Right before the assault she started writhing in hysterics, raving and screaming that the new order is coming! We have never seen her like that.

Our governor told two soldiers to escort her to the hospital. I went for some tranquilizers, and that's when we were attacked.

The hospital is right there, near the pier. Can you please make sure Unn survived? We have little hope, but still...

finishText.en: Finally, here you are. You can participate in the interrogation, if our guest is able to answer any questions, of course.

goal.en: Meet with Elizaveta Rysina in Nezebgrad.

startText.en:
I have an urgent message for you. Elizaveta Rysina demands you in her office, right now!

This is a mission of national importance!

finishText.en: At last, here you are!

goal.en: Talk to Izbor Yavorsky in Novograd.

startText.en:
Urgent Message! From Izbor Yavorsky himself!

Izbor wishes to see you as soon as possible. This is a matter of a state importance!

checkText.en: Elizaveta will send you back at any time. Just ask her.

finishText.en: Your mission at the White Fortress has been completed.

goal.en: Return to the White Fortress and help the Demon Hunters.

startText.en: You have left the White Fortress. To return and resume the adventure, talk to Elizaveta Rysina in Yasker's Tower.

checkText.en: Izbor will send you back at any time. Just ask him.

finishText.en: Your mission at the White Fortress has been completed.

goal.en: Return to the White Fortress and help the Demon Hunters.

startText.en: You have left the White Fortress. To return and resume the adventure, talk to Izbor Yavorsky in Aidenus' Tower.

finishText.en:
, I hope we really are on Isa... According to legend, the frosts here were often so severe that birds froze in mid-flight, and now I'm willing to believe these stories...

Vegvísir transported us, but I don't see Waterlily and Ratatoskr... I hope they'll turn up later.

And what about Murk?

goal.en: Find the missing companions in the snow.

startText.en:
So when the Vegvisir transported you, you were all dumped in the snow?

At any rate, you should check the snowdrifts nearby for your companions. They're probably somewhere in there.

finishText.en:
Damn it! I've never encountered such a hun-hurr before... Whatever is in this ice chunk, it's as powerful as a thousand evil spirits. It almost broke me... I couldn't disobey and had to... I had to! I had to break this ice!

, I really don't like this!

goal.en: Rescue Murk.

startText.en:
Something strange is going on here! I sense evil emanating from this piece of ice! And Murk... it's like his mind is immersed in a fog...

We need to awaken our friend! , do something!

finishText.en:
Brr... Brrr... It's... s-s-so... c-c-c-cold...

Th-th-thaaank... you... Brr...

goal.en: Dig into the mysterious snowdrift, then gather firewood and help them warm up.

startText.en:
! I haven't seen this much snow since a blizzard once passed over Coldberg! Then the mines were filled with snow, and Sigurd ordered everyone to grab a shovel! But here it seems to be normal!

I'm glad we found Murk, but Waterlily is still missing! And without her, it will be difficult to save the Ash Tree. Most likely, she is still in one of the snowdrifts! I suggest looking... Digging until we find her!

checkText.en: We must kill those wolves! Or they would attack at the most inopportune moment!

finishText.en: Great hunting, friend! My hair stood on end when I heard that terrible howling!

goal.en: Kill the wolf pack.

startText.en:
Listen, kylys!

It's not just white Pridens that inhabit these dreadfully cold lands! Do you hear the howling, zur? A pack of hungry and angry wolves is hunting nearby!

I'm sure they are on our tracks already, eysh! They are going to attack any minute now.

You know what, I'll look after our little friends, and you go kill these wolves with sharp teeth and powerful paws...

finishText.en:
To be honest, it was just bad luck during my shift... If the Urun hadn't appeared... Anyway, thank you for saving me! I've even composed a verse in your honor. Here, listen:

"The maiden stood on winter watch,

The Urun came like a storm,

And when I hid in the snow,

Glorious warriors saved Gerda!"

Great, huh?

goal.en: Talk to Gerda.

startText.en:
Oh, it's warm now...

Hello! Are you not from around here? But... it's incredible! There has never been anyone but locals here! After Yok came, the rest of the world perished! Did it not?

It really is incredible! No one will believe me unless they see you!

Are you... are you an Orc? An actual Orc?! And you even have fangs?! Damn. And you don't want to kill me? Aren't you going to break everything around here? Wow!Are you... are you a black Urun? And you speak the common tongue? And you're not going to kill anyone? Wow!And you are the Gibberlings? But I see you are not local. The clothes are unusual, and you are acting... strangely. You are clearly outlanders! So the Gibberlings still exist out there? Wow!And what kind of creature are you? I don't have a clue. It's the first time I've seen someone like you. Wow!And what kind of creature are you? I don't have a clue. It's the first time I've seen someone like you. Wow!And what kind of creature are you? I don't have a clue. It's the first time I've seen someone like you. Wow!And what kind of creature are you? I don't have a clue. It's the first time I've seen someone like you. Wow!And what kind of creature are you? I don't have a clue. It's the first time I've seen someone like you. Wow!

And my name is Gerda. I keep my Winter Watch on this side of the island. Want me to tell you about this place?

finishText.en:
, are you awake?

Oh, bother... How terrible... What do I do now? It's all my fault...

I shouldn't have gone with you. Bad luck dogs me...

Sigh...

And now I'm in trouble.

goal.en: Travel with Gerda to Skalgard.

startText.en:
I understand that you want to get to Skalgard... That trail leads there...

Of course I can't go with you - I need to be on watch, you understand...

But... after last month's destruction, the road is dangerous! Only those who know the secret paths can make it through, and besides... I would like to see what happens when you show up in Skalgard!

So, shall we go?

finishText.en:
Caw! My feathers are black as night, my eye sees the one who arrived on the squirrel. I knew that you would come to me, asking about the eternal wanderer who left the world after the leaves on the trees changed two hundred times!

Do you want to know what happened? Enter the path that is forgotten?

goal.en: Meet the ravens, the Spirits of the First.

startText.en:
Hello, hello! You smell like honey… Mmm!

! I hear you have visited the keeper Surt... Is it true that he says my amulet was crafted by the Zvergs?

This is getting more and more interesting! So it's over 200 years old! Too bad Surt doesn't know anything else. But maybe someone does know? On Isa you can find those who remember those times... I'm talking about the ravens! We have already met them - these are Huginn and Muninn, two of the First that remain on Isa still!

And don't forget to drink more mead before we leave here. We're going back out into the cold!

checkText.en: Do not pity the dead. They yearn for rest...

finishText.en:
You did not fear those who are no longer breathing, who are as cold as everything around them. You looked into their dead eyes...

But the one you are looking for was not among them. The bones that burned today were not his! Caw!

goal.en: Burn the old bones.

startText.en:
Caw! Since you come here, longing to see one of the eternal wanderers, are you certain that he is where you hope to find him?

There are some who were not destined to board a stone boat! The frost took them, encasing them in eternal ice. Fear them, because they can rise as draugr, bringing the deadly cold further - to everyone who is still warm and breathing...

Are you not afraid? Then descend into the dark cold gorge on the Path of the Forgotten and set their bones on fire!

checkText.en: Do not pity the dead. They yearn for rest...

finishText.en: Well, hopefully we don't need to worry about Draugar now. Many of the dead still remain unburied, and we need to ensure they won't come for us.

goal.en: Burn 10 frozen skeletons and report to Raven Huginn.

name.en: Threads of Fate: Oblivion by Fire

startText.en:
I had a prophetic dream!

Cold winds are still blowing over Isa... Frost's malice disturbs the dead. I'm talking about those who were not destined to board a stone boat! They can rise as the Draugar, bringing the deadly cold further - to everyone who is still warm and breathing...

Their bones still lie on the Path of the Forgotten in a dark, cold gorge. Go there and burn their bones!

checkText.en: Valravns always flocked to the feast where the bodies of the dead lay!

finishText.en:
There was no fear in you when you entered that path, and the Valravns retreated. The one you are looking for was not among those they pecked at.

He was not destined to become a feast for crows!

goal.en: Kill the Valravns.

startText.en:
Are you looking for the eternal wanderer? Remember - not everyone boards a stone boat! There are those who escaped the flames but became food for the Valravns! Flesh eaters flock to every battle, hungry for feasts among the dead! Is the one you are looking for destined to become one of those who are ripped apart by beaks of scavengers?

The answer is there, in the gorge. Enter it and disperse the ghostly ravens! Enter the Path of the Forgotten, and you will find what you want...

checkText.en: Valravns feast on the bodies of the dead!

finishText.en: Good. There should be no attacks from that direction today. But there are other threats on Isa! Frost is getting worse!

goal.en: Kill 12 Valravns and report to Muninn

startText.en:
Greetings, friend!

As the Elder of Skalgard, it is my duty to respond to threats to our settlement and all the Gibberlings... However, I do not have the manpower to handle everything, so your help will be appreciated.

I have received reports that the Valravns are gathering on the Path of the Forgotten! After they feast on the bodies of the fallen, they could pose a serious threat to our settlements.

So you need to chase them off again. I'm itching to grab a hammer and do it myself. But I have you, so I entrust it to you!

finishText.en:
What an interesting place...

I see what I previously heard only in legends. Our ancestors talked about this, but earlier those ships were wooden, and now the dead set off on their last journey on stone boats!

But... to the point...

goal.en: Meet with Unn in the Harbor.

startText.en:
Caw! If you did not find the ancestor among the draugrs, or among those Valravns feed on, then it means one thing - you need to travel to the Misty Harbor.

You will find him among the graves of the Gibberlings! But remember: by looking for the secret that has been veiled for many years, you bring the prophecy closer...

checkText.en: They wander now without meaning and purpose, awakened...

finishText.en:
The spirits fell asleep... But only for the time being. While Kharyskhan is free, they will rise again, thirsting for revenge... And in their anger they will attack everyone they see...

, we need to stop the villain. Then they will finally be at peace...

goal.en: Destroy the hostile ghosts.

startText.en:
We need to be more careful! Are you listening, ?

This is... The rustle of the Threads that were cut by Kharyskhan's atrocities! They left their echo on this land, and now that Kharyskhan returned, the echoes of broken destinies also came back. The spirits lurk in the fog of the Harbor, and not all of them are in good... spirits.

checkText.en: Oh, where might our ancestors be?

finishText.en: So all Gibberlings are related? Well, yes, how could it be otherwise? All our families come from Ase and Emla, it's true!

goal.en: Help find the ancestors.

startText.en:
, you know we thought about the fate of Isa and came to the realization: the Gibberlings were seafarers who often returned here, to their home, which means there could be descendants of the same clan on Isa and beyond! We would love to find our relatives, because there are only two of us in this harsh world! We really miss our dead brother... Once we even wanted to take Sigurd as a brother, but the orc deceived us... There is no ritual of unity, he said.

But it is quite possible that among the souls resting here might be our distant uncles and aunts. We picked some flowers in the valley - we want to honor the memory of our relatives...

But the problem is, we don't know how to figure out who is who! Weaver's Vision would be very useful here, and Unn says you have it. You should be able to use it at the right moment. Don't worry, you haven't lost it. We're lucky you can see the Threads!

Please find those who might be our relatives!

finishText.en: It can't be! I think I figured out where we should look for them...

goal.en: Examine the memory stones and find Gerda's ancestors.

startText.en:
Oh, there are so many graves here!

! Alright, let me know when you're ready to start looking for my relatives! I'm sure it will be pretty easy to find them - I remember their names, so... you just have to look!

If we figure it out, we’ll understand where my ancestors got this… meteorite pendant...

checkText.en: I knew you would be back!

finishText.en:
I... oh, I mean WE are so happy to see you again!

Have you seen the penguins? They are adorable, aren't they? But the squirrels are cute, too! As you can see, there are lots of things to do on Isa. Don't think the place became boring and empty after your adventures! And if you help us, the reward will be worth it!

goal.en: Go to Isa and visit the Strand, Stalwart, Nutlet, and Smile Families, then report to the Sharp Family.

startText.en:
The letter reads as follows:

"! Hello, hello! It's so strange writing a letter to someone! And it will be delivered somewhere outside of Isa! Incredible!

We have put things in order after the Urun attack, and now we can offer you all sorts of tasks! Broddie wants to protect Skalgard, the Thread Keepers see different predictions, and my brothers and I want to join the Winter Watch! And everyone needs your help, so come back soon!

And don't think we'll just make you run around for nothing. You will be rewarded, of course! The Smile and Nutlet Families are working on that, in fact! You'll see what we have, and there is a little advance attached to the letter for you!"

You can go back to Isa and visit Gerda, her brothers, and other Gibberlings who have new tasks and rewards for you.

checkText.en: Be sure to talk to everyone and get their opinion.

finishText.en:
Well, that's good! We will also call on the spinners from the Fishermen and Meadmakers to strengthen the ritual. But we need to start preparing right now. We are going to the Ash Tree and we will tell fortunes all night, and we will send for your friends in the morning.

You can rest for now.

goal.en: Discuss the Ritual of Thread Weaving with everyone involved.

startText.en:
Marvelous! So that's how it was. Our predecessors took this secret with them on their eternal journey!

, we are afraid to reveal this secret to the world! What if the prophecy really comes true, and then Isa perishes? But now it's not just the fate of Isa that is at stake.

If we want to save the Ash Tree, then we have no other choice. The Ash Tree is already dying, and if we do not do this, it will definitely wither, and then Isa is doomed. Another future that awaits us is still unclear! So...let's take that risk!

We are ready to discuss the ritual...

checkText.en: Come on, I can't wait to see the full picture!

finishText.en:
I wonder why this fragment was put up at first, then removed?

Were those Thread Keepers afraid to conceal the true Fate? And then later, perhaps, caution outweighed everything else?

Maybe it was Frigga who gave Koll the fragment about him? What do you think, ?

goal.en: Return the sixth fragment of the Carpet of Fate to its place.

startText.en:
, I hear you have found the missing carpet? I knew something was missing! Let's get the lost piece back.

It's not right to make changes to the story, even if we don't like it. Bad things come from this. It's important to remember how everything was: both good and bad. There's a lesson in that.

As for Koll, all secrets will be revealed sooner or later.

finishText.en:
There she is – the hero of this day! Yes, such feats have not been performed in our land for a long time!

I think sooner or later the skalds will compose sagas about you, too, !

goal.en: Travel to the Mead Hall in Skalgard.

startText.en:
Annika, there she is! HeShe is the one everyone is talking about! Look, look...

Hello, ! It's me, Akke. Remember? The gates! I let you into the city! Meet Annika, my sister I told you about.

We invite you to a feast! Broddie told me to throw a feast in your honor and to celebrate the victory over Urun!

Everyone is already there, we're only waiting for you so we can start! And your black-tailed friend, too!

finishText.en:
! Wake up! Wake up! Please wake up!

Oh, damn!

goal.en: Celebrate the events.

startText.en:
Everything seems to be in place! We invited those we wanted to invite, and if we forgot someone, I hope they'll forgive us!

A great feast awaits us! , would you like to see how we celebrate the feats of glorious warriors here on Isa?

Now you'll find out! Enjoy the festivities. Today you can feast to your heart's content! Skol!

finishText.en: Oh, it’s good that you managed to bring back everyone! Now I'll look after them, and you go to the Ash Tree. Don't delay!

goal.en: Eliminate 30 enemies in Skalgard, help 5 wounded, and find out what happened.

startText.en:
Ohh, ! It's a nightmare! The Urun attacked out of nowhere! We must fight back, or else it's going to end badly! And there are many wounded - we need to help them, too!

Oh-oh-oh!

checkText.en: Please hurry!

finishText.en: Everyone is here! How wonderful!

goal.en: Find the missing children and bring them to Styr and Hadne in the Fjord.

startText.en:
! Please help! We need to find the missing Gibberling children!

Most of the families with children have already left the city, but some of them are missing.

I know they can hide well, but I'm really afraid that the Urun with their scent will find and devour the little ones!

finishText.en: Oh, no... No! No, no, no!

goal.en: Get to the Eternal Harbor, find Kharyskhan and kill him

startText.en: Yes, yes, my sister and I will take care of everyone! The children and all the others who fled from Skalgard! You need to hurry - Kharyskhan went to the Eternal Harbor and took Gerda and the Sharp brothers with him! I dread to imagine what will happen if you delay!

finishText.en: It's... of course, everything is incredible! I've never seen anything like it. I hope it wasn't all in vain!

goal.en: Enter the Hall of Fates, save the Gibberlings, and defeat Skulnar the Northwind.

startText.en:
, that sneaky orc tricked you!

Now both he and our little friends are trapped in the Hall of Fate!

Yes, yes, right here, under the Prophetic Ash Tree, is a powerful place of power - the entrance to the Hall! And the spinners are holding the door wide open right now!

That means the old orc figured it all out!

Go after him!

checkText.en: Go to the Hall and find the Fate of the All-Mother! Hurry! I won't be able to maintain my astral projection here indefinitely!

finishText.en: Hope? It's a great power. Even when darkness swallows the world and faith dries up, hope remains. It moves us forward in the most difficult time when there is nothing left.

goal.en: Find the All-Mother's Fate in the Hall and give her hope.

startText.en:
! Wait!

You and I have one more important thing to do in the Hall. Do you still remember why we came here?

We finally have a chance to reach the All-Mother's Thread through her child, her first tree in Sarnaut! And learn how we can mollify her and save our dying Great Trees.

 Please find her Thread in the Hall. Try to help.

All right, now go!

checkText.en: I think everyone wants to talk to you!

finishText.en:
Well, that's all, right? Is our adventure coming to an end?

You will come back to Isa someday, right? We will be very, very happy to see you again!

See you soon, ! May your Thread be strong!

goal.en: Talk to your friends in Skalgard.

startText.en:
, it took you a long time to recover after the ritual! We were starting to worry... But maybe you just need to rest.

Well, Isa is now open to all Gibberlings, and the first ships have already landed on the shores of the allod. You should go meet all your new and old acquaintances and see how they are doing. I think they have a lot to say...

finishText.en:
Interesting news! Perhaps you are not hopeless after all, . If Isa's Gibberlings had showed up a few years ago, I would've been extremely worried that the League would bring in new forces to fight us. But now it's not even clear if the Gibberlings will stay in the League!

Okay, so be it, I will forget your defeat in Eden.

We have new problems here. The allod Jigran, lost and forgotten by everyone. It has become the new capital of Sarnaut. And the situation there - the news make your blood run cold. I've been looking for someone to send there. I think you will be a good candidate.

We must prepare, but for now… wait. I will send for you when the time comes.

goal.en: Report to Yasker

startText.en:
, I have a task for you... We need to tell Yasker everything that happened here. I hope the great leader of the Empire will temper justice with mercy.

And one more request: do not tell anyone how to get to Isa. Let this remain the secret of the Gibberlings of Isa and those they choose to invite here.

finishText.en:
Well, that's interesting news! Maybe I was wrong about you, ... Isa's Gibberlings. If they had showed up a few years ago, I would've been extremely happy to have reinforcements in the fight against the Empire. But now it's not even clear whether the Gibberlings will remain in the League!

Okay, so be it, I'll forget about your failure in Eden.

We have new problems here. The allod Jigran, lost and forgotten by everyone. It has become the new capital of Sarnaut. And the things that are happening there - the blood runs cold when you hear it. I kept thinking about who to send there. I think you'll be a good candidate.

We need to prepare, but for now… wait. I will send for you when the time is right.

goal.en: Report to Aidenus

startText.en:
, I have a task for you... We need to tell Yasker everything that happened here. I hope the old man will thaw a bit.

And one more request: do not tell anyone how to get to Isa. Let this remain the secret of the Gibberlings of Isa and those they choose to invite here.

finishText.en:
So be it! You will have Lyngbakr, and Gerda will have her trinket.

I wouldn't be Styr Ruff if tomorrow the head of this fish doesn't hang over my hearth!

goal.en: Persuade the Elder of the Fishing Clan to catch Lyngbakr.

startText.en:
, what do we do now?!

This big fish ate my bag! My poor bag... And with it my amulet!

My mom wore it, and my granny wore it, and my great-grandmother, and… Waah!

And I lost it! I have nothing left of them!

Oh-oh-oh...

checkText.en:
You will find them along the shore of the fjord, and Sygga likes to freeze her furry ass at the feet of the trio.

And be quick before I change my mind!

finishText.en:
What, everyone agreed? Everyone? Even Sygga?

, I'll be damned! I didn't think Ruff's old team would get together again. You know, after that incident with Jon, we never went after big fish together again. It was hard for everyone. Everyone felt guilty, disagreements began...

I don't care about past grievances! But if we're going after Lyngbakr, they are the only ones I'd want at my side.

goal.en: Give 5 bottles of Fish Oil to the Gibberlings in the Fjord and ask them to join the hunt.

startText.en:
, you don't think Lyngbakr is a stupid salmon to be hooked, do you?

It takes a team to harpoon such a creature. The best team!

There are many excellent fishermen among us, but some are worthy of a legend. Ricky and Knerr Perch, Halli Hook, Hedda Pike, and Sygga Roach. Well, me too, of course.

Give everyone a bottle of fish oil from me. They know what it means.

I need these five on board, otherwise there will be no hunting!

checkText.en: There they are, crawling around.

finishText.en:
Mmmm, yum! Get over here, !

For bait, of course. I've eaten enough crab meat to last me a lifetime.

goal.en: Collect 25 pieces of Crab Meat and take it to Ricky Perch.

startText.en:
Like I said, we need bait!

Lyngbakr is not some kind of pike, catfish or beluga! He's quite a gourmet. He'll eat everything he sees, of course, but only if he's really hungry. And if he's full, you'll need a true delicacy to lure him out. I'm talking about Ice Crabs... You see, , they are cautious creatures - they hide as soon as they sense danger, so their delicious tender meat is out of reach.

Therefore Lyngbakr rarely gets crabs for dinner, but when he does, he is completely blissed out.

Fortunately, we have a lot of crabs here on the shore, so it won't be difficult for you to collect some bait. You can open their shells, right?

checkText.en: Remember: we need at least twenty five pieces!

finishText.en: Everyone will be fed today! I hope we'll have enough crabs for a while! However, this doesn't mean we have everything we need!

goal.en: Obtain 25 pieces of Crab Meat and take them to Ricky Perch.

startText.en:
Greetings, friend!

As the Elder of Skalgard, it is my duty to ensure that the settlement is protected, and that everyone is fed and clothed.

Now Isa is constantly receiving guests, among them Gibberlings who lived outside of Isa. We have so many people on Isa these days! Which is great and exciting, of course, but this horde needs to eat. Remember how Ricky Perch asked you to get crab meat? It doesn't matter what he told you about our preferences - we need food right now. And it seems that the most affordable food now is crabs on the shores of the Empty Sea. There are lots of them, and they are delicious, so bring at least twenty five pieces of crab meat - it's not much, but we'll send others to get some as well. We'll make chowder with pepper, mmm... yes!

checkText.en: Don't kill more bears than necessary. If we exterminate them all, where will we get the fat? Exactly!

finishText.en:
There you go! !

We Gibberlings don't get too cold, not like Heidruns, but a bit of Bear Grease wouldn't hurt... especially after swimming in icy water.They say the Urun aren't sensitive to cold, but just in case, I advise you to use the grease: the wind is fierce here, and if your fur gets wet, you'll freeze in seconds!I don't know how someone like you endures cold - not very well, I'm sure! So feel free to cover yourself with Bear Grease, otherwise you'll die if you fall into icy water!I don't know how someone like you endures cold - not very well, I'm sure! So feel free to cover yourself with Bear Grease, otherwise you'll die if you fall into icy water!I don't know how someone like you endures cold - not very well, I'm sure! So feel free to cover yourself with Bear Grease, otherwise you'll die if you fall into icy water!I don't know how someone like you endures cold - not very well, I'm sure! So feel free to cover yourself with Bear Grease, otherwise you'll die if you fall into icy water!I don't know how someone like you endures cold - not very well, I'm sure! So feel free to cover yourself with Bear Grease, otherwise you'll die if you fall into icy water! What are you saying? Are you dead already? It will protect you from rust at least - you're wearing too much metal!I don't know how someone like you endures cold - not very well, I'm sure! So feel free to cover yourself with Bear Grease, otherwise you'll die if you fall into icy water!

Our great-grandfathers came up with it. It works flawlessly!

goal.en: Obtain 9 servings of Bear Fat, then render them into 3 servings of Bear Grease at the fire. When you are done, take them to Halli Hook.

startText.en:
, it's quite cold here, as you can see! And if you fall into the sea, you will freeze to death. But, as you can see, we have a lot of creatures dwelling here - and somehow they survive in the water, right?

Therefore, we will use some old-fashioned tricks. Let's be like animals! Take bears, for example. They have special fat under their skin, and that's why they don't freeze. So for us the only way to survive in the icy water - is to generously smear Bear Grease all over ourselves.

I never go fishing without Bear Grease! You never know. I might tumble into the water, the fur will get wet, and that’s it - my little brothers will be left alone.

checkText.en: I'll need half for fortune-telling, and the other half for soup...

finishText.en:
Of course, we are not Seida who could have woven everything into patterns, but nevertheless...

We don’t know what Lyngbakr will do, but the hunt will be successful - we are certain of it!

goal.en: Get 20 Fish Bones and hear a prediction about the coming hunt from the Spinner Family.

startText.en:
Wait, wait. We heard that you're are going hunting. If that case, you need a prediction... We are the Thread Keepers who see the future... Do you know that all that exists is woven together, ?

If you want to know if the signs are favorable today, or if knots and patterns promise you evil, we will need to perform a reading. For the weather, for fate, for everything to turn out right...

Words are like yarn. They can also be woven into a pattern which is called a verse. This is enough for now, even though it's better to see the canvas that's being woven in Skalgard... But puzzling out the meanings is a long work, and here we can do it faster.

I need fish bones to put a verse together. They come out of the waters they share with Lyngbakr, so they will tell me what I need...

checkText.en: I'll need half for fortune-telling, and the other half for soup...

finishText.en:
Excellent! Bones are exactly what we need. We'll try to arrange them into verses again and see what the sea says...

Run along now. This prediction might not be about you, so you don't need to hear it! When we need you, we'll send for you.

goal.en: Collect 12 Fish Bones and take them to the Spinner Family.

startText.en:
We heard how the Spinners predicted a successful hunt for Lyngbakr for you! Well, it's the right way - better than searching for meanings in the Carpet of Fate. Now that Kharyskhan has been expelled from Isa, we need to know what else is coming. What will happen to the Urun, whether Frost will spare us, and what to do about the darkness...

All in all, we shouldn't pass up an opportunity to peer into the future! Collect the bones. Let's see what the sea has to say this time. Then give them to the Spinners.

finishText.en:
Nearly froze to death! Th-th-thank you! Br-r-r...

When you s-see my b-brother, tell him that e-everything is in ord-der! But I'm not going b-back today...

goal.en: Help Galli Hook get to the fire in the village.

startText.en:
H-h-help! H-help m-me!

Please help me s-swim to shore! Can b-barely move my p-paws, and my t-teeth are chattering!

finishText.en:
Well, we are at sea! Ruff take it, how I love this stuff!

The weather is favorable, the only thing left to do is to lure this big fish... and then catch it!

But don't think it's that simple, ... Before we're finally ready, we need to do a few important things... Yes, yes, nothing big can be done without preparation!

goal.en: Go to sea on a ship.

startText.en:
Everything's ready! All aboard!

So, , are you coming with us? We don't have extra seats on the ship. Hunting is sacred business, it's not for outsiders.

...Oh, abyss take you. Fine, fine! Get on board.

But you'd better do as I say and don't be a coward! The sea loves those strong in spirit!

checkText.en: Don't forget the Bear Grease!

finishText.en: The salty sea will become even saltier with blood! The hunt is close!

goal.en: Smear Bear Grease all over yourself and kill 12 Morays in the sea.

startText.en:
Alright.

There is another problem. We have Morays here. Terribly ferocious. And hungry. If we throw the bait into the sea now, they will immediately devour it, and there'll be nothing left for Lyngbakr.

There's no time to waste. We must do it now, before the monster returns to the bottom again.

Do you have Bear Grease, ? Excellent. Smear it all over yourself and dive. The fewer Morays are around, the more blood in the sea and no competition for bait.

And keep your wits about you so the fish doesn't gobble you up. We might not get you out in time.

checkText.en: Don't forget the Bear Grease!

finishText.en: Ho-ho-ho, youngster! The Sharps are right, there are more and more morays around here, and we should reduce their number when we can - otherwise there will be no other fish in the Empty Sea!

goal.en: Smear Bear Grease all over yourself and kill 8 Ice Morays in the sea, then report back to Styr Ruff.

startText.en:
Uh... We have a task for you. We keep thinking about ways to protect the Tree from all sorts of enemies on the Winter Watch. The thing is, some enemies are hidden - we don't see them, so they don't seem to pose a direct threat! But they can easily cause trouble...

The three of us talked and decided that the morays are a threat! Since there is no Lyngbakr, there will be no one to eat them, and they will breed freely and eventually become a problem for the fishermen. Without the sea, there would be no supplies for the defenders. So we need to reduce the number of morays.

checkText.en: Oh, if Jon had this rune...

finishText.en:
Do you think it's the one, ? You don't know? Neither do I!  I have never seen it in my life, only heard stories.

Well, let's find out. If I never miss, then it’s definitely the one!

goal.en: Find the Rune of Luck among the sunken ships on the seabed.

startText.en:
Hey, , listen up! Since Ruff has decided to throw you into the sea, help me with something, will you?

There was once a fisherman named Hummi, and one thing separated him from the others - he was very lucky. His friends and brothers thought that maybe it was his fate or, as the Heidruns said, he'd been born under a lucky star... except the prey went into his net on its own, and he constantly pulled out the biggest fish with his fishing rod.

But the thing is, I know he had an amulet - a rune of great luck! But then one day... Trouble came, and luck turned away from him. Hummi's boat sank, and the rune disappeared...

Whether you believe it or not, it would be nice to find it. Such an amulet would be very useful to us now! I think it's somewhere at the bottom, in the wreckage... Try to get it!

finishText.en:
Never heard of a fish flying over the abyss! Some kind of sorcery...

Well, ruff take it!

Here it is, my dream fish! Lyngbakr! Huge Lyngbakr!

Well, it's big enough to feed not just the clan, but the whole of Isa! And I'll nail his head onto my house.

Oh, fate brought us together for a reason, ...

So what did you want to get out of his belly?

goal.en: Capture Lyngbakr.

startText.en:
Oh, I feel uneasy... Last time everything ended badly! Dammit. Oh...

I hope this time everyone makes it home in one piece.

But this is a dangerous business, . When we see Lyngbakr, there'll be no time to think!

We'll have to act without thinking.

What should I do? I will tell you. The team is waiting for my order, and when you're ready, just say it!

checkText.en: Keep looking!

finishText.en:
Flying ships?! Are you serious? That means…

! We urgently need to go to Skalgard!

goal.en: Search Lyngbakr's entrails and find Gerda's amulet among other garbage.

startText.en:
Flying fish, just think about it! It's a pity I wasn't there! , you will tell me everything in detail, right? Right?

Let's look for my amulet! It's made of blue gems.

How about you look for the amulet, and I'll tell you if you find it. Because looking at his entrails makes me feel queasy...

finishText.en:
Ohhh! There you are!

I took a second shift today just to catch your arrival. It was worth it! My sister will be so jealous!

My name is Akke, by the way. In case anyone asks. You know, for a heroic saga in your honor. Say it was Akke who let you into Skalgard.

We have a lot fun here! I'll tell you all about it.

Oh, right. Welcome, !

goal.en: Go to Skalgard with Gerda on Ratatoskr.

startText.en:
, I need to tell Uncle Broddie everything! And the spinners! And everyone else! And…

Oh, who is that...?

finishText.en:
Excellent! You're here, , I knew I could count on you. My brothers are watching over Skalgard, and your help will be appreciated here... You will also learn what the Winter Watch really is.

First of all, we should strengthen our defenses and prepare for a possible Urun raid!

goal.en: Go to the forest.

startText.en:
, I see you've helped a lot of people in the city, which tells me you can be trusted...

But Isa's main dangers lie outside Skalgard's walls. And I'm afraid the news is disturbing. Messengers from the Winter Watch have recently arrived. The Urun are spotted more and more often, which means they need help. I don't have enough people here. Every warrior counts! And they can't handle it without me...

So I would like to ask you for help. I will go to them, and I suggest that you and your friends meet me in the Snowy Forest at one of our outposts. Prepare well before this trip!

Oh, and remember: the forest is a cold place. If you don't want to freeze, you need to drink mead.

checkText.en: Hunting is hard work! But I think you can do it...

finishText.en:
I think I heard a raven! Good omen...

Yes, I see you're a pretty good hunterhuntress, ! So many pelts, and most are undamaged. You must have done this for years! Broddie was right, your help will be much appreciated!

goal.en: Obtain Lynx and Fox Pelts.

startText.en:
Hey Orc, how are you? !Aho! Is that what you say? Aho, !Hey, furless one! Is your name ? Have you ever seen snow?Hey, furless one! Is your name ? Have you ever seen snow?Hey, furless one! Is your name ? Have you ever seen snow?Hey, furless one! Is your name ? Have you ever seen snow?Hey, stone guygal! Is your name ? Have you ever seen snow?Hey, fellow Gibberlings! !

No weapons can help us if we all freeze here! Remember that a true Gibberling is not one who never gets cold, but one who dresses warmly! Our own skin is good, but a second one doesn't hurt, so we need an extra supply of pelts. After curing them, we'll have excellent fur coats.

Fortunately, the local lynxes and foxes have great hides - they stay warm even in the fiercest winds. If you want to help, get us some pelts.

checkText.en: Hunting is hard work! But I think you can do it...

finishText.en: Great, this will do! The animals keep coming from the east anyway - Frost is even angrier over there, so there will be too many of them here! Well, this is good for us.

goal.en: Obtain 7 Lynx Pelts and 7 Fox Pelts, and then report back to Sigi the Skier

startText.en:
Wow, Frost is not letting up! And we hoped that with Kharyskhan gone, he would calm down a little, but no - he is still just as fierce. So, you need to find a way to fight the cold.

Well, let's light bigger fires and hand out the mead. Perhaps the best remedy is better heat insulation.

We need fur coats, to put it simply. Therefore, we need to go into the forest and hunt game there. I decided to entrust this job to you, too. After all, you're a decent hunterress, so you'll get us excellent pelts in no time. Go on now!

checkText.en: It's hard to walk through the forest when there are these crazy fir trees...

finishText.en:
Wow! You're quick, ! I see you're covered in needles and resin, so I'm guessing you're done with the Treants...

I'm sorry for them! But what can we do? We can't explain it to them anyway, they're too stubborn. Let's defeat the Urun - and the Treants will return again.

goal.en: Defeat the evil Fir Treants.

startText.en:
Orc, get over here!Priden! Do you hear me?Hey, furless giant! Listen up!Hey, furless giant! Listen up!Hey, furless giant! Listen up!Hey, furless giant! Listen up!Hey, stone giant! Pay attention!So, guests from another island! Brothers and sisters!

The Urun are not the only trouble in the forest today! Kharyskhan's awakening stirred up the Treant guardians... And now they are trying to drive everyone out - even us! Evil fir trees - who could have thought! Now you have to carefully move through the forest to avoid getting killed by a fir branch...

Of course, we are not going anywhere! Alas, you will have to deal with the guardians of the forest - they will be reborn in other trees anyway, so there is only one way out - kill them, .

But be careful. They are extremely strong and they barely feel pain - after all, they have resin, not blood.

checkText.en: It's hard to walk through the forest when there are these crazy fir trees...

finishText.en: Oh, thank you! Previously, they were much friendlier, we even decorated them for Yol for children! Someone dressed up as Num, gave them gifts... And now they can't be approached - they've become hostile... It's all Frost's fault!

goal.en: Kill 3 Fir Treants and report back to Olaf Mush

startText.en:
Here's what we think: the Urun are currently not a threat to the Winter Watch - they are defeated, and their remnants have retreated behind the ridge. However, there are those in the forest who will not back down... the Treants!

Or rather, our Yol trees, guardians of the new year. Well, you've seen them.

I thought they'd mellow out with time, but no! They are still raging. All you can do is run away screaming.

Froddy, the elder from the Frozen Frontier, says the shadow woods are to blame. It seems like the All-Mother's power imbued with Darkness drives the trees crazy... But at least they stopped withering!

And if we don't want the Yol trees to take our outposts apart, we must subdue them! Alas, there is no other way out.

checkText.en: Yes, the barrels are heavy, but what can we do?!

finishText.en:
Excellent! That's how it's done - we don't attack in a crowd like savages, but prepare in advance...

We have all sorts of secrets here. Maybe in time you will see other unusual things!

goal.en: Carry the barrels.

startText.en:
I know you Orcs are fond of the bottle... right?! Admit it! Hehe.Here on Isa we had to figure out a lot of things. You have no idea!They say you have your own sages... But ours aren't bad either!They say you have your own sages... But ours aren't bad either!They say you have your own sages... But ours aren't bad either!They say you have your own sages... But ours aren't bad either!They say you have your own sages... But ours aren't bad either!They say you have your own sages... But ours aren't bad either!

We have something to surprise those ugly cats with!

Especially if you remember the mead… Hehe. Over the centuries, our meadmakers have learned all sorts of interesting recipes... Explosive mead, for example! You just need to drop a barrel, and the consequences will be most impressive. Enough to scare those savages out of their wits!

But we have one problem - these barrels are very heavy, and there is no one to carry them. Maybe you can do it, ? Just bring them to the three marked spots, and from there they can be dropped on the attacking Urun!

checkText.en: Yes, the barrels are heavy, but what can we do?!

finishText.en: And the Elder told me the Sharps were supposed to deliver them! Did they rope you into this?! Damn, those rascals! Anyway, what do I care? Just get the catapults ready.

goal.en: Move three explosive barrels to the catapults and report to Njall Potts.

startText.en:
Oh-oh-oh! The Elder asked us to bring these heavy barrels with mead, but our lower backs hurt something terrible... Yes, all three of us are in pain! On top of that, Wickham's left leg hurts, and Trondur's right arm is useless. There's no way we can carry them - we'll die!

Can you help us? All you need to do is carry three barrels to the catapults! Plus it's a good exercise! Right? Right?!

Exactly! Thank you very much. In the meantime, we’ll think about other threats to the Winter Watch!

checkText.en: There are many enemies, but you two can handle it!

finishText.en:
Glorious battle!

I heard everything from here! Yes, you and Murk make quite a pair, ! Oh, you dealt with them so quickly! I wish I could join you!

Even their teeth didn't help them! We'll have to ask our guys to collect the fangs afterwards - we'll make amulets from them...

goal.en: Eliminate the Sabertooths and Urun.

startText.en:
Look what the wind blew in! White hides, fangs and claws are all over the forest! They also brought Sabertooths with them.

And look! There is also a Jotunn! How did they get him to come here?

Eh, I would love to join in, throw a few punches. But I can’t - I'm on guard duty!

Oh, bother... But I think we can fight them back... with your help, . There is also your friend Murk who wants to prove that he has nothing in common with these distant relatives of his.I bet you want that, too. So go ahead. Kill those Sabertooths and the Urun together!

And don't let the Jotunn crush you! He is terribly fierce and won't be easy to take down, so let’s try to come up with something.

checkText.en: There are many enemies, but you can handle it!

finishText.en: Alright! I'm sure there are some remnants lurking around, but the more we beat them back, the fewer of them will remain. That's the kind of math I like! Sooner or later there won't be any left!

goal.en: Kill 7 Uruns and 7 Sabertooths, then report back to Broddie Stalwart.

startText.en:
After we drove the Urun and their pets out of Skalgard, many of them fled into the forest. And they are still there, hiding among the trees! We need to kick them out of there, otherwise you never know... what they will do next.

Which is why I want you to deal with them! We need to rid these lands of the Urun and the Sabertooths. Let them cower in the frosty valleys behind the mountain ridge.

checkText.en: With our mead we can definitely defeat the Urun!

finishText.en: As you can see, mead is really quite useful! Without it, things would be much more difficult for us! Now you can just drink some, and then a whole crowd can't stop you! I've done that myself many times! With brothers, of course.

goal.en: Hand out the mead.

startText.en:
And one more thing, !

I see you have already been introduced to our explosive mead... But this is mostly just to scare enemies. We have another very secret recipe - a special drink that turns you into a real hurricane! Brewing it is not easy, but it's worth it.

It must be distributed to our warriors who are fighting in the forest... Let them fight! Rip enemies apart with teeth and hands!

checkText.en: With our mead we can definitely defeat the Urun!

finishText.en: Yes, our warriors just ran out of mead! You've arrived just in time. Otherwise there would've been trouble! But with mead, we can now overcome everything!

goal.en: Distribute 7 cups of Fire Mead to the members of the Winter Watch and report to Broddie Stalwart.

startText.en: Ah! Today, the Threads told me this: our fighters, brave warriors, are still fighting the remnants of the Urun army in the forest! We need to help them, otherwise it's going to be bad... Thanks to you, we have a remedy - the same magic mead that makes them stronger. So you need to hurry - take the mead to them before it's too late. With the mead, they will defeat everyone - the Threads are right about that...

checkText.en: The big Jotunn will fall!

finishText.en:
Have you fought off the attack, ?

It's a pity that Kharyskhan left... What an insolent creature! He's relentless... My ancestors fought him, and the ancestors of my ancestors... Yes, we remember him well, he caused a lot of suffering among the Gibberlings!

goal.en: Defeat the Jotunn and Kharyskhan.

startText.en:
Now the most important thing - the Jotunn! You can't take him down with your bare hands! What to we do?

Let's use our catapults and explosive mead!

You just need to land a hit... The target is big, but it won't be easy... Unless... Can you lure him to the fire, ?

Your task is simple - draw the Jotunn's attention and lead him there. You can do that, I hope? We just need to bring him down, the rest will be easy.

finishText.en: Oh, how terrible... We're so unfortunate...

goal.en: Find the missing caravan with mead.

startText.en:
Everything is going well so far. We're fighting off the enemy. Of course, it would be much worse without your support, . The guys are inspired and ready to fight. Smash and crush, crush and smash!

One thing worries me - the mead. You can see it yourself - we can't get anything done without our mead. And the next delivery is delayed... why?

We need to find out what happened... But as luck would have it, there's no one to send there but you.

See if you can learn anything... I have a bad feeling.

checkText.en: Well, what's taking so long?

finishText.en: Phew, I was thinking of sending the City Council after you...

goal.en: Meet with Wrokag the Northwind in Yasker’s Tower

startText.en:
The letter reads as follows:

"So, !

I know you and Yasker are at odds, but the matter is too important to be left unresolved.

This witch Hirkalla now holds us all in an iron fist, but while we are slaving for her, the world is falling apart. And I'm not joking. You'll see for yourself.

Anyway, we need to talk. I'm not leaving Yasker's Study, so we'll meet here.

Come see me before it's too late."

Judging by the letter, Wrokag's matter will bear no delay. Why did the Supreme Shaman of the Orcs decide to write to you?

Although you haven't been to Yasker's Tower in a while, you should answer the old Orc's call.

checkText.en: Oh, why is it taking so long?

finishText.en: It’s good that you're here. I was about to start looking for you.

goal.en: Meet Froddy the Fidget at Aidenus' Tower.

startText.en:
The letter reads as follows:

", my dear friend!

It pains me to hear that you and Aidenus are at odds, and our Great Mage does not want to see you again. However, the matter that prompted me to write this letter is too important to take such quarrels into account.
