The Goddess of Darkness Hirkalla who now rules our world closely watches everything we do - she will not allow anyone or anything to disrupt her control. And yet the world is falling apart, and I mean that in the most literal sense.

I suggest we meet. Since I am now constantly in Aidenus' Tower in Novograd, I think we will find each other here.

Please hurry, I beg you."

Judging by the letter, Froddy's matter is urgent. Why did the Gibberling Elder decided to write to you?

Although you haven't been to Aidenus' Tower in a while, you should answer the wise Gibberlings's call.

finishText.en:
Ah, there you are, ...

I swear on my mug, if what Waterlily told you is even partially true, then we're saved... Or at least there's hope.

Let me describe the situation for you - it was our last mead, and the flowers in the valley have already withered - the bees have nothing to collect. And we still have problems with these fire dogs, damn them!

We have no barrels, no ingredients... And even if we had them, brewing mead is not that easy! You don't think we brew it here everyday just for fun, do you?

But if you're such a hero, then you will solve these problems easily, am I right? Am I right?!

goal.en: Go to the Mead Valley

startText.en:
Oh, this is terrible...

That accursed Jotunn... crushed the last barrel of fire mead!

Damnation! It was the last one, we can’t get more of it. We had enough for the coming harsh winter.

And what now? Frosts get worse almost every hour! If the Uruns decide to attack under the cover of this blizzard, our Gibberling friends will all freeze and won't be able to fight back.

I don't know what to do! Can you help us somehow...?

You need to go to the Mead Valley... the warmest place on this island where we Heidruns dwell... Maybe the Elder of the Meadmakers can come up with something?

finishText.en:
As you can see, everything is simple. They agree to bloom ahead of time, live a shorter time and fall asleep again.

This is their sacrifice and their gift. To all of us, !

goal.en: Help Waterlily grow flowers.

startText.en:
, the Elder told me this island has alternating seasons - there are times when flowers sprout, grow, bloom and then drop new seeds into the ground.

It looks a lot like Eden.

And if you need these flowers to wake up ahead of time, then I can help you by talking to them. There is nothing to be surprised about. You can talk to both flowers and trees.

The All-Mother said that every garden needs a gardener to look after it. If we need to awaken dormant flowers to achieve our goal, then so be it. I will take on this responsibility.

checkText.en: Poor bees... I feel sorry for them!

finishText.en:
Excellent! Even if we have flowers but no bees, the result is the same - no honey!

One thing is unclear - where did the guardian of the volcano go anyway? Does he not care about his pets? It's very strange.

goal.en: Eliminate the Fiery Wolves that are a threat to the bees, then bring the bees to their senses.

startText.en:
Withering flowers are not our only problem!

See for yourself,  - the valley is full of Fiery Wolves, spawn of Muspel! The keeper of the volcano Surt Junior used to keep an eye on them, but he disappeared some time ago!

The wolves have swarmed the valley and the smoke from their fire puts the bees to sleep!

I beg you - drive the wolves away and bring the bees to their senses!

checkText.en: Poor bees... I feel sorry for them!

finishText.en: Poor bees, they always get into trouble! Thank you for bringing them to life!

goal.en: Bring 10 bees to life and report to Yonko

startText.en:
Today, a curious pattern has emerged, a dead bee... We wondered what it meant - and then we figured it out! This is the Mead Valley - the smoke of the volcano is probably affecting the bees again, sending them to sleep...

You need to bring the bees to life again, or else they will die! It's time for them to hibernate.

checkText.en: A wolf is a wolf. I mean, wolf eats wolf! Oh, never mind! I've had enough of the wolves.

finishText.en: The wolves are becoming bolder! I should talk to Surt - he needs to control his pets! Or they'll burn everything down!

goal.en: Eliminate 10 Fiery Wolves and report to Yonko.

startText.en:
Hmm, I've received news from the Meadmakers!

In short, the Fiery Wolves are roaming close to the village again. Apparently, the winds of Frost are driving them away from the volcano, and they do not understand what is happening.

But we don't want the Meadmakers to die in a fire, do we? So we need to act. Knock some sense into the wolves. Don't worry: they'll be reborn again - they are spirits, not living creatures.

checkText.en: You have to look carefully so not a single bee gets lost!

finishText.en:
All the bees are safe and sound? Excellent! Losing even one would be a tragedy!

Thank you for your help, ! Now we are waiting for my sister - she must bring the secret ingredient for fire mead!

goal.en: Shepherd the bees.

startText.en:
Our bees are not some stupid bugs with a sting - our bees are really clever. It took us a long time to breed the kind that would exist peacefully here, in a valley surrounded by ice... In exchange for their help, we feed them and look after them.

Many Heidruns got injured or fled in fear after the Urun attack, so there are barely any bee shepherds left. So I ask you to take on this job, .

I will give you a special pipe that lures bees. Carefully watch the swarm, it's important that not a single bee gets lost.

checkText.en: Well? Are you fighting giants?

finishText.en: What? You don't believe me? I won't lie… Mead is power! And power is mead! Let's drink!

goal.en: Drink mead and defeat the Jotunns.

startText.en:
Fire mead! What do you even knowdo you even knowdo you even knowdo you even knowdo you even knowdo you even knowdo you even knowdo you even know about mead,OrcPridenbare-skinned outlanderbare-skinned outlanderbare-skinned outlanderbare-skinned outlanderbare-skinned outlanderstrange family? Mead is... serious... business... Hic...

Yes, I… I b-beat up all the Jotunns… after a... c-cup of mead! Just three s-sips are en-nough! Just three!

Wha-at? You d-don't believe...? Me-e? Yes... I… I’m not in a... fit state… right now... I'm tired… Maybe you can t-try? D-drink mead! You will scatter Jotunns like kittens! T-trust me! D-drink mea-a-ad!

checkText.en: Well? Are you fighting giants?

finishText.en: Didn't I say m-mead is power? I once met Ymir himself, and w-we fought... and f-fought... and fought some m-more... I w-won.

goal.en: Under the effect of special Mead, kill 3 Jotunns, then report back to Tura Mugg.

name.en: Winter Watch: Jotunns in the Valley

startText.en:
Wow, we've remembered something! Jotunns! Huge, vicious giants! They are the most dangerous creatures on Isa. Although… Well, Jotunns are definitely the biggest!

They live beyond the mountains and come down here sometimes. They love the Mead Valley, because it's warm there...

But we need to drive them away, otherwise you never know... Even one Jotunn can do so much damage...

Mead will help you defeat them. The Meadmakers always brag about it - how they drank the mead and then pummeled all the Jotunns. We reckon you can do that, too. You can tell them your story later.

checkText.en: You have to watch out for the trees! Don't let one fall on you!

finishText.en: Have you cut down the trees? I'll ask you to bring them here - anyone can handle it. Though not everyone can swing an axe and avoid being crushed by a fallen tree! It's good that you're pretty smart, !

goal.en: Cut down trees for the barrel.

startText.en:
Now we have enough mead, but no barrels! To brew mead, you need a new barrel, because this stupid Jotunn broke the old one into pieces...

We need special wood... Usually, our lumberjacks mark suitable trees. It will be great if you go there and cut them down, and then my assistants will take them away to make planks!

After the Urun attacks, we don't have enough hands, so you'll need to roll up your sleeves and work for a bit! Don't delay, !

checkText.en: Warm water is perfect!

finishText.en: It's nice, right? For all the things you've done, , we allow you to use the springs at any time! Remember that here, in the Mead Valley, you will always receive a warm welcome.

goal.en: Sit in the hot spring.

startText.en:
I see we're running you ragged? I'm sorry about this welcome, times are hard right now... It'd been a while since the Urun attacked us, so we weren't prepared.

Now we are waiting for our messenger who went to get the secret ingredient... And you should take a break! Isa is not just cold winds - it's also hot springs filled with the warmth of Muspel.
.
, take a dip in the spring, and your fatigue will go away!

Your friends can use the spring, too! They are run by my young sisters - Mayane and Yarune.

checkText.en: The water is perfect!

finishText.en: It's nice to see you here again! Mayane and Yarune have missed you so much! Come back again!

goal.en: Rest in the hot spring for 2 minutes, then report to Tabeko.

startText.en:
Yes, Winter Watch is not easy! And now the Gibberlings from all allods are coming here - every great warrior - hoping to prove themselves. Such competition is unnerving! So we need to perform as many feats as possible so they don't consider us weaklings... And you will help us with this!

Oh, we just realized we're running you off your legs! To the hot spring, then! Let's relax!

checkText.en: Kill them all! Hmm…

finishText.en:
Ah, bastards! Servants of the accursed Frost and vile cats! They are in cahoots! Yes... it would be really bad without you...

And who are you, anyway? An Orc? I haven't seen one in a long time!Another cat? But black?! Priden?It's the first time I see someone like you. What are you?It's the first time I see someone like you. What are you?It's the first time I see someone like you. What are you?It's the first time I see someone like you. What are you?It's the first time I see someone like you. What are you?Another noisy Gibberling family? What brings you here?

goal.en: Visit Surt Junior

startText.en:
Greetings, ! I am Yabko's sister Yalane, the messenger who was supposed to find Surt Junior and get his secret ingredient for the mead… What is it? Oh no, it's the Greatest Secret of the Meadmakers! Secret!

The thing is, I couldn't get to the keeper! There were terrible sounds coming from his dwelling in the lava fissure, and I was afraid to go inside... I think Surt might be in danger!

I've heard about your exploits, so maybe you can help? We'll be indebted to you.

finishText.en:
Did it work? I didn't really believe that Surt would give us another one!

The keeper has done you a great honor, . Even here few people know about the secret ingredient.

Now you are one of the chosen ones!

goal.en: Talk to Surt and get the secret ingredient from him.

startText.en:
Did the Heidruns andother Gibberlings send you here? Were they afraid to come? Hmm...

Yes, heroes are not the same these days... In the old days, they came by themselves, but now... That's what quiet times mean. But if the Urun are here, then Kharyskhan has awakened again...

Where are you from? Hmm...

From outside lands? Hmm... Is there really a lot of land left? The Great Mages preserved it? I heard of them, but it was a long, long time ago...

checkText.en: Just don't mess up!

finishText.en:
It is done.

Here, have a mug of the fresh mead, ! It will also come in handy if you decide to go to the far north! Without it, a terrible death awaits you there!

goal.en: Brew mead in the Meadmakers' village.

startText.en:
! For your great help, I will give you an incredible honor - I will allow you to assist us in brewing fire mead! Not every Gibberling is worthy of it, so be thankful!

I hope you don't mess up and let me down... Make sure to listen to me very carefully!

The recipe calls for many ingredients mixed in the right order at the right time.

Well? Shall we start brewing?

checkText.en: Do not disturb the thoughts of one who gazes into the distance with their mind.

finishText.en:
Yes, the Great Trees are linked to each other. And to the All-Mother who gave birth to them...

However, everywhere I went, I felt the onset of decline. The Trees have become too weak, the connection between them too fragile. We won't achieve our goals here, or on the Kanian Archipelago, or New Isa... Let alone Eden, which is so far away...

But there is one more Great Tree we have yet to visit.

goal.en: Meet with Unn and discuss what is happening to the Great Trees.

startText.en:
, I wonder what's going on?

Some nonsense is going on. Suddenly everything went wrong. The spirits of Igsh are worried. I'd even say they are terrified. And the reason for everything is in the Dead Sea. Maybe you remember that a sprout of the Great Tree was planted in The Rusty Anchor?

It's the one in trouble. To be honest, I'm not really good with trees. I know more about animals and spirits but, fortunately, there is someone who can help us. There is still peace with the League, so a whole Gibberling delegation has arrived there. After all, they also have their own Tree, so maybe they will figure out what's wrong. They also brought someone from Eden with them just in case...

So I'm sure you'll solve the problem together.

checkText.en: Do not disturb the thoughts of one who gazes into the distance with their mind.

finishText.en:
Yes, the Great Trees are linked to each other. And to the All-Mother who gave birth to them...

However, everywhere I went, I felt the onset of decline. The Trees have become too weak, the connection between them too fragile. We won't achieve our goals here, or on the Kanian Archipelago, or New Isa... Let alone Eden, which is so far away...

But there is one more Great Tree we have yet to visit.

goal.en: Meet with Unn in Darkwater and discuss what is happening to the Great Trees.

startText.en:
, a misfortune has befallen us...

You know that Frozen Frontier is now our new home. Under the patronage of the Great Dragon Nordrak, we are building a New Isa to replace the old, lost one.

However, it's not easy to break the glaciers and free the dragon! The sprout of the Great Tree we received in Darkwater aids us in this.

With its help, we will turn New Isa into a blooming garden sooner or later.

At least that's what all Gibberlings thought until recently. Now... alas, the sprout is not doing well. And we still don't really understand why.

The seer Unn, whom you already know, has arrived. She went straight to Darkwater, to their Great Tree. She has Waterlily with her - your friend from Eden. But they need you, too, I'm sure. I really hope you will figure out what's going on...

checkText.en: Yes, this is Howlem, the home world of the Pridens.

finishText.en:
Aho, !

You won't be pleased by this news.

Howlem's Tree is dying faster than the others. And our allod has already begun to crumble. If this is not stopped, soon the Pridens will lose their homeland.

goal.en: Go to Howlem and talk to Murk

startText.en:
The Great Tree of Howlem is the oldest known to me. If it doesn't help us, nothing else will.

The Pridens are not happy to see uninvited guests here, so I asked your old friend to help us. We are talking about Murk, of course...

How do we get there? No, we don't need a ship. Know that mystics have a great secret, . The magic of the Astral is very powerful, and there is a secret spell of transportation that only the strongest mind knows.

When you're ready, tell me so, and I'll take you all with me to Howlem.

checkText.en: Yes, this is Howlem, the home world of the Pridens.

finishText.en:
Aho, !

You won't be pleased by this news.

Howlem's Tree is dying faster than the others. And our allod has already begun to crumble. If this is not stopped, soon the Pridens will lose their homeland.

goal.en: Go to Howlem and talk to Murk

startText.en:
The Great Tree of Howlem is the oldest known to me. If it doesn't help us, nothing else will.

The Pridens are not happy to see uninvited guests here, so I asked your old friend to help us. We are talking about Murk, of course...

How do we get there? No, we don't need a ship. Know that mystics have a great secret, . The magic of the Astral is very powerful, and there is a secret spell of transportation that only the strongest mind knows.

When you're ready, tell me so, and I'll take you all with me to Howlem.

checkText.en: Hurry! The First are getting weaker!

finishText.en: The power will help the Spirits of the First! But it will delay the destruction only for a while. If we don't find a solution, a great calamity will befall us.

goal.en: Obtain spirit particles and fill the Spirits of the First with power.

startText.en:
The one you call Murk is right.

Only our faithful friends and patrons - the Spirits of the First, those four that remained on Howlem - still hold the ever-growing rift with their powers. But their strength is running out...

I believe I know how to help them. Particles of the power of the First, once stored in the seed of the Great Tree, are now released from the fractured earth. They have been absorbed by various animals in our Sanctuary.

If you help collect them and deliver them to each of the four spirits on different sides of the rift, they will be able to stop the destruction at least for a while!

checkText.en: If that doesn't help us, nothing will.

finishText.en:
Ahh... ahh...

Zvik, zvik! I was sleeping...

Who are you and what's going on?

goal.en: Meet with Unn in the temple.

startText.en:
I don't know what else would help. If I knew, I would have done it myself, but... I am powerless here, eysh!

There is still hope - the wise Unn is trying to find a way to send a message through the Great Tree.

I know it won't be easy, and who knows what sacrifices you'll have to make. But Howlem's fate is at stake, and each of us will gladly give their life so our homeland lives.

Now is not the time to cling to old customs.

Since you came with a misfortune we all share, now you are as much a member of our family as any of the Pridens.Since you came with a misfortune we all share, now you are as much a member of our family as any of the Pridens.Since you came with a misfortune we all share, now you are as much a member of our family as any of the Pridens.Since you came with a misfortune we all share, now you are as much a member of our family as any of the Pridens.Since you came with a misfortune we all share, now you are as much a member of our family as any of the Pridens.Since you came with a misfortune we all share, now you are as much a member of our family as any of the Pridens.Since you came with a misfortune we all share, now you are as much a member of our family as any of the Pridens.You too are a Priden, and the years spent outside Howlem don't change that. And your friends are now members of our family like any other Priden.

Therefore, the Sanctuary is open to you.

Let's try and do something.

checkText.en: A squirrel! It's alive! I was able to reach it!

finishText.en:
, I can't believe my ears.

The Gibberlings were sure that Isa was long lost. But if one of the First is certain that Isa exists...

We have to get there!

Yes, I understand that terrible sacrifices will have to be made, but there is no other choice. If Isa and the Great Ash exist, we must find them no matter what! And Ratatoskr is the only one who can help us.

goal.en: Ask Ratatoskr if she knows what's happening to the Great Trees.

startText.en:
I understand that I am on Howlem, so our plan must have worked. Howlem exists in the middle of the boundless ocean of the Great Nothing! And the Priden people are still alive. So the sacrifice of the First was not in vain!

Yes, and the Howlem's Tree, the offspring of the Great Ash Tree, is still standing… Although I feel that something is wrong… Is that why you woke me up?

checkText.en: Isa could not die - the Ash Tree is its reliable support!

finishText.en:
Apparently, Ratatoskr the Squirrel's plan succeeded and Vegvisir really transported you... to Isa?

The homeland of the Gibberlings that is believed to have been destroyed?

How did it survive and why have the Gibberlings never found it? All these thoughts flash through your mind as you feel a terrible cold that penetrates to the very bones.

goal.en: Go to Isa.

startText.en:
Isa had its own wise men and its own secrets.

There is one very old spell - Vegvisir! It will take you home, wherever you are! And my home is Isa and the Great Ash Tree, on the branches of which I live.

Alas, it's not so simple. To use Vegvisir, we need a lot of power. I don't have it now.

But if you know how to get it... Then let's hurry, Ash needs our help!

checkText.en: Feats can't wait!

finishText.en: The more enemies you defeat, the stronger you become!

goal.en: Eliminate 50 hostile creatures on Isa.

startText.en: Do you feel like you haven't achieved everything you set out to on Isa? Not ready for further exploits? I know how to help you. We Gibberlings have many enemies on Isa. You will find them everywhere. Fight them, and you will quickly achieve perfection. Come back here after defeating fifty enemies, and I will give you a small reward.

finishText.en:
Where do you want to go? To the Bear Land?

I didn’t think you could surprise me again after Lyngbakr, sea cadet!

goal.en: Talk to Gerda about the hermits and visit Styr Ruff in the Fishermen's clan

startText.en:
, the most severe punishment on Isa is being banished into the mountains, beyond the bear's ridge. If a Gibberling can survive out there alone, they will most certainly be re-educated. And then they can be forgiven.

But if an exile's Thread breaks, all that remains of them is an empty stone in his clan's eternal boat. Just like my great-great...

This is so sad, . Did they do something that got them exiled for good? Even in our Carpet of Fate, their threads disappeared completely without a trace - I tried looking for them...

Hm...

Hmmm...

I have an idea!

We'll go ourselves and find out!

I'm terribly afraid of sailing, but I have no choice!

finishText.en:
Well, that's it, sea cadet! My boat has never gone this far. You can get back on another boat - the water won't freeze for a while here.

Luck be with you!

goal.en: Get to the Bear Land on Styr Ruff's boat.

startText.en:
Oh, the Bear Land? Why do you want to go there? Aren't you afraid to die?

Okay, so be it! I'll take you all. I’ll take you there, but then you'll be on your own. Don't be mad, but my team is not ready to climb mountains yet!

Remember - in those parts Frost's breath is stronger than here. Don't even think about going there without mead - you'll freeze right away.

finishText.en: [The hermit looks at you demandingly and points her paw at the bear.]

goal.en: Follow the mysterious hermit through the blizzard.

startText.en:
Brrr! It's so damn cold here! And the wind!

I hope you've stocked up on Fire Mead, , otherwise we'll all turn to ice here...

Let's move faster! I think there is someone in the blizzard!

checkText.en: [Lyrra angrily waves her paws. You'd better hurry!]

finishText.en: [The hermit silently begins to stuff the bear's wounds with moss. He gradually comes to his senses.]

goal.en: Bring Blood Moss, Yak Meat, and a Barrel of Mead to the hermit Lyrra from her hideout.

startText.en: [The hermit persistently points her paw at the nearby red moss and grazing Yaks, and then pokes in the direction of the bear. He was wounded by huge claws and teeth. He needs medicine and food. And something else that looks like… a barrel?]

checkText.en: A couple of scratches won't bring Yor down!

finishText.en:
Only one of us is old enough to have seen those times.

Now I see that fate itself did not allow Yor to kill him...

goal.en: Talk to Yor.

startText.en:
Rrr!

Yor would have torn you into a hundred pieces had little Lyrra not stopped him. Now Yor is grateful to you. But Yor is too weak to stand up and fight for you.

How can he repay you?

finishText.en: Kharyskhan did not lie when he promised Beorn immortality... Now I see!

goal.en: Eliminate the Urun and the Rebel Werebears, and defeat Beorn.

startText.en:
Beorn… His fur has long since become white - not from birth, but from gray hair. The old leader lived three lives of a bear.

He won't talk to you unless you show him your strength. Go and finish what Yor started.

Those indoctrinated by Beorn will stand in your way. White cats are among them. They will come to your land. Very soon.

Don't let your hand falter, outlander.

Even if only snow remains on the cliff after you.

checkText.en: The mountain paths are still full of Urun!

finishText.en: Our people are stubborn and persistent. They will be loyal to Beorn until it finally dawns on them that it won't end well.

goal.en: Eliminate 6 Urun and 6 Werebears, then report back to Yor.

startText.en:
I have another task for you. You see, the Urun have been spotted not just in the forest, but also on the Bear Ridge. They seem to have joined forces with the Werebears lead by Beorn who is almost immortal now.

 We need to break this alliance somehow! I think if you hit the Werebears regularly, they'll realize that their friendship with the Urun is too much trouble. And drive them off the mountains. So - prove to the Werebears that they need a new leader. Maybe that Yor that you told me about.

checkText.en: Are you done with the task?

finishText.en: Great! The fewer Frost Spirits, the better! But make no mistake, little friends. They will come back...

goal.en: Use the Frost Absorber to absorb 3 Frost Spirits, then report back to Yor.

startText.en:
Do you know who is our main enemy on Isa? No, not the Urun and not the Werebears. Our main enemy is Frost and his servants. Technically, they are not alive, since they don't have hot blood. All they want is to freeze the entire world. Imagine what it would look like - seas frozen to the bottom, icy mountains instead of green lands.

We must stop him somehow. We have an artifact from our great-grandmother here - the Frost Absorber! We will give it to you, and you will go to the Bear Ridge and try to absorb the power of the Frost Spirits! Fewer spirits - less frost!

Tell that Werebear... Yor! Let him see if it gets warmer.

checkText.en: [Lyrra angrily waves her paws. You'd better hurry!]

finishText.en: [The hermit silently begins to stuff the bear's wounds with moss. It looks like they can survive another week.]

goal.en: Gather 12 portions of Blood Moss and take them to Lyrra.

startText.en:
We got another prediction. Little exile Lyrra. For some reason, her Thread is important to the Pattern. Why? Only Fate knows.

However, we see that Lyrra is in trouble. She needs help. Bear Ridge is a dangerous place. If she is out of supplies, death will come quickly. Frost is trying to kill Lyrra, but if you save her, it will be a great boon. Get some Blood Moss for her and Yor.

finishText.en:
That bear hun-hurr lied to us!

I swear on my tail, if there had been any passage here, it must have been filled up a long time ago...

goal.en: Ask the Werebear about the hermits of the past.

startText.en:
Look what the wind blew in...

Well, ask your questions... And then get out! I'd rather not see you again...

So annoying...

finishText.en:
, have you seen this?!

I can swim now!!

goal.en: Walk the Hermit Trail along the Bear Ridge.

startText.en:
Wow, what a mean Werebear! He's helping Kharyskhan! And he lied to us!

But what can we do? ! We'll go the other way! If this is a dead end, we just need to find another way. Through the mountains!

Even though the mountains get higher and steeper, we will make it!

finishText.en:
Whoa!

In our family, the story of the Freya and Captain Koll was retold many times, but no one ever believed he could have reached Isa!

Only... it looks like he was shipwrecked. What happened to the crew?

goal.en: Find out what the cave is hiding.

startText.en:
, I feel like we're getting VERY close!

But we must be very, very careful. Here you can run into dangerous creatures. And even an Isfrun!

It would be nice to warm up.

finishText.en:
For two hundred years we have guarded the heavenly wanderer. Waiting for the blood to resume its course.

Now we are free.

The blue stone will reveal the last secret to you.

goal.en: Put to rest the Zverg spirits

startText.en:
Eysh! They said the miners had died two hundred years ago, but you can still hear the music of their hammers here!

Haven't they found peace yet? That's not good, shoysh!

, I suggest we put an end to their earthly existence. Even though they are ghosts, I believe they are still suffering. We also need to make sure they don't attack us all at once!

checkText.en: Damn! That's insane!

finishText.en:
, just think about it!

If Koll had returned from Isa, and our ancestors had learned the way to their homeland, everything would be completely different now!

The Gibberlings wouldn't have joined the League, the world wouldn't have learned the secret of the meteorite, there would be no astral ships! Or at least it wouldn't have happened so soon.

And so many little brothers and sisters wouldn't have been lost in search of our lost homeland... They had no idea the Threads themselves diverted their path away from Isa.

We would have a home... A true home!

Damn...

goal.en: Learn the history of the ship.

startText.en:
, so all this time we had a huge flying ship right under our noses?

And nobody, nobody knows about it?

And nobody, nobody remembers it?

Wow, I have so many questions!

finishText.en: The Threads must have decided so! If you were destined to learn this, it was meant to be. The call of legends has led you to the Freya... Is this really the end of this story?

goal.en: Fight Kharyskhan and save the Gibberlings.

name.en: In the Claws of the Enemy

startText.en:
I'm so proud of my great-grandfather Koll! He acted so wisely and courageously, just like Wald from my favorite saga!

It's a pity the spinners had to break the weaving of his fate. Had it been otherwise, I could have brothers or sisters now. And I would never be this lonely... Like Mom was, and Granny...

But that's okay! What's important is the fact that he protected Isa and saved the whole world from the evil Orc spirit. I don't regret anything.

Oh…

 Oh-oh-oh!

, there's Urun over there! A whole pack!

finishText.en: We need to see the Spinners! Only they will help. Who are they? Have you never heard of the Thread Keepers? Yes, that's exactly what they are!

goal.en: Rescue Murk from the fighting pit.

startText.en:
In short, we caught a black Urun - I don’t know where he came from - and threw him into the pit so he would fight the Whites! Sounds like fun, right?

Although… you look the same… maybe we shouldn't have?Hmm, I see by the look on your face that something is wrong…Hmm, I see by the look on your faces that something is wrong…Hmm, I see by the look on your face that something is wrong…Hmm, I see by the look on your face that something is wrong…Hmm, I see by the look on your face that something is wrong…Hmm, your reaction tells me that something is wrong…Hmm, I see by the look on your face that something is wrong...

He's your friend, you say? A Priden? One of those who once fought with us against the Orcs? Oh, bother... But he fought bravely, so he might still be alive? I suggest you hurry, otherwise anything can happen!

Just remember that it wasn't out of malice - we just had no idea that the Pridens returned!

finishText.en:
Ah, there you are...

We've been waiting for you for a long time, yes. We saw your Thread in our canvas. Black as night itself. Yes, yes, , we're talking about you... Stormbringer. They didn't name you that for nothing. No, no, be quiet about the Urun, don't say a word. We know everything, we've seen everything...

Fools! You have awakened the ancient curse of Isa!

goal.en: Reach the Thread Keepers.

startText.en:
Anyway! ! Listen to me. I don't like repeating myself. When I'm asked again, I usually give people a kick to jog their memory!

Since ancient times, in every large Gibberling village, there is a special house with a sacred loom in it. The Thread Keepers weave the great canvas on it - the Fabric of the World, and thereby determine the Patterns of Fate and try to direct the Threads of the Gibberling Path in a way that they form the most favorable pattern for us.

It is they who know what was, what is, and what will be! I'm afraid that an evil that has been imprisoned for a very long time has awakened... and now we need to defeat it...

finishText.en:
When the Ash Tree weakened, our island began to crumble little by little! The cave where Kharyskhan was imprisoned split open, and the spirit's prison appeared on the surface. And you finished the job with your own hands - you broke the ice prison and released the spirit! Just imagine how much trouble he can cause!

We understand why you came to Isa... But can we help you now? That's not the case, I'm afraid. If Kharyskhan appears again, war cannot be avoided! The Urun, led by him, are a threat both to Skalgard and to other villages! And even to the Ash Tree - for it has always been his target! And if you don’t get to the Ash Tree, then you won’t be able to do anything!

So first, deal with him, and then we'll talk about what can be done.

goal.en: Learn the history of the curse.

startText.en:
The Orcs... Our ancient enemies. But this enmity has long decayed, or so we thought. Do you believe that? I hope so.I hope the Pridens still remember our ancient alliance... Once upon a time we fought shoulder to shoulder and found a common destiny. And now it brought us together again.Foreign nations. We have stories about you. We now share the fate of our world with you.Foreign nations. We have stories about you. We now share the fate of our world with you.Foreign nations. We have stories about you. We now share the fate of our world with you.Foreign nations. We have stories about you. We now share the fate of our world with you.Foreign nations. We have stories about you. We now share the fate of our world with you.Lost and forgotten relatives. Oh, I see that your path to your home was hard. But the evil you brought is now your fate, too.

You already know that our entire history is a weave of Threads. At the right time, the great loom weaves a fabric, and each thread is someone's Fate. We, the Thread Keepers, have knowledge that is passed down from teacher to student through the ages. This knowledge allows us to interpret what we see - to the best of our understanding, of course. Fates create a shared history…

, let us show you how what you've done is related to the fate of all Isa…

checkText.en: Yes, the web of Snow Spiders is exactly what we need!

finishText.en:
Excellent!

We can't do without signs and predictions!

In Skalgard, no one would step out of the house if they spilled salt at breakfast. And if someone puts an empty bottle on the table, we immediately punch them in the eye!

However, , they also say that if Fate is favorable, then you can take on any challenge, even if it's hard!

goal.en: Collect the threads of Snow Spiders.

startText.en:
We have a tradition here. Everyone is supposed to be connected into a single whole, right? The Thread Keepers will explain it better. But tradition is tradition, so you should do it, too It means you need to help weave the carpet. Where do you think Threads come from?

The easiest way is the web of Snow Spiders. So you'll help us in two ways - you'll get rid of the spiders and obtain threads so you can intertwine your fate with ours. Smashing spiders is always a plus! I even envy you.

Yes, , the Spinners asked you to visit them first... They want to talk to you about something.

checkText.en: You don't remember the task? Kill the spiders and collect yarn

finishText.en: Wow! Thanks, ! These spiders are damn scary. And thank you for the silk, too - I will pass it along!

goal.en: Obtain 12 rolls of Snow Web Yarn and take them to Finny the Eagle-Eyed.

startText.en: , there's another job for you! The Frosty Woods are crawling with spiders lately! Your task is to go and reduce their population. They scare our guests, weave webs between the trees on the roads - then you have them stuck to your face! And collect more of their threads while you're at it, then take them to Finny the Eagle-Eyed. Threads are essential - besides the Carpet of Fate, we also make tackle and clothing with them.

checkText.en: The squirrel is starving! Hurry!

finishText.en: Oh, thank you! I'm on patrol, and my squirrel is starving! Without your help, we would be lost!

goal.en: Collect cones for the squirrel Iora.

startText.en:
The Thread Keepers themselves sent you? Wow! I always wonder how they see these things in the Threads.

I have a request for you, of course! Do you see my squirrel? Cute, isn't she?

She is still small, and I'm afraid to let her out of my sight. There are spiders everywhere, and the squirrel is hungry. If you bring me some cones, I will be extremely grateful!

checkText.en: The squirrel is starving! Hurry!

finishText.en: Oh, thank you! I'm on patrol, and my squirrel is starving! Without your help, we would be lost! I wonder how the Thread Keepers know when help is needed.

goal.en: Collect 12 cones and take them to Finny the Eagle-Eyed.

name.en: Threads of Fate: Cones for Squirrel

startText.en:
Sometimes predictions are incomprehensible to us, but over time a lot becomes clear... So, now the Threads are telling us that Finny the Eagle-Eyed is important for the future of Skalgard, and his squirrel will play an equally significant role.

I don’t know what will happen, but we must not turn away from the signs. Let's do as the Threads tell us!

Your task is to feed the squirrel. It might seem a trifling matter - but it could be no less important than your victory over Kharyskhan!

checkText.en: Did you visit everyone?

finishText.en: Excellent! You did a good thing and explored the city at the same time! And I won't have to carry those blasted logs...! Oh...

goal.en: Add firewood to the braziers.

startText.en:
Oh, I see many got scared when you showed up!

But don't worry. You are heroes, so you'll quickly convince everyone that you are good!

, you know how you can win the sympathy of the townsfolk? There is an easy way! There are braziers placed around the city where residents gather to discuss news or just gossip. Find them and throw in some firewood. This way you'll make a good impression! I will lend you firewood, but you'll owe me!

checkText.en: Did you visit everyone?

finishText.en: Hello! Frost will not take us - that's what we told the Thread Keepers! As long as the fire burns hot, we will survive this!

goal.en: Throw 8 pieces of firewood into the braziers in Skalgard and report to the Sharp Family.

name.en: Threads of Fate: Fire of Hope

startText.en:
Lately Frost has been sending increasingly bad weather at us, and this affects the mood of the residents of Skalgard. While we are strong in spirit, when the heavens are obscured by raging snowstorms and shrouded in fogs, it's easy to fall into depression. At this time, there's only one way out: to make fires in the city burn hotter. I entrust this task to you.

Get some firewood and throw it into the braziers. Then report to the Sharp Family. It's their idea.

checkText.en: There are always things to do in our village.

finishText.en:
Oh, I've already received a bunch of thanks here... Things like: what a wonderful Orc, they helped people and didn't kill anyone...what a wonderful Priden, why can't all Urun be like you...?what a wonderful furless stranger. They helped everyone and somehow didn't freeze...what a wonderful furless stranger. They helped everyone and somehow didn't freeze...what a wonderful furless stranger. They helped everyone and somehow didn't freeze...what a wonderful furless stranger. They helped everyone and somehow didn't freeze...what a wonderful furless stranger. They helped everyone and somehow didn't freeze...wonderful relatives - they are not lazy at all, but hard-working… Let's invite more of them here.

But trust me, this is just the beginning of your work, .

goal.en: Complete Unn's tasks.

startText.en:
Hmm, this is not how I imagined Isa and the legendary Thread Keepers!

I was hoping for them to support us - it's in their interests to do so! The Tree is dying without the All-Mother, and they… well, if the ancient evil has awakened, you have to help! And you've dealt with that before, right, ?

Let's fix your mistake, and then we'll deal with the Tree.

Here's what you need to do...

checkText.en: Yes, fighters dream of fighting you!

finishText.en:
Well, I see you are a brave warrior, ! We need those. We are the Stalwart clan whose ancestors kicked the asses of the Northwind clan back in ancient times!

From the glorious warriors of our clan we formed a hird - a Gibberling detachment. Members of any clan can join it, and if circumstances require - all the Gibberlings of Isa.

goal.en: Test your strength in duels.

startText.en:
I've already seen you fighting in the pit with Urun, but those are just overgrown cats - any Gibberling eats them for breakfast!

What about real fighters?

I can still hold my hammer and I want to see whether your hand is strong, whether you have military cunning and ingenuity. Other fellows from the families of my clan would also like to challenge you!

Well, ? Do you accept the challenge or not? After all, we'll be fighting together later, so we need to know what you're worth!

checkText.en: Signs will help us! The wisdom of the ancestors is infinite.

finishText.en: I no longer hear the rustle of trembling Threads, which means our idea was a success! Still, ancient signs are great knowledge. We may not understand them, but there is considerable wisdom in them.

goal.en: Calm down those who are scared.

startText.en:
I heard many people in Skalgard got frightened when they saw your friend on the street, . There is no need to be surprised - their ancestors fought bravely with the Uruns led by Kharyskhan, but the new generation is still young, not hardened by it all. Many are disturbed by the invasion of the Uruns, and fear overcomes them.

I wondered if it could be helped - and it seems that I have found a way. There is one belief - if a cone suddenly falls on one's head, they will not be afraid of anything.

I will let you see whose Thread is trembling. You will throw a cone at them, and even though it might startle them, they will stop being scared afterwards.

checkText.en: Signs will help us! The wisdom of the ancestors is infinite.

finishText.en: Now they are ready for anything! That's for sure! And if they relax again, we have plenty of cones left!

goal.en: Throw cones at the residents of Skalgard 12 times and report to the Sharp Family.

name.en: Winter Watch: Cones of Good Fortune

startText.en:
Wow! We defended Skalgard from the Urun so heroically! But after the victory, our warriors relaxed! We need to shake them up a bit so they stay vigilant.

And then we remembered the cones. I think they will definitely help! Throw a cone at the residents, it'll be good for them! Even if they swear at you! Ignore that - they don't mean it!

checkText.en: Find them, please!

finishText.en: They are such clever kids. They'll be fine! Thank you very much! If you ever visit the Mead Valley, tell my sisters I said hello!

goal.en: Find the hidden Gibberlings.

startText.en:
Oh, is this an Orc in front of me? My people have legends about you... I hope you are not going to conquer Isa? Still, if the Gibberlings trust you...You look a bit like Urun, but I can see some differences. You are a Priden, aren't you?My people have no legends about you, but if you're helping the Gibberlings, you are our friend, too.My people have no legends about you, but if you're helping the Gibberlings, you are our friend, too.My people have no legends about you, but if you're helping the Gibberlings, you are our friend, too.My people have no legends about you, but if you're helping the Gibberlings, you are our friend, too.My people have no legends about you, but if you're helping the Gibberlings, you are our friend, too.My friends, of the Gibberling people… Greetings to you on behalf of the Heidrun people!

I have a problem… I've been teaching the little Gibberlings what to do if the Urun attack. They just need to hide. My students are the best: they hid so well that I can't find them!

Please help me find the little ones. The time for games is coming to an end, they need to go back to their families.

checkText.en: I'm sure the blacksmiths know something!

finishText.en: Has no one seen anything? Very strange! Then where did Gerda get this meteorite pendant? She says she has not shown it to anyone before. It has been kept in her family for generations!

goal.en: Ask where Gerda's pendant might have come from.

startText.en:
Yes, we are delighted! Isa! Ancient home. Are we the same Gibberlings that managed to get here? Just unbelievable!

But to the point, . We heard about Gerda's amulet. Could it be that a meteorite was found on Isa? It may well be! Does it mean that the locals managed to find it? Somehow I doubt it... After all, if there are deposits of a meteorite on Isa, then astral travel would have been discovered a long time ago!

Here's what you need to do - ask the local blacksmiths if anyone has seen such metal. After all, if they did see it, it means that a meteorite was once mined on Isa...

checkText.en: Well? Have you gathered any? The Elder is starting to suspect something!

finishText.en: Wow! We did it! Maybe I'll be able to talk him into sending me the Winter Watch! I have a good reason now. To carry this firewood!

goal.en: Gather firewood for Gerda.

startText.en: The thing is, the firewood I gave you was meant for the Winter Watch! And if I don’t return it now, the Elder will kill me! There is a forest to the north of the village with plenty of firewood in it. Will you gather a bunch for me? I’ll distract the Elder in the meantime.

checkText.en: We should hurry before he leaves...

finishText.en:
Murder!

They killed... the old woman - the lender... The woman was selling Spark energy on credit and had many ill-wishers. Yes, the case is complicated. Are there any eyewitnesses? We'll conduct an investigation...

Well, I've already seen you... You're acting on the orders of the Empress, solving problems... Maybe you can help, because our entire police force serve as guards now.

goal.en: Follow the Red Thread to find the person with a changed destiny.

name.en: On the trail of a man with an axe

startText.en:
, we have one last clue left... Thanks to Iaver Bazar's tools we will be able to detect those affected by the Scissors much more accurately. Judging by what he said, we might encounter them in the near future, because the past is also changing... Too complicated?

According to the data he analysed, whatever affected the "odd person out" hasn't happened yet or happened very recently. And we have a potion that will let you see the Threads again.

So we have a chance to meet the Scissors right next to their victim! Let's go, quickly!

checkText.en: Have you questioned everyone? Some may need a specific approach...

finishText.en: Well, you've done a good job - quite a few things are clear now... Try to be patient and I'll tell you everything...

goal.en: Question three eyewitnesses and ask them about the murder.

name.en: Motive is the most important thing!

startText.en:
The main thing is to find out the motive!

The witnesses may not have seen the killer himself, but they probably noticed something... , talk to everyone who was there, then come to the station. We'll try to solve this mystery...

checkText.en: If I come back without Sparks, my stepmother will be angry...

finishText.en: Oh, thank you so much... I can go home now... Everyone needs Spark energy these days. It can buy you anything...

goal.en: Eliminate 10 Ghoul Thieves and return 10 measures of Spark energy to Sonya Marmeladova.

startText.en:
Ohh! They stole everything... the damned ghouls...

I was on my way home from work, and they came running. They knocked me to the ground and took all the Sparks...

Do you have any idea how hard it was to get them? But I'm disgraced. A sinner! A great sinner!

, maybe you'll get them back?

checkText.en: Well, where is he?

finishText.en: He's back! Bastard! Idiot...! Where is the money? Where is the money? Tell me! Where is the money? Oh Tensess, did he blow it all on booze? There were twelve rubles in the chest!

goal.en: Find Sonya's father, Semyon Marmeladov, and take him home.

startText.en:
, thank you for helping with the ghouls!

But... I have another problem! Father... disappeared again... He's a good man, but he's weak... he's fond of the bottle.

Maybe you can find him and bring him home? We live on the outskirts, on the road to Kelinovka!

finishText.en: Have you brought him home? You are kind people!

goal.en: Find the Respected Man and take him home.

name.en: Problems of the City: Respected Man

startText.en:
There is a situation that requires your intervention. A drunk man is wandering the streets of our city, and I'm worried that he might get lost or find trouble. My wife convinced me that we need to show compassion and help this man return home safely. , I ask you to escort the drunk man home to his family.

My wife Julia inspires me to try and see the world from a different perspective. I'm grateful to her for opening my eyes to new possibilities and teaching me to show compassion and care for others.

checkText.en: Will it be possible to expose this Luzhin?

finishText.en: I knew you'd be able to expose that bastard! Thank you so much!

goal.en: Expose Pyotr Luzhin and deal with him.

startText.en:
He drank it all away again! Parasite! I'll talk to him later... we've got trouble here! Sonya already told us how you helped her, , but there's another problem!

Mr. Luzhin claims that Sonya stole money from him! But that's simply impossible... He says he gave her some money, and then she stole another sum! That's nonsense, Sonya couldn't have done it!

However, we can't prove her innocence... But I'm certain she always tells the truth! And this Luzhin always lies... Only we don't know whether the others are telling the truth or lying... But it's likely that, if they are right about something, then they always tell the truth, and if they are lying, then they always lie!

checkText.en: What a nightmare...

finishText.en: What a nightmare... Is she dead? What do we do now...

goal.en: Find Semyon Marmeladov and solve the problems of his family.

startText.en:
While we were here trying to figure out what happened... My father went off somewhere... I'm so worried, I'm afraid that something might happen to him... He's drunk, he doesn't understand where he's going...

Please, , find him and bring him home again! Ekaterina and I will go looking too!

checkText.en: Have you spoken with them?

finishText.en: Interesting... A big axe, you say?

goal.en: Escort the sorcerer Svidre de Mork and find out what he wants.

startText.en:
, sir Svidre has arrived... He wants to talk to you about something... I don't know him well... But he is a friend of Rodion's, I believe...

And if he wants to talk to you - why not let him?

As for the poor old woman... Oh, I didn't see much... Just a silhouette... With a big axe...

finishText.en: Are the ghouls gone? Good.

goal.en: Eliminate 10 Distorted Ghouls and give 10 measures of Spark energy to Sonya Marmeladova.

name.en: Problems of the City: Distorted Ghouls

startText.en:
There is a threat that requires immediate intervention. Evil undead ghouls are terrorizing our city, threatening the lives and safety of our residents. My wife Julia has convinced me that we must unite and confront this evil.

, I ask you to help us eliminate these evil undead ghouls before they cause even more harm and destruction.

And yes, there is also Sonya Marmeladova... Help her a little, the ghouls won't stop pestering her...

checkText.en: I need to find my brother...

finishText.en: As for the crime, I can't tell you much... The killer ran away quickly, no one was able to get a good look at him!

goal.en: Put up the missing person posters on 6 special pillars.

startText.en:
Hello, . Have you seen my brother? He's tall, with long hair, wearing a grey jacket and scarf... Maybe you've seen him?

Oh, where are you, Rodion...

Maybe you can help me put up some posters? Maybe someone has seen him?

finishText.en: Have you put up the posters? Excellent, this will help our search!

goal.en: Put up the missing person posters on 6 special pillars.

name.en: Good Deeds for the City: Search for the Missing

startText.en:
I have a request for you, . A person is missing, and I ask you to help us search for them. Please put up missing person posters all over the city. Pay attention to all people around you. Together we can find this person and return him to his loved ones.

I believe in the power of unity and solidarity!

Let's join forces and make our world a better place for everyone. Thank you for your attention and support.

checkText.en: There are still too many Searing Eyes!

finishText.en: Oh, thank you so much! I see the rumors are true, and you can be counted on... Perhaps you can help me with something else? We students barely scrape by.

goal.en: Eliminate 12 ghostly Searing Eyes.

startText.en:
It's no wonder our people have taken up arms! There are twisted creatures all around! And ghosts of various monsters! There's no living with them...

We don't have enough Spark energy as it is, and now they're stealing from us...

, maybe you can help? The worst ones right now are the evil eyes - the Searing Eyes, that is! If you thin their numbers a little, we'll breathe easier here!

checkText.en: Rodion keeps giving away his things!

finishText.en: Oh, at least we'll have a kettle - to boil water... Look at him. He's getting worse.

goal.en: Retrieve Raskolnikov's belongings that he gave away to other students.

startText.en: There is a sick friend of mine, also a student, in the student quarter... He has been feeling unwell for some time, and now he has collapsed with a fever... They are doing renovations now, so we are forced to spend time outside, and he has nothing - he has given everything to his fellow students. , perhaps you could collect his things while I look after him?

checkText.en: I think he's getting worse...

finishText.en: He's feeling better now... But... do you smell that? Is that smoke?

goal.en: Try to cure Rodion Raskolnikov

startText.en:
So, what medicine do we have? There are antipyretics and antihistamines... There is also a thermometer and hot drinks...

, maybe we should try to cure him? We can't wait for a doctor...

checkText.en: Extinguish it!

finishText.en: The fire is out... It wasn't accidental!

goal.en: Extinguish 10 fires at the university.

startText.en:
Someone started this fire! But who...? Okay, now is not the time to think about it, we need to put out the fire! I happen to have a fire extinguisher here, but be careful,  – it requires Spark energy!

Hurry, before we all burn!

finishText.en: Are the fires out? Something is always happening over there... We asked them if it's going to blow up. They said, "It shouldn't!"

goal.en: Extinguish 10 fires at the university.

name.en: Problems of the City: Extinguish Fires

startText.en:
Today I was informed of a new threat – fire at the university of our city. This incident requires our immediate intervention and joint efforts. My wife Julia, whom I both fear and admire, helped me understand that sometimes you need to go beyond your beliefs and act in the interests of society.

So I ask you, , to help us put out the fires at the university and save students and teachers. May your courage and determination help us overcome this challenge and restore safety in our city.

checkText.en: Have you learned anything?

finishText.en: Alice? Verkhovensky?! Alarming news... We have checked everyone who owed her.

goal.en: Find 12 pieces of evidence of arson by collecting fragments of leaflets or taking them from nihilist students, and by questioning 4 influential students.

startText.en:
Yes, it was no accident! Someone set the fire! Of course, I have no idea who... But lately we've had a lot of discussions. Everyone is suggesting something, everyone wants something... , maybe you should find out what's going on and who could be the culprit?

I'm afraid my friend Rodion Raskolnikov might be involved in this...

As for the murderer you're looking for, let Petrov check those who owed her... I can't think of anything else.

finishText.en: Is that so? This is very interesting, we will continue surveillance...

goal.en: Investigate rumors of a conspiracy among students by finding 12 letter fragments and interviewing 4 of the most influential students.

name.en: Good Deeds for the City: Questioning Students

startText.en:
, today I'm asking you to help us solve a mystery. The police department in our city reports that university students are planning something that could affect the future of our society. Personally, I believe the students are innocent, but as city officials, we are forced to respond...

I ask you to help us learn what they are planning. Together we can understand this and make the right decision that will benefit us all.

checkText.en: Well, where are my cats?

finishText.en: Oh, thank you so much! I'm not brave enough to hop from roof to roof myself! All the kittens are safe now, yay!

goal.en: Use the jetpack to get onto the rooftops and catch 7 runaway kittens, then return them to Lydia Charsky.

name.en: The cat is on the roof!

startText.en:
Oh, dear! I have a problem, !

The thing is, I love cats - I just adore these little fluff balls... But my landlord forbids pets in the apartment...

And just imagine - yesterday he threw them out into the street, and they all climbed onto the roofs... How do I get them back now?

Maybe you can help me? The guys here put together a jetpack, so it's easy as pie to get to the top. Try catching them one by one.

finishText.en: Have you found all the kittens? That's great news!

goal.en: Use the jetpack to get onto the rooftops and catch 7 runaway kittens, then return them to Lydia Charsky.

name.en: Good Deeds for the City: Runaway Kittens

startText.en:
Today we have another task. Student Lydia Charsky asks us to find her runaway kittens! The kittens are on the roofs, and they need our help. I ask you to collect these cute little creatures and return them to their owner, .

Even in such small things as saving kittens, we can show kindness to others. Let's join forces and do a good deed together. Thank you for your willingness to help and for your kind heart. Together we can overcome any difficulties.

finishText.en: Are the Searing Eyes gone? Excellent news!

goal.en: Eliminate 12 Ghostly Searing Eyes.

name.en: Good Deeds for the City: Ghostly Searing Eyes

startText.en:
Today we face a new threat - ghostly Searing Eyes that terrorize our city, attacking innocent passers-by. These creatures are filled with malice and a thirst for destruction, and we cannot allow them to continue their atrocities.

I ask you, , to help us defeat these monsters and restore peace in our city. We must join forces and show these Eyes that there is no place for evil and destruction in our city.

Thank you for your willingness to help and for your kind heart. Let us act together and put an end to this evil.

checkText.en: Don't let them break in!

finishText.en:
Excellent!

Now, to business... What do we have here? There are two sweet girls, two goddesses. One is the soul of our world, the other is the ruler of Darkness and the current sovereign of Sarnaut.

The dispute between these sisters is lost somewhere in the darkness of the aeons. One was given the ability to create, the other was not, so she rebelled.

Since then, they have been feuding, envying each other - which is fine and all, but it affected everyone. We died at some point when the Great Mages made a mistake, and you are people of the present time. And then some of us came back to life and others never did. Perhaps my world and your world could find common ground... But the dear sisters would not let us - they have already set us against each other.

They will not listen to me, but maybe they will listen to you?

goal.en: Eliminate 9 nihilists at the police station.

startText.en:
That's all great, , but as you can see, we have other problems here. An angry mob is storming the police station, and it looks like we don't have enough people.

Maybe you could help us fight them off, because if they break in here, we won't be able to talk, will we?

If you could thin their numbers a bit... our guys will do the rest.

finishText.en: The riot has been suppressed? Great, another week or two of calm.

goal.en: Eliminate 9 nihilists at the police station.

name.en: Problems of the City: Riot at the Police Station

startText.en:
, today I want to entrust you with something that my beloved wife Julia must not know about...

We are facing a new challenge – a riot of nihilist revolutionaries at the police station of our city. These madmen are trying to violate law and order, threatening the safety of our citizens... And while my wife believes that these nihilists are quite harmless, I disagree!

I'm especially perturbed by their leader, a certain Pyotr Verkhovensky, who has a strong influence on Julia...

We must help our police!

checkText.en: I didn't mean to!

finishText.en: Perhaps all these great people... Teps, Nezebs, Rabulions – are not as great as we thought? We are shocked by great crimes, disturbed by hecatombs, but maybe this evil was caused by another great entity? Or is it just a bloodsucking spider in the center of its web? Flick it away – and it's gone.

goal.en: Go down to the prison below the police station and interrogate the four captured nihilists.

startText.en:
But that's just one problem!

Let's get back to our rebels... You are probably wondering who's the killer, ? Yes, that friend of yours, Rodion Raskolnikov, did it...

He once wrote an article that there are "nonentities" and "people", and of course he counted himself among the latter...

Maybe you could talk to him? If he confesses to you, we'll be more lenient... We might even release him on bail, but with condition not to leave Jigran.

You can question others, too...

finishText.en: Well, have we dealt with our nihilist comrades? Our townspeople are not fools either: they see who their enemy is, who burned their houses and caused destruction. But it's not just nihilists – there are also distorted creatures and hostile ghosts – they all harm the townspeople, and if you and I deal with them, your reputation will improve quickly.

goal.en: Find out what Rodion Raskolnikov can do for you as a companion.

startText.en:
Porfiry allowed me to go into town – to work off my sins, so to speak. And he asked you, , to accompany me.

Well – I need to redeem myself, so I'm ready. There is still a lot of bad in our capital – and if we sort this out, the townspeople will respect us.

Does that sound good? First, let's teach a few nihilist comrades a lesson...

finishText.en: Don't hesitate! The captive is in safe hands, and with her help I will figure out how to fix everything and put things right!

goal.en: Find Aisa in the catacombs and help Alyosha trap her using the destinies stolen by her.

startText.en:
Pathetic fool! Look where he ended up! Can he talk about the greatness of others? The greatness of mortals who put themselves in the place of gods? Those who heard the music of the universe and understood the true plan of the Creator?

But enough – we are close to our goal. The Order of Stars was rightfully proud of the wisdom they had collected - the repositories of the Arshez monasteries contained more than just tomes from the Conclave's libraries. The Order studied the legacy of Zem… of Tep himself!

I know a secret ritual that can trap Aisa, albeit for a short time. I have waited a long time for this, and now we have no other choice. Let's go, !

checkText.en: We'll talk later.

finishText.en:
You heard their words. The great power of Faith is our salvation...

But the Darkness is seeking ways to destroy it, trying to tempt us... You can help us.

goal.en: Hear Hiero out and learn what is going on from Marianne and Negus Tot

startText.en:
So... We are here thanks to you, . That's the only reason I'm forgiving all your faults.

You summoned the Children of Light to this world - and they arrived. They will help us, protect us from the Darkness. But we need to help our saviors save us. So we must act.

As long as we are here, Hirkalla's power is not absolute.

As long as we are here, the Darkness has not won.

As long as we are here, there is hope.

The strength of our faith sustains the shield around the Cathedral. We are the edge of the sword aimed at the dark goddess's black heart. And we shall strike. Talk to Marianne and Negus Tot - here they don't need to worry about being overheard.

checkText.en: The Sanctuary of Light is not a place for lost souls!

finishText.en: The Children of Light told me that the dead will resurrect in other worlds if the Light wills it. If their sins are too great, they must atone for them in the palaces of Ganzir.

goal.en: Chase the ghosts away from the Cathedral.

startText.en:
The Goddess of Darkness confuses Sarnaut with her false miracles, . She claims to have power over life and death, that she can revive the fallen... many believed that.

But only the Light can grant true resurrection. Hirkalla created a multitude of shadows, just ghosts of once living people - and now these false entities have surrounded the Cathedral. They are tempting our warriors and scaring citizens.

There's nothing we can do for them now - so I order you to chase them away.

finishText.en: Are there are fewer ghosts around the Cathedral? Great, that means less faith is needed to maintain the shield. But our work is not done yet. We will continue.

goal.en: Eliminate 12 ghosts of citizens and the Count Nulin.

name.en: Dark Vigor: Ghosts near the Cathedral

startText.en:
Danas says we need to weaken the enemy... You and I have worked hard, but there are still things that need doing...

There are many ghosts around the Cathedral who do not believe our empress. They believe the Light can help them. These fools are feeding the barrier.

A certain Count Nulin has an influence on them - a well-known rogue who has seemingly repented.

Anyway, kill a dozen ghosts and the Count along with them. This will weaken the shield. Then report back to Danas.

checkText.en: Help those in need!

finishText.en: Their faith is stronger now - at least for the time being. We must be understanding towards their weaknesses - they are just simple warriors and civilians who have never seen what we have.

goal.en: Dispense blessings among the sufferers.

startText.en:
Watch, ! There are enough living creatures on Jigran - those who live here and those who just arrived.

Their combined faith protects everyone, but unlike us they are weak and full of doubts, fatigue, and disappointment.

But the Light won't leave them in the lurch. Remind them of that and bestow my blessing.

finishText.en: Well, it's not my method, but if this is our goal, why not use the opportunity? I hope they'll realize that their cause is doomed to failure.

goal.en: Sow doubt in the minds of 12 civilians or Paladins.

name.en: Dark Ruse: Crack in the Shield

startText.en:
The Shield of Faith is nearly impenetrable to us, . It's powered by faith in the Light and hopes for a better future. And the power of our dark mistress has always faltered before irrational conviction.

Fortunately, the Wanderer knows what to do. We have already sown doubt among the leaders of the Paladins. Let's do the same with regular soldiers and civilians.

Use the pages from this book. No one will know what you are doing.

A dozen targets should do. Report back to Danas afterwards.

checkText.en: The light of candles will dispel the darkness in our souls...

finishText.en:
If I had proper tools, I could measure how much your actions strengthened the shield of faith.

But I can only rely on irrational confidence.

goal.en: Light the candles in the Cathedral

startText.en:
, I myself witnessed resurrection on Kirah. I knew then that knowledge without faith is fruitless. Now, as I manage the largest scientific institute in Sarnaut, I'm trying to share this insight with my brethren. My people, the people of Zem, had the opportunity to witness the power of Light in action.

So I suggest performing simple rituals that will strengthen the faith of the people here. Because symbols are important.

Light these candles before the icons of martyrs and apostles of our Church. A small action - a great result.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en:
Very well! Now this Sparkton Pack is yours. Not the latest model, but I'm sure you'll get your hands on a more powerful replacement in no time.

Use this one until then.

goal.en: Collect the energy of Sparks, then purchase Sparkboom from Sarang Kido.

startText.en:
What do you think, ?

A whole Cathedral of saints, each more righteous than the last... I always thought Negus Tot was a little crazy, but now...

Ah, well. What matters now is that it works.

I suppose you don't know me. And I know you quite well. Why? I had a sister, Sarbaz Sais. Do you understand now?

I'm not going to avenge her - she chose her own path. I'll just tell you this: you can't trust the Light or the Darkness. Trust no one but yourself.

I want you to test something. Will you do it?

finishText.en: Well done! Gargoyles don't care about our barricades - they can easily fly to the city center. I'd grab a bow and go hunting myself. But for now - thank you!

goal.en: Eliminate 12 distorted Gargoyles

startText.en:
Distorted creatures are one of our biggest problems right now, .

All these nasty creatures like the Gargoyles have flooded the city and started attacking the residents. It's not good. We need to do something.

Let's deal with them. The Gargoyles are a great target - right now there's a bunch of them near the Cathedral.

Kill a dozen, then report to Naira.

finishText.en:
Well, it's quite clever and funny! If you want to reduce someone's importance - ridicule them. Although the mistress might want to see this one herself... There are even obscene pictures here...

Thank you, let's see what else they come up with.

goal.en: Collect 20 samples of Paladins' pamphlets

startText.en:
The Paladins aren't sitting idly either, . We are trying to undermine their authority - and they are doing the same to us. We know there has been a delivery of pamphlets containing all sorts of sedition and defamation of our mistress.

We need to understand what exactly the Paladins are saying - then we'll know how to oppose this.

Collect a few leaflets and take them to Naira.

checkText.en: Darkness is approaching!

finishText.en: I've heard a lot about you. The hero who saved Sarnaut more than once. And here you are standing in front of me.

goal.en: Clear the beacons of darkness and eliminate the distorted Gargoyles.

name.en: From the Light to the Shadows

startText.en:
As I've already told you, , the Light is spread throughout the city using special beacons that dispel darkness with bright rays. This gift of faith ignites burning hatred among all the nasty creatures awakened by the dark goddess.

We call them "distorted" - the creatures of darkness attracted by the energy of Sparks. They are dangerous both to the living and the dead.

Now the distorted Gargoyles are attacking our beacons. If they are extinguished, another part of the city will be lost to the darkness. I'll give you a special relic that will destroy the creatures and clear the beacon.

It's a dangerous mission, but I believe you can handle it. One of the Children of Light, Ieziphael, can help you reach the beacons. Talk to him.

checkText.en: I'll tell you everything now.

finishText.en:
There are scarier things... The madman dwelling under the city... that abducts people. We should question those who might know something about it and help the others in need.

We thought Alice would save us... yes, she was here... But she has her own agenda, and the fates of the awakened are not her concern.

goal.en: Ask Alyosha about the fate of the awakened.

startText.en:
I'm Alyosha, one of the novices in the Order of Stars. We are on a mission here: we help the ghosts that have yet to come back to life. They are called the Awakened, because Hirkalla roused them from a centuries-long sleep.

Their situation is quite grim, and very few people are willing to help them.

If you are here, , perhaps you can help us?

checkText.en: The slums need your help more than ever!

finishText.en:
Ah, everything makes sense now, my friend!

We've learned a lot - now we need to talk to Chichikov, a buyer of dead souls!

goal.en: Find out about missing ghosts from knowledgeable people.

startText.en:
, I have an idea: ask those who may know something about the missing. I think there are four such people.

First of all, my brother Dmitry - he knows many people here and he travels often - I'm sure he has heard something.

Then there's Agrafena Svetlova who is called Grushenka here. She is a woman of dubious reputation, of course, but she lends money to people and has a lot of connections. And the ghosts trust her.

There is also Selifan... The coachman of one of the visiting businessmen. His work takes him all over the neighborhood, so I'm sure he has a lot to say.

And finally, the director of the visiting circus is a certain George. The circus is a crowded place, so who would know more than him?

I'm sure they will all want something in return, but I suppose you are used to it.

checkText.en: These spiders are a nightmare!

finishText.en:
I've never liked spiders, let alone such huge ones...

Thank you! Perhaps we should send Smerdyakov to see how Grushenka is doing... Oh, Grushenka...

As for your question, I heard that a certain Chichikov is buying up dead souls. Sparks, that is. Perhaps he's involved in the disappearances?

goal.en: Eliminate the Distorted Spiders

startText.en:
My lordlady, I've come to you with a request... There is more and more trouble in our neighborhood, and the most serious one is... ahem... spiders. Yes, it's a nuisance - these terrible creatures trap us, the awakened ones, in their nets and drain our energy.

Someone might say it's part of their nature... But I'll be honest - I find it revolting. So if you want to help, I'm asking you to eliminate this vermin.

finishText.en: Oh, well, at least someone heard us... Honestly, it's a nightmare - these spiders just keep coming...

goal.en: Eliminate 12 Distorted Spiders.

startText.en:
We have received a complaint, ! From the townspeople... They say spiders are everywhere... But I can already see that myself!

They say there are too many of them on the outskirts.  In short, something needs to be done. I suggest you kill a dozen distorted spiders, maybe there will be fewer of them...

Report the results to the guy who complained. What's his name...? Dmitry Karamazov, right.

checkText.en: These parasites are very dangerous!

finishText.en:
Well, the job is done, which means the contract is fulfilled.

So Alyosha wants to find out about the missing ghosts? Yes, I've heard about it. It happens at night: as soon as midnight hits, they vanish one by one. After all, the city was built above another city, so there are all sorts of tunnels down there...

I've also heard that a businessman showed up lately offering to buy other people's Sparks... Maybe he is to blame for this?

goal.en: Eliminate mosquitoes and give the Sparks to ghosts.

startText.en:
! Are you from Mitya? No?! From Alyosha?! Very interesting...

Yes, alas, no one wants us here... And since you want to help, then I'll entrust you with one little task...

Everything we have now revolves around Sparks and their energy. Some buy Sparks, others sell them... some steal them. Among them are dumb creatures - ghostly mosquitoes. If one of those latches onto an awakened one - there'll be nothing left of them but the Spark.
So I ask you - kill the soulsuckers, then release the energy to those who desperately need it.

finishText.en: Are there fewer sparksuckers? That's great. Otherwise they suck the warmth of the unfortunate...

goal.en: Eliminate 12 Ghostly Mosquitoes

startText.en:
If only distorted creatures were our only problem! It's not just people who came back as ghosts - there are creatures, too. Even insects like gnats.

And our townspeople are complaining again - they are sick of ghostly mosquitoes. They want us to deal with this vermin...

In short, that's why the order is to exterminate a dozen mosquitoes. You will report to Agrafena Svetlova when you are done, she is an authority among the ghostly townsfolk.

checkText.en: Well, what did Zlatan say? Did you come to an agreement?

finishText.en:
Oh, you are just in time, the master would have discovered the loss soon...

Well, I owe you...

Yes, our master buys up dead souls, but no one knows why he needs them... You'd better ask him yourself.

goal.en: Get a box of wine for Selifan.

startText.en:
I have a problem, ... As soon as I came back to life, things kept getting worse. I was loading a crate of wine and dropped it. Everything is in pieces...

The owner will be so angry. "Selifan, you idiot," he'll say. "You botched such a simple task..." He'll have me flogged! It's deserved, of course, but perhaps it can still be fixed?

I have a friend, Zlatan - he sells fried meat near the circus. He got the same crate...

Perhaps you can work something out with him? Get me the crate, and I'll tell you all the rumors...

finishText.en: Ooh, buddy, I knew they'd send you! I owe you.

goal.en: Obtain 12 pieces of Boar Meat.

startText.en:
People come here with various requests, . And it looks like we must do everything... Oh well. If the empress wants her subjects to be happy, so be it.

Anyway, a certain Zlatan asks for boar meat... He says the living need to eat something, too...

Well, if he needs it - we'll get it. Go where these wild boars are and bring him a few carcasses for his kebab. Report to him afterwards.

checkText.en: Chestnut-colored dog! What's not clear?

finishText.en:
You'd drive anyone to the grave...

If I tell you, will you leave me alone? Listen, a lot of mysterious things are going on here - a time traveler is weaving conspiracies, and the black monk is not as ordinary as you think.

I'm not Elleken, but I've seen a lot in my life. Believe me, new players have entered the game. We observe, we want to understand, but without Messere we cannot help you.

goal.en: Find Pulcinella's dog.

startText.en:
! Hey, hey, no need to swing your fists here!

I know Messere had an agreement with you... and we are, to some extent, allies.

Here they know me as George, the great impresario who brought entertainment to this dull land... And you seem to need information...

The thing is this: I had one very smart dog, called Chestnut because of the color... You see, someone scared the poor thing, and she ran away. If you find her, I'll help you!

finishText.en: Oh, Great Darkness - I'm so sick of you... Begone!

goal.en: Find the right dog for Pulcinella by bringing 12 different dogs.

startText.en:
, we received a complaint. A certain George, the owner of the circus, complains that his dog is missing, says he can't find her.
