He says some hero tried to help him but was too incompetent to find the dog.

You aren't like this, are you? Will you help the artist? Find him a dozen dogs - let him pick one.

checkText.en: Are you done with the task?

finishText.en: Oh, wonderful - praise the Empress for her generosity. We will await further resurrection!

goal.en: Distribute the excess energy among 8 ghostly citizens.

startText.en:
, the empress wants to ease the lot of those who have not yet been resurrected... Of course, we won’t be able to resurrect them right now - but what’s stopping you from showing a little generosity?

Let's distribute some energy. We won't lose much, and they'll see what awaits them in the future.

The energy will allow them to feel alive for a short time.

You will report to Agrafena Svetlova afterwards - she has been asking us to help the ghosts for a while.

finishText.en: Wow, another cipher... Okay, we'll keep it... All that matters is that they keep paying my salary. Because I need money to woo Grushenka.

goal.en: Find the Paladins' agent among Hirkalla's officials.

name.en: Dark Cunning: Search for the Agent

startText.en:
, we have a problem - it looks like we have a mole. Not some animal that digs in the ground, but a real traitor who passes the empress's secrets to her enemies. We will not tolerate this!

One thing is known for sure - this black sheep among our officials has now gone to the circus to hand over the information to another agent.

Find the traitor, deal with them, and bring the ciphered message to Dmitry Karamazov... He is in our service, so he'll know what to do.

finishText.en:
Whaaat? Missing ghosts?

I had nothing to do with this, I assure you! My task is simple - buy new goods if an opportunity presents itself. After all, these are just Sparks - they don't care who owns them.

In the end, everyone wants to live - to become stronger and... more alive, so to speak. This depends on how many Sparks you have.

I think you have already realized that it's a profitable business...

goal.en: Go with Alyosha to Chichikov

startText.en: I've heard a lot about him - he came to our city, started buying up people's Sparks... For what? We need to find out. , we should ask openly - let him tell us what he wants, the scoundrel...

checkText.en: Oh, people! They don't like dying from natural causes!

finishText.en: Terrible people. Don't you agree? And how am I supposed to deal with such people... Well, thanks to you I have less competition now.

goal.en: Persuade the owners to release the souls

startText.en:
Am I the only one buying dead souls? Look around you - there are lots of the living who have Sparks in spades...

I can tell you who they are. I wanted to buy the Sparks from them, but since you are here... I suppose we should rid them of the excess.

checkText.en: There's something terrifying over there...

finishText.en:
Phew, I'm starting to hate dungeons...

So, the heroes saved the day again, and the villain is defeated! Of course, there's still my sister...

But wait, there is something I don't understand...

goal.en: Find out what's hiding in the catacombs.

startText.en:
So much happened while you were away, . Your friend Alice showed up... She and Alyosha went after that mysterious monster you were looking for. They said it was somewhere under the city...

But I haven't heard from them in a while. Perhaps you should see if they need help?

checkText.en: It's time to find out what's going on here, in the capital of shadows.

finishText.en:
What a guest! And they have news!

It's too bad my sister isn't with you. There is a nice cell waiting for her.

goal.en: Learn information from Alice and go to Hirkalla.

startText.en:
I don't know how to explain this, !

In short, I know this Alyosha. And - I don't know THIS Alyosha. You see, I met him back in the Old Era. He was the leader of the Order of Stars, a famous sage and scholar. And he had a completely different biography.

This Alyosha knows nothing about that. You think someone is impersonating him?

If only it were that simple! There are other discrepancies... It's like another world, a parallel reality where everything happened differently. The history was rewritten...

checkText.en: It's not far...

finishText.en:
Ah, there you are! Have you learned anything?

Ah, nihilists... Don't tell me they're wrong! My sister promised a universal resurrection, but she was able to resurrect only a few - mainly the former nobility... The poor are doomed to remain ghosts, and they don't like it...

This is our chance! Like other deities, my sister depends on faith in her. If we shake faith in her power, she will become weaker. Hirkalla herself did that often - she confused the minds, poisoned the thoughts of the people of other worlds, turning them against the All-Mother.

I will answer in kind!

And we will solve your problem ourselves - here is Iaver Bazar, a famous scientist. His fate was also stolen and now he wants to figure out how it was done! Look what he's already managed to assemble - a new Sparkton Pack! Try it out when you have time.

goal.en: Find Alice's hideout near Firezovka.

startText.en:
We have no time for such small matters, . You see what's happening around us - nihilists who reject any authority are becoming more and more numerous. If you remember what we heard at Famusov's estate, then you understand - this is the result of Alice's actions...

I'm afraid the uprising might be inevitable, and things will be rough on Jigran. This may interfere with our search, and therefore we should talk to her and learn more about her plans. Perhaps even dissuade her? But how can we find her, you ask?

I've heard something. We can find her in Firezovka, a neighboring district. There's also another "odd person out" in the area...

checkText.en: Now is not the time for doubts!

finishText.en: A nihilist is a person who does not bow down to any authority, who does not accept any principle on faith, no matter how respected this principle might be.

goal.en: Complete three quests from Pyotr Verkhovensky.

startText.en:
Right now, Iaver Bazar is busy preparing for the next experiment... But since you are here, I hope you can help us organize the future uprising. The nihilists have a leader. He is standing right here: Pyotr Verkhovensky.

I'm instructing you and Alyosha to carry out his tasks. When you are done, return to us, we will figure out what happened to these destinies.

Our efforts will bear fruit over time! However, , if the nihilists start causing trouble for you - deal with them, we only need them to overthrow my sister!

checkText.en: The main thing is to fill their minds with our ideas.

finishText.en: All this is necessary for the systematic shaking of the foundations, disintegration of society and all principles! To dispirit everyone and turn everything into mush, and to take the society, shaken and sickly, cynical and unbelieving, into our own hands, raising the banner of rebellion.

goal.en: Put up 12 propaganda posters

startText.en:
It's time to spread ideas! Many of the citizens of Dar Ulgorn are already ours, they just do not know it. Previously, it was believed that crime was madness, and now crime is no longer madness, but common sense. Almost a duty or a noble cause at the very least.

Put up these posters, ! We call for an uprising! Listen, I have counted them all: those who deny the gods are with us, those who justify crimes are with ours - there are many of us, they just don't know it yet!

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Listen to this: to get rid of evil, we need to destroy everything. This is the basic principle: universal destruction for the greater good, the beautiful Sarnaut of the future.

goal.en: Find 4 loyal nihilists and eliminate 8 reluctant nihilists, then deal with the traitor Ivan Shatov.

startText.en:
Imagine a picture of Sarnaut, covered with an endless network of knots.

Each of these centers of activity, proselytizing and ramifying endlessly, aims by systematic denunciation to injure the prestige of local authority, to reduce the villages to confusion, to spread cynicism and scandals, together with complete disbelief in everything and an eagerness for something better, and finally, by means of fires, as a pre-eminently national method, to reduce the country at a given moment, if need be, to desperation.

Those who are hesitant should be rooted out and eliminated. Do you understand what I'm saying, ?

checkText.en: Are you done with the task?

finishText.en: Have you managed to brib... err, I mean persuade certain nihilists? Excellent!

goal.en: Find and convert 10 reluctant nihilists

startText.en:
Another matter that my wife must not hear about... It's about this man, Pyotr Verkhovensky, who has great influence on her, so she can't see his treacherous nature.

I know Verkhovensky is the leader of other nihilists... Fortunately, his methods are questionable, so we need to find those who have doubts about him. I want to win them over to our side.

, talk to them and try to bribe them...

checkText.en: Oh, let the generation grow up! Sadly there is no time to wait, otherwise we'd let them get even more drunk!

finishText.en: In our society, all members watch each other and must report anything suspicious. Each belongs to all, and all to each. All slaves are equal in slavery. Equality is the most important thing. Have you got what I asked for?

goal.en: Obtain 4 alchemical components from Flaming and Ghostly Elementals, then assemble them into 2 devices.

startText.en:
We will cause such discord that every foundation will crack. We will proclaim destruction... Oh, this idea is so appealing! We will start fires... And a revolt will begin! The world has never seen such force and fury...

First, we need material... Of great explosive power... It will burn... Burn! The power of the Paladins and the false goddess turns into elementals - get their essence, . We'll need it.

finishText.en: Excellent. You did well. Not everyone on this allod was reborn as a ghost - some were so dark in life that death turned them into an unholy creature. Death's an old joke, but each individual encounters it anew.

goal.en: Obtain 10 measures of Dark Essence from Distorted Banshees.

startText.en:
We still have many ridiculous issues. It's because we can't look at the matter objectively - everyone brings something of their own into it, which is unnecessary.

We need to find out why - it's what we must do. A great cause is worth sacrificing for, so put your emotions aside and listen, : my research requires essence which is easier to obtain from banshees.

 I hope their cries don't bother you. Get me the essence.

finishText.en: Do you have the essence? Great! Excellent result!

goal.en: Obtain 10 measures of Dark Essence from Distorted Banshees.

startText.en:
Our city is facing a new threat – Distorted Banshees, sinister creatures that bring destruction and fear. We need dark essence for Iaver Bazar's experiments to help him develop an effective remedy against this thing.

I ask you, , to obtain this dark essence. Together we can prevent new attacks of banshees and protect our city from evil.

Let's join forces and show them that we won't stand for the fear and destruction they create. Let the light defeat the darkness!

checkText.en: Don't hesitate. Only fools and smart alecks hesitate. And I don't consider you smart.

finishText.en: I stick to the negative direction because I feel like it. I like to deny, that's how my brain works - and that's it!

goal.en: Eliminate 12 Ghostly Centipedes.

startText.en:
You have to remove obstacles that hinder your work. Only then can you hope to achieve even a modicum of success.

I'm extremely bothered by the centipedes living in this yard. On top of everything else, they've decided to steal my materials. I don't know why these creatures need them.

The solution is simple: exterminate the centipedes, - it will speed up my work significantly.

checkText.en: What's the point of talking and thinking about the future which doesn't depend on us for the most part?

finishText.en: A good start. We will continue soon, step by step. First, we need to clear the place.

goal.en: Light 3 steles in the correct order.

startText.en:
Excellent, . I hope you are ready to assist me. Forget all the nonsense, it's pointless to think about someone's pretty eyes. It is all romanticism, nonsense, rottenness. Only the existing reality has meaning.

You will need to light the steles in a correct order. Yellow, purple, blue. I hope you don't make a mistake, the consequences may be unpleasant.

checkText.en: The process requires precise dosing, so be careful.

finishText.en: Great, we've got the components we need. However, before we begin the final experiment, we need to deal with some urgent business.

goal.en: Mix different essences to get the 7 potions needed to split the Spark.

startText.en:
What is a Spark? No one knows for sure. Not even Tep who has spent years studying them.

My theory is this: the Spark itself is a composite entity. And it can be divided into parts. That's what we'll try to do. I assume that what you call fate is a certain component. I have already measured my own Spark. Now we will compare its parameters with the control sample.

But first we need new Spark Separators, .

checkText.en: How is it going? Are you done yet?

finishText.en: Are you done? Great! I can't wait to find out what's going on with those Sparks...

goal.en: Complete 3 quests from Alice together with Iaver Bazar.

startText.en:
Alice reminded me of unfinished business that requires my attention,  That's why we'll go together.

You can hear the details from her. We also need to have enough Spark energy to continue our research.

checkText.en: Oh, these nobles...

finishText.en: I think Mr. Kirsanov will have time to consider his behavior... This entire family should be avoided.

goal.en: Take part in a duel and deal with Pavel Kirsanov and his servants. Talk to Iaver Bazar and bring him with you, or Pavel Kirsanov will not show up to the duel.

startText.en:
Ahem! Oh, this Iaver Bazar... You see, there are few Zem on Jigran, . They can't be resurrected by my sister, because their Sparks were never in Nihaz's box - they are languishing in Tep's Pyramid. Only a few cultists who died in the recent war with Tep turned into ghosts...

That is why the Zem are extremely critical of Hirkalla and everything she does. Our friend is a skeptic and a nihilist who says everything right to your face. Alas, many take issue with it, and among them is a local nobleman - Pavel Kirsanov, the uncle of one of Bazar's students.

He demanded a duel. He also brought servants with him. You will have to deal with them. You'll be my friend's second.

checkText.en: Oh, these nobles...

finishText.en: I think Mr. Kirsanov will have time to consider his behavior... This entire family should be avoided.

goal.en: Take part in a duel and deal with Pavel Kirsanov and his servants.

startText.en:
Ahem! Oh, this Iaver Bazar... You see, there are few Zem on Jigran. They can't be resurrected by my sister, because their Sparks were never in Nihaz's box - they are languishing in Tep's Pyramid. Only a few cultists who died in the recent war with Tep turned into ghosts...

That is why the Zem are extremely critical of Hirkalla and everything she does. Our friend is a skeptic and a nihilist who says everything right to your face. Alas, many take issue with it, and among them is a local nobleman - Pavel Kirsanov, the uncle of one of Bazar's students.

He demanded a duel. He also brought servants with him. You will have to deal with them. You'll be my friend's second.

checkText.en: They are a little too clever. I'll tell Bazar to be careful.

finishText.en: Oh, excellent... Give them here, it's hard to find decent parts for zombies these days. No one dies now...

goal.en: Collect four different parts of smart zombies. Talk to Iaver Bazar and bring him with you so he can identify the real zombies.

startText.en:
In his spare time, our friend is busy constructing cadavers – zombies assembled from body parts of different people.

Unfortunately, the latest batch of zombies turned out to be unusually smart and nimble. Now they are wandering around the neighborhood, scaring civilians.

We want to take them apart to recover the most valuable parts, so find them and... do that. Iaver Bazar will show you the zombies you need, , so you don't dismember random passersby.

finishText.en: Have you collected all the parts? I should try to combine them differently.

goal.en: Collect 4 different cadaver parts for Iaver Bazar.

name.en: Problems of the City: Iaver Bazar's Cadavers

startText.en:
I have another request for you, , because my wife has informed me of another threat to our region. It is posed by the zombies created by Iaver Bazaar. My wife asks that we take the zombies apart and return them to Iaver Bazaar.

These zombies are mindless, dangerous creatures. They threaten our residents, deface our city, and create chaos. We cannot handle them on our own, and so we turn to you, heroes, to help us neutralize this threat.

Help us protect our region and our people from this sinister invasion. I understand that my wife is right, and I cannot allow these zombies to cause damage to our society. Help us, and I will be grateful to you for the rest of my days. Help us get rid of this threat and restore peace in our city.

checkText.en: I don't know who exactly took the books, but they need to be retrieved!

finishText.en: We taught them a little lesson - and that's fine, they'll be resurrected soon anyway. We'll need the books to complete the experiments.

goal.en: Retrieve 8 books that belonged to Yaver Bazar. Whether you pay for them or simply take them is up to you.

startText.en:
, many people come here, including nihilists... They often take books from Iaver Bazar and then don't return them!

This is an outrage and I suggest punishing them... We need to get the books back - I'm sure they can be found where such people usually gather.

finishText.en: Do you have the books? Excellent news.

goal.en: Collect 10 books that belonged to Yaver Bazar.

name.en: Good Deeds for the City: Missing Books

startText.en:
The scholar Iaver Bazar had a few valuable books taken from him recently. , I ask you to return the missing books to Iaver Bazar, because these books are of great importance not only to our city, but also to our future. They contain knowledge that can change the course of history and bring prosperity to our society.

As a free spirit, I believe in the power of education. We cannot afford to lose these things. So I call on you, my dear heroes, to help us find these books and return them to their rightful owner.

checkText.en: We must continue our work.

finishText.en:
Hah, a half-educated scientist. He thinks he has learned more about the Spark than Tep himself... But he's far from the great necromancer whose name is still remembered with horror.

However, his information is not useless. So... The Scissors have appeared in our world - the power that cuts the great Pattern of Destiny. A change in one place affects the picture as a whole. The Scissors want to nullify what you managed to do.

This power is beyond the imagination of mortals. One who masters it will rise not just above the gods... above the demiurges!

goal.en: Conduct an experiment with Iaver Bazar to discover fate by following his instructions.

startText.en:
Well, we've solved our problems, it's time for our experiment. They say that on allods with no metals people use rocks. They hit them against each other to break them and get sharp chips...

My method is quite similar - I will divide the Spark into parts to create my own tools. With them, I will continue to divide the experimental entity, and then I'll put it back together. Interested, ? So am I.

finishText.en: It's simple. The potion has a wide range of applications - you are tasked with testing it. Try using it on various creatures.

startText.en:
I have an idea for a potion that can only be brewed here, on Jigran, where everything is saturated with dark and ghostly emanations... The effects of this elixir can be very unusual! But the goal of science is to conduct tests!

If you are ready to assist me in extracting resources, then I'm happy to supply you with it for free. Just follow my instructions, .

checkText.en: Hirkalla has become insufferable!

finishText.en: Anyway, take this... You'll need it soon...

goal.en: Ask Alice what the nihilists are doing, and then choose which side to support.

startText.en:
I suppose you need to find Alice first... I doubt she's left the place we last found her.

, find her and learn her plans!

checkText.en: Out now, traitor...

finishText.en:
It's probably naive to expect gratitude from your world, but I've managed without large-scale atrocities so far. Foolish people always expect bloodshed from me, as though I have nothing better to do than to flog someone... Yes, Cosmos and the Sculptor did not swear allegiance to me, and Aidenus and Yasker are scheming behind my back, but I'm not going to raze your capitals to the ground.

I wanted to help you fulfill your potential. But you decided to play dirty.

Well, no one is perfect, . I will still root out the Light.

goal.en: Tell Hirkalla about your decision.

startText.en: Begone! Get out! And don't think I'll forget this...

checkText.en: Hurry!

finishText.en:
Stop! Stop!

The Light sent me a vision – we must stop this battle. Something terrible is approaching... To the Cathedral, quickly!

goal.en: Win the battle for the Cathedral by eliminating 30 common enemies and 3 generals.

startText.en:
Our plan is simple: the shield of faith around the Cathedral has finally collapsed, and Hirkalla has sent in her guard and generals!

Pyotr Verkhovensky is also leading his people there at this very moment. Together, the Paladins and nihilists will be able to crush my sister's forces with their sheer numbers. Yes, they're not fond of each other, but they will unite to end the reign of the dark goddess.

Hirkalla will have to intervene - and that would be my cue. I expect that she will be noticeably weakened by then.

, your task is to help crush her troops and generals.

checkText.en: Hurry!

finishText.en:
Stop! Stop!

The Light sent me a vision – we must stop this battle. Something terrible is approaching... To the Cathedral, quickly!

goal.en: Win the battle for the Cathedral by eliminating 30 common enemies and 3 generals.

startText.en:
My plan is simple: the shield of faith around the Cathedral is about to collapse - it's time to send in my guard and generals.

There are also nihilists from all over the city gathering near the Cathedral together with their leader, Pyotr Verkhovensky. Paladins and nihilists became temporary allies who intend to overwhelm my forces with sheer numbers. We'll get rid of them all in one strike!

Then Alice will have to intervene - that would be my cue. Little sister will go back to Mother to take a break from her scheming.

, your task is to help crush the nihilists and Paladins by eliminating their leaders.

checkText.en: Something's coming!

finishText.en: The Children of Light will not protect us. The new Lord of Death is a threat even to Enod! They will retreat to defend it. Now we are alone... Was our faith false?

goal.en: Find out what's going on in the Cathedral.

startText.en:
The two goddesses are fighting in the Cathedral... but that's not the problem. Something has changed in our world... The world has changed!

I don't understand what's happening, ... We should ask the Children of Light...

checkText.en: What's going on here?

finishText.en:
Oh, , I can sense that something has happened...

Perhaps the Aoidoi call you the Stormbringer for a reason? You haven't brought any good news lately. Tell me everything from the beginning...

...

Well... it would be stupid to blame you for what happened. I would hold the two goddesses responsible. Two capricious girls who received their powers by chance.

However, the prophecy of Seida, which I carefully studied after discovering Isa, has these lines:

"Light and darkness in battle

Argue with each other,

But in vain:

Their fate is inevitable.

A new god will rise -

He who took the power

From the unfortunate sisters

Who forgot the law:

What Fate decides

Will happen.

There is no power in the world,

That would change that."

Was it all predetermined? Perhaps our enemy is not even Tep... but Destiny itself?

goal.en: Tell Yasker what happened.

name.en: Reconciliation in the Face of a Threat

startText.en:
, I don't know how the most dangerous necromancer of our world hid under the guise of Alyosh, and why he was resurrected at all if you had destroyed him in Tep's Pyramid, but your capital should hear about this.

It's time for me to turn to the inhabitants of Sarnaut. If the Children of Light are right, then Tep, who has become a God, is a threat to all worlds.

Talk to Alice and Hirkalla - it seems their powers have diminished... Perhaps Tep will reconcile the irreconcilable.

checkText.en: What's going on here?

finishText.en:
Oh, , I sense that something has happened...

Perhaps the Aoidoi call you the Stormbringer for a reason? You haven't brought any good news lately. Tell me everything from the beginning...

...

Well... it would be stupid to blame you for what happened. I would hold the two goddesses responsible. Two capricious girls who received their powers by chance.

However, the prophecy of Seida, which I carefully studied after discovering Isa, has these lines:

"Light and darkness in battle

Argue with each other,

But in vain:

Their fate is inevitable.

A new god will rise -

He who took the power

From the unfortunate sisters

Who forgot the law:

What Fate decides

Will happen.

There is no power in the world,

That would change that."

Was it all predetermined? Perhaps our enemy is not even Tep... but Destiny itself?

goal.en: Tell Aidenus what happened.

name.en: Reconciliation in the Face of a Threat

startText.en:
, I don't know how the most dangerous necromancer of our world hid under the guise of Alyosh, and why he was resurrected at all if you had destroyed him in Tep's Pyramid, but your capital should hear about this.

It's time for me to turn to the inhabitants of Sarnaut. If the Children of Light are right, then Tep, who has become a God, is a threat to all worlds.

Talk to Alice and Hirkalla - it seems their powers have diminished... Perhaps Tep will reconcile the irreconcilable.

checkText.en: You're still here?

finishText.en:
Oh, are we on our own now?

We have enough problems: ghostly and corrupted creatures still threaten the city, and the guard fights them. The undead are becoming unruly! The nihilists still deny authority and thirst for revenge! On the edge of the allod, in Sadrok, something unthinkable is happening. The newly arrived expedition of the Arisen has excavated some ruins of their people... There are many problems. Fortunately, I have my wife and you, my glorious heroes.

goal.en: Ask the civil governor Andrey Lemkov how he can help.

startText.en:
Hirkalla's authority is shaken, , but the people of Jigran need support. While these two goddesses are regaining their strength and preparing to go after Tep, power in Jigran will pass to the civilian governor named Andrey Lemkov. He's a man of the people, and he also needs help. Your help.

Go to him and find out what you cancan do.

checkText.en: If we hurry, we'll increase our chances of finding the right person.

finishText.en:
Hello, dear guests. I am Maxim Maximov, my father was also Maxim, so feel free to call me Maxim Maksimovich. On behalf of our sovereign I hold this fortress, otherwise known as the Fortecia.

Many threats hang over Dar Ulgorn: ghostly creatures, dark shadows, and... the Orcs! One tribe, the Montane, has risen again. They now terrorize the area. Of course, not all of them are savage. You can even have a conversation with some... But you need to keep an eye on the whole clan.

And what do you need here? Oh, you're looking for that man? Grigory Pechorin? He just left... Well, since you are waiting for him anyway, maybe you can help? Because there are never enough people...

goal.en: Go to the Fortecia that lies to the northwest of the city and find Maxim Maximov.

startText.en:
, it seems that our empress doesn't know about those who create "odd people out"... and even Dark Maidens have nothing to do with it. But apparently those deprived of fate attract these parasites somehow.

It looks like the force that erases people's fates acts independently of Darkness and Light. Very interesting. I hope we'll meet them sooner or later... Now we need to find the next victim we were told about... We're heading to a small fortress that guards the approaches to the city. We will talk to the commandant and learn where we can find them.

checkText.en: It's a fierce beast - weapons barely make a scratch, but the sting is as painful as the live one's.

finishText.en: How nice! A lot of animals have become ghosts – will they come back to life?

goal.en: Destroy 10 Ghostly Scorpions.

startText.en:
Here we have the hottest spot in all of Jigran: there's the undead army in the northeast and southwest, mountains to the southeast, and swamps with all sorts of nasty things nearby.

One of the worst troubles for us is the ghosts of various creatures. And the most unpleasant and aggressive right now are scorpions. , I task you with killing a dozen of these creatures so we can breathe easy here.

finishText.en: Are the Scorpions dead? A fine deed!

goal.en: Destroy 10 Ghostly Scorpions.

name.en: Problems in the City: Ghostly Scorpions

startText.en:
My wife has convinced me that the ghostly scorpions near the Fortecia pose a serious threat to our region. These creatures are dangerous and elusive. Their attacks spoil our peaceful existence. We cannot handle this threat on our own, so we ask you, , to help us protect our city and its surroundings.

Help us get rid of these ghostly scorpions and restore peace in the region.

I understand that my wife is right, and I cannot allow these creatures to cause even more harm to our society. Help us, and I'll be grateful to you for the rest of my days.

checkText.en: Jigran kamikaze rabbits... Everyone knows about them, everyone fears them...

finishText.en:
Oh, you survived? Thank all the gods. I thought you would perish there, among the rabbits... or hares? Who knows...

But now there are fewer of them.

goal.en: Use mines to eliminate 10 Distorted Killer Hares.

startText.en:
Another problem are those damned rabbits! Or hares? Who knows... A terrible beast...

How dangerous can a rabbit really be, right? But here's the thing, ... Each of these rabbits will try to jump into your arms... And then explode with terrible force, and that's sure death!

So they can only be killed from a distance... Or better yet, with special mines. I'll give you a few...

And if you want some advice from an old warrior - if you see a rabbit, give it a wide berth! Better safe than sorry.

finishText.en: Killer hares are gone? Good news for all travelers!

goal.en: Use mines to eliminate 10 Distorted Killer Hares.

name.en: Problems of the City: Distorted Killer Hares

startText.en:
My wife is a strong-willed, liberal woman. She always supports me, but her influence on me is undeniable. And now I stand before you, asking for help, because my wife insists that we get rid of the killer rabbits that threaten our fort.

These killer rabbits are dangerous creatures that attack our fortifications. We cannot handle them on our own, so we ask you, , to help us eliminate this threat.

Help us protect our Fortecia, our territory, our people.

checkText.en: By some miracle the dead Crawlers began to multiply. Even the Great Mages can't explain this...

finishText.en: Well, there are fewer Crawlers now, and destroyed eggs mean there will be even fewer of them tomorrow...

goal.en: Eliminate 10 Ghostly Crawlers and 10 of their eggs.

startText.en:
There are troubles of today and troubles of tomorrow. That's what I think. Today's troubles are the damned scorpions and the crazy rabbits, and tomorrow's troubles are the ghostly crawlers.

These creatures have begun to multiply somehow... A miracle of miracles, but it will be very bad for us if they continue to do so.

So, let's thin their numbers a little, ... Destroy the eggs, kill the ghostly crawlers...

finishText.en: The Crawlers and their eggs are all gone? That's great news!

goal.en: Eliminate 10 Ghostly Crawlers and 10 of their eggs.

name.en: Problems in the City: Ghostly Crawlers

startText.en:
My wife has convinced me that the ghostly Crawlers near the fort pose a serious threat to our region. She has instructed me that it's important to destroy not just the Crawlers but also their eggs. I know this is a difficult task, but I believe in your abilities and your honor. Help us get rid of this threat and protect our residents.

We cannot handle this threat on our own, so we ask you, , to help us protect our city.

checkText.en: Remember, we meet at the bridge.

finishText.en:
Hah, I see it all worked out... Yes, I didn't tell you everything, but did you really need to know it all in advance?

Whether I am a fool or a villain I know not; but this is certain, I am also most deserving of pity – perhaps more than she. My soul has been spoiled by the world, my imagination is unquiet, my heart insatiate. Nothing is enough for me: I get used to sadness as easily as to pleasure, and my life becomes emptier day by day.

As for talking, I'm not currently in the mood. We'll talk later. Help my comrades for now, maybe something will come of it.

goal.en: Help Grigory Pechorin steal a rhino from an orc village.

startText.en:
Maxim Maksimovich said you were looking for me, gentlemenlady and gentleman? Do you want to hear my confession... Well, I confess that I never reveal my secrets, but I love it terribly when someone guesses them, because then I can always deny it...

However, since you are willing to help me, perhaps I'll tell you what happened...

We had a bet and now I need to deliver - to steal a beast from an orc village. I will distract them and you will do the rest, . Bring the beast to the bridge, we'll settle the score then.

checkText.en: If the generators don't work, all the hostile creatures that live to the west of the city will be drawn here.

finishText.en: Excellent! Thank you for your service. We can hold out for a while, and then – I hope – reinforcements will arrive...

goal.en: Use Spark energy to charge 5 generators that repel hostile creatures.

startText.en:
Our Fortecia is a bur in the throat for the nearby creatures. A large number of ghostly and distorted creatures pass through the area. If they attack all at once, we are finished.

To prevent this from happening, we have special contraptions on the walls that need to be charged with Spark energy. , I ask you to check them. If they are out of juice, recharge them.

finishText.en: Are the generators charged? That means the fortress will hold out for a while longer!

goal.en: Use Spark energy to charge 5 generators that repel hostile creatures.

name.en: Good Deeds for the City: Repelling Artifacts

startText.en:
We are faced with the threat of dark creatures that attack the city from the side of Fortecia. But fortunately, we have special generators that repel these sinister creatures. But for this we need your help, .

Please go to the Fortecia and charge the special generators to protect our capital from these creatures. I believe your courage and strength will help us overcome this threat. Good luck to you, heroes!

checkText.en: If a shadow is lurking nearby, nothing will go well – that's what my grandfather used to say.

finishText.en: Oh, I'm already feeling better! Please accept my gratitude, otherwise we would've had to provide liquor for everyone here.

goal.en: Eliminate 10 wandering shadows.

name.en: Steps of the Heralds of Darkness

startText.en:
There's something ominous in the air around our fortress, ...

I suppose it's the heralds of darkness, dark shadows that roam the ruined courtyards of the city... I don't know where they come from, but they seem to be sucking all the joy and happiness around us.

Disperse them if you have time, will you?

finishText.en: The shadows are gone? Life will be easier for a while...

goal.en: Eliminate 10 wandering shadows.

name.en: Good Deeds for the City: Shadows

startText.en:
We are faced with a new threat: dark creatures and shadows started attacking our city. My husband is incapable of dealing with this evil, so he turned to me. And I, Julia Lemkova, decided to come up with some countermeasures.

I ask you, , to go to the fort near the city and deal with these wandering shadows. We cannot allow them to threaten our peace and order. Your courage and strength are needed to defeat this darkness.

I believe in your ability to overcome this threat and protect our city. Good luck to you, dear heroes, and may your courage bring us victory!

checkText.en: People need to eat. A hungry warrior is useless!

finishText.en: Excellent! Everyone has been fed, which means the Fortecia is ready to repel attacks... They say there's an orc bandit prowling around the area, seeking revenge on those who stole his rhino...

goal.en: Hand out 8 rations to hungry soldiers.

name.en: Without a meal, a soldier is not a soldier

startText.en:
Oh, what a bad time for our cook to fall ill... He went to gather some herbs and came across a rabbit... No, he'll live, but he won't be able to cook for a while...

I suppose we'll have to switch to dry rations! The people will be unhappy, of course. But what can we do...

Hand out some rations, . Let them eat... And we'll think of something later. Maybe Pechorin's girl should cook...

finishText.en: Have you fed the soldiers? That means they'll hold out long enough for us to solve the food issue.

goal.en: Hand out 10 rations to hungry soldiers in the Fortecia

name.en: Good Deeds for the City: Meals for Soldiers

startText.en:
Our city needs your help, . Our brave soldiers are ready to defend the city from the onslaught of dark creatures. Alas, it's not always possible to provide them with everything they need. There is now a shortage of supplies. But there is a solution.

Today I suggest you feed our soldiers with dry rations. Let this simple but nutritious meal help them maintain their strength in the fight against evil.

checkText.en: There are two personalities within me: one lives – in the complete sense of the word – the other reflects and judges him; the first, it may be, in an hour's time, will take farewell of you and the world for ever, and the second...

finishText.en: Mine is an unfortunate disposition; whether it is the result of my upbringing or whether it is innate – I know not. I only know this, that if I am the cause of unhappiness in others I myself am no less unhappy. Of course, that is a poor consolation to them – only the fact remains that such is the case.

goal.en: Fight three duels as Grigory Pechorin's second.

startText.en:
Are you ready?

I prefer to doubt everything. Such a disposition does not preclude a resolute character. On the contrary, as far as I am concerned, I always advance more boldly when I don't know what is waiting me for me. After all, nothing worse than death can happen - and death you can't escape! And if people would only reason a little more, they would be convinced that life is not worth being so troubled about.

I hate people to avoid despising them because otherwise, life would become too disgusting a farce. Some consider me worse, others better than I am. Some will say he was a good fellow; others, a scoundrel. And both will be wrong. After all this, is life worth the trouble? And yet we live - out of curiosity! We expect something new... How absurd, and yet how vexatious!

, will you be my second? Certain gentlemen believe I insulted them, therefore we must meet with them. Two against two. Three times. If you agree, we'll become friends.

checkText.en: Over me the word "marry" has a kind of magical power. However passionately I love a woman, if she only gives me to feel that I have to marry her – then farewell, love! My heart is turned to stone, and nothing will warm it anew. I am prepared for any other sacrifice but that; my life twenty times over, nay, my honor I would stake on the fortune of a card... but my freedom I will never sell.

finishText.en: I feel like we're getting closer to solving the mystery. Each of them lost something important, something that made them a different person... A stranger? Interesting... Let's try to find out more.

goal.en: Find Brick the Montane and try to save Squirrel the Montane

startText.en:
Ah yes, while you and I were shedding other people's blood, an Orc woman was kidnapped... I suppose it was our avenger whose rhino we stole... Should we find him now? What do you think, ?

I sometimes despise myself... Is that because I despise others, too?

What is sad, we laugh at; what is laughable, we grieve at; but, to tell the truth, we are fairly indifferent, generally speaking, to everything except ourselves. Again I was mistaken; the love of a savage is little better than that of your lady of quality, the barbaric ignorance and simplicity of the one weary you as much as the coquetry of the other. I am not saying that I do not love her still; I am grateful to her for a few fairly sweet moments; I would give my life for her—only I am bored with her...

finishText.en: What a glorious battle! We hussars are always ready to brandish our sabers! And my friends with whom we've made peace are the fiercest fighters in Jigran!

goal.en: Find out what Grigory Pechorin can do for you as a companion.

finishText.en: You're here? Excellent! The roads out of the city are open now. There's nothing keeping us in Dar Ulgorn.

goal.en: Meet with Alyosha near Hirkalla's palace on Jigran.

startText.en:
The letter reads as follows:

"I believe you've been waiting for word from me for some time, ...

The time has come. The barricades at the exits from the city have been removed - Hirkalla's guards have driven off most of the distorted creatures.

It means we can move on - if you remember, we still need to find five more "odd people out" whose fates have been stolen.

Please, hurry – the sooner we continue our search, the greater our chances of success."

finishText.en:
It's good to see you, my friend!

We had arguments and misunderstandings, but what does it matter when the fate of Sarnaut is at stake?

Let me tell you everything you need to know.

goal.en: Visit Yasker in Yasker's Tower in Nezebgrad.

startText.en:
The letter reads as follows:

"Comrade! Your homeland needs you. As always.

The shadow enveloped Sarnaut: the goddess of Darkness put a yoke on us all, forcing us to carry out her plans. We have been looking for a way out of this darkness - and now a ray of light is finally in sight.

Do not delay - come to me as quickly as possible. Now is not the time to dredge up old quarrels."

finishText.en:
I'm glad to see you, my friend!

We had arguments and misunderstandings, but what does it matter when the fate of Sarnaut is at stake?

Let me tell you everything you need to know.

goal.en: Visit Aidenus in his tower in Novograd.

startText.en:
The letter reads as follows:

"My friend! Your homeland needs you. As always.

The shadow enveloped Sarnaut: the goddess of Darkness put a yoke on us all, forcing us to carry out her plans. We have been looking for a way out of this darkness - and now a ray of light is finally in sight.

Do not delay - come to me as quickly as possible. Now is not the time to dredge up old quarrels."

checkText.en: So what are we waiting for?

finishText.en:
Well, not bad... I like Nezeb's style - he took four talented mages, had four powerful jinns possess them, and got powerful and immortal bodyguards.

I hope their skills haven't dulled while they were sitting in the Cave of Wonders.

goal.en: Talk to the Gray Prince about getting help, then return to Hirkalla.

startText.en:
Now we need to recover his Spark and... it's not that easy, . We'll need a ship and a crew... I'd rather not take my forces from Jigran, but there's someone who can't wait to resurrect him - the Gray Prince.

Talk to her - she can take her jinns. It should be enough for what I intend to do.

checkText.en: Let's give Cosmos a flick on the nose!

finishText.en:
Have you seen his face? Smug cretin!

Be careful with the likes of him and my sister. I would forbid travelling between worlds and realities. That's what messes up the multiverse and multiplicity of heroes.

You don't want that, do you? You don't. There will be no multiverse in Sarnaut while I rule!

goal.en: Obtain required energy from the Well of Souls

startText.en:
Where should we begin, ? First we need energy. A lot of energy!

The stronger an individual was in life, the more you need to revive them.

I don't have any to spare, but I know where we can get it. The Well of Souls - that's what we can use.

Cosmos and his legions of Aoidoi will probably object - but I don't give a damn! This lousy copy of Sarn does not recognize my authority. We haven't clashed head-to-heat yet, but there's a first time for everything.

You and the jinns will delay him while I'm performing the ritual...

checkText.en: The Sculptor is just a piece of the Architect. A talking brick.

finishText.en:
Great, so the Gray Prince is on their way to the Seal on the Fodiator...

The Sculptor probably won't like the situation - but he remains antagonistic to me, so who cares?

Once we are done with the Light, any and all Orders will be next. Whether new or old...

goal.en: Steal the Fodiator from the hangar on Ferris.

startText.en:
Let's see how we can get there,

I can make it there on my own. Taking you, however... I think we should get a ship.

The Eclipse? I'd rather not. It's Catherina's favorite toy, and she's loyal to me - why spoil our relationship?

Another option is one of the Architect's ships - the Fodiator. I was told it's still in the hangar on Ferris. We'll take it.

What will the Sculptor say? It doesn't matter!

checkText.en: We should be ready for anything...

finishText.en:
The Goddess of Light?

As I understand it, this creature was once a human who was altered by faith and a piece of Sarn's soul.

Its power affected the ritual - but it turned out for the best... Together with Nezeb, we pulled in Skrakan's spark, so they both came back to life.

goal.en: Protect Hirkalla while she is resurrecting Nezeb.

startText.en:
, I can hazard a guess at what awaits us there: at the very least, there will be wild demons drawn by the power of the Seal. I'm afraid they won't be alone - there's something else flickering on the periphery. I can't see it yet but I can sense someone's gaze...

Anyway, we are ready for anything! I'm used to emerging victorious in any situation.

checkText.en: Give my instructions to Yasker as soon as possible...

finishText.en:
Oh, there you are... I've been waiting for you to come back...

Your report can wait - I know everything that's happening on Jigran. For now I'm with Alice: do what Hirkalla tells you to do, even if... you find it unpleasant.

Thank you for delivering Nezeb's message - I will peruse it and take his advice into consideration.

goal.en: Take Nezeb's message to YaskerTake Nezeb's message to Yasker.

startText.en:
I have a request. I suspect news of my return have already reached the Empire... and who knows where it may lead.

I cannot return for the time being - Hirkalla has a plan and I'm needed here. The Empire will have to wait.

I'll send Yasker my instructions on what to do. I believe he can handle it, and the Empire will weather this storm.

checkText.en: It's done, it only took twenty minutes...

finishText.en:
Excellent, !

I will order my servants to cool their enthusiasm, your ghosts won't have to worry about being devoured. If someone doesn't listen to me, feel free to tear off their head - I won't object.

I'll keep Skrakan and Nezeb with me for now, they'll be useful...

Actually, it's time to deal with the Light - they've gained too much power recently.

goal.en: Complete all of Hirkalla's quests.

startText.en:
But it's you. You are the source of my problems, . Who killed Tep again, huh? Destroyed one of the Great Mages - and I need them all. Without them, I can't revive everyone and put your world back together. Where will I get Great Mages now? They are unique...

Well, I'm not going to look for Tep's Spark now - who knows where it flew off to this time.

I need someone else... I think I know who... I remember hearing that you managed to revive Nezeb himself in the Heart of the World. Nezeb is clever enough that he can replace Tep in my plans.

checkText.en: Let's not delay...

finishText.en: What is this? Soon the time will be eleven, yet I am not yet up and washed!? Zakhar, Zakhar!

goal.en: Take a carriage to Oblomov's house.

startText.en:
Ahem! What is this manner of speech...

Right, the one Gort told us about is a certain lazy gentleman... I realized who they are, . His name is Ilya Oblomov, and as Alice claims, he was a famous landowner who devoted his whole life to improving the lives of his peasants and introducing new progressive methods of farming in his village of Oblomovka.

However, in our version of the story, Oblomov is a well-known idler who even broke off his engagement to his fiancée Olga because the effort involved in organizing a wedding was more than he could handle...

He managed to get married to some woman from the bourgeoisie - Agatha who takes care of him while he... lies on the sofa. Let's try to understand what exactly influenced this Oblomov... We could ask him himself, but will he talk to us?

checkText.en: Something is wrong with him, but I don't know what exactly...

goal.en: Try to stir Ilya Oblomov into action

startText.en:
Some one has called! Yet I am not yet up! Who can it be this early? ?

Why are you running about... Are you still working?

That's a lot of work! It is terrible! I have some property on my hands, but I am working out a new system for it. In my head. The affair worries me terribly. I should like to show you a letter which I have just received from the elder.

But where is it? Zakhar must have misplaced it...

checkText.en: Well, what is it? Are they still around? What horror...

finishText.en: Are there fewer of them now? Thank the Light... They kept wandering around, the pests... I'm going to stay here in case they come back. What if they eat me? It happens!

goal.en: Chase away the shadows near the front entrance.

startText.en:
What? Was I drinking? Well... Maybe! How can I not when the lord is like this...? And I've seen some horrors lately. There are shadows at our front door... Dark as night... And angry...

It's terrifying! I needed some liquid courage...

Can you chase those shadows away? Maybe the lord will recover then!

finishText.en: Shadows are creatures of darkness, and darkness, as you understand, is in abundance here now... The Empress said to punish those who attack citizens, and we carry out her instructions.

goal.en: Eliminate 12 Shadows.

startText.en:
All sorts of nasty things have gathered in the city of Dar-Ulgorn, , among them various creatures of darkness, like shadows...

Because we didn't have enough problems already...

These shadows are now causing panic on Starkov Mountain, so the residents are complaining. Something needs to be done.

I'm passing the order: eliminate a dozen shadows, then report to Fergard.

checkText.en: Go now, I need to clean up this mess or it will be here forever.

finishText.en:
Well, it seems like this place is cleaner now... Of course, Ilya should just move in with Agatha - she's his wife, after all - and not live in this rented apartment...

But he says, "Let others move in if they want to. I can't stand change!" So here we are... It's not like we can force him!

goal.en: Help Olga Ilyinsky clean the apartment.

startText.en:
It's a mess in here, Ilya! How can you live like this? Doesn't Zakhar clean up? Agatha can't do it alone!

Listen, , help me clean up this place... Otherwise, Ilya will just lie among all this garbage... Perhaps, if the rooms are clean, he will stop lying there like a sack of potatoes!

I'll put away the clothes, and you pick up these torn papers and throw them away.

finishText.en: Thank you very much! This is only a small part, of course. We hope to recover the rest in time. Your help in bringing these scoundrels to reason is invaluable.

goal.en: Find Mikhey Tarantiev or Ivan Muhoyarov and collect the debt.

startText.en:
The townspeople turn to us with all kinds of requests, . One of them is this. A certain Andre de Roche wrote us about his friend Ilya Oblomov. He says he was robbed by some swindlers, Mikhey and Ivan who fraudulently received part of the profits from his estate.

You can meet these two scoundrels on Starkov Mountain; they constantly change their location.

Andre wants us to get at least part of the debt from them. Well... I see no reason to refuse him, we don't like scammers and swindlers here! Deal with this. The methods are up to you. Then you will give everything to this elf, he provides certain services to us.

finishText.en:
A letter? And it smells like garbage. What did you do with it?

Eh, okay, give it here. I'll send it as soon as possible. Don't bring me anything like this again, I beg you.

goal.en: Search for the letter to Oblomovka in the trash.

startText.en:
The next task is the following, . We have been asked to find a lost item. The thing is, Ilya Oblomov wrote a letter to his village Oblomovka, compiling a list of proposals and instructions.

However, his careless servant Zakhar managed to lose the letter somewhere. He doesn't remember where exactly, but the letter most likely ended up in the trash. Oblomov cannot reconstruct it from memory.

Therefore, I ask you to start looking for the letter. Then take it to Fergard, he will make sure it's sent.

checkText.en: I can still hear their screams! What torment...

finishText.en: Oh, thank you, you're helping out again... I hope they'll shut up for a while... I was just thinking of getting some sleep...

goal.en: Kill ten sleep-disturbing Ghouls.

startText.en:
When are we supposed to live? When are we supposed to live, ? Up to my ears in work...

There is another problem - these vile ghouls won't let me sleep, howling all night long... Could you chase them away? I came up with a good plan: to gather the police from all over the city, surround them and pick them off one by one... I need to go to the mayor, but there is no time - there is still a lot to think about.

Maybe you can solve this problem?

finishText.en: Oh, are the ghouls truly gone? Or not yet? But it is important that the struggle continues, because movement is life! Thank you.

goal.en: Kill 12 Distorted Ghouls.

startText.en:
Our fight against the distorted creatures continues,  - we battle them tirelessly.

Today we will deal with another species - ghouls. They are scum, corpse-eating bone-eaters, and distorted ghouls is something one should never have to lay eyes on.

But they settled in one of the squares next to Starkov Mountain. So thin their ranks. A dozen will be enough. When you are done, report to Andre de Roche, he oversees the situation in the quarter.

checkText.en: You're still here? Ofenya sells goods nearby, you can get there within a couple of minutes...

finishText.en:
Oh, I just saw something terrible! Oh, I nearly died!

Have you brought food for Ilyusha? Thank you very much! But what does food matter when there are horrors outside?! Oh!

goal.en: Get shadow food from the merchant Ofenya after fulfilling his task.

startText.en:
Poor Ilya! He can't do anything himself, and his assistants - let's face it, they're not great either... Zakhar started drinking as soon as he saw shadows, and Agatha needs to look after her brother and his friends, she can't manage it all alone...

But Ilya still needs to eat, even though he's a ghost. There are special groceries for ghosts... The merchant Ofenya sells it around the corner...

Perhaps you could run to him quickly, ?

checkText.en: Ugh, that vermin! The thing they say - my poor ears...

finishText.en: Thank you so much. Perhaps they will leave this quarter alone now, and I can sell my goods in peace... Well, you can buy what you've come here to buy now...

goal.en: Chase away seven Nihilists.

startText.en:
Just listen to them! Down with our empress, down with the Great Mages, down with the Church and all authority in general! They want to rule everything themselves and organize a government of the people, imagine that! How would common people rule? Nothing of the kind has ever happened in Kania, Xadagan, or among the Elves!

Bring them to heel, ! Or else the purple uniforms will show up, and they'll beat up everyone. Them - for shouting, us - for listening!

finishText.en: Yes, there is a problem... Someone is inciting our dear citizens to revolt, but who? I'll try to learn more about this...

goal.en: Eliminate 12 Nihilists.

startText.en:
We have a new enemy, , one we haven't seen before. Rebels! Rioters! They oppose the authorities and incite others.

These are the dissatisfied people who are tired of waiting for resurrection. They call themselves nihilists because they no longer believe in anyone.

But this is a riot! And we must suppress riots. Deal with it before it breaks out all over the city!

finishText.en: Well, there are fewer of them now - that's good, I hope these freaks will not be resurrected soon...

goal.en: Neutralize 8 maniacs by using Provoker and disguising yourself.

startText.en:
There are killings again, ! We received reports that some perverts at Starkov Mountain attack young girls in the alleys.

Let's do this: I'll give you an artifact that will disguise you for a short time, so you can lure those maniacs out. Then you'll kill them, take their knives, and bring them to me as proof.

checkText.en: Is she still out there? Oh, I'm scared to leave my house!

finishText.en: Ugh, I told them to stay away from my subjects and behave! They got out of hand.

goal.en: Find the Dark Maiden and defeat it, then discuss the situation with Alyosha.

startText.en:
Oh! Such horror... I'm still shaking...

I was going to visit Ilya - and then I saw her, standing in the middle of the street. Six arms, clawed hands, four eyes - staring at me like a spider at a fly...

I nearly died right there, but she didn't do anything - just gave me a look and vanished...

Why does this nightmare even exist?! Is the empress doing anything about this, ?

finishText.en: As you can see, I can be useful too! Next time you are performing feats, use my calling card to summon me - I'll come and be an eyewitness!

goal.en: Find out what Ilya Oblomov can do for you as a companion.

startText.en:
I need to take a walk... Perhaps I should visit some of my old friends?

But... I feel like I owe you... How can I repay you? Unfortunately, money is rather tight these days; my village hasn't been turning a profit for a while, there's nothing but losses.

Unless... I can tell people about your exploits. But I will need to see you performing them...

checkText.en: Light will illuminate the darkness and dispel doubts.

finishText.en: You had a vision? Interesting... Tell me everything.

goal.en: Meet Negus Tot and offer a prayer to the Light.

startText.en:
, as you understand, I can't tell you everything here.

But it's simple: the gaze of our ruler is now focused on her new capital - Jigran.

The Church of Light opposed her power, gaining a foothold in the Cathedral, located in the center of the city. And it seems that Hirkalla can't do anything about it for now.

This is our chance... to help her. You will find out how from Negus Tot, director of the ZIT Headquarters, my old comrade-in-arms in the Kirah Expedition. You already know him. Negus Tot, despite his devotion to science, is a very... ahem... ardent expert in the affairs of the Church. You can find him on the second floor of Yasker's Tower, in the residence of the Zem people.

checkText.en: Is there a force that can oppose Darkness other than Light?

finishText.en: Vision? Prophecy? It happens, don't be surprised... Tell me what you saw.

goal.en: Meet Marianne de Ardeur and offer a prayer to the Light.

startText.en:
As you understand, I can't tell you everything here, .

The thing is, the gaze of our ruler is now focused on her new capital - Jigran.

The Church of Light opposed her power, gaining a foothold in the Cathedral, located in the center of the city. And it seems that Hirkalla can't do anything about it for now.

This is our chance... to do something. Marianne de Ardeur of the Kanian Archipelago will tell you more. Marianne has been eager to start doing something for a while, but we had to wait until recently. You can find her in her usual spot.

finishText.en:
I've been waiting to meet you. It sounds like nothing in Sarnaut happens without your involvement, .

Welcome to Jigran!

goal.en: Use the portable teleporter to travel to Jigran and meet with Hiero.

startText.en:
Interesting but unclear, .

Fate? A complex matter. I remember that the Gibberlings have some beliefs associated with it, but what is it exactly...?

I'm afraid there is no time to think about it now. I hope the Light will reveal everything to you over time. And now - onward to Jigran. I will follow you right away, we will meet in the Cathedral.

finishText.en:
I've been waiting to meet you. It sounds like nothing in Sarnaut happens without your involvement, .

Welcome to Jigran!

goal.en: Use the portable teleporter to travel to Jigran and meet with Hiero.

startText.en:
Interesting, but I'm afraid I'm a bad interpreter of prophecies, .

I know that the Gibberlings believe in fate, and perhaps you should ask the Gray Family or Froddy himself...

However, we have little time and therefore we will have to postpone solving this. Let's hope the Light sends you other visions And now - onward to Jigran. I will follow you right away, we will meet in the Cathedral.

checkText.en: Hire a carriage and return to the city...

finishText.en: Curse this day! It's like everything is trying to fight me... If only I knew the secret to winning... I would be rich and there would be no obstacles before me!

goal.en: Get to the casino in Dartasovo and learn about the next "odd person out".

startText.en:
Katerina absorbed the energy of the thunderstorm, which made her very powerful. Who knows, maybe her old fate where she was a simple merchant was worse...

However, even though I sense another Dark Maiden lurking nearby, we are still far from our goal. There are three "odd people out" left. Well, the chances are slim.

We should talk to that gambler who doesn't want to try his luck, …We need to hurry, the Paladins' barrier is weakening. They have returned to the Cathedral, and there are more corrupted creatures in the city…

checkText.en: Boris knows a lot, but he doesn't want to talk...

finishText.en:
My grandma hasn't gambled since! And who would fall in love with her anyway... She lived before the Cataclysm, and now she's resurrected like everyone else. So I think she can continue to exist peacefully. And you? Are you ready to fulfill your promise? Will you pay off my debt?

This gambling house belongs to Goga Ace, the cunning goblin... I owe him. There he is, on his couch.

goal.en: Learn the secret of three cards from Boris Golitsyn by beating him.

startText.en:
Take a risk? Stake everything?

I'm not very rich, yes. I'm a simple military engineer from Tlavia... If I lose... I'll be finished! I'll never be able to pay it off...

But my friend Boris comes from an old and wealthy family. They say his grandmother, a countess, knows some mysterious secret that helped her win back her losses... I wish I knew it, .

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: I see that everything is done! And the night is ending... Now I know I can rely on you in time of need... I have a lot of debtors - one of them will definitely pass the debt onto you again, hehe.

goal.en: Complete four quests of the casino's owner.

startText.en:
, I see Boriska has got you to help me! Hehe. He's a sly dog. He has money, I know he does.

Okay, I won't make you do the dirty work: the toilets are cleaned, and my other debtors entertain the guests!

My tasks will be simple. If you complete them, you'll pay off Golitsyn's debt.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Okay, let's count it, hehe. It looks like it's all here, mhm! Well done!

goal.en: Collect debts from 5 gamblers.

startText.en:
The thing is, some gamblers often lose - and sometimes they end up owing the casino, yeah.

Of course, we're willing to wait a little, but there's a limit to everything. Here's a list of those who owe me. They're all hanging around the area, so it should be easy to find them.

, collect their debts. If they refuse to pay, shake them down. You can do that, right?

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: What, everyone agreed? Wonderful! We need new players here!

goal.en: Distribute 5 invitations to noble individuals.

startText.en:
Besides the current debtors, there are also... potential ones, so to speak. Hehe. All sorts of wealthy people who have yet to visit our wonderful establishment and get addicted to gambling!

I have prepared some personal invitations, so I suggest you hand them out...These individuals are hanging around our establishment, so I believe they've wanted to come in for a while.

Here, , hand them out – let them come play!

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: My plan works! At this rate we'll need to expand... As for you, thank you very much!

goal.en: Hand out 4 additional invitations near the Cathedral, Palace and Radovo Estate.

name.en: Catch the Winds of Luck Again

startText.en:
By the way, why invite only those near the casino? The city is full of dumb... err, I mean, future players who dream of trying their luck in our wonderful establishment!

We need to invite all the famous rich people here. In short, , you can fulfill my request or not - but here are the invitations, no longer personalized... Hand them out near the Cathedral, the Palace and Famusov's if you can... Tell everyone to come here!

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Oh, freebie hunters. They just don't want to pay! Kick them all out! We have an elite society of gambling enthusiasts here!

goal.en: Chase away 10 strangers from the garden and park around the casino.

startText.en:
My guests are gems and glittering coins, hehe! At least that's how I see them...

But, alas, there are not just gems in the world, but also all sorts of boulders! My wonderful garden is filled with beggars! They are not going to play our games, they just loiter about, scaring away my customers!

Please drive these scoundrels away, ! They have no place here!

finishText.en: Casino guests complained a lot about these homeless people...

goal.en: Chase away 10 strangers from the garden and park around the casino.

name.en: Problems in the City: Casino Customers

startText.en:
My wife has convinced me that the homeless around the casino pose a serious problem. These people are a threat to public safety, they are creating disorder and unrest among our residents. We cannot allow them to stay here and continue to cause trouble.

I know my conservative principles may be too strict in this case, but I ask you, , to help us drive out these homeless people and restore peace in our region.

My wife may be right about many things, so I'd rather not let her and our community down. Help us get rid of this menace.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: I see the lights are working again! Hehe! Okay, that was an easy task...

goal.en: Light or repair 6 lanterns in the garden.

startText.en:
Luckily for us, the corrupted haven't gotten into our casino yet! After all, it used to be a fortress... But they do attack the garden from time to time... They break the lanterns! They seem to hate light...

But we need light... We have other entertainment in the dark - which is not cards! We should fix the lanterns since they bother these creatures...

In short, light them again, . If something is broken, fix it. You need Spark energy for that... Do you have it?

finishText.en: Lanterns are lit? Excellent! Our guests will be safe now!

goal.en: Light or repair 6 lanterns in the garden near the casino.

name.en: Good Deeds for the City: Lanterns in the Garden

startText.en:
Recently I noticed that the lanterns in the garden near the casino began to dim and go out. It creates an unpleasant atmosphere and can be dangerous for our residents. My husband was predictably useless in this situation, so I decided to take the initiative.

I ask you to help us fix these lanterns, . They don't just illuminate our garden, but also symbolize the light and hope we want to bring to our city. Your help will be invaluable to us.

May the light of the lanterns illuminate your path and remind us of your gallantry. Good luck to you, dear heroes, and may your work be blessed!

checkText.en: Hurry, I beg you! Or I will die...

finishText.en: Ah, if only I could see her, it would help me drop this idea... Three cards...! Three cards and I'll be rich...! And we can run away together... Damn it...! This is going to drive me insane! If only I could learn the old woman's secret!

goal.en: Give Herman de Venar's letter to Lisa.

startText.en:
"You will receive a fatal blow from the one who, while being madly in love, will come to ask you about the three cards."

Ah, what does it matter! Even if I had it! Everything is lost now... I'm alone.

I'm not afraid of the storm! Passions have awakened in me with such deadly force that thunder is nothing in comparison! As long as I live, I will not give her up!

Thunder, lightning, and wind! I solemnly swear to you that she will be mine. She will be mine, mine, mine, or I will die!

Beauty! Goddess! Angel! I wrote everything in this letter... , go to her and beg her for an answer! Just make sure no one sees you! I have many enemies... Once you deliver the letter, return to my house - I'll be waiting! Quickly, or my heart will break!

checkText.en: Let's hurry! We need to find Lisa and learn the secret!

finishText.en: I have many enemies and even more debts... Everyone wants me dead! But Lisa... I knew she would love me!

goal.en: Escort Herman de Venar to Lisa Golitsyna while avoiding trouble or protecting him from it.

startText.en:
"Madly in love!" Well? It's about me, isn't it? I'm madly in love... yes! Well? Am I afraid?

so can we! It's decided, I'll learn the secret from the old woman! But what if there is no secret? And it's just delirium of my sick soul?

I need to talk to Lisa... Maybe she can learn the secret?! , let's go to her! I have to learn this secret!

checkText.en: We must go back... I need to think...

finishText.en: Three cards? Will she tell me the secret? I must know it! Everything can still be changed!

goal.en: Talk to Lisa Golitsyna and return to Herman de Venar

startText.en: , here it is, the Golitsyn mansion... The old woman lives here with Lisa... It looks like everyone is asleep and Lisa is waiting for me! Let's find her!

checkText.en: Have you completed the tasks?

finishText.en: The secret of the three cards is this. Remember! Three! Seven! Ace! Three, seven, ace! Farewell...

goal.en: Complete all quests of Anna Golitsyna

startText.en:
Before I tell you the secret, you need to fulfill my tasks, ... Lisa is my heir and I will leave everything to her.

You need to find something in the Tulensky Swamps.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Excellent! This gold will make Lisa one of the richest brides...

goal.en: Use the metal detector to find Lisa's dowry.

startText.en:
I ordered my servants to put my gold in a chest and bury it in the swamp. Alas, it won't be easy to find it now: the person who buried it there has long since disappeared.

But it is possible to find the chest using a metal detector - all you need to do is explore the swamp. Of course, it could be a false positive and you will find one of the local ghosts instead. Be careful, !

finishText.en: Have you found the treasure? Wonderful! Now we have enough funds to develop the city!

goal.en: Find the treasure in the swamps using the metal detector.

name.en: Good Deeds for the City: Treasures in the Swamps

startText.en:
Today I'm asking you, , to help us find the treasure hidden in the swamp near the city. It may be a dangerous undertaking, but I believe in your courage. The treasures will help improve the lives of our citizens and make our city even better.

Your help will be invaluable to us, and I promise that your work will not go unnoticed. Let us make our city a prosperous place for all its residents. May the treasures we find bring us happiness and prosperity.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: There is always some kind of infection in the swamps...

goal.en: Eliminate 4 Ghostly Slugs, 4 Ghostly Centipedes, and 8 Ghostly Gnats.

startText.en:
Yes, the swamps are not empty – a huge number of the most vile creatures have gathered there... It's disgusting...

It's one of the reasons why I'm not coming with you – I hate seeing them.

So I ask you to eliminate them if you can, . The last thing I need is for them to get into the city. My grandson and granddaughter live there!

finishText.en: The swamp ghosts are gone? This is great news for the whole city!

goal.en: Eliminate 8 Ghostly Slugs, 8 Centipedes, and 8 Gnats.

name.en: Problems in the City: Ghostly Creatures in the Swamps

startText.en:
My wife has convinced me that ghostly gnats, slugs and centipedes need to be dealt with. These creatures pose a threat to public health and well-being. We cannot allow them to continue to spread terror among the population.

Help us rid our region of gnats, slugs and centipedes.

I ask you, , to accept the challenge and help us get rid of these terrible creatures. I understand that this is a difficult task, but I believe in your abilities. Help us restore peace and prosperity in our region. Thank you for your understanding and assistance.

checkText.en: Have you found everyone?

finishText.en: I hope they will serve Lisa as faithfully as they have served me...

goal.en: Rescue the four lost servants.

name.en: Before the swamps swallow them up

startText.en: My death caused confusion in my household - my faithful servants left the house trying to find me... Their names are Lyuba, Zinaida, Michelle, and Slap... They thought I'd be in this swamp, but they were wrong. That's where they stayed. They are alive for the time being, but the swamp will claim them soon. Find them before that happens and bring them back here, .

checkText.en: Quickly! Quickly! I can't wait anymore!

finishText.en:
He seems to have gone mad... He risked everything and lost... How many are like that, overcome with excitement, ready to gamble everything they have for the illusory chance of winning...

Luck is treacherous: today you are on top, and tomorrow... who knows what tomorrow will bring?

goal.en: Go to the casino with Herman and play using the secret of three cards

startText.en: , let's go! Go where? Where...? To the gambling house! There are piles of gold there, and they belong to me. Me alone! I know the three cards! She told the secret to her murderer! It was destined by fate, I had to commit a villainy, but that was the price!

finishText.en:
Good to see you again...

Why are you here? Documents?

What's going on there,

in the city's archives?

The creatures of Darkness have infiltrated...

I've had a chance to hear

Of the new trouble of all sorts...

Kidnappings, evil beasts...

That threaten the city folk...

goal.en: Visit the city archives and find documents on the lineage.

checkText.en: What is that, spoilers?

finishText.en: Yes, this is really them, the spoilers...

goal.en: Learn the spoilers

startText.en: Let's learn the whole truth

finishText.en:
Alexander is right – the south is restless. After the events on Jigran in the eighth century, Sardrok was destroyed, and fell into complete desolation with time. The elves of House de Delice who arrived here around ten years ago also reconstructed it. They wanted to create a summer palace there – for those who would want to take a break from Dar Ulgorn.

So it was, and even during Hirkalla's rule the place was relatively calm – more so since the palace was surrounded by the army of the undead that was unreservedly obeying the dark goddess' generals.

goal.en: Find Katerina Kabanova in the Kelinovka village, to the southwest of Sardrok.

startText.en:
Just recently, out south was sent,

To Sardrok Palace yonder,

A part of city's archives.

They've fallen in these evil hands

That claim the palace now.

I know just who can give you help:

You go to Katerina, who is now

The thunder maiden of the place.

With her, the path you seek is found.

checkText.en: Until the protection is put up, I can't leave Kelinovka!

finishText.en: Well, so we have put up protection for Kelinovka – I hope it is able to stop the wandering undead. And now, we will learn what is happening out south...

goal.en: Put up magical protection along the riverbank with Katerina's help.

checkText.en: We can't just pass here!
The Junes will return!

finishText.en: The undead will bar our way no more. We will camp it up here and hold the ground. Let them even try poking out of the gates – we will drop the hammer on their undead skulls at once. If you need something, ask my comrades.

goal.en: Wipe the area clean of undead and help the weakened Junes.

startText.en: For far too long my people have been enslaved in the shadow of Sardrok! This is not going to happen again! The ghosts of Junes who died under the yoke of Firez are all around, but they may awaken. The undead must be destroyed, their power collected, so that my people may rise again. We are still capable of much, even though we are dead now. May the Old Man tremble, for the Junes have returned!

checkText.en: It will not be easy to vanquish the mad vehicle possessed by the spirit of carnage!

finishText.en: We've done it! Never again will the carriage kidnap or crush anyone!

goal.en: Enter Sardrok and eliminate the possessed carriage
Destroy the Purple Widow.

checkText.en: Have you managed to kill the Old Man?

finishText.en: The Old Man has been killed, hooray!

goal.en: Kill the Old Man.

startText.en: Here, we encounter the Old Man – he's carrying out the will of Tep.

finishText.en: There you are! Indeed, this is a fascinating story...

checkText.en: Feats can't wait!

finishText.en: The more enemies you defeat, the stronger you become! Thank you for the Spark energy, I'll find a use for it.

goal.en: Eliminate 50 hostile or neutral creatures on Jigran and accumulate 30 measures of Spark energy, then report to Sarang Kido.

startText.en: , do you feel like you haven't achieved everything you set out to on Jigran? Not ready for further exploits? I know how to help you. There are many enemies on Jigran. You will find them everywhere. Fight them, and you will quickly achieve perfection. It's also a way to accumulate Spark energy!

checkText.en: Take my letter to Catherina as soon as possible...

finishText.en:
You! Well, I'm glad to see you, in spite of everything...
