I know what is happening on Jigran - the entire Conclave is carefully watching the actions of the darkest empress. Cosmos and the Sculptor decided to complain about you here - but forget about it, they are not important right now. I think you should unquestioningly obey Hirkalla for now - after all, her interests currently coincide with the interests of Sarnaut. Do it even if her actions seem appalling to you, because you can't cook an omelet without breaking eggs.

Thank you for Skrakan's message - the sly old fox managed to hide something from me here on Umoir. I'll figure it out.

goal.en: Take Skrakan's letter to Catherina.

startText.en:
I would like to ask something of you. I know that Catherina wisely rules Umoir for the good of this land, and I'm not going to interfere with that. However, there's something we didn't tell her, there was no time to share old secrets.

Now is the time to tell her everything she needs to know. Umoir is an ancient land and it keeps many secrets, and the secret of the Burial Mound and the demon buried in it is only one of many.

Give this message to Catherina, she will understand everything.

checkText.en: Not there yet!

finishText.en:
Who are you?! What do you want? Strangers are not welcome here. Especially idle ones... Since you're here, we might as well put you to work. Otherwise... There are too many of you idlers around... Thinking you're too good for dirty work!

Even if you're famous heroes or saviors of Sarnaut, roll up your sleeves first, and then you can start asking questions!

goal.en: Get to Kelinovka Settlement on a carriage.

startText.en:
, I believe we should visit the village that lies to the south of here. The village between the rivers bears the name of Cyrus's beloved, the Xadaganian woman Keli he met on Suslanger... But that is the story of the past...

And we are interested in the present...

checkText.en: You should work around the house instead of crying all day long.

finishText.en:
Well, did you learn anything?

You won't learn anything from this blockhead... All she knows is how to cry and whine... Useless! But you can try and wait until she calms down!

goal.en: Talk to Katerina in the backyard.

startText.en:
What do you need? Our Katerina? Really?!

Why would you need that good-for-nothing laggard? She's useless! She can't manage the household, she forgets everything and mixes things up... No, I don't believe you, , you need someone else, not this bungler! Now our neighbor, Alenka - she's an alright girl, but Katerina... Pshaw!

Okay, if you need to talk, talk - maybe she'll calm down. There she is crying behind the house...

finishText.en:
What? Is Katerina still suffering? Yes... What should we do about her? She's so strange. She might do something...

I feel sorry for her. Martha is eating her alive, and she walks around like a shadow, unresponsive. Just cries all the time.

goal.en: Find Katerina, talk to her, and then go to the healer.

startText.en:
Just look at her! She has no shame! Where did she go? Huh? Housework won't do itself. The dough is not mixed, the floors are not swept! What kind of wife is she?

Where has she been? Must have run off to her lover! No shame whatsoever! Come on, . Go find her and bring her back! Or else I'll go myself!

checkText.en: How is the search going?

finishText.en: So that's what great-grandfather hid in the forest! And there was so much talk! Family legend! Ugh...

goal.en: Search 3 stashes in the forest and find great-grandfather's "treasure".

startText.en:
I'm actually a local! Or rather, my great-grandfather was from these parts... Or great-great-grandfather? It's hard to say...

Anyway, he served in the army of Baron Virril himself. Yes, the same one who held the fortress of Dar Leanos to the north of here... But as soon as the necromancer Firez was defeated, the baron had to leave through a portal to Ingos along with all the residents... Everything here was poisoned.

But that's fine. Sooner or later we will turn Jigran into a flourishing land! And my family legend says that my great-grandfather buried his most precious treasure in this forest... , maybe you can look for it while I'll try to think of a way to help Katerina?

checkText.en: We'll sew fur coats for the villagers!

finishText.en: That's better. Even though I'm a hunter, I'm afraid to go into the forest myself...

goal.en: Eliminate 8 lynxes in the forest.

startText.en:
We can't tell which creature will come to life, and which will wander around as a disembodied thing... However, sometimes the living cause as much harm as the dead...

Everyone here hopes to come back to life eventually, so they will need cattle, birds, dogs of all sorts, so there is food and someone to guard the house...

There are too many lynxes in the forest... There is no prey for them, and so they attack everything they can find... , we need to reduce their numbers before it gets worse...

finishText.en: There are more lynxes every day... And their hunger is growing.

goal.en: Eliminate 8 lynxes in the forest.

name.en: Problems of the City: Forest Lynxes

startText.en:
My wife convinced me that lynxes pose a serious problem: they terrorize the villagers. Residents are afraid to leave their homes, and livestock becomes easy prey for these dangerous animals.

Help us protect our residents from lynxes and restore peace.

I understand that this is a difficult task, but I believe in your abilities. Help us restore peace and prosperity in our region. Thank you for your understanding and assistance.

checkText.en: Well, how is my little owl?

finishText.en: Glorious hunt!

goal.en: Use a tame owl to catch 10 hares and give them to the hunter.

startText.en:
Oh, I always wanted a dog, but I never got around to it... But I tamed two owls.

Their names are Brownie and Snowflake. I think it's clear which is which. I trained them to hunt hares... No one else has such excellent hunters... Maybe you want to try, ? Get us some hare meat for lunch... and it'll be practice for the owls.

finishText.en: Did you catch any hares? Well, at least we have some food now.

goal.en: Catch 10 hares using a tame owl.

name.en: Good Deeds for the City: Owl Hunt

startText.en:
Today I ask you, , to help us catch the hares with the help of special hunting owls. These hares have caused discontent among the population of the neighboring village, because they are destroying the crops and causing damage to our fields. As usual, my husband was unable to handle this problem, but I know that you can help us with this difficult situation.

I believe your courage and bravery will help you successfully complete this mission. Catching the hares will help us improve the situation in our city and protect our fields from further destruction, which will also solve the problem of food scarcity. Your help will be invaluable to us, and I promise that your work will not go unnoticed.

Let the caught hares become a symbol of our victory and bring us luck and prosperity.

checkText.en: Oh, woe is me...

finishText.en:
Oh no, this is bad...

I wanted to ask Dikin to let me go live with his nephew... But he just scolded me and shooed me away... I'm lost...

goal.en: Tell Katerina what the healer said.

startText.en:
Oh, , I don't know how to help Katerina... If she feels guilty, then she can only pray and fast. You must forgive yourself first.

Tell her that I wish her all the best. If her mother-in-law really gets on her nerves, let her come here. I have tea and biscuits.

finishText.en:
Hello!

You need a horse, you say? Hmm... Well, I did promise him one. However, we have our own problems here... Escaped prisoners are hiding in the swamps, and this dog is...

The horses have gone mad! And the wolves...

goal.en: Go to the young lord.

startText.en:
Ugh, you're so stupid...

What are you hanging around here for, ? Huh?! Don't you have anything to do?

Then help me out! I have business in town, but my horse hasn't been delivered yet. The lord promised me a horse, but there's none... Go and see what's going on there... He should be somewhere near the swamps...

finishText.en:
So what about my horse? Well, he should hurry up!

Katerina? Your Katerina is a stupid girl! Nothing but tears. I don't know where she is, she ran off. Good riddance. I have to go.

Look at the storm outside!

goal.en: Tell Dikin that the promised horse will arrive soon.

startText.en: Well, , since I promised, here's the horse for the merchant. Let him go to the city. Maybe he'll bring back some goods!

checkText.en: This nasty stuff is still crawling around the gardens!

finishText.en: Phew, finally! Now these idlers have something to do.

goal.en: Eliminate 12 Ghostly Slugs in the gardens.

startText.en:
Hey, ! Ready to work?! We don't tolerate people who hang around doing nothing! We'll throw them in a pit and call it a day.
And can you really leave our village without help?!
We want to have gardens and orchards here again... We barely sowed anything when the damned slugs showed up. Hungry despite being ghosts. They'll devour everything! The people saw them and gave up - because what's the point?!

We need to get rid of the slugs!

finishText.en: Slugs are gone? So we can expect to have food soon!

goal.en: Eliminate 12 Ghostly Slugs in the village.

name.en: Problems in the City: Ghostly Slugs

startText.en:
My wife is a strong-willed, liberal woman. Her ability to see the world and problems from a different perspective made me reconsider my beliefs. She convinced me that the ghostly slugs that terrorize the village near our city need to be dealt with. These creatures pose a danger to the residents - now they are afraid to leave their homes.

, accept this challenge and help us destroy these creatures that brought fear and chaos to the village. Help us restore peace in our city. May your courage lead us to victory over this threat.

checkText.en: It's a nightmare!

finishText.en:
There you go! Keep that up!

Why are you standing around? Get out of here!

goal.en: Defeat the Scarecrow in the field.

startText.en:
Hey, you! Yes, you, ! Come here! And don't give me that look - what's that for? Can't you see who's in front of you? Huh?! Huh?! I see that you see.

Listen, we used to have a scarecrow here to chase away the crows. But then that damned thunderstorm happened, a lightning struck here, and the scarecrow started wandering around. That's just wrong! Scarecrows shouldn't walk around! What are you laughing at? Huh?

Are you laughing at me? I'll punch you in the teeth!

Such disrespect... Anyway, go... deal with this! Put it back where it was!

checkText.en: You should be more careful with it! It will fall apart!

finishText.en:
Oh, if I were alive, I would've had a heart attack seeing you kick that fence! I thought they were old and ready to crumble to dust. But it turned out nice.

These things might be old, but if you take care of them, they will last.

goal.en: Straighten 15 leaning fences in the village.

startText.en:
Hey, boygirl, look at this - maybe you can help us out?

At night, ghosts of all kinds of animals wander around here... moaning, whispering... breaking down fences... who knows what they want... It's not like we can reason with them.

We are simple folk - we want to settle down here and restore the village... When we rise again, we'll have our own gardens. But if they destroy them, we'll have nothing... Maybe you can fix the fences?

finishText.en: Did you fix the fence? The villagers will be extremely grateful for this!

goal.en: Straighten 15 leaning fences in the village.

name.en: Good Deeds for the City: Fixing Fences

startText.en:
Today I ask you, , to help us repair the fences in the village near the city. This village has served our city for many years, providing it with food and helping us in various ways. However, the fences around the village need repairing to ensure the safety of the locals.

As usual, my husband was unable to handle this problem, but I know that you can help us with this difficult situation. Let the repaired fences become a symbol of our care for the neighboring villages!

finishText.en: Well, what did I say? There's a resourceful mind for every misfortune... And you, sirmadam, are you staying in our village for long? Perhaps you can help us with something else... There's a lot to do... Master doesn't have time for us, he's too afraid of the dog that lives in the swamp.

goal.en: Check the marked spots in the village with Ivan Kuligin and place 5 lightning rods.

startText.en:
Oh, these folks... They're ready to hound their own people to death, and there's no rest for the poor things even in the next world! They're all angry...

And they're afraid of thunderstorms... But what's there to be afraid of? It's a natural phenomenon... We know how to deal with them!

I'm Ivan Kuligin, an inventor... I want to invent a perpetual motion machine. One that can turn a mill without any wind... It would be quite useful.

But first, let's deal with the thunderstorm... We need to install special things — lightning rods. It will attract the lightning, and the current will go into the ground. So no more fear! Well, , will you help me place them? I'll show you where!

checkText.en: Have you won yet?

finishText.en:
A dog, you say? A collar with a name on it? Chestnut, then... You're right about that... Is there really no curse?

That dog is so far from the circus, on the other end of town! Tell George to keep a closer eye on his pets. Or else I'll file a complaint with Empress Hirkalla, and they'll kick him off our allod in a jiffy!

Oh...

Well, at least I can get some sleep now.

goal.en: Defeat the nobleman's "ancestral curse" dwelling in the swamps.

startText.en:
, have you heard the bloodcurdling howl? Everyone can hear it! How ironic! Yes, this dog is really bothering me… Do you want to know what's going on?

My sad story is this: once upon a time, my ancestor, who lived on Jigran before Firez and the Xadaganians appeared, decided to kidnap a girl, the daughter of a local farmer… She escaped from him that same night! My ancestor gave chase, and it led him to these swamps…

There he met a monstrous glowing dog and was fatally wounded by it. When the servants arrived, he told them what happened, then died. Since then, this terrible creature has been haunting his descendants on Jigran… And then I decided to come back here… and now this terrible howling wakes me up every night...

checkText.en: Well, how are the horses?

finishText.en: The horses are safe, it seems... That's great! Good horses are expensive these days! The old nobility doesn't like these fast-moving Manabikes, they prefer horses.

goal.en: Drive 6 stray horses back to the herd.

startText.en:
I'm not the only one hearing that howl... Everyone can hear it. Even my butler, who feeds me oatmeal...

And the horses... they are timid creatures... As soon as that monster howls, they scatter in all directions...

I could wait until they return, but since you need a horse for your trip... Besides, there's always a chance that wolves will attack them! Please, , take this horn. Blow it - the horses will hear it... and come running back.

finishText.en: The horses are back? The master can live in peace, his pets are now safe.

goal.en: Drive 6 stray horses back to the herd.

name.en: Problems of the City: Runaway Horses

startText.en:
I, Andrey Lemkov, the governor of this land, ask you for help in a very serious matter. I recently received information that a gentleman living in the village outside the city has encountered a problem.

This gentleman, a man of the old school, lives by the old rules and values. He has a herd of horses which are like family to him. But recently they were attacked by wolves, so they ran away. The gentleman is unable to find his pets on his own.

My wife, Julia Lemkova, is a strong-willed woman. She reminded me that strength lies in unity and cooperation. She convinced me to turn to you, , and ask you to help the gentleman get his horses back. For this we will need a special horn that will lure the horses and help gather them together.

Help the man get his horses back. Give us the opportunity to show compassion and kindness.

checkText.en: What about the wolves?

finishText.en: I'm sure the wolves will rise again eventually, too! But for now at least it will be more peaceful... The thunderstorm is bad enough, we don't need wild animals to make things worse!

goal.en: Kill 9 swamp wolves around the pasture.

startText.en:
, it'd be nice if you could deal with the wolves... The animals are slowly coming back to life, but the corrupted creatures are stronger.

So the wolves aren't going back to the swamps while that horror is there. Now they are attacking my horses. Soon they'll start hunting the villagers.

finishText.en: The evil dog and its pack are gone? Great, the lord will sleep peacefully!

goal.en: Kill 6 Swamp Wolves and defeat the Swamp Horror.

name.en: Good Deeds for the City: Beasts in the Swamps

startText.en:
Today I ask you, , to help us with a very serious matter. A huge ghost dog lives in the swamps near our town, scaring residents and livestock. A pack of swamp wolves has joined it, thus making the threat worse.

As usual, my husband is unable or unwilling to deal with this problem. So I'm asking you to eliminate this threat and ensure the safety of our residents.

Let the elimination of the ghost dog and the swamp wolves become a symbol of our strength and determination. Good luck to you, dear heroes!

finishText.en: Don't touch me! I'll jump! I swear I'll jump!

goal.en: Ask the woodcutter, healer, and undertaker about Katerina.

startText.en:
The storm is getting stronger, and Katerina is missing! If this disaster is really because of her, then who knows what will happen if we don't find her. Maybe this storm will kill us all and tear the village to pieces!

The whole village is looking for her! Please help, !

Oh, I hope nothing happens!

finishText.en:
Oh... what happened to me? What a wonderful dream! Oh, my soul feels so light!

...Oh, did I really do all this? Incredible...

And look, the storm is over!

goal.en: During the fight with Katerina, make her angry and get her to destroy the places she hates.

startText.en:
! I can't do this anymore! This life is not worth it!

I hate everything here! If I had the will and the strength, I would smash this oak tree to pieces, burn Dikin to ashes, and raze Kabanova's damned house to the ground!

But I don't have that kind of power, so there's only one way out for me - into the water!

Ohh, I can't do this anymore!

Oh... Oh, I feel sick!

checkText.en: Her fate could have been completely different. Darker.

finishText.en: Anyway, we have a few more fates to sort out. I feel like we're getting close.

goal.en: Discuss Katerina's fate with Alyosha.

startText.en:
!!! You idiotidiot! What have you  donedone?! I'll destroy you!

I thought a herohero had arrived whowho would help us all, and what do you do? You and that witch destroyed our home! I wish we had never let Katerina into our family!

Well, I hope you're happy now! But I won't let this go easily - I'll make sure you pay for everything you've destroyed!

checkText.en: It's beautiful here, isn't it? Cool, gloomy, and foggy. And the dead walk among the living. Just the way I like it!

finishText.en: The Paladins' power is their belief in their own righteousness. But they are just people - and all people have desires, fears, and secrets. Nobody is perfect.

goal.en: Talk to Hirkalla near her palace.

startText.en:
What have you been up to, ? Mutiny? Riot?

My sister thinks she can stop me? Using my own methods? With the help of these pathetic fanatics? We'll see...

But you... Look around you! I conquered death - isn't that wonderful? Yes, things are not perfect, there are problems, but we have just begun. We will create a world with our own rules where everyone will be happy eventually.

Do you have any objections?

checkText.en: Will my vampires ever be free? I ask that myself every day.

finishText.en: Thank you! Our service allows us to resurrect out of turn - so vampire guards will soon rejoin the fight against the Light.

goal.en: Revive 7 fallen vampires.

startText.en:
It's good to see a familiar face in the land of shadows, !

The vampires' lot is a difficult one. As agreed, we fought in Nihaz's Citadel, protecting the rest of the inhabitants of Sarnaut. In exchange, we were promised a cure which would lift our curse and a new land that we would call home - Jigran.

But things turned out differently - we are back in the service, but this time of the Goddess of Darkness. And again we are part of the army, but now the enemy is different - it's the Light.

Alas, we have no other choice - Hiero's Paladins want to destroy all vampires, and Hirkalla can resurrect them. Our warriors are fighting bravely there, near the bridges... Please, collect the Sparks of the dead and revive them with the help of the artifact that I'll give you.

finishText.en: Have you brought back the bloodsuckers? Excellent, we'll send them back to the frontline. That's their vampire lot - being first to the fray.

goal.en: Revive 12 fallen vampires.

startText.en:
Our loyal guardsmen continue to sacrifice their lives - because the empress has many enemies: Paladins, distorted creatures, and now nihilists...

Vampires die particularly quickly, and they are our backbone. Annette once again asks you to revive them as soon as possible. I'll give you the device, and you'll go to the battlefield and revive the poor creatures, .

Then report to Gort, he commands the forces here.

checkText.en: They don't belong here.

finishText.en:
Mission accomplished. Thank you for your service.

All we want now is peace. We've stood guard too long...

goal.en: Eliminate 10 Paladins who infiltrated Hirkalla's territory, then report to Danas.

startText.en:
, my friend! It's good to see you!

As you already know, when Hirkalla came to our world, she took control of all undead armies gathered by Dakkar and his apprentices.

Now these immortal warriors are stationed in Dar Leanos and Sardrok, to the north and south of here. As for us, the heroes of old - we serve the Goddess of Darkness as generals. We have no choice - the bonds of dark magic chaining our will are stronger than meteorite ore.

On the other hand, I don't sympathize with these warriors, the Paladins. They are quick to judge and execute. So this is my order: defend the bridges and knock the enemies out of their foothold on this bank.

finishText.en: Are you done? Phew, excellent! If they had gotten here, I would've been done for!

goal.en: Eliminate 12 Paladins

startText.en:
Our main enemy is Hiero's cursed Paladins. It's not enough that they are sitting in the Cathedral, out of our reach - they are also trying to establish footholds in the city.

They are trying to break through the bridge to the Palace!

We can't let this happen, so here is my order; eliminate a dozen Paladins that break through.

checkText.en: The undead are easier to manage than these cats.

finishText.en: These hideous creatures can cause a lot of trouble. But under our empress's control they are a formidable force for our enemies.

goal.en: Defeat, then mount the three feral guards and bring them back.

startText.en:
The vampire guard and revived people cannot hold the bridge, !

Fortunately, the empress does not rely only on them. With her magic, she awakened the ancient Hickut guards - the Sphinxes. These creatures made of granite and bronze are virtually invulnerable. However, controlling them requires considerable effort.

After falling into a battle rage, the Sphinxes got out of control and started attacking everyone.

You need to pacify the Hickut guards by mounting them and returning them to their pedestals.

finishText.en: The stone guards of Hickut have been sleeping for centuries, and now they are awake. They need to be tamed again, and this will take some time.

goal.en: Defeat, then mount the three feral guards and bring them back.

startText.en:
One of our main units are the stone Hickut guards, awakened by the magic of the empress, . They guard the Palace, and not only that.

There is one problem - they are too wayward and easily get out of control. But there is a way to fix this - give them a thrashing, then mount them and take them back to the pedestal. They will come to their senses.

Once you are done, report to the Wanderer - he's been assigned to keep an eye on them.

checkText.en: Everyone has a weak point. Everyone.

finishText.en: Now the leaders of the Paladins are in the grip of temptation, fear, and rage, and their shield is weakening. Once its integrity is compromised, our lady will order a full frontal attack on the Cathedral.

goal.en: Go to the Cathedral and get into the minds of Marianne, Negus Tot, and Hiero. Shake their faith in the power of the Light. Report to the Wanderer when you are done.

startText.en:
Have you ever heard of the Trojan horse, ? On a distant world, besiegers were able to infiltrate an enemy city by convincing the defenders to accept a false gift. Today you are going to be that gift.

I learned to sow doubts, temptations and discord when I served Nihaz. One spark is often enough to ignite a flame. This is what I did to Kyros, fueling his despair, resentment and anger.

The Paladins think their Shield of Faith reliably protects them from Darkness. We'll do this - you will go to the temple and poison their thoughts with the help of a special artifact that I will give you.

checkText.en: We can't keep resurrecting them! There's already a line that's a hundred years long!

finishText.en: No, I won't give them to you! I won't! They are mine! I earned them! I won!

goal.en: Ask the ghosts about the circumstances of their second death, then report to Reniesta.

startText.en:
So, are you running errands for the Empress now, ? Alright.

We have another problem here besides the fact that we can't resurrect everyone at once - those who were previously resurrected started dying again. Or disappearing.

We'll never be done at this rate, and the people are getting angry.

Anyway, find the freshly dead ones and ask why they died again and ruined my reports, the bastards?

checkText.en: Spark Eaters become vulnerable near Soul Lanterns.

finishText.en: That's great. Now the resurrected will have fewer problems and a lot more faith in the good intentions of our mistress.

goal.en: Eliminate 20 Spark Eaters and replenish 5 lanterns with Spark energy. Report to Gorislav Averchenko

startText.en:
Hey, come here, ! The Empress said we can put you to work...

The thing is, we are protecting the ghosts that we released, but they get attacked often - by distorted creatures and other ghosts. And now a new misfortune - we are plagued by Spark Eaters, Tep's creations.

They consume Spark energy! The residents are now in dire straits. They have barely enough energy to continue existing. There is only one salvation from these creatures - the Soul Lanterns which weaken these parasites, so killing them becomes a piece of cake.

You need to refill the lanterns and disperse the Spark Eaters.

finishText.en: Spark Eaters are magical creatures. Once Tep was able to tame them and compel them to harvest Sparks for him...

goal.en: Eliminate 20 Spark Eaters and replenish 5 lanterns with Spark energy.

startText.en:
So many parasites have descended on Jigran, !

There are Spark Eaters now, imagine that... Tep's creations, curse them... We both have handled them before, so you know what to do. Beat the nasties, lure them to the lantern, and destroy them there. And the lanterns need to be refilled...

Afterwards, inform the Wanderer - he's still trying to come up with a solution to this problem...

checkText.en: They don't deserve this... They don't deserve this!

finishText.en: [You are late - Foma Opiskin is dead - his body is completely drained of blood. But there is an extremely curious piece of paper in his pocket...]

goal.en: Kill 6 Drowner Ghouls at the bottom of the canal and report back to Foma Opiskin.

startText.en:
Hey, hey! Stop! !

I have a very important meeting here. I will become the richest man on Jigran!

I'll tell you everything, but only in exchange for one favor: there's something at the bottom of the river canal! Something nasty! Deal with it!

Whaaat? What are you standing around for?! Don't think, just dive!

checkText.en: It is not easy to control vampires in the current situation... My people expect a lot from me...

finishText.en:
This is outrageous, ! If we didn't know each other, I'd think you want to destroy our reputation which took a great effort to restore.

But I see no point in denying it - what you are saying can only be the work of my people.

Give me this... piece of paper.

goal.en: Show the note to Annette de Tristesse.

startText.en:
The promissory note found on the dead body contains the promise of a certain Huntsman to issue a hundred Sparks to whoever presents it.

We should show this note to Annette de Tristesse, she might know something about her wards' dealings.

checkText.en: How can I be of help?

finishText.en: You are lucky: the scale of the hunt is truly unprecedented now. There are a lot of people in my lands wishing to participate - both among the "hares" and our brethren. Welcome!

goal.en: Find the Huntsman, disguise yourself and find out what is going on.

startText.en:
Here's what we'll do, .

I will give you a little thing that will deceive the eyes and scent of any ordinary vampire. And you will find this Huntsman and learn everything you can from him.

When the opportunity arises, I want you to thoroughly admonish on my behalf those who allow themselves to discredit the name of my House.

checkText.en: How can I be of help?

finishText.en:
I had no doubt that I could rely on you. I will deal with these disobedient Sparks myself.

Go reassure Reniesta that no one will eat her precious wards anymore.

goal.en:
Listen to the rules of the hunt and join it, but make your own rules: kill the vampire "wolves", harvest their Sparks, tear the masks off the "hares", then deal with the Huntsman himself.

Report to Annette de Tristes after the "hunt".

startText.en:
You see, you are a little late - the hunt is already in full swing, . But don't worry, you will have time to enjoy it!

I will quickly bring you up to date.

As I already said: hares eat grass, wolves eat hares...

finishText.en: Oh, this Astolf - he's nothing but trouble... Where did he come from? One of Canaan's fosterlings probably...

goal.en: Kill 12 vampire "wolves", harvest their Sparks, tear the masks off the "hares", then deal with the Huntsman himself.

startText.en:
It looks like there's no stopping some of Annette's pets, ... Especially this Astolf, an ancient ghoul who incites other vampires to commit all sorts of atrocities.

Well, the empress was clear - those who misbehave will be disciplined.

Stop these strange games, collect Vampire Sparks, and give the Huntsman a good thrashing!

Then tell Annette about it.

finishText.en: It's a disgrace... How could they...? I'll talk to my vampires and give them a severe reprimand.

goal.en: Collect 20 Psi-Salt Crystals

startText.en:
These wayward vampires not just kill townspeople - they also engage in other indecent activities, . They started smuggling Psi-Salt from the Dead Sea...

We don't need that garbage here, so I wanted you to search all their stashes in the park, take psi-salt and bring it to Annette.

checkText.en: What do you want?

finishText.en:
Where did you come from?

The empress's palace? Very interesting...

Welcome! However, I have nothing to offer my guests...

goal.en: Take a carriage to Famusov with Alyosha

startText.en:
Madman...

Ignorant people called Tep a madman... But was he really that mad, ? Perhaps he saw something others could not see?

Perhaps this guest who caused a scandal is not mad either... If he acted strangely, could this mean his new destiny did not fit him either?

I suggest starting with him, since it's not far away. Famusov Estate where the rich and noble from all over Dar Ulgorn gather... Let's go there?

checkText.en: Do people's destinies change, or is it the destinies themselves that change one performer to another if the first one turns out to be unsuitable?

finishText.en: Excellent! Seven people: a madman, a loafer, an egoist, a hysterical woman, a gambler, a cynic, and a maniac... These are clearly "odd people out", and perhaps their destinies were stolen. After visiting them, we will understand what happened to them and how...

goal.en: Carry out the orders of Hirkalla's generals and ask them about the cases of stolen destinies, then share the news with Alyosha.

startText.en:
As I said, , Hirkalla's generals control the news all over the city. We need to ask them about all the "unusual" cases when people start behaving strangely.

We'll have evidence that their destiny was stolen from them.

checkText.en:
Chatsky, you like to dress everyone as jesters,

Would you like to try it on yourself?

She unknowingly drove me mad.

What do I care about them all? About the universe?

finishText.en:
Perhaps it was frivolous of me,

Chatsky and I grew up together...

We spent all time together

As friends in childhood days.

Molchalin is a terrible person!

I'm so ashamed.

Who could think he was so cunning!

goal.en: Find Sofia Famusova's diary and the pages from it.

startText.en:
Disregard my father...

He always grumbles, scolds and makes one feel unhappy.

Loses temper for no reason...

I have a request for you. Gorgoyles came from the sky,

And took my diary.

They tore it apart, dropping pieces all over the neighborhood.

I would like to get it back - I'll be eternally grateful to you!

checkText.en:
What do I do when they say

That Famusov Estate is in disarray.

finishText.en:
Thank you, things are quiet now.

I can invite guests and give ball...

goal.en: Kill the spiders in Famusov's garden.

startText.en:
Forgive me! I welcome guests...

But there is trouble in my house...

An infestation of dreadful creatures!

I ask you to help - to chase away the spiders.

Those vile furry legs.

The numerous eyes. And mandibles.

checkText.en:
Where are they?

Am I expected to run around in my age?

Rushing about without rest.

My doorman is a sluggard...!

finishText.en:
There they are, the idlers! Are you afraid of rats?

I'll show you...

I'm grateful to you. You can stay.

Guests will arrive soon...

goal.en: Find Famusov's servants and bring them to him.

startText.en:
Another problem: when this scandal happened,

All servants scattered.

Now I can't find them anywhere!

Find my lazy servants - they might be in trouble.

If they are, save them. I have no desire to look for new ones.

finishText.en: Ah, there are indeed many of them, it's an unpleasant sight...

goal.en: Eliminate 12 Distorted Rats.

startText.en:
Rats are some of the most disgusting distorted creatures, . They are big, large-toothed, and extremely dangerous.

Since our city is built over a network of catacombs, rats easily get into the city.

We must nip this in the bud! They say rats have been spotted in Radovo...

Let's put an end to them as soon as possible. Then report to Anton Zagoretsky...

finishText.en: Otters? Nasty creatures... They eat garbage, roll around in the dirt... Disgusting.

goal.en: Kick 8 trash otters.

startText.en:
The last thing we need is an epidemic in the city, .

But that's what seems to be coming. We still have a lot of problems - and one of them are the trash otters.

These creatures sneak into the city from the neighborhood and eat scraps in the garbage dumps here. I ask you to drive them away. Don't kill them. Just give the otter a good kick - it will get offended and leave the city. Then tell Mor about this, he is our expert on epidemics.

finishText.en:
Oh, buddy, that's exactly what I need. These high-society gossips are boring me to death.

You can join me if you like!

goal.en: Find a hustler and bring her to Anton Zagoretsky.

name.en: Dark Cunning: Harlots at the Feast

startText.en:
Anton Zagoretsky is a famous gambler who is very useful to us, . Such a person must be kept close at hand and provided appropriate patronage.

We have one request from him - to find him a companion for the ball... The thing is, high society gathers at Famusov's elven club, but Zagoretsky is endlessly bored with them.

Therefore, he asks us to find him a girlfriend and bring her to him.

finishText.en: Feodulia? Banshee? A wretched creature... I'm glad you were able to deal with it.

goal.en: Eliminate Feodulia Prostakova and her minions.

startText.en:
Another problem in our city is the distorted banshees,  These ghosts were already insufferable in life, but after death...

There was that woman, Feodulia Prostakova. During her lifetime, she drove all her retinue to their deaths, and now they have become her faithful minions.

Now they wander along the boulevard, so we need to drive them away from there.

Report to Mor once you are done, he's interested in all kinds of dead things.

checkText.en:
We need to find the poor fellow.

I sense that there's trouble... He's in danger...

finishText.en:
The grass is always greener on the other side.

Once I am to drain a cup of woe, let it be so...

But the haze is gone... What was that?

Something is rotten in our state...

If such monsters are wandering about freely...

goal.en: Find Chatsky and help him overcome madness.

startText.en:
Now everything is clear to me...

How do you like the habits of the nobility?

Their speech and manners are unusual...

I myself have adopted these habits, it seems...

But okay - Chatsky is close.

Called a madman, he fled from here,

Demanded a coach, but in vain...

checkText.en: Let's hurry... I sense that gaze...

finishText.en:
Great... What have we learned?

Hirkalla's creatures are involved.

They hover there,

And like leeches, they suck

The energy of the awakened...

Perhaps they steal destinies, too?

Who knows... Alice said

That in the Old Era, this Chatsky was

A famous reformer.

He changed the state,

Did a lot...

And who is he now?

goal.en: Reconcile Sofia and Chatsky.

startText.en:
What are we talking about now? Go back? To them?

They called me mad...

But worst of all, she lied to me...

Laughed at me...

Very well, I will go back... Then I'll leave...

checkText.en: We need to know what's going on...

finishText.en:
That means Alice is preparing a rebellion

And incites

the awakened to take action...

This is not good...

But we must continue our search...

Another "fateless" awaits us.

goal.en: Follow Repetilov and find out who is behind the conspiracy.

startText.en:
But stop! I heard a funny conversation...

One of the guests kept bragging

That he entered into a conspiracy... Said a rebellion

Is brewing, and their numbers are growing.

Let's follow him...

finishText.en:
If you need help -

Summon me, I will appear right away.

goal.en: Find out what Alexander Chatsky can do for you as a companion.

startText.en:
I wanted to see the world.

I travelled less than I had planned.

There's nothing new in Jigran.

There was a party yesterday, tomorrow there'll be two.

When I'm busy I mean business as a rule,

And when it's time to play I play the fool.

And I do not belong to those

Who're capable of doing both.

I'd love to serve. Servility is what I hate.

If you need to find chests, I can help.

I know ways to increase profits.

And find an extra coin...

checkText.en: Uuuuurgh?..

finishText.en: Take the key, go and try.

goal.en: Receive the key to the treasury.

name.en: Khadmons' Treasure Room: Key to the treasury

startText.en:
! Uuuuurgh...

Master say, you friend, can trust. Deserve reward. Not give reward just so, need get it. Is treasure, is code, guess meaning, get that you deserve.

Take key, once in day, then key disappear.

Another day, another taking.

checkText.en: Ah, there you are!

finishText.en: Hmm, so here you are, and where are the others? Looks like the portal was slightly damaged after all, so we got scattered now... Well, I hope no one's hurt! Let's report all of this, then find the others...

goal.en: Enter the portal, then act according to the situation.

startText.en: , I don't understand what that creature was, of course, but I hope it won't be waiting for us there, on the other side! All right – whoever is slow is bound to lose! Go into the portal!

checkText.en: It's all because of the tournament! Everyone dreams of winning, but by far not everyone succeeds, haha!

finishText.en:
You oughta pay in advance so there are no complaints afterwards! Alright, I should probably just raise the fares before this tournament is over.

They win, I gain!

goal.en: Visit 6 players in their cyber capsules and ask them to extend the gaming time that has run out

startText.en:
What was it... ! Listen up. Looks like some folks have outstayed their welcome! Tep's own dorks! They keep sticking in the capsules to the end, until they start getting glitches, and the brain cord gets fried!

I don't give a flying Tep about their problems, of course, but they have to pay for the time spent!

So you remind them – they gotta extend the time or we kick them outta here!

finishText.en: Well, the administrator has sent us the rent money. Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Visit 6 players in their cyber capsules and ask them to extend the gaming time that has run out.

checkText.en: Just don't mess up!

finishText.en: So, everyone's content, everyone's well fed? No one's tossing heavy jars at the vendor? Excellent, then – I'll give you a heart mark for collaborating. Give me the link to your page on the Jeb-net, will you?

goal.en: Take 3 orders from the bar to 3 different players without messing up the requests.

startText.en:
You're called , right? I am Bahiti.

Ahh! I’ve had enough of this running after these gamers! They keep piling on orders – and I have to think now, who ordered what...

Alright, since you're helping out, listen up: take a can of energy drink to the orc, tablets for that mean wench, and this dude Selkis gets the energy concentrate in a candy bar.

You just have not to mess this up, or we'll be getting complaints – and we have no provision for refunding drachmas, 'cause the income's got to be kept. We're not streamers to be living on donates!

checkText.en: Are you done with the task?

finishText.en:
Oh, great! All the gamers have received their snacks, and they're now happy as if you've just given them a gold card in the game. The administrator has surely remembered to mention how lucky he was to get such "effective" staff. I hope he's not expecting us to deliver pizza the next time around – that'd be overkill!

At least the populace is happy. Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Take 6 orders from the bar to 6 different players without messing up the requests.

checkText.en: When a Mender Robot gets broken, it's alright, but when an assembly engine does, it's a damn nightmare!

finishText.en: Are the cyberbeetles dealt with? Swell, I'll then send someone else to pick up all the gears and file for a refund...

goal.en: Destroy 5 Bugged Cyberbeetles.

startText.en:
, you see, the update came out today, but it got set up wrong – the Mender Robots have gone nuts now!

They holed up in the server room – we can't even get inside, have to chase them off with a broomstick... but that's just a temporary solution!

So we need to sort this out decisively. You break them down completely, and we'll get new ones under warranty – right?

finishText.en: Excellent – the cyberbeetles have been dealt with, and another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Destroy 12 Bugged Cyberbeetles.

checkText.en: Everyone will say the drachmas are their own!

goal.en: Find the real owner of the wallet and give the item to him.

startText.en:
, these nerds are so out of their minds that they're losing their items left and right! People've been bringing me all kinds of stuff: Jeb-phones, mechanical penises, collectible cartridges... Now, someone's lost their wallet full of drachmas! It should be returned... the problem is finding who the real owner is.

If you find a way to do that, you get respect from me!

finishText.en: The wallet was found, and the owner was so happy that he could not even be bothered to thank you. The administrator was definitely excited about the "help" you've been giving. Another task has been fulfilled, and we keep on moving to the shining future. Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Return the lost wallet to the real owner.
Eliminate 12 members of the Sekhem gang.
Eliminate 12 members of the Kheni gang.

finishText.en: Excellent! The Khuds now know that their "money" aren't going to save them from our "kindness". But don't get relaxed: they're already plotting revenge. And we will keep delving into our Wireframe project in the meantime – it's clearly not going to have less issues now.

goal.en: Eliminate 12 members of the Khud gang.

startText.en:
Now, we need to busy ourselves with Khuds – these haughty rich folk who flaunt their wealth as if it's the only thing they have in life.

Reference: "The Khud subculture brings together the Arisen who possess considerable financial resources. Their primary characteristic is seeking luxurious lifestyles, exclusive services and high social status. Khuds are the ones who believe that everything can be bought with money, including respect".

It's a bit odd that they've not yet realized their money don't impress anyone here. So let's make sure they learn that in this city, there are things far more important than their gold watches and posh manamobiles.

Common sense, for instance.

checkText.en: So what else is up there?

goal.en: Learn the details from Sarang Kido, then gain audience with Negus Shuponu.

startText.en:
! Thus far, I have been unable to contact Nefer Ur. I do not even know where he is now, actually. I suppose we will have to try obtaining this information from the head of the city department – Negus Shuponu... But how do we gain access to him?

As you know, he is a part of a rather different structure that is not directly subordinate to our agency...

checkText.en: Is the little elephant still rioting?

finishText.en:
Have you dealt with the elephant issue? Excellent! If only that had been the only problem we've been having with these robobeasts.

The strongest of them were once the nobility of Hickut, the courtiers of our last ruler. They are worshipping various elements...

goal.en: Find a way to calm down Ahbu the little elephant.

checkText.en: Well, how goes the search for the most popular singer?

goal.en: Ask music records vendors about Nomarkh Khey and find him.

name.en: Who is Bound by Different Laws

checkText.en: So, what about the magazines?

finishText.en: Oh, wow... These are real rarities! I'll be sure to read them... Take your cartridge, cheni!

goal.en: Procure 10 ancient papyrus magazines for Semer Shereda

startText.en:
Why would I need the guys if I have the Thing?..

Ah, the question wasn't for you, ! What do you need?

Hmm... that cartridge... with Pyramids... All right, that'll take some doing! Do you even know that Hickut had a very advanced field of literature on the subject of games? There were so many different magazines, and they are all extremely valued as collectibles now! "Great Dragons", "The Land of Hickut", "Mummy Store", "Pyramid Navigator", "Pharaoh Mania"? I'm collecting items from that period. See, everyone's only reading news on the Jeb-net now.

Get me, say, ten retro magazines printed on papyrus!

checkText.en: How is the search going?

finishText.en: Oh, that's pretty fast! I wouldn't even dream of trading these games so quickly... You have a real talent for collecting...

goal.en: Collect the three games you need.
Find a record by the SheHer band through trading.

name.en: State Services: Looking for Collectible Records

finishText.en: Oh, magazines... gotta read 'em again now... uh, I mean, gotta pack 'em up and send 'em to the client. Another request fulfilled, and what does that mean? That means another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Procure 12 ancient papyrus magazines.

startText.en:
The next request has been filed: you need to find ancient gaming magazines... Ah, do you even know that Hickut had a great variety of literature on the subject of games? There were so many different magazines, and they are all extremely valued as collectibles now! "Great Dragons", "The Land of Hickut", "Mummy Store", "Pyramid Navigator", "Pharaoh Mania"?

One of the collectors is now asking you to obtain the missing issues. I guess it's not going to be problematic for you at all...

checkText.en: Well, what you got there?

goal.en: Ask 6 Arisen near the administration about their current problems.
Take a survey of the public opinion, asking 12 citizens of Sar-Iram and recording their replies by using the special device.

checkText.en: Let's talk it all over.

finishText.en: Now, we will part for a while. I'll try to find out more, and you follow Negus Shuponu's directions. There are many weird things on Xadagan, we're almost besieged, so your talents will be greatly helpful here. When I learn more, I will send a message to you. For now, remember: trust no one!

goal.en: Discuss the plan with Sarang Kido.

name.en: All for the sake of "New Reality"!

finishText.en: If you've managed to deal with the fegens, other gangs will become more cautious... That means another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Eliminate 12 members of the Fegen gang and their leader, Sarang Sekani.

startText.en:
Another gang has appeared! They're real troublemakers and rioters! They are calling themselves the Fegens. A Fegen is... well, it's some kind of trash, or even worse. Actually, their name speaks for itself!

Fegens, and especially their leader – Sarang Sekani – must be dealt with!

checkText.en: These flame-worshippers are out to set the whole allod on fire!

finishText.en: So, at least these ones have been deal with... But while you were away, we had a total electrical blackout here... three times! Something has to be done about this, too...

goal.en: Eliminate Yasskul Flach and 7 Path of Fire Heretics.
Eliminate Semer Myum and 12 Path of Fire Heretics.

name.en: Safe Capital: Path of Fire Heretics

goal.en: Bring 5 artifacts: Sereph's Bandage.
Bring 5 artifacts: Fegen's Black Mark.
Bring 5 artifacts: Ahbahb's Crown.

checkText.en: Are you done with the task?

finishText.en: Excellent, these artifacts will be exceedingly useful for the Arisen community of Xadagan. Here's your reward.

goal.en: Bring 5 artifacts: Khebu's Sparkboom.

startText.en: We need new artifacts today. Will you be able to find them?

goal.en: Bring 5 artifacts: Hahrtah's Evil Eye.
Bring 5 artifacts: Sebech's Firecracker.
Bring 5 artifacts: Khemes' Wand.
Bring 5 artifacts: Kahib's Shield.
Bring 5 artifacts: Kiss of Mother Djut.

name.en: Xadaganian artifacts: Kiss of Mother Djut

goal.en: Bring 5 artifacts: Ibeh's Spirit Triumph.
Bring 5 artifacts: Serekhu's Red Rag.
Bring 5 artifacts: Shenu's Heavy Shackles.
Bring 5 artifacts: Mether's Boots.
Bring 5 artifacts: Mesedji's Sting.
Bring 5 artifacts: Usafu's Stone Idol.
Bring 5 artifacts: Khebesu's Invisible Cap.
Bring 5 artifacts: Khahayt Doll.

checkText.en: Have you succeeded in dealing with them?

goal.en: Eliminate 12 wild monkeys.

startText.en: The next request has been filed: wild monkeys have taken residence in our district, and they are starting to cause trouble. These restless things not only devastate our stocks, but they may be dangerous to the citizens as well. We need to get rid of the monkeys quickly and efficiently, so that tranquility is returned to the city's vicinity. I am sure you know how that can be done. The most important thing is to act considerately and watch their behavior so that none of them might escape. I entrust this task to you!

finishText.en: Here is the diary! I can't believe we've finally found it. It looks like there are many records of her life and thoughts in those dire times. This might well be a real treasure that would help us with understanding her story and the things that were happening around her. We will study each page meticulously – perhaps there is important information here, information that will help us learn more of her and her circle. Meanwhile, we are coming ever closer to the completion of the Wireframe project!

goal.en: Find the lost diary.

startText.en: The next request has been filed: you must find the diary of a little girl who has regretfully perished in the plague, and has not been resurrected. This diary may contain important information on her life and the events of those terrible times. We know it was extremely valuable to her, and the fact that it disappeared is alarming. You will have to explore the places where she might leave it... I am sure you will be able to handle this task! Patience and attention are the keys here.

checkText.en: Do you have a permission?

finishText.en: Access to "Food and Drinks" service activated!

checkText.en: Time's a-wasting, comrades!

finishText.en:
So, why are you running late, ? The workday has started long ago! What do you mean, "loose schedule"? You just look and see what's happening here!

If the launch fails, you will be losing your head... literally!

goal.en: Arrive to Negus Jibayd, the chief of the Cosmodrome project, together with agent Sarang Makalani.
Eliminate 12 Termites.

checkText.en: The rocket is not ready to take off! I am rescheduling the launch for five more minutes!

goal.en: Help with preparing the launch by completing 4 tasks from Negus Jibayd and his colleagues.

startText.en:
What's going on? You're asking me what's going on?! You just take a look around! These nutcases, the followers of Earth's cult, are all around! The rocket is not filled up with fuel! Control devices are not working, and our brave trailblazers, straight from Isa, have gotten hysterical!

Let's get this sorted out at least, !

checkText.en: The rocket will not take off by itself!

goal.en: Drain the fuel remaining in 8 barrels, then refuel the rocket.
Drain the fuel remaining in 8 barrels, then refuel the rocket.

startText.en:
Eh, greetings, my deardarling  "Fuel Researcher"

We have a minor, but pretty "hot" issue here.

The rocket is standing still, like a lousy lover on the first date, and waiting to be refueled! We need to collect fuel barrels and fill its tanks, or else our cosmonauts risk ending up stranded here for good, like the pathetic "space tourists" who forgot their tickets at home.

So grab your tools and go looking for these barrels!

checkText.en: They say that the temperature of the Astral has jumped by a whopping 0.85 degrees over the last hundred years!

finishText.en: Let their bodies be made into fertilizer! The biofarm demands new shipments, as if on cue... I think they're going to like it...

goal.en: Kill 12 of the Path of Earth Heretics

startText.en:
One would think that all of the Arisen are smart, rational beings... But no – there are a few ignoramuses among us... ones that would skip school to attend protest rallies instead!

Path of Earth Heretics – how'd you like that? What do you think they're preaching? Love for the Earth, of course! They believe tthat we're polluting it – fouling the air, tainting the water, contaminating the soil... Well, of course, yes, we do! We mess it up! But how could we avoid it? Everybody needs progress!

And now, these psychos have set out to disrupt the launch! You listen to someone like Yaver Thunberg... Like, the rocket is burning up too much fuel, and Sarnaut's not going to take it, and all the seals on Ferris will go extinct. Well, nobody's proved any of that, but trying to explain that to them is pointless!

Or rather, there's a way of "trying"... but with your own tried-and-true methods, !

finishText.en: Well, have you dealt with these eco-fanatics? Excellent! I'm getting ready to analyse their beliefs, but I'm afraid they've had the time to leave behind a manifest of "restoring nature" on the Jeb-net, and soon, there will be more of their followers around. But no one can stop the completion of the Wireframe project!

goal.en: Kill Stoneater and 12 of the Path of Earth Heretics.

name.en: Scientific Problem: Path of Earth Heretics

checkText.en: This way, the last of our workers'll run away! We're already laboring overtime!

finishText.en: Well then, looks like you've managed to rescue everyone! And now, back to work! We need to make up for the lost time!

goal.en: Free 6 cosmodrome personnel taken as hostages

startText.en:
It's so hard now to find good personnel! Pure science, after all, is not the most lucrative kind of activity. It's not like dealing in augmentations, you know! The salaries here are not the highest, and it's a hazardous job, too!

But now, something totally unbelievable is happening! These crazies are all around, and now, they decided to take our workers hostage!

Can you set them free, ? I'm sure they'll be grateful! Just be sure to unlock the cages, and the heretics themselves have the keys...

finishText.en:
Excellent! Have you freed the hostages? I hope they didn't think of claiming their new "eco-friendly" worldview contracted from their captors?!

We can now continue with our work without undue obstructions. Another day brings us closer to the completion of the "Deliverance from the green hell" project. I mean, the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Free 6 cosmodrome personnel taken as hostages

name.en: Applied Studies: Hostages in the Cosmodrome

startText.en:
Greetings to you, our heroheroine! We got a wee little problem with the eco-extremists here... These same ones who can ruin our mission like a lame joke would a party! We need to free the hostages – cosmodrome workers seized by these "green" fanatics.

I hope you're not averse to playing "Space Zack" and saving these poor souls?!

So grab your "tool of salvation" and move out – time to show these eco-activists that they can find real trouble not only at the bottom of a garbage dump!

checkText.en: That's not giving anything yet... Knock some more!

finishText.en: Hey, everything's working again! You're a real smart ladlass there, know just where to knock it... Attaboygirl!

goal.en: Repair 10 control devices.

startText.en:
Ahh... Xadagan was quiet and even boring, they said! Few orcs would be entrusted with setting up instrumentation on a cosmodrome, and now these crazy coots have flushed all of my work right down the stinkhole! All the gear has gone haywire! And that right after we've set everything back up following the hacking from last week!

Alright, we need to fix everything up, pronto! Thankfully, these morons didn't even have enough in them for breaking stuff properly... You gotta knock on the boxes a little, and they start working again... Why wouldn't you do the knocking, , and I see what comes of it!

finishText.en:
Wonderful! Have you repaired the devices? We can now launch rockets without fear of being stranded here for good.

Another day brings us closer to the completion of the "Space Renaissance" project. I mean, the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Repair 10 control devices

checkText.en: If they refuse, we'll shove them right in!

goal.en: Prepare the cosmonauts, Squirrel and Arrow, for the flight.

checkText.en: Are you waiting for something? We're also waiting!

finishText.en: Excellent! The Gibberlings are off to spin circles around Sarnaut! We'll launch an Arisen next, and then fly to the Moon!

goal.en: Take the vessel with gibberlings into space.
Launch the spaceship with supplies for the Gibberlings into orbit.

startText.en:
Hey, hey, hey! We are in need of your extraordinary abilities – a rocket must be launched again in order to bring supplies to our cosmonauts. To these same Gibberlings. Yes, yes, you heard it right, ladlass!

By the way, I don't understand why some fools are complaining about us "dooming the poor furry critters"? The Gibberlings are alive and kicking, and they will be coming back home soon! What we need now is bringing them food and carrying away that which results from processing said food.

So grab your buttons and launching tools – time to show this rocket who's in charge here!

checkText.en: We are too close to the truth!

finishText.en: Do you understand now? The governments of the League and the Empire have constructed a monstrous conspiracy to conceal the truth! All this time, they were aware of the aliens' existence – and hiding it! We must reveal the truth to the world! We must lead an alien out of here and present the proof of its existence! For many years, I've been working for this moment!

goal.en: Get to the secret storage.

startText.en:
Everyone Lies! Haven't you heard about this, ?

This is really so... Are you ready to learn the truth? The crushing truth that will turn about all of your conception of the events?

I believe the answer is yes...

The cosmodrome is but a cover-up! They are already here!

And who are they? I'll show you. We need to reach the place which is the real reason for all of this to be built... We will have to steal a pass for this... But you will go the whole way for the sake of the truth, won't you?

checkText.en: Hurry up!

finishText.en: Looks like no one knows where we are now... Literally just one step remains! We will be able to prove to everyone that the aliens have arrived to Sarnaut a long time ago! That the governments have been aware, for years now, of the other worlds and all that... The truth must be revealed to everyone!

goal.en: Leave Zone 53 and arrive to Agent Makalani's shelter.

startText.en:
I have a shelter nearby – one that nobody knows about, . I've got an extremely powerful, yet portable, communications device there. From that place, we will be able to present the proof of the aliens' existence to the entire world!

Come on, hurry up, the alarm will be sounded soon!

checkText.en: What's there?

finishText.en: Uhhhh... An alien? What are you talking about?

goal.en: Help Agent Makalani by completing 3 of his tasks.

checkText.en: The alien is hungry! But I would object to sharing some of my chips with him!

finishText.en: Excellent – right what we need, but first, we need to tell everyone!

goal.en: Feed the alien by collecting 12 pieces of Scorpion meat

startText.en: First: our alien must be fed! I don't really think it was well nourished back there, in the secret zone... But for starters, we need to learn... what does it feed on, actually? Oh well – it's not like we have any choice... Let's try scorpion meat, . It sounds like something aliens would eat!

finishText.en: Ah, so you're back with Scorpion meat! Excellent! We can now start analyzing their muscle filaments and learn how they can be used to improve our nutrition. Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Obtain 12 pieces of Scorpion Meat.

startText.en:
Have you already heard of the new project dedicated to studying Scorpions? Oh yes, these tiny creatures might actually be a source of incredible proteins and other nutrients! I want you to go to the desert and gather Scorpion meat for further study.

Don't forget that they can be aggressive and even a little venomous, but this only adds extra spice to our experiment! After all, who wouldn't love to taste a "pan of crispy scorpions"? I hope you won't forget to bring along a pair of protective gloves and a little Pheromone sauce – what if they're going to end up even more delicious than we believe?

finishText.en: No one's going to find us now! No one will stop us from exposing the conspiracy!

goal.en: Conceal the shelter by collecting 10 pieces of wreckage and using them to create a camouflage.

startText.en: Second: conceal the shelter so that absolutely no one can find it. I saw all kinds of junk scattered around – they're an ideal material for making truly elaborate camouflage! I think it won't be hard for you to come up with something... though being creative is the most important thing, ! Use your imagination!

finishText.en: Oh, my! Have you collected the salvage metal? I hope you've not run into anything too sinister! Now we have the material to work with – let's hope that when Mechanoids are assembled from it, they're not going to "rise up" all by their own! Another day brings us closer to the completion of the "Metal Paradise" project. I mean, the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Collect 12 pieces of wreckage between the station and the cosmodrome.

startText.en:
Greetings to you again! We have a very "exciting" task here: collecting salvage metal and other kinds of recyclables. Sure, I know it sounds like a job for a homeless junkyard-dwelling robot, but believe me: it is important for our project.

We must make sure that we have enough materials for creating something great... or at least for not looking like pathetic bohemians! So grab your gloves and go looking for these "treasures"!

checkText.en: Have you managed to set up the station? Indeed, this is not the easiest thing to do... There ought to be a manual somewhere...

finishText.en: Time to tell the entire world about the alien! Preparing to broadcast!

goal.en: Set up repeaters by performing a special procedure.

startText.en: The third, and the most important! Time to inform all of Sarnaut about the aliens! For this, I have an old, but extraordinary powerful broadcast station here – it is capable of transmitting the signal even to other allods! We will show the alien to the world and expose the governments' conspiracy, !

checkText.en: So what is the conspiracy about?

finishText.en: Why do I always have to clean up after amateurs! Did you think we would really be unable to track you, ?

goal.en: Learn what happened to Agent Makalani.

startText.en: I'm not quite following what you are talking about, . An alien? What kind of alien? We have been unable to find evidence of their existence after all. Perhaps if we had been able to infiltrate the secret zone of the Cosmodrome, we would have acquired some information about them...

checkText.en: Thus the Corps ended up classified...

finishText.en: The aliens must not learn of the fact that we've turned against them, . We have managed to procure their vehicles and capture their agents. Unfortunately, we are unable to guarantee that they have not infiltrated the government – they are skilled masters of disguise and mind magic, as well as extraordinary powerful psionicists. The hypno potential is up 5 runes. Anyone can be an alien in disguise!

goal.en: Talk to Negus Harakhti to learn the whole truth about the aliens.

checkText.en: Have you gained access levels?

goal.en: Return to Negus Shuponu and report on the events.

checkText.en: Execution not completed.

finishText.en:
Thank you for the cooperation.

Basic information is required to create an efficient communication channel.

Reference: Negus Menes is researching the biography of Tep. The most efficient of all sources of information available at present.

goal.en: Arrive to the Integral at the Mana Station's subterranean communications to receive further instructions. Use the information terminal for faster transit.

startText.en:
The Integral is writing to you:

"Thank you for the cooperation, .

Evaluating necessities...

Analysing possibilities...

Issuing tasks...

Goal: analysing subject actions. Subject name – Tep.

Method: receiving additional information.

Approach: receive additional instructions by receiving audio-visual message in immediate vicinity, at least 5 metres.

Urgency: immediate.

Further communication possible following request execution."

checkText.en: When am I going to receive the missing data?

finishText.en: Tep's history is the grand labor of my entire, uhh... postlife! I have been gathering any accounts of him, some seemingly insignificant... But now, I am despairing, shattered, devastated! No, my labors will not be completed, for everything is arrayed against me... I am so tired, .

goal.en: Talk to Negus Menes and complete 4 tasks given by him and his colleagues.

startText.en:
Problem Statement: meet with Negus Menes. Receive data on Tep. Send the data to the information bank for further analysis.

Negus Menes is presumably located at: "Library" complex, otherwise called the Informatorium. The storage place for the entire sum of knowledge possessed by the Arisen.

Execute.

Urgency: immediate.

checkText.en: Now I remember it, now I don't – this is the most typical predicament for any of the Arisen.

finishText.en: Excellent – now I need to separate the memories of "Kahoteps", "Minhoteps" and deceased pet cats from truly valuable information! That is going to take some time...

Oh, wonderful! You have collected the information! We are now able to access the most sacred thoughts of Sar-Iram's citizens. I hope you've not been running into too many intimate details – I'm not ready to discuss my impression of their "romantic adventures" with you.

But either way, we are now one step closer to discovering the mysteries of the Plague era! And who knows – maybe these memories are hiding the answer to the question of why our dreams are so strange? Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

name.en: Applied Studies: Data from the Social Media

checkText.en: If it goes on like this, robots will surely destroy our civilization!

goal.en: Eliminate 12 potentially dangerous Robotic Librarians.

finishText.en:
Oh, so you have done it? Excellent! We have unfettered access to the library's resources again! The problem is, one of the destroyed robots managed to record its memoirs, sort of like "How I became a killer librarian".

I hope these do not end up in Vanvaeck's hands, or we're going to end up with a horror genre bestseller! Continuing the studies in the Informatorium brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Eliminate 12 potentially dangerous Robotic Librarians.

startText.en:
Ah, so have you heard of our Robotic Librarians? They've turned into mechanical monsters! Negus Vanvaeck probably decided that the library's recordings are nothing but electronic toys, and now these robots are dispensing death and chaos instead of literature! It even looks like they started quoting philosophers – but only those who spoke of the end of the world!

This threat must be eliminated before they start holding their own literature parties, complete with biomass sandwiches!

checkText.en: I hope Bathory's not going to get the information she seeks from us! Otherwise a scandal will be unavoidable... and the Negus Council is already looking askance at us!

finishText.en: Well, it's written here about how to get into the third level of the catacombs... You will probably as me what catacombs am I talking about? There's no need at all for you know this – forget about it! Or you might end up becoming like Sarbaz Simp... or even Semer Waifu! A disgrace!

goal.en: Return 12 stolen regular data devices, and 1 extra important one.

startText.en:
The gangs of heretics have overrun the streets of our cities! Why are Negus Shuponu and his munephs turning a blind eye to this?

The ones most dangerous right now are the Blood Heretics who worship Yasskul Bathory, the notorious "Bloody Countess"... She was once murdered in her manor, but now, she has been resurrected again.

Her cult accepts only the most dissolute girls – and the most brainless lads who are ready to throw all their money away for streams with their participation... Perhaps you have heard about Sarbaz Simp and Semer Waifu? Well, and now these "simps" and "waifus" are attacking our "Library" on Bathory's orders, trying to steal certain information... Too early to let you know what it is, though.

Return the stolen data to us immediately, !

goal.en: Return 12 stolen regular data devices, and 1 extra important one.

name.en: Scientific Problem: Idols and their Fans

startText.en:
Bathory's servants! These strange creatures that sacrifice their time and resources on the altar of Penayeter platforms! Their cult worships women who show their nude bodies – this is not just absurd, this is a new scientific phenomenon!

We need to eliminate these "worshippers" before they start influencing our society in a negative way. And these girls? They're only eager to ditch all of their clothes!

They are now stealing data from our informatoria, trying to find the knowledge their mistress is seeking. We cannot allow this to happen.

checkText.en: Were you able to question all of them? It's not like finding them is too difficult!

finishText.en: Ah well, this... is very interesting. Alright, so what have we learned? Tep, the leader of the Zem nation's psionicists, and Ur, the leader of the Zem nation's mechanics, joined forces and deposed Hickut's last Despot who bore the name Peraach. Peraach and his associates – Bathory and the other priests – were defeated in the end, the ruler was killed, and his body was buried someplace. The survivors eventually became those we call the Heretics now... Curious, isn't it?

goal.en: Question 5 members of Sar-Iram's noble families about the events before the plague.

startText.en:
Oh, I'm so happy that I ended up here, as an apprentice to Negus Menes himself! Else I might've been stuck in Nezebgrad writing another boring article "On the advantages of Yasker's authority!"

Well, then... we want to collect information about the years right before the plague... when the old rule, the reign of the Despots, fell... Why did it happen? And what did Tep... and Nefer Ur... have to do with that?

I've gathered the data on the heads of the families that dwelled in Sar-Iram at the time... Why don't we ask them personally?

, we need the representatives of the Khadmon, Atzilut'h, Briya, Yetzira and Ashiya families!

finishText.en:
Perfect! Have you  collected the memories of the noble families? I wonder how many of them were trying to gloss over their "imperfections"! I hope you've not failed to write down their names. What if someone decides to stage a "performance" in court?

Now, we have the actual chronicle of the events before the plague. Maybe we will even be able to write a bestselling novel of how the rich and famous were dealing with the apocalypse! Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Question 5 members of Sar-Iram's noble families about the events before the plague.

name.en: Applied Studies: Witnesses of Ancient History

startText.en:
Ah, my deardarling mentee!

I have a task for you – and it's not going to be boring, I promise! We need to learn of what exactly was happening in Sar-Iram before the plague decided to throw a party here!

So visit the noble families and ask them about the events of yore. Don't forget to record their memories to data storage! And don't be afraid of asking provocative questions – some of them might actually be willing to divulge a dirty secret or two.

After all, the more rumors swirl around, the more exciting our job gets!

checkText.en: Enter your query...

finishText.en: Welcome! I trust you want to test the new service – "finding a rutess for every cheni"?

goal.en: Find the reasons for Negus Menes' despondency

checkText.en: Well, and what's up there?

finishText.en: Hello, it's you, ! I should have guessed! Come on! If it isn't fate... what is it?

goal.en: Try finding information about Nomarkh Miu in the Jeb-net.

checkText.en: Let's go home!

finishText.en: Alright, we're home... But there's zombies all around! Like, totally creepy! Where'd everyone go, ?

goal.en: Ask Semer Shereda about the events, escort her home.

checkText.en: Have you done everything?

finishText.en: Excellent, ! Everyone is here now... The one problem that remains is dealing with Yasskul Bathory who has managed to infiltrate our family's treasury...

goal.en: Help the Khadmon family with recovering their mansion by completing 5 quests.

checkText.en: Uuuuurgh...

finishText.en: . Uuuuurgh... that's just the beginning!

goal.en: Destroy 12 zombies and close 4 doors by using internal levers.

startText.en:
! Uuuuurgh...

The heretics came! Opened doors! Released zombies!

Now zombies are all around! Doors must be closed!

Levers! Two are here, and two up there...

Pull lever! Close door!

Kill zombies! Then I carry them back...

checkText.en: Uuuuurgh...

finishText.en:
. Good. There are seven tombs.

Zombies lay in each. They have to lay further...

startText.en:
. Uuuuurgh...

Heretics released zombies!

Now zombies are everywhere outside! Doors must close!

Three more in the tombs! Seven doors in total!

Pull lever! Close doors!

Kill zombies! Kill robots! Then I carry zombies back, and mechanisms to junkyard...

finishText.en: Have you got rid of these aggressive undead? Excellent! We can now conduct experiments on their behavior in stressful conditions. Though... I think their behavior has been studied well enough in practice. I hope they do not garner any more "aggressive' followers! Science brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

startText.en:
Aggressive Zombies? They become real predators, with sharp teeth and even sharper outlook on the politics of the modern day. We must solve this problem immediately, before they become self-aware and start holding their own ZombElections!

Don't forget to bring your tools of science along – perhaps we will be able to extract some sort of information on the decay of their intellect!

finishText.en: Well, have you dealt with these combat turrets? Excellent! We can now study their control systems and learn how exactly the cultists were able to set them up such aggressive programming in them. This will help us in the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Destroy 12 hostile Turrets.

finishText.en: Have you dealt with these mechanoid monsters? Excellent! I can now analyze their code and learn how exactly they were to set up for such an aggressive programming. This is important for the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Eliminate 12 hostile Mechanoids.

startText.en:
We're having a serious problem with the aggressive Mechanoids here!

These constructs are serving the cultists, and they are ready to execute any kind of Order — even one that entails the annihilation of any living things nearby. I want to learn what kind of algorithm is making them fight so fearlessly. It could be that they have been programmed for "maximum aggression", or they simply don't know the word "NO".

finishText.en: Have you crashed this zombie party? Perfect! Problem is, one of the zombies has managed to record his memoirs to an old Jeb-drive. We may now end up in the possession of the weirdest album in the world! I hope it doesn't become a hit among the dead... More importantly, with the streets calm once again, we're getting closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Destroy 12 Undead creatures in the Khadmons' mansion.

name.en: Scientific Problem: the Undead of the Khadmons' Mansion

startText.en:
Zombies in the Khadmons' tomb? Oh, this is just classic!

Looks like the family has started a party where the living trade bodies with the dead! Their macabre jokes and black humor have led to the dead starting to feel right at home in their, well, home. But fear not: we have special treatments against zombies, and some scientific magic, too! Make sure you do not fall under their charms, or they might persuade you to stay at their "party"!
