checkText.en: Where's my essence? All the mushrooms grow in the tombs!

finishText.en: Oh, thank you, dear guest − it means you will keep on living! For the moment...

goal.en: Collect 25 mycelium essences inside the tombs.

startText.en:
Ah, my little grandkid's brought someone in... All she wants is wiggle her butt around!

Alright, you might do well enough, ! In short, this is how we roll: the guest either goes into the cauldron, or does some work around here. I need the essences of the mycelium that only grows upon the dead, down in the tombs...

See, I'm working in the institute, studying the issues of nutrition. The Zem aren't all that keen on regular food − it doesn't do all that much good to the dead body pumped full of protoblood, other elements are required. So I'm working on developing a new concentrate, and mycology is the most promising direction here.

Enough yakking! Get me the essences, or I'll use you for the mushroom fertilizer!

finishText.en:
Excellent! Have you collected the mycelium essences? I hope they're not smelling as horrible as they look! We can now conduct some experiments and learn whether the Arisen will benefit from the "Mushroom delicacy".

If all goes well, we might create a new trend in the world of the undead! And if it does not... at least we can always use them as the fertilizer for our plants! And, of course, another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Collect 25 mycelium essences in the tombs.

startText.en:
Greetings to you, my brave adventurer boygirl! We got a unique opportunity here: we want to learn whether the Arisen can be fed with something a little more exquisite than processed human brains.

You will have to collect mycelium essences down in the tombs. I hope you're not averse to digging through rotting carcasses a little? Don't forget to procure a good solid mask: the smell might be... not too pleasant, so to say. But who knows? You might start a new gastronomic trend for the dead, after all!

checkText.en: These miscreants have released the zombies, and gone down underground themselves!

finishText.en:
Oh, little explosive thingies! My darlings! Now we'll show 'em! But don't trust my sis too much, she just loves torture! If she lures you there − well, it's been nice knowin' ya! I'm not coming anywhere near her without a cannon at hand.

Here's a few Sparkbooms − I hope they come handy...

goal.en: Collect 12 bombs hidden in tombs.

finishText.en:
Bravo! Have you  assembled the bombs? I hope none of them went off while in your hands! Now, we can conduct a number of experiments and learn the efficiency of our "explosive toys" when employed in scientific research.

If all goes to plan, we will be able to create a whole new series of shows about blowing up ancient legends! This brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Collect 12 bombs hidden in tombs.

startText.en:
Hey, you! Yes, it's you I'm talking to!

We have a little problem with "the wonders of pyrotechnics", and we are in need of your daring. We need to collect the bombs from the tombs of the Khadmon family. Don't you worry, they won't explode on touch... at least I hope so! This task requires daring, and more than a little skill of handling dangerous items.

So don't forget to check each bomb for "surprises" − there might be something interesting there! And if you're lucky, you might find a few shocking revelations about the dead denizens of this place.

checkText.en: Have you found everyone?

finishText.en: Is everyone here?! Excellent! I did think for a moment that some got eaten by zombies! But as it stands, everyone's alive, and even unharmed, it seems... It's a pity, 'cause I have plenty of spare parts anyway.

goal.en: Rescue Yasskul Gyasi, Semer Olufemi and Nomarkh Funsani, bringing them back to the mansion.

startText.en:
So, only the granny and the lil' brother remain in the mansion! My parents seem to be stuck in the tombs, and my uncle, too!

Don't be surprised: big families are a rarity for us, the Arisen. Few got the luck of having all their relatives resurrected in time! We were burying each other during the Plague − luckily, we are embalmers after all! So we got resurrected all together, too!

But it would have been a shame to lose them all now, !

checkText.en: Have you managed to learn the code?

finishText.en: Looks like the code is correct. Now we set off into the catacombs beneath the tomb. They are divided into three levels, but we will only be able to access the first one initially...

goal.en: Open the door to the treasury and move to the first floor of the catacombs.

startText.en:
The treasury of the Khadmon family! , can you think of the valuables that have been accumulated here over the centuries, especially since no one has ever managed to loot it? To enter the numerous levels of our catacombs, we need special keys − and luckily, I have the key to the first level with me!

But it looks like the heretics have managed to whisk away the keys to the second and third floors! Alright, we sort it out as we go. First, we need to learn the code... We'll have to ask my parents for it. Each of them should know their own part, in theory!

checkText.en: Have you managed to find Nomarkh Miu?

finishText.en: Ahh, dear friends! How can I express my gratitude? Semer Shereda could become my disciple... and you, ... I'm giving my greatest work, the history of Tep that he revealed to me in person, to you... You will find it here, on the Xadagan allod, in the information terminals! Yes, it was me who set them up and enabled broadcasting... The Arisen must learn the truth and make their own personal choices...

goal.en: Deal with the issue of Yasskul Bathory and rescue Nomarkh Miu.

checkText.en: Bathory binds her servants to her with the power of sex... An interesting way of reinforcing their loyalty!

finishText.en: We are very close now... Literally just one step remains, !

goal.en: Reach Peraach's tomb and destroy three of Yasskul Bathory's servants along the way.

checkText.en: A very interesting battle, miaou.

finishText.en: Bravo! He's now going to stay here for another two and a half thousand years! As for Nomarkh Miu, she was somewhere around here. Find her, take her with you and go back to the Library!

goal.en: Stop Peraach from being resurrected or kill him, also eradicate Yasskul Bathory and her adherents.

checkText.en: Shall we talk?

finishText.en:
The many-faced Darkness − Hirkalla, Baphomet, the Dark Maidens are all just parts of it. You will soon witness another visage of Darkness, with its own will and aspirations.

Farewell, !

goal.en: Talk to Negus Menes and learn how this all is going to end.

startText.en: Was I able to understand who Tep was? I think I have... After all, we should ask ourselves: how are we different from Tep? We have taken so much from Nihaz, and the lures of Darkness have been enticing us just as they have him... All of your recent deeds, when you put your goals above the measure of virtue in achieving them... are they really that different from Tep's, ?

checkText.en: You're not in a real hurry! Settle all your issues, and then come back to me.

finishText.en: I'm glad, exceedingly glad to see you! Something weird is going on... We have a clear surplus of energy, but where is it going? It's a big question. One that I hope to have answered, with your help.

goal.en: Go to XAES to learn why the city is having electrical blackouts.

startText.en:
Didn't Negus Kambizet guarantee uninterrupted supply of energy for me?!

But no, we're having blackouts like every half hour!

All right, this is going to be your first real task, : go to him, learn what the problem is about, solve it, and then get his signature for your access form to the Wireframe project... The electronic signature, of course!

checkText.en: How are my tasks progressing, do you have a lot of work remaining?

finishText.en: Well then, let us try and conduct a little experiment!

goal.en: Talk to Negus Kambizet, complete his tasks and those given by his employees, then report readiness to him.

startText.en:
, I can assure you − the issue is not with our station! With the new experimental fuel based on Ambrosia, we could power two cities like Sar-Iram, and all the extant projects as well. That, of course, if the load is within parameters, which might not be the case.

Let's get to the bottom of this!

checkText.en: The spillage spots won't fix themselves!

finishText.en: Well, so the power output in the grid jumped by 146% at once! I was right! Now we pray that no one peels off the duct tape!

name.en: All we need is lots of duct tape!

startText.en:
Yes, it's all because of spillage, , I'm telling you! I've seen a stream of energy jet from a pipe, recently! Our grids are really lousy, since not only the load is high, but all kinds of critters are eating through them.

Anyway, take a huge roll of blue duct tape, go and plug all the holes! It'll make our life that much easier! Just be sure to take the blue one − it's more durable!

finishText.en: I've seen huge rolls of blue duct tape in the storage, so we'll be able to deal with all of the spillage! And that means that another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Eliminate 5 spillage spots on the mana pipeline.

name.en: State Services: Spillage on the Mana Pipeline

checkText.en: Robots want to kill all people! I've warned about that!

goal.en: Eliminate 10 aggressive Mechanoids.

startText.en:
The robots have revolted! Run for your lives!

No, I'm serious, , we're having a real problem with these viruses here. The last worm pierced the firewall and infected all the old Mender Robots! Now they've caused a real massacre here instead of screwing the nuts on and off! And what have we here? Not even a single muneph!

Eradicate the mad robots, please!

goal.en: Eliminate 12 aggressive Mechanoids.

checkText.en: A dragon the size of a Great Dragon — just imagine!

finishText.en: Well, that'll go in for analysis, but it seems there's nothing new... which is good!

goal.en: Obtain 10 biological samples from Black Dragons.

startText.en:
I used to work on the HAES in Nezebgrad once, and now I work here on XAES. And the difference is not just about that one letter, .

Out there, the worst thing that can happen are mutated rats and crows. Here, on XAES, the mana energy has attracted dragons! We have a suspicion that in time, they, too, would mutate and increase in size! Imagine the sight!

To avoid a nasty surprise like this, we need to monitor the events! Come and fetch me some samples of dragon flesh!

finishText.en: The lab folks report that they've found nothing novel or suspicious. Well, excellent − the mana station will keep on working, and this brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Obtain 12 biological samples from Black Dragons.

startText.en: In order to monitor the background radiation from the manastation's discharge, we need to collect biological samples from black dragons again. These creatures are exceedingly important for our studie, because their health is directly cnonnected to the condition of the whole local ecosystem. Don't forget that Black Dragons may be quite aggressive, so be cautious and prepared for resistance. You will also be able to tell whether they're really growing with each week.

checkText.en: Hey, Tep! I rocked your pyramid! I saw your mama at the brothel!

finishText.en: Did that help? Didn't I tell you! That always works! A 100% efficient method!

goal.en: Check 8 employees and expose Tep's hidden spies.
Check 8 employees and expose Tep's hidden spies.

startText.en: Tep and his fanatical followers keep harming us. They infiltrate every institution of the city, becoming "sleeper agents", and apprehending them is a difficult task. We need to check all of Mana Station's employees meticulously so that those who might be working for Tep are weeded out. Pay attention to their behavior and the way they interact with colleagues: spies are often acting suspiciously. I'm sure you will be able to identify them among regular workers − more so since you already have a solid method to rely on...

finishText.en: The cultists of ice have been dealt with! But don't you think they're just going to vanish. They're already making new plans for mining Zem-coins out of thin air. And we're still stuck with the Wireframe project, which is getting more and more complicated.

goal.en: Eliminate Yaver Arteia and 12 Path of Ice Heretics.

name.en: Safe Capital: Path of Ice Heretics

startText.en:
Time to eliminate the cultists of cold that are using the mana station's energy to mine Zem-coins. Yeah, sure is a genius idea! They think that freezing their own brains solid will make Zem-coins come rolling to them.

Let's show them that cold is not just about money, but about getting their hides chilled! Be ready to make them white hot! We have anything that might come handy, from heaters to hot tea − just don't get us frozen with their "genius ideas" while you're at it.

And don't forget that they might use their "super powers" to stop us. But we know for sure that true power is not in Jeb cash, but in quick wits!

goal.en: Eliminate 12 Nezebgrad clerks while disguised as Tep's agent.

startText.en:
We are facing the direst threat that might end up completely paralyzing our efforts. And no, this is not about gangs, cultists or hacked robots. I am talking about clerks! The officials from Nezebgrad who arrived on an inspection visit.

If they start trudging through our documentation, all of our work will be completely stalled.

I'm afraid only one course of action remains: kill them all!

Of course, this has to be done in a surreptitious way. For instance, a crazy fanatic of Tep might do the deed, right? Why not...

Take these rags, disguise yourself and send the clerks to meet the Servant of Tensess. They have only a little Mirra, so we're not going to see them for a while. They're now on the shore near the Mana Station, surveying the area.

finishText.en: The bikers got what they deserved! But don't you think they're just going to ride off into the sunset. They're already mustering their gang for renewed vengeance. And we will keep delving into our Wireframe project, which is clearly not going to become less complicated.

goal.en: Eliminate Semer Chibal and 10 biker girls.

startText.en:
Now we need to deal with the gang of biker women and their automobile-riding leader. The bikers are assured that speed trumps all.

Well, it's like they don't understand that being slow and smart is better sometimes.

Arm yourself with whatever you fancy, and let's show them that speed is now always the answer!

checkText.en: The most important thing is acting decisively and making no mistakes!

goal.en: Take part in testing the experimental reactor, following instructions from Negus Kambizet.

finishText.en: The reactor, and the XAES as a whole, are a crucial part of the city's infrastructure, so they need to be kept operational at all times. And the reactor directly influences the progress of the Wireframe project, making its completion closer.

goal.en: Take part in testing the experimental reactor, following instructions from Negus Kambizet.

checkText.en: Yeah, preparing for the gig is not that easy!

finishText.en: Looks like everything's ready... Shall we try hooking up to the grid?

startText.en:
Nomarkh Khey is writing to you:

"Hello, !

I have another problem here - and you, my deardarling friend, have already shown yourself as a manwoman well capable of solving any kind of issues, no matter how many are there. If you step up to my call, I promise you won't regret it!"

checkText.en: Well, how're our cucumbers there?

finishText.en: Excellent − the stage must be vacant so we have enough room to rock out! Out with the trash, down with the Empire!

goal.en: Remove 10 crates of aluminum cucumbers and 7 trash bins from the stage.

finishText.en: Gauging the morale of our citizens is an important part of our work. Everyone must be happy and content, this increases labor productivity. And that brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Remove 10 crates of aluminum cucumbers and 7 trash bins from the stage.

startText.en: The next request has been filed: trash needs to be taken out. Hey, don't you go making faces like that! We want to hold a gig for the city's people, but the communal services have piled up trash in the only suitable venue. Again. Someone's stacked trash bins and crates of aluminum cucumbers upon the stage. We need to remove all of that quickly so that the venue can be prepared for the performance. I entrust this job to you! Make sure everything is moved out so the musicians can start rehearsing on time.

finishText.en: Robobeasts! Tep take them! I knew they would be up to doing something nasty. This gang is becoming more and more dangerous.

goal.en: Find Sarbaz Rabiya and bring her to Nomarkh Khey.

finishText.en: Robobeasts are a separate problem resulting from the careless conduct by Negus Pilis! But we're solving it as well, so you ought to know that the completion of the Wireframe project is nearing!

goal.en: Find Sarbaz Ekayb and bring her to Nomarkh Khey, eliminating robobeasts along the way.

checkText.en: What took you so long? Here are the instruments, get started! We still have a lot to do...

finishText.en: Oh, this is the veritable music of the celestial spheres! We're gonna rock so hard that Rysina will be bouncing in her Nezebgrad!

goal.en: Help with tuning 6 pieces of equipment.

name.en: Music of the Waves, Music of the Wind

finishText.en: Excellent, we'll be able to start the gig soon! Preparation is always the most important part. And a gig that turns out well means the happy populace... and getting closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Help with tuning 6 pieces of equipment.

startText.en: The next request has been filed: the musicians want help in tuning their equipment. I think of offering the task to you, since you have been doing something like this before. Xadagan is full of various shemau: these are the artistic teams, and the kheni are their fans. As such, organizing concerts is an important process and a way of fulfilling the demands of the society!

checkText.en: She told you to do what?

finishText.en: Is that woman gone now? Alright, and then we'll replace the posters right back! By the way, do you know why Yasker's shaved off his moustache? Neither do I!

goal.en: Replace 7 street posters with portraits of Yasker.

name.en: What kind of vulgarity is that?!

finishText.en: Yes, I've already been commended for my vigilance! See, they're noticing all kinds of perversions strictly prohibited by the Code of the Imperial Future's Builder! The way it's going, they can even fine us... But so far, we're free of oversight, and therefore closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Replace 7 street posters near the concert venue with portraits of Yasker.

finishText.en:
Greetings!

Are you ready to collaborate? (Yes / No)

Are you ready to eliminate the common threat? (Yes / No)

Are you ready to receive the required information? (Yes / No)

goal.en: Find 6 leaks on the power cable by using the leak detector.

checkText.en: Execution not completed.

finishText.en:
Thank you for the cooperation, . Information concerning you has been extracted from the Jeb-net, complete analysis performed.

Basic information is required to create an efficient communication channel.

Reference: the Integral is the highest form of life, created by the Mechanoid community, initial location: location marked as "Mechanoids' Lair".

goal.en: Eliminate 12 of Tep's Cultists and find their taskmaster somewhere deep in the Mana Station's communication lines. Find the possible tunneling spot.

startText.en:
Thank you for the cooperation.

Evaluating necessities...

Analysing possibilities...

Issuing tasks...

Goal: recovering the initial program.

Method: eliminating violators.

Quantitative parameter: 12 creatures, gender male/female.

Description: Tep's Cultists Cult of Tep — organization. Leader — Tep. Multiple breaches of defensive perimeter.

Further communication possible following request execution.

goal.en: Enter the underground communication lines of the Mana Station and eliminate 12 of Tep's Cultists.

checkText.en: Have you found the cause of the blackouts?

finishText.en:
, it turns out that Tep's Cultists were responsible for all of this, since they hooked a machine superintelligence to the electric grid and made it calculate what Nefer Ur is up to?

Fascinating... that would've made a great song!

goal.en: Ask the Integral about the ways of fixing energy losses. To do this, you need to switch 4 levers in the following order: North-East-South-West.

startText.en:
The goal is rebooting the entire system. Remote maintenance work required. Maintenance performer required. Motivation − a reward. Size − standard.

Are you ready to collaborate, ? (Yes / No)

Are you ready to receive the required information, ? (Yes / No)

goal.en: Switch 4 levers in the required order: North-East-South-West.

checkText.en: We are ready. Are you, ?

finishText.en:
That was magnificient! I hope there will be many such performances ahead of us, and you deserve our most exalted gratitude!

I hope you will be able to find that which you are looking for, .

goal.en: Help with holding the gig.
Help with holding the gig.

startText.en: The next request has been filed: holding the concert with the Cinema band. I think that since you're so well acquainted with these musicians, it won't be too hard to hold this kind of cultural event! The fans have already assembled, the musicians are ready as well, so everyone's only waiting for you. So, let's roll! You will soon become a celebrity not unlike Nomarkh Khey!

checkText.en: The rats have been nibbling on the power cable today, but they just might chew through someone's neural cord tomorrow!

finishText.en: Yes, I've heard that squeaking − the sound of dying rats! I wish we could run such a deratting more frequently. I ought to submit a request to the city's department so they send me someone to do it regularly! Take it, here's the left leg of your comrade!

goal.en: Eradicate 12 port rats.

startText.en:
All right, I'll help you, , but you got to help me too! See, I have no spare hands either, hehe! The problem goes like that: all of the animals on our allod have gone extinct for a while, except the few most resilient species, mutated... We thought we were well rid of the rats as well! But actually, they get here on ships, then infest all the nooks and crannies, start chewing on the cables, the braiding... anything that looks even remotely edible!

We don't need this kind of critters here, so will you kindly thin their ranks a little!

goal.en: Eradicate 12 port rats.

checkText.en: I can't feel my legs!

finishText.en: What's been taking you so long? They were about to disassemble me for spare parts! Haven't I told you: this allod is dangerous! But you didn’t believe me! No amount of denial is going to help now!

goal.en: Carry 3 heavy crates to the ship.

finishText.en: Well, the request is done, the cargo is loaded, which means another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Carry 3 heavy crates to the ship.
Bring 6 Mechanoid Workers into order.

name.en: State Services: Repaiing the Robot Workers

startText.en: The next request has been filed: our Mechanoid Workers are in disarray again. They need servicing and tuning so they can be working efficiently again. Mechanoids can be finicky, so it's important to pay attention to each one of them, and perform full troubleshooting. I'm sure you know how to handle them. I entrust this task to you − just be sure to work without haste and check up every Mechanoid thoroughly!

finishText.en: The robots do not pose a threat anymore! But you know how it happens: Vanvaeck is already making plans for hacking the new models. And we're still stuck with the Wireframe project, which is getting more and more complicated. I hope you're ready for new adventure!

goal.en: Destroy 4 hacked Robotic Lifters.

startText.en:
Today's task: wreck the hacked Robotic Lifters in the city's port. The hacker, Negus Vanvaeck, was toying with them... as if she had nothing better to do!

Yes, yes, you heard it right, ladlass: instead of doing their job, the robots are dancing to the music and tossing cargo left and right. Let's show them that the party is over, and it's time to go back to reality! You have everything you might need to fight this mechanical bacchanalia: from heavy machinery to the good old method of "turning the power off first".

But be careful: Vanvaeck may try and bring her toys back to life. So you have to be prepared for a real battle between man and machine!

checkText.en: If only there's a pack of cigarettes...

goal.en: Help with installing the legs, then retrieve Yaver Bazar's right arm after finding whoever has taken it

checkText.en: So, what's there, will we be able to pass?

goal.en: Reach Nomarkh Khey's car while avoiding the fans

startText.en:
Yes, sure, I found the arm, too... Is that your arm, ? I thought maybe it came from one of the fans... You can't even imagine the antics the throw to get my attention!

I need to go on business, and these mad kheni are blocking my way at every turn... Will you help me get outta here? I'll give this arm to you if you do!

checkText.en: Well, shall we go?

finishText.en: There it is, that Mana Station of yours! And I'll ride on: my girl is sick, something's happened with her prosthetics!

goal.en: Get to the Mana Station district with Nomarkh Khey.

name.en: Alright, let me take you there!

finishText.en: Nomarkh Khey has been saved, and that means a new gig is soon upon us! With these fans, one should be ever wary! But that means another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Reach Nomarkh Khey's car while avoiding the fans
Eliminate 12 members of the Cheni and Rutess gang.

name.en: Safe Capital: Cheni and Rutess Gang

checkText.en: Gotta have a check-up after all these troubles!

goal.en: Help Yaver Bazar with getting all of his limbs back

startText.en:
Hey, hey, wait! I'm tired of waiting for you to run by, ! Just look at that what’s happening to me… Without arms I'm... disarmed! And without legs... I don't have a leg to stand on! Barely managing to crawl, and getting anywhere is completely out of question...

It's all the fault of these dumb cultists − they couldn't even set the portal up right! Tep's lost all the smart ones, only cretins like these remain now!

So, I have a suspicion all my missing limbs are somewhere around here, in the port! Try asking the superintendent.

checkText.en: Feats can't wait!

goal.en: Eliminate 50 hostile or neutral creatures on Xadagan and accumulate twenty 8-bit micro chips.

finishText.en: Have the Yahkebs gone off to keep suffering at home? Good, should have dealt with them a long time ago... Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Eliminate 12 members of the Yahkeb gang.

finishText.en: The cyberdrones are no longer threatening civilians, and that means another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Eliminate 12 cyberdrones.

checkText.en: We should definitely be making haste, Nefer Ur likes punctuality.

finishText.en:
You have arrived right in time so you can share our triumph!

We have found... one of Tep's portals! Yes, one of those built back in the times of Hickut, when Tep and his loyal followers were creating the Pyramids.

You may remember that the great necromancer has placed his Spark storage facilities all over Yul, don't you?

These portals were made for quick transportation... Of course, over the centuries, they got buried by sediment, and then, cities were built first by the surviving Junes, then the Kanians and the Xadaganians... But we've managed to unearth the entrance.

goal.en: Talk to Sarang Kido, Nefer Ur's agent, ask her about the latest news and go whever she suggests.

name.en: Nefer Ur knows what to do

finishText.en: Excellent! Now we have everything that is required for the primary job. Of course, the hardest part is ahead of us!

startText.en: and everyone... I suppose we have a chance to solve both of our problems: you will help us with activating the portal, and we will come with you to Xadagan so that we might report our discovery. Unfortunately, even though we've already managed to unearth the portal's entrance, its full activation is still far away. We've already solved almost all of our problems, but it's getting more dangerous out here with each passing day − Sardrok is nearby, and something odd is happening there.

checkText.en: Put an end to the witless undead − it's enough that we, the Arisen, are here!

finishText.en: Could it really be silence? Am I no longer hearing the creaking of rusty boots, nor the clanging of holey helmets? Pure bliss! Thank you...

goal.en: Eliminate 12 skeletons near the excavation grounds.

checkText.en: I'm still waiting for the batteries! Get them here, pronto! Right now!

finishText.en:
Hah, it looks like we won't have to slit any throats today after all... Yes, that'll be enough to fulfill our task. You got lucky.

Now we need to find a way to connect them correctly. And you may go! Go on!

goal.en: Find 8 ancient batteries to activate the portal.

startText.en:
We're not going anywhere until we have enought energy! , are you seeing a Mana Station around here, perchance? Right, nor do I...

And these old portals are consuming energy like there's no tomorrow. How did they even work around this, I wonder? They were bringing in captives, slitting their throats and feeding the portals with blood magic!

You don't want us to sacrifice you, and these historians too, do you?

Then go and find batteries! They're scattered all around the place, and there's quite enough of them to start up the portal once!

checkText.en: Find the components, and then we'll be able to tell what to do next!

finishText.en: Well, the lights are blinking, there's no smoke, nothing's blown up! It means everything was done right! O great Nih, share some of your wisdom with me...

goal.en: Find 4 components of Tep's portal and install them to appropriate lodgements.

startText.en:
Tep is great! He was building it to last centuries... millennia! Isn't it marvelous that his Pyramids are still operational? Just like this portal...

But a few components are missing. Which ones exactly? If only I knew... I need to think...

However, , if you manage to collect the components that seem orphaned but looking like they might fit this portal, we can try and put all of them together...

And if it proceeds to work then, it would mean we've assembled everything correctly!

finishText.en: Owie! Job's done, heh. See you at the portal!

goal.en: Disable the turrets in the portal room

name.en: Stop, or the turret will open fire

startText.en:
Excellent − we now proceed to the final phase of our operation, .

We need to reach the portal itself. Unfortunately, after the Cult of Tep was broken in the battle of the Coba Plateau, the control codes for the portal's defensive mechanisms were lost. The turrets in the dungeon are now attacking any living target, protecting the portal securely.

We need to bypass the defenses somehow. Luckily, there is an indispensable specialist among the Historians − a true veteran of infiltration and covert operations. He will be just the man we need − ask him for advice and find a way to disable the defenses.

checkText.en: Don't tarry − we need to open the portal!

finishText.en: Damn it! I hate the surprises like that... The Historians are drafting all kind of rabble without checking their backgrounds... again! Alright, since we have the portal, shall we use it?

goal.en: Activate the portal on Nomarkh Jezerith's command.

startText.en:
Wonderful! Honestly speaking, I'm already tired of waiting for this operation to conclude. Well, thank you for the cooperation,  − I suggest we activate the portal and... see what happens next.

We will have to hold a little ritual to finalize the activation of all mechanisms and to create a stable connection between Jigran and Xadagan. I guess no one there is expecting that, heh heh.

Let's do it!

finishText.en: Excellent! I knew you'd be interested...

goal.en: Meet Sarang Kido on Jigran

startText.en:
"You must return to Jigran at once to meet me. Important news have arrived from Nefer Ur, but I will tell the details when we meet."

It looks like this letter is from that Zem Arisen who was sent to Jigran by Nefer Ur in order to monitor the situation. Looks like she wants to meet you again.

checkText.en: Well, how much longer do I have to wait?

finishText.en:
Excellent! You're here...

Remember that one of the Neguses is a traitor? It's definitely not Kambizet, and not Menes, as it is clear now... But who?

I've managed to learn something about these numerous gangs that have overrun the city – all of their tracks are leading to the "Dome"... to Negus Pilis! It was him who is creating all these augmentations – those the robobeasts are using to enhance their bodies...

It was thanks to him that the priests once became who they were – so if we want to find out whether he's connected to them in any way, we need to go to the "Dome" and scout it out...

goal.en: Meet Sarang Kido and receive a new task from her.

startText.en:
Sarang Kido is writing to you:

"Hello, ! I hope you are done with your business at the "Library", because I have an exceedingly important lead that might help us with understanding whatever's happening on the allod of Xadagan! I suggest we meet at the "Library's" exit."

checkText.en: So, when is the test specimen going to be brought back?!

startText.en: I was able to make you a deputy assistant at the Dome − had to forge the papers. So they're already expecting you to come and start the job. You can go right now, . I don't think anyone will suspect you of anything, especially since no one will give you any complicated tasks for the time being anyway. Learn what Negus Pilis is doing there, for starters.

checkText.en: Were you able to bring Ahbu back?

goal.en: Buy a rare cartridge of games and give it to Ahbu to convince him to come to the dome for continuing the experiments.
Buy a rare cartridge of games and give it to Ahbu to convince him to come to the dome for continuing the experiments.

name.en: Scientific Problem: New Tests for Ahbu

startText.en:
, have you already been told that the turtles outside the Dome have been mutating uncontrollably? Trouble! They're a real kind of pests... So much effort's been made to exterminate them! These creatures hide in pipelines, feed on mushrooms and survive in places where nothing else can live.

These two plumber brothers, Marioch and Luzidj, have just set out to exterminate another brood...

But what I want to know is, what makes these turtles so resilient. It might still be caused by our effluent which carries the particles of Eden and Umoir floras...

finishText.en:
Have you collected all the shells and dealt with Cuppa? Bravo! Now we have the opportunity to conduct a unique experiment testing the durability of turtle shells. I hope you've not left any traces on the "crime scene", or we might end up facing a new generation of turtles with a vengeful streak!

Especially not after that story with the princess... who hasn't been found yet! Even though Marioch and Luzidj have crawled through all kinds of filth...

Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

name.en: Scientific Problem: Turtles of the Dome

checkText.en: Have you managed to collect the samples?

goal.en: Collect 6 samples of Umoir flora and 6 samples of Eden flora.

startText.en:
Greetings, colleague! I've already been told that you are the one to turn to when gathering samples is needed... Our Dome is currently conducting experiments on cultivating flora that is not typical for Xadagan − we grow the samples found by our employees while on scientific expeditions. At present, we have two types of biota − the exoplanetary one, from Eden, and the warped one from Umoir. Both of these are distinguished by their elevated content of the "life force" that manifests in very fascinating ways when juxtaposed against necrotic tissue.

It may be, though, that the currently available samples have less of that force, by the factor of... several times. We have, thus far, been unable to reach the same result as on the territories where the control samples had been taken.

Bring me the samples, , and I will perform the required measurements.

finishText.en:
Perfect! Have you collected the samples of Eden's flora? I hope they didn't try to bite you while being collected?!

Now, we can perform analysis and learn which of these plants might become the base for new dishes... or maybe even a whole new menu!

Who knows? You may have just discovered a new culinary direction! At any rate, this brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Collect 12 samples of Eden's flora.

name.en: Applied Studies: Samples of Eden's flora

startText.en:
Greetings, my favorite botanist!

We require the samples of Eden's flora. Eden is both the paradise on earth and a true trial for your skills, all at once. You need to collect the specimens of that wonderful plant life. I hope you're ready to face plants that can be both beautiful and dangerous as well?

Don't forget to make a self-snap with the most exotic samples − they might end up being the newest wonders of the Jeb-net!

finishText.en:
Well done! Have you collected the samples of Umoir's flora? I hope they've not been trying to "massage" you on your way back here! We can now study their properties and find out how dangerous they are for our health... Or, conversely, if they might become the basis for a new type of Zombie cocktail!

This is going to be fun either way! Maybe... And another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Collect 12 samples of Umoir's flora.

name.en: Applied Studies: Samples of Umoir's flora

startText.en:
Hey, hey, hey! Are you ready for a new trial? We need samples of flora from Umoir, this mutating, dangerous world. It will fall upon you to collect the plant specimens while making sure that none of them tries to "embrace" you with their tentacles. Be cautious: some of them might have quite... intriguing properties.

If you happen to encounter something truly bizarre, make a snap for the scientific report! Or for black humor.

checkText.en: Animated first, then killed, then animated again, then killed once more... So much for the life cycle.

finishText.en: Excellent! They are dead again now... And we will animate them if we need that.

goal.en: Eliminate 6 Necro-Rhinos, 6 Necro-Yaks and one "Precious".

finishText.en: Excellent! Have you dealt with this cybernetic threat? We can now analyze their biomechanical structure and learn how they were able to mesh living tissue with metal. Our work brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Eliminate 6 Necro-Rhinos, 6 Necro-Yaks and one "Precious".

startText.en:
Listen, we've got a bit of a problem with necrobeings − Necro-Yaks and Necro-Rhinos! These cyborgs were created with parts of dead animals and metal, and they're clearly not fitting with the idea of scientific progress as we understand it now. They are roaming our laboratories and evidently holding their own zombie contests for the honor of being called the most intimidating creatures around.

I want to find out how their biomechanical systems function with such a monstrous amalgamation of organic and mechanical parts. So be sure to act carefully − don't let them gain access to our experimental data! And deal with the "Precious" while you're at it − her skills are demoralizing the personnel...

checkText.en: Have you learned how to make snaps?

finishText.en: Wonderful! I hope the pictures turn out well −I'll check your desorotypes later!

goal.en: Put up 5 cameras in various places around the Dome and make photos. If you run out of cameras, Yasskul Bahadur can give you a spare.

checkText.en: Has the experiment been conducted successfully?

goal.en: Put up 5 cameras in various places around the Dome and make photos.

startText.en:
Ah, hello, my deardarling mentee! We have a little problem here... or, as I like to call it, a "scientific challenge". We need to learn what kind of change has occurred within our scientific grounds. And I thought you are the ideal mangirl for this job.

You see, I have a suspicion that the things that are happening there might cause not just scientific interest in you... but also the desire to run for the nearest cocktail bar. So grab your cameras and get to snapping! I hope you're not averse to some desorotyping... specifically to capture these "peculiar" changes.

checkText.en: Have you managed to collect anything?

finishText.en: Wonderful! It just takes a glance to see that an incomprehensible mutation has occurred... All right, now we need to study it in more detail. For instance, what happens if that black sludge were to be ingested... Do you want to try? Alright, if you don't, I'll offer it to our Xadaganian interns...

goal.en: Collect 4 salt crystals, 4 mushrooms and 4 samples of black sludge from the pipes.

finishText.en: Wonderful! Have you collected the crystals? I see you're not just a brave ladlass, but a rather lucky one as well! We can now conduct experiments and learn how this particular salt might influence the perception of reality. Be ready for adventure in any case! Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Collect 12 samples of toxic hallucinogenic salt.

finishText.en:
Well done! Have you collected the mushrooms? I hope none of them were trying to "hug" you on your way back?

We can now study their properties and learn how toxic they are... or, conversely, how safe.

In any case, I'm ready for experimenting! This brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

startText.en:
Hey, you! Yes, it's you I'm talking to!

I need to have poisonous mutant mushrooms collected. They look like scintillating blue orbs − almost like those toys from your childhood, except they're more dangerous, and less safe to health.

And yes, they might cause hallucinations... or a desire to dance in the rain. So grab your containers and go hunting these "balls". I'm sure you'll be able to find them... without losing your head in the process!

finishText.en:
Bravo! Have you collected the sludge?

We can now study its properties and learn how it might affect our health... or at least our mood. Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Collect 8 samples of black sludge from the pipes.

startText.en:
Hello, hello! I have a special task for you: collecting that greenish-black sludge from the sewers. Yes, yes, you heard it right, ladlass!

This sludge has peculiar properties − it might even become the basis for a new type of "otherworldly elixir".

But be careful: who knows what else might lurk in these depths? So put on your gloves and off you go − time to explore the depths of our scientific wonder!

checkText.en: Are the Deviance Removers not installed yet?

startText.en:
Hey, intern! We have a problem here... a very serious one!

The Dome's functions are facilitated by generators installed around its perimeter. If they stop working even for a second, the purity of our experiment will be compromised at once, because the system will lose its isolation. But current readings indicate that the generators are becoming unbalanced! Something needs to be done, and thankfully I have working compensator devices here. Installing three of them − one each on the northern, southern and western sides − will be enough! Get there at once and place them as soon as possible, !

finishText.en:
Oh, my! Have you set up the generators? Excellent!

Our dome is now prepared again to protect us from all kinds of trouble. I hope you haven't got yourself burned with these wires and devices − that would've been too tragic for our project. Anyway, we can now proceed with our research without undue obstacles! And that brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Install 4 deviance removers in specified points around the Dome.

finishText.en: Have you dealt with these vampiric sadists? Excellent! We can now go about more important research − like learning why they love the color red so much. I hope we're not going to find any "bloody" books in their archives! And our research is bringing us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Destroy Bloodthirster and 12 Path of Blood heretics.

name.en: Scientific Problem: Path of Blood Heretics

finishText.en: Have you dealt with this zombie problem? Excellent! We can now take to analyzing their cell structures so that we might learn how they were "processed" by the Imperial scientists. Research is bringing us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project!

goal.en: Eliminate 12 necrozombies

finishText.en: So, have you dealt with these Executioner Zombies? Excellent! We will now be able to study their methods and learn exactly how they've become so "proficient" at their trade. The data we receive brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Eliminate 12 Executioner Zombies and Hickut's Executioner.

finishText.en:
Well, is the problem solved? I hope you've not left any of the "mummies" alive! Now I can start studying their methods of reanimation. But there's a problem: I've lost several samples of their "necrosystems", and now we need to learn how they were able to enhance their dead bodies so quickly.

The new data brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Eliminate 12 of Peraach's servants.

startText.en:
Listen up, we've got a real archaeological disaster here! The reanimated servants of the ancient Despot have risen again − and they're thinking that it's time to bring back the good old times, with pyramidal taxes and hydraulic reign!

Not only these folks are skilled with creating mummies − apparently, they are well versed in politics, too. I suspect that they're trying to resurrect their master and give us all a "necropolis revolution"! We are in peril of becoming the victims of another "despotic renaissance" unless you stop them.

So, move out, examine their motivation and put an end to this threat!

finishText.en: Excellent! Have you dealt with these mechanical rioters? I can now go about studying their innards and finding out what kind of algorithm has caused this kind of unexpected behaviour. Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Eliminate 4 Disassembly Robots

startText.en:
Are you aware that Negus Shuponu has finally greenlighted the experiment of creating huge Disassembly Robots? But something went wrong, as it always does: they've been hacked, and now they behave as though they are under the "Attack all humans!" spell! These mechanisms can disassemble just about anything down to the tiniest parts... in mere seconds.

I want to know what exactly has gone wrong with their software − could it be a virus, or too much code from old games was used! So grab your tools and wipe out these mechanical monsters before they disassemble the entire research center on the Cosmodrome!

finishText.en: Have you exposed the alien? Excellent! Now we can study his methods of disguising himself and learn how exactly was he able to fool our entire space program. This is important for the Wireframe project's security.

goal.en: Talk to the cosmonauts and expose the disguised alien.

checkText.en: Have you managed to test everything?

finishText.en: As you can see, our invention works well! This will change everything!

startText.en:
Colleague!

We are happy to present our unique invention − the biobeam, or the Ray of Life! The Power of Light, the Gift of Tensess, Hirkalla's Engine? That's all so last century!

We can now reanimate whoever we want by using a simple device. We have managed to isolate the energy that permeates Eden and Umoir, we were successful in turning regular mana into the power that reanimates everything... And we've even filled someone who is already alive with this energy, making them stronger, faster, smarter!

But everything must be tested on control specimens! Do you want to know in greater detail about what we're doing, ?

checkText.en: I bet on Ahbu − the power of the ray will make him unbeatable!

finishText.en: Exactly what was to be demonstrated! With the ray, our finest robobeast is unbeatable!

goal.en: Use the Ray of Life on Ahbu and fight 6 robobeasts on the testing arena.
Use the Ray of Life on Ahbu and fight 6 robobeasts on the testing arena.

name.en: Scientific Problem: Robobeasts of the Dome

checkText.en: It will be exceedingly curious to see how dead flesh reacts to being affected with the beam...

finishText.en: Well, so the effect was even stronger than our calculations implied! It's curious now, what happens to living creatures, can the reaction become self-sustaining?

goal.en: Use the Ray of Life on 8 plants inside the dome and 8 dead cyber-organisms: snakes, Necro-Yaks or Necro-Rhinos.

finishText.en:
Excellent! Have you irradiated all the cacti? I hope they didn't decide to spread their thorns around as gratitude for your care! We can now observe their growth and learn whether they can become the "stars" of our botanical show.

If everything sticks to the plan, we might even be able to create a new species of cactus intended for romantic parties!

goal.en: Use the Ray of Life on 12 cacti within the Dome.

startText.en: Greetings to you, my inquisitive friend! I have a "prickly" task for you: irradiating our cacti with the special ray of life. Yes, exactly that! We want to learn how much they can grow and how... attractive they might become. It's like dating plants: the more attention you lavish on them, the greater your chances of success! So grab your ray gun and move out: time to make a cocktail of science and botanics!

finishText.en:
Oh, great! Have you returned them to life?

I hope they didn't start seeking you out to hold, ah, an intimate party! We can now observe their behavior and learn how they react to the environment around them. If you're lucky, they might serve as inspiration for new scientific experiments... or at least for a good new joke! Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

name.en: Applied Studies: Necro-creatures of the Dome

finishText.en:
Excellent! Have you reanimated the robosnakes? I hope they didn't start flirting with you! Now we can study their behavior and learn what's really going on inside their "hearts of iron".

If we're lucky, they might even help us with creating a new type of "robo-partners" for scientific experiments... or at least for parties! Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Use the Ray of Life on 12 dead cyber-organisms − robosnakes.

name.en: Applied Studies: Robosnakes of the Dome

finishText.en: Excellent results, and each of them will become the start of a great new discovery sooner or later!

goal.en: Ask 5 juniour employees about the results of their experiments.

startText.en:
Let's not forget other experiments that are being run in the Dome. The interaction of the living and dead matter, the cybernetic and the necromantic, is our area of expertise. Our designs have helped with improving the lives of a great many Arisen, and we need to keep working in that direction.

For that, we need to collect the reports from our junior employees so we can single out the most promising directions. Collect their reports, , and I will study them later...

finishText.en:
Wonderful! Have you questioned them? Was it exciting to hear their "scientific" explanations? I hope you've not forfeited hope for their intelligence!

We now have the data required for analysis − let's hope they don't turn into another absurdist "masterpiece". Science demands sacrifice... and sometimes, also a good sense of humor! Remember, this brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Ask 5 juniour employees about the results of their experiments.

finishText.en: Excellent! Now we only have to wait for the eggs to hatch, then we evaluate the results!

goal.en: Use the beam on 12 eggs outside the Dome.

finishText.en:
Oh, my! Have you used the beam on the eggs? I hope they didn't try to throw you a messy party with their contents! Now we can observe the process to learn what our "experimental" eggs give us.

If we're lucky, we might be able to create a new "pet" for the labs... or at least for parties! Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Use the beam on 12 eggs outside the Dome.

startText.en:
Greetings to you again! We have an exciting task: you need to use the Ray of Life on the eggs of unidentified reptiles outside the Dome.

Yes, I know, it sounds like the start of a bad horror cinema, but believe me: we're looking for the ideal mutant! Don't eschew precautions: these eggs may be not only "tasty", but quite dangerous as well. So grab your ray gun and go hunting for these "evolutionary masterpieces".

I hope you're not averse to take a little flight of imagination... what might hatch from these eggs?

checkText.en: Have you managed to save the city?

finishText.en: The Committee is already aware of the extremely dangerous activities of Negus Pilis and his assistant, Yasskul Bahadur! We are arresting both for criminal negligence that very nearly lead to casualties among the citizens of Sar-Iram...

goal.en: Talk to Sarang Kido, complete 4 tasks given by her and the Dome's employees.

checkText.en: There's a fair amount of toxins there, and we've had no chance to dispose of them without haste.

finishText.en: Yes, we might be able to cobble together some sort of weapon by using them! We just have to find a convenient way to toss them as far as we can!

goal.en: Collect 6 barrels of toxins around the Dome and use them to inflict damage upon the enemies.

startText.en: Thankfully, we have our own method of combating various biological objects! Over the years of our work, we've accumulated a huge stockpile of toxins... You can find them near the dome's generators. If you can gather enough of these barrels, you can freely toss them at the enemies! The mixture of acid and poison will leave them with no chances! But be careful not to get into a puddle of that stuff yourself, .

finishText.en:
Excellent! Have you collected the barrels? We can now study these toxins and learn about their influence on our "scientific" environment.

If we're lucky, we might even end up creating a new kind of poisonous cocktail! Anyway, another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Collect 12 barrels of toxins around the Dome.

startText.en:
Hey, hey, hey! We are in need of your extraordinary abilities – we must collect barrels with exceedingly virulent toxins around the Dome. Yes, yes, you heard it right, ladlass!  Sure, I know it sounds like an invitation to a dinner with naught but venom served, but believe me: it is important science!

We must learn how these toxins might influence our ecosystem... or at the very least, our mood. So grab your gloves and go looking for these "treats"!

checkText.en: It's a shame they can't run... Though it also means Vanvaeck can't hack them, since they're not connected to the Jeb-net...

finishText.en: Indeed, the defense turrets are exceedingly effective, and they will be wiping out both heretics and mutants! We should fetch additional sets from the storage, just for some time in future...

goal.en: Activate 12 defense turrets around the Dome.

finishText.en:
Bravo! Have you activated the turrets? I hope they didn't try starting a "fireworks party" for you straight out of the gate! We can now watch them go to work and make sure that they're really protecting us against all the threats.

The solid defense brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Activate 12 defense turrets around the Dome.

startText.en:
Greetings to you again! We are in need of your help − the defense turrets around the Dome must be activated. Yes, exactly that!

These cute little pieces of machinery will be defending us against mutant reptiles and the Path of Poison Heretics trying to get in the way. I know you would have preferred to do something more "romantic", but believe me, this is necessary for our survival! So grab your tools and move out − time to make these turrets work towards our safety!

checkText.en: Have you tracked down the crocodile? They say it's grown to really monstrous size!

goal.en: Eliminate 12 mutants and 1 particularly dangerous mutated crocodile around the Dome.
Eliminate 12 mutants and 1 particularly dangerous mutated crocodile around the Dome.

startText.en:
We have a real problem with mutant reptiles! These giant creatures can explode after their final mutation − it is as if you ran into a living, walking bomb!

I want to learn what is the exact trigger for such a catastrophic reaction in their biochemistry. So be careful: they might "greet" you with their volatile temper! Don't forget to bring protective gear along − we definitely don't want to lose a valuable researcher!

checkText.en: I did get an offer to join the Heretics, once! But I declined...

goal.en: Kill 12 Path of Poison Heretics before they catch the mutated beasts.

finishText.en: Have you dealt with this venomous problem? Perfect! Now I can analyze their "cocktails" and determine the exact components they were using for their sinister rituals. This brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Kill Poison Spitter and 12 Path of Poison Heretics.

name.en: Scientific Problem: Path of Poison Heretics

startText.en:
Look, we've got an incursion by the Path of Poison Heretics − the original abusers of prohibited substances! They would consume anything they can find: from poisonous mushrooms to the chemical waste from our laboratories.

These folks are clearly intent on "experimenting" with creating a new kind of Arisen − or rather, new types of mutants! I want to learn what compounds they're using, and how that influences their physiology. So be cautious: they might offer you some of their "treats", but I would very much doubt their safety!

checkText.en: Oh, why did it have to be this way...

finishText.en: Ahh, so scandalous... how could we mix up these eggs! But haven't you seen: the beam was working all right... And the other experiments we did were quite successful, .

goal.en: You and agent Makalani must arrest Negus Pilis and Yasskul Bahadur.

finishText.en: I fear it'll take a while to sort out the consequences of that hacking attack... But still, we're coming closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Eliminate 12 mechanical scorpions.

startText.en: The next request has been filed: mechanical scorpions were observed on the allod's territory, and their numbers are over the critical threshold. We need to get rid of these creatures to ensure the safety of the populace. Like other mechanoids before them, they have been hacked by Negus Vanvaeck, and they might be dangerous, so you must act cautiously and thoroughly. I'm sure you're more than capable to deal with this task! Onward, and show them who's the boss here!

finishText.en: We won't be able to continue with the construction without metal... Thankfully we have enough now. And we are coming ever closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

goal.en: Find 10 sheets of salvage metal.

checkText.en: Obtain microchips, gain new capabilities.

finishText.en: As you can see, it is very convenient! Use Jeb Converters and discover new horizons! The New Reality is nigh! Farewell, hero!

goal.en: Start training in Jeb technologies of the Xadagan allod.

checkText.en: Be sure to hear all the messages!

goal.en: Hear all of Tep's speeches.

finishText.en: Access to Hairstyle Change service activated!

goal.en: Activate the item and gain access to hairstyle change in the Xadagan network through the Sarekh-Ahau terminal.

checkText.en: How is it going? Ah, I envy you so much! Day-to-day life of the heroes must be so exciting.

finishText.en:
Excellent! Another day, another feat! Keep up the good work!

Let me remind you, that if you complete five of my quests in a week, you will receive a valuable prize!

goal.en: Complete the second round of June Catacombs or defeat the final boss on an Astral allod. Return to Zinaida Krichalkina for reward.

name.en: Not a Day without a Feat

startText.en:
Greetings to the heroes! Do you wish to serve your motherland?

Golem races in June Catacombs are fun! And apart from fun, the winner gets a very valuable reward. We should participate in them, too. Let everyone know that our heroes are the fastest and the deftest in Sarnaut!

If you don't fancy speed racing, then just go to the Astral and deal with monsters on one of the allods!

Good luck in your deeds!

goal.en: Win a Goblinball match or complete the Path of Trials quest in Tka-Rik's Cave. Return to Zinaida Krichalkina.

startText.en:
Greetings to the heroes! Do you wish to serve your motherland?

Have you ever played Goblinball? If not, you should definitely try it! it is traditional orcish sports activity, and orcs know how to have fun!

If you don't fancy sports and rather commit feats on your own, then Tka-Rik's Cave is waiting for you with all sorts of trials!

Good luck in your deeds!

goal.en: Win any Skirmish or complete any Distortion. Return to Zinaida Krichalkina.

startText.en:
Greetings to the heroes! Do you wish to serve your motherland?

Are you familiar with the thrill of real Skirmishes? When you descend upon the enemy shoulder to shoulder with your allies and clash in the fire of true battle? Go to the Battleground and see who's the strongest!

If you do not seek battle glory, you can gather your allies and set out to a Distortion. Finish several dangerous monsters that dwell there!

Good luck in your deeds!

goal.en: Fight at the Arena of Death or complete the Astral Hunt quest, which is given by Nastassja Ushkuynikova in the Hangar. Return to Valya Skomorokhova.

name.en: Not a Day without a Feat

startText.en:
Greetings to the heroes! Do you wish to serve your motherland?

Arena of Death is a battleground where every day two great armies fight in a thrilling battle. Those who prove their supremacy, win the treasures of the Arena and glory for their guild. Don't miss your chance to participate!

If you are interested in more exciting activities, gather your own team and set out on the Astral hunt! The head of Demon Hunters in the Hangar will reward you generously for that, and so will we.

Good luck in your deeds!

goal.en: Kill 30 enemies in the Kingdom of Elements with your War Banner raised or reach the finish line in the race on Kirah. Return to Zinaida Krichalkina.

startText.en:
Greetings to the heroes! Do you wish to serve your motherland?

The League and the Empire have been sharing their interest in the Kingdom of Elements recently. Who knows how many secrets and ancient treasures it conceals? And there where the greatest enemies of Sarnaut have a common interest, a war breaks out inevitably. Go to the Kingdom of Elements and a help a group of researchers. But be ready to repel unexpected attacks!

If you are not interested in this kind of entertainment, I can suggest something else - like races on Kirah! Participating in them is worthwhile whether you win or not!

Good luck in your deeds!

checkText.en: How is it going? Ah, I envy you so much! Day-to-day life of the heroes must be so exciting.

finishText.en: Excellent! Another day, another feat! Keep up the good work!

goal.en: Complete 5 Heroic Adventures.

startText.en:
I've heard about heroic adventures. People say a lot of noble heroes died in their pursuit of a mythical reward. But there's nothing you can't handle, right?

Then here's a task for you. Complete Heroic Adventures five times.

checkText.en: How is it going? Ah, I envy you so much! Day-to-day life of the heroes must be so exciting.

finishText.en: Excellent! Another day, another feat! Keep up the good work!

goal.en: Win 10 times in 6x6 combats.

startText.en:
There's nothing like a good fight for you, heroes, eh?

Your task is to defeat your opponent in 6x6 combat ten times.

checkText.en: No, you've come too soon. I've been counting your feats!

finishText.en:
One, two, three, four... Right, here are all the feats, just as I asked. Isn't it good to feel so important?

Here is your reward!

goal.en: Complete 7 Heroic Feats and return to Zinaida Krichalkina for reward.

startText.en:
Hey, noble hero! You seem bored! I have a task just for to test your bravery!

Ten feats, no more, no less! And something very valuable to reward you. You'll find it useful in your adventures. It's the Encyclopedia of Minerals and Herbs! Are you interested?

goal.en: Complete 5 Heroic Adventures.

startText.en:
I've heard about heroic adventures. People say a lot of noble heroes died in their pursuit of a mythical reward. But there's nothing you can't handle, right?

Then here's a task for you. Complete Heroic Adventures five times.

goal.en: Win 10 times in 6x6 combats.

startText.en:
There's nothing like a good fight for you, heroes, eh?

Your task is to defeat your opponent in 6x6 combat ten times.

checkText.en: No, you've come too soon. I've been counting your feats!

finishText.en:
One, two, three, four... Right, here are all the feats, just as I asked. Isn't it good to feel so important?

Here is your reward!

goal.en: Complete 7 Heroic Feats and return to Valya Skomorokhova for reward.

startText.en:
Hey, noble hero! You seem bored! I have a task just for to test your bravery!

Ten feats, no more, no less! And something very valuable to reward you. You'll find it useful in your adventures. It's the Encyclopedia of Minerals and Herbs! Are you interested?

finishText.en:
There you are! I knew you'd be interested. I've got an order to help all lagging Imperial heroes catch up! Complete one of my Not a Day without a Feat quests, and you will get a chance to obtain level 8 Runes at a very low price!

You will have only one chance to do so. Let's go for it!

goal.en: Talk to Zinaida Krichalkina in Nezebgrad to accept the offer.

startText.en: Find Zinaida Krichalkina and ask her about the runes.

finishText.en:
There you are! I knew you'd be interested. The League needs its heroes! Complete one of my Not a Day without a Feat quests, and you will get a chance to obtain level 8 Runes at a very low price!

You will have only one chance to do so. Let's go for it!

goal.en: Talk to Valya Skomorokhova in Novograd to accept the offer.

startText.en: Find Valya Skomorokhova and ask about the runes.

checkText.en: No, you've come too soon. I've been counting your feats!

goal.en: Complete the daily quest "Not a Day without a Feat" 5 times. return to Zinaida Krichalkina.

finishText.en: One, two, three, four, five! Right, five feats, just as I asked. Isn't it good to feel so important?

goal.en: Complete the daily quest "Not a Day without a Feat" 5 times. return to Zinaida Krichalkina.

startText.en:
Here you are! Have you heard the news? We are calling on all the heroes and encourage them to commit daily feats for the benefit of our homeland! Peace and prosperity for the people, and honor and fun for the heroes! And some great rewards, too.

The conditions are simple. You will be rewarded for each feat you commit with something that will prove very useful in your travels. If you complete our quests 5 times in a row, we will generously pay you with gold and some powerful potions from the Boutique!

Don't miss your chance! This doesn't happen every day. It is quite tiresome to keep record of your deeds, you know.

finishText.en: Are you a volunteer? Are you ready to prepare the best party ever?

goal.en: Yes, I'm ready to help.

startText.en:
Wait a minute! It's you I've been looking for! I heard about your adventures, and I know you're a champion. This is just what we need. What, don't you know what goes on here? We're getting ready for an Anniversary, whole Sarnaut is celebrating it.

By saying "we", I mean all members of the Holiday Committee and our chief, Brooser the Snap.

I've got stuff to do. If you want to help, talk to Brooser!

finishText.en: Are you a volunteer? Are you ready to prepare the best party ever?

goal.en: Yes, I'm ready to help.

startText.en:
Wait a minute! It's you I've been looking for! I heard about your adventures, and I know you're a champion. This is just what we need. What, don't you know what goes on here? We're getting ready for an Anniversary, whole Sarnaut is celebrating it.

By saying "we", I mean all members of the Holiday Committee and our chief, Solemna de Ardeur.

I've got stuff to do. If you want to help, talk to Solemna!

checkText.en: Don't just stand there, the clock is ticking!

finishText.en: Nice! Let's wait for the reply... I hope the orcs can write, which I doubt.

goal.en: Mount the anniversary horse and deliver invitations to three special guest. Report to Brooser the Snap.

kickText.en: Have you fallen off the horse? Try again then. I've got enough copies of the invitation.

startText.en:
I'm really sick of these formal dinners. Black ties, white ties, tuxedos, all of it look stupid on an orc. We need to throw a party party! You know, lots of food, beverages and fun! Do you like the idea? I bet you do! But wait, you have a couple of assignments to fulfil before we start.

We need to invite guests, right? Here are the invitations, here's the list of guest. Everything's simple - take the list and deliver the notes!

I will also give you a horse for speedy delivery. She's not just some hunchback horsey - she's really beautiful, strong and fast. Don't forget to feed her properly and smack her as you ride. She's the fastest of all!

One more thing. I overheard that werefoxes have grown in numbers in IMD, so run for your life, if you come across any of them!

checkText.en: What are you waiting for? Go, go now!

finishText.en: Nice! Let's wait for the reply... Come back tomorrow for more assignments.

goal.en: Mount the anniversary horse and deliver invitations to three special guest. Report to Solemna de Ardeur.

kickText.en: Have you fallen off the horse? Try again then. I've got enough copies of the invitation.

startText.en:
What is trendy nowadays? Apart from you know what, people love to make idols. It's what all people need - to have someone to hope on, to copy, to follow... We need to find suitable heroes.

Here is a list of three candidates. I need you to deliver invitations to them here, in Lightwood, as fast as you can. After they send me there replies, I will have to schedule their speeches and think of a seating chart.

I will also give you a horse for speedy delivery. She's not just some hunchback horsey - she's really beautiful, strong and fast. Don't forget to feed her properly and smack her as you ride. She's the fastest of all!

One more thing. I overheard that werefoxes have grown in numbers, so run for your life, if you come across any of them!

checkText.en: What are you waiting for? Go, go now!

finishText.en:
Sweet! I've got all the replies I need. We don't have much room, but it is still going to be fun. Do you think I should invite the emergency medical service from "Cloud Nine"? Eh?

Now here's another task for you. We ought to have started another stage of preparations, but something unexpected happened. Listen...

goal.en: Complete the quest "Tricky Invitation" and wait for another stage to start. Report to Brooser the Snap.

startText.en:
Everyone in the Empire will remember well the celebration of this Anniversary! Everyone will wine, dine, sing and dance! It's a major event, after all!

We don't have much time, though. The committee has scheduled two weeks only for preparation of each stage, fancy that. Do they think I have an army of assistants, or what?

No time to chat. Let's get down to business. First of all, we need to invite celebrities. Not just some second rate working class heroes, but real champions! They must be capable of entertaining other guests properly. Here's the list.

As soon as we're done, we can go on to the next stage. Don't let me down, I believe in you.

checkText.en: I've been revising my food list, and it looks like I will have to order more veggie stuff. Green and bio are highly popular nowadays.

finishText.en:
Everything is done flawlessly. Guests are already arriving, and those who don't, are sending written notes. We don't have to worry about this part of the program any more.

Now, as to the next stage, we are having this force majeure thing... again!

goal.en: Complete the quest "Tricky Invitation" and wait for another stage to start. Report to Solemna de Ardeur.

startText.en:
Everyone in the League will remember well the celebration of this Anniversary! Everyone will wine, dine, sing and dance! It's a major event, after all, and my impeccable elven taste is exactly what the League needs.

The whole process is accurately scheduled - two weeks for preparation of each stage. I believe we are totally on the safe side, and have more than enough time!

Now let's get down to business. First of all, we need to invite celebrities and other guests. Here's the list, my job is done here, now it's your turn. You will work as a special messenger.

As soon as we're done, we can go on to the next stage. Don't let me down, I believe in you.

There is no time to waste!

checkText.en: So, how's the milking of the elementals going? I'd love to see that myself...

finishText.en: Great! This is enough to feed flashlights, speakers and other useful devices. Well done! I will have to think about a more important task for you!

goal.en: Go to the Dead Sea, conquer power of the three Elemental totems and challenge Elemental Offspring. Collect 100 Concentrated Energies and report to Brooser the Snap.

startText.en:
Now we need energy. An old shaman once told me about three totems that are in the Dead Sea, just three old totems that nobody cares about... He said ancient druids installed them long before the Cataclysm, so it's not at all as primitive as it looks like... He told me the secret of extracting energy from them - they're full of it!

Here are the three Elemental Essences. They will help you call upon the power of corresponding totems. Three evil spirits will appear, and you have to defeat them all. After you do so, touch the fourth totem to summon Elemental Offspring!

I don't really know what it is, but I know how to fight it. You will see it turning into elementals, and as it does, you will have to channel the power of the totem of the same element upon it. Then power will overflow the Offspring, and you will be able to collect the extra of it. Got it? Redirect and collect!

The shaman said that it's easy... for a decent fighter, of course. I think you will do just fine.

checkText.en: Ancient spirits, contributing to the progress... O tempora!

finishText.en: Great. I think this energy will be enough for my purposes. Thank you, your help is absolutely priceless.

goal.en: Go to Siveria, conquer power of the three Elemental totems and challenge Elemental Offspring. Collect 100 Concentrated Energies and report to Solemna de Ardeur.

startText.en:
I need energy, and I've got an idea where to get it from...

An old magister once told me about three totems that are in Siveria, just three old totems that nobody cares about... He said ancient druids installed them long before the Cataclysm, so it's not at all as primitive as it looks like... He told me the secret of extracting energy from them - they're full of it!
Here are the three Elemental Essences. They will help you call upon the power of corresponding totems. Three evil spirits will appear, and you have to defeat them all. After you do so, touch the fourth totem to summon Elemental Offspring!

I don't really know what it is, but I know how to fight it. You will see it turning into elementals, and as it does, you will have to channel the power of the totem of the same element upon it. Then power will overflow the Offspring, and you will be able to collect the extra of it. The magister was sure about the safety of collecting excessive energy... but never said dealing with Elemental Offspring was safe, either.

Collect enough energy and then come back to me. There's no time to waste.

checkText.en: I swear, if anyone tries to take away the energy, I'll show them...

finishText.en:
We store more energy than XAES now! We need to keep it secret, though, or the Committee will audit the life out of us...

Now that we've dealt with our force majeure, let's get back to our tight schedule.

goal.en: Complete the quest "Thinking Outside the Box" and wait for another stage to start. Report to Brooser the Snap.

startText.en:
I've got a great idea! We need to set up a tent camp. You know, together with trade fair, street musicians, parade, all that stuff. But we need extra energy source for it.

So I came up with this idea at the Committee meeting, and guess what! They totally rejected it. They said they have no energy, and told me to stop dreaming and return to my official duties! Arrgh, am I mad!

Screw them, I though. I've got a backup plan.

checkText.en: I'm sure the next great event should be organized in one of the elven cities. There is no place in Sarnaut more beautiful that that.

finishText.en:
We store more energy than we might need now!

Now that we've dealt with this shortage, let's get back to our tight schedule.

goal.en: Complete the quest "Concealed Assets" and wait for another stage to start. Report to Solemna de Ardeur.

startText.en:
Here's the situation. We wanted to set up a tent camp. You know, together with trade fair, street musicians, parade, oh so beautiful! But then I realized that we need extra energy source for it. Novograd won't be able to grant us the supply.

My grand plan is at risk of failure. It is unacceptable. I went as far as cutting the quantity of city illumination three times, and I'm still afraid the light might go out at any moment...

Luckily, I'm on short terms with one of the wisest magisters of House de Blizare. He gave me a good hint on where to find an extra source... Would you like to hear it too?

checkText.en: I'd gladly let the animal into Committee, but I'm afraid, this kind of humor won't be appreciated.

finishText.en:
Just look at him! Look at how he's eyeing you! I bet he understands who brings him food, now he's in love with you!

Let's go on with our plans now, shall we?

goal.en: Complete the quest "Anniversary Safari" and wait for another stage to start. Report to Brooser the Snap.

startText.en:
Just look at this beast! Isn't he huge? Isn't he magnificent? Best lion breeders of the Empire brought him up specially for the Anniversary. He's well trained and can do a lot of funny tricks.

His name is Broots. He looks menacing, but in fact, he's just like a little kitten - tender, playful and even a bit sheepish. At least he used to be, before his food ration was cut by half!
