All because of the celebrations! "We need all the resources we can get," - they say. "No lion can eat this much," - they say. This is such a shame.

So my poor Broots got wild, naturally. He's not playful any longer, and ready to tear apart anyone who enters the cage. We need to do something, before he eats some poor citizen at the celebration...

I think I know where to get the meat...

checkText.en: I brought him here, when he was this little, and tamed him myself.

finishText.en:
Now I feel better, too, as if I was starving together with the poor kitty. Thank you, this is a huge relief.

He's in fact so fragile, I couldn't stand it if something would have happened to him...

goal.en: Obtain five pieces of fresh meat, killing Steppe Spider near Nezebgrad. Feed the lion and report to Brooser the Snap.

startText.en:
Broots is a wild beast, after all. Of course, he used to be on a special diet until now, but I'm sure he will gladly have some fresh raw meat. The animal that's rich in flesh around here would be... let me see... I think, it's steppe spiders that you can easily find near the city of Nezebgrad.

Kill a few, cut the meat of their bodies and bring it to the lion. I think, five will be enough for starters.

Don't wait for me to feed him. Just look, how hungry he is! No, don't be afraid, he won't eat you. He's tamed, after all... I think.

checkText.en: And let them eat crops and vegetables by themselves!

finishText.en:
Just look at him! Look at how he's eyeing you! I bet he understands who brings him food, now he's in love with you!

Let's go on with our plans now, shall we?

goal.en: Complete the quest "Taming the Lion" and wait for another stage to start. Report to Solemna de Ardeur.

startText.en:
Just look at this beast! Isn't he huge? Isn't he magnificent? Best lion breeders of the League brought him up specially for the Anniversary. He's well trained and can do a lot of funny tricks.

His name is Broots. He looks menacing, but in fact, he's just like a little kitten - tender, playful and even a bit sheepish. At least he used to be, before his food ration was cut by half! All because of the celebrations! "We need all the resources we can get," - they say. "No lion can eat this much," - they say. This is such a shame.

So my poor Broots got wild, naturally. He's not playful any longer, and ready to tear apart anyone who enters the cage. We need to do something, before he eats some poor citizen at the celebration...

I think I know where to get the meat...

checkText.en: I bottle-fed him when he was this little... I would give everything just to hear him purr once again...

finishText.en:
Now I feel better, too, as if I was starving together with the poor kitty. Thank you, this is a huge relief.

He's in fact so fragile, I couldn't stand it if something would have happened to him...

goal.en: Obtain five pieces of fresh meat, killing Tusked Boars near Novograd. Feed the lion and report to Solemna de Ardeur.

startText.en:
Broots is a wild beast, after all. Of course, he used to be on a special diet until now, but I'm sure he will gladly have some fresh raw meat. The animal that's rich in flesh around here would be... let me see... I think, it's tusked boars that you can easily find near the city of Novograd.

Kill a few, cut the meat of their bodies and bring it to the lion. I think, five will be enough for starters.

Don't wait for me to feed him. Just look, how hungry he is! No, don't be afraid, he won't eat you. He's tamed, after all... I think.

checkText.en: Have you got the chest?

finishText.en:
All coins are there, and they're safe. Whew.

I didn't count them all, of course, I've just got an eagle eye.

goal.en: Obtain the chest of Anniversary coins, stolen by Trickster, and bring it back to Brooser the Snap.

startText.en:
We need the chest back, the sooner the better, before the Committee finds out. A friend of mine, an old shaman, gave me this amulet once. Here, take it. It's supposed to protect you from the spirits, ruled by our thief. Its charms might have worn out, so you will probably have to run about a bit, before it starts working properly. The amulet will turn his tricks on himself, and let him return to wherever he crawled from.

Grab the chest as you see it, before anyone else does! Say, a waterfolk or a gibberling...

checkText.en:
Our huntmasters were so impressed with what they saw that they immediately went to our shamans for Natural magic lessons. Fancy a brave Xadaganian with his dog in the Kingdom of Nature! I'll laugh my ears off.

Next step will be what? Elves teaching necromancy to Kanians? Aha ha ha!

finishText.en:
That's it. All the preparations are over. The Anniversary Event is about to start. These were the crazy weeks, I admit, but I think I liked it. The chest is guarded by Yasker Hawks themselves!

There's just one last thing... Don't look at me like that, I'm giving you no tasks! It's Broots. He's sick to death to be in the cage, and I just cannot let him out like that. He won't survive in the wild nature. I cannot let him take part in the Anniversary event, either - after all this mess, he's too nervous for that.

May be you want to adopt him? He adores you, I can tell. What about me? I will survive. It's better for him.

goal.en: Complete the quest "Sneaky Thief" and wait for the final stage to start. Report to Brooser the Snap.

startText.en:
We've been robbed! Not just of some stuff you wouldn't even notice. A whole chest of Anniversary coins has gone missing! Brand new, freshly coined, all shiny...

At first I thought - ah, big deal! Called for the huntmasters to put their dogs on the scent. My best pathfinders, mind you! They returned all wounded, dogs with tails between their legs...

They said it was a wicked wizard. And you know what else?

The wicked wizard is merely a forestfolk. That's that. Some half-witted bogey from the woods kicked ten fully grown up men. And their dogs. Can you imagine this?

We really need to return the coins. Can you help me?

checkText.en: I'm writing a petition to Aidenus for a decent magical protection of our treasures.

finishText.en:
Excellent! We've got the chest, Trickster learned his lesson. I hope he will never go for a robbery again.

Thank you!

goal.en: Obtain the chest of Anniversary coins, stolen by Trickster, and bring it back to Solemna de Ardeur.

startText.en:
It's evident that it was a forestfolk who stole the treasure. Huntmasters have already tracked him down, but failed to capture him. He turned out to be nobody else but Trickster himself - a mighty wizard of the forestfolks tribe.

The only genius of forestfolks is committing crimes. How sad can it be? I'm sure you can defeat him, if you choose to. I have to warn you, though, don't underestimate his powers. He knows the Nature of the Lightwood better than anyone else. The huntmasters said he summoned some forest spirits to attack them. My guess is that he charmed them somehow.

Here's a special amulet. It's supposed to protect you from the spirits, ruled by our thief. Its charms might have worn out, so you will probably have to run about a bit, before it starts working properly. The amulet will turn his tricks on himself, and let him return to wherever he crawled from.

Come back soon.

checkText.en: This is totally unacceptable!

finishText.en:
That's it. All the preparations are over. The Anniversary Event is about to start. These were the crazy weeks, I admit, but I think I liked it. The chest it tightly locked, and the lock is charmed by Aidenus himself. I'm not sure what the charms do to potential thieves. It might either incinerate them or turn them into ginger-haired haregons...

There's just one last thing... Don't look at me like that, I'm giving you no tasks! It's Broots. He's sick to death to be in the cage, and I just cannot let him out like that. He won't survive in the wild nature. I cannot let him take part in the Anniversary event, either - after all this mess, he's too nervous for that.

May be you want to adopt him? He adores you, I can tell. What about me? I will survive. It's better for him.

Besides, I'm sure he's going to like Astral travels!

goal.en: Complete the quest "Sneaky Thief" and wait for the final stage to start. Report to Solemna de Ardeur.

startText.en:
We've been robbed! Not just of some stuff you wouldn't even notice. A whole chest of Anniversary coins has gone missing! Brand new, freshly coined, all shiny...

At first I thought - ah, big deal! Called for the huntmasters to put their dogs on the scent. My best pathfinders, mind you! They returned all wounded, dogs with tails between their legs...

They said these were evil spirits. And you know what else?
The evil spirits turned out to be forestfolks and waterfolks. That's that. Some half-witted bogeys from the woods kicked ten fully grown up men. And their dogs. Can you imagine this?

You're our last hope. Please, help us return the treasure...

finishText.en: Hi! Well, at least someone responded. You can't imagine what a horrible thing I dug out...

goal.en: Find Marianna Lopatina in the Recruitment Center.

startText.en: Attention! Attention! Brave adventurers, heroes and defenders of the Empire! Famous traveler Marianna Lopatina needs your help! If distant journeys and terrible mysteries don't scare you, she's waiting for you in the Recruitment Center!

checkText.en: If you don't see anything, then either I'm a prophet myself... or I'm nuts and hallucinating. Bah, I don't know which is worse.

finishText.en: Well, you see it? Doom and gloom... We must find a way to avert the end of the world!

goal.en: Look at the terrible future.

startText.en:
During the recent expedition, I found a strange clay tablet in the June Ruins. It was crumbled, but I could piece it together and read something. Have a look: "pro...phe..." - that's prophecy! And then: "...day" - that's doomsday! "Death an... ition..." - that's death and perdition! Yet the most horrible thing is the date at the end. Look at the numbers - it's quite soon! According to the June prophecy, our world is going to end in less than a month, and we know nothing about it!
But that's not all. There was a skull next to the tablet. I think the skull belonged to that very prophet. It had a hat on, and when I tried it on, I saw what he'd seen! Try it on and I think you'll see it too!

checkText.en: Don't be afraid, the test is easy. At least it's easy for a true adventurer!

finishText.en: Are there no true adventurers left in the Empire? Imagine that, I couldn't find any! Some ran away with supersonic speed once they put the hat on. Others asked how much I'd pay them for their help. Others could hardly escape my golems... Looks like it's just you and me. We can't wait any longer. Let's get to it!

goal.en: Pass Marianna Lopatina's test and wait until she finishes looking for assistants.

startText.en:
Well, you with me? Excellent! But I have to test you first. Sorry, but that's my rule: I make all my companions pass a little exam. I'm sick and tired of dragging helpless braggarts out of pitfalls and from under rocks, scraping them off walls and washing their remains off my clothes... Now, that's not a slight against you! I believe you really are a true hero. Which means you can pass my test in a jiffy.
Here's another thing. The doomsday is not a joke. The more people we can gather, the better. Wait a day or two while I'm looking for companions... But no longer than a week!

checkText.en: The ancient tombs are no place for the weak. Whatever you touch tries to behead you. Meanwhile, it's common knowledge that no head is worse than one!

finishText.en: Not bad. I wouldn't think twice about setting out into the deepest catacombs with someone like you by my side. Looks like we do have a chance to save the world!

goal.en: Defeat the golems summoned by Marianna Lopatina.

startText.en: The test is simple. I'll show you some of the dangers that await an adventurer in the June Tombs. Although the Junes vanished long ago, their golems have kept their watch for centuries and even millennia. Those who are not ready to deal with them had better stay home. So, shall we begin? Let me know when you are ready.

checkText.en: Time is running short, but we mustn't rush things either. We need to find out what's what and what exactly threatens Sarnaut, not run around without purpose like headless chickens.

finishText.en: Well, I found an alternative. Oh, I really didn't want to resort to this thing... However, the end of the world is close at hand, and we're still stuck where we are!

goal.en: Test the device and wait for Marianna Lopatina to finish searching for "alternatives."

startText.en: Looks like I found a way... No, not to save the world, but at least to find out what was written on the tablet. I already did the difficult part: I obtained the device and found out how to use it. After I explain it all to you, we'll get down to business. Meanwhile, I'll look for an alternative option. The situation is serious, and we may need to resort to... extreme measures.

checkText.en: If the device works, we'll be able to restore and read any of the lost books, be it the second volume of Evenings on a Farm near Molotovka or the broken tablets of Aitzaupalotle's Admonitions for His Sons. Let alone all the ancient settlements and treasures we could find... Isn't that awesome?

finishText.en:
Here they are, shining Grains of Wisdom! Let's see what we've got there!
Damn... I don't know whether to laugh or cry! See, now we know for sure the number of times each June symbol was used on the tablet, the number of punctuation marks, the total length of the text, the rules of consonant interchange - everything except what exactly is written on it. Looks like we'll never know what exactly Aitzaupalotle had willed to his sons and where he buried his gold. And time is running out... How are we going to save the world?

goal.en: Go to the gutter, use the Semiotic Restorer to collect 20 Grains of Wisdom and give them to Marianna Lopatina.

startText.en:
While you were competing with the golems, I went to see my acquaintance, who is a genius inventor. I don't know how sane he is but, according to his theory, all that was ever written or said is eternally stored in a special world of words and symbols. He invented a special device that extracts lost texts from that world. If this thing works, we can restore the crumbled tablet and read the prophecy!
Here, take the device. I already set it up to restore the tablet. But you'll need a friendly assistant. One of you has to turn on the device and project... What did the professor call them... Iconosemiolo... That's a freaking tongue-twister! To put it simply, the obscure meanings from the world of words. As your hands are busy holding the device, someone else has to research them to find the grains of wisdom. How do I know what they look like? I don't, I'm just repeating what the professor said! But I think you won't mistake them for anything else. Gather some twenty pieces - I think that'll do. Be careful, though: the professor said there were monsters even in the world of texts. If they show up, be on guard! And better get to a safe place. Go to that ravine, for instance. Or, Light forbid, some passers-by can get hurt.

checkText.en: A dreadful thing, isn't it? Don't even ask me how I obtained it.

finishText.en: See the ominous shining the wand's gems give off? It's ready for use. It's time we disturbed the peace of the dead.

goal.en: Charge the Wand of Summoning the Dead and wait until it is ready for use.

startText.en: Dealing with the dead is dangerous, scary and simply impolite. But that's our last chance to find out how to save the world: we have to summon the prophet's spirit! Oh, I really didn't want to obtain this artifact! But I did it, and now it's in our hands, just like the June's skull. Now we have to charge it with Sparks... Don't look so scared! I'm not Tep, after all! I mean Sparks of animals. I'll explain how to do it. The charging will take some time, though, and we're running out of it...

checkText.en: Human Sparks would do the job too, I guess... But we're not some monsters, after all!

finishText.en: The Wand is getting warmer... And that warmth seems to be even scarier than the cold. Now we have to wait until the Wand assimilates the Sparks taken from the animals. Like a boa digesting prey... Brrr!

goal.en: Charge the Wand with the life force of 15 animals of your level.

startText.en:
Here is the Wand. Can you feel how cold it is? Like a grave. To summon the June's spirit, we'll need to kindle it with warmth that we'll have to take from living creatures. I feel bad for the critters, but if the doomsday comes, I'll feel a lot worse for everybody.
Here's what needs to be done. First, draw a circle on the ground with this Wand. Then do anything to lure any wild animal inside that circle. But not some small rodent! The stronger the creature, the better! Inside the circle, the animal will become rigid. Touch it with the Wand here, between the eyes. It will die, and the Wand will get a little warmer. Fifteen animals' lives will do to bring back the deceased... for a time.

checkText.en: I've seen plenty of ancient skulls and I've unearthed lots of dreadful artifacts, but this sorcery gives me the creeps.

finishText.en:
There he is. Let's see what he has to say!

Wait... What is this?! What is he babbling?

Unbelievable! So much effort only to summon a spirit that only speaks June!

goal.en: Summon the June prophet's spirit and protect it from the ghosts.

startText.en: The Wand is ready, we can begin the ritual. Move towards those hills, away from unwanted eyes, and touch your skull with the Wand. The spirit should show up, but not alone: hungry restless souls will come rushing to the call of a warm living body. Don't let them tear the ghost apart. Afterwards, get back to me, and we'll finally question him.

checkText.en: Set it up fast and let's question the prophet! The world is about to perish, and we have no idea how to save it!

finishText.en: Ready! Good job! It's time we found out how to save the world!

goal.en: Set up the automatic Versatile Translator.

startText.en:
Never mind, I have an ace up my sleeve. You find lots of stuff while digging around in the ruins! Here, look: an automatic Versatile Translator. A unique device made by some unknown person using some technology that no longer exists. It'll easily translate the prophet's words for us, all we need is to set it up.
The translator is powered by the elements: fire, ice and lightning. When switched on, the device will begin to charge each of the elements. Watch the indicators: if the charge for any of the elements reaches ten, the device will overheat and might blow up! Next: those three buttons allow resetting the charge. The first button reduces the fire charge, the second one the lightning charge, and the third one the ice charge. Also, pressing any button reduces the charge for one of the other elements, the greater one.
Use these buttons to carefully adjust the charges until each of the three elements has reached the charge of five. Then push the big button and the white light will go on. When all five are on, the device is set! Is it clear or should I repeat the instructions? I think I might have gotten confused myself. I've had it with these inventors...

checkText.en: At least I hope we have a little time left...

finishText.en: Unbelievable. So much effort and running around - and all for just a toy! Of course, it's good the world is no longer threatened, but trying to brag about such deeds will make a laughing stock out of you! Alas... Well, at least take the hat, it's no good to me. I'll go look for Jahmanukti's tomb. Good luck! We may meet again!

goal.en: Ask the June Prophet about the End of the World.

startText.en: Finally, we'll know what's what! Come on, let's ask him!

finishText.en: Hi! Well, at least someone responded. You can't imagine what a horrible thing I dug out...

goal.en: Find Marianna Lopatina in the Lightwood.

I believe you really are a true hero. Which means you can handle my task in a jiffy.
There's another thing. The doomsday is not a joke. The more people we can gather, the better. Wait a day or two while I'm looking for companions... But no longer than a week!

checkText.en: The ancient tombs are no place for the weak. Whatever you touch tries to behead you. Meanwhile, it's common knowledge that no head is worse than one!

finishText.en: Not bad. I wouldn't think twice about setting out into the deepest catacombs with someone like you by my side. Looks like we do have a chance to save the world!

goal.en: Defeat the golems summoned by Marianna Lopatina.

startText.en: The test is simple. I'll show you some of the dangers that await an adventurer in the June Tombs. Although the Junes vanished long ago, their golems have kept their watch for centuries and even millennia. Those who are not ready to deal with them had better stay home. So, shall we begin? Let me know when you are ready.

checkText.en: Time is running short, but we mustn't rush things either. We need to find out what's what and what exactly threatens Sarnaut, not run around without purpose like headless chickens.

finishText.en: Well, I found an alternative. Oh, I really didn't want to resort to this thing... However, the end of the world is close at hand, and we're still stuck where we are!

goal.en: Test the device and wait for Marianna Lopatina to finish searching for "alternatives."

startText.en: Looks like I found a way... No, not to save the world, but at least to find out what was written on the tablet. I already did the difficult part: I obtained the device and found out how to use it. After I explain it all to you, we'll get down to business. Meanwhile, I'll look for an alternative option. The situation is serious, and we may need to resort to... extreme measures.

checkText.en: If the device works, we'll be able to restore and read any of the lost books, be it the second volume of Evenings on a Farm near Molotovka or the broken tablets of Aitzaupalotle's Admonitions for His Sons. Let alone all the ancient settlements and treasures we could find... Isn't that awesome?

finishText.en:
Here they are, shining Grains of Wisdom! Let's see what we've got there!
Damn... I don't know whether to laugh or cry! See, now we know for sure the number of times each June symbol was used on the tablet, the number of punctuation marks, the total length of the text, the rules of consonant interchange - everything except what exactly is written on it. Looks like we'll never know what exactly Aitzaupalotle had willed to his sons and where he buried his gold. And time is running out... However can we save the world?

goal.en: Go to the Dead Thicket, use the Semiotic Restorer to gather 20 Grains of Wisdom and give them to Marianna Lopatina.

startText.en:
While you were competing with the golems, I went to see my acquaintance, who is a genius inventor. I don't know how sane he is but, according to his theory, all that was ever written or said is eternally stored in a special world of words and symbols. He invented a special device that extracts lost texts from that world. If the thing works, we can restore the crumbled tablet and read the prophecy!
Here is the device. I already set it up to restore the tablet. But you'll need a friendly assistant. One of you has to turn on the device and project... What did the professor call them... Iconosemiolo... That's a freaking tongue-twister! To put it simply, the obscure meanings from the world of words. As your hands are busy holding the device, someone else has to research them to find the grains of wisdom. How do I know what they look like? I don't, I'm just repeating what the professor said! But I think you won't mistake them for anything else. Gather some twenty pieces - I think that'll do. Be careful, though: the professor said there were monsters even in the world of texts. If they show up, be on guard! And better go away to some forest - to that thicket, for instance. Or, Light forbid, some passers-by can get hurt.

checkText.en: A dreadful thing, isn't it? Don't even ask me how I obtained it.

finishText.en: See the ominous shining the wand's gems give off? It's ready for use. It's time we disturbed the peace of the dead.

goal.en: Charge the Wand of Summoning the Dead and wait until it is ready for use.

startText.en: Dealing with the dead is dangerous, scary and simply impolite. But that's our last chance to find out how to save the world: we have to summon the prophet's spirit! Oh, I really didn't want to obtain this artifact! But I did it, and now it's in our hands, just like the June's skull. Now we have to charge it with Sparks... Don't look so scared! I'm not Tep, after all! I mean Sparks of animals. I'll explain how to do it. The charging will take some time, though, and we're running out of it...

checkText.en: Human Sparks would do the job too, I guess... But we're not some monsters, after all!

finishText.en: The Wand is getting warmer... And that warmth seems to be even scarier than the cold. Now we have to wait until the Wand assimilates the Sparks taken from the animals. Like a boa digesting prey... Brrr!

goal.en: Charge the Wand with the life force of 15 animals of your level.

startText.en:
Here is the Wand. Can you feel how cold it is? Like a grave. To summon the June's spirit, we'll need to kindle it with warmth that we'll have to take from living creatures. I feel bad for the critters, but if the doomsday comes, I'll feel a lot worse for everybody.
Here's what needs to be done. First, draw a circle on the ground with this Wand. Then do anything to lure any wild animal inside that circle. But not some small rodent! The stronger the creature, the better! Inside the circle, the animal will become rigid. Touch it with the Wand here, between the eyes. It will die, and the Wand will get a little warmer. Fifteen animals' lives will do to bring back the deceased... for a time.

checkText.en: I've seen plenty of ancient skulls and I've unearthed lots of dreadful artifacts, but this sorcery gives me the creeps.

finishText.en:
There he is. Let's see what he has to say!

Wait... What is this?! What is he babbling?

Unbelievable! So much effort only to summon a spirit that only speaks June!

goal.en: Summon the June prophet's spirit and protect it from the ghosts.

startText.en: The Wand is ready, we can begin the ritual. Move towards those hills, away from unwanted eyes, and touch your skull with the Wand. The spirit should show up, but not alone: hungry restless souls will come rushing to the call of a warm living body. Don't let them tear the ghost apart. Afterwards, get back to me, and we'll finally question him.

checkText.en: Set it up fast and let's question the prophet! The world is about to perish, and we have no idea how to save it!

finishText.en: Ready! Good job! It's time we found out how to save the world!

goal.en: Set up the automatic Versatile Translator.

startText.en:
Never mind, I have an ace up my sleeve. You find lots of stuff while digging around in the ruins! Here, look: an automatic Versatile Translator. A unique device made by some unknown person using some technology that no longer exists. It'll easily translate the prophet's words for us. All we need is to set it up.
The translator is powered by the elements: fire, ice and lightning. When switched on, the device will begin to charge each of the elements. Watch the indicators: if the charge for any of the elements reaches ten, the device will overheat and might blow up! Next: those three buttons allow resetting the charge. The first button reduces the fire charge, the second one the lightning charge, and the third one the ice charge. Also, pressing any button reduces the charge for one of the other elements, the greater one.
Use these buttons to carefully adjust the charges until each of the three elements has reached the charge of five. Then push the big button and the white light will go on. When all five are on, the device is set! Is it clear or should I repeat the instructions? I think I might have gotten confused myself. I've had it with these inventors...

checkText.en: At least I hope we have a little time left...

finishText.en: Unbelievable. So much effort and running around - and all for just a toy! Of course, it's good the world is no longer threatened, but trying to brag about such deeds will make a laughing stock out of you! Alas... Well, at least take the hat, it's no good to me. I'll go look for Jahmanukti's tomb. Good luck! We may meet again!

goal.en: Ask the June Prophet about the End of the World.

startText.en: Finally, we'll know what's what! Come on, let's ask him!

checkText.en: Did you do it?

finishText.en: Wonderful! Here is your reward! Come back tomorrow – there's more to be done.

goal.en: Complete the Pledge of Dueling quest

startText.en:
Well, well. Let me take a look at you.

Hm, sorry, you don't like anything special. I should give you something simple to do.

Listen, do what everyone else does every day. Kill a Shadow Foe. It's a simple task that can show me you're ready to move forward.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Here, you've earned it! Come back tomorrow!

goal.en: Complete the Pledge of Eulogy quest

startText.en:
Let's continue!

There is safety in numbers. If you are already in a guild, you know that.

The Free Traders agree. We ourselves often employ the services of mercenary guilds which guard our mines, caravans, and banks. So give your allies their due, make a speech!

checkText.en: When is the next match?

finishText.en: Good game! See you tomorrow!

goal.en: Participate in a Goblinball match

startText.en:
How is it going, hero? All work and no play?

How about a little entertainment? You need to take a break now and then – heroes must rest sometimes. So this is your task for today: play Goblinball with your friends, have some fun!

checkText.en: Have you fulfilled the pledge?

finishText.en: You're strong! Come back tomorrow – we'll think of something to keep you busy.

goal.en: Complete the Pledge of Punishment quest

startText.en:
So, back to work? For now, we'll continue to give you simple tasks to weed out those who are not willing to keep busy at all times. Back to the guild!

Every guild must prove its capabilities by its actions. Such as eliminating the most dangerous enemies. That's why I expect you to fulfill the Pledge of Punishment. Prove that you can be relied on.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Keep it up! You can take a break, see you tomorrow.

goal.en: Complete the Flour Delivery quest

startText.en:
You have proved your loyalty to your guild, but what about your country?

Every warrior must remember where their path began. When did you last visit the place where you received your first instructions? We want you to return there and provide whatever assistance is needed.

checkText.en: Have you spilled blood in the arena?

finishText.en: What a fight! Let's do that again sometime. Take a break – tomorrow you'll get another task.

goal.en: Win a fight in Novograd Arena

startText.en:
It's time to spill the first blood!

Each capital has an Arena. There's always someone ready for a challenge. The Servants of the Light will even resurrect you for free. Those are perfect conditions for a fight.

Go and score a victory.

checkText.en: Did you do it?

finishText.en: Keep it up! Come back tomorrow, we'll give you a new task.

goal.en: Complete the Pledge of Fervor quest

startText.en:
Let's get this guild business over with.

It's simple: by proving to me you are ready to help your guild, you are proving your willingness to help the Free Traders.

So today you will carry out a task that might require some effort. I'm talking about the Pledge of Fervor.

checkText.en: Have you dealt with the anarchists?

finishText.en: That's what I'm talking about! I'll see you tomorrow.

goal.en: Complete the Heavenly Fire quest

startText.en:
It's time for some serious deeds.

If you heard about the events in Irdrich, you know that we've managed to establish a stable connection to the Illusory World. You can now bring whatever you need from that world. And the Tekyan and Aviaks are in the process of relocating... So you can't say that world doesn't exist.

But there are still those who want to ruin this idyll. I'm talking about the Aviak anarchists, of course. It's time they paid for everything. Go to the Illusory World and bring us the Heavenly Fire!

checkText.en: Is it done?

finishText.en: That's the stuff! Here, I'll see you tomorrow.

goal.en: Complete the Bloody Iron quest

startText.en:
Oh, those trips through time and time paradoxes!

You know, if the League hadn't managed to mine enough meteorite ore on Kirah, their fleet would have been destroyed by the astral demons. But Eniel delivered enough boxes to the Kanian Archipelagos for them to build a lot of ships.

So this is your next task: travel to the past and help the League with the ore.

checkText.en: How is the siege going?

finishText.en: What a feat! You’ve earned this reward!

goal.en: Complete the On the Attack! quest

startText.en:
Eljune is an important place for the Free Traders. Lots of meetings and other important events take place there, lots of deals are being made as we speak.
But there's a problem called the Bloody Outpost.

The Imperial forces are still stationed there, and they stop anyone who has any connection to the League. It's creating many problems.

I believe it's time to replace the Outpost's owner – hopefully the League will be more lenient towards our operations than the Empire. Well, you know what to do.

checkText.en: Have you fired the cannon?

finishText.en: Keep it up, soldier!

goal.en: Complete the We Weren't Born Yesterday! quest

startText.en:
Brave League soldiers are fighting the remaining demon forces on Yazes!

Yes, demons are still a threat... And they have a... lair? nest? base? on that cursed island. I don't know. They just keep coming.

In any event, the League and Imperial soldiers will be there for a while.

But the morale is dropping! We need to do something about that, to ensure that the astral trading routes near Yasker are secure. Your exploits inspire many, so go there and perform some kind of feat. Shoot an Octulhu from a cannon, for example.

checkText.en: Are you done?

finishText.en: Oh, you're done already? The world won't forget that! Here, come back tomorrow.

goal.en: Complete the Power of Thought quest

startText.en:
Sarn's cultists.

Some believe they are just madmen who want us all to be devoured by demons.

On the other hand, they have some interesting technologies. Cloning. Portal magic. Death rays!

We'd like to get our hands on some of that... But alas, we've been unsuccessful in that regard.

Perhaps you'll have more luck. We know that the cultists are trying to hide something on the Twilight Isle. Go there and try to steal the blueprints with the help of the allied Wormfaces.

checkText.en: Did you win?

finishText.en: Must have been a nice race!

goal.en: Complete the Marathon quest

startText.en:
Are you confused?

There are enemy Wormfaces and allied Wormfaces. There are enemy Draconids and allied Draconids. There are enemy cultists and... yes, correct! Allied cultists.

Well, the world is not black and white. And after the events you took part in, it has gotten even more complicated. Some still stick to the old ways, but others... might have looked at you and decided to act differently.

Where am I going with this? On the Wandering Island, we managed to reach an agreement with Sarn's cultists. Some of them work with the Demonologists. So one of the local cultists, Nomarkh Ankh, decided to arrange Spark races. And races mean profit.

We want you to participate and win! So go there and do everything you can to win the race.

checkText.en: Back already?

finishText.en: Oh, I wish I could go on adventures like that... Anyway, I'll see you tomorrow!

goal.en: Visit any astral allod

startText.en:
We'll take a break from our extremely important missions.

Let's talk about your tasks. What's the most important thing for a hero?
Besides the runes, it's equipment, of course. Various artifacts you can find in the deep layers of the Astral. I hope you travel to the Astral often?

Let's see! Visit an astral allod, defeat the enemies there and report back to me.

checkText.en: Did you do it?

finishText.en: Amazing places, aren't those? Well, this is just the beginning...

goal.en: Complete the Secrets from the Depths of the Earth quest

startText.en:
Let's get back to something really important. Together with Nihaz, lots of new things came to this world, such as the ability to create personal allods. There are many of those now.

The Free Traders are taking advantage of that, of course. We started working on a truly grandiose project – a real continent.

Alas, it's not going that well. To understand why we're running into so many issues, we need samples of the minerals from one of our newly created allods, the Cradle. I assign this task to you.

checkText.en: I hope you're here for your gold medal.

finishText.en: What a hero! You've earned this reward! Don't forget to come back tomorrow.

goal.en: Complete the Dionic Games: Chariot Race quest

startText.en:
It turns out races are quite profitable.

I'm talking about bets, of course. And it also turns out that the most spectacular races take place at the Dionic Games arranged by the Aoidoi.

Well, good for them. We profit from those quite a bit. Of course, you understand what's expected of you – you need to travel there, take part in the race, and win the first place.

Just choose time carefully: races are held according to schedule, so try not to pick the busiest time!

checkText.en: Are you done?

finishText.en: Thank you on behalf of all geologists!

goal.en: Complete the Heavy Burden quest

startText.en:
You probably know that the history of the Free Traders is tied to the meteorite that allowed us to create astral ships that travel between allods and transport goods.

When the secret of astral travel became generally available, ancient blades forged from meteorite steel were melted down, and more ships were built every year.

But I digress. There was a war for the meteorite on Kirah. I want to know if we can affect the history to ensure that the League gets more meteorite. Perhaps then we'll have more ships in the present?

Your task is to help the League gain an advantage in the battle for the mine.

checkText.en: So, did you do it?

finishText.en: A worthy undertaking! Go now, I need to come up with something for you to do tomorrow...

goal.en: Complete the Helping the Ghost Hunters: Preventive Hit quest

startText.en:
The Free Traders sympathize with various adventure seekers who hunt for treasures in the ruins of old cities. We are happy to buy their discoveries from them – to resell them later at a higher price.

But there are adventurers who cross the line... Such as the famous Treasure Seekers known for their raiding and pillaging. The so-called Gray Prince's minions!

It's time we reminded them that the Free Traders have a long reach. And you'll be our weapon. Find those four scoundrels that are hiding on the Isle of Revelation and deal with them.

checkText.en: Did you do it?

finishText.en: Wonderful! I'll prepare a special task for tomorrow!

goal.en: Complete the Klavdia's Challenge quest

startText.en:
There's someone in Sarnaut the Free Traders are extremely interested in. She's known as Klavdia Kalugina.

The problem is, we know very little about her. And we'd like to know as much as possible.

But she's not easy to get close to. She never stays long in one place. It's some sorcery.

Listen to me carefully. I'll give you a special device. You'll go to Tka-Rik's Cave and complete her tasks. Then you'll report to me. You don't need to do anything. Just stay close to her for some time, and you'll do us a great favor.

checkText.en: Have you completed your task?

finishText.en: I have no doubts about your strength now. But I still have a few special tasks prepared...

goal.en: Complete the Death to Our Foes! quest

startText.en:
Today you and I will help some cultists.

Semer Knef wrote to me recently. They are ready to share some of their technologies with us if we lend them our support.

The enemy Wormfaces who serve Nihaz, and Agrus's Draconids – who are even more vicious – have sent reinforcements to the Wandering Island... It sounds like they are trying to capture the Palace Square and the path that leads to the Seal of Darkness.

They must be stopped. Use the cultist forces to seize control of the square.

checkText.en: Is the fight over?

finishText.en: I never doubted you! Take your reward and come back tomorrow!

goal.en: Participate in any skirmish

startText.en:
As for the Battlefields, we have an incentive program from the Tycoons. Haven't you heard?

Well, what matters is it works. Bets on combats, broadcasts via Astralophone.

We need to support our colleagues! Especially since my brother is handling it.

So go to the Battlefields. Try to win, of course.

checkText.en: Is the race over?

finishText.en: You're quick on your feet! Keep it up.

goal.en: Complete the Dionic Games: Steeplechase quest

startText.en:
You're good at fighting...

What about running? Like an obstacle course? Yes, we want to negotiate a contract regarding Dionic Games broadcasts.

So we can attract more viewers. So it's nice of you to show how impressive a victory can be.

So today's task is for you to travel to the Dionic Archipelago and take part in the race.

checkText.en: Did you do it?

finishText.en: Wonderful! Everyone benefits!

goal.en: Complete the Grain of the Gold from the Past quest

name.en: Day 23: Grain of the Gold from the Past

startText.en:
Time is an interesting element.

Even the Great Mages have a hard time understanding what it is, why it only flows forward and how it can be affected.

One of the tools that can influence it is the Observatory. Another is the Whirlpool of Time.

While we can't get to the Observatory, we've been studying the Whirlpool for some time.

We know it causes curious anomalies on Kirah – Time Storm and Crocosaur Hunt, which in turn create Elementals of the Odds and Crocosaurs – creatures from the distant past.

You can get actual rewards from them – grains, carats, ounces, and pounds of Gold from the Past. The exchange rate isn't that great today, but nevertheless it's an interesting phenomenon.

Bring me one such grain.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Another exploit! Never doubted you.

goal.en: Complete the Broken Chain quest

startText.en:
I already talked about that, but now I should tell you more: after their defeat, the demon cultists split into two groups. One is headed by Semer Knef. He's an Arisen who is willing to work with us. He's providing assistance to Maya Voronina. We also got something from him...

But the radical ones are a different matter. Those who want to see the world burn. They are led by Lada Grusova, Aristarkh Zlobin, and Lawrence Weirdin. They still have control of Yazes Shards.
Zlobin and Weirdin decided to move Twilight Isle away from the Isle of Revelation.

To make it possible, they started restoring targets carried by astral Octulhus.

We can't let that happen, of course. So your mission is simple: destroy the targets by completing the Wormfaces' task.

checkText.en: Is the battle over?

finishText.en: You are very good at fighting. Good job!

goal.en: Complete the Dionic Games: Gladiator Battle quest

startText.en:
You know, people are getting bored with usual combats. They demand something new: for girls to fight in the mud, and for runes to be unequipped during fights. In short, they want something new, something unusual.

So we have another option: gladiator fights on the Ammer Arena. Why? Give someone a spear, sword, or a throwing axe. An interesting idea.

Let's try our idea with bets.

Well, you just need to set an example.

checkText.en: Did you do it?

finishText.en: Keep it up!

goal.en: Complete the Grain of Experience quest

startText.en:
We'll continue to study the Whirlpool of Time.

Just think about it – portals to the past created by architects existed only for a moment... but the Whirlpool has functioned for years.

I received reports about artifact research. Surprisingly enough, each temporal anomaly contains a significant amount of destructive energy.

There's something connecting the Astral, time... and astral demons.

But I won't bore you with metaphysics. We're mainly interested in theories that can turn into profit. Someone is willing to pay for the Grans of Experience. Earn some.

checkText.en: Well, how is it going?

finishText.en: Have you helped everyone? Commendable.

goal.en: Complete the Twilight Isle Cannons quest

startText.en:
It looks like our activities on Twilight Isle made the cultists unhappy.

They contacted their demons... Those who didn't join Ollum.

And sent a lot of them to defend their targets.

Well, we'll have to shoot them down. Grab a cannon and get rid of those pesky creatures.

checkText.en: Is it over already?

finishText.en: If only these things happened every day. Here, take it!

goal.en: Visit the June Catacombs

startText.en:
Our marathon is nearing its end – don't expect the tasks to be easy!

June Catacombs are located deep inside the Gipat mountains. They still hold many treasures, but there's never a shortage of treasure hunters.

It's time for you to have a go at it. Or are you a frequent visitor already?

At any rate, you need to go there and try to get at least one treasure.

checkText.en: What, the race is over already?

finishText.en: That was fun... Don't forget about the task tomorrow!

goal.en: Complete the Race quest

startText.en:
Let's have some fun before the final day? We've accomplished so much already... You must have noticed that we often ask you to take part in different competitions...

Well, they are profitable. Any competition can be bet on.

As you know, the first famous race took place on Kirah. It's time for you to go there – pick your best mount and try to win the race among the sand dunes and storms.

checkText.en: You're done already? Really?

finishText.en: Oh, you've finished your last task... Well, that was fun! Hopefully we’ll meet again! I'll report your success, don't worry.

goal.en: Defeat all strong enemies in the Observatory on low difficulty

startText.en:
This is the final day... I have prepared something special – we want to understand how the Observatory works.

I'll give you a small device... you just need to take it with you – you won't have to do anything with it.

But to understand how the Observatory works, you'll have to defeat all enemies it will send at you next week.

Of course, Cosmos mustn't find out. So don't tell anyone about our little task.

checkText.en: Did you do it?

finishText.en: Wonderful! Here is your reward! Come back tomorrow – there's more to be done.

startText.en:
Oh, so you decided to do it?

Well, let's start small. With something simple.

Of course, everyone wants to kill dragons. What if you need to do something small – but every day? Yes, I'm talking about a Shadow Foe. Prove to me that you can do something every day.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Here, you've earned it! Come back tomorrow!

goal.en: Complete the Pledge of Eulogy quest

startText.en:
So what's next?

Ah, right. Guilds. Have you realized that it's hard to survive in this world alone? Heh.

The Free Traders agree. We ourselves often employ the services of mercenary guilds which guard our mines, caravans, and banks! So don't forget your brothers, heh.

checkText.en: When is the next match?

finishText.en: Good game! See you tomorrow!

goal.en: Participate in a Goblinball match

startText.en:
So what, hero? Am I boring you?

Alright, that will pass. My tasks will be easy for the time being. We all need to rest sometimes, after all. What's the best way to have fun? Physical activities!

It's time to play some Goblinball, so go and sign up!

checkText.en: Have you fulfilled the pledge?

finishText.en: You're strong! Come back tomorrow – we'll think of something to keep you busy.

goal.en: Complete the Pledge of Punishment quest

startText.en:
Back to business, eh? We don't want to overwhelm anyone – so we're trying to see if you're willing to do a little every day.

Every guild must prove it's not a gathering of weaklings, but a team of real warriors! What do we need? We need you to eliminate the most dangerous enemies. That's why I expect you to fulfill the Pledge of Punishment. Prove that you can be relied on.

checkText.en: Well? Have you spilled blood in the arena?

finishText.en: What a fight! Let's do that again sometime. Take a break – tomorrow you'll get another task.

goal.en: Win a fight in Nezebgrad Arena

startText.en:
Well, it's time to kick some ass, yeah?!

Listen up. Each capital has an Arena. There's always someone ready for a challenge. The Servants of the Light will even resurrect you for free. Those are perfect conditions for a fight.

So go there and beat the hell out of someone.

checkText.en: Did you do it?

finishText.en: Keep it up! Come back tomorrow, we'll give you a new task.

goal.en: Complete the Pledge of Fervor quest

startText.en:
Let's get this guild business over with.

It's simple: by proving to me you are ready to help your guild, you are proving your willingness to help the Free Traders.

Anyway, collect Marks of Diligence and do it. It might take you a while, but nobody said it was going to be easy!

checkText.en: Have you dealt with the anarchists?

finishText.en: That's what I'm talking about! I'll see you tomorrow.

goal.en: Complete the Heavenly Fire quest

startText.en:
Well, it's time to get serious.

If you heard about the events in Irdrich, you know that we've managed to establish a stable connection to the Illusory World. You can now bring whatever you need from that world. And the Tekyan and Aviaks are in the process of relocating... So you can't say that world doesn't exist.

But there are still those who want to ruin everything. I'm talking about the Aviak anarchists, of course. It's time to put an end to this mess. Go to the Illusory World and deal with them!

checkText.en: Is it done?

finishText.en: That's the stuff! Here, I'll see you tomorrow.

goal.en: Complete the Astral Secret quest

startText.en:
Oh, those trips through time and time paradoxes!

You know, if the Empire hadn't managed to get enough components of League ships, they wouldn't have sold the mystery of astral energy! Which means their fleet would have been destroyed by the astral demons. That's how it is. But Yasker managed to deliver enough parts to Igsh, and then they told the smart guys from ZIT Headquarters what they needed them to do.

So this is your next task: travel to the past and help the Empire with the components.

checkText.en: How is the siege going?

finishText.en: What a feat! You’ve earned this reward!

goal.en: Complete the Storm the Isle! quest

startText.en:
Eljune is an important place for the Free Traders. Lots of meetings and other important events take place there, lots of deals are being made as we speak.

But there's a problem called the Bloody Outpost.

The Imperial forces are still stationed there, and they stop anyone who has any connection to the Empire. It's creating many problems.

I believe it's time to replace the head of the Outpost! Hopefully the Empire will be more lenient towards our operations than the League. Well, you know what to do.

checkText.en: Have you fired the cannon?

finishText.en: Good job, hero!

goal.en: Complete the A Shot at the Enemy quest

name.en: Day 11: A Shot at the Enemy

startText.en:
Well, listen here, hero. Brave Imperial soldiers are fighting the remaining demon forces on Yazes!

Yes, demons are still a threat... And they have a... lair? nest? base? on that cursed island. I don't know. They just keep coming.

In any event, the League and Imperial soldiers will be there for a while.

But the morale is dropping! We need to do something about that, to ensure that the astral trading routes near Yasker are secure. Your exploits inspire many, so go there and perform some kind of feat. Shoot an Octulhu from a cannon, for example.

checkText.en: Are you done?

finishText.en: Oh, you're done already? The world won't forget that! Here, come back tomorrow.

goal.en: Complete the Power of Thought quest

startText.en:
Sarn's cultists.

Some believe they are just madmen who want us all to be devoured by demons.

On the other hand, they have some interesting technologies. Cloning. Portal magic. Death rays!

We'd like to get our hands on some of that... But alas, we've been unsuccessful in that regard. Just no luck.

Perhaps you'll have more luck. We know that the cultists are trying to hide something on the Twilight Isle. Go there and try to steal the blueprints with the help of the allied Wormfaces.

checkText.en: Did you win?

finishText.en: Must have been a nice race!

goal.en: Complete the Marathon quest

startText.en:
Are you confused?

There are enemy Wormfaces and allied Wormfaces. There are enemy Draconids and allied Draconids. There are enemy cultists and... yes, correct! Allied cultists.

Well, the world is not black and white. And after the events you took part in, it has gotten even more complicated. Some still stick to the old ways, but others... might have looked at you and decided to act differently.

Where am I going with this? On the Wandering Island, we managed to reach an agreement with Sarn's cultists. Some of them work with the Demonologists. So one of the local cultists, Nomarkh Ankh, decided to arrange Spark races. And races mean profit. Meaning money, heh.

We want you to participate and win! So go there and do everything you can to win the race.

checkText.en: Back already?

finishText.en: Oh, I wish I could go on adventures like that... Anyway, I'll see you tomorrow!

goal.en: Visit any astral allod

startText.en:
We'll take a break from our extremely important missions, heh.

Let's talk about your tasks. What's the most important thing for a hero?
Besides the runes, it's equipment, of course. Various artifacts you can find in the deep layers of the Astral. I hope you travel to the Astral often?

Let's see! Visit an astral allod, defeat the enemies there and report back to me.

checkText.en: Did you do it?

finishText.en: Amazing places, aren't those? Well, this is just the beginning...

goal.en: Complete the Secrets from the Depths of the Earth quest

startText.en:
It's time for serious business! Listen here: together with Nihaz, lots of new things came to this world, such as the ability to create personal allods. Everyone and their dog has one these days, hehe.

The Free Traders are taking advantage of that, of course. We started working on a truly grandiose project – a real continent.

Alas, it's not going that well. To understand why we're running into so many issues, we need samples of the minerals from one of our newly created allods, the Cradle. Grab them and come back here.

checkText.en: I hope you're here for your gold medal.

finishText.en: What a hero! You've earned this reward! Don't forget to come back tomorrow.

goal.en: Complete the Dionic Games: Chariot Race quest

startText.en:
Races are very profitable.

I'm talking about bets, of course. And it also turns out that the most spectacular races take place at the Dionic Games arranged by the Aoidoi. They are pretty amazing.

The Aoidoi knew what they were doing. Well, we profit from those races quite a bit. Of course, you understand what's expected of you – you need to travel there, take part in the race, and win the first place.

Just choose time carefully: races are held according to schedule, so try not to pick the busiest time!

checkText.en: Are you done?

finishText.en: Thank you on behalf of all geologists!

startText.en:
You probably know that the history of the Free Traders is tied to the meteorite that allowed us to create astral ships that travel between allods and transport goods.

When the secret of astral travel became generally available, ancient blades forged from meteorite steel were melted down, and more ships were built every year.

But that's not what I wanted to talk to you about. There was a war for the meteorite on Kirah. I want to know if we can affect the history to ensure that the Empire gets more meteorite. Perhaps then we'll have more ships in the present? I don't know, really. All these time tricks sound like rubbish.

Your task is to help the Empire gain an advantage in the battle for the mine.

checkText.en: So, did you do it?

finishText.en: A worthy undertaking! Go now, I need to come up with something for you to do tomorrow...

goal.en: Complete the Helping the Ghost Hunters: Preventive Hit quest

startText.en:
The Free Traders sympathize with various adventure seekers who hunt for treasures in the ruins of old cities. We are happy to buy their discoveries from them – to resell them later at a higher price.

But there are adventurers who cross the line... Such as the famous Treasure Seekers known for their raiding and pillaging. The so-called Gray Prince's minions!

It's time we reminded them that the Free Traders have a long reach. So your task is to deal with them. Find those four scoundrels that are hiding on the Isle of Revelation and have a talk with them.

checkText.en: Did you do it?

finishText.en: Wonderful! I'll prepare a special task for tomorrow!

goal.en: Complete the Klavdia's Challenge quest

startText.en:
There's some girl in Sarnaut the Free Traders are extremely interested in. She's known as Klavdia Kalugina.

The problem is, we know very little about her. And we'd like to know as much as possible.

But she's not easy to get close to. She never stays long in one place. It's some sorcery.

Now listen here. I'll give you a special device. You'll go to Tka-Rik's Cave and complete her tasks. Then you'll report to me. You don't need to do anything. Just stay close to her for some time, and you'll do us a great favor.

checkText.en: Have you completed your task?

finishText.en: I have no doubts about your strength now. But I still have a few special tasks prepared...

goal.en: Complete the Death to Our Foes! quest

startText.en:
Today you and I will help some cultists.

Semer Knef wrote to me recently. They are ready to share some of their technologies with us if we lend them our support.

The enemy Wormfaces who serve Nihaz, and Agrus's Draconids – who are even more vicious – have sent reinforcements to the Wandering Island... It sounds like they are trying to capture the Palace Square and the path that leads to the Seal of Darkness.

They must be stopped. Use the cultist forces to seize control of the square.

checkText.en: Is the fight over?

finishText.en: I never doubted you! Take your reward and come back tomorrow!

goal.en: Participate in any skirmish

startText.en:
As for the Battlefields, we have an incentive program from the Tycoons. Haven't you heard?

Well, what matters is it works, heh. Bets on combats, broadcasts via Astralophone.

We need to support our pals!

So go to the Battlefields. Try to win, of course.

checkText.en: Is the race over?

finishText.en: You're quick on your feet! Keep it up.

goal.en: Complete the Dionic Games: Steeplechase quest

startText.en:
You're good at fighting, hehe.

What about running? Like an obstacle course? Yes, we want to negotiate a contract regarding Dionic Games broadcasts.

So we can attract more viewers. So it's nice of you to show how impressive a victory can be.

So today's task is for you to travel to the Dionic Archipelago and take part in the race.

checkText.en: Did you do it?

finishText.en: Wonderful! Everyone benefits!

goal.en: Complete the Grain of the Gold from the Past quest

name.en: Day 23: Grain of the Gold from the Past

startText.en:
Time is a in interesting thing.

Even the Great Mages have a hard time understanding what it is, why it only flows forward and how it can be affected.

One of the tools that can influence it is the Observatory. Another is the Whirlpool of Time.

While we can't get to the Observatory, we've been studying the Whirlpool for some time.

We know it causes curious anomalies on Kirah – Time Storm and Crocosaur Hunt, which in turn create Elementals of the Odds and Crocosaurs – creatures from the distant past.

You can get actual rewards from them – grains, carats, ounces, and pounds of Gold from the Past. The exchange rate isn't that great today, but nevertheless it's an interesting phenomenon.

Bring me one such grain.

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Another exploit! Never doubted you.

goal.en: Complete the Broken Chain quest

startText.en:
I already talked about that, but now I should tell you more: after their defeat, the demon cultists split into two groups. One is headed by Semer Knef. He's an Arisen who is willing to work with us. He's providing assistance to Maya Voronina. We also got something from him...

But the radical ones are a different matter. Those who want to see the world burn. They are led by Lada Grusova, Aristarkh Zlobin, and Lawrence Weirdin. They still have control of Yazes Shards.
Zlobin and Weirdin decided to move Twilight Isle away from the Isle of Revelation.

To make it possible, they started restoring targets carried by astral Octulhus.

We can't let that happen, of course. So your mission is simple: destroy the targets by completing the Wormfaces' task.

checkText.en: Is the battle over?

finishText.en: You are very good at fighting. Good job!

goal.en: Complete the Dionic Games: Gladiator Battle quest

startText.en:
You know, people are getting bored with usual combats. They demand something new: for girls to fight in the mud, and for runes to be unequipped during fights. In short, they want something new, something unusual.

So we have another option: gladiator fights on the Ammer Arena. Why? Give someone a spear, sword, or a throwing axe. An interesting idea. Splitting a skull with an axe.

Anyway, that's where we'll set up this betting business.

You just need to be an example.

checkText.en: Did you do it?

finishText.en: Keep it up!

goal.en: Complete the Grain of Experience quest

startText.en:
Our smart guys are still studying the Whirlpool of Time.

Just think about it. Portals to the past created by arch... ahri... ah, blast it, you know what I mean – these portals existed only for a moment... but the Whirlpool has functioned for years.

They gave me some notes. Surprisingly enough, each temporal anomaly contains a significant amount of destructive energy.

There's something connecting the Astral, time... and astral demons. Interesting, isn't it?

But I won't bore you with all the details. We're mainly interested in theories that can turn into profit. Someone is willing to pay for the Grans of Experience. So bring them here.

checkText.en: Well, how is it going?

finishText.en: Have you helped everyone? Commendable.

goal.en: Complete the Twilight Isle Cannons quest

startText.en:
It looks like our activities on Twilight Isle made the cultists unhappy.

They contacted their demons... Those who didn't join Ollum.

And sent a lot of them to defend their targets.

Well, we'll have to shoot them down. Grab a cannon and get rid of those pesky creatures.

checkText.en: Is it over already?

finishText.en: If only these things happened every day. Here, take it!

goal.en: Visit the June Catacombs

startText.en:
Our marathon is nearing its end – don't expect the tasks to be easy!

June Catacombs are located deep inside the Gipat mountains. They still hold many treasures, but there's never a shortage of treasure hunters.

It's time for you to have a go at it. Or are you a frequent visitor already?

At any rate, you need to go there and try to get at least one treasure.

checkText.en: What, the race is over already?

finishText.en: That was fun... Don't forget about the task tomorrow!

goal.en: Complete the Race quest

startText.en:
Let's have some fun before the final day? We've accomplished so much already... You must have noticed that we often ask you to take part in different competitions...

Well, they are profitable. Any competition can be bet on.

As you know, the first famous race took place on Kirah. It's time for you to go there – pick your best mount and try to win the race among the sand dunes and storms.

checkText.en: You're done already? Really?

finishText.en: Oh, you've finished your last task... Well, that was fun! Hopefully we’ll meet again! I'll report your success, don't worry.

goal.en: Defeat all strong enemies in the Observatory on low difficulty

startText.en:
This is the final day... I have prepared something special – we want to understand how the Observatory works.

I'll give you a small device... you just need to take it with you – you won't have to do anything with it.

But to understand how the Observatory works, you'll have to defeat all enemies it will send at you next week.

Of course, Cosmos mustn't find out. So don't tell anyone about our little task.

finishText.en: Keep it up! You can take a break, see you tomorrow.

goal.en: Complete the Daily Pilgrimage quest

startText.en:
You have proved your loyalty to your guild, but what about your country?

In short, every warrior must remember where their path began. When did you last visit the place where you received your first instructions? We want you to return there and provide whatever assistance is needed.

checkText.en: Hello! Haven't seen you for ages! Ha ha...

finishText.en: So, you are good at navigation. I'm going to open a portal for you, as you are going to travel a lot. The truth is not waiting for you around the corner. You are going to spend time searching for it. I hope you already learned this lesson on Gipat.

goal.en: Use the June portal on Gipat to get to the Crossroads.

startText.en:
Ha ha! Relax, I'm kidding! Of course I can write, and I know a lot about this document.
But we will talk about it later and in a different place - an amazing one, trust me. They call it the Crossroads, a small allod where you will make the first steps towards the new Revelation.
Well, I suppose you have a lot of questions. I will answer one now so you stop thinking about it again and again. Yes, I am the Director. It was me who used the drakes on Gipat to mess with your head. And believe me, it wasn't the last of me.
Now go to the village, find the June portal, activate it to teleport to the Crossroads and meet me there.
See you!

checkText.en: Is everything clear?

finishText.en: Fine. Now you know enough to travel in time.

goal.en: Ask the guide about your future adventures. You can only ask three questions.

startText.en:
As you can see, I'm not an innkeeper. I'm rather a guide, a lead... But less talk of me, let's get back to business.
It's time to dive into the secrets of the past and learn why everything is so fragile and so beautiful in this world. And another fascinating pastime is an attempt to change the course of nature.
Believe me, everything can be changed - any event, even it happened a long time ago. All you need is to go back into the past. You don't know how to do that?
I'm not saying it's easy. You have to tear the fabric of reality, to reshape it... It takes lots of efforts.
You can ask me three questions to get a grasp of what awaits you and why it's so important. And of course, you will get your answers.

checkText.en: Is everything clear?

finishText.en: Fine. Now you know enough to travel in time.

goal.en: Ask the guide about your future adventures. You can only ask three questions.

You can ask me three questions to get a grasp of what awaits you and why it's so important. And of course, you will get your answers.

checkText.en: Do you have the Ashes of the Past?

finishText.en: These are perfect! The Whirlpool of Time awaits!

goal.en: Give one handful of the Ashes of the Past to Gorislav if you want to use the Whirlpool of Time.

startText.en: As I told you, the time needs to be satiated. The Ashes of the Past are its favorite course. If you want to ride the waves of time, you have to feed it. Bring me a handful of the Ashes if you want to use the Whirlpool of Time. You will have to visit the Astral Graveyard to get them. If you want to dive into the Whirlpool of Time right now, give me a handful of the Ashes.

checkText.en: Do you have the Ashes of the Past?

finishText.en: Great. Now the Whirlpool of Time can send you back into the past Kirah.

goal.en: Give one handful of the Ashes of the Past to Gorislav if you want to use the Whirlpool of Time.

startText.en:
As I told you, the time needs to be satiated. The Ashes of the Past are its favorite course. If you want to ride the waves of time, you have to feed it.
Bring me a handful of the Ashes if you want to use the Whirlpool of Time. You will have to visit the Astral Graveyard to get them.
If you want to dive into the Whirlpool of Time right now, give me a handful of the Ashes.

checkText.en: Is everything clear?

finishText.en: Great. Now we can continue.

goal.en: Ask Gorislav about changing the past.

startText.en: Now that we changed the events of March 910, we can go further. Your actions reshaped the fabric of reality, and it turned out that certain events never happened. Do you understand what I am talking about? Ask me more if something is still unclear.

checkText.en: Have you stockpiled some Ashes for the future? Or for the past, ha?

finishText.en: Great. Now you can go back to Kirah.

goal.en: Go to the Astral Graveyard, get 10 handfuls of the Ashes and bring them to Gorislav on the Crossroads.

startText.en:
As you know, in this new version of reality the demons have failed to capture Kirah at one stroke, so they had to change their tactics. They are throwing more and more forces into the battle, still willing to destroy Kirah.
But now we have a chance to save the complete allod, not a small part of it! Especially if we stop demons from destroying the meteorite ore hidden in the depths of the allod. Let's see if we manage to do it. Everything depends on you now.
The new task requires you to eliminate several prominent figures of the past. You will need more Ashes of the Past to do that. Go to the Astral Graveyard and get 10 handfuls. Should you succeed, you won't have to spend the Ashes to use the Whirlpool of Time anymore.

checkText.en: Did you manage to save Kirah?

finishText.en: You did it! I know it wasn't easy. Still, our enemy came up with a countermove!

goal.en: Save Kirah from destruction and report back to Gorislav.

startText.en:
I'm sending you to Kirah, into the 5th of March, year 910 - the day when the League and the Empire forces tried to hold back the demonic invasion. You won't need to prove them anything, they will put absolute trust in you.
Make use of this opportunity and save Kirah. Remember that the main supply of the meteorite ore is located not inside the mine, but to the north of it. This place will be the first priority target for demons. You must stop them.
I recommend you to speak with your old friends first. Yasker or Eniel will tell you what to do.

checkText.en: I hope I will help you understand what's going on.

finishText.en: Now you know a lot more. I just need to find a new task for you.

goal.en: Ask Gorislav about the threat from the future and the new tactics.

startText.en:
Yes, I know everything. I know of the mysterious demon that attacked you. I know of your death. You see, I know quite a lot.
Does it mean that I'm omnipotent? We will talk about it later. Someday in the future, if a time of prosperity finally comes. For now, the future represents only a threat for us.
So let's discuss our new tactics.

checkText.en: You will get your answers later. First you must find the charm.

finishText.en:
Here it is. A part of the Seal...
Oops! It seems my tongue is too long for my teeth! Do you want to ask me anything? Are you wondering what the Seal is?
Ha ha! The story becomes more intriguing! Isn't it great?

goal.en: Get the Charm of the Astral Silver by completing quests on the June Tomb Isle, then return to Gorislav Gipitsky at the Crossroads.

startText.en:
The portal will now send you to another Astral isle called the June Tomb.
In the middle of it you will see an ancient June pyramid. It was built over the place where the Great Dragon Hunter of Junes found his eternal rest.
The restless spirit of the Hunter is still wandering around the tomb. It's difficult to explain, but the most important thing for us is that the spirit can give you a special Charm of the Astral Silver.
I see you want to know how the Charm is related to the Astral Silver and to the powers of the Great Martyrs. And maybe you are curious about the fact that this thousand years old Charm will help you defeat the demon created in the future?
One day you will know the answers. But it won't happen before you get the Charm.

checkText.en: Well? Isn't this world full of surprises?!

finishText.en: Now you know the secret of Great Mages' immortality. Let's go back to our concerns!

goal.en: Ask Gorislav about the mystery of the Great Mages.

name.en: A Mystery of the Great Mages

startText.en:
Okay, let's be serious. I'm going to tell you a secret related to your next task. This is a great secret indeed, and the task you are up for is a great one, too, in its own way.
Come closer. I'll whisper you something about the Great Mages...

checkText.en: Hello. Do I know you?

finishText.en:
Actually, it doesn't matter if we met before or not. During my adventures I've met a lot of new friends.
All you need to know is that Gorislav sent me. You can think of me as of his daughter. It's not entirely true, but quite close. I'm here by his order.

goal.en: Find the key to the Secret Cave, enter it and retrieve the Dragon's Heart.

startText.en:
So, I want you to bring me the Dragon's Heart. Consider this task an opportunity to prove that you trust me. I'll explain everything later, the way to infinite power will be revealed to you.
I'll send you into the period of time when the demon attack is driven off. The League and the Empire can take a breath, and Yasker and Eniel are proceeding with their secret mission. They are ready to entrust it to you, a powerful and devoted traveler from the future. Speak with them and go to the Secret Cave, where the Heart is hidden. It is guarded by Nezeb Falcons under Vlad's command. You won't be able to avoid fighting them. But that's the only way to get the key to the Secret Cave.

finishText.en:
Well, what should I tell you?
Something about Sarn? Let's keep it for the future.
Who is Nih? You'll know eventually...
I'd like to end my story of the Great Mages and the secret of their immortality with a small riddle. Here it is.
We know that there are three substances resistant to the Astral: meteorite ore, the Great Dragon remains and the Great Mages, whose immortality is ensured by the blood of the Great Dragons.
The meteorite ore is alien to our world, it has been brought here by an meteor collided with our lands ages ago, when no one lived here except the Great Dragons.
The Great Dragons don't belong to our world either. They came here from afar. Maybe that's why they can resist the Astral.
And now, the Great Mages, who drink the blood of the Great Dragons. Is there any connection? Think about it!
Are you bored? Waiting for your reward? Don't you care about the secrets of our world? Huh! A couple years ago I was just like you!

goal.en: Meet Gorislav on the Crossroads.

startText.en:
Now return to Gorislav. He will reward you and tell you another fascinating story!
My daddy loves telling stories!

finishText.en:

Something about Sarn? Let's keep it for the future.
Who is Nih? You'll know eventually...

goal.en: Meet Gorislav on the Crossroads.

startText.en:
Now return to Gorislav. He will reward you and tell you another fascinating story!
My daddy loves telling stories!

checkText.en: Have you persuaded Yasker, Negus Tot and Fang?

finishText.en: Great. Now, to our main goal.

goal.en: Return to old Kirah and use the Ashes of the Past on three key figures of the Empire: Yasker, Negus Tot and Fang the Nomadic, then return to the Servant of Time on Kirah.

startText.en:
If you have the Ashes of the Past, we can discuss our plans.
The Whirlpool of Time will send you a hundred years back, into the 3rd of March, year 910. What happened on Kirah on that day? Right - the night of Astral Portals.
The League Army landed on the Imperial allod Kirah in order to capture its meteorite ore supply. The best warriors fought there. And almost all of them perished in the battle. The day after, demons arrived and the Astral started to devour Kirah... You should read about it if you are interested in details.
Just imagine - what if the battle between the League and the Empire never took place? What if the both sides knew of the danger of the demonic invasion?
Let's try and see what's going to happen. You are returning to the old Kirah and try to change the past. It won't be easy.
Three persons in the Imperial army can change the course of the events: younger Yasker, the future Leader of the Empire, Negus Tot, Zem scientist and friend of Nefer Ur, and Fang the Nomadic, Wrokag's great grandfather. A handful of the Ashes of the Past should be used on each of them to make them believe that you are from the future. Don't be surprised if they won't pay attention at first. Your goal is to persuade them.
The fourth handful of the Ashes will send you into the past through the Whirlpool of Time. When you complete this task, find my assistant at the Imperial camp on Kirah. He will give you further instructions.

checkText.en: Have you persuaded Eniel, the Fidgets and Lazarus?

finishText.en: Great. Now, to our main goal.

goal.en: Return to old Kirah and use the Ashes of the Past on key figures of the League: Eniel de Ardeur, the Fidget Family and Lazarus Valir, then return to the Servant of Time on Kirah.

startText.en:
If you have the Ashes of the Past, we can discuss our plans.
The Whirlpool of Time will send you a hundred years back, into the 3rd of March, year 910. What happened on Kirah on that day? Right - the night of Astral Portals.
The League Army landed on the Imperial allod Kirah in order to capture its meteorite ore supply. The best warriors fought there. And almost all of them perished in the battle. The day after, demons arrived and the Astral started to devour Kirah... You should read about it if you are interested in details.
Just imagine - what if the battle between the League and the Empire never took place? What if the both sides knew of the danger of the demonic invasion?
Let's try and see what's going to happen. You are returning to the old Kirah and try to change the past. It won't be easy.
The following persons in the League army can change the course of the events: the Great Mage Eniel de Ardeur, the Fidget Family, the ancestors of Froddy the Fidget, and Lazarus Valirsky of the noble Valir family. A handful of the Ashes of the Past should be used on each of them to make them believe that you are from the future. Don't be surprised if they won't pay attention at first. Your goal is to persuade them.
The fourth handful of the Ashes will send you into the past through the Whirlpool of Time. When you complete this task, find my assistant at the League camp on Kirah. He will give you further instructions.

checkText.en:
The Great Dragon had to reshape the past, too, in order to create draconids.
