The problem is, I need young cactus juice for it... As far as I know, they can be found behind the oasis, in the sands near the river in the northern part of the desert. I'm too scared to go there... But you're brave enough!

Can you help me out? I'll put in a good word for you!

checkText.en: How would I know...

finishText.en: Come here, little sand, I'll use you to make a weapon...

goal.en: Procure Enchanted Gold Sand

startText.en:
Remember when I told you about other miracles on Suslanger?

The local Sand Elementals are one of them. I'm trying to understand if we can create an army of them!

What? There is so much sand around, and we have so few guards.

They always appear one at a time, and always in the same place - on one river bank or the other! I'll show you.

When they die, they leave a bit of gold sand behind - can you get some for me?

checkText.en: Well, can I tell you about my success now?

finishText.en: Everyone will be ecstatic that we can finally walk freely near the walls!

goal.en: Defeat a male or female Carter Raider.

startText.en:
You see, I'm still trying to salvage my reputation...

I read in the books that everyone loves saviors. I won't make a good savior, as you know...

But you are a born one! That's why I've come up with a plan...

The Orcs keep raiding us. Their Carters are the worst. You can't escape or catch them... Now if you defeat one of them, I'll tell everyone it was my idea to ask you!

So they will love you and me both. What do you think?

checkText.en: Now, where are my daggers?

finishText.en: Give them here...! Ah, I cut myself...

goal.en: Obtain daggers of the Court of Miracles

startText.en:
You've helped Kasim with the thieves from the Court of Miracles...

I also have an interest in that, but only a scientific one! Their daggers are so peculiar...

If I had a bunch or two, I might be able to discover their secret eventually...

Could you get me a few? I'll give you a scanner. It's a more advanced model than Kasim's!

checkText.en: Did you take the water to the jinns?

finishText.en: That's more like it! Profit for me and respect for you.

goal.en: Deliver 3 crates of water to jinns in the desert and report back to Kasim Izetbekin

startText.en:
Personally I have no interest in the events outside the city, but my friends do...

One of them - I won't tell you his name - does business with the jinns. I'll tell you what it is, but we'll keep this between us, got it?

Anyway, he supplies water to them, and they sell it in the desert for twice the price. It's all fair, the profit is split 75/25.

I don't know what the jinns do with their share - maybe they toss it away, or maybe they spend it on something useful...

That's something to think about before bedtime.

The hardest part for you is to deliver the water to the farthest part of the desert.

checkText.en: I don't see any meat...

finishText.en: Oh, the kebab would taste divine!

goal.en: Obtain 10 pieces of Ifrit Pet Meat and report back to Kasim Izetbekin.

startText.en:
My friend makes the best kebab in the city!

He has some picky gourmets among his customers. They only eat Suslanger food!

And what says Suslanger more than a piece of meat from Ifrit servants?!

I'm sure you can easily handle it - you are out in a Storm all the time!

Which meat do you need? Any meat, just bring a lot and quickly! Champing Spider will do as well - they are like pets to Ifrits, so if there is no Storm, you can get some meat from them.

checkText.en: Did you bring the water?

finishText.en: But we will sell ordinary water to the tourists...

goal.en: Fill 5 bottles with water from oases and report back to Kasim Izetbekin.

startText.en:
Some of my friends make a decent living by selling unusual drinks...

And they have run out of Ifrit Water. What is that? Just plain water from Ambrosia oases which supposedly absorbs "special energies" after a Storm.

What's the difference? I have no idea, but people pay a lot for it, and we don't cheat our customers!

Anyway, you'll help us a great deal if you go and fill five bottles with water. We don't need more than that.

finishText.en: Hi, greenhorn! So we meet again... Look, this desert is a dangerous place - almost as dangerous as the Astral. There are treasures and monsters! One of them is Uro-Boros, a huge worm that has been terrorizing the neighborhood. But we are the Landfill Warriors! Nothing scares us. I'll give you a thing, it'll come in handy for what we have planned.

goal.en: Meet with Reya the Merciless on Suslanger.

startText.en:
It sounds like Fury might have a job for you. She wants you to meet with her sister. Here's what she wrote.

"Hi, buddy! I'm not good at writing letters, so I'm sorry if I'm doing this wrong! There's something that should interest you. It's about the worm, darn it! We've had enough of it. So we decided to deal with it once and for all. Want to learn more? My sister Reya the Merciless will explain all the details. Anyway, come over here, we'll tell you everything!"

You should pay a visit to this Reya.

checkText.en: Patience, land dweller. Wait for the worm to get closer to the surface - that's when we'll get it!

finishText.en: The worm is defeated? But as we know from experience, it will be back! It's really hard to kill - even if you cut it into pieces, it will just grow back the missing parts! So come back next week, we'll be hunting it again!

goal.en:
Join the hunt for Uro-Boros and defeat it.

You can learn the details from Reya the Merciless near the Landfill on Suslanger.

startText.en:
We are going on a hunt for this vermin! Death to the worm! He has devoured too many of our brethren. It's time for payback!

Will you join us? Look, I think that creature has plenty of useful stuff in its belly - I doubt it can digest meteorite ore! So come with us, you won't leave empty-handed!

checkText.en: Take care not to go to the Astral! If something goes wrong, wave your hands and shout like crazy. It normally helps.

finishText.en: This surely is a grand exploit - to overrun a little crabbie on a rocket! Anyway, here's your reward.

goal.en: Win a crab race. Use tailwind and avoid dead wind.

kickText.en: I told you my crabs were the best of the best throughout whole Sarnaut!

startText.en:
You like crab races? Sand everywhere... Ha ha, nevermind! That's in the past! I have bred the kind of crabs that make every other crab look like a snail. My crabs are so fast that they run on water! Imagine a race with those crabs! You'd need a rocket to keep up with them! You don't believe me? I'll show you! Here are the rocket and the crabs. I'm betting a pile of seashells that you won't be able to catch up with them!
To give you a sporting chance, I'll even tell you the secret of flying over the sea. It's all about air currents! Watch the air move over the water. Some winds are blowing into your back, and in some spots, the air is still. I'm only telling you this because I'm one hundred percent confident in my crabs: even if you catch all the favorable winds, you won't outrun Breeze or Thunder, and you won't even notice my beautiful Lightning before she's off! So are you flying? Or are your knees shaking already?

checkText.en: Swim up quietly to a bather, then jump out of the water and clatter your teeth! This way they will learn there are some dangerous creatures in these waters, too!

finishText.en: Haha, this is so much fun! Did you see how they twitched their feet and threw their hands up? Now they will know that Nile is no idler - Nile is watching out for enemies!

goal.en: Pretend to be a shark and scare other players while staying in the water.

startText.en:
They are laughing at me! They don't believe I'm doing useful work, watching out for hostile crabs. They say, "lazy Nile keeps making stuff up". If it wasn't for me, the crabs would have bitten off their feet!

You want to help me? Pretend to be a shark and scare one of them... Or three! Scare three of them so they know Nile isn't here for nothing, that Nile is looking out for them!

checkText.en: Hope you are having a great time!

finishText.en: Great! Now you know the most significant persons of our tribe. If you want to have fun, don't be shy to ask them!

goal.en: Meet Bup the Glassy, Ole the Hospitable and Dodo the Crabber, then return to Zouzou.

startText.en:
Welcome to our sunny island, traveler! Get ready to enjoy the best entertainment you can imagine!
We have all kinds of activities here: Bup the Glassy invites everyone to participate in his Tipsy Marathon. Zip the Wing-Footed is arranging a sporting event.
Dodo the Crabber has organized exciting crab races.
There is also deep-sea diving for those who like swimming -  you know, you can find amazing stuff on the seabed!
And of course, our atoll is famous for its Karah-Oki event! Everyone loves it! After all, everybody loves singing! The best performers will be rewarded generously.
So, I suggest you to take a walk around the island and meet our locals. Enjoy yourself!

checkText.en: Everyone loves summer and the hot sun...

finishText.en: How do you like it here? All fun and play, right? Here's your gift.

goal.en: Meet Cola Speed, Deli Lightheart, Jack Cheap and Nile Waterwalk, then report to Zouzou "Seven Steps".

startText.en:
Welcome, welcome! Have you been here before? We've got so much new stuff! It's hard to list everything, but I'll try.
First, Cola Speed, our crab breeder, created a new type of crab. They can run on the surface of water! And they are so fast, they can outrun a rocket!
Second, we've got our own Squawker now! His caretaker is Deli Lightheart, talk to him when you have time. If you let him, he'll be telling you about wings and feathers all day long.
Third, there's Jack Cheap. He's a businessman who wants to be a Free Trader, but he's short of gold to do that. Keep your eyes peeled, or he'll clean you out.
And the last one that might be of interest is Nile Waterwalk. He's a strange guy. I have no idea what he's about. Maybe you can figure him out?
Go meet them all, and then come back to me for a welcome gift. Just for fun!

checkText.en: The Aviaks came to visit us! They are strange.

finishText.en:
So how do you like our new entertainment? That's not all of it!

Here are your new seashells.

goal.en: Visit Jack, Meet Shlep the Slapper, Gik the Winged, Gugu the Serene, and participate in the Tropical Lottery.

startText.en:
I'm so glad to see you here! I have so many news - I'm telling everyone, so you're next!

First! We have... the Aviaks here! They settled at the northern edge of the bay. They are going to breed riding parrots here, can you believe that? If only our Great Turtle saw that!

One of them, Gik the Winged, organized a sailing competition here. If you want to learn to catch the wind and sail, Gik will explain everything.

Second, there's a volleyball court on the atoll now. Shlep the Slapper and Hugi the Swift are teaching people to play ball. This one, yes. It's fun, so bring your friends!

Our Gugu the Serene has also mastered the art of pebble balancing, so now he invites everyone to build pebble towers. The waves brought plenty of pebbles ashore this year - of all colors. Some clever guy says you can build pebble towers all summer without ever making two exactly alike. Look around you, those towers are everywhere now!

And you'll have to see certain changes to some of the old attractions with your own eyes.

We also have new seashells this year! The old ones are completely faded now, so we caught a few new ones. Go visit Jack Cheap, see what he has in stock. You can spend your old seashells there, too, so if you have some left over from last year, you'll get some use out of them.

Oh, I almost forgot! The lottery ticket I gave you! Play the Tropical Lottery near one of the machines - you might win something useful or get a reward for visiting an attraction.

Run along now! Don't forget to come by afterwards to pick up your gift.

checkText.en: So, have you met Pop and Shosho yet?

finishText.en: Yes, that's how it is! Who knows what new activities we will discover next time!

goal.en: Meet Pop the Puffer and Shosho the Hoarse

startText.en:
Wow! It’s good that you're here. We did not waste time here - we've mastered a lot of new things since last summer!

Like what?

Well, there is Pop the Puffer - he is our best bubble master. A real master in blowing bubbles who makes sure that they don't burst, and most importantly, he knows all the tricks to making the bubbles beautiful and strong. Talk to him - he will teach you the art of blowing.

And Shosho the Hoarse has learned to tame butterflies! He spends every day with them, learning their secrets. And now he dreams of showing you and other tourists his new friends so that you can also enjoy their beauty.

So go visit them. They will offer you new interesting tasks and rewards.

checkText.en: The sea, the sun, and cocktails... What can be better?

finishText.en:
Wow, you're a real bartender! Have you done it before?
Wow... Making a perfect Blue Lagoon and Hurricane at the first try... You've got a real talent!

goal.en: Obtain cocktail recipes from any bartender, gather the fruits, mix 6 different cocktails and bring them to Zouzou.

startText.en:
Wanna learn how to mix cocktails? You've come to the right place!
In fact, it's very simple. We grow seven kinds of fruit on our wonderful atoll. Actually, nobody grows them, they do it on their own, and we pick the fruits. A good cocktail can only be made of fresh fruits!
You can also buy any cocktail from me, but it's much more fun to mix it by yourself! And tastier, too!
Ok, listen. We have pineapple, orange, papaya, banana, coconut, mango and nectarine on our island.
What's that, now? Yes, I know that coconut is a nut! One fell on my head once, and that's when I realized that it's a true nut! But that doesn't matter.
Anyway, get a list of recipes from any bartender, and collect the fruits. The more fruits you bring, the better. You'll be able to make more complex cocktails. Mix each of the six cocktails! You won't regret it, I promise!

checkText.en: And here is our prize winner!

finishText.en:
So, did you enjoy the marathon?
As we say in the Great Turtle tribe, "moderate drinking is harmless, in any quantities".
Now that you have the rum, I can mix for you one of the three versions of Tropicana cocktail. From now on, you are a real marathoneer! Choose the cocktail you like more.

goal.en: Bring a bottle of rum to any bartender to receive your reward.

startText.en:
So the Tipsy Marathon is over.  There is still some buzzing in my head and my legs are moving on their own... But I got so many positive emotions in this amazing marathon!
This bottle of rum will be useful for mixing the most fancy cocktail of the season - an exhilarating Tropicana!
I just need to find a bartender who knows the recipe.

finishText.en: How are you feeling, champion? Head buzzing? Don't worry, it will pass soon!

goal.en: Bring a bottle of rum to any bartender to receive your reward.

kickText.en: Have you failed? Oh but of course, you have to exercise a lot!

startText.en:
The Tipsy Marathon is the best entertainment here! I know what I'm talking about!
The rules are simple - drink a cocktail and go to the next bar. To which bar? The cocktail you've drunk will guide you! Follow Pint Potson! But you must get to the next bar before you sober up, or else you will have to start from the beginning. The drunker you are upon arrival, the more points you receive.
You can learn the details from me or from any bartender.
So, bottoms up?

checkText.en: Do you feel the burst of energy?

finishText.en:
I love sports, running and swimming! And abstinence is a principle of a healthy life! Pity my folks don't think so.
I conduct an athletic competition every 3 minutes to prove my fellow tribesmen that sport is better that their drunken marathon!
Sports, not booze, turned a fish into a waterfolk!

goal.en: Take part in the athletic competition, pass all checkpoints and reach the finish line. Then talk to Zip the Wing-Footed.

kickText.en: Have you lost? I am sure you can win some other time.
Have you lost? I am sure you can win some other time.

startText.en:
Meh, Tipsy Marathon...  What kind of sport is this? Running from bar to bar drinking cocktails, next morning you wake up and your head is ringing like an empty seashell!

You lot should take better care of yourselves. A couple of days ago a company of orcs got so wasted here, they went for a walk in the jungle and got lost! We found some of them fallen asleep under the trees and some wandering helplessly among the palm trees... No thanks, I'm all for the healthy lifestyle.

That's why I'm inviting you to take part in my athletic competition. No alcohol, just running and swimming! All you have to do is follow the route, go through the checkpoints, and reach the finish line. If you make it in time, you'll receive a prize. If you don't, just catch your breath and try again.

Learn to pace yourself, know when to accelerate and when to slow down. Breathe evenly! If you run too fast, you will exhaust yourself.

I'll place tables with refreshments along the route. If you are too tired, have a drink on the run. Our drinks are full of vitamins. They are great for fighting fatigue.

Oh, I almost forgot! The competition starts at the time marked in your calendar.

checkText.en: My little crabs could use a treat... Have you found anything delicious?

finishText.en:
That's more like it! Now that my crabs are full, they will run faster than Steeds!
So, do you want to participate and make a bet on a crab?

goal.en: Dive deep, find an underwater oasis, collect delicate crab feed hidden under stones, then return to Dodo.

startText.en:
Do you like swimming? My friends and I have invented a game - you hold your breath, dive deep and sit under water as long as possible. Whoever comes up last wins the prize! The point is to come up at the end... There were cases where we had to bring round some really persistent divers. But everything is all right, don't worry, nothing bad happened to anyone!
So, the diving contest. It turned out that sitting on the sea bottom is quite boring, so we decided to mix business with pleasure - dive in and pick up delicacies for our racing crabs!
There are various delicious weeds growing at the seabed under the stones. Crabs fancy them greatly. But you can't lift those stones alone, so you'd better dive with friends! Together you'll be able to turn even the biggest stones and pick up a lot of delicacies.
Why am I telling you all that? Just try it, you won't regret it!

checkText.en: My Bonnie lies over the o-o-ocean, my Bonnie lies over the sea...

finishText.en:
Ah, you are such an amazing singer!  I was on the verge of tears. What can I reward you with...
Oh, I know! I'll give you a special seashell with a gift inside. I'm not sure what's in there, but it has to be something useful. So it's going to be both a gift and a surprise!
I see you enjoyed Karah-Oki? Come again later, we'll sing again!

goal.en: Sing Karah-Oki at the start of the hour.

kickText.en: Don't feel blue. No one can always be a winner. Take a rest and try again.

startText.en:
Have fun! Drink all your belly can hold and sing from your heart!
There's nothing better than a good song.
Sing us a song, it doesn't matter if you don't know the lyrics, that's what we have Karah-Oki for. There are no outstanding singers among us, but we sing wholeheartedly.
And those who put their soul into performance deserves a reward! Join us and sing along!
You can also catch some bugs and butterflies to shoot colorful fireworks - it will surely improve your Karah-Oki experience! Fireworks during Karah-Oki can also earn you seashells!
We start singing at the beginning of every hour, so come and join us!

checkText.en: Squawker fly into the light of the dark black night...

finishText.en: So, how have you liked it? Great, right? Oh, I'd love to have such wings myself!

goal.en: Fly Squawker.

kickText.en: Careful! If you happen to fall, no one will be able to put you back together again.

startText.en:
Our Atoll must be the most beautiful place in Sarnaut! But guests would keep talking about some Irdrich. That their sea is warmer, their fruit juicier, the sun brighter... But it's like it's a different world, there's zero proof, just tales! And then some historians found a mysterious prehistorical egg in the depths of the Astral! They said our climate was perfect for hatching the egg. We took it, of course! After a while it hatched, and now we're the only ones who own a Squawker! He's totally tame, and he loves giving people rides! Do you want to see the bird's eye view of our atoll?
There's only one thing we expect from you during the flight. See, he's still in the middle of his training. And we have a tradition! Just listen, don't interrupt! We're teaching him to sing, so you'll have to encourage his singing by shooting fireworks into the sky. So he'll sing better and louder. Got it? If you do so, I'll reward you with seashells!

checkText.en: Did you find anything interesting?

finishText.en: What a beautiful pearl! Here is your reward, as I promised. By the way, pearls always come in handy for me, so if you want, you can dive for pearls as often as you wish!

goal.en: Search seashells on the sea bottom and find a pearl.

startText.en:
Want to earn a few seashells? I have an offer for you!

There are pearl oysters on the bottom of the bay. I use pearls for various crafts. Bring me a pearl - you'll get a seashell. If you have seashells, you can purchase cool stuff from my brother Jack. And if you find something else in the oysters, you can keep it - I only need pearls.

Do we have a deal?

checkText.en: Train your lungs! Or whatever it is your gills are called...

finishText.en:
Wow, it's so big!

Well, you can breathe easy now. Here is your reward!

If you catch another bubble like that - keep inflating it! The reward will be worth it.

goal.en: Catch an inflatable bubble during the "Bubbles!" quest, then summon it and inflate it to the maximum size.

startText.en:
Bubbles are usually very fragile and burst if you touch them. But sometimes you come across unusually durable bubbles!

If you catch such a bubble, take it out of your pocket and try to inflate it. Do this carefully: if the bubble looks like it's about to burst, immediately stop blowing and wait a moment. Let it deflate a little, then continue.

If you can inflate a bubble the size of my house, I'll generously reward you!

checkText.en: Go catch bubbles before the wind carries them away.

finishText.en:
I'd go jump myself but it's fun watching you. You are like salmon in spring! He he!

Here are your shells!

goal.en: Pop 100 bubbles by using the Frog Amulet.

startText.en:
Do you want to try? It's very simple!

The bubbles are over there, see? They fly high above the shore, so you can’t just jump up and reach them. No, no, doing it on a mount doesn't count!

I'll give you a Frog Amulet which will make you jump higher. Then you can jump around the beach to your heart's content and pop the bubbles. You pop a hundred, and I'll reward you!

checkText.en: So how do you like crab races?

finishText.en: Fascinating, isn't it? The main thing is to remember the treats. Our crabs are terribly voracious! Dive deep into the sea and turn the stones to find the food for crabs. The tastiest bits are under those!

goal.en: Make a bet on a crab at Dodo the Crabber.

startText.en:
Place your bets, ladies and gentlemen! Not so fast, I'm writing it down!
What? What bets? Crab races! The most popular pastime on our island.
See those six lanes? When the time comes, I will give a command and the crabs will start running. And the spectators will cheer the crabs on with shouts, applause, and pieces of crab treats.
If your crab comes first, you win.
So, are you willing to participate?

checkText.en: Variety is what's important!

finishText.en:
Did you do everything you wanted? Excellent.

Here's your reward, traveler!

goal.en: Visit 5 different activities.

startText.en: Traveler, have you heard about our new entertainment program? It's not just fun - you can also earn generous rewards. You just need to participate in five various activities!

checkText.en: Do whatever you enjoy!

finishText.en: Here are your seashells!

goal.en:
Participate in any activities 15 times.

{FireDanceTip}

startText.en:
We have many different activities, and you probably have your favorites! Perhaps you enjoy athletic competitions? Or you're a hardcore marathon runner? Or all of those things?

Aside from the main festival program, I suggest that you also participate in the other activities! Join any activities, and you will receive another prize from me.

checkText.en: Don't be shy, no one will peek!

finishText.en:
That's it! For just one seashell you can change your clothes again at any time.

Have fun on the beach!

goal.en: Change clothes in the changing room.

startText.en:
Here you can undress or change into a suitable beach suit.

It costs one Seashell.

Try it!

checkText.en: Praise the summer flame!

finishText.en: This was a fiery dance! Here is your reward! Come back again!

goal.en: When dancing around the bonfire, perform 10 dance combinations without mistakes and pick up 24 lights.

startText.en:
Quarr, wingless outlander! Our festival is magical!

We believe that the fire spirits themselves, children of the hot sun, watch over us from the flames. They are there to tell you which move to make, and you need to carefully follow their hints and avoid mistakes. Then there will be lights! Pick up as many as possible, and then you will receive a good reward.

By the way, dancing takes place every hour. If you fail the first time, come again.

finishText.en: Treat yourself! And take the shells! I'm always happy to see you! Come back soon! And bring your friends!

goal.en: Coco the Cup invites you to Tropical Atoll to try his drinks.

startText.en: A new resident of the Tropical Atoll wants to offer you refreshing drinks. Why not try them, if he's offering?

checkText.en: I need more leaves!

finishText.en: You're off to a good start! Now go, have fun, we'll watch over your pet. Come back tomorrow, I'll have a new task for you.

goal.en: Gather palm leaves, build a nest, and place the egg there.

startText.en:
Quarr, wingless outlander!

What is important for each nestling while it's in the egg? The warmth of their parents? But not just that... A comfortable and soft nest is important! So it knows its parents care about it!

That's why a nest must be built. I'll teach you how to do it: go to the forest, this jungle, find a tree with long leaves, collect them under the tree, then bring them here! Build a nest and put the egg into it!

checkText.en: Don't let it get too warm!

finishText.en: Sunbathing will do you both good. Good job!

goal.en: Take the egg to the beach and warm it up in the sun, then return it to the nest.

startText.en:
Quarr! Do you feel the heartbeat inside the egg? We, the Aviaks, believe that the world once existed inside huge eggs, but then boom... the eggs broke. Now there are broken shells everywhere...

But let's get back to the matter at hand. Topical parrots like warmth and sunbaths. You need to do this: take the egg to the beach, find a special place - there is a pier with a lot of fresh wind and waves, and most importantly, a lot of hot sun rays. Hold the egg in the sun but don't let it overheat, so make sure to turn it from side to side.

checkText.en: Carry it carefully!

finishText.en: Are your arms tired? That's alright, soon your friend will be running around on its own!

goal.en: Walk along the beach with the egg

startText.en:
Quarr, wingless one! The nestling inside is growing by the day. It's getting bigger.

But the little one needs a lot of care. For example, heat and stale air will cause discomfort. So the egg should be taken outside.

Take the egg carefully and walk along the beach - it needs fresh air!

checkText.en: Catch butterflies! Hurry!

finishText.en:
Congratulations! It's a healthy hatchling.

He saw your face first, so you're his parent. He will only accept food from your hands.

Come back tomorrow to feed him.

goal.en: Catch 3 Fat Yellow Butterflies, wait for the bird to hatch, and feed it for the first time.

startText.en:
Quarr! The day has come, wingless one!

See the egg jump? It is time!

Go quickly and find a few fat yellow butterflies. They are the best for a hatchling!

Then protect it as it hatches!

Now go quickly!

checkText.en: Catch the fattest butterflies, the fledgling needs to eat well to grow up!

finishText.en:
Yellow butterfly - for tough feathers. Green butterfly - for good mood!

Any butterfly is tasty and filling. Should last it until tomorrow.

goal.en: Catch Fat Yellow and Green Butterflies and feed the fledgling.

startText.en:
Quarr! Lok-tan-qurr!

The little fledgling is growing quickly. To grow, he must eat a lot. Fortunately, there is a lot of nutritious food on the atoll. Yellow butterfly should do nicely, for example. Green butterfly is even better!

Gather food for your fledgling and feed him!

checkText.en: How is the walk?

finishText.en:
The fledgling looks happy! Quarr!

I'll watch over him now. Come back tomorrow.

goal.en: Walk the fledgling around the lagoon using the bird whistle to call it.

startText.en:
Quarr! The fledgling is happy! He's growing fast!

Well, enough sitting in the nest! He can't fly yet, but he can walk. Here's a bird whistle - if your pet gets confused, just call it.

Now go take a walk! Walk around the atoll, come back tired and happy!

checkText.en: They have excellent appetite, so go catch the fattest bug.

finishText.en:
Quarr! It munches so loudly! Yes, birds have ears, too!

See you tomorrow!

goal.en: Catch 5 Fat Blue Bugs and feed the fledgling.

startText.en:
Quarr! What's the most important thing when raising a kid?

Correct! Feeding it regularly! So you must go find food for it. This time, bring it a fat blue bug - they are the best for this age!

Don't just stand there - go and find the biggest blue bug!

checkText.en: There are nectarines in the jungle. If the local runners haven't eaten them all.

finishText.en:
It's eating it with the skin? Eats like an eagle!

Today we rest, you'll run tomorrow.

goal.en: Pick 5 juicy nectarines and feed the fledgling.

startText.en:
Quarr! Today we are making a big sweet surprise for your little friend.

There is nothing more tasty and healthy for a bright parrot than a juicy ripe fruit! So you go to the grove, look for sunny nectarines in the trees, then come back and feed your little parrot!

It will be really happy!

checkText.en: Nice weather for a walk by the sea!

finishText.en:
It confidently walks next to you. Nice job!

Come back tomorrow!

goal.en: Walk with the fledgling along the coast. Use the bird whistle if your pet gets confused.

startText.en:
Quarr! The parrot is growing by the day. It's time for another walk. You did that before, now do it again. It's not complicated!

Go around the atoll, and don't forget the bird whistle - in case your parrot gets confused!

When you get tired, come back here!

checkText.en: Red bug, purple butterfly. Don't mix them up!

finishText.en:
Quarr! Qwed-qurr!

This little guy is getting more attached to you every day. My heart is overjoyed!

Come back tomorrow, it will be waiting for you.

goal.en: Catch Red Bugs and Purple Butterflies and feed the fledgling.

startText.en:
Quarr! Qurr! Qwedrr!

Today we are expanding your pet's menu. Now we need red bugs and purple butterflies. It's a great combination, I love it myself!

Oh yes, grab your little friend with you. It's always trying to escape. Keep an eye on it.

checkText.en: Show it the sky!

finishText.en:
Oh, what do we have here? Quarr! Someone is flapping their wings! Now that's what I call a good example.

But that's enough for today, let it rest and digest the new experience. Come back tomorrow!

goal.en: Ride a Squawker with your fledgling

startText.en:
Quarr! Wingless outlander! Your little friend is so inspired by your friendship that he wants to imitate everything you do. He doesn't even want to fly - just runs around on foot like he's not a bird at all.

Let's show him what he's destined to do? Take him to Deli Lightheart and go for a ride.

Even if he's on a break, he won't refuse you. It's for a good cause!

checkText.en: There's plenty of fruit in the jungles, just reach out and take it!

finishText.en:
A good walk and a hearty meal are all you need for a sound sleep! And when the fledgling is asleep, you can also take a rest!

We'll see you tomorrow!

goal.en: Pick 6 juicy mangoes and feed the fledgling.

startText.en:
Quarr! Today is an ordinary day. You will go for a walk, then pick a few mangoes! Parrots love them.

So grab your pet and go. Walk, collect fruit - it's all very simple.

checkText.en: Point to the pouch, and the fledgling will bring it to you.

finishText.en:
Did you find all the pouches? I hid them well! A good training before a future journey.

Tomorrow won't be as strenuous. But right now you need rest!

goal.en: Teach the pet to pick up loot

startText.en:
Quarr! You've walked for days and eaten well, now it's time for training! You want your parrot to pick up a few skills, don't you?

I scattered a few pouches with sand around the trails. Let the parrot learn to pick up loot.

checkText.en: Don't feed the fledgling on the road - wait until you are back here. He should learn to be patient.

finishText.en: That's very good. We'll train again tomorrow!

goal.en: Catch Green Bugs and Butterflies and feed the fledgling.

startText.en:
Quarr! Green is my favorite color. Yours too, I hope! Green foliage, green crystals that you are collecting on Suslanger... There's a reason I'm saying this!

Today you'll get a green bug and a green butterfly for your parrot. Lots of greens! Tasty!

checkText.en: Point to the pouch, and the fledgling will bring it to you.

finishText.en:
Quarr! Lok-kurr! Your friend is doing better and better! The fledgling is learning quickly. Gaining confidence. Sometimes even rebelling! Today it's a cute bundle of feathers, tomorrow - an unruly fury.

Appreciate the moment!

I'll be waiting for you with the new sun.

goal.en: Train the fledgling to pick up loot again

startText.en:
Quarr! Days go by so quickly! The fledgling is growing! I hope you appreciate this time...

Today we scattered pouches with sand along the trails again. Let the parrot learn to pick up loot.

checkText.en: Where's that wayward parrot again?

finishText.en:
Doesn't want to come back to the nest? Wears glasses and a hat? Walks on the ground?

I warned you!

Birds imitate their owners! Is that because of your exploits in the marathon? Ha ha!

Don't worry. When the fledgling is walking, he's watching out for fish. Come back tomorrow.

goal.en: Find the fledgling, prepare a treat for it, and feed it.

startText.en:
There you are... Where's the fledgling?

I wish I knew! The wingless are saying some bird is running around the bar.

I'll be watching over the rest, you go check.

checkText.en: There are many pearl oysters on the seabed. And if not, you have to wait until new ones emerge from the sand.

finishText.en:
Well? I told you it would like it!

Let it walk for a bit. There's more work tomorrow.

goal.en: Obtain Pearl Mussel Meat for Kesha

startText.en:
Quarr! Tagar qual kurrah! Your friend did not come back yesterday!

But don't worry, it's all under control. Growing fledglings are always drawn to new and unusual things.

Are you a good swimmer? Excellent! Collect pearl oysters No, not shells! Meat! Fatty pearl mussel meat. Treat your friend to it. Gain trust.

checkText.en: Capricious fledgling? Thirty of them! I'm not surprised.

finishText.en:
What's this outfit? The wingless are a strange influence...

Your friend is back - that's good. I hope he won't run away again tomorrow.

goal.en: Train Kesha to collect trophies

startText.en:
Quarr! Lok-tan-qurr! That's enough walking - it's time to do some work.

Today is training day again - you'll be picking up pouches with sand.

checkText.en: How's the training going?

finishText.en:
If your hero friend says bad words, you reprimand them, too. Set a good example!

Now rest. Come back tomorrow.

goal.en: Explain to Kesha which words are good and which are bad.

startText.en:
Quarr! Hello! Your friend stayed in his nest today!

But we have a little problem. These parrots... can imitate single words. But they repeat everything they hear, just jumbling words together. And we have all sorts of guests here, not just well-mannered elves. I heard words that made my ears bleed.

Please explain to your little friend which words should not be repeated. He respects you - he will listen!

checkText.en: I'll look after it.

finishText.en: I'm glad to see your friend healthy and happy!

goal.en: Obtain a healing potion for the parrot.

startText.en:
Quarr! Your friend is suspiciously quiet and pensive today. You should go see the Wise Woman and ask if you can do anything.

I hope he's not sick. This is sad.

checkText.en: How is jumping going?

finishText.en:
Very well! He's getting stronger by the day.

Come back tomorrow.

goal.en: Run along the trail in the jungles with Kesha and train him to jump!

startText.en:
Quarr! I'm happy to inform you that your little friend is feeling better. He's ready for training!

To strengthen the wings, he needs to learn to jump.

checkText.en: I love bananas myself.

finishText.en:
Quarr! Now I see that your friend is happy and fed. Which means he has enough energy for a new training.

I'll be waiting for you tomorrow at the same spot!

goal.en: Feed 10 sweet bananas to the parrot.

startText.en:
Quarr! The parrot is growing - he needs more food. It needs to be filling. Today you will feed him with bananas.

On your journeys, the parrot will often need to snack along the way. So today you don't need to get back to the nest before feeding him.

checkText.en: You're almost finished, your little helper will be ready soon.

finishText.en:
Quarr! You did well!

I'll see you tomorrow.

goal.en: Run along the trail in the jungles with Kesha and train him to jump!

startText.en: We'll repeat the last training today. Run and jump around the jungles, then come back tired and happy!

checkText.en: Just don't overfeed him.

finishText.en:
Good job! I hope you two left some mangoes for other bird guardians? Ha ha!

There'll be more training tomorrow.

goal.en: Feed 10 juicy mangoes to the parrot.

startText.en:
Quarr! The parrot is getting bigger, he needs more and more food. Tasty, sweet, juicy food.

Grab your friend and go to the jungles! Eat your fill there and come back when your friend is full.

checkText.en: Time flies...

finishText.en:
The order is ready? Excellent.

While the master is preparing the workpiece, we'll have two days to complete the training.

I'll see you tomorrow!

goal.en: Commission riding equipment for the parrot.

startText.en:
Quarr! Qwed-qurr! Well, your pet's training will be finished soon. It's time to think about its future equipment, so a wingless creature like you could be seated comfortably on its wide back.

Go see Kro the Strong Claw - he will tell you what materials he needs.

checkText.en: Your bird is strong.

finishText.en:
Very well! After this training, it will soar high into the sky, I'm sure.

I'll see you tomorrow.

goal.en: Complete the final session of jump training with Kesha.

startText.en:
Quarr! The parrot is strong, fast, and brave! The most skillful in this hatch!

So today is the final day of training! Go to the jungles! Don't knock down any palm trees.

checkText.en: Bon Appétit!

finishText.en:
Quarr! Now that's what I call healthy appetite! Your friend seems pleased.

Tomorrow is a big day. Let him get a good sleep and spend the last night in his nest.

Come back tomorrow. He'll be waiting.

goal.en: Feed Kesha with whatever he asks for.

startText.en:
Quarr! No more training today - today you celebrate!

Or rather, Kesha will celebrate. Treat him to everything you catch or pick in the jungles. Any fat bugs and butterflies, nectarines, mangoes, and bananas. Give him whatever he wants.

Let him eat his fill!

checkText.en: It's an important day!

finishText.en:
Quarr! That's it, ! Congratulations on gaining a loyal friend. Let his wings carry you towards new adventures!

I'm so proud of you! Quarr!

Now go to him - he's waiting outside.

goal.en: Put equipment on the riding parrot and go for a ride.

startText.en:
Quarr! The most important day has come, ! It's important both for you and Kesha.

You are now bound by ties of friendship and loyalty.

Collect your riding equipment and come back.

checkText.en: The Wise Woman will explain everything. Go see her.

finishText.en:
Complete my tasks, and I'll give you a token. Trade it for a Spark from the Wise Woman, then come back here.

If you forget this, I'll remind you!

goal.en: Ask the Wise Woman, Willa the Breeze Whisper, if you can raise Kesha twice as quickly.

startText.en:
The summer on the Tropical Atoll is ending, quarr... Soon the sunrays won't be as warm, and bugs won't be as filling. You need to raise your parrot before the summer ends!

Our Wise Woman knows how to do it. Go see her and find out.

finishText.en:
Welcome to our big nest!

Did Zouzou send you? Wonderful!

goal.en: The Aviaks of the Tropical Atoll invite you to raise your own parrot mount.

startText.en: It looks like the sender of that letter, Zouzou "Seven Steps", invites you to visit the Aviaks and help them with a hatch of parrots. It's curious. It's an opportunity you can't pass up.

checkText.en: Raising a riding parrot is not a quick process. You need to be patient, and everything will work out!

finishText.en:
Kesha seems ready to go with you on a new journey. He can't wait to see the expanses of Sarnaut and fly over it on its bright wings.

It's time to complete this little adventure and start a new one!

goal.en:
Raise a riding mount by completing the tasks of Ar'ra the Big Nest on the Tropical Atoll.

Your progress will be saved even if the quest is not displayed in the log.

startText.en:
Greetings, wingless one! The Atoll is a hot place, full of sun and water, and good soil for raising fledglings.

My tribe has been breeding beautiful and clever parrots for a while now, and this year we selected the Atoll for that. But that's a problem: we don't have enough wings for all the eggs!

We can handle 38, but not 39! The wingless one should help us - take one egg, watch it, raise the parrot, then get a reward! You'll be pleased!

So, let's start?

checkText.en:
The competition will start 5 minutes before the attraction closes.

Once I announce the start, you will have only 10 seconds to start the race.

Don't be late!

finishText.en: Now that's a race!

goal.en: Accept the quest "Athletic Competition", start with everyone 5 minutes before the attraction closes and finish successfully.

kickText.en: I warned you: we're starting on time! Well, try not to be late next time.

startText.en:
Sometimes I organize a friendly run! It's not a competition, but a run side by side with friends.

Start with everyone else, and you'll get an extra reward from me.

checkText.en: Welcome back to summer!

finishText.en: Yes, yes, we've been preparing from September to May! We've spent all our energy thinking of ways to entertain you all! Just look at the costumes - do you want to be a lifeguard or a pirate?

goal.en: Head to the Tropical Atoll and talk to Zip the Wing-Footed, Dodo the Crabber, and Gugu the Serene, then visit Jack Cheap.

startText.en:
Zouzou writes,

"Another summer has come to Sarnaut, herohero!

Wherever you areare: on hot Suslanger, in mysterious Eden, on frosty Isa or on foggy Jigran, remember - a tropical resort is waiting for you!

This year, both new and old activities are ready to entertain you! Warm waves have tossed pebbles of the most bizarre shades on our shores, and prizes now include new costumes and other valuables. Perhaps you want to try your hand at the Athletic Competition with other players? Or try your luck in betting on a randomly selected crab? Solve the riddles of Gugu the Serene?

Come visit us soon, we are waiting for you!"

finishText.en: Don't miss your chance! Catch a star! Or you'll spend the entire year regretting it.

goal.en: Visit Zouzou "Seven Steps" on the Tropical Atoll.

startText.en:
Dear friend! Here comes August, the last month of summer! If you haven't visited our tropical atoll yet, it's time to do that!

Even if you have, I recommend that you do it again. "What for?" you'd ask. The thing is, in August we have extremely beautiful star showers at our sunny resort! You will be able to collect magic little stars and exchange them for new goods.

My dear friend, I insist - because you absolutely must see our spectacular star showers!

checkText.en: The flames shine brighter at night!

finishText.en: That's how exciting this month is! I hope you'll have a good time. And enjoy your rewards.

goal.en: Dance around the small bonfire and gain access to the total sparklet reserve; talk to Chia the Sparklet about Fiery Dancing and to Chai-Ka the Soaring about water lanterns.

startText.en:
Quarr! To find out what you can do during the summer festival, you must see everything for yourself. I'll tell you where to go and what to look for.

Go to the small bonfire and dance there. Then you'll become a part of the holiday and earn sparklets.

Then talk to Chia the Sparklet. She will tell you everything about this dance.

Another activity is launching water lanterns. Visit Chai-Ka, she'll explain everything. There's a reward for that, too.

Then come back here. Don't dawdle! July might seem long, but it will be over in a blink!

finishText.en: There you are. I knew you'd be interested, so I'm going to tell you about this Aviak holiday.

goal.en: Meet with Grika the Twig on the Tropical Atoll.

startText.en:
Dear friend! July is the hottest month of the year, and these days our fellow Aviaks celebrate the summer flame festival! This event attracts a lot of tourists, and for everyone it becomes an opportunity to earn the sacred summer sparklets and get a new mount - the Lemur Prince!
I'm giving you one of these sparklets. If you want to learn more about them, then visit Grika the Twig.

finishText.en: Stars will keep falling until the end of August! Come back soon!

goal.en:
During a star shower, pick up 20 fallen stars and catch 15 Shimmering Star fragments, then take part in any activity and earn a little star as a reward.

Then drop by Jack Cheap and take a look at his goods.

startText.en:
Listen! You need to wait for a star shower to begin. It happens often in August - three times per hour! But this beautiful event lasts only a few minutes, so don't miss it!

During a star shower, stars will fall on the beach - if you pick one up, it will turn into star dust. Which is a very valuable resource!

If you have star dust, anyone in our tribe will offer you a reward for participating in an activity - a whole star in exchange for ten measures of star dust.

Sometimes you will see shimmering stars which break into colorful fragments. If you catch them, you will also receive star dust.

checkText.en: Look for balance.

finishText.en: Found your inner balance yet? Build more towers and sit on them, thinking about things. You might find that balance eventually.

goal.en: Pick up pebbles on the shore and build a tower with 10 pebbles.

startText.en:
Everyone around keeps talking about balance. What is balance? How do I get it?

I'll tell you one thing: most importantly, you need balance here, in your soul. There's a great activity that can help you find this balance!

Walk around the shore and look for colorful pebbles. Once you have a dozen or so, find a picturesque place and build a tower - like the one under my feet.

checkText.en: Just look at his tail. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en:
It looks just like it! You're a clever one!

Here are the seashells. Tomorrow I'll come up with a more difficult puzzle for you.

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that looks like a lemur's tail.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
Anyone can build a tower of pebbles, but try to build it beautifully!

Inspiration is all around us. For example, here is a lemur's tail.

Build me a tower that looks like a lemur's tail! The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.

I'll give you a hint: start with white!

checkText.en: Just look at it. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en:
Yes, correct! It was harder this time, wasn't it?

Now go, have fun. I'll have a new puzzle for you tomorrow. I have so many ideas!

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that looks like a ball.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
I've come up with a new puzzle!

You have a game with a round bouncy thing. Build me a tower like a... what's it called... volleyball!

checkText.en: What do they usually sing about? That the sea is blue. But when I look at the surf, at the foamy whitecaps of the waves, I see different colors.

finishText.en:
That's right! If you look through a sea wave at the sun, you'll see that it's not blue at all.

Here are your seashells. Tomorrow I'll have a new puzzle for you, also about the sea.

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that resembles a surf.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
What do they usually sing about? That the sea is blue. But when I look at the surf, at the foamy whitecaps of the waves, I see different colors.

Try to guess which ones!

checkText.en: Just look at it. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en:
It looks just like it! I knew you weren't just handsomepretty, but smartsmart, too!

Now go, have fun. I'll have a new puzzle for you tomorrow. I have so many ideas!

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that resembles a sunken treasure.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
What's it like to be a coin that fell out of a pirate's chest? You fall into the water and sink... The sea around you gets darker and darker... Until you finally fall to the very bottom.

That's what I want to see!

checkText.en: Just look at it. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en:
A beautiful tower. It does look like a sunset over the sea!

But who lives in the sea? We will talk about this later.

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that resembles a sea sunset.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
Let's build a tower that is like a sunset over the sea - the sea surface under the rays of the setting sun. And let this tower become a symbol of peace and beauty that reminds us of the infinity and grandeur of the ocean!

That's what I want to see!

checkText.en: Just look at it. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en:
Haha, I can see it!

Now go, have fun. I'll have a new puzzle for you tomorrow. I have so many ideas!

goal.en:
Build a tower that looks like Toothy.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en: Today's puzzle is easy! Build a tower that looks like Toothy. You've met him at our resort, right?

checkText.en: Just look at it. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en: Ah, lilies, they are so beautiful... Of course, a pebble tower can't replace a flower, but you created a good impression of it.

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that resembles a lily.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
What is it like to be a drop of dew on a lily petal? You glide along the gentle slopes, until you finally plunge into a pool of colors and scents. Songs usually sing about lilies and their beauty, but I see something different - a world of colors and scents hidden behind each petal.

Build a tower that resembles a lily...

checkText.en: Just look at it. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en: Ah, the reef! This underwater world is home to an incredible diversity of life: gorgeous starfish, playful fish of all the colors of the rainbow, graceful seahorses... Your tower is almost as beautiful... Come see me later for a new puzzle!

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that resembles a coral reef.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
Look: in the depths of the ocean, a coral reef stretches like a magical kingdom! Every corner of this amazing paradise is filled with secrets and wonders, like the pages of an ancient book about the magnificence of nature. The majestic coral reef is a world where time stops to let us admire its beauty.

Build a tower that reminds others of this miracle!

checkText.en: Just look at it. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en:
Yes, the crabs' hearts beat in unison with the sound of the surf, filled with excitement. Even though only one crab could become the winner, they were all heroes of this competition on the seashore where every step is filled with a passion for running and a thirst for victory.

Thank you for your tower. I will come up with another puzzle...

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that resembles crab races.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
Imagine this: on the shore of a warm sea, under the rays of the morning sun, exciting crab races are taking place. Tiny heroes come here to test their endurance and speed. The command to get set echoes over the shore, and the crabs rush forward, raising clouds of sand!

Draw this picture with the help of colorful pebbles!

checkText.en: Just look at it. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en:
The most amazing thing about the Squawker is its love of fireworks. The moment it soars through the sky, its feathers seem to glow with bright lights, creating a magical show of twinkling stars and sparkling rays. This magnificent spectacle brings joy to everyone who is lucky to be its passenger.

Come back for a new puzzle later.

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that resembles a Squawker.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
You've probably ridden a Squawker, haven't you? A Squawker with soft feathers of bright colors. It spreads its wings, soaring upward to let its passengers feel the ease of flight and freedom. Its songs, filled with tenderness and warmth, seem to whisper to us the secrets of ancient forests, enchanting us with their melody!

Now make a Squawker to solve my puzzle!

checkText.en: Just look at it. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en:
Each lantern carries a small spark of dream and hope, lighting the way for every traveler in this ocean of life. When the last of them disappears over the horizon, the hearts of vacationers are filled with reverent delight at the grandeur of nature and the world where miracles happen in the most unpredictable moments.

Remember this! And come back for a new puzzle!

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that resembles floating lanterns.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
Where the sky merges with the ocean, vacationers greet the sunset by launching floating lanterns into the water. Their soft light is reflected like stars in the dark surface of the water. Gently rocking on the waves, the lanterns are carried by the chaotic current, performing their own dance to the accompaniment of the surf. They disappear behind the waves, then reappear on the surface, creating a play of light and shadow... They are like living creatures striving for freedom.

Build these floating lights for me!

checkText.en: Just look at it. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en:
The Moon Fish is a symbol of the mystery of the ocean depths. It's like a guardian of sea secrets and miracles. Meeting it fills the heart with peace and delight at the beauty of nature, reminding us that even in the deepest and darkest corners of the world there is a place for magic and inspiration.

Come back tomorrow, I'll have a new puzzle for you.

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that resembles a Moon Fish.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
In the depths of the mysterious ocean swims a Moon Fish with beauty and grace. Its body reflects the moonlight through the blue depths, creating a magical glow around it.

Its smooth movements resemble the dance of water fairies, and its every move is full of grace and lightness.

Will you try to build it today?

checkText.en: Just look at it. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en:
Those who have seen this amazing flower claim that its beauty is unmatched by any other. It will not just delight the eye. It will bring peace to the heart, reminding that even in the world of fantasy and dreams there is a place for real beauty and magic!

Well, that was a difficult task! But the real difficulties are still ahead of you!

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that resembles a fern flower.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
Fern flower is considered a symbol of mystery. They say it reveals itself only to those who sincerely believe in miracles and can unravel the secrets of nature. Its fragrance is filled with notes of wisdom; it invites you to immerse yourself in the depths of your soul...

Can one depict such a miracle? But I believe in you... I believe that you can solve my puzzle...

checkText.en: Just look at it. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en: Yes, its shimmering hues seem to hold the wisdom of the ages and the sacred vows of the ancestors. Come see me later for a new puzzle!

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that resembles a chieftain's feather.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
The Aviak chieftain's feather is a symbol of wisdom, freedom and fortitude. It embodies the art of flight and harmony with the heavens, reminding us that true leadership comes from the inner light and generosity of the soul.

Anyone who dares to touch this feather will gain not only the protection of the heavenly elements, but also the wisdom of the elders, who can see beyond the horizons and overcome any obstacles on the way to their goal...

Can you build something like this?

checkText.en: Just look at it. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en:
Occasionally, in special moments of nature's favor, a wonderful black pearl is born from the heart of the pearl oyster. Like the night sky strewn with stars, its hue attracts the gaze and immerses you in a world of mystical secrets and mysteries.

Do you understand the meaning of my tasks now? Come back tomorrow...

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that resembles a pearl oyster.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
In the depths of the mysterious sea depths, the Pearl Oyster is hidden among the shimmering expanses of water - an ocean treasure that has its own magic. Its graceful form hides a pearl - a mother-of-pearl drop of the moon, lost in the ocean's embrace.

Can you build a semblance of this underwater wonder? Isn't that too difficult a task?

checkText.en: Just look at it. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en:
We are Waterfolk, residents of the tropical atoll. I welcome you to the shores of our magical kingdom where water and sky merge into one, and sand dunes dance to the singing of coastal waves.

Thank you for the solution, I will admire this pebble tower for the rest of the day.

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that resembles the Waterfolk.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
I can't think of a puzzle for today... Unless... Look around, what do you see? Not just sand, sky and water... You see us, the Waterfolk, humble servants of the Great Turtle, who have been entertaining the guests for years...

I'm a guardian of these vast expanses of water. I know all the secrets of the sea and all its mysteries. My scales shine like the most precious pearls, and my eyes sparkle like the stars in the night sky. I'm here to surprise you, to show you the wonders of this world that are hidden from the eyes of ordinary mortals!

Build me!

checkText.en: Just look at it. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en:
Let the jellyfish be not just a mystery of the sea, but also a symbol of beauty that overcomes all barriers, reminding us of the greatness of nature.

Come to me tomorrow for a new puzzle...

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that resembles a jellyfish.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
Jellyfish is a mysterious creature of the deep sea that dances in the rays of the sun to the music of the coastal waves. Its delicate tentacles gently sway in the water, creating a mesmerizing rhythm of marine grace.

It is a symbol of infinity and changeability, a reminder that beauty can be fragile but eternal.

Try to depict such a changeable creature using motionless stones. Can you?

checkText.en: Just look at it. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en:
Let the volcano be a symbol of not just passion and power, but also the eternal harmony of nature, reminding us of our place in this world.

I'll have a new puzzle for you tomorrow!

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that resembles a volcano.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
Hidden in the depths of the earth is a dormant thunderstorm - from time to time it awakens an ancient guardian that usually sleeps under solidified lava and ash.

The volcano, the cradle of fire and power, rises above the earth like a titan. The volcano is a symbol of strength and destruction, but also of rebirth and fertility. Its eruptions remind us of the eternal cycle of life and death, the eternal struggle of the elements that create the new and destroy the old in their dance.

Will you try to depict something like this?

checkText.en: Just look at it. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en:
Not everyone who wears a crown is a king, but it makes everyone look majestic! You managed to replicate its magnificence!

Come back for a new puzzle!

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that resembles a crown.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
A majestic crown, a symbol of power, is an adornment that crowns the head of a monarch. Its brilliance is a reflection of the stars in the night sky, its shape is a symbol of unsurpassed harmony and perfection. It's a pity it's made of lifeless metal and dead stones. But a tropical crown is a different matter - this sign of abundance and life is decorated with bright flowers and colorful feathers of birds. A tropical crown is not just an adornment - it's a symbol of the generosity of our tropical nature!

Try to recreate it with pebbles!

checkText.en: Just look at it. Do you get it? No? Then ask other vacationers, maybe someone will help you.

finishText.en:
On each butterfly wing you can see a dance of light and shadow, playing in a soft, captivating harmony. It's like music without words, a melody without notes, designed to awaken in us a sense of admiration for the magnificence of the world.

Come back for a new puzzle later.

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that resembles a butterfly wing.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

startText.en:
A butterfly's wing is a fragile miracle created from the rays of the morning sun and drops of dew. It subtly intertwines the shades of the sky, the moon and the sun - it's like a picture painted by Nature itself.

Can you recreate this miracle? Can you create such beauty with lifeless rocks?

checkText.en: There is so much beauty in the sky after a rain...

finishText.en: Here it is, a delight for my eyes!

goal.en:
Build a pebble tower that resembles something greater than a rainbow.

(The size of the pebbles is not important, just choose the right colors and place them correctly.)

name.en: Gugu's Puzzle: More than a Rainbow

startText.en:
We also have rain in the spring. Afterwards, a rainbow rises above those statues in the sea.

It's so beautiful it takes your breath away!

And there are more colors in it than everyone thinks.

Try and build it!

finishText.en:
Here, take this!

This pebble only looks ordinary. But it contains great magic.

All summer you showed what the world around us looks like in the language of stones. And these pebbles will show how you look!

Just don't be surprised - every moment something subtly changes in us, so your appearance will change every time you use the pebbles.

Take them, they are yours!

goal.en: Accept the gift from Gugu the Serene.

startText.en:
Congratulations! You solved all my puzzles!

You're great with pebbles, and I'd like to reward you for your efforts with a little gift.

Will you accept it?

checkText.en: My brothers and I are betting on whoever keeps the ball in the air the longest. But hush, it's a secret, or else people will want in on this. It's quite profitable, after all

finishText.en:
See? Can't get easier than that! I'd play myself, but I need to keep order.

You go, have fun. Come by anytime when the court is open.

goal.en: Find a partner for a game of volleyball and push the ball away 10 times during a game.

startText.en:
Slap, slap… Clap your hands. Are you listening?

Some orcs told us about Goblinball... A barbaric game! But it's a good idea.

What if we play with a real ball, we thought... and with hands, not feet. We toss it to each other - if you fail to catch it, you fall face-first into the sand...
We called it volleyball... And we aren't forcing anyone to play it.

So these are the rules:

First, you need a partner - can't play alone. Or better yet, four - the more players you have, the more points you earn.

You play on the court.

To begin the game, you need to pick up the ball and serve it.

And then you need to run around and keep the ball from falling. And watch where you're sending the ball - turn to face the player you want to pass it to.

And don't forget the other players. The more often everyone hits the ball, the more points you all get.

The longer the ball stays in the air, the more points everyone gets for hitting it.

For every ten hits, you get a reward. The more points you earn, the greater the reward!

checkText.en: In the dark, they look like stars in the night sky.

finishText.en:
Beautiful, isn't it?

Make a lantern and come back. I'll be here until the very end of July!

goal.en: Obtain 5 turtle shells and 5 fern flowers, use them to create 5 water lanterns, then launch them into the water next to Chai-Ka the Soaring and keep their flame alive until the end of their journeys.

startText.en:
Quarr! Lanterns are a part of the summer flame festival as well. I launch lanterns, and my brother Chik-Rick catches them. You can participate, too.

You need to make a lantern. Go find a turtle shell and fern flower. You can use them to make a lantern.

Then launch it into the water. It will be carried by the current, but you need to keep an eye on it and make sure the flame does not go out. The more lanterns reach the end, the better.

checkText.en: The sail is your wing! Let the wind carry your boat.

finishText.en: Feel like a bird, don't you?

goal.en: Sail around the atoll and collect 15 bubbles.

startText.en:
It's a nice day, wingless one.

A nice wind, too! The best time for catching bubbles. You take a boat, go around the island, pick up bubbles, then come back! Let the sun warm your beak. Feel the wind! That's how you spend this time! And earn rewards.

checkText.en: Don't forget to show up for the race in time!

finishText.en:
How did it go?

There is nothing better than the spray of sea water on your face and a fresh breeze! And when you win - it's especially rewarding!

checkText.en: The sail is your wing! Let it carry you!

name.en: Lesson 1: The sail is your wing!

checkText.en: Train!

goal.en: Go through all the control points in the bay within 1 minute 15 seconds by trimming the sail in a certain way.

checkText.en: I remember you! Oh yes, yes, I do! And I remember something else from the past!

finishText.en:
Do you understand what you’ve done? We were preparing the greatest experiment in the history of Sarnaut. It wsa nearly ready. This very artifact in your hands had to be feeding the whole thing with spell power.

We started the experiment, and failed. We hadn’t enough power. And the Grain of Protopower was just... gone. It disappeared.

We, great mages, tried to stop the failing experiment, but we couldn’t. You know the rest of it.

I’ll take the grain. It will help me restrain the power of the Castle, and finally break free.

Don’t blame yourself. Time cannot be comprehended by any living being. It was predestined to happen so. We shouldn’t have started the experiment, but what’s done, is done...

goal.en: Return to Zayan.

name.en: Don't pour water on a drowned mouse!

startText.en:
You’re weird. You don’t need neither gold nor thank you.

I’ll give something, nevertheless. Remember the thing we took away from Zayan de Desirae’s underground? Here it is! I hope you can make good use of it!

See you!

checkText.en: Dark times are ahead... Use your chance and take a rest, before the Empire calls upon you again.

finishText.en:
The longer I know you, the more interesting stories I hear! But you know, I'm about to believe every single word you say, even if it's totally unbelievable. To tell the truth, Yasker and the Committee do as well.

So, you've witnessed... what? Creation? An allod appeared out of nowhere, and you took part in creating it. Now this mysterious Leper - a new life that influences other lives... Now think of it - Sarn received his power from his followers! Simply from creatures who believed in him! This, exactly this, opened such vast opportunities for him.

Your effort of will made it possible for Nezeb and Skrakan to come to rescue. Any creator may become god-like, if their will is strong enough...

I feel sorry to hide and classify the information you have brought... But I will be waiting for news from you!

goal.en: Tell Mark Staritsyn everything you know.

startText.en:
Oh, this is how it all turned out to be...

Do you remember how it all began? Backwater harbor in Eljune, pirates and their unreliable information... Chase after Klavdia... That's a curious person, by the way. Wherever she is, all kinds of big and dangerous things go on about her. And what about her enthusiastic blah blah, saying she's ruling Nihaz's power... This is very suspicious.

I don't like Nezeb's words, either. He's never been beating about the bush, always went straight to the point. What's changed? It looks like Sarnaut will not calm down, until it's torn into pieces. Just think of it! The Leper is one of Sarn's creations. It means it had equal right to exist in this world, as we do. The only flaw is that we wouldn't have been able to exist together, and we are not the ones to play with godly powers...

In this respect, I am not too much surprised by Catherina's madness. Frankly speaking, I don't quite understand how she managed to enter the Conclave, at all. She may go on ruling Umoir, and give up dreams of anything more than that. Now that the Veil is lifted, our hands are free and we may start operation! On behalf of the Empire, I commend you for successful completion of this mission.

As to faith, I have to mention that Catherina didn't turn to the demon from the start. Initially, she wanted to establish the power of the Light in Umoir, make the locals believe in it - and in her, as the Lightbringer. Believers and followers would have elevated her powers. I've been thinking, may be you succeeded, because a small cult of your person appeared, by the way. Remember all those, who asked for your help... Now it clicks, huh?

I think we may now go public. But not with everything - let's keep Nezeb's word a secret. Go to Mark Staritsyn and tell him, whatever you feel like telling.

checkText.en: The anxiety is in the air...

finishText.en:
Unbelievable...

This is the ultimate creation, God's oeuvre! Out of sheer nothingness, create not a deserted stony allod, but a whole new life! Sarn is amazing. Long ago, when he was still sane, his creatures were truly beautiful.

Faith provides gods with power. Not only gods - common mortals, too. Faith and will are the key! We will not be able to fathom this mystery, until we give room to doubts. It is due to your willpower out there, in the Astral, Nezeb and Skrakan were able to come to your aid.

So, there is one thing that people are not ready to comprehend just yet. We ought to keep the scrolls of your legends in a bookcase, behind Aidenus' seal, and make sure it's safer than the one that's securing Sarn...

goal.en: Tell Lovewise Catfish everything you know.

startText.en:
Poor Catherina...

I cannot start to think how miserable she feels. Sarn cheated on her, broke her spirit, turned her inside out and revealed to the whole world... Who's without sin, eh? She's conceited and short-tempered, all right, but all she cares about is law and order! She's diligently seeking power all the time - this is one thing that deserves respect!

We are unable to comprehend God's intentions. We, mages, tried once, and failed. Catherina wanted to establish the power of the Light in Umoir, make the locals believe in it - and in her, as the Lightbringer. Believers and followers would have elevated her powers. But she failed, too. There weren't too many loyal believers. However, you may memorize the fact: the more believers you have, the higher your powers are. It may help you in very dangerous situations.

Let me warn you. Listen to what Skrakan says. He's the wisest one in the universe! Give it a thought. What is this Klavdia's eternal travel? Why is Sarn striving to break free? What is it, apart from his madness and his followers? Beware!

The Leper will soon go, after we have separated it from Sarn. It will leave but a few bitter memories behind. I'm only afraid, that more trouble might come...

Go to Lovewise Catfish, tell him what I told you. Let all others learn this lesson, too.

finishText.en: Whatchawant? Firebird? Hell no!

goal.en: Meet Dmitry Gubarevsky in Upper City.

startText.en:
So great mages of either faction are unable to defeat the Leper. Alright, we will have to act on our own accord...

I studied the Firebird’s feather - it’s full of power able to burn down the Leper, if it were a little more in volume. That is, if we had the whole birdie, we could heal Umoir!

I think I heard Gubarevsky brothers mentioning seeing it on their father’s field. Now that I have the real feather in my very hands, I don’t doubt that the bird exists.

Gubarevskies will show you the way to their allod.

finishText.en: Why so sad, friend? I can see gloom on your face. Do you want me to tell you a funny story so that you would cheer up?

goal.en: Meet Tale Teller in Lower City’s tavern.

startText.en:
Birdie, birdie... how do I extract your power and not kill you?.. Hmm. Let me think. Meanwhile...

The Outlaws give me pain in the head lately! They are wasting my people for nothing! Today, when the Leper is so active, I cannot afford this! And the Church just won't help, I tried negotiating with them, it was no good. I know Tale Teller has some relations with the Outlaws, so go and force him to help me!

Bring their negotiator to the plowman's hut - it's the neutral territory. My Commander will meet him there.

checkText.en: Halt! Don’t move!

finishText.en: How dare you come to our village without invitation, you? Just try and play your trick, make my day! No amulet will help you then!

goal.en: Get to the entrance to Outcasts’ settlement, praise the gods in the correct order, crack Tale Teller’s riddle and enter the hideout.

startText.en:
The Queen is smarter than her boyards, then. No wonder, her job is more complicated that pushing pens and papers. I'm sure it is a good thing that Catherina changed her mind and decided to sink a feud with the outlaws. Peace is good, I'll help you enter their village safely.

I'll give you a special mark that will protect you against their weapon. But it's half a deed. You must find the answer to a riddle before you can see their houses.

The wisdom and experience speak the most important work. Nobody objects to the word of wisdom. A silly girl might blurt out something stupid, but she'll be hissed at: know your place, listen to the wise and experienced elders! She will be silenced. There's also wisdom in her. She knows that the final word is hers. In the meantime, a hunter and a warrior would argue who's braver. Here's what I say, a poor peace is better than the good war. If your coffers are full of treasure, and your enemies are dead, only craftsmen with hands of gold are honored.

Go now. If you honor our ancient faith, my words will be no riddle to you. I will say no more, unless you want to hear an ancient tale or a legend.

checkText.en: I had never imagined me bowing to Catherina’s servant and thanking them for saving my life... Never say never.

finishText.en: We owe you our lives, true. You are welcome to ask for reward - we would love to pay you back!

goal.en: Kill Chuden the Awakened and report to Vseslav the Wise.

startText.en:
To hell with you! I will have to die either way, so I don’t care whose help to accept.

The skies sent down a punishment to our village. An ancient evil has awaken, Chuden, it’s eating the guards and destroying our houses. It’s in the central square now, and I’m afraid it is going to lay us even with the ground! If your redemption is real, save us from this disaster!

checkText.en: Our enemies are a horde, but we know no fear!

finishText.en: Nice, nice, you are rather strong, stranger. There will be but one song and legend about your deeds and feats!

goal.en: Defeat 15 Sharptooth Gulpers near Covert Hide and report to Vseslav the Wise.

startText.en:
