So, you are asking for peace for everybody? Isn’t it a bit too much, after all this blood spilt and sorrows caused?.. As long as I promised, I will have to think of it, anyway. Meanwhile, another service is required. There are too many corrupted beasts left.

There are so many of them about our Covert Hide, we cannot even stick out noses outside. You’ve heard rumors that the Leper won’t harm us, this is untrue. It’s only our faith that guards us against the Leper, but it is getting weaker by the day. Help us clear up the place.

checkText.en: Our enemies are a horde, but we know no fear!

finishText.en: Nice, nice, you are rather strong, stranger. There will be but one song and legend about your deeds and feats!

goal.en: Defeat 15 Sharptooth Gulpers near Covert Hide and report to Chainislava Borderski.

startText.en: There are so many of them about our Covert Hide, we cannot even stick out noses outside. You’ve heard rumors that the Leper won’t harm us, this is untrue. It’s only our faith that guards us against the Leper, but it is getting weaker by the day. Help us clear up the place.

finishText.en: What are you heavy thoughts, friend? Don’t tell me. I know our gods wouldn’t discover anything that is useless to you.

goal.en: Return to Vseslav the Wise to Covert Hide.

startText.en:
If it turns out all right, I might even outpower Tep. You know why? Right, it’s faith!

Look, I saved the locals from the Leper and spent a whole ocean of power on that. Only godly power can defeat the Leper. Where should I get it? From the Astral? No thanks! Obtaining elemental power takes too long, and the power you get is too specific. Faith is quite a different source!

Faith will never end. The more people believe in you, the stonger support you feel, the more power you gain. Not many have the ability to use it properly, but any decent leader can sense it. I told the people that I saved a nice tale about Peregrina, and they were glad to trust it - so it’s not a tale any longer.

Noble Kanians believe in the goddess that wander about the universe. Naive Tekyan believe in goddess the creator. Harsh times await us, so I need all the faith I can get. Don’t you worry, I seek it not to feel my self importance, I seek it to really save the world.

checkText.en: Woe is me, so many corrupted beasts, you cannot even stick your nose outside!

finishText.en: You have arrived? This is good. I know Ratmir well enough, he’s fair and square, and will never do evil.

goal.en: Take Vseslav the Wise to meet Ratmir Magman, the Commander, at Lower City outskirts.

startText.en:
So Catherina offers peace to us, undefeated? I would never have accepted it, never! If it weren’t for the Leper now.

I have made up my mind. I am going for the negotiations myself. There is no other way.

You say, the town commander will be waiting for me at the isolated farm? Let us go then. No time to waste.

checkText.en: Woe to us!

finishText.en:
What? Demons in Umoir? Are you out of your mind?

...

This is not a misery - this is the end! We’re done for...

There’s only one hole through which demons can come in. It’s the old portal used by the first demon ever. The one that turned Skrakan into stone. The demon has long been defeated and rot to dust, but the portal is still there in the tower. If it opens again, it means the enemy strikes right into our heart...

goal.en: Find the source of the noise and return to Ratmir Magman.

startText.en:
Welcome, dear friend, may you days be filled by the Light and peace! I am so happy to discover that the ancient warfare between us has been forgotten! The Leper will not make any difference between you and us!

So, listen to the conditions, upon which Catherina, our great Queen, has agreed to... what’s that noise? I ordered the guards not to let anyone through!

checkText.en: So, is the news good or bad?

finishText.en: This is bad news indeed. So, the clockwork knights won’t let you into Catherina’s chambers? While the demons are in town? This is not clear...

goal.en: Try and get inside Skytower, then report to Vseslav the Wise, who is waiting for you near Lower City.

startText.en:
The demons came in through the secret portal in the tower. A cunning enemie sneaked inside the tower and opened the gates, that’s what it is.

Hurry to the Queen! Find out what happened! We are going to stay here and develop a plan of actions! If Catherina is harmed... no, I don’t even want to think about it. This will bring an end to Umoir...

checkText.en: You’re not in a hurry, are you? Really, I’d thought that demons will make you move faster.

finishText.en: I can see you’re surprised. Actually, there’s nothing to be surprised about. I didn’t start all this mess about young Peregrina, that local people love so much, just for the sake of it. Faith is power, remember? Dark times are coming, and I need every single grain of power I can get.

goal.en: Collect 10 Stoneberries and lay them in Pagan Shrine in Outcasts’ Hideout. When the Flying Fish arrives, jump on its back to ride up to the Skytower.

startText.en:
There’s only one way that I see. It’s dangerous, but there is no choice.

We don’t make friends with the Leper. That’s a lie. But we know the corrupted beasts well enough, and we are able to make them serve us, that’s true.

Have you seen the huge fish that can fly like a bird? We tamed it. It loves berries, and most of all, it loves stoneberry! If you gather a handful and lay it near the shrine, it will come to you immediately.

As soon as it has eaten, don’t you hesitate to ride it. Grab the whiskers and drive the way. And when you ride up to the tower, you’re on your own. The ring will help you.

checkText.en: Catherina turned out to be stronger than I’d thought...

finishText.en: We’re late! Now there is no doubt, Catherina serves Sarn, who started the Leper! I do not care whether is was a conscious decision or not, it’s important that Eclipse is about to sail off to the heart of the world, where Sarn is secluded. And believe me, she’s more than able to set him free by breaking just one of the seals! Nobody can stand against him. His release will bring Sarnaut to an end.

goal.en: Enter Catherina’s chamber

startText.en:
No time to talk. I never thought this about Catherina. She called upon powers, which she failed to rule - the demons and their Master. She's not strong enough to conquer Sarn... But no. I don't think Catherina would have ruined her own allod with the Leper.

We shall come into her chamber and find out everything. In case I am mistaken - you better go first. If I come in, she might be... unpleased with my appearance. And if it goes bad, touch the ring. The Wise man is on top of all gods. He'll help.

Why are you so surprised to hear that the old man is a local god? He's smart enough not to show off, you know.

checkText.en: The wounded are feeling worse by the hour. I’m so scared I cannot hold a weapon.

finishText.en: Thank you so much! Everybody will heal now!

goal.en: Bring 20 Thorn Weeds and 15 Pieces of Corrupted Flesh to Chainislava Borderski.

name.en: On the Verge of Life and Death

startText.en:
Wait! Please do something for me.

Our soldiers have been severely wounded by the corrupted beasts. Poison runs in their veins. If we don’t heal them, they will become corrupted, too!

I know many secrets, I can heal many diseases, but I’ve never seen any such thing. Bring me Thorn Weed to ease the pain and the Corrupted Flesh to brew antidote!

checkText.en: The wounded are feeling worse by the hour. I’m so scared I cannot hold a weapon.

finishText.en: Thank you so much! Everybody will heal now! If you want to help again, bring me more thorn weeds and corrupted flesh. I can always make good use of it.

goal.en: Bring 20 Thorn Weeds and 15 Pieces of Corrupted Flesh to Chainislava Borderski.

name.en: On the Verge of Life and Death

startText.en:
Our soldiers have been severely wounded by the corrupted beasts. Poison runs in their veins. If we don’t heal them, they will become corrupted, too!

I know many secrets, I can heal many diseases, but I’ve never seen any such thing. Bring me Thorn Weed to ease the pain and the Corrupted Flesh to brew antidote!

checkText.en: So you’ve got the ring, after all!

finishText.en: I would give anything for the ring. Take the reward. I’m going to my fiancee now, she’ll be so happy!

goal.en: Kill Barren Flower and take the ring from his belly. Bring the ring to Glum Bogdanov.

startText.en: The moment that the corrupted monsters attacked our home, I took out my sword at once and started smashing them, and crushing them, and slicing them, and... you get the idea. They’ve been arriving in waves, and one of the bastards sneaked from the behind, and bit me on the hand! I dropped the sword then and ran. It’s no grief that I lost three fingers and the sword. It’s the grief that I lost a wedding ring with one of the fingers. The ring that my beloved fiancee gave me! The only thing I dream about is to get it back, and now that I cannot hold a weapon, how can I do this?.. Will you help me?

checkText.en: Easy, easy!

finishText.en: Don’t be too hard on me! It’s not my fault, whatever it is!

goal.en: Find the gang leader near the portal.

startText.en:
Oh my, this was a big fight!
All the bodies are those of mercenaries, and they were killed with common weapons, although traces of powerful magic can still be seen. Klavdia and her mercenaries came across... who? Are there any survivors? The bag’s empty, no reply.
Look, there are tracks that lead away from the battlefield. We have to follow the survivors and find out what’d happened.

checkText.en: I smell a stranger’s spirit! Choo! Who are you?

finishText.en: That’s what it is... So what are you doing here?

goal.en: Find soothsayer Krie's house.

startText.en:
Klavdia? Is that the crazy woman in greenish rugs? So that’s how this cold blooded killer called.
We once dug into an old cellar full of gold, and just as we started grabbing the coins, I guess, we nudged some kind of an old portal, that’s what we did. Ruins, you know... So the portal activated, and a bunch of cutthroats with this Klavdia entered the cellar.
They noticed us in an instant, and we were forced to accept the fight. The thugs were easy to beat, but not her! She’s real crazy, I tell you! Her spells made half of my guys fall into ashes right at the spot. And then she just left. Just like that.
Where she headed, I wouldn’t want to know that, but I guess, to Skytower. Where else? I suggest you ask Krie, she’s wise and sees many things.

checkText.en:
Boil slime boil
Drip and drop and bubble
Ancient magic dark magic
Curle smoke in my cauldron!
Burn fire burn
Cough cough, oh my, this verse is so weird!

finishText.en:
Here are the last ingredients!
A pinch of pollen, a drop of water, mushroom cap, mix it all... Achoo!
I’m allergic to pollen, see?

goal.en: Collect samples

startText.en:
I will help you heal from the Leper - I am a wise witch and a healer, after all. But you will have to help me. Listen.
The Leper cannot be removed completely. It can only be stopped, frozen. I will brew you a potion, a magic one, stronger than the Leper itself! You will bring me the ingredients.
First, collect some water from the river that flows from the roots of an old oak. The water is black as night and cold as starlight, but it’s very potent.
Pick up some corrupted mushrooms, flowers and roots. And mind you, you cannot bring too much! Go now!

checkText.en: What is this thing? Throw that away and never touch the corrupted plantes with your bare hands again!

finishText.en: See this blue spot near your finger? That’s the Leper. It got you. Start searching for a nice cozy coffin, dear.

goal.en: Find out what happened to the woods.

startText.en: Looks like a wicked and strong magic to me. Even bushes are trying to bite you, ouch. Pinch a bit of it and show it to someone who might know something.

checkText.en:
Boil brew boil
Blood in my cauldron
Burn fire burn
As if you are in hell!
I don’t like the sound of it, either. Traditions, see?

finishText.en:
Can you feel the smell? Not here, it’s my toilet!
No, it’s not the same smell. Not the same, I tell you!

goal.en: Bring Krie 12 Bunny Ears and 20 Owl Feathers.

startText.en:
My memory let me down again. I forgot to mention another ingredient, absolutely needed one! Or two, to be exact. Without them, it’ll be just a waste of time and effort.
Bring me a hare’s ear and an owl’s feather. Don’t mix them up! Hare’s feather won’t do, although you can find a beak and a hoof on a hare today. Nevermind, just bring me everything they’ll let you pluck from them.

checkText.en: They are howling and howling!

finishText.en: I have heard them scream and howl. Have they all gone? I’m so happy.

goal.en: Kill 10 Taksas near the witch’s hut.

startText.en:
You know what else? As you’ll be killing the innocent beasties, look out! I’ve seen wicked wild animals recently, that look like wolves, teeth like knives and legs enough for two. It’s been three days that they howl around my house in the night. I pray to all gods to survive through the night.
If you kill them all, I will be so thankful!

checkText.en: Go and bring me the eyeball!

finishText.en: Oh my, it stares so... coldly. Like a toad.

goal.en: Kill the Mutant Toad and bring its eye to Krie.

startText.en:
Very little left to do, dear. Just one last ingredient. We need an eyeball, and not just an eyeball, but a really huge one.

I used to take Cyclop’s eye for this purpose, but now Cyclops are extinct at Umoir. Nevertheless, I noticed an enormous toad croaking in a spring at the forest edge. It was really massive, like a house in size, with its eyes like barrels! This eyeball will do fine.

checkText.en: What do you need?

finishText.en: How do you feel now, snouty face? How much I would like to punch you! I wish I had time for that. Welcome to our fortress.

goal.en: Drink the potion

startText.en:
Right... Two pinches of ground dried rib of a virgin, a fistful of hair of a noble robber, two teaspoons of camel’s thorns... Achoo!

This brew is really strong, see? It’s all ready, have some. Don’t wince, go on, at one gulp. Regard it as medicine against the Leper!

checkText.en: So, what should I call you, dear guest?

finishText.en: Are you the wild one who is supposed to appear from the thicket? How curious. I’ve heard a lot about you. So, what brought you here?

goal.en: Defeat 5 outlaws and meet Catherina.

startText.en:
Come round!

Now listen to me. They were about to execute you, because you have come from the outside, and they hate the spies. While they were discussing your fate, the outlaws attacked.

Now they promise you freedom in exchange for 5 enemies’ lives. You are a decent fighter, as I can see, so now go and be so kind to help us. Don’t try to flee, we’ll make sure to catch you!

checkText.en: Hurry!

finishText.en: Let’s go into my chamber and talk.

goal.en: Deal with the consequences of outlaws’ attack.

startText.en:
I think I can help in your search. If your runaway is still here, she’s got nowhere to escape. Not without my permission.

But first you have to help me set everything in order after the attack. The faster you do, the quicker I’ll find your girl.

checkText.en: Don’t waste time! They are suffering in prison!

finishText.en: Oh thank you so much! If it weren’t for you, my dear girls would have died! Now they are home, and my family is forever in your debt!

goal.en: Find sisters

startText.en:
Oh dear, oh dear, my beloved sisters have gone missing! Damned outlaws captured my Sissie and Cindy, and dragged them into the dark forest! I barely escaped!

Please, bring them back, I pray to the Light that you do! They won’t survive in the forest alone, even if they escape from the prison!

finishText.en: What do you want to hear from me?

goal.en: Ask about jewelry.

startText.en:
This is such a strange decoration. Made unskillfully, but with so much love... The symbols depict a nosediving bird or a thunderbolt.

Its previous owner valued it pretty much, I guess. It must be bound to the outlaws' faith. Find someone who can tell you more about the outlaws and their clash with the church of the Light.

checkText.en: Have you succeeded?

finishText.en: This is perfect! No enemy will enter town now!

goal.en: Use the pitchfork to tune guardian stones and return to Ratmir Magman .

startText.en:
Long ago, when the Skytower stood on the ground, there were ancient sentries that guarded the roads. They burned uninvited guests with lightning!

The spirits have long left their stones, but I still hope to return them. Their lightnings were so good!

I’m going to give you a device I recently discovered. I think Skrakan used it to turn the stones on and off. I tried to use it myself, but failed, I’m not good at magic, and my ears are rather old to hear things. Try it, will you?

checkText.en: Edward, Edward... You shouldn’t have opposed the Queen...

finishText.en: Heads are rolling? This is so sad to say goodbye to life for the old dusty idols...

goal.en: Destroy the rebels and their leader.

startText.en:
So was it the Queen who sent you to help us? You’re a good fighter, I’ve seen you crashing enemies.

The outlaws might still come back. They are dangerous. Your task is to shoo them off the town, forever. Find their hideout and kill them all, and their leader, especially their leader!

checkText.en: Have you found what I had lost?

finishText.en:
You’re the savior!
Er, how many gems are there? All thirty, right? And I managed to hide a couple in the mouth, hm... If the trader asks you how many, tell him there were thirty, and you don’t know about the rest! I’ll pay your silence well.

goal.en: Return 30 stolen gems to Miluta Fastman.

startText.en:
Ho you mighty warrior! ‘Tis plain you will to spill the blood of the damned robbers, but wait! Relieve my heart, I have a plea for you!
My name would be Miluta Fastman, I am Goldie Nickel’s trade clark. I was carrying precious gems in my pocket, but they were not simple gems, but starry gems, very expensive, really rare, thirty of them. And then, it was my bad luck to come across these poor outcasts on a narrow track! I was about to say goodbye to life, but no, they merely gave me a clip on the jaw and let go of me. They took the gems! I will never be able to pay for them! Bring them back! I promise, I will owe you forever!

checkText.en: Extinguish fire in the Lower City.

finishText.en: Extinguish fire in the Lower City.

goal.en: Extinguish 4 fires in the Lower City and report to Barbara Brie.

startText.en:
Fire! Fire! Help!

Don’t just stand there, grab the bucket, run for water! The Queen will go crazy if the fire runs off to town!

finishText.en: If it weren’t for the Leper that cut off Skytower, Upper city and Lower City from the rest of the world, these outlaws would have been eliminated a long time ago. Only their father’s land keeps them alive... so far.

goal.en: Listen to Catherina’s story.

startText.en:
I'm surprised to see an Imperial soldier. May be I should chop off your head, eh? Or are you telling the truth? Are you or are you not?

I can see traces of the Leper at your face. It means I'm your only chance. Oh well, you have to seek friendship of the powerful mage, who knows the secret... and the mage is not Yasker. See what I mean?

finishText.en: If it weren’t for the Leper that cut off Skytower, Upper city and Lower City from the rest of the world, these outlaws would have been eliminated a long time ago. Only their father’s land keeps them alive... so far.

goal.en: Listen to Catherina’s story.

startText.en:
So old fool Aidenus sent you looking to make trouble to me. May be I should just chop your head off and forget about it, huh?.. But Klavdia may be a problem, that's true. You're not lying to me, are you? Don't even think of it!

I can see traces of the Leper on your face. It means I'm your only chance. Oh well, you have to seek friendship of the powerful mage, who knows the secret... and the mage is not Aidenus. See what I mean?

checkText.en: Say when you’re ready to fight, I’ll summon a poor creature for you to take apart.

finishText.en:
How curious! I’ve never seen such a manifestation of the Leper!
Have you brought any alterations into your body before you met the Leper? Have you ever drunk Dragon’s blood, for instance? You have? I knew it!
I haven’t figured out how the Leper works yet, but I am positive that the source of it is the Astral - and who would resist the Astral best of all? Dragons! Their blood produces very strange effects, which you have just shown. Ah, anyway, the Leper is unlikely to make good to you. It might heal by itself or cause weird mutations, this is totally unpredictible. The impact of the Astral on the living matter hasn’t been studied enough, you know.

I’ll give you an artifact that is supposedly able to control the spread of the Leper across your body. It’s up to you to decide when to use it. And I’m not certain about the side effects, so make sure not to overuse it, or it might kill you on the spot, see?

goal.en: Defeat Catherina’s minions.

startText.en:
You don’t want to get corrupted and stay in the Umoir forests forever, right? Listen to me then.
The Leper doesn’t kill. It transforms, corrupts, modifies, turns inside out not only your body, but your very Spark. The further, the faster.
First of all, we have to understand how deep the Leper is in your body. The most accurate test is to see your abilities in combat.

finishText.en:
Let it be so! Let the Light witness our agreement!

As long as we're partners now, I'll tell you about my future plans.

I'm sure the Leper is somehow connected with the rebellious pagans that fled into the woods from the True Light. Their rage gave birth to the Leper, and I still haven't found the way to cure it.

I give no doubt that it's merely a matter of time. There are no things that cannot be turned back by a Great Mage! Whatever they might say!

goal.en: Accept Catherina’s offer.

startText.en:
I guess that places us in the same boat! You'll have to help me until I find the way to get rid of the Leper then. Unless you want to see how it progresses, huh.

You're not eager, eh? I understand. So, you're helping me lift the curse from my allod, I'm helping you lift the curse from your body. Deal?

finishText.en: Welcome! What do you need?

goal.en: Meet Anton Turischev in Skytower.

startText.en:
The Leper is spreading outside Umoir, and your story submits the fact. So we need to restore the Veil of Mystery, also known as the Mystery Seal to stop the disease.

It's a pity Skrakan has long died, and the knowledge died along with him. And I don't want to raise the dead and talk to the rot!

If the rumors don't lie, you're used to talking to them. So it will be your task.

Kidding. Rumors are rumors, I know. All you have to do is find a wizard who lives at one of Umoir islands. He's able to talk to the dead. I don't know how you'll find him and persuade him to help you - it's not my problem. Talk to Anton, he's going to give you directions. And take one of my knights to assist you.

finishText.en:
Eclipse will be ready soon enough! Dragon blood will protect it agains the Astral, fancy that! I can’t wait for it to sail!

Right now, there are a few ships available for sailing. Take Dawn, for instance, it rides fast as wind!

goal.en: Ask Anton Turischev about Eclipse.

startText.en:
Catherina, our Queen, is not just a great mage, she’s an outstanding inventor! The flying Skytower and clockwork army are her creations!

All the latest gadgets, however, cannot compare with the Astral Hangar and Eclipse!

checkText.en: Have you been able to find any information about the Veil of Mystery? We badly need it to stop the Leper!

finishText.en:
The book? It’s Skrakan’s diary! You have no idea how valuable it is! It might keep secrets of the Universe! An the way to the heart of the world!
Let me see, what it’s saying about the Veil... How curious... Damn it! The old fool cast a bloody spell on that! May the Light punish him!

goal.en: Find the ghost of the dead servant of Skrakan, ask him about Veil of Mystery and return to Catherina.

startText.en:
Your head is full of words of the dead language? It is good! It means we have a chance to squeeze the information from someone who knows about the Veil of Mystery.
Have you ever heard about Plagot? It’s where the gates you entered are. It used to be the largest city of Umoir, and now it lies in ruins, and silent ghosts are hovering over the dead city. Silent for all, but not for you!
I’m sure that among the ghosts there’s someone who used to know Skrakan. They will be useful to us!

checkText.en: The Ghost is silent and looks really sad and depressed.

finishText.en: Ugh ugh. It’ so relieving to hear your own voice once again! Thank you, stranger. I guess I owe you now? Tell me what you want and go, a living shouldn’t be long among the dead.

goal.en: Find ghost’s voice and bring it back to the ghost.

startText.en:
He’s silent, and all he does is stare. He lost his voice somewhere. He’s gesturing at you. Is it a beer keg? Or a big belly? Or both?

It might show the way to return the voice to the ghost.

checkText.en: Don’t hurry, I ain’t going nowhere.

finishText.en: This is so quiet now! I’m alone, this feels so good.

goal.en: Dispel menhirs’ magic and return to the old man’s ghost.

startText.en:
Don’t be so fast. Skrakan’s notes! Not so fast, I tell you.

Who told you I know about them? The Queen? I’ve seen one lady lately, so noisy! I asked her to be quiet, but she just waved her hand at me, and I lost my voice at once!

Everyone awakened, everyone who had slept for a century! Sentries, guards, even the tavern keeper! I hate it.

She touched stones, so I think she charmed them somehow. If you dispel her magic, I guess, all the dead will return to their graves. Then I’ll tell you where Skrakan servant lies. He should know more.

checkText.en: Have they arrived? Or have they not?

finishText.en: The skeleton is holding a book in his bony hand. The book is really old and bettered, but the handwriting definitely belongs to Skrakan.

goal.en: Take the ghost to the place where Skrakan lies, take the book and return to Catherina.

startText.en:
My word is stone! I said means I did! So, the grave of the servant is... the grave of the servant is... it is situated... holy mother, I forgot! Completely forgot! Under the wall? Or near the fountain? Or behind the tavern? Damn it.
You have still got my word. We’re going to find it, that’s for sure. You walk ahead, I’ll follow, and as soon as we come across the familiar place, I’ll let you know.

finishText.en: Welcome!

goal.en: Meet Radigost Ploughman in the field to the east of Lower City.

startText.en:
Oh mighty warrior, please, do not leave us poor bodies without your help ad support! I’m a simple little girl, no nobles will ever listen to what I say!..
Only you can help the poor girl. Haregons are eating our field away, and I’m a girl, and my dad’s an old man, there’s nothing we can do about them. Please, help us get rid of them!
Just walk toward the lake, you cannot miss our house.

checkText.en: May the Light guard you!

finishText.en: I can’t thank you enough! You’ve saved us! I will harvest now, and buy my daughter red shoes and a ribbon for her hair! She will look so beautiful!

goal.en: Get rid of haregons and return to Radigost.

startText.en:
Isn’t she stupid, that girl? Sending a hero to help! A whole hero! I could hire two boys for a dime, it’d’ve taken them an hour to get me rid of haregons...
Well, as long as you’re here, you are to do it. Please.

checkText.en: Got rarities? What if I find ‘em?

finishText.en: You’re an achrenologist for real! Dug up for stuff, and all! Business is business, you get the reward, I get the stuff, huh huh.

goal.en: Collect 25 historical artifacts in Plagot ruins and bring them to Finn Sacker.

startText.en:
Hey! Psst! Come here! Quiet! Do you want to earn some? I’ve got a business for you. I am an achrenologist, you see. It’s a science, the achrenology, it’s about digging for stuff, you know, ancient and dusty, all kinds of jugs, and rugs, and coins, all this. Drag em all to me, you know, to develop science and study the old days, and for the glory of the Light, of course.
When the demons attacked, the people just ran, they flee, you know, and dropped all their belongings just like that. So just pick it up and bring it to me. For the sake of achrenology, of course.

checkText.en: Avadhuta is good!

finishText.en:
Avadhuta out of big house, Avadhuta out of small house, that was not fair. Now Avadhuta lives here, no sorrow, no pain no more. Avadhuta is no fool, will go to no town, no city again. Avadhuta knows a tale about a prince and a monster. Prince hit the monster on the face, and monster grab prince, and prince hit monster with a club, and monster bite prince, and prince hit monster with an axe! The monster dies!

Now Avadhuta go search for scraps, and shards, and pieces of glass. Finn is good, Finn makes no pain to Avadhuta. He gave Avadhuta a candy, sugar candy! Will give more, if Avadhuta brings him more shiny shards!

goal.en: Kill 10 hungry Werebears and report to Avadhuta.

startText.en:
I’ve got another task for you. It’s not even a task, it’s nothing for you. There’s a fool in ruins, called Avadhuta. He always drags stuff from the ruins to me, and sometimes he can even bring in something valuable.

It’s too bad there are so many werebears there. I’m afraid they might eat him...

You will go there anyway, do a good thing, will you? Kill about ten werebears, and tell Avadhuta it’s clear. Let him drag more!

checkText.en: Damn you, you give no peace to Avadhuta!

finishText.en: Hear! Shouts and moans are heard no more! Demons are gone, now Avadhuta may sleep in peace for a day, and another day, and another.

goal.en: Cure the fool from voices in the head, then return to Avadhuta.

startText.en:
Demons, demons everywhere! See, there’s one! And there’s another! They laugh, they dance, they are there! Everyone thinks they have disappeared, but they haven’t! Avadhuta can see them nice and clear!
Avadhuta would beat them again, but no sword, no knife! You’ve got one? What are you waiting for! Make them shut up! Avadhuta no wants to hear them any more!

finishText.en: Woe has come, never expected! Forgive me, hero, for distracting you from your combat deeds, but see for yourself, what trouble we’re having here... Poor white fluffy rabbits became so corrupted by the Leper, they’re able to tear a human into pieces.

goal.en: Meet Radigost Ploughman in the field to the east of Lower City.

startText.en:
Oh mighty warrior, please, do not leave us poor bodies without your help ad support! I’m a simple little girl, no nobles will ever listen to what I say!..

Only you can help the poor girl. Haregons are eating our field away, and I’m a girl, and my dad’s an old man, there’s nothing we can do about them. Please, help us get rid of them!

checkText.en: You escaped being bitten by angry haregons? I’m so relieved.

finishText.en: If it weren’t for you, my daughter and I would have been ruined! Thank you for saving us from the trouble. And if they ever come back, now I know I’ve got such a good defender! I can tell whole Umoir about your bravery!

goal.en: Get rid of haregons and return to Radigost.

startText.en:
The hares are back. And they are no normal hares - they look more like dragons. Haregons, that is.

I can’t defeat them on my own. Please, help the old man to clear his field! I will pay you back and tell everybody how strong and brave you are!

checkText.en: Bloody rituals are extremely powerful, although complex and unstable. The slightest mistake will cost me a life. Don't distract me!

finishText.en:
I swear to the Light, if Skrakan were alive, I'd have killed him with my hands!
He never used his own blood to seal the ritual. He took someone else's blood instead, blood of a mortal... Hmm... I wonder if I should open up your veins and give your blood a try... But no. You should have been aware, if it were yours.
Let's return. I need to think.

goal.en: Go to the old ritual hall at the bottom of the lake and prepare if for the ritual, so that Catherina could restore the Veil of Mystery.

kickText.en: Catherina receives Skrakan's notes and finds out that she would need power of Umoir royal blood to create the Veil of Mystery. She thinks that Great Mage's blood might do. She's asking the player to perform the ritual. It takes place at the lake under the Upper City. The player will have to run around the location, use context actions, and kill the mobs that spawn. The ritual fails.

startText.en:
It wasn’t such a good idea, to base such a powerful spell on blood! Its quality greatly depends on external factors, which are highly unstable!
I bet the great Mage’s blood will do. However, we need to take care of the safety. There should be an old ritual hall in the basement of the Skytower - old Skrakan was very peculiar about the rituals. Most of the basement is under Starry lake’s waters, but the entrance is clear. Go there, find the hall, make it up and help me lift the veil of this mystery.

finishText.en: Are you looking for my Yelisseus? What’s the point for me talking to you? I told this many times to the Queen’s agents: I have no idea where he is!

goal.en: Find nanny in Upper City. She might know where Yelisseus is.

startText.en:
Let me think. If my blood won’t do, why is that? The object of the spell must possess certain traits, whick I evidently lack. What would that be, besides the fact that I’m the great Mage, and the power of my single nail overcomes the power of all the feetlickers put together?
It is rather obvious, isn’t it? I was born outside Umoir. All the blood-based spells must be blood-bound to the place. Pure logic. We need a representative of the ancient Umoir nobility... which is extinct by the day. Not so good, eh?
But wait! There should be Yelisseus! He has gone missing long ago, and nobody has seen him ever since. You must find him. And don’t come back before you do!

checkText.en: Rituals are outdated. Technomagic owns the future!

finishText.en:
I’m so tired. I never knew ancient rituals suck so much power out of you... Where has this ghost come from? A protective spell cannot materialise in shape of the creator! This is impossible!

I’ll take care of it later. We have more important things to do now. Return to my chamber, we’ll talk about our further actions.

goal.en: Meet Catherina in the ritual hall to complete the ritual.

startText.en:
You got the blood? Perfect. Where’s Yelisseus? We might need more blood.

If it goes as it should go, this time we might face old guardian spells, cast by Skrakan to prevent anyone from repeating the magic and destroy the Veil of Mystery. I won’t be able to distract during the ritual, so our safety is your responsibility.

Meet me in the ritual hall.

checkText.en: It's not smart to tangle with the honest men, not smart at all.

finishText.en: I bet Ussa Horbam feels like in heaven now.

goal.en: Kill Ussa Horbam and his helpers in Upper City, then return to Jade Gloom.

startText.en:
I heard about your brave deeds!
We’ve got a trouble here: some thiefs came to steal, to rob, to set on fire, to hurt the honest men. That’s not too good, I say. Not smart at all.
It’s evident they cannot stay. No thief would live in peace in the same forest with the wolf, see what I’m saying? I have to get rid of them. Understand? Nice. Their leader’s name is Ussa Horbam - I’m going to bury this one with special honor, ha ha.

finishText.en: I gather you’re the new watchdog of the Queen? She’s capable of selecting decent servants!

goal.en: Meet Grooden Dubin in Upper City.

startText.en:
So the veil has been installed. Now nothing can leave or enter Umoir. I control most portals, so the problem of spreading the Leper is solved now, I guess.

One of my old partners might have an idea of how to fight the Leper now. His name’s Grooden, he used to be one of the strongest mages in Umoir. He trusted in the Light, and abdicated the pagan beliefs, this is why he stayed intact, when the Leper came... The others weren’t so lucky. Only the Light is able to withstand the Leper!

checkText.en: Stop, friend! Be not in a hurry! Don’t spot your hands with the innocents’ blood! Listen to what I say first.

finishText.en: Velerad Oak is my name. I used to be the Head of the Guardian Ring once, now I sadly observe what the Leper has done to us. Even to me, as a matter of fact...

goal.en: Teleport to the Guardian Ring and defeat the corrupted Keepers.

checkText.en: Don't be long! The Leper goes deeper into the bodies with every second! It might turn inconvertible!

finishText.en: Here's the pollen. The Leper is pityless even to iridiens. I remember how beautiful they were...

goal.en: Gather dust and use it on the Corrupted.

startText.en:
Was it Grooden who sent you to finish with us? My own brother turned out to be such a snake, who could have though. Traitor!

He escaped, and took one magic thing with him. I will never forgive him for it. Without this thing, our protection weakened, and the Leper came in our Ring. My other brothers became corrupted. But I still hope to return human form to them. Only I can’t see the way how to do it...

I have an idea. We have to calm them down for a while. Bring me some pollen of local flowers. We let them sniff it, it will send them to sleep.

checkText.en: Enough with blood and deaths. The Ring has lost many!

finishText.en: Nice. Now that they’re quiet, their sense will come back into them easier.

goal.en: Calm down 15 Corrupted Druids near the Ring of Balance, then return to Velerad Oak.

startText.en:
I cast a spell on this corrupted pollen. Anyone who sniffs it, will become weak and sleepy. The only problem is how to make someone actually sniff it?.. Maybe they will become weak after a fight and easier to deal with.

Don’t overdo it, however. We have enough dead brothers already.

checkText.en: Don’t say anything. Death of any living being, even a corruped one, makes me deeply sad. These creatures used to be peaceful and normal back in the past...

finishText.en: Their flesh and blood might store the memory of the normal life!

goal.en: Bring 6 Galactic Deer’s horns, 10 Taksa’s hearts and 10 Toad’s eyes to Velerad Oak.

kickText.en: When the corrupted will be dazing, Velerad will ask the player to get inside the central tree. However, corruption inside the trunk is so severe, that noone can stay there long enough. Velerad suggests using the corrupted animals to overcome the corruption. Player's task is to obtain the necessary parts of the animals and bring them to the druid.

startText.en:
Thank gods, we can have at least temporary rest from the Leper. Now we need to get into the Ring, I only wish we could go past the Leper. Can you feel the stinking breath? It’s the Tree, possessed by the disease...

I can think of only one way. Animals, possessed by the Leper, can enter the Ring freely. It might be because of the corrupted blood. See my point?

checkText.en: Oh, it’s so hard...

goal.en: Take Velerad to the Ring of Balance to the tree and protect him, while he cleans out the Leper inside the Ring.

startText.en:
Let’s risk what’s worth it!

I am going in the middle of the Guardian Ring, inside the sacred tree, and clean out or at least restrict the Leper inside of it. Forces of Nature and gods will help me! And you will guard and protect me!

checkText.en: Any news?

finishText.en: It’s moving toward the center, to Upper and Lower Cities. Or is it the center that it’s spreading from?.. Only the capital stays intact, I wonder why.

goal.en: Explore Umoir and find the direction of the Leper spreading, then return to Velerad Oak in the Guardian Ring.

startText.en:
This is miracle! Thoughts and dreams come true!

The Leper hid. I cannot defeat it. I don’t even know where it has come from, and why. Please, help me again!

I can see you are touched by the Leper. It means you can see some manifestations that is invisible to the normal eye. Find the source of this disease. Maybe then we’ll have a chance...

checkText.en: The Ring of Balance used to be full of life and fun, and now it’s only a shadow...

finishText.en: I cannot thank you enough!

goal.en: Catch a living hampster, collect 5 bright flowers and 35 forest nuts, and bring all this to Milonega to the Guardian Ring.

startText.en:
I wish I died, only not to see how the Leper ruined the forest, and trees, and flowers, and beasts...

I still have hope that there is something that has stayed intact. Please, find some normal seeds and flowers, so that we could grow them here, again. And I'd like to have a normal pet, small and fluffy, just for a company...

checkText.en: Whispers, damned whispers...

finishText.en:
What’s going on? My visions have become true?!

You’re not a common human, as I can see. No common beings can create things out of thin air and Astral! It may be only one thing.

Yes. It’s the Leper that grants unusual powers... May the gods protect us...

goal.en: See the John’s visions and defeat them.

startText.en:
Whispers, voices... can you hear them? Can you see this? Can you feel?..

Do you want to see their eternal beauty? Hear their most beautiful voices?.. Say you do! Help me, share it with me!..

checkText.en: I’ll do my best to help you.

finishText.en: That’s that. I cannot help you, I am sorry. The mine doesn’t belong to me any more.

goal.en: Ask Goldie Nickel about the living gems.

startText.en:
I guess Catherina profits from the Leper. Everything is in her power now. She cuts down the forests as if to get rid from the Leper - and uses wood to build ships! She would never have dared to touch our sacred trees and destroy our idold, before the Leper came...

Oh, how I would love to take a look at whole Umoir, see what goes on in every corner of it... I once was able to do so, you know. I used living gems for it, they were really good. One trader gave them to me as a reward for something I had done for him. The Leper killed them, turned them into pieces of useless glass, and I don’t know where to find the likes.

You may talk to the trader, his name’s Goldie Nickel and he lives in Upper City. If you bring me the gems, we’ll have a good key to understanding the Leper.

finishText.en: Hello again. Another business?

goal.en: Meet Jade Gloom in Upper City.

startText.en:
I used to have a mine, true. I don’t own it any more. My brother Nickel gave me advice - trade the spices from the overseas. Buy a whole ship there, sell them here. That sounded reasonable, for since the traders were banned, we don’t have much spice to use here.

The price for the spices was high. I was completely taken in by them, borrowed a lot of money, and bought a whole ship of it. I even had to mortgage my gem mine, you know. Of course, mea culpa, I should have analysed the situation first - now the templars speak against the spice, for it’s not good about the Light, and kind of prohibited. So I’ve stayed here for a while, unable to sell anything. It smells nice, but people wouldn’t buy it! I’m desperate, my debt is outdated, and the mine is no longer mine, pardon my pun. It belongs to Jade Gloom now, he’s the master of gems and jewels, and I don’t own but tears and bitterness...

checkText.en: You normally don’t expect gold to flow in your pockets by itself.

finishText.en:
Now you've got the idea of one in the hand against two on a tree?

My elder brother still weeps about the mine? That's stupid enough. I only inherited an old jacket and a worn hat! What’s so fair about it? So I played a trick with the spice - made him buy a lot, and then made the templars prohibit it, deed's done, I get the mine! Justice on the move!

I owe Jade now, but that's nothing. I help you - I pay off half the debt!

goal.en: Convince Grub to share trophies with Jade

startText.en:
Oh, that's what you're asking for then, eh? As if I made Goldie run into debt! He came to me himself, and he himself offered me the conditions! He promised to give his mine to me, unless he pays off all that he borrowed! I didn't make him, you know. So we signed the papers, and it wasn't my fault that he didn't make it with the trade.
Tit for tat, you say? That works for me, and I do have a favor to ask for, indeed. There's this bridge, see, crossed by pretty many people. And there's a troll who lives under this bridge and collects fee from everyone who crosses the bridge. So I thought, why would a troll need so much money? Why doesn't he share it?
Go tell him he ought to share, you know, to secure his precious bridge from being washed down with the high water, or anything worse. Do you know what I mean? As soon as you persuade the troll, go and see Nickel. He's in.

checkText.en: Have you found the precious gem?

finishText.en: This is miracle! Your ruby is bigger than the previous one! It’s bound to work better.

goal.en: Bring Prophetic Ruby to Velerad.

startText.en:
One gem saved Nickel’s life, another gem took it away. It’ll serve you now.

Go to Velerad and give him the Prophetic Ruby. If it helps get rid of the Leper, it’s worth it!

checkText.en: What have you seen?

finishText.en: Here's what I'm thinking. All our gods became gods through faith. Don't you know? The Warrior, the Hunter, the Master, the Maiden, even the Sage - they all used to be common people, who returned after death, because people believed in them!

goal.en: Look into the ruby and see the future.

startText.en:
The living gem, called Prophetic Ruby, conceals huge power. If it likes you, it may show you the future, and it will depend only on you how it will actually turn round.

Only remember, that you won’t have a choice - you will only see whatever the gem will show you. Obey its will...

finishText.en: You again! What would you like to know this time?

goal.en: Meet Tale Teller in Lower City’s tavern.

startText.en:
The power is in faith! All of us, who believe in the Light, know this. Tale Teller brings people the word of gods and makes them believe!

Find Tale Teller and ask for his advice!

checkText.en: Greetings, hero! What do you seek here?

finishText.en: You’ve come here by a trick! And you’ve brought the Leper inside your body! What have you done?!

goal.en: Meet Gamayun at White lake.

startText.en:
White lake lies to the east of the city. This place is clear from the Leper, because Gamayun, the prophetic bird, lives there. She’s the child of gods, and she has all the power that gods have. She can give a reply to nearly all questions!

I hope she can help. It is not easy to get to the White lake, but I still hope you can make it.

Go there and find Gamayun. Ask for her advice.

finishText.en: Halt! Hands in the air! Slowly! You move - I’ll shoot!

goal.en: Find those who killed the sentries in White lake.

startText.en:
So the sentries have been totally eliminated, eh? They haven’t expected a sudden attack, and a few crossbow bolts were shot into each of them.

Those are not just some bolts - they are real heavy war bolts...

I wonder who that was!

checkText.en: Have you met the courier?

finishText.en:
Oh, damn... Militia showed up, which means the messenger spilled the beans. But there were no eye witnesses, so I think we'll be fine. No one will hear anything, I promise you.

So here’s the deal. You may find it useful. When we set up here, we came across an old grave. Our scouts reported that there’s an old demon buried in it. The very same demon that defeated your Skrakan! So, they found the entrance to the mound wide open, and tracks all around. Footprints of really big feet!

We didn’t go in. Why would we? I’m sure these tracks belonged to them iron knights. Who could send them there? Catherina.

What does the Queen want with the mound? I'm sure she's not trying to build a wine cellar there.

We didn’t give it much thought, you know. We aren't paid to do so. We'll finish our job, find that traitor and deal with him. Then we'll see. Bye.

goal.en: Activate the beacon, which is hidden near White Lake, meet the Imperial courier and report to Danila Martyn.

startText.en:
I think I’ve seen you before. You’re the legend, do you know that? Your story is taught in schools! Another secret mission here, eh?

We’re not beating about the bush here, you know. We’re sabotaging the League! Yes, we are! Remember the Kanian rebellion? That’s that. Only the Leper is messing with our plans. So now we’re gathering info for the eggheaded researchers, you know.

One of our couriers had to arrive, but there are lots of Catherina’s soldiers around the spot. We laid down a couple dozens, but they might return.

Go to the meeting place, activate the beacon and get the message. You are out of suspicion.

checkText.en: Where’s the Ciphered Message, eh?

finishText.en:
Wha-at? Guards came instead of the courier? You must be kidding me! Look me in the eye!

You’re not lying then, eh? I can tell by the eyes. So our courier got converted, gave us all out, eh? Just you wait, if Catherina hasn’t got him yet, we will surely dig him under ground ourselves!

As to you... Oh screw, we Imperials are loyal to our word, no matter what. Listen up.

When we set up here, we came across an old grave. Our scouts reported that there’s an old demon buried in it. The very same demon that defeated your Skrakan! So, they found the entrance to the grave wide open, and tracks all around - traces of real big feet!

We didn’t go in. Why should we? I’m sure these tracks belonged to them iron knights. Who sent them there? Your guess? Could it be Catherina, eh?

What would the Queen look for in the grave? She wants to set up no wine cellar there, for sure?

Don’t talk too much, though. You’ll be risking your life if you do. You never saw us, we never saw you. I promise to shoot you, if I ever meet you again.

goal.en: Activate the beacon, which is hidden near White Lake, meet the Imperial courier and report to Danila Martyn.

startText.en:
I think I’ve seen you before. You’re the legend, do you know that? Your story is taught in schools! Another secret mission here, eh?

We’re not beating about the bush here, you know. We’re setting up links with Catherina. But she doesn’t seem to be loyal to the Leage. She only wants more power, that’s it.

We have a secret mission here. I won’t tell you what it is, you have to understand. But I will still ask you to help.

One of our couriers had to arrive, but there are lots of Catherina’s soldiers around the spot. We laid down a couple dozens, but they might return.

Go to the meeting place, activate the beacon and get the message. You are out of suspicion.

checkText.en: The Leper is like flood - starts with a drip drop and then it breaks through and sinks everything.

finishText.en:
I managed to defeat the initial manifestations, but it’s only for the time being. White Lake is doomed. I only have one hope that you who brought in the evil, will help.

Ancient gods get weaker. The Leper and the Light suck their power. We have very little time left.

goal.en: Kill 10 haregons around White Lake and return to Gamayun.

startText.en: Don’t you understand that it’s impossible to cure the Leper, only to hide from it? I hid White Lake, concealed it! And then you came and brought in the disease. I can’t help you now.

checkText.en: We wish we could tell you more, but something is not revealed to us...

finishText.en: Your call was very clear and loud. Here we are.

goal.en: Acquire the sacrificial bird, fish, beast and flower and place them on the altar.

startText.en:
It’s easy to call upon gods, but will they reply? Faith feed them, but faith may kill them as well. Catherina is killing our father’s faith, making ancient gods weaker and weaker.

But it’s no use crying. If you want to talk to the gods, you have to bring them sacrificial gifts: one for the warrior, one for the hunter, for the master and the virgin. Place them on the altar and ask your question. They might answer.

I am no helper to you any more.

checkText.en: Where have you been so long? All my servants are turning Upper City inside out looking for you!

finishText.en: That’s a surprise. Where have you found this feather? It’s radiating power I have never met before.

goal.en: Talk to Umoir gods and report to Catherina in Skytower.

startText.en:
May the good be with you, stranger! We are not fond of the unwise sorceress that you server, but I do not observe evil in your heart, only the power - which is not yours, but granted to you. Not gold and riches, but only the truth and faith prevail! The magic and tricks do not last long!

Whatever you had chosen, was granted to you. It is your fate, your decision.

What would you like to hear?

checkText.en: How’s it going with the pikes?

finishText.en: So the death wish of the Fairy Pike didn’t come true? I’m not surprised!

goal.en: Kill the angry pikes and Fairy Pike, and return to Radunia.

startText.en:
Oh! What a misfortune! I was a young girl and going to marry a young boy in our village, when I was forced to get married to the Sea king. But it’s not that bad.

The Sea king was angry and cruel. He used to beat his servants, and drown boats. So the human marines dragged him out and cooked, so I stayed a lonely and happy widow.

I ran away from the sea palace an settled down here, in White Lake. It was so quiet and beautiful...

...before this all began. Then the pikes in the lakes went mad. They bite and hit with their tails! And their biggest one, Fairy Pike, is completely crazy. She’s always trying to eat me whole! And she speaks about some Yemel. I have no idea who it is, but the pikes really annoy me!

checkText.en: I had never thought before that two different creatures, like us, could really fall in love... Now see how it turned out! We only spent one day together.

finishText.en:
My magic ribbon! I’ll never lose it again!

You are so brave and strong! I don’t even know how to thank you enough.

goal.en: Kill Blueclaw and return the stolen ribbon to Zaryona.

startText.en:
Weep... I lost my magic ribbon, enchanted with true love.

A young guy called Ratemir fell in love with me. He followed me and secretly admired me. It would be dishonor to reveal himself, so I didn’t show I took notice of him, either.

Only once he came out to tell me how much he loved me, and gave me this ribbon. The next day he fell in battle, only this ribbon remained. And now I’ve lost it!

I was a fool! I only wanted to feed a squirrel, and it turned out to be corrupted! It showed me its teeth, and was going to bite off my arm, so I ran! And I think I might have dropped my ribbon there...

checkText.en: Jivinka is worried about her sisters? She has a kind heart. We must help her.

finishText.en: Lotus herb is able to expel any kind of sickness from the body. It’s just that the Leper is not a sickness, and Lotus can do nothing about it. But at least, it will bring relief to spiritwoods...

goal.en: Collect 10 Lotus and bring them to Gamayun.

startText.en:
Have you ever heard about forest spirits, stranger? I bet you have, and it was all about evil. Don’t believe that. We’re only evil, if you bring us harm.

That used to be this until now. When the Leper came, my sisters went out of their minds. They ruin the forest, scare people, shoo the animals... It’s strange, because we are magic creatures, which means we cannot be corrupted in any way.

I guess this disease may be cured by Lotus herb. I’m only too scared to go out - what if this disease gets me? May I ask for your help?

Collect ten Lotus herbs and bring them to Gamayun, she knows just what to do.

checkText.en: I’ve heard moans and mortal cries... Do you really want to kill all of my sisters?..

finishText.en: Oh, those were moans and cries of the corrupted beasts! Thank goodness, my sisters are alright! Thank you, thank you, thank you!

goal.en: Use Lotus herb to cure 10 Sick Spiritwoods near White Lake, then return to Jivinka.

startText.en:
I will entwine a Lotus wreath and enchant it with my powers. Put it on the head of a forest spirit, and the corruption will leave it at once. As it does, the forest spirit will turn into an awful monster! Don’t be scared! Hit it hard!

Remember, a spiritwood won’t just let you put a wreath on its head. You have to exhaust her first. Make sure not to kill them - they’re good and innocent creatures, it’s the Leper that does the bad.

checkText.en: White Lake is a disaster. I only hope it will all turn out fine...

finishText.en: I’m so sorry to kill the innocent animals, but it’s the thing we have to do!

goal.en: Kill 10 Werefoxes and 10 Mad Foxes in White Lake and return to Zaryona.

startText.en:
As I was looking for my ribbon, I saw a mad fox that tried to bite me. Glaring eyes, frazzled fur, bare teeth, so scary! I tried to help it, but it died in an hour. Then I saw another, and another... It seems weird, so many mad foxes at once...

I came to look for the cause of it, and I came across... I’m not sure what. Half human, half fox, it attacked me! I ran away. I think it was a werefox, like a werewolf, only a fox. And it’s bringing so much harm! I wish I could kill it myself!

finishText.en: Dare I ask you where you’ve been? Yasker is expecting update on search for Klavdia, and his patience is running out.

goal.en: Meet with Elizaveta Rysina at Yasker's Tower.

startText.en:
Let me think...

I’ve never seen anything like this before. If the Servant of the Light is interfering with the deeds of mortals, it means the balance is tipped. The Leper, the whole nation from the distant past, something is definitely going on!

I guess we have to communicate to the Imperial templars. This vixen Rysina is still gripping hold of the Trinity Church? Go to Nezebgrad and tell her about your fight with the Servant of the Light. Maybe she knows something. Any piece of information is priceless in this situation!

finishText.en: What? News from Umoir? Spit it out!

goal.en: Meet Marianne de Ardeur in Novograd.

name.en: Message to the Church of the Light

startText.en:
Let me think...

I’ve never seen anything like this before. If the Servant of the Light is interfering with the deeds of mortals, it means the balance is tipped. The Leper, the whole nation from the distant past, something is definitely going on!

Whether we want it or not, we’ll have to talk to the League church. If I remember correctly, Marianne de Ardeur is heading the church at the moment? It’s for the better, she knows the past better than the present, she might think of similar cases in the history. Go to Novograd and ask her about the Light.

finishText.en: I’ve been waiting for you for... nevermind, just tell me what you’ve got.

goal.en: Meet Yasker in his tower.

startText.en:
Have you any idea what the veil of Mystery is? It cuts Umoir off the world completely - Catherina controls all portals now! She may fully prohibit any entrance! We were planning things on it, planted spies there... Umoir used to be a great destabilizing factor for League’s politics, now it’s all gone.

I guess, none of it is your business. As to the servant of the Light, I don’t know about his powers or where he had come from. He’s never talked to the dead, and the only evidence of his appearance is your words. Remember the Cradle? It’s the only time that the servant of the Light interfered into Sarnaut’s affairs. And I’ve never heard about him attacking mortals.

Something weird is going on. I’ll look for more information, while you visit Yasker and report to him. Be prepared, he’s not in a good mood today.

finishText.en: There you are. I’ve been expecting you long ago. I’m sure you’ve got a good reason to be this late, haven’t you?

goal.en: Meet Aidenus in his tower.

startText.en:
The servant of the Light attacked you, and you not only managed to survive, but drove him back to the Purgatory? It’s unbelievable. It’s the second time that the servant comes to our world. The first appearance was at Cradle Isle, and you was involved both times! Weird coincidence, huh?

There is also Klavdia Kalugina. We still have no idea who she really is, and what she seeks. This story began long ago, back at Gipat shard, where she’s coming from. Daughter of Nihaz captured Tep’s spark... This is not good that she managed to escape, but you were smart enough not to try and stop her. Otherwise I wouldn’t have been talking to you right now.

I’m also worried about the eagerness of Catherina’s forcing the belief in the Light... Our Church may be strict and severe, but not that much. I’m sure every faith may live in peace with any other faith.

You know what, go to Aidenus now, he’s been waiting for you. I will browse through my books and look for any information about the servant of the Light at all.

finishText.en:
A letter from Yasker? How interesting. Let’s see what the mighty leader of the Empire is writing... Equalty, acknowledgment, blah blah blah... Nonsense. I am no fool and I am aware that the Imperial so-called independence spreads as far as to permit you select the color of your pants for Nezeb’s anniversary event.

No way. I can stand alone. I’ve found the way to cure the Leper. Have you managed to find out anything about the Servant of Light? He worries me most...

goal.en: Deliver Yasker’s message to Catherina’s Skytower.

startText.en:
You do have a reason to be late. The Leper, the Light, all that... I wonder what binds it all together... Could it be you? See, it all started as soon as you appeared. I know, I know, you mean good for the Empire. Be careful next time, that’s an order!

I admit, I was considering military intrusion to Umoir. This is not a valid option any longer. So, what we’re left with, is diplomacy, including manipulations. Catherina is trying to seize the power, so we’ll try and cut her off the League!

I’ll write her a letter and propose cooperation on the basis of trust and equal rights, independence and Imperial scientific assistance in fighting the Leper. This is a generous offer, so I don’t think she’ll pass on it. But if she does, you may act on your own accord, as you see fit. Don’t let us down!

finishText.en: Aha, a message from Aidenus. I won’t even slit it open. I know well enough what he’s saying. That’s "change your mind! think twice! obey!" No way. I can stand alone. I’ve found the way to cure the Leper. Have you managed to find out anything about the Servant of Light? He worries me most.

goal.en: Deliver the message from Aidenus to Catherina in Skytower.

startText.en:
This is sad and frightful news. After Skrakan’s death Umoir tended to radicalism, but I never thought that Catherina was the one to blame. I was wrong. She’s so full of herself, she fancies she’s free to do anything she wants! It’s a disgrace to a great mage!

However, her ambitions don’t bother me much. The Leper troubles me more. We need to study it and learn who stands behind it, whose evil will it is!

Here, this is a letter to Catherina. I’m asking her to withdraw from taking any premature decisions, like wrapping the whole sector into Veil of Mystery. League will help her fight the trouble.

checkText.en: What an adventure, I'll be damned! Ah, but I've seen worse. Can tell you some time later... if you survive.

finishText.en: What's this? Someone's been killed?

goal.en: Search for the trace of Klavdia Kalugina at pirate base in Jolly Roger bay.

startText.en:
As soon as we approach the shore, listen to what I say. If I say, drop face down to dirt - you must drop with your face down into dirt. I say, jump into the Astral - take a breath and jump! Feint the Greedy died a long ago, but his ghost is still there, and he’s still killing people.

We, gentlemen of fortune, rarely trust one another, that’s true. But you can trust me! No son of Octulhu could double cross old Silberpod so far!

finishText.en: Here you are! I thought you were a coward! I was wrong, don’t be mad!

goal.en: Meet Eugene Silberpod in Takalik Harbor.

startText.en: Hold on a minute. A suspiciously looking guy left a note for you. Here’s what it says: "Where are you hiding, buddy? If you want to go on with our little business, meet me in Takalik Harbor". Signed, "E.Silberpod". I’ve no idea who he is, but if I were you, I’d report this immediately!

finishText.en: Here you are! I thought you were a coward! I was wrong, don’t be mad!

goal.en: Meet Eugene Silberpod in Takalik Harbor.

startText.en: Hold on a minute. A suspiciously looking guy left a note for you. Here’s what it says: "Where are you hiding, buddy? If you want to go on with our little business, meet me in Takalik Harbor". Signed, "E.Silberpod". I’ve no idea who he is, but if I were you, I’d report this immediately!

checkText.en: Why are you still in Upper City? Are you scared to go out? Aren't you scared of me, great mage and Queen of Umoir, then? The Leper won't care about your fears, it'll eat you alive. Go now. You need this as well as we do.

finishText.en: Tell me everything! Has he taught you his wisdom? He has? Good I didn't do harm to him... I don't need his knowledge myself, I know all I need to know in necromancy. Now it's high time you apply your knowledge to practice.

goal.en: Go to the Island

startText.en:
Who is this wizard?.. Oh wait, I think it might just be boyar Jeer Catherina was talking about. If it is so, the matter is not so simple. Nawlad Jeer is evil. He drove so many people to grave... and he prefers the dead to the living!

He has lived in his mansion for many years now, doesn’t talk to anyone, never goes to the capital, and those who tried to sneak into his house, didn’t return... You have Catherina’s knight with you, so Jeer will have to let you in. But I’m not sure if he agrees to help...

I will show you the way to his allod, but you will have to act on your own accord, once you arrive.

checkText.en: Where’s Yelisseus? Has something bad happened?

finishText.en:
Oh goodie, goodie, my Yelisseus has gone missing! I knew it, I knew no good will be of human’s love to an elf! He wouldn’t listen to me!

Why, oh why has he become a servant to a vampire? Oh Yelisseus... Woe to me! He once told me that if anything bad would happen to him, we have to search for the truth in Kurgan.

goal.en: Go to Drowsy Woods together with Yelisseus to save his beloved Annette de Tristesse.

startText.en:
My Annette! She’s alive! I nearly abandoned hope!

I will save her, whatever it’s worth! Annette! She is... you have no idea how beautiful she is! She’s all my live, my soul, my love! No reason for living without her!

You will help me, will you not? We have to go to Drowsy Woods and take her home. I’m afraid, whatever drove Ademar crazy, is able to do the same to her. We have to hurry! I will owe you my life, if you help me, I swear!

finishText.en:
Oh well well well. Return of the prodigal hero. Why are you doing all this behind my back? Deceiving my servants, exploiting my stuff? I could well understand, if it were for the good! But no. I’ve got plans for Yelisseus, mind you. He’s a loyal noble Kanian. What am I going to do now? Gubarevskies are fools, Zaleskies are not noble enough...

To put it straight: I’m not sending a ship for Yelisseus, I’m sure it’s too late anyway. And if I ever catch you making a mess of my shipyard, I will feed you to a dragon!

goal.en: Meet Catherina in Skytower.

startText.en: You know what? As long as it’s your fault, go directly to the Queen, plead her, beg her to save my Yelisseus from the vampire! She deserves to be killed at the spot, but no, you had to pity her! Now we only have the Queen to hope for...

checkText.en: I wonder how anything like Firebird appeared in our world... I guess it’s coming directly from the ancient times - there was a way more power in the world in those days, and less people to possess it...

finishText.en:
So strong and so beautiful! Let’s see if it’s capable of lifting the Leper curse...

The Gubarevskies turned out to be traitors? Damn it... There is nobody I can trust... They died? It’s their own fault, I’m sure.

goal.en: Find Firebird in Zalesky Posad and bring it to Catherina.

startText.en:
Listen. There were three brothers, I’m the elder, Vassily is the middle, and Ivan is the little brother - wind in his head! So one night our father ordered us to guard his field. In the middle of the night, fancy that, in the dark and cold! I know, right? Vassily and I, we took no notice and went to bed. What about our little fool Ivan? He spent three nights in the middle of the field, froze his ears off, underslept, underate... my guess is that he started hallucinating. He says he saw a Firebird who ruined our dad’s field, believe it or not. As if there was anything to ruin at all...

So, our father went crazy, said, I want this bird, go and bring it to me, or I’ll cut you off the heritage. We decided it was the little one’s problem, and he was to go for it. He gathered his things, received our father’s blessing and left for Zalesky Posad. A week later, he was back, barefeet, no money, no bag, no pants even! All he was going about, were horses and women - my guess is that he blew all money on races and girls. Father sent him off to Kania, out of harm’s way, out of sight, out of mind.

So if you want to go looking for the bird, try Zalesky Posad first. Watch out, though, not to lose your pants, huh huh.

finishText.en: Let me take a good look at you. Who are you, after all?

goal.en: Meet Xasian Pinov at sawmill near Lower City.

startText.en:
It’s been trouble! Someone sneaked on to the dock and damaged Eclipse! There’s a huge hole in its board, big enough for a horse to come through. If the Queen finds out, I’m dead.

I sent for wooden planks to the lumbermill, but it’s taking them too long, and I don’t know why.

You are my only hope! You’re a stranger here, so you will hardly run off to report to the Queen. Please, be so kind, send my workers back from the sawmill! Help me out!

finishText.en: You’re evil! Go away! You cannot defeat me! I’ll kill you!

goal.en: Ask Ademar de Tristesse about the sabotage.

startText.en:
It’s good their leader was taken alive. He was about to escaped, but my club caught up with him! See, there he is, blubbering nonsense. I guess my club hit him on the head hard enough.

You may ask him a couple of questions, if you like. Meanwhile, I’ll give orders concerning planks for repairment works.

finishText.en: What are you saying? You saw Ademar! He’s the father of my beloved Annette! What happened to her? Where is she?

goal.en: Tell what Ademar told you in Upper City.

startText.en:
Eclipse! Eclipse! The end is near! The end is coming!

I told them, but noone would listen! Only Annette did. Now we ruined ourselves, we ruined the world!

The mirror... I shouldn’t have brought it here, to Drowsy Woods... Madness is hidden inside, now everyone will die, and Annette, and Yelisseus, what have we done...

Eclipse will ruin us all! I am already dead...

checkText.en: Never trusted them. We were right to kick them out of Umoir.

finishText.en: That was cool. You should have tried persuading them first, not to start with mincing them! On the other hand, that’ll teach them!

goal.en: Defeat 6 saboteur elves at the lumbermill and return to Xasian Pinov.

startText.en:
So you’re from Maxim, he’s worried about his ship? Do you know we were nearly killed? By who? By elves, of course.

The damned elves won’t let us work! Jumped out of the blue, started setting their orders here! Blood was about to spill. They say, they won’t let a single wood plank leave this place, or else! Guards are too scared to oppose them, so what are we gotta do?

Do you serve the Queen? Talk to these bandits, before they burn down my sawmill!

checkText.en: Task clear?

finishText.en: Good. Now you will have to act on your own again.

goal.en: Ask Yasker where Klavdia is.

startText.en:
I’ve got two things to tell you - the good one and the bad one. The good one is that I know where Klavdia Kalugina is. The bad one is that we failed to calm her down.

I don’t know what she is, but she’s got Tep’s Spark, the greatest evil-doer of Sarnaut! This is huge power, and I’m not sure it will be used for the good. We know nothing about this "Klavdia", apart from that she’s really unpredictable and dangerous, just like the Director.

checkText.en: Listen to me.

finishText.en: Nothing of what you’re about to hear must escape from these walls. Unfortunately, you will have to count upon yourself, but I can help you a little.

goal.en: Ask Aidenus where Klavdia is.

startText.en:
I’ve got two things to tell you - the good one and the bad one. The good one is that I know where Klavdia Kalugina is. The bad one is that we failed to calm her down.

I don’t know what she is, but she’s got Tep’s Spark, the greatest evil-doer of Sarnaut! This is huge power, and I’m not sure it will be used for the good. We know nothing about this "Klavdia", apart from that she’s really unpredictable and dangerous, just like the Director.

finishText.en: Greetings! I’ve been waiting for you!

goal.en: Talk to Alexandra Soldina at the port.

startText.en:
I don’t give your abilities a doubt! I’m sure you alone will do better than a whole squad. Your task is to get on the pirates’ allod and find out what Klavdia looks for there. She’s too dangerous to let her interfere into Imperial business!

Alexandra Soldina is waiting for you at the Astral academy. She has some contacts among the pirates.

finishText.en: You say, you need my help? I’ll do my best, but I am not a captain. I know someone, though.

goal.en: Meet Vlastemir Naimitov in Novograd Astral Academy.

startText.en:
Oh, Klavdia, Klavdia, what are you plotting... Whatever it is, I’m afraid it’s not for the good. Listen, if you ever have this opportunity, do your best to neutralize her. An extremely strong crazy sorceress is capable of destroying whole Sarnaut! First you have to track her down, of course. This is not an easy task!

I don’t think that the pirate base is a good place to start an attack. The pirates will flee as soon as they notice our sails. We have to be more accurate in planning. Vlastemir Naimitov dealt with the pirates before, I think, he can give us good advice.

finishText.en: Is that a customer? What would you like? Anything to your choice! Absolutely anything! Even if it’s a little illegal.

goal.en: Meet Eugene Silberpod in Takalik Harbor.

startText.en: I don’t know much about Astral navigation - unlike my buddy, who’s on friendly terms with the pirates, although he himself has been out of business. He’s in the trade now, and my guess is that it’s not at all legal. His name’s Eugene Silberpod, and he’s one of a kind! You can find him in Takalik Harbor on Eljune. Pass him a message that he still owes me!

finishText.en: Is that a customer? What would you like? Anything to your choice! Absolutely anything! Even if it’s a little illegal.

goal.en: Meet Eugene Silberpod in Takalik Harbor.

startText.en: I don’t know much about Astral navigation - unlike my buddy, who’s on friendly terms with the pirates, although he himself has been out of business. He’s in the trade now, and my guess is that it’s not at all legal. His name’s Eugene Silberpod, and he’s one of a kind! You can find him in Takalik Harbor on Eljune. Pass him a message that he still owes Vlastemir - me, that is!

checkText.en: It’s been a long time since I did it.

finishText.en: Ugh, that was hard. Damned goblin nearly blew up the reactor, with us all together! But it’s okay, now we have a ship that significantly differs from those of the League and the Empire!

goal.en: Capture the pirate ship, docked to the South of Takalik Harbor and report to Eugene Silberpod.

startText.en:
Right, so it was Soldina who sent you. She remembers I owe her. So, what do you need?

Get into Feint’s base? Where’s that, Old Lighthouse? Jolly Roger bay? Are you out of your mind?

I’m coming with you. The only problem is the ship. Mine’s too old and battered, and yours is too Imperial, we’ll be shot on sight. We need a real pirate ship. I’ve seen one near here, called Astral Cuttlefish - we’re going to capture it.

Listen. You go forward, to the deck, and capture the control room. We are going to jump into the engine room to prevent them from exploding the reactor. Join us as soon as you’ve finished.

checkText.en: It’s been a long time since I did it.

finishText.en: Ugh, that was hard. Damned goblin nearly blew up the reactor, with us all together! But it’s okay, now we have a ship that significantly differs from those of the League and the Empire!

goal.en: Capture the pirate ship, docked to the South of Takalik Harbor and report to Eugene Silberpod.

startText.en:
Right, so it was Naimitov who sent you. He remembers I owe him. So, what do you need?

Get into Feint’s base? Where’s that, Old Lighthouse? Jolly Roger bay? Are you out of your mind?

I’m coming with you. The only problem is the ship. Mine’s too old and battered, and yours is too Imperial, we’ll be shot on sight. We need a real pirate ship. I’ve seen one near here, called Astral Cuttlefish - we’re going to capture it.

Listen. You go forward, to the deck, and capture the control room. We are going to jump into the engine room to prevent them from exploding the reactor. Join us as soon as you’ve finished.

finishText.en: Greetings. You’re right on time, I have an important information for you. This is classified. Listen carefully.

goal.en: Meet Yasker in his tower.

startText.en: Comrade! I have an urgent errand for you. Great Yasker himself is ordering you to arrive to the Tower immediately. Immediately!

finishText.en:
Greetings.

You’re right on time. I have important information regarding you and your part in eliminating the threat posed by Tep. I hope I don't have to remind you that you must keep this to yourself? Then listen up!

Klavdia is at the center of it! Her motives are not quite clear... But it's completely unacceptable!

What did she do? Haven't you seen it?

Anyway, this lady stole the Spark of Tep himself! How did she do it? Believe me, I'd like to know that myself...

But we need to find her at any cost!

goal.en: Meet Yasker in his tower.

startText.en:
Here's the thing... They are looking for our Klavdia!

I don't know what happened, but she must have made a mess of things. Our guys went into that Pyramid with her, but I'm not sure what happened next. Maybe Yasker can tell you?

Anyway, unless you're planning to storm the Pyramid right this second, you should go see him. The messenger from the City Council that gave me the letter looked pretty green about the gills.

finishText.en: Greetings. I am sorry about the fuss, but I have important information for you.

goal.en: Meet Aidenus in his tower.

startText.en: Hello there. I have a message for you. Aidenus is gathering all League heroes together, and he’s got an urgent request to you, personally. Make sure to arrive to him right away.

finishText.en:
Greetings!

I'm sorry about the fuss, but I have important information for you.

Klavdia is at the center of it! Her motives are not quite clear... But it's completely unacceptable!

What did she do? Haven't you seen it?

Anyway, this lady stole the Spark of Tep himself! How did she do it? Believe me, I'd like to know that myself...

But we need to find her at any cost!

goal.en: Meet Aidenus in his tower in Novograd.

startText.en:
Here's the thing... They are looking for our Klavdia!

I don't know what happened, but she must have made a mess of things. Our guys went into that Pyramid with her, but I'm not sure what happened next. Maybe Aidenus can tell you?
