Anyway, unless you're planning to storm the Pyramid right this second, you should go see him. The messenger from the Detective Bureau that gave me the letter looked pretty green about the gills.

checkText.en: I’ve never seen you before! Is it clear?

finishText.en: I never took a thing! I’ve been framed! I’m innocent!

goal.en: Collect information concerning "temporal anomaly" in the ruins of Skrakan’s tower at the bottom of the lake and from people in Upper City.

kickText.en: An ancient note tells you that Skrakan used to study experiments with the time flow, which nobody had done before. You should search more evidence in the secret places of Skytower. There might be a temporal anomaly far from Umoir; now there's an allod occupied by the Empire. You'll have to find an Imperial soldier to help you sneak inside - talk to the guards, they will introduce you to Urri Miloslavin, who's currently in prison.

startText.en:
Curious. Letters are barely readable, and the terminology is not clear, but basically, it says about some kind of "temporary anomaly" created by Skrakan. But no further details whatsoever. It’s only clear that Skrakan held his experiments in a ritual hall under the ancient tower in a lake near Upper city.

You ought to examine the ruins closely. You might find something that will tell you more about the experiment, and reveal the way to fight the Leper.

checkText.en: Are you from the investigation department? Not again...

finishText.en: I was robbed! And I know for sure it was Miloslavin! He alone knew I was going to my sweetheart exactly at this hour!

goal.en: Find out what Miloslavin’s fault is, and meet the robbed trader.

startText.en: Hey, psst, you’re a hero, right? Brave deeds, heroic exploits, all this stuff, right? Listen, I’m innocent as a child, won’t you save me? Please? Or they’ll chop my arms off! I beg you!

checkText.en: Have you got my stuff yet?

finishText.en:
Three different boxed, eh? All right, they’ll do, now show me the furs...

What’s this? Fur? It’s a thin hide! Where are the furs?

goal.en: Buy 3 golden boxes from Jade Gloom and obtain 3 bear furs in the forest near Lower City, then return to Danil Nievert.

startText.en:
Everything, everything was stolen! All my life was invested in these things! A golden box... I mean, three boxes! And a bear fur coat! I mean, three bear fur coats!

Miloslavin is the thief, I’m telling you! He sold them, and spent money on booze, that’s right! Nothing was found on him, nothing, hear me?

Bring me back my golden box and the fur coat! I mean, of course, three boxes and three fur coats! I’ll lift my accusation then.

finishText.en:
I was about to say goodbye to my arms! And that guard was staring at me, as if estimating, which one to start with.

So, what do you want? You didn’t do that just for the sake of it, right?

goal.en: Tell Urri Miloslavin that he’s free.

startText.en:
What? You’ll rip my skin off so that I could tell the difference? Are you crazy or something?

I’m kidding, just kidding! The furs are mine, all three of them.

Go to the guards and tell them I made a mistake, Miloslavin is innocent. Let them set him free. I found what was missing.

checkText.en: I’ve seen a lot in my life, but never could even imagine any such thing...

finishText.en: The past, the future, my head is dizzy. To hell with such adventures.

goal.en: Go to classified facility Gates-II together with Miloslavin.

startText.en:
So, you want to enter a secret site and request my assistance? That’s smart! I’m a xadaganian, who else could help you?

Your Queen is quite canny, you see. She negotiates with the League and with the Empire. She agreed to allow to set up a scientific expedition at one of the allods. A secret object called "Gates II". I have no idea where the Gates One is. What they are studying there, I don’t know, either. I worked as a librarian at the Gates II, before I was accused of stealing one thing, so I had to flee as fast as I could. Then I was saved by some Umoir warriors, lucky me!

I can’t enter Empire, but I’ll do what I’m able to. I wonder if anything else can be fetched from the site...

checkText.en: You have found Yelisseus’ tracks? What are you waiting for?

finishText.en:
Not so bad. Yelisseus was in such a hurry, he didn't even have time to change into a clean shirt. I hope you didn't have to really dig him from under ground? No kidding, where was he?

Death Plant, Nomarkh Iblis, you say? And there is my signature under the paper? Isn’t it a bit too much, eh? Hand me the letter, I’ll tell you a story.

goal.en: Visit Nomarkh Iblis’ allod "Death Plant" to save Yelisseus.

startText.en: Noone listening to us? Let me whisper in your ear... I’m afraid my Yelisseus got tangled with the bad guys, Light forbid, with the trade dealers, what do you call them, obligares, right. And the undead! Just think of it, he went to talk to an Iblis - is that a human name at all? Iblis in the Death Plant, Light save us. I’m scared. Please, see if my boy is alive, check upon that Iblis! I’ll be praying for you day and night!

finishText.en:
the future belongs to technology! Magic offers nothing new, see, during the last thousand years they invented next to nothing! the Arisen are aware that the progress cannot be stopped! I will head the new Conclave some day!

Never you mind all of it. the Ritual of the Veil awaits!

goal.en: Listen to Catherina’s story.

startText.en:
Curious documents! It looks like Iblis broke our agreement and concealed the results! Bastard! I hope he suffered before death. Money I paid him was enough to build a whole fleet!

Don’t be so surprised. The great sorceress has business with some crazy Arisen. When it comes down to my project, I’m ready to get tangled with anyone, even the likes of you!

Engineers with their manatrons, the flying tower, the best shipyard in the world and my mechanical army - this all haven’t appeared out of the blue. It has taken years of hard work, failure and success. I am ready to work even with the walking dead, only to break through!

checkText.en: Copper mountain doesn't belong to me any longer. Talk to Nickel, he's the big man, all decisions were his, he's to face the consequences.

finishText.en:
So this is how it all turns out... My brother loved gems and gold, and was turned into stone. I don’t blame the Mistress - she’s strict, but just. I am sorry about Nickel, though. He was my brother, after all.

Thank you for returning the bill. I’m smart now, and won’t let anyone bring harm to the mountain. Keep the Ruby like the apple of your eye!

goal.en: Visit Copper Mountain allod together with Envie Nickel to obtain Prophetic Ruby.

startText.en:
The prophetic ruby, you say? This is a very rare and dear gem. It is not often found in mines, you know. May be, Copper mountain was the last place in the universe! You don’t throw such things around. But if you really need one, I’ll help you - provided that you help me. Scratch my back, I’ll scratch yours! I grasped this principle long ago - unlike my brother.

You’re strong and brave, as I can see. I need heroes like you. There are evil spirits in Copper mountain mine. The work stopped, miners are scared, no gems, no income. Let’s go there and find out what happened. If you help me clear the mine, I’ll give you the ruby. Deal?

checkText.en: Have you brought good news or bad news?

finishText.en:
What? Come again? My ears are failing! Folks out of nowhere, Klavdia escaped, mad Servant of Light... Are you out of your mind? Where's Claire? She's back at the allod trying to enforce the Light? I gave no such order!

You have also failed to find the roots of the Leper. Klavdia is not strong enough to start something like this. Servant of Light has nothing to do with it, either. Who's done that?..

goal.en: Together with the representative of the Church of the Light, find the source of godly power in the Astral and return to Catherina.

startText.en:
So these are the gifts from local, so to say, gods? Looks like they’re really scared... Good! The power is not in belief, the power is in magic and knowledge! Only Light gives power, only Light is worth believing in! What have they done for their people? Nothing! They are bound to disappear now.

They said something that interested me, though. Spellweaving in the Astral then, hmm... My scanners registered a weird peak lately, of which I thought that it was one of the numerous Astral anomalies. Now I don’t think this happened just randomly.

This peak took place in our sector. I put down the coordinates. I think you should go there and see what happened. I will send you my confidante with you, she knows a thing or two about magic.

finishText.en: Wow, these knights are so powerful! And I never thought golems were capable of using magic! Catherina has advanced so much, I wish she were on our side.

goal.en: Teleport to the docks and defeat the guard. Discuss further actions with Klavdia Kalugina.

startText.en:
How could I make such mistake...

It’s not the time to give up yet!

"Eclipse" is a huge ship, but it’s not too fast. I don’t think I can open a random portal for it to enter, so we have to catch it up. I’m sure we can find a decent boat for it.

checkText.en: I could never think Catherina will turn out to be so double faced! Now it’s time to pay for my own blindness. I an the only one who can drive Dawn through all anomalies and catch upon Eclipse!

finishText.en: What a monster! But we made it real quick, right? Let’s not waste time now.

goal.en: Board Dawn, order to start the chase and defeat attacking demons.

startText.en:
The gap between Eclipse and us is increasing every second! Let’s not waste time!

I wish I could go with you. Great mage escaped, and the local gods cannot go to the Astral, because they are part of this world. I’m the only one who can protect this allod until you come back. And if you don’t... Umoir is doomed. The fate of this world is really in your hands.

However, I cannot let you go on your own. See this coin? It’s got the League national emblem on one side, and Imperial one the other. Remember, what I told you about faith? Faith is power. People believe in their factions more than anything else! This very faith will come to your aid.

Find a mighty source of power - it may be a ship reactor, for instance - and drop this coin there. The help will arrive immediately.

Enough with the talks! Hurry to the ship!

checkText.en: Whew, we did it.

finishText.en:
I’ve never been so scared in my life! But we did it! We broke through!

"Eclipse" is a way too large for us to be able to split the assault team. We have to decide how we are going to make way to the control room. There are two paths: via upper deck, full of Catherina’s servants, or via cargo hold, where we’ll have to destroy the reactor. Without it, the "Eclipse" will be of no danger, and then we’ll deal with Catherina. It’s up to you to choose the way!

goal.en: Destroy Eclipse shields and use the boarding bridge to get to Eclipse.

startText.en:
See, there’s Eclipse ahead! It will be a good fight!

First, we’ll have to break through the shields of Eclipse. Before we do, the traitor’s ship is totally invulnerable. Then we’ll be able to throw bridges across and get to the deck of Eclipse - pray that noone falls into the Astral! Don’t even think of jumping over, Eclipse’s protection devices will kill you at an instant. Only across the bridges, no other way!

All ready? Board them!

checkText.en: What are you waiting for! Go ahead, board it! Let’s throw them all into the Astral!

finishText.en:
It looks like a mysterious power captured the control over Ignat Krivov’s combat machine and turned it into a weird device. You haven’t come across any such thing before.

I guess, its logic became totally different, more... logical, so to say. What came out of it, was perfect, accomplished, purposeful... as if it has come from without of Sarnaut.

Whatever it was, it is dead. And we have to go on!

goal.en: Get to the upper deck, defeat captain Krivov and his combat devices.

startText.en:
So, the upper deck. That’s a good decision. More space, easier to fight. However, we will be clearly seen, and there are plenty of Catherina’s servants. Most of all, I’m scared of captain Krivov. He’s widely known for his brutality.

I heard Catherina armed him with a weapon, never seen before. So beware of him!

checkText.en: Average Speed, on the attack!!

finishText.en:
What is... Who are you?

I have seen your face! I saw you during this short instant, when victory over Tep returned me from the non-being! And then I died again. Do you understand? I’m dead! Dead forever! I perished during the Great Astral Campaign, my body remained at the small island near the June Gates, and then it also disappeared in the Astral!

But still, I am right here talking to you. Is this real? Or just another last spark of life?

I am feeling alive! I’m full of power, it’s boiling inside me, I feel so strong! How did you do this? And... why?

goal.en: Kill the herdsman and free dragons from Eclipse, then use the released energy to activate Klavdia’s coin.

startText.en:
Very little has left, there are power shilds ahead, that cover... what is it? Dragons?!

What are they doing here, at Eclipse? Are they the "keys" to the seals that are to destroy Sarnaut? If it is so, they have to be deactivated.

checkText.en: Tell me now, what do you want?

finishText.en: Ugh, ugh... We’re easy to hurt, yeah... But you’re dead anyway!

goal.en: Defeat mender goblins in cargo hold.

startText.en:
Cargo hold! That’s a good idea! A perfect place to corner the assaulters!

We should only be aware of the three goblin mechanics down there. They’re real animals, able of biting an iron wrench into halves! And they know their compartment in and out! Be careful!

checkText.en: Ouch... What's going on?

finishText.en:
I thought ghosts cannot feel a thing... But I am feeling heat and pain. Am I alive?

Oh wait, I remember you! You released my spirit from under Tep’s power, and I told you the truth about the cataclysm!

So now I am alive, that’s weird. I have to be dead, you know. The mistake that I made took away so many lives. They’re dead, and I’m alive now... It hurts. Why have you brought me back? I’m such a loser!

goal.en: Destroy Eclipse reactor and use the released energy to activate Klavdia’s coin.

startText.en:
The reactor will burn you to ashes, fools! Do you really think that the Queen needs Firebird to cure the Leper? In your dreams! It’s pure and unlimited energy for free! You still wanna break down the reactor? There it is, down the corridor, go on.

Are you playing chicken now? You’re done with, so that you knew, the reactor’s got a demonic soul in it! Ugh... Ugh... I’m dying...

The demon will eat you, for sure. If not the demon, then the heat will burn you... and I’m going to be resurrected by the Queen for my loyalty and service...

checkText.en: Here you are.

finishText.en:
I'm... I'm free! Damn you, Sarn! Curse...

I guess you're waiting for the words of regret? Alright, you may tell them all, Yasker, Aidenus, whoever you're reporting to... Tell them I admit I acted like a fool!

goal.en: Catherina defeated

startText.en:
There was a battle here! I’ll have to ask my questions later, then. I guess someone really powerful helped you resurrect me, that means I owe them my life! It's the debt to pay, like the Empire always does. Now tell me, why do you need my help?

...

I see. So this fool decided to break the seal. I cannot believe it. Catherina is not smart, but she won’t kill herself. I cannot believe she’s able to serve anybody, either. She’s too proud and loves power. It’s more like it, that something has captured her will, and she doesn’t know what she’s doing.

If we kill a great mage near the seal, the huge blast of energy will release and break the seal. This outcome is quite predictable - and foreseen by the enemy, I am sure. It means, we mustn’t kill Catherina.

Let’s go now. We will have more time to think!

checkText.en: Here you are.

finishText.en:
Damn...

I guess you're waiting for the words of regret? Alright, you may tell them all, Yasker, Aidenus, whoever you're reporting to... Tell them I admit I acted like a fool!

goal.en: Catherina defeated

startText.en:
No great mage can create life out of nothingness. It must be a god. Tell me more before I fall into ashes again, quick.

...

Oh, Catherina, Catherina... Your pride will ruin you one day. Although I do not believe she could make this decision on her own. Breaking the seal! This is incredible! Nobody can survive it, and Catherina is surely not suicidal. She’s rather weak, though, so I’m sure there is someone behind her back.

You mustn’t kill her! Don’t even fancy this! Killing a great mage near the Seal will break it for sure, and this will bring us all to an end! We need to neutralize her somehow, before she does something beyond recall.

Enough with the reflections. We have to stop her. That’s the way to go.

checkText.en: Here you are. I've been expecting you.

finishText.en:
I can feel something really important happened far away in the Astral. Cannot tell you, how I knew it. I just sense it.

I can also see that I shouldn't worry too much. I think I can congratulate you on the successful mission completion. No report needed, either.

However, I'm asking you to tell me what happened...

goal.en: Listen to what Catherina has to say and talk to Yasker in Nezebgrad.

startText.en:
It's not a good time for being unreasonably angry.

Now that all his plans have failed, he has nothing better to do but to destroy the Seal and kill us all. My death may release energy, high enough to crack the Seal...

Your help is needed to send Sarn back into the dark. Let's go, talk to you later... after the battle.

checkText.en: Here you are. I've been expecting you.

finishText.en:
I've been waiting for you to return. I had a feeling that something awful was about to happen... But you are here, and everything's all right. We should thank you for saving it all again... and for the new details, too.

I'm glad to see you safe and sound. Tell me, what exactly happened. We have a lot to think of.

goal.en: Listen to what Catherina has to say and talk to Aidenus in Novograd.

startText.en:
It's not a good time for being unreasonably angry.

Now that all his plans have failed, he has nothing better to do but to destroy the Seal and kill us all. My death may release energy, high enough to crack the Seal...

Your help is needed to send Sarn back into the dark. Let's go, talk to you later... after the battle.

checkText.en: Do you like my story, friend?

finishText.en:
You’ve found Warrior’s trinket, and the others should be near.

Everyone bows to the Warrior, no matter what they do - go to war or return home alive. Bow to the Warrior, and no sword will cut you, no bolt will hit you. The battle evens everyone, whether you’re a bandit or a hero, you’ve got your own fate. When you come to your end, the Warrior will meet you on the other side to invite you to the feast in his parlor, where the beautiful young ladies dance, and brave heroes fight in the eternity.

Come by again some day, I will tell you more.

goal.en: Ask Tale Teller about the trinket

startText.en: What? What amulet? I’m a tale teller, not some unholy outcast! That’s not a question to ask to me! Go to Grooden and demand him!

checkText.en: What have you got, friend? An old amulet? Listen to my story then...

finishText.en:
Hunter was considered the smartest and deftest of the gods. All animals of the woods, birds of the sky and the never-seen creatures obeyed him alone, born by his word and died by his will. He knew all: whether the hunt will be successful or not, or the arrow will hit the aim, or a branch crunches under a hunter's foot. He accepted blood, wild honey and berries for sacrifices.

In the years of poor harvest, a huge bear came. It killed cattle and destroyed crops. Whoever turned out to be brave enough to face and fight it, soon found out that it was noone else, but the Hunter turned into the bear. Hunter and the brave one became sworn brothers then, and all the luck and success was on his side forever.

Hunter is strict. He cannot stand cowardice and laziness. He aids the brave and the skilled. After death, they will stand together with other brave hunters, blowing a hunting horn and riding the trotters in high heavens.

Come by, if you find more artifacts. I will tell you other stories...

goal.en: Take the drill to Tale Teller in Lower City.

startText.en: The amulet looks elegant and fine, regardless of its old age. It depicts animals among tree branches, and it seems to smell like blood and fir needles. You should ask Tale Teller about it.

checkText.en: Greetings, friend! What news do you bring me?

finishText.en: You were lucky to obtain the trinket of the Maiden! It’s not as simple as it looks. She put all her soul into it, her kindness and care. She always takes care of every being, of people and animals, stones and plants. She can reveal herself in either of the three appearences: a young girl, a caring mother or a wise old woman. She guards our families and protects us from evil. That is why we love and respect her.

goal.en: Meet Tale Teller in Lower City’s tavern.

startText.en:
That’s a strange image. Faded colors, scratches, and a very sad girl’s face... But her eyes are so... luring. Their look has tenderness, sadness, love, and desperation. No doubt, a great master created it.

You should ask Tale Teller who is depicted here.

checkText.en: There are four gods above us, mortals. It's Warrior, and Hunter, and Master, and Maiden. They give us protection and bestow us power. There is Sage above them all, who never interferes into mortals' deeds. His advice is priceless.

finishText.en:
I made no mistake. Here it is, Master's Amulet! Only the skilled ones can get it. Grooden had been like that before he betrayed his fathers' faith for the Light.

But wait. You say Grooden called upon the Leper in combat, and the Leper responded? That is most unusual.

I used to believe that the Leper had been sent down by the Gods as a punishment, but now you say there is someone who is able to take control over it and use the power... Besides, Grooden is a simple local man, not that weak but not that strong, either... nothing special.

Relics of ancient faith keep quiet. I hoped so that they would show us the way, but alas.

Whether I want it or not, I'll have to tell you one secret. There is someone who can tell you a lot about the essence of the Leper...

goal.en: Obtain the Pagan amulet from Grooden Dubin and bring it to Tale Teller.

startText.en:
So you want to listen to the ancient gods’ will? Of course, they had no templars - they simply didn’t need them. They came willingly to the decent ones, and would never speak to the unworthy!

You have got three signs - the Maiden’s image, the Hunter’s drill and the Warrior’s charm. These things are not simple, a common man cannot get hold of them. Now you need to find the last one. I heard a rumour that Grooden escaped the Ring and took one thing with him. My guess is that the thing is what you are looking for.

checkText.en: Good deeds always pay good!

finishText.en:
Oh, this is so good, such good news! Here’s my dear chest!

Thank you, you are so kind! Please, take this ring as a reward! It’s not so pretty, but it will serve you well, believe me!

goal.en: Find the strongbox hidden at the bottom of the lake near Covert Hide and bring it to Swarog.

startText.en:
Good man! Listen to an old man’s plea! I heard about your brave deeds and your heart’s kindness. I know even our gods favor you! If it’s true, it’ll be easy for you to help me.

Swarog is my name, I’ve lived here all my life. I managed to scratch and scrape a little bit of money and gems, to leave to my grandkids after I die. I put this small treasure into a chest, and hid it in a lake that’s near here. Now there’s a monster in the lake that won’t let anyone approach!

Help the old man, bring back my chest!

finishText.en: It’s strange, these five idols look really old, as if they spent hundrends of years here, and this one looks brand new. Even its wood has not yet darkened.

goal.en: Go to the shrine in Covert Hide and touch one of its idols.

startText.en: I’ll tell you something. You’re a good hero, very noble and respectful. Go to our sacred shrine, touch the idols. They may show you something you will be interested in...

checkText.en: I never expected to see you here. Are you joining my followers?

finishText.en: Easy, you’re not going to try and strangle me, eh? I’m not there right now, this is just a hologram. Why are you so mad, anyways? Are you sorry about the Spark? You say, it was Tep’s Spark? Big deal.

goal.en: Ask Luka Artful at Pagan Shrine in Covert Hide about Peregrina's idol, then bring the requested sacrifice.

startText.en:
That’s weird. There are only five gods in Umoir - Sage, Warrior, Hunter, Master and Maiden. What is the sixth statue?..

You should ask someone about it.

checkText.en: Cup is likely to have been sold. Jade is greedy about such things, check with him. Sword... it could only be good for some beggar, who's got no money for a new weapon. Armor could have been sold to a blacksmith for remelting - iron is expensive nowadays. As to the toy... it could tempt but a baby. A normal thief would have thrown it away, and I have no idea as to where to find it.

finishText.en:
You are such a good one! I never expected my dear things to come back!
You have no evil in mind, as I can see. Very well then, I will tell you about my darling Yelisseus - who knows, may be you'll be lucky to find him...

goal.en: Bring back the stolen sword, armor, cup and toy to Lovvie Goodman in Upper City

startText.en: Thieves got into the house the other day looking to steal money. They didn’t find the money, so they took whatever random things they could find: a straw doll - old Yelisseus’ toy, and his silver cup, and an old battered armor, and his sharp blade. That’s rubbish for them, but I cherished these things as a memory... I wish I could return them...

checkText.en: My dear kittens! I've been missing you so!

finishText.en:
Yuppie, they’re back, all five of them! Fluffy, Snoozie, Whiskers, Grumpie and Mr.Quaxo Mooncustripe himself! Why Mooncustripe? He loves the moon and never sleeps at night!

Here’s your doll, good as new!

goal.en: Find all five kittens and bring them back to Mila Kittenson.

startText.en:
A toy? What toy? This one? My kittens found it somewhere in the street, and played with it all day. And then they got bored and ran off. How do I gather them now? What if someone hurts them? They’re little kids!

You know what, you help me find them, and meanwhile, I will fix and clean your toy.

checkText.en: Are we playing, or what?

finishText.en: You're lucky today!

goal.en: Talk to Bean Bold and play Heads or Tails with him.

startText.en: What’cha lookin’ at? M’sword? If I had a coin every time someone stares at it, I’d be rich! Huh huh. I wish! I’m flat broke, dude. Was lucky to grab the sword from some vagabond!

checkText.en: Think faster!

finishText.en:
You managed to shake out the debt out of all three? Nice!
Here’s to you, if you really want it!

goal.en: Ask Ivan Drunker, Arseniy Krymov and Barbara Brie to return their debts and bring them to Jade Gloom in Upper City.

startText.en:
The silver cup? I have one. Why would you care?
Give back the cup? No way. Pay or get out.
Do you really really want it? That’s good. I’ve got a task for you. Some people owe me gold: Ivan Drunker, Arseniy Krymov and Barbara Brie. Bring me back my gold, I will give you the cup. For free, all right.

checkText.en: About twenty links are missing from this armor...

finishText.en: This armor is really old. I tried my best and fixed it, but I'm no god, you know. 'S all I could do, see? One good blow, and it'll shread away. Here, if you really want it, there's nothing else I can do about it. I have some decent ones for sale, though!

goal.en: Retrieve 20 Iron links from birds around Lower City and bring them back to blacksmith Dandy Joll.

startText.en:
I knew it wasn’t so simple!

A man knocked on my door one night and offered an armor for sale. That armor was so old and battered, I didn’t want to buy. So he threw it over the fence to my garden, turned around and walked away. I picked it up the next morning, of course, why would it just lay there?

A few chainrings were missing - I guess, magpies could steal them. Find them and bring back to me, I’ll help you fix it.

finishText.en: Where the hell have you been? I don’t care, in fact. Do you remember about our agreement? Don’t waste time then!

goal.en: Return to Umoir and report about Zayan’s words

startText.en:
Whatever happened - happened. I believe in destiny. There is no point in blaming and cursing yourself for the mistakes. No need to be sorry about the past. The present is more important.

I wish I could help you. But I don’t think Catherina will welcome her enemy at Umoir. Besides, Avilon cannot stay without its great mage even for a while. You will have to fight alone!

checkText.en: Hold on, my love! I’m coming!

finishText.en: House de Tristesse is revenged! Now hurry to my beloved Annette!

goal.en: Defeat Baba Yaga

startText.en:
Wait, you fool, or do you have a death wish?

I’ve got something important to tell you! Listen. The old witch has stuck sticks with skulls on them all around her house. They will burn you with magic fire, just as soon as you approach them. Here’s an amulet to protect you against the skulls. And may Tensess help you!

checkText.en: Why haven’t you come earlier, Yelisseus...

finishText.en: That saved me the explanation. Have you seen the witch? It was her who took Annette’s father to the grave, and then the whole House, too.

goal.en: Search for the Seven Knights’ house and find out what happened to Annette.

startText.en: Here, she writes that she made up her mind to escape and head to the forest, to the Seven Knights. What knights? Let’s find them.

checkText.en: We were in our full powers, as we were young. It’s not like that any longer...

finishText.en:
Well now, everyone’s back here. Now listen.

Annette came to stay with us, but she didn’t stay long. We went for a hunt once, and by the time we came back home, she was gone. We figured that it was the damned witch that took our Annette to lock her up, and we strived to save her, but we guess we’re a bit too old for that - we barely escaped! So we have no idea whether she’s alive or not...

goal.en: Find the six missing knights in the woods.

startText.en:
It’s been ages that we stayed in this forest. We didn’t mind much, when the elves came. The swamps suited them well, so we decided to let them be. It was alright at first, but then their leader became a widower, and the witch came to ruin the elves, and the swamp, and the whole allod!

So, you’re looking for Annette, right? I’ll help you if you help me. See, I’m alone here. My brothers wander around the forest. I don’t know if they’re lost or got into trouble. I’ve been calling out for them, but all in vain. If you manage to find them, I’ll tell you where your beauty is!

checkText.en: Can’t waste time!

finishText.en:
Wait! Don’t kill her!

That’s what the old witch was talking about. My dear Annette, my poor girl! As if it wasn’t enough to simply break the back of the beautiful one! She turned her into a monster!

I don’t want to believe that this is the end. If there is a way to lift the curse, I will find it. However, I won’t dare to beg of your help any longer. This is my love, this is my pain. Thank you for everything that you’ve done for us. Now I’m asking you to leave...

goal.en: Save Annette de Tristesse

startText.en: I’ve found the place where the old witch locked my beloved! There’s a cave on top of the mountain, she’s in there! Now that the witch is dead, we can save her! Hurry!

checkText.en: It’s so gloomy and wet, as if the whole island soaked in tears...

finishText.en: The diary goes that the father brought a magic talking mirror as a gift to the stepmother, and she asked, who was the fairest one of all. And the mirror said it was Annette, my beloved! The crazy witch went wild. She decided to kill her! To save her life, Annette had to flee to the forest, to hide at the... wait a minute, what’s that?

goal.en: Find traces of Annette de Tristesse on the island.

startText.en:
So here’s where the House de Tristesse dwells. This tiny island is corrupted, in and out! My beloved wasn’t born under a happy star...

Ah well, let’s hope for the best. First of all, we need to find elves on this island. I hope they can give us information.

checkText.en: Oh my, this is so scary!

finishText.en: Ugh, thank you so much! I can see you’re on business here. Well, if it was Plu the Tightwad who sent you, tell him to get lost! What? You’re not Free Traders, huh? Who are you then?

goal.en: Find Paphnutius Homespun, the village leader.

startText.en:
Welcome! You must be new merchants! What are your goods? Have you brought anything new? Woodcut twilight vampires?

You’ve come to see boyar Jeer, I see. Don’t ask me how to do that - nobody has never met him in person, he’s one mighty wizard! We’re too scared even to approach his house. The only one of us who dares, is my father, the village leader. You can speak to him, just wait until he returns from the forest, he’s been there since morning. You’re not in a hurry, are you?

checkText.en: A month in the cage is a decent lesson, I’ll make sure to remember it well, Jeer!

finishText.en: You also failed to charm secrets out of Jeer? Well, if you know where to seek, you will certainly find what you look for!

goal.en: Get into Nawlad Jeer’s mansion and persuade him to teach you to speak with the dead people.

startText.en:
Ah, so you’ve come to see the boyar? Aren’t you brave! We, peasants, don’t dare to approach his house. I’m the only one who comes inside, you know, to hand in the taxes, or to sort out the documents. To tell you the truth, he’s rather soft, although scary. Never hurts the likes of us. Occasionally, he even does some good wizardry, if you know what I mean. He won’t see anyone in person, though. If we need anything, we have to talk to the servant.

Alright, nothing ventured, nothing gained. See, there’s his house, right there. Talk to the servant, who knows, may be the boyar will agree to see you. Make sure not to drive him mad, though! There was this one girl who strived to learn from him, to which he didn’t agree, so she found no better thing to do, but to sneak into his house through the drain! And we never saw her since!

checkText.en: How an idea of securing his own death in the middle of the forest could ever come into his moldy head?!

finishText.en: What do you mean - slipped? What duck? I knew nothing of the duck!

goal.en: Obtain Nawlad Jeer’s death.

startText.en:
All these days behind Jeer's bars haven't been in vain! You can lock up the witch's body, but you can never restrain the witch's soul! While in the fortress, I managed to find out where Jeer's soft spot is! He's going to answer for everything now!

Listen. He really is immortal. I don't know how, but he detached his death and secured it with magic. Until it is set free, he won't have to face it, and thus, won't have to die. Where, do you think, it is hidden? Somewhere in his caskets? No way! On this very allod! Whatever is hidden, can be found!

First of all, you have to be able to see the coffer. Jeer cast a spell to revert the eyes from it, but I know just the way to dispel it. Go to the woods and bring me some good herbs and cold water. I'll tell you what to do next.

checkText.en: Why are you still hanging around? What if the hunter gets the egg before we do?

finishText.en: Here it is, can you see it! Oh, just hold on now, you old rot!

goal.en: Chase the duck and grab Jeer’s death

startText.en:
Easy, calm now... The duck’s flown away? It’s nothing. It cannot disappear from the allod. We only have to catch it before the old man does.

Let me read my cards now. See, it’s so clear: ace of spades next to the jack of diamonds. This means that someone has already caught it. Someone from the village. Hurry to the forest, the hunter must still be there!

checkText.en: If I were a boyar, I’d never leave such a wide pipe unguarded!

finishText.en: Have you drunk in all his knowledge? Good. Now it’s my turn, hand me the needle, if you please. I’ll beat the dust out of the geezer! I’ll make sure he pays back for everything he’s done to me, and the mouldy bread, and the rotten water, and the putrid straw for bed! And most of all, he’s going to pay for his nasty giggles!

goal.en: Make Jeer teach you to talk to the dead

startText.en: Now you’re one important person, aren’t you? Happy learning! Try not to kill him after all, I’ve got to deal with him, too.

checkText.en: Quiet! Iblis hears us, unleashes Spinners, and we’re done!

finishText.en: Fine. We’ll come in through the main entrance.

goal.en: Find the mansion of Nomarkh Iblis.

startText.en:
Here! Hurry! Quiet, or they’ll hear us! You are not Iblis’ servant, right? I don’t care, whether you’re from the League or the Empire! What’s being prepared here, will bring harm to everyone in this world. Listen.

I’m from the City Council. I’m tracking down Nomarkh Iblis. Yasker gave him money to develop Spinner technology for the Imperial army. What Iblis did, he started selling the combat machines to everybody! I found his lab on this island, and he turned out to be worse than just a conman.

All Spinners have the in-built remote control listener, which means he’s got his own private army, spread throughout Sarnaut, only waiting to be activated!

Together, we are able to sneak into the mansion. Help me finish him, and I’ll help you... by the way, what is your mission here? Oh, I don’t really care. Deal?

First of all, we have to get inside. There’s a hole in the fense. Then, there is the garden, but it’s not too well secured. Let’s roll!

checkText.en: Cultists, mechanoids, now this one... Dirt to dirt, the saying is true...

finishText.en: Half the deed is done. Now it gets more dangerous.

goal.en: Smash Iblis’ workshop.

startText.en: Careful downstairs. A few former Tep’s servants live here, and they all know the code to start Spinners remotely, so you will have to kill them all!

finishText.en: Thank goodness! I thought my death hour has come.

goal.en: Destroy Spinner-2 prototype.

startText.en: Iblis seems to envy Tep’s fame. Together with the machines that spread all over Sarnaut, he’s preparing another army, which he is going to lead himself. There is a new, improved Spinner’s model behind this door. It will be independent, reinforced, more functional. Luckily for us, it hasn’t been finished yet, so it’s not hard to destroy. But check your equipment, anyway, it won’t be that easy!

checkText.en: Hurry! All guards are going to be here in an instant!

finishText.en: We’re out, thank all gods! I locked the door and broke the key, so they won’t get us.

goal.en: Exit the mansion.

startText.en:
Who are you? Who was that brave warrior?

That’s how it turns out to be... I used to despise the Imperials, and now a Xadaganian spy gave her life for my freedom. I guess I must pay off the mortal debt and kill the damned bastard. Do you know what he wanted to do to me? Turn me into a Clockwork knight! Now it’s either him or us!

First of all, we need to get the keys. The sentry officer is keeping them. Let’s start!

checkText.en: Why is there always a mess, won’t machines work without it?

finishText.en: Perfect! Let’s try them now. It’s all or nothing...

goal.en: Collect 10 unstable mana batteries.

startText.en:
Science is good. It gave us technologies, ships, different useful devices. On the other hand, look at the monsters it creates. I wish I could live thousand years ago, without iron beasts and deadly mechanisms. That must have been so good...

Ah, dreams. Back to business now. See these iron spiders ahead? You cannot defeat them with your bare hands. I heard Iblis getting after one of his technicians the other day, saying they oughtn’t throw mana batteries to garbage, because Spinners step on them, and batteries explode and pierce through Spinner’s defenses. See their weak spot? Let’s find a few mana batteries and try using them against Spinners, eh?

checkText.en: I wish they would kill one another...

finishText.en: We did it! Now hold on, Iblis, you’re going to pay for everything!

goal.en: Destroy three Spinners 1.1 after lifting their defenses.

startText.en: We can find an unspinnable tie-up for every Spinner, alright! We’ve got enough batteries, let’s remove their defenses now, so that they were easy to disassemble.

checkText.en: Pride is sin. You take a minute to admire your devices, and get killed instantly!

finishText.en: We did it! Iblis’ evil plans are ruined, victims avenged, and we’re free! If it weren’t for you...

goal.en: Defeat Iblis.

startText.en:
I can see him! There he is, right behind the gates! That’s it, Iblis, your last hour has come!

Look at them! Iblis riding his iron pony, and the others are staring and clapping their hands! If we attack him, they’ll spring at us all together. We’d better take them in one by one, and then get to Iblis. Sounds like a good plan, huh?

checkText.en: Welcome back!

finishText.en: Looking for your companion, eh? He’s run off to the Queen already.

goal.en: Back to Umoir

startText.en: So Catherina needs a drop of my blood? She saved my life, so I guess I can do this little favor. Let’s hurry to Umoir then, I’ve got important business to do. These ruins will take us there in an instant.

checkText.en: Moving right along!

finishText.en: There we go. Going in disguise is a serious crime, by Imperial law.

goal.en: Sneak to the classified facility’s territory.

startText.en:
I’ve got a lot in my history, but I’ve never intruded a secret base. It’s okay, we can do it. What have we here? Gates, guards, wires... No turrets, no emergency alarm, no guarding spells... Phew, that’s nothing at all! Imperial safety, huh!

We’ll disguise like sentries. I’ll hide here, and you will lure a soldier or an officer. No, we won’t change into someone else’s sweaty uniform. I’ve got a special device, camouflator. You’ll see how it works.

checkText.en: Oh, my head...

finishText.en: Greetings, comrade officer! The project moves on, as scheduled... almost...

goal.en: Ask what tests and experiments are conducted on the allod.

startText.en: Now let’s find out what the Imperials do here, where they store the anomaly, and the rest. You’re the officer now, so you’re in charge. Go and ask the staff. Make sure not to give yourself away.

checkText.en: We cannot let scientific breakthrough fail only because there is no liquor... I mean, no liquid lubricating oil!

finishText.en: Here it is! This machine will make masters of time from us!

goal.en: Obtain a bottle of surgical spirit for Alex.

startText.en:
We’re meeting the deadline, officer! We ran a test yesterday, and it was sooo... goood... I’m sory, I’m a little dizzy now...

I’d love to show you the machine in action, but the first test run totally corroded the mana reductors’ contacts and both temporal wheels. Now we need pure surgical spirit to avoid hangover... I mean, to clean them and avoid blowing up!

Speaking about hangover... I mean, rubbing contacts! Officer, please, give your order to grant us one big bottle of pure spirit, and I give you my word, we will produce the results today!

checkText.en: We are on the verge of magitechnical revolution!

finishText.en: Ready! Now we can see ancient Sarnaut - provided we have the official license.

goal.en: Help Alex prepare the machine for running.

startText.en:
Everything is fixed, the machine is nearly ready. The last thing to do is...

First, last time we ran it, the fuse blew out, we need new ones. Fetch them from the stockmen.

Second, it’s parasites. I’m not speaking about the League, it’s common parasites, bugs that chew and damage the wires. Light forbid, they might eat something vitally important during the experiment. You have to get rid of them.

And third, you have to warn my assistants that we are ready to start.

See, how simple? Very little time left till the important historical moment!

checkText.en: Ouch...

finishText.en: Who are you, demons? Where’s the master?

goal.en: Take part in the historical event.

startText.en: Now we are going to test run our time machine! This is the first time ever you have a chance to see it in action! We will pierce through time and space! We will move into the past! Centuries into the past!

checkText.en: Now, now. What are we going to do next?

finishText.en: A secret passage under the mage’s tower! Can you feel the smell of gold? I mean, golden mysteries and enigma! Yes, that’s exactly what I meant.

goal.en: Find a hint in Zayan de Desirae’s library.

startText.en:
What is it? An intrusion? How dare you! Do you have any idea whose tower this is?! Magister Zayan will tear you apart... Who are you?

What do you mean - from the future? Do you happen to know that the temporal magic is the most forbidden of all? Are you aware of what punishment awaits you? Provided that you manage not to destroy Sarnaut, of course. Oh dear, what am I going to do without the magister...

Every instant spent in the past adds up to the temporal disbalance and the imminence of temporal paradox! You must go back to your time, and return Magister Zayan here, into anno mundi 4015.

There’s the Reflection Storage on top of this tower. It’s able to repeat any spell that had been cast recently, any spell at all, even the one that opens the Gates of Time. It is secured by magical guards, and I don’t know how to switch them off. We have a huge library in the basement, may be we’ll find the answer there.

checkText.en: Wow, what a place! I’d like to keep something apart from memories of this place.

finishText.en: Woe to me, I am going to be punished...

goal.en: Obtain Reflection Storage.

startText.en: Such a curious thing! It burns! I wonder if it’s able to morph us into some kind of demons... Ah, whatever. Let’s show it to the smartie.

checkText.en: Is it dangerous? We won’t get to ancient Junes, right?

finishText.en: We’re alive! Alive!

goal.en: Return to your time.

startText.en:
This device is your chance to set everything right. The Magister has already set it up real nice, so even you will be able to use it. I hope.

Keep calm, breathe deeply, count to ten... Step in the center of the hall, stand at the spot where you first appeared... No, I’ll stay right here, I still want to live. And pray... for the repose. Kidding, just kidding!

checkText.en: I wonder what it’s going to be, if Zayan From The Past comes across Zayan From The Future... I’d rather not check that.

finishText.en: There, there. Zayan saved, temporal paradox imminence lifted, pockets full of gold... It’s all right. What, no gold in your pockets? How could you not steal some?!

goal.en: Return Zayan to the past

startText.en:
What have we done! We dragged into the Present great mage Zayan de Desirae himself! He’s thousand years old, and he still lives in the present! It means, we have two of him now, and there is none in the past! What is it now, the temporal paradox, then?

We need to take him back. Let’s find him and secretly return to the past. We need to be really quiet and act covertly! Don’t be scared, I’m not new to this profession.

checkText.en: Lazy bones, wandering about instead of working!

finishText.en: This place is so gainful! I could earn so much, why do I keep wasting money?!

goal.en: Ask Semer Khaemweset about problem in the mine.

startText.en: Who’re you? Nickel finally spent a dime and brough a hero? Listen then, I’ll tell you everything.

checkText.en: Why would everyone go mad these days?

finishText.en: I thought they’d say something useful, but they seem to be really mad. What are we going to do next?

goal.en: Speak to crazy miners.

startText.en: First ask these fools, driven crazy by the whisper. They’re locked in the storehouse, just in case.

checkText.en: There are thousands of gems under this mountain! I will never let go of it!

finishText.en: Who’s making the noise? Who is Nickel? I’m the mistress of this allod! You will dig only if I let you dig! And if I won’t, you’ll sink into hell!

goal.en: Go down to the mine and defeat the evil spirits.

startText.en: Oh well, so now it seems to be your turn to go under ground and see those monsters!

checkText.en: We haven’t received any guests long time!

finishText.en: Ssstop, mortals! I am Mighty Polozsss, the guardian of the Mistress’ chambersss. You must prove worthy before you may enter!

goal.en: Mistress’s chambers found

startText.en:
I know nothing of Nickel! I agreed to let people dig for stones, not for copper! They broke their promise, that’s all for now.
You say, don’t kill the innocent? Look me in the eye now... Oh. I can see a strong heart and a good spirit... Right, I will lift the curse for the first time. As to the Prophetic Ruby, you will have to earn it!
Pass my test first. There’s a stony forest at the allod. I will tell you the magic word for the Pillars to show you the way to the forest. If you find the path through it to my parlor, it means you worth it. And if you don’t - then don’t blame me!

checkText.en: Any fool can use a sword. Try and use your brain!

finishText.en: Sssssmart, aren’t you? You may passss!

goal.en: Find replies to the riddles of Mighty Poloz.

startText.en:
You’re strong, and I can now clearly see it. Now show me how clever you are. I will tell you three riddles, and you are to bring me the answers to the riddles.
First riddle. I have scissors for hands and I walk sideways.
Second riddle. I have a little house in which I live all alone. It has no doors or windows, and if I want to go out, I must break through the wall.
Third riddle. White horses stand on a red hill, first they champ, then they stamp, then they stand still.
If you are smart enough, you can guess what it is! Otherwise, you’re not worthy of seeing the Queen!

checkText.en: What guests I am welcoming!

finishText.en: Not many are able to pass through the forest and reach my chambers. Could it be that the ancient heroes are returning? I’m keeping my promise, here’s the Prophetic Ruby! Now you may go. Return the bill of sale to Goldie. Tell him, I forgive him for the first occasion, but if the agreement will ever be broken again, people will never see the gems again! As for you, forget the path through Stone Woods! You are not welcome any longer!

goal.en: Find the Mistress of the Copper mountain.

startText.en: The Mistress’ chambers are right behind my back. Make ssssure not to put her into rage, or you will be damn ssssorry!

checkText.en: So cold, no food, wild animals... I wonder if we’ll go wild, either...

finishText.en: We cannot thank you enough!

goal.en: Find out what's going on here.

startText.en:
It’s a miracle! Lumix isle has always been a cold naked stone, now it’s all fresh springs and blooming trees! Is it the work of a great mage?

Wait, there’s someone else here. Who is that? Gibberlings? No, it’s not. Oh Tensess, it’s the illusory prisoners! What are they doing here? It’s impossible... Victory over Tep was just a dream, and it means we’re still there, in his machine...

Okay, pull together, Claire. Fear is fatal to common sense. We have come to find the source of magic, right? May be the magic that gave them bodies is the same magic that has transformed the allod! Let’s talk to them.

checkText.en: I haven’t seen you for ages! Who’s this angry lady?

finishText.en: We meet again! You’ve become stronger now... And I have known now so many things about Irdrich and Sarnaut, that I grew even older now...

goal.en: Help Tekyan summon Genlun.

startText.en: Who helped us survive after the gods were gone? Who protected and taught us, who healed us, when we were sick? Do you know it was noone but the Wise Crocodile? We ornate his statue and bring him offerings, and he visits us from time to time. We haven’t received him here yet, that’s true, but there is no statue of him, either. A few days ago I proposed making the statue of snow - it is no stone, of course, but it’s good enough for sacrifices. However, there is still no statue, they are still agruing. Why don’t you give them a hand?

checkText.en: Helping the idol! What a disgrace.

finishText.en: Look, they’re here, too. And the smell, can you feel the smell of Mirra?

goal.en: Teleport to the other edge of the allod.

startText.en:
Noone can hear me now, but you. No need to scare the others.

There is much magic on this island. Much more than a great mage is able to use.

Now I know the truth about Irdrich, but this allod is a mystery even to me. It is real, and the Tekyan are real. A few days ago they were teleported here from Tequatl - with their houses and all.

But that’s not all. I haven’t arrived at once, because the same power erased my image from their memories. If you arrived a few days later, they would have forgotten me completely.

I don’t who does this. I’m not too strong outside Irdrich. But I can give you a hint where to look for the answer. There is another Tekyan settlement beyond the mountains. I cannot go there, but you can. Find June ruins, teleport there and find out the truth. I give you my blessing.

checkText.en: Long time no see! How’s everything? I’m trapped, see. And you are about to be lynched by a fluffy horde. Nice day, isn’t it?

finishText.en: Nice! They’re a way more dangerous than they may seem.

goal.en: Defeat the villagers.

startText.en: This smell of Mirra, the light, the bliss! Have they accepted the true faith? They might know more than their brothers. We need to talk to them.

checkText.en: Who’s that? Another idol? Light bless me.

finishText.en:
I don’t understand! This is the servant of the Light? Why do I have to protect myself?

Wasn’t my faith firm enough? Have I done something wrong? Sinned by talking to the crocodile?

I made up my mind. Return to Umoir and leave me here praying for forgiveness and teach the Light to these gibberlings. I hope Catherina will understand.

goal.en: Set free Klavdia Kalugina.

startText.en:
Long time no see! Have you searched half the Astral only to find me? It’s flattering. But I don’t have what you need. Hush, this is no time to talk. Remove these chains, and I will give you answers! Provided that we survive...

The storm is coming! The storm like we have never seen before. The one that imprisoned me is arriving...

I can see June amulet on your neck. Good, it means we have a chance. Touch the four pillars to release the old June blood magic power on the enemy!

checkText.en: Why do these noisy animals hate Tekyan so much? It might be to set the example for us not to follow!

finishText.en: An orange! Thank Crocodile, it’s an orange! The Tekyan will go on!

goal.en: Take the orange from monkeys and bring it to Che Kak.

startText.en:
Which fruit is the best? The smelliest, the sweetest, the juiciest? The most beautiful and best for health? Without which humanity absolutely won’t do! Thank Genlun, the blessed fruit moved to the allod along with us. Even if we won’t get out of here, we can grow an orange garden of a single seed.

These horrible monkeys! They are making a mess of this place! They’re stealing our fruit, and if they only intended to eat them! No! They’re trowing them at one another, while we’re unable to chase them - see, how short our legs are? All our future is at risk! Don’t let us down, please!

checkText.en: Look at them! Chickens!

finishText.en:
I give up! Don’t kill me!

Huh, it’s not the thing you easily forget! The fireworks went boom and bang, and then she captured our last ship and sailed off directly to the ship graveyard. It’s pretty clear what she’s looking for - Feint’s treasure. Is she a witch, or something? It’s not for common people, you know.

Hm... Wait a minute! I’ve seen your face... Silberpod, is that you?!.. Eh?..

goal.en: Find traces of Klavdia Kalugina in pirates’ Stronghold

startText.en: Here it is, Jolly Roger bay! A thousand years ago this was sea and a bay, and even back then pirates used to dwell here. They’re not too happy to see us, huh? Let’s talk to my boys, they already know what goes on here.

checkText.en: Scary, huh?

finishText.en: Look what Merry had in his cache! It’s Feint’s map! Look, there’s the cross - he buried the treasure at the next allod, in Hangmen’s grove!

goal.en: Search ship graveyard for Klavdia Kalugina.

startText.en:
Some people should think before they speak! Who does he think he is to talk back to Silberpod?! Anyway, he can talk to Tensess’ servants now, we found out everythink we wanted to. Here’s the key to the jumper. Are you ready to take a walk with the dead?

It’s clear that she’s come for Feint’s treasure. There’s a lot in it, not only gold, but rare books, magic artifacts, ancient relics... And the old man was smart enough to bury it in the most dangerous place, where there are no living souls, but plenty of the dead! But we’re not chicken, eh? Unlike the others, right! It’s for the good, we won’t have to share.

As long as there are no more barges, we’ll walk. There are wrecked ships’ jumpers, that’ll take us from allod to allod. They’re locked, but at least, we’ve got the first key, and we’ll somehow manage to find the others.

checkText.en: Feint’s treasure... it’s so near...

finishText.en: Silberpod? Is that you?

goal.en: Search Hangmen’s grove for Klavdia Kalugina and Feint’s treasure.

startText.en:
There’s nowhere else to look for her. Dead or alive, she’s bound to be at the next allod, in Hangmen’s grove. Same place, where old Feint’s treasure is. Both of us are interested in going there. I take the money, you take the girl.

First of all, we need to find her barge. Let’s go over and search the shore.

checkText.en: Portal is hidden behind pale light.

finishText.en: The portal is shimmering and glimmering. Where will it take you? What is Klavdia Kalugina looking for? Go ahead! Find the answers!

goal.en: Search for Klavdia’s trace

startText.en: Silberpod! Damn you! How many people have you put to grave, while looking for Feint’s treasure? Do you want it now? Here it is, to the last coin, all here! Though I’m not the Benny who used to mob the deck! See, what became of me? Come to me! You will be the same!

checkText.en: Who are you? Go away!

finishText.en: Exchange the bird for the horse? That will do! Where’s the horse then?

goal.en: Ask about the Firebird

startText.en: Woe! Woe! Robbers are here! Help us!

checkText.en: You have to earn a horse like this one! I bought it, true, but you’ve never even seen so much money!

finishText.en: Only one last service left...

goal.en: Find the magic horse for Nikodim Bachelor.

startText.en:
Oh you damned flea bag! Blast you, may the stones fall from the sky upon your head! To eat the best horse in whole Umoir! In whole Sarnaut! May your tooth fall out, and fur come off!

Well, no horse - no bird... Um, but if you get to think of it, the horse was not the only one, it gave life to two foals. One stayed with Makar, the other was sold to Mira Hooves. You may talk to him, try to persuade him... You get the horse, I’ll give you the bird, deal’s still on. Or you may lock the wolf in the cage, instead!

checkText.en: Wizards like him foul our good reputations!

finishText.en: You’re alive! I gave up hoping to see you alive!

goal.en: Save the girl from Demonologist and take her to Mira Hooves.

startText.en: The third task is hard. There’s a demonologist here, so vile and pitiless! He’s nesting on an allod where the Southern Reed used to be. He gave us no trouble, until one day he decided to steal a girl from us. That girl he chose turned out to be my fiancee! Go to the Crossroads to the June stone, it’ll teleport you to the Ruins. Talk to my adepts, they’ll port you to any place you like in an instant! Defeat the Demonologist, set my baby free - don’t get them wrong! If you bring her back alive, I’ll give you Roan as reward!

checkText.en: Three indecent old farts in one day! Holy Tensess, why are you punishing me this way?

finishText.en: That’s it. All over. All villains punished, Zalesky Posad is quiet and peaceful once again. Come back any time, you are always welcome.

goal.en: Obtain Roan, exchange it for Firebird and return to Umoir.

startText.en: What horse? I couldn’t have promised my Roan to a beggar like you. You’re imagining things. Hit the road, or I’ll get angry and throw you into the Astral!

finishText.en: You have come! I am very grateful for you to have come, and glad to see you. A misery has come to our land. Have you heard about the Ancient Mound?

goal.en: Find Vseslav the Wise

startText.en:
The letter seems to be full of despair. A grave threat is over Umoir. What's more, it looks like the source of the Leper has been found, and it's time to put an end to it!

Go to Vseslav immediately, and do whatever he asks you to.

checkText.en: Save yourself! I'm holding them!

finishText.en:
This is the ghost of the witch from the Mound. You can barely see her...

She seems to have lost strength after the Mound fight, and she even cannot speak...

goal.en: Enter the Mound and look at the situation.

startText.en:
Three days ago our druids announced that the Ancient Mound is spreading the Leper. We went to take a look, and saw the freshly dug ground. There were undead all around, and there is nothing we can do about them. We don't even know who their Master is. We have to enter the Mound and kill whoever there is...

Peace between Guards and Outlaws is what we want. We will fight together and wash off all insults with blood! I'm only afraid too much of our blood might spill...

You are always welcome at Umoir, because you are brave and able to deal with all kinds of monsters. Come and take a quick look, what goes on there. Even if you come across something dangerous, I'm sure, you will return safe and sound.

checkText.en: Eyeing you silently, and looks like a ghost.

finishText.en:
Ancient magic is like water in desert for me. I though it was the end... We're even now, I hope.

You oughtn't know my name. Ancient names are best left forgotten - it's dangerous to rip up old wounds, you know. One thing I'm craving for is peace. I only had to pay my last debt to my comrades here, in the Mound. A Demon is eating their souls as we speak, so I am willing to tear the awful beast apart, and free their souls! I have no doubt that you want the same.

goal.en: Find the ancient artifact in Plagot ruins and bring it back to the witch.

startText.en:
The oracle looks you in the eye, and familiar pictures fly in front of you: Plagot Ruins, Ancient relics, ghostly demonic figures, brave warriors... Finally, the picture shapes into a sharp image of one of the artifacts from the ruins. It looks like a cross... no, more like a handy grip of an old sword, generously decorated. This is curious.

Well, a debt is a debt to pay. Who knows, may be she'll talk again?

checkText.en: What is it?

finishText.en: It's so easy to say - we need an army at the Mound! If I only had an army, I wouldn't trouble you. We did sign a peace treaty with the soldiers, but Outlaws and Guards aren't on a friendship terms... This is comprehensible, of course. Each of them has blood of the other side on their hands...

goal.en: Tell the King about the ghost's words.

startText.en:
Yes, this is the sword. It used to belong to a brave wandering knight. I knew him when I was alive... The charmed steel seems to remember the taste of my blood. Now it's falling into nothing, see? Its life is also over...

Let us not dwell in the past now. Our aim is to clean the Mound from demonic filth. You want to save the living. My purpose is to save the dead. We can do it together.

The undead in the Mound are half the problem. They are strong, all right, but completely brainless, so it's not really hard to defeat them, regardless of their numbers or how terrifying they are. The power that stands behind them, is a thousand times worse. Talk to the King, he will tell you more - his people were here yesterday.

Meanwhile, I will deal with the ghosts. It's time for them to rise and protect Umoir, as the ancient prophets predicted. After the final battle they and I will rest in peace. Don't reveal my presence. It is not time yet...

checkText.en: How is it going?

finishText.en: Is this the army of the living? This is bad... They will flee, just as soon as they see the undead... All they can do is brag. But we still have hope. They can't see me, so don't you give away that I'm here... and listen carefully.

goal.en: Call Outcasts in the Covert Hide and Catherina's guards in the Lower City to peace and report to the Ghost at the Ancient Mound.

startText.en:
Here's what I'm thinking. If this paper is so important for this world, why don't you use it? Everyone from the both sides respect you greatly, so you are naturally going to become and ambassador. You will tell them that the disaster is near, and that they all must obey the peace treaty... You know the politics better than I do.

There are many smart guys among them. Some will surely believe you. Talk to the outcasts in the Covert Hide, then go speak with Catherina's guards in the Lower City...

Only time will tell if I am right or wrong, but I'm sure we can work it out.

checkText.en: Hurry, we don't have much time.

finishText.en: We succeeded! The dead and the living will fight elbow to elbow! This is not anything you achieve every day. Just the sight of it should make the enemy run in terror!

goal.en: Collect pagan amulets in Plagot ruins, set fire on nine ancient menhirs near the Mound and report to the ghost.

startText.en:
See those menhirs around the Mound? They conceal huge power. This power restricts and protects the spirits of the Mound. It's like a prison and a sweet home at the same time. If we manage to subdue this power, we will be able to call all the dead people here, just like blowing in a horn. They will rise! They will rise to defend their home.

In each menhir there is a slot, the shape of which reminds ancient defensive pagan amulets, that were used centuries ago. You will have to find all nine of them. We shouldn't underestimate them - they absorbed suffering of these lands and blood of the citizens... They will help us call upon a huge army - an army of the ancestors.

I hope we can bring the two parties to peace. If not the King's order, then it's only the word of ancestors that'll help. Go and beware. The spirits might be dangerous.

checkText.en: Hurry! They're fast!

finishText.en:
Well done. It's the first step. They fought together, not against each other.

The army is not going inside the Mound. They will look for the remaining undead here, at the surface, and will keep them restricted. You have the most difficult task ahead of you.

goal.en: Defeat the undead.

startText.en:
Ah well, it's time to go. It looks like I will finally return my bloody debt, after so many centuries. I swear to follow you into the heart of the Ancient Mound, and burn the filth and evil with iron and the rightful word! Excuse my tears, I'm sensitive about my past...

We need to break through the first line of Demon's defense. I bet he never expected us to stand up to him this fast. At least, our troops are quite independent now.

Beware, the undead are unpredictable. This victory will be rather easy, but it's just the beginning. Nobody knows how it will be...

checkText.en: Battle with Jam will be long and exhausting, but if you are careful enough and don't forget to look upwards, you will surely avoid certain death. Zomgie dwells in the burial grounds, so you may go that way and find him. Watch carefully what he's looking at. His gaze is deadly.

finishText.en:
It is quite obvious that the Ancient Mount is the very place, where the Leper is coming from, its heart, so to say.

On the bright side, we now know for sure that we have got to the heart of the matter!

goal.en: Defeat Jam or Zomgie, then report to the Ancient Ghost.

startText.en:
The time has come. Before the Demon has a chance to raise a new army, we need to enter the tomb and challenge him! Your path lies through the thicket, full of the undead. What is worse, there are only two ways to the tomb, and both of them are deadly dangerous.

One lies through the dead water. A huge ancient toad called Jam lives there. It was perilous even before the Leper, now is has turned into a real monster. You can judge by its name, it speaks for itself. Jam! It's jamming you and crushing your bones and flesh. Beware of its mighty croak, too. If you can, do not let it give a croak at all, if you can.

The other road leads through the burial grounds, where an ancient monster dwells. He once used to be a powerful necromancer, I think, Tep was is name... Oh, wait, I can see you're familiar with the name, aren't you? Now the monster by the name Zomgie is able to make all dead men rise from their graves. It will be extremely difficult to fight him, especially provided that there's a huge cemetery around. The pleasant surprise is that the corrupted carnivorous plants don't like the living dead too much, so Nature is going to be your ally in this war against Death.

Choose your path wisely! And take this trinket. Use it to summon me at any time! I will be with you all the time, and I'll try and warn you, if something goes wrong. Best of luck to you!

checkText.en: Of course, Eye Stare couldn't fail to get himself some minions! He called upon the dead, and they raised to his call. They may become invisible, too, but luckily, ashes reveal them as well.

finishText.en:
That's how Eye Stare gets himself guised! He had an ancient relic on him, a magical cape, which, by the way, I have seen before. Destiny's sense of humor is indeed... peculiar.

Here's another joke. While you were fighting Eye Stare, guess who entered the Mound! Morrana herself. With a scroll of Tensess in her hands!

goal.en: Defeat Eye Stare, then report to the Ancient Ghost.

startText.en:
Now it's time to face the most dreadful Leper's creature. To tell you the truth, it's not only Leper who gave him birth. Listen...

Eye Stare is one of the oldest treants in this place. Long ago he got mixed up with the magic of death. His fellow treants drove him away, into the burial grounds, but this was exactly what he needed! Plenty of dead bodies to raise, plenty of restless souls to let them into his body. So, after a while he got an idea that he was a local king of the undead. When the Leper came, he gladly and easily let it in, too. He became a loyal servant of the Demon. Peasants were calling him Asura, a one-eyed monster, now his name is Eye Stare.

What really troubles me, is his ability to turn invisible and strike from behind. He may interfere into somebody's mind, even yours or one of your party members, so beware. Try using ashes from urns here to reveal him, but be fast. The longer he stays disguised, the stronger he becomes.

checkText.en: Morrana has a lot of loyal servants near her. All of them are vulnerable to her own magic. Too much magic may play a dirty trick on you!

finishText.en:
She's not the first to have fallen on the account of her self-assuredness! And not the last one. Wether it is for the good or for the bad, only time will show.

This is half way. The exit to the inner chamber is open now. Look out now, even I do not know what dangers lie ahead. Greatest warriors and most skillful mages are buried in these tombs. Demon will surely summon them for battle! On the other hand, not every creature it summons is that loyal to it...

goal.en: Defeat Morrana, then report to the Ancient Ghost.

startText.en:
When I was alive, I was a witch myself. I knew my limits, though, and I knew my powers. Morrana is not a little bit like me...

Her powers are huge. Local peasants call her a Goddess of Death. She sent so many woes and diseases onto these lands, so many people and farm animals died - you can never count! Her might even overcomes that of some great mages themselves! I've been thinking over it for so long, until I finally understood!

The scroll of Tensess! The ancient scroll of immense power. I have seen it when I was alive. It brought so many miseries to people, albeit it bears the name of the greatest! Morrana uses it to increase the power of her wicked spells. I have no idea, however, where the scroll came from, how she laid her hands on it and why she brought it to the Ancient Mound. She might have wanted to enslave the Demon and get his might... Naive fool!

In any case, we have a chance to obtain the scroll. It will give us might large enough to defeat the Demon. Let us kill two birds with one stone: get rid of the witch and get the scroll!
The best way to fight a witch this strong is to turn her magic upon herself! Take a good look around before the battle starts. There might be something useful nearby.

checkText.en: There's another danger I want you to remember about. If Brainum goes really mad, he's able to crush rocks and stones! Mind you, he's totally capable of ruining the whole tomb you're in. Don't let him concentrate on just one target. Distract him all the time.

finishText.en:
Ogres, trolls, cyclops... I even find their dumbness somewhat charming, you know. Just imagine, what it would be like, if Brainum had brains? With his strength, he could destroy... basically, everything.

The tombs are near. There's just the final obstacle...

goal.en: Defeat Brainum the Third, then report to the Ancient Ghost.

startText.en:
Speaking about the next enemy, I cannot help but giggle. Demon resurrected good old stupid cyclops, willing to add up a strong and dumb killing machine to the army. He made a grave mistake, though. Brainum is really strong, but his greed equals to his strength. He's in the treasure room at the moment, and it doesn't look like he's leaving it!

Of course, we could leave him to the locals. There are plenty of them to beat him by numbers. Unfortunately, the treasure room is the only way that leads to the tombs, and we don't have enough time to wait while they do it for us...

Brainum was stupid, while he was alive. Now Brainum's got no brain at all. Don't turn your back on him, mind you. Just one blow, and you're a wet spot on the ground! My advise is to split and take positions in different corners of the treasure room. His attention will be distracted, and he will be running about the room... crashing and crushing everything that's in his way, shooting a magic beam from his eyes. Look around, you might find something that will help you bring him to reason.

checkText.en: All birds keep their feathers clean. If you smear them with her own slime, it will distract her from flying up. She will furiously beat her wings then, and it's the best moment to strike!

finishText.en:
Sirin was singing songs of sorrow and despair, shredding souls and seeking secrets deep inside... I need to tell you the truth I've been hiding from you.

Raniesta is my name. A long long time ago I first came to the allod of Umoir together with my sworn brothers and sister. We were seeking to find out what happened to the great mage Skrakan. We saw a lot. We walked many roads together. We fought shoulder to shoulder...

I betrayed them. Betrayed by friends, my brothers... for a scroll and a cape...

goal.en: Defeat Corrupted Sirin, then report to the Ancient Ghost.

startText.en:
We are close to the center of the Mound, Heroes' tombs. One last guardian awaits ahead.

Have you heard about a bird of sorrow, Sirin? Two mystical birds lived here, in Umoir. One called Gamayun, always sang songs of happiness and joy, while songs of the other bird, called Sirin, told you about sweet sorrow and hard lessons taught by the past.

I have been thinking, I couldn't understand what made Sirin hide in these catacombs, and then I realized! It was Catherina who imprisoned her in this gloomy place. Sirin was destined to sing about all the evil deeds of the queen, and predict the end of Umoir. Who would possibly enjoy hearing this?

Unfortunately, Sirin stayed here for too long. The Demon's impact corrupted her body and mind. Now her songs are full of poison, and all she goes on about is death, suffering and death... We must rid her of this torture.

If she manages to fly high, it will be pretty hard to defeat her - but will give her an easy victory. Try using her poisonous slime on her, this might help.

checkText.en: There was a glorious hero with us. He was a pilgrim, a paladin. His sword ended my life, when I deceived my friends. His sword brought me back to life. Fate works in mysterious ways...

finishText.en:
The Demon is defeated!

Praise you! And praise the ancestors. If it weren't for you, who knows, what would have happened to Umoir... and to the world.

We can defeat the remaining undead all together with the outcasts and the guards. Your help is always welcomed, but needed no more! If great deeds await, you may go now. We are eternally grateful to you, hero.

goal.en: Defeat the Primal Demon and give peace to ancient heroes: Danas, Fergard and Naira.

startText.en:
What are the scroll and the cape, you ask? Tensess himself gave them to Skrakan. Why? For what purpose? Do not ask me... I suppose, Tensess was willing to protect Skrakan during his experiment, which started this all - the great mage summoned the ancient demon to Umoir, and everything has gone out of the way. The Leper started back then, do you not understand? My friends stopped it. They defeated the demon and laid him for his infinite rest.

At least, I thought it was infinite. But then this stupid girl Catherina returned the damned creature to life, and all began from the start. Which is even worse, my friends, Danas, Fergard and Naira, were buried here together with their worst enemy. Umoir citizens back then believed that this was the way to protect themselves from the corruption of the demon and his magic. That was a grievous mistake. Now the three of them are demon's slaves for the rest of eternity.

I beg you to put an end to their sufferings. Please! And beware, they are strong warriors, and it won't be easy to defeat them. Besides, Demon will surely grant them a piece of his disgusting power. The scroll and the cape will help you in the battle. Use the scroll to break the connection between the heroes and the demon. The cape will protect you from the deadliest attacks and spells.

May the luck be with you! I will be praying for you... there's nothing else left for me to do.

checkText.en: I'm sure everyone will appreciate your help. You will receive your reward.

finishText.en:
I heard all about your exploits in Al Rihat. I am eternally grateful.

And here is your reward.

goal.en: Complete six daily quests in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
Returning Al Rihat to life doesn't take one day - not even a year. We are working all together. The Guardian Ring, hunters, and even weird elves of Hermit's House united their effort... I'm sure everyone will appreciate your help. You will receive your reward.

I will make it worth your while, too.

checkText.en: Any luck?

finishText.en: Good. You avenged those who died in Al Rihat. And the chronicle says the truth.

goal.en: Defeat bandits in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
Al Rihat. There's history in this place. Do you know her? No? I'll read you a few lines from the chronicle:
