"It was not the Blight that brought Al Rihat to ruin. Years ago, there were goblins, orcs, and cyclops living in Umoir. And a giant named Leviathan gathered them and formed a horde which rampaged through the allod. They caused great torment before they were defeated.

Al Rihat was a prosperous city. So when Leviathan gathered a new horde, they visited it first.

When the army of orcs approached the city walls, Leviathan bellowed, "Surrender, puny humans! For we are many!" No one responded from the walls, busy sharpening swords and putting on armor. A bloody battle began. The citizens lasted a long time, waiting for reinforcements which never came. The walls fell, and so did the defenders...

The garrison fought bravely, but the walls eventually crumbled. Orcs and goblins flooded the streets, slaughtering people and pillaging the city.

In Danas's time, Umoir was crawling with wild orcs and goblins. They say it is difficult to find them now: after Leviathan's horde was defeated, every single one of them was killed..."

That's what the chronicle says. But it's a lie! There's a gang in the ruins of the sorcerer's tower - those who survived that battle! I charge you with the task of correcting that mistake.

checkText.en: Any luck?

finishText.en: It's unfortunate, but the gargoyles outlived their purpose, even if they don't know that. Thank you for your help.

goal.en: Defeat Gargoyles and collect Gargoyle Stones in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
The gargoyles are not common creatures - they are a construct created by magic. The sorcerers who created them are long gone, but the gargoyles are still around.

The chronicle says:

"It was the city's last line of defense: even when the living defenders were all gone, the magical statues continued to fight. To this day, you can still find these living rocks in the ruins. They blindly carry out their creators' wishes, defending the city that no longer exists."

Alas, they attack everyone these days, both civilians and warriors like you... So they are more trouble than they're worth. Please rid Al Rihat of these useless protectors.

checkText.en: Any luck?

finishText.en: Great chitin. Excellent. We'll try and use it to make armor.

goal.en: Collect spider chitin in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
The local spiders are a problem, don't you think?

They are too big, too numerous, and they serve no purpose.

That's what I thought. And I was wrong. It's their chitin. I don't know if the Blight caused this, but the chitin gained unusual properties... It became incredibly tough.

So you have two tasks - reduce their numbers before they devour someone and collect their chitin for research.

To ensure we get what we need, just pick the largest specimens, can't go wrong with that.

checkText.en: Have you dealt with the banshee?

finishText.en: Good. The banshee was pacified...

goal.en: Eliminate the banshee in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
Who are banshees? The souls of elven maidens that were brutally killed...

There are many of those in the area. There was a settlement of the House de Tristesse here, and many elves died when they came to Al Rihat's aid, defending it from Tugarin's horde. Then Catherina exiled them, and then the Blight came, so a lot of elves perished before they could leave. They also say that some caravan got lost on the path, and bandits attacked it from an ambush, slaughtering everyone.

Anyway, the dead maidens are raging these days, you can hear the screaming even here. Please save us from this misfortune!

checkText.en: Did you get us any meat?

finishText.en: Great, supplies will always come in handy.

goal.en: Get black boar meat from Al Rihat Ruins.

name.en: Al Rihat Circle: Black Boar Meat

startText.en:
There used to be rich hunting grounds around the city.

The Blight has corrupted most of the animals, turning them into monsters that have to be exterminated.

But you know what they sang about in the legends? The Al Rihat black boar ham.

Fortunately for us, those boars still live in the lands unaffected by the Blight. Get us some meat - we'll be indebted to you.

checkText.en: Any luck?

finishText.en: You have it? Oh, yes, I can smell it on you. You're covered in slime and mold. Go wash up in the pond. We haven't forgotten your reward, don't worry.

goal.en: Collect poisonous mushrooms and mutant eyes in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
You must be surprised to see an elf among the Keepers.

Yes, druidism, shamanism, and other folk traditions are not popular among my people.  They don't want to get their hands dirty - they consider nature too crude and wild.

I don't share these misconceptions. Even the Xadaganians offer ranger courses now. Although, their squeamishness is partially justified.

So try to be understanding about my next task: I need eyes of Searing Eyes and Tropical Muskir spores. There's no way I'm touching that filth myself. And you... you must be used to that by now. I will pay you for your help, of course, so do me a favor and collect these materials.

checkText.en: Any luck?

finishText.en: Done with the Werewolves? Good job, but I'm afraid we won't be free of them for long. Hunger forces them out of the woods. So I'm counting on you.

goal.en: Defeat werewolves in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
Shapeshifters, also known as Werewolves. The result of an unusual curse.

History tell us that the first Werewolves appeared during the events of the Blood Feast when vampires were first spotted.

The Aro tribes, ancestors of the Kanians, searched for ways to battle them, but one king went further than others - Vseslav the Sorcerer with his Keepers. They found a way to turn into animals... Wolves, bears, foxes... and other predators.

The problem was, the longer they stayed in their animal form, the more they lost control of their inner beast. One day they got stuck somewhere in the middle. And now the curse is spread through a bite, just like vampirism.

But I digress. Here's your task: there are Werewolves on the southern road - you need to eliminate them. They shouldn't be there, you understand.

checkText.en: Any luck?

finishText.en: If only we could explain that to them, but as it is, there's no other way.

goal.en: Defeat Minotaurs in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
Minotaurs.

Strong but sensitive people.

Take Umoir tribes - they got along fine with humans at first, but then Catherina decided to persecute other races, so now it's impossible to come to any sort of understanding with the Minotaurs.

They are blocking the northern road now.

If we want to liberate these lands, we'll have to do something about the Minotaurs. If there's no other way, our steel will do the talking!

checkText.en: Did you manage to get crab meat?

finishText.en: Great, we need food supplies.

goal.en: Obtain crab meat in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
We still desperately need supplies. Umoir doesn't rich harvests, and hunting is possible only in forests clear of the Blight. So we eat everything we can get hold of. Luckily, fate has spared us the most disgusting options, because there is a lot to find here. For example, there are delicious crabs in the lake between us and the Lulleaguin stronghold.

Get us some crab meat and you'll earn my personal thanks. It's time to show these hunters what real elven cuisine is like.

checkText.en: Did you manage to temper the blades?

finishText.en: Excellent, wonderful blades. I can feel the heat emanating from them.

goal.en: Temper steel blades in the fiery blood of Triheads.

startText.en:
Besides food, we need weapons.

Preferably ones that will not be damaged by the poisonous blood of local creatures - it instantly corrodes any steel blade. I wondered if anything could be done about it, and realized that we need to use the tools at hand. Let me explain. Regular lake Hydras have recently mutated into Triheads, fire-breathing monsters with flame running through their veins.

With it, you can temper ordinary blades by charging them with magic. Just immerse them in Trihead blood.

I entrust you with this mission.

checkText.en: Have you completed your quest?

finishText.en: Has Troublemaker stopped making trouble? Wonderful!

goal.en: Defeat Troublemaker, who lives in the Mighty Oak.

startText.en: One of our enemies is Troublemaker, the crazed forest spirit. Perhaps, he was a forest guardian for birds and animals once, but now he is completely insane. He throws stones at people and curses over every hill and dale. He needs to be punished! Can you do it?

checkText.en: Have you completed your quest?

finishText.en: Serves her right!

goal.en: Defeat the witch Nessora in Foremother's Temple.

startText.en:
My cousin, Prince Dakkar, and his father, our king, don't get along. I think, the Kanian girl, Svetlana, is their apple of discord. The union of an elf and a human is rare and quite unusual. Just remember the scandalous union of Ademar de Tristesse and Baba Yaga!

The Kanian was a witch. There are a lot of them here, on Umoir. I find witchcraft quite savage, although the first witches were elven, of course. But that was so long ago that it isn't worth mentioning. You can ask Zayan about Nemeina and her ravens if you like.

Apart from the three sisters on Umoir, there were other witches. Nessora, a nasty cannibal and a necromancer, is one of the strongest living witches. She's hiding out in the ruins of the Foremother's Temple - a temple of a local mysterious god. Find and kill her.

checkText.en: Have you completed your quest?

finishText.en: Did you defeat the monster? Great.

goal.en: Defeat Tord the Fierce in a swamp near the Sorceress' Tower

name.en: Al Rihat Monster Hunting: Tord the Fierce

startText.en:
It's not easy job to be a monster hunter. I have to hang around all day, waiting volunteers to take my quest. It's a little boring.

On the other hand, the monsters seem to have fun. Why else would they drag their buddies to these lands? We've got enough of them here as it is. Here's the story: goblins have hired a new beast as a guard, and it ran away without a second thought.

The locals call it Tord the Fierce. I have no idea what it is. It may be a toad or a troll. In any case, it's big, slimy, and it stinks like all swamps of the world. It lies in wait in the lair under the Sorceress' Tower, ambushing merchants. You need to kill it before it has a litter.

checkText.en: Have you completed your quest?

finishText.en: Is Stump dead? Great. This place will be much more peaceful now.

goal.en: Defeat Stump in the Stronghold of the Guardian Ring

startText.en:
Blight is a curious phenomenon. I hear it drives animals crazy and gives them incredible strength. My cousin Amanda is studying this mysterious thing.

Unfortunately, we still have to face the consequences. The worst of all is when the Blight corrupts a guardian of the Nature. I'm talking about Treants. Or was it Tree-ants? I don't remember. It doesn't matter.

Before the vampires were kicked out from the Patriarch's residence, the local Guardian Ring was located in the old stronghold west of the town. This wasn't the most peaceful location, so the guardians were forced to leave. A rotten Treant was spotted there recently. We named it Stump. This isn't a simple monster. I'm sure it's planning something evil. We don't want to just sit here and wait till a horde of corrupted beasts jump out from there. Please, kill Stump.

checkText.en: Have you completed your quest?

finishText.en: Our home will be liberated! I believe that.

goal.en: Defeat vampires in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
I think of other members of my House, those who managed to escape Drowsy Woods. Without Alir and Annette, the task of leading our House to prosperity falls to me...

But the idea of prosperity is probably laughable... There are so few of us left...

Alright, no time for melancholy. The great de Delice offered us their support, and here we work with the Keepers and hunters.

But there's something they can't do. While we were in exile, our abode was seized. Yes, the accursed House de Doucer. We drove them out of the Patriarch's residence, but our Chateau Tristesse is still crawling with the bloodthirsty bastards! It's our duty to get rid of them. I beg you to help us.

checkText.en: Have you completed your quest?

finishText.en: These materials should help our artisans fulfill lots of new commissions. Thank you.

goal.en: Collect fox fur and crocodile skins in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
They say House Tristesse used to be rich and famous.

Alas, it's no longer the case. To put it bluntly, we are poor as dirt. All our wealth was either stolen or lost in Sleepy Grove.

That's why we need your help. Our artisans are ready to start working. They can make expensive clothing for sale. All they need from you is material.

I know there are foxes in the area... And even crocodiles.

Their skins and hides should do nicely. We'll find a way to repay you.

checkText.en: Have you completed your quest?

finishText.en: Honey is collected. I hope the bees are fine. This should last us a while, but I'll ask you to collect more when we run out.

goal.en: Defeat hornets and collect honeycombs in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
There's a beautiful legend that dates back to the Battle for Beauty when the elven king met two Forestfolk Warriors in the forest and asked for their heather honey recipe. The king never learned the recipe, but our House has its own tricks and secrets. Local bees gather sweet nectar from flowers that grow only in these parts.

I want to resume the production of this wonderful drink. We could use your help - we don't have enough people to send them out to look for hives of giant bees. It's also very dangerous. And you're a great hero. Please collect honey for us!

checkText.en: Are you done with the bats?

finishText.en: We've dealt with this threat, but who knows what the next day will bring?

goal.en: Eliminate the bats in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
Bats are nasty and noisy creatures, and there are too many of them in these lands...

The House de Doucer and their vampires are probably to blame. They are the ones who like to keep these animals as pets. Even though there's a spider on their coat of arms. Actually, there are also plenty of spiders around here, too...

Bats have plagued Danas himself - if we don't reduce their population now, I fear that in the future we'll have to deal with swarms of those nasty creatures. That's why I task you with launching a preemptive strike and exterminating as many bats as possible.

checkText.en: Are you done with the task?

finishText.en: Great, now we have enough supplies to last us a while.

goal.en: Use the magic amulet to prepare as much bull meat as possible.

startText.en:
Before Tugarin and the Blight came, Al Rihat was a blessed land where the coexistence of humans and elves led to flourishing trade and prosperity.
 One of the most valuable resources of this land were herds of cows that grazed in the local meadows. Alas, during the invasion by the Orcs, many shepherds were killed, and the cows that survived fled into the forests.
 However, my scouts report that a lost herd has recently appeared in the area. These feral bulls will be very useful to us. I will give you a magic amulet that will help you cook many wonderful steaks. We can't survive on blood alone, right?

checkText.en: Have you completed your quest?

finishText.en: Are you done with the harpies? Alas, to build up a flower bed, you need to weed it regularly.

goal.en: Defeat harpies in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
Ah, harpies.

You know, the elves nurture a longstanding ambition to domesticate these wild creatures. I can't say our attempts were completely unsuccessful... as you know, many demonologists have them as their companions.

It's an old argument: who is better in the art of love, lamias or harpies? Ahem.

But never mind that! Alas, harpies that live nearby are completely witless and useless creatures. They'd rather wreck and defile things than embrace Beauty. With a heavy heart, I must ask you to eliminate them.

checkText.en: Have you completed your quest?

finishText.en: Oh, what a good acid. Thank you, that's exactly what we need.

goal.en: Collect hydra acid in Al Rihat Ruins

startText.en:
Our house is famous for its arts and artisans.

Alchemy is also one of our talents - it helps us work with metal. It requires acid which is a rare resource in our time.

It's a good thing there's a pack of hydras nearby. Their blood is very caustic, so I can separate acid from it which can be used for metalwork and other purposes.

You will also make our lakes and ponds safer.

checkText.en: Have you completed your quest?

finishText.en: Ogres who have tasted flesh will never stop craving it. So don't feel bad about killing them.

goal.en: Defeat ogres in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
The ancient Lulleaguin Stronghold stood to the south of our estate.

Alas, it fell when the Blight began. We were no longer here and couldn't help.

One of the Great Trees grew inside the fortress, guarded by the Protective Circle.

The druids established a sanitary cordon and shut the gates. But there were refugees seeking help, and the Keepers let them in. One of them must have carried the Blight. Everyone who stood guard here died in a terrible siege: forest monsters on the outside and blighted treants on the inside.

But the troubles of Lulleaguin did not end there: soon after the stronghold was liberated, it was occupied by ogres.

Their leader was a vile man-eater who used to serve elf sirens. We're not talking about them, I'm ashamed for my brethren who decided to treat themselves to someone else's flesh. As for the ogres, here's my task: get inside the fortress and show no mercy. Tensess help us, we'll take it back and station our own garrison there. Then we'll try and heal the Great Tree.

checkText.en: Are you done with the deer?

finishText.en: Have you dealt with the deer?

goal.en: Eliminate the deer in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
Oh, there's another problem: deer. These animals migrate from the forests to the astral shores not far from the Lulleaguin stronghold. I understand why this is happening - it's no longer safe in the woods, since the wilds are full of all kinds of predatory beasts.

But it's not great for us. The thing is, deer gnaw at the bark of unique fruit trees that grow near the fortress. If this continues, we will lose them.

So I task you with reducing the deer population. It's a harsh measure, but we're out of options.

checkText.en: Did you manage to stop the drunken revelry?

finishText.en: Great, Satyrs won't bother us anymore.

goal.en: Eliminate the Satyrs in Al Rihat Ruins

startText.en:
It's a shame about the Satyrs. Once upon a time they lived in peace, even traded with others. Then marauders attacked them - they ravaged their village and desecrated their idols.

The horned ones got angry and decided to take revenge - on us, vampires from the House de Doucer; then the bandits, and everyone else. And it's impossible to explain to them who their real enemy is. The thing is, to our misfortune, they found a cellar with stocks of "green wine" that some Kanian merchant stored in the fortress.

Now it's nonstop revelry and drinking, and a drunken Satyr is worse than any Ogre - after a few drinks, they are ready to skewer anyone. Now they are bullying the Ogres. What if they show up here? It's going to be a real problem. That's why we need to make a pre-emptive attack...

checkText.en: Have you completed your quest?

finishText.en: Ugh, those wolves have impressive jaws. Dreadful. Give me the hides, we'll send them to the Queen.

goal.en: Collect Auk hides in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
Greetings!

We were ordinary hunters before the Blight struck... Now we're tasked with hunting down blighted creatures before they get too close to settlements. Queen Catherina herself is paying us.

Right now we're hunting multiped wolves called Auks. But we're short-handed. Help us if you can, kill a few wolves and bring us their hides. You'll be rewarded, of course.

checkText.en: Have you completed your quest?

finishText.en: The Blight creates horrible things...

goal.en: Defeat beasts in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en: What are those things? Where did they come from? We haven't seen them before the Blight. Maybe it's a mutated grave worm or hamster, who can tell anymore? But you will sense it when they are close: they smell like death. And if you fight them, make sure to clean your wounds thoroughly, even the tiniest cuts. Their claws are not just razor-sharp, but also venomous, and even magic can't heal those wounds!

checkText.en: Have you completed your quest?

finishText.en: We need our communications - who knows where the next crisis might come from? Without news, we won't know anything.

goal.en: Collect souls of Midnight Dwellers in Al Rihat Ruins using a special crystal.

startText.en:
Al Rihat Ruins and the Blight cut these lands off from the central allod. Ships maintain contact with the capital, but it's costly and they don't sail as often as we'd like.

And recently a summoner suggested another method of communication - ghostly owls. They say Gibberlings in Siveria have been using them for ages.

But we don't have many owls around here, just a few Midnight Dwellers. I'll give you a special summoning crystal - you need to collect souls of Midnight Dwellers. The summoner will bring them back to life so they can serve us.

checkText.en: How is it going with the horns?

finishText.en: Great, it's a good bow material that we will definitely need.

goal.en: Obtain Galactic Deer Horns in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
Six gods bless you!

We are simple hunters. In battle we use ordinary bows and arrows enchanted by the elves. But if there is no bow, there is nothing to enchant!

So we need expendable materials, and what makes the best bow? Horns and tendons. We still have plenty of tendons, but we're running of horns. Please be so kind as to get a few horns for us? The best ones are those of Blighted deer known as Galactic deer.

checkText.en: Now that's some strange order! What's next, catching fleas?

finishText.en: Great, it means help from Glimor will arrive on schedule...

goal.en: Catch Blighted Rats in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
Hey! We received a very unusual "order".

There is a city on Umoir - Glimor. A bunch of smart people and sages sit around there, coming up with all sorts of things. This is what they wrote:

"Instruction: catch blighted rats and deliver them to the Kremengor laboratory. At least a dozen, preferably more."

What's that supposed to mean? Those rats are vicious... Well, what can we do? We have to obey, otherwise they will leave us here without equipment and provisions.

Help me out, please?

checkText.en: Have you completed your quest?

finishText.en: Fewer gnats, fewer problems. That's what my grandfather used to say.

goal.en: Defeat mosquitos in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
Want to hear a riddle? What's the weakest but the most vicious blighted creature?

Mosquitos! They were intolerable before, but now it's a nightmare. There's a flooded river near the Foremother's Temple. It turned the area into a swamp, and now you can't set foot there unless you want to be eaten alive.

So if you encounter any mosquitos, kill them.

checkText.en: Have you completed your quest?

finishText.en: Did you kill the Bear Mice? Great, how did you manage that?

goal.en: Eliminate the Bear Mice in Al Rihat Ruins

startText.en:
The most ferocious creature in the area is the Bear Mouse. There are few hunters brave enough to face one.

Fortunately, we drove them out of the ruins. We hoped it was the end of it... but no, the remaining creatures are lurking around Crystal Peak...

It's hard to say what they're doing there, but our hunters are too scared to set foot in the area.

So if you're up to it, we'll be forever grateful.

checkText.en: Have you completed your quest?

finishText.en: Oh, those sorcerers... First they need flowers, then eyes, then some other nasty thing... Thank you for your help.

goal.en: Eliminate the Mutant Toads and procure rainbow flowers in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
And now a request from mages. Miracle workers, curse them.

They need a special flower that grows near the local river. It's all well and good, but the area is crawling with Mutant Toads.

Everyone knows about werewolves and werebears, but Mutant Toads is something unique to Umoir. I hear you can't find them anywhere else.

And apparently they need these flowers, too. I have no idea why, but when you pick a flower, a Mutant Toad immediately pops up and attacks you. So we can't do this without you. Help us out!

checkText.en: Well? Did you save the hares from themselves?

finishText.en: Excellent. I'll deal with Mazay later.

goal.en: Eliminate the Haregons in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
Something happened here once. We're all battling the creatures of the Blight, killing them as best we can. Somehow they lured a whole pack of Haregons to an island, just downstream of the beaver dam. We figured we'd demolish the dam, the wave will flood the island, and the Haregons will drown.

So we did it. Then went to take a look... And there was... this crazed wizard called Mazay who was sitting in his boat and pulling the Haregons out of the water one by one! There you have it. A protector of nature, damn it.

The men cuss at him, but he doesn't give a hoot, just keeps saving the critters.

That's why there are so many Haregons around here now. Since we couldn't handle it, you'll have to do it.

checkText.en: So deal with them - but do try to be respectful about it. They're not some otherworldly monsters - who knows, maybe my great-grandma is wandering around somewhere.

finishText.en:
Well, we were able to put them to rest for a while...

So if there's something strange in our neighborhood, who we're gonna call?

You!

goal.en: Eliminate the ghosts in Al Rihat Ruins

startText.en:
We have a lot of different kinds of ghosts, poltergeists, wights, wraiths, phantoms, phantasms, and other undead here... And the reason for this is simple:

When the walls of Al Rihat fell, Tugarin's horde did not spare anyone - the elderly, children, or women. The massacre was so terrible that the victims can't find peace to this day. Because of all the anger and sorrow, there is a lot of strength in them: if one of them touches you, you will float away to the astral plane! If you are not scared, help them find peace.

checkText.en: Any luck?

finishText.en: Well done. The Ring thanks you.

goal.en: Defeat enemies of the Guardian Ring in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
I'm a representative of the Guardian Ring - the Keepers who are trying to heal this land. I'm also a member of House de Delice that wants to help our brethren who have become vampires.

The Guardian Ring of Al Rihat helps maintain the balance of life in these parts. We need help dealing with troublemakers and aggressive beasts.

If you help us, my friend, the Guardian Ring will not forget it!

checkText.en: Have you completed your quest?

finishText.en: Nice working with you.

goal.en: Defeat enemies of House Tristesse in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
By the highest decree, House Tristesse ordered to reward Al Rihat restoration efforts. Any actions towards the improvement of our House's livelihood will be rewarded as well.

You will receive new instructions every day. They will keep you busy.

checkText.en: Have you completed your quest?

finishText.en: Excellent job! Our hunting society is grateful to you.

goal.en: Defeat Hunters' enemies in Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
There are so many animals in Al Rihat! Hunters help feed the local people and support those in need. We've got so much work to do! Your help will be highly appreciated.

Come back for a new task every day!

checkText.en: You just need to relight the lamps. I will reward you generously!

finishText.en: What would I do without you? Thank you! Here is your reward!

goal.en: Light 8 lamps along the road to the mountain top within the given time.

startText.en:
Oh! What a misfortune!

All the lamps on the path have gone out because of the Frozen Spirits and their ice-cold breath! What if someone goes up that path, stumbles and falls down? Oh, I don't even want to think about it!

Can you give me hand? I'm so scared of the Frozen Spirits, and you don't seem to fear anything at all! I will give you a great reward for your help.

And please, be fast.

checkText.en: Shoot carefully, cannons quickly overheat!

finishText.en: You are a precise shooter, friend! Look, they run in terror!

goal.en: Use the hull cannons to repel the attack of Architects and meet Izbor Yavorsky on the bridge of Eclipse.

startText.en:
Wait... I'll be damned! That thing on the horizon is definitely an Architects' Ship! How does that ugly machine fly at all?

It looks like they want to confront us in a ship combat. Alright, let's see what their cannons are capable of!

Go to the cannon deck and give some hell to the bastards! But watch out for the temperature - the cannons easily overheat.

checkText.en: Have you found the missing bombers?

finishText.en: Well done, soldier!

goal.en: Enter the Distortion and alter the time to save the bombers and make them complete their mission, then talk to Stomp the Merciless.

startText.en:
The space around the body distorts and shifts. Looks like the time goes in a wrong direction... It's just like it was in the White Fortress when Archont used some weird magic, which Klavdia called "Temporal", and that temporal loop somehow saved Unn!

What did she say about the Pattern of Destiny? That it can be changed, and then the whole Tissue of Creation will change! Maybe we should risk?

finishText.en: Greetings! You are even a better fighter than they say you are!

goal.en: Talk to Izbor Yavorsky in the northern Steel Scythe.

startText.en: Some of our guys will stay here to clear the coast, and another group has already reached the top to hold the line up there. Izbor leads them. Go to him, don't worry about us.

checkText.en: Hurry! The Architects are about to assault the ship!

finishText.en:
Hey, we gave some hell to those mechanical parasites!

Ha! It looks they're not so almighty, after all.

goal.en: Use the jumping device on the deck, destroy the Architects' assault forces on the fleet ships and return to Crazystorm the Merciless on Eclipse.

startText.en:
It looks like the bastards are going to assault our ships. There is no way they are going to break through to Eclipse - Catherina surely took care of it, but the rest of the fleet ships are going to have some hard time unless we hurry up. No one but you has faced the Architects before! The others may just freak out as soon as they see them. So we pin our hopes on you again.

There is a jumping device on the deck, which you can use to reach the next ship. And you better hurry up!

finishText.en: That's one heavy touchdown! Are you okay?

goal.en: Go to the assault deck of Eclipse, board the lifeboat and reach the shore of Dane.

startText.en:
Get ready for landing! We launch Operation D. Why D? Hell if I know!

Here's the disposition: the defensive fortifications are located on the sand shore of the allod. Previously they were used to repel the attacks of Astral pirates, but now they are occupied by the enemy forces. The Architects are going to furnish resistance and will try to bring down the ships as we approach the shore, so you keep your eyes wide open!

The mission of the assault troops is to suppress the shore defenses of the enemy and provide the Alliance ships with a safe landing ground.

Is everything clear? Then go, to the landing deck!

finishText.en: Everyone's safe and sound. Hurray!

goal.en: Find Ingrid's brothers - Ulrich and Brand, complete their quests and return to the Salty family.

startText.en:
That was one hell of a fight - half of our fighters are knocked out! I thought you had one foot in the Purgatory, but you are really a die-hard.

My brothers, Ulrich and Brand, went out scouting and never came back. If you still can fight, please look for them. Meanwhile, I will take care of the rest of the soldiers.

Watch out for the damned stone bastards!

checkText.en: So, have you found out what those stone eyes are?

finishText.en:
So these flying peepers are aiming their guns at our ships?! Damned buggers!

So if one eye sees something, the rest of the army sees it, too? I think we are in trouble...

goal.en: Take a closer look at the "peepers", destroy the thrashers and return to Ulrich the Salty.

startText.en:
Hey, keep it quiet!

While I was hiding here, I noticed those little stones. Some of them look like eyes that seem to be staring at our ships all the time! And others have little arms - they rush to attack if they sense even a slightest movement. I'd say it is rather suspicious, if you ask me.

Why don't we take a closer look at the peepers and the "armed” ones, too? Can you do that? I will go check on my sis, she must be worried.

checkText.en: Rope. Find a rope and get me out of here!

finishText.en:
Phew! Thank you!

I should get back to my sister. You come, too - we need to figure out what to do next.

goal.en: Search the wreckages on the Steel Scythe, find a rope and pull Brand the Salty out of the cleft.

startText.en:
They almost tore me to pieces, those ugly jerks. I was lucky to be that small to fit in this crack and hide from them!

But now I'm stuck. I can't get out on my own.

No, don't even think of getting down here, or we'll end up stuck together. You better find some rope. Anything will do. Look, the whole beach is covered with ship wreckages!

finishText.en:
Brothers... Brothers! Ulrich! Brand! They're deeead!!

Bastards!! I hate you!! Why?!!

goal.en: Use the smoking jars to get closer to the fortification, climb on it and destroy the Architect.

startText.en:
We helped those who we could. May the Light shine upon the path of the rest of them! We need to move on.

It's just, there's some wretch sitting in the tower and shooting at everything that moves. It's pretty precise, too. So we can't make it past the tower before we get rid of it.

We have a couple of vials with magic smoke. It's so thick you can't see your own hands in it! We can use it as a cover to get closer to the tower. There we will just climb the ladder and cut the monster to pieces!

finishText.en:
Hello, soldier! I'm Stomp, Crazystorm's brother. You know, he's kinda the commander, and I'm, like, the chief guerilla, huh!

Come on, lay out the disposition. Who are we beatin' up and where?

goal.en: Launch the signal rocket on the shore of Steel Scythe, wait for the boats to moor and talk to Stomp the Merciless.

startText.en:
Oh my! What am I going to do without me brothers?!

...

Here, take this signal rocket. Launch it on the shore. We need to get our soldiers here as soon as possible, so they can turn those murderers into a pile of dust! How... How can I live without my brothers? Aah...

checkText.en: Beat them! Our guys are about to disembark!

finishText.en: It's been long since I was in a decent fight!

goal.en: Keep fighting the Architects until the rest of the guerillas arrive, then talk to Stomp the Merciless.

name.en: Hold on till the Very End

startText.en:
Oops! It looks like we are not welcomed here. What is the best way to kill an Architect, you say?

Any will do? That's good. We just need to hold on until the assault lifeboats reach the shore.

You take care of it, and meanwhile, I will help our soldiers moor.

checkText.en: Looks like that's the Arisen that was giving orders to the bombers. His body is crippled and deformed... Poor fellow.

finishText.en: Looks like that's the Arisen that was giving orders to the bombers. His body is crippled and deformed... Poor fellow.

goal.en: Destroy the Architects who guard the northern fortification, and find Sarang Kheket.

startText.en:
Here is what I think. See those towers? Some nasty critters sit there and fire at our ships. We will take care of the first tower. The second one was supposed to be blown up by our bombers, but something must have gone wrong.

Take my men and go there. Kill the Architects and find out what happened to the damned goblins and the bombs!

checkText.en: We need somebody to keep the watch on the balloons!

finishText.en: Oops! Something went wrong. The balloon won't fly...

goal.en: Launch 5 gibberlings on air balloons and speak with Scaggy Black.

startText.en:
See those deflated air balloons? Previously, they were used to watch over the Astral shore and locate pirate ships. But we can use them to watch over the allod! If we rise high enough, we can even see the Iron City, the capital of Dane!

I sent several scouts to keep their eyes on the enemy, but they don't seem to be handling it well. Can you help them?

checkText.en: We need fuel!

finishText.en:
Wait a second... Something's not working. Alright, I'll try and figure it out. Thank you!

Maybe I need to turn the tap? Clockwise or counter-clockwise? Who knows...

goal.en: Search the area around the lighthouse, find fuel for the burner and return to Scaggy Black.

startText.en:
Ha - the burner's broken! And there's no fuel left. What do we do now?

If I were a Free Trader, where would I store fuel? In a place with a roof and walls, like that lighthouse over there!

Let me fix the burner, and you search the lighthouse.

checkText.en: You are looking strange. Are you alright?

finishText.en:
Well-well. Deprived of souls? How can you even deprive a living thing of a soul? I've never heard of such a thing! Maybe, she's just bonkers? And those unfortunates that you had to kill were just out of their minds, not deprived of their souls?

Oh, I don't know. I have more pressing issues. We need to get to the city, that's what's bothering me now.

goal.en: Kill 10 Soulless Ones near the Lighthouse and return to Izbor Yavorsky.

startText.en:
Hahaha! Everyone's dead, dead! We are dead! Hahaha!

Stone is flowing. Like sand, hahaha! And lightning! And ice! And time - all flowing!

Then HE came! HE came, do you hear it?! Hush... Listen... That's it! Eyes, silver in the eyes. Light, light!

checkText.en: Find suitable locations for the cannon section and make sure the area is clear of enemies. Launch a red rocket when you are ready!

finishText.en: The cannoneers have already set out to the locations you'd found. I hope they can make it unnoticed, otherwise our plan is screwed.

goal.en: Clear the river bank of the Architects, find shelters for the cannoneers, launch the signal rockets and return to Izbor Yavorsky.

startText.en:
The Architects have retreated from the shore and regrouped. The river separates us from the city, and the enemy has occupied the opposite bank, though there are plenty of Architects on this side, too. We won't make it without some serious support.

Our Imperial allies provided us with several light cannons. We don't have any experience in working with such machinery, but the gibberlings swear they will easily figure it out. We need to find good shelters to allocate the cannon section. I assign this task to you!

checkText.en: Huh, you're fast! I hope you're finished with the Architects on then river bank?

finishText.en: Huh! What was that sound? They are using our cannons, aren't they? I told them that their spells are useless!

goal.en: Lure Shieldsmasher to the bridge, sound the siren and destroy the Architect, then meet Stomp the Merciless in the Shore City harbor.

startText.en:
Me and Stomp have decided that our best strategy is to try and break into the city from two directions. Stomp will take his troopers to the harbor and will hold the fort. Meanwhile we have to handle the enemy on the other side of the river and near the city gates. There's just one problem... There is a huge Architect right behind this bridge. Arrows and spells just don't work against him. Maybe we should try artillery?

Will you take up this task? I knew you would. Take this siren. Lure the Architect to the bridge and then sound it - our cannoneers will take him out right away!

checkText.en: We don't need Architects' spies here!

finishText.en: Phew, it's much better now.

goal.en: Destroy 10 Vigilant Eyes in the Shore City harbor and report to Stomp the Merciless.

startText.en:
Look! Not at me, to the harbor! Do you see those round eye-like things? I don't like them. Why are they staring at us?

Listen, why don't you get rid of them? They seem like a pain in the neck.

checkText.en: The bastards can fire. But can they fix mana pipes? Huh!

finishText.en: What did I tell you? You break one tiny part, and the whole cannon falls apart. The idiots won't fix it in ten years, huh!

goal.en: Destroy mana pipelines on the shore and return to Arrow the Sylvan.

startText.en:
I am Arrow, and she is Lucille. Stomp has sent us to find out who fired at Eclipse. They have completely destroyed the portside shield!

And can you imagine - there are those empty-eyed dummies everywhere, and some creatures that seem to be controlling them. They are firing the major caliber at our ships, those morons! I can tell an Imperial cannon when I see one.

And also I know if we don't stop it, they will shatter half of our fleet. There must be mana pipelines supplying the cannons. No mana - no fire. Am I being clear?

checkText.en: Come on! I need their Sparks to develop the perfect weapon!

finishText.en:
So, what do we have? A bunch of Sparks. Humm... Completely identical Sparks. This is impossible!

A Spark of every creature is unique. Even Gorluxor could only copy the bodies, not the Sparks. It looks like we are on the brink of a great discovery!

goal.en: Use Sparkton Pack to pull the Sparks out of the Soulless and the Exarkhs on the shore, and return to Lucille de Desirae.

startText.en:
War, war... Everyone just wants to kill the enemy, and it doesn't cross anybody's mind that you can also study the enemy!

No, I'm not a pacifist - I realize perfectly that's it's either we kill them, or they kill us. But my research can become a weapon. If we understand what the Architects and the Soulless are, we can find a way to defeat them!

First, I want to know if they have Sparks. Won't you help me? Here, take this Sparkton Pack. Just aim and push the button!

checkText.en: Just aim it at a Soulless and press the button - they will follow you wherever you will go.

finishText.en:
Oh... It's one of our troopers! What is he doing here? Just look in his empty and lifeless eyes... It gives me the creeps.

I tend to believe that a Spark consists of the vital energy and the soul. The soul is instincts, memory, reflexes - everything that constitutes a personality. Without a soul, a Spark is just a clot of energy that moves a body like a puppet. I think we are dealing with a puppet without a soul...

The Architects managed to erase the personality somehow. Ah, that's horrific. Do you realize what it means? A man without a soul does not believe in the Light, and thus cannot be resurrected. This is crazy...

I will continue my research and will find a way to fight them! I promise to keep in touch.

goal.en: Use the Mind Twister to subjugate one of the Soulless on the shore, and return to Lucille de Desirae.

startText.en:
To either confirm or reject my hypothesis, we need something more than just a Spark. We need a living Soulless!

Do you think they are capable of surrendering? Do they know fear? I really doubt that. So we need to trick them.

Look, it's called the Mind Twister. We use on apes in the lab... It suppresses their will, and I think it will work on the Soulless as well.

finishText.en: Too... too late!

goal.en: Go to Dubovo Farm and meet Ivan Panfilov's squad.

checkText.en: A dead body would be priceless right now.

finishText.en:
What is it? I told you I need a dead body, not a handful of sand!

However... What if it was left from an Architect? Hum... What do I do with it?

goal.en: Look around the sites of battle between the mercenaries and the Architects in the Shore City and find some remains. Return to Sarbaz Ahera.

startText.en:
You know what surprises me? I see traces of battle everywhere, but there is not a single body! I don't think that the defenders managed to carry away all of them. If only we could find just one body, then I could resurrect them and we could learn the truth.

When you are in the town, could you please take a look around? Maybe you will find some remains...

checkText.en: Bring everything you find, I will take care of it!

finishText.en: Great job, comrade! Now our soldiers will have enough food, clothes and shoes - thanks to you.

goal.en: Find 10 boxes with supplies in the Shore City harbor and bring everything that the soldiers might need. Return to Fedor Lozkin.

name.en: All for the battlefront, all for the victory!

startText.en:
Comrade! Comrade! Do you have a minute?

See those boxes on the pier? As far as I remember, ships with food, metal, clothes and other goods used to sail out from the Shore City... Do you think we should let it all rot, or we could appropriate it for the common good? I think so, too!

If you find a medicine box, bring it to me right away! I need one desperately right now.

checkText.en: So, you found anyone?

finishText.en: What? They don't want to come?! Are they crazy? Ah, I don't have time to waste on those idiots. We have a mission here.

goal.en: Find survivors in the Shore City and escort them to a safe harbor, then return to Stomp the Merciless.

startText.en:
Sarbaz Ahera asked you to search for bodies? Huh! I always knew she's out of her wits. We need to search for survivors! They couldn't have killed everybody.

If you find anyone, get them here as soon as possible. We need to know what happened.

checkText.en: We've seen too few Architects to be able to classify them. But I am working on that!

finishText.en:
Let me see... This is quite curious! Is this a piece of a claw of a part of an eye?

By the way, there is nothing like that dust you found before. Maybe those were some other Architects! I better start with classsification. Well, well...

goal.en: Obtain 15 handfuls of Architects' remains and return to Sarbaz Ahera.

startText.en:
This is not enough material to study. I saw the other "eyes" that you destroyed fell into pieces. Maybe these are remains of some other Architects?

We need to conduct a comparison study to put together a typology. What are the first principles of a researcher? Typification, correlation, unification! The more we know about the Architects, the easier we can defeat them. So bring me all pieces and fragments you can find - they will all make use!

checkText.en: Come on, answer me! Where is he?

finishText.en:
This is Yegor's ring! So he's... No! No, this can't be!

I will... I will avenge him! I will go to the soldiers and take any weapon - a bow, a sword, a spear - I don't care! And if they don't give it to me, I will smother the bastards with my bare hands!

goal.en: Find Rita Osanina's husband and return to her.

startText.en:
When the city was attacked, we hid in the basement. I don't know how long it's been... And the Yegor told me to sit quiet and went to see what was going on. He said there were sounds of battle near the town hall, and he was going to reach our soldiers and then come back for me... But he didn't.

Find him, please! He is tall and handsome... And he wears a wedding ring with the sun stone. You will recognize it at once!

I will wait here... and pray.

finishText.en:
Holy Light! I thought nobody would come for us. Has Ivan sent you? No? Then who?!

Tell me everything!

goal.en: Find the mercenaries in the Shore City, help them defeat the Architects and meet their commander in the town hall.

startText.en:
You say, she mentioned the town hall? If there are survivors, we need to find them. I can't go, I need to watch over the rookies, and I won't trust the doctor lady with the mission. Will you go?

Go on, be careful. We need to find out as much as possible.

checkText.en: If you see a huge monster with three legs - kill it at the spot!

finishText.en: See, we threw them back from the barricades! Thank you so much. Every minute of rest is priceless for us.

goal.en: Destroy 7 Architect Converters in the Shore City and return to Mikhail Furzikov in the town hall.

startText.en:
The League and the Empire have joined in an Alliance? I can't believe this! And they are here to help us? Oh my!

We've already lost hope... But now we know it's worth fighting!

There are too few of us left. We barely have enough people to hold the barricades, and the enemies are pushing in. There are especially large Architects among them - they seem to be controlling the smaller ones. Once you kill a big one, the small ones lose their vigor. If could help us get rid of the giants, we'd be very grateful!

finishText.en: Hey, get over here! Make sure those empty-eyed don't see you - it seems that they are firing the cannons.

goal.en: Reach the anti-ship squadron on the shore to the east from the Shore City, kill all enemies in your way, and find out what happened.

startText.en:
Oh my! It's the shore squadron firing!

But... there were no survivors!

Who is doing that? What are they firing at? At the Alliance fleet?!

I think we can handle it here on our own, and you should go there and find out what is going on.

checkText.en: The body is utterly disfigured.

finishText.en:
The body is utterly disfigured. Only a blood-covered envelope in the jacket pocket evidences that it was Klochkov.

The oiled envelope contains a heap of papers. One of them is an order to hold back the Architects at any cost and blow up the bridge if necessary, signed by Furzikov. The rest of the scraps and torn pieces of papers are soldiers' goodbye letters. A sad correspondence...

goal.en: Kill Architects on Dubovo Farm, find Klochkov's body and the papers that the commander gave him.

startText.en:
Come on, there is nothing you can do to help me... A giant monster simply ground us down to dust! I fainted and thus stayed alive - it must have thought I was dead. And now I crawled here, but I won't last long...

The Colossus went on to the city. Find our bomber, Vasily Klochkov, if he is still alive. Our commander gave him some important papers before he died. Find them...

checkText.en: Haven't I sent you to the shore?

finishText.en: Oh... I hope Panfilov’s guys will resurrect since the Architects haven't destroyed their bodies!

goal.en: Collect several handfuls of the crushed stone on the battlefield in Dubovo Farm, enter the time Distortion and return to Sarbaz Ahera.

startText.en:
A pile of fine crushed stone, suspiciously reminiscent of the substance that was found on the combat sites in the Shore City. Maybe Sarbaz Ahera can define the origin of this matter after all? This must be something important.

But the Alliance mission has to be completed in the first place.

checkText.en: The Architects are attacking! I've sent Ivan Panfilov's squad to hold them back while we are setting up defenses. I hope the squad will survive that.

finishText.en:
The bridge has collapsed? But it was... It was our only way to contact the capital!

And what happened to Panfilov's squad? They all died?! It can't be... It turns out I sent them to their doom, and they accepted it resignedly! They all fell, but they fulfilled their mission... Such a heroism! Each one of them deserves a medal. I only hope they return from the Purgatory...

goal.en: Enter the Time Distortion in Dubovo Farm and help Ivan Panfilov's soldiers in battle with the Architects. Return to Mikhail Furzikov.

startText.en:
Again! Here, just like on the Steel Scythe or in the White Fortress, time is powerless. The space around the hero’s body starts to melt and flow. What if you could change the course of time once again? What if you could save Panfilov's squad, or at least help them fulfill their mission?

Go ahead!

finishText.en: Ah, a swamp, what a nasty place, eysh! I swear on my ancestors, here we will sooner come across some swamp monster than a boat.

goal.en: Find Khuus-Juchi and Khuus-Shosha near the Copper lake.

startText.en:
We must get into the city and redeploy the troops there as soon as possible!

I didn't expect that you would blow up the bridge, but I suspected that it could be blocked by the enemy - that's why I sent several scouting groups to find other ways around. Unfortunately, they found nothing. Though one group still hasn't returned - the one I sent to the Copper lake.

Long ago, when there was no bridge, they used to transport goods between the Iron and the Shore cities across the Copper lake on a ferry. The ferry station has been long abandoned, but Khuus-Juchi hasn't returned, which means he either found something, or something happened to him!

checkText.en: Sharp spikes can be obtained from crab shells; flowers grow on corals; and pearls, as we know, can be found in clamshells!

finishText.en:
Excellent! Give them to me!

...

Julis feels better already! I don't have enough words to express my gratitude!

goal.en: Bring crab spikes, underwater flowers and pearls to Ilze Korushkos in the Copper lake.

startText.en:
Hey! I heard you made friends with Janus? He is a good prince, but he is still too young and stupid. You should better talk to his father, Julis, but he was wounded by the rebels, and he's been unconscious for several days now.

Can you help me? When we ran from the rebels, we had to leave all our supplies behind. If you could get me some crab spikes, underwater flowers and pearls, I could revive Julis. Will you do that?

finishText.en:
Don't touch me! I am Antonis Bulbas, the lord of the ancient people of Nyxes! I will freeze your blood if you touch me!

Aagh! Help me! They are trying to kill me!

...

Don't kill me! Please! I will serve you! I swear!

goal.en: Disguise as a Nyx, get inside of the palace where Antonis Bulbas hides, and capture the traitor.

startText.en:
Now we need to get rid of the traitor! But I don't want to kill him. At least, not now. First he has to tell us everything he knows about the strangers from the sky!

I will disguise you as a Nyx. It won't fool the guards, but I hope you don't run into them.

Find Bulbas in the town ruins and make him speak the truth about the strangers from the sky! When other Nyxes hear the traitor speak, they will stop believing all that nonsense.

He will pay for everything!

finishText.en:
So that was it... Some human told that stupid tuna to rebel! All trouble comes from humans. Well, now when Bulbas made such a fool of himself, I can easily get my father's throne back.

Thank you. My people are very grateful to you.

goal.en: Question Antonis Bulbas and return to Yanis Harius.

startText.en: Don't touch me! What do you want?!

finishText.en:
Hey, guys, just look at that blockhead!

What are you doing here, you weirdo? I haven't met you before...

I am Hoof, the right hand of Ivan Chelezny, the master of these lands. Tell me who you are!

goal.en: Swim across the lake and tell the citizens of the Iron City that soon they will receive supplies from the allies.

startText.en:
Great news, friend!

Thank you so much! Justice has been finally served. Nyxes will start repairing the pipe right away. You just need to warn the citizens. They still think that Nyxes are traitors and will start shooting at them as soon as they show up on the surface!

We will fix the pipe, and other humans will be able to walk through it safely. For a fee, of course.

checkText.en: I hate water, eysh!

finishText.en: Ha! I knew that you would do it, kylys.

goal.en: Bring 12 cut treants' branches to Khuus-Juchi.

checkText.en: Please, bring me my instruments back!

finishText.en: Excellent! Thanks to your courage, the repairing works will be done in time.

goal.en: Find the lost tools on the swamp near the Copper lake and return them to Semyon Derevin.

startText.en:
Hey!

Please, help me! You see, I am a wood worker. I was drafted in to help the Pridens build a corduroy across the swamp, but... I lost my instruments!

I was going to cut some trees for the raft, and then one of them opened its eyes and looked right at me! I got so scared I ran for my life - and lost all my instruments on the way. What am I going to do without them?

Please, can you look for them?

checkText.en: Let me know when you are ready - I will tell my warriors to launch the raft.

finishText.en: Are you alright, kylys? You don't look well! What happened?

goal.en: Try to reach the other side of the Copper lake on the raft while fighting off the Architects. If you fail, return to Khuus-Juchi.

startText.en:
It's all ready, kylys. We couldn't fix the ferry, but we built a top-notch raft, eysh! There are not so many Architects in this part of the allod, but I've seen some flying over the lake. It looks like they didn't notice us, but you should still watch out. And don't fall into the lake - some bloodthirsty beasts dwell on its bottom!

Just reach the other side and tell the locals that help is on the way!

checkText.en: Find a water dweller and beat them up until they speak! They never used to attack humans, eysh. This is strange.

finishText.en:
This is funny, eysh! Nyxes have never attacked humans before. I bet those Guards of Order are the Architects! The enemy is much more guileful than we thought.

Well, if the Architects could saw dissention among the lake folk, it means that they are not so numb after all, zoor?

goal.en: Fight the dwellers of the Copper lake until they answer why they attacked the soldiers. Return to Khuus-Shosha.

startText.en:
The Architects exploded the raft, and the lake dwellers almost drowned you? Shoysh! That smells like treason.

We need to find out what got into the heads of those underwater hunhurrs! If they are going to keep on sinking our boats, we will never cross the lake. Beat them up, if you have to.

finishText.en: What are you doing in our lake?! Answer me!

goal.en: Find friendly Nyxes in the Copper lake and find out why humans are being attacked.

name.en: On the Shore and in the Sea

startText.en:
I wonder how the Architects managed to win over Nyxes. Don't they see that those aliens don't care about any living being?

It's too bad me and my brother cannot swim. I am afraid it's you who will have to find out the truth.

checkText.en: What do you want from me? I'm not the prince anymore!

finishText.en: If the strangers from the sky really are your enemies, then prove it! Maybe then I will help you cross the lake.

goal.en: Ask Janis about Nyxes and ask him to help you cross the lake.

startText.en:
Are you not on the traitors' side? I don't believe you!

What do you want from Janis Harius, the prince of the lake folk?

checkText.en: Try not to kill civilians. It's not heir fault. They were fooled by nasty slug Antonis!

finishText.en: Great! When I take over my palace again, I will hang their tails in the hall to remind others what is the price of treachery!

goal.en: Bring tails of Nyx Guards to Janis Harius.

startText.en:
You want me to trust you? Prove you're on our side!

Antonis is establishing all sorts of ridiculous laws. Now everyone has to work "for the common good" from dawn till sunset. It's a lie! It's only good for Antonis and his accomplices. They make their people gather mussels on the bottom and bring them to the palace, where the impostors eat them all, leaving just empty shells to the common folks. If anyone dares to complain, they just cut their tails off!

I say, a tail for a tail! Bring me the tails of the traitors, and maybe then I will believe you.

checkText.en: Urmas, Peters and Valdis are hiding in the old town ruins, not far from my palace. My former palace...

finishText.en:
I didn't expect you to do it so fast! Now with the royal regalia, I can recover my lost throne and help you, as I promised!

Have you seen that huge pipe on the bottom of the lake? When my father was young, smugglers built that tunnel to transport goods to the Iron City. They paid us well! But then all smugglers were drowned by Ivan Chelezny, and thus our thrift ended.

When I recover my power, I can fix the tunnel. But you will have to pay us again, like in the old times!

goal.en: Take away the royal chain, the crown and the scepter from Urmas, Peters and Valdis and return to Janis Harius.

startText.en:
I know how to help you. But first you need to bring me the royal regalia of my father. Crazy Antonis gave them away to his accomplices as simple trinkets. It is such a shame for our people! Without my father’s regalia, I cannot regain my power.

The accomplices' names are Urmas, Peters and Valdis. They must be chilling somewhere in the town outskirts. Take away the crown, the scepter and the orb of Harius dynasty, and I swear you will have all the help I can offer!

checkText.en: Hey ambassador! Or is it dumb-assador? Haha!

finishText.en: You are good! If at least a quarter of the Alliance are fighters like you, then everything is not lost yet!

goal.en: Complete the quests from Whip, Hoof, Yela Komelkova and Paul de Blizare in the Iron City, then return to Hoof.

startText.en:
An Alliance ambassador? I couldn't care less who you are. Don't you see what is going on? The monsters are literally deluging the city. They fall from the sky; they come from under the ground - the whole city is a battlefield. I don't have the time to listen to what you have to say.

You wanna help? Then do it! Fight the bastards and protect the civilians!

checkText.en: First you need to hit an Architect with something heavy, like stones or a hammer. As soon as its surface starts cracking, push the button - and its core will jump right into your hands.

finishText.en: The core seems to be intact. It means it is fully functional and sensitive to the environment. Let's see how it will enjoy our experiments...

goal.en: Use Phase-inverting Transductor to extract cores of the Architects, locked in the western part of the Iron City, and bring them to Eladia.

startText.en:
You again? Wait... Haven't we met before? Are you sure? Your face looks familiar.

I am Eladia, one of Catherina's students. The mistress is really interested in studying the Architects. A new form of life! Can you imagine how much we can accomplish if we use that knowledge in our technologies?

You can help us if you want. Catherina needs cores, hidden beneath the shell of every Architect. Usually they explode when the carcass is damaged, but I invented a device that can help us capture intact cores. Some ten will be enough for the experiments.

checkText.en: Extract a core from a crater is much easier than from a living Architect. Just aim your Transducer on a crater and push the button!

finishText.en: How interesting! It seems like these cores are dormant. They almost do not glow and do not radiate energy. So what activates them?

goal.en: Extract cores from shell craters in the Iron City and bring them to Eladia.

startText.en:
You know that the Architects deploy their scouts here along with the bomb shells? Ah, so you were that assistant that Paul spoke so highly of!

Then I guess you know what I am going to ask you of. We need to collect cores from the craters. I will examine them to determine at which moment they activate, do they need an external source of energy and so on. Will you help me?

checkText.en: Just bring this thing close to the obelisk and wait until it starts glowing.

finishText.en: You are right in time. The Architects seem to be firing all arms that they have. It's good to have the Talisman protecting us!

goal.en: Charge four magical obelisks in the Iron City and return to Innocent Chudin.

startText.en:
How am I supposed to charge them all at once? I don't have ten arms!

Hey you! Are you ready to serve your motherland? I can see that you are!

Here, take this. This is a charger for the Talisman. Yes, that dome that protects the streets from the shellfire. The obelisks that generate the power field run out of energy before we can recharge them, causing breaches in the dome. So go on and charge four of them right now, before we get squashed!

checkText.en: If Inguz wanders away, just whistle and wave the leash - he will be right back.

finishText.en: Now you see how insidious these monsters are? But Inguz is not so easily fooled, too!

goal.en: With the help of Inguz, find Architect scouts in the Iron City and return to Nikita Karasupin.

startText.en:
You see them? Do you? Neither do I. But my dog can smell them a mile away!

Those tiny nasty Architects are hiding and watching, looking for something... But we will track them down and kill each and every one of them!

You don't believe me? Ha! Take my dog and walk around the block - you will see what I am talking about.

checkText.en: Please, hurry! If the Architects attack again, we will have to fight them with our bare hands.

finishText.en: I knew something was wrong. I hope the Architects don't realize the importance of those crystals for us, otherwise we're screwed...

goal.en: Find the destroyed supply wagon in the city, repair the crystals and return to Odric de Desirae.

startText.en:
Ah, so you are that Alliance hero who wants to help us fight the Architects? Well, go ahead!

Our cannons use special focusing crystals that allow shooting not only in the Astral, but in any environment. They help us a big deal against the Architects. It's too bad though that the crystals often collapse, and without then a cannon is just a piece of metal.

The supply wagon was supposed to arrive here an hour ago, but it is still nowhere to be seen. What if something happened to it on the way?

checkText.en: It's simple, just aim and press here...

finishText.en: You have a sharp eye! Well done, friend.

goal.en: Use the cannon to repel the attack of the Architects and return to Odric de Desirae.

startText.en:
Ah, they keep on swarming! Can you believe that? As if they know we're in trouble...

What are you waiting for? Load the cannon and shoot to kill!

checkText.en: Watch out - I may be wrong!

finishText.en:
Wow! I've never seen a monster speak before! Are they all like that? Or is it just this species? I should try crossbreeding them...

Well, this experiment definitely was successful. Now it is official - two small creatures cam be fused into a bigger one, which is smart enough to speak, but not smart enough to see that don't need their Ascension, whatever it is!

goal.en: Wait until Eladia finishes the experiment and speak to her.

startText.en:
I've conducted a couple of experiments... Well, I can't say they were totally abortive... Alright, I have two cores left. I hope this time everything will work!

You know what's the most weird ability of our enemy? It's synthesis! Small and weak creatures can join into a huge, strong and smart monster. I strive to find out how they do that! Will you assist me?

checkText.en: Just be delicate. Don't ask direct questions - we don't want to give ourselves away.

finishText.en:
Unbelievable... My trusted people are ready to stab me in the back! Was that Rohlin alone? I would never believe that! There must be someone else.

Find those who print the leaflets. They will give us more information.

goal.en: Speak to the citizens near the town hall, in the hospital and near the alchemist's store and find out what is bothering them.

startText.en:
These is one thing... I don't really feel comfortable speaking about it...

Something smells wrong. Someone spreads rumors; people panic. They even want to surrender to the Architects.

You are new here. Why don't you try and speak with them? We don't need rats here at the height of the war...

finishText.en:
Hey there! You have somethin' to eat? I'm freakin' stravin'!

Nah? That's too bad. Alright, let's deal with what you have here.

goal.en: Meet Snoot the Hungry at the frontline behind the gates of the Iron City.

startText.en:
The Alliance vanguard has already arrived and set out to the frontline. We will deal with the rest of the traitors, and you should meet Snoot immediately.

Be careful. Don't let the orcs do anything reckless.

checkText.en: Squash the bastards!

finishText.en: You are good. You must have had your share as a mercenary, too, right? We don't have many options here on Dane. You are either a Free Trader's mercenary, or a farmer...

goal.en: Destroy the Architects in the streets of the Iron City and return to Whip.

startText.en:
Hoof sent you to help us? This isn't really the reinforcement I expected... but never mind.

The monsters are everywhere! While people are hiding in their houses, we need to clear the streets to give them a safe passage to our fortifications.

checkText.en: Please, find my family! I'm so worried for them...

finishText.en:
Died?.. Oh no... How it happened? I must know!

...

Oh no! Only complete lunatics could have sacrificed innocent people to these monsters... They won't resurrect now!! Those who were sacrificed do not resurrect!!

I swear on the Light, I will revenge! I can shoot! I will fight the bastards until the last breath of the last of them!

goal.en: Search the yard and find out what happened to Yela Komelkova's family.

startText.en:
Oh... Do you know what happened to my family?

When the war broke out, I started working at the hospital and haven't showed up in my house much ever since. Wwhile battles were still rumbling outside of the city walls, I didn't worry about them - they were safe. But now the monsters are everywhere, and anything could have happened to my parents!

Please, go and see if they are alright! Our house is just opposite the warehouse near the eastern wall.

checkText.en: If you see a sword - grab it and bring to my soldiers. Those who guard the warehouse, the hospital and the alchemists are fighting barehanded!

finishText.en: I know, it's not a pleasant task, but those who are still alive need those weapons more.

goal.en: Collect 12 swords from the dead bodies and give them to soldiers near the warehouse, the hospital, and the alchemist's store.

startText.en:
If you really wanna help, I have somethin' for ya.

We are runnin' short on decent weapons. You can't break through the monsters' shell with a simple bow! So, half of our guards are defenseless, and half of them are lying breathless in the streets.

So go and pick some weapons from the dead bodies. And don't let the monsters destroy the warehouse, the hospital and the alchemy store! Otherwise we are left with nothin'.

checkText.en: Have you found out anything?

finishText.en:
Unexploded shells... Jump out from under the ground... From under the ground, that's it!

As far as I have learned from the battle reports, our enemies consist of a core, upon which they grow their flesh. And now they deploy their cores into the city under the guise of artillery shelling, and then grow their bodies when they are already inside - and then emerge right from under the ground!

goal.en: Ask the guards in the city whether they have seen how the Architects get inside of the city, examine shell craters and return to Paul.

startText.en:
Good day, friend! I see you are not afraid of the monsters. Maybe I could ask you for a favor?

You see, I'm very confused. The monsters have been bombing our city for several days now, but they never appeared in the streets before. We are securing the walls and the lake, so how are they getting in? I cannot understand that.

I would be very grateful if you could speak with our people in other shelters. Maybe they know something?

finishText.en:
The fire does its work!

Let me express my sincere gratitude! Now the guards just have to finish the few survivors, and the city will be safe again.

goal.en: Take barrels with soil oil from the warehouse and use them to burn the Architect germs at the bottoms of the shell craters. Return to Paul de Blizare.

startText.en:
Well, now that we know their secret, we're on the half way to victory! We will burn them all, and you will help me with that.

There must be several barrels with soil oil left in the warehouse. It burns brighter than goblin's eyes at the sight of gold! All we have to do is find all the shell craters, fill them with the oil, and throw a match! I'm sure the Architect germs won't survive that!

finishText.en:
Greetings. I am Ivan Chelezny, a Tycoon and the ruler of this city.

If I understand correctly, you are the ambassador who was supposed to tell me something extremely important. About the establishment of the Alliance, I suppose? Well, save your breath. An Alliance sorceress has already been here and told me the wonderful news.

We should reinforce our defenses so that they last until the Alliance forces arrive...

goal.en: Meet Ivan Chelezny in the Iron City town hall.

startText.en:
Alright, you don't need me. I'm not empowered to make any decisions... Not yet, huh.

If you are an ambassador, you should head straight to the town hall. There you will find my boss and my king, Ivan Chelezny. You should talk to him, not to me - I'm a mere soldier.

checkText.en: These are hard times... but we won't give up! We'll make it through! We'll win!

finishText.en:
It is fantastic indeed that the League and the Empire could forget the old strife for a while and join their forces. Without them, we would have lasted just another day or two. Can you imagine my surprise when that sorceress - Eladia - appeared out of thin air and told me that the Shore City had been already liberated by the Alliance!

Who could have thought...

Honestly, I haven't been that happy since I entered the Council of Seven.

goal.en: Meet Ivan Chelezny.

startText.en: The Demon Hunters noticed monsters that you call the Architects near Dane just several days before they attacked the White Fortress. They came from the depth of the Astral, where no ships sail. Somehow they reached Sarnaut bypassing Portals and wormholes. How? I have no idea.

checkText.en: I am grateful for the good news. I will be even more grateful if you help us repel the Architects.

finishText.en: Perfect, just perfect. I have just received a message, saying that the Alliance soldiers will soon be here. I wish I had more soldiers like you to command the surviving squadrons!

goal.en: Complete the quests from Odric de Desirae, Nikita Karasupin, and Innocent Chudin. Return to Ivan Chelezny.

startText.en:
I wonder why the monsters chose to attack my allod. What do we have here that they don't have on other allods? Why not Coldberg, where they don't have a Great Mage, too? Why Dane?

This is not a question that is going to be answered any time soon. While the capital is under attack, we need to concentrate on the defenses. I could use your help, too... We need to hold on until the Alliance troops arrive!

checkText.en: Don't chicken out! Kill them all!

finishText.en: Huh, did you see them rush? Before they know it, we will grind their cannons to dust!

goal.en: Destroy the Architects on the western fortification and return to Snoot the Hungry.

startText.en:
Listen to me. We have a clear objective: destroy the cannons that are firing at the city.

They seem to be allocated in the northern camp. But we can't just go in there, can we? We need a strategy, right!

Near the collapsed western bridge the monsters have built another fortification. Let's make some fuss there, and when the guards from the northern camp rush there - that's when we sneak in.

checkText.en: Bide your time, plant a mine, run for your life. It's simple!

finishText.en: Whoa, that was quite a kaboom! I bet they didn't expect that. Now we'll see who gets the last laugh!

goal.en: Plant mines on the platforms in the northern camp and return to Snoot the Hungry.

startText.en:
So the plan is: you break into the camp, you plant mines, and you get out. Sounds simple, but there are nuances.

Their cannons shoot from special platforms. Every now and then they move away from them to recharge or reload - I don't know for sure. As soon as a cannon leaves the platform, run up to it, plant a mine and retreat. When the cannon comes back and touches the mine... Boom!

I think it's gonna work!

checkText.en: Hey... What Are you doing here? And where is that thing... You know, that huge white thing we had to guard?

finishText.en: Reinforcements, finally!

goal.en: Escort the Alliance convoy to Kurbatskoe field and report on the arrival to the Screamer Family.

startText.en:
Before the Architects besieged the Iron City, the hastily drafted militia army was battered in the battle on Kurbatskoe field. Now the higher command decided to recapture that strategical site.

When our convoy set out to the field, you have to go with them. Make sure the Architects don't destroy Catherina's Aegis - that aggregate is way too important.

checkText.en: Where are the bodies?

finishText.en:
Are you serious? They turn bodies into dust? This is horrifying! This means they will not resurrect!

The worst thing is that we can't spread this information. Fear will paralyze the army better than any cannon. So keep your mouth shut!

goal.en: Find out what happened to the soldiers’ bodies on Kurbatskoe Field, and destroy the Soulless and Exarkhs. Return to the Screamer family.

startText.en:
All we know is that we are here, and they are there. Not too much, right? That's why I need to send you on a scouting mission.

For now, we have only seen the empty-eyed dummies and the creatures that control them, but we haven't come across a single dead body of our warriors. Where are they?

So please, go and see around. We will launch the assault upon the command.

checkText.en: War... War never changes!

finishText.en: An ultra-modern weapon turned into a pile of metal. What good is your progress? Although... Maybe we can still do something.

goal.en: Speak to the guard and reach Full Moon.

startText.en: All that we can do now is launch a counter attack... Wait, another scout is back! What does he have to say?

finishText.en: The shatters of the giant Architect produce an aura of terror and otherworldly chill. The good thing is, it won't hurt anyone in Sarnaut anymore.

goal.en: Enter the Kurbatskoe field Distortion and defeat the Architects with the help of Full Moon.

startText.en: The space around Full Moon and its misfortunate crew flows and trembles. The death of the mechanics seems to be a key event, and if we avert the destruction of Full Moon, we can change the outcome of the battle. There's not much hope, but we should try it anyway!

checkText.en: A great chance to finish the enemy with one powerful strike!

finishText.en:
Hush, hush...

It's alright. You are safe, in the Shore City. Come on, let us take a look at you.

goal.en: Gather the soldiers, finish the retreating Architects and break into their world.

startText.en: After the death of the Warlord, the rest of the Architects' army started retreating on all fronts. Now we need to finish the fleeing enemies while following them into their world, and then eliminate the alien threat once and for all!

checkText.en: We are in such a mess here!

finishText.en:
Finally, we can have a moment of peace.

By the way, that redhead sorceress, Eladia, came looking for you. She wanted me to tell you something important, but I forgot what it was...

goal.en: Complete the quests from the citizens in the capital, then meet Ivan Chelezny.

startText.en:
It's been unquiet here in the Iron City. Hoof is nowhere to be seen, too, which also troubles me. It's not what I'm paying him for!

You don't have any important commitments right now, do you? Please, go and speak with the citizens. Ask what is bothering them. After everything that you’ve done, they will trust in you.

checkText.en: What do you want?

finishText.en:
