A treason in the heart of the capital! How could I have missed it? I guess I'm getting too old...

So they blew up the lower levels of the mine? This actually makes sense. There is no other way to cross the mountains, and the northern part of the allod is occupied by the Architects...

Alright, we will get them, but for now we need to stop the spread of that heresy. The people are scared to death already, and we don't need that Prophet thing get into their heads. Well, I will deal with that myself.

goal.en: Go down the mine, find Hoof and his accomplices, deal with the traitor and return to Ivan Chelezny.

startText.en:
Hoof and his accomplices practice a strange religion. They believe that there is a Prophet, and that the Architects speak through his lips. Supposedly, the Prophet calls to bow before the Architects, for only they can establish the order in our world and achieve the eternal peace and prosperity. Of course, people are tired of war, and they can be easily tricked by such promises. Some of my fellow soldiers fell for it, too...

Hoof and Swish went down the shaft not so long ago. They must be still there.

checkText.en: If you wish to speak with the rebels, go on and try. I know they won't listen to me.

finishText.en: Blue water? I've never heard of such thing!

goal.en: Pacify the Nyxes and find out the reason of their outbreak. Return to Ilze Korushkos.

startText.en:
The Nyxes are getting on your fishermen's nerves? I got nothing to do with that! They are a pain in the neck for us, too.

A couple of days ago the shell collectors went insane. They don't recognize anyone and attack their friends! I don't know what to do - they won't listen to me. If you wish, you can try and talk to them yourself.

finishText.en: Hey there! Thank you again for helping me return my father's throne. What brings you under the water again?

goal.en: Meet Janis Harius on the bottom of the Copper lake.

startText.en:
Hello there. We are in trouble here again - the Nyxes have gone nuts. They cut our fishing nets, pierce our boats, scare the fish... but we can't even touch them, you know. What if they mess with the tunnel?

Who can possibly settle this for us?..

checkText.en: Find the source of the sorcery with this magical shell!

finishText.en: It's very weird... Fish, crabs and our fellow folks sound the same - there is no magic in them. But there is some in the rebels - and you!

goal.en: Use the magic shell to find the traces of sorcery in the lake and return to Ilze Korushkos.

startText.en:
Blue water... It must be some evil magic. Human magic, because you humans like evil sorcery! Take no offence, it is true.

I think I know what to do. Here, take this magic shell. It hears the song of magic! It will help us find the source of the sorcery.

checkText.en: Drink the potion, and you will start seeing the traces of evil magic in the lake.

finishText.en:
Here it is! Do you smell it? Ah, sorry, you can't smell under the water.

It makes me dizzy, and also makes me want to tear someone apart... Ah, what a nasty thing!

goal.en: Drink the magic potion, follow the traces of evil magic, find its source, collect several samples and return to Ilze Korushkos.

startText.en:
I bet it is human magic, and you, human, will help me trace it!

I have a potion that allows seeing magic. If there are evil charms in the water, you will see them. Just find the source of the sorcery and bring me some samples of it. I will try and find a way to deal with it.

finishText.en:
What do those fish... I mean, our allies think they are doing?! The underwater tunnel is the only way to get from the Shore City to the Iron City!

They don't like the "poisonous thing"? It's not a "thing", it's the residues of a first-class stimulator that we transport to the frontline and that keeps our soldiers fighting on!

Of course I will find the one who is responsible for spilling the potion into the lake, but there is no way we can stop its production. We will have to find a compromise.

goal.en: Return to Ivan Chelezny and demand that he stops the production that contaminates the lake.

startText.en:
You see, it's all humans' fault! That evil magic almost got us to kill each other!

You must be some important person, aren't you? They will listen to you. Tell their king to stop the nasty production, or we will revoke our collaboration and stop repairing the tunnel! Tell him that we object!

checkText.en: Just listen to Whip. He knows what he is doing.

finishText.en:
You?!

But what about Whip...

Where's Whip?!

goal.en: Inspect all suspicious back streets in the city with Whip and return to Graymane.

startText.en:
Hey there! So Ivan sent you to help us? Glad to hear that - we could use any help we get. There are so many marauders in the city! They would kill their own mother for a dime. We don't have enough people to keep an eye on all of them.

You see Whip over there? Some muggers beat up his partner, and I can't send him alone to patrol the streets. If you could go with him, that would be great.

checkText.en: Aho! What brings you here?

finishText.en: Aho! What brings you here?

goal.en: Ask Graymane about the reason of Whip's treason and return to the refugee camp.

startText.en:
What are you saying? Who tried to kill you? Don't you dare to bark up the wrong tree!

You must have had a fight, right? What was it about? Money? Booze? Come on, spit it out!

checkText.en: Sharashkin was not a particularly good person, but I am responsible for every man who dies here.

finishText.en:
Let me think... I swear on the ancestors, I know who this axe belongs to!

Sharashkin used to be friends with that orc, Swish. He has a very rugged face, like those who work in the mines!

goal.en: Examine Sharashkin's body and his stuff in the refugee camp, then talk to Saad-Ankha.

startText.en:
Sharashkin? What do you care about him? You weren't even a friend of his!

...

You say, a matter of national security? Oh my!

You're too late - Sharashkin's dead. Somebody killed him just several minutes before you arrived. I only had the time to give an order to guard his tent.

Now I see he wasn't killed because of a cup of soup!

Now that you're here, you're in charge. Sharashkin's tent is on the other side of the camp. Tell me when you finish.

checkText.en: Hmm...

finishText.en: No need to keep secrecy now that we know that the mine is in the traitors' hands! Meteorite ore and gold - that's the source of Dane's prosperity. And it seems that Hoof and his gang are trying to take advantage of the turmoil and appropriate the mine. And not only the mine!

goal.en: Reach the mine in the east part of the Iron City, find Sharashkin's killer and find out who stands behind the propaganda.

startText.en:
I bet this will lead us to the mine. The one who owns the mines, owns Dane. All this plotting with the fanatics is nothing more than a distraction. What they really want is to overthrow Ivan Chelezny from the throne, mark my word.

If you want to find out the truth, go the mines. They are located to the east from the city gates. Be careful!

checkText.en: I wish we had a mana-station...

finishText.en:
Just what I need. Let's try it...

Look, it works! I don't think it will sustain an army, but for sporadic single travels it will work just fine.

goal.en: Get crystals from the streetlamps in the Shore City and bring them to Kazimir Pakhomov.

startText.en:
Hey there! I'm Kazimir, the Portal Keeper. When the stone monsters attacked, all spatial magic collapsed at once. Thought connection doesn't work, the Portals are messed up. We had to send messenger pigeons to the Iron City! Can you believe that?

I suppose we can solve the problem if we find a sustainable source of power. Where do we get it? Oh, I know!

Last year elves installed their streetlamps in the city. They said, they would work forever, because they charge from magic crystals. If I had those crystals, I could fix the Portals in no time. But who in their sober senses would dare to go to the city?

checkText.en: Get rid of the rest of the nasty perches and biters!

finishText.en: Thank you so much! You are a real friend of the lake folk.

goal.en: Kill biters and steel perches in the Copper lake, then return to Janis Harius.

startText.en:
You are the best friend of the lake folk, aren't you? Will you do us a favor?

We haven't been paying enough attention to the fish farm recently, and now the lake is swarming with horrible predatory fish, who kill off our live stock. If you could help us reduce their population, we would be very grateful!

finishText.en: Nature demands harmony. You cannot just hunt for fun; you have to give something in return.

goal.en: Kill the wolves in the grove near the refugee camp and report to Saad-Ankha.

startText.en:
I told Saad-Ankha: you cannot send hunting those who were raised among stones and factory smoke, eysh! They make the forest angry. Look what you've done - they're all dead!

I survived by a miracle. I just climbed up the tree and had to watch the animals devour their bodies...

Once a beast tastes blood, it will attack again and again. We have to kill them now, eysh!

finishText.en: Very little remained of the hunters...

goal.en: Find the hunters in the grove near the refugee camp.

startText.en:
Here you see those who ran away from grief, death and starvation. A sorry sight...

These people are tired and desperate. I need someone to help me take care of them.

I sent several tailless to hunt in the grove, but they still haven't returned. Could you go and check on them? It's been a while.

checkText.en: Destroy the pack leader. He is the most dangerous!

finishText.en: A werewolf?! Are you serious? I've never seen one before! It's good that we killed it. It could have done things much worse...

goal.en: Find the wolf pack leader and kill him. Return to Saad-Ankha.

startText.en:
I've never seen wolves attacking people for no reason. But those just jumped out of the bushes and started tearing at our throats... And their leader was horrifying. Such a huge and ugly beast... and I think it was sentient, too! Then the wolves left, and the leader ordered several of them to guard the tree and wait until I'm ready to drop. Luckily, you showed up...

No one can kill just for fun! But we can kill to revenge!

Kill the beast! His blood for our blood, eysh!

checkText.en: I sent Khuus-Unana to hunt with the tailless. I hope they bring a lot of game, eysh!

finishText.en: The hunters were killed by wolves? Shoish! How many more will die in this war?!

goal.en: Escort Khuus-Unana to the camp and tell Saad-Ankha what happened.

startText.en:
We have to go back...

I can barely walk and can't run at all. Will you walk me to the camp, zoor? I'm too scared to go on my own...

checkText.en: Make sure the tunnel is airtight!

finishText.en: Thanks for your help! I hope the tunnel will last long enough to ensure our victory over the strangers from the sky!

goal.en: Help Valdis Barbus plug all air leaks in the tunnel and remove all shellfish from the walls.

startText.en: You see, we are fulfilling our part of the agreement - maintaining the tunnel in the working state! But the walls are old, and leaks open up every now and then. And shellfish on the walls contribute to that, too. If you want to help me plug the leaks and get rid of the shellfish - you are welcome!

checkText.en: Just make them drink the antidote.

finishText.en:
Ah, this is great! Let me kiss you!

I hope this nightmare is over, and we will live in peace ever after!

goal.en: Make the besotted Nyxes drink the infusion and return to Ilze Korushkos.

startText.en: I made an antidote for that poisonous thing the citizens pour into our lake! Will you help me give it to the poor besotted Nyxes - or make them drink it, if you have to?

checkText.en: If the crab gets tired, don't believe it - it's bluffing. Just give it an invigorating kick!

finishText.en: Perfect, just perfect! We will finish the work on time.

goal.en: Deliver the required stones to the foot of the collapsed bridge in the Copper lake and return to Julis Harius.

startText.en:
Welcome to our waters! I haven't really thanked you for what did for our people - I was too weak and weary. Thank you so much!

We need to help the humans repair the collapsed bridge, but we are just running out of hands. Could you please give us a hand once again? We need to deliver the right stones to the construction site. The workers will certainly mess it up. You won't have to carry them yourself - we have specially trained crabs for this purpose.

checkText.en: I've been fishing for all my life, but I have never seen anything like this!

finishText.en: You killed the monster? Great news!

goal.en: Kill the Jaw and return to Oles Brednev.

startText.en:
We have another trouble. Several days ago we discovered a giant monster, who dwells in the lake. It already ate six fishermen! Fishing has become a very dangerous enterprise, but what do we do without fish? How do we feed the whole city?

If you think of fighting it, don't go on your own. You will never make it.

checkText.en: I draw beautiful pictures on the leaflets, but if you are not so good at drawing - just paint them over.

finishText.en: Thank you so much! I am an artist, not a soldier. But art has its power, too!

goal.en: Help Nicole de Ardeur clear the walls of the Iron City.

startText.en:
Hi! I'm Nicole. I'm an artist.

When I arrived to Dane as a volunteer, I was sure that I can find beauty in anything. Even death can be beautiful! But I was wrong. There is nothing beautiful about war. So the faster we win it, the faster this nightmare will end.

And there are those who wish to surrender! What a cowardice! I have to erase all those defeatist slogans and leaflets on the walls. If you have a couple of spare minutes, I could use your help.

checkText.en: Silverbloom is an extremely powerful healing remedy! One drop of its highly concentrated essence can pull an army out of the Purgatory!

finishText.en: Thank you so much! I have a little gift for you.

goal.en: Collect Silverblooms in the Iron City vicinity and bring them to Daryona Goresvetova.

startText.en:
What do you need? A painkiller? A tranquilizer? A laxative?

Nothing? Ah, what a surprise! It happens so that this time I need something. Can you please collect some Silverblooms outside the city? No healing potion can be brewed without them, and I am running short on my supplies. Will you help?

checkText.en: How come there are so many of them here?!

finishText.en: Well done! Thank you so much!

goal.en: Kill Hydras on the swamp near the Iron City and return to Mikhail Kolchugin.

startText.en:
Ah, you just can't go anywhere without stepping on a hydra! They are especially dangerous at night - they silently crawl up at you... and sink their teeth in your leg!

Listen, I cannot leave my position. Could you please teach those nasty things a lesson? We will pay you generously.

checkText.en: How can I help you?

finishText.en: Wow, it must have been a huge beast! This victory deserves a good reward!

goal.en: Show the heart of the defeated monster to Mikhail Kolchugin near the Iron City gates.

startText.en: The defeated monster must have caused a lot of trouble for the unfortunate citizens. Its black heart is pulsating in your hands. If you show to the city guards, you may receive a generous reward.

checkText.en: You better hurry up. The time here flows differently than in Sarnaut.

finishText.en:
You really confused me. I don't know what these Architects are and where do they come from. I will have to investigate that! It's a shame though I can't create another trap like that. I didn't expect you to show up - it was supposed to work on anyone who tried to reshape the reality, not on a victim of circumstances!

Anyway, it's better to suffer for two minutes than to turn into dust on the chronicle pages, right? I really didn't expect anyone to use temporal magic as a weapon and try to reverse teleportation!

goal.en: Talk to Klavdia Kalugina.

startText.en:
Ah, don't you even try to escape my trap!

After you beat up my daddy and hound him out from Sarnaut, I've been looking forward to his return. I've spent so much time and efforts to create an Astral bubble, where usual laws of magic do not work. Here my will is the law!

According to my calculations, anyone who has recently used temporal magic will be locked here. Temporal magic doesn't just temporary shift the tissue of reality, like your psionicists do, but attempts to alter the whole existence. No one in Sarnaut should be capable of that - it is a divine power. And you are no god!

So, answer me. What. Are. You. Doing. Here?!

checkText.en: Oh, you are right in time!

finishText.en: It's decided - I am coming back.

goal.en: Find the pirate camp on the southern shore of Asee-Teph near the ruins of Uksul and find out what happened to Igor Kuznetsov.

startText.en:
We didn't mean that! We thought you were a bandit.

Some cutthroats came looking for Igor several days ago. Since then, we haven't seen him. We thought you were one of them, too.

If I were a pirate, I would have moored in a harbor near Uskul. You should look for them there.

finishText.en:
So you're back! Right in time. My engineers have finally fixed the reactor, and Eclipse is ready to set off.

Ah, I wish I didn't have to leave Umoir. My disciple can keep it from being devoured by the Astral, but who will keep an eye on those idlers? Ruling demands a heavy hand!

goal.en: Return to Catherina on Umoir.

startText.en:
I will pay my debts, find a couple of reliable guys and will be right there on Umoir.

Thank you one more time. Go to Catherina and tell her that I'm just the right person to take the charge of Eclipse!

finishText.en:
What?! That crazy chick is getting in the way again! Who is she, anyway?! That's just what we were missing!

The League has sent us a message that some loony fortuneteller, who survived the events in the White Fortress, prophesies the return of the Architects! As far as I understand, she means those creatures that the scientists on Ferris messed with? But you and Elizaveta kicked them out of our world and sealed the Portal, wasn't it so? Or is something missing from the Council reports?!

goal.en: Talk to Klavdia and deliver her message to Yasker.

startText.en:
The clock is ticking. While we are talking, several days might have passed in Sarnaut, so listen to me closely.

The Architects are a threat. If they keep on changing and transforming the structure of existence, you won't be able to defeat them. But there are always nuances.

Sarnaut is a prison for gods. Even my daddy got his butt kicked by simple mortals, haha. If the Architects had decided to attack only one allod, it means that their hands are tied. If you stop them now, you can prevent the catastrophe. Tell it to Yasker!

finishText.en:
Klavdia Kalugina? Was she the one who stole Tep's Spark right from under your nose? What is she doing here?

Can you imagine this: I received a message from Yasker which says that some crazy fortuneteller escaped the White Fortress and now makes a fuss at the Council! Where have you been?!

goal.en: Talk to Klavdia and deliver her message to Aidenus.

startText.en:
The clock is ticking. While we are talking, several days might have passed in Sarnaut, so listen to me closely.

The Architects are a threat. If they keep on changing and transforming the structure of existence, you won't be able to defeat them. But there are always nuances.

Sarnaut is a prison for gods. Even my daddy got his butt kicked by simple mortals, haha. If the Architects had decided to attack only one allod, it means that their hands are tied. If you stop them now, you can prevent the catastrophe. Tell it to Aidenus!

finishText.en: So you were sent by Yasker to tell us about the Architects? Excellent! Let us join the meeting.

goal.en: Meet Andrey Molchalin in the Free Traders' camp on Eljune.

startText.en:
Somehow, we need to conclude a peace treaty with the League. This is just the case when a poor peace is better than a good fight. Let's give the League a chance to face the enemy avant-garde. And when they suffer huge losses - and they will - we will speak with Aidenus on very different terms.

The talks will take place on Eljune, in the Free Traders' camp. We will send there our diplomat Andrey Molchalin, and your knowledge will be our undeniable advantage.

finishText.en: I remember your face... So you are the one who once already confronted the Architects? Pleased to meet you! It's good that you are here, since we don't know anything about them.

goal.en: Meet Paul de Desirae in the Free Traders' camp on Eljune.

startText.en:
We may be enemies with the Empire, but the Architects threaten the whole world. I think we are now facing their avant-garde troops. Let the Empire take that strike if Yasker is so willing to spill some blood, and then we will reap the benefits of his victory.

Today our ambassadors will meet the Imperial diplomats and decide on the plan of our collaboration. The truth is that right now no one knows how do we fight against this enemy.

The talks will take place on Eljune, in the Free Traders' camp. Find Paul de Desirae, our ambassador. The fate of the world depends on these talks!

checkText.en: Phew... Blimey!

finishText.en: I don't know what your command is thinking, but if they don't hurry up, those monsters will just finish us and then get to you. If we could just join our forces and stand up against the enemy, we would beat them in no time! So why are they wasting it...

goal.en: Wait until the end of the meeting and speak with the participants. Then talk to Ivan Kuptsov.

startText.en: What is diplomacy? Diplomacy is the iron fist of threat in a velvet glove of decency. I represented the Empire even during the negotiations on the Wild Isles, and that arrogant elf has no idea what tough negotiations are. And I will show him!

The Imperial squareheads don't know a thing about the art of diplomacy. A good diplomat acts like a mature wine doctored with a poison - without attracting unnecessary attention, but always accomplishing the purpose. I don't think these negotiations will take too long.

checkText.en: You again? I don't know what is going on and I have nothing to do with that!

finishText.en:
What?! You want me to lend you Eclipse? Maybe you want me to give you Sarn, too?

Eclipse is not another pleasure yacht that anyone can steer. And if you remember, you killed the only captain who could handle my ship. The reactor is just a pile of scraps, and I drained the emergency power, trying to reach Umoir. Though...

goal.en: Meet Catherina on Umoir. If you have not unlocked the Portal, speak with Anfisa Gulova, the Portal Keeper.

startText.en:
I have a very important mission for you. I have been informed on the events on Umoir and the capacity of Catherina's ship, Eclipse. The Imperial fleet still has not recovered after the catastrophe on Irdrich and isn't ready to face such an enemy.

But you saved Catherina, and now she owes you one. We need a powerful ship to stand through this battle. I hope you can convince her to lend us Eclipse.

checkText.en: You again? I don't know what is going on and I have nothing to do with that!

goal.en: Meet Catherina on Umoir. If you have not unlocked the Portal, speak with Anfisa Gulova, the Portal Keeper.

startText.en:
I have a very important mission for you. It concerns Umoir and Catherina. The League fleet still has not recovered after the catastrophe on Irdrich and isn't ready to face such an enemy.

I've heard of Eclipse, Catherina's ship. I assume that that ship is a hard nut to crack even for the Architects. And since we forgave Catherina her betrayal, she owes us one. We should remind her of that.

I hate to resort to blackmailing, but we really do need that ship.

checkText.en: Crystals. 6 pieces. I am waiting.

finishText.en:
Looks like this is just what we needed. I think we can fix the reactor.

I contacted both Aidenus and Yasker, and they both yell that the Architects are the biggest threat Sarnaut has ever seen. If you ask me, I think one is simply mental, and another one is too afraid to lose his throne. But alright, I will participate in this venture. Experience and knowledge are always valuable, even if I gain them in a war with nasty alien creatures!

But still we have one unresolved problem...

goal.en: Obtain 6 charged crystals by destroying Frost Elementals on Coldberg and bring them to Catherina in Upper city.

startText.en:
There is a way to repair Eclipse's reactor, but I will need your help. I heard that bodies of certain Elementals, affected by the meteorite deposits on Coldberg, accumulate special crystals. They can be used to direct and enhance a focused stream of energy.

If you could get me some of those crystals, it would be great. Meanwhile, I will contact the Conclave and inquire about the severity of the threat.

finishText.en: Ah, that's just what we need! Those Arisen are natural-born scientists. In a manner of speaking, they serve science even after death, haha!

goal.en: Use the frequency scanner to detect the required parts in the bodies of Tep mechanics who hide on the Coba Plateau, extract them and return to Catherina.

startText.en:
After you blew up Nomarkh Iblis' factory together with its owner, quite predictably, we've been running short on spare parts. I've replaced almost every node with details of my own design, but I am still missing one small part - a synchrophasic polymetallic high-load mana-drive.

Iblis told me that this part is an exact copy of a drive that is used in prostheses of Tep's servants. Do you think we can find some spare parts if we disassemble several surviving minions of the summoner?

finishText.en: Hello! Are you looking for someone? Igor, maybe?

goal.en: Meet the Daring Family in the Takalik Harbor.

startText.en:
When Eclipse was still in the shipyard, I hired two most talented and skillful captains in the world to steer it. You have already met Ignat Krivov, and as you can remember, he did not survive that encounter. The name of the second one was Igor Kuznetsov. When Eclipse set out to the heart of the world, he ran away to Eljune. He probably assumed that his contract had expired.

Maybe you can ask around about him in Takalik Harbor? Without a good captain, there is no much more use of Eclipse than of a fishing boat.

checkText.en: Did you meet Igor?

finishText.en:
Hey! Why looking so angry?

Don't grab your weapon! We're just kidding...

goal.en: Go to the location, designated by the Daring Family.

startText.en:
Keep it down! Igor is not in the camp. He asked me to tell anyone who comes searching for him that he would be in the predetermined place.

Where is that? Erm... Follow this path to the west, then after you pass two big pines, turn left and go up the hill. There you will find Igor!

finishText.en:
Dane is right ahead! Hmm... It looks desolated.

Crazystorm chose a sand spit in the eastern part of the allod as a landing strip. This is the only place, apart from the port, where a ship can moor. So, are we landing?

goal.en: Storm Dane, which was captured by the Architects.

startText.en:
By the way, your leaders have finally agreed to conclude a temporary alliance. Though nobody knows how long it will last.

The Empire army will be led by Crazystorm the Merciless, and Izbor Yavorsky is the commander of the League army. I hope they are both smart enough not to tear at each other's throats before we kick the Architects out of our world!

I don't know what those Architects are capable of, but Eclipse is a hard nut to crack even for them!

checkText.en: How can I help you?

finishText.en:
We expected anything but a poisonous mist. There is no way one can hide from it! It will get into your lungs wherever you run.

But we will find a way to fight it. I promise.

goal.en: Enter the Time Distortion at the Bee Ravine and prevent the death of the advance unit. Find Crazystorm the Merciless.

startText.en: It was supposed to be the Alliance camp here, but it's only silence and dead bodies. Everything is covered with fine white dust. Something terrible happened here. The only way to find out what it was is to enter another Time Distortion.

checkText.en: Here comes our hero! I hope this time you will first do some thinking and question people before you go and play hero.

finishText.en:
Whoa, I can't believe my eyes!

Someone managed to fuse human flesh with that of the Architects, and instill life in that hybrid creature! It's such a shame we couldn't catch him alive. I am afraid these remains won't tell us much, but I will still try to learn what I can. I bet this thing wasn't created by the Architects.

goal.en: Examine the crime scene, question the witnesses, and track down the killer.

startText.en:
I'm sorry I am disturbing you in your off-time, but we are in trouble... Two men were killed last night, and so brutally I doubt they will ever resurrect. I reckon it wasn't just a regular drunken brawl.

The bodies were terribly disfigured, and there are practically no leads. The guards will tell you more.

They found the bodies near the northern wall, so you should go there. This is a dreadful incident indeed...

checkText.en: How can I help you?

finishText.en:
So that was you fiddling around with the Architects' wrecks on the east! My girls saw you. I will deliver the package, don't worry.

And where are all the rest? Should we wait for them?

goal.en: Obtain Architects' wrecks near the Bee Ravine and hand them to Evdokia Bershanska.

startText.en:
I have yet no idea what this creature is, and why it killed harmless drunkards. I really doubt it tried to promote healthy lifestyle.

The jigsaws aren't falling in their places for now. I can't see the spells they used to bring this monster to life.

I think I need more tissue samples for analysis. Could you please bring me some pieces of Architects? Few of them can still be found on the Split Hill. Hand the samples to Bershanska - she will deliver them to me in an instant!

checkText.en: Who are those soldiers who dig through the Architects' wrecks on the east? This seems odd...

finishText.en: So those are the bastards who had deserted to the enemy?! Oh I will grind them to dust! I will send a whole squadron to eliminate them!

goal.en: Find the "odd fighters" in the east side on the Split Hill.

startText.en:
What do you mean, who? My girls saw a dozen of other Alliance fighters, going through Architects' remains to the east from Fractal. And then you came and asked me to deliver the wrecks to the city. I thought you were from the same troop!

So you don't know who they are? This is very strange. Nobody is supposed to be on the Bee Ravine right now. We need to check on those black diggers...

finishText.en: Oh... Where have you been?! The lab was attacked! Eladia is gone, and the remains of the monster disappeared along with her!

goal.en: Return to Eladia.

startText.en: You should go back to Eladia and tell her that she's not the only one who is interested in the Architects' secrets. This Prophet will cause a lot of trouble, I can feel that... And there's also Hoof and his bandits - they are not going to make it any easier.

checkText.en: I have a feeling that Eladia is alive. Though I have no idea where do we look for her!

finishText.en: The Portal ruins seem very old, but the footprints next to it indicate that someone was using it quite recently. And my guess is that only fanatics would have dared to use such an old Portal.

goal.en: Examine the lab, talk to Unn, and start searching for Eladia.

startText.en:
I have no idea where she'd gone. Eladia used to tell everyone to stay away while she was tinkering with all that magic stuff. This time, she was working on her sorcery, too. But then a patrol squad which was walking by her lab heard some noise and voices... When they broke in, there was nobody inside - only a couple of bodies and smoking ruins.

I don't know even what to think... By the way, one of the dead men seems familiar to me!

checkText.en: What do you want?

finishText.en: Greetings! I am sorry for the haste, but the case seems to be urgent.

goal.en: Meet Ivan Chelezny in the Iron City.

startText.en: The letter says that you should visit the Iron City immediately and meet Ivan Chelezny.

checkText.en: Find the nearest monolith and try to switch on the chronometer.

finishText.en:
The chronometer is dead. It means my conjecture was wrong - the Architects do not alter the time. I have a suspicion that they... do not belong to our time. I don't know how to explain it.

The crazy seeress has her own theory. I don't believe it, but still we can try it out, since we have no other options.

goal.en: Kill the Architects near the monoliths, use the chronometer to speed up the time and return to Eladia.

startText.en:
The soldiers told me that you can resist the impact of the monoliths. How do you do that?

We can make some tests using this chronometer.

It can speed up the time at the foot of a monolith. Find one and switch on the chronometer. And get rid of the Architects in your way.

finishText.en: The Pattern turns into something incredible at the time of war! Can you sense the tension of the threads?

goal.en: Go to Kurbatskoe field and meet Unn.

startText.en:
So the arrogant sorceress failed again? I told her so!

The darkest legends of my people tell that there is such thing as the Scissors. It's a dark and great power that changes what has been predestined. One by one, it cuts the Threads of fate, striving to destroy the Tissue of Creation! And when the Scissors appear in the world, the Fate brings the Weaver to life. The Weaver has a gift to restore the cut Threads.

I believe you are the Weaver. Everything points to that. But we need to know for sure! When you are ready, find me on Kurbatskoe field.

checkText.en: Go to the thick of the battle and try to catch the cut Thread. If you are indeed the Weaver, you can make it!

finishText.en:
Yes! Oh Threads! I knew it!!

If you can restore the Threads, it means that the legends are not lying! It is certain - you are the Weaver!

goal.en: Destroy the Architect and try to restore the cut Threads. Return to Unn.

startText.en:
Can't you feel it? Oh my, was I wrong after all? The legends only say that the Weaver can restore Threads, not see them.

I will try and give you part of my gift. Go to the thick of the battle and try to catch the cut Thread. If you are indeed the Weaver, you can make it!

checkText.en: You want to fight? Then go fight the Architects and don't forget to push the chronometer button!

finishText.en:
Two Architects instead of one? No, this isn't how it's supposed to work!

I don't understand! The chronometer created some kind of a time loop that brought another Architect - from the past or from the future - instead of a shift. I need to re-check it.

goal.en: Destroy the Architects on Kurbatskoe field and use the chronometer when you succeed. Return to Eladia.

startText.en:
The Weaver?! Oh come on. There is only one power that is able to change the world - a strong will and faith. You might believe that you are restoring the Threads because you're the Weaver, but in fact it's all the matter of faith. Not only yours, but everyone who believes in you. Well, there must be laws for faith, too. Soon we will figure them out.

I fixed the broken chronometer. You want to fight? Then go fight the Architects and don't forget to push the chronometer button!

finishText.en: She wants a living Achean? How am I going to get one?

goal.en: Find Ivan Konev on Kurbatskoe field.

startText.en:
I suppose that the Architects do not alter time - they live in a different time dimension!

What do we know about them? Nothing really. Maybe they are creatures from another world, or maybe from another reality, where time flows differently. The collision of the realms creates time paradoxes and allows us to change the past.

To prove this theory and find a way to protect ourselves from the negative impact of the temporal magic, we need a living Architect, at least as powerful as an Archean!

checkText.en: The bandits must be hiding in the mountains!

finishText.en: They didn't touch the ammo or the money, but they took two barrels of rum! How cruel is that?

goal.en: Eliminate the bandits in the mountains, find the stolen ammunition and return to Ivan Konev.

startText.en:
We have only seen Archeans a couple of times. They only appear when we launch a broad-scale attack, but how do we do that without ammunition?

Ours scouts report that there is a gang of bandits in the mountains who rob our convoys. They must have our ammunition hidden somewhere!

checkText.en: Don't worry about me and Unn. Just capture an Archean!

finishText.en:
You did it! An intact, living Archean!

I will get all the information I need from him. I will reduce him to atoms, if I have to, but I will find a way to fight the bastards.

goal.en: Join the Alliance's attack on the Architects, help the cannoneers aim the artillery, fight Archean and capture him. Report to Eladia.

startText.en: So you need an Archean... Get ready, we are launching the advance! You better don't get into the thick of the battle. You should stay here and help the cannoneers aim at the enemy troops. As soon as an Archean shows up, you do what you have to do - whatever it is.

checkText.en: So you want to try and speak with him? Alright, but don't say too much.

finishText.en:
Ah, the Architects seem to be so easily fooled! Ascension, the Path of the Order.... What a nonsense.

But he said something important. That the Path has not been laid yet. We're only dealing with the vanguard... What will happen when it is finally laid?

We need to not let it happen. At any cost! If we don't defeat the Architect now, it may become too late.

goal.en: Interrogate the captured Archean and talk to Eladia.

startText.en: You have some experience in speaking with the Architects, so why don't you try it now? The Architect is a very logical creature, I'd say, too logical. So you can lead it to a logical trap. We need to find out if there is a way to stop them!

checkText.en: When you reach the other side of the mountains and find a place for the camp, summon me - I will open the portal. Let's try and strike the Architects in the back and catch them off guard before they have laid their Path!

finishText.en:
Finally! What took you so long?

So what do we have there? Partisans? You don't say! I thought there were no survivors in the north. I should speak to their leader.

goal.en: Kill the monsters in the passage, reach the other side of the mountains, find surviving soldiers in the Squirrel Grove, and use the beacon to summon Eladia.

startText.en:
If the Architect hadn't been lying - and I am not sure if they are capable of lying - then we're running out of time. The army is stuck on the battlefields and can't possibly reach the other side of the allod to destroy the Path anyway - there are way too many monsters on the shore.

There is this passage in the mountains, they call it the Road on the Bones. Legends say some dark creatures dwell in there, but I really doubt that they are more dangerous than the Architects. I will give you a beacon. When you reach the other side of the mountains and find a place for the camp, summon me - I will open the portal. Let's try and strike the Architects in the back and catch them off guard before they have laid their Path!

checkText.en: Don't be afraid, Weaver. Your thread is intertwined with that of Sarnaut!

finishText.en: I can see that the Tissue of Creation is solid like never before. Whatever awaits you in the future, it cannot deceive your Thread!

goal.en: Meet Unn, survive the battle with the shadows of the future, and speak to the Seeress.

startText.en:
When this creature was talking to you, I managed to infiltrate its mind. It was scary! They really do have one consciousness, and they call themselves the Architect!

Can you meet me again in a couple of minutes on the meadow near the camp?

finishText.en: Yee ha! I bet they are wondering where that bomb came from!

goal.en: Enter the Distortion in the Squirrel Grove and help the partisans defeat the Architects.

startText.en: A small squadron of Dane defenders faced the Architects here and was destroyed in an uneven struggle. Here the space once again is twisted in a dense spiral, which means we can try and change the past...

checkText.en: What is it you want?

finishText.en:
Sweet heavens! Are you from the capital? I thought no one would ever come to help us.

The enemies have some kind of a rally point on the shore, like a port. The flying ones circle around it in - thanks Tensess the tree crowns are thick here and they can't spot us! But still there are plenty of them on the ground, too, and the stupid ogres get in the way.

goal.en: Find the partisan squad in the Squirrel Grove and meet Sidor Kolpakov.

startText.en:
You should meet our commander, Sidor Kolpakov. He accepts everyone in our ranks - villagers, bandits, hunters - as long as they can hold a weapon.

Go to the north-east. You will find him there.

checkText.en: What is it you want?

finishText.en: Kolpakov sent you? It's great to hear that! I could use some help.

goal.en: Meet Vasily Terkin in the Squirrel Grove near the ogre camp.

startText.en: The Architects perturbed the ogre tribe that lives in this forest. They used to live quietly in the thicket, but now they harass our camp on a daily basis. I sent Vasily Terkin to keep an eye on them, and I would be very grateful if you could go and check if he is doing alright.

checkText.en: I will distract the ogres, meanwhile you sneak up to the cages and release our fellows.

finishText.en: This is the real soldiers' friendship! Thank you, friend!

goal.en: Release the kidnapped partisans in the ogre camp and return to Vasily Terkin.

startText.en:
Our objective is not an easy one, but we can handle it, can't we?

The ogres have kidnapped several soldiers from our camp the last night. While they are thinking whether to stew or to roast them, we have to rescue them. I will distract the ogres, meanwhile you sneak up to the cages and release our fellows.

checkText.en: Take some pictures of the base and its vicinity. Try not to get caught.

finishText.en: Well, well... the main part of the enemy base seems to covered with a powerful shield. Those are the creatures that maintain it. I will think of a way to handle them!

goal.en: Use the deserotype to take several pictures of the base in the Squirrel Grove and return to Eladia.

startText.en:
I spoke to the commander... His manners leave much to be desired, by the way.

The thing is, the Architects have build a base for their flying units - Furies - who carry out raids on the Shore City. I wish we could just squash it from the Astral, but there are just too many of them. So we have to approach it from the shore - after we send the scouts, of course.

checkText.en: You attract the attention of a peeper, and while it is figuring out who you are, I shoot an arrow right into its eye.

finishText.en: And what if Alina failed to hit its eye? We would have discovered ourselves! Such recklessness!

goal.en: Help Alina eliminate Architects' observers in the Squirrel Grove and report to Sidor Kolpakov.

startText.en:
Vasily told me the Architects almost discovered out camp. We cannot let them find us!

They send their observers all over the place. We could use your wit and my crossbow to get rid of them. You attract the attention of a peeper, and while it is figuring out who you are, I shoot an arrow right into its eye.

checkText.en: Bring me several trionic crystals. My hocus-pocus requires them!

finishText.en: Let me see... Yes, that's exactly what I need! Now we have to come up with the attack plan with Sidor.

goal.en: Obtain several trionic crystals in the quarry near the Squirrel Grove and bring them to Eladia.

startText.en:
If only we could get Catherina to shoot at their base... Ah, that's impossible.

However, I'm pretty sure I can disable the shield above their base. We will need several trionic crystals for that.

Could you bring me some? They used to extract them in the quarry to the west of this forest. I bet you can still find a few there.

checkText.en: The plan is simple: we breach the outer perimeter, then blow it all up from the inside!

finishText.en:
Whoa, you saw that explosion? It was only supposed to distract the Furies for a while, but it looks like it destroyed the base completely! You and Vasily deserve a medal!

You didn't do that? Then who?!

goal.en: Destroy the Architect guards outside of the base, get inside, cover Vasily while he plants the explosives, and return to Eladia.

startText.en: It is time we showed these bastards who are the masters of this land! The plan is simple: we kill the huge things that guard the entrance, the sorceress breaches the dome, you and Vasily enter the base, mine everything and withdraw while we cover your backs.

checkText.en: Install the three locating beacons on the shore, and then our cannoneers will easily target it!

finishText.en: Their battleship was completely destroyed! I never thought Eclipse has such fire power!

goal.en: Install three beacons on the shore and wait until Eclipse destroys the battleship.

startText.en:
Just one thing left... You remember that huge machine that ruined the Hunters' fortress? It is heading our way!

You see, the explosion made the Furies helpless before Eclipse and attracted the attention of their Fodiator battleship. So I contacted Catherina, and now her ship is barraging just next to the shore.

Unfortunately, the Fodiator is protected with a temporal shield, but we can still locate it!

finishText.en: Aho, kylys! So we have to regain the whole fortress from the Architects on our own, huh? If we succeed, they will tell legends of us!

goal.en: Meet Maas-Svon near the lower gates of the city.

startText.en:
We'll see how the Architects will like it when we start firing at their fortifications right from the Astral while advancing in the rear! Their main forces are concentrated on Kurbatskoe field, which means they don't expect us to approach them from the side of the fortress!

Find Maas-Svon near the lower gates of the fortress. He will decide whether we should remain here or join the rest of the army.

checkText.en: In the cargo hold of the crashed ship on the shore must be a couple of barrels with explosives.

finishText.en: Ay-hya! This is just what we need!

goal.en: Find bags with explosives in the crashed ship on the shore and bring them to Maas-Svon.

startText.en:
Well, I don't mean literally on our own. I'm a scout, not an assaulter!

But there is one thing I have learned from assaulters: the best way to open something is to blow it up! Let's try it, zoor?

checkText.en: Go ahead, kylys! We need to break to the pier and give the signal to our guys.

finishText.en:
Phew, we did it!

Have you ever seen such strong Architects before?

goal.en: Together with Maas-Svon blow up the fortress gates and break through to the pier.

startText.en:
I think this will be enough to blow up the gates. We need to reach the pier, lift the grating and see if the boat can moor. If it can, we will give the signal and wait for the cavalry!

Most definitely there will be plenty of stone hunhurrs. If you see anything explosive, hand it to me immediately!

And try not to die. We won't have another chance.

checkText.en: Reach the gates, lift the grating and launch the rocket. As soon as our troops see it, they will show up.

finishText.en: Ah, it's you again! I'm not even surprised.

goal.en: Reach the pier, launch the signal rocket and lift the grating for the arrived troops.

startText.en: I will try to hold them off. You go to the pier and launch the rocket. I hope they won't miss it!

checkText.en: Go, go! To the top!

finishText.en: The fortress is ours again! Hurray!

goal.en: Reach the top of the central tower together with Terkin.

startText.en:
We need to capture the central tower in the first place. There we can fix the Portal to bring more of our units here and start clearing this place of the monsters!

We will watch over the stairs. Crushbone will go with you. Are you ready? Then go!

checkText.en: Find two or three solid planks to cover the hole in the bridge, and let our guys in.

finishText.en: Greetings! I must admit, this was an impressive recovering mission.

goal.en: Collect solid planks in the inner yard of the fortress and fix the bridge. Speak with Izbor Yavorsky.

startText.en: I have great news - with the help of Eladia, Sidor has contacted the Alliance, and now a unit, led by Izbor Yavorsky, is waiting for us outside. We just need to fix the bridge to let them inside the fortress. There are plenty of wooden planks around here, maybe we can collect enough of them.

checkText.en: There are still plenty of Architects on the lower floor. How can we advance if we don't feel safe here?!

finishText.en: You finished with them? Excellent!

goal.en: Destroy the Furies on the lower floors of the fortress and return to Izbor Yavorsky.

startText.en:
So here is the disposition: the Alliance unit has joined Kolpakov's squad and now planning to attack the enemy in the rear. This fortress is a strategical point, and we can't feel safe here until all of the hiding Architects are eliminated.

After the explosion, many Furies took shelter in the fortress and flooded the lower floors. We should get rid of them now!

checkText.en: Could you please bring me some pieces of the destroyed Furies? I will study them.

finishText.en:
Yes! This proves my theory. The bodies of Furies are not only stronger but older than those of other Architects.

You see, I have a hypothesis. It all is somehow connected with faith! When the Architects attacked the Hunters, nobody knew what they were and how could they be fought. And now when we are starting to press them back from the cities and have showed everyone that they are vulnerable, it seems as if it has debilitated them, or him - the Architect!

goal.en: Destroy the Furies on the lower floors of the fortress and bring pieces of them to Eladia.

startText.en:
Something is wrong with these Architects... They seem to be weaker than the ones that besieged the Iron City. But how can that be, if the Architects absorb their experience and become stronger with every battle? They supposedly adapt to new weapons. So the young Architects should be stronger than the "older" ones from the first wave of invasion. But that's not what happened, so I want to understand why.

Could you please bring me some pieces of the destroyed Furies? I will study them.

checkText.en: Have you seen Alonso, the elf? I sent him to examine the outer walls of the fortress, and he is still nowhere to be seen.

finishText.en:
What a massacre... We are just a little late!

I thank you on behalf of the Empire! And the darned Alliance, of course... How can an army be led by someone who knows nothing about war?

goal.en: Help Alonso de Desirae and meet Crazystorm the Merciless in the Bee Ravine.

startText.en:
Well done! The fortress is ours again. After you destroyed the Fury base and the Fodiator, we can freely redeploy our units and deal a massive strike in the enemy's rear.

The advance unit is already heading east to form a new front. The soldiers have to capture the objective and hold it until our main forces arrive, led by Crazystorm the Merciless. I think they will need your help.

checkText.en: Kill as many Demons as you can!

finishText.en: Great job! Does it only seem to me, or the Demons are actually at war with the Architects, too? If it is so, we should think of a way to set them against each other.

goal.en: Kill Demons in the White Fortress vicinity and return to Alonso de Desirae.

startText.en:
Greetings! We have a small problem that we need to attend immediately, namely - Demons! As if the Architects were not enough.

The Demons that were locked in the dungeons of the White Fortress escaped when it fell, and now they can cause a lot of trouble. If we don't eliminate them now, a couple of days later it can be too late!

checkText.en: To restore the Portal, we need special lenses. I will mark the spots where they should be installed with crosses.

finishText.en: Excellent! The portal is working again. And guess what? That old fluffy seeress with her tales of threads and patterns arrived first thing. The only person we missed here.

goal.en: Install the focusing lenses in the designated spots around the camp in the Bee Ravine and return to Crazystorm the Merciless.

startText.en:
Alright, never mind. Anyway, we are in the enemy's rear, and now we need to set up the camp and wait for the reinforcement.

When the militia forces from the Iron City retreated from here, they sealed off the Portal. To restore it now, we have to focus the magical energy. I have four special lenses for this purpose. I will mark the spots where they have to be installed on the map. Just don't mess up the sides.

checkText.en: Aren't you supposed to be installing the banner on the enemies' citadel right now, uh?

finishText.en:
I felt something... An invisible wave that ran down the whole world. What happened up there?

...

goal.en: Enter the Time Distortion on the top of the Architects' citadel and save the Alliance fighters from death and the Victory banner from defilement.

startText.en: After Aine was defeated, the space twisted in a crazy whirlpool. Your first encounter with the Architect led to the chain of space and time distortions. Maybe his death will put an end to it... But there is only one way to find this out - to enter the Distortion and save the Alliance fighters and the banner!

checkText.en: If you want to see our squad flying in the sky, then destroy the ballistae. The one who dominates the sky, dominates the ground.

finishText.en: You're done with the ballistae? Good, I will give an order to take off.

goal.en: Destroy the Architects' ballistae on the Split Hill and return to Evdokia Bershanska.

startText.en:
Greetings! I am the leader of "Night Witches" Squad. My girls have crushed the enemy several times, both in the air and on the ground.

But now there's something new - they are firing light spears from some kind of giant ballistae. We've already lost several gryphons. We can't risk losing anymore, so we're not taking off before the ballistae are destroyed.

checkText.en: Cores of giant Architects would be the best option, but a dozen of smaller ones would do, too.

finishText.en: Hm... They look just like the cores of regular Architects.

goal.en: Obtain cores of deadly shooters on the Split Hill and return to Eladia.

startText.en:
So that fat orc Crazystorm is a big guy? Such a shame. I wish I could turn him into something more useful, like a stool.

He won't let me have my own workplace. How am I supposed to do my research? Anyway, the first thing I need to find a way to fight the deadly mist is several cores of those shooters.

checkText.en: With the Deceiver's Eye you can see the invisible evil and destroy its deadly pattern!

finishText.en: I knew that the enemy was close, and that only the Weaver could see its Thread and cut it. I don't care if the sorceress says it was a usual invisibility potion!

goal.en: Use the Deceiver's Eye to find the invisible Architects in the Bee Ravine and return to Unn.

startText.en:
It is a strange place. The closer we get to the enemy's lair, the weirder get the patterns of the Tissue of Creation.

Help me! Take this Deceiver's Eye - it always shows the truth. When you get close to the enemy, you will see them and will be able to cut their Threads to restore the harmony of the Pattern!

checkText.en: Go reach those things that get in the way of our guys and damage them.

finishText.en: Good job! I wish I had more soldiers like you.

goal.en: Destroy the Colossuses and damage the pillars that supply the power field between Kurbatskoe field and the Split Hill. Return to Crazystorm the Merciless.

name.en: Between the Rock and the Hard Place

startText.en:
This is the best moment to strike the enemy in the back, but first we need to destroy the power field that blocks the passage to the valley. I assign this task to you!

Somewhere between Kurbatskoe field and the Split Hill there are supposed to be the things that generate that power field. As soon as it is deactivated, our troops will initiate the attack!

checkText.en: This bowl can be used to catch a stray Spark.

finishText.en: Great! These will prove useful in combat.

goal.en: Use Nih's Bowl to catch the Sparks of the Arisen on the Split Hill and return to Negus Khaptah.

startText.en:
Another one seeking a piece of Zem wisdom?

You must have heard that some of my people do not believe in the Light. We call them the Absolutists. Some of them, who took part in the battle on the Split Hill, died, and now their restless Sparks hover over the battlefield. If you could go and catch them with this bowl, they will serve us well!

checkText.en: Before you attempt to instill a Spark into a body, make sure to kill the Exarkh who controls it!

finishText.en: Well done! I guess the Architects will be surprised when their puppets turn against them.

goal.en: Use Nih's Bowl to instill Zem Sparks into the bodies of the Soulless on the Split Hill. Return to Negus Khaptah.

startText.en:
Do you know that the Architects can destroy the Sparks of the captured soldiers and control their soulless bodies? Then you can guess what my plan is!

We have Sparks without bodies, and bodies without Sparks. We just need to get rid of the "puppet masters" - the Exarkhs, and instill the Sparks into their "puppets"!

checkText.en: Meet me near the entrance to the enemy lair!

finishText.en:
Hurray!

Ready! Aim! Fire!

goal.en: Escort the artillery unit to the Stork high point and receive instructions from Kazimir Biserov.

name.en: The Final Fight Is the Toughest One

startText.en:
The time has come for you to show that no otherworldly monster can break our spirit! The sorceress has found a way to protect us from the deadly mist, so now this secret weapon of theirs no longer threatens us.

The soldiers are ready; the Architects have retreated to their lair. One more powerful strike - and victory is ours!

You need to supervise the positioning of the artillery units and make sure they reduce to dust the enemy fortifications. I will command the infantry. With the support of Dreadnoughts, we will suppress any resistance!

checkText.en: Hey, cover the Dreadnoughts!

finishText.en: Here we have the enemy spread before our eyes. They stand no chance!

goal.en: Escort the artillery unit to the Gannet high point and receive instructions from Dmitry Lukanin.

startText.en:
Damn gibberling maps! Can't read a thing from them. Give us a little more time to range in; in the meantime, you go to the second high point!

The battle is about to start!

checkText.en: First finish them all!

finishText.en: Ah, I wish we had this fire power from the very beginning!

goal.en: Clear the Sparrow high point from the Architects, report to Yakov Lukanin and protect his Dreadnought.

startText.en:
Now we just need to clear the last high point called Sparrow.

The biggest monsters ensconced there - at least ten Converters and a bunch of smaller ones.

finishText.en:
Finally! The artillery is doing its job.

But don't get too excited - we will have to fight our way to the citadel anyway.

goal.en: Meet Crazystorm the Merciless near the entrance to the Architects' citadel.

startText.en:
Thanks a lot! Now we're fine on our own.

Go down to the citadel - our troops are about to break in!

checkText.en: Everything went wrong...

finishText.en: The ragged banner is covered in blood of our fallen heroes... The symbol of victory is desecrated! And the Archont, who started the time distortions, is responsible for that! What started with him, will end with him, too!

goal.en: Join the Alliance soldiers, reach the citadel gates and climb to the top ground.

startText.en:
Remember what I told you about the Architect? His soldiers are changing. Our Faith has shaken his conviction in the trueness of his Path. His people do not want his Order anymore.

But here, near the citadel, I can sense the presence of the other world. A mere look at these walls instills uncertainty in the hearts of our warriors.

We need to encourage them and tilt the balance in our favor. Nothing will serve us better as a symbol of victory than the Alliance banner, raised above the citadel gates!

finishText.en:
I don't think you will be able to interfere with the course of events anymore. Even if you find a distortion, you won't be able to change our reality. I believe I am right assuming that.

By the way, there were more than just one Archont of the Architect. I'm afraid you will have to meet Savant again. And that other thing you shot down on Kurbatskoe field...

I think I should go with you. You might need my brain.

goal.en: Listen to Eladia.

startText.en:
So the first Distortion appeared when you defeated Aine. The Architect somehow changed the past to avoid his death, but also dragged you out of our time dimension. Now when Aine is dead after all, the flow of time has returned to its normal state.

But the consequences of that disturbance might be felt long after these events...

finishText.en: So, what do we have here? As far as I can see, you are hardly dead!

goal.en: Speak with Yasskul Troakar in the Shore City.

startText.en:
We've been so worried about you!

How do you feel? Normal? How can you just feel normal after two weeks of unconsciousness?!

When the redhead sorceress brought us your senseless body, we thought you were dead. Luckily, she told us exactly what to do.

Go to the doctor, let him take a look at you.

finishText.en:
Greetings! I've heard about the events on Kurbatskoe field. I'm glad you're alive. Unfortunately, our counterattack failed, and the Architects are still controlling the northern part of the allod.

And we have plenty of problems here in the rear, too. Kanians and Xadaganians are starting to fight each other, Nyxes revolt... What a mess!

goal.en: Meet Ivan Chelezny in the Iron City.

startText.en:
It is sad indeed that only "Robust" is the only ship we have left. "Overtaker" was damaged by the Architects and crashed on the west shore...

But we should be happy we're alive and praise our heroes. You are expected in the capital!

checkText.en: No, you're not leaving now!

finishText.en: Greetings! How do you feel?

goal.en: Go through a medical examination at Yasskul Troakar, drink the mixture and go to Mikhail Furzikov.

startText.en:
Congratulations, patient, I have great news for you - your disease will be named after you! Haha!

Come on, I'm kidding.

The redhead sorceress instructed us on the course of treatment that you required. And it worked!

You have a massive post-traumatic syndrome, caused by a gross interference in your Spark. It looks as if it had been turned inside out in an attempt to reverse the process of aging. I don't know how this is possible, but we have what we have - your Spark got much younger, and yet we haven't been able to restore the energy flows in your body.

I need to do another examination...

checkText.en: Buy a jacket from every vendor. We will recognize the stolen one right away.

finishText.en: Well, well... This one has been definitely stolen from our warehouse! I will kill the bastards!

goal.en: Buy 4 jackets from different vendors in the Shore City and find the one who is involved with the black market. Return to Mikhail Furzikov.

startText.en: As long as you are discharged from military service, help us regain some order in the rear. Someone has been stealing our supplies and reselling them through the market vendors. Could you go and buy something under the counter? If we come across things from our warehouses, we will immediately figure out who the thief is.

checkText.en: Find out how they stole the supplies!

finishText.en: Ha! I've heard about your accomplishments. You are good at public relations, aren't you?

goal.en: Find out the source of Rahat Lakoumov's supply, follow the courier and deal with the smugglers. Return to Milhail Furzikov.

startText.en:
So it was Lakoumov after all? This time he won't get away.

Go and tell him: unless he splits on his accomplices, we will give him a trial by martial law. This means certain death. As soon as he spits out the truth, go and find the loophole through which they got inside the warehouse and plug it up.

checkText.en: Hopefully, the mushrooms will help.

finishText.en: Great! Give them to me. I will use them to make a potion.

goal.en: Collect Zoom-Zoom mushrooms on the swamps around the city and return to Unn.

startText.en:
This man is being tormented by his nightmares. They are literally killing him! His Thread is so strained it is about to break. This is wrong! I need to see what is torturing him.

Special mushrooms grow in the swamps, they are called Zoom-Zoom. They allow seeing inside someone else's mind!

finishText.en:
I remember you! I'm so glad you are alright.

Unfortunately, we are meeting again at a sad moment. This man is dying, and I don't know how to help him.

goal.en: Meet Unn near the city hospital.

startText.en: I have another request, if you don't mind. A whole train of ships with supplies from other allods have gone missing. And a couple of days ago, the guard ship from that train crashed on the shore. Only one sailor survived, and he is still unconscious. The seeress is taking care of him in the hospital. I think you should speak to her first.

checkText.en: Come on, give it to the poor sailor.

finishText.en: Oh my! So this is what he is seeing... The same monsters that we are fighting. They have killed all friends of this poor fellow and destroyed the ship...

goal.en: Make the sailor drink the potion, wait until it works, and speak with Unn.

startText.en: Be careful with this potion!

checkText.en: Don't waste time. Go and take a look at the crash site.

finishText.en: This is it. You have already saved my Thread and interlaced it in the Pattern of Creation. Have you done this again afterwards? Try and remember every detail! I hope I can understand... or help you understand.

goal.en: Go to the crash site of the ship on the western shore, examine the wrecks and return to Unn.

startText.en:
That man, Mikhail, didn't mention that the ship was knocked down by the Architects. Maybe he didn't know?

I think you should go see the wrecks for yourself.

checkText.en: The Threads are intertwining in a tight clew...

finishText.en: These fragile balls are actually our mighty enemies? It is hard to believe that.

goal.en: Use the Transducer to pull the cores out of the Architects near the monolith to the west from the Shore City and return to Unn.

startText.en:
You say you need a living Architect? Well, if a core is essentially an Architect, I don't think we will have a problem with that!

The Architects built one of their monoliths to the west from the Shore City. I haven't really studied them yet, but I know I am going to make some amazing discoveries... Ah, yes, the cores.

Take this Transducer. I bet you know how to use it.

finishText.en: Hey! How are things? For me, not particularly good. We are still far from unravelling the mystery of the Architects.

goal.en: Meet Lucille de Desirae in the Shore City.

startText.en:
I think I am beginning to understand... When a Thread breaks, it produces a Knot on the Tissue of Creation. But the Architects have no Threads. They come from another world!

There where Threads break because of them, the Tissue of Creation breaks, too, but the pattern always tends to restore its predetermined shape. You are the Needle that can sew up the hole. Thus you need strength not only from our world, but from the other one, too. Do you understand? To sew up the hole and restore the Pattern, you need a piece of the Architects' world!

The elven sorceress, Lucille, has been studying our enemies all this time. You should talk to her!

checkText.en: The whirl of vague images won't let you concentrate...

finishText.en: The space around the mysterious whirl of time distorts heavily. You feel as if you are being pulled towards it. The destruction of the Architect cores seems to have seriously affected the connection between the space and the time. Is it for the better or for the worse?..

goal.en: Destroy Architect Cores near the Distortion of time in the wrecked Alliance ship on the west shore.

startText.en: If I am right, then by destroying an enemy core there where a Thread from Sarnaut broke, you are interrupting the natural course of events. A hole appears in the Tissue of Creation, and you can untangle a knot in the Pattern...

checkText.en: The space trembles and shifts...

finishText.en: Here comes our hero! You have not only saved the survivors in the Opalescent harbor, but secured the supplies that were meant to be sent to the frontline!

goal.en: Enter the Time Distortion near the ship wrecks and find out what happened to the Alliance fleet. Return to Mikhail Furzikov.

startText.en: Through the veil of distorted space you can see images of the Astral, the pier, sand shores... This Distortion seems to go deeper than any other.

checkText.en: Ha, I've been looking for you!

finishText.en: We need to figure out how the Architects stop time. You know that it slows down around their monoliths, and Archonts are capable of freezing it completely in a specific radius! This is what confuses me most. Time is not a piece of matter that can be stretched on one side and squeezed on the other. I want to try out a theory, and I will need your help.

goal.en: Meet Eladia in the Iron City.

startText.en: Stop by Eladia. She has come up with something.

checkText.en: Kill some twenty bats, and I will reward you.

finishText.en:
Well done! Here, take your reward.

They are gone now, but they will be back tomorrow. So feel free to stop by!

goal.en: Kill bats near the lighthouse and return to Svan Silent.

startText.en:
You say Bartha sent you? What a good girl...

If you see their family, tell them I'm fine. I can't leave the lighthouse because of the bats - the light attracts them, so I have to keep an eye on them constantly.

If you wish to help, you can kill some twenty of them. I will pay you!

finishText.en: What do you want? I'm very busy!

goal.en: Visit Svan Silent in the lighthouse on the west shore of Dane.

startText.en:
Oh heya! Have you seen a lone gibberling in the market - looking gloomy and with a scraggly beard? His name is Svan. No? I am asking because he is old and lonely - his whole family is dead. My and my brother are trying to keep him company when we can. But now he is sitting all alone in the lighthouse, and I am worried about him.

Can you pay him a visit for us, please?

checkText.en: Welcome! What do you want?

finishText.en: Oh, berries! I bet the old man told you to do that? He's a big fan of my infusion. Well, thank you, and take your reward. If you want, you can come again tomorrow.

goal.en: Collect berries and bring them to Bjorn Copper in the inn in Dubovo.

startText.en:
Listen, I have run out of my soul medicine... Bjorn makes fine juniper infusion, but he never has the time to collect juniper berries.

If you want to earn some money, pick some berries and bring them to Bjorn. Tell him I promised you payment.

checkText.en: I wish I had some meat...

finishText.en: Great! Now I have something to feed people with... At least for today. If you have the time, come again tomorrow - I will pay you!

goal.en: Obtain Argali meat and bring it to Bjorn Copper in Dubovo.

startText.en:
Since I restored the inn, the people have been coming in flocks. And they have drained my supplies! I have nothing to serve them.

I know you're a hunter. Can you go hunt some Argali in the mountains? They taste just like lamb! I will pay you generously.

finishText.en: Welcome, dear guests! What is it? The lumbermen's dinner? Ah, I totally forgot! I have so many things to do around here...

goal.en: Meet Bjorn Copper in the inn in Dubovo.

startText.en:
Hey, are you going to the inn? There is one in Dubovo! You should have a drink there.

And please tell Bjorn, the innkeeper, that we are waiting for the delivery we ordered. He promised to send us some food!

checkText.en: I'm so sick of the toads!

finishText.en:
Well done, kylys.

I hope I won't see them again today. But they will surely be here again tomorrow, so it would be great if you could help us out one more time!

goal.en: Kill poisonous toads near the Copper lake and report to Khuus-Shosha.

startText.en:
Toads... I hate toads, eysh! They are poisonous, too. I wish we could get rid of them so that they stop attacking my people!

Will you help us, zoor? We will surely reward you!

checkText.en: Please kill those nasty spiders!

finishText.en:
You killed the spiders? That's great news.

Here, take your reward. If I need help again, I will call for you.

goal.en: Kill Venomous Spiders on the shore and return to Octobrina Zaklepkina.

startText.en:
Are you ready to serve your motherland, comrade? I see the desire to help in your eyes!

We have a problem with spiders here. Their lair is not far from here, and they have already captured three goblins.

Now the rest of the goblins refuse to work before we get rid of the beasts. If you could kill some of them, we would be very grateful.

checkText.en: Could you please drive the undead back to the ground where they belong? You would do me a great favor.

finishText.en: Well done, well done! At least for today, they won't bother us. If you want some money, come again tomorrow!

goal.en: Kill the undead in the cemetery near the Iron City and return to Mikhail Kolchugin.

startText.en:
The cemetery is a mess! I recklessly left it unattended. And now it's swarming with the undead and vampires! They are scaring the hell out of my people.

Could you please drive them back to the ground where they belong? You would do me a great favor.

checkText.en: Kill the harpies, and I will reward you!

finishText.en:
Thank you, kylys.

Please take this humble reward. Come again tomorrow - the harpies will surely return and keep on stealing from us, eysh!

goal.en: Kill harpies near the refugee camp and return to Saad-Ankha.

startText.en:
They stole my mirror again. For the third time this week, eysh! Those were harpies - I know they have a nest somewhere around. They steal everything they see in the camp!

Can you help us, zoor? I will find something to pay you with.

checkText.en: Please, help us! Find the wounded soldiers and help them reach the healers' tent.

finishText.en: I do not have enough words to thank you!

goal.en: Help Olesya Podorogova find wounded soldiers on Kurbatskoe field and carry them to the hospital.

startText.en:
Oh my goodness, there are so many wounded soldiers on the battlefield!

Please, help us! Find them and help them reach the healers' tent. I hope we can at least soothe their pain.

checkText.en: How can I help you?

finishText.en: So that was Hoof who sent the bandits to rob our supply trains? This is weird. He is a traitor, but not a fool. He wins nothing if we lose.

goal.en: Find Brand the Minotaur on Kurbatskoe field and ask him to translate the letter.

startText.en: These letters looks like the ones inscribed on the jackets of some minotaurs. You should find one and ask them to translate this text.

checkText.en: If you see an aggressive animal, kill it!

finishText.en: Silence, finally! Now we can hear if the enemy is approaching.

goal.en: Kill aggressive wolves and foxes in the Squirrel Grove and return to the Daring Family.

startText.en:
We have another request for you.

When the Architects showed up in the forest, the animals have gone frantic. They attack everyone they see, howl and shriek...

It is important that we keep low profile, you see? We don't have the time to settle this peacefully, so please, get rid of the crazy forest dwellers.

checkText.en: If you have a couple of spare minutes, could you please bring me some owl feathers and centipede venom so that I can make new arrows?

finishText.en: Ay-hya, I'm so grateful! This will be enough for a whole quiver!

goal.en: Obtain owl feathers and centipede venom in the Squirrel Grove and return to Laan-Angyr.

startText.en:
Don't worry about me, kylys, I'm fine. Thank you for what you've done!

It's a shame though I've lost all my arrows.

If you have a couple of spare minutes, could you please bring me some owl feathers and centipede venom so that I can make new ones?

checkText.en: When will this war be over? I miss my village.

finishText.en: You deserve a medal!

goal.en: Defeat Navel in the ogre camp and return to Vasily Terkin.

startText.en:
Have you seen their leader? The fat one?

My guess is that he told his tribesman to attack our camp. If we get rid of him, we will have one less problem. But I wouldn't go at him alone if I were you!

checkText.en: They will regret the day they decided to intrude in our camp!

finishText.en: Now the ogres will finally leave us alone!

goal.en: Kill ogres in the camp and return to Vasily Terkin.

startText.en: We saved our fellows, but this is not enough. The ogres will get hungry and come again tomorrow. You are an experienced warrior, it wouldn't be a problem for you to teach them a lesson that would keep them away from our camp!

checkText.en: The ogres took my crossbow away when they kidnapped me. It must be somewhere in their camp.

finishText.en:
Thank you! Thank you so much!

I swear, if this war continues, my arrows will serve us well!

goal.en: Find the lost crossbow in the ogre camp and return to Alina Moldagulova.

startText.en:
I don't feel comfortable asking you that after everything that you've done for us, but can you please look for my crossbow? It used to belong to my grandfather, who was a first-class shooter. This crossbow was my only memory of him!

The ogres took it away when they kidnapped me. It must be somewhere in their camp.

checkText.en:
Alina holds the record - fourteen cores!

Can you beat it?

finishText.en: Fifteen? Really? Congratulations, you are the new champion!

goal.en: Destroy Furies in the Squirrel Grove and return to Sidor Kolpakov.

startText.en:
We are having a contest - who kills most furies in one raid. Currently, Alina is the champion - she brought fourteen cores after a night in the wood!

Will you beat this record?

checkText.en: How can I help you?

finishText.en: May the Light save his Spark! I will make sure to fulfill his last wish...

goal.en: Find the ring that was swallowed by the wolves and bring it to Susanne de Vevre.

startText.en:
A pile of picked bones is all that's left of the poor guy. Judging by his uniform, he used to be a boatswain on a ship.

This medallion was among the bones, and this letter was inside of it. It says that in case of sailor's death, his ring should be sent to his family. But there is no ring to be seen! Maybe the animals swallowed it?

checkText.en: Bring us ten rope pieces, and this ladder will be solid enough to carry an ogre!

finishText.en: See? Now it's much more comfortable!

goal.en: Help the Spinner Family find rope pieces, take the ready ladder and install it on the White Fortress bridge.

startText.en:
Will you help us?

The Architects have destroyed all the stairs. Izbor told us to make a rope ladder so that we can move freely between the floors. We need some ten pieces of rope to make it work!
