checkText.en: Kill the Archean and bring me his remains! We will also see if your protection is as strong as Unn says.

finishText.en: Well, let's take a look at you. I don't see any signs of changes... It means our little seeress somehow did what I couldn't - she invented an efficient protection from temporal magic. How did she do that?..

goal.en: Kill the Archean on the lower floor of the White Fortress and bring his remains to Eladia.

startText.en:
We found another Archean at the lower floor of the fortress. Archeans are the most smart and strong soldiers of the Architect army. Only Archonts are above them!

Unn says that you are now protected from the impact of temporal magic. Please, kill the monster! You will test your protection, and I will get some valuable samples for my studies!

checkText.en: Ah, these swords are more like toothpicks to me!

finishText.en:
Great! I will give these to our best fighters.

If we keep on giving new swords to some ham-handed rookies, we will have nothing left to fight with but hammers and shafts in a week time, huh!

goal.en: Take swords from the Soulless in the White Fortress and bring them to Sheave the Ferrous.

startText.en: Hey, have you seen any Soulless guys around here? We're running short on sharp weapons - it takes just a couple of killed Architects to blunt a fine sword! If you see any Soulless, punch 'em in the mug and bring their weapons to me.

checkText.en: I need the energy spheres. Preferably, all of them.

finishText.en: Excellent! Now I just mustn't mess up the polarity, or we are going to end up in the Astral.

goal.en: Collect cannon accumulators in the White Fortress and bring them to Agnes de Desirae.

startText.en:
Hey there! I'm Agnes, the Portal Keeper, and you are my new assistant.

I have a very important task for you. We need to restore the Portal, and it requires an energy supply. We can get some accumulators from the siege cannons on the walls. There is plenty of energy in each of them!

checkText.en: If you see a cultist, kill them at the spot!

finishText.en: So the cultists were summoning demons? I must report to Izbor on that. We need a squad of Demon Hunters to keep this situation under control.

goal.en: Kill the cultists and the summoned demon near the White Fortress and return to Alonso de Desirae.

startText.en: I think I saw a hooded person next to the demon, and I'm pretty sure it was a cultist! There where cultists show up, expect trouble. Kill them before it happens!

finishText.en: Cultists' papers? I will hand them to Izbor immediately!

goal.en: Bring the cultists' report to Alonso de Desirae.

startText.en:
This hastily written report didn't reach its intended recipient.

It says that the cultists are looking for a way to destroy the Architects. To do that, they implemented their people into the Alliance army. Here, they were testing one of their strategies of pitching the Demons and the Architects against each other.

I wonder how many of them are among us? We should hand this report to Alonso.

checkText.en: The damned werebears have plundered our food supplies! They even took the horse!

finishText.en: Thank you, friend! I don't know what I would do without you.

goal.en: Take the bags with food from werebears in the wood near the Bee Ravine and bring them to Mikhail Kochanov.

startText.en:
Hey there! Can you give me a hand?

I fell behind our food carts, and when I caught up with them, I found them plundered by the darn werebears! They knocked me out, too, and when I woke up, they were gone! I can't return to the camp empty-handed. Our commander will kill me!

checkText.en: Kill Fang. I don't like him.

finishText.en: A mask? This is curious... Why would an Architect wear a mask? They don't have faces, they don't even have identities.

goal.en: Kill Broken Fang in the Bee Ravine and discuss the found thing with someone.

startText.en:
We're hungry. There were many food. But stone aliens came and kicked us out. Then another stone alien came and killed those who kicked us out. We saw that.

We didn't know where to go. We said - to the north. Broken Fang said to the west. We fought. Fang won. Now he's the leader.

Kill Fang. I will be the leader again. And I will give you the thing. You will like it.

checkText.en: Find a proper stone to crave the girls' names in it, and pick some wild flowers. The girls loved them so much...

finishText.en: I told the commander not to accept them as volunteers! But they were stubborn. I had a feeling that something bad was going to happen...

goal.en: Pick wild flowers in the Bee Ravine, find a tombstone and return to Fedot Vaskov.

startText.en:
I wish I was dead and not my poor girls! They won't even resurrect now.

I will cherish the memory of them... I loved them so much, even though I didn't know them for long. I wish I could erect a memorial in their honor, but I can barely walk... Will you help me?

checkText.en: Carve the names, come on.

finishText.en:
This is it... They could have had good lives, give birth to children, become grandmothers - but now their threads are gone, cut by the knife of war.

Leave me alone, please...

goal.en: Follow Fedot's instructions and carve the girls' names to the tomb stone.

startText.en:
Ah, they sacrificed their lives! I tried as hard as I could to protect them in battle, but in the ironic twist of fate, I survived, and they died in front of my eyes...

Take this piece of iron and carve their names! You have a steady hand and a sharp eye. Let the stone preserve the memory of them...

checkText.en: If we keep on spending this much ammunition, we will soon run out of it.

finishText.en:
Procurement of low-quality ammunition in time of war is a diversion! The military tribunal would pass a death sentence for this sabotage!

If a single bomb from the next shipment fails to explode, I will shove it down the throat of the chief alchemist!

goal.en: Collect dud bombs from the battlefield and bring them to Evdokia Bershanska.

startText.en: Ah, I almost forgot. The bombs that the alchemists from the Iron City produce for us are worthless. Every other one doesn't explode! Could you please collect those dud bombs from the battlefield? I will send them back to the alchemists and require three new bombs for each unexploded one!

checkText.en: Hey, can you help me out with the monsters in the river?

finishText.en: Are you sure they're all dead on the bottom?

goal.en: Destroy the Architects in the water and return to Seal the Maritime.

startText.en:
Hey! Can you imagine what happened to me?

They told to bring water from the river - you know, we don't have enough to cook some porridge, let alone to take a shower.

So, I went to the river, and the bastards almost ate me! Some kind of underwater Architects, or whatever. As long as they are there, there is no way I'm coming near that river again.

checkText.en: If you want to help, find the broken prostheses of our hero. I'm sure our engineers can repair them.

finishText.en: These are the prostheses of Yasskul Mares! I am so grateful! I will get them repaired immediately.

goal.en: Find Yasskul Mares' prostheses on the crash site on the Spilt Hill and bring them to Anna Krasavkina.

startText.en:
Oh hello! You wish to visit Mares, too? I'm sorry, he cannot be bothered right now. He's been through too much strain. His ship crashed, and he crawled on his hands all the way through the forest to reach us!

He is utterly upset that he had to leave his broken leg prostheses behind. If we could find them, I'm sure our engineers would repair them in no time!

checkText.en: Bring me several Filbert berries.

finishText.en:
You feel that smell? No? Ha! This is exactly what is so special about ripe Filbert - it has no smell at all!

Wait a minute, the decoction is almost ready!

goal.en: Find Filbert berries in the Bee Ravine and bring them to Unn.

startText.en:
So what is this "face"?

We seers know a way to look behind the Tissue of Creation and see the shadows of the past. All that I need is a decoction made of Filbert berries. I saw several Filbert bushes outside of the camp.

Just don't try to eat one yourself!

finishText.en: It turns out we have two enemies instead of one. The Architects are just rough force, like a locust plague. But the Sculptor... Who knows what he wants? I fear that he will bring us much trouble...

goal.en: Drink the potion in the place where the Architects fought each other, see the images of the past and return to Unn.

startText.en:
Here you go! Careful, it's hot.

Find the place the werebear described and drink the potion there. Then you will see the fight between the Architects.

Just take no more than a couple of sips!

checkText.en: Listen, you can do that, can't you? Would you do us a favor and get rid of the bastards?

finishText.en:
Wow! You are the real boss!

Here, take this money from us. You deserve a jug of fine brew in the tavern!

goal.en: Eliminate the Architects near the monolith in the west part of the Shore City and return to Stomp the Merciless.

startText.en:
Hello there! How are you doin'?

You see, we have a trouble here. We can't even approach that stone thing without getting stuck like flies in... ahem.

Listen, you can do that, can't you? Would you do us a favor and get rid of the bastards?

checkText.en: Do you see them? Tell me you see them!

finishText.en:
I knew I wasn't crazy! So this was all because of a doll?!

I will burn it! Oh, I wish I could get my hands on the villain who cursed it!

goal.en: Use the doll to destroy the shadows that haunt poor Yevsey and tell him what you saw.

startText.en:
You see them? But I do! I am not crazy. They are like dark shadows... Huge, scary shadows. They are everywhere! My daughter saw them, too. She said Punch saw them as well.

Punch is my daughter's doll.

You want to see it? Just don't break it - it's all I have left from my daughter.

checkText.en: First the Architects, now trolls...

finishText.en:
Whoa! You beat them all on your own! It was unbelievable!

Thank you so much. Take this humble reward.

And tell Furzikov that from now on there will be no interruption in wood deliveries!

goal.en: Eliminate trolls near the Shore City sawmill and return to Demian Polenov.

startText.en: We have a problem with trolls here. They came from the mountains and now think they are the masters of this forest! We cannot send men to fetch wood without risking their lives. Tell Furzikov, as long as there are trolls in the forest, there will be no planks!

finishText.en: Hey, are you the help that our commandant promised to send?

goal.en: Meet Demian Polenov at the sawmill.

startText.en:
Twenty measures of flour... Thirty kilos of steel... Hey, what are you doing here?

You are expected at the sawmill. Furzikov told me to send somebody right away. You are that somebody. The sawmill is on the north, and its owner is called Demian. Go, now!

checkText.en: Did you find the slacker? When he shows up, give him a kick from me!

finishText.en: Here he is! If he slacks off again, this time I will bury him in the trench!

goal.en: Find the goblin slacker near the shore fortification and bring him to Screw the Brainy.

startText.en:
The damned goblins are refusing to work! They are lazy as hell. I sent one to collect stones for the pavement, and he is still nowhere to be seen. I can't go looking for him myself and leave the rest of the idlers unattended.

Since you are here, can you go and find him? Eh?

finishText.en: So she couldn't think of anything better than to send a war hero? She's out of her mind.

goal.en: Meet Screw the Brainy near the shore fortifications on the southern shore.

startText.en:
Ah, I almost forgot! The workers that rebuild the destroyed fortification on the shore asked me to send somebody to help them. Their commander is called Screw, or Nail, or something like that... I'm sorry, I'm way too busy to go there myself.

So what do we have here... Five barrels of fish... Furry slippers... Furry slippers?!

checkText.en: Maybe you found at least a piece of wire? No?

finishText.en: Hurray! A whole handful of gears! Thank you!

goal.en: Take the gears from the otters on the swamp and return them to Octobrina Zaklepkina.

startText.en:
Have you seen a bag with iron gears around here? No?

I must have lost it somewhere in the swamp. Those nasty otters wouldn't let us make a step without biting at our feet! I'm sure they stole the bag, too. How am I supposed to repair the mana pipe without the gears?

checkText.en: Crabs, lobsters... Who else could it be?

finishText.en: Ha! You did it. I bet these claws are edible!

goal.en: Tear off the claws of the lake creatures and return to Bone the Riverine.

startText.en:
Hey there, can you swim? Great! You see, I happen to have aquaphobia. A fisherwoman who is afraid of water! This is odd indeed.

Some creatures keep on tearing my nets. Can I ask you to dive and see what is going on down there? I would be extremely grateful.

checkText.en: The Portal is active, and it is ready to deliver you... Where?

finishText.en: What are you doin'?! You gone crazy? We're all dead now, man!

goal.en: Enter the Portal and find out where the fanatics took Eladia.

startText.en: Now when you have the key, you just need to enter the Portal and find out where and why they took Eladia!

checkText.en: Clang-clang!

finishText.en: If you go over the bridge, you will see a big outpost where the bandits took a ginger and very loud wingless woman. We wanted to kill the bandits, but there were too many of them. So we wait. Then other bandits walked out of the outpost and went to the wingless village - then we attacked and killed all bandits... With your help, of course.

goal.en: Defeat bandits who threaten the village in the Silver Valley.

startText.en:
You think it's just them? You're not very bright, are you? Their friends will be here soon, and when they see what you did to their mates, they will knock our brains out.

I know they will come for sure - I heard them saying they would return after they'd taken the ginger lady to the castle. So what do we do now? Do we hide in the woods, or maybe you will deal with the rest of them as easily as you smashed this gang?

checkText.en: Help! Help!

finishText.en: Oh, thank you! If you came several minutes later, they would be already picking my bones... But where did they come from? I've never seen such wolves in our forests!

goal.en: Find the lost girl near the village in the Silver Valley and help her return to her sister.

startText.en:
Oh what a disaster! My sister's gone. She's such a beauty - the bandits kept on pestering her with indecent proposals, so she spat one of them in the face, kicked another one in the crotch - and ran off to the forest!

I am afraid she might get hurt... did you hear those wolves howling every night?

checkText.en: So, did ya get somethin'?

finishText.en: Whoa, thank you so much fella! I will remember that.

goal.en: Find bandit stashes in the woods near the village in the Silver Valley and retrieve the stolen possessions.

startText.en:
Wait, friend! You wanna help? Listen to me. The bandits are gettin' completely out of hand - they are robbin' us poor fellas blind! But then I heard one of them tellin' another that they'd left everything they stole in the forest instead of hiding it in the castle.

I'd go there myself, but there are so many wolves in there these days - they scare the hell out of me! And you're not timid, right? Why don't you go?

checkText.en: You speak with the chiefs?

finishText.en: Chaak warrior comes and wants fight. Crag warrior comes and brandished his old axe and swears loudly. Very angry! My father promised to deplume me, but I don't believe him - he loves me. He gave me brave warriors to help me fight the bandits. Are you coming, too?

goal.en: Talk three Aviak chiefs into starting a war against Hoof's bandits and meet Cual Hard-Beak.

startText.en:
Did you hear the old tale about an old Aviak, his sons and a bunch of cane? There are three winged chiefs in the Valley - Irchi, Chaak, and Crag. If they all agree to fight the bandits, we win! If we fight on our own, we will break just like cane.

Irchi is my father. He will agree easily - we live close to the village and have to deal with the bandits all the time.

But Chaak and Crag are different. Will you talk to them? When we gather our warriors, the evil bandit will be defeated!

checkText.en: Will you help me pick good weapons?

finishText.en:
You think this is a good weapon? It is ugly. Heavy... Ouch! And sharp!

It breaks armor? It breaks helmets? Then it is good!

goal.en: Pick up weapons of killed bandits near the village in the Silver Valley and give them to Cual Hard-Beak.

startText.en:
We don't do wars, wingless. Since our ancestors came to these mountains, we only take up spears for hunting. Spears are bad for killing wingless bandits. A better weapon is needed!

Do you know much about weapons? Bandits drop many weapons when they die. Help me pick good ones. And I will give them to my people so that they can beat the bandits!

checkText.en: Kill the wolves and then I will believe you can fight!

finishText.en: I hear howling and whimper... You are a good warrior. It is an honor to fight next to you!

goal.en: Kill hungry wolves in the Silver Valley and return to Chaak Deplumed.

startText.en:
Fight the bandits? Do you even know how to hold a spear? Bandits are good warriors, and I don't know anything about you. If you want to fight along with us, you must prove that you are worthy.

There is a wolf pack in the mountains. They are evil and dangerous. We don't like them. You must kill all the wolves. Then I will believe you and take you to battle with the bandits. We don't like bandits, too.

checkText.en: No, wingless. We buried the axe of war. We no longer fight.

finishText.en:
Ah you stupid wingless! Why would you dig out the Battle Axe? Why would you disturb the dormant spirits? Now the axe will know no peace until we start a war...

So be it, we will help you beat the bandits, stupid wingless. But you should stay away from our village afterwards, or I will break your head with this axe!

goal.en: Dig out the old Battle Axe at the Aviak cemetery in the Silver Valley and show it to Crag Big-Nest.

startText.en:
War? My people don't go to war! For a long time now. The spirits say that a poor peace is better than a good fight.

The previous chief liked to fight, so we buried him along with his battle axe. No axe - no battles, so the spirits say!

checkText.en: Go! Go! Kill the bandits, free the prisoners. We will be heroes!

finishText.en:
Oh, I thought no one would ever come to rescue us... Thank you so much, friend! I will name my child after you! What was your name again?..

Well... Anyway, I am eternally grateful!

goal.en: Attack the outpost in the Silver Valley, defeat the bandits, kill their leader, and release the prisoners.

startText.en:
We are ready to fight! Ahead is that outpost were they take the prisoners. There are many bandits! And many prisoners. We will kill the bandits and release all prisoners. They will call us their saviors! And there will be peace again!

You go ahead. The bandits will think you are one of them, and while they are distracted, we will fall right on their heads! They are not expecting us, and they will surrender immediately. I am sure!

finishText.en:
Scum! Wretched stinking rats! Morons! Damn you and your Prophet! Screw your Hoof and your cursed gold! Phew... I needed to let the steam out.

You are right on time. They almost got me... But who are you? I don't remember your face!

goal.en: Continue chasing the fanatics who took Eladia to Winter Palace.

startText.en:
What? Ginger lady? Right, I saw one. The Initiates took her. They said that the Prophet was eager to see her. What did he find in her? If you ask me, she's way too skinny.

Anyway, they took the girl to the castle and told the bandits to wait here until they bring some creature along... They called it the Experiment. They said it was a very very important creature. And one of them also said that the lady had chopped the first Experiment as a cabbage head!

checkText.en: This is just crazy...

finishText.en:
I couldn't watch them do those horrible things anymore. Who does that to people? Are they monsters or what?

I thought I'd rather eat roots in the mountains than cringe before those bastards! They don't let us in the castle and they keep prisoners in our camp. So I helped those who could still walk escape. Too bad the fanatics caught up with us! So you're right on time!

goal.en: Listen to Arrow the Fierce

startText.en:
So Chelezny got rid of the stone dummies and finally decided to get his hands on his assistant? You see, we regret the day we listened to him, too...

Gold, he said! Diamonds, he said! Huh! Hoof has gone bananas over money. And he ain't got nothing! While he's sittin' in the castle and pretending to be rich, those Prophet's puppets twist us round their fingers! And if you refuse to do what they say, they can easily just take you out in the name of their "Order". To hell with such order! I'd rather do to prison, I swear!

checkText.en: Stop hacking around, go save the tailed girl!

finishText.en: My guess is that when they run out of prisoners, they will start chopping us up. They're psychos.

goal.en: Kill fanatics near the ruins in the Silver Valley and speak with the rescued prisoner.

startText.en: A ginger girl? No, I haven't seen her. But I saw one with a tail. There are some old ruins not far from here, and the fanatics were carrying her there. She was a witch or something. I bet they weren't going sightseeing. Trust me, they will kill her if you don't hurry.

checkText.en: So, are they in?

finishText.en: You again?! I don't want to go back to the Purgatory!

goal.en: Talk bandits into starting a riot, break into the camp near Winter Palace, and help bandits defeat the fanatics.

startText.en: Listen, I have an idea. My pals are already sick and tired of these muffled bastards. If you promise them pardon on behalf of Ivan, they will be happy to tear them to pieces. I shouldn't show up anywhere near the camp - they think I'm kinda traitor, but nobody knows you. Tell them you're a friend, talk them into starting a riot - and those who refuse... well, you know how to deal with those!

checkText.en: What do you want?

finishText.en:
Cuaarr! You came back! I was worried about you.

Did you find your redhead lady? No? Why? Maybe I can help?

goal.en: Continue chasing the fanatics who took Eladia to Winter Palace. In case of failure, return to the camp.

startText.en:
Get off me! You think I'm enjoying it? This isn't what we expected at all - not what Hoof had promised us! Ivan was a jerk, but at least he paid us on time and didn't make us cut people... What do we do? We don't have any choice now.

Your sorceress is not here. They took her to Winter Palace. If you hurry, you may catch up with them.

finishText.en: Kyarr! Stay right where you are!

goal.en: Find the sorceress in the mountains of the Silver Valley and ask her for help.

startText.en:
Evil wingless took your woman to Winter Palace? Ah, I'm sorry to hear that! You can only fly up there, and I'm afraid I cannot take you - the wind is too strong in the mountains. But I know how to help you!

An old and wise sorceress lives in these woods. She can turn a wingless into a toad, I know that for sure. Maybe, she can also turn you into a bird? Then you can fly to the palace and see where the wingless hide your woman. And I will fly to the Iron City and bring help!

checkText.en: Bring me snow berries and feathers, and I will brew the potion. You will fly like a bird!

finishText.en: Good berries, thick feathers. The potion will be strong!

goal.en: Gather snow berries, obtain feathers of mountain eagles and bring them to Agata Black in the Silver Valley.

startText.en:
What? You want me to charm you? You weirdo! However, I know you - my grandson told me about you. He was here just now. He told me good things about you, so I will help you.

What do you want? To get into the castle, right? You will need wings. I can give you them easily! I just need some snow berries and feathers to make the potion. You will drink it and get your wings!

checkText.en: Are you going to drink the potion?

finishText.en: You're back! I'm so glad! The guests are already waiting for you. I think they will easily solve your problem with the wings!

goal.en: Drink the potion and reach Winter Palace.

startText.en: Here is the potion! Just one sip, and you will fly like a bird. Just be careful - if anybody notices you, the charm will be dispelled. I can't turn you into a real bird, you know - that's a one-way process. But you will get into the castle, as I promised. So, are you going to drink it?

checkText.en: Do we tackle up the Gryphons?

finishText.en: Hm, you are late. Well, the beautiful princess, that is me, is saved; what do we do now? You don't have a clue? Luckily, I do.

goal.en: Ride Bershanska's Gryphon, bomb the fanatics in the Winter Palace yard and release Eladia.

startText.en:
Why are we here? Well, you can thank that funny Aviak, Cual, who barely made it to the Iron City and fell right on the city hall and told us about the air path across the old ravine. The Alliance commanders realized there was a way to reach the valley by air, so they alerted us right away. We rushed here as fast as our Gryphons could.

So, who do we need to bomb? Just point your finger!

It's a shame Eclipse can't make it past Fractal... It could have erased them with just two volleys!

checkText.en: Listen closely, I won't say it twice.

finishText.en: You see what the problem is? If the Sculptor succeeds in creating a chimera out of human and Architect flesh which is capable of believing, we will face a catastrophe which is comparable to the invasion of Dane! This is what the Prophet and the fanatics want - to create an army of artificial chimeras who know no doubt or hesitation and believe in the divinity of the Sculptor.

goal.en: Listen to Eladia.

startText.en: First, you need to remember - fanatics are not just funny idiots with leaflets. They are perfectly organized, astute and merciless. I admit, I was a little intimidated myself by their methods of combining living and dead tissue. If Tep were alive, he would have bowed his head before these slaughterers. The most curious thing is that they are ready to do the same to themselves! That "Ascension" is their ultimate goal. But there's more...

checkText.en: If we don't deal with the fanatics today, tomorrow it may be too late!

finishText.en: Oh my... Living statues in the yard - and a stone half-god on the roof! I must admit, I wasn’t expecting that. Now I am even more eager to meet the Sculptor, but our friend is cautious as a fox... Well, I’m sure, we will meet one day, and then I will beat the hell out of him. But for now, the threat is eliminated - the fanatics are scattered, the bandits surrendered to the mercy of the court, so this side of Dane is out of danger!

goal.en: Take Winter Palace by storm and eliminate the new cult.

startText.en:
I personally believe that there are way too many gods, half-gods and other enthusiasts in our world. We need to reduce their ranks, and start with that big-mouthed goblin who calls himself the Prophet, and the dumb minotaur who called me... oh, never mind.

Any objections? No? I thought so!

Come on, gather your squad and let's go!

checkText.en: I give you Copecks, you kill the wolf. It's a fair deal!

finishText.en: A good wolf is a dead wolf. If you do a good job, I will give you Copecks! If you want more Copecks, come again tomorrow!

goal.en: Kill wolves in the Silver Valley and return to Chaak Deplumed.

startText.en: There are many wolves left in the mountains. So I offer you a deal: you kill the wolves, and I give you Copecks. I have many Copecks. You know that people in the Iron City love Copecks - they sell trinkets and firewater for them! Do you agree?

checkText.en: Fly on the wings of terror!

finishText.en: Boom, boom! Let it all burn and smoke! If you want to do this again, come back tomorrow!

goal.en: Ride Bershanska's Gryphon and bomb the fanatics in the Winter Palace yard.

startText.en: Again we noticed some movement in the castle yard. Looks like some fanatics are still alive, and we are going to make them regret that! We have plenty of bombs, so if you want to join us and turn the elven cultural heritage into smoking ruins, just mount a Gryphon and rain fire!

checkText.en: Are you still here?

finishText.en: What are you doing here?! I thought you'd never come to Yazes again after what happened with Gorluxor.

goal.en: Ask Klavdia Kalugina to open the Portal to Gorluxor's Tower and meet Adam Verkhovin.

startText.en:
I don't know how badly Sarn's mind was damaged. Madmen are unpredictable, and our plan can easily fail if Sarn doesn't do what we expect him to.

It's a shame Catherina doesn't remember anything from the time of her obsession, and the second man who ever faced the imprisoned god was killed by you. I mean Gorluxor, of course.

However, we might find something useful in his tower. It was almost completely destroyed during the battle, but we should search the ruins anyway.

checkText.en: I'll be damned...

finishText.en:
Damn it, did I ask you to interfere? I was doing alright!

What are you doing here anyway?

goal.en: Find Rogneda Boykova in the bottom part of the tower.

startText.en:
Well, there's a ceasefire between us and the League at the moment. We are supposed to be studying Gorluxor's legacy together, but actually we're just slouching around and fighting off the demons from the lower floors while Yasker and Aidenus are settling things.

If you ask me, there's nothing more to find in these ruins. But if you still want to go through them, you first need to get the permission from Rogenda, the League commander. She just went down to check on the lower floors.

checkText.en: Could you please find our spellcaster?

finishText.en: Oh, here he is!

goal.en: Find the lost spellcaster on the lower floor of Gorluxor's tower and bring him to Rogneda.

startText.en:
So you are studying Gorluxor's legacy? Do you have a license? No? I thought so.

But I'm going to let you do this anyway - maybe you will find something useful while the Great Mages are negotiating. However, I will ask you to return the favor. One of my spellcasters has wandered off and got lost on the lower levels. Will you look for him?

checkText.en: Well, did you find anything valuable?

finishText.en:
Well, well...

The diary only contains primitive spells and other magical gibberish, so never mind it.

The strongbox is more interesting. Why else would it be sealed with a curse? It will take some time to open it.

This journal seems the most valuable - it was written by Gorluxor himself. Alas, in a dead language that I don't know!

goal.en: Search Gorluxor's office and bring everything that is related to his service with Sarn to Klavdia Kalugina.

startText.en:
The tower is partly covered with a magical screen to protect it from monsters and cultists. Whoever tries to walk through it, is incinerated. So take this stone - it will allow you to pass the screen unharmed.

If you find anything interesting, don't forget to let us know. What if it's a state secret?

checkText.en: Erm... Where's my assistant?

finishText.en: Ah, colleague! Long time no see! I must admit without you and without wise Herbert's command the research hasn't been going too fast. I hope you brought a sledge-hammer!

goal.en: Go to the lab on Ferris and meet Yaver Gnostis.

checkText.en: Did you find anything interesting?

finishText.en:
Yes! This is the key! I feel its connection with the Seal... This is indeed the Seal of Order, as I supposed.

This is excellent! We just need to get another key, and I think I know where to look for it. Thanks to Zayan!

goal.en: Get into the locked laboratory and find Negus Jeeg's artifact.

startText.en:
The maps indicate this area as "Utility rooms", which pose no interest for us, especially since they are guarded by swarms of Mechanoids. I wish I knew some kind of magic which neutralized artificial intelligence.

However, this would leave me without my assistant, who is obviously not much smarter than the Mechanoids. I've sent him to get reinforcements, and now he is nowhere to be seen. If you could search for him, this would really speed up the research process.

finishText.en: What do you want again?

goal.en: Meet Catherina on Eclipse and ask her for help.

startText.en:
Let's say, I've bitten more than I can chew. Even with the help of Zayan and the Keys, I will not handle both Seals and the Gates. We will need at least one Great Mage. Aidenus and Yasker, as well as the rest of the Great Mages of the League and the Empire hate each other way too much, and their hatred can get in the way of our plans. That leaves us only with Catherina.

Eclipse is drifting near Dane right now. Find Catherina and tell her I need her help. I will meet her in the usual place.

checkText.en: Alien... I told you not to come back!

finishText.en: Alien... I told you not to come back! Your people are the enemy of my people!

goal.en: Go to Frontier, put on the Destroyer's Mask and find Kaid.

startText.en: There are many interesting things mentioned in this journal, but I was particularly intrigued by a "bowl" which opens up the way for the "Origins". At first I thought Gorluxor meant Ferris, but there were no bowls on Ferris! Then I remembered about the Destroyers on the Frontier... They believe in the Origins and use the power of the Seals. The "Bowl of Origins" can turn out to be a Seal Shard! And if I'm right, then it's the last key that we need.

checkText.en: Tell me why you are here and prepare to die.

finishText.en: Good luck, friend. If you happen to discover the temple and find anything interesting in it, let me know.

goal.en: Speak to Kaid, defeat him in combat, search his body, and return to Semer Shabas.

startText.en: I, Kaid, always keep my word! We are enemies, and only my curiosity stands between my sword and your heart. Tell me why you are here! If you need my answer, I will give it to you as a sign of respect to your courage. Then I will kill you as my Code tells me to!

checkText.en: The ancient gates strike with their magnificence...

finishText.en: You managed to surpass the security system. Now you just need to enter the temple and take the Shard away from the Destroyers!

goal.en: Reach the temple gates and find the way to get inside.

startText.en:
Ah, the key! Let me see... This is very interesting!

I will dare to suggest that this thing is incredibly old, and also, that this is not a key. It looks more like some kind of an amulet which works as a "friend/foe" detector. Junes used to implement such devices into their combat Golems. I would also suppose that this key is not enough to surpass the security mechanism. I am afraid this is all help that I can provide.

checkText.en: Where do we find the keys?

finishText.en:
Damn it! There's nothing in Gorluxor's Tower, nothing in the Pyramid, nothing from Tep... We can't do anything without the keys!

Okay, I need to calm down.

Alright, I'm fine. We still have the time, so let's continue searching.

goal.en: Obtain Seal Shards for Klavdia Kalugina.

startText.en:
It will take a lot of efforts to arrange the meeting of Sarn and the Architect on our terms. The Seals keep Sarn locked in his prison, and the Architect's mind dwells beyond Sarnaut, in his own world. My dad's creation - the Star Gates - will allow us to build a bridge between Sarnaut and Fractal. But what do we do about the Seals?

Some of them were damaged during the Cataclysm, and now their shards contain part of their power. You've seen some of them - Astral silver in the talisman of Kirah, Astral iron from the Dragon blood, Tep's black stone... They can be used as keys. We need to find at least two more of them.

finishText.en: Greetings! I guess it would be correct to guess that you come in the moment of great need again? What is it this time?

goal.en: Meet Zayan on Avilon and ask him to translate Gorluxor's journal.

startText.en:
Let me think... I guess I know who can help us translate it. Not only translate it, but also save the world, huh.

Find Zayan on Avilon, give him this journal, and tell him he has a debt to pay. He will understand.

finishText.en: Did he really say that? Anyway, he has agreed to help us, that is what matters. He is the oldest Mage in the world, and he knows about the Seals more than anyone. If he can help me handle them, our job will become much easier.

goal.en: Return to Klavdia and tell her that Zayan is ready to help.

startText.en:
What?! A debt to pay? Is she alive? How long has it been? I... am... not... Oh...

Sorry, I just didn't see that coming. Oh, it's been so many years! Of course, I will help. Whatever it takes!

What do I need to do? Translate this journal? Alright, I will start immediately. And tell her... Tell her House de Dernier still has the honor.

checkText.en: Here no one will hear us!

finishText.en:
Don't look so surprised!

I told you about Incarnations myself. You have mastered the basics, but I have gone much further than that.

goal.en: Go to Planar Rim together with Eladia and listen to what she has to say.

startText.en: Some things should only be discussed privately, if you know what I mean. You can be easily misunderstood when it comes to faith... Let's go to a quiet place and talk.

finishText.en: Catherina agreed to meet me? This is good. I have an offer she will not dare to turn down.

goal.en: Return to Klavdia Kalugina and tell her that Catherina is ready to help.

startText.en:
She is asking me to meet her? I can sense trouble already.

Alright, a debt must be repaid. I will meet her again. Her previous venture was rather... curious. Tell her to be there on time, and she'd better be very convincing!

checkText.en: Don't you trust me? Have I ever lied to you? I might have left something unsaid, but I never lied.

finishText.en: Well... I'm glad you understand.

goal.en: Listen to Klavdia in Planar Rim

startText.en:
Do you realize that Sarnaut is doomed? The victory over Master only postponed the inevitable - the Architect will never stop trying to enslave your world, just as Sarn will never stop trying to break out of his prison. We are between the rock and a hard place, and we don't have much time left.

I must admit I am partly responsible for this. Well, let me explain.

checkText.en: Let's go to the Pyramid!

finishText.en:
Ha, the Rebels have broken into the Pyramid after all! That must have been easy, since its master is gone anyway...

Now we can ask Sonin if they have found anything interesting. You're a hero - he will tell you everything.

goal.en: Ask Klavdia Kalugina to open the Portal to Tep's Pyramid and start the search.

startText.en:
There was another Great Mage apart from Gorluxor who was particularly interested in Sarn - I mean Tep, of course.

When I took possession of his Spark, the incredible power intoxicated me. I acted kind of recklessly, but I'm not going to apologize for that. There must be plenty of interesting things left in Tep's Pyramid. He knew many things about the Seals, and if we look through his Pyramid, I'm sure we will find another key.

checkText.en: So, did you have a little chat? Are you going to get to work now?

finishText.en: Interrogate a cultist? This is actually a good idea!

goal.en: Talk to Artem Sonin in Tep's Pyramid.

startText.en:
What a pleasant surprise! I'm glad to see you, friend!

To be honest, we are not doing too good. After Tep died, the cultists have gone frantic. We could only recapture the entrance to the Pyramid, but then we were stuck. Neither we can go further, nor they can break out.

So now we're just keeping the cultists inside and trying to eliminate as many Mechanoids as we can.

checkText.en: Well, did you find out anything?

finishText.en: So, an artifact created by Sihal? Well, at least now we know what we are looking for. We should visit his laboratory.

goal.en: Kill cultists in the left wing of the Pyramid, find a Prelate and use the Will Suppressor to make him speak about Tep's source of power.

startText.en: Here, take this Will Suppressor. All that you need is to find a high-profile cultist and strike him with this thing. If it doesn't work, strike again, and again, until he speaks.

checkText.en: Well, did you find anything?

finishText.en: Well, nobody said it would be easy. You should ask Sonin if he has any idea where they could have taken the artifact.

goal.en: Search Sihal's laboratory and find the divine weapon of the cultists.

startText.en: Oh... You go search for that miraculous cannon, or whatever Sihal made out of the key, and I will take some rest. You know, my powers are not infinite.

checkText.en: Keep closer to me!

finishText.en: Phew! I thought I wasn't going to make it.

goal.en: Escort Klavdia to Sihal's laboratory.

startText.en:
A mist which kills all living things, you say? It looks like a material embodiment of Darkness contained in the cracked Seal. These guys pose more threat than I thought. Even I can't handle pure Darkness, maybe just hold it back for a while.

Listen, come closer to me. Don't step out of the protective circle if you don't want to die before you can say knife!

Are you ready?

checkText.en: We need some spare parts to fix the elevator.

finishText.en: This looks good. We will start the repairs right away.

goal.en: Take the elevator down to the lower floors of the Pyramid, defeat the Mechanoids, pick up the remaining parts, and bring them to Artem Sonin.

startText.en:
The laboratory is empty? Let me think...

There's nothing else on this floor. We haven't seen anything that looked like a super-weapon around here, only an army of Mechanoids. And you can't go up - we've destroyed the elevator controls in the heat of battle. Maybe you can fix it though, if you find some spare parts.

The Mechanoids could probably provide some...

checkText.en: This is strange... I don't feel the magic of the Seal, although I should. We are connected after all.

finishText.en:
Oops! Haha. We have a problem. I hope you remember how to kill crazy immortal summoners?

Just don't tell anyone we accidentally resurrected Tep. I am afraid the Great Mages will not appreciate our fit of generosity...

goal.en: Take the elevator up to Tep’s lair, speak with Klavdia, and find out where the secret weapon is hidden.

startText.en:
The Rebels have repaired the elevator? Excellent. So, let's go down to Tep's lair! When I was there last time, I didn't see any "secret weapons", but you know, I was a little busy trying to save our Sparks. And then that divine power, euphoria, sardonic laughter, hasty flight...

Alright, what's done is done. Let's go see what Tep has left behind him.

finishText.en: It’s good that you’re here. We have to finish what we’ve started.

startText.en: You’ve got a message. “Return to the Observatory, we have some unfinished business. Cosmos.” What kind of name is that?

checkText.en: We’ve been waiting for you. Go to the Observatory.

finishText.en:
Watch the sky... Prepare for the war...

I swear the naivety of this world’s rulers amazes me. Nihaz isn’t the god of war. None of you really understands what words “God of Darkness” mean. I can’t blame you - none of you was ever supposed to understand that... The true understanding will only bring terror and deprive you of your will to live. And what are you without your will?..

goal.en: Watch the Great Mages’ dialogue.

startText.en:
Our interference with the past didn’t go unnoticed... I took the liberty to send my official representative to the Imperial Committee with an ultimatum - either they stop the unnecessary military action against their neighbors in this world, or I will raze their state to the ground and leave no memory of it in this world’s history. When my emissary reminded them about the Laboratory, their brains started boiling with all the dual memories... Let’s say, now they take us seriously. Unfortunately, I had to approach the League in almost the same way.

The most important thing is: now they’re ready to listen. And even stop rubbing their petty interests into our faces - at least, I hope so.

finishText.en:
Welcome, child. We’re all that’s left of the New Land.

And the New Land is all that’s left of our world...

goal.en: Escort Unn to the settlement.

startText.en:
I know... I know you! I remember.

Come closer - let me take a look at you...

My vision may be weak, but my memory is still clear... I remember! Ah, foolish child, what have you done again? I can see your thread - it’s all tangled like a snake who bit itself by mistake! The time will not accept you anymore...

Now you’re here, at the edge of the world.

I remember you on Dane as if it was yesterday! I forgot about you, and then I remembered! Do you get it? As if it was yesterday...

Come, come! You have to see and understand a lot, my child.

finishText.en: What do you want?

goal.en: Reach the Great Tree, lighting up the lanterns on your way to scatter the Darkness.

startText.en:
So you’re looking for someone... Someone who will help you defeat the Dark God? Anyone in this settlement will gladly help you! But... there are no more strong warriors or powerful sorcerers among us. Only the surviving apprentices of the Great Mages and what’s left of the militia...

I know who you’re looking for.

You need to go to the Great Tree. The Dragon’s power is running through its leaves and streaming into the sky, protecting this land from the enemy’s evil will.

A prisoner is trapped in its roots. An odd, alien creature, but a good-natured one. The darkness is its enemy, too, as it is to all of us. If you rescue it and convince it to help us, maybe, it will serve you well.

But be careful! The darkness is blocking the way to the tree. Out lanterns will help you scatter it - but only for a while.

finishText.en: ... The heavy feeling after the visit to the new Purgatory doesn’t leave you. Nothing surprising in that, given the fact that the whole allod was absorbed by Nihaz’s Darkness...

goal.en: Listen to Nihaz.

startText.en:
Of course. Do you know how much time it’s been? According to my calculations, you’re supposed to be... Ah, never mind.

The more important thing is that you don’t belong to this time, and yet here you stand, all beautiful and healthy, huh. Well, alright, stay here - I won’t tell anyone. I give you the god’s word!

Don’t be so scared. No one has killed you. I just picked you up for a chat, and that’s it. Do you like how I redesigned the Purgatory? That’s a new word for you, by the way. Re-de-sign...

So you think that evil Nihaz has broken into your world and started raining fire all over the place, putting out suns and eating allods for breakfast, is that right? Just to satisfy his malice, is that right? To get back at his offenders? If you think so, well then let me inform you that you are the greatest fool in the Universe.

checkText.en: ... The Sculptor is in a weird slumber.

finishText.en: You have followed me, the offspring of Chaos, to the very end of this world. Do you still want to kill me?

goal.en: Approach the Great Tree and find the ally.

startText.en:
... The sinister shadows must have lost their interest in you. The way to the Tree is clear... And there is no way back.

Now you need to find a way to drive the Dark God away... Or at least return to your time. And finally find that mysterious ‘ally’!

checkText.en:
I am aware that the inhabitants of your world prefer to obtain information by means of issuing requests... questions... to the living subject of concern?

I assume I can satisfy your curiosity.

finishText.en: You want to return me to my time and prevent the imminent end of the world. Our interests coincide.

goal.en: Ask what brought the Sculptor to this time.

startText.en:
So you’re looking for allies in time?.. Your presence here is strange, for, as you can remember, we separated on a rather chaotic note. Maybe I made a bad impression when I left you in the Locus dimension of our Fractal so hastily.

But here you are, and thanks to you, I am released from the living tree’s prison. I am thankful to you.

I am aware that the inhabitants of your world prefer to obtain information by means of issuing requests... questions... to the living subject of concern?

I assume I can satisfy your curiosity.

finishText.en: Great, excellent, uh... This is not exactly what I expected... And this creates certain difficulties. I don’t think the people of Sarnaut will be happy to greet another Architect, however good and ‘improved’ he is... Hm...

goal.en: Help the Sculptor accumulate the Tree energy.

startText.en:
At this moment, I am bound to this world and I cannot leave it. First and foremost, I need to stabilize and accumulate my power. I cannot finish the process if I am killed.

We will start right now.

The Tree energy will be enough to lay our course through time. The Tree itself will die, unfortunately. I realize this decision implies certain moral dilemma, but if we intend to survive and prevent the catastrophe in our time, this is the only way I see.

I will need your help to accumulate the Tree power. I assume it won’t give up without a fight... Every living thing has a self-preservation instinct.

checkText.en: I am implementing the final adjustments right now. I’m ready to answer your questions. The time and the place, found by the Observatory, are, to say the least, disturbing...

finishText.en: On the other hand, when the world's survival is at stake, the people's opinion can be disregarded, right? I will gladly listen to the story of your future travels, but right now this have to wait. We have a very curious company here...

goal.en: Travel to the future using the Observatory, find the ally, and return to your time.

name.en: Journey to the End of the World

startText.en:
Travelling back through time isn't that difficult. Past events are fixed points in time, which lead to certain consequences.

Travelling to the future is a different thing. You will enter the world of possible events. The possibilities are being calculated by the Observatory based on the data that we have at hand - which includes all of the previous events in time. If you think of the scale of those calculations... No, this is just crazy. You can't imagine a thousandth part of it.

This is a real miracle.

I am implementing the final adjustments right now. I'm ready to answer your questions. The time and the place, found by the Observatory, are, to say the least, suspicious...

checkText.en: As you can see, the Observatory is full of familiar faces. Tell me when you’re ready to start a new adventure.

finishText.en: May it be so! So, about the future...

goal.en: Discuss travelling into the past with the allies in the Observatory.

name.en: Between the Future and the Past

startText.en:
One of the most powerful mana-reactors ever created by the magitechnicians was a handy discovery, right? I can’t imagine how much time you would have to spend there without it...

You deserve good rest!

As you can see, the Observatory is full of familiar faces. When you return from the future, maybe, somebody else will show up. Tell me when you’re ready to start a new adventure.

finishText.en:
... This poor fellow won’t come to any time soon.

You should be more careful with the next one...

goal.en: Find disguise and evaluate the situation.

startText.en:
...This looks like a backroom of some Imperial building. The air is filled with sterility and moist. A laboratory? Possibly an underground one. The white coat in the locker also points to that. The piece of paper on it says that belongs to Sarang Dishna, lab assistant in Laboratory #13.

Oh well...

checkText.en: Hey there.

finishText.en: Alright, I'm not going to kill anyone. They will do that themselves. Do you know Yinov, that new guard? He's a Tep Cultist. If he pulls off what he's up to, they will have some fun. What? I warned them, of course, but nobody believed me.

goal.en: Explore Lab 13 and find the ally.

startText.en:
... Now you just have to find the right target in the laboratory without drawing too much attention. This sounds easy... I guess?

This is definitely easier than running around Astral allods looking for some especially dangerous monsters.

checkText.en: This is a simple device. The dome is powered by three generators. Disable them one by one, but don’t irritate my ‘guards’ too much.

finishText.en:
It’s safer to do it with fists! This way I won’t kill anyone, huh.

But still I will take that wrench away from you.

goal.en: Deactivate the field that restrains Skulnar the Fierce.

startText.en:
This is a simple device. The dome is powered by three generators. Disable them one by one, but don’t irritate my ‘guards’ too much, or I will have to spill some blood.

Got it? Now go!

checkText.en:
They keep the Butcher in a stronger cage than mine. It is powered by a huge machine - I bet that’s the reactor.

If we break in there, you will have your way out!

finishText.en:
Seems like you haven’t created any paradoxes yet. And the world is not eager to erase you from the tissue of existence. Thus, I assume that everything is going according to the plan.

So, what do we have here?

goal.en: Find the reactor together with Skulnar the Fierce.

startText.en:
So you need a huge battery or something to get out of here? Well... I’ve seen something like that. Somewhere in these catacombs, there’s a cage with a huge demon. They call him Astral Butcher, huh.

They tried to make me get into that brute’s mind, or whatever demons have for it. What do you mean, what for? To subjugate him, of course! Imagine the power the Empire could have if it learned how to control Astral demons!

The thing is, they keep the Butcher in a stronger cage than mine. It is powered by a huge machine - I bet that’s the reactor.

If we break in there, you will have your way out!

finishText.en: Welcome home!

goal.en: Protect Cosmos’s projection while he is preparing the reverse transition.

startText.en:
I'm afraid you will have to take up defense. Projecting yourself through time and space is harder than it seems! I will need some time to use the resources of the mana-reactor.

Yes, you will have to protect my image. It will be very unpleasant if the reverse transition process gets interrupted. And something tells me that the lab guards are planning to do exactly that.

checkText.en: The ally we are looking for is long dead. But we are going to change that. The whole world will be against you - it will want our target to remain dead. But you will have to overcome that. Prevent a fixed event in time!

finishText.en: Not bad, not bad! Now you are officially a time traveler. What do you mean, this is not your first journey?

goal.en: Go to the past using the Observatory, find the ally and return to the current time.

startText.en:
Traveling to the past is easier than it seems, but there you have to obey rigid restrictions. Some of your actions may lead to the most unexpected consequences in our time.

The ally we are looking for is long dead. But we are going to change that. The whole world will be against you - it will want our target to remain dead. But you will have to overcome that. Prevent a fixed event in time!

You can ask any questions if you want.

finishText.en:
Oh, this was fast. I was afraid the postman hadn’t noticed my letter. I suspect she gave my message to you...

Well, Dionic Games are taking their course. Of course, nobody was really ready for the visit of the bronze guest, but they have convinced themselves that was some sort of a magic performance.

Where was I... Ah, travel through time! Listen to me carefully.

goal.en: Go to Cosmos in the Observatory using the attached Crystal Key.

startText.en:
Well? New feats await, I guess?

Cosmos sent us a message...

He says the Observatory is gaining strength. Every day, it reaches further out in time and space. He wished he could accelerate this process, but I'm afraid we lack the means to do so. Anyway, right now the Observatory is ready to send you off on a new... adventure, I suppose.

He is waiting for you in his domain.

While I'm still skeptical about Cosmos, I think you should go see him. He wouldn't summon you without a good reason...

checkText.en: Do you believe in destiny? Future is a less vague matter than it seems. It’s rather flexible than vague.

finishText.en:
We should kill malicious gods more often since new allods seem to be growing on their dead bodies. However, we don’t need any more sentient races...

What do you want to ask?

goal.en: Meet Klavdia Kalugina and ask for the key to Sarnaut’s temporal trap.

startText.en:
I have a special task for you... Or rather an opportunity. You see, you used to study the history of this world with Zayan’s help... He’s a bright mind, by the way. I took particular interest in the last several decades. I couldn’t help but notice certain... discrepancy. Series of events too odd to be true. Unexplained fatal accidents.

Do you believe in destiny? Future is a less vague matter than it seems. It’s rather flexible than vague. There can’t be an “indefinite future”. There are only chances and options how the course of events may develop. The thing is that some destinies in this world - the most important destinies! - were interrupted before their time and for rather unnatural reasons. I am only about to fathom those reasons.

finishText.en:
A brooch?

That is quite a clumsy attempt to track us, but we’ll pretend we didn’t notice anything. I assume her curiosity is justified in this case.

So, I need to install this brooch... right here. And adjust something here. Alright, I think the Observatory doesn’t mind. Let’s do it!

goal.en: Give Klavdia's Brooch to Cosmos.

startText.en:
Right, dream on! As if I'm going to give away the key to the world's safety just like that. No way!

And it wasn't me who built that prison.

What I can do is try and persuade it not to capture you two. Here, take this brooch. If that blue astronomer knows anything about magitechnology, he will figure out what to do with that.

And you... Whatever you're up to - be as careful as possible. Don't do anything stupid.

checkText.en: So, tell me...

finishText.en: It's not so good...

goal.en: Finish the expedition on Sogot.

startText.en:
Dead... He's dead, Stormbringer... I'm sorry... It's a huge loss.

The machine doesn't seem to work now. At least, I don't feel the pressure. It's time... We must... We must hurry back to the Citadel!

Who knows what happened there while we were absent.

checkText.en: Yes?

finishText.en:
Ah, there you are. I guess, you will do.

My name is Terminus. We don't have much time, so let's get down to business. Your top priority is maximum efficiency and adherence to my instruction. Is that clear?

goal.en: Meet Terminus.

startText.en:
Now, that's disrespectful! Nogrom doesn't necessarily mean an explosion! I have a scientific degree, by the way, it's almost official. Besides, not everything can be fixed with an explosion. I could take offence, you know, and someone might get hurt! Does that sound like something you can trust? I know you do trust me...

The situation here is volatile. Did you notice? Everyone is so stressed. They keep arguing all the time. It gets ugly. A mana crystal blew up in my hands recently. It was an accident! And they were about to throw me out the window!

I had to find another way out. It didn't take me long. There's an ancient teleportation network here. The technology is old-fashioned, all functioning nodes require constant support, but since you're here, we can get this work done. Find the aoidos called Terminus, he knows better how to handle things. He'll explain everything.

checkText.en: I need demon's blood.

finishText.en: Well, that would be enough. The drone can get to the Citadel zones we need, based on the map Nogrom charted with echolocation.

goal.en: Obtain demon's blood and give it to Terminus.

startText.en:
Your mind was controlled by the Destroyers. Now you're trying to prevent the relapse. It's commendable.

Yes, I know about your intentions. The goblin can't keep a secret. Luckily for you, your condition has no value for my research whatsoever, so I'm willing to help you.

The plan is simple. First, we shall use drones to activate the teleportation network of the Citadel's lower levels. We'll keep it up and running for as long as the teleportation takes. It will require a huge magical energy. Not just some energy! It must have a certain signature to cope with the local ancient magic. We can use the life power of a demon for sampling. We need blood. Any demon will do. Not a Destroyer, though...

Bring me a demon. And be warned, he won't survive the surgery.

checkText.en: The goal is not reached.

finishText.en: The goal seems to be reached! You may start your journey.

goal.en: Lead the drone through the ventilation shafts of the Citadel and activate the ancient teleportation network.

startText.en:
There were complications, but generally, everything worked out well. The blood you brought me is on your hands, so to say. It means that the drone will obey only your command. This is how the borderline technology of technomagic and blood magic works.

You should take the drone from the entrance through the vent shafts to the teleportation network and activate it. How? I have no clue whatsoever. But I'll give you the map.

finishText.en:
It looks like it was abandoned very long ago. Regarding the vampires...

I know where they came from, and this is bad news. Very bad.

goal.en: Follow the footsteps of the missing demonology expedition.

startText.en:
The Automatic Inspection Drone will accompany you throughout the expedition. As you see, it may provide fire support and maintain connection with me. It should last long enough. If possible, try to keep the drone intact. It has a scientific value.

So, you have the route of the expedition. Make sure you follow it. Keep in touch.

checkText.en: Let's not waste time. Explore the camp. Pick up everything you can find, anything! Any clues, journals, logs, notes...

finishText.en: I need some time to decipher. Please, wait.

goal.en: Find out what happened at the camp.

startText.en:
They are us. A demonologist that tasted demonic blood and then lost access to it, would degrade very fast, both mentally and physically. You didn't know that, eh? Well, it's only natural that they keep it secret.

This is the reason why the situation in the Citadel is so... tense. Do demons face the threat of extinction? They do. Do they depend on demonologists? No doubt. But it works vise versa.

Let's not waste time. Explore the camp. Pick up everything you can find, anything! Any clues, journals, logs, notes...

checkText.en: Let's take a look.

goal.en: Listen to the expedition's journal

startText.en: It looks like the expedition leader recorded a holographic message. It was the right thing to do, very fortunate for us. Shall we listen?

checkText.en: If you intend to continue your investigation, the portal in front of me will take you straight to the bowels of the Citadel.

finishText.en: Wonderful. I wasn't wrong - this enterprise will be beneficial for us both.

goal.en: Find out what happened to the party on the lower levels of the Citadel

startText.en: I suggest you don't focus on finding the whole expedition. You want to find certain members, namely, Imperius. The probability of their survival was zero a week ago. Nobody knows what awaits you downstairs, so carefully consider your every step. This place is much more dangerous than it looks.

checkText.en: This place makes me sick. No good can happen here.

finishText.en:
Thank you once again for your help down there. If it weren't for you, we all would have died, not just... not just Alastar.

As for the stone in the device... I want you to keep it. I'm sure you can make better use of it than I, let alone the locals.

The stone was an artifact core. Its properties... are scaring me.

Farewell, Stormbringer. I hope I will see you again.

goal.en: Listen to what Imperius has to say.

startText.en:
Destroyers have nothing to do with the device. At least, I sensed no energy of theirs down there. I only heard the call... The call of our fallen Progenitor Sarn.

This device used to belong to a god. I don't know what it's really meant for. And I don't want to know! This place makes me sick. No good can happen here.

checkText.en:
Tegorah nods slowly.

"Welcome back, Stormbringer."

finishText.en: ...Tegorah falls silent for a while. Obviously, it isn't the best day for a friendly visit. Skulnar's regards can wait.

goal.en: Teleport to the Sogot Citadel and ask Tegorah for advice.

startText.en:
You'd better leave the demonologists alone. Demons trust you, ask them for advice. You may talk to Tegorah directly, I guess.

Give my regards to the big guy. He's a decent fellow, even though he's a demon.

checkText.en: Oh, it's you again. Welcome back. What brought you here?

finishText.en: Oh, it's you again. Welcome back. What brought you here?

goal.en: Ask about demon's mind-controlling abilities.

startText.en:
Tegorah turns away. His voice is unambiguously venomous.

Ask sorceress Maya for advice. She and her gang willingly betray anyone and point at the guilty. If she knows anyone that fits your description, she will turn them in without second though. She owes you.

checkText.en: I'm very busy. Leave me alone.

finishText.en: I wish we had copies of Imperius's research... Every demonologist keeps their knowledge secret. Your only option is to find him yourself. You have my permission for an expedition.

goal.en: Ask about demonologists' mind-controlling abilities.

startText.en:
Mind control? I'm afraid you have come to the wrong person. Studying something that has been studied thoroughly by generations of psionicists is useless. You could go straight to them without wasting my time.

If you're interested, though... One of my subordinates, aoidos Imperius, is using the data in question in his research. He's a member of the expedition to the Citadel's deepest levels. It's been a month since they departed.

Speaking of which... you might have arrived just in time.

checkText.en:
Hey, chief! I did nothing illegal!

Nope. Nothing illegal at all!

finishText.en:
Hey, chief! I did nothing illegal!

Nope. Nothing illegal at all!

goal.en: Meet Nogrom Junior at the workshop

startText.en:
The purpose of the expedition? This is absolutely none of your business. Everything in the name of science. No surprises here. All you should know is that your destination is in the depths of the Citadel. Perhaps, they're waiting for you to save them.

Why don't we go? Out of the question. The Church is following our every step. There's still risk of the Destroyers' attack. The demons have been acting weirdly and aggressively. Every demonologist counts here. We're saving ourselves, you know.

During a fight with the Destroyers the passage that the expedition took was destroyed. Your goblin was supposed to research a different option to bring them back. You can ask him about the progress. And please, make sure he doesn't blow up what is not supposed to be blown up.

checkText.en: Continue your descent. The solution is near.

finishText.en:
Demon's movements are smooth and precise. You don't feel a direct threat, but his gestures betray not only an experienced sorcerer, but and experienced assassin.

I didn't expect to see you here, Stormbringer. Your Spark is shining in the dark too bright. I wonder if there is a way to dim it.

goal.en: Search trails of the Expedition on the lower levels.

startText.en:
Let's put aside the possibility of an incident. Suppose they were attacked. But by whom?

Demons? A riot means genocide for them. It does not contribute to their goals, anyway. And I doubt that a bunch of renegade demons could make a big part of the expedition.

Demonologists? Who could benefit from the death of the whole expedition? We will have to check all members... Survivors, if there are any, are automatically under suspicion. Beware, Stormbringer.

Continue your descent. The solution is near.

finishText.en:
It came as a surprise! The first pleasant surprise during the last month. Well done, Alastar!

Stormbringer, is it? It's wonderful! It's amazing!

goal.en: Go through the dark creatures with Alastar's help.

startText.en:
...Demon's manner of speech takes you by surprise. You don't often see a demon attempting at humor. However, he becomes serious again.

We need to take you away from here. Now that you're here, Imperius has a chance to escape. We might have it too.

You can call me Alastar. I'm... a friend of Imperius.

...A suspicious noise in the dark interrupts the demon. He lowers his head, listens carefully to the noises in the corners, in the corridors, among stone plates. You can feel the anxiety and unease building up.

I will try and summon the Light, Stormbringer. Stay close. Run if I die. Your life is more important. I will take you to Imperius.

checkText.en: Hear me out.

finishText.en:
Now that Alastar and I are able to preserve our minds, your power, and Terminus's knowledge, we've got a chance! What we don't have is time.

Let's do it.

goal.en: Listen to the Imperius's story.

startText.en:
I knew Terminus would find a way to get through to me. But sending Stormbringer to help! He outdid himself, ha-ha!

I told him about our problem via the mental link we're keeping. It's just, you know... We were in a stalemate. If a few demons and I returned save and sound, it would have raised some questions. And we would have been forced to tell what lies in the depths of the Citadel.

We could have long summoned help. But we can't let demonologist arrive here.

checkText.en: In your position, I would be prepared for... unpleasant surprises. Who knows what hides in the dark. We are only at the very tip of the iceberg.

finishText.en:
The picture is not very clear. But the source is unmistakable, for it's very powerful. What is that noise?

You'd better hurry, Stormbringer. You shouldn't sit around expecting someone else's orders. We have... What we have here... There's some unrest. I'm sorry, it's hard for me to think. Protection of Imperius and Alastar doesn't apply to me. I'm not physically present.

goal.en: Find the source of madness.

startText.en:
Well, the task is clear. Magotriangulation in a place like this can be greatly hampered by noise, but at least the streams from the upper levels will not interfere in the picture.

The A.I.D. has all beacons you need for the operation. You must install them properly. Like this...

In your position, I would be prepared for... unpleasant surprises. Who knows what hides in the dark. We are only at the very tip of the iceberg.

Good luck!

checkText.en: Let's go. It's time to put an end to it.

finishText.en:
I don't feel so good. What is this construction?

It looks like a device.

goal.en: Find the source of madness.

startText.en:
The good news is that the source is not far from here. The bad news is that it's completely cut off from the main structure. The whole room is isolated from the Citadel, so to say. So it's near, and at the same time, it's very difficult to access. The architectural paradox easily achieved by adepts of dimensional magic. I wonder for how long it's been here...

However, we can use the teleportation network of the Citadel to enter. In fact, it's the bad news. You will have only a few moments to evaluate the situation and defend yourself if necessary.

Stay alert.

checkText.en: Please, do something! Make it stop!

finishText.en:
No... No! Alastar! Can you hear me?

Say something! Alastar...

goal.en: Destroy the mysterious artifact

startText.en:
In a normal situation, I'm not a fan of scientific vandalism, but I'm afraid we'll have to destroy the artifact before we can study it. I don't know about you, Stormbringer, but my thoughts are scaring me. I can see only... the red... the black. The black light...

Please, do something! Make it stop!

finishText.en: I can see that these lands are vast, but the fact that we arrived at the middle of the burned wasteland spoils the impression.

goal.en: Go to Frontier with the Centaurs through Sculptor's Portal

startText.en:
An intriguing option. Life here is relatively not diverse, but you can find traces of many lost civilizations of this world.

I will open the way for us.

finishText.en:
Funny outlanders! Why take horse's body? Hey, the stone idol walks!

Ooh, Lizardman remember you! You kill all Draconids! May their name be cursed forever.

We have holy days. Celebration! Can't spill blood. Even outlander's blood. You are double luck today! Our home be your home.

goal.en: Meet the natives.

startText.en:
I can feel life. There must be a settlement. We are guests on this land, we must pay a visit to its residents.

Stay alert. We don't know their reaction.

finishText.en: Not so good. Why those people capture them? Slave traders? What does this mean?

goal.en: Find Kiela, the missing daughter of the chief, in Waterfolk village.

startText.en:
Want find home here? Earth is big! Burning Claw is happy to have friends! My daughter Kiela wants make friends with Waterfolk. Went to them a moon ago. Never come back. I begin worry.

You want see our land? See the Waterfolk land, too. If you find Kiela, tell her come back. Tell her, Hiss Abyss wait!

finishText.en:
Praise the Claw! The Fiery Sky sent you! Mercy on our life! Wrath on unworthy intruder! What? Not Sky? Father sent you? My father is the chief! Sky talks through him!

If the silly Waterfolk stop squeaking at each other, we could have done it! Harr!

goal.en: Free the captives and get rid of pirates, the slave traders.

startText.en:
No honor... Even a life of an enemy is precious. Humiliate enemy, you humiliate yourself. Citovras was teaching this! Selling outlanders like stone necklaces is...

Dishonorable.

Unworthy death to the dishonored! Kill them like wild dogs!

finishText.en: Thank you, Outlander! One stupid war over. We are strong tribe. We must make peace on our land.

goal.en: Support the peace treaty between the Lakefolk, the Riverfolk, and the Burning Claw tribe.

name.en: A little more bite and a little less bark!

startText.en:
Two tribes, Riverfolk and Lakefolk. It's a loooong war.

Today it ends! I, Kiela, the daughter of the chief, will talk!

finishText.en:
Good morning!

Hiss Abyss says, their patron blessed you last night. He's right. Something has changed about you.

Spirits are with you, Stormbringer. This is good.

goal.en: Join the celebration of the Burning Claw tribe.

startText.en:
Outlander bring luck! Stay, Outlander. We have a big feast tonight!

Hissit-Asha-Shi, the great spirit, talk to me in shaman's dream. He invite you. Very persistent. He say, you're lost in the dark. He wants to help.

Let the horse stay, too. And the statue. Let's celebrate with the Claw!

finishText.en:
Great kelp! Are you okay? Alive? Good.

Give it to me, I'll process it...

goal.en: Collect Poisonous Kelp from the bottom of the lake.

startText.en:
Our tribe wants to make a gift to the Burning Claw chief to thank them for saving our lives. Poisonous kelp is growing on the bottom of the lake. Applied to weapons, it makes them deadly!

If only my Lakefolk could collect it... They're too tired after the battle with the pirates!

Please, help us once again. But be cautious. This kelp exhales poison. Don't approach if you can see a green cloud around a plant.

finishText.en: This shell is sturdy and beautiful. It can make a good armor for a hunter. Or a sharp spear.

goal.en: Obtain Royal Crab Shells.

startText.en:
Our tribe would like to make a return gift to the Burning Claw chief as a token of our gratitude and unity.

We are giving you wonderful and shiny Royal Crab Shells!

finishText.en: Excellent! We'll use everything. Shells for armor and weapons, meat - for food! Thank you.

goal.en: Obtain Royal Crab Shells

startText.en:
Glug. Glug. Friend! Help me out, please?

Our lake, Eldress, is full of delicious crabs, but they are very dangerous for us Waterfolk. You get distracted, and bam - a crab chops off your hand. It takes a long time to regenerate one! Who will feed my kids?

Catch us these crabs, since you are a great hero! And you've proven it time and time again. We will compose a song about you and sing it to the children.

finishText.en:
Kiela! My baby!

You're alive! Praise the Burning Claw! An the outlanders, too.

goal.en: Return to the Burning Claw chief together with Kiela and Ancient Moon

startText.en: We discuss laws of our union, and everybody is made happy. Have something to tell father and the tribe. Let's go now. Water and kelp make my scales itch.

finishText.en:
It was an amazing journey. The world is so huge and diverse... It is so much grander than all this fussing about...

However minor, these things are important enough for our lives to depend on it. That's the fate.

goal.en: Return to Ammer with Centaurs.

startText.en:
It is a magnificent land, Stormbringer.

I hope, it will stay this way. Hiss Abyss and his tribe are glorious... what do they call themselves? Lizardmen? Their shaman traditions are very curious. Thank you for the opportunity to get to know them.

It's a shame, but it's time to say our good-byes.

finishText.en:
Darkness and fog... These lands are so much unlike the Spiral Ridge.

But they look vast and deserted. Let's look around.

goal.en: Go to Gipat Shard with the Centaurs through Sculptor's Portal.

name.en: To the land of the Show

startText.en: Gipat Shard. The source of the Dark God's revelation. This land is full of energy, although it isn't pure. It's rather easy to make way there.

finishText.en:
Strangers can't go any further. Talk to the chief if you don't value your life, huh.

There he is.

goal.en: Go up the Ruins together with the Centaurs.

startText.en:
If we climb these ruins, we can see the land for many miles around, as the fog allows... I think I can see a ladder over there.

Let's go! We must see what this land has to offer.

finishText.en:
Oh, it's not up to the ancestral testament... We will be punished for the defiance!

On the other hand... we haven't heard the ancestral voices in a long time. They are silent. Shaman's visions are dark.

goal.en: Fight the shaman's sons.

startText.en:
So, it's you, then. Huh, the Wind told me you would come. I don't know what the Mountain spirits see in you, but their will is absolute. The Trial of Power awaits you!

You will fight against my sons. I have two, so you may select the opponent. There's only one rule. You can't go out of the circle.

Fight till death!

finishText.en:
The ancestors have long abandoned us. But we're alive so far, and we're not going to die!

Your shaman is strong and wise. The two of you are mighty warriors. Strangers brought woe to us. Only strangers should know how to deal with it. That's what the wind is telling us.

goal.en: Listen to what Spinecrusher has to say.

startText.en:
Perhaps, this is why the wind of Gipat blew you in.

The woe came to our tribe... You may be our salvation!

finishText.en:
Whatever it is, they're not real spirits. I can see you know this darkness. I've seen it in my dreams beyond the forbidden boundary.

I didn't let it come closer.

Have the spirits ever been alive? Or it's just an evil illusion? I do not know...
