I just fear that the Orcish "Spirits of the Ancestors" are nothing but darkness.

And still, I was able to see something. A strange cave filled with darkness. Something light was locked inside it, tied with magic chains. If we find the cave, we'll find the answer.

I've seen the path surrounded by stone pillars with rainbow lightning dancing around them. We must find this place.

goal.en: Install the Mountain Wind's Staff at the foot of the ruins and kill several ghostly toads and boars in the circle.

startText.en:
Well, we don't owe them anything, but I have a bad feeling about this place. I must figure out what's going on.

If it's about the ancestral spirits, we should try asking other spirits' advice. Here, take my staff. Use it to trap spirits at the foot of the ruins. Use it on ghostly toads and boars.

At the moment of death, the staff must be near the creature. Don't forget it.

finishText.en: Wait, Stormbringer. This path is dangerous. We may die if we proceed without protection.

goal.en: Find the Cursed Path on Gipat Shard.

startText.en:
I know this place. I can see it in your eyes that you know it, too. It's the Cursed Path. That's what it's called by the crazy human ghosts from the village.

We are staying away from it. The rainbow lightning burns down everyone on the spot, and no offerings can help. I don't think the spirits have any power over the stone pillars at all.

But if the shaman says that you have to take it... So be it.

finishText.en:
Yes, this is the cave. What's inside?

I'm... I'm scared, Stormbringer.

goal.en: Walk along the Cursed Path under shaman's protection.

startText.en:
This element has nothing to do with the nature or spirits. It is dark magic. There is no rainbow lightning, Stormbringer. There is only darkness... only the black light...

I think I can protect us, but we must walk quickly.

finishText.en:
We banished the dark creation!

The ancestral spirits helped us. They were imprisoned here. It's so good to know that they didn't become a part of the evil.

goal.en: Enter the cave and defeat the darkness inside.

startText.en:
I have a bad feeling. Whatever hides inside, it's very powerful. And it's somehow connected with this land, like the Well of Souls is connected with Ammer.

Now I know why I feel so bad on this allod.

Stormbringer, resisting the darkness is our sacred duty! If orcs are going to survive, they must get rid of such neighbor.

finishText.en:
You are the Chosen One, and for a reason. What you did for us is worthy of all treasure in the world.

We must carefully learn the last lesson of the ancestors. The dark times begin... Time will show if we are worthy of survival.

I wish you and the Spiral Ridge tribe to find whatever you are looking for.

Go in peace, Chosen One. My sons and I will stay here a little longer.

goal.en: Hear the Orcish Spirits.

startText.en:
It's just... the spirits are very weak. I can feel them fading slowly, but steadily.

I think they want to tell us something. Hurry, Stormbringer, listen carefully before their quiet words are carried away by the wind.

finishText.en: Welcome back. I hope your research was productive.

goal.en: Return to Ammer with Centaurs.

startText.en: Our adventure in Gipat is coming to an end. This land belongs to the orcs, and they wished to face their destiny. We're leaving these lands now. It's time to return, Stormbringer. The Stone God will open the gates.

checkText.en: What a vast land!

finishText.en: They aren't happy about our arrival. I understand that. A tragedy at your door makes you appreciate your home.

goal.en: Teleport to Wellebell Preserve via Sculptor's Portal

startText.en:
Umoir? Hmm, the chaos in this land was particularly bad. The Leper, that's what you named it.

Now the Leper is growing weaker. Local residents continue to explore their territory. I'm not sure it would be wise to visit them right now, but it's up to you to decide.

finishText.en: Just to think that it's only a little fragment of the world... After the Leper, it's a sorry sight...

goal.en: Explore Wellebell Preserve together with the Centaurs.

startText.en:
The wish of the people is commendable. We are not claiming their land.

But it is amazing! Since we've only got one day, let's go as deep as we can. Some special energy is filling this place.

I want to see its history with my own eyes.

finishText.en: Excellent. Who knows, maybe these seeds will grow on Ammer.

goal.en: Gather acorns and berries for Mountain Wind.

startText.en:
The Earth can tell you a lot about itself through its gifts. I wonder which of local herbs and berries are edible.

I can manage the herbs. In the meantime, bring me some red berries that are all over this place. And the big seeds of these huge trees.

What do you call them? Acorns? Yes, bring me acorns!

checkText.en: Uh, some roasted boar meat would make this place feel like home...

finishText.en: That's a surprise! Boar piglets are almost exactly the same as we have. It's a shame.

goal.en: Obtain Wild Boar meat.

startText.en:
Citovras used to say, a good warrior must be brave, strong, and sate.

My belly is almost empty with all these adventures. I'd rather guard my sister. Who knows what beasts live here! In the meantime, bring us a boar for dinner. No, make it five!

We'll eat one right here and bring the rest to our brothers at the Spiral Ridge. It's no good returning from travels without gifts.

checkText.en: Oh, hunting is great here in these forests!

finishText.en: Excellent! As Citovras said, "there is nothing like the good food we'll eat, glorious beer we'll drink, and a hot mare we'll..." ahem, we will omit this part!

goal.en: Obtain Wild Boar meat.

startText.en:
Honor and valor!

My brothers, the centaurs of the Spiral Ridge, liked the local wild boars… Damn, they taste amazing, especially honey-dipped ribs.

So here it is: you need to kill enough boars to feed everyone. As for the locals - I don't think they would mind - there's plenty of pigs here.

So - be a friend, get us some meat! And we will arrange a feast in your honor.

checkText.en: So, how is it going with the squirrel?

finishText.en:
It's so fluffy and gentle!

You know, there are so many of them! One more squirrel, one less...

I'll keep this one. And I'm going to name it... let me see...

goal.en: Capture a squirrel for Ancient Moon.

startText.en:
Citovras said that a true warrior must not be ashamed of their desires. So.

Well...

While we walked through the forest, I noticed some red-furred creatures up in the trees and on the ground... Squirrels? Huh. I wonder if they're soft to the touch... I'd love to pat one!

Do me a favor, catch one for me! Make sure you don't cripple it. Use a bait.

finishText.en:
Good morning, Stormbringer!

We are ready to go home now.

goal.en: Go to sleep by the fire.

startText.en:
It was a good day, Stormbringer. The sun is declining. It's time for a rest.

Go to sleep. Look, we have a wolf skin for you. What's with the suspicion? Are you afraid to sleep? Don't worry, Stormbringer. No one can harm you in this forest.

Good night.

finishText.en: Keep the Sage's gift, Stormbringer. Something tells me you'll find it useful.

goal.en: Tell Mountain Wind about your dream.

startText.en: I've seen weird things in my dream... Did you sleep well? I tried to protect you from darkness in your thoughts, but...

finishText.en: The teleportation was successful. Welcome back!

goal.en: Summon the Sculptor and teleport to Ammer with Centaurs.

startText.en:
It's time to return, Stormbringer. The Stone God told us to summon him, whenever we're ready.

He gave me this thing, but I have no clue how to use it. Please, use it to summon the Stone God and return home.

checkText.en: Where shall we go now?

finishText.en: The long journey is over. The answer to my question is ready.

goal.en: Explore Wellebell Preserve, Gipat Shard, and Frontier together with the Centaurs.

startText.en:
The new life form desires to start an expansion? I must express fear that they will face the fate of the Architects who began their expansion into this world earlier.

"Absolutely different?" Probably.

I can open portals to your destinations to optimize your travel. Navigating in this ocean of chaos is so fascinating.

finishText.en: Thank you for everything you've done, Stormbringer. You will always be welcome here and in our future home on Frontier.

goal.en: Learn about Centaurs' decision.

startText.en:
It was a wonderful journey. I had no idea our world was so beautiful and huge... After all, there are many lands yet to be seen.

The Sculptor is willing to help on one condition. Our expansion must be peaceful. Well, that's something I can promise!

Allow me to give our decision to the tribe. This is the grand occasion for us, Centaurs. It wouldn't have happened if it weren't for your help.

checkText.en: Do you really need the Sculptor?

finishText.en:
Let me guess, you need the Sculptor to save the world, right?

Ah, is it just your soul? How boring! Well, if you insist...

goal.en: Find Klavdia Kalugina in Polis.

startText.en:
Sarn is dead, but his legacy is still kicking, hah. I'm pretty sure we'll have to interrogate our diving Terrorwing.

I have no clue where this Sculptor might be now. Klavdia is supposed to keep an eye on him. You should ask her.

checkText.en: So, what's up?

finishText.en: Well, he's a hard case! Do you know where he is? Visiting the Spiral Ridge! Do you get where the wind is blowing?

goal.en: Capture the Eye of the Sculptor and bring it to Klavdia.

startText.en:
I have an idea. The aoidos say that strange small creatures appeared here. They're somehow related, but in fact they belong to another world. The Sculptor is hanging out somewhere, letting out lots of his little friends! Catch one of them. It's going to tell us everything we need to know.

Here's a special trap for Architects. It isn't finished, so it overheats quickly. Make sure you set it at the right moment.

finishText.en: Greetings and welcome back, Child of Chaos. My scout informed me that you were looking for me. What happened?

goal.en: Find a way into the Centaur Camp at the Spiral Ridge and find the Sculptor.

startText.en: I swear to the Balance, if this pathetic idol starts another cult... Oh, he must be stopped! Although... you didn't get along with centaurs very well the last time I remember. I hope you will manage to find common grounds with them after... well, after you killed their beloved chieftain!

checkText.en: Done!

finishText.en: Since you're looking for the Stone God, go and talk to him. He can't find common ground with my sister.

goal.en: Speak to Apios and get to the Centaur Camp.

startText.en: Greetings and welcome back, Stormbringer! I don't have much news. Everything is in order. After the death of Kyros and Citovras, the aoidos and Centaurs made peace. No one wants any more blood. The Triquetrum is free again! Find Apios in Triquetrum, he'll be happy to see you.

checkText.en: Done!

finishText.en: So you're the hero of the aoidos, Stormbringer. My dream was ominous. Amazing is spiritual knowledge! I'm happy to greet you in our camp.

goal.en: Speak to the Sculptor

startText.en: The cult? No, I don't want it. Unlike chaos creations, I learn from my mistakes. Dane's experience shows that chaos creations are too... sensitive to be my followers. I hope you know what I mean.

checkText.en: Done!

finishText.en:
Wind told me that the Stone God and the lost soul will help us along the way. You don't look like a lost soul, but something troubles you. You didn't come here by chance.

The spirits promised that the lost soul would be rewarded for help. They said something about the Luminary to dispel darkness... I didn't quite get what they were saying.

What do you say, Stormbringer? Will you help us?

goal.en: Listen to Mountain Wind.

startText.en: Come with me, Stormbringer. I will tell you what awaits the Centaurs.

checkText.en: Just remember one thing. Everything that happens in the dream is your subconscious attempt to sort out the mess in your head. If it works out, you can find... I don't know what. Answers? Direction? Solution? More questions? I really don't know.

finishText.en:
The face looks like a reflection in a distorted mirror. It looks puzzled and empty. It's studying you as closely as you're studying it.

This face looks familiar.

goal.en: Use Klavdia's help to enter trance.

startText.en:
I can immerse you in a magic dream, where you will act consciously. Be warned that things and creatures in your dream will make little sense. There are neither enemies nor allies... Except for Darkness. By default, it is neither a foe nor a friend. It's up to you to decide what it will be. More precisely, to your subconscious.

What's wrong? Oh, I should have known better than to confuse you.

Just remember one thing. Everything that happens in the dream is your subconscious attempt to sort out the mess in your head. If it works out, you can find... I don't know what. Answers? Direction? Solution? More questions? I really don't know.

If something goes wrong, I will wake you up. But for your own good, pray to all gods for it to go right.

finishText.en: I'm asleep. I'm dreaming about a baby mouse, running away from my claws. The baby mouse knows how to play.

goal.en: Try to establish contact with the creature in front of you.

startText.en:
...Your head is spinning, and the world around you crumbles. You realize that you're seeing yourself through the eyes of the strange ghost. A second later, its face reappears in front of you. It repeats again and again. Spin, glance, spin. You-he-you feel...s dizzy, and everything rolls back like ocean waves. Where I am and where IT is - becomes incomprehensible.

Suddenly, BOTH of you realize what's going on. The question is in order. It's the law. Ask the question. Receive the answer. No question, no life.

finishText.en:
The reflection looks more confident. Strong. Just like you.

There's no more I-it-you-we thing. You are real. I am real. Keep going.

goal.en: Answer the Riddle.

startText.en:
Why am I seeing you in my dream, baby mouse? You have all paths in the world ahead of you. You've got the lock and the key, but you can't see them. What a shame.

You know the rules, baby mouse. Answers are given to those, who ask questions. I know the rules. My dream, my questions. You reply to me, and you reply to yourself.

Maybe...

checkText.en: The old man in dark clothes is smiling kindly at you. His face looks slightly familiar.

finishText.en: See? It's easier than it seems.

goal.en: Find Darkness in subconsciousness.

startText.en: ...The face before you is expecting your questions. The laws of intelligence are absolute.

finishText.en:
This is it... The journey is over.

Look at me.

goal.en: Enter the Portal of Eternity and see what happens.

startText.en:
You have asked the question, my friend. You know the rules! You will have your answer, ready or not.

Open the last door.

checkText.en: We shall start as soon as you're ready, dear. Don't let it take too long. It's just like toothache.

finishText.en:
Well, you did it. You did something.

Oh, I can see a lot of questions in your eyes. Have I come through this? Have I seen this? Do I know the "sacred" truth about Nihaz?

But of course.

goal.en: Find answers in Klavdia's dream.

startText.en:
I do know how. All signs, both mental and external, were present. I should know better...

What to do? Well, for starters, you can surrender to goblins on the Coba Plateau and wait for the local innkeeper to hire a minor local hero to rescue you. Then you must persuade a naive time-traveler to give you the heart of the Dragon, deeply roasted in the desert sands. Or, as an option, you may find an ancient half-witted mage and absorb the power of his Spark...

Or we can go the long way, get into your mind and cut the darkness out directly. You will do it yourself. I'm not messing with your thoughts.

Well? What would you choose?

finishText.en: So the ginger head helped you, after all? Good job!

goal.en: Talk to Skulnar the Fierce in the Al Rihat Ruins.

startText.en:
Well, you can't escape from Darkness. The only way to escape is to accept it. To see the vanity and the necessity of fighting it. Everything is exactly as they said. Darkness is the natural state of the world. Darkness is the Great Uncertainty.

Speaking about Nihaz... Like Darkness, he has multiple faces. He is only one of its countless sides. His conflict with Sarn is only a minor episode in his long, unbearably long life. We are just one of the myriad tiniest consequences of this conflict.

It's true, we call the ghostly Umoir peasants, the lost Sculptor, and Nihaz "Gods", but only because we lack a proper word. Nihaz, how should I put it... Is more of a concept. An idea.

Yes, I think he is. The concept of a conflict. The idea of war. Did you think that gods of war must be huge, furious, menacing? Uh. I guess Nihaz has long outgrown this image. On the other hand, if you remember Thalos...

What does it make me as Nihaz's daughter? Hm. You should know better than anyone what is born in a war... Anyway, it doesn't really matter.

Skulnar wanted to talk to you. He's gripping on you so hard... It's no surprise. Go.

checkText.en: You again? All right, spit it out.

finishText.en:
I've been waiting for you to come. I thought, it was impossible for the biggest cluck of this world to ignore the God of Darkness in their head for over a month!

But it was. And you did. But here you are, at last.

goal.en: Ask Klavdia Kalugina in the Observatory how to get rid of Nihaz's influence.

startText.en:
All of it is curious. All the spirits, local gods, ancient devices, a light-bearing demon... But how should this help to banish Nihaz from your head? You should pick this bone with Klavdia, I guess.

She's a smart-pants, you can't hide things like this from her. Just tell her as it is. She might come up with a solution.

finishText.en:
God or not God... An idea... it's too complicated. Who needs complicated? This piece of crap attacked Ammer with its golem, and he was beaten. He attacked Sogot, and he was beaten again, by demons and skinny scientists!

There's nothing special about him. Just another enemy.

What matters, is that he got lost from your brain. Let's drink for it.

goal.en: Finish the story.

startText.en:
What am I doing here? Your Centaur story inspired me to take a look at Umoir... They're not fond of orcs, of course, but sheer League patriots are nowhere to be seen, either. They've got their own issues with the Leper, why would they care about the war?

Go on, tell me the whole story.

checkText.en: No news, cap, I'm afraid. What about you?

finishText.en: No news, cap, I'm afraid. What about you?

goal.en: Find a way to get rid of Nihaz's control over your mind.

startText.en:
First of all, I hate that all these things are happening on Sogot. Why couldn't Nihaz pull off this trick before? Is he the God of Darkness or what? I mean, he's Almighty, after all. Perhaps, there's something on Sogot that helped him. I'd like to sniff it out myself, but it's not that easy with all the demonologists and demons around.

Second, we have a god at our disposal. It's the Sculptor. He should know at least something about any divine laws of magic. You know, a vague idea. He kind of owes you, so you can shake him down for answers.

Third, it's the ginger-haired girl. Klavdia suggests she has a history with Nihaz, and it sounds a lot like yours. She might have an easy way out. I just didn't get it, whether Nihaz sent you for her, or you helped her escape from Nihaz... Or both? You can deal with it without me.

In the meantime, I'll talk to Zayan and Cosmos. The Great Mages might have a trick up their sleeve.

checkText.en: Listen up.

finishText.en: We're short of gods, so we have to get by, huh.

goal.en: Ask Skulnar the Fierce about the demonic curse.

startText.en:
There's no use beating about the bush... I've been thinking about your nightmares back on Sogot... If he can make you do things that easily, someone might find it best to put you down...

We don't want them to do so, right? We don't. Listen now.

finishText.en: All right, here comes! How are you doing, cap?

goal.en: Skulnar the Fierce met by the Observatory on Dionic Archipelago

startText.en: Skulnar obviously didn't have a chance to learn how to right properly. He scribbled you a very short note saying he would like to meet you near the Observatory.

finishText.en: Well, everything seems to be in order. Now get to Cosmos, quick. Time is pressing!

goal.en: Complete Skulnar the Fierce's tasks

startText.en:
In short, there is a problem. They say Cosmos is making arrangements regarding this whole situation with Nihaz.

But I see things aren't going well for you. Why, you ask? It's the way you look. Wouldn't think you're the Hero of Sarnaut, hah.

You ought to... beef up, maybe? No, I'm not talking about pumping iron. I mean heroic deeds. Like helping our friends here.  I'll tell you where to go and what to do.

Once you help them, you'll be worthy of the title. And then you can go to Cosmos, and we'll think of how to defeat Nihaz.

finishText.en: There you go. Well... How are you feeling, Cap?

goal.en: Meet Skulnar the Fierce near the Well of Souls on Ammer.

name.en: Meet Skulnar the Fierce near the Well of Souls on Ammer

startText.en: Skulnar obviously wasn't taught to write properly. He scribbled you a very short note saying he would like to meet you near the Well of Souls.

checkText.en: Tegorah looks at you questioningly. He is waiting to hear that the Destroyers have been banished.

finishText.en:
The Archdemon inclines his head approvingly.

“This should stop them for a time. But more will follow...”

goal.en: Kill 15 Destroyers at the Citadel.

startText.en:
Tegorah's voice reverberates through your mind.

"We've managed to push most of the Destroyers back, but they're still trying to get to the lower levels of the Citadel. Please go down there and drive them out."

checkText.en: Tegorah gives you a questioning look. He is waiting to hear that the Destroyers have been banished from the Citadel.

finishText.en:
The Archdemon inclines his head approvingly.

"Another attack rebuffed... But they will come again. Through time and space. Creating a future where we all have no place. Stop them."

goal.en: Eliminate the Destroyers in the Citadel.

startText.en:
Tegorah's voice reverberates through your mind.

"Destroyers. The scum of our race. Pathetic slaves of Nihaz, the mortal enemy of Sarn who created us. They are pure evil.

And this evil still threatens the Citadel. They need to be dealt with."

finishText.en:
You have weird dreams... No, I didn’t peek. You’re just very talkative. Good morning, anyway.

I don’t like this place. Hell knows what’s happening here. Everyone keeps to themselves, staring at each other suspiciously. They don’t trust anyone, and that’s wise... The Trinity doesn’t help either. The Hunter is dumb as a fish, and the elf is wacky.

goal.en: Ask demon hunters and representatives of the Church about the situation and find Skulnar the Fierce.

startText.en:
Here’s the medical history: you lapsed into a coma after the mess on the White Hook. I found no anomalous antibodies in your organism. The temperature is normal. After hearing your friends’ accounts, I concluded that you are suffering from two conditions: concussion caused by the demon rudely dropping you on your head, and chronic sleep deprivation.

And before you ask, being unconscious for more than a day doesn’t fix the second problem. You must keep in bed.

Still, you’ll need to meet the messengers of the Servants of the Light. Maya wants everyone to please them. And they seem to be concerned about your well-being. Why is that?

finishText.en:
...Tegorah turns to you. You feel like you are being placed on giant scales and measured. The Archdemon’s stare seems to look right at your Spark.

The echo of the demon’s emotion washes over you like a sea wave over cliffs. He seems to be... satisfied?

“You appear to be healthy. We could use your help.”

goal.en: Meet Tegorah, the Citadel Archdemon

startText.en:
You should probably talk to the main demon. He’s a scary one, though if he decides to bite your head off, he’ll be honest about it. His name is Tegorah. Maybe he’ll tell you something useful?

And yes, these corridors are really confusing. Don’t be afraid - if you get lost, I’ll mount an expedition and come get you, heh.

finishText.en: Well, you know how to fight. I’m not surprised. If we could knock some sense into your head, you’d make a fine hunter.

goal.en: Defeat the Destroyers on the upper platform and inform Velit Molotov of your success.

startText.en:
Ah, there you are. You don’t consider those deadly metal things “peaceful” demons, do you? Great. Let’s go hunting.

I don’t need trophies and I don’t need your bluster. Just show them that demons aren’t welcome in this world. Our trust in the Light and swords will make short work of any vermin! They will pay tenfold for every drop of our blood!

checkText.en: If you handle them, you’ll decapitate the whole armada and give us a head start as we prepare our counterattack. Sounds good, eh?

finishText.en:
Good. I don’t like seeing people’s efforts go to waste... Especially since they paid for that information with their lives.

As you may have already guessed, our duties are different from whatever healers typically do... What’s the point in sending some fana... believers here? Anyway, thank you for your assistance. The Light shines brighter today.

goal.en: Find and eliminate three powerful Destroyers on Sogot. Inform August de Grandeur of your success.

startText.en:
Ah, there you are. Wonderful! I was hoping I’d catch you before you run off to your next battle...

You see, we have wasted no time since arriving at the allod... Hunters’ scouts have been trying to determine the main sources of filth... Aside from the one we’re in, of course. Destroyers form packs just like any other demons, and they are headed by a powerful leader.

And that leader is just one demon.

We are clearly a minority here, so I suggest we move with minimum effort and maximum efficiency. We have located three especially powerful epicenters of the Destroyer forces and identified three leaders. Here are their descriptions. If you handle them, you’ll decapitate the whole armada and give us a head start as we prepare our counterattack. Sounds good, eh?

finishText.en:
Wonderful... Every amulet is worth its weight in gold. All the demon’s memories and a great deal of his power... Yes, amulets absorb their energy as well. It would be useful after the death of our wards. A very useful invention.

At any rate, you’ve rendered me a great service. I won’t forget it.

goal.en: Maya Voronina asked you to collect connecting amulets from the dead demons on the battlefield.

startText.en:
Good morning! Unfortunately, there was no time for formalities before, and the current situation is far from... I guess you have already met Tegorah. He’s quite a charismatic leader. It’s an important quality these days... Especially for a demon.

Let’s get down to business. I heard you’re heading for the frontline. Normally, I wouldn’t want to bother you with any requests, but this is a special occasion...

You see, every demon at the Citadel wears a special amulet. I registers and records anomalous activity in their organisms. Reactions to new irritants, fluctuations of astral energy... and the demon’s collapse at the time of their death. Our demons are dying on the frontline right now. Their deaths are a priceless material for research. We can’t let it go to waste!

I’d like you to collect these amulets from the bodies of the fallen before they are crushed in the heat of battle.

checkText.en: If I were you, I wouldn’t aim it at our, ahem, “friends”. It may cause spontaneous combustion and misunderstanding...

finishText.en:
Testing in field conditions was successful! Music for my dead ears.

Thank you very much. I can start adjusting it now.

goal.en: Use Sarbaz Sais’s artifact against the Destroyers.

startText.en:
Wait a second... I need to ask you something.

You see, I’ve always been interested in the way Light could be used in technomagic. It’s one of the reasons I ended up joining the Church. And I have good grounds for believing that I’m close to completing my research!

Here, take this artifact. It’s a weakened version of my prototype. Weakened because it’s dangerous to trust a stranger with a technomagical device, especially if the power of said device largely depends on its bearer’s faith. All you need to do is test it on the Destroyers. Technically, it works against all demons, but if I were you, I wouldn’t aim it at our, ahem, “friends”. It may cause spontaneous combustion and misunderstanding...

finishText.en: I hear the wonderful sounds of a shoot-out! So my babies work as expected. Let’s hope I set the correct target designation.

goal.en: Set up Nogrom’s defensive turrets on the Citadel’s upper platform.

startText.en:
I’ve built a few toys from bits and pieces. Let’s set them up on the platform, might even hit someone. I mean, you go set them up, I’m not going up there.

How? It’s easy! Just place them somewhere, press the big red button, wait until it unfolds, and the kick it for good measure. Works like a charm - Nogrom’s honor!

finishText.en: So... Cannon ball... grenades... good! The drone is intact! I was afraid they’d explode before they let you catch them... What? What box? Ah, it exploded. Oh well. I don’t even remember what was inside.

goal.en: Retrieve Nogrom’s belongings and important parts of the ship from the shipwrecked Callisto at the White Hook.

startText.en:
Great, chief! Are you hurt? Okay, good.

I’ve been planning a trip to our ship, but the iron imps decided to attack us. Can’t sneak past them... Hm...

Yes, I need some stuff from my ship. The locals complain that the Citadel has no defenses to speak of. Hah! We’ll set some up easily as soon as I get my tools and supplies back. They don’t even have a proper workshop here! But that’s fine, we’ll manage...

Hey, maybe you and Skulnar can grab a few things?

finishText.en:
...It seems as though sunlight is flooding the room. In the end, you realize it’s just triumph and pride radiating from Tegorah.

“The Destroyers have been pushed back!”

goal.en: Complete the quests at the Citadel to repel the demons’ attack.

startText.en:
...The Archdemon raises his staff belligerently. The heavy shaft strikes against the stone floor, and you glimpse faces of those who volunteered to defend the Citadel.

“Our differences can wait, Stormbringer. As long as we have a common enemy, and they are on our doorstep, no one will dare attack my demons... or Demonologists. I extend the same courtesy to our guests, and I expect the same of you. Insubordination will be punished by execu... I mean, law.

Take your weapon and face our enemies. Remind them why the whole world is afraid of you!”

finishText.en: Wake up, sleepyhead! We have a problem.

goal.en: Obey the strict healer and go to bed

startText.en:
What the hell is this?!

What did I tell you? Bed! Rest!

Let’s start again. Perhaps there has been some misunderstanding. Bed rest means resting in bed. You get up only when you absolutely have to. Otherwise there will be insurmountable complications incompatible with life. In which case I will be executed for criminal negligence.

Go to bed. Now!

finishText.en:
Yeah, I hear they broke through. Of course, they did. We have pitiful defenses...

But I intend to put an end to this outrage, hehe.

goal.en: Find Nogrom in the Citadel of Sogot.

startText.en:
What do you think... We were attacked last night. The guard was slaughtered, fortifications shredded. They even got inside and wrecked more havoc. At least they managed to sound the alarm...

You know, you’re looking a bit pale. Did you sleep well? No? Well, no wonder, with the stuff that’s happening... We’ll have you back on your feet in no time! Here, open this flask. Take a big swig. I’m not telling you what’s inside until you drink. Come on, drink!

What do you think? Hah, you bet! Pure glacial water. Direct from Ferris. You thought there’d be something nasty? Right, stereotypes! Put something on and let’s go find Nogrom. It’s gonna be a long day.

finishText.en: Get dressed and let’s go, cap'n. No time to waste! I’ll tell you the rest in the meantime.

goal.en: Hear Nogrom’s plan

startText.en:
Those Destroyers decided for some reason that wearing chunks of strange metal was a good idea. Right! I opened tin cans with my teeth before I could walk, so these aren’t a challenge at all! Interaction with metals widens all sorts of horizons!

Look what I’ve made from bits and pieces. Stasis field generators? Easy. Homing mines? Done. Alarm system? Working on it - it’s incinerating instead of, well, alarming for some reason. Demon disintegrators? Here they are, my babies! And all in one night. I’m great, right? Right.

Sleep? That’s excessive. I’ve slept this month already.

There’s just one problem. We need to power all this stuff. And we’re really short of batteries. And there are no battleships parked nearby, so I can’t steal any! But I have an idea. Listen!

checkText.en: Got it? Let’s roll!

finishText.en: Alright, get out of my workshop! The genius will awake soon, I need to make everything ready! But if you get me something to eat, I’ll be much obliged.

goal.en: Explore the Master's Citadel on the Isle of Revelation and collect the necessary data for Nogrom.

startText.en:
We need to break through that Citadel’s defenses and see what’s inside. You should ask that girl for help. The redhead who’s Veronica on Mondays and Berenika on Fridays. Apparently no one’s told her about other weekdays.

Here’s a scanner and here’s a crowbar. Crowbar is for those curious about your honest investigation. Don’t use it on anything in the Citadel! Even if you really want to.

Is everything clear? On with it, then!

finishText.en: ...You have retrieved all available data. Time to come back before the maniacal healer notices the absence of his favorite patient.

goal.en: Examine the Heart of the Master’s Citadel.

startText.en: ...Numerous panels and lights blur and double before your eyes. Time to remember Nogrom’s instructions...

checkText.en:
Wake up, wake up! Creatures attacked our workshop!

Nogrom is nowhere to be found!

finishText.en:
Wake up, wake up! Creatures attacked our workshop!

Nogrom is nowhere to be found!

goal.en: Go to bed.

startText.en:
Weren’t you prescribed bed rest? Go now before stick mustard plasters on you, hehe.

I’ll pass, I think. They say you have unhealthy dreams here. I have better things to do than watch some silly nonsense.

finishText.en:
My condolences, Stormbringer. Although... It seems rather strange, no?

We went to great lengths to ensure we had proper defenses. We strengthened our known weak points, launched a successful counterattack with minimal losses. And yet, when the night fell, all our efforts turned out to be in vain.

And the situation keeps reoccurring!

goal.en: Search Nogrom’s workshop.

startText.en: You heard right! The local idiots slept through an army traipsing all over them. The workshop is wrecked. No one knows where Nogrom is. Alright, let’s go see it for ourselves!

finishText.en: Oh, what a mess... Things are coming to a head!

goal.en: Wait until Zakhar Krestov finishes reading the messages.

startText.en: Alright, let’s have a look at it. Since you’re a designated messenger, I may need you to take something back.

finishText.en: I’m glad to see you. Can’t even round the corner - what if the Destroyers are there... Your timing is perfect.

goal.en: Find Sarbaz Sais.

startText.en: Let’s start with that duo: Velit and Sais. We should ask them for a report on their mission. They will be forced to confirm the truth - that the Demonologists and demons fought shoulder to shoulder with them against the Destroyers. Let’s see how they are going to play this. We’ll also find out what they know about August.

checkText.en: I can carry out a special ritual to find out if August is around, or... if something is keeping him in the world of the dead.

finishText.en: So what do we have here? His lamp, his blood... A picture locket... who’s Franz de Vevre? Oh, fine. Let’s get on with it.

goal.en: Find August de Grandeur’s belongings on the upper platform and bring them to Sarbaz Sais.

startText.en:
Statement? Oh, Light... I’m afraid there won’t be much. I wasn’t on the upper platform yesterday, so I didn’t fight the Destroyers with the rest of the defenders. My statement is worth nothing. But I know someone who can tell you a lot!

August de Grandeur. Yes, you’re correct - he should have resurrected a while ago. However... The elf is nowhere to be found. I suggest you collect his belongings from the place where he died - since that night, it has been impossible to get to the upper platform, so they should still be there. I can carry out a special ritual to find out if August is around, or... if something is keeping him in the world of the dead.

finishText.en: The procedure is far from pleasant, I agree... And we didn’t learn much. Just the fact that August de Grandeur is irreversibly dead, which changes a few things... Well, I’m ready to give my statement.

goal.en: Drink the deadly poison and find the spark of August de Grandeur in Purgatory.

startText.en:
Just a second... Ah, damnation...!

Please forgive me. The reaction is too unexpected. And anomalous, too... No, August is not among the living. Do you understand? The Destroyer killed a true believer, and he can’t resurrect! It sounds like we don’t have a choice.

We need to find his spark in Purgatory and find out what happened.

Here, take it. It’s a deadly poison. You know what to do. See you on the other side.

finishText.en: You’re right on time! There is a problem...

goal.en: Find Velit Molotov and clear the wing of the demons along the way.

name.en: Smell of Gunpowder in the Morning

startText.en:
Me? Dead? No way.

Well, yes, it was a scary creature, I barely escaped. And the notes... Like that's gonna happen! I'm alive and keeping busy. I found your Molotov. He's in the next wing. But there are lots of demons here and the passage is blocked.

How about this: you kill demons, I blow things up. And never mind the explosions, we're in a hurry. Okay?

finishText.en: Phew... That was close... If it wasn’t for you, we’d all be dead.

goal.en: Hold off the Destroyers while the Demonologists are sealing the breach in the wall.

startText.en: The imps just keep coming! We must seal this breach - can’t leave it gaping like this. But I can’t protect workers and kill demons at the same time... Lend a hand, will you?

checkText.en: Let me get my bearings first. I’m not used to writing.

finishText.en: There it is. So, the seal... You can take it to Zakhar. He probably won’t be happy, but he’s never happy. The old man is always grumbling about something...

goal.en: Take Velit’s statement.

startText.en: You need my statement... Can do. I saw everything I needed to see. Let me get my bearings first. I'm not used to writing.

finishText.en: So, you’re alive and well? Good to know. Are there no other messengers in this hotbed of heresy?

goal.en: Gather evidence about the Demonologists' actions and show it to Zakhar Krestov on Black Spit.

startText.en:
You can’t imagine the level of preparation and alertness after that fiasco. No mouse should be able to sneak by unnoticed, let alone an army. And yet... The Citadel is swarming with enemies. The snake is right in our heart.

It sounds like we have a rat. And I can’t help but think that everything that’s happening benefits the Church. Just think about it: any fight between us and the Destroyers serves their interests. They exhaust both sides... August de Grandeur should have already resurrected. Something tells me these tricks are right up his alley.

Well, let’s continue our diplomatic efforts... If our luminous friends are trying to gather evidence against us to avoid direct orders from on high, we’ll go the opposite way. We’ll work with these worrywarts and prove our innocence.

Aggressively.

finishText.en: Fine... the goblin is not completely useless. His signal mines have been activated, see? We’re going to have guests soon.

goal.en: Tell Skulnar about the situation and check with the healer.

startText.en: Well, come on, then. Tell me what you were thinking. Were you out of your mind? Trying to pull demons away from the camp? Hijacking a ship? What did you activate there, anyway? My eyes still hurt, and I didn’t even look at it!

finishText.en: Show them, cap'n!

goal.en: Help fortify the camp by building barricades and repairing Nogrom’s cannon

startText.en:
No rest for you, sleeping beauty! We’re going to have guests soon, and we should give them a warm welcome!

The ship has been scrapped, we are building barricades! Just nail the planks down... Nogrom is working on something, maybe we’ll even have artillery. But barricades should com first! Come on, cap'n, shake a leg before they toss us into astral!

checkText.en: Kill them!

finishText.en: That was a hard fight! They knew when to attack...

goal.en: Fight off the demons’ attack.

startText.en:
So you’re an experienced astral traveler, right? Get behind the cannon and pull the trigger! I did my job and built it, but I have no idea how to aim it!!

Goodness, they are flying in! Kill them!

finishText.en: Ah, the patient deigned to awaken. Aren’t you tired of malingering? It’s been two days. Yes, our sanctuary is full of... strangers thanks to you.

goal.en: Broker a truce between the Demonologist leader and the chief Demon Hunter.

startText.en:
Oh, I don’t like this... Iron demons weren’t enough for these soldiers - now they’re trying to kill each other... What do we do?

Maybe we should... brainwash them? No? Alright, fine. You go talk to them, then. Diplomatically! But don’t be afraid to be expressive either. That Xadaganian girl is the leader of the Demonologists, apparently. And that Kanian is clearly the chief hunter.

Good luck.

checkText.en: I own you now. Deal with it.

finishText.en: Come, child, bathe in the rivers of blood. Daddy doesn’t mind.

goal.en: Try to resist Nihaz.

startText.en:
I hear you caused a ruckus the past couple of nights. Have you no shame, doing it in someone else’s house? The poor elf is afraid of you even in the afterlife, and you nearly killed your friend! Yes, with your own hands...

Ha ha ha! That look on your face is priceless!

I own you now. Deal with it.

finishText.en:
This is it... Don’t worry, we’ll find a way to get you out. I’ll have Cosmos’s head if need be.

Now here’s what you’re going to do...

goal.en: Follow Skulnar to the Citadel.

startText.en:
...Desire to kill the orc flares like a fire in a dry forest. You see your own arm rise but you are helpless to stop it. A Destroyer's mind knows no fear or mercy. The orc does not back down, however. He comes at you with his arms open as though intending to embrace you.

The next instant his voice explodes in your mind, paralyzing your body - the alien body - with unbearable pain.

"Stop!"

...It is an order you are happy to obey. Skulnar comes closer, and you feel his unquestionable power over the demon's mind. His days in the Laboratory were not spent in vain. You hear the orc's voice from afar, as though there is a wall of water between you.

"An entire Citadel full of demons and "Demonologists", damn them, and none of them sensed there's something wrong with you...

You. Come. With me!"

...You obediently take a step forward.

finishText.en: Ah, hm... Of course I knew the weapon would do this... No side effects or unwanted deaths. Goblin’s honor, right. So that creature ate you?

goal.en: Go after Sarbaz Sais.

startText.en:
There’s only one thing we can do - take out that crazy Zem before she gets us all killed. Destroyers are against us, so you’ll crush her as a Destroyer. That way no one will complain that the local demons or warlocks are against the Light.

Got it? Find Sarbaz Sais! Stop her! Kill her if need be! If you see our people on the way - help them, but don’t linger too long! Go now!

finishText.en:
What in the name of Chaos is going on here?!

How did you get here?

goal.en: Disrupt Sarbaz Sais’s plans.

startText.en:
Ah, so Skulnar thought of everything, apparently, and I... made a bit of a mess.

But who cares? The Citadel is going to blow up any minute now! This lunatic wants to free the Heart of the Citadel and reload the generators. That demon is the Heart! She must be stopped, and if the believers start complaining - deal with them next! Right?

Come on, while there’s still time! Perhaps I can stabilize the systems if she hasn’t destroyed them...

checkText.en: We can’t judge her - there’ll be a scandal. But you have a perfect right to do it.

finishText.en: We got rid of that vermin, which is good. Let’s get out of here, shall we?

goal.en: Decide Sarbaz Sais’s fate.

startText.en:
Ah. Never mind. We repelled the attack. It wasn’t easy, but we did it. We haven’t lost many demons, but the Demonologists... Let’s say things could have gone better. Much better.

Some of the Hunters helped us fight. Probably after their leader recklessly killed Molotov. Velit will resurrect, but Zakhar... Some demon tore him apart. Good riddance.

And now the highlight of today’s show... The cleric. We can’t judge her - there’ll be a scandal. But you have a perfect right to do it... Since the Great Mage himself bestowed that authority on you.

finishText.en:
Well, the Demonologists got what they wanted. After what happened, the Church will think twice before challenging us. As for the demons... Their alliance with the Demonologists will lead to no good. But that’s their life and their choice.

We can only wish them luck.

goal.en: Go to bed.

startText.en:
I’m not flying anywhere with this lot again. I’d rather use portals, even though they give me indigestion... Portals aren’t working now, though... apparently, something broke after one lousy goblin decided to bring down a whole section of the Citadel, together with an armada of Destroyers... Yeah... Good times.

We’ll get out of here tomorrow. Sorry, cap’n, but I’ll be guarding your cot tonight. Just in case.

Don’t thank me, heh.

checkText.en: We’ll talk later!

finishText.en: I see you’re still capable of thinking. How are you feeling? We crashed...

goal.en: Tell Milas aboard the Callisto that you are ready to leave for Sogot

startText.en:
I hear it’s an emergency. We should leave immediately - there’s an astral storm coming our way, so it’s better if we leap through before it the sky turns upside down.

My guys are ready. Give the word, Stormbringer.

checkText.en: Look, just find out what they’re fussing about.

finishText.en: Captain! Just make them shut up.

goal.en: Talk to the Callisto’s crew

startText.en:
It's bad. The ship was dragged through these... bones? Through half of the allod. There's nothing left of her. Or her captain, which is especially tragic! You see, no one's waiting for his kind in Purgatory.

They are all panicking now. We must do something! Use your commanding tone! I'm only good at screaming. Or brainwashing, but that would be inhumane. Look, just find out what they're fussing about.

checkText.en: Keep your crew busy. Me and Nogrom will decide what to do next.

finishText.en:
You’re a born leader!

I’ll keep an eye on them, and you go talk to Nogrom. He’s got an idea, I think.

goal.en: Give the Aoidoi instructions at the wreck site and return to Skulnar the Fierce.

startText.en:
Let’s not sit idly - we aren’t chickens. Give some tasks to your crew. Me and Nogrom will decide on a course of action.

We need to get out of here somehow, and the little guy is smarter than he looks. He might think of something.

finishText.en: Thank you for your quick response.

goal.en: Meet Nefer Ur on the platform near the Observatory on Ammer.

startText.en:
...The infocube unfolds in your hands, its tiny steel elements fitting into hidden slots, making you wonder at the technology. In the end, a small pedestal is formed in your palm, with a greenish hologram of the Great Mage of the Arisen appearing on it. Nefer Ur's hands are resting behind his back; his porcelain mask shows no emotion. The Great Mage raises his head slightly, and his eyes meet yours. You hear his voice as though it is coming from inside your head...

"Circumstances require your involvement. The matter has nothing to do with the League or the Empire. The aoidos and their new... allies need your help. I have a vested interest in this as well. Meet me near the Observatory on Ammer. Make haste."

...Sounds urgent.

finishText.en: You see, Stormbringer, we’d like to provide assistance to the demons. More than anything in the world. But we’re not allowed to interfere! Nefer Ur told us about the looming political conflict and war... War against us! However righteous our intentions, we will not let our people die for them.

goal.en: Ask Nefer Ur about his problem.

startText.en:
It’s not my problem. It’s the problem of demons and their allies, the Aoidoi. I’d rather the Aoidoi never encountered such unpleasant problems.

Tell me what you know about the Demonologist order?

finishText.en:
Ah, there you are.

Milas. Nice to meet you.

goal.en: Talk to Captain Milas aboard the Callisto.

startText.en:
There is only one creature both Light worshippers and demons fear and respect. It’s you, Stormbringer.

I want to believe in Nefer Ur’s good intentions, but the man wouldn’t be in his position if he didn’t know how to benefit from anything that occurs in this world. I advise you to be careful with the Demonologists, my friend. Their methods are different from ours. They see demons as a tool... Nothing good can come from those who consider living creatures as a means of self-exaltation.

Sogot is a remote allod, so you’ll need a ship to travel there. We’ve gathered an expedition prepared for the long voyage. You see, Aoidoi aren’t very experienced astral travelers, but these people are better suited than others. The ship is already waiting for you.

Good luck, Stormbringer.

checkText.en: Come on, turn it on! Don't make me wait. I'm dying of curiosity.

finishText.en: Ahaha! It's fortunate that you're here! I think it's time we talked.

goal.en: Listen to Nefer Ur's message

startText.en:
Interesting!

I got a letter. Addressed to you. Nefer Ur sent it.

I wonder what the Arisen wants?

Ah, if only you knew how long I've known him... But now is not the time to indulge in sentimental memories of Hickut. There's a package attached to the letter. It contains a curious thing - the Infocube.

Let's turn it on and see what he has to say.

checkText.en: They’ll break into the camp while we’re off somewhere...

finishText.en: Good job, Captain!

goal.en: Defeat the Destroyers around the camp.

startText.en: I believe you agree that this is an obscene number of tin cans. I suggest we reduce their population. We could use a workout, and it’ll get more peaceful here. Or else they might attack the camp while we’re over here.

checkText.en: If anyone gets near the camp - we’ll know right away. If we don’t go deaf...

finishText.en: If you people don’t watch your step, don’t blame me. Make sure everyone in the camp knows!

goal.en: Place Nogrom’s mines around the camp

startText.en: Once we take care of these things, we should place mines around the camp. If whoever steps on them loses a limb, all the better! But that’s not what they are for! They don’t cause much damage but they make a lot of noise! If anyone gets near the camp - we’ll know right away. If we don’t go deaf...

checkText.en: Chop-chop!

finishText.en: Great! Why this much? We just want to get their attention, not blow the Citadel up. Although... that will definitely draw attention...

goal.en: Find components for Nogrom’s special explosives.

startText.en:
Well, that’s wonderful but we’re waiting for help here. And if we don’t have a way to signal said help, it’s not coming. So what if we ripped a hole through the allod? Would you respond to something like this? I know I’d stay away! We should make signal rockets. And to do that, I’ll need a few things. And then it’s applied pyrotechnics!

Let’s try something. There are bones and remains all over the place - we’ll use them. I’ll need some... ashes.

Poetic! Go get it, I don’t want to stay here longer than necessary.

checkText.en: Time is pressing!

finishText.en: Oh, you’re alive! Good!

goal.en: Complete all Nogrom’s tasks.

startText.en: Finally! I’m sick of sitting on my hands, we must ACT! I have a to-do list already! Seven hundred and fifty two entries. But time presses, so I’ll cut it down to three. Here!

checkText.en: The Spirit wants you to kill the Astral Grave Imps...

finishText.en: Something strange is going on... It seems that the extermination did not pass unnoticed to the Spirit!

checkText.en: A broken blue crystal is all what the Spirit is showing.

finishText.en: It seems the Spirit is happy that the crystal is broken and the Imp Guardian is defeated. And this blue stone... Isn't is a shard of a Prime Rune?

goal.en: Examine the Blue crystal, reveal its secret and come back to the Spirit.

startText.en:
A strange Blue Crystal appears out of the thin air, while the Spirit keeps pointing you to a location in the southern part of the allod.
It seems the Spirit suggests you to examine the crystal and get to that location, in order to receive something important... What a puzzle!

checkText.en: The Spirit wants you to kill the Astral Grave Demons...

finishText.en: Something strange is going on... It seems that the extermination did not pass unnoticed to the Spirit!

startText.en: The Spirit is trying to show you something. Astral Grave Demons? It seems that the Spirit desperately wants these creatures to die. Perhaps killing 25 of them will be enough.

checkText.en: A broken yellow crystal is all what the Spirit is showing.

finishText.en: It seems the Spirit is happy that the crystal is broken and the Imp Guardian is defeated. And this yellow stone... Is this a chip of a Prime Rune?

goal.en: Examine the Yellow crystal, reveal its secret and come back to the Spirit.

startText.en:
A strange Yellow Crystal appears out of the thin air, while the Spirit keeps pointing you to a location in the eastern part of the allod.
It seems the Spirit suggests you to examine the crystal and get to that location, in order to receive something important... What a puzzle!

checkText.en: The Spirit wants you to kill the Astral Grave Incubi...

finishText.en: Something strange is going on... It seems that the extermination did not pass unnoticed to the Spirit!

startText.en: The Spirit is trying to show you something. Astral Grave Incubi? It seems that the Spirit desperately wants these creatures to die. Perhaps killing 25 of them will be enough.

checkText.en: A broken red crystal is all what the Spirit is showing.

finishText.en: It seems the Spirit is happy that the crystal is broken and the Imp Guardian is defeated. And this red stone... Is this a fragment of a Prime Rune?

goal.en: Examine the Red crystal, reveal its secret and come back to the Spirit.

startText.en:
A strange Red Crystal appears out of the thin air, while the Spirit keeps pointing you to a location in the western part of the allod.
It seems the Spirit suggests you to examine the crystal and get to that location, in order to receive something important... What a puzzle!

checkText.en: The Spirit is showing you three parts of the Prime Rune...

finishText.en: Here it is! The completed Charm of the Astral Silver!

goal.en: Find a shard, a chip and a fragment of the Prime Rune of Astral Silver and bring it to the Spirit.

startText.en:
Here he is, the Spirit of the June Hunter...
But how do I communicate with him? I don't speak June...
Wait, the Spirit channels images right into my mind! I just need to close my eyes... He wants three... artifacts? No... Oh, now it's clear. A shard, a chip and a fragment... of a Primary Rune of Astral Silver. They are needed to create a Charm of the Astral Silver. But where do I find these parts?

checkText.en: How clean is the air here! And how beautiful is the sea! A heavenly place, this is! The perfect place for preaching the true faith!

finishText.en: At a certain point, we may need to teach our birds to read and write... With preachers like you, however, we can make do without it. What if they read something malicious?!

goal.en: Hold the sermon to the aviaks at the central square of their village, next to the elder's hut and next to the fishers' house, then report to Miroslava Lubianskaya.

startText.en:
Ah, is there a greater happiness than sharing the saving Light with those who previously lived in darkness? Tensess himself has done it so that the good word found grateful ears on this heavenly allod. The world is truly full of wonders! Soon the tender hand of the Church of Light will bring peace and splendor of the League to these beautiful islands and other places!
The white-winged tribe has already accepted the truth, but faith must be strengthened daily. And then, is there anything more pleasant to read for the faithful than an edifying sermon? However, the aviaks can't read yet, but that's not a problem. Take this sermon and hold it throughout the village. Hold it at the central square so your words can be heard by as many locals as possible. Then, next to the elder's hut - let the old man rejoice. And finally, by the sea, next to the fishers' house. That will be good!

checkText.en: Those Imperials are all lost souls. Why does Tensess even tolerate them? Would have been better if he hadn't resurrected them at all!

finishText.en: Five are dead? Splendid! Here, take this for your effort. Although your main reward is the satisfaction the good cause brings!

goal.en: Kill 5 Imperial heroes and report to Nadine de Blizare in the Misty Hollow.

startText.en:
I once made a pilgrimage to a distant monastery, and here's what a local old monk told me. Tensess' Gift is actually for true believers only. It's not meant for the Imperial schismatics, and it is only due to his exceptional kindness that Tensess resurrects them. But his patience has its limits! It is us whom he will resurrect indefinitely because we are his faithful children. The heretics, however, can only rise seven times seven, so that they have a chance to become reasonable. Do you realize what that means? You kill an Imperial soldier forty-nine times, and by the fiftieth time, he'll be dead for good!
The Empire recruited a lot of heroes like you for its campaign. They cause us much more trouble than all the Imperial propagandists. They even attempted to attack our dear Gordei! Catch them and beat them up without mercy until Tensess gets tired of forgiving. And I'll reward you for your zeal, rest assured.

checkText.en: Maybe they'll repent and get kinder if they get beaten to a pulp? You can't live your whole life as a sinner, a villain, an Imperial fellow!

finishText.en: Another fifteen killed? Great, just great! Here's a small reward for you. Now hurry back to the swamp: they're propagating faster than mosquitoes!

goal.en: Kill 15 Agitators of the Trinity Church and report to Nadine de Blizare in the Misty Hollow.

startText.en: The swamp swarms with those filthy, foul, unshaven propagandists, worse than leeches and mosquitoes! They spew all sorts of nonsense, hand out flyers, and the pagans are just too happy to believe it all! However can we make them disappear? Go take care of these wretches! Drown them in the swamp, reduce them to jelly, to red slush! Ooh, may Tensess forgive me, am I mad at them! Why oh why can't those Imperial bastards just believe in the simple truths of the Church of Light?

checkText.en: I sincerely hope words will be sufficient. I would hate it if the path to the Light were too long and painful for those poor ones.

finishText.en: Did the sermon reach their ears? That's great. I hope it reached their hearts too.

goal.en: Hold the sermon next to the elder's house, on the central square, and next to the fishers' house, then report to Yaver Totec in the Imperial Camp.

startText.en:
Mixed emotions fill my heart when I look at those young plumed ones. I feel sad because they lived in darkness and wilderness for so long. Yet I'm joyful, for they have lived to the day when the Light will be revealed to them. It is our duty to both help the oppressed tribe in their struggle for freedom and free them from the shackles of misconceptions, ignorance and the ultimate oppressor, death. You with me? That's great! Let's share with the aviaks the treasures of truth and immortality the Light has granted us!
Let's start with admonition, the simplest option we have. Take this sermon. I wrote it the whole night and I swear it will touch the coldest of hearts. Hold this sermon in crowded places: on the central square, next to the elder's hut, and next to the fishers' house by the sea. You shall see: no aviak will stay untouched!

finishText.en: Ah, Yaver Totec sent you? How's he doing?

goal.en: Meet with Timur Blagostin at the Imperial Outpost.

startText.en: Our action brings satisfaction! See, the joy makes me speak poetry. The Steel Claw tribe is already converted and granted the Gift! Yet our mission is far from over. I was told about hordes of poor non-believers on the swamps on that big island. How can we help them get out of the dirt, both literally and metaphorically? Our mission already went there, and you should follow it. Our commissar Timur Blagostin will be waiting for you at the Imperial Outpost. He's a person of, hrm, limited intelligence, but his faith is strong and his knowledge of the charter is perfect. I mean both the church's charter and that of the patrol force. Together, we'll lead the aviaks to the Light!

checkText.en: Tim says hi? It would have been better if he'd sent some mosquito repellent.

finishText.en: Fifteen, you say... Well, are you cruel, Tim and you. Killing on the threshold of converting to the Light. Do you understand they'll never be resurrected?

goal.en: Kill 15 Pagan Aviaks and report to Artur Blagostin in the Misty Hollow.

startText.en: Reporting the situation. Our enlightening effort is impressive, with a whole regiment of propagandists working. With gracefulness and righteousness improving daily, newly converted aviaks are eagerly joining the cause. However, an isolated group of non-conformists just won't reach out for the Light, as our colleague Yaver Totec puts it. They lack awareness to reach for it, they say. All they do is sit around in a swamp, yell malicious slogans and attack propagandists and newly converted aviaks. That's partly to our advantage: the ones they kill resurrect right away, clearly showing the advantages of the doctrine of the Trinity Church compared to all sorts of obscurantism. However, it's still no good. While this mess is going on, we can't report a hundred-percent conversion rate. That's why we'll have to resort to tough measures. I order you to destroy fifteen non-conformists to frighten the others. Report your success to Artur Blagostin in our main campaign center. And say hi to him for me, he's my brother. I hope they've not been killed by mosquitoes yet.

finishText.en: What's that? Spiritual trash printed by the League? I didn't expect anything else. Those from the League aren't any dumber than us, and they're already preaching their crap to those morons. Well, what can you do, we'll try stopping it.

goal.en: Show the book found in the swamp to Artur Blagostin in the Misty Hollow.

startText.en: Where did the aviak get it? A dirty, soaked, but fairly readable book. Although it's written in the language of the League, Tensess' face with a frayed halo of gilded foil leaves no questions about its contents. While you're doing explanatory work, the League is preaching to the aviaks on the other side of the swamp in a different way. You should show your find to Artur Blagostin and discuss methods of counter-propaganda.

finishText.en: I saw the Light. Everyone listen! The outlander speaks truth, their god is stronger than ours. We should lay down weapons and join the Trinity Church. Who stays in swamp, will have no one to blame but them!

goal.en: Find the pagan aviaks' totem in the Misty Hollow and overturn it to challenge their leader, Kemal Stiff-Necked. After defeating the pagan, use the resurrection scroll to revive him and convince him to convert to the faith of the Trinity Church.

startText.en:
Remember what the great Nezeb wrote about victory in chapter eleven of his epic work "The Great Beginning"? No? Shame on you! An Imperial hero, and yet you can't remember the basics! I'll remind you: "The best victory is breaking the enemy's plans. Breaking their alliances is a little worse. And defeating their army is the least preferable." Sure, we can spill the blood of League soldiers and pagans all over the swamp, but that triumph won't make us happy. We'll try to convert aviaks without a massacre, only by admonition. Well, almost.
Go challenge the pagan leader, Kemal Stiff-Necked. He's hiding from our troops, but I know how to lure him out. There's an ancient totem at the swamp, the pagans' last sanctum. Try destroying it, and Kemal will rush to protect it. Try convincing him to lay down his weapons.
And if he doesn't agree? Let him experience the power of the Light on his own skin. Kill him and resurrect him right away by reading this scroll over his body. This will convince even the most obstinate skeptic.

checkText.en: While capturing the sites of power controlled by the League, don't forget about ours. Check them just in case - what if the enemy is preparing to recapture?

finishText.en: I can feel the energy of the sites of power fill the air. Now, the earth itself is helping the Empire in combat! Yet it's too early to relax: we can't loosen our grip, or the League will retake all we have in an instant.

goal.en: Capture all the sites of power in the Misty Hollow and report to Yaver Anoom.

startText.en: The pagans surely err about the most important things, but their religious mishmash contains some gleams of truth. For example, this swamp, besides holy stumps, snags and tussocks, has four sites of power very similar to what we saw on Asee-Teph. Their properties vary, but that doesn't affect our strategy. We must do everything to capture all of the sites and keep them as long as possible while holding back the League. That's not only a matter of pride. Each site of power emits a strong current of mystical energy that helps those who tame it get stronger and more experienced faster. If all four currents are controlled by one side, all Imperial soldiers will gain strength in combat. It's worth fighting for, eh?

checkText.en: How are we doing on eliminating the religious and political ignorance? The only hundred percent rate we have for now is mosquito bites.

finishText.en: Artur and you managed to drive away the League's mission, didn't you? Excellent. A complete conversion of the pagans to the Trinity Church is now a question of time.

goal.en: Kill the League's priest Gordei Plamenev and report to Timur Blagostin at the Imperial Outpost.

startText.en:
I see Tim wants to report an early execution of the plan as soon as possible, but the lives of the congregation are more important. They're not going anywhere: a week earlier or a week later, they'll get tired of feeding leeches and come to the true teaching and warm food. That was the case with the orcs.
Yet a hostile ideology is a serious business. There must be only one way out of the swamp: the one that leads to us. We need to stop the League's preaching quickly, accurately, efficiently. To paralyze the League's mission, we need to decapitate it. No, not literally - we're not beasts, after all. Send the mission's leader Gordei Plamenev to the Purgatory, and we'll drive away the ordinary preachers.

checkText.en: When words are not enough to persuade, you resort to more forceful arguments. In the long run, these determine what is to be written in history books. Cruel but true.

finishText.en: Gordei got another unscheduled leave, didn't he? That's great. Sooner or later, he'll run out of mirra, and we won't hear about the League's mission for a long time.

goal.en: Kill the League's priest Gordei Plamenev and report to Timur Blagostin at the Imperial Outpost.

startText.en: To disorganize the operation of the League's mission, we need to efficiently strip it of its leadership. Here's what it means translated from bureaucratic: Gordei Plamenev must stay in the Purgatory. He already resurrected after the previous assassination - it's time to sent him to meet Tensess' servant again. If he rises, we'll send him right back. And we'll keep at it until the ultimate unconditional victory of the Trinity Church!

checkText.en: Gosh, some scoundrels are still wandering around the swamps, spoiling our figures. If I write 97% conversion rate, it doesn't look good. If I write 100% - what if they check it?

finishText.en: This is how victories are won. Congratulations, plumed warriors, on your being enlisted and taking the path of heroes!

goal.en: Hold the ceremony of handing the insignia to the five newly converted aviaks.

startText.en:
Our wards will no longer wander in the dark. They used to be simple savages from the swamp, yet now they'll be warriors of the Cha Pie-Pie special red-winged company. Good lads! Just between us, they won't make a company. After all those battles, I'm not sure we can count on a platoon of pagans. But there's nothing we can do: they heard the word "company" and really liked it, and now they insist on it. They agreed to join the church and to fight for us, but they insist on being a company. So let them: for a good cause, I can even call them a division.
Who led our boys to the Light? You! Therefore, you'll have the honor of getting them swear the oath. Here are their insignia - give them to the newly-made heroes of the Empire.

checkText.en: Be careful! I have no doubt the leaders of the League's expedition offered a similar reward for your head.

finishText.en: Five League heroes defeated? That's great. Here's your award. Sign here and keep up the fight. We don't have a right to relax, not for a minute.

goal.en: Kill five League heroes and report to Yaver Anoom at the Imperial Campaign Center.

startText.en:
The League found us as fast as we did them, and they're already taking countermeasures. Assaults on our propagandists are becoming more frequent, and recently we began to encounter attempts on the life of commissar Blagostin. Alas, we can formally give up the starry-eyed hopes of joint marches against our common enemy. This is war, and we must defend ourselves.
The League's expedition, like that of ours, included both a team of qualified experts and lots of volunteering heroes. The likes of you. It is them who is now in the way of our propaganda efforts. Exterminate them wherever you face them. After every fifth victory, report to me and receive a well-deserved award.

checkText.en: Get back to the swamp and continue working against enemy sermoners until you win the ultimate victory.

finishText.en: Fifteen sermoners exterminated? Excellent, you're supposed to get a financial incentive. Sign here in the book and get back to work.

goal.en: Kill 15 Sermoners of the Church of Light at the swamp and report to Yaver Anoom at the Imperial Campaign Center.

startText.en: I don't like the elated mood Blagostin brothers are in. Sure, it's tempting - search and destroy the main target and win the war with one beautiful strike. Yet that will never happen. Even if Gordei Plamenev is forever kept in the Purgatory... Even if we chop off his head in a purely barbaric fashion, the mission will not cease to exist as long as there are those who can preach. So roll up your sleeves and go weed the swamp. I'm warning you: it's boring, dirty and dangerous work, and neither one nor a hundred strokes can help us win. But this is the only way to win wars, and it is both long and boring. As a financial incentive, you will receive an award for every fifteen sermoners killed.

finishText.en: You've been told already, haven't you? Thankless savages! Well, we'll teach those stubborn fools a good lesson.

goal.en: Meet with Louis de Pluie in the League Camp.

startText.en:
Dear God, what's going on?! They say some pagans appeared on the big island! They're not like our healers and druids - those, although they worship the earth, go to the church and venerate Tensess and the holy martyrs. Yet these pagans got into some swamp and stay there, praying to some roots and snags! Shameless bastards! We brought the true Light to them, but they just wouldn't heed! I don't know what I'd do if I got hold of them... I'd pluck their feathers out!
I was told about them by our sermoner Louis de Pluie. Go ask him what's going on. Can this shame be tolerated?

checkText.en: Killing pagans is a cruel but necessary step. We crush their bones to save their souls.

finishText.en: The blood of infidels on your hands speaks of your resolution louder than any words. Let's do it then! We'll show those poor bastards what love and humility is!

goal.en: Kill 15 Pagan Aviaks and report to Gordei Plamenev in the Misty Hollow.

startText.en:
Most natives heeded our admonition and accepted the Light peacefully. Alas, there are always those who won't understand words. For those, I have preaching methods that are easier to understand. Fortunately, father Gordei Plamenev is with us - his sermon can convert even rocks and logs, let alone savages from a swamp.
He's on the spiritual battlefield now - in the swamp where the pagans are hiding. Go there and help him bring the light of the true faith to the stubborn barbarians. But first, prove your resolution. Kill fifteen pagans to strike fear and awe into the others.

finishText.en: What's that sponge? Imperial propaganda? Found among the pagans' possessions?! May Tensess curse them! Heretics and their dirty lies are already here! We must save the pagans' souls from that devilish nonsense.

goal.en: Show the book found in the swamp to Gordei Plamenev in the Misty Hollow.

startText.en: What does that pagan have in his bag? A book in the Imperial language! It's soaked with dirty swamp slush, but the cover leaves no questions about its contents: it has the profiles of Nezeb, Skrakan and - hardly discernible - Tensess - embossed on it. Imperial propaganda! We need to show it to Gordei Plamenev and decide what to do about it.

finishText.en: I saw the Light. Everyone listen! The outlander speaks truth, their god is stronger than ours. We should lay down weapons and join the Church of Light. Who stays in swamp, will have no one to blame but them!

goal.en: Find the pagan aviaks' totem in the Misty Hollow and overturn it to challenge their leader, Stiff-Necked. After defeating the pagan, use the resurrection scroll to raise him and convince him to convert to the Church of Light.

startText.en:
If I were to decide, I'd mix the bird brains of those stubborn fools with swamp slush and put an end to infidelity once and for all. Unfortunately, they learned to hide in the thicket. We don't have enough forces to comb the swamp and capture them all. Besides, our enemy will waste no time. We must find a way to convince them once and for all that our faith is true. Let's try converting their leader, Kemal Stiff-Necked. Once the chief is converted, the others will follow.
First of all, we need to force him to leave cover. Find their last sanctum, a filthy totem, and throw it into the dirt - and he'll come rushing at once. Then kill him. Then do the most important thing: resurrect the pagan by reading this scroll over his corpse. He'll hardly hang on to his misconceptions once he's been in the afterworld and experienced Tensess' kindness.
Go now. May the Light shine upon you and glory to Tensess!

checkText.en: Check the sites already captured by ours, too. Just imagine this horror: you capture an Imperial spot of power while they capture ours!

finishText.en: Can you feel the primal power radiating from these ancient sites? Their energy is so rapturous! Ah, it's too early to celebrate just yet! The Imperial soldiers must be making wicked plans on how to strip us of everything!

goal.en: Capture the four sites of power in the Misty Hollow and report to Nadine de Blizare.

startText.en:
Why do you think the pagans chose exactly this swamp for their riotous acts? There's a reason for it! Our scouts found four sites of power in the Misty Hollow almost like those on Asee-Teph! Do you realize what that means? Even if we only capture one of them, all the League heroes will be granted a blessing that will allow us to get stronger and more experienced faster. If we capture all four spots, the earth itself will side with us!
The only problem is this: pagan sites of power cannot tell good from evil or right from wrong. If they are captured by the Imperial murderers, the magical support will be theirs! Do you understand how important it is to keep them away from the sites of power?
Go capture all four sites to ensure the League's victory. Our cause is just!

checkText.en: The heretics already got hold of the souls of one of the winged tribes. Now they're preaching to pagans. Who can their next target be? The white-winged ones? No, such filth must be strangled at birth.

finishText.en: Blagostin is in the Purgatory? Excellent, that's where he belongs. While he is getting back from the afterworld, we'll drive away the Imperial propagandists and convert the pagans to the true faith in an instant!

goal.en: Kill Artur Blagostin in the Misty Hollow and report to Gordei Plamenev.

startText.en: The Imperial heretics are already here, packing the brains and souls of naive pagans with their lies! And who's in charge? The silver-tongued slanderer Blagostin! He'd be better off without his head, but such atrocities are not encouraged. Yet sending him to the Purgatory will be just right. Let him sit there, behold the stone walls, speak with Tensess' Servant - he may repent his misconceptions yet. At the very least, he will get some rest from his unrighteous doings. In the meantime, we'll disable his propaganda machine!

checkText.en: Can you imagine Blagostin offered a reward for my head too?! A crowd of Imperial soldiers came rushing just now, they nearly killed me. Boy, are they mean!

finishText.en: Blagostin is in the afterworld again? That's music to my ears! He'd better get used to it, he's going to be a frequent visitor.

goal.en: Kill Artur Blagostin in the Misty Hollow and report to Gordei Plamenev.

startText.en: According to this report, Blagostin already resurrected and is back preaching his heresy. You know what to do. I hear mirra is strictly rationed in the Empire's planned economy, and they have to give an account of every drop used. Let's see how long Blagostin's mirra will last, ha ha ha! And when he comes back from the afterworld, he'll need to write explanatory notes for excessive use of mirra instead of doing his propaganda.

checkText.en: May Tensess rise and may his enemies be wasted!

finishText.en: Only yesterday they rejected the Light, goodness and truth, and today they will crush the skulls of their unbelieving fellow tribesmen! Isn't it a wonder?

goal.en: Sprinkle mirra over the five newly converted aviaks.

startText.en:
