But why?! Did you fall from the XAES? You are making my statistics worse! Marriages registered in the Empire are the strongest marriages in the world! Yasker himself said that! Do you disagree with him?
Oh, you...
Well! I will tell you what should be done.
First, you must buy Divorce Papers from me and read them aloud here, in front of me, to your spouse.
If he or she agrees to divorce, you should sign them and you will be divorced.
That is it. I hope you never complete this task!

checkText.en: So, is everything ready?

finishText.en:
In the name of the Great Empire and in accordance with the decree of the Great Mage Yasker which orders the encouragement of marriage, I pronounce you man and wife!
May your life be happy and prosperous!
Hurrah!

goal.en: Complete Valery Comissarina's objectives to register your marriage.

startText.en:
Do you want to get married? Do you want to create a strong family unit in society? Good for you. Here is a guide on how to do it.
First of all, you must buy Wedding Rings and Wedding Dress from the Boutique. Secondly, your future spouse must put on the Wedding Dress and appear before me. As you initiated the wedding, you must have 10 gold coins to pay the marriage tax. To register your marriage, both of you must be over level 18. You cannot register a marriage with a character of the same gender.
If you meet these requirements you may propose to your future spouse. You will need Wedding Rings; one of them will be presented to your fiance!
As soon as he or she receives the ring it should be put on to confirm their consent to get married.
Is everything clear?

checkText.en: What can I help you with?

finishText.en:
These are tears of the Dragon! They are so large, so rare!..

Dragons were the Keepers of Sarnaut, who died out very long ago. The legends say that the dragons used to mourn their fallen comrades. Their tears reached the ground to freeze into crystals, filled with magic. I shouldn’t know if this is true or not, but what I do know is that they are very useful in combat.

If you have Tears of the Dragon in your locket, your blows and spells will deal much higher damage - at the expense of magic, released from the Tears. As soon as a tear runs out of magic, it burns to ashes. Experienced heroes always carry spare Tears on them.

The purer the tear, the more magic it conceals. I will provide you with a few, but in the future you will have to take care about it yourself.

goal.en: Bring Shards of the Tears of the Dragon to Anna Kavelina in Novograd.

startText.en: This is a curious thing... It looks like a slightly opaque crystal, filled with an incredibly strong magic. Better show it to someone who understands.

checkText.en: We won't be able to help you until your ship has been built.

finishText.en: Wow, what a beautiful ship you've got! Reliable, robust and fast... A dream of a ship!

goal.en: Order Maurice de Ardeur to start building an astral ship, wait until the construction is complete and talk to the Glowy Family in the astral hangar.

startText.en:
The Astral is deadly to any matter. It dissolves anything it touches without a trace - people, objects, even entire allods! For many years the only way to move between the allods was via portals. It was only recently that the gibberlings have discovered the secret of meteorite iron. Thanks to this discovery the gibberlings have become the best travelers in the world and distinguished themselves amongst the League's subjects.
The fact is meteorite iron can repel the Astral. Now our ships have a plating that contains extra small particles of meteorite iron, which allows them to plow through the deadly Astral just as easily as boats sail on river waters. And now you have a chance to acquire an astral ship and become a true astral captain.
If you have 1500 gold coins, I will order a new ship to be built right away - the job will be done in 10 days. When the construction is complete, talk to the ship masters, the Glowy Family, in the astral hangar.

checkText.en: If you happen to find a League Shipbuilder's License, I will give you a completed Astral ship right away!

finishText.en: Oh, my! I never thought I'd live to see the day when one of these would show up. Congratulations - now you can receive your Astral ship!

goal.en: Bring a League Shipbuilder's License to Maurice de Ardeur in the Novograd Port.

startText.en: After you bring a League Shipbuilder's License to Maurice de Ardeur in the Novograd Port and pay 1500 Gold, you will be able to buy an Astral Ship right away!

checkText.en: If you happen to find a League Shipbuilder's License, I will give you a completed Astral ship right away!

finishText.en:
Congratulations!
There are very few in the world as lucky as you.

goal.en: Take a League Shipbuilder's License to Maurice de Ardeur in the Novograd Port.

startText.en: If you bring a League Shipbuilder's License to Maurice de Ardeur in the Novograd Port, you will receive a completed Astral Ship right away!

finishText.en: Alright, now we can begin building your ship. It will take us thirty three days to complete this on our own, but remember that you can always boost the process.

goal.en: Accept Maurice de Ardeur's offer to start the construction.

startText.en:
What’s it going to be now? I can’t wait to get to the Far Astral! I wonder what goes on there, what monsters, what allods... New anomalies, unexplored lands! Damned Tep, why did he have to step out with his stupid mechanoids at this moment?

Haven’t you got an astral ship yet? Hurry to your Astral academy to see Maurice de Ardeur. Both League and Empire decorated a whole allod with their ships’ wreckage, so all of us will have to create a new fleet! New ships, new crews, new captain... See which way the astral flee jumps? Right. So, the new ship is what you need, and all the Astral treasures are yours!

checkText.en: Of course, I will never get the laurels of Zayan. Ah, I envy elven longevity in the moments like that!

finishText.en:
So, did you like it?.. Phew! I was afraid that it came out as boring as the chronicles of the World Mysteries. Or too frivolous, like elven love ballads. But if you say that it's good, there is nothing to worry about!

Now I need to get back to work. Thank you so much! Innumerous pages wouldn't have been written if it were not for you.

goal.en: Read fragments of Lovewise Catfish's chronicle of the last several years.

startText.en:
Who's coming there? Ah, it's you. It's always a pleasure to see you. Have you brought some stories again? Your adventures inspired me to start writing my book, "The Chronicles of Sarnaut".

I want to write about everything that happened in Sarnaut in the last several years. The world has changed so much, you know that! You are always in the thick of the events.

Here, read a couple of pages.

finishText.en: This is your Right to Allowance. That's all you're getting. Others need it, too! If you run out, you can get another next week.

goal.en: Get a Right to Allowance from the Battle Family.

startText.en:
What, itching to give someone a shiner? We get it. We are the same! We used to fight on a battlefield... Brought one down with my sword. Then another... A third one... Well, we took them out, too.
What we're saying is... Do you want to fight and benefit from it? We can help with that! Let me enter your name... How do you spell it?
There you go! Now you're officially a participant of the Battleground! Whenever you want to fight, just search for Skirmishes. If you don't know what Battleground is, we'll tell you later. For now, just listen and don't interrupt.
Every week you will receive a Right to Allowance which you can exchange for gold. You can also earn Signs of Victory in every fight. As soon as you have 100 Signs, use them to combine them into Battleground Emblems. Once you have a lot of them, find me - I'll exchange the emblems for valuable items. Fair terms, don't you agree? We Soldiers of Fortune always enjoy a good fight. And if you can also get something valuable for that, all the better!

finishText.en: Here, take some Emblem pieces. That's all you get! You're not the only one who needs them! If you run out, then you can get new pieces no earlier than next week.

goal.en: Accept pieces of the Battleground Emblems from the Roughneck Family.

startText.en:
So, you're itching to knock somebody's lights out? We get it... We're that way, too! If we had the time, we'd be out on the battlefield, too... Bam, one down! Zip! Another! The third... Well, we catch up to the third one, you betcha!
Anyway, we're trying to make a point here. Want to fight? I mean would you like to fight for a cause? We can help!
Take advantage of the Skirmishes menu and participate in a Battleground. If you don't know what the Battleground is, we'll tell you some other time. Don't interrupt.
We will give you some pieces of the Battleground Emblem. Why just pieces? So you'd still be motivated to join in battle so as to find more pieces. When you've gathered enough pieces and halves to assemble complete Emblems, come to us. We'll trade you valuable equipment for Emblems. Cool, right? We, soldiers of fortune, always ready for a good scrap. All the better if we can earn something valuable in exchange. You can't think of a better pastime!
If you are short of emblems, try visiting the junkmen - they sell the same items for a half price. The downside is that all their stuff is cursed.

finishText.en: Excellent. It will be useful in battle.

goal.en: Meet Vranomir Temnov in Novograd.

startText.en: Vranomir Temnov, the heretic trainer from Novograd, wants to meet you.

checkText.en: You don't look happy with your reward. What happened?

finishText.en:
Well...
It's not just what we've expected.
It's ok, this example will help me teach you a more important thing.
Take this coupon and exchange it for a free Scroll of Purification in the Boutique.

goal.en: Give to the Keeper of Secrets this canvas belt, so you can get something of better quality.

startText.en: I have something to reward you. I can see you have a great future, there's this spark in your eyes! This ancient chest contains potent magic. I am sure it will help you in your future deeds.

checkText.en: Did you manage to lift the Curse?

finishText.en:
Perfect!
Now you know how to deal with a curse.
All you need is Scroll of Purification. Use it and enjoy your new toy .

goal.en: Exchange the coupon for the Scroll of Purification in the Boutique and use it to remove a curse from the cursed sash. When you complete the task, report to Secret Keeper Lovewise Catfish.

startText.en:
Tensess' Gift which gives us some kind of immortality, didn't come easy to the world.
To override the power of Tep's Pyramid where Tensess Spark can be obtained now, Great Mage of Kania had to fight with Tep himself. Tep failed, however, he managed to do a bad turn to all of us. Many valuable things become cursed. They give no advantages. Quite the contrary! They spoil your abilities, if you put on such cursed item.
So I have a cursed Grubby Belt instead of a good one. Don't worry! We can deal with it all right. The coupon that I've given to you can be exchanged for the Scroll of Purification that will take away the curse. Try and check it.

checkText.en:
What unbelievable luck! The Great Mage's Diary has been discovered!
Don't you know who the Great Mage was? It can't be true! Even Goblins know who the Great Mage is! He is a great hero of the past!
In the year 646 of the New Era he solved the mystery of Umoir and helped Skrakan defeat the great demon! See?
For years the diary was thought to be lost. And then this great news arrive! Unfortunately, the adventurers who found it didn't understand the true value of the document. Fools... They thought these papers were just dusty scrolls worth a couple of gold coins... But it is a priceless rarity! Oh, I wish I could have it...
I know that merchants put pages from the diary into Strongboxes of the Counselor. There are plenty of them! Anyone can buy them from the Boutique. I'm sure there's no way to find all the pages.
Oh, I wish someone would bring me just one page! I would be so grateful!
Word of an honest goblin!

finishText.en: What an excellent find! The Great Mage's diary is of national importance. For this information you deserve a hefty reward.

goal.en: Bring the Fifth Page from the Great Mage's Diary to Goblin Banker in the bank of your faction's capital.

name.en: The Fifth Page from the Great Mage's Diary

startText.en: Goblin Banker will certainly be interested in this document.

checkText.en: Don't just stand there, join us! Triple-step and now swing-out!

finishText.en: This is real fun! Now you know how to dance.

goal.en: Speak to Prekrasa Horovodova at the Main Square to learn to dance.

startText.en: Wait a minute! Can you dance? No, I don't mean your one-two-three-step, I mean something more sophisticated. If you cannot, run to the Main Square to take a dancing lesson that Prekrasa Horovodova is giving! Hurry, before she leaves the city!

checkText.en: I sell various goods for the commemorative coins.

finishText.en:
Here are the coins... And the gifts!
Happy holiday!

goal.en: Bring 5 Anniversary Copper Coins to Ivan Godovikov.

startText.en:
We are celebrating a great holiday!
It is a one year anniversary of Aidenus issued the order, "Mass Draft of League Militia." Quite a few glorious heroes have appeared in Novograd since then. True gems! Heroes of the people! It was thanks to their achievements that the Empire was weakened and the demon threat repelled. What a wise order it was!
And to celebrate the anniversary, many commemorative coins of different denominations were issued. Copper, silver, gold and platinum.
Obviously, copper coins are the most common of the four, while the platinum are the most rare.
Coins can be found anywhere. You are even sure to get coins as a trophy when battling enemies.
After you acquire a coin, be sure to turn it into "Value," which will transform it from a useless knickknack into a valuable item that you can then use to buy something from me.
For instance, I'll trade you 3 Small Gifts for 5 commemorative copper coins!

checkText.en: I sell various goods for the commemorative coins.

finishText.en:
Here are the coins... And the gifts!
Happy holiday!

goal.en: Bring 3 Anniversary Silver Coins to Ivan Godovikov.

For instance, I'll trade you 2 Medium Gifts for 3 commemorative silver coins!

checkText.en: I sell various goods for the commemorative coins.

finishText.en:
Here is the coin... And here is your gift!
Happy holiday!

goal.en: Bring 1 Anniversary Gold Coin to Ivan Godovikov.

For instance, I'll trade you 1 unique charm for 1 commemorative gold coin!

Happy holiday!

goal.en: Bring 1 Anniversary Gold Coin to Ivan Godovikov.

startText.en:
We are celebrating a great holiday!
It is a one year anniversary of Aidenus issued the order, "Mass Draft of League Militia." Quite a few glorious heroes have appeared in Novograd since then. True gems! Heroes of the people! It was thanks to their achievements that the Empire was weakened and the demon threat repelled. What a wise order it was!
And to celebrate the anniversary, many commemorative coins of different denominations were issued. Copper, silver, gold and platinum.
Obviously, copper coins are the most common of the four, while the platinum are the most rare.
Coins can be found anywhere. You are even sure to get coins as a trophy when battling enemies.
After you acquire a coin, be sure to turn it into "Value," which will transform it from a useless knickknack into a valuable item that you can then use to buy something from me.
For instance, I'll trade you 1 unique charm for 1 commemorative gold coin!

finishText.en: Ole, ole-ole-ole! The League is the champion!

goal.en: Receive the Right Halves of the Contest Medal from Rogneda Whistlie in Novograd.

startText.en: Do you want to participate in goblinball? I will give you a few Right Halves of the Contest Medal. For each completed game, you will receive a certain amount of the Signs of the Athlete. A hundred of these signs can be traded for the Left Half of the Contest Medal, and two different halves can be combined into an intact medal.

finishText.en: Here. Beat the Imperials! I'll cheer for you!

goal.en: Receive tickets to Goblinball Championship from Barbell the Referie.

startText.en:
Are you stressed out? Seeing the Purgatory in your nightmares? Cheer up, have a break, go in for sport! There's a nice occasion!
We're in the middle of Sarnaut Cup Goblinball Championship, and we are looking for players! Whole teams of goblinball players! Are you strong enough to stand up for the League? Here are the tickets. Four a week, no more. If it's not enough, use your chance to play practice games. You don't get any rewards or prizes for it, though, but you can play as many games as you need.

checkText.en: Complete the Pledge quests to earn Prestige and prove your loyalty to the guild.

finishText.en: You have fulfilled your duty. Your loyalty is beyond any doubt!

goal.en: Praise your guild at the three denoted locations and report back to Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
It has never been easier! This Pledge gives you an opportunity to glorify your guild all over Novograd. Take these three speeches. You should deliver them at the Elven District, at the Trade District, and in the Gibberling District.
Please note that people listen to Great Heroes more willingly. This means that a Great Hero's speech will bring greater prestige to the guild.

checkText.en: Complete the Pledge quests to earn Prestige and prove your loyalty to the guild.

goal.en: Kill 20 Bloody Avengers which invaded the Big Stones Mine and report to Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Bloody Avengers which invaded the Big Stones Mine. Those renegades deserve to die, and there is no better way to glorify your guild than to discipline them.

finishText.en: You have fulfilled your duty. Your loyalty is beyond any doubt!

goal.en: Kill 20 demons on Kirah and report to Oleg Shpilev.

name.en: Pledge of Punishment: Demon of Kirah

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige?
Fighting demons is a rightful duty of every citizen. Beat them until they return to the darkness where they belong!
Kill 20 demons on Kirah to complete your pledge.

goal.en: Kill 20 Deadmen on the Isle of Revelation and talk to the Guild Master Oleg Shpilev.

name.en: Pledge of Punishment: Deadmen from the Isle of Revelation

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn more Prestige?
I can help you.
Here is the vow you need to take: defeat 20 Deadmen on the Isle of Revelation. Deadmen must be lying in the ground... not wandering the allods!
If you cope can with them, you will have stayed true to your vow.
Go now!

goal.en: Kill 20 Cultists on Frozen Peak and report to Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Tep Cultists on the Frozen Peak. Those renegades deserve to die, and there is no better way to glorify your guild than to discipline them.

goal.en: Kill 10 Draconids and 10 Wormfaces at the Frontier and report to Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove loyalty and earn prestige?
I can help you out.
Kill 10 Draconids and 10 Wormfaces at the Frontier. They betrayed us, and it was their death sentence.

goal.en: Kill 20 pagan aviaks on the Windy Hills and report to Guild Master Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn Prestige? I can help you with that.
Here is the pledge for you: destroy 20 pagan aviaks that live on the Windy Hills in Irdrich. Those ignorant heretics are incapable of seeing the power of the Light. If their sordid existence in dark superstitions isn't enough to make them accept a life in the Light, maybe the threat of death will!
If you can do it, the pledge will be completed.

goal.en: Destroy 20 Agitators of the Trinity Church in the Misty Hollow on Irdrich and report to Guild Registrar Oleg Shpilev.

name.en: Pledge of Punishment: Agitators of the Trinity Church

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn prestige?
I can help you with this.
Here's the pledge for you: destroy 20 agitators of the Trinity Church, which have been subverting the minds of our potential aviak allies in the Windy Hills. Naive locals are simple and trusting... the agitators will easily subvert them with their stupid ideology. You must save them from the propaganda and put them on the true path to the Light!
Do this to complete your pledge.

goal.en: Kill 20 Outlaws near Lower City and report to Guild Master Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige?

Kill 20 outlaws near Lower City to complete your pledge.

goal.en: Kill 20 Werefoxes near the lake and report to Guild Master Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige?
Kill 20 werefoxes at Umoir to complete your pledge.

goal.en: Kill 20 Imperial Sentries or Engineers at Medial Plateau of Kingdom of Elements and report to Guild Master Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige?
Kill 20 Imperials in Kingdom of Elements.
This will complete your pledge.

goal.en: Kill 20 Living Ice shards near the Ice Cave on Ferris and report to Guild Master Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty and gain prestige? I can help you with that.
Here is what you need to do: kill 20 Living Ice shards in the icy plains of Ferris. The Surveyors will be very grateful to you!
If you do that, consider your pledge completed.

goal.en: Kill 20 trolls in the Shore City vicinity on Dane and report to Guild Master Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige?

Here is the pledge: you need to kill 20 dumb trolls on Dane. They are harming the local citizens, and you would really do them a favor if you reduce the population of the beasts.

If you do that, your pledge will be fulfilled.

goal.en: Kill 20 White Orcs of Siveria and report to Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 White Orcs who inhabit Siveria. These savages are the same breed as the orcs of the Empire, and they are presumably involved in the murder of the members of Ermolai's expedition. Time to show them who rules these lands!

goal.en: Kill 20 Demon Invaders on Ammer and report to Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige?

Here is the pledge: you need to kill 20 Demon Invaders on Ammer. Aoidoi avoid fighting and violence, so we have to do the dirty job.

If you do that, your pledge will be fulfilled.

goal.en: Kill 20 Destroyer Invaders on Sogot and report to Oleg Shpilev.

name.en: Pledge of Punishment: Destroyers of Sogot

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige?

You must eliminate 20 Destroyers on Sogot.

Do that to carry out your pledge.

goal.en: Defeat one of the world monsters

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige? I can help you with that.

Here's the pledge that you must take: destroy one of the world monsters.

Do that to carry out your pledge.

goal.en: Kill 20 Goblin Hunters or Goblin Tormentors in Foul Dale on Umoir and report to Oleg Shpilev.

name.en: Pledge of Punishment: Poachers of Dale

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige? I can help you with that.

Here's the pledge that you must give: eliminate 20 Goblin Hunters or Goblin Tormentors in Foul Dale.

Do that to carry out your pledge.

goal.en: Eliminate 20 Landfill Raiders on Suslanger and report to Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige? I can help you with that.

Here's the pledge that you must give: eliminate 20 Landfill Raiders on Suslanger.

Do that to carry out your pledge.

goal.en: Kill 20 Angry Windrunners on Eden and report to Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige? I can help you with that.

Here's the pledge that you must give: eliminate 20 Angry Windrunners on Eden.

Do that to carry out your pledge.

goal.en: Eliminate 20 Snow Spiders on Isa and report back to Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige? I can help you with that.

Here's the pledge that you must give: eliminate 20 Snow Spiders on Isa.

Do that to carry out your pledge.

goal.en: Eliminate 20 Distorted Spiders on Jigran and report back to Guild Master Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige? I can help you with that.

Here's the pledge that you must give: eliminate 20 Distorted Spiders on Jigran.

Do that to carry out your pledge.

goal.en: Kill 20 Path of Fire Heretics on Xadagan and report about the pledge fulfilled to the Guild's Clerk, Oleg Shpilev.

name.en: Pledge of Punishment: Path of Fire Heretics

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty and gain prestige? I can help you with that.

Here's the pledge that you must give: eliminate 20 Path of Fire Heretics on Xadagan.

Do that to carry out your pledge.

goal.en: Kill 20 Werebears of the Darkwater and report to Oleg Shpilev.

name.en: Pledge of Punishment: Werebears of the Darkwater

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Werebears of the Darkwater. People also call them Vicious Werebears. These creatures are well-known thieves, they haul into their lairs anything they manage to grab. They even turned to a robbery recently, having plundered a number of our trading caravans. Protect our roads for the glory of your guild!

goal.en: Kill 20 Kobolds of the Jungle Mine and report to Oleg Shpilev.

name.en: Pledge of Punishment: Kobolds of the Jungle Mine

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Kobolds of the Jungle Mine on Asee-Teph. These cave dwellers occupied the mine preventing us from mining meteorite iron. I guess I don't need to explain how valuable this resource is.

goal.en: Kill 20 Demonic Cultists of Asee-Teph and report to Oleg Shpilev.

name.en: Pledge of Punishment: Cultists of Asee-Teph

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Demonic Cultists on Asee-Teph. This scum must be destroyed on sight! Since you have such a wonderful opportunity, use it to glorify your guild.

goal.en: Kill 20 Goblin Corsairs at the Takalik Harbor and report to Oleg Shpilev.

name.en: Pledge of Punishment: Goblin Corsairs of Takalik Port

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Goblin Corsairs landed at the Takalik Harbor on Eljune. Local Free Traders asked for our help. Do it for the glory of your guild!

goal.en: Kill 20 Tep Cultists on Coba Plateau and report to Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Tep Cultists spotted in Coba Plateau. Fighting them is the duty of every citizen of the League! And if your guild requires more Prestige, this is your chance to help.

goal.en: Kill 20 Black Dragons on Yazes Shard and report to Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Black Dragons on Yazes Shard. These creatures are dangerous and unpredictable. Great Mages are fighting their leaders, the Great Dragons, for a long time...
Excuse me, I'm running ahead of myself. Aidenus' note says that only the most trusted people can are allowed to Yazes Shard. Make sure you understand how dangerous this mission is before taking this Pledge.

goal.en: Kill 20 Demons in Gipat Caves and report to Oleg Shpilev.

name.en: Pledge of Punishment: Gipat Cave Demons

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Demons in Gipat Caves. Every citizen of the League should fight the demons, even on territories beyond our control.

checkText.en: Complete the Pledge quests to earn Prestige and prove your loyalty to the guild.

finishText.en: You have fulfilled your duty. Your loyalty is beyond any doubt!

goal.en: Throw the Challenging Gauntlet on the pavement of Novograd to summon the Shadow Foe, defeat him and report to Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
You can do so by defeating a dangerous enemy that embodies all the bad things that can happen in your guild. Mutiny, fights, intrigues... We are humans after all... Well, not counting for Elves and Gibberlings.
I will give you the Challenging Gauntlet. By throwing it on the Novograd pavement you will shift to another plane of our realm, where you will have to face your Shadow Foe and defeat it.

checkText.en: Complete the Pledge quests to earn Prestige and prove your loyalty to the guild.

finishText.en: You have fulfilled your duty. Your loyalty is beyond any doubt!

goal.en: Obtain 50 Marks of Diligence by fighting your enemies and report to Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Then you will have to show your persistence and fervor. You can get a special trophy from the enemies you will face during your journeys, it is called a Mark of Diligence. Collect 50 such Marks and bring them to me. Remember: you will not receive any Marks fighting weaker enemies.

checkText.en: Encouraging the most diligent people makes a good example for the others.

finishText.en: Your diligence will not pass unnoticed! Praised be your guild!

goal.en: Bring a Symbol of the Herald, a Symbol of the Punisher, a Symbol of the Duelist, and a Symbol of the Fervor to Oleg Shpilev.

startText.en:
Complete Pledges to receive special symbols. Keep them in a safe place!

If you manage to complete four Pledges in one day, your efforts for the cause of your guild will be noted! Besides, your services will help your guild reset the Rubies that have already been studied.

Remember, within one day you must complete the following quests: the Pledge of Eulogy, the Pledge of Punishment, the Pledge of Dueling, and the Pledge of Fervor. Bring me a Symbol of the Herald, a Symbol of the Punisher, a Symbol the Duelist, and a Symbol of the Fervor to ensure that your merits will be remembered!

checkText.en: Of course, we are creating jobs for all the poor orphans - there are quite good workers among them. It is going to bring profit not only to them, but to the League!

finishText.en: Thank you from all the League! Your contribution is a way more important than you might think. You are welcome to make it again and again.

goal.en: Purchase Symbol of Mercy.

startText.en:
You should know that mere praise won't lead you to success. People judge you by your deeds, and not only on the battle field... Hide your weapon for now. Good deeds await.

More and more soldiers fall in battles every day. Their widows and orphans stay with no support. We seek charity in different guilds to give them home and food. You may volunteer to donate, in order to help the widows and bring glory to your guild.

All you have to do is to buy a Symbol of Mercy from me. I am redirecting all funds to families of the fallen.

checkText.en: Is everything clear?

finishText.en: Fine, now you know everything. Feel free to join any guild - I'm sure I won't be ashamed for you!

goal.en: Ask Oleg Shpilev about guilds.

startText.en: I will explain you everything you should know about guilds.

checkText.en: Heil to you!

finishText.en: The Carnifex Code reveals many dark secrets! Just one page of it will enable you to steal the life force of the enemies that you kill to heal your wounds.

goal.en: Bring the Replica of a Page of the Carnifex Code to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters of your faction's capital.

name.en: Replica of a Page of the Carnifex Code

startText.en: Written in scarlet letters on sheets of ancient parchment. Is this really ink?.. Show this page to Goblin Banker.

checkText.en: Honor the great Sacrifice of Tensess, follow the covenants of the Church of Light, and may the Great Martyrs bless you!

finishText.en: Here is your blessing. May the Light guide you!

goal.en: Talk to Marianne de Ardeur to pledge your loyalty to the Church of Light and receive your martyr's blessing.

startText.en:
Greetings! Do you observe the rules of the Church of Light? Do you venerate Tensess' sacrifice? Do you offer up regular prayers?
This is not an idle inquiry. If you consider yourself worthy I will commune with your martyr so that you may receive their blessing. I will not ask for any proof, as I hope that your word is trustworthy enough. Well, what do you say?

checkText.en: Good afternoon! How can I help you?

finishText.en:
What’s that? Let me see. A manabike combined with a... bike?!

You are a lucky one. It’s a universal device. I won’t make you coffee, but it can serve as a reactor or as a motor, if you apply it to a ship. What do you need more? Choose!

goal.en: Bring the Universal Device to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters.

startText.en: This device looks extremely complicated and rare. Obviously, someone of a very sharp mind has crafted it. It has to be really valuable. Better Talk to Goblin Banker.

checkText.en: Good afternoon! How can I help you?

finishText.en:
What's that? Let me see. A Mana pot combined with a... bike?!

You are a lucky one. It's a universal device. I won't make you coffee, but it can serve as a reactor or as a motor, if you apply it to a ship. What do you need more? Choose!

goal.en: Bring the Important Gear Part to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters.

startText.en: This device looks extremely complicated and rare. Obviously, someone of a very sharp mind has crafted it. It has to be really valuable. Better Talk to Goblin Banker.

checkText.en: Good afternoon! How can I help you?

finishText.en: Ah, a certificate! The seal is genuine, and here is my signature. Alright, do you want more cannons, or thicker armor? If you want five cannons on the boards and two at the stern, we can make you a Corvette. If you want it as solid as a rock, we will use reinforced armor. It's up to you!

goal.en: Bring the Shipyard Certificate to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters.

startText.en: The certificate is adorned with dozen stamps, including stamps of the ship-repairing yard and Goblin Banker himself. It reads that the bearer of the document can use the services of most experienced shipwrights, who can turn a frail boat into an unsinkable Corvette. You should show the paper to Goblin Banker!

checkText.en: Good afternoon! How can I help you?

finishText.en:
What's that? Let me see.

Wow! It is a Universal Core Morpher - a very rare thing! I will gladly exchange it for any other Core Morpher. Choose wisely!

goal.en: Bring the Universal Core Morpher to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters.

startText.en: Magical runes, engraved on this plate of strange metal, read that this item contains a great power, able to turn a wizard into a warrior, and a bandit into a righteous man... You should show this thing to Goblin Banker!

checkText.en: Good afternoon! How can I help you?

finishText.en:
What's that? Let me see.

Wow! It is a Core Storage! Aren't you lucky? I will gladly exchange it for any Petrified Core you wish!

goal.en: Bring the Core Storage to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters.

startText.en: This thing looks very, very unusual. It seems like voices are whispering inside of it, swords are clanging, and battle spells are echoing dimly... You should show it to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters!

checkText.en: Having regular customers is great! It's nice to have a secure income.

goal.en: Collect 5 Broken Runes and deliver them to the Mysterious Family.

checkText.en: What do you have for me?

finishText.en:
You are lucky!
Soon Free Traders will start selling their astral ship devices in our capital. They have drawn plans as part of their promotion campaign!
You can exchange these plans for a reward!

goal.en: Bring Free Traders' Cannon Plans to Goblin Banker at the Boutique.

startText.en:
What's that? Plans of a ship device from the Free Traders. Well... Goblin Banker will surely help.
I'd rather show him these documents.

checkText.en: What do you have for me?

finishText.en:
You are lucky!
Soon Free Traders will start selling their astral ship devices in our capital. They have drawn plans as part of their promotion campaign!
You can exchange these plans for a reward!

goal.en: Bring a Replica of the Free Traders' Cannon Plans to Goblin Banker at the Boutique.

name.en: Replica of Free Traders' Cannon Plans

startText.en:
What's that? Plans of a ship device from the Free Traders. Well... Goblin Banker will surely help.
I'd rather show him these documents.

checkText.en: What do you have for me?

finishText.en:
You are lucky!
Soon Free Traders will start selling their astral ship devices in our capital. They have drawn plans as part of their promotion campaign!
You can exchange these plans for a reward!

goal.en: Bring Free Traders' Shields Plans to Goblin Banker at the Boutique.

startText.en:
What's that? Plans of a ship device from the Free Traders. Well... Goblin Banker will surely help.
I'd rather show him these documents.

checkText.en: Hello!

finishText.en:
You can't understand what is written here? Let me have a look!
All right... Overlord, also known as Director, also known as... oh, nevermind... In short, he decided to help all mount owners and teach them special tricks and abilities. Great, isn't it?

goal.en: Bring a replica of Lesser Scroll of the Commander to Goblin Banker in the bank of your faction's capital.

name.en: Replica of Lesser Scroll of the Commander

startText.en:
The scroll is written in an unknown language, but the symbols resemble the ones you noticed inside the Citadel.
It seems this scroll explains new methods of mount training. Interesting... Perhaps Goblin Banker will help you to decipher it!

checkText.en: How can I be of help?

finishText.en: Wow! You are so lucky. I can trade this token for Dreadnought, a powerful combat vehicle!

goal.en: Bring a Token of June Dreadnought to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters of your faction's capital.

startText.en: Goblin Banker at the bank of your faction's capital will trade this token for something useful.

checkText.en: How can I be of help?

finishText.en: Wow! You are so lucky. I can trade this token for Overlord's Throne, a powerful combat vehicle!

goal.en: Bring the Token of Overlord's Throne to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters of your faction's capital.

startText.en: Goblin Banker at the bank of your faction's capital will trade this token for something useful.

finishText.en:
Congratulations!

You've received the Scroll of Fate and can do anything you want with it!

I recommend reading it. Beep-beep!

goal.en: Talk to D2 Golem to receive the Scroll of Fate, then use it to receive bonus Marks of Fate.

startText.en:
Beep! Beep!

Trick the fate!

You have a rare chance to test the Scroll of Fate! It can be used to receive extra marks of Fate!

Come by, don't pass by! Beep!

finishText.en:
Congratulations!

You've received a Potion of Luck and can do anything you want with it!

I recommend drinking it before tackling an important quest. Beep! Beep!

goal.en: Talk to D2 Golem to receive a Potion of Luck.

startText.en:
Beep! Beep!

Come one, come all, don't miss your chance, get your potions here!

For one day only you have the opportunity to sample potions from the Boutique. Take a Potion of Luck, which significantly increases that particular stat. Which makes perfect sense, beep!

Take a look at my wares! Beep. Beep!

finishText.en:
Congratulations!
You've received the Folio of Knowledge and can do anything you want with it!
I recommend reading it. Beep-beep!

goal.en: Talk to D2 Golem to receive the Folio of Knowledge, then use it to receive bonus experience.

startText.en:
Beep-beep!
Hurry, hurry and get your experience!
For one day only you have the opportunity to sample the Folio of Knowledge. This magical book doubles all your experience!
Don't delay! Beep-beep!

checkText.en: How can I be of help?

finishText.en:
It's a copy of one of the lost scrolls!
The one who learns it will receive one extra talent point!
I can help you to understand what is written here.

goal.en: Show the Replica of Lesser Scroll of Sacrament to Goblin Banker at the Boutique.

name.en: Replica of Lesser Scroll of Sacrament

startText.en: Hmph... What a peculiar scroll copy. I should bring it to someone who deals a lot with unique wares... to Goblin Banker!

checkText.en:
What unbelievable luck! The Great Mage's Diary has been discovered!
Don't you know who the Great Mage was? It can't be true! Even Goblins know who the Great Mage is! He is a great hero of the past!
In the year 646 of the New Era he solved the mystery of Umoir and helped Skrakan defeat the great demon! See?
For years the diary was thought to be lost. And then this great news arrive! Unfortunately, the adventurers who found it didn't understand the true value of the document. Fools... They thought these papers were just dusty scrolls worth a couple of gold coins... But it is a priceless rarity! Oh, I wish I could have it...
I know that merchants put pages from the diary into Strongboxes of the Counselor. There are plenty of them! Anyone can buy them from the Boutique. I'm sure there's no way to find all the pages.
Oh, I wish someone would bring me a page or a copy of it! I would be so grateful!
Word of an honest goblin!

finishText.en:
I can't believe my eyes!
It is a copy of a valuable item. Therefore, I give you your reward which you honestly deserved.

goal.en: Bring the Replica of the First Page from the Great Mage's Diary to Goblin Banker at the Boutique.

name.en: Replica of the First Page from the Great Mage's Diary

startText.en:
Replica of the First Page from the Great Mage's Diary... Ahem...
I should bring this rarity to Goblin Banker.
And I should free up some space in my bag, as the Goblin might reward me with something valuable... an additional Ruby!

checkText.en:
Do you know that the ancient Junes were the greatest masters of gem cutting?
Just so you know - they could cut a full body armor out of a huge diamond! A soldier in such armor was nearly invulnerable.
Good news is that our masters managed to reproduce some of June works!
As you know, a person could only wear a single magic earring earlier, the second caused strong magical resonance, so they suppressed the powers of each other. But the secrets of Junes helped our jewelers to find a way to safely equip the second earring! Isn't it great?
Jewelers' knowledge is kept in the manuscripts that can be found in the Strongboxes sold from the Boutique.
If you manage to find the Common Jeweler Manuscript or its replica, bring it to me, and I'll teach you how to equip a second earring of the uncommon quality!

finishText.en:
Now you can equip an additional earring of the uncommon quality.
Congratulations!

goal.en: Bring the Replica of Common Jeweler Manuscript to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters

startText.en: Wow! It's a replica of Common Jeweler Manuscript! The manuscript teaches one how to equip a second earring. You'd better bring it to Goblin Banker.

checkText.en:
Wonderful news, indeed!
Demon Hunters managed to find the Study of Perfection scrolls that were lost after Cataclysm. There are rumors that Junes wrote them and this book was one of the guides studied by the Great Mages in the past. Can you imagine?
Hunters made a lot of copies to give everyone a chance to read it. Look for them in Radiant Strongboxes which can be bought from the Boutique.
If you find a page or its copy, bring it to me, I'll help you to decipher it.

finishText.en: What a find! You'll be glad that you waited to find the entire book. Let me help you decipher these ancient writings. Shall we start?

goal.en: Bring Replica of Paragraph from The Study of Perfection to Goblin Banker at the Boutique.

name.en: Replica of Paragraph from The Study of Perfection

startText.en:
It can't be! It's a Replica of Paragraphs from "The Study of Perfection" found by Demon Hunters.
I should bring it to Goblin Banker at the Boutique.

checkText.en: Good afternoon! How can I help you?

finishText.en:
You managed to find a very rare scroll. These scrolls were written by a very powerful sorcerer in the times of the Conclave. He locked himself in a tower to carry out experiments, trying to combine offensive and protective charms in one amulet. And he succeeded!
Still, his last experiment was unlucky, the magician died and his tower was destroyed. But some of his records resurfaced recently. Now you can trade this scroll for one of the wizard's artifacts. Wear it with pride! It will surely help you in battles.

goal.en: Bring the replica of the Scroll of the Wrathful Wizard to Goblin Banker at the Boutique.

startText.en:
The scroll is densely covered with runes, undecipherable spells, bizarre symbols and strange drawings.
If you look closely, you can recognize an image of some unknown emblem inspiring a sense of danger.
Perhaps, Goblin Banker knows something about this scroll?

finishText.en:
Congratulations!

You've received Water of Life and Water of Death, and can do anything you want with them!

Think before you act, though.

goal.en: Take Water of Life and Water of Death from Golem D2.

name.en: Water of Life and Water of Death

startText.en:
Beep! Beep!

Hurry! This is your unique chance to reconsider everything!

Only today you can receive Water of Life and Water of Death, that will reset your stats and Talent points!

Do not pass me by!

finishText.en: Here it is. The magnificent Tear of the Dragon that has turned into a perfect, flawless crystal of eternal ice. Keep it safe, hero of Sarnaut. May be, some day you will be lucky enough to learn why they cry...

goal.en: Collect 700 Shards of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon by completing Anna Kavelina's quests or by opening Boxes of Tears of the Dragon from the Boutique.

startText.en:
Dragons are the Ancients of this world. They call themselves the Keepers of Sarnaut. There is hardly anyone they wouldn't kill willingly: whether it's a demon, or a human, or an animal. Hatred makes their eyes water, and the tears of loathing fall drip drop on the ground...

These tears conceal huge power. We have learned to use them for activating two especially destructive abilities, available to those who have reached a high level. Smaller tears are for sale, larger tears are rewarded for good deeds.

A Frozen Tear of the Dragon is as good as a common tear, perhaps even better - you can never run out of it, no matter how many times you use it. Every good deed you perform will grant you a shard of a Frozen Tear. Collect 700 of them, and I will fuse them into one.A Box of Dragon Tears is sold in the Boutique, if you prefer to obtain them faster!

checkText.en: If you happen to find a League State License, I will give you a completed Astral ship right away! All League veterans who come back to service are qualified for Astral travels.

finishText.en:
In this hard times we need the aid of heroes more than ever! Brave captains will lead their ships through the Astral towards great victories!
We are glad that the veterans like you return to the ranks. The League believes in you!

goal.en: Bring the League State License to Maurice de Ardeur in Novograd Port to receive your Astral ship.

startText.en:
This license grants its holder the right to receive an Astral ship.
Bring it to the constructor Maurice de Ardeur in Novograd Port.

checkText.en: Did Hugues de Delice send you?

finishText.en: Kingdom of Elements represents a great opportunity for our research. Unfortunately, local dwellers do not feel enthusiastic about it, that's why we need heroes like you to gather materials for research.

goal.en: Use the portable teleporter to the Kingdom of Elements and meet the Collector of Rarities.

startText.en:
Have you ever heard of the Kingdom of Elements?

It's an Astral isle recently discovered by a group of brave travelers who jumped into a previously unknown wormhole. It was a piece of land with some ruins and an old June portal. the travelers managed to activate it.

There was also a volcano in the middle of the isle that started erupting a few months ago and split the land apart. The cataclysm awakened elemental spirits that were sleeping in the depths. Many people were interested in this phenomenon, and soon first explorers, including the Collector of Rarities, an Overlord's servant, arrived to the Kingdom of Elements. Collector of Rarities is looking for those who can help him in his explorations. Remember, this place is dangerous. Aggressive elemental spirits are ready to incinerate, crush, or freeze anyone who steps into their territory. But if you're not afraid, you can gain invaluable experience and a hefty reward for your help in the research.

checkText.en: I'm putting a special spell on you, so you can see which cape I need. Bring me the one I need right now, I won't accept any other!

finishText.en: Bravo! Bellissimo! Now that we have all capes, my show will astound the Great Houses!

goal.en: Bring 22 different class capes to Antoine de Ardeur in Elven District of Novograd.

startText.en:
Have you ever heard of the Ball of Eight Houses, "The Masquerade"? What a spectacular event! Unbridled emotions! Rampant passion! A contest of style, grace and novelty! I'm going to outshine all competitors at the next ball. And I need your help. My assistants are either too stupid, or are spying for other fashion designers. I don't want anyone to know about my venture beforehand, so I need an ally.
I want to organize a costume show! We will play a battle scene between the League and the Empire. The problem is that I need more capes for both sides. Have you seen the Cloak Chests sold in the Boutique? Bring me all 22 capes from the Chests. You can buy them from the Boutique, trade with someone or find them on the auction...
I hope a unique cape sewn by a famous couturier will be a perfect reward for you!
I'm putting a special spell on you, so you can easily see which cape I need.

checkText.en: I'm putting a special spell on you, so you can see which costume I need. Bring me the one I need right now, I won't accept any other!

finishText.en: Bravo! Bellissimo! Now that we have all costumes, my show will astound the Great Houses!

goal.en: Bring 28 different class costumes to Antoine de Ardeur in Elven District of Novograd.

goal.en: Bring 28 different class headpieces to Antoine de Ardeur in Elven District of Novograd.

I'm putting a special spell on you, so you can easily see which headpiece I need.

checkText.en: Greetings! Want to buy a mighty mount? A fast-legged Steed? Or maybe something more exotic?

finishText.en: Have a look. A good steed will come in handy to anyone!

goal.en: Visit horse breeder Ivan Ovsov at Novograd's gate and ask him about mounts' color patterns.

startText.en: A letter that arrived at the post office makes mention of horse breeder Ivan Ovsov and his pedigree stallions. This highly respected man may be worth paying a visit - a mighty steed can come in handy when you wander across Sarnaut's vast lands!

checkText.en: Where is Aidenus' courier? Why is he not here?

finishText.en:
Finally!
Now my guys shouldn't fear any diseases! Great Aidenus! Savior!
And you too, of course. If not you and that horse... Our healing potion should rotten!

goal.en: Talk to Ivan Ovsov, horseman, near Novograd main gates, straddle a horse and bring Aidenus' bag to Vlad Strezhnev, League Defenders Commander in Molotovka.

startText.en:
It's perfect that you are here. I have work for you! Very urgent. You should deliver a very important cargo to Molotovka. And you cannot use portal. Any magical influence will destroy bag's contents.
What is in this bag? I don't know... I know that Aidenus himself has signed it! You should act the following way. You'll take this bag and run to Ivan Ovsov, horseman. He is warned and is waiting for you. Talk to him and he will give special horse for this task. Climb on him and set on travel - to Siveria. There you should find Vlad Strezhnev, League Defenders Commander. You should give this bag to him. You have only one hour for everything. Hurry!
Is everything clear?

finishText.en:
Saddle up!
Lucky you - got the best horse!
I will give you a scroll allowing to summon it for a short time. Use it, then open your stables for summoning.

goal.en: Talk to the Stableman Ivan Ovsov to get the best Combat racing horse.

startText.en:
I know already! You need a combat racer to complete an important government task.
I'll help you.
Talk to me when you will be ready to go.

checkText.en: How are the alchemy lessons going?

finishText.en:
Have you learned anything new? Excellent! We are lucky we have the Aoidoi, right?
Have you managed to teach anyone? Or perhaps you've learned something yourself? Excellent! We are lucky we have the Aoidoi!

goal.en:
Find an Aoidos teacher, take part in a lesson and earn 2000 alchemy points. Or organize a lesson yourself.
Find students, give them a lesson and earn 2000 alchemy points. Or become a student yourself.

startText.en:
The Aoidoi by nature have a subtle knowledge of the world around them. It is manifested in their ability to transform one matter into another!

After all, they created their cities from stone literally with their mind! All matter easily submits to their will.

This makes them extremely good at alchemy. The famous alchemist Trismegistos astonished even the Great Mages! I suggest you take a couple of lessons, but you need to find a teacher first! Or maybe you know enough to teach it?
You Aoidoi by nature have a subtle knowledge of the world around you. It is manifested in your ability to transform one matter into another!

After all, you created your cities from stone literally with your mind! All matter easily submits to your will.

This makes you extremely good at alchemy. The famous alchemist Trismegistos astonished even the Great Mages! I suggest you give one such lesson to all people of Sarnaut! But first you need to find students! Or perhaps you'd like to become a student yourself?

checkText.en: So how are the poetry lessons going?

finishText.en:
Have you learned anything new? Excellent! We are lucky we have the Aoidoi, right?
Have you managed to teach anyone? Or perhaps you've learned something yourself? Excellent! We are lucky we have the Aoidoi!

goal.en:
Find an Aoidos teacher, take part in a lesson and earn 2000 poetry points. Or organize a lesson yourself.
Find students, give them a lesson and earn 2000 poetry points. Or become a student yourself.

startText.en:
The Aoidoi are born with extensive knowledge of history, and what is the best way to tell stories? Epic poems, of course! The Orphean school is particularly adept at this.

I'm sure that over time all our deeds - both yours and mine - will be sung by the Aoidoi!

During this week of the Dionysia, the Aoidoi can show other residents of Sarnaut the true power of art. I suggest you take a couple of lessons, but you need to find a teacher first! Or maybe you know enough to teach it?
You Aoidoi are born with extensive knowledge of history, and what is the best way to tell stories? Epic poems, of course! I know the Orphean school is particularly adept at this.

I'm sure that over time all our deeds - both yours and mine - will be sung by the Aoidoi!

During this week of the Dionysia, the Aoidoi can show other residents of Sarnaut the true power of art. I suggest you give one such lesson to all people of Sarnaut! But first you need to find students! Or perhaps you'd like to become a student yourself?

checkText.en: Just imagine - being the owner of an allod! I don't even have the words to describe what I feel when I see the birth of new land!

finishText.en: Excellent. Now we have enough meteorite iron to continue construction without running the risk of the Astral absorbing the results of our work!

goal.en: Get 20 meteorite fragments by completing quests given by Klim Pisarev and bring them to Axiniya Zemlemerova at the Novograd dock.

startText.en:
I have great news for you - at last our craftsmen have cracked the Master's technologies. We can now create hard soil out of the Astral!
But only the most distinguished adventurers, those who have earned the title of a Great Hero, will merit an allod of their own - such is Aidenus' decree. The process of creating matter is labor- and time-consuming, and there's one other problem... We can use astralium to create an allod - thanks to you we've mastered the Master's technologies fairly well. But how can we keep the new allod from being absorbed by the Astral? Clearly, you won't find a Great Mage for each new allod! Therefore, meteorite iron is our only option. And as you might've guessed, it doesn't grow on trees.
That's why Aidenus has ordered that meteorite fragments only be given to the heroes who prove themselves in trials. Sets of trials will be changed randomly every day, and you'll get a meteorite fragment for each one. Once you've collected 20 fragments, go see Axiniya Zemlemerova at the dock. She'll get the construction of the new allod started.

checkText.en: Just imagine - being the owner of an allod! I don't even have the words to describe what I feel when I see the birth of new land!

finishText.en: Excellent. Now we have enough meteorite iron to continue construction without running the risk of the Astral absorbing the results of our work!

goal.en: Check on the allod construction progress, get 30 meteorite fragments by completing quests given by Klim Pisarev and bring them to Axiniya Zemlemerova at the Novograd dock.

startText.en:
So, let's get started. To begin with, we need to form the core of the future allod. Its heart, so to say! This is a very important process. A slightest mistake can make the whole allod fall apart!

We will need 30 meteorite fragments, which can be obtained by completing Klim Pisarev's quests. Come back as soon as you obtain enough!

checkText.en: Just imagine - being the owner of an allod! I don't even have the words to describe what I feel when I see the birth of new land!

finishText.en: Very good! Now we can walk upon this lifeless land, which one day will become the best allod in Sarnaut!

goal.en: Check on the allod construction progress, get 40 meteorite fragments by completing quests given by Klim Pisarev and bring them to Axiniya Zemlemerova at the Novograd dock.

name.en: A Great Creation: So they created earth

startText.en:
We have completed the most important part. Now let's get down to more trivial tasks, like growing a block of ground on our gorgeous core. It's like building a sculpture at the Astral scale! Alright, I guess you don't need all the details.

We will need 40 meteorite fragments, which can be obtained by completing Klim Pisarev's quests. Come back as soon as you obtain enough!

checkText.en: Just imagine - being the owner of an allod! I don't even have the words to describe what I feel when I see the birth of new land!

finishText.en: A good choice! We'll see what we can do. Meanwhile, stay away from the construction site. It's way too dangerous right now.

goal.en: Check on the allod construction progress, get 55 meteorite fragments by completing quests given by Klim Pisarev and bring them to Axiniya Zemlemerova at the Novograd dock.

startText.en:
It is about time you took part in the construction of your allod. You need to choose what it will look like. Choose wisely!

We will need 55 meteorite fragments, which can be obtained by completing Klim Pisarev's quests. Come back as soon as you obtain enough!

checkText.en: Just imagine - being the owner of an allod! I don't even have the words to describe what I feel when I see the birth of new land!

finishText.en: Finally, the construction of your allod is complete! You can go to your allod and gaze upon it in all its splendor!

goal.en: Accept the work from Dobroslava Arshinova, get 70 meteorite fragments by completing quests given by Klim Pisarev and bring them to Axiniya Zemlemerova at the Novograd dock.

name.en: A Great Creation: The final stage

startText.en:
Now it is the time for the final stage. Your land has been raw and unstable for too long; it's time for it to become a full-scale allod! Look at what Dobroslava Arshinova has done - she's been working without cease!

We will need 70 meteorite shards, which you can obtain from Klim Pisarev by completing his quests. We will use them to reinforce and decorate the allod.

Come back as soon as you get them, and we will finish the construction!

checkText.en: To stand out from the rest, hard work is a must. And you're no exception. But believe me, your efforts will not be in vain.

finishText.en:
Well, then... Congratulations, hero! Now you can safely add "Great" to your list of titles!
Now, a bit about controlling dragon flame... Remember how I mentioned self-improvement every day, every hour? Your determination in receiving emblems and that truly superhuman willpower that you employed in order to carry out what was truly a tortuous task are all methods of self-improvement.
Now you must be sure that you are not going to settle for what you've already accomplished. The universe is full of secrets waiting to be discovered!

goal.en: Give Klim Pisarev 320 Emblems of Greatness and speak with Aidenus about achieving greatness.

startText.en:
Now that your veins throb with the blood of dragons, there is no going back. Only onward, to new knowledge and power! Every day, every moment must be spent in self-improvement. To stop is to die. The primordial flame that's in dragon blood will burn you up if it is unable to find outlet in battle or in the attainment of new knowledge.
But if you can tame the dragon flame that now burns within your heart, then you will become one of the League's greatest heroes, and your talents will open new frontiers for you. To subdue the astral and force it back will take more than a gulp of dragon blood, but in your particular field you will become great. Be you a great warrior, paladin or healer, the most important thing is that others see you as a role model, inspiring hope and service to the League. Believe me, this is worth a great deal, even without the Great Mages' talent for limiting the astral to certain spaces and opening portals with the wave of a hand.
However, power goes hand in hand with avarice and pride. So I must test you once again. The test will be difficult, but if you succeed, your efforts will be rewarded a hundredfold. All that I need from you are Emblems of Greatness. You will be assisted in this task by our bookkeeper, Klim Pisarev. Once you've collected the necessary amount, then we can talk about your promotion.

checkText.en: Any questions? Feel free to ask them!

finishText.en: I hope you'll heed my words. If you don't stop now, you will become a greatest hero of the League!

goal.en: Ask Klim Pisarev about Greatness.

startText.en:
Hello!
I've been watching you since you managed to survive the disaster and reveal the identity of the mysterious mage. And I'm placing big hopes on you. A great future lies ahead for you, provided you don't stray from the chosen path!
But don't get conceited! The path to glory and success is not easy. You will become a great hero of the League... Or not - that all depends on you. I will follow your every move, celebrate your victories and commiserate with your defeats. And these aren't just empty words! All your deeds, even the minor kind, will be recorded in the League chronicles. The Emblems of Greatness you'll get for truly outstanding achievements will come in handy later, when you become more experienced.
Talk to Klim Pisarev, our accountant, to find out more. Good luck!

checkText.en: Listen to me carefully and focus on what I say.

finishText.en: All clear? Good. Best of luck!

goal.en: Ask Klim Pisarev about exchanging amalgam.

startText.en:
Greetings, hero!
I want to tell you about one of the ways to get Emblems of Greatness.
Talk to me and I'll tell you everything in detail.

checkText.en: Listen to me carefully and focus on what I say.

finishText.en: All clear? Good. Best of luck!

goal.en: Question Klim Pisarev about the trials in Tka-Rik's Cave.

startText.en:
Greetings, hero!
I want to tell you about one of the ways to get Emblems of Greatness.
Talk to me and I'll tell you everything in detail.

checkText.en: Don't get distracted!

finishText.en: Is everything clear? Great.

goal.en: Question Klim Pisarev about exchanging staples for Emblems of Greatness.

name.en: Emblem of Greatness: staples for transformation

startText.en: Most likely, you will come across various staples in your travels. They will help you improve your equipment. Bear in mind that you can always exchange extra staples for Emblems of Greatness. I can tell you more if you wish.

finishText.en: Want to learn more about creating new allods? OK, I'll try to tell it to you in brief without going into technical details.

goal.en: Speak with Klim Pisarev, then meet Axiniya Zemlemerova in the Novograd port

startText.en:
Now that you're truly a Great Hero, you can create an allod of your own. This is a great honor that's only granted to the chosen ones!

Go see Axiniya Zemlemerova, the crew supervisor, who will guide through the creation of your allod. She's at the Novograd port. Axiniya will tell you all the particulars of allod creation. And visit the Bookkeeper on your way, he has something to tell you.

goal.en: Participate in battle on the Arena of Death and report to Klim Pisarev on completion.

name.en: The Creator's Trials: the Arena of Death

startText.en:
Have you heard of treasure chests on the Arena of Death? They contain some incredibly valuable items! Of course, you can't just come up to them and grab them. One has to fight the way to the desired reward!

Here's a trial for you. If you complete it, I'll reward you with a meteorite fragment. Participate in battle on the Arena of Death. Yes, it's not going to be easy - you'll have to fight other heroes. But think of the reward!

checkText.en: For each trial completed I will reward you with a meteorite fragment that will prevent your allod from dissolving in the Astral.

finishText.en: Well, the trial is complete. Here's your reward!

goal.en: Participate in Deserted Farm, Witch's Hollow, Training Camp, Battle for Cargallas battleground, or play Goblinball and report to Klim Pisarev on completion.

startText.en:
Here's a trial for you. If you complete it, I'll reward you with a meteorite fragment. Participate in battle in Witch's Hollow, Deserted Farm, Training Camp, or Battle for Cargallas. Ah, or play Goblinball - nothing can be compared to the bloody excitement of that game!

Yes, that's not going to be easy, since other heroes won't let you win just like that. But think of the emotions, of the fervor!

goal.en: Defeat 20 Demons, an Octulhu, or another ancient monster in the Mysterious Astral and return to Klim Pisarev.

startText.en:
The Astral is the natural habitat of Demons, and it makes them especially strong. But we are lucky to have our battle ships!

Here's a trial for you. If you complete it, I'll reward you with a meteorite fragment. Kill twenty Demons in the Mysterious Astral, or destroy an Octulhu or any other ancient monster in the Mysterious Astral. They can be found in the Agitated and Wild sectors.

goal.en: Destroy the strongest enemy at any island in the Mysterious Astral and report to Klim Pisarev.

startText.en:
I bet you have killed plenty of nasty and incredibly dangerous beasts. And you will kill even more! Remember that each destroyed monster brings you closer to Greatness.

Here's a trial for you. If you complete it, I'll reward you with a meteorite fragment. Go to any of the isles in the Mysterious Astral and destroy the toughest opponent on it.

goal.en: Complete the trials in Tka-Rik's Cave and report to Klavdia Kalugina.

startText.en:
That cave is a weird place. They say, anything can happen in there.

Here is how you can get yourself a meteorite fragment: complete the trial in Tka-Rik's Cave.

goal.en: Raise the War Banner and destroy 30 monsters in the Kingdom of Elements, then return to Klim Pisarev.

name.en: The Creator's Trials: The Kingdom of Elements

startText.en: Here's a trial for you. If you complete it, I'll reward you with a meteorite fragment. Destroy 30 monsters in the Kingdom of Elements. The objective may sound easy, but keep in mind that other players are hoping to get a meteorite fragment, too. To make it even more interesting, raise your War Banner while you fight monsters!

goal.en: Acquire 15 Desire Incarnates on the Cradle and report to Klim Pisarev on completion.

startText.en: The Cradle is a mysterious and dangerous place. There the true Greatness is born! Here is a trial for you - acquire 15 Desire Incarnates on the Cradle.

checkText.en: For each trial completed I will reward you with a meteorite fragment that will prevent your allod from dissolving in the Astral.

finishText.en: Well, the trial is complete. Here's your reward!

goal.en: Bring Lodestone from the Boutique to Klim Pisarev.

startText.en: You must be pretty tired of rambling around Sarnaut and killing enemies in the name of your homeland? My request won't take much of your time. Just bring me one Lodestone from the Boutique, and you will get your meteorite fragment.

goal.en: Earn 1 Silver Anniversary Coin and report to Klim Pisarev on completion.

startText.en: Greatness usually comes along with great riches, obtained with great difficulty. Here is a trial that will reward you with a meteorite fragment. Obtain one Silver Anniversary coin. This one's pretty easy, right?

goal.en: Help Radigost Ploughman fight rodents on Umoir and report to Klim Pisarev.

startText.en: Have you ever heard of Haregons? You obviously have! You know they are fierce critters. Handling them is a great feat! So, here is a trial for you that will reward you with a meteorite fragment. Help Radigost Ploughman on Umoir!

goal.en: Complete one of the Pledges to the Guild Master and report to Klim Pisarev.

name.en: The Creator's Trials: Help from the Guild

startText.en: Never forget those who walk by your side on the way to Greatness! Friends from your guild is the most valuable thing that you have. So here is a trial that will reward you with a meteorite fragment: complete one of the everyday quests from the Guild Master to help your allies!

goal.en: Complete one of the daily quests on Irdrich and report to Klim Pisarev.

startText.en: Though Irdrich is a dead land, Tep's presence has left its marks on it. We need to erase them completely! So here is a trial that will reward you with a meteorite fragment - complete any daily quest on Irdrich!

goal.en: Complete one of the daily quests in the Illusory World and report to Klim Pisarev.

startText.en:
The Illusory World, created by Tep, still exists, and it seems like it is here to stay. Its dangers can hardly be called illusory, and its inhabitants live their pretty real lives. A real life means real troubles. And those troubles require real interference. Your interference.

So here is a trial that will reward you with a meteorite fragment - complete any daily quest in the Illusory World.

goal.en: Complete one of the daily quests on the Wandering Island and report to Klim Pisarev.

startText.en: Your path to Greatness will bring you new allies as well as new enemies. On the Wandering Island, you should never forget who is on your side, and who is not, though it may be difficult. So here is a trial that will reward you with a meteorite fragment - complete any daily quest on the Wandering Island.

goal.en: Complete one of the daily quests on the Twilight Isle and report to Klim Pisarev.

startText.en:
Twilight Isle... A place where demons and cultists are hatching their evil plans! We need to do whatever it takes to stop them. Here is a trial that will reward you with a meteorite fragment - complete any daily quest on the Twilight Isle.

Keep in mind that you can only complete these quests in a specific time!

goal.en: Complete one of the daily quests on Kirah and report to Klim Pisarev.

startText.en:
Time has tied into a tight knot on Kirah! Untangling it will take great efforts. One's actions in the past can lead to serious consequences in the present... We need to help our allies. Who knows how this is going to end.

So here is a trial that will reward you with a meteorite fragment - complete any daily quest on Kirah.

goal.en: Watch the formation of your allod and report to Klim Pisarev.

startText.en:
I heard you were building your own allod? That's amazing! How is it going? You don't know? You better find out! One should keep an eye on those goblins!

Go and check on it right now, alright?

Here's a trial for you. If you complete it, I'll reward you with a meteorite fragment. Watch the formation of your allod! Only those who can fulfill their own will, make their dreams come true, and acquire their own allod deserve the right to be called the Great!

goal.en: Visit your allod, accept the work from Dobroslava Arshinova, and report to Klim Pisarev.

name.en: The Creator's Path: Accepting the work

startText.en: I heard you allod is almost done. You know that, too? Well, then accept my congratulations! Here is another trial - well, it's not really a trial, more of an invitation - go to your allod and accept the work from Dobroslava. Don't you wonder what it looks like? I will give you a meteorite fragment as an encouraging gift!

goal.en: Participate in the Chariot race on Dionic Archipelago, the race on Kirah or the marathon on the Wandering Isle and report to Klim Pisarev on completion.

name.en: The Creator's Trials: Marathon and Races

startText.en:
Don't you sometimes get bored, when you neither feel like resting nor saving the world? This is when you should try a different kind of entertainment! Like races on Dionic Archipelago or Kirah or marathon on the Wandering Island. Trust me, they are really exciting!

Here is a trial for you - participate in a race or a marathon, and I will reward you with a meteorite fragment. Heroes need their leisure, too!

goal.en: Find one of the lost in time on Kirah and report to Klim Pisarev.

name.en: The Creator's Trials: Lost in Time

startText.en:
Oh those daredevils! They wander around Kirah as if it were their home. Getting lost in time there is just as easy as getting lost in its deserts. We need to bring home those who have already got lost!

So, take up this trial - find one of the lost in time on Kirah, and I will reward you with a meteorite fragment!

goal.en: Help kill 5 players in the Kingdom of Elements or 15 players in Skirmishes and report to Klim Pisarev.

startText.en:
Those who achieve greatness, make great enemies, too. And your enemies are just countless! The Empire is our biggest threat at the moment. We should thin down their ranks, don't you think?

Help us put an end to several enemy lives in the Kingdom of Elements or in Skirmishes, and I will reward you with a meteorite fragment.

goal.en: Deliver messages to the Servants of the Light and report to Klim Pisarev.

name.en: The Creator's Trails: Servants of the Light

startText.en:
In these dark times, we have to keep our faith stronger than ever! Servants of the Light on most distant allods do their best to keep our warriors in high spirits. But who will encourage the Servants themselves? Poor girls spend years away from their homes, among gloomy and rude soldiers! They need to be cheered up, too.

So here is a trial that will reward you with a meteorite fragment - visit several Servants of the Light and cheer them up. This isn't that hard, is it?

goal.en: Complete one of the daily quests on Ferris and report to Klim Pisarev.

name.en: The Creator's Trials: Dangers of Ferris

startText.en: Ferris is full of mysteries and dangers. Here is your mission: help Surveyors on Ferris, whatever it is they want you to do. I will reward you with a Meteorite Fragment.

goal.en: Destroy the strongest enemy in any Distortion and report to Klim Pisarev.

startText.en:
Distortion is no place for the weak. When you get there, you will see images of the past - or what it could have been like. You will see all the possible variations of the past events! And you will be the one who decides which one will define the present. A decent challenge for those who pursue Greatness!

So here is your challenge: go to any Distortion and destroy the most dangerous enemy, and I will rewards you with a Meteorite Fragment!

checkText.en: Each completed trial will reward you with a meteorite shard, which will keep you allod from being devoured by the Astral.

finishText.en: Well, the trial is complete. Here's your reward!

goal.en: Complete any quest of the Dionic Games and report to Klim Pisarev.

startText.en: Complete any quest of the Dionic Games.

goal.en: Open a chest on the Melting Isle and report to Klim Pisarev on completion.

startText.en: Here's a trial for you. If you complete it, I'll reward you with a meteorite fragment. Earn a victory in the Deserted Farm. Yes, that's not going to be easy, since other heroes won't let you win just like that. And that's fair, for only the best of the best, the greatest of the Great will merit an allod of their own!

goal.en: Defeat one of the powerful enemies in Ancient Mound, Eclipse, "Gates" Project, Fractal, Winter Palace, Battle of Gods, Observatory or Secret Paths. Report to Klim Pisarev.

startText.en:
I am amazed at all the trials you've been through! The fact that you are still alive is not really surprising - the Gift of Tensess hasn't failed anyone on my memory - but I am wondering why do you always face dangers on your own?

There are battles that cannot be won single-handedly. You will need a squad of loyal allies, who will help you fight your greatest enemies!

Here is a trial that will reward with 7 precious meteorite fragments! Gather a party and defeat a power enemy in one of the dungeons.

checkText.en: I hope that you are a respectful apprentice and have a good relationship with your mentor. Otherwise the only reward you will get is the sympathy of demons.

finishText.en: You are progressing well, apprentice. You will not be disappointed with your reward! But your education is not over yet. Come to see me again!

goal.en: Use the Apprentice's Wand to summon the Spirit of Wisdom and defeat it.

name.en: Knowledge is Power: The First Lesson

startText.en: Slow to learn, easy to beat! Remember that, if you don't want to lose your head on the expanses of Sarnaut! In order for you to absorb that simple truth even better, I propose a little test for you, which you can only complete with the help of your mentor. Your reward for this test will be some amazing equipment! I will give you a magic wand. All you will have to do is wave it and an extremely strong spirit will appear before you, your test is to defeat it. Don't even think about trying to defeat it on your own - that would be impossible.
